namo namaḥ sarvasukhapradāya  33.23
namo namaḥ sarvadhanapradāya  33.23
namo namaḥ sarvamatipradāya  33.23
stutaḥ sa bhagavānevaṃ taijasaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ  |
uvāca vācā kalyāṇyā ko varo vaḥ pradīyatām  || 33.24 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
tavātitaijasaṃ rūpaṃ na kaścitsoḍhumutsahet |
sahanīyaṃ tadbhavatu hitāya jagataḥ prabho  || 33.25 ||
evamastviti so'pyuktvā bhagavānādikṛtprabhuḥ  |
lokānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ gharmavarṣahimapradaḥ  || 33.26 ||
tataḥ sāṃkhyāśca yogāśca ye cānye mokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ  |
dhyāyanti dhyāyino devaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ divākaram  || 33.27 ||
sarvalakṣaṇahīno'pi yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥ  |
sarvaṃ ca tarate pāpaṃ devamarkaṃ samāśritaḥ  || 33.28 ||
agnihotraṃ ca vedāśca yajñāśca bahudakṣiṇāḥ  |
bhānorbhaktinamaskāra kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm  || 33.29 ||
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam  |
pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ prapadyante divākaram  || 33.30 ||
śakrādyaiḥ saṃstutaṃ devaṃ ye namasyanti bhāskaram  |
sarvakilbiṣanirmuktāḥ sūryalokaṃ vrajanti te  || 33.31 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
cirātprabhṛti no brahmañśrotumicchā pravartate  |
nāmnāmaṣṭaśataṃ brūhi yattvayoktaṃ purā raveḥ  || 33.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
aṣṭottaraśataṃ nāmnāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama  |
bhāskarasya paraṃ guhyaṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ dvijāḥ  || 33.33 ||
oṃ sūryo'ryamā bhagastvaṣṭā pūṣārkaḥ savitā raviḥ  |
gabhastimānajaḥ kālo mṛtyurdhātā prabhākaraḥ  || 33.34 ||
pṛthivyāpaśca tejaśca khaṃ vāyuśca parāyaṇam  |
somo bṛhaspatiḥ śukro budho'ṅgāraka eva ca  || 33.35 ||
indro vivasvān dīptāṃśuḥ śuciḥ śauriḥ śanaiścaraḥ  |
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca skando vaiśravaṇo yamaḥ  || 33.36 ||
vaidyuto jāṭharaścāgniraindhanastejasāṃ patiḥ  |
dharmadhvajo vedakartā vedāṅgo vedavāhanaḥ  || 33.37 ||
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliḥ sarvāmarāśrayaḥ  |
kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrtāśca kṣapā yāmāstathā kṣaṇāḥ  || 33.38 ||
saṃvatsarakaro'śvatthaḥ kālacakro vibhāvasuḥ  |
puruṣaḥ śāśvato yogī vyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ  || 33.39 ||
kālādhyakṣaḥ prajādhyakṣo viśvakarmā tamonudaḥ  |
varuṇaḥ sāgaro'ṃśaśca jīmūto jivano'rihā  || 33.40 ||
bhūtāśrayo bhūtapatiḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ  |
sraṣṭā saṃvartako vahniḥ sarvasyādiralolupaḥ  || 33.41 ||
anantaḥ kapilo bhānuḥ kāmadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ  |
jayo viśālo varadaḥ sarvabhūtaniṣevitaḥ  || 33.42 ||
manaḥ suparṇo bhūtādiḥ śīghragaḥ prāṇadhāraṇaḥ  |
dhanvantarirdhūmaketurādidevo'diteḥ sutaḥ  || 33.43 ||
dvādaśātmā ravirdakṣaḥ pitā mātā pitāmahaḥ  |
svargadvāraṃ prajādvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ triviṣṭapam  || 33.44 ||
dehakartā praśāntātmā viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ  |
carācarātmā sūkṣmātmā maitreyaḥ karuṇānvitaḥ  || 33.45 ||
etadvai kīrtanīyasya sūryasyāmitatejasaḥ  |
nāmnāmaṣṭaśataṃ ramyaṃ mayā proktaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 33.46 ||
suragaṇapitṛyakṣasevitaṃ hy 33.47
asuraniśākarasiddhavanditam  33.47
varakanakahutāśanaprabhaṃ  33.47
praṇipatito'smi hitāya bhāskaram  33.47

labheta jātismaratāṃ naraḥ sa tu  33.48

vimucyate śokadavāgnisāgarāl 33.49
labheta kāmānmanasā yathepsitān  33.49
{brahmovāca̱ }
yo'sau sarvagato devastripurāristrilocanaḥ  |
umāpriyakaro rudraścandrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ  || 34.1 ||
vidrāvya vibudhān sarvān siddhavidyādharānṛṣīn  |
gandharvayakṣanāgāṃśca tathānyāṃśca samāgatān  || 34.2 ||
jaghāna pūrvaṃ dakṣasya yajato dharaṇītale  |
yajñaṃ samṛddhaṃ ratnāḍhyaṃ sarvasaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtam  || 34.3 ||
yasya pratāpasaṃtrastāḥ śakrādyāstridivaukasaḥ  |
śāntiṃ na lebhire viprāḥ kailāsaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ  || 34.4 ||
sa āste tatra varadaḥ śūlapāṇirvṛṣadhvajaḥ  |
pinākapāṇirbhagavān dakṣayajñavināśanaḥ  || 34.5 ||
mahādevo'kale deśe kṛttivāsā vṛṣadhvajaḥ  |
ekāmrake muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvakāmaprado haraḥ  || 34.6 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kimarthaṃ sa bhavo devaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ  |
jaghāna yajñaṃ dakṣasya devaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtam  || 34.7 ||
na hyalpaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra prabho manyāmahe vayam  |
śrotumicchāmahe brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 34.8 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
dakṣasyāsannaṣṭa kanyā yāścaivaṃ patisaṃgatāḥ  |
svebhyo gṛhebhyaścānīya tāḥ pitābhyarcayadgṛhe  || 34.9 ||
tatastvabhyarcitā viprā nyavasaṃstāḥ piturgṛhe  |
tāsāṃ jyeṣṭhā satī nāma patnī yā tryambakasya vai  || 34.10 ||
nājuhāvātmajāṃ tāṃ vai dakṣo rudramabhidviṣan  |
akarotsaṃnatiṃ dakṣe na ca kāṃcinmaheśvaraḥ  || 34.11 ||
jāmātā śvaśure tasmin svabhāvāttejasi sthitaḥ  |
tato jñātvā satī sarvāstāstu prāptāḥ piturgṛham  || 34.12 ||
jagāma sāpyanāhūtā satī tu svapiturgṛham  |
tābhyo hīnāṃ pitā cakre satyāḥ pūjāmasaṃmatām  |
tato'bravītsā pitaraṃ devī krodhasamākulā  || 34.13 ||
{satyuvāca̱ }
yavīyasībhyaḥ śreṣṭhāhaṃ kiṃ na pūjasi māṃ prabho  |
asatkṛtāmavasthāṃ yaḥ kṛtavānasi garhitām  |
ahaṃ jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā ca māṃ tvaṃ satkartumarhasi  || 34.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamukto'bravīdenāṃ dakṣaḥ saṃraktalocanaḥ  ||* 34.15 ||
{dakṣa uvāca̱ }
tvattaḥ śreṣṭhā variṣṭhāśca pūjyā bālāḥ sutā mama  |
tāsāṃ ye caiva bhartāraste me bahumatāḥ sati  || 34.16 ||
brahmiṣṭhāśca vratasthāśca mahāyogāḥ sudhārmikāḥ  |
guṇaiścaivādhikāḥ ślāghyāḥ sarve te tryambakātsati  || 34.17 ||
vasiṣṭho'triḥ pulastyaśca aṅgirāḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ  |
bhṛgurmarīciśca tathā śreṣṭhā jāmātaro mama  || 34.18 ||
taiścāpi spardhate śarvaḥ sarve te caiva taṃ prati  |
tena tvāṃ na bubhūṣāmi pratikūlo hi me bhavaḥ  || 34.19 ||
ityuktavāṃstadā dakṣaḥ saṃpramūḍhena cetasā  |
śāpārthamātmanaścaiva yenoktā vai maharṣayaḥ  |
tathoktā pitaraṃ sā vai kruddhā devī tamabravīt || 34.20 ||
{satyuvāca̱ }
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiryasmādaduṣṭāṃ māṃ vigarhasi  |
tasmāttyajāmyahaṃ dehamimaṃ tāta tavātmajam  || 34.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatastenāpamānena satī duḥkhādamarṣitā  |
abravīdvacanaṃ devī namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuve  || 34.22 ||
{satyuvāca̱ }
yenāhamapadehā vai punardehena bhāsvatā  |
tatrāpyahamasaṃmūḍhā saṃbhūtā dhārmikī punaḥ  |
gaccheyaṃ dharmapatnītvaṃ tryambakasyaiva dhīmataḥ  || 34.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatraivātha samāsīnā ruṣṭātmānaṃ samādadhe  |
dhārayāmāsa cāgneyīṃ dhāraṇāmātmanātmani  || 34.24 ||
tataḥ svātmānamutthāpya vāyunā samudīritaḥ  |
sarvāṅgebhyo viniḥsṛtya vahnirbhasma cakāra tām  || 34.25 ||
tadupaśrutya nidhanaṃ satyā devyāḥ sa śūladhṛk |
saṃvādaṃ ca tayorbuddhvā yāthātathyena śaṃkaraḥ  |
dakṣasya ca vināśāya cukopa bhagavān prabhuḥ  || 34.26 ||
{śrīśaṃkara uvāca̱ }
yasmādavamatā dakṣa sahasaivāgatā satī  |
praśastāścetarāḥ sarvāstvatsutā bhartṛbhiḥ saha  || 34.27 ||
tasmādvaivasvate prāpte punarete maharṣayaḥ  |
utpatsyanti dvitīye vai tava yajñe hyayonijāḥ  || 34.28 ||
hute vai brahmaṇaḥ sattre cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ  |
abhivyāhṛtya saptarṣīn dakṣaṃ so'bhyaśapatpunaḥ  || 34.29 ||
bhavitā mānuṣo rājā cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ  |
prācīnabarhiṣaḥ pautraḥ putraścāpi pracetasaḥ  || 34.30 ||
dakṣa ityeva nāmnā tvaṃ māriṣāyāṃ janiṣyasi  |
kanyāyāṃ śākhināṃ caiva prāpte vai cākṣuṣāntare  || 34.31 ||
ahaṃ tatrāpi te vighnamācariṣyāmi durmate  |
dharmakāmārthayukteṣu karmasviha punaḥ punaḥ  || 34.32 ||
tato vai vyāhṛto dakṣo rudraṃ so'bhyaśapatpunaḥ  ||* 34.33 ||
{dakṣa uvāca̱ }
yasmāttvaṃ matkṛte krūra ṛṣīn vyāhṛtavānasi  |
tasmātsārdhaṃ surairyajñe na tvāṃ yakṣyanti vai dvijāḥ  || 34.34 ||
kṛtvāhutiṃ tava krūra apaḥ spṛśanti karmasu  |
ihaiva vatsyase loke divaṃ hitvāyugakṣayāt |
tato devaistu te sārdhaṃ na tu pūjā bhaviṣyati  || 34.35 ||
{rudra uvāca̱ }
cāturvarṇyaṃ tu devānāṃ te cāpyekatra bhuñjate  |
na bhokṣye sahitastaistu tato bhokṣyāmyahaṃ pṛthak || 34.36 ||
sarveṣāṃ caiva lokānāmādirbhūrloka ucyate  |
tamahaṃ dhārayāmyekaḥ svecchayā na tavājñayā  || 34.37 ||
tasmin dhṛte sarvalokāḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti śāśvatāḥ  |
tasmādahaṃ vasāmīha satataṃ na tavājñayā  || 34.38 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato'bhivyāhṛto dakṣo rudreṇāmitatejasā  |
svāyaṃbhuvīṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā utpanno mānuṣeṣviha  || 34.39 ||
yadā gṛhapatirdakṣo yajñānāmīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ  |
samasteneha yajñena so'yajaddaivataiḥ saha  || 34.40 ||
atha devī satī yatte prāpte vaivasvate'ntare  |
menāyāṃ tāmumāṃ devīṃ janayāmāsa śailarāṭ || 34.41 ||
sā tu devī satī pūrvamāsītpaścādumābhavat |
sahavratā bhavasyaiṣā naitayā mucyate bhavaḥ  || 34.42 ||
yāvadicchati saṃsthānaṃ prabhurmanvantareṣviha  |
mārīcaṃ kaśyapaṃ devī yathāditiranuvratā  || 34.43 ||
sārdhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śrīstu maghavantaṃ śacī yathā  |
viṣṇuṃ kīrtiruṣā sūryaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ cāpyarundhatī  || 34.44 ||
naitāṃstu vijahatyetā bhartṝn devyaḥ kathaṃcana  |
evaṃ prācetaso dakṣo jajñe vai cākṣuṣe'ntare  || 34.45 ||
prācīnabarhiṣaḥ pautraḥ putraścāpi pracetasām  |
daśabhyastu pracetobhyo māriṣāyāṃ punarnṛpa  || 34.46 ||
jajñe rudrābhiśāpena dvitīyamiti naḥ śrutam  |
bhṛgvādayastu te sarve jajñire vai maharṣayaḥ  || 34.47 ||
ādye tretāyuge pūrvaṃ manorvaivasvatasya ha  |
devasya mahato yajñe vāruṇīṃ bibhratastanum  || 34.48 ||
ityeṣo'nuśayo hyāsīttayorjātyantare gataḥ  |
prajāpateśca dakṣasya tryambakasya ca dhīmataḥ  || 34.49 ||
tasmānnānuśayaḥ kāryo vareṣviha kadācana  |
jātyantaragatasyāpi bhāvitasya śubhāśubhaiḥ  |
jantorna bhūtaye khyātistanna kāryaṃ vijānatā  || 34.50 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kathaṃ roṣeṇa sā pūrvaṃ dakṣasya duhitā satī  |
tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjātā girirājagṛhe prabho  || 34.51 ||
dehāntare kathaṃ tasyāḥ pūrvadeho babhūva ha  |
bhavena saha saṃyogaḥ saṃvādaśca tayoḥ katham  || 34.52 ||
svayaṃvaraḥ kathaṃ vṛttastasminmahati janmani  |
vivāhaśca jagannātha sarvāścaryasamanvitaḥ  || 34.53 ||
tatsarvaṃ vistarādbrahman vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam  |
śrotumicchāmahe puṇyāṃ kathāṃ cātimanoharām  || 34.54 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm  |
umāśaṃkarayoḥ puṇyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām  || 34.55 ||
kadācitsvagṛhātprāptaṃ kaśyapaṃ dvipadāṃ varam  |
apṛcchaddhimavān vṛttaṃ loke khyātikaraṃ hitam  || 34.56 ||
kenākṣayāśca lokāḥ syuḥ khyātiśca paramā mune  |
tathaiva cārcanīyatvaṃ satsu tatkathayasva me  || 34.57 ||
{kaśyapa uvāca̱ }
apatyena mahābāho sarvametadavāpyate  |
mamākhyātirapatyena brahmaṇā ṛṣibhiḥ saha  || 34.58 ||
kiṃ na paśyasi śailendra yato māṃ paripṛcchasi  |
vartayiṣyāmi yaccāpi yathādṛṣṭaṃ purācala  || 34.59 ||
vārāṇasīmahaṃ gacchannapaśyaṃ saṃsthitaṃ divi  |
vimānaṃ sunavaṃ divyamanaupamyaṃ mahardhimat || 34.60 ||
tasyādhastādārtanādaṃ gartasthāne śṛṇomyaham  |
tamahaṃ tapasā jñātvā tatraivāntarhitaḥ sthitaḥ  || 34.61 ||
athāgāttatra śailendra vipro niyamavāñśuciḥ  |
tīrthābhiṣekapūtātmā pare tapasi saṃsthitaḥ  || 34.62 ||
atha sa vrajamānastu vyāghreṇābhīṣito dvijaḥ  |
viveśa taṃ tadā deśaṃ sa garto yatra bhūdhara  || 34.63 ||
gartāyāṃ vīraṇastambe lambamānāṃstadā munīn  |
apaśyadārto duḥkhārtāṃstānapṛcchacca sa dvijaḥ  || 34.64 ||
{dvija uvāca̱ }
ke yūyaṃ vīraṇastambe lambamānā hyadhomukhāḥ  |
duḥkhitāḥ kena mokṣaśca yuṣmākaṃ bhavitānaghāḥ  || 34.65 ||
{pitara ūcu̱ḥ }
vayaṃ te kṛtapuṇyasya pitaraḥ sapitāmahāḥ  |
prapitāmahāśca kliśyāmastava duṣṭena karmaṇā  || 34.66 ||
narako'yaṃ mahābhāga gartarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ  |
tvaṃ cāpi vīraṇastambastvayi lambāmahe vayam  || 34.67 ||
yāvattvaṃ jīvase vipra tāvadeva vayaṃ sthitāḥ  |
mṛte tvayi gamiṣyāmo narakaṃ pāpacetasaḥ  || 34.68 ||
yadi tvaṃ dārasaṃyogaṃ kṛtvāpatyaṃ guṇottaram  |
utpādayasi tenāsmānmucyema vayamenasaḥ  || 34.69 ||
nānyena tapasā putra tīrthānāṃ ca phalena ca  |
etatkuru mahābuddhe tārayasva pitṝn bhayāt || 34.70 ||
{kaśyapa uvāca̱ }
sa tatheti pratijñāya ārādhya vṛṣabhadhvajam  |
pitṝn gartātsamuddhṛtya gaṇapān pracakāra ha  || 34.71 ||
svayaṃ rudrasya dayitaḥ suveśo nāma nāmataḥ  |
saṃmato balavāṃścaiva rudrasya gaṇapo'bhavat || 34.72 ||
tasmātkṛtvā tapo ghoramapatyaṃ guṇavadbhṛśam  |
utpādayasva śailendra sutāṃ tvaṃ varavarṇinīm  || 34.73 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa evamuktvā ṛṣiṇā śailendro niyamasthitaḥ  |
tapaścakārāpyatulaṃ yena tuṣṭirabhūnmama  || 34.74 ||
tadā tamutpapātāhaṃ varado'smīti cābravam  |
brūhi tuṣṭo'smi śailendra tapasānena suvrata  || 34.75 ||
{himavānuvāca̱ }
bhagavan putramicchāmi guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtam  |
evaṃ varaṃ prayacchasva yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho  || 34.76 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā girirājasya bho dvijāḥ  |
tadā tasmai varaṃ cāhaṃ dattavānmanasepsitam  || 34.77 ||
kanyā bhavitrī śailendra tapasānena suvrata  |
yasyāḥ prabhāvātsarvatra kīrtimāpsyasi śobhanām  || 34.78 ||
arcitaḥ sarvadevānāṃ tīrthakoṭisamāvṛtaḥ  |
pāvanaścaiva puṇyena devānāmapi sarvataḥ  || 34.79 ||
jyeṣṭhā ca sā bhavitrī te anye cātra tataḥ śubhe  ||* 34.80 ||
so'pi kālena śailendro menāyāmudapādayat |
aparṇāmekaparṇāṃ ca tathā caivaikapāṭalām  || 34.81 ||
nyagrodhamekaparṇaṃ tu pāṭalaṃ caikapāṭalām  |
aśitvā tvekaparṇāṃ tu aniketastapo'carat || 34.82 ||
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ duścaraṃ devadānavaiḥ  |
āhāramekaparṇaṃ tu ekaparṇā samācarat || 34.83 ||
pāṭalena tathaikena vidadhe caikapāṭalā  |
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu āhāraṃ tāḥ pracakratuḥ  || 34.84 ||
aparṇā tu nirāhārā tāṃ mātā pratyabhāṣata  |
niṣedhayantī co meti mātṛsnehena duḥkhitā  || 34.85 ||
sā tathoktā tayā mātrā devī duścaracāriṇī  |
tenaiva nāmnā lokeṣu vikhyātā surapūjitā  || 34.86 ||
etattu trikumārīkaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam  |
etāsāṃ tapasāṃ vṛttaṃ yāvadbhūmirdhariṣyati  || 34.87 ||
tapaḥśarīrāstāḥ sarvāstisro yogaṃ samāśritāḥ  |
sarvāścaiva mahābhāgāstathā ca sthirayauvanāḥ  || 34.88 ||
tā lokamātaraścaiva brahmacāriṇya eva ca  |
anugṛhṇanti lokāṃśca tapasā svena sarvadā  || 34.89 ||
umā tāsāṃ variṣṭhā ca jyeṣṭhā ca varavarṇinī  |
mahāyogabalopetā mahādevamupasthitā  || 34.90 ||
dattakaścośanā tasya putraḥ sa bhṛgunandanaḥ  |
āsīttasyaikaparṇā tu devalaṃ suṣuve sutam  || 34.91 ||
yā tu tāsāṃ kumārīṇāṃ tṛtīyā hyekapāṭalā  |
putraṃ sā tamalarkasya jaigīṣavyamupasthitā  || 34.92 ||
tasyāśca śaṅkhalikhitau smṛtau putrāvayonijau  |
umā tu yā mayā tubhyaṃ kīrtitā varavarṇinī  || 34.93 ||
atha tasyāstapoyogāttrailokyamakhilaṃ tadā  |
pradhūpitamihālakṣya vacastāmahamabravam  || 34.94 ||
devi kiṃ tapasā lokāṃstāpayiṣyasi śobhane  |
tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ mā kṛtvā tadvināśaya  || 34.95 ||
tvaṃ hi dhārayase lokānimān sarvān svatejasā  |
brūhi kiṃ te jaganmātaḥ prārthitaṃ saṃpratīha naḥ  || 34.96 ||
{devyuvāca̱ }
yadarthaṃ tapaso hyasya caraṇaṃ me pitāmaha  |
tvameva tadvijānīṣe tataḥ pṛcchasi kiṃ punaḥ  || 34.97 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatastāmabravaṃ cāhaṃ yadarthaṃ tapyase śubhe  |
sa tvāṃ svayamupāgamya ihaiva varayiṣyati  || 34.98 ||
śarva eva patiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvalokeśvareśvaraḥ  |
vayaṃ sadaiva yasyeme vaśyā vai kiṃkarāḥ śubhe  || 34.99 ||
sa devadevaḥ parameśvaraḥ svayaṃ  34.100
svayaṃbhurāyāsyati devi te'ntikam  34.100
udārarūpo vikṛtādirūpaḥ  34.100
samānarūpo'pi na yasya kasyacit 34.100
maheśvaraḥ parvatalokavāsī  34.101
carācareśaḥ prathamo'prameyaḥ  34.101
vinendunā hīndrasamānavarcasā  34.101
vibhīṣaṇaṃ rūpamivāsthito yaḥ  34.101
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatastāmabruvan devāstadā gatvā tu sundarīm  |
devi śīghreṇa kālena dhūrjaṭirnīlalohitaḥ  || 35.1 ||
sa bhartā tava deveśo bhavitā mā tapaḥ kṛthāḥ  |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya devā viprā gireḥ sutām  || 35.2 ||
jagmuścādarśanaṃ tasyāḥ sā cāpi virarāma ha  |
sā devī sūktamityevamuktvā svasyāśrame śubhe  || 35.3 ||
dvāri jātamaśokaṃ ca samupāśritya cāsthitā  |
athāgāccandratilakastridaśārtiharo haraḥ  || 35.4 ||
vikṛtaṃ rūpamāsthāya hrasvo bāhuka eva ca  |
vibhagnanāsiko bhūtvā kubjaḥ keśāntapiṅgalaḥ  || 35.5 ||
uvāca vikṛtāsyaśca devi tvāṃ varayāmyaham  |
athomā yogasaṃsiddhā jñātvā śaṃkaramāgatam  || 35.6 ||
antarbhāvaviśuddhātmā kṛpānuṣṭhānalipsayā  |
tamuvācārghapādyābhyāṃ madhuparkeṇa caiva ha  || 35.7 ||
saṃpūjya sumanobhistaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇapriyā  ||* 35.8 ||
{devyuvāca̱ }
bhagavanna svatantrāhaṃ pitā me tvagraṇīrgṛhe  |
sa prabhurmama dāne vai kanyāhaṃ dvijapuṃgava  || 35.9 ||
gatvā yācasva pitaraṃ mama śailendramavyayam  |
sa ceddadāti māṃ vipra tubhyaṃ taducitaṃ mama  || 35.10 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ sa bhagavān devastathaiva vikṛtaḥ prabhuḥ  |
uvāca śailarājānaṃ sutāṃ me yaccha śailarāṭ || 35.11 ||
sa taṃ vikṛtarūpeṇa jñātvā rudramathāvyayam  |
bhītaḥ śāpācca vimanā idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 35.12 ||
{śailendra uvāca̱ }
bhagavannāvamanye'haṃ brāhmaṇān bhuvi devatāḥ  |
manīṣitaṃ tu yatpūrvaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate  || 35.13 ||
svayaṃvaro me duhiturbhavitā viprapūjitaḥ  |
varayedyaṃ svayaṃ tatra sa bhartāsyā bhaviṣyati  || 35.14 ||
tacchrutvā śailavacanaṃ bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ  |
devyāḥ samīpamāgatya idamāha mahāmanāḥ  || 35.15 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
devi pitrā tvanujñātaḥ svayaṃvara iti śrutiḥ  |
tatra tvaṃ varayitrī yaṃ sa te bhartā bhavediti  || 35.16 ||
tadāpṛcchya gamiṣyāmi durlabhāṃ tvāṃ varānane  |
rūpavantaṃ samutsṛjya vṛṇoṣyasadṛśaṃ katham  || 35.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tenoktā sā tadā tatra bhāvayantī tadīritam  |
bhāvaṃ ca rudranihitaṃ prasādaṃ manasastathā  || 35.18 ||
saṃprāpyovāca deveśaṃ mā te'bhūdbuddhiranyathā  |
ahaṃ tvāṃ varayiṣyāmi nādbhutaṃ tu kathaṃcana  || 35.19 ||
athavā te'sti saṃdeho mayi vipra kathaṃcana  |
ihaiva tvāṃ mahābhāga varayāmi manogatam  || 35.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
gṛhītvā stabakaṃ sā tu hastābhyāṃ tatra saṃsthitā  |
skandhe śaṃbhoḥ samādhāya devī prāha vṛto'si me  || 35.21 ||
tataḥ sa bhagavān devastayā devyā vṛtastadā  |
uvāca tamaśokaṃ vai vācā saṃjīvayanniva  || 35.22 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
yasmāttava supuṇyena stabakena vṛto'smyaham  |
tasmāttvaṃ jarayā tyaktastvamaraḥ saṃbhaviṣyasi  || 35.23 ||
kāmarūpī kāmapuṣpaḥ kāmado dayito mama  |
sarvābharaṇapuṣpāḍhyaḥ sarvapuṣpaphalopagaḥ  || 35.24 ||
sarvānnabhakṣakaścaiva amṛtasvāda eva ca  |
sarvagandhaśca devānāṃ bhaviṣyasi dṛḍhapriyaḥ  || 35.25 ||
nirbhayaḥ sarvalokeṣu bhaviṣyasi sunirvṛtaḥ  |
āśramaṃ vedamatyarthaṃ citrakūṭeti viśrutam  || 35.26 ||
yo hi yāsyati puṇyārthī so'śvamedhamavāpsyati  |
yastu tatra mṛtaścāpi brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati  || 35.27 ||
yaścātra niyamairyuktaḥ prāṇān samyakparityajet |
sa devyāstapasā yukto mahāgaṇapatirbhavet || 35.28 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tadā deva āpṛcchya himavatsutām  |
antardadhe jagatsraṣṭā sarvabhūtapa īśvaraḥ  || 35.29 ||
sāpi devī gate tasmin bhagavatyamitātmani  |
tata evonmukhī bhūtvā śilāyāṃ saṃbabhūva ha  || 35.30 ||
unmukhī sā bhave tasminmaheśe jagatāṃ prabhau  |
niśeva candrarahitā na babhau vimanāstadā  || 35.31 ||
atha śuśrāva śabdaṃ ca bālasyārtasya śailajā  |
sarasyudakasaṃpūrṇe samīpe cāśramasya ca  || 35.32 ||
sa kṛtvā bālarūpaṃ tu devadevaḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ  |
krīḍāhetoḥ saromadhye grāhagrasto'bhavattadā  || 35.33 ||
yogamāyāṃ samāsthāya prapañcodbhavakāraṇam  |
tadrūpaṃ saraso madhye kṛtvaivaṃ samabhāṣata  || 35.34 ||
{bāla uvāca̱ }
trātu māṃ kaścidityāha grāheṇa hṛtacetasam  |
dhikkaṣṭaṃ bāla evāhamaprāptārthamanorathaḥ  || 35.35 ||
prayāmi nidhanaṃ vaktre grāhasyāsya durātmanaḥ  |
śocāmi na svakaṃ dehaṃ grāhagrastaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ  || 35.36 ||
yathā śocāmi pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca tapasvinīm  |
grāhagṛhītaṃ māṃ śrutvā prāptaṃ nidhanamutsukau  || 35.37 ||
priyaputrāvekaputrau prāṇānnūnaṃ tyajiṣyataḥ  |
aho bata sukaṣṭaṃ vai yo'haṃ bālo'kṛtāśramaḥ  |
antargrāheṇa grastastu yāsyāmi nidhanaṃ kila  || 35.38 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvā tu devī taṃ nādaṃ viprasyārtasya śobhanā  |
utthāya prasthitā tatra yatra tiṣṭhatyasau dvijaḥ  || 35.39 ||
sāpaśyadinduvadanā bālakaṃ cārurūpiṇam  |
grāhasya mukhamāpannaṃ vepamānamavasthitam  || 35.40 ||
so'pi grāhavaraḥ śrīmān dṛṣṭvā devīmupāgatām  |
taṃ gṛhītvā drutaṃ yāto madhyaṃ sarasa eva hi  || 35.41 ||
sa kṛṣyamāṇastejasvī nādamārtaṃ tadākarot |
athāha devī duḥkhārtā bālaṃ dṛṣṭvā grahāvṛtam  || 35.42 ||
{pārvatyuvāca̱ }
grāharāja mahāsattva bālakaṃ hyekaputrakam  |
vimuñcemaṃ mahādaṃṣṭra kṣipraṃ bhīmaparākrama  || 35.43 ||
{grāha uvāca̱ }
yo devi divase ṣaṣṭhe prathamaṃ samupaiti mām  |
sa āhāro mama purā vihito lokakartṛbhiḥ  || 35.44 ||
so'yaṃ mama mahābhāge ṣaṣṭhe'hani girīndraje  |
brahmaṇā prerito nūnaṃ nainaṃ mokṣye kathaṃcana  || 35.45 ||
{devyuvāca̱ }
yanmayā himavacchṛṅge caritaṃ tapa uttamam  |
tena bālamimaṃ muñca grāharāja namo'stu te  || 35.46 ||
{grāha uvāca̱ }
mā vyayastapaso devi bhṛśaṃ bāle śubhānane  |
yadbravīmi kuru śreṣṭhe tathā mokṣamavāpsyati  || 35.47 ||
{devyuvāca̱ }
grāhādhipa vadasvāśu yatsatāmavigarhitam  |
tatkṛtaṃ nātra saṃdeho yato me brāhmaṇāḥ priyāḥ  || 35.48 ||
{grāha uvāca̱ }
yatkṛtaṃ vai tapaḥ kiṃcidbhavatyā svalpamuttamam  |
tatsarvaṃ me prayacchāśu tato mokṣamavāpsyati  || 35.49 ||
{devyuvāca̱ }
janmaprabhṛti yatpuṇyaṃ mahāgrāha kṛtaṃ mayā  |
tatte sarvaṃ mayā dattaṃ bālaṃ muñca mahāgraha  || 35.50 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
prajajvāla tato grāhastapasā tena bhūṣitaḥ  |
āditya iva madhyāhne durnirīkṣastadābhavat |
uvāca caivaṃ tuṣṭātmā devīṃ lokasya dhāriṇīm  || 35.51 ||
{grāha uvāca̱ }
devi kiṃ kṛtyametatte suniścitya mahāvrate  |
tapaso'pyarjanaṃ duḥkhaṃ tasya tyāgo na śasyate  || 35.52 ||
gṛhāṇa tapa eva tvaṃ bālaṃ cemaṃ sumadhyame  |
tuṣṭo'smi te viprabhaktyā varaṃ tasmāddadāmi te  |
sā tvevamuktā grāheṇa uvācedaṃ mahāvratā  || 35.53 ||
{devyuvāca̱ }
dehenāpi mayā grāha rakṣyo vipraḥ prayatnataḥ  |
tapaḥ punarmayā prāpyaṃ na prāpyo brāhmaṇaḥ punaḥ  || 35.54 ||
suniścitya mahāgrāha kṛtaṃ bālasya mokṣaṇam  |
na viprebhyastapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhā me brāhmaṇā matāḥ  || 35.55 ||
dattvā cāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi grāhendra vihitaṃ hi te  |
nahi kaścinnaro grāha pradattaṃ punarāharet || 35.56 ||
dattametanmayā tubhyaṃ nādadāni hi tatpunaḥ  |
tvayyeva ramatāmetadbālaścāyaṃ vimucyatām  || 35.57 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathoktastāṃ praśasyātha muktvā bālaṃ namasya ca  |
devīmādityāvabhāsastatraivāntaradhīyata  || 35.58 ||
bālo'pi sarasastīre mukto grāheṇa vai tadā  |
svapnalabdha ivārthaughastatraivāntaradhīyata  || 35.59 ||
tapaso'pacayaṃ matvā devī himagirīndrajā  |
bhūya eva tapaḥ kartumārebhe niyamasthitā  || 35.60 ||
kartukāmāṃ tapo bhūyo jñātvā tāṃ śaṃkaraḥ svayam  |
provāca vacanaṃ viprā mā kṛthāstapa ityuta  || 35.61 ||
mahyametattapo devi tvayā dattaṃ mahāvrate  |
tattenaivākṣayaṃ tubhyaṃ bhaviṣyati sahasradhā  || 35.62 ||
iti labdhvā varaṃ devī tapaso'kṣayamuttamam  |
svayaṃvaramudīkṣantī tasthau prītā mudā yutā  || 35.63 ||
idaṃ paṭhedyo hi naraḥ sadaiva  35.64
bālānubhāvācaraṇaṃ hi śaṃbhoḥ  35.64
sa dehabhedaṃ samavāpya pūto  35.64
bhavedgaṇeśastu kumāratulyaḥ  35.64
{brahmovāca̱ }
vistṛte himavatpṛṣṭhe vimānaśatasaṃkule  |
abhavatsa tu kālena śailaputryāḥ svayaṃvaraḥ  || 36.1 ||
atha parvatarājo'sau himavān dhyānakovidaḥ  |
duhiturdevadevena jñātvā tadabhimantritam  || 36.2 ||
jānannapi mahāśailaḥ samayārakṣaṇepsayā  |
svayaṃvaraṃ tato devyāḥ sarvalokeṣvaghoṣayat || 36.3 ||
devadānavasiddhānāṃ sarvalokanivāsinām  |
vṛṇuyātparameśānaṃ samakṣaṃ yadi me sutā  || 36.4 ||
tadeva sukṛtaṃ ślāghyaṃ mamābhyudayasaṃmatam  |
iti saṃcintya śailendraḥ kṛtvā hṛdi maheśvaram  || 36.5 ||
ābrahmakeṣu deveṣu devyāḥ śailendrasattamaḥ  |

{dadhīciruvāca̱ }
apūjyapūjane caiva pūjyānāṃ cāpyapūjane  |
naraḥ pāpamavāpnoti mahadvai nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 39.28 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tu viprarṣiḥ punardakṣamabhāṣata  ||* 39.29 ||
{dadhīciruvāca̱ }
pūjyaṃ ca paśubhartāraṃ kasmānnārcayase prabhum  || 39.30 ||
{dakṣa uvāca̱ }
santi me bahavo rudrāḥ śūlahastāḥ kapardinaḥ  |
ekādaśasthānagatā nānyaṃ vidmo maheśvaram  || 39.31 ||
{dadhīciruvāca̱ }
sarveṣāmekamantro'yaṃ mameśo na nimantritaḥ  |
yathāhaṃ śaṃkarādūrdhvaṃ nānyaṃ paśyāmi daivatam  |
tathā dakṣasya vipulo yajño'yaṃ na bhaviṣyati  || 39.32 ||
{dakṣa uvāca̱ }
{ dakṣa uvāca̱ }
viṣṇośca bhāgā vividhāḥ pradattās 39.33
tathā ca rudrebhya uta pradattāḥ  39.33
anye'pi devā nijabhāgayuktā  39.33
dadāmi bhāgaṃ na tu śaṃkarāya  39.33
{brahmovāca̱ }
gatāstu devatā jñātvā śailarājasutā tadā  |
uvāca vacanaṃ śarvaṃ devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim  || 39.34 ||
{umovāca̱ }
bhagavan kutra yāntyete devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ  |
brūhi tattvena tattvajña saṃśayo me mahānayam  || 39.35 ||
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
dakṣo nāma mahābhāge prajānāṃ patiruttamaḥ  |
hayamedhena yajate tatra yānti divaukasaḥ  || 39.36 ||
{devyuvāca̱ }
yajñametaṃ mahābhāga kimarthaṃ nānugacchasi  |
kena vā pratiṣedhena gamanaṃ te na vidyate  || 39.37 ||
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
suraireva mahābhāge sarvametadanuṣṭhitam  |
yajñeṣu mama sarveṣu na bhāga upakalpitaḥ  || 39.38 ||
pūrvāgatena gantavyaṃ mārgeṇa varavarṇini  |
na me surāḥ prayacchanti bhāgaṃ yajñasya dharmataḥ  || 39.39 ||
{umovāca̱ }
bhagavan sarvadeveṣu prabhāvābhyadhiko guṇaiḥ  |
ajeyaścāpyadhṛṣyaśca tejasā yaśasā śriyā  || 39.40 ||
anena tu mahābhāga pratiṣedhena bhāgataḥ  |
atīva duḥkhamāpannā vepathuśca mahānayam  || 39.41 ||
kiṃ nāma dānaṃ niyamaṃ tapo vā  39.42
kuryāmahaṃ yena patirmamādya  39.42
labheta bhāgaṃ bhagavānacintyo  39.42
yajñasya cendrādyamarairvicitram  39.42
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ bhagavān vicintya  39.43
patnīṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ kṣubhitāmuvāca  39.43
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
na vetsi māṃ devi kṛśodarāṅgi  39.43
kiṃ nāma yuktaṃ vacanaṃ tavedam  39.43
ahaṃ vijānāmi viśālanetre  39.44
dhyānena sarve ca vidanti santaḥ  39.44
tavādya mohena sahendradevā  39.44
lokatrayaṃ sarvamatho vinaṣṭam  39.44
māmadhvareśaṃ nitarāṃ stuvanti  39.45
rathaṃtaraṃ sāma gāyanti mahyam  39.45
māṃ brāhmaṇā brahmamantrairyajanti  39.45
mamādhvaryavaḥ kalpayante ca bhāgam  39.45
{devyuvāca̱ }
vikatthase prākṛtavatsarvastrījanasaṃsadi  |
stauṣi garvāyase cāpi svamātmānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  || 39.46 ||
{bhagavānuvāca̱ }
nātmānaṃ staumi deveśi yathā tvamanugacchasi  |
saṃsrakṣyāmi varārohe bhāgārthe varavarṇini  || 39.47 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā bhagavān patnīmumāṃ prāṇairapi priyām  |
so'sṛjadbhagavān vaktrādbhūtaṃ krodhāgnisaṃbhavam  || 39.48 ||
tamuvāca makhaṃ gaccha dakṣasya tvaṃ maheśvaraḥ  |
nāśayāśu kratuṃ tasya dakṣasya madanujñayā  || 39.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato rudraprayuktena siṃhaveṣeṇa līlayā  |
devyā manyukṛtaṃ jñātvā hato dakṣasya sa kratuḥ  || 39.50 ||
manyunā ca mahābhīmā bhadrakālī maheśvarī  |
ātmanaḥ karmasākṣitve tena sārdhaṃ sahānugā  || 39.51 ||
sa eṣa bhagavān krodhaḥ pretāvāsakṛtālayaḥ  |
vīrabhadreti vikhyāto devyā manyupramārjakaḥ  || 39.52 ||
so'sṛjadromakūpebhya ātmanaiva gaṇeśvarān  |
rudrānugān gaṇān raudrān rudravīryaparākramān  || 39.53 ||
rudrasyānucarāḥ sarve sarve rudraparākramāḥ  |
te nipetustatastūrṇaṃ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ  || 39.54 ||
tataḥ kilakilāśabda ākāśaṃ pūrayanniva  |
samabhūtsumahān viprāḥ sarvarudragaṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ  || 39.55 ||
tena śabdena mahatā trastāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ  |
parvatāśca vyaśīryanta cakampe ca vasuṃdharā  || 39.56 ||
marutaśca vavuḥ krūrāścukṣubhe varuṇālayaḥ  |
agnayo vai na dīpyante na cādīpyata bhāskaraḥ  || 39.57 ||
grahā naiva prakāśante nakṣatrāṇi na tārakāḥ  |
ṛṣayo na prabhāsante na devā na ca dānavāḥ  || 39.58 ||
evaṃ hi timirībhūte nirdahanti gaṇeśvarāḥ  |
prabhañjantyapare yūpān ghorānutpāṭayanti ca  || 39.59 ||
praṇadanti tathā cānye vikurvanti tathā pare  |
tvaritaṃ vai pradhāvanti vāyuvegā manojavāḥ  || 39.60 ||
cūrṇyante yajñapātrāṇi yajñasyāyatanāni ca  |
śīryamāṇānyadṛśyanta tārā iva nabhastalāt || 39.61 ||
divyānnapānabhakṣyāṇāṃ rāśayaḥ parvatopamāḥ  |
kṣīranadyastathā cānyā ghṛtapāyasakardamāḥ  || 39.62 ||
madhumaṇḍodakā divyāḥ khaṇḍaśarkaravālukāḥ  |
ṣaḍrasānnivahantyanyā guḍakulyā manoramāḥ  || 39.63 ||
uccāvacāni māṃsāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca  |
yāni kāni ca divyāni lehyacoṣyāṇi yāni ca  || 39.64 ||
bhuñjanti vividhairvaktrairvilumpanti kṣipanti ca  |
rudrakopā mahākopāḥ kālāgnisadṛśopamāḥ  || 39.65 ||
bhakṣayanto'tha śailābhā bhīṣayantaśca sarvataḥ  |
krīḍanti vividhākārāścikṣipuḥ surayoṣitaḥ  || 39.66 ||
evaṃ gaṇāśca tairyukto vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān  |
rudrakopaprayuktaśca sarvadevaiḥ surakṣitam  || 39.67 ||
taṃ yajñamadahacchīghraṃ bhadrakālyāḥ samīpataḥ  |
cakruranye tathā nādān sarvabhūtabhayaṃkarān  || 39.68 ||
chittvā śiro'nye yajñasya vyanadanta bhayaṃkaram  |
tataḥ śakrādayo devā dakṣaścaiva prajāpatiḥ  |
ūcuḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā kathyatāṃ ko bhavāniti  || 39.69 ||
{vīrabhadra uvāca̱ }
nāhaṃ devo na daityo vā na ca bhoktumihāgataḥ  |
naiva draṣṭuṃ ca devendrā na ca kautūhalānvitāḥ  || 39.70 ||
dakṣayajñavināśārthaṃ saṃprāpto'haṃ surottamāḥ  |
vīrabhadreti vikhyāto rudrakopādviniḥsṛtaḥ  || 39.71 ||
bhadrakālī ca vikhyātā devyāḥ krodhādvinirgatā  |
preṣitā devadevena yajñāntikamupāgatā  || 39.72 ||
śaraṇaṃ gaccha rājendra devadevamumāpatim  |
varaṃ krodho'pi devasya na varaḥ paricārakaiḥ  || 39.73 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
nikhātotpāṭitairyūpairapaviddhaistatastataḥ  |
utpatadbhiḥ patadbhiśca gṛdhrairāmiṣagṛdhnubhiḥ  || 39.74 ||
pakṣavātavinirdhūtaiḥ śivārutavināditaiḥ  |
sa tasya yajño nṛpaterbādhyamānastadā gaṇaiḥ  || 39.75 ||
āsthāya mṛgarūpaṃ vai khamevābhyapatattadā  |
taṃ tu yajñaṃ tathārūpaṃ gacchantamupalabhya saḥ  || 39.76 ||
dhanurādāya bāṇaṃ ca tadarthamagamatprabhuḥ  |
tatastasya gaṇeśasya krodhādamitatejasaḥ  || 39.77 ||
lalāṭātprasṛto ghoraḥ svedabindurbabhūva ha  |
tasmin patitamātre ca svedabindau tadā bhuvi  || 39.78 ||
prādurbhūto mahānagnirjvalatkālānalopamaḥ  |
tatrodapadyata tadā puruṣo dvijasattamāḥ  || 39.79 ||
hrasvo'timātro raktākṣo haricchmaśrurvibhīṣaṇaḥ  |
ūrdhvakeśo'tiromāṅgaḥ śoṇakarṇastathaiva ca  || 39.80 ||
karālakṛṣṇavarṇaśca raktavāsāstathaiva ca  |
taṃ yajñaṃ sa mahāsattvo'dahatkakṣamivānalaḥ  || 39.81 ||
devāśca pradrutāḥ sarve gatā bhītā diśo daśa  |
tena tasmin vicaratā vikrameṇa tadā tu vai  || 39.82 ||
pṛthivī vyacalatsarvā saptadvīpā samantataḥ  |
mahābhūte pravṛtte tu devalokabhayaṃkare  || 39.83 ||
tadā cāhaṃ mahādevamabravaṃ pratipūjayan  |
bhavate'pi surāḥ sarve bhāgaṃ dāsyanti vai prabho  || 39.84 ||
kriyatāṃ pratisaṃhāraḥ sarvadeveśvara tvayā  |
imāśca devatāḥ sarvā ṛṣayaśca sahasraśaḥ  || 39.85 ||
tava krodhānmahādeva na śāntimupalebhire  |
yaścaiṣa puruṣo jātaḥ svedajaste surarṣabha  || 39.86 ||
jvaro nāmaiṣa dharmajña lokeṣu pracariṣyati  |
ekībhūtasya na hyasya dhāraṇe tejasaḥ prabho  || 39.87 ||
samarthā sakalā pṛthvī bahudhā sṛjyatāmayam  |
ityuktaḥ sa mayā devo bhāge cāpi prakalpite  || 39.88 ||
bhagavānmāṃ tathetyāha devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk |
parāṃ ca prītimagamatsa svayaṃ ca pinākadhṛk || 39.89 ||
dakṣo'pi manasā devaṃ bhavaṃ śaraṇamanvagāt |
prāṇāpānau samārudhya cakṣuḥsthāne prayatnataḥ  || 39.90 ||
vidhārya sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ bahudṛṣṭiramitrajit |
smitaṃ kṛtvābravīdvākyaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te  || 39.91 ||
śrāvite ca mahākhyāne devānāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha  |
tamuvācāñjaliṃ kṛtvā dakṣo devaṃ prajāpatiḥ  |
bhītaḥ śaṅkitacittastu sabāṣpavadanekṣaṇaḥ  || 39.92 ||
{dakṣa uvāca̱ }
yadi prasanno bhagavān yadi vāhaṃ tava priyaḥ  |
yadi cāhamanugrāhyo yadi deyo varo mama  || 39.93 ||
yadbhakṣyaṃ bhakṣitaṃ pītaṃ trāsitaṃ yacca nāśitam  |
cūrṇīkṛtāpaviddhaṃ ca yajñasaṃbhāramīdṛśam  || 39.94 ||
dīrghakālena mahatā prayatnena ca saṃcitam  |
na ca mithyā bhavenmahyaṃ tvatprasādānmaheśvara  || 39.95 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathāstvityāha bhagavān bhaganetraharo haraḥ  |
dharmādhyakṣaṃ mahādevaṃ tryambakaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ  || 39.96 ||
jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatvā dakṣo labdhvā bhavādvaram  |
nāmnāṃ cāṣṭasahasreṇa stutavān vṛṣabhadhvajam  || 39.97 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā dakṣaḥ śaṃbhorvīryaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
prāñjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā saṃstotumupacakrame  || 40.1 ||
{dakṣa uvāca̱ }
namaste devadeveśa namaste'ndhakasūdana  |
devendra tvaṃ balaśreṣṭha devadānavapūjita  || 40.2 ||
sahasrākṣa virūpākṣa tryakṣa yakṣādhipapriya  |
sarvataḥpāṇipādastvaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ  || 40.3 ||
sarvataḥśrutimāṃlloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhasi  |
śaṅkukarṇo mahākarṇaḥ kumbhakarṇo'rṇavālayaḥ  || 40.4 ||
gajendrakarṇo gokarṇaḥ śatakarṇo namo'stu te  |
śatodaraḥ śatāvartaḥ śatajihvaḥ sanātanaḥ  || 40.5 ||
gāyanti tvāṃ gāyatriṇo arcayantyarkamarkiṇaḥ  |
devadānavagoptā ca brahmā ca tvaṃ śatakratuḥ  || 40.6 ||
mūrtimāṃstvaṃ mahāmūrtiḥ samudraḥ sarasāṃ nidhiḥ  |
tvayi sarvā devatā hi gāvo goṣṭha ivāsate  || 40.7 ||
tvattaḥ śarīre paśyāmi somamagnijaleśvaram  |
ādityamatha viṣṇuṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ sabṛhaspatim  || 40.8 ||
kriyā karaṇakārye ca kartā kāraṇameva ca  |
asacca sadasaccaiva tathaiva prabhavāvyayau  || 40.9 ||
namo bhavāya śarvāya rudrāya varadāya ca  |
paśūnāṃ pataye caiva namo'stvandhakaghātine  || 40.10 ||
trijaṭāya triśīrṣāya triśūlavaradhāriṇe  |
tryambakāya trinetrāya tripuraghnāya vai namaḥ  || 40.11 ||
namaścaṇḍāya muṇḍāya viśvacaṇḍadharāya ca  |
daṇḍine śaṅkukarṇāya daṇḍidaṇḍāya vai namaḥ  || 40.12 ||
namo'rdhadaṇḍikeśāya śuṣkāya vikṛtāya ca  |
vilohitāya dhūmrāya nīlagrīvāya vai namaḥ  || 40.13 ||
namo'stvapratirūpāya virūpāya śivāya ca  |
sūryāya sūryapataye sūryadhvajapatākine  || 40.14 ||
namaḥ pramathanāśāya vṛṣaskandhāya vai namaḥ  |
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya hiraṇyakavacāya ca  || 40.15 ||
hiraṇyakṛtacūḍāya hiraṇyapataye namaḥ  |
śatrughātāya caṇḍāya parṇasaṃghaśayāya ca  || 40.16 ||
namaḥ stutāya stutaye stūyamānāya vai namaḥ  |
sarvāya sarvabhakṣāya sarvabhūtāntarātmane  || 40.17 ||
namo homāya mantrāya śukladhvajapatākine  |
namo'namyāya namyāya namaḥ kilakilāya ca  || 40.18 ||
namastvāṃ śayamānāya śayitāyotthitāya ca  |
sthitāya dhāvamānāya kubjāya kuṭilāya ca  || 40.19 ||
namo nartanaśīlāya mukhavāditrakāriṇe  |
bādhāpahāya lubdhāya gītavāditrakāriṇe  || 40.20 ||
namo jyeṣṭhāya śreṣṭhāya balapramathanāya ca  |
ugrāya ca namo nityaṃ namaśca daśabāhave  || 40.21 ||
namaḥ kapālahastāya sitabhasmapriyāya ca  |
vibhīṣaṇāya bhīmāya bhīṣmavratadharāya ca  || 40.22 ||
nānāvikṛtavaktrāya khaḍgajihvogradaṃṣṭriṇe  |
pakṣamāsalavārdhāya tumbīvīṇāpriyāya ca  || 40.23 ||
aghoraghorarūpāya ghorāghoratarāya ca  |
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya namaḥ śāntatamāya ca  || 40.24 ||
namo buddhāya śuddhāya saṃvibhāgapriyāya ca  |
pavanāya pataṃgāya namaḥ sāṃkhyaparāya ca  || 40.25 ||
namaścaṇḍaikaghaṇṭāya ghaṇṭājalpāya ghaṇṭine  |
sahasraśataghaṇṭāya ghaṇṭāmālāpriyāya ca  || 40.26 ||
prāṇadaṇḍāya nityāya namaste lohitāya ca  |
hūṃhūṃkārāya rudrāya bhagākārapriyāya ca  || 40.27 ||
namo'pāravate nityaṃ girivṛkṣapriyāya ca  |
namo yajñādhipataye bhūtāya prasutāya ca  || 40.28 ||
yajñavāhāya dāntāya tapyāya ca bhagāya ca  |
namastaṭāya taṭyāya taṭinīpataye namaḥ  || 40.29 ||
annadāyānnapataye namastvannabhujāya ca  |
namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya sahasracaraṇāya ca  || 40.30 ||
sahasroddhataśūlāya sahasranayanāya ca  |
namo bālārkavarṇāya bālarūpadharāya ca  || 40.31 ||
namo bālārkarūpāya bālakrīḍanakāya ca  |
namaḥ śuddhāya buddhāya kṣobhaṇāya kṣayāya ca  || 40.32 ||
taraṃgāṅkitakeśāya muktakeśāya vai namaḥ  |
namaḥ ṣaṭkarmaniṣṭhāya trikarmaniyatāya ca  || 40.33 ||
varṇāśramāṇāṃ vidhivatpṛthagdharmapravartine  |
namaḥ śreṣṭhāya jyeṣṭhāya namaḥ kalakalāya ca  || 40.34 ||
śvetapiṅgalanetrāya kṛṣṇaraktekṣaṇāya ca  |
dharmakāmārthamokṣāya krathāya krathanāya ca  || 40.35 ||
sāṃkhyāya sāṃkhyamukhyāya yogādhipataye namaḥ  |
namo rathyādhirathyāya catuṣpathapathāya ca  || 40.36 ||
kṛṣṇājinottarīyāya vyālayajñopavītine  |
īśāna rudrasaṃghāta harikeśa namo'stu te  || 40.37 ||
tryambakāyāmbikānātha vyaktāvyakta namo'stu te  |
kālakāmadakāmaghna duṣṭodvṛttaniṣūdana  || 40.38 ||
sarvagarhita sarvaghna sadyojāta namo'stu te  |
unmādana śatāvarta gaṅgātoyārdramūrdhaja  || 40.39 ||
candrārdhasaṃyugāvarta meghāvarta namo'stu te  |
namo'nnadānakartre ca annadaprabhave namaḥ  || 40.40 ||
annabhoktre ca goptre ca tvameva pralayānala  |
jarāyujāṇḍajāścaiva svedajodbhijja eva ca  || 40.41 ||
tvameva devadeveśa bhūtagrāmaścaturvidhaḥ  |
carācarasya sraṣṭā tvaṃ pratihartā tvameva ca  || 40.42 ||
tvameva brahmā viśveśa apsu brahma vadanti te  |
sarvasya paramā yoniḥ sudhāṃśo jyotiṣāṃ nidhiḥ  || 40.43 ||
ṛksāmāni tathauṃkāramāhustvāṃ brahmavādinaḥ  |
hāyi hāyi hare hāyi huvāhāveti vāsakṛt || 40.44 ||
gāyanti tvāṃ suraśreṣṭhāḥ sāmagā brahmavādinaḥ  |
yajurmaya ṛṅmayaśca sāmātharvayutastathā  || 40.45 ||
paṭhyase brahmavidbhistvaṃ kalpopaniṣadāṃ gaṇaiḥ  |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā varṇāśramāśca ye  || 40.46 ||
tvamevāśramasaṃghāśca vidyutstanitameva ca  |
saṃvatsarastvamṛtavo māsā māsārdhameva ca  || 40.47 ||
kalā kāṣṭhā nimeṣāśca nakṣatrāṇi yugāni ca  |
vṛṣāṇāṃ kakudaṃ tvaṃ hi girīṇāṃ śikharāṇi ca  || 40.48 ||
siṃho mṛgāṇāṃ patayastakṣakānantabhoginām  |
kṣīrodo hyudadhīnāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ praṇavastathā  || 40.49 ||
vajraṃ praharaṇānāṃ ca vratānāṃ satyameva ca  |
tvamevecchā ca dveṣaśca rāgo mohaḥ śamaḥ kṣamā  || 40.50 ||
vyavasāyo dhṛtirlobhaḥ kāmakrodhau jayājayau  |
tvaṃ gadī tvaṃ śarī cāpī khaṭvāṅgī mudgarī tathā  || 40.51 ||
chettā bhettā prahartā ca netā mantāsi no mataḥ  |
daśalakṣaṇasaṃyukto dharmo'rthaḥ kāma eva ca  || 40.52 ||
induḥ samudraḥ saritaḥ palvalāni sarāṃsi ca  |

gūḍhavrataśca gūḍhaśca gūḍhavrataniṣevitaḥ  |

hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śakunirdhanado'rthapatirvirāṭ |

durdharo durvaśo nityo durdarpo vijayo jayaḥ  |

vṛṣāṅgarāmbho vṛṣabhastathā vṛṣabhalocanaḥ  |

yaḥ sahasrāṇyanekāni puṃsāmāvṛtya durdṛśām  |

{brahmovāca̱ }
stutvaivaṃ sa mahādevaṃ virarāma mahāmatiḥ  |

{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }

{brahmovāca̱ }

{śrīśiva uvāca̱ }
dakṣa duḥkhaṃ na kartavyaṃ yajñavidhvaṃsanaṃ prati  |

bhūyaśca tvaṃ varamimaṃ matto gṛhṇīṣva suvrata  |

aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya vai  |
prajāpate matprasādātphalabhāgī bhaviṣyasi  || 40.106 ||
vedān ṣaḍaṅgān budhyasva sāṃkhyayogāṃśca kṛtsnaśaḥ  |

abdairdvādaśabhiryuktaṃ gūḍhamaprajñaninditam  |

samāgataṃ vyavasitaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam  |
sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ ca mayā pāśupataṃ vratam  || 40.109 ||
utpāditaṃ dakṣa śubhaṃ sarvapāpavimocanam  |
asya cīrṇasya yatsamyakphalaṃ bhavati puṣkalam  |

{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tu deveśaḥ sapatnīkaḥ sahānugaḥ  |

avāpya ca tathā bhāgaṃ yathoktaṃ comayā bhavaḥ  |

śāntyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ śṛṇudhvamatha vai dvijāḥ  |

apāṃ tu nīlikāṃ vidyānnirmoko bhujageṣu ca  |

śṛṇuyādvā idaṃ nārī bhaktyātha bhavabhāvitā  |

śṛṇuyādvā idaṃ sarvaṃ kīrtayedvāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ  |

mṛtaśca gaṇasāyujyaṃ pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ  || 40.133 ||
vṛṣeṇa viniyuktena vimānena virājate  |
ābhūtasaṃplavasthāyī rudrasyānucaro bhavet || 40.134 ||

{lomaharṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
śrutvaivaṃ vai muniśreṣṭhāḥ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm  |

{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
brahmaproktāṃ kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śrutvā tu ṛṣipuṃgavāḥ  |

{ṛṣaya ūcu̱ḥ }
aho devasya māhātmyaṃ tvayā śaṃbhoḥ prakīrtitam  |

ekāmrakaṃ kṣetravaraṃ vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam  |

{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā lokanāthaścaturmukhaḥ  |

{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ  |

purāṭṭālakasaṃyuktaṃ rathibhiḥ samalaṃkṛtam  |

vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgaiśca kṣepaṇībhiralaṃkṛtam  || 41.18 ||
devatāyatanairdivyaiḥ prākārodyānamaṇḍitaiḥ  |

puruṣāstatra dṛśyante rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ  |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāḥ sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalāḥ  || 41.28 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca munisattamāḥ  |
svadharmaniratāstatra nivasanti sudhārmikāḥ  || 41.29 ||
anyāśca tatra tiṣṭhanti vāramukhyāḥ sulocanāḥ  |
ghṛtācīmenakātulyāstathā samatilottamāḥ  || 41.30 ||
urvaśīsadṛśāścaiva vipracittinibhāstathā  |

sarvāstāḥ priyavādinyaḥ sarvā vihasitānanāḥ  |

evaṃ paṇyastriyastatra nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ  |
nivasanti muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvastrīguṇagarvitāḥ  || 41.33 ||
prekṣaṇālāpakuśalāḥ sundaryaḥ priyadarśanāḥ  |
na rūpahīnā durvṛttā na paradrohakārikāḥ  || 41.34 ||
yāsāṃ kaṭākṣapātena mohaṃ gacchanti mānavāḥ  |
na tatra nirdhanāḥ santi na mūrkhā na paradviṣaḥ  || 41.35 ||
na rogiṇo na malinā na kadaryā na māyinaḥ  |
na rūpahīnā durvṛttā na paradrohakāriṇaḥ  || 41.36 ||
tiṣṭhanti mānavāstatra kṣetre jagati viśrute  |
sarvatra sukhasaṃcāraṃ sarvasattvasukhāvaham  || 41.37 ||
nānājanasamākīrṇaṃ sarvasasyasamanvitam  |
karṇikāraiśca panasaiścampakairnāgakesaraiḥ  || 41.38 ||
pāṭalāśokabakulaiḥ kapitthairbahulairdhavaiḥ  |
cūtanimbakadambaiśca tathānyaiḥ puṣpajātibhiḥ  || 41.39 ||
nīpakairdhavakhadirairlatābhiśca virājitam  |
śālaistālaistamālaiśca nārikelaiḥ śubhāñjanaiḥ  || 41.40 ||
arjunaiḥ samaparṇaiśca kovidāraiḥ sapippalaiḥ  |
lakucaiḥ saralairlodhrairhintālairdevadārubhiḥ  || 41.41 ||
palāśairmucukundaiśca pārijātaiḥ sakubjakaiḥ  |
kadalīvanakhaṇḍaiśca jambūpūgaphalaistathā  || 41.42 ||
ketakīkaravīraiśca atimuktaiśca kiṃśukaiḥ  |
mandārakundapuṣpaiśca tathānyaiḥ puṣpajātibhiḥ  || 41.43 ||
nānāpakṣirutaiḥ sevyairudyānairnandanopamaiḥ  |
phalabhārānatairvṛkṣaiḥ sarvartukusumotkaraiḥ  || 41.44 ||
cakoraiḥ śatapattraiśca bhṛṅgarājaiśca kokilaiḥ  |
kalaviṅkairmayūraiśca priyaputraiḥ śukaistathā  || 41.45 ||
jīvaṃjīvakahārītaiścātakairvanaveṣṭitaiḥ  |
nānāpakṣigaṇaiścānyaiḥ kūjadbhirmadhurasvaraiḥ  || 41.46 ||
dīrghikābhistaḍāgaiśca puṣkariṇībhiśca vāpibhiḥ  |
nānājalāśayaiścānyaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ  || 41.47 ||
kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiśca tathā nīlotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
kādambaiścakravākaiśca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ  || 41.48 ||
kāraṇḍavaiḥ plavairhaṃsaistathānyairjalacāribhiḥ  |
evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ puṣpairnānāvidhairvaraiḥ  || 41.49 ||
nānājalāśayaiḥ puṇyaiḥ śobhitaṃ tatsamantataḥ  |
āste tatra svayaṃ devaḥ kṛttivāsā vṛṣadhvajaḥ  || 41.50 ||
hitāya sarvalokasya bhuktimuktipradaḥ śivaḥ  |
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaśca sarāṃsi ca  || 41.51 ||
puṣkariṇyastaḍāgāni vāpyaḥ kūpāśca sāgarāḥ  |
tebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ samāhṛtya jalabindūn pṛthakpṛthak || 41.52 ||
sarvalokahitārthāya rudraḥ sarvasuraiḥ saha  |
tīrthaṃ bindusaro nāma tasmin kṣetre dvijottamāḥ  || 41.53 ||
cakāra ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ tena bindusaraḥ smṛtam  |
aṣṭamyāṃ bahule pakṣe mārgaśīrṣe dvijottamāḥ  || 41.54 ||
yastatra yātrāṃ kurute viṣuve vijitendriyaḥ  |
vidhivadbindusarasi snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ  || 41.55 ||
devānṛṣīnmanuṣyāṃśca pitṝn saṃtarpya vāgyataḥ  |
tilodakena vidhinā nāmagotravidhānavit || 41.56 ||
snātvaivaṃ vidhivattatra so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet |
grahoparāge viṣuve saṃkrāntyāmayane tathā  || 41.57 ||
yugādiṣu ṣaḍaśītyāṃ tathānyatra śubhe tithau  |
ye tatra dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ prayacchanti dhanādikam  || 41.58 ||
anyatīrthācchataguṇaṃ phalaṃ te prāpnuvanti vai  |
piṇḍaṃ ye saṃprayacchanti pitṛbhyaḥ sarasastaṭe  || 41.59 ||
pitṝṇāmakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ te kurvanti na saṃśayaḥ  |
tataḥ śaṃbhorgṛhaṃ gatvā vāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ  || 41.60 ||
praviśya pūjayeccharvaṃ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam  |
ghṛtakṣīrādibhiḥ snānaṃ kārayitvā bhavaṃ śuciḥ  || 41.61 ||
candanena sugandhena vilipya kuṅkumena ca  |
tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ candramaulimumāpatim  || 41.62 ||
puṣpairnānāvidhairmedhyairbilvārkakamalādibhiḥ  |
āgamoktena mantreṇa vedoktena ca śaṃkaram  || 41.63 ||
adīkṣitastu nāmnaiva mūlamantreṇa cārcayet |
evaṃ saṃpūjya taṃ devaṃ gandhapuṣpānurāgibhiḥ  || 41.64 ||
dhūpadīpaiśca naivedyairupahāraistathā stavaiḥ  |
daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiśca gītairvādyairmanoharaiḥ  || 41.65 ||
nṛtyajapyanamaskārairjayaśabdaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ  |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivaddevadevamumāpatim  || 41.66 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ  |
kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ  || 41.67 ||
sauvarṇena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā  |
upagīyamāno gandharvairapsarobhiralaṃkṛtaḥ  || 41.68 ||
uddyotayan diśaḥ sarvāḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati  |
bhuktvā tatra sukhaṃ viprā manasaḥ prītidāyakam  || 41.69 ||
tallokavāsibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  |
tatastasmādihāyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ puṇyasaṃkṣaye  || 41.70 ||
jāyate yogināṃ gehe caturvedī dvijottamāḥ  |
yogaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 41.71 ||
śayanotthāpane caiva saṃkrāntyāmayane tathā  |
aśokākhyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pavitrāropaṇe tathā  || 41.72 ||
ye ca paśyanti taṃ devaṃ kṛttivāsasamuttamam  |
vimānenārkavarṇena śivalokaṃ vrajanti te  || 41.73 ||
sarvakāle'pi taṃ devaṃ ye paśyanti sumedhasaḥ  |
te'pi pāpavinirmuktāḥ śivalokaṃ vrajanti vai  || 41.74 ||
devasya paścime pūrve dakṣiṇe cottare tathā  |
yojanadvitayaṃ sārdhaṃ kṣetraṃ tadbhuktimuktidam  || 41.75 ||
tasmin kṣetravare liṅgaṃ bhāskareśvarasaṃjñitam  |
paśyanti ye tu taṃ devaṃ snātvā kuṇḍe maheśvaram  || 41.76 ||
ādityenārcitaṃ pūrvaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam  |
sarvapāpavinirmuktā vimānavaramāsthitāḥ  || 41.77 ||
upagīyamānā gandharvaiḥ śivalokaṃ vrajanti te  |
tiṣṭhanti tatra muditāḥ kalpamekaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 41.78 ||
bhuktvā tu vipulān bhogāñśivaloke manoramān  |
puṇyakṣayādihāyātā jāyante pravare kule  || 41.79 ||
athavā yogināṃ gehe vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ  |
utpadyante dvijavarāḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ  || 41.80 ||
mokṣaśāstrārthakuśalāḥ sarvatra samabuddhayaḥ  |
yogaṃ śaṃbhorvaraṃ prāpya tato mokṣaṃ vrajanti te  || 41.81 ||
tasmin kṣetravare puṇye liṅgaṃ yaddṛśyate dvijāḥ  |
pūjyāpūjyaṃ ca sarvatra vane rathyāntare'pi vā  || 41.82 ||
catuṣpathe śmaśāne vā yatra kutra ca tiṣṭhati  |
dṛṣṭvā talliṅgamavyagraḥ śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ  || 41.83 ||
snāpayitvā tu taṃ bhaktyā gandhaiḥ puṣpairmanoharaiḥ  |
dhūpairdīpaiḥ sanaivedyairnamaskāraistathā stavaiḥ  || 41.84 ||
daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiśca nṛtyagītādibhistathā  |
saṃpūjyaivaṃ vidhānena śivalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ  || 41.85 ||
nārī vā dvijaśārdūlāḥ saṃpūjya śraddhayānvitā  |
pūrvoktaṃ phalamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 41.86 ||
kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ samagrānmunisattamāḥ  |
tasya kṣetravarasyātha ṛte devānmaheśvarāt || 41.87 ||
tasmin kṣetrottame gatvā śraddhayāśraddhayāpi vā  |
mādhavādiṣu māseṣu naro vā yadi vāṅganā  || 41.88 ||
yasmin yasmiṃstithau viprāḥ snātvā bindusarombhasi  |
paśyeddevaṃ virūpākṣaṃ devīṃ ca varadāṃ śivām  || 41.89 ||
gaṇaṃ caṇḍaṃ kārttikeyaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā  |
kalpadrumaṃ ca sāvitrīṃ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati  || 41.90 ||
snātvā ca kāpile tīrthe vidhivatpāpanāśane  |
prāpnotyabhimatān kāmāñśivalokaṃ sa gacchati  || 41.91 ||
yaḥ stambhyaṃ tatra vidhivatkaroti niyatendriyaḥ  |
kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchati  || 41.92 ||
ekāmrake śivakṣetre vārāṇasīsame śubhe  |
snānaṃ karoti yastatra mokṣaṃ sa labhate dhruvam  || 41.93 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
viraje virajā mātā brahmāṇī saṃpratiṣṭhitā  |
yasyāḥ saṃdarśanānmartyaḥ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam  || 42.1 ||
sakṛddṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ devīṃ bhaktyāpūjya praṇamya ca  |
naraḥ svavaṃśamuddhṛtya mama lokaṃ sa gacchati  || 42.2 ||
anyāśca tatra tiṣṭhanti viraje lokamātaraḥ  |
sarvapāpaharā devyo varadā bhaktivatsalāḥ  || 42.3 ||
āste vaitaraṇī tatra sarvapāpaharā nadī  |
yasyāṃ snātvā naraśreṣṭhaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 42.4 ||
āste svayaṃbhūstatraiva kroḍarūpī hariḥ svayam  |
dṛṣṭvā praṇamya taṃ bhaktyā paraṃ viṣṇuṃ vrajanti te  || 42.5 ||
kāpile gograhe some tīrthe cālābusaṃjñite  |
mṛtyuṃjaye kroḍatīrthe vāsuke siddhakeśvare  || 42.6 ||
tīrtheṣveteṣu matimān viraje saṃyatendriyaḥ  |
gatvāṣṭatīrthaṃ vidhivatsnātvā devān praṇamya ca  || 42.7 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto vimānavaramāsthitaḥ  |
upagīyamāno gandharvairmama loke mahīyate  || 42.8 ||
viraje yo mama kṣetre piṇḍadānaṃ karoti vai  |
sa karotyakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 42.9 ||
mama kṣetre muniśreṣṭhā viraje ye kalevaram  |
parityajanti puruṣāste mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti vai  || 42.10 ||
snātvā yaḥ sāgare martyo dṛṣṭvā ca kapilaṃ harim  |
paśyeddevīṃ ca vārāhīṃ sa yāti tridaśālayam  || 42.11 ||
santi cānyāni tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca  |
tatkāle tu muniśreṣṭhā veditavyāni tāni vai  || 42.12 ||
samudrasyottare tīre tasmin deśe dvijottamāḥ  |
āste guhyaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ pāpanāśanam  || 42.13 ||
sarvatra vālukākīrṇaṃ pavitraṃ sarvakāmadam  |
daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham  || 42.14 ||
aśokārjunapuṃnāgairbakulaiḥ saraladrumaiḥ  |
panasairnārikelaiśca śālaistālaiḥ kapitthakaiḥ  || 42.15 ||
campakaiḥ karṇikāraiśca cūtabilvaiḥ sapāṭalaiḥ  |
kadambaiḥ kovidāraiśca lakucairnāgakesaraiḥ  || 42.16 ||
prācīnāmalakairlodhrairnāraṅgairdhavakhādiraiḥ  |
sarjabhūrjāśvakarṇaiśca tamālairdevadārubhiḥ  || 42.17 ||
mandāraiḥ pārijātaiśca nyagrodhāgurucandanaiḥ  |
kharjūrāmrātakaiḥ siddhairmucukundaiḥ sakiṃśukaiḥ  || 42.18 ||
aśvatthaiḥ saptaparṇaiśca madhudhāraśubhāñjanaiḥ  |
śiṃśapāmalakairnīpairnimbatinduvibhītakaiḥ  || 42.19 ||
sarvartuphalagandhāḍhyaiḥ sarvartukusumojjvalaiḥ  |
manohlādakaraiḥ śubhrairnānāvihaganāditaiḥ  || 42.20 ||
śrotraramyaiḥ sumadhurairbalanirmadaneritaiḥ  |
manasaḥ prītijanakaiḥ śabdaiḥ khagamukheritaiḥ  || 42.21 ||
cakoraiḥ śatapattraiśca bhṛṅgarājaistathā śukaiḥ  |
kokilaiḥ kalaviṅkaiśca hārītairjīvajīvakaiḥ  || 42.22 ||
priyaputraiścātakaiśca tathānyairmadhurasvaraiḥ  |
śrotraramyaiḥ priyakaraiḥ kūjadbhiścārvadhiṣṭhitaiḥ  || 42.23 ||
ketakīvanakhaṇḍaiśca atimuktaiḥ sakubjakaiḥ  |
mālatīkundabāṇaiśca karavīraiḥ sitetaraiḥ  || 42.24 ||
jambīrakaruṇāṅkolairdāḍimairbījapūrakaiḥ  |
mātuluṅgaiḥ pūgaphalairhintālaiḥ kadalīvanaiḥ  || 42.25 ||
anyaiśca vividhairvṛkṣaiḥ puṣpaiścānyairmanoharaiḥ  |
latāvitānagulmaiśca vividhaiśca jalāśayaiḥ  || 42.26 ||
dīrghikābhistaḍāgaiśca puṣkariṇībhiśca vāpibhiḥ  |
nānājalāśayaiḥ puṇyaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ  || 42.27 ||
sarāṃsi ca manojñāni prasannasalilāni ca  |
kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiśca tathā nīlotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ  || 42.28 ||
kahlāraiḥ kamalaiścāpi ācitāni samantataḥ  |
kādambaiścakravākaiśca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ  || 42.29 ||
kāraṇḍavaiḥ plavairhaṃsaiḥ kūrmairmatsyaiśca madgubhiḥ  |
dātyūhasārasākīrṇaiḥ koyaṣṭibakaśobhitaiḥ  || 42.30 ||
etaiścānyaiśca kūjadbhiḥ samantājjalacāribhiḥ  |
khagairjalacaraiścānyaiḥ kusumaiśca jalodbhavaiḥ  || 42.31 ||
evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sthalajalodbhavaiḥ  |
brahmacārigṛhasthaiśca vānaprasthaiśca bhikṣubhiḥ  || 42.32 ||
svadharmaniratairvarṇaistathānyaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam  |
hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇaṃ naranārīsamākulam  || 42.33 ||
aśeṣavidyānilayaṃ sarvadharmaguṇākaram  |
evaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham  || 42.34 ||
āste tatra muniśreṣṭhā vikhyātaḥ puruṣottamaḥ  |
yāvadutkalamaryādā dikkrameṇa prakīrtitā  || 42.35 ||
tāvatkṛṣṇaprasādena deśaḥ puṇyatamo hi saḥ  |
yatra tiṣṭhati viśvātmā deśe sa puruṣottamaḥ  || 42.36 ||
jagadvyāpī jagannāthastatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  |
ahaṃ rudraśca śakraśca devāścāgnipurogamāḥ  || 42.37 ||
nivasāmo muniśreṣṭhāstasmin deśe sadā vayam  |
gandharvāpsarasaḥ sarvāḥ pitaro devamānuṣāḥ  || 42.38 ||
yakṣā vidyādharāḥ siddhā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ  |
ṛṣayo vālakhilyāśca kaśyapādyāḥ prajeśvarāḥ  || 42.39 ||
suparṇāḥ kiṃnarā nāgāstathānye svargavāsinaḥ  |
sāṅgāśca caturo vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca  || 42.40 ||
itihāsapurāṇāni yajñāśca varadakṣiṇāḥ  |
nadyaśca vividhāḥ puṇyāstīrthānyāyatanāni ca  || 42.41 ||
sāgarāśca tathā śailāstasmin deśe vyavasthitāḥ  |
evaṃ puṇyatame deśe devarṣipitṛsevite  || 42.42 ||
sarvopabhogasahite vāsaḥ kasya na rocate  |
śreṣṭhatvaṃ kasya deśasya kiṃ cānyadadhikaṃ tataḥ  || 42.43 ||
āste yatra svayaṃ devo muktidaḥ puruṣottamaḥ  |
dhanyāste vibudhaprakhyā ye vasantyutkale narāḥ  || 42.44 ||
tīrtharājajale snātvā paśyanti puruṣottamam  |
svarge vasanti te martyā na te yānti yamālaye  || 42.45 ||
ye vasantyutkale kṣetre puṇye śrīpuruṣottame  |
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ teṣāmutkalānāṃ sumedhasām  || 42.46 ||
ye paśyanti suraśreṣṭhaṃ prasannāyatalocanam  |
cārubhrūkeśamukuṭaṃ cārukarṇāvataṃsakam  || 42.47 ||
cārusmitaṃ cārudantaṃ cārukuṇḍalamaṇḍitam  |
sunāsaṃ sukapolaṃ ca sulalāṭaṃ sulakṣaṇam  || 42.48 ||
trailokyānandajananaṃ kṛṣṇasya mukhapaṅkajam  ||* 42.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
purā kṛtayuge viprāḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ  |
babhūva nṛpatiḥ śrīmānindradyumna iti śrutaḥ  || 43.1 ||
satyavādī śucirdakṣaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ  |
rūpavān subhagaḥ śūro dātā bhoktā priyaṃvadaḥ  || 43.2 ||
yaṣṭā samastayajñānāṃ brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ  |
dhanurvede ca vede ca śāstre ca nipuṇaḥ kṛtī  || 43.3 ||
vallabho naranārīṇāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā śaśī  |
āditya iva duṣprekṣyaḥ śatrusaṃghabhayaṃkaraḥ  || 43.4 ||
vaiṣṇavaḥ sattvasaṃpanno jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ  |
adhyetā yogasāṃkhyānāṃ mumukṣurdharmatatparaḥ  || 43.5 ||
evaṃ sa pālayan pṛthvīṃ rājā sarvaguṇākaraḥ  |
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā harerārādhanaṃ prati  || 43.6 ||
kathamārādhayiṣyāmi devadevaṃ janārdanam  |
kasmin kṣetre'thavā tīrthe nadītīre tathāśrame  || 43.7 ||
evaṃ cintāparaḥ so'tha nirīkṣya manasā mahīm  |
ālokya sarvatīrthāni kṣetrāṇyatha purāṇyapi  || 43.8 ||
tāni sarvāṇi saṃtyajya jagāmāyatanaṃ punaḥ  |
vikhyātaṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ puruṣottamam  || 43.9 ||
sa gatvā tatkṣetravaraṃ samṛddhabalavāhanaḥ  |
ayajaccāśvamedhena vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaḥ  || 43.10 ||
kārayitvā mahotsedhaṃ prāsādaṃ caiva viśrutam  |
tatra saṃkarṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ sthāpya vīryavān  || 43.11 ||
pañcatīrthaṃ ca vidhivatkṛtvā tatra mahīpatiḥ  |
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaṃ devatāprekṣaṇaṃ tathā  || 43.12 ||
bhaktyā cārādhya vidhivatpratyahaṃ puruṣottamam  |
prasādāddevadevasya tato mokṣamavāptavān  || 43.13 ||
mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  |
sāgare cendradyumnākhye snātvā mokṣaṃ labheddhruvam  || 43.14 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kasmātsa nṛpatiḥ pūrvamindradyumno jagatpatiḥ  |
jagāma paramaṃ kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ puruṣottamam  || 43.15 ||
gatvā tatra suraśreṣṭha kathaṃ sa nṛpasattamaḥ  |
vājimedhena vidhivadiṣṭavān puruṣottamam  || 43.16 ||
kathaṃ sa sarvaphalade kṣetre paramadurlabhe  |
prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa ceṣṭaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  || 43.17 ||
kathaṃ sa kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca prajāpate  |
nirmame rājaśārdūlaḥ kṣetraṃ rakṣitavān katham  || 43.18 ||
kathaṃ tatra mahīpālaḥ prāsāde bhuvanottame  |
sthāpayāmāsa matimān kṛṣṇādīṃstridaśārcitān  || 43.19 ||
etatsarvaṃ suraśreṣṭha vistareṇa yathātatham  |
vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa caritaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ  || 43.20 ||
na tṛptimadhigacchāmastava vākyāmṛtena vai  |
śrotumicchāmahe brahman paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 43.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sādhu sādhu dvijaśreṣṭhā yatpṛcchadhvaṃ purātanam  |
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham  || 43.22 ||
vakṣyāmi tasya caritaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ kṛte yuge  |
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ prayatāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ  || 43.23 ||
avantī nāma nagarī mālave bhuvi viśrutā  |
babhūva tasya nṛpateḥ pṛthivī kakudopamā  || 43.24 ||
hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇā dṛḍhaprākāratoraṇā  |
dṛḍhayantrārgaladvārā parikhābhiralaṃkṛtā  || 43.25 ||
nānāvaṇiksamākīrṇā nānābhāṇḍasuvikriyā  |
rathyāpaṇavatī ramyā suvibhaktacatuṣpathā  || 43.26 ||
gṛhagopurasaṃbādhā vīthībhiḥ samalaṃkṛtā  |
rājahaṃsanibhaiḥ śubhraiścitragrīvairmanoharaiḥ  || 43.27 ||
anekaśatasāhasraiḥ prāsādaiḥ samalaṃkṛtā  |
yajñotsavapramuditā gītavāditranisvanā  || 43.28 ||
nānāvarṇapatākābhirdhvajaiśca samalaṃkṛtā  |
hastyaśvarathasaṃkīrṇā padātigaṇasaṃkulā  || 43.29 ||
nānāyodhasamākīrṇā nānājanapadairyutā  |
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiścaiva dvijātibhiḥ  || 43.30 ||
samṛddhā sā muniśreṣṭhā vidvadbhiḥ samalaṃkṛtā  |
na tatra malināḥ santi na mūrkhā nāpi nirdhanāḥ  || 43.31 ||
na rogiṇo na hīnāṅgā na dyūtavyasanānvitāḥ  |
sadā hṛṣṭāḥ sumanaso dṛśyante puruṣāḥ striyaḥ  || 43.32 ||
krīḍanti sma divā rātrau hṛṣṭāstatra pṛthakpṛthak |
suveṣāḥ puruṣāstatra dṛśyante mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ  || 43.33 ||
surūpāḥ suguṇāścaiva divyālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ  |
kāmadevapratīkāśāḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ  || 43.34 ||
sukeśāḥ sukapolāśca sumukhāḥ śmaśrudhāriṇaḥ  |
jñātāraḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ bhettāraḥ śatruvāhinīm  || 43.35 ||
dātāraḥ sarvaratnānāṃ bhoktāraḥ sarvasaṃpadām  |
striyastatra muniśreṣṭhā dṛśyante sumanoharāḥ  || 43.36 ||
haṃsavāraṇagāminyaḥ praphullāmbhojalocanāḥ  |
sumadhyamāḥ sujaghanāḥ pīnonnatapayodharāḥ  || 43.37 ||
sukeśāścāruvadanāḥ sukapolāḥ sthirālakāḥ  |
hāvabhāvānatagrīvāḥ karṇābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ  || 43.38 ||
bimbauṣṭhyo rañjitamukhāstāmbūlena virājitāḥ  |
suvarṇābharaṇopetāḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ  || 43.39 ||
śyāmāvadātāḥ suśroṇyaḥ kāñcīnūpuranāditāḥ  |
divyamālyāmbaradharā divyagandhānulepanāḥ  || 43.40 ||
vidagdhāḥ subhagāḥ kāntāścārvaṅgyaḥ priyadarśanāḥ  |
rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyuktāḥ sarvāḥ prahasitānanāḥ  || 43.41 ||
krīḍantyaśca madonmattāḥ sabhāsu catvareṣu ca  |
gītavādyakathālāpai ramayantyaśca tāḥ striyaḥ  || 43.42 ||
vāramukhyāśca dṛśyante nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ  |
prekṣaṇālāpakuśalāḥ sarvayoṣidguṇānvitāḥ  || 43.43 ||
anyāśca tatra dṛśyante guṇācāryāḥ kulastriyaḥ  |
pativratāśca subhagā guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtāḥ  || 43.44 ||
vanaiścopavanaiḥ puṇyairudyānaiśca manoramaiḥ  |
devatāyatanairdivyairnānākusumaśobhitaiḥ  || 43.45 ||
śālaistālaistamālaiśca bakulairnāgakesaraiḥ  |
pippalaiḥ karṇikāraiśca candanāgurucampakaiḥ  || 43.46 ||
puṃnāgairnārikeraiśca panasaiḥ saraladrumaiḥ  |
nāraṅgairlakucairlodhraiḥ saptaparṇaiḥ śubhāñjanaiḥ  || 43.47 ||
cūtabilvakadambaiśca śiṃśapairdhavakhādiraiḥ  |
pāṭalāśokatagaraiḥ karavīraiḥ sitetaraiḥ  || 43.48 ||
pītārjunakabhallātaiḥ siddhairāmrātakaistathā  |
nyagrodhāśvatthakāśmaryaiḥ palāśairdevadārubhiḥ  || 43.49 ||
mandāraiḥ pārijātaiśca tintiḍīkavibhītakaiḥ  |
prācīnāmalakaiḥ plakṣairjambūśirīṣapādapaiḥ  || 43.50 ||
kāleyaiḥ kāñcanāraiśca madhujambīratindukaiḥ  |
kharjūrāgastyabakulaiḥ śākhoṭakaharītakaiḥ  || 43.51 ||
kaṅkolairmucukundaiśca hintālairbījapūrakaiḥ  |
ketakīvanakhaṇḍaiśca atimuktaiḥ sakubjakaiḥ  || 43.52 ||
mallikākundabāṇaiśca kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ  |
mātuluṅgaiḥ pūgaphalaiḥ karuṇaiḥ sindhuvārakaiḥ  || 43.53 ||
bahuvāraiḥ kovidārairbadaraiḥ sakarañjakaiḥ  |
anyaiśca vividhaiḥ puṣpa vṛkṣaiścānyairmanoharaiḥ  || 43.54 ||
latāgulmairvitānaiśca udyānairnandanopamaiḥ  |
sadā kusumagandhāḍhyaiḥ sadā phalabharānataiḥ  || 43.55 ||
nānāpakṣirutai ramyairnānāmṛgagaṇāvṛtaiḥ  |
cakoraiḥ śatapattraiśca bhṛṅgāraiḥ priyaputrakaiḥ  || 43.56 ||
kalaviṅkairmayūraiśca śukaiḥ kokilakaistathā  |
kapotaiḥ khañjarīṭaiśca śyenaiḥ pārāvataistathā  || 43.57 ||
khagaiścānyairbahuvidhaiḥ śrotraramyairmanoramaiḥ  |
saritaḥ puṣkariṇyaśca sarāṃsi subahūni ca  || 43.58 ||
anyairjalāśayaiḥ puṇyaiḥ kumudotpalamaṇḍitaiḥ  |
padmaiḥ sitetaraiḥ śubhraiḥ kahlāraiśca sugandhibhiḥ  || 43.59 ||
anyairbahuvidhaiḥ puṣpairjalajaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ  |
gandhāmodakarairdivyaiḥ sarvartukusumojjvalaiḥ  || 43.60 ||
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaiścakravākopaśobhitaiḥ  |
sārasaiśca balākaiśca kūrmairmatsyaiḥ sanakrakaiḥ  || 43.61 ||
jalapādaiḥ kadambaiśca plavaiśca jalakukkuṭaiḥ  |
khagairjalacaraiścānyairnānāravavibhūṣitaiḥ  || 43.62 ||
nānāvarṇaiḥ sadā hṛṣṭairañcitāni samantataḥ  |
evaṃ nānāvidhaiḥ puṣpairvividhaiśca jalāśayaiḥ  || 43.63 ||
vividhaiḥ pādapaiḥ puṇyairudyānairvividhaistathā  |
jalasthalacaraiścaiva vihagaiścārvadhiṣṭhitaiḥ  || 43.64 ||
devatāyatanairdivyaiḥ śobhitā sā mahāpurī  |
tatrāste bhagavān devastripurāristrilocanaḥ  || 43.65 ||
mahākāleti vikhyātaḥ sarvakāmapradaḥ śivaḥ  |
śivakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā vidhivatpāpanāśane  || 43.66 ||
devān pitṝnṛṣīṃścaiva saṃtarpya vidhivadbudhaḥ  |
gatvā śivālayaṃ paścātkṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam  || 43.67 ||
praviśya saṃyato bhūtvā dhautavāsā jitendriyaḥ  |
snānaiḥ puṣpaistathā gandhairdhūpairdīpaiśca bhaktitaḥ  || 43.68 ||
naivedyairupahāraiśca gītavādyaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ  |
daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiśca nṛtyaiḥ stotraiśca śaṃkaram  || 43.69 ||
saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā mahākālaṃ sakṛcchivam  |
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ  || 43.70 ||
pāpaiḥ sarvairvinirmukto vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ  |
āruhya tridivaṃ yāti yatra śaṃbhorniketanam  || 43.71 ||
divyarūpadharaḥ śrīmān divyālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ  |
bhuṅkte tatra varān bhogān yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  || 43.72 ||
śivaloke muniśreṣṭhā jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ  |
puṇyakṣayādihāyātaḥ pravare brāhmaṇe kule  || 43.73 ||
caturvedī bhavedvipraḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ  |
yogaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 43.74 ||
āste tatra nadī puṇyā śiprā nāmeti viśrutā  |
tasyāṃ snātastu vidhivatsaṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ  || 43.75 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto vimānavaramāsthitaḥ  |
bhuṅkte bahuvidhān bhogān svargaloke narottamaḥ  || 43.76 ||
āste tatraiva bhagavān devadevo janārdanaḥ  |
govindasvāmināmāsau bhuktimuktiprado hariḥ  || 43.77 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā muktimāpnoti trisaptakulasaṃyutaḥ  |
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā  || 43.78 ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhena kāmagenāsthireṇa ca  |
upagīyamāno gandharvairviṣṇuloke mahīyate  || 43.79 ||
bhuṅkte ca vividhān kāmānnirātaṅko gatajvaraḥ  |
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvatsurūpaḥ subhagaḥ sukhī  || 43.80 ||
kālenāgatya matimān brāhmaṇaḥ syānmahītale  |
pravare yogināṃ gehe vedaśāstrārthatattvavit || 43.81 ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt |
vikramasvāmināmānaṃ viṣṇuṃ tatraiva bho dvijāḥ  || 43.82 ||
dṛṣṭvā naro vā nārī vā phalaṃ pūrvoditaṃ labhet |
anye'pi tatra tiṣṭhanti devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ  || 43.83 ||
mātaraśca muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā tān vidhivadbhaktyā saṃpūjya praṇipatya ca  || 43.84 ||
sarvapāpavinirmukto naro yāti triviṣṭapam  |
evaṃ sā nagarī ramyā rājasiṃhena pālitā  || 43.85 ||
nityotsavapramuditā yathendrasyāmarāvatī  |
purāṣṭādaśasaṃyuktā suvistīrṇacatuṣpathā  || 43.86 ||
dhanurjyāghoṣaninadā siddhasaṃgamabhūṣitā  |
vidyāvadgaṇabhūyiṣṭhā vedanirghoṣanāditā  || 43.87 ||
itihāsapurāṇāni śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca  |
kāvyālāpakathāścaiva śrūyante'harniśaṃ dvijāḥ  || 43.88 ||
evaṃ mayā guṇāḍhyā sā taduyinī?? samudāhṛtā  |
yasyāṃ rājābhavatpūrvamindradyumno mahāmatiḥ  || 43.89 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasyāṃ sa nṛpatiḥ pūrvaṃ kurvan rājyamanuttamam  |
pālayāmāsa matimān prajāḥ putrānivaurasān  || 44.1 ||
satyavādī mahāprājñaḥ śūraḥ sarvaguṇākaraḥ  |
matimān dharmasaṃpannaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ  || 44.2 ||
satyavāñśīlavān dāntaḥ śrīmān parapuraṃjayaḥ  |
āditya iva tejobhī rūpairāśvinayoriva  || 44.3 ||
vardhamānasurāścaryaḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ  |
śāradendurivābhāti lakṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ  || 44.4 ||
āhartā sarvayajñānāṃ hayamedhādikṛttathā  |
dānairyajñaistapobhiśca tattulyo nāsti bhūpatiḥ  || 44.5 ||
suvarṇamaṇimuktānāṃ gajāśvānāṃ ca bhūpatiḥ  |
pradadau vipramukhyebhyo yāge yāge mahādhanam  || 44.6 ||
hastyaśvarathamukhyānāṃ kambalājinavāsasām  |
ratnānāṃ dhanadhānyānāmantastasya na vidyate  || 44.7 ||
evaṃ sarvadhanairyukto guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtaḥ  |
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā kurvan rājyamakaṇṭakam  || 44.8 ||
tasyeyaṃ matirutpannā sarvayogeśvaraṃ harim  |
kathamārādhayiṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ prabhum  || 44.9 ||
vicārya sarvaśāstrāṇi tantrāṇyāgamavistaram  |
itihāsapurāṇāni vedāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ  || 44.10 ||
dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi niyamānṛṣibhāṣitān  |
vedāṅgāni ca śāstrāṇi vidyāsthānāni yāni ca  || 44.11 ||
guruṃ saṃsevya yatnena brāhmaṇān vedapāragān  |
ādhāya paramāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ kṛtakṛtyo'bhavattadā  || 44.12 ||
saṃprāpya paramaṃ tattvaṃ vāsudevākhyamavyayam  |
bhrāntijñānādatītastu mumukṣuḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ  || 44.13 ||
kathamārādhayiṣyāmi devadevaṃ sanātanam  |
pītavastraṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam  || 44.14 ||
vanamālāvṛtoraskaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam  |
śrīvatsoraḥsamāyuktaṃ mukuṭāṅgadaśobhitam  || 44.15 ||
svapurātsa tu niṣkrānta ujjayinyāḥ prajāpatiḥ  |
balena mahatā yuktaḥ sabhṛtyaḥ sapurohitaḥ  || 44.16 ||
anujagmustu taṃ sarve rathinaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ  |
rathairvimānasaṃkāśaiḥ patākādhvajasevitaiḥ  || 44.17 ||
sādinaśca tathā sarve prāsatomarapāṇayaḥ  |
aśvaiḥ pavanasaṃkāśairanujagmustu taṃ nṛpam  || 44.18 ||
himavatsaṃbhavairmattairvāraṇaiḥ parvatopamaiḥ  |
īṣādantaiḥ sadā mattaiḥ pracaṇḍaiḥ ṣaṣṭihāyanaiḥ  || 44.19 ||
hemakakṣaiḥ sapatākairghaṇṭāravavibhūṣitaiḥ  |
anujagmuśca taṃ sarve gajayuddhaviśāradāḥ  || 44.20 ||
asaṃkhyeyāśca pādātā dhanuṣprāsāsipāṇayaḥ  |
divyamālyāmbaradharā divyagandhānulepanāḥ  || 44.21 ||
anujagmuśca taṃ sarve yuvāno mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ  |
sarvāstrakuśalāḥ śūrāḥ sadā saṃgrāmalālasāḥ  || 44.22 ||
antaḥpuranivāsinyaḥ striyaḥ sarvāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ  |
bimbauṣṭhacārudaśanāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ  || 44.23 ||
divyavastradharāḥ sarvā divyamālyavibhūṣitāḥ  |
divyagandhānuliptāṅgāḥ śaraccandranibhānanāḥ  || 44.24 ||
sumadhyamāścāruveṣāścārukarṇālakāñcitāḥ  |
tāmbūlarañjitamukhā rakṣibhiśca surakṣitāḥ  || 44.25 ||
yānairuccāvacaiḥ śubhrairmaṇikāñcanabhūṣitaiḥ  |
upagīyamānāstāḥ sarvā gāyanaiḥ stutipāṭhakaiḥ  || 44.26 ||
veṣṭitāḥ śastrahastaiśca padmapattrāyatekṣaṇāḥ  |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā anujagmuśca taṃ nṛpam  || 44.27 ||
vaṇiggrāmagaṇāḥ sarve nānāpuranivāsinaḥ  |
dhanai ratnaiḥ suvarṇaiśca sadārāḥ saparicchadāḥ  || 44.28 ||
astravikrayakāścaiva tāmbūlapaṇyajīvinaḥ  |
tṛṇavikrayakāścaiva kāṣṭhavikrayakārakāḥ  || 44.29 ||
raṅgopajīvinaḥ sarve māṃsavikrayiṇastathā  |
tailavikrayakāścaiva vastravikrayakāstathā  || 44.30 ||
phalavikrayiṇaścaiva pattravikrayiṇastathā  |
tathā javasahārāśca rajakāśca sahasraśaḥ  || 44.31 ||
gopālā nāpitāścaiva tathānye vastrasūcakāḥ  |
meṣapālāścājapālā mṛgapālāśca haṃsakāḥ  || 44.32 ||
dhānyavikrayiṇaścaiva saktuvikrayiṇaśca ye  |
guḍavikrayikāścaiva tathā lavaṇajīvinaḥ  || 44.33 ||
gāyanā nartakāścaiva tathā maṅgalapāṭhakāḥ  |
śailūṣāḥ kathakāścaiva purāṇārthaviśāradāḥ  || 44.34 ||
kavayaḥ kāvyakartāro nānākāvyaviśāradāḥ  |
viṣaghnā gāruḍāścaiva nānāratnaparīkṣakāḥ  || 44.35 ||
vyokārāstāmrakārāśca kāṃsyakārāśca rūṭhakāḥ  |
kauṣakārāścitrakārāḥ kundakārāśca pāvakāḥ  || 44.36 ||
daṇḍakārāścāsikārāḥ surādhūtopajīvinaḥ  |
mallā dūtāśca kāyasthā ye cānye karmakāriṇaḥ  || 44.37 ||
tantuvāyā rūpakārā vārtikāstailapāṭhakāḥ  |
lāvajīvāstaittirikā mṛgapakṣyupajīvinaḥ  || 44.38 ||
gajavaidyāśca vaidyāśca naravaidyāśca ye narāḥ  |
vṛkṣavaidyāśca govaidyā ye cānye chedadāhakāḥ  || 44.39 ||
ete nāgarakāḥ sarve ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ  |
anujagmustu rājānaṃ samastapuravāsinaḥ  || 44.40 ||
yathā vrajantaṃ pitaraṃ grāmāntaraṃ samutsukāḥ  |
anuyānti yathā putrāstathā taṃ te'pi nāgarāḥ  || 44.41 ||
evaṃ sa nṛpatiḥ śrīmān vṛtaḥ sarvairmahājanaiḥ  |
hastyaśvarathapādātairjagāma ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ  || 44.42 ||
evaṃ gatvā sa nṛpatirdakṣiṇasyodadhestaṭam  |
sarvaistairdīrghakālena balairanugataḥ prabhuḥ  || 44.43 ||
dadarśa sāgaraṃ ramyaṃ nṛtyantamiva ca sthitam  |
anekaśatasāhasrairūrmibhiśca samākulam  || 44.44 ||
nānāratnālayaṃ pūrṇaṃ nānāprāṇisamākulam  |
vīcītaraṅgabahulaṃ mahāścaryasamanvitam  || 44.45 ||
tīrtharājaṃ mahāśabdamapāraṃ subhayaṃkaram  |
meghavṛndapratīkāśamagādhaṃ makarālayam  || 44.46 ||
matsyaiḥ kūrmaiśca śaṅkhaiśca śuktikānakraśaṅkubhiḥ  |
śiṃśumāraiḥ karkaṭaiśca vṛtaṃ sarpairmahāviṣaiḥ  || 44.47 ||
lavaṇodaṃ hareḥ sthānaṃ śayanasya nadīpatim  |
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvavāñchāphalapradam  || 44.48 ||
anekāvartagambhīraṃ dānavānāṃ samāśrayam  |
amṛtasyāraṇiṃ divyaṃ devayonimapāṃ patim  || 44.49 ||
viśiṣṭaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prāṇināṃ jīvadhāraṇam  |
supavitraṃ pavitrāṇāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam  || 44.50 ||
tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthamavyayaṃ yādasāṃ patim  |
candravṛddhikṣayasyeva yasya mānaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  || 44.51 ||
abhedyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ devānāmamṛtālayam  |
utpattisthitisaṃhāra hetubhūtaṃ sanātanam  || 44.52 ||
upajīvyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ puṇyaṃ nadanadīpatim  |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭho vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ  || 44.53 ||
nivāsamakarottatra velāmasādya sāgarīm  |
puṇye manohare deśe sarvabhūmiguṇairyute  || 44.54 ||
vṛtaṃ śālaiḥ kadambaiśca puṃnāgaiḥ saraladrumaiḥ  |
panasairnārikelaiśca bakulairnāgakesaraiḥ  || 44.55 ||
tālaiḥ pippalaiḥ kharjūrairnāraṅgairbījapūrakaiḥ  |
śālairāmrātakairlodhrairbakulairbahuvārakaiḥ  || 44.56 ||
kapitthaiḥ karṇikāraiśca pāṭalāśokacampakaiḥ  |
dāḍimaiśca tamālaiśca pārijātaistathārjunaiḥ  || 44.57 ||
prācīnāmalakairbilvaiḥ priyaṅguvaṭakhādiraiḥ  |
iṅgudīsaptaparṇaiśca aśvatthāgastyajambukaiḥ  || 44.58 ||
madhukaiḥ karṇikāraiśca bahuvāraiḥ satindukaiḥ  |
palāśabadarairnīpaiḥ siddhanimbaśubhāñjanaiḥ  || 44.59 ||
vārakaiḥ kovidāraiśca bhallātāmalakaistathā  |
iti hintālakāṅkolaiḥ karañjaiḥ savibhītakaiḥ  || 44.60 ||
sasarjamadhukāśmaryaiḥ śālmalīdevadārubhiḥ  |
śākhoṭhakairnimbavaṭaiḥ kumbhīkauṣṭhaharītakaiḥ  || 44.61 ||
guggulaiścandanairvṛkṣaistathaivāgurupāṭalaiḥ  |
jambīrakaruṇairvṛkṣaistintiḍīraktacandanaiḥ  || 44.62 ||
evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaistathānyairbahupādapaiḥ  |
kalpadrumairnityaphalaiḥ sarvartukusumotkaraiḥ  || 44.63 ||
nānāpakṣirutairdivyairmattakokilanāditaiḥ  |
mayūravarasaṃghuṣṭaiḥ śukasārikasaṃkulaiḥ  || 44.64 ||
hārītairbhṛṅgarājaiśca cātakairbahuputrakaiḥ  |
jīvaṃjīvakakākolaiḥ kalaviṅkaiḥ kapotakaiḥ  || 44.65 ||
khagairnānāvidhaiścānyaiḥ śrotraramyairmanoharaiḥ  |
puṣpitāgreṣu vṛkṣeṣu kūjadbhiścārvadhiṣṭhitaiḥ  || 44.66 ||
ketakīvanakhaṇḍaiśca sadā puṣpadharaiḥ sitaiḥ  |
mallikākundakusumairyūthikātagaraistathā  || 44.67 ||
kuṭajairbāṇapuṣpaiśca atimuktaiḥ sakubjakaiḥ  |
mālatīkaravīraiśca tathā kadalakāñcanaiḥ  || 44.68 ||
anyairnānāvidhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugandhaiścārudarśanaiḥ  |
vanodyānopavanajairnānāvarṇaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ  || 44.69 ||
vidyādharagaṇākīrṇaiḥ siddhacāraṇasevitaiḥ  |
gandharvoragarakṣobhirbhūtāpsarasakiṃnaraiḥ  || 44.70 ||
muniyakṣagaṇākīrṇairnānāsattvaniṣevitaiḥ  |
mṛgaiḥ śākhāmṛgaiḥ siṃhairvarāhamahiṣākulaiḥ  || 44.71 ||
tathānyaiḥ kṛṣṇasārādyairmṛgaiḥ sarvatra śobhitaiḥ  |
śārdūlairdīptamātaṅgaistathānyairvanacāribhiḥ  || 44.72 ||
evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣairudyānairnandanopamaiḥ  |
latāgulmavitānaiśca vividhaiśca jalāśayaiḥ  || 44.73 ||
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaiḥ padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ  |
kādambaiśca plavairhaṃsaiścakravākopaśobhitaiḥ  || 44.74 ||
kamalaiḥ śatapattraiśca kahlāraiḥ kumudotpalaiḥ  |
khagairjalacaraiścānyaiḥ puṣpairjalasamudbhavaiḥ  || 44.75 ||
parvatairdīptaśikharaiścārukandaramaṇḍitaiḥ  |
nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇairnānādhātuvibhūṣitaiḥ  || 44.76 ||
sarvāścaryamayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ sarvabhūtālayaiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
sarvauṣadhisamāyuktairvipulaiścitrasānubhiḥ  || 44.77 ||
evaṃ sarvaiḥ samuditaiḥ śobhitaṃ sumanoharaiḥ  |
dadarśa sa mahīpālaḥ sthānaṃ trailokyapūjitam  || 44.78 ||
daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ pañcayojanamāyatam  |
nānāścaryasamāyuktaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham  || 44.79 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
tasmin kṣetravare puṇye vaiṣṇave puruṣottame  |
kiṃ tatra pratimā pūrvaṃ na sthitā vaiṣṇavī prabho  || 45.1 ||
yenāsau nṛpatistatra gatvā sabalavāhanaḥ  |
sthāpayāmāsa kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ śubhapradām  || 45.2 ||
saṃśayo no mahānatra vismayaśca jagatpate  |
śrotumicchāmahe sarvaṃ brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ ca naḥ  || 45.3 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ pūrvasaṃvṛttāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm  |
pravakṣyāmi samāsena śriyā pṛṣṭaḥ purā hariḥ  || 45.4 ||
sumeroḥ kāñcane śṛṅge sarvāścaryasamanvite  |
siddhavidyādharairyakṣaiḥ kiṃnarairupaśobhite  || 45.5 ||
devadānavagandharvairnāgairapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ  |
munibhirguhyakaiḥ siddhaiḥ sauparṇaiḥ samarudgaṇaiḥ  || 45.6 ||
anyairdevālayaiḥ sādhyaiḥ kaśyapādyaiḥ prajeśvaraiḥ  |
vālakhilyādibhiścaiva śobhite sumanohare  || 45.7 ||
karṇikāravanairdivyaiḥ sarvartukusumotkaraiḥ  |
jātarūpapratīkāśairbhūṣite sūryasaṃnibhaiḥ  || 45.8 ||
anyaiśca bahubhirvṛkṣaiḥ śālatālādibhirvanaiḥ  |
puṃnāgāśokasarala nyagrodhāmrātakārjunaiḥ  || 45.9 ||
pārijātāmrakhadira nīpabilvakadambakaiḥ  |
dhavakhādirapālāśa śīrṣāmalakatindukaiḥ  || 45.10 ||
nāriṅgakolabakula lodhradāḍimadārukaiḥ  |
sarjaiśca karṇaistagaraiḥ śiśibhūrjavanimbakaiḥ  || 45.11 ||
anyaiśca kāñcanaiścaiva phalabhāraiśca nāmitaiḥ  |
nānākusumagandhāḍhyairbhūṣite puṣpapādapaiḥ  || 45.12 ||
mālatīyūthikāmallī kundabāṇakuruṇṭakaiḥ  |
pāṭalāgastyakuṭaja mandārakusumādibhiḥ  || 45.13 ||
anyaiśca vividhaiḥ puṣpairmanasaḥ prītidāyakaiḥ  |
nānāvihagasaṃghaiśca kūjadbhirmadhurasvaraiḥ  || 45.14 ||
puṃskokilarutairdivyairmattabarhiṇanāditaiḥ  |
evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ puṣpairnānāvidhaistathā  || 45.15 ||
khagairnānāvidhaiścaiva śobhite surasevite  |
tatra sthitaṃ jagannāthaṃ jagatsraṣṭāramavyayam  || 45.16 ||
sarvalokavidhātāraṃ vāsudevākhyamavyayam  |
praṇamya śirasā devī lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  |
papracchemaṃ mahāpraśnaṃ padmajā tamanuttamam  || 45.17 ||
{śrīruvāca̱ }
brūhi tvaṃ sarvalokeśa saṃśayaṃ me hṛdi sthitam  |

lobhamohagrahagraste kāmakrodhamahārṇave  |
yena mucyeta deveśa asmātsaṃsārasāgarāt || 45.19 ||
ācakṣva sarvadeveśa praṇatāṃ yadi manyase  |
tvadṛte nāsti loke'smin vaktā saṃśayanirṇaye  || 45.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasyā devadevo janārdanaḥ  |
provāca parayā prītyā paraṃ sārāmṛtopamam  || 45.21 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
sukhopāsyaḥ susādhyaśca'bhirāmaśca susatphalaḥ  |
āste tīrthavare devi vikhyātaḥ puruṣottamaḥ  || 45.22 ||
na tena sadṛśaḥ kaścittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate  |
kīrtanādyasya deveśi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ  || 45.23 ||
na vijñāto'maraiḥ sarvairna daityairna ca dānavaiḥ  |
marīcyādyairmunivarairgopitaṃ me varānane  || 45.24 ||
tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tīrtharājaṃ ca sāṃpratam  |
bhāvenaikena suśroṇi śṛṇuṣva varavarṇini  || 45.25 ||
āsītkalpe samutpanne naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame  |
pralīnā devagandharva daityavidyādharoragāḥ  || 45.26 ||
tamobhūtamidaṃ sarvaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana  |
tasmiñjāgarti bhūtātmā paramātmā jagadguruḥ  || 45.27 ||
śrīmāṃstrimūrtikṛddevo jagatkartā maheśvaraḥ  |
vāsudeveti vikhyāto yogātmā harirīśvaraḥ  || 45.28 ||
so'sṛjadyoganidrānte nābhyambhoruhamadhyagam  |
padmakeśarasaṃkāśaṃ brahmāṇaṃ bhūtamavyayam  || 45.29 ||
tādṛgbhūtastato brahmā sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ  |
pañcabhūtasamāyuktaṃ sṛjate ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ  || 45.30 ||
mātrāyonīni bhūtāni sthūlasūkṣmāṇi yāni ca  |
caturvidhāni sarvāṇi sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca  || 45.31 ||
tataḥ prajāpatirbrahmā cakre sarvaṃ carācaram  |
saṃcintya manasātmānaṃ sasarja vividhāḥ prajāḥ  || 45.32 ||
marīcyādīnmunīn sarvān devāsurapitṝnapi  |
yakṣavidyādharāṃścānyān gaṅgādyāḥ saritastathā  || 45.33 ||
naravānarasiṃhāṃśca vividhāṃśca vihaṃgamān  |
jarāyūnaṇḍajān devi svedajodbhedajāṃstathā  || 45.34 ||
brahma kṣatraṃ tathā vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ caiva catuṣṭayam  |
antyajātāṃśca mlecchāṃśca sasarja vividhān pṛthak || 45.35 ||
yatkiṃcijjīvasaṃjñaṃ tu tṛṇagulmapipīlikam  |
brahmā bhūtvā jagatsarvaṃ nirmame sa carācaram  || 45.36 ||
dakṣiṇāṅge tathātmānaṃ saṃcintya puruṣaṃ svayam  |
vāme caiva tu nārīṃ sa dvidhā bhūtamakalpayat || 45.37 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti loke'smin prajā maithunasaṃbhavāḥ  |
adhamottamamadhyāśca mama kṣetrāṇi yāni ca  || 45.38 ||
evaṃ saṃcintya devo'sau purā salilayonijaḥ  |
jagāma dhyānamāsthāya vāsudevātmikāṃ tanum  || 45.39 ||
dhyānamātreṇa devena svayameva janārdanaḥ  |
tasmin kṣaṇe samutpannaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt || 45.40 ||
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ  |
saliladhvāntameghābhaḥ śrīmāñśrīvatsalakṣaṇaḥ  || 45.41 ||
apaśyatsahasā taṃ tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ  |
āsanairarghyapādyaiśca akṣatairabhinandya ca  || 45.42 ||
tuṣṭāva paramaiḥ stotrairviriñciḥ susamāhitaḥ  |
tato'hamuktavān devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam  |
kāraṇaṃ vada māṃ tāta mama dhyānasya sāṃpratam  || 45.43 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
jagaddhitāya deveśa martyalokaiśca durlabham  |
svargadvārasya mārgāṇi yajñadānavratāni ca  || 45.44 ||
yogaḥ satyaṃ tapaḥ śraddhā tīrthāni vividhāni ca  |
vihāya sarvameteṣāṃ sukhaṃ tatsādhanaṃ vada  || 45.45 ||
sthānaṃ jagatpate mahyāmutkṛṣṭaṃ ca yaducyate  |
sarveṣāmuttamaṃ sthānaṃ brūhi me puruṣottama  || 45.46 ||
vidhāturvacanaṃ śrutvā tato'haṃ proktavān priye  |
śṛṇu brahman pravakṣyāmi nirmalaṃ bhuvi durlabham  || 45.47 ||
uttamaṃ sarvakṣetrāṇāṃ dhanyaṃ saṃsāratāraṇam  |
gobrāhmaṇahitaṃ puṇyaṃ cāturvarṇyasukhodayam  || 45.48 ||
bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham  |
mahāpuṇyaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ siddhidaṃ vai pitāmahe  || 45.49 ||
tasmādāsītsamutpannaṃ tīrtharājaṃ sanātanam  |
vikhyātaṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ caturyuganiṣevitam  || 45.50 ||
sarveṣāmeva devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ brahmacāriṇām  |
daityadānavasiddhānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām  || 45.51 ||
nāgavidyādharāṇāṃ ca sthāvarasya carasya ca  |
uttamaḥ puruṣo yasmāttasmātsa puruṣottamaḥ  || 45.52 ||
dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre nyagrodho yatra tiṣṭhati  |
daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham  || 45.53 ||
yastu kalpe samutpanne mahadulkānibarhaṇe  |
vināśaṃ naivamabhyeti svayaṃ tatraivamāsthitaḥ  || 45.54 ||
dṛṣṭamātre vaṭe tasmiṃśchāyāmākramya cāsakṛt |
brahmahatyātpramucyeta pāpeṣvanyeṣu kā kathā  || 45.55 ||
pradakṣiṇā kṛtā yaistu namaskāraśca jantubhiḥ  |
sarve vidhūtapāpmānaste gatāḥ keśavālayam  || 45.56 ||
nyagrodhasyottare kiṃciddakṣiṇe keśavasya tu  |
prāsādastatra tiṣṭhettu padaṃ dharmamayaṃ hi tat || 45.57 ||
pratimāṃ tatra vai dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ devena nirmitām  |
anāyāsena vai yānti bhuvanaṃ me tato narāḥ  || 45.58 ||
gacchamānāṃstu tān prekṣya ekadā dharmarāṭpriye  |
madantikamanuprāpya praṇamya śirasābravīt || 45.59 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
namaste bhagavan deva lokanātha jagatpate  |
kṣīrodavāsinaṃ devaṃ śeṣabhogānuśāyinam  || 45.60 ||
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ kartāramakṛtaṃ prabhum  |
viśveśvaramajaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvajñamaparājitam  || 45.61 ||
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam  |
sarvajñaṃ nirguṇaṃ śāntaṃ jagaddhātāramavyayam  || 45.62 ||
sarvalokavidhātāraṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham  |
purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ vedyaṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ sanātanam  || 45.63 ||
parāvarāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ lokanāthaṃ jagadgurum  |
śrīvatsoraskasaṃyuktaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam  || 45.64 ||
pītavastraṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam  |
hārakeyūrasaṃyuktaṃ mukuṭāṅgadadhāriṇam  || 45.65 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam  |

bhāvābhāvavinirmuktaṃ vyāpinaṃ prakṛteḥ param  |
namasyāmi jagannāthamīśvaraṃ sukhadaṃ prabhum  || 45.67 ||
ityevaṃ dharmarājastu purā nyagrodhasaṃnidhau  |
stutvā nānāvidhaiḥ stotraiḥ praṇāmamakarottadā  || 45.68 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mahābhāge praṇataṃ prāñjalisthitam  |
stotrasya kāraṇaṃ devi pṛṣṭavānahamantakam  || 45.69 ||
vaivasvata mahābāho sarvadevottamo hyasi  |
kimarthaṃ stutavānmāṃ tvaṃ saṃkṣepāttadbravīhi me  || 45.70 ||
{dharmarāja uvāca̱ }
asminnāyatane puṇye vikhyāte puruṣottame  |
indranīlamayī śreṣṭhā pratimā sārvakāmikī  || 45.71 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣa bhāvenaikena śraddhayā  |

ataḥ kartuṃ na śaknomi vyāpāramarisūdana  |
prasīda sumahādeva saṃhara pratimāṃ vibho  || 45.73 ||
śrutvā vaivasvatasyaitadvākyametaduvāca ha  |
yama tāṃ gopayiṣyāmi sikatābhiḥ samantataḥ  || 45.74 ||
tataḥ sā pratimā devi vallibhirgopitā mayā  |
yathā tatra na paśyanti manujāḥ svargakāṅkṣiṇaḥ  || 45.75 ||
pracchādya vallikairdevi jātarūpaparicchadaiḥ  |
yamaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa svāṃ purīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam  || 45.76 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
luptāyāṃ pratimāyāṃ tu indranīlasya bho dvijāḥ  |
tasmin kṣetravare puṇye vikhyāte puruṣottame  || 45.77 ||
yo bhūtastatra vṛttānto devadevo janārdanaḥ  |
taṃ sarvaṃ kathayāmāsa sa tasyai bhagavān purā  || 45.78 ||
indradyumnasya gamanaṃ kṣetrasaṃdarśanaṃ tathā  |
kṣetrasya varṇanaṃ caiva prāsādakaraṇaṃ tathā  || 45.79 ||
hayamedhasya yajanaṃ svapnadarśanameva ca  |
lavaṇasyodadhestīre kāṣṭhasya darśanaṃ tathā  || 45.80 ||
darśanaṃ vāsudevasya śilpirājasya ca dvijāḥ  |
nirmāṇaṃ pratimāyāstu yathāvarṇaṃ viśeṣataḥ  || 45.81 ||
sthāpanaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ prāsāde bhuvanottame  |
yātrākāle ca viprendrāḥ kalpasaṃkīrtanaṃ tathā  || 45.82 ||
mārkaṇḍeyasya caritaṃ sthāpanaṃ śaṃkarasya ca  |
pañcatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ darśanaṃ śūlapāṇinaḥ  || 45.83 ||
vaṭasya darśanaṃ caiva vyuṣṭiṃ tasya ca bho dvijāḥ  |
darśanaṃ baladevasya kṛṣṇasya ca viśeṣataḥ  || 45.84 ||
subhadrāyāśca tatraiva māhātmyaṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ  |
darśanaṃ narasiṃhasya vyuṣṭisaṃkīrtanaṃ tathā  || 45.85 ||
anantavāsudevasya darśanaṃ guṇakīrtanam  |
śvetamādhavamāhātmyaṃ svargadvārasya darśanam  || 45.86 ||
udadherdarśanaṃ caiva snānaṃ tarpaṇameva ca  |
samudrasnānamāhātmyamindradyumnasya ca dvijāḥ  || 45.87 ||
pañcatīrthaphalaṃ caiva mahājyeṣṭhaṃ tathaiva ca  |
sthānaṃ kṛṣṇasya halinaḥ parvayātrāphalaṃ tathā  || 45.88 ||
varṇanaṃ viṣṇulokasya kṣetrasya ca punaḥ punaḥ  |
pūrvaṃ kathitavān sarvaṃ tasyai sa puruṣottamaḥ  || 45.89 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
śrotumicchāmahe deva kathāśeṣaṃ mahīpateḥ  |
tasmin kṣetravare gatvā kiṃ cakāra narādhipaḥ  || 46.1 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ  |
kṣetrasaṃdarśanaṃ caiva kṛtyaṃ tasya ca bhūpateḥ  || 46.2 ||
gatvā tatra mahīpālaḥ kṣetre trailokyaviśrute  |
dadarśa ramaṇīyāni sthānāni saritastathā  || 46.3 ||
nadī tatra mahāpuṇyā vindhyapādavinirgatā  |
svittropaleti vikhyātā sarvapāpaharā śivā  || 46.4 ||
gaṅgātulyā mahāsrotā dakṣiṇārṇavagāminī  |
mahānadīti nāmnā sā puṇyatoyā saridvarā  || 46.5 ||
dakṣiṇasyodadhergarbhaṃ gatāvartātiśobhitā  |
ubhayostaṭayoryasyā grāmāśca nagarāṇi ca  || 46.6 ||
dṛśyante muniśārdūlāḥ susasyāḥ sumanoharāḥ  |
hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ  || 46.7 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāstatra pṛthakpṛthak |
svadharmaniratāḥ śāntā dṛśyante śubhalakṣaṇāḥ  || 46.8 ||
tāmbūlapūrṇavadanā mālādāmavibhūṣitāḥ  |
vedapūrṇamukhā viprāḥ saṣaḍaṅgapadakramāḥ  || 46.9 ||
agnihotraratāḥ kecitkecidaupāsanakriyāḥ  |
sarvaśāstrārthakuśalā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ  || 46.10 ||
catvāre rājamārgeṣu vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca  |
sabhāmaṇḍalaharmyeṣu devatāyataneṣu ca  || 46.11 ||
itihāsapurāṇāni vedāḥ sāṅgāḥ sulakṣaṇāḥ  |
kāvyaśāstrakathāstatra śrūyante ca mahājanaiḥ  || 46.12 ||
striyastaddeśavāsinyo rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ  |
saṃpūrṇalakṣaṇopetā vistīrṇaśroṇimaṇḍalāḥ  || 46.13 ||
saroruhamukhāḥ śyāmāḥ śaraccandranibhānanāḥ  |
pīnonnatastanāḥ sarvāḥ samṛddhyā cārudarśanāḥ  || 46.14 ||
sauvarṇavalayākrāntā divyairvastrairalaṃkṛtāḥ  |
kadalīgarbhasaṃkāśāḥ padmakiñjalkasaprabhāḥ  || 46.15 ||
bimbādharapuṭāḥ kāntāḥ karṇāntāyatalocanāḥ  |
sumukhāścārukeśāśca hāvabhāvāvanāmitāḥ  || 46.16 ||
kāścitpadmapalāśākṣyaḥ kāścidindīvarekṣaṇāḥ  |
vidyudvispaṣṭadaśanāstanvaṅgyaśca tathāparāḥ  || 46.17 ||
kuṭilālakasaṃyuktāḥ sīmantena virājitāḥ  |
grīvābharaṇasaṃyuktā mālyadāmavibhūṣitāḥ  || 46.18 ||
kuṇḍalai ratnasaṃyuktaiḥ karṇapūrairmanoharaiḥ  |
devayoṣitpratīkāśā dṛśyante śubhalakṣaṇāḥ  || 46.19 ||
divyagītavarairdhanyaiḥ krīḍamānā varāṅganāḥ  |
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgaiśca paṇavaiścaiva gomukhaiḥ  || 46.20 ||
śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣairnānāvādyairmanoharaiḥ  |
krīḍantyastāḥ sadā hṛṣṭā vilāsinyaḥ parasparam  || 46.21 ||
evamādi tathāneka gītavādyaviśāradāḥ  |
divā rātrau samāyuktāḥ kāmonmattā varāṅganāḥ  || 46.22 ||
bhikṣuvaikhānasaiḥ siddhaiḥ snātakairbrahmacāribhiḥ  |
mantrasiddhaistapaḥsiddhairyajñasiddhairniṣevitam  || 46.23 ||
ityevaṃ dadṛśe rājā kṣetraṃ paramaśobhanam  |
atraivārādhayiṣyāmi bhagavantaṃ sanātanam  || 46.24 ||
jagadguruṃ paraṃ devaṃ paraṃ pāraṃ paraṃ padam  |
sarveśvareśvaraṃ viṣṇumanantamaparājitam  || 46.25 ||
idaṃ tanmānasaṃ tīrthaṃ jñātaṃ me puruṣottamam  |
kalpavṛkṣo mahākāyo nyagrodho yatra tiṣṭhati  || 46.26 ||
pratimā cendranīlākhyā svayaṃ devena gopitā  |
na cātra dṛśyate cānyā pratimā vaiṣṇavī śubhā  || 46.27 ||
tathā yatnaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā devo jagatpatiḥ  |
pratyakṣaṃ mama cābhyeti viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ  || 46.28 ||
yajñairdānaistapobhiśca homairdhyānaistathārcanaiḥ  |
upavāsaiśca vidhivaccareyaṃ vratamuttamam  || 46.29 ||
ananyamanasā caiva tanmanā nānyamānasaḥ  |
viṣṇvāyatanavinyāse prārambhaṃ ca karomyaham  || 46.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ sa pṛthivīpālaścintayitvā dvijottamāḥ  |
prāsādārthaṃ harestatra prārambhamakarottadā  || 47.1 ||
ānāyya gaṇakān sarvānācāryāñśāstrapāragān  |
bhūmiṃ saṃśodhya yatnena rājā tu parayā mudā  || 47.2 ||
brāhmaṇairjñānasaṃpannairvedaśāstrārthapāragaiḥ  |
amātyairmantribhiścaiva vāstuvidyāviśāradaiḥ  || 47.3 ||
taiḥ sārdhaṃ sa samālocya sumuhūrte śubhe dine  |
sucandratārāsaṃyoge grahānukūlyasaṃyute  || 47.4 ||
jayamaṅgalaśabdaiśca nānāvādyairmanoharaiḥ  |
vedādhyayananirghoṣairgītaiḥ sumadhurasvaraiḥ  || 47.5 ||
