puṣpalājākṣatairgandhaiḥ pūrṇakumbhaiḥ sadīpakaiḥ  |
dadāvarghyaṃ tato rājā śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ  || 47.6 ||
dattvaivamarghyaṃ vidhivadānāyya sa mahīpatiḥ  |
kaliṅgādhipatiṃ śūramutkalādhipatiṃ tathā  |
kośalādhipatiṃ caiva tānuvāca tadā nṛpaḥ  || 47.7 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
gacchadhvaṃ sahitāḥ sarve śilārthe susamāhitāḥ  |
gṛhītvā śilpimukhyāṃśca śilākarmaviśāradān  || 47.8 ||
vindhyācalaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ bahukandaraśobhitam  |
nirūpya sarvasānūni cchedayitvā śilāḥ śubhāḥ  |
saṃvāhyantāṃ ca śakaṭairnaukābhirmā vilambatha  || 47.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ gantuṃ samādiśya tānnṛpān sa mahīpatiḥ  |
punarevābravīdvākyaṃ sāmātyān sapurohitān  || 47.10 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
gacchantu dūtāḥ sarvatra mamājñāṃ pravadantu vai  |
yatra tiṣṭhanti rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tān suśīghragāḥ  || 47.11 ||
hastyaśvarathapādātaiḥ sāmātyaiḥ sapurohitaiḥ  |
gacchata sahitāḥ sarva indradyumnasya śāsanāt || 47.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ dūtāḥ samājñātā rājñā tena mahātmanā  |
gatvā tadā nṛpānūcurvacanaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ  || 47.13 ||
śrutvā tu te tathā sarve dūtānāṃ vacanaṃ nṛpāḥ  |
ājagmustvaritāḥ sarve svasainyaiḥ parivāritāḥ  || 47.14 ||
ye nṛpāḥ sarvadigbhāge ye ca dakṣiṇataḥ sthitāḥ  |
paścimāyāṃ sthitā ye ca uttarāpathasaṃsthitāḥ  || 47.15 ||
pratyantavāsino ye'pi ye ca saṃnidhivāsinaḥ  |
pārvatīyāśca ye kecittathā dvīpanivāsinaḥ  || 47.16 ||
rathairnāgaiḥ padātaiśca vājibhirdhanavistaraiḥ  |
saṃprāptā bahuśo viprāḥ śrutvendradyumnaśāsanam  || 47.17 ||
tānāgatānnṛpān dṛṣṭvā sāmātyān sapurohitān  |
provāca rājā hṛṣṭātmā kāryamuddiśya sādaram  || 47.18 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ nṛpaśārdūlā yathā kiṃcidbravīmyaham  |
asmin kṣetravare puṇye bhuktimuktiprade śive  || 47.19 ||
hayamedhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ prāsādaṃ caiva vaiṣṇavam  |
kathaṃ śaknomyahaṃ kartumiti cintākulaṃ manaḥ  || 47.20 ||
bhavadbhiḥ susahāyaistu sarvametatkaromyaham  |
yadi yūyaṃ sahāyā me bhavadhvaṃ nṛpasattamāḥ  || 47.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityevaṃ vadamānasya rājarājasya dhīmataḥ  |
sarve pramuditā hṛṣṭā bhūpāste tasya śāsanāt || 47.22 ||
vavṛṣurdhanaratnaiśca suvarṇamaṇimauktikaiḥ  |
kambalājinaratnaiśca rāṅkavāstaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ  || 47.23 ||
vajravaidūryamāṇikyaiḥ padmarāgendranīlakaiḥ  |
gajairaśvairdhanaiścānyai rathaiścaiva kareṇubhiḥ  || 47.24 ||
asaṃkhyeyairbahuvidhairdravyairuccāvacaistathā  |
śālivrīhiyavaiścaiva māṣamudgatilaistathā  || 47.25 ||
siddhārthacaṇakaiścaiva godhūmairmasurādibhiḥ  |
śyāmākairmadhukaiścaiva nīvāraiḥ sakulatthakaiḥ  || 47.26 ||
anyaiśca vividhairdhānyairgrāmyāraṇyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ  |
bahudhānyasahasrāṇāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ ca rāśibhiḥ  || 47.27 ||
gavyasya haviṣaḥ kumbhaiḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ  |
tathānyairvividhairdravyairbhakṣyabhojyānulepanaiḥ  || 47.28 ||
rājānaḥ pūrayāmāsuryatkiṃciddravyasaṃbhavaiḥ  |
tān dṛṣṭvā yajñasaṃbhārān sarvasaṃpatsamanvitān  || 47.29 ||
yajñakarmavido viprān vedavedāṅgapāragān  |
śāstreṣu nipuṇān dakṣān kuśalān sarvakarmasu  || 47.30 ||
ṛṣīṃścaiva maharṣīṃśca devarṣīṃścaiva tāpasān  |
brahmacārigṛhasthāṃśca vānaprasthān yatīṃstathā  || 47.31 ||
snātakān brāhmaṇāṃścānyānagnihotre sadā sthitān  |
ācāryopādhyāyavarān svādhyāyatapasānvitān  || 47.32 ||
sadasyāñśāstrakuśalāṃstathānyān pāvakān bahūn  |
dṛṣṭvā tānnṛpatiḥ śrīmānuvāca svaṃ purohitam  || 47.33 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
tataḥ prayāntu vidvāṃso brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ  |
vājimedhārthasiddhyarthaṃ deśaṃ paśyantu yajñiyam  || 47.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ sa tathā cakre vacanaṃ tasya bhūpateḥ  |
hṛṣṭaḥ sa mantribhiḥ sārdhaṃ tadā rājapurohitaḥ  || 47.35 ||
tato yayau purodhāśca prājñaḥ sthapatibhiḥ saha  |
brāhmaṇānagrataḥ kṛtvā kuśalān yajñakarmaṇi  || 47.36 ||
taṃ deśaṃ dhīvaragrāmaṃ sapratoliviṭaṅkinam  |
kārayāmāsa vipro'sau yajñavāṭaṃ yathāvidhi  || 47.37 ||
prāsādaśatasaṃbādhaṃ maṇipravaraśobhitam  |
indrasadmanibhaṃ ramyaṃ hemaratnavibhūṣitam  || 47.38 ||
stambhān kanakacitrāṃśca toraṇāni bṛhanti ca  |
yajñāyatanadeśeṣu dattvā śuddhaṃ ca kāñcanam  || 47.39 ||
antaḥpurāṇi rājñāṃ ca nānādeśanivāsinām  |
kārayāmāsa dharmātmā tatra tatra yathāvidhi  || 47.40 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vaiśyānāṃ nānādeśasamīyuṣām  |
kārayāmāsa vidhivacchālāstatrāpyanekaśaḥ  || 47.41 ||
priyārthaṃ tasya nṛpaterāyayurnṛpasattamāḥ  |
ratnānyanekānyādāya striyaścāyayurutsave  || 47.42 ||
teṣāṃ nirviśatāṃ sveṣu śibireṣu mahātmanām  |
nadataḥ sāgarasyeva divispṛgabhavaddhvaniḥ  || 47.43 ||
teṣāmabhyāgatānāṃ ca sa rājā munisattamāḥ  |
vyādideśāyatanāni śayyāścāpyupacārataḥ  || 47.44 ||
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi śālīkṣuyavagorasaiḥ  |
upetya nṛpatiśreṣṭho vyādideśa svayaṃ tadā  || 47.45 ||
tathā tasminmahāyajñe bahavo brahmavādinaḥ  |
ye ca dvijātipravarāstatrāsan dvijasattamāḥ  || 47.46 ||
samājagmuḥ saśiṣyāstān pratijagrāha pārthivaḥ  |
sarvāṃśca tānanuyayau yāvadāvasathāniti  || 47.47 ||
svayameva mahātejā dambhaṃ tyaktvā nṛpottamaḥ  |
tataḥ kṛtvā svaśilpaṃ ca śilpino'nye ca ye tadā  || 47.48 ||
kṛtsnaṃ yajñavidhiṃ rājñe tadā tasmai nyavedayan  |
tataḥ śrutvā nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtaṃ sarvamatandritaḥ  |
hṛṣṭaromābhavadrājā saha mantribhiracyutaḥ  || 47.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasmin yajñe pravṛtte tu vāgmino hetuvādibhiḥ  |
hetuvādān bahūnāhuḥ parasparajigīṣavaḥ  || 47.50 ||
devendrasyeva vihitaṃ rājasiṃhena bho dvijāḥ  |
dadṛśustoraṇānyatra śātakumbhamayāni ca  || 47.51 ||
śayyāsanavikārāṃśca subahūn ratnasaṃcayān  |
ghaṭapātrīkaṭāhāni kalaśān vardhamānakān  || 47.52 ||
nahi kaścidasauvarṇamapaśyadvasudhādhipaḥ  |
yūpāṃśca śāstrapaṭhitān dāravān hemabhūṣitān  || 47.53 ||
upakṣiptān yathākālaṃ vidhivadbhūrivarcasaḥ  |
sthalajā jalajā ye ca paśavaḥ kecana dvijāḥ  || 47.54 ||
sarvāneva samānītānapaśyaṃstatra te nṛpāḥ  |
gāścaiva mahiṣīścaiva tathā vṛddhastriyo'pi ca  || 47.55 ||
audakāni ca sattvāni śvāpadāni vayāṃsi ca  |
jarāyujāṇḍajātāni svedajānyudbhidāni ca  || 47.56 ||
parvatānyupadhānyāni bhūtāni dadṛśuśca te  |
evaṃ pramuditaṃ sarvaṃ paśuto dhanadhānyataḥ  || 47.57 ||
yajñavāṭaṃ nṛpā dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ  |
brāhmaṇānāṃ viśāṃ caiva bahumiṣṭānnamṛddhimat || 47.58 ||
pūrṇe śatasahasre tu viprāṇāṃ tatra bhuñjatām  |
dundubhirmeghanirghoṣānmuhurmuhurathākarot || 47.59 ||
vinanādāsakṛccāpi divase divase gate  |
evaṃ sa vavṛdhe yajñastasya rājñastu dhīmataḥ  || 47.60 ||
annasya subahūn viprā utsargānnirgatopamān  |
dadhikulyāśca dadṛśuḥ payasaśca hradāṃstathā  || 47.61 ||
jambūdvīpo hi sakalo nānājanapadairyutaḥ  |
dvijāśca tatra dṛśyante rājñastasya mahāmakhe  || 47.62 ||
tatra yāni sahasrāṇi puruṣāṇāṃ tatastataḥ  |
gṛhītvā bhājanaṃ jagmurbahūni dvijasattamāḥ  || 47.63 ||
śrāviṇaścāpi te sarve sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalāḥ  |
paryaveṣayan dvijātīñśataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ  || 47.64 ||
vividhānyanupānāni puruṣā ye'nuyāyinaḥ  |
te vai nṛpopabhojyāni brāhmaṇebhyo daduḥ saha  || 47.65 ||
samāgatān vedavido rājñaśca pṛthivīśvarān  |
pūjāṃ cakre tadā teṣāṃ vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaḥ  || 47.66 ||
digdeśādāgatān rājño mahāsaṃgrāmaśālinaḥ  |
naṭanartakakādīṃśca gītastutiviśāradān  || 47.67 ||
patnyo manoramāstasya pīnonnatapayodharāḥ  |
indīvarapalāśākṣyaḥ śaraccandranibhānanāḥ  || 47.68 ||
kulaśīlaguṇopetāḥ sahasraikaṃ śatādhikam  |
evaṃ tadbhūpaparama patnīgaṇasamanvitam  || 47.69 ||
ratnamālākulaṃ divyaṃ patākādhvajasevitam  |
ratnahārayutaṃ ramyaṃ candrakāntisamaprabham  || 47.70 ||
kariṇaḥ parvatākārānmadasiktānmahābalān  |
śataśaḥ koṭisaṃghātairdantibhirdantabhūṣaṇaiḥ  || 47.71 ||
vātavegajavairaśvaiḥ sindhujātaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ  |
śvetāśvaiḥ śyāmakarṇaiśca koṭyanekairjavānvitaiḥ  || 47.72 ||
saṃnaddhabaddhakakṣaiśca nānāpraharaṇodyataiḥ  |
asaṃkhyeyaiḥ padātaiśca devaputropamaistathā  || 47.73 ||
ityevaṃ dadṛśe rājā yajñasaṃbhāravistaram  |
mudaṃ lebhe tadā rājā saṃhṛṣṭo vākyamabravīt || 47.74 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
ānayadhvaṃ hayaśreṣṭhaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam  |
cārayadhvaṃ pṛthivyāṃ vai rājaputrāḥ susaṃyatāḥ  || 47.75 ||
vidvadbhirdharmavidbhiśca atra homo vidhīyatām  |
kṛṣṇacchāgaṃ ca mahiṣaṃ kṛṣṇasāramṛgaṃ dvijān  || 47.76 ||
anaḍvāhaṃ ca gāścaiva sarvāṃśca paśupālakān  |
iṣṭayaśca pravartantāṃ prāsādaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tataḥ  || 47.77 ||
sarvametacca viprebhyo dīyatāṃ manasepsitam  |
striyaśca ratnakoṭyaśca grāmāśca nagarāṇi ca  || 47.78 ||
samyaksamṛddhabhūmyaśca viṣayāścaivamarthinām  |
anyāni dravyajātāni manojñāni bahūni ca  || 47.79 ||
sarveṣāṃ yācamānānāṃ nāsti hyetanna bhāṣayet |
tāvatpravartatāṃ yajño yāvaddevaḥ purā tviha  |
pratyakṣaṃ mama cābhyeti yajñasyāsya samīpataḥ  || 47.80 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tadā viprā rājasiṃho mahābhujaḥ  |
dadau suvarṇasaṃghātaṃ koṭīnāṃ caiva bhūṣaṇam  || 47.81 ||
kareṇuśatasāhasraṃ vājino niyutāni ca  |
arbudaṃ caiva vṛṣabhaṃ svarṇaśṛṅgīśca dhenukāḥ  || 47.82 ||
surūpāḥ surabhīścaiva kāṃsyadohāḥ payasvinīḥ  |
prāyacchatsa tu viprebhyo vedavidbhyo mudā yutaḥ  || 47.83 ||
vāsāṃsi ca mahārhāṇi rāṅkavāstaraṇāni ca  |
suśuklāni ca śubhrāṇi pravālamaṇimuttamam  || 47.84 ||
adadātsa mahāyajñe ratnāni vividhāni ca  ||* 47.85 ||
vajravaidūryamāṇikya muktikādyāni yāni ca  |
alaṃkāravatīḥ śubhrāḥ kanyā rājīvalocanāḥ  || 47.86 ||
śatāni pañca viprebhyo rājā hṛṣṭaḥ pradattavān  |
striyaḥ pīnapayobhārāḥ kañcukaiḥ svastanāvṛtāḥ  || 47.87 ||
madhyahīnāśca suśroṇyaḥ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇāḥ  |
hāvabhāvānvitagrīvā bahvyo valayabhūṣitāḥ  || 47.88 ||
pādanūpurasaṃyuktāḥ paṭṭadukūlavāsasaḥ  |
ekaikaśo'dadāttasmin kāmyāśca kāminīrbahūḥ  || 47.89 ||
arthibhyo brāhmaṇādibhyo hayamedhe dvijottamāḥ  |
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca saṃpūrṇaṃ nānāsaṃbhārasaṃyutam  || 47.90 ||
khaṇḍakādyānyanekāni svinnapakvāṃśca piṣṭakān  |
annānyanyāni medhyāṃśca ghṛtapūrāṃśca khāṇḍavān  || 47.91 ||
madhurāṃstarjitān pūpānannaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ supākikam  |
prītyarthaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ dīyate'nnaṃ punaḥ punaḥ  || 47.92 ||
dattasya dīyamānasya dhanasyānto na vidyate  |
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāyajñaṃ devadaityāḥ savāraṇāḥ  || 47.93 ||
gandharvāpsarasaḥ siddhā ṛṣayaśca prajeśvarāḥ  |
vismayaṃ paramaṃ yātā dṛṣṭvā kratuvaraṃ śubham  || 47.94 ||
purodhā mantriṇo rājā hṛṣṭāstatraiva sarvaśaḥ  |
na tatra malinaḥ kaścinna dīno na kṣudhānvitaḥ  || 47.95 ||
na vopasargo na glānirnādhayo vyādhayastathā  |
nākālamaraṇaṃ tatra na daṃśo na grahā viṣam  || 47.96 ||
hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāḥ sarve tasmin rājño mahotsave  |
ye ca tatra tapaḥsiddhā munayaścirajīvinaḥ  || 47.97 ||
na jātaṃ tādṛśaṃ yajñaṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitam  |
evaṃ sa rājā vidhivadvājimedhaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
kratuṃ samāpayāmāsa prāsādaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā  || 47.98 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
brūhi no devadeveśa yatpṛcchāmaḥ purātanam  |
yathā tāḥ pratimāḥ pūrvamindradyumnena nirmitāḥ  || 48.1 ||
kena caiva prakāreṇa tuṣṭastasmai sa mādhavaḥ  |
tatsarvaṃ vada cāsmākaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 48.2 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam  |
kathayāmi purā vṛttaṃ pratimānāṃ ca saṃbhavam  || 48.3 ||
pravṛtte ca mahāyajñe prāsāde caiva nirmite  |
cintā tasya babhūvātha pratimārthamaharniśam  || 48.4 ||
na vedmi kena deveśaṃ sarveśaṃ lokapāvanam  |
sargasthityantakartāraṃ paśyāmi puruṣottamam  || 48.5 ||
cintāviṣṭastvabhūdrājā śete rātrau divāpi na  |
na bhuṅkte vividhān bhogānna ca snānaṃ prasādhanam  || 48.6 ||
naiva vādyena gandhena gāyanairvarṇakairapi  |
na gajairmadayuktaiśca na cānekairhayānvitaiḥ  || 48.7 ||
nendranīlairmahānīlaiḥ padmarāgamayairna ca  |
suvarṇarajatādyaiśca vajrasphaṭikasaṃyutaiḥ  || 48.8 ||
bahurāgārthakāmairvā na vanyairantarikṣagaiḥ  |
babhūva tasya nṛpatermanasastuṣṭivardhanam  || 48.9 ||
śailamṛddārujāteṣu praśastaṃ kiṃ mahītale  |
viṣṇupratimāyogyaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam  || 48.10 ||
etaireva trayāṇāṃ tu dayitaṃ syātsurārcitam  |
sthāpite prītimabhyeti iti cintāparo'bhavat || 48.11 ||
pañcarātravidhānena saṃpūjya puruṣottamam  |
cintāviṣṭo mahīpālaḥ saṃstotumupacakrame  || 48.12 ||
vāsudeva namaste'stu namaste mokṣakāraṇa  |
trāhi māṃ sarvalokeśa janmasaṃsārasāgarāt || 49.1 ||
nirmalāmbarasaṃkāśa namaste puruṣottama  |
saṃkarṣaṇa namaste'stu trāhi māṃ dharaṇīdhara  || 49.2 ||
namaste hemagarbhābha namaste makaradhvaja  |
ratikānta namaste'stu trāhi māṃ saṃvarāntaka  || 49.3 ||
namaste'ñjanasaṃkāśa namaste bhaktavatsala  |
aniruddha namaste'stu trāhi māṃ varado bhava  || 49.4 ||
namaste vibudhāvāsa namaste vibudhapriya  |
nārāyaṇa namaste'stu trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam  || 49.5 ||
namaste balināṃ śreṣṭha namaste lāṅgalāyudha  |
caturmukha jagaddhāma trāhi māṃ prapitāmaha  || 49.6 ||
namaste nīlameghābha namaste tridaśārcita  |
trāhi viṣṇo jagannātha magnaṃ māṃ bhavasāgare  || 49.7 ||
pralayānalasaṃkāśa namaste ditijāntaka  |
narasiṃha mahāvīrya trāhi māṃ dīptalocana  || 49.8 ||
yathā rasātalādurvī tvayā daṃṣṭroddhṛtā purā  |
tathā mahāvarāhastvaṃ trāhi māṃ duḥkhasāgarāt || 49.9 ||
tavaitā mūrtayaḥ kṛṣṇa varadāḥ saṃstutā mayā  |
taveme baladevādyāḥ pṛthagrūpeṇa saṃsthitāḥ  || 49.10 ||
aṅgāni tava deveśa garutmādyāstathā prabho  |
dikpālāḥ sāyudhāścaiva keśavādyāstathācyuta  || 49.11 ||
ye cānye tava deveśa bhedāḥ proktā manīṣibhiḥ  |
te'pi sarve jagannātha prasannāyatalocana  || 49.12 ||
mayārcitāḥ stutāḥ sarve tathā yūyaṃ namaskṛtāḥ  |
prayacchata varaṃ mahyaṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam  || 49.13 ||
bhedāste kīrtitā ye tu hare saṃkarṣaṇādayaḥ  |
tava pūjārthasaṃbhūtāstatastvayi samāśritāḥ  || 49.14 ||
na bhedastava deveśa vidyate paramārthataḥ  |
vividhaṃ tava yadrūpamuktaṃ tadupacārataḥ  || 49.15 ||
advaitaṃ tvāṃ kathaṃ dvaitaṃ vaktuṃ śaknoti mānavaḥ  |
ekastvaṃ hi hare vyāpī citsvabhāvo nirañjanaḥ  || 49.16 ||
paramaṃ tava yadrūpaṃ bhāvābhāvavivarjitam  |
nirlepaṃ nirguṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvam  || 49.17 ||
sarvopādhivinirmuktaṃ sattāmātravyavasthitam  |
taddevāśca na jānanti kathaṃ jānāmyahaṃ prabho  || 49.18 ||
aparaṃ tava yadrūpaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam  |
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇi mukuṭāṅgadadhāriṇam  || 49.19 ||
śrīvatsoraskasaṃyuktaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam  |
tadarcayanti vibudhā ye cānye tava saṃśrayāḥ  || 49.20 ||
devadeva suraśreṣṭha bhaktānāmabhayaprada  |
trāhi māṃ padmapattrākṣa magnaṃ viṣayasāgare  || 49.21 ||
nānyaṃ paśyāmi lokeśa yasyāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje  |
tvāmṛte kamalākānta prasīda madhusūdana  || 49.22 ||
jarāvyādhiśatairyukto nānāduḥkhairnipīḍitaḥ  |
harṣaśokānvito mūḍhaḥ karmapāśaiḥ suyantritaḥ  || 49.23 ||
patito'haṃ mahāraudre ghore saṃsārasāgare  |
viṣamodakaduṣpāre rāgadveṣajhaṣākule  || 49.24 ||
indriyāvartagambhīre tṛṣṇāśokormisaṃkule  |
nirāśraye nirālambe niḥsāre'tyantacañcale  || 49.25 ||
māyayā mohitastatra bhramāmi suciraṃ prabho  |
nānājātisahasreṣu jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ  || 49.26 ||
mayā janmānyanekāni sahasrāṇyayutāni ca  |
vividhānyanubhūtāni saṃsāre'smiñjanārdana  || 49.27 ||
vedāḥ sāṅgā mayādhītāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca  |
itihāsapurāṇāni tathā śilpānyanekaśaḥ  || 49.28 ||
asaṃtoṣāśca saṃtoṣāḥ saṃcayāpacayā vyayāḥ  |
mayā prāptā jagannātha kṣayavṛddhyakṣayetarāḥ  || 49.29 ||
bhāryārimitrabandhūnāṃ viyogāḥ saṃgamāstathā  |
pitaro vividhā dṛṣṭā mātaraśca tathā mayā  || 49.30 ||
duḥkhāni cānubhūtāni yāni saukhyānyanekaśaḥ  |
prāptāśca bāndhavāḥ putrā bhrātaro jñātayastathā  || 49.31 ||
mayoṣitaṃ tathā strīṇāṃ koṣṭhe viṇmūtrapicchale  |
garbhavāse mahāduḥkhamanubhūtaṃ tathā prabho  || 49.32 ||
duḥkhāni yānyanekāni bālyayauvanagocare  |
vārdhake ca hṛṣīkeśa tāni prāptāni vai mayā  || 49.33 ||
maraṇe yāni duḥkhāni yamamārge yamālaye  |
mayā tānyanubhūtāni narake yātanāstathā  || 49.34 ||
kṛmikīṭadrumāṇāṃ ca hastyaśvamṛgapakṣiṇām  |
mahiṣoṣṭragavāṃ caiva tathānyeṣāṃ vanaukasām  || 49.35 ||
dvijātīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ caiva yoniṣu  |
dhanināṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca daridrāṇāṃ tapasvinām  || 49.36 ||
nṛpāṇāṃ nṛpabhṛtyānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ ca dehinām  |
gṛheṣu teṣāmutpanno deva cāhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ  || 49.37 ||
gato'smi dāsatāṃ nātha bhṛtyānāṃ bahuśo nṛṇām  |
daridratvaṃ ceśvaratvaṃ svāmitvaṃ ca tathā gataḥ  || 49.38 ||
hato mayā hatāścānye ghātito ghātitāstathā  |
dattaṃ mamānyairanyebhyo mayā dattamanekaśaḥ  || 49.39 ||
pitṛmātṛsuhṛdbhrātṛ kalatrāṇāṃ kṛtena ca  |
dhanināṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ ca daridrāṇāṃ tapasvinām  || 49.40 ||
uktaṃ dainyaṃ ca vividhaṃ tyaktvā lajjāṃ janārdana  |
devatiryaṅmanuṣyeṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca  || 49.41 ||
na vidyate tathā sthānaṃ yatrāhaṃ na gataḥ prabho  |
kadā me narake vāsaḥ kadā svarge jagatpate  || 49.42 ||
kadā manuṣyalokeṣu kadā tiryaggateṣu ca  |
jalayantre yathā cakre ghaṭī rajjunibandhanā  || 49.43 ||
yāti cordhvamadhaścaiva kadā madhye ca tiṣṭhati  |
tathā cāhaṃ suraśreṣṭha karmarajjusamāvṛtaḥ  || 49.44 ||
adhaścordhvaṃ tathā madhye bhraman gacchāmi yogataḥ  |
evaṃ saṃsāracakre'smin bhairave romaharṣaṇe  || 49.45 ||
bhramāmi suciraṃ kālaṃ nāntaṃ paśyāmi karhicit |
na jāne kiṃ karomyadya hare vyākulitendriyaḥ  || 49.46 ||
śokatṛṣṇābhibhūto'haṃ kāṃdiśīko vicetanaḥ  |
idānīṃ tvāmahaṃ deva vihvalaḥ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ  || 49.47 ||
trāhi māṃ duḥkhitaṃ kṛṣṇa magnaṃ saṃsārasāgare  |
kṛpāṃ kuru jagannātha bhaktaṃ māṃ yadi manyase  || 49.48 ||
tvadṛte nāsti me bandhuryo'sau cintāṃ kariṣyati  |
deva tvāṃ nāthamāsādya na bhayaṃ me'sti kutracit || 49.49 ||
jīvite maraṇe caiva yogakṣeme'thavā prabho  |
ye tu tvāṃ vidhivaddeva nārcayanti narādhamāḥ  || 49.50 ||
sugatistu kathaṃ teṣāṃ bhavetsaṃsārabandhanāt |
kiṃ teṣāṃ kulaśīlena vidyayā jīvitena ca  || 49.51 ||
yeṣāṃ na jāyate bhaktirjagaddhātari keśave  |
prakṛtiṃ tvāsurīṃ prāpya ye tvāṃ nindanti mohitāḥ  || 49.52 ||
patanti narake ghore jāyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ  |
na teṣāṃ niṣkṛtistasmādvidyate narakārṇavāt || 49.53 ||
ye dūṣayanti durvṛttāstvāṃ deva puruṣādhamāḥ  |
yatra yatra bhavejjanma mama karmanibandhanāt || 49.54 ||
tatra tatra hare bhaktistvayi cāstu dṛḍhā sadā  |
ārādhya tvāṃ surā daityā narāścānye'pi saṃyatāḥ  || 49.55 ||
avāpuḥ paramāṃ siddhiṃ kastvāṃ deva na pūjayet |
na śaknuvanti brahmādyāḥ stotuṃ tvāṃ tridaśā hare  || 49.56 ||
kathaṃ mānuṣabuddhyāhaṃ staumi tvāṃ prakṛteḥ param  |
tathā cājñānabhāvena saṃstuto'si mayā prabho  || 49.57 ||
tatkṣamasvāparādhaṃ me yadi te'sti dayā mayi  |
kṛtāparādhe'pi hare kṣamāṃ kurvanti sādhavaḥ  || 49.58 ||
tasmātprasīda deveśa bhaktasnehaṃ samāśritaḥ  |
stuto'si yanmayā deva bhaktibhāvena cetasā  |
sāṅgaṃ bhavatu tatsarvaṃ vāsudeva namo'stu te  || 49.59 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
itthaṃ stutastadā tena prasanno garuḍadhvajaḥ  |
dadau tasmai muniśreṣṭhāḥ sakalaṃ manasepsitam  || 49.60 ||
yaḥ saṃpūjya jagannāthaṃ pratyahaṃ stauti mānavaḥ  |
stotreṇānena matimān sa mokṣaṃ labhate dhruvam  || 49.61 ||
trisaṃdhyaṃ yo japedvidvānidaṃ stotravaraṃ śuciḥ  |
dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca labhate naraḥ  || 49.62 ||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ  |
sa lokaṃ śāśvataṃ viṣṇoryāti nirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ  || 49.63 ||
dhanyaṃ pāpaharaṃ cedaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śivam  |
guhyaṃ sudurlabhaṃ puṇyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 49.64 ||
na nāstikāya mūrkhāya na kṛtaghnāya mānine  |
na duṣṭamataye dadyānnābhaktāya kadācana  || 49.65 ||
dātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktāya guṇaśīlānvitāya ca  |
viṣṇubhaktāya śāntāya śraddhānuṣṭhānaśāline  || 49.66 ||
idaṃ samastāghavināśahetuḥ  49.67
kāruṇyasaṃjñaṃ sukhamokṣadaṃ ca  49.67
aśeṣavāñchāphaladaṃ variṣṭhaṃ  49.67
stotraṃ mayoktaṃ puruṣottamasya  49.67
ye taṃ susūkṣmaṃ vimalā murāriṃ  49.68
dhyāyanti nityaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam  49.68
te muktibhājaḥ praviśanti viṣṇuṃ  49.68
mantrairyathājyaṃ hutamadhvarāgnau  49.68
ekaḥ sa devo bhavaduḥkhahantā  49.69
paraḥ pareṣāṃ na tato'sti cānyat 49.69
draṣṭā sa pātā sa tu nāśakartā  49.69
viṣṇuḥ samastākhilasārabhūtaḥ  49.69
kiṃ vidyayā kiṃ svaguṇaiśca teṣāṃ  49.70
yajñaiśca dānaiśca tapobhirugraiḥ  49.70
yeṣāṃ na bhaktirbhavatīha kṛṣṇe  49.70
jagadgurau mokṣasukhaprade ca  49.70
loke sa dhanyaḥ sa śuciḥ sa vidvān  49.71
makhaistapobhiḥ sa guṇairvariṣṭhaḥ  49.71
jñātā sa dātā sa tu satyavaktā  49.71
yasyāsti bhaktiḥ puruṣottamākhye  49.71
{brahmovāca̱ }
stutvaivaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ praṇamya ca sanātanam  |
vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam  || 50.1 ||
cintāviṣṭo mahīpālaḥ kuśānāstīrya bhūtale  |
vastraṃ ca tanmanā bhūtvā suṣvāpa dharaṇītale  || 50.2 ||
kathaṃ pratyakṣamabhyeti devadevo janārdanaḥ  |
mama cārtiharo devastadāsāviti cintayan  || 50.3 ||
suptasya tasya nṛpatervāsudevo jagadguruḥ  |
ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa śaṅkhacakragadābhṛtam  || 50.4 ||
sa dadarśa tu saprema devadevaṃ jagadgurum  |
śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ gadācakrograpāṇinam  || 50.5 ||
śārṅgabāṇadharaṃ devaṃ jvalattejotimaṇḍalam  |
yugāntādityavarṇābhaṃ nīlavaidūryasaṃnibham  || 50.6 ||
suparṇāṃse tamāsīnaṃ ṣoḍaśārdhabhujaṃ śubham  |
sa cāsmai prābravīddhīrāḥ sādhu rājanmahāmate  || 50.7 ||
kratunānena divyena tathā bhaktyā ca śraddhayā  |
tuṣṭo'smi te mahīpāla vṛthā kimanuśocasi  || 50.8 ||
yadatra pratimā rājañjagatpūjyā sanātanī  |
yathā sā prāpyate bhūpa tadupāyaṃ bravīmi te  || 50.9 ||
gatāyāmadya śarvaryāṃ nirmale bhāskarodite  |
sāgarasya jalasyānte nānādrumavibhūṣite  || 50.10 ||
jalaṃ tathaiva velāyāṃ dṛśyate tatra vai mahat |
lavaṇasyodadhe rājaṃstaraṅgaiḥ samabhiplutam  || 50.11 ||
kūlānte hi mahāvṛkṣaḥ sthitaḥ sthalajaleṣu ca  |
velābhirhanyamānaśca na cāsau kampate drumaḥ  || 50.12 ||
paraśumādāya hastena ūrmerantastato vraja  |
ekākī viharan rājan sa tvaṃ paśyasi pādapam  || 50.13 ||
īdṛkcihnaṃ samālokya chedaya tvamaśaṅkitaḥ  |
chedyamānaṃ tu taṃ vṛkṣaṃ prātaradbhutadarśanam  || 50.14 ||
dṛṣṭvā tenaiva saṃcintya tato bhūpāla darśanāt |
kuru tāṃ pratimāṃ divyāṃ jahi cintāṃ vimohinīm  || 50.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā mahābhāgo jagāmādarśanaṃ hariḥ  |
sa cāpi svapnamālokya paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ  || 50.16 ||
tāṃ niśāṃ sa samudvīkṣya sthitastadgatamānasaḥ  |
vyāharan vaiṣṇavānmantrān sūktaṃ caiva tadātmakam  || 50.17 ||
pragatāyāṃ rajanyāṃ tu utthito nānyamānasaḥ  |
sa snātvā sāgare samyagyathāvadvidhinā tataḥ  || 50.18 ||
dattvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo grāmāṃśca nagarāṇi ca  |
kṛtvā paurvāhṇikaṃ karma jagāma sa nṛpottamaḥ  || 50.19 ||
na cāśvo na padātiśca na gajo na ca sārathiḥ  |
ekākī sa mahāvelāṃ praviveśa mahīpatiḥ  || 50.20 ||
taṃ dadarśa mahāvṛkṣaṃ tejasvantaṃ mahādrumam  |
mahātigamahārohaṃ puṇyaṃ vipulameva ca  || 50.21 ||
mahotsedhaṃ mahākāyaṃ prasuptaṃ ca jalāntike  |
sāndramāñjiṣṭhavarṇābhaṃ nāmajātivivarjitam  || 50.22 ||
naranāthastadā viprā drumaṃ dṛṣṭvā mudānvitaḥ  |
paraśunā śātayāmāsa niśitena dṛḍhena ca  || 50.23 ||
dvaidhīkartumanāstatra babhūvendrasakhaḥ sa ca  |
nirīkṣyamāṇe kāṣṭhe tu babhūvādbhutadarśanam  || 50.24 ||
viśvakarmā ca viṣṇuśca viprarūpadharāvubhau  |
ājagmaturmahābhāgau tadā tulyāgrajanmanau  || 50.25 ||
jvalamānau svatejobhirdivyasraganulepanau  |
atha tau taṃ samāgamya nṛpamindrasakhaṃ tadā  || 50.26 ||
tāvūcaturmahārāja kimatra tvaṃ kariṣyasi  |
kimarthaṃ ca mahābāho śātitaśca vanaspatiḥ  || 50.27 ||
asahāyo mahādurge nirjane gahane vane  |
mahāsindhutaṭe caiva kathaṃ vai śātito drumaḥ  || 50.28 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tayoḥ śrutvā vaco viprāḥ sa tu rājā mudānvitaḥ  |
babhāṣe vacanaṃ tābhyāṃ mṛdulaṃ madhuraṃ tathā  || 50.29 ||
dṛṣṭvā tau brāhmaṇau tatra candrasūryāvivāgatau  |
namaskṛtya jagannāthāvavāṅmukhamavasthitaḥ  || 50.30 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
devadevamanādyantamanantaṃ jagatāṃ patim  |
ārādhayituṃ pratimāṃ karomīti matirmama  || 50.31 ||
ahaṃ sa devadevena parameṇa mahātmanā  |
svapnānte ca samuddiṣṭo bhavadbhyāṃ śrāvitaṃ mayā  || 50.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
rājñastu vacanaṃ śrutvā devendrapratimasya ca  |
prahasya tasmai viśveśastuṣṭo vacanamabravīt || 50.33 ||
{viṣṇuruvāca̱ }
sādhu sādhu mahīpāla yadetanmatamuttamam  |
saṃsārasāgare ghore kadalīdalasaṃnibhe  || 50.34 ||
niḥsāre duḥkhabahule kāmakrodhasamākule  |
indriyāvartakalile dustare romaharṣaṇe  || 50.35 ||
nānāvyādhiśatāvarte jalabudbudasaṃnibhe  |
yataste matirutpannā viṣṇorārādhanāya vai  || 50.36 ||
dhanyastvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtaḥ  |
saprajā pṛthivī dhanyā saśailavanakānanā  || 50.37 ||
sapuragrāmanagarā caturvarṇairalaṃkṛtā  |
yatra tvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla prajāḥ pālayitā prabhuḥ  || 50.38 ||
ehyehi sumahābhāga drume'smin sukhaśītale  |
āvābhyāṃ saha tiṣṭha tvaṃ kathābhirdharmasaṃśritaḥ  || 50.39 ||
ayaṃ mama sahāyastu āgataḥ śilpināṃ varaḥ  |
viśvakarmasamaḥ sākṣānnipuṇaḥ sarvakarmasu  |
mayoddiṣṭāṃ tu pratimāṃ karotyeṣa taṭaṃ tyaja  || 50.40 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasya tadā rājā dvijanmanaḥ  |
sāgarasya taṭaṃ tyaktvā gatvā tasya samīpataḥ  || 50.41 ||
tasthau sa nṛpatiśreṣṭho vṛkṣacchāye suśītale  |
tatastasmai sa viśvātmā dadāvājñāṃ dvijākṛtiḥ  || 50.42 ||
śilpimukhyāya viprendrāḥ kuruṣva pratimā iti  |
kṛṣṇarūpaṃ paraṃ śāntaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam  || 50.43 ||
śrīvatsakaustubhadharaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam  |
gaurāṅgaṃ kṣīravarṇābhaṃ dvitīyaṃ svastikāṅkitam  || 50.44 ||
lāṅgalāstradharaṃ devamanantākhyaṃ mahābalam  |
devadānavagandharva yakṣavidyādharoragaiḥ  || 50.45 ||
na vijñāto hi tasyāntastenānanta iti smṛtaḥ  |
bhaginīṃ vāsudevasya rukmavarṇāṃ suśobhanām  || 50.46 ||
tṛtīyāṃ vai subhadrāṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām  ||* 50.47 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvaitadvacanaṃ tasya viśvakarmā sukarmakṛt |
tatkṣaṇātkārayāmāsa pratimāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ  || 50.48 ||
prathamaṃ śuklavarṇābhaṃ śāradendusamaprabham  |
āraktākṣaṃ mahākāyaṃ sphaṭāvikaṭamastakam  || 50.49 ||
nīlāmbaradharaṃ cograṃ balaṃ balamadoddhatam  |
kuṇḍalaikadharaṃ divyaṃ gadāmuśaladhāriṇam  || 50.50 ||
dvitīyaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ nīlajīmūtasaṃnibham  |
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam  || 50.51 ||
pītavāsasamatyugraṃ śubhaṃ śrīvatsalakṣaṇam  |
cakrapūrṇakaraṃ divyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ harim  || 50.52 ||
tṛtīyāṃ svarṇavarṇābhāṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇām  |
vicitravastrasaṃchannāṃ hārakeyūrabhūṣitām  || 50.53 ||
vicitrābharaṇopetāṃ ratnahārāvalambitām  |
pīnonnatakucāṃ ramyāṃ viśvakarmā vinirmame  || 50.54 ||
sa tu rājādbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇenaikena nirmitāḥ  |
divyavastrayugacchannā nānāratnairalaṃkṛtāḥ  || 50.55 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāḥ pratimāḥ sumanoharāḥ  |
vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 50.56 ||
{indradyumna uvāca̱ }
kiṃ devau samanuprāptau dvijarūpadharāvubhau  |
ubhau cādbhutakarmāṇau devavṛttāvamānuṣau  || 50.57 ||
devau vā mānuṣau vāpi yakṣavidyādharau yuvām  |
kiṃ nu brahmahṛṣīkeśau kiṃ vasū kimutāśvinau  || 50.58 ||
na vedmi satyasadbhāvau māyārūpeṇa saṃsthitau  |
yuvāṃ gato'smi śaraṇamātmā tu me prakāśyatām  || 50.59 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
nāhaṃ devo na yakṣo vā na daityo na ca devarāṭ |
na brahmā na ca rudro'haṃ viddhi māṃ puruṣottamam  || 51.1 ||
artihā sarvalokānāmanantabalapauruṣaḥ  |
ārādhanīyo bhūtānāmanto yasya na vidyate  || 51.2 ||
paṭhyate sarvaśāstreṣu vedānteṣu nigadyate  |
yamāhurjñānagamyeti vāsudeveti yoginaḥ  || 51.3 ||
ahameva svayaṃ brahmā ahaṃ viṣṇuḥ śivo'pyaham  |
indro'haṃ devarājaśca jagatsaṃyamano yamaḥ  || 51.4 ||
pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni tretāgnirhutabhuṅnṛpa  |
varuṇo'pāṃ patiścāhaṃ dharitrī ca mahīdharaḥ  || 51.5 ||
yatkiṃcidvāṅmayaṃ loke jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam  |
carācaraṃ ca yadviśvaṃ madanyannāsti kiṃcana  || 51.6 ||
prīto'haṃ te nṛpaśreṣṭha varaṃ varaya suvrata  |
yadiṣṭaṃ tatprayacchāmi hṛdi yatte vyavasthitam  || 51.7 ||
maddarśanamapuṇyānāṃ svapnānte'pi na jāyate  |
tvaṃ punardṛḍhabhaktitvātpratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi  || 51.8 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvaivaṃ vāsudevasya vacanaṃ tasya bho dvijāḥ  |
romāñcitatanurbhūtvā idaṃ stotraṃ jagau nṛpaḥ  || 51.9 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
śriyaḥ kānta namaste'stu śrīpate pītavāsase  |
śrīda śrīśa śrīnivāsa namaste śrīniketana  || 51.10 ||
ādyaṃ puruṣamīśānaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvatomukham  |
niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ praṇato'smi sanātanam  || 51.11 ||
śabdātītaṃ guṇātītaṃ bhāvābhāvavivarjitam  |
nirlepaṃ nirguṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvabhāvanam  || 51.12 ||
prāvṛṇmeghapratīkāśaṃ gobrāhmaṇahite ratam  |
sarveṣāmeva goptāraṃ vyāpinaṃ sarvabhāvinam  || 51.13 ||
śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ gadāmuśaladhāriṇam  |
namasye varadaṃ devaṃ nīlotpaladalacchavim  || 51.14 ||
nāgaparyaṅkaśayanaṃ kṣīrodārṇavaśāyinam  |
namasye'haṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ harim  || 51.15 ||
punastvāṃ devadeveśaṃ namasye varadaṃ vibhum  |
sarvalokeśvaraṃ viṣṇuṃ mokṣakāraṇamavyayam  || 51.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ stutvā tu taṃ devaṃ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā nipatya dharaṇītale  || 51.17 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
prīto'si yadi me nātha vṛṇomi varamuttamam  |
devāsurāḥ sagandharvā yakṣarakṣomahoragāḥ  || 51.18 ||
siddhavidyādharāḥ sādhyāḥ kiṃnarā guhyakāstathā  |
ṛṣayo ye mahābhāgā nānāśāstraviśāradāḥ  || 51.19 ||
parivrāḍyogayuktāśca vedatattvārthacintakāḥ  |
mokṣamārgavido ye'nye dhyāyanti paramaṃ padam  || 51.20 ||
nirguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ śāntaṃ yatpaśyanti manīṣinaḥ  |
tatpadaṃ gantumicchāmi tvatprasādātsudurlabham  || 51.21 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
sarvaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ sarvamāpnuhi  |
bhaviṣyati yathākāmaṃ matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ  || 51.22 ||
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi tathā nava śatāni ca  |
avicchinnaṃ mahārājyaṃ kuru tvaṃ nṛpasattama  || 51.23 ||
prayāsyasi padaṃ divyaṃ durlabhaṃ yatsurāsuraiḥ  |
pūrṇamanorathaṃ śāntaṃ guhyamavyaktamavyayam  || 51.24 ||
parātparataraṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirlepaṃ niṣkalaṃ dhruvam  |
cintāśokavinirmuktaṃ kriyākāraṇavarjitam  || 51.25 ||
tadahaṃ darśayiṣyāmi jñeyākhyaṃ paramaṃ padam  |
yaṃ prāpya paramānandaṃ prāpsyasi paramāṃ gatim  || 51.26 ||
kīrtiśca tava rājendra bhavatyatra mahītale  |
yāvadghanā nabho yāvadyāvaccandrārkatārakam  || 51.27 ||
yāvatsamudrāḥ saptaiva yāvanmervādiparvatāḥ  |
tiṣṭhanti divi devāśca tāvatsarvatra cāvyayā  || 51.28 ||
indradyumnasaro nāma tīrthaṃ yajñāṅgasaṃbhavam  |
yatra snātvā sakṛllokaḥ śakralokamavāpnuyāt || 51.29 ||
dāpayiṣyati yaḥ piṇḍāṃstaṭe'smin sarasaḥ śubhe  |
kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya śakralokaṃ gamiṣyati  || 51.30 ||
pūjyamāno'psarobhiśca gandharvairgītanisvanaiḥ  |
vimānena vasettatra yāvadindrāścaturdaśa  || 51.31 ||
saraso dakṣiṇe bhāge nairṛtyāṃ tu samāśrite  |
nyagrodhastiṣṭhate tatra tatsamīpe tu maṇḍapaḥ  || 51.32 ||
ketakīvanasaṃchanno nānāpādapasaṃkulaḥ  |
nārikelairasaṃkhyeyaiścampakairbakulāvṛtaiḥ  || 51.33 ||
aśokaiḥ karṇikāraiśca puṃnāgairnāgakesaraiḥ  |
pāṭalāmrātasaralaiścandanairdevadārubhiḥ  || 51.34 ||
nyagrodhāśvatthakhadiraiḥ pārijātaiḥ sahārjunaiḥ  |
hintālaiścaiva tālaiśca śiṃśapairbadaraistathā  || 51.35 ||
karañjairlakucaiḥ plakṣaiḥ panasairbilvadhātukaiḥ  |
anyairbahuvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ śobhitaḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ  || 51.36 ||
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ pitṛdaivate  |
ṛkṣe neṣyanti nastatra nītvā sapta dināni vai  || 51.37 ||
maṇḍape sthāpayiṣyanti suveśyābhiḥ suśobhanaiḥ  |
krīḍāviśeṣabahulairnṛtyagītamanoharaiḥ  || 51.38 ||
cāmaraiḥ svarṇadaṇḍaiśca vyajanai ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ  |
vījayantastathāsmabhyaṃ sthāpayiṣyanti maṅgalāḥ  || 51.39 ||
brahmacārī yatiścaiva snātakāśca dvijottamāḥ  |
vānaprasthā gṛhasthāśca siddhāścānye ca brāhmaṇāḥ  || 51.40 ||
nānāvarṇapadaiḥ stotrairṛgyajuḥsāmanisvanaiḥ  |
kariṣyanti stutiṃ rājan rāmakeśavayoḥ punaḥ  || 51.41 ||
tataḥ stutvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca saṃpraṇamya ca bhaktitaḥ  |
naro varṣāyutaṃ divyaṃ śrīmaddharipure vaset || 51.42 ||
pūjyamāno'psarobhiśca gandharvairgītanisvanaiḥ  |
hareranucarastatra krīḍate keśavena vai  || 51.43 ||
vimānenārkavarṇena ratnahāreṇa bhrājatā  |
sarvakāmairmahābhogaistiṣṭhate bhuvanottame  || 51.44 ||
tapaḥkṣayādihāgatya manuṣyo brāhmaṇo bhavet |
koṭīdhanapatiḥ śrīmāṃścaturvedī bhaveddhruvam  || 51.45 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ tasmai varaṃ dattvā kṛtvā ca samayaṃ hariḥ  |
jagāmādarśanaṃ viprāḥ sahito viśvakarmaṇā  || 51.46 ||
sa tu rājā tadā hṛṣṭo romāñcitatanūruhaḥ  |
kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mene saṃdarśanāddhareḥ  || 51.47 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca varapradām  |
rathairvimānasaṃkāśairmaṇikāñcanacitritaiḥ  || 51.48 ||
saṃvāhya tāstadā rājā mahāmaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ  |
ānayāmāsa matimān sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ  || 51.49 ||
nānāvāditranirghoṣairnānāvedasvanaiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
saṃsthāpya ca śubhe deśe pavitre sumanohare  || 51.50 ||
tataḥ śubhatithau kāle nakṣatre śubhalakṣaṇe  |
pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayāmāsa sumuhūrte dvijaiḥ saha  || 51.51 ||
yathoktena vidhānena vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā  |
ācāryānumatenaiva sarvaṃ kṛtvā mahīpatiḥ  || 51.52 ||
ācāryāya tadā dattvā dakṣiṇāṃ vidhivatprabhuḥ  |
ṛtvigbhyaśca vidhānena tathānyebhyo dhanaṃ dadau  || 51.53 ||
kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivatprāsāde bhavanottame  |
sthāpayāmāsa tān sarvān vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā  || 51.54 ||
tataḥ saṃpūjya vidhinā nānāpuṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ  |
suvarṇamaṇimuktādyairnānāvastraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ  || 51.55 ||
ratnaiśca vividhairdivyairāsanairgrāmapattanaiḥ  |
dadau cānyān sa viṣayān purāṇi nagarāṇi ca  || 51.56 ||
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dattvā rājyaṃ kṛtvā yathocitam  |
iṣṭvā ca vividhairyajñairdattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ  || 51.57 ||
kṛtakṛtyastato rājā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ  |
jagāma paramaṃ sthānaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam  || 51.58 ||
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhāḥ kathito vo nṛpottamaḥ  |
kṣetrasya caiva māhātmyaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchatha  || 51.59 ||
{viṣṇuruvāca̱ }
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasya brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ  |
āścaryaṃ menire viprāḥ papracchuśca punarmudā  || 51.60 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kasmin kāle suraśreṣṭha gantavyaṃ puruṣottamam  |
vidhinā kena kartavyaṃ pañcatīrthamiti prabho  || 51.61 ||
ekaikasya ca tīrthasya snānadānasya yatphalam  |
devatāprekṣaṇe caiva brūhi sarvaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 51.62 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
nirāhāraḥ kurukṣetre pādenaikena yastapet |
jitendriyo jitakrodhaḥ saptasaṃvatsarāyutam  || 51.63 ||
dṛṣṭvā sadā jyeṣṭhaśukla dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamam  |
kṛtopavāsaḥ prāpnoti tato'dhikataraṃ phalam  || 51.64 ||
tasmājjyeṣṭhe muniśreṣṭhāḥ prayatnena susaṃyataiḥ  |
svargalokepsuviprādyairdraṣṭavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ  || 51.65 ||
pañcatīrthaṃ tu vidhivatkṛtvā jyeṣṭhe narottamaḥ  |
śuklapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ paśyettaṃ puruṣottamam  || 51.66 ||
ye paśyantyavyayaṃ devaṃ dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamam  |
te viṣṇulokamāsādya na cyavante kadācana  || 51.67 ||
tasmājjyeṣṭhe prayatnena gantavyaṃ bho dvijottamāḥ  |
kṛtvā tasmin pañcatīrthaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ  || 51.68 ||
sudūrastho'pi yo bhaktyā kīrtayetpuruṣottamam  |
ahanyahani śuddhātmā so'pi viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet || 51.69 ||
yātrāṃ karoti kṛṣṇasya śraddhayā yaḥ samāhitaḥ  |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ vrajennaraḥ  || 51.70 ||
cakraṃ dṛṣṭvā harerdūrātprāsādopari saṃsthitam  |
sahasā mucyate pāpānnaro bhaktyā praṇamya tat || 51.71 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
āsītkalpe muniśreṣṭhāḥ saṃpravṛtte mahākṣaye  |
naṣṭe'rkacandre pavane naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame  || 52.1 ||
udite pralayāditye pracaṇḍe ghanagarjite  |
vidyudutpātasaṃghātaiḥ saṃbhagne taruparvate  || 52.2 ||
loke ca saṃhṛte sarve mahadulkānibarhaṇe  |
śuṣkeṣu sarvatoyeṣu saraḥsu ca saritsu ca  || 52.3 ||
tataḥ saṃvartako vahnirvāyunā saha bho dvijāḥ  |
lokaṃ tu prāviśatsarvamādityairupaśobhitam  || 52.4 ||
paścātsa pṛthivīṃ bhittvā praviśya ca rasātalam  |
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ bhayaṃ janayate mahat || 52.5 ||
nirdahannāgalokaṃ ca yacca kiṃcitkṣitāviha  |
adhastānmuniśārdūlāḥ sarvaṃ nāśayate kṣaṇāt || 52.6 ||
tato yojanaviṃśānāṃ sahasrāṇi śatāni ca  |
nirdahatyāśugo vāyuḥ sa ca saṃvartako'nalaḥ  || 52.7 ||
sadevāsuragandharvaṃ sayakṣoragarākṣasam  |
tato dahati saṃdīptaḥ sarvameva jagatprabhuḥ  || 52.8 ||
pradīpto'sau mahāraudraḥ kalpāgniriti saṃśrutaḥ  |
mahājvālo mahārciṣmān saṃpradīptamahāsvanaḥ  || 52.9 ||
sūryakoṭipratīkāśo jvalanniva sa tejasā  |
trailokyaṃ cādahattūrṇaṃ sasurāsuramānuṣam  || 52.10 ||
evaṃvidhe mahāghore mahāpralayadāruṇe  |
ṛṣiḥ paramadharmātmā dhyānayogaparo'bhavat || 52.11 ||
ekaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate viprā mārkaṇḍeyeti viśrutaḥ  |
mohapāśairnibaddho'sau kṣuttṛṣṇākulitendriyāḥ  || 52.12 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā taṃ mahāvahniṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ  |
tṛṣṇārtaḥ praskhalan viprāstadāsau bhayavihvalaḥ  || 52.13 ||
babhrāma pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ kāṃdiśīko vicetanaḥ  |
trātāraṃ nādhigacchan vai itaścetaśca dhāvati  || 52.14 ||
na lebhe ca tadā śarma yatra viśrāmyatā dvijāḥ  |
karomi kiṃ na jānāmi yasyāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje  || 52.15 ||
kathaṃ paśyāmi taṃ devaṃ puruṣeśaṃ sanātanam  |
iti saṃcintayan devamekāgreṇa sanātanam  || 52.16 ||
prāptavāṃstatpadaṃ divyaṃ mahāpralayakāraṇam  |
puruṣeśamiti khyātaṃ vaṭarājaṃ sanātanam  || 52.17 ||
tvarāyukto muniścāsau nyagrodhasyāntikaṃ yayau  |
āsādya taṃ muniśreṣṭhāstasya mūle samāviśat || 52.18 ||
na kālāgnibhayaṃ tatra na cāṅgārapravarṣaṇam  |
na saṃvartāgamastatra na ca vajrāśanistathā  || 52.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato gajakulaprakhyāstaḍinmālāvibhūṣitāḥ  |
samuttasthurmahāmeghā nabhasyadbhutadarśanāḥ  || 53.1 ||
kecinnīlotpalaśyāmāḥ kecitkumudasaṃnibhāḥ  |
kecitkiñjalkasaṃkāśāḥ kecitpītāḥ payodharāḥ  || 53.2 ||
keciddharitasaṃkāśāḥ kākāṇḍasaṃnibhāstathā  |
kecitkamalapattrābhāḥ keciddhiṅgulasaṃnibhāḥ  || 53.3 ||
kecitpuravarākārāḥ kecidgirivaropamāḥ  |
kecidañjanasaṃkāśāḥ kecinmarakataprabhāḥ  || 53.4 ||
vidyunmālāpinaddhāṅgāḥ samuttasthurmahāghanāḥ  |
ghorarūpā mahābhāgā ghorasvananināditāḥ  || 53.5 ||
tato jaladharāḥ sarve samāvṛṇvannabhastalam  |
tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saparvatavanākarā  || 53.6 ||
āpūritā diśaḥ sarvāḥ salilaughapariplutāḥ  |
tataste jaladā ghorā vāriṇā munisattamāḥ  || 53.7 ||
sarvataḥ plāvayāmāsuścoditāḥ parameṣṭhinā  |
varṣamāṇā mahātoyaṃ pūrayanto vasuṃdharām  || 53.8 ||
sughoramaśivaṃ raudraṃ nāśayanti sma pāvakam  |
tato dvādaśa varṣāṇi payodāḥ samupaplave  || 53.9 ||
dhārābhiḥ pūrayanto vai codyamānā mahātmanā  |
tataḥ samudrāḥ svāṃ velāmatikrāmanti bho dvijāḥ  || 53.10 ||
parvatāśca vyaśīryanta mahī cāpsu nimajjati  |
sarvataḥ sumahābhrāntāste payodā nabhastalam  || 53.11 ||
saṃveṣṭayitvā naśyanti vāyuvegasamāhatāḥ  |
tatastaṃ mārutaṃ ghoraṃ sa viṣṇurmunisattamāḥ  || 53.12 ||
ādipadmālayo devaḥ pītvā svapiti bho dvijāḥ  |
tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame  || 53.13 ||
naṣṭe devāsuranare yakṣarākṣasavarjite  |
tato muniḥ sa viśrānto dhyātvā ca puruṣottamam  || 53.14 ||
dadarśa cakṣurunmīlya jalapūrṇāṃ vasuṃdharām  |
nāpaśyattaṃ vaṭaṃ norvīṃ na digādi na bhāskaram  || 53.15 ||
na candrārkāgnipavanaṃ na devāsurapannagam  |
tasminnekārṇave ghore tamobhūte nirāśraye  || 53.16 ||
nimajjan sa tadā viprāḥ saṃtartumupacakrame  |
babhrāmāsau muniścārta itaścetaśca saṃplavan  || 53.17 ||
nimamajja tadā viprāstrātāraṃ nādhigacchati  |
evaṃ taṃ vihvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayā puruṣottamaḥ  |
provāca muniśārdūlāstadā dhyānena toṣitaḥ  || 53.18 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
vatsa śrānto'si bālastvaṃ bhaktatra mama suvrata  |
āgacchāgaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ mārkaṇḍeya mamāntikam  || 53.19 ||
mā tvayaiva ca bhetavyaṃ saṃprāpto'si mamāgrataḥ  |
mārkaṇḍeya mune dhīra bālastvaṃ śramapīḍitaḥ  || 53.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā muniḥ paramakopitaḥ  |
uvāca sa tadā viprā vismitaścābhavanmuhuḥ  || 53.21 ||
{mārkaṇḍeya uvāca̱ }
ko'yaṃ nāmnā kīrtayati tapaḥ paribhavanniva  |
bahuvarṣasahasrākhyaṃ dharṣayanniva me vapuḥ  || 53.22 ||
na hyeṣa samudācāro deveṣvapi samāhitaḥ  |
māṃ brahmā sa ca deveśo dīrghāyuriti bhāṣate  || 53.23 ||
kastapo ghoraśiraso mamādya tyaktajīvitaḥ  |
mārkaṇḍeyeti coktvā manmṛtyuṃ gantumihecchati  || 53.24 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tadā viprāścintāviṣṭo'bhavanmuniḥ  |
kiṃ svapno'yaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kiṃ vā moho'yamāgataḥ  || 53.25 ||
itthaṃ cintayatastasya utpannā duḥkhahā matiḥ  |
vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ devaṃ bhaktyāhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 53.26 ||
sa gatvā śaraṇaṃ devaṃ munistadgatamānasaḥ  |
dadarśa taṃ vaṭaṃ bhūyo viśālaṃ salilopari  || 53.27 ||
śākhāyāṃ tasya sauvarṇaṃ vistīrṇāyāṃ mahādbhutam  |
ruciraṃ divyaparyaṅkaṃ racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā  || 53.28 ||
vajravaidūryaracitaṃ maṇividrumaśobhitam  |
padmarāgādibhirjuṣṭaṃ ratnairanyairalaṃkṛtam  || 53.29 ||
nānāstaraṇasaṃvītaṃ nānāratnopaśobhitam  |
nānāścaryasamāyuktaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam  || 53.30 ||
tasyopari sthitaṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālavapurdharam  |
sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ dīpyamānaṃ suvarcasam  || 53.31 ||
caturbhujaṃ sundarāṅgaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam  |
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam  || 53.32 ||
vanamālāvṛtoraskaṃ divyakuṇḍaladhāriṇam  |
hārabhārārpitagrīvaṃ divyaratnavibhūṣitam  || 53.33 ||
dṛṣṭvā tadā munirdevaṃ vismayotphullalocanaḥ  |
romāñcitatanurdevaṃ praṇipatyedamabravīt || 53.34 ||
{mārkaṇḍeya uvāca̱ }
aho caikārṇave ghore vinaṣṭe sacarācare  |
kathameko hyayaṃ bālastiṣṭhatyatra sunirbhayaḥ  || 53.35 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca jānannapi mahāmuniḥ  |
na bubodha tadā devaṃ māyayā tasya mohitaḥ  |
yadā na bubudhe cainaṃ tadā khedāduvāca ha  || 53.36 ||
{mārkaṇḍeya uvāca̱ }
vṛthā me tapaso vīryaṃ vṛthā jñānaṃ vṛthā kriyā  |
vṛthā me jīvitaṃ dīrghaṃ vṛthā mānuṣyameva ca  || 53.37 ||
yo'haṃ suptaṃ na jānāmi paryaṅke divyabālakam  ||* 53.38 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ saṃcintayan vipraḥ plavamāno vicetanaḥ  |
trāṇārthaṃ vihvalaścāsau nirvedaṃ gatavāṃstadā  || 53.39 ||
tato bālārkasaṃkāśaṃ svamahimnā vyavasthitam  |
sarvatejomayaṃ viprā na śaśākābhivīkṣitum  || 53.40 ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ munimāyāntaṃ sa bālaḥ prahasanniva  |
provāca muniśārdūlāstadā meghaughanisvanaḥ  || 53.41 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
vatsa jānāmi śrāntaṃ tvāṃ trāṇārthaṃ māmupasthitam  |
śarīraṃ viśa me kṣipraṃ viśrāmaste mayoditaḥ  || 53.42 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvā sa vacanaṃ tasya kiṃcinnovāca mohitaḥ  |
viveśa vadanaṃ tasya vivṛtaṃ cāvaśo muniḥ  || 53.43 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa praviśyodare tasya bālasya munisattamaḥ  |
dadarśa pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ nānājanapadairvṛtām  || 54.1 ||
lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalodadhīn  |
dadarśa tān samudrāṃśca jambu plakṣaṃ ca śālmalam  || 54.2 ||
kuśaṃ krauñcaṃ ca śākaṃ ca puṣkaraṃ ca dadarśa saḥ  |
bhāratādīni varṣāṇi tathā sarvāṃśca parvatān  || 54.3 ||
meruṃ ca sarvaratnāḍhyaṃ apaśyatkanakācalam  |
nānāratnānvitaiḥ śṛṅgairbhūṣitaṃ bahukandaram  || 54.4 ||
nānāmunijanākīrṇaṃ nānāvṛkṣavanākulam  |
nānāsattvasamāyuktaṃ nānāścaryasamanvitam  || 54.5 ||
vyāghraiḥ siṃhairvarāhaiśca cāmarairmahiṣairgajaiḥ  |
mṛgaiḥ śākhāmṛgaiścānyairbhūṣitaṃ sumanoharam  || 54.6 ||
śakrādyairvividhairdevaiḥ siddhacāraṇapannagaiḥ  |
muniyakṣāpsarobhiśca vṛtaiścānyaiḥ surālayaiḥ  || 54.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ sumeruṃ śrīmantamapaśyanmunisattamaḥ  |
paryaṭan sa tadā viprastasya bālasya codare  || 54.8 ||
himavantaṃ hemakūṭaṃ niṣadhaṃ gandhamādanam  |
śvetaṃ ca durdharaṃ nīlaṃ kailāsaṃ mandaraṃ girim  || 54.9 ||
mahendraṃ malayaṃ vindhyaṃ pāriyātraṃ tathārbudam  |
sahyaṃ ca śuktimantaṃ ca mainākaṃ vakraparvatam  || 54.10 ||
etāścānyāśca bahavo yāvantaḥ pṛthivīdharāḥ  |
tatastāṃstu muniśreṣṭhāḥ so'paśyadratnabhūṣitān  || 54.11 ||
kurukṣetraṃ ca pāñcālānmatsyānmadrān sakekayān  |
bāhlīkān śūrasenāṃśca kāśmīrāṃstaṅgaṇān khasān  || 54.12 ||
pārvatīyān kirātāṃśca karṇaprāvaraṇānmarūn  |
antyajānantyajātīṃśca so'paśyattasya codare  || 54.13 ||
mṛgāñśākhāmṛgān siṃhān varāhān sṛmarāñśaśān  |
gajāṃścānyāṃstathā sattvān so'paśyattasya codare  || 54.14 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni grāmāśca nagarāṇi ca  |
kṛṣigorakṣavāṇijyaṃ krayavikrayaṇaṃ tathā  || 54.15 ||
śakrādīn vibudhāñśreṣṭhāṃstathānyāṃśca divaukasaḥ  |
gandharvāpsaraso yakṣānṛṣīṃścaiva sanātanān  || 54.16 ||
daityadānavasaṃghāṃśca nāgāṃśca munisattamāḥ  |
siṃhikātanayāṃścaiva ye cānye suraśatravaḥ  || 54.17 ||
yatkiṃcittena loke'smin dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ carācaram  |
apaśyatsa tadā sarvaṃ tasya kukṣau dvijottamāḥ  || 54.18 ||
athavā kiṃ bahūktena kīrtitena punaḥ punaḥ  |
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ yatkiṃcitsacarācaram  || 54.19 ||
bhūrlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  |
maharjanastapaḥ satyamatalaṃ vitalaṃ tathā  || 54.20 ||
pātālaṃ sutalaṃ caiva vitalaṃ ca rasātalam  |
mahātalaṃ ca brahmāṇḍamapaśyattasya codare  || 54.21 ||
avyāhatā gatistasya tadābhūddvijasattamāḥ  |
prasādāttasya devasya smṛtilopaśca nābhavat || 54.22 ||
bhramamāṇastadā kukṣau kṛtsnaṃ jagadidaṃ dvijāḥ  |
nāntaṃ jagāma dehasya tasya viṣṇoḥ kadācana  || 54.23 ||
yadāsau nāgataścāntaṃ tasya dehasya bho dvijāḥ  |
tadā taṃ varadaṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatavānmuniḥ  || 54.24 ||
tato'sau sahasā viprā vāyuvegena niḥsṛtaḥ  |
mahātmano mukhāttasya vivṛtātpuruṣasya saḥ  || 54.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa niṣkramyodarāttasya bālasya munisattamāḥ  |
punaścaikārṇavāmurvīmapaśyajjanavarjitām  || 55.1 ||
pūrvadṛṣṭaṃ ca taṃ devaṃ dadarśa śiśurūpiṇam  |
śākhāyāṃ vaṭavṛkṣasya paryaṅkopari saṃsthitam  || 55.2 ||
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ devaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam  |
jagadādāya tiṣṭhantaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam  || 55.3 ||
so'pi taṃ munimāyāntaṃ plavamānamacetanam  |
dṛṣṭvā mukhādviniṣkrāntaṃ provāca prahasanniva  || 55.4 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
kaccittvayoṣitaṃ vatsa viśrāntaṃ ca mamodare  |
bhramamāṇaśca kiṃ tatra āścaryaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi  || 55.5 ||
bhakto'si me muniśreṣṭha śrānto'si ca mamāśritaḥ  |
tena tvāmupakārāya saṃbhāṣe paśya māmiha  || 55.6 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvā sa vacanaṃ tasya saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ  |
dadarśa taṃ suduṣprekṣaṃ ratnairdivyairalaṃkṛtam  || 55.7 ||
prasannā nirmalā dṛṣṭirmuhūrtāttasya bho dvijāḥ  |
prasādāttasya devasya prādurbhūtā punarnavā  || 55.8 ||
raktāṅgulitalau pādau tatastasya surārcitau  |
praṇamya śirasā viprā harṣagadgadayā girā  || 55.9 ||
kṛtāñjalistadā hṛṣṭo vismitaśca punaḥ punaḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ paramātmānaṃ saṃstotumupacakrame  || 55.10 ||
{mārkaṇḍeya uvāca̱ }
devadeva jagannātha māyābālavapurdhara  |
trāhi māṃ cārupadmākṣa duḥkhitaṃ śaraṇāgatam  || 55.11 ||
saṃtapto'smi suraśreṣṭha saṃvartākhyena vahninā  |
aṅgāravarṣabhītaṃ ca trāhi māṃ puruṣottama  || 55.12 ||
śoṣitaśca pracaṇḍena vāyunā jagadāyunā  |
vihvalo'haṃ tathā śrāntastrāhi māṃ puruṣottama  || 55.13 ||
tāpitaśca taśāmātyaiḥ pralayāvartakādibhiḥ  |
na śāntimadhigacchāmi trāhi māṃ puruṣottama  || 55.14 ||
tṛṣitaśca kṣudhāviṣṭo duḥkhitaśca jagatpate  |
trātāraṃ nātra paśyāmi trāhi māṃ puruṣottama  || 55.15 ||
asminnekārṇave ghore vinaṣṭe sacarācare  |
na cāntamadhigacchāmi trāhi māṃ puruṣottama  || 55.16 ||
tavodare ca deveśa mayā dṛṣṭaṃ carācaram  |
vismito'haṃ viṣaṇṇaśca trāhi māṃ puruṣottama  || 55.17 ||
saṃsāre'sminnirālambe prasīda puruṣottama  |
prasīda vibudhaśreṣṭha prasīda vibudhapriya  || 55.18 ||
prasīda vibudhāṃ nātha prasīda vibudhālaya  |
prasīda sarvalokeśa jagatkāraṇakāraṇa  || 55.19 ||
prasīda sarvakṛddeva prasīda mama bhūdhara  |
prasīda salilāvāsa prasīda madhusūdana  || 55.20 ||
prasīda kamalākānta prasīda tridaśeśvara  |
prasīda kaṃsakeśīghna prasīdāriṣṭanāśana  || 55.21 ||
prasīda kṛṣṇa daityaghna prasīda danujāntaka  |
prasīda mathurāvāsa prasīda yadunandana  || 55.22 ||
prasīda śakrāvaraja prasīda varadāvyaya  |
tvaṃ mahī tvaṃ jalaṃ deva tvamagnistvaṃ samīraṇaḥ  || 55.23 ||
tvaṃ nabhastvaṃ manaścaiva tvamahaṃkāra eva ca  |
tvaṃ buddhiḥ prakṛtiścaiva sattvādyāstvaṃ jagatpate  || 55.24 ||
puruṣastvaṃ jagadvyāpī puruṣādapi cottamaḥ  |
tvamindriyāṇi sarvāṇi śabdādyā viṣayāḥ prabho  || 55.25 ||
tvaṃ dikpālāśca dharmāśca vedā yajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ  |
tvamindrastvaṃ śivo devastvaṃ havistvaṃ hutāśanaḥ  || 55.26 ||
tvaṃ yamaḥ pitṛrāṭdeva tvaṃ rakṣodhipatiḥ svayam  |
varuṇastvamapāṃ nātha tvaṃ vāyustvaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ  || 55.27 ||
tvamīśānastvamanantastvaṃ gaṇeśaśca ṣaṇmukhaḥ  |
vasavastvaṃ tathā rudrāstvamādityāśca khecarāḥ  || 55.28 ||
dānavāstvaṃ tathā yakṣāstvaṃ daityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ  |
siddhāścāpsaraso nāgā gandharvāstvaṃ sacāraṇāḥ  || 55.29 ||
pitaro vālakhilyāśca prajānāṃ patayo'cyuta  |
munayastvamṛṣigaṇāstvamaśvinau niśācarāḥ  || 55.30 ||
anyāśca jātayastvaṃ hi yatkiṃcijjīvasaṃjñitam  |
kiṃ cātra bahunoktena brahmādistambagocaram  || 55.31 ||
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca tvaṃ jagatsacarācaram  |
yatte rūpaṃ paraṃ deva kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvam  || 55.32 ||
brahmādyāstanna jānanti kathamanye'lpamedhasaḥ  |
deva śuddhasvabhāvo'si nityastvaṃ prakṛteḥ paraḥ  || 55.33 ||
avyaktaḥ śāśvato'nantaḥ sarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ  |
tvamākāśaḥ paraḥ śānto ajastvaṃ vibhuravyayaḥ  || 55.34 ||
evaṃ tvāṃ nirguṇaṃ stotuṃ kaḥ śaknoti nirañjanam  |
stuto'si yanmayā deva vikalenālpacetasā  |
tatsarvaṃ devadeveśa kṣantumarhasi cāvyaya  || 55.35 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
itthaṃ stutastadā tena mārkaṇḍeyena bho dvijāḥ  |
prītaḥ provāca bhagavānmeghagambhīrayā girā  || 56.1 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
brūhi kāmaṃ muniśreṣṭha yatte manasi vartate  |
dadāmi sarvaṃ viprarṣe matto yadabhivāñchasi  || 56.2 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvā sa vacanaṃ viprāḥ śiśostasya mahātmanaḥ  |
uvāca paramaprīto munistadgatamānasaḥ  || 56.3 ||
{mārkaṇḍeya uvāca̱ }
jñātumicchāmi deva tvāṃ māyāṃ vai tava cottamām  |
tvatprasādācca deveśa smṛtirna parihīyate  || 56.4 ||
drutamantaḥ śarīreṇa satataṃ paryavartitam  |
icchāmi puṇḍarīkākṣa jñātuṃ tvāmahamavyayam  || 56.5 ||
iha bhūtvā śiśuḥ sākṣātkiṃ bhavānavatiṣṭhate  |
pītvā jagadidaṃ sarvametadākhyātumarhasi  || 56.6 ||
kimarthaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ śarīrasthaṃ tavānagha  |
kiyantaṃ ca tvayā kālamiha stheyamariṃdama  || 56.7 ||
jñātumicchāmi deveśa brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ  |
tvattaḥ kamalapattrākṣa vistareṇa yathātatham  |
mahadetadacintyaṃ ca yadahaṃ dṛṣṭavān prabho  || 56.8 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena devadevo mahādyutiḥ  |
sāntvayan sa tadā vākyamuvāca vadatāṃ varaḥ  || 56.9 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
kāmaṃ devāśca māṃ vipra nahi jānanti tattvataḥ  |
tava prītyā pravakṣyāmi yathedaṃ visṛjāmyaham  || 56.10 ||
pitṛbhakto'si viprarṣe māmeva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ  |
tato dṛṣṭo'smi te sākṣādbrahmacaryaṃ ca te mahat || 56.11 ||
āpo nārā iti purā saṃjñākarma kṛtaṃ mayā  |
tena nārāyaṇo'smyukto mama tāstvayanaṃ sadā  || 56.12 ||
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo nāma prabhavaḥ śāśvato'vyayaḥ  |
vidhātā sarvabhūtānāṃ saṃhartā ca dvijottama  || 56.13 ||
ahaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ brahmā śakraścāpi surādhipaḥ  |
ahaṃ vaiśravaṇo rājā yamaḥ pretādhipastathā  || 56.14 ||
ahaṃ śivaśca somaśca kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ  |
ahaṃ dhātā vidhātā ca yajñaścāhaṃ dvijottama  || 56.15 ||
agnirāsyaṃ kṣitiḥ pādau candrādityau ca locane  |
dyaurmūrdhā khaṃ diśaḥ śrotre tathāpaḥ svedasaṃbhavāḥ  || 56.16 ||
sadiśaṃ ca nabhaḥ kāyo vāyurmanasi me sthitaḥ  |
mayā kratuśatairiṣṭaṃ bahubhiścāptadakṣiṇaiḥ  || 56.17 ||
yajante vedaviduṣo māṃ devayajane sthitam  |
pṛthivyāṃ kṣatriyendrāśca pārthivāḥ svargakāṅkṣiṇaḥ  || 56.18 ||
yajante māṃ tathā vaiśyāḥ svargalokajigīṣavaḥ  |
catuḥsamudraparyantāṃ merumandarabhūṣaṇām  || 56.19 ||
śeṣo bhūtvāhameko hi dhārayāmi vasuṃdharām  |
vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya mameyaṃ jagatī purā  || 56.20 ||
majjamānā jale vipra vīryeṇāsmi samuddhṛtā  |
agniśca vāḍavo vipra bhūtvāhaṃ dvijasattama  || 56.21 ||
pibāmyapaḥ samāviṣṭastāścaiva visṛjāmyaham  |
brahma vaktraṃ bhujau kṣatramūrū me saṃśritā viśaḥ  || 56.22 ||
pādau śūdrā bhavantīme vikrameṇa krameṇa ca  |
ṛgvedaḥ sāmavedaśca yajurvedastvatharvaṇaḥ  || 56.23 ||
mattaḥ prādurbhavantyete māmeva praviśanti ca  |
yatayaḥ śāntiparamā yatātmāno bubhutsavaḥ  || 56.24 ||
kāmakrodhadveṣamuktā niḥsaṅgā vītakalmaṣāḥ  |
sattvasthā nirahaṃkārā nityamadhyātmakovidāḥ  || 56.25 ||
māmeva satataṃ viprāścintayanta upāsate  |
ahaṃ saṃvartako jyotirahaṃ saṃvartako'nalaḥ  || 56.26 ||
ahaṃ saṃvartakaḥ sūryastvahaṃ saṃvartako'nilaḥ  |
tārārūpāṇi dṛśyante yānyetāni nabhastale  || 56.27 ||
mama vai romakūpāṇi viddhi tvaṃ dvijasattama  |
ratnākarāḥ samudrāśca sarva eva caturdiśaḥ  || 56.28 ||
vasanaṃ śayanaṃ caiva nilayaṃ caiva viddhi me  |
kāmaḥ krodhaśca harṣaśca bhayaṃ mohastathaiva ca  || 56.29 ||
mamaiva viddhi rūpāṇi sarvāṇyetāni sattama  |
prāpnuvanti narā vipra yatkṛtvā karma śobhanam  || 56.30 ||
satyaṃ dānaṃ tapaścogramahiṃsāṃ sarvajantuṣu  |
madvidhānena vihitā mama dehavicāriṇaḥ  || 56.31 ||
mayābhibhūtavijñānāśceṣṭayanti na kāmataḥ  |
samyagvedamadhīyānā yajanto vividhairmakhaiḥ  || 56.32 ||
śāntātmāno jitakrodhāḥ prāpnuvanti dvijātayaḥ  |
prāptuṃ śakyo na caivāhaṃ narairduṣkṛtakarmabhiḥ  || 56.33 ||
lobhābhibhūtaiḥ kṛpaṇairanāryairakṛtātmabhiḥ  |
tanmāṃ mahāphalaṃ viddhi narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām  || 56.34 ||
suduṣprāpaṃ vimūḍhānāṃ māṃ kuyoganiṣeviṇām  |
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati sattama  || 56.35 ||
abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham  |
daityā hiṃsānuraktāśca avadhyāḥ surasattamaiḥ  || 56.36 ||
rākṣasāścāpi loke'smin yadotpatsyanti dāruṇāḥ  |
tadāhaṃ saṃprasūyāmi gṛheṣu puṇyakarmaṇām  || 56.37 ||
praviṣṭo mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ sarvaṃ praśamayāmyaham  |
sṛṣṭvā devamanuṣyāṃśca gandharvoragarākṣasān  || 56.38 ||
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni saṃharāmyātmamāyayā  |
karmakāle punardehamanucintya sṛjāmyaham  || 56.39 ||
āviśya mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ maryādābandhakāraṇāt |
śvetaḥ kṛtayuge dharmaḥ śyāmastretāyuge mama  || 56.40 ||
rakto dvāparamāsādya kṛṣṇaḥ kaliyuge tathā  |
trayo bhāgā hyadharmasya tasmin kāle bhavanti ca  || 56.41 ||
antakāle ca saṃprāpte kālo bhūtvātidāruṇaḥ  |
trailokyaṃ nāśayāmyekaḥ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam  || 56.42 ||
ahaṃ tridharmā viśvātmā sarvalokasukhāvahaḥ  |
abhinnaḥ sarvago'nanto hṛṣīkeśa urukramaḥ  || 56.43 ||
kālacakraṃ nayāmyeko brahmarūpaṃ mamaiva tat |
śamanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtakṛtodyamam  || 56.44 ||
evaṃ praṇihitaḥ samyaṅmamātmā munisattama  |
sarvabhūteṣu viprendra na ca māṃ vetti kaścana  || 56.45 ||
sarvaloke ca māṃ bhaktāḥ pūjayanti ca sarvaśaḥ  |
yacca kiṃcittvayā prāptaṃ mayi kleśātmakaṃ dvija  || 56.46 ||
sukhodayāya tatsarvaṃ śreyase ca tavānagha  |
yacca kiṃcittvayā loke dṛṣṭaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam  || 56.47 ||
vihitaḥ sarva evāsau mayātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ  |
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo nāma śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  || 56.48 ||
yāvadyugānāṃ viprarṣe sahasraṃ parivartate  |
tāvatsvapimi viśvātmā sarvaviśvāni mohayan  || 56.49 ||
evaṃ sarvamahaṃ kālamihāse munisattama  |
aśiśuḥ śiśurūpeṇa yāvadbrahmā na budhyate  || 56.50 ||
mayā ca datto viprendra varaste brahmarūpiṇā  |
asakṛtparituṣṭena viprarṣigaṇapūjita  || 56.51 ||
sarvamekārṇavaṃ kṛtvā naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame  |
nirgato'si mayājñātastataste darśitaṃ jagat || 56.52 ||
abhyantaraṃ śarīrasya praviṣṭo'si yadā mama  |
dṛṣṭvā lokaṃ samastaṃ hi vismito nāvabudhyase  || 56.53 ||
tato'si vaktrādviprarṣe drutaṃ niḥsārito mayā  |
ākhyātaste mayā cātmā durjñeyo hi surāsuraiḥ  || 56.54 ||
yāvatsa bhagavān brahmā na budhyeta mahātapāḥ  |
tāvattvamiha viprarṣe viśrabdhaścara vai sukham  || 56.55 ||
tato vibuddhe tasmiṃstu sarvalokapitāmahe  |
eko bhūtāni srakṣyāmi śarīrāṇi dvijottama  || 56.56 ||
ākāśaṃ pṛthivīṃ jyotirvāyuḥ salilameva ca  |
loke yacca bhavetkiṃcidiha sthāvarajaṅgamam  || 56.57 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tadā viprāḥ punastaṃ prāha mādhavaḥ  |
pūrṇe yugasahasre tu meghagambhīranisvanaḥ  || 56.58 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
mune brūhi yadarthaṃ māṃ stutavān paramārthataḥ  |
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva yacchreṣṭhaṃ dadāmi nacirādaham  || 56.59 ||
āyuṣmānasi devānāṃ madbhakto'si dṛḍhavrataḥ  |
tena tvamasi viprendra punardīrghāyurāpnuhi  || 56.60 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvā vāṇīṃ śubhāṃ tasya vilokya sa tadā punaḥ  |
mūrdhnā nipatya sahasā praṇamya punarabravīt || 56.61 ||
{mārkaṇḍeya uvāca̱ }
dṛṣṭaṃ paraṃ hi deveśa tava rūpaṃ dvijottama  |
moho'yaṃ vigataḥ satyaṃ tvayi dṛṣṭe tu me hare  || 56.62 ||
evamevamahaṃ nātha iccheyaṃ tvatprasādataḥ  |
lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya nānābhāvapraśāntaye  || 56.63 ||
śaivabhāgavatānāṃ ca vādārthapratiṣedhakam  |
asmin kṣetravare puṇye nirmale puruṣottame  || 56.64 ||
śivasyāyatanaṃ deva karomi paramaṃ mahat |
pratiṣṭheya tathā tatra tava sthāne ca śaṃkaram  || 56.65 ||
tato jñāsyanti loke'sminnekamūrtī harīśvarau  |
pratyuvāca jagannāthaḥ sa punastaṃ mahāmunim  || 56.66 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
yadetatparamaṃ devaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhuvaneśvaram  |
liṅgamārādhanārthāya nānābhāvapraśāntaye  || 56.67 ||
mamādiṣṭena viprendra kuru śīghraṃ śivālayam  |
tatprabhāvācchivaloke tiṣṭha tvaṃ ca tathākṣayam  || 56.68 ||
śive saṃsthāpite vipra mama saṃsthāpanaṃ bhavet |
nāvayorantaraṃ kiṃcidekabhāvau dvidhā kṛtau  || 56.69 ||
yo rudraḥ sa svayaṃ viṣṇuryo viṣṇuḥ sa maheśvaraḥ  |
ubhayorantaraṃ nāsti pavanākāśayoriva  || 56.70 ||
mohito nābhijānāti ya eva garuḍadhvajaḥ  |
vṛṣadhvajaḥ sa eveti tripuraghnaṃ trilocanam  || 56.71 ||
tava nāmāṅkitaṃ tasmātkuru vipra śivālayam  |
uttare devadevasya kuru tīrthaṃ suśobhanam  || 56.72 ||
mārkaṇḍeyahrado nāma naralokeṣu viśrutaḥ  |
bhaviṣyati dvijaśreṣṭha sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ  || 56.73 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā sa tadā devastatraivāntaradhīyata  |
mārkaṇḍeyaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvavyāpī janārdanaḥ  || 56.74 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pañcatīrthavidhiṃ dvijāḥ  |
yatphalaṃ snānadānena devatāprekṣaṇena ca  || 57.1 ||
mārkaṇḍeyahradaṃ gatvā naraścodaṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ  |
nimajjettatra vārāṃstrīnimaṃ mantramudīrayet || 57.2 ||
saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ pāpagrastamacetanam  |
trāhi māṃ bhaganetraghna tripurāre namo'stu te  || 57.3 ||
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya sarvapāpaharāya ca  |
snānaṃ karomi deveśa mama naśyatu pātakam  || 57.4 ||
nābhimātre jale snātvā vidhivaddevatā ṛṣīn  |
tilodakena matimān pitṝṃścānyāṃśca tarpayet || 57.5 ||
snātvā tathaiva cācamya tato gacchecchivālayam  |
praviśya devatāgāraṃ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam  || 57.6 ||
mūlamantreṇa saṃpūjya mārkaṇḍeyasya ceśvaram  |
aghoreṇa ca bho viprāḥ praṇipatya prasādayet || 57.7 ||
trilocana namaste'stu namaste śaśibhūṣaṇa  |
trāhi māṃ tvaṃ virūpākṣa mahādeva namo'stu te  || 57.8 ||
mārkaṇḍeyahrade tvevaṃ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca śaṃkaram  |
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ  || 57.9 ||
pāpaiḥ sarvairvinirmuktaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati  |
tatra bhuktvā varān bhogān yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  || 57.10 ||
ihalokaṃ samāsādya bhavedvipro bahuśrutaḥ  |
śāṃkaraṃ yogamāsādya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 57.11 ||
kalpavṛkṣaṃ tato gatvā kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam  |
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā mantreṇānena taṃ vaṭam  || 57.12 ||
oṃ namo vyaktarūpāya mahāpralayakāriṇe  |
mahadrasopaviṣṭāya nyagrodhāya namo'stu te  || 57.13 ||
amarastvaṃ sadā kalpe hareścāyatanaṃ vaṭa  |
nyagrodha hara me pāpaṃ kalpavṛkṣa namo'stu te  || 57.14 ||
bhaktyā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā natvā kalpavaṭaṃ naraḥ  |
sahasā mucyate pāpājjīrṇatvaca ivoragaḥ  || 57.15 ||
chāyāṃ tasya samākramya kalpavṛkṣasya bho dvijāḥ  |
brahmahatyāṃ naro jahyātpāpeṣvanyeṣu kā kathā  || 57.16 ||
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṅgasaṃbhūtaṃ brahmatejomayaṃ param  |
nyagrodhākṛtikaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇipatya ca bho dvijāḥ  || 57.17 ||
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam  |
tathā svavaṃśamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  || 57.18 ||
vainateyaṃ namaskṛtya kṛṣṇasya purataḥ sthitam  |
sarvapāpavinirmuktastato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet || 57.19 ||
dṛṣṭvā vaṭaṃ vainateyaṃ yaḥ paśyetpuruṣottamam  |
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim  || 57.20 ||
praviśyāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛtvā taṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇam  |
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ svamantreṇa bhaktyāpūjya prasādayet || 57.21 ||
namaste haladhṛgrāma namaste muśalāyudha  |
namaste revatīkānta namaste bhaktavatsala  || 57.22 ||
namaste balināṃ śreṣṭha namaste dharaṇīdhara  |
pralambāre namaste'stu trāhi māṃ kṛṣṇapūrvaja  || 57.23 ||
evaṃ prasādya cānantamajeyaṃ tridaśārcitam  |
kailāsaśikharākāraṃ candrātkāntatarānanam  || 57.24 ||
nīlavastradharaṃ devaṃ phaṇāvikaṭamastakam  |
mahābalaṃ haladharaṃ kuṇḍalaikavibhūṣitam  || 57.25 ||
rauhiṇeyaṃ naro bhaktyā labhedabhimataṃ phalam  |
sarvapāpairvinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  || 57.26 ||
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvadbhuktvā tatra sukhaṃ naraḥ  |
puṇyakṣayādihāgatya pravare yogināṃ kule  || 57.27 ||
brāhmaṇapravaro bhūtvā sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ  |
jñānaṃ tatra samāsādya muktiṃ prāpnoti durlabhām  || 57.28 ||
evamabhyarcya halinaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ  |
dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa pūjayetsusamāhitaḥ  || 57.29 ||
dviṣaṭkavarṇamantreṇa bhaktyā ye puruṣottamam  |
pūjayanti sadā dhīrāste mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti vai  || 57.30 ||
na tāṃ gatiṃ surā yānti yogino naiva somapāḥ  |
yāṃ gatiṃ yānti bho viprā dvādaśākṣaratatparāḥ  || 57.31 ||
tasmāttenaiva mantreṇa bhaktyā kṛṣṇaṃ jagadgurum  |
saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ praṇipatya prasādayet || 57.32 ||
jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya sarvāghanāśana  |
jaya cāṇūrakeśighna jaya kaṃsaniṣūdana  || 57.33 ||
jaya padmapalāśākṣa jaya cakragadādhara  |
jaya nīlāmbudaśyāma jaya sarvasukhaprada  || 57.34 ||
jaya deva jagatpūjya jaya saṃsāranāśana  |
jaya lokapate nātha jaya vāñchāphalaprada  || 57.35 ||
saṃsārasāgare ghore niḥsāre duḥkhaphenile  |
krodhagrāhākule raudre viṣayodakasaṃplave  || 57.36 ||
nānārogormikalile mohāvartasudustare  |
nimagno'haṃ suraśreṣṭha trāhi māṃ puruṣottama  || 57.37 ||
evaṃ prasādya deveśaṃ varadaṃ bhaktavatsalam  |
sarvapāpaharaṃ devaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam  || 57.38 ||
pīnāṃsaṃ dvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam  |
mahoraskaṃ mahābāhuṃ pītavastraṃ śubhānanam  || 57.39 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ mukuṭāṅgadabhūṣaṇam  |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam  || 57.40 ||
dṛṣṭvā naro'ñjaliṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca  |
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti vai dvijāḥ  || 57.41 ||
yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snāne dāne prakīrtitam  |
narastatphalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 57.42 ||
yatphalaṃ sarvaratnādyairiṣṭe bahusuvarṇake  |
narastatphalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 57.43 ||
yatphalaṃ sarvavedeṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam  |
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti naraḥ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 57.44 ||
yatphalaṃ sarvadānena vratena niyamena ca  |
narastatphalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 57.45 ||
tapobhirvividhairugrairyatphalaṃ samudāhṛtam  |
narastatphalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 57.46 ||
yatphalaṃ brahmacaryeṇa samyakcīrṇena tatkṛtam  |
narastatphalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 57.47 ||
yatphalaṃ ca gṛhasthasya yathoktācāravartinaḥ  |
narastatphalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 57.48 ||
yatphalaṃ vanavāsena vānaprasthasya kīrtitam  |
narastatphalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 57.49 ||
saṃnyāsena yathoktena yatphalaṃ samudāhṛtam  |
narastatphalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 57.50 ||
kiṃ cātra bahunoktena māhātmye tasya bho dvijāḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ naro bhaktyā mokṣaṃ prāpnoti durlabham  || 57.51 ||
pāpairvimuktaḥ śuddhātmā kalpakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ  |
śriyā paramayā yuktaḥ sarvaiḥ samudito guṇaiḥ  || 57.52 ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhena vimānena suvarcasā  |
trisaptakulamuddhṛtya naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet || 57.53 ||
tatra kalpaśataṃ yāvadbhuktvā bhogānmanoramān  |
gandharvāpsarasaiḥ sārdhaṃ yathā viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ  || 57.54 ||
cyutastasmādihāyāto viprāṇāṃ pravare kule  |
sarvajñaḥ sarvavedī ca jāyate gatamatsaraḥ  || 57.55 ||
svadharmanirataḥ śānto dātā bhūtahite rataḥ  |
āsādya vaiṣṇavaṃ jñānaṃ tato muktimavāpnuyāt || 57.56 ||
tataḥ saṃpūjya mantreṇa subhadrāṃ bhaktavatsalām  |
prasādayettato viprāḥ praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ  || 57.57 ||
namaste sarvage devi namaste śubhasaukhyade  |
trāhi māṃ padmapattrākṣi kātyāyani namo'stu te  || 57.58 ||
evaṃ prasādya tāṃ devīṃ jagaddhātrīṃ jagaddhitām  |
baladevasya bhaginīṃ subhadrāṃ varadāṃ śivām  || 57.59 ||
kāmagena vimānena naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet |
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvatkrīḍitvā tatra devavat || 57.60 ||
iha mānuṣatāṃ prāpto brāhmaṇo vedavidbhavet |
prāpya yogaṃ harestatra mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam  || 57.61 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā balaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ praṇipatya ca  |
dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam  || 58.1 ||
niṣkramya devatāgārātkṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ  |
praṇamyāyatanaṃ paścādvrajettatra samāhitaḥ  || 58.2 ||
indranīlamayo viṣṇuryatrāste vālukāvṛtaḥ  |
antardhānagataṃ natvā tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet || 58.3 ||
sarvadevamayo yo'sau hatavānasurottamam  |
sa āste tatra bho viprāḥ siṃhārdhakṛtavigrahaḥ  || 58.4 ||
bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ devaṃ praṇamya narakesarīm  |
mucyate pātakairmartyaḥ samastairnātra saṃśayaḥ  || 58.5 ||
narasiṃhasya ye bhaktā bhavanti bhuvi mānavāḥ  |
na teṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcitphalaṃ syādyadyadīpsitam  || 58.6 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena narasiṃhaṃ samāśrayet |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phalaṃ yasmātprayacchati  || 58.7 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
māhātmyaṃ narasiṃhasya sukhadaṃ bhuvi durlabham  |
yathā kathayase deva tena no vismayo mahān  || 58.8 ||
prabhāvaṃ tasya devasya vistareṇa jagatpate  |
śrotumicchāmahe brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 58.9 ||
yathā prasīdeddevo'sau narasiṃho mahābalaḥ  |
bhaktānāmupakārāya brūhi deva namo'stu te  || 58.10 ||
prasādānnarasiṃhasya yā bhavantyatra siddhayaḥ  |
brūhi tāḥ kuru cāsmākaṃ prasādaṃ prapitāmaha  || 58.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ tasya bho viprāḥ prabhāvaṃ gadato mama  |
ajitasyāprameyasya bhuktimuktipradasya ca  || 58.12 ||
kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ samastāṃstasya bho dvijāḥ  |
siṃhārdhakṛtadehasya pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ  || 58.13 ||
yāḥ kāścitsiddhayaścātra śrūyante daivamānuṣāḥ  |
prasādāttasya tāḥ sarvāḥ sidhyanti nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 58.14 ||
svarge martye ca pātāle dikṣu toye pure nage  |
prasādāttasya devasya bhavatyavyāhatā gatiḥ  || 58.15 ||
asādhyaṃ tasya devasya nāstyatra sacarācare  |
narasiṃhasya bho viprāḥ sadā bhaktānukampinaḥ  || 58.16 ||
vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi bhaktānāmupakārakam  |
yena prasīdeccaivāsau siṃhārdhakṛtavigrahaḥ  || 58.17 ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ kalparājaṃ sanātanam  |
narasiṃhasya tattvaṃ ca yanna jñātaṃ surāsuraiḥ  || 58.18 ||
śākayāvakamūlaistu phalapiṇyākasaktukaiḥ  |
payobhakṣeṇa viprendrā vartayetsādhakottamaḥ  || 58.19 ||
kośakaupīnavāsāśca dhyānayukto jitendriyaḥ  |
araṇye vijane deśe parvate sindhusaṃgame  || 58.20 ||
ūṣare siddhakṣetre ca narasiṃhāśrame tathā  |
pratiṣṭhāpya svayaṃ vāpi pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ  || 58.21 ||
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya upoṣya munipuṃgavāḥ  |
japellakṣāṇi vai viṃśanmanasā saṃyatendriyaḥ  || 58.22 ||
upapātakayuktaśca mahāpātakasaṃyutaḥ  |
mukto bhavettato viprāḥ sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 58.23 ||
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tatra narasiṃhaṃ prapūjayet |
puṇyagandhādibhirdhūpaiḥ praṇamya śirasā prabhum  || 58.24 ||
karpūracandanāktāni jātīpuṣpāṇi mastake  |
pradadyānnarasiṃhasya tataḥ siddhiḥ prajāyate  || 58.25 ||
bhagavān sarvakāryeṣu na kvacitpratihanyate  |
tejaḥ soḍhuṃ na śaktāḥ syurbrahmarudrādayaḥ surāḥ  || 58.26 ||
kiṃ punardānavā loke siddhagandharvamānuṣāḥ  |
vidyādharā yakṣagaṇāḥ sakiṃnaramahoragāḥ  || 58.27 ||
mantraṃ yānāsurān hantuṃ japantyeke'nyasādhakāḥ  |
te sarve pralayaṃ yānti dṛṣṭvādityāgnivarcasaḥ  || 58.28 ||
sakṛjjaptaṃ tu kavacaṃ rakṣetsarvamupadravam  |
dvirjaptaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ rakṣate devadānavāt || 58.29 ||
gandharvāḥ kiṃnarā yakṣā vidyādharamahoragāḥ  |
bhūtāḥ piśācā rakṣāṃsi ye cānye paripanthinaḥ  || 58.30 ||
trirjaptaṃ kavacaṃ divyamabhedyaṃ ca surāsuraiḥ  |
dvādaśābhyantare caiva yojanānāṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 58.31 ||
rakṣate bhagavān devo narasiṃho mahābalaḥ  |
tato gatvā biladvāramupoṣya rajanītrayam  || 58.32 ||
palāśakāṣṭhaiḥ prajvālya bhagavantaṃ hutāśanam  |
palāśasamidhastatra juhuyāttrimadhuplutāḥ  || 58.33 ||
dve śate dvijaśārdūlā vaṣaṭkāreṇa sādhakaḥ  |
tato vivaradvāraṃ tu prakaṭaṃ jāyate kṣaṇāt || 58.34 ||
tato viśettu niḥśaṅkaṃ kavacī vivaraṃ budhaḥ  |
gacchataḥ saṃkaṭaṃ tasya tamomohaśca naśyati  || 58.35 ||
rājamārgaḥ suvistīrṇo dṛśyate bhramarājitaḥ  |
narasiṃhaṃ smaraṃstatra pātālaṃ viśate dvijāḥ  || 58.36 ||
gatvā tatra japettattvaṃ narasiṃhākhyamavyayam  |
tataḥ strīṇāṃ sahasrāṇi vīṇāvādanakarmaṇām  || 58.37 ||
nirgacchanti puro viprāḥ svāgataṃ tā vadanti ca  |
praveśayanti tā haste gṛhītvā sādhakeśvaram  || 58.38 ||
tato rasāyanaṃ divyaṃ pāyayanti dvijottamāḥ  |
pītamātre divyadeho jāyate sumahābalaḥ  || 58.39 ||
krīḍate saha kanyābhiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  |
bhinnadeho vāsudeve līyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 58.40 ||
yadā na rocate vāsastasmānnirgacchate punaḥ  |
paṭṭaṃ śūlaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca rocanāṃ ca maṇiṃ tathā  || 58.41 ||
rasaṃ rasāyanaṃ caiva pādukāñjanameva ca  |
kṛṣṇājinaṃ muniśreṣṭhā guṭikāṃ ca manoharām  || 58.42 ||
kamaṇḍaluṃ cākṣasūtraṃ yaṣṭiṃ saṃjīvanīṃ tathā  |
siddhavidyāṃ ca śāstrāṇi gṛhītvā sādhakeśvaraḥ  || 58.43 ||
jvaladvahnisphuliṅgormi veṣṭitaṃ triśikhaṃ hṛdi  |
sakṛnnyastaṃ dahetsarvaṃ vṛjinaṃ janmakoṭijam  || 58.44 ||
viṣe nyastaṃ viṣaṃ hanyātkuṣṭhaṃ hanyāttanau sthitam  |
svadehe bhrūṇahatyādi kṛtvā divyena śudhyati  || 58.45 ||
mahāgrahagṛhīteṣu jvalamānaṃ vicintayet |
hṛdante vai tataḥ śīghraṃ naśyeyurdāruṇā grahāḥ  || 58.46 ||
bālānāṃ kaṇṭhake baddhaṃ rakṣā bhavati nityaśaḥ  |
gaṇḍapiṇḍakalūtānāṃ nāśanaṃ kurute dhruvam  || 58.47 ||
vyādhijāte samidbhiśca ghṛtakṣīreṇa homayet |
trisaṃdhyaṃ māsamekaṃ tu sarvarogān vināśayet || 58.48 ||
asādhyaṃ tu na paśyāmi trailokye sacarācare  |
yāṃ yāṃ kāmayate siddhiṃ tāṃ tāṃ prāpnoti sa dhruvam  || 58.49 ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ tveke pūjayitvā mṛgādhipam  |
mṛttikāḥ sapta valmīke śmaśāne ca catuṣpathe  || 58.50 ||
raktacandanasaṃmiśrā gavāṃ kṣīreṇa loḍayet |
siṃhasya pratimāṃ kṛtvā pramāṇena ṣaḍaṅgulām  || 58.51 ||
limpettathā bhūrjapattre rocanayā samālikhet |
narasiṃhasya kaṇṭhe tu baddhvā caiva hi mantravit || 58.52 ||
japetsaṃkhyāvihīnaṃ tu pūjayitvā jalāśaye  |
yāvatsaptāhamātraṃ tu japetsaṃyamitendriyaḥ  || 58.53 ||
jalākīrṇā muhūrtena jāyate sarvamedinī  |
athavā śuṣkavṛkṣāgre narasiṃhaṃ tu pūjayet || 58.54 ||
japtvā cāṣṭaśataṃ tattvaṃ varṣantaṃ vinivārayet |
tamevaṃ piñjake baddhvā bhrāmayetsādhakottamaḥ  || 58.55 ||
mahāvāto muhūrtena āgacchennātra saṃśayaḥ  |
punaśca dhārayetkṣipraṃ saptasaptena vāriṇā  || 58.56 ||
atha tāṃ pratimāṃ dvāri nikhanedyasya sādhakaḥ  |
gotrotsādo bhavettasya uddhṛte caiva śāntidaḥ  || 58.57 ||
tasmāttaṃ muniśārdūlā bhaktyā saṃpūjayetsadā  |
mṛgarājaṃ mahāvīryaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam  || 58.58 ||
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  |
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāntyajātayaḥ  || 58.59 ||
saṃpūjya taṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ bhaktyā siṃhavapurdharam  |
mucyante cāśubhairduḥkhairjanmakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ  || 58.60 ||
saṃpūjya taṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ prāpnuvantyabhivāñchitam  |
devatvamamareśatvaṃ gandharvatvaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  || 58.61 ||
yakṣavidyādharatvaṃ ca tathānyaccābhivāñchitam  |
dṛṣṭvā stutvā namaskṛtvā saṃpūjya narakesarīm  || 58.62 ||
prāpnuvanti narā rājyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca durlabham  |
narasiṃhaṃ naro dṛṣṭvā labhedabhimataṃ phalam  || 58.63 ||
nirmuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  |
sakṛddṛṣṭvā tu taṃ devaṃ bhaktyā siṃhavapurdharam  || 58.64 ||
mucyate cāśubhairduḥkhairjanmakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ  |
saṃgrāme saṃkaṭe durge coravyāghrādipīḍite  || 58.65 ||
kāntāre prāṇasaṃdehe viṣavahnijaleṣu ca  |
rājādibhyaḥ samudrebhyo graharogādipīḍite  || 58.66 ||
smṛtvā taṃ puruṣaḥ sarvai rājagrāmairvimucyate  |
sūryodaye yathā nāśaṃ tamo'bhyeti mahattaram  || 58.67 ||
tathā saṃdarśane tasya vināśaṃ yāntyupadravāḥ  |
guṭikāñjanapātāla pāduke ca rasāyanam  || 58.68 ||
narasiṃhe prasanne tu prāpnotyanyāṃśca vāñchitān  |
yān yān kāmānabhidhyāyan bhajate narakesarīm  || 58.69 ||
tāṃstān kāmānavāpnoti naro nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ bhaktyāpūjya praṇamya ca  || 58.70 ||
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet |
pāpaiḥ sarvairvinirmukto guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtaḥ  || 58.71 ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ  |
sauvarṇena vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā  || 58.72 ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhena kāmagena suvarcasā  |
taruṇādityavarṇena muktāhārāvalambinā  || 58.73 ||
divyastrīśatayuktena divyagandharvanādinā  |
kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya devavanmuditaḥ sukhī  || 58.74 ||
stūyamāno'psarobhiśca viṣṇulokaṃ vrajennaraḥ  |
bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān viṣṇuloke dvijottamāḥ  || 58.75 ||
gandharvairapsarairyuktaḥ kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam  |
manohlādakaraṃ saukhyaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  || 58.76 ||
puṇyakṣayādihāyātaḥ pravare yogināṃ kule  |
caturvedī bhavedvipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ  |
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 58.77 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
anantākhyaṃ vāsudevaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā praṇamya ca  |
sarvapāpavinirmukto naro yāti paraṃ padam  || 59.1 ||
mayā cārādhitaścāsau śakreṇa tadanantaram  |
vibhīṣaṇena rāmeṇa kastaṃ nārādhayetpumān  || 59.2 ||
śvetagaṅgāṃ naraḥ snātvā yaḥ paśyecchvetamādhavam  |
matsyākhyaṃ mādhavaṃ caiva śvetadvīpaṃ sa gacchati  || 59.3 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
śvetamādhavamāhātmyaṃ vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ  |
vistareṇa jagannātha pratimāṃ tasya vai hareḥ  || 59.4 ||
tasmin kṣetravare puṇye vikhyāte jagatītale  |
śvetākhyaṃ mādhavaṃ devaṃ kastaṃ sthāpitavān purā  || 59.5 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
abhūtkṛtayuge viprāḥ śveto nāma nṛpo balī  |
matimān dharmavicchūraḥ satyasaṃdho dṛḍhavrataḥ  || 59.6 ||
yasya rājye tu varṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ daśa mānavāḥ  |
bhavantyāyuṣmanto lokā bālastasminna sīdati  || 59.7 ||
vartamāne tadā rājye kiṃcitkāle gate dvijāḥ  |
kapālagautamo nāma ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ  || 59.8 ||
suto'syājātadantaśca mṛtaḥ kālavaśāddvijāḥ  |
tamādāya ṛṣirdhīmānnṛpasyāntikamānayat || 59.9 ||
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ nṛpatiḥ suptaṃ kumāraṃ gatacetasam  |
pratijñāmakarodviprā jīvanārthaṃ śiśostadā  || 59.10 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
yāvadbālamahaṃ tvenaṃ yamasya sadane gatam  |
nānaye saptarātreṇa citāṃ dīptāṃ samāruhe  || 59.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvāsitaiḥ padmaiḥ śatairdaśaśatādikaiḥ  |
saṃpūjya ca mahādevaṃ rājā vidyāṃ punarjapet || 59.12 ||
atibhaktiṃ tu saṃcintya nṛpasya jagadīśvaraḥ  |
sāṃnidhyamagamattuṣṭo śmītyuvāca sahomayā  || 59.13 ||
śrutvaivaṃ giramīśasya vilokya sahasā haram  |
bhasmadigdhaṃ virūpākṣaṃ śaratkundenduvarcasam  || 59.14 ||
śārdūlacarmavasanaṃ śaśāṅkāṅkitamūrdhajam  |
mahīṃ nipatya sahasā praṇamya sa tadābravīt || 59.15 ||
{śveta uvāca̱ }
kāruṇyaṃ yadi me dṛṣṭvā prasanno'si prabho yadi  |
kālasya vaśamāpanno bālako dvijaputrakaḥ  || 59.16 ||
jīvatveṣa punarbāla ityevaṃ vratamāhitam  |
akasmācca mṛtaṃ bālaṃ niyamya bhagavan svayam  |
yathoktāyuṣyasaṃyuktaṃ kṣemaṃ kuru maheśvara  || 59.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śvetasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā mudaṃ prāpa harastadā  |
kālamājñāpayāmāsa sarvabhūtabhayaṃkaram  || 59.18 ||
niyamya kālaṃ durdharṣaṃ yamasyājñākaraṃ dvijāḥ  |
bālaṃ saṃjīvayāmāsa mṛtyormukhagataṃ punaḥ  || 59.19 ||
kṛtvā kṣemaṃ jagatsarvaṃ muneḥ putraṃ sa taṃ dvijāḥ  |
devyā sahomayā devastatraivāntaradhīyata  || 59.20 ||
evaṃ saṃjīvayāmāsa muneḥ putraṃ nṛpottamaḥ  ||* 59.21 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
devadeva jagannātha trailokyaprabhavāvyaya  |
brūhi naḥ paramaṃ tathyaṃ śvetākhyasya ca sāṃpratam  || 59.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ sarvasattvahitāvaham  |
pravakṣyāmi yathātathyaṃ yatpṛcchatha mamānaghāḥ  || 59.23 ||
mādhavasya ca māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  |
yacchrutvābhimatān kāmān dhruvaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ  || 59.24 ||
śrutavānṛṣibhiḥ pūrvaṃ mādhavākhyasya bho dvijāḥ  |
śṛṇudhvaṃ tāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ bhayaśokārtināśinīm  || 59.25 ||
sa kṛtvā rājyamekāgryaṃ varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraśaḥ  |
vicārya laukikān dharmān vaidikānniyamāṃstathā  || 59.26 ||
keśavārādhane viprā niścitaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ  |
sa gatvā paramaṃ kṣetraṃ sāgaraṃ dakṣiṇāśrayam  || 59.27 ||
taṭe tasmiñśubhe ramye deśe kṛṣṇasya cāntike  |
śveto'tha kārayāmāsa prāsādaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam  || 59.28 ||
dhanvantaraśataṃ caikaṃ devadevasya dakṣiṇe  |
tataḥ śvetena viprendrāḥ śvetaśailamayena ca  || 59.29 ||
kṛtaḥ sa bhagavāñśveto mādhavaścandrasaṃnibhaḥ  |
pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivaccakre yathoddiṣṭāṃ svayaṃ tu saḥ  || 59.30 ||
dattvā dānaṃ dvijātibhyo dīnānāthatapasvinām  |
athānantarato rājā mādhavasya ca saṃnidhau  || 59.31 ||
mahīṃ nipatya sahasā oṃkāraṃ dvādaśākṣaram  |
japan sa maunamāsthāya māsamekaṃ samādhinā  || 59.32 ||
nirāhāro mahābhāgaḥ samyagviṣṇupade sthitaḥ  |
japānte sa tu deveśaṃ saṃstotumupacakrame  || 59.33 ||
{śveta uvāca̱ }
oṃ namo vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca  |
pradyumnāyāniruddhāya namo nārāyaṇāya ca  || 59.34 ||
namo'stu bahurūpāya viśvarūpāya vedhase  |
nirguṇāyāpratarkyāya śucaye śuklakarmaṇe  || 59.35 ||
oṃ namaḥ padmanābhāya padmagarbhodbhavāya ca  |
namo'stu padmavarṇāya padmahastāya te namaḥ  || 59.36 ||
oṃ namaḥ puṣkarākṣāya sahasrākṣāya mīḍhuṣe  |
namaḥ sahasrapādāya sahasrabhujamanyave  || 59.37 ||
oṃ namo'stu varāhāya varadāya sumedhase  |
variṣṭhāya vareṇyāya śaraṇyāyācyutāya ca  || 59.38 ||
oṃ namo bālarūpāya bālapadmaprabhāya ca  |
bālārkasomanetrāya muñjakeśāya dhīmate  || 59.39 ||
keśavāya namo nityaṃ namo nārāyaṇāya ca  |
mādhavāya variṣṭhāya govindāya namo namaḥ  || 59.40 ||
oṃ namo viṣṇave nityaṃ devāya vasuretase  |
madhusūdanāya namaḥ śuddhāyāṃśudharāya ca  || 59.41 ||
namo anantāya sūkṣmāya namaḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe  |
trivikramāya ca namo divyapītāmbarāya ca  || 59.42 ||
sṛṣṭikartre namastubhyaṃ goptre dhātre namo namaḥ  |
namo'stu guṇabhūtāya nirguṇāya namo namaḥ  || 59.43 ||
namo vāmanarūpāya namo vāmanakarmaṇe  |
namo vāmananetrāya namo vāmanavāhine  || 59.44 ||
namo ramyāya pūjyāya namo'stvavyaktarūpiṇe  |
apratarkyāya śuddhāya namo bhayaharāya ca  || 59.45 ||
saṃsārārṇavapotāya praśāntāya svarūpiṇe  |
śivāya saumyarūpāya rudrāyottāraṇāya ca  || 59.46 ||
bhavabhaṅgakṛte caiva bhavabhogapradāya ca  |
bhavasaṃghātarūpāya bhavasṛṣṭikṛte namaḥ  || 59.47 ||
oṃ namo divyarūpāya somāgniśvasitāya ca  |
somasūryāṃśukeśāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca  || 59.48 ||
oṃ nama ṛksvarūpāya padakramasvarūpiṇe  |
ṛkstutāya namastubhyaṃ nama ṛksādhanāya ca  || 59.49 ||
oṃ namo yajuṣāṃ dhātre yajūrūpadharāya ca  |
yajuryājyāya juṣṭāya yajuṣāṃ pataye namaḥ  || 59.50 ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīpate deva śrīdharāya varāya ca  |
śriyaḥ kāntāya dāntāya yogicintyāya yogine  || 59.51 ||
oṃ namaḥ sāmarūpāya sāmadhvanivarāya ca  |
oṃ namaḥ sāmasaumyāya sāmayogavide namaḥ  || 59.52 ||
sāmne ca sāmagītāya oṃ namaḥ sāmadhāriṇe  |
sāmayajñavide caiva namaḥ sāmakarāya ca  || 59.53 ||
namastvatharvaśirase namo'tharvasvarūpiṇe  |
namo'stvatharvapādāya namo'tharvakarāya ca  || 59.54 ||
oṃ namo vajraśīrṣāya madhukaiṭabhaghātine  |
mahodadhijalasthāya vedāharaṇakāriṇe  || 59.55 ||
namo dīptasvarūpāya hṛṣīkeśāya vai namaḥ  |
namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya te namaḥ  || 59.56 ||
nārāyaṇa namastubhyaṃ namo lokahitāya ca  |
oṃ namo mohanāśāya bhavabhaṅgakarāya ca  || 59.57 ||
gatipradāya ca namo namo bandhaharāya ca  |
trailokyatejasāṃ kartre namastejaḥsvarūpiṇe  || 59.58 ||
yogīśvarāya śuddhāya rāmāyottaraṇāya ca  |
sukhāya sukhanetrāya namaḥ sukṛtadhāriṇe  || 59.59 ||
vāsudevāya vandyāya vāmadevāya vai namaḥ  |
dehināṃ dehakartre ca bhedabhaṅgakarāya ca  || 59.60 ||
devairvanditadehāya namaste divyamauline  |
namo vāsanivāsāya vāsavyavaharāya ca  || 59.61 ||
oṃ namo vasukartre ca vasuvāsapradāya ca  |
namo yajñasvarūpāya yajñeśāya ca yogine  || 59.62 ||
yatiyogakareśāya namo yajñāṅgadhāriṇe  |
saṃkarṣaṇāya ca namaḥ pralambamathanāya ca  || 59.63 ||
meghaghoṣasvanottīrṇa vegalāṅgaladhāriṇe  |
namo'stu jñānināṃ jñāna nārāyaṇaparāyaṇa  || 59.64 ||
na me'sti tvāmṛte bandhurnarakottāraṇe prabho  |
atastvāṃ sarvabhāvena praṇato natavatsala  || 59.65 ||
malaṃ yatkāyajaṃ vāpi mānasaṃ caiva keśava  |
na tasyānyo'sti deveśa kṣālakastvāmṛte'cyuta  || 59.66 ||
saṃsargāṇi samastāni vihāya tvāmupasthitaḥ  |
saṅgo me'stu tvayā sārdhamātmalābhāya keśava  || 59.67 ||
kaṣṭamāpatsuduṣpāraṃ saṃsāraṃ vedmi keśava  |
tāpatrayaparikliṣṭastena tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ  || 59.68 ||
eṣaṇābhirjagatsarvaṃ mohitaṃ māyayā tava  |
ākarṣitaṃ ca lobhādyairatastvāmahamāśritaḥ  || 59.69 ||
nāsti kiṃcitsukhaṃ viṣṇo saṃsārasthasya dehinaḥ  |
yathā yathā hi yajñeśa tvayi cetaḥ pravartate  || 59.70 ||
tathā phalavihīnaṃ tu sukhamātyantikaṃ labhet |
naṣṭo vivekaśūnyo'smi dṛśyate jagadāturam  || 59.71 ||
govinda trāhi saṃsārānmāmuddhartuṃ tvamarhasi  |
magnasya mohasalile niruttāre bhavārṇave  |
uddhartā puṇḍarīkākṣa tvāmṛte'nyo na vidyate  || 59.72 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
itthaṃ stutastatastena rājñā śvetena bho dvijāḥ  |
tasmin kṣetravare divye vikhyāte puruṣottame  || 59.73 ||
bhaktiṃ tasya tu saṃcintya devadevo jagadguruḥ  |
ājagāma nṛpasyāgre sarvairdevairvṛto hariḥ  || 59.74 ||
nīlajīmūtasaṃkāśaḥ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇaḥ  |
dadhatsudarśanaṃ dhīmān karāgre dīptamaṇḍalam  || 59.75 ||
kṣīrodajalasaṃkāśo vimalaścandrasaṃnibhaḥ  |
rarāja vāmahaste'sya pāñcajanyo mahādyutiḥ  || 59.76 ||
pakṣirājadhvajaḥ śrīmān gadāśārṅgāsidhṛkprabhuḥ  |
uvāca sādhu bho rājan yasya te matiruttamā  |
yadiṣṭaṃ vara bhadraṃ te prasanno'smi tavānagha  || 59.77 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvaivaṃ devadevasya vākyaṃ tatparamāmṛtam  |
praṇamya śirasovāca śvetastadgatamānasaḥ  || 59.78 ||
{śveta uvāca̱ }
yadyahaṃ bhagavan bhaktaḥ prayaccha varamuttamam  |
ābrahmabhavanādūrdhvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padamavyayam  || 59.79 ||
vimalaṃ virajaṃ śuddhaṃ saṃsārāsaṅgavarjitam  |
tatpadaṃ gantumicchāmi tvatprasādājjagatpate  || 59.80 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
yatpadaṃ vibudhāḥ sarve munayaḥ siddhayoginaḥ  |
nābhigacchanti yadramyaṃ paraṃ padamanāmayam  || 59.81 ||
yāsyasi paramaṃ sthānaṃ rājyāmṛtamupāsya ca  |
sarvāṃllokānatikramya mama lokaṃ gamiṣyasi  || 59.82 ||
kīrtistavātra rājendra trīṃllokāṃśca gamiṣyati  |
sāṃnidhyaṃ mama caivātra sarvadaiva bhaviṣyati  || 59.83 ||
śvetagaṅgeti gāsyanti sarve te devadānavāḥ  |
kuśāgreṇāpi rājendra śvetagāṅgeyamambu ca  || 59.84 ||
spṛṣṭvā svargaṃ gamiṣyanti madbhaktā ye samāhitāḥ  |
yastvimāṃ pratimāṃ gacchenmādhavākhyāṃ śaśiprabhām  || 59.85 ||
śaṅkhagokṣīrasaṃkāśāmaśeṣāghavināśinīm  |
tāṃ praṇamya sakṛdbhaktyā puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇām  || 59.86 ||
vihāya sarvalokān vai mama loke mahīyate  |
manvantarāṇi tatraiva devakanyābhirāvṛtaḥ  || 59.87 ||
gīyamānaśca madhuraṃ siddhagandharvasevitaḥ  |
bhunakti vipulān bhogān yatheṣṭaṃ māmakaiḥ saha  || 59.88 ||
cyutastasmādihāgatya manuṣyo brāhmaṇo bhavet |
vedavedāṅgavicchrīmān bhogavāṃścirajīvitaḥ  || 59.89 ||
gajāśvarathayānāḍhyo dhanadhānyāvṛtaḥ śuciḥ  |
rūpavān bahubhāgyaśca putrapautrasamanvitaḥ  || 59.90 ||
puruṣottamaṃ punaḥ prāpya vaṭamūle'tha sāgare  |
tyaktvā dehaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā tataḥ śāntapadaṃ vrajet || 59.91 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śvetamādhavamālokya samīpe matsyamādhavam  |
ekārṇavajale pūrvaṃ rohitaṃ rūpamāsthitam  || 60.1 ||
vedānāṃ haraṇārthāya rasātalatale sthitam  |
cintayitvā kṣitiṃ samyaktasmin sthāne pratiṣṭhitam  || 60.2 ||
ādyāvataraṇaṃ rūpaṃ mādhavaṃ matsyarūpiṇam  |
praṇamya praṇato bhūtvā sarvaduḥkhādvimucyate  || 60.3 ||
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo hariḥ svayam  |
kāle punarihāyāto rājā syātpṛthivītale  || 60.4 ||
vatsamādhavamāsādya durādharṣo bhavennaraḥ  |
dātā bhoktā bhavedyajvā vaiṣṇavaḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ  || 60.5 ||
yogaṃ prāpya hareḥ paścāttato mokṣamavāpnuyāt |
matsyamādhavamāhātmyaṃ mayā saṃparikīrtitam  |
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā muniśārdūlāḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 60.6 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
bhagavañśrotumicchāmo mārjanaṃ varuṇālaye  |
kriyate snānadānādi tasyāśeṣaphalaṃ vada  || 60.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlā mārjanasya yathāvidhi  |
bhaktyā tu tanmanā bhūtvā saṃprāpya puṇyamuttamam  || 60.8 ||
mārkaṇḍeyahrade snānaṃ pūrvakāle praśasyate  |
caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  || 60.9 ||
tadvatsnānaṃ samudrasya sarvakālaṃ praśasyate  |
paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 60.10 ||
mārkaṇḍeyaṃ vaṭaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rauhiṇeyaṃ mahodadhim  |
indradyumnasaraścaiva pañcatīrthīvidhiḥ smṛtaḥ  || 60.11 ||
pūrṇimā jyeṣṭhamāsasya jyeṣṭhā ṛkṣaṃ yadā bhavet |
