tadā gacchedviśeṣeṇa tīrtharājaṃ paraṃ śubham  || 60.12 ||
kāyavāṅmānasaiḥ śuddhastadbhāvo nānyamānasaḥ  |
sarvadvaṃdvavinirmukto vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ  || 60.13 ||
kalpavṛkṣavaṭaṃ ramyaṃ tatra snātvā janārdanam  |
pradakṣiṇaṃ prakurvīta trivāraṃ susamāhitaḥ  || 60.14 ||
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpātsaptajanmasamudbhavāt |
puṇyaṃ cāpnoti vipulaṃ gatimiṣṭāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  || 60.15 ||
tasya nāmāni vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ ca yuge yuge  |
yathāsaṃkhyaṃ ca bho viprāḥ kṛtādiṣu yathākramam  || 60.16 ||
vaṭaṃ vaṭeśvaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ dvijāḥ  |
vaṭasyaitāni nāmāni kīrtitāni kṛtādiṣu  || 60.17 ||
yojanaṃ pādahīnaṃ ca yojanārdhaṃ tadardhakam  |
pramāṇaṃ kalpavṛkṣasya kṛtādau parikīrtitam  || 60.18 ||
yathoktena tu mantreṇa namaskṛtvā tu taṃ vaṭam  |
dakṣiṇābhimukho gaccheddhanvantaraśatatrayam  || 60.19 ||
yatrāsau dṛśyate viṣṇuḥ svargadvāraṃ manoramam  |
sāgarāmbhaḥsamākṛṣṭaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam  || 60.20 ||
praṇipatya tatastaṃ bhoḥ paripūjya tataḥ punaḥ  |
mucyate sarvarogādyaistathā pāpairgrahādibhiḥ  || 60.21 ||
ugrasenaṃ purā dṛṣṭvā svargadvāreṇa sāgaram  |
gatvācamya śucistatra dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ param  || 60.22 ||
nyasedaṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ paścāddhastaśarīrayoḥ  |
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti yaṃ vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ  || 60.23 ||
kiṃ kāryaṃ bahubhirmantrairmanovibhramakārakaiḥ  |
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ  || 60.24 ||
āpo narasya sūnutvānnārā itīha kīrtitāḥ  |
viṣṇostāstvayanaṃ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 60.25 ||
nārāyaṇaparā vedā nārāyaṇaparā dvijāḥ  |
nārāyaṇaparā yajñā nārāyaṇaparāḥ kriyāḥ  || 60.26 ||
nārāyaṇaparā pṛthvī nārāyaṇaparaṃ jalam  |
nārāyaṇaparo vahnirnārāyaṇaparaṃ nabhaḥ  || 60.27 ||
nārāyaṇaparo vāyurnārāyaṇaparaṃ manaḥ  |
ahaṃkāraśca buddhiśca ubhe nārāyaṇātmake  || 60.28 ||
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca yatkiṃcijjīvasaṃjñitam  |
sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ caiva sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam  || 60.29 ||
śabdādyā viṣayāḥ sarve śrotrādīnīndriyāṇi ca  |
prakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva sarve nārāyaṇātmakāḥ  || 60.30 ||
jale sthale ca pātāle svargaloke'mbare nage  |
avaṣṭabhya idaṃ sarvamāste nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ  || 60.31 ||
kiṃ cātra bahunoktena jagadetaccarācaram  |
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam  || 60.32 ||
nārāyaṇātparaṃ kiṃcinneha paśyāmi bho dvijāḥ  |
tena vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyādṛśyaṃ carācaram  || 60.33 ||
āpo hyāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ sa ca evāmbhasāṃ patiḥ  |
tasmādapsu smarennityaṃ nārāyaṇamaghāpaham  || 60.34 ||
snānakāle viśeṣeṇa copasthāya jale śuciḥ  |
smarennārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyeddhaste kāye ca vinyaset || 60.35 ||
oṃkāraṃ ca nakāraṃ ca aṅguṣṭhe hastayornyaset |
śeṣairhastatalaṃ yāvattarjanyādiṣu vinyaset || 60.36 ||
oṃkāraṃ vāmapāde tu nakāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset |
mokāraṃ vāmakaṭyāṃ tu nākāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset || 60.37 ||
rākāraṃ nābhideśe tu yakāraṃ vāmabāhuke  |
ṇākāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyasya yakāraṃ mūrdhni vinyaset || 60.38 ||
adhaścordhvaṃ ca hṛdaye pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhato'grataḥ  |
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ paścādārabhetkavacaṃ budhaḥ  || 60.39 ||
pūrve māṃ pātu govindo dakṣiṇe madhusūdanaḥ  |
paścime śrīdharo devaḥ keśavastu tathottare  || 60.40 ||
pātu viṣṇustathāgneye nairṛte mādhavo'vyayaḥ  |
vāyavye tu hṛṣīkeśastatheśāne ca vāmanaḥ  || 60.41 ||
bhūtale pātu vārāhastathordhvaṃ ca trivikramaḥ  |
kṛtvaivaṃ kavacaṃ paścādātmānaṃ cintayettataḥ  || 60.42 ||
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  |
evaṃ dhyātvā tadātmānamimaṃ mantramudīrayet || 60.43 ||
tvamagnirdvipadāṃ nātha retodhāḥ kāmadīpanaḥ  |
pradhānaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvānāṃ prabhuravyayaḥ  || 60.44 ||
amṛtasyāraṇistvaṃ hi devayonirapāṃ pate  |
vṛjinaṃ hara me sarvaṃ tīrtharāja namo'stu te  || 60.45 ||
evamuccārya vidhivattataḥ snānaṃ samācaret |
anyathā bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ snānaṃ tatra na śasyate  || 60.46 ||
kṛtvā tu vaidikairmantrairabhiṣekaṃ ca mārjanam  |
antarjale japetpaścāttrirāvṛttyāghamarṣaṇam  || 60.47 ||
hayamedho yathā viprāḥ sarvapāpaharaḥ kratuḥ  |
tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ cātra sūktaṃ sarvāghanāśanam  || 60.48 ||
uttīrya vāsasī dhaute nirmale paridhāya vai  |
prāṇānāyamya cācamya saṃdhyāṃ copāsya bhāskaram  || 60.49 ||
upatiṣṭhettataścordhvaṃ kṣiptvā puṣpajalāñjalim  |
upasthāyordhvabāhuśca talliṅgairbhāskaraṃ tataḥ  || 60.50 ||
gāyatrīṃ pāvanīṃ devīṃ japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam  |
anyāṃśca sauramantrāṃśca japtvā tiṣṭhan samāhitaḥ  || 60.51 ||
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ sūryaṃ namaskṛtyopaviśya ca  |
svādhyāyaṃ prāṅmukhaḥ kṛtvā tarpayeddaivatānyṛṣīn  || 60.52 ||
manuṣyāṃśca pitṝṃścānyānnāmagotreṇa mantravit |
toyena tilamiśreṇa vidhivatsusamāhitaḥ  || 60.53 ||
tarpaṇaṃ devatānāṃ ca pūrvaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ  |
adhikārī bhavetpaścātpitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇe dvijaḥ  || 60.54 ||
śrāddhe havanakāle ca pāṇinaikena nirvapet |
tarpaṇe tūbhayaṃ kuryādeṣa eva vidhiḥ sadā  || 60.55 ||
anvārabdhena savyena pāṇinā dakṣiṇena tu  |
tṛpyatāmiti siñcettu nāmagotreṇa vāgyataḥ  || 60.56 ||
kāyasthairyastilairmohātkaroti pitṛtarpaṇam  |
tarpitāstena pitarastvaṅmāṃsarudhirāsthibhiḥ  || 60.57 ||
aṅgasthairna tilaiḥ kuryāddevatāpitṛtarpaṇam  |
rudhiraṃ tadbhavettoyaṃ pradātā kilbiṣī bhavet || 60.58 ||
bhūmyāṃ yaddīyate toyaṃ dātā caiva jale sthitaḥ  |
vṛthā tanmuniśārdūlā nopatiṣṭhati kasyacit || 60.59 ||
sthale sthitvā jale yastu prayacchedudakaṃ naraḥ  |
pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭheta salilaṃ tannirarthakam  || 60.60 ||
udake nodakaṃ kuryātpitṛbhyaśca kadācana  |
uttīrya tu śucau deśe kuryādudakatarpaṇam  || 60.61 ||
nodakeṣu na pātreṣu na kruddho naikapāṇinā  |
nopatiṣṭhati tattoyaṃ yadbhūmyāṃ na pradīyate  || 60.62 ||
pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ sthānaṃ mahī dattā mayā dvijāḥ  |
tasmāttatraiva dātavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītimicchatā  || 60.63 ||
bhūmipṛṣṭhe samutpannā bhūmyāṃ caiva ca saṃsthitāḥ  |
bhūmyāṃ caiva layaṃ yātā bhūmau dadyāttato jalam  || 60.64 ||
āstīrya ca kuśān sāgrāṃstānāvāhya svamantrataḥ  |
prācīnāgreṣu vai devān yāmyāgreṣu tathā pitṝn  || 60.65 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
devān pitṝṃstathā cānyān saṃtarpyācamya vāgyataḥ  |
hastamātraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ caturdvāraṃ suśobhanam  || 61.1 ||
puraṃ vilikhya bho viprāstīre tasya mahodadheḥ  |
madhye tatra likhetpadmamaṣṭapattraṃ sakarṇikam  || 61.2 ||
evaṃ maṇḍalamālikhya pūjayettatra bho dvijāḥ  |
aṣṭākṣaravidhānena nārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhum  || 61.3 ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāyaśodhanamuttamam  |
akāraṃ hṛdaye dhyātvā cakrarekhāsamanvitam  || 61.4 ||
jvalantaṃ triśikhaṃ caiva dahantaṃ pāpanāśanam  |
candramaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rākāraṃ mūrdhni cintayet || 61.5 ||
śuklavarṇaṃ pravarṣantamamṛtaṃ plāvayanmahīm  |
evaṃ nirdhūtapāpastu divyadehastato bhavet || 61.6 ||
aṣṭākṣaraṃ tato mantraṃ nyasedevātmano budhaḥ  |
vāmapādaṃ samārabhya kramaśaścaiva vinyaset || 61.7 ||
pañcāṅgaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva caturvyūhaṃ tathaiva ca  |
karaśuddhiṃ prakurvīta mūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ  || 61.8 ||
ekaikaṃ caiva varṇaṃ tu aṅgulīṣu pṛthakpṛthak |
oṃkāraṃ pṛthivīṃ śuklāṃ vāmapāde tu vinyaset || 61.9 ||
nakāraḥ śāṃbhavaḥ śyāmo dakṣiṇe tu vyavasthitaḥ  |
mokāraṃ kālamevāhurvāmakaṭyāṃ nidhāpayet || 61.10 ||
nākāraḥ sarvabījaṃ tu dakṣiṇasyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ  |
rākārasteja ityāhurnābhideśe vyavasthitaḥ  || 61.11 ||
vāyavyo'yaṃ yakārastu vāmaskandhe samāśritaḥ  |
ṇākāraḥ sarvago jñeyo dakṣiṇāṃse vyavasthitaḥ  |
yakāro'yaṃ śirasthaśca yatra lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ  || 61.12 ||
oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ śiraḥ oṃ jvalanāya namaḥ śikhā |
oṃ viṣṇave namaḥ kavacamoṃ viṣṇave namaḥ sphuraṇaṃ diśobandhāya |
oṃ huṃphaḍastramoṃ śirasi śuklo vāsudeva iti |
oṃ āṃ lalāṭe raktaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo garutmān vahnisteja āditya iti |
oṃ āṃ grīvāyāṃ pītaḥ pradyumno vāyumegha iti |
oṃ āṃ hṛdaye kṛṣṇo'niruddhaḥ sarvaśaktisamanvita iti |
evaṃ caturvyūhamātmānaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ karma samācaret ||61.13|
mamāgre'vasthito viṣṇuḥ pṛṣṭhataścāpi keśavaḥ  |
govindo dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme tu madhusūdanaḥ  || 61.14 ||
upariṣṭāttu vaikuṇṭho vārāhaḥ pṛthivītale  |
avāntaradiśo yāstu tāsu sarvāsu mādhavaḥ  || 61.15 ||
gacchatastiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato'pi vā  |
narasiṃhakṛtā guptirvāsudevamayo hyaham  || 61.16 ||
evaṃ viṣṇumayo bhūtvā tataḥ karma samārabhet |
yathā dehe tathā deve sarvatattvāni yojayet || 61.17 ||
tataścaiva prakurvīta prokṣaṇaṃ praṇavena tu  |
phaṭkārāntaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ sarvavighnaharaṃ śubham  || 61.18 ||
tatrārkacandravahnīnāṃ maṇḍalāni vicintayet |
padmamadhye nyasedviṣṇuṃ pavanasyāmbarasya ca  || 61.19 ||
tato vicintya hṛdaya oṃkāraṃ jyotīrūpiṇam  |
karṇikāyāṃ samāsīnaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam  || 61.20 ||
aṣṭākṣaraṃ tato mantraṃ vinyasecca yathākramam  |
tena vyastasamastena pūjanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam  || 61.21 ||
dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa yajeddevaṃ sanātanam  |
tato'vadhārya hṛdaye karṇikāyāṃ bahirnyaset || 61.22 ||
caturbhujaṃ mahāsattvaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham  |
cintayitvā mahāyogaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam  |
tataścāvāhayenmantraṃ krameṇācintya mānase  || 61.23 ||
āvāhanamantra̱ḥ mīnarūpo varāhaśca narasiṃho'tha vāmanaḥ |
āyātu devo varado mama nārāyaṇo'grataḥ ||61.24|
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.24|
sthāpanamantra̱ḥ
karṇikāyāṃ supīṭhe'tra padmakalpitamāsanam  |
sarvasattvahitārthāya tiṣṭha tvaṃ madhusūdana  || 61.25 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.25|
arghamantra̱ḥ oṃ trailokyapatīnāṃ pataye devadevāya hṛṣīkeśāya viṣṇave namaḥ |
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.26|
pādyamantra̱ḥ
oṃ pādyaṃ pādayordeva padmanābha sanātana  |
viṣṇo kamalapattrākṣa gṛhāṇa madhusūdana  || 61.27 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.27|
madhuparkamantra̱ḥ
madhuparkaṃ mahādeva brahmādyaiḥ kalpitaṃ tava  |
mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gṛhāṇa puruṣottama  || 61.28 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.28|
{ācamanīyamantra̱ḥ }
mandākinyāḥ sitaṃ vāri sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam  |
gṛhāṇācamanīyaṃ tvaṃ mayā bhaktyā niveditam  || 61.29 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.29|
{snānamantra̱ḥ }
tvamāpaḥ pṛthivī caiva jyotistvaṃ vāyureva ca  |
lokeśa vṛttimātreṇa vāriṇā snāpayāmyaham  || 61.30 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.30|
{vastramantra̱ḥ }
devatattvasamāyukta yajñavarṇasamanvita  |
svarṇavarṇaprabhe deva vāsasī tava keśava  || 61.31 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.31|
{vilepanamantra̱ḥ }
śarīraṃ te na jānāmi ceṣṭāṃ caiva ca keśava  |
mayā nivedito gandhaḥ pratigṛhya vilipyatām  || 61.32 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.32|
{upavītamantra̱ḥ }
ṛgyajuḥsāmamantreṇa trivṛtaṃ padmayoninā  |
sāvitrīgranthisaṃyuktamupavītaṃ tavārpaye  || 61.33 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.33|
{alaṃkāramantra̱ḥ }
divyaratnasamāyukta vahnibhānusamaprabha  |
gātrāṇi tava śobhantu sālaṃkārāṇi mādhava  || 61.34 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.34|
oṃ nama iti pratyakṣaraṃ samastena mūlamantreṇa vā pūjayet ||61.35|
{dhūpamantra̱ḥ }
vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyaḥ surabhiśca te  |
mayā nivedito bhaktyā dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām  || 61.36 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.36|
{dīpamantra̱ḥ }
sūryacandrasamo jyotirvidyudagnyostathaiva ca  |
tvameva jyotiṣāṃ deva dīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām  || 61.37 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.37|
{naivedyamantra̱ḥ }
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ caiva rasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samanvitam  |
mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā naivedyaṃ tava keśava  || 61.38 ||
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya namaḥ ||61.38|
pūrve dale vāsudevaṃ yāmye saṃkarṣaṇaṃ nyaset |
pradyumnaṃ paścime kuryādaniruddhaṃ tathottare  || 61.39 ||
vārāhaṃ ca tathāgneye narasiṃhaṃ ca nairṛte  |
vāyavye mādhavaṃ caiva tathaiśāne trivikramam  || 61.40 ||
tathāṣṭākṣaradevasya garuḍaṃ purato nyaset |
vāmapārśve tathā cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset || 61.41 ||
tathā mahāgadāṃ caiva nyaseddevasya dakṣiṇe  |
tataḥ śārṅgaṃ dhanurvidvānnyaseddevasya vāmataḥ  || 61.42 ||
dakṣiṇeneṣudhī divye khaḍgaṃ vāme ca vinyaset |
śriyaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ sthāpya puṣṭimuttarato nyaset || 61.43 ||
vanamālāṃ ca puratastataḥ śrīvatsakaustubhau  |
vinyaseddhṛdayādīni pūrvādiṣu caturdiśam  || 61.44 ||
tato'straṃ devadevasya koṇe caiva tu vinyaset |
indramagniṃ yamaṃ caiva nairṛtaṃ varuṇaṃ tathā  || 61.45 ||
vāyuṃ dhanadamīśānamanantaṃ brahmaṇā saha  |
pūjayettāntrikairmantrairadhaścordhvaṃ tathaiva ca  || 61.46 ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ maṇḍalasthaṃ janārdanam  |
labhedabhimatān kāmānnaro nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ  || 61.47 ||
anenaiva vidhānena maṇḍalasthaṃ janārdanam  |
pūjitaṃ yaḥ saṃpaśyeta sa viśedviṣṇumavyayam  || 61.48 ||
sakṛdapyarcito yena vidhinānena keśavaḥ  |
janmamṛtyujarāṃ tīrtvā sa viṣṇoḥ padamāpnuyāt || 61.49 ||
yaḥ smaretsatataṃ bhaktyā nārāyaṇamatandritaḥ  |
anvahaṃ tasya vāsāya śvetadvīpaḥ prakalpitaḥ  || 61.50 ||
oṃkārādisamāyuktaṃ namaḥkārāntadīpitam  |
tannāma sarvatattvānāṃ mantra ityabhidhīyate  || 61.51 ||
anenaiva vidhānena gandhapuṣpaṃ nivedayet |
ekaikasya prakurvīta yathoddiṣṭaṃ krameṇa tu  || 61.52 ||
mudrāstato nibadhnīyādyathoktakramacoditāḥ  |
japaṃ caiva prakurvīta mūlamantreṇa mantravit || 61.53 ||
aṣṭāviṃśatimaṣṭau vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tathā  |
kāmeṣu ca yathāproktaṃ yathāśakti samāhitaḥ  || 61.54 ||
padmaṃ śaṅkhaśca śrīvatso gadā garuḍa eva ca  |
cakraṃ khaḍgaśca śārṅgaṃ ca aṣṭau mudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ  || 61.55 ||
{visarjanamantra̱ḥ }
gaccha gaccha paraṃ sthānaṃ purāṇapuruṣottama  |
yatra brahmādayo devā vindanti paramaṃ padam  || 61.56 ||
arcanaṃ ye na jānanti harermantrairyathoditam  |
te tatra mūlamantreṇa pūjayantvacyutaṃ sadā  || 61.57 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā taṃ puruṣottamam  |
praṇamya śirasā paścātsāgaraṃ ca prasādayet || 62.1 ||
prāṇastvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yoniśca saritāṃ pate  |
tīrtharāja namaste'stu trāhi māmacyutapriya  || 62.2 ||
snātvaivaṃ sāgare samyaktasmin kṣetravare dvijāḥ  |
tīre cābhyarcya vidhivannārāyaṇamanāmayam  || 62.3 ||
rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca praṇipatya ca sāgaram  |
śatānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ  || 62.4 ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ  |
vṛndāraka iva śrīmān rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ  || 62.5 ||
vimānenārkavarṇena divyagandharvanādinā  |
kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  || 62.6 ||
bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān krīḍitvā cāpsaraiḥ saha  |
manvantaraśataṃ sāgraṃ jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ  || 62.7 ||
puṇyakṣayādihāyātaḥ kule sarvaguṇānvite  |
rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān satyavādī jitendriyaḥ  || 62.8 ||
vedaśāstrārthavidvipro bhavedyajvā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ  |
yogaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ prāpya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 62.9 ||
grahoparāge saṃkrāntyāmayane viṣuve tathā  |
yugādiṣu ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatīpāte dinakṣaye  || 62.10 ||
āṣāḍhyāṃ caiva kārttikyāṃ māghyāṃ vānye śubhe tithau  |
ye tatra dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ prayacchanti sumedhasaḥ  || 62.11 ||
phalaṃ sahasraguṇitamanyatīrthāllabhanti te  |
pitṝṇāṃ ye prayacchanti piṇḍaṃ tatra vidhānataḥ  || 62.12 ||
akṣayāṃ pitarasteṣāṃ tṛptiṃ saṃprāpnuvanti vai  |
evaṃ snānaphalaṃ samyaksāgarasya mayoditam  || 62.13 ||
dānasya ca phalaṃ viprāḥ piṇḍadānasya caiva hi  |
dharmārthamokṣaphaladamāyuṣkīrtiyaśaskaram  || 62.14 ||
bhuktimuktiphalaṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam  |
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam  || 62.15 ||
nāstikāya na vaktavyaṃ purāṇaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  |
tāvadgarjanti tīrthāni māhātmyaiḥ svaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 62.16 ||
yāvanna tīrtharājasya māhātmyaṃ varṇyate dvijāḥ  |
puṣkarādīni tīrthāni prayacchanti svakaṃ phalam  || 62.17 ||
tīrtharājastu sa punaḥ sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ  |
bhūtale yāni tīrthāni saritaśca sarāṃsi ca  || 62.18 ||
viśanti sāgare tāni tenāsau śreṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ  |
rājā samastatīrthānāṃ sāgaraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ  || 62.19 ||
tasmātsamastatīrthebhyaḥ śreṣṭho'sau sarvakāmadaḥ  |
tamo nāśaṃ yathābhyeti bhāskare'bhyudite dvijāḥ  || 62.20 ||
snānena tīrtharājasya tathā pāpasya saṃkṣayaḥ  |
tīrtharājasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati  || 62.21 ||
adhiṣṭhānaṃ yadā yatra prabhornārāyaṇasya vai  |
kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ tīrtharājasya bho dvijāḥ  || 62.22 ||
koṭyo navanavatyastu yatra tīrthāni santi vai  |
tasmātsnānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca homaṃ japyaṃ surārcanam  |
yatkiṃcitkriyate tatra cākṣayaṃ kriyate dvijāḥ  || 62.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ yajñāṅgasaṃbhavam  |
indradyumnasaro nāma yatrāste pāvanaṃ śubham  || 63.1 ||
gatvā tatra śucirdhīmānācamya manasā harim  |
dhyātvopasthāya ca jalamimaṃ mantramudīrayet || 63.2 ||
aśvamedhāṅgasaṃbhūta tīrtha sarvāghanāśana  |
snānaṃ tvayi karomyadya pāpaṃ hara namo'stu te  || 63.3 ||
evamuccārya vidhivatsnātvā devānṛṣīn pitṝn  |
tilodakena cānyāṃśca saṃtarpyācamya vāgyataḥ  || 63.4 ||
dattvā pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍāṃśca saṃpūjya puruṣottamam  |
daśāśvamedhikaṃ samyakphalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ  || 63.5 ||
saptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśānuddhṛtya devavat |
kāmagena vimānena viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  || 63.6 ||
bhuktvā tatra sukhān bhogān yāvaccandrārkatārakam  |
cyutastasmādihāyāto mokṣaṃ ca labhate dhruvam  || 63.7 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā pañcatīrthīmekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ  |
jyeṣṭhaśuklapañcadaśyāṃ yaḥ paśyetpuruṣottamam  || 63.8 ||
sa pūrvoktaṃ phalaṃ prāpya krīḍitvā vācyutālaye  |
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yasmānnāvartate punaḥ  || 63.9 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
māsānanyān parityajya māghādīn prapitāmaha  |
praśaṃsasi kathaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ prabho  || 63.10 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ  |
jyeṣṭhaṃ māsaṃ yathā tebhyaḥ praśaṃsāmi punaḥ punaḥ  || 63.11 ||
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaśca sarāṃsi ca  |
puṣkariṇyastaḍāgāni vāpyaḥ kūpāstathā hradāḥ  || 63.12 ||
nānānadyaḥ samudrāśca saptāhaṃ puruṣottame  |
jyeṣṭhaśukladaśamyādi pratyakṣaṃ yānti sarvadā  || 63.13 ||
snānadānādikaṃ tasmāddevatāprekṣaṇaṃ dvijāḥ  |
yatkiṃcitkriyate tatra tasmin kāle'kṣayaṃ bhavet || 63.14 ||
śuklapakṣasya daśamī jyeṣṭhe māsi dvijottamāḥ  |
harate daśa pāpāni tasmāddaśaharā smṛtā  || 63.15 ||
yastasyāṃ halinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paśyedbhadrāṃ susaṃyataḥ  |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ vrajennaraḥ  || 63.16 ||
uttare dakṣiṇe viprāstvayane puruṣottamam  |
dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ subhadrāṃ ca viṣṇulokaṃ vrajennaraḥ  || 63.17 ||
naro dolāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā govindaṃ puruṣottamam  |
phālgunyāṃ prayato bhūtvā govindasya puraṃ vrajet || 63.18 ||
viṣuvaddivase prāpte pañcatīrthīṃ vidhānataḥ  |
kṛtvā saṃkarṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadrāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  || 63.19 ||
naraḥ samastayajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti durlabham  |
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati  || 63.20 ||
yaḥ paśyati tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ candanarūṣitam  |
vaiśākhasyāsite pakṣe sa yātyacyutamandiram  || 63.21 ||
jyaiṣṭhyāṃ jyeṣṭharkṣayuktāyāṃ yaḥ paśyetpuruṣottamam  |
kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  || 63.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yadā bhavenmahājyaiṣṭhī rāśinakṣatrayogataḥ  |
prayatnena tadā martyairgantavyaṃ puruṣottamam  || 64.1 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  |
naro dvādaśayātrāyāḥ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam  || 64.2 ||
prayāge ca kurukṣetre naimiṣe puṣkare gaye  |
gaṅgādvāre kuśāvarte gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame  || 64.3 ||
kokāmukhe śūkare ca mathurāyāṃ marusthale  |
śālagrāme vāyutīrthe mandare sindhusāgare  || 64.4 ||
piṇḍārake citrakūṭe prabhāse kanakhale dvijāḥ  |
śaṅkhoddhāre dvārakāyāṃ tathā badarikāśrame  || 64.5 ||
lohakuṇḍe cāśvatīrthe sarvapāpapramocane  |
kāmālaye koṭitīrthe tathā cāmarakaṇṭake  || 64.6 ||
lohārgale jambumārge somatīrthe pṛthūdake  |
utpalāvartake caiva pṛthutuṅge sukubjake  || 64.7 ||
ekāmrake ca kedāre kāśyāṃ ca viraje dvijāḥ  |
kālañjare ca gokarṇe śrīśaile gandhamādane  || 64.8 ||
mahendre malaye vindhye pāriyātre himālaye  |
sahye ca śuktimante ca gomante cārbude tathā  || 64.9 ||
gaṅgāyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yāmuneṣu ca bho dvijāḥ  |
sārasvateṣu gomatyāṃ brahmaputreṣu saptasu  || 64.10 ||
godāvarī bhīmarathī tuṅgabhadrā ca narmadā  |
tāpī payouṣṇī kāverī śiprā carmaṇvatī dvijāḥ  || 64.11 ||
vitastā candrabhāgā ca śatadrurbāhudā tathā  |
ṛṣikulyā kumārī ca vipāśā ca dṛṣadvatī  || 64.12 ||
śarayūrnākagaṅgā ca gaṇḍakī ca mahānadī  |
kauśikī karatoyā ca trisrotā madhuvāhinī  || 64.13 ||
mahānadī vaitaraṇī yāścānyā nānukīrtitāḥ  |
athavā kiṃ bahūktena bhāṣitena dvijottamāḥ  || 64.14 ||
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarveṣvāyataneṣu ca  |
sāgareṣu ca śaileṣu nadīṣu ca saraḥsu ca  || 64.15 ||
yatphalaṃ snānadānena rāhugraste divākare  |
tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇamālokya mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ labhennaraḥ  || 64.16 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena gantavyaṃ puruṣottame  |
mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ muniśreṣṭhā sarvakāmaphalepsubhiḥ  || 64.17 ||
dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ mahājyeṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ subhadrayā saha  |
viṣṇulokaṃ naro yāti samuddhṛtya samaṃ kulam  || 64.18 ||
bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  |
puṇyakṣayādihāgatya caturvedī dvijo bhavet || 64.19 ||
svadharmanirataḥ śāntaḥ kṛṣṇabhakto jitendriyaḥ  |
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 64.20 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kasmin kāle bhavetsnānaṃ kṛṣṇasya kamalodbhava  |
vidhinā kena tadbrūhi tato vidhividāṃ vara  || 65.1 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ snānaṃ kṛṣṇasya vadato mama  |
rāmasya ca subhadrāyāḥ puṇyaṃ sarvāghanāśanam  || 65.2 ||
māsi jyeṣṭhe ca saṃprāpte nakṣatre candradaivate  |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tadā snānaṃ sarvakālaṃ harerdvijāḥ  || 65.3 ||
sarvatīrthamayaḥ kūpastatrāste nirmalaḥ śuciḥ  |
tadā bhogavatī tatra pratyakṣā bhavati dvijāḥ  || 65.4 ||
tasmājjyaiṣṭhyāṃ samuddhṛtya haimāḍhyaiḥ kalaśairjalam  |
kṛṣṇarāmābhiṣekārthaṃ subhadrāyāśca bho dvijāḥ  || 65.5 ||
kṛtvā suśobhanaṃ mañcaṃ patākābhiralaṃkṛtam  |
sudṛḍhaṃ sukhasaṃcāraṃ vastraiḥ puṣpairalaṃkṛtam  || 65.6 ||
vistīrṇaṃ dhūpitaṃ dhūpaiḥ snānārthaṃ rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ  |
sitavastraparicchannaṃ muktāhārāvalambitam  || 65.7 ||
tatra nānāvidhairvādyaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nīlāmbaraṃ dvijāḥ  |
madhye subhadrāṃ cāsthāpya jayamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ  || 65.8 ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiścānyaiśca jātibhiḥ  |
anekaśatasāhasrairvṛtaṃ strīpuruṣairdvijāḥ  || 65.9 ||
gṛhasthāḥ snātakāścaiva yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ  |
snāpayanti tadā kṛṣṇaṃ mañcasthaṃ sahalāyudham  || 65.10 ||
tathā samastatīrthāni pūrvoktāni dvijottamāḥ  |
svodakaiḥ puṣpamiśraiśca snāpayanti pṛthakpṛthak || 65.11 ||
paścātpaṭahaśaṅkhādyairbherīmurajanisvanaiḥ  |
kāhalaistālaśabdaiśca mṛdaṅgairjharjharaistathā  || 65.12 ||
anyaiśca vividhairvādyairghaṇṭāsvanavibhūṣitaiḥ  |
strīṇāṃ maṅgalaśabdaiśca stutiśabdairmanoharaiḥ  || 65.13 ||
jayaśabdaistathā stotrairvīṇāveṇunināditaiḥ  |
śrūyate sumahāñśabdaḥ sāgarasyeva garjataḥ  || 65.14 ||
munīnāṃ vedaśabdena mantraśabdaistathāparaiḥ  |
nānāstotraravaiḥ puṇyaiḥ sāmaśabdopabṛṃhitaiḥ  || 65.15 ||
yatibhiḥ snātakaiścaiva gṛhasthairbrahmacāribhiḥ  |
snānakāle suraśreṣṭha stuvanti parayā mudā  || 65.16 ||
śyāmairveśyājanaiścaiva kucabhārāvanāmibhiḥ  |
pītaraktāmbarābhiśca mālyadāmāvanāmibhiḥ  || 65.17 ||
saratnakuṇḍalairdivyaiḥ suvarṇastabakānvitaiḥ  |
cāmarai ratnadaṇḍaiśca vījyete rāmakeśavau  || 65.18 ||
yakṣavidyādharaiḥ siddhaiḥ kiṃnaraiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ  |
parivāryāmbaragatairdevagandharvacāraṇaiḥ  || 65.19 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve marudgaṇāḥ  |
lokapālāstathā cānye stuvanti puruṣottamam  || 65.20 ||
namaste devadeveśa purāṇa puruṣottama  |
sargasthityantakṛddeva lokanātha jagatpate  || 65.21 ||
trailokyadhāriṇaṃ devaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ mokṣakāraṇam  |
taṃ namasyāmahe bhaktyā sarvakāmaphalapradam  || 65.22 ||
stutvaivaṃ vibudhāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ caiva mahābalam  |
subhadrāṃ ca muniśreṣṭhāstadākāśe vyavasthitāḥ  || 65.23 ||
gāyanti devagandharvā nṛtyantyapsarasastathā  |
devatūryāṇyavādyanta vātā vānti suśītalāḥ  || 65.24 ||
puṣpamiśraṃ tadā meghā varṣantyākāśagocarāḥ  |
jayaśabdaṃ ca kurvanti munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ  || 65.25 ||
śakrādyā vibudhāḥ sarva ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā  |
prajānāṃ patayo nāgā ye cānye svargavāsinaḥ  || 65.26 ||
tato maṅgalasaṃbhārairvidhimantrapuraskṛtam  |
ābhiṣecanikaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā devatāgaṇāḥ  || 65.27 ||
indro viṣṇurmahāvīryaḥ sūryācandramasau tathā  |
dhātā caiva vidhātā ca tathā caivānilānalau  || 65.28 ||
pūṣā bhago'ryamā tvaṣṭā aṃśunaiva vivasvatā  |
patnībhyāṃ sahito dhīmānmitreṇa varuṇena ca  || 65.29 ||
rudrairvasubhirādityairaśvibhyāṃ ca vṛtaḥ prabhuḥ  |
viśvairdevairmarudbhiśca sādhyaiśca pitṛbhiḥ saha  || 65.30 ||
gandharvairapsarobhiśca yakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ  |
devarṣibhirasaṃkhyeyaistathā brahmarṣibhirvaraiḥ  || 65.31 ||
vaikhānasairvālakhilyairvāyvāhārairmarīcipaiḥ  |
bhṛgubhiścāṅgirobhiśca sarvavidyāsuniṣṭhitaiḥ  || 65.32 ||
sarvavidyādharaiḥ puṇyairyogasiddhibhirāvṛtaḥ  |
pitāmahaḥ pulastyaśca pulahaśca mahātapāḥ  || 65.33 ||
aṅgirāḥ kaśyapo'triśca marīcirbhṛgureva ca  |
kraturharaḥ pracetāśca manurdakṣastathaiva ca  || 65.34 ||
ṛtavaśca grahāścaiva jyotīṃṣi ca dvijottamāḥ  |
mūrtimatyaśca sarito devāścaiva sanātanāḥ  || 65.35 ||
samudrāśca hradāścaiva tīrthāni vividhāni ca  |
pṛthivī dyaurdiśaścaiva pādapāśca dvijottamāḥ  || 65.36 ||
aditirdevamātā ca hrīḥ śrīḥ svāhā sarasvatī  |
umā śacī sinīvālī tathā cānumatiḥ kuhūḥ  || 65.37 ||
rākā ca dhiṣaṇā caiva patnyaścānyā divaukasām  |
himavāṃścaiva vindhyaśca meruścānekaśṛṅgavān  || 65.38 ||
airāvataḥ sānucaraḥ kalākāṣṭhāstathaiva ca  |
māsārdhaṃ māsaṛtavastathā rātryahanī samāḥ  || 65.39 ||
uccaiḥśravā hayaśreṣṭho nāgarājaśca vāmanaḥ  |
aruṇo garuḍaścaiva vṛkṣāścauṣadhibhiḥ saha  || 65.40 ||
dharmaśca bhagavān devaḥ samājagmurhi saṃgatāḥ  |
kālo yamaśca mṛtyuśca yamasyānucarāśca ye  || 65.41 ||
bahulatvācca noktā ye vividhā devatāgaṇāḥ  |
te devasyābhiṣekārthaṃ samāyānti tatastataḥ  || 65.42 ||
gṛhītvā te tadā viprāḥ sarve devā divaukasaḥ  |
ābhiṣecanikaṃ dravyaṃ maṅgalāni ca sarvaśaḥ  || 65.43 ||
divyasaṃbhārasaṃyuktaiḥ kalaśaiḥ kāñcanairdvijāḥ  |
sārasvatībhiḥ puṇyābhirdivyatoyābhireva ca  || 65.44 ||
toyenākāśagaṅgāyāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmeṇa saṃgatam  |
sapuṣpaiḥ kāñcanaiḥ kumbhaiḥ snāpayantyavanisthitāḥ  || 65.45 ||
saṃcaranti vimānāni devānāmambare tathā  |
uccāvacāni divyāni kāmagāni sthirāṇi ca  || 65.46 ||
divyaratnavicitrāṇi sevitānyapsarogaṇaiḥ  |
gītairvādyaiḥ patākābhiḥ śobhitāni samantataḥ  || 65.47 ||
evaṃ tadā muniśreṣṭhāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmeṇa saṃgatam  |
snāpayitvā subhadrāṃ ca saṃstuvanti mudānvitāḥ  || 65.48 ||

jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya saṃkarṣaṇānuja  |
jaya padmapalāśākṣa jaya vāñchāphalaprada  || 65.50 ||
jaya mālāvṛtoraska jaya cakragadādhara  |

evaṃ stutvā tadā devāḥ śakrādyā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ  |

munayo vālakhilyāśca kṛṣṇaṃ rāmeṇa saṃgatam  |

dṛṣṭvā stutvā namaskṛtvā tadā te tridivaukasaḥ  |

saṃcaranti vimānāni devānāmambare tadā  |

gītairvādyaiḥ patākābhiḥ śobhitāni samantataḥ  || 65.56 ||

yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu vratairdānaiśca kīrtitam  |

subhadrāṃ ca muniśreṣṭhāḥ prāpnoti śubhakṛnnaraḥ  |
tasmānnaro'thavā nārī paśyettaṃ puruṣottamam  || 65.76 ||
tataḥ samastatīrthānāṃ labhetsnānādikaṃ phalam  |

vandhyā mṛtaprajā yā tu durbhagā grahapīḍitā  |

sadyastāḥ snānaśeṣeṇa udakenābhiṣecitāḥ  |
prāpnuvantīpsitān kāmān yān yān vāñchanti cepsitān  || 65.79 ||
putrārthinī labhetputrān saubhāgyaṃ ca sukhārthinī  |
rogārtā mucyate rogāddhanaṃ ca dhanakāṅkṣiṇī  || 65.80 ||
puṇyāni yāni toyāni tiṣṭhanti dharaṇītale  |

śāstreṣu yatphalaṃ proktaṃ pṛthivyastripradakṣiṇaiḥ  |

badaryāṃ yatphalaṃ proktaṃ dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ naram  |

yatphalaṃ snānadānena vidhivatsamudāhṛtam  |

dṛṣṭvā naro labhetkṛṣṇaṃ tatphalaṃ sahalāyudham  |

guḍivāmaṇḍapaṃ yāntaṃ ye paśyanti rathe sthitam  |

ye paśyanti tadā kṛṣṇaṃ saptāhaṃ maṇḍape sthitam  |

{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kena sā nirmitā yātrā dakṣiṇasyāṃ jagatpate  |

kimarthaṃ sarasastīre rājñastasya jagatpate  |

kṛṣṇaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaścaiva subhadrā ca rathena te  |

{brahmovāca̱ }
indradyumnena bho viprāḥ purā vai prārthito hariḥ  |

{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
saptāhaṃ sarasastīre tava rājan bhaviṣyati  |

ye māṃ tatrārcayiṣyanti śraddhayā maṇḍape sthitam  |

brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāśca vai nṛpa  |

upahārairbahuvidhaiḥ praṇipātaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ  |

sarvakāmapradaṃ devaṃ paśyettaṃ puruṣottamam  || 66.14 ||

yān yān samīhate bhogān dṛṣṭvā taṃ puruṣottamam  |

yātrāṃ kṛtvā guḍivākhyāṃ vidhivatsusamāhitaḥ  |
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe naro yoṣidathāpi vā  || 66.18 ||
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  |
daśapañcāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam  || 66.19 ||
saptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśānuddhṛtya cātmanaḥ  |
kāmagena vimānena sarvaratnairalaṃkṛtaḥ  || 66.20 ||
gandharvairapsarobhiśca sevyamāno yathottaraiḥ  |
rūpavān subhagaḥ śūro naro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet || 66.21 ||
tatra bhuktvā varān bhogān yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  |
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ  || 66.22 ||
puṇyakṣayādihāgatya caturvedī dvijo bhavet |
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 66.23 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
ekaikasyāstu yātrāyāḥ phalaṃ brūhi pṛthakpṛthak |
yatprāpnoti naraḥ kṛtvā nārī vā tatra saṃyatā  || 67.1 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pratiyātrāphalaṃ viprāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama  |
yatprāpnoti naraḥ kṛtvā tasmin kṣetre susaṃyataḥ  || 67.2 ||
guḍivāyāṃ tathotthāne phālgunyāṃ viṣuve tathā  |
yātrāṃ kṛtvā vidhānena dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca  || 67.3 ||
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca labhetsarvatra vai phalam  |
naro gacchedviṣṇuloke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa  || 67.4 ||
yāvadyātrāṃ jyeṣṭhamāse karoti vidhivannaraḥ  |
tāvatkalpaṃ viṣṇuloke sukhaṃ bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ  || 67.5 ||
tasmin kṣetravare puṇye ramye śrīpuruṣottame  |
bhuktimuktiprade nṝṇāṃ sarvasattvasukhāvahe  || 67.6 ||
jyeṣṭhe yātrāṃ naraḥ kṛtvā nārī vā saṃyatendriyaḥ  |
yathoktena vidhānena daśa dve ca samāhitaḥ  || 67.7 ||
pratiṣṭhāṃ kurute yastu śāṭhyadambhavivarjitaḥ  |
sa bhuktvā vividhān bhogānmokṣaṃ cānte labheddhruvam  || 67.8 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
śrotumicchāmahe deva pratiṣṭhāṃ vadatastava  |
vidhānaṃ cārcanaṃ dānaṃ phalaṃ tatra jagatpateḥ  || 67.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ vidhicoditām  |
yāṃ kṛtvā tu naro bhaktyā nārī vā labhate phalam  || 67.10 ||
yātrā dvādaśa saṃpūrṇā yadā syāttu dvijottamāḥ  |
tadā kurvīta vidhivatpratiṣṭhāṃ pāpanāśinīm  || 67.11 ||
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe tvekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ  |
gatvā jalāśayaṃ puṇyamācamya prayataḥ śuciḥ  || 67.12 ||
āvāhya sarvatīrthāni dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ tathā  |
tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta vidhivatsusamāhitaḥ  || 67.13 ||
yasya yo vidhiruddiṣṭa ṛṣibhiḥ snānakarmaṇi  |
tenaiva tu vidhānena snānaṃ tasya vidhīyate  || 67.14 ||
snātvā samyagvidhānena tato devānṛṣīn pitṝn  |
saṃtarpayettathānyāṃśca nāmagotravidhānavit || 67.15 ||
uttīrya vāsasī dhaute nirmale paridhāya vai  |
upaspṛśya vidhānena bhāskarābhimukhastataḥ  || 67.16 ||
gāyatrīṃ pāvanīṃ devīṃ manasā vedamātaram  |
sarvapāpaharāṃ puṇyāṃ japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam  || 67.17 ||
puṇyāṃśca sauramantrāṃśca śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ  |
triḥ pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya bhāskaraṃ praṇamettataḥ  || 67.18 ||
vedoktaṃ triṣu varṇeṣu snānaṃ jāpyamudāhṛtam  |
strīśūdrayoḥ snānajāpyaṃ vedoktavidhivarjitam  || 67.19 ||
tato gacchedgṛhaṃ maunī pūjayetpuruṣottamam  |
prakṣālya hastau pādau ca upaspṛśya yathāvidhi  || 67.20 ||
ghṛtena snāpayeddevaṃ kṣīreṇa tadanantaram  |
madhugandhodakenaiva tīrthacandanavāriṇā  || 67.21 ||
tato vastrayugaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhaktyā taṃ paridhāpayet |
candanāgarukarpūraiḥ kuṅkumena vilepayet || 67.22 ||
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā padmaiśca puruṣottamam  |
anyaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ puṣpairarcayenmallikādibhiḥ  || 67.23 ||
saṃpūjyaivaṃ jagannāthaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ harim  |
dhūpaṃ cāgurusaṃyuktaṃ daheddevasya cāgrataḥ  || 67.24 ||
guggulaṃ ca muniśreṣṭhā dahedgandhasamanvitam  |
dīpaṃ prajvālayedbhaktyā yathāśaktyā ghṛtena vai  || 67.25 ||
anyāṃśca dīpakān dadyāddvādaśaiva samāhitaḥ  |
ghṛtena ca muniśreṣṭhāstilatailena vā punaḥ  || 67.26 ||
naivedye pāyasāpūpa śaṣkulīvaṭakaṃ tathā  |
modakaṃ phāṇitaṃ vālpaṃ phalāni ca nivedayet || 67.27 ||
evaṃ pañcopacāreṇa saṃpūjya puruṣottamam  |
namaḥ puruṣottamāyeti japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam  || 67.28 ||
tataḥ prasādayeddevaṃ bhaktyā taṃ puruṣottamam  |
namaste sarvalokeśa bhaktānāmabhayaprada  || 67.29 ||
saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ trāhi māṃ puruṣottama  |
yāste mayā kṛtā yātrā dvādaśaiva jagatpate  || 67.30 ||
prasādāttava govinda saṃpūrṇāstā bhavantu me  |
evaṃ prasādya taṃ devaṃ daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca  || 67.31 ||
tato'rcayedguruṃ bhaktyā puṣpavastrānulepanaiḥ  |
nānayorantaraṃ yasmādvidyate munisattamāḥ  || 67.32 ||
devasyopari kurvīta śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ  |
nānāpuṣpairmuniśreṣṭhā vicitraṃ puṣpamaṇḍapam  || 67.33 ||
kṛtvāvadhāraṇaṃ paścājjāgaraṃ kārayenniśi  |
kathāṃ ca vāsudevasya gītikāṃ cāpi kārayet || 67.34 ||
dhyāyan paṭhan stuvan devaṃ praṇayedrajanīṃ budhaḥ  |
tataḥ prabhāte vimale dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśaiva tu  || 67.35 ||
nimantrayedvratasnātān brāhmaṇān vedapāragān  |
itihāsapurāṇajñāñśrotriyān saṃyatendriyān  || 67.36 ||
snātvā samyagvidhānena dhautavāsā jitendriyaḥ  |
snāpayetpūrvavattatra pūjayetpuruṣottamam  || 67.37 ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpairupahārairnaivedyairdīpakaistathā  |
upacārairbahuvidhaiḥ praṇipātaiḥ pradakṣiṇaiḥ  || 67.38 ||
jāpyaiḥ stutinamaskārairgītavādyairmanoharaiḥ  |
saṃpūjyaivaṃ jagannāthaṃ brāhmaṇān pūjayettataḥ  || 67.39 ||
dvādaśaiva tu gāstebhyo dattvā kanakameva ca  |
chattropānadyugaṃ caiva śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ  || 67.40 ||
bhaktyā tu sadhanaṃ tebhyo dadyādvastrādikaṃ dvijāḥ  |
sadbhāvena tu govindastoṣyate pūjito yataḥ  || 67.41 ||
ācāryāya tato dadyādgovastraṃ kanakaṃ tathā  |
chattropānadyugaṃ cānyatkāṃsyapātraṃ ca bhaktitaḥ  || 67.42 ||
tatastān bhojayedviprān bhojyaṃ pāyasapūrvakam  |
pakvānnaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca guḍasarpiḥsamanvitam  || 67.43 ||
tatastānannatṛptāṃśca brāhmaṇān svasthamānasān  |
dvādaśaivodakumbhāṃśca dadyāttebhyaḥ samodakān  || 67.44 ||
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśaktyā dadyāttebhyo vimatsaraḥ  |
kumbhaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ caiva ācāryāya nivedayet || 67.45 ||
evaṃ saṃpūjya tān viprān guruṃ jñānapradāyakam  |
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā viṣṇutulyaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 67.46 ||
suvarṇavastragodhānyairdravyaiścānyairvarairbudhaḥ  |
saṃpūjya taṃ namaskṛtya imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 67.47 ||
sarvavyāpī jagannāthaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  |
anādinidhano devaḥ prīyatāṃ puruṣottamaḥ  || 67.48 ||
ityuccārya tato viprāṃstriḥ kṛtvā ca pradakṣiṇām  |
praṇamya śirasā bhaktyā ācāryaṃ tu visarjayet || 67.49 ||
tatastān brāhmaṇān bhaktyā cāsīmāntamanuvrajet |
anuvrajya tu tān sarvānnamaskṛtya nivartayet || 67.50 ||
bāndhavaiḥ svajanairyuktastato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ  |
anyaiścopāsakairdīnairbhikṣukaiścānnakāṅkṣibhiḥ  || 67.51 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ samyaṅnārī vā labhate phalam  |
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ rājasūyaśatasya ca  || 67.52 ||
atītaṃ śatamādāya puruṣāṇāṃ narottamāḥ  |
bhaviṣyaṃ ca śataṃ viprāḥ svargatyā divyarūpadhṛk || 67.53 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ  |
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā devavadvigatajvaraḥ  || 67.54 ||
rūpayauvanasaṃpanno guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtaḥ  |
stūyamāno'psarobhiśca gandharvaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ  || 67.55 ||
vimānenārkavarṇena kāmagena sthireṇa ca  |
patākādhvajayuktena sarvaratnairalaṃkṛtaḥ  || 67.56 ||
udyotayan diśaḥ sarvā ākāśe vigataklamaḥ  |
yuvā mahābalo dhīmān viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  || 67.57 ||
tatra kalpaśataṃ yāvadbhuṅkte bhogān yathepsitān  |
siddhāpsarobhirgandharvaiḥ suravidyādharoragaiḥ  || 67.58 ||
stūyamāno munivaraistiṣṭhate vigatajvaraḥ  |
yathā devo jagannāthaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  || 67.59 ||
tathāsau mudito viprāḥ kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam  |
bhuktvā tatra varān bhogān krīḍāṃ kṛtvā suraiḥ saha  || 67.60 ||
tadante brahmasadanamāyāti sarvakāmadam  |
siddhavidyādharaiścāpi śobhitaṃ surakiṃnaraiḥ  || 67.61 ||
kālaṃ navatikalpaṃ tu tatra bhuktvā sukhaṃ naraḥ  |
tasmādāyāti viprendrāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradam  || 67.62 ||
rudralokaṃ suragaṇaiḥ sevitaṃ sukhamokṣadam  |
anekaśatasāhasrairvimānaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam  || 67.63 ||
siddhavidyādharairyakṣairbhūṣitaṃ daityadānavaiḥ  |
aśītikalpakālaṃ tu tatra bhuktvā sukhaṃ naraḥ  || 67.64 ||
tadante yāti golokaṃ sarvabhogasamanvitam  |
surasiddhāpsarobhiśca śobhitaṃ sumanoharam  || 67.65 ||
tatra saptatikalpāṃstu bhuktvā bhogamanuttamam  |
durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu svasthacitto yathāmaraḥ  || 67.66 ||
tasmādāgacchate lokaṃ prājāpatyamanuttamam  |
gandharvāpsarasaiḥ siddhairmunividyādharairvṛtaḥ  || 67.67 ||
ṣaṣṭikalpān sukhaṃ tatra bhuktvā nānāvidhaṃ mudā  |
tadante śakrabhavanaṃ nānāścaryasamanvitam  || 67.68 ||
gandharvaiḥ kiṃnaraiḥ siddhaiḥ suravidyādharoragaiḥ  |
guhyakāpsarasaiḥ sādhyairvṛtaiścānyaiḥ surottamaiḥ  || 67.69 ||
āgatya tatra pañcāśatkalpān bhuktvā sukhaṃ naraḥ  |
suralokaṃ tato gatvā vimānaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ  || 67.70 ||
catvāriṃśattu kalpāṃstu bhuktvā bhogān sudurlabhān  |
āgacchate tato lokaṃ nakṣatrākhyaṃ sudurlabham  || 67.71 ||
tato bhogān varān bhuṅkte triṃśatkalpān yathepsitān  |
tasmādāgacchate lokaṃ śaśāṅkasya dvijottamāḥ  || 67.72 ||
yatrāsau tiṣṭhate somaḥ sarvairdevairalaṃkṛtaḥ  |
tatra viṃśatikalpāṃstu bhuktvā bhogaṃ sudurlabham  || 67.73 ||
ādityasya tato lokamāyāti surapūjitam  |
nānāścaryamayaṃ puṇyaṃ gandharvāpsaraḥsevitam  || 67.74 ||
tatra bhuktvā śubhān bhogān daśa kalpān dvijottamāḥ  |
tasmādāyāti bhuvanaṃ gandharvāṇāṃ sudurlabham  || 67.75 ||
tatra bhogān samastāṃśca kalpamekaṃ yathāsukham  |
bhuktvā cāyāti medinyāṃ rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ  || 67.76 ||
cakravartī mahāvīryo guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtaḥ  |
kṛtvā rājyaṃ svadharmeṇa yajñairiṣṭvā sudakṣiṇaiḥ  || 67.77 ||
tadante yogināṃ lokaṃ gatvā mokṣapradaṃ śivam  |
tatra bhuktvā varān bhogān yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  || 67.78 ||
tasmādāgacchate cātra jāyate yogināṃ kule  |
pravare vaiṣṇave viprā durlabhe sādhusaṃmate  || 67.79 ||
caturvedī vipravaro yajñairiṣṭvāptadakṣiṇaiḥ  |
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 67.80 ||
evaṃ yātrāphalaṃ viprā mayā samyagudāhṛtam  |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ kimanyacchrotumicchatha  || 67.81 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
śrotumicchāmahe deva viṣṇulokamanāmayam  |
lokānandakaraṃ kāntaṃ sarvāścaryasamanvitam  || 68.1 ||
pramāṇaṃ tasya lokasya bhogaṃ kāntiṃ balaṃ prabho  |
karmaṇā kena gacchanti tatra dharmaparāyaṇāḥ  || 68.2 ||
darśanātsparśanādvāpi tīrthasnānādināpi vā  |
vistarādbrūhi tattvena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 68.3 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve yatparaṃ paramaṃ padam  |
bhaktānāmīhitaṃ dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃsāranāśanam  || 68.4 ||
pravaraṃ sarvalokānāṃ viṣṇvākhyaṃ vadato mama  |
sarvāścaryamayaṃ puṇyaṃ sthānaṃ trailokyapūjitam  || 68.5 ||
aśokaiḥ pārijātaiśca mandāraiścampakadrumaiḥ  |
mālatīmallikākundairbakulairnāgakesaraiḥ  || 68.6 ||
puṃnāgairatimuktaiśca priyaṅgutagarārjunaiḥ  |
pāṭalācūtakhadiraiḥ karṇikāravanojjvalaiḥ  || 68.7 ||
nāraṅgaiḥ panasairlodhrairnimbadāḍimasarjakaiḥ  |
drākṣālakucakharjūrairmadhukendraphalairdrumaiḥ  || 68.8 ||
kapitthairnārikeraiśca tālaiḥ śrīphalasaṃbhavaiḥ  |
kalpavṛkṣairasaṃkhyaiśca vanyairanyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ  || 68.9 ||
saralaiścandanairnīpairdevadāruśubhāñjanaiḥ  |
jātīlavaṅgakaṅkolaiḥ karpūrāmodavāsibhiḥ  || 68.10 ||
tāmbūlapattranicayaistathā pūgīphaladrumaiḥ  |
anyaiśca vividhairvṛkṣaiḥ sarvartuphalaśobhitaiḥ  || 68.11 ||
puṣpairnānāvidhaiścaiva latāgucchasamudbhavaiḥ  |
nānājalāśayaiḥ puṇyairnānāpakṣirutairvaraiḥ  || 68.12 ||
dīrghikāśatasaṃghātaistoyapūrṇairmanoharaiḥ  |
kumudaiḥ śatapattraiśca puṣpaiḥ kokanadairvaraiḥ  || 68.13 ||
raktanīlotpalaiḥ kāntaiḥ kahlāraiśca sugandhibhiḥ  |
anyaiśca jalajaiḥ puṣpairnānāvarṇaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ  || 68.14 ||
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaiścakravākopaśobhitaiḥ  |
koyaṣṭikaiśca dātyūhaiḥ kāraṇḍavaravākulaiḥ  || 68.15 ||
cātakaiḥ priyaputraiśca jīvaṃjīvakajātibhiḥ  |
anyairdivyairjalacarairvihāramadhurasvanaiḥ  || 68.16 ||
evaṃ nānāvidhairdivyairnānāścaryasamanvitaiḥ  |
vṛkṣairjalāśayaiḥ puṇyairbhūṣitaṃ sumanoharaiḥ  || 68.17 ||
tatra divyairvimānaiśca nānāratnavibhūṣitaiḥ  |
kāmagaiḥ kāñcanaiḥ śubhrairdivyagandharvanāditaiḥ  || 68.18 ||
taruṇādityasaṃkāśairapsarobhiralaṃkṛtaiḥ  |
hemaśayyāsanayutairnānābhogasamanvitaiḥ  || 68.19 ||
khecaraiḥ sapatākaiśca muktāhārāvalambibhiḥ  |
nānāvarṇairasaṃkhyātairjātarūpaparicchadaiḥ  || 68.20 ||
nānākusumagandhāḍhyaiścandanāgurubhūṣitaiḥ  |
sukhapracārabahulairnānāvāditraniḥsvanaiḥ  || 68.21 ||
manomārutatulyaiśca kiṅkiṇīstabakākulaiḥ  |
viharanti pure tasmin vaiṣṇave lokapūjite  || 68.22 ||
nānāṅganābhiḥ satataṃ gandharvāpsarasādibhiḥ  |
candrānanābhiḥ kāntābhiryoṣidbhiḥ sumanoharaiḥ  || 68.23 ||
pīnonnatakucāgrābhiḥ sumadhyābhiḥ samantataḥ  |
śyāmāvadātavarṇābhirmattamātaṅgagāmibhiḥ  || 68.24 ||
parivārya naraśreṣṭhaṃ vījayanti sma tāḥ striyaḥ  |
cāmarai rukmadaṇḍaiśca nānāratnavibhūṣitaiḥ  || 68.25 ||
gītanṛtyaistathā vādyairmodamānairmadālasaiḥ  |
yakṣavidyādharaiḥ siddhairgandharvairapsarogaṇaiḥ  || 68.26 ||
surasaṃghaiśca ṛṣibhiḥ śuśubhe bhuvanottamam  |
tatra prāpya mahābhogān prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ  || 68.27 ||
vaṭarājasamīpe tu dakṣiṇasyodadhestaṭe  |
dṛṣṭo yairbhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ puṣkarākṣo jagatpatiḥ  || 68.28 ||
krīḍantyapsarasaiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvaddyauścandratārakam  |
prataptahemasaṃkāśā jarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ  || 68.29 ||
sarvaduḥkhavihīnāśca tṛṣṇāglānivivarjitāḥ  |
caturbhujā mahāvīryā vanamālāvibhūṣitāḥ  || 68.30 ||
śrīvatsalāñchanairyuktāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharāḥ  |
kecinnīlotpalaśyāmāḥ kecitkāñcanasaṃnibhāḥ  || 68.31 ||
kecinmarakataprakhyāḥ kecidvaidūryasaṃnibhāḥ  |
śyāmavarṇāḥ kuṇḍalinastathānye vajrasaṃnibhāḥ  || 68.32 ||
na tādṛksarvadevānāṃ bhānti lokā dvijottamāḥ  |
yādṛgbhāti harerlokaḥ sarvāścaryasamanvitaḥ  || 68.33 ||
na tatra punarāvṛttirgamanājjāyate dvijāḥ  |
prabhāvāttasya devasya yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  || 68.34 ||
vicaranti pure divye rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ  |
kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ subhadrāṃ ca paśyanti puruṣottame  || 68.35 ||
prataptahemasaṃkāśaṃ taruṇādityasaṃnibham  |
puramadhye harerbhāti mandiraṃ ratnabhūṣitam  || 68.36 ||
anekaśatasāhasraiḥ patākaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam  |
yojanāyutavistīrṇaṃ hemaprākāraveṣṭitam  || 68.37 ||
nānāvarṇairdhvajaiścitraiḥ kalpitaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ  |
vibhāti śārado yadvannakṣatraiḥ saha candramāḥ  || 68.38 ||
caturdvāraṃ suvistīrṇaṃ kañcukibhiḥ surakṣitam  |
purasaptakasaṃyuktaṃ mahotsekaṃ manoharam  || 68.39 ||
prathamaṃ kāñcanaṃ tatra dvitīyaṃ marakatairyutam  |
indranīlaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu mahānīlaṃ tataḥ param  || 68.40 ||
puraṃ tu pañcamaṃ dīptaṃ padmarāgamayaṃ puram  |
ṣaṣṭhaṃ vajramayaṃ viprā vaidūryaṃ saptamaṃ puram  || 68.41 ||
nānāratnamayairhema pravālāṅkurabhūṣitaiḥ  |
stambhairadbhutasaṃkāśairbhāti tadbhavanaṃ mahat || 68.42 ||
dṛśyante tatra siddhāśca bhāsayanti diśo daśa  |
paurṇamāsyāṃ sanakṣatro yathā bhāti niśākaraḥ  || 68.43 ||
ārūḍhastatra bhagavān salakṣmīko janārdanaḥ  |
pītāmbaradharaḥ śyāmaḥ śrīvatsalakṣmasaṃyutaḥ  || 68.44 ||
jvalatsudarśanaṃ cakraṃ ghoraṃ sarvāstranāyakam  |
dadhāra dakṣiṇe haste sarvatejomayaṃ hariḥ  || 68.45 ||
kundendurajataprakhyaṃ hāragokṣīrasaṃnibham  |
ādāya taṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ savyahastena keśavaḥ  || 68.46 ||
yasya śabdena sakalaṃ saṃkṣobhaṃ jāyate jagat |
viśrutaṃ pāñcajanyeti sahasrāvartabhūṣitam  || 68.47 ||
duṣkṛtāntakarīṃ raudrāṃ daityadānavanāśinīm  |
jvaladvahniśikhākārāṃ duḥsahāṃ tridaśairapi  || 68.48 ||
kaumodakīṃ gadāṃ cāsau dhṛtavān dakṣiṇe kare  |
vāme visphurati hyasya śārṅgaṃ sūryasamaprabham  || 68.49 ||
śarairādityasaṃkāśairjvālāmālākulairvaraiḥ  |
yo'sau saṃharate devastrailokyaṃ sacarācaram  || 68.50 ||
sarvānandakaraḥ śrīmān sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ  |
sarvalokagururdevaḥ sarvairdevairnamaskṛtaḥ  || 68.51 ||
sahasramūrdhā deveśaḥ sahasracaraṇekṣaṇaḥ  |
sahasrākhyaḥ sahasrāṅgaḥ sahasrabhujavān prabhuḥ  || 68.52 ||
siṃhāsanagato devaḥ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇaḥ  |
vidyudvispaṣṭasaṃkāśo jagannātho jagadguruḥ  || 68.53 ||
parītaḥ surasiddhaiśca gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ  |
yakṣavidyādharairnāgairmunisiddhaiḥ sacāraṇaiḥ  || 68.54 ||
suparṇairdānavairdaityai rākṣasairguhyakiṃnaraiḥ  |
anyairdevagaṇairdivyaiḥ stūyamāno virājate  || 68.55 ||
tatrasthā satataṃ kīrtiḥ prajñā medhā sarasvatī  |
buddhirmatistathā kṣāntiḥ siddhimūrtistathā dyutiḥ  || 68.56 ||
gāyatrī caiva sāvitrī maṅgalā sarvamaṅgalā  |
prabhā matistathā kāntistatra nārāyaṇī sthitā  || 68.57 ||
śraddhā ca kauśikī devī vidyutsaudāminī tathā  |
nidrā rātristathā māyā tathānyāmarayoṣitaḥ  || 68.58 ||
vāsudevasya sarvāstā bhavane saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ  |
atha kiṃ bahunoktena sarvaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam  || 68.59 ||
ghṛtācī menakā rambhā sahajanyā tilottamā  |
urvaśī caiva nimlocā tathānyā vāmanā parā  || 68.60 ||
mandodarī ca subhagā viśvācī vipulānanā  |
bhadrāṅgī citrasenā ca pramlocā sumanoharā  || 68.61 ||
munisaṃmohinī rāmā candramadhyā śubhānanā  |
sukeśī nīlakeśā ca tathā manmathadīpinī  || 68.62 ||
alambuṣā miśrakeśī tathānyā muñjikasthalā  |
kratusthalā varāṅgī ca pūrvacittistathā parā  || 68.63 ||
parāvatī mahārūpā śaśilekhā śubhānanā  |
haṃsalīlānugāminyo mattavāraṇagāminī  || 68.64 ||
bimbauṣṭhī navagarbhā ca vikhyātāḥ surayoṣitaḥ  |
etāścānyā apsaraso rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ  || 68.65 ||
sumadhyāścāruvadanāḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ  |
gītamādhuryasaṃyuktāḥ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ  || 68.66 ||
gītavādye ca kuśalāḥ suragandharvayoṣitaḥ  |
nṛtyantyanudinaṃ tatra yatrāsau puruṣottamaḥ  || 68.67 ||
na tatra rogo no glānirna mṛtyurna himātapau  |
na kṣutpipāsā na jarā na vairūpyaṃ na cāsukham  || 68.68 ||
paramānandajananaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam  |
viṣṇulokātparaṃ lokaṃ nātra paśyāmi bho dvijāḥ  || 68.69 ||
ye lokāḥ svargaloke tu śrūyante puṇyakarmaṇām  |
viṣṇulokasya te viprāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm  || 68.70 ||
evaṃ hareḥ purasthānaṃ sarvabhogaguṇānvitam  |
sarvasaukhyakaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvāścaryamayaṃ dvijāḥ  || 68.71 ||
na tatra nāstikā yānti puruṣā viṣayātmakāḥ  |
na kṛtaghnā na piśunā no stenā nājitendriyāḥ  || 68.72 ||
ye'rcayanti sadā bhaktyā vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum  |
te tatra vaiṣṇavā yānti viṣṇulokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  || 68.73 ||
dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre kṣetre paramadurlabhe  |
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  || 68.74 ||
kalpavṛkṣasamīpe tu ye tyajanti kalevaram  |
te tatra manujā yānti mṛtā ye puruṣottame  || 68.75 ||
vaṭasāgarayormadhye yaḥ smaretpuruṣottamam  |
te'pi tatra narā yānti ye mṛtāḥ puruṣottame  || 68.76 ||
te'pi tatra paraṃ sthānaṃ yānti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ  |
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhā viṣṇulokaḥ sanātanaḥ  |
sarvānandakaraḥ prokto bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ  || 68.77 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
bahvāścaryastvayā prokto viṣṇuloko jagatpate  |
nityānandakaraḥ śrīmān bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ  || 69.1 ||
kṣetraṃ ca durlabhaṃ loke kīrtitaṃ puruṣottamam  |
tyaktvā yatra naro dehaṃ yāti sālokyatāṃ hareḥ  || 69.2 ||
samyakkṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ tvayā samyakprakīrtitam  |
yatra svadehasaṃtyāgādviṣṇulokaṃ vrajennaraḥ  || 69.3 ||
aho mokṣasya mārgo'yaṃ dehatyāgastvayoditaḥ  |
narāṇāmupakārāya puruṣākhye na saṃśayaḥ  || 69.4 ||
anāyāsena deveśa dehaṃ tyaktvā narottamāḥ  |
tasmin kṣetre paraṃ viṣṇoḥ padaṃ yānti nirāmayam  || 69.5 ||
śrutvā kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ vismayo no mahānabhūt |
prayāgapuṣkarādīni kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni ca  || 69.6 ||
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrthāni saritaśca sarāṃsi ca  |
na tathā tāni sarvāṇi praśaṃsasi surottama  || 69.7 ||
yathā praśaṃsasi kṣetraṃ puruṣākhyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ  |
jñāto'smābhirabhiprāyastavedānīṃ pitāmaha  || 69.8 ||
yena praśaṃsasi kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ puruṣottamam  |
puruṣākhyasamaṃ nūnaṃ kṣetraṃ nāsti mahītale  |
tena tvaṃ vibudhaśreṣṭha praśaṃsasi punaḥ punaḥ  || 69.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
satyaṃ satyaṃ muniśreṣṭhā bhavadbhiḥ samudāhṛtam  |
puruṣākhyasamaṃ kṣetraṃ nāstyatra pṛthivītale  || 69.10 ||
santi yāni tu tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca  |
tāni śrīpuruṣākhyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm  || 69.11 ||
yathā sarveśvaro viṣṇuḥ sarvalokottamottamaḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.12 ||
ādityānāṃ yathā viṣṇuḥ śreṣṭhatve samudāhṛtaḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.13 ||
nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā somaḥ sarasāṃ sāgaro yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.14 ||
vasūnāṃ pāvako yadvadrudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaro yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.15 ||
varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yadvadvainateyaśca pakṣiṇām  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.16 ||
śikhariṇāṃ yathā meruḥ parvatānāṃ himālayaḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.17 ||
pramadānāṃ yathā lakṣmīḥ saritāṃ jāhnavī yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.18 ||
airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛguryathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.19 ||
senānīnāṃ yathā skandaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.20 ||
uccaiḥśravā yathāśvānāṃ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.21 ||
munīnāṃ ca yathā vyāsaḥ kubero yakṣarakṣasām  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.22 ||
indriyāṇāṃ mano yadvadbhūtānāmavanī yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.23 ||
aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ pavanaḥ plavatāṃ yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.24 ||
bhūṣaṇānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yathā cūḍāmaṇirdvijāḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.25 ||
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ śastrāṇāṃ kuliśo yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.26 ||
akāraḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.27 ||
sarvāṅgebhyo yathā śreṣṭhamuttamāṅgaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.28 ||
arundhatī yathā strīṇāṃ satīnāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ gatā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tatpuruṣottamam  || 69.29 ||
yathā samastavidyānāṃ mokṣavidyā parā smṛtā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tatpuruṣottamam  || 69.30 ||
manuṣyāṇāṃ yathā rājā dhenūnāmapi kāmadhuk |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.31 ||
suvarṇaṃ sarvaratnānāṃ sarpāṇāṃ vāsukiryathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.32 ||
prahlādaḥ sarvadaityānāṃ rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.33 ||
jhaṣāṇāṃ makaro yadvanmṛgāṇāṃ mṛgarāḍyathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.34 ||
samudrāṇāṃ yathā śreṣṭhaḥ kṣīrodaḥ saritāṃ patiḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.35 ||
varuṇo yādasāṃ yadvadyamaḥ saṃyamināṃ yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.36 ||
devarṣīṇāṃ yathā śreṣṭho nārado munisattamāḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.37 ||
dhātūnāṃ kāñcanaṃ yadvatpavitrāṇāṃ ca dakṣiṇā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.38 ||
prajāpatiryathā dakṣa ṛṣīṇāṃ kaśyapo yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.39 ||
grahāṇāṃ bhāskaro yadvanmantrāṇāṃ praṇavo yathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.40 ||
aśvamedhastu yajñānāṃ yathā śreṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ kṣetraṃ ca taddvijottamāḥ  || 69.41 ||
oṣadhīnāṃ yathā dhānyaṃ tṛṇeṣu tṛṇarāḍyathā  |
tathā samastatīrthānāmuttamaṃ puruṣottamam  || 69.42 ||
yathā samastatīrthānāṃ dharmaḥ saṃsāratārakaḥ  |
tathā samastatīrthānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tatpuruṣottamam  || 69.43 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sarveṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  |
japahomavratānāṃ ca tapodānaphalāni ca  || 70.1 ||
na tatpaśyāmi bho viprā yattena sadṛśaṃ bhuvi  |
kiṃ cātra bahunoktena bhāṣitena punaḥ punaḥ  || 70.2 ||
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kṣetraṃ tatparamaṃ mahat |
puruṣākhyaṃ sakṛddṛṣṭvā sāgarāmbhaḥsamāplutam  || 70.3 ||
brahmavidyāṃ sakṛjjñātvā garbhavāso na vidyate  |
hareḥ saṃnihite sthāna uttame puruṣottame  || 70.4 ||
saṃvatsaramupāsīta māsamātramathāpi vā  |
tena japtaṃ hutaṃ tena tena taptaṃ tapo mahat || 70.5 ||
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra yogeśvaro hariḥ  |
bhuktvā bhogān vicitrāṃśca devayoṣitsamanvitaḥ  || 70.6 ||
kalpānte punarāgatya martyaloke narottamaḥ  |
jāyate yogināṃ viprā jñānajñeyodyato gṛhe  || 70.7 ||
saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavaṃ yogaṃ hareḥ svacchandatāṃ vrajet |
kalpavṛkṣasya rāmasya kṛṣṇasya bhadrayā saha  || 70.8 ||
mārkaṇḍeyendradyumnasya māhātmyaṃ mādhavasya ca  |
svargadvārasya māhātmyaṃ sāgarasya vidhiḥ kramāt || 70.9 ||
mārjanasya yathākāle bhāgīrathyāḥ samāgamam  |
sarvametanmayā khyātaṃ yatparaṃ śrotumicchatha  || 70.10 ||
indradyumnasya māhātmyametacca kathitaṃ mayā  |
sarvāścaryaṃ samākhyātaṃ rahasyaṃ puruṣottamam  |
purāṇaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ dhanyaṃ saṃsāramocanam  || 70.11 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
nahi nastṛptirastīha śṛṇvatāṃ tīrthavistaram  |
punareva paraṃ guhyaṃ vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ  |
paraṃ tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam  || 70.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
imameva purā praśnaṃ pṛṣṭo'smi dvijasattamāḥ  |
nāradena prayatnena tadā taṃ proktavānaham  || 70.13 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
tapaso yajñadānānāṃ tīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam  |
sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā tvatto jagadyone jagatpate  || 70.14 ||
kiyanti santi tīrthāni svargamartyarasātale  |
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ sarvadā kiṃ viśiṣyate  || 70.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
caturvidhāni tīrthāni svarge martye rasātale  |
daivāni muniśārdūla āsurāṇyāruṣāṇi ca  || 70.16 ||
mānuṣāṇi trilokeṣu vikhyātāni surādibhiḥ  |
mānuṣebhyaśca tīrthebhya ārṣaṃ tīrthamanuttamam  || 70.17 ||
ārṣebhyaścaiva tīrthebhya āsuraṃ bahupuṇyadam  |
āsurebhyastathā puṇyaṃ daivaṃ tatsārvakāmikam  || 70.18 ||
brahmaviṣṇuśivaiścaiva nirmitaṃ daivamucyate  |
tribhyo yadekaṃ jāyeta tasmānnātaḥ paraṃ viduḥ  || 70.19 ||
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ tīrthaṃ medhyamudāhṛtam  |
tatrāpi jāmbavaṃ dvīpaṃ tīrthaṃ bahuguṇodayam  || 70.20 ||
jāmbave bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  |
karmabhūmiryataḥ putra tasmāttīrthaṃ taducyate  || 70.21 ||
tatraiva yāni tīrthāni yānyuktāni mayā tava  |
himavadvindhyayormadhye ṣaṇnadyo devasaṃbhavāḥ  || 70.22 ||
tathaiva devajā brahman dakṣiṇārṇavavindhyayoḥ  |
etā dvādaśa nadyastu prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ  || 70.23 ||
abhisaṃpūjitaṃ yasmādbhārataṃ bahupuṇyadam  |
karmabhūmirato devairvarṣaṃ tasmātprakīrtitam  || 70.24 ||
ārṣāṇi caiva tīrthāni devajāni kvacitkvacit |
āsurairāvṛtānyāsaṃstadevāsuramucyate  || 70.25 ||
daiveṣveva pradeśeṣu tapastaptvā maharṣayaḥ  |
daivaprabhāvāttapasa ārṣāṇyapi ca tānyapi  || 70.26 ||
ātmanaḥ śreyase muktyai pūjāyai bhūtaye'thavā  |
ātmanaḥ phalabhūtyarthaṃ yaśaso'vāptaye punaḥ  || 70.27 ||
mānuṣaiḥ kāritānyāhurmānuṣāṇīti nārada  |
evaṃ caturvidho bhedastīrthānāṃ munisattama  || 70.28 ||
bhedaṃ na kaścijjānāti śrotuṃ yukto'si nārada  |
bahavaḥ paṇḍitaṃmanyāḥ śṛṇvanti kathayanti ca  |
sukṛtī ko'pi jānāti vaktuṃ śrotuṃ nijairguṇaiḥ  || 70.29 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ bhedaṃ ca śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ  |
yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 70.30 ||
brahman kṛtayugādau tu upāyo'nyo na vidyate  |
tīrthasevāṃ vinā svalpā yāsenābhīṣṭadāyinīm  || 70.31 ||
na tvayā sadṛśo dhātarvaktā jñātāthavā kvacit |
tvaṃ nābhikamale viṣṇoḥ saṃjāto'khilapūrvajaḥ  || 70.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
godāvarī bhīmarathī tuṅgabhadrā ca veṇikā  |
tāpī payouṣṇī vindhyasya dakṣiṇe tu prakīrtitāḥ  || 70.33 ||
bhāgīrathī narmadā tu yamunā ca sarasvatī  |
viśokā ca vitastā ca himavatparvatāśritāḥ  || 70.34 ||
etā nadyaḥ puṇyatamā devatīrthānyudāhṛtāḥ  |
gayaḥ kollāsuro vṛtrastripuro hyandhakastathā  || 70.35 ||
hayamūrdhā ca lavaṇo namuciḥ śṛṅgakastathā  |
yamaḥ pātālaketuśca mayaḥ puṣkara eva ca  || 70.36 ||
etairāvṛtatīrthāni āsurāṇi śubhāni ca  |
prabhāso bhārgavo'gastirnaranārāyaṇau tathā  || 70.37 ||
vasiṣṭhaśca bharadvājo gotamaḥ kaśyapo manuḥ  |
ityādimunijuṣṭāni ṛṣitīrthāni nārada  || 70.38 ||
ambarīṣo hariścandro māndhātā manureva ca  |
kuruḥ kanakhalaścaiva bhadrāśvaḥ sagarastathā  || 70.39 ||
aśvayūpo nāciketā vṛṣākapirariṃdamaḥ  |
ityādimānuṣairvipra nirmitāni śubhāni ca  || 70.40 ||
yaśasaḥ phalabhūtyarthaṃ nirmitānīha nārada  |
svatoudbhūtāni daivāni yatra kvāpi jagattraye  |
puṇyatīrthāni tānyāhustīrthabhedo mayoditaḥ  || 70.41 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
tridaivatyaṃ tu yattīrthaṃ sarvebhyo hyuktamuttamam  |
tasya svarūpabhedaṃ ca vistareṇa bravītu me  || 71.1 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tāvadanyāni tīrthāni tāvattāḥ puṇyabhūmayaḥ  |
tāvadyajñādayo yāvattridaivatyaṃ na dṛśyate  || 71.2 ||
gaṅgeyaṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvakāmapradāyinī  |
tridaivatyā muniśreṣṭha tadutpattimataḥ śṛṇu  || 71.3 ||
varṣāṇāmayutātpūrvaṃ devakārya upasthite  |
tārako balavānāsīnmadvarādatigarvitaḥ  || 71.4 ||
devānāṃ paramaiśvaryaṃ hṛtaṃ tena balīyasā  |
tataste śaraṇaṃ jagmurdevāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ  || 71.5 ||
kṣīrodaśāyinaṃ devaṃ jagatāṃ prapitāmaham  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭā devā viṣṇumūcurananyagāḥ  || 71.6 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
tvaṃ trātā jagatāṃ nātha devānāṃ kīrtivardhana  |
sarveśvara jagadyone trayīmūrte namo'stu te  || 71.7 ||
lokasraṣṭāsurān hantā tvameva jagatāṃ patiḥ  |
sthityutpattivināśānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ jaganmaya  || 71.8 ||
trātā na kopyasti jagattraye'pi  71.9
śarīriṇāṃ sarvavipadgatānām  71.9
tvayā vinā vārijapattranetra  71.9
tāpatrayāṇāṃ śaraṇaṃ na cānyat 71.9
pitā ca mātā jagato'khilasya  71.10
tvameva sevāsulabho'si viṣṇo  71.10
prasīda pāhīśa mahābhayebhyo  71.10
śmadārtihantā vada kastvadanyaḥ  71.10
ādikartā varāhastvaṃ matsyaḥ kūrmastathaiva ca  |
ityādirūpabhedairno rakṣase bhaya āgate  || 71.11 ||
hṛtasvāmyān suragaṇān hṛtadārān gatāpadaḥ  |
kasmānna rakṣase deva ananyaśaraṇān hare  || 71.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ provāca bhagavāñśeṣaśāyī jagatpatiḥ  |
kasmācca bhayamāpannaṃ tadbruvantu gatajvarāḥ  |
tataḥ śriyaḥ patiṃ prāhustaṃ tārakavadhaṃ prati  || 71.13 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
tārakādbhayamāpannaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ romaharṣaṇam  |
na yuddhaistapasā śāpairhantuṃ naiva kṣamā vayam  || 71.14 ||
arvāgdaśāhādyo bālastasmānmṛtyumavāpsyati  |
tasmāddeva na cānyebhyastatra nītirvidhīyatām  || 71.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
punarnārāyaṇaḥ prāha nāhaṃ balotkaṭaḥ surāḥ  |
na matto madapatyācca na devebhyo vadho bhavet || 71.16 ||
īśvarādyadi jāyeta apatyaṃ bahuśaktikam  |
tasmādvadhamavāpnoti tārako lokadāruṇaḥ  || 71.17 ||
tadgacchāmaḥ surāḥ sarve yatitumṛṣibhiḥ saha  |
bhāryārthaṃ prathamo yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ prabhaviṣṇubhiḥ  || 71.18 ||
tathetyuktvā suragaṇā jagmuste ca nagottamam  |
himavantaṃ ratnamayaṃ menāṃ ca himavatpriyām  || 71.19 ||
idamūcuḥ sarva eva sabhāryaṃ tuhinaṃ girim  ||* 71.20 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
dākṣāyaṇī lokamātā yā śaktiḥ saṃsthitā girau  |
buddhiḥ prajñā dhṛtirmedhā lajjā puṣṭiḥ sarasvatī  || 71.21 ||
evaṃ tvanekadhā loke yā sthitā lokapāvanī  |
devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ yuvayorgarbhamāviśat || 71.22 ||
samutpannā jaganmātā śaṃbhoḥ patnī bhaviṣyati  |
asmākaṃ bhavatāṃ cāpi pālanī ca bhaviṣyati  || 71.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
himavānapi tadvākyaṃ surāṇāmabhinandya ca  |
menā cāpi mahotsāhā astvityevaṃ vaco'bravīt || 71.24 ||
tadotpannā jagaddhātrī gaurī himavato gṛhe  |
śivadhyānaratā nityaṃ tanniṣṭhā tanmanogatā  || 71.25 ||
tāṃ vai procuḥ suragaṇā īśārthe tapa āviśa  |
tathā himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe gaurī tepe tapo mahat || 71.26 ||
punaḥ saṃmantrayāmāsurīśo dhyāyati tāṃ śivām  |
ātmānaṃ vā tathānyadvā na jānīmaḥ kathaṃ bhavaḥ  || 71.27 ||
menakāyāḥ sutāyāṃ tu cittaṃ dadhyātsureśvaraḥ  |
tatra nītirvidhātavyā tataḥ śraiṣṭhyamavāpsyatha  |
tataḥ prāha mahābuddhirvācaspatirudāradhīḥ  || 71.28 ||
{bṛhaspatiruvāca̱ }
yastvayaṃ madano dhīmān kandarpaḥ puṣpacāpadhṛk |
sa vidhyatu śivaṃ śāntaṃ bāṇaiḥ puṣpamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ  || 71.29 ||
tena viddhastrinetro'pi īśāyāṃ buddhimādadhet |
pariṇeṣyatyasau nūnaṃ tadā tāṃ girijāṃ haraḥ  || 71.30 ||
jayinaḥ pañcabāṇasya na bāṇāḥ kvāpi kuṇṭhitāḥ  |
tathoḍhāyāṃ jagaddhātryāṃ śaṃbhoḥ putro bhaviṣyati  || 71.31 ||
jātaḥ putrastrinetrasya tārakaṃ sa haniṣyati  |
vasantaṃ ca sahāyārthaṃ śobhiṣṭhaṃ kusumākaram  || 71.32 ||
āhlādanaṃ ca manasā kāmāyainaṃ prayacchatha  ||* 71.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā suragaṇā madanaṃ kusumākaram  |
preṣayāmāsuravyagrāḥ śivāntikamariṃdamāḥ  || 71.34 ||
sa jagāma tvarā kāmo dhṛtacāpo samādhavaḥ  |
ratyā ca sahitaḥ kāmaḥ kartuṃ karma suduṣkaram  || 71.35 ||
gṛhītvā saśaraṃ cāpamidaṃ tasya mano'bhavat |
mayā vedhyastvavedhyo vai śaṃbhurlokaguruḥ prabhuḥ  || 71.36 ||
trailokyajayino bāṇāḥ śaṃbhau me kiṃ dṛḍhā na vā  |
tenāsau cāgninetreṇa bhasmaśeṣastadā kṛtaḥ  || 71.37 ||
tadeva karma sudṛḍhamīkṣituṃ surasattamāḥ  |
ājagmustatra yadvṛttaṃ śṛṇu vismayakārakam  || 71.38 ||
śaṃbhuṃ dṛṣṭvā suragaṇā yāvatpaśyanti manmatham  |
tāvacca bhasmasādbhūtaṃ kāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayāturāḥ  |
tuṣṭuvustridaśeśānaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ surāḥ  || 71.39 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
tārakādbhayamāpannaṃ kuru patnīṃ gireḥ sutām  ||* 71.40 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
viddhacitto haro'pyāśu mene vākyaṃ suroditam  |
arundhatīṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca māṃ tu cakradharaṃ tathā  || 71.41 ||
preṣayāmāsuramarā vivāhāya parasparam  |
saṃbandho'pi tathāpyāsīddhimavallokanāthayoḥ  || 71.42 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
himavatparvate śreṣṭhe nānāratnavicitrite  |
nānāvṛkṣalatākīrṇe nānādvijaniṣevite  || 72.1 ||
nadīnadasaraḥkūpa taḍāgādibhirāvṛte  |
devagandharvayakṣādi siddhacāraṇasevite  || 72.2 ||
śubhamārutasaṃpanne harṣotkarṣaikakāraṇe  |
merumandarakailāsa mainākādinagairvṛte  || 72.3 ||
vasiṣṭhāgastyapaulastya lomaśādibhirāvṛte  |
mahotsave vartamāne vivāhaḥ samajāyata  || 72.4 ||
tatra vedī ratnamayī śobhitā svarṇabhūṣitā  |
vajramāṇikyavaidūrya tanmayastambhaśobhitā  || 72.5 ||
jayālakṣmīśubhākṣānti kīrtipuṣṭyādisaṃvṛtā  |
merumandarakailāsa raivataiḥ pariśobhitaiḥ  || 72.6 ||
pūjito lokanāthena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā  |
mainākaḥ parvataśreṣṭho reje'tīva hiraṇmayaḥ  || 72.7 ||
ṛṣayo lokapālāśca ādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ  |
vivāhe vedikāṃ cakrurdevadevasya śūlinaḥ  || 72.8 ||
viśvakarmā svayaṃ tvaṣṭā vedīṃ cakre satoraṇām  |
surabhī nandinī nandā sunandā kāmadohinī  || 72.9 ||
ābhistu śobhiteśānyā vivāhaḥ samajāyata  |
samudrāḥ sarito nāgā oṣadhyo lokamātaraḥ  || 72.10 ||
savanaspatibījāśca sarve tatra samāyayuḥ  |
bhuvaḥ karma ilā cakre oṣadhyastvannakarma ca  || 72.11 ||
varuṇaḥ pānakarmāṇi dānakarma dhanādhipaḥ  |
agniścakāra tatrānnaṃ yacceṣṭaṃ lokanāthayoḥ  || 72.12 ||
tatra tatra pṛthakpūjāṃ cakre viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ  |
vedāśca sarahasyā vai gāyanti ca hasanti ca  || 72.13 ||
nṛtyantyapsarasaḥ sarvā jagurgandharvakiṃnarāḥ  |
lājādhṛkcāpi maināko babhūva munisattama  || 72.14 ||
puṇyāhavācanaṃ vṛttamantarveśmani nārada  |
vedikāyāmupāviṣṭau daṃpatī surasattamau  || 72.15 ||
pratiṣṭhāpyāgniṃ vidhivadaśmānaṃ cāpi putraka  |
hutvā lājāṃśca vidhivatpradakṣiṇamathākarot || 72.16 ||
aśmanaḥ sparśahetośca devyaṅguṣṭhaṃ kare'spṛśat |
viṣṇunā preritaḥ śaṃbhurdakṣiṇasya padasya ca  || 72.17 ||
tāmadarśamahaṃ tatra homaṃ kurvan harāntike  |
dṛṣṭe'ṅguṣṭhe duṣṭabuddhyā vīryaṃ susrāva me tadā  || 72.18 ||
lajjayā kaluṣībhūtaḥ skannaṃ vīryamacūrṇayam  |
madvīryāccūrṇitātsūkṣmādvālakhilyāstu jajñire  || 72.19 ||
tato mahānabhūttatra hāhākāraḥ suroditaḥ  |
lajjayā paribhūto'haṃ nirgatastu tadāsanāt || 72.20 ||
paśyatsu devasaṃgheṣu tūṣṇīṃbhūteṣu nārada  |
gacchantaṃ māṃ mahādevo dṛṣṭvā nandinamabravīt || 72.21 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
brahmāṇamāhvayasveha gatapāpaṃ karomyaham  |
kṛtāparādhe'pi jane santaḥ sakṛpamānasāḥ  |
mohayantyapi vidvāṃsaṃ viṣayāṇāmiyaṃ sthitiḥ  || 72.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā sa bhagavānumayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ  |
mamānukampayā caiva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 72.23 ||
etaccakāra lokeśaḥ śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ  |
pāpināṃ pāpamokṣāya bhūmirāpo bhaviṣyati  || 72.24 ||
tayośca sārasarvasvamāhariṣyāmi pāvanam  |
evaṃ niścitya bhagavāṃstayoḥ sāraṃ samāharat || 72.25 ||
bhūmiṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ kṛtvā tatrāpaḥ saṃniveśya ca  |
pāvamānyādibhiḥ sūktairabhimantrya ca yatnataḥ  || 72.26 ||
trijagatpāvanīṃ śaktiṃ tatra sasmāra pāpahā  |
māmuvāca sa lokeśo gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum  || 72.27 ||
āpo vai mātaro devyo bhūmirmātā tathāparā  |
sthityutpattivināśānāṃ hetutvamubhayoḥ sthitam  || 72.28 ||
atra pratiṣṭhito dharmo hyatra yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ  |
atra bhuktiśca muktiśca sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā  || 72.29 ||
smaraṇānmānasaṃ pāpaṃ vacanādvācikaṃ tathā  |
snānapānābhiṣekācca praṇaśyatyapi kāyikam  || 72.30 ||
etadevāmṛtaṃ loke naitasmātpāvanaṃ param  |
mayābhimantritaṃ brahman gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum  || 72.31 ||
atratyaṃ vāri yaḥ kaścitsmaredapi paṭhedapi  |
sa sarvakāmānāpnoti gṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum  || 72.32 ||
bhūtebhyaścāpi pañcabhya āpo bhūtaṃ mahoditam  |
tāsāmutkṛṣṭametasmādgṛhāṇemaṃ kamaṇḍalum  || 72.33 ||
atra yadvāri śobhiṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanameva ca  |
spṛṣṭvā smṛtvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca brahman pāpādvimokṣyase  || 72.34 ||
evamuktvā mahādevaḥ prādānmama kamaṇḍalum  |
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve bhaktyā procuḥ sureśvaram  |
āhlādaśca mahāṃstatra jayaśabdo vyavartata  || 72.35 ||
devotsave māturajaḥ padāgraṃ  72.38
samīkṣya pāpātpatitatvamāpa  72.38
prādātkṛpāluḥ smaraṇātpavitrāṃ  72.38
gaṅgāṃ pitā puṇyakamaṇḍalusthām  72.38
{nārada uvāca̱ }
kamaṇḍalusthitā devī tava puṇyavivardhinī  |
yathā martyaṃ gatā nātha tanme vistarato vada  || 73.1 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
balirnāma mahādaityo devāriraparājitaḥ  |
dharmeṇa yaśasā caiva prajāsaṃrakṣaṇena ca  || 73.2 ||
gurubhaktyā ca satyena vīryeṇa ca balena ca  |
tyāgena kṣamayā caiva trailokye nopamīyate  || 73.3 ||
tasyarddhimunnatāṃ dṛṣṭvā devāścintāparāyaṇāḥ  |
mithaḥ samūcuramarā jeṣyāmo vai kathaṃ balim  || 73.4 ||
tasmiñśāsati rājyaṃ tu trailokyaṃ hatakaṇṭakam  |
nārayo vyādhayo vāpi nādhayo vā kathaṃcana  || 73.5 ||
anāvṛṣṭiradharmo vā nāstiśabdo na durjanaḥ  |
svapne'pi naiva dṛśyeta balau rājyaṃ praśāsati  || 73.6 ||
tasyonnatiśarairbhagnāḥ kīrtikhaḍgadvidhākṛtāḥ  |
tasyājñāśaktibhinnāṅgā devāḥ śarma na lebhire  || 73.7 ||
tataḥ saṃmantrayāmāsuḥ kṛtvā mātsaryamagrataḥ  |
tadyaśognipradīptāṅgā viṣṇuṃ jagmuḥ suvihvalāḥ  || 73.8 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
ārtāḥ sma gatasattvāḥ sma śaṅkhacakragadādhara  |
asmadarthe bhavānnityamāyudhāni bibharti ca  || 73.9 ||
tvayi nāthe jagannātha asmākaṃ duḥkhamīdṛśam  |
tvāṃ tu praṇamatī vāṇī kathaṃ daityaṃ namasyati  || 73.10 ||
manasā karmaṇā vācā tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ  |
tvadaṅghriśaraṇāḥ santaḥ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi  || 73.11 ||
yajāmastvāṃ mahāyajñairvadāmo vāgbhiracyuta  |
tvadekaśaraṇāḥ santaḥ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi  || 73.12 ||
tvadvīryamāśritā nityaṃ devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ  |
tvayā dattaṃ padaṃ prāpya kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi  || 73.13 ||
sraṣṭā tvaṃ brahmamūrtyā tu viṣṇurbhūtvā tu rakṣasi  |
saṃhartā rudraśaktyā tvaṃ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi  || 73.14 ||
aiśvaryaṃ kāraṇaṃ loke vinaiśvaryaṃ tu kiṃ phalam  |
hataiśvaryāḥ sureśāna kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi  || 73.15 ||
anādistvaṃ jagaddhātaranantastvaṃ jagadguruḥ  |
antavantamamuṃ śatruṃ kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi  || 73.16 ||
tavaiśvaryeṇa puṣṭāṅgā jitvā trailokyamojasā  |
sthirāḥ syāmaḥ sureśāna kathaṃ daityaṃ namemahi  || 73.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityetadeva vacanaṃ śrutvā daiteyasūdanaḥ  |
uvāca sarvānamarān devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye  || 73.18 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
madbhakto'sau balirdaityo hyavadhyo'sau surāsuraiḥ  |
yathā bhavanto matpoṣyāstathā poṣyo balirmama  || 73.19 ||
vinā tu saṃgaraṃ devā hatvā rājyaṃ triviṣṭape  |
baliṃ nibadhya mantroktyā rājyaṃ vaḥ pradadāmyaham  || 73.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā suragaṇāḥ saṃjagmurdivameva hi  |
bhagavānapi deveśo hyadityā garbhamāviśat || 73.21 ||
tasminnutpadyamāne tu utsavāśca babhūvire  |
jāto'sau vāmano brahman yajñeśo yajñapūruṣaḥ  || 73.22 ||
etasminnantare brahman hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ  |
balirbalavatāṃ śreṣṭha ṛṣimukhyaiḥ samāhitaḥ  || 73.23 ||
purodhasā ca śukreṇa vedavedāṅgavedinā  |
makhe tasmin vartamāne yajamāne balau tathā  || 73.24 ||
ārtvijya ṛṣimukhye tu śukre tatra purodhasi  |
havirbhāgārthamāsanna devagandharvapannage  || 73.25 ||
dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ pūjā kriyatāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak |
paripūrṇaṃ punaḥ pūrṇamevaṃ vākye pravartati  || 73.26 ||
śanaistaddeśamabhyāgādvāmanaḥ sāmagāyanaḥ  |
yajñavāṭamanuprāpto vāmanaścitrakuṇḍalaḥ  || 73.27 ||
praśaṃsamānastaṃ yajñaṃ vāmanaṃ prekṣya bhārgavaḥ  |
brahmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ vāmanaṃ daityasūdanam  || 73.28 ||
dātāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ phalaṃ hantāraṃ rakṣasām  |
jñātvā tvarannathovāca rājānaṃ bhūritejasam  || 73.29 ||
jetāraṃ kṣatradharmeṇa dātāraṃ bhaktito dhanam  |
baliṃ balavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sabhāryaṃ dīkṣitaṃ makhe  || 73.30 ||
dhyāyantaṃ yajñapuruṣamutsṛjantaṃ haviḥ pṛthak |
tamāha bhṛguśārdūlaḥ śukraḥ paramabuddhimān  || 73.31 ||
{śukra uvāca̱ }
yo'sau tava makhaṃ prāpto brāhmaṇo vāmanākṛtiḥ  |
nāsau vipro bale satyaṃ yajñeśo yajñavāhanaḥ  || 73.32 ||
śiśustvāṃ yācituṃ prāpto nūnaṃ devahitāya hi  |
mayā ca saha saṃmantrya paścāddeyaṃ tvayā prabho  || 73.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
balistu bhārgavaṃ prāha purodhasamariṃdamaḥ  ||* 73.34 ||
{baliruvāca̱ }
dhanyo'haṃ mama yajñeśo gṛhamāyāti mūrtimān  |
āgatya yācate kiṃcitkiṃ mantryamavaśiṣyate  || 73.35 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā sabhāryo'sau śukreṇa ca purodhasā  |
jagāma yatra viprendro vāmano'ditinandanaḥ  || 73.36 ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā kenārthitvaṃ taducyatām  |
vāmano'pi tadā prāha padatrayamitāṃ bhuvam  || 73.37 ||
dehi rājendra nānyena kāryamasti dhanena kim  |
tathetyuktvā tu kalaśānnānāratnavibhūṣitāt || 73.38 ||
vāridhārāṃ puraskṛtya vāmanāya bhuvaṃ dadau  |
paśyatsu ṛṣimukhyeṣu śukre caiva purodhasi  || 73.39 ||
paśyatsu lokanātheṣu vāmanāya bhuvaṃ dadau  |
paśyatsu daityasaṃgheṣu jayaśabde pravartati  || 73.40 ||
śanaistu vāmanaḥ prāha svasti rājan sukhī bhava  |
dehi me saṃmitāṃ bhūmiṃ tripadāmāśu gamyate  || 73.41 ||
tathetyuvāca daityeśo yāvatpaśyati vāmanam  |
yajñeśo yajñapuruṣaścandrādityau stanāntare  || 73.42 ||
yathā syātāṃ surā mūrdhni vavṛdhe vikramākṛtiḥ  |
anantaścācyuto devo vikrānto vikramākṛtiḥ  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā daityarāṭprāha sabhāryo vinayānvitaḥ  || 73.43 ||
{baliruvāca̱ }
kramasva viṣṇo lokeśa yāvacchaktyā jaganmaya  |
jitaṃ mayā sureśāna sarvabhāvena viśvakṛt || 73.44 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvākyasamakālaṃ tu viṣṇuḥ prāha mahākratuḥ  ||* 73.45 ||
{viṣṇuruvāca̱ }
daityeśvara mahābāho kramiṣye paśya daityarāṭ ||* 73.46 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ vadantaṃ sa prāha krama viṣṇo punaḥ punaḥ  ||* 73.47 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kūrmapṛṣṭhe padaṃ nyasya baliyajñe padaṃ nyasat |
dvitīyaṃ tu padaṃ prāpa brahmalokaṃ sanātanam  || 73.48 ||
tṛtīyasya padasyātra sthānaṃ nāstyasureśvara  |
kva kramiṣye bhuvaṃ dehi baliṃ taṃ harirabravīt |
vihasya balirapyāha sabhāryaḥ sa kṛtāñjaliḥ  || 73.49 ||
{baliruvāca̱ }
tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ na sraṣṭāhaṃ sureśvara  |
tvaddoṣādalpamabhavatkiṃ karomi jaganmaya  || 73.50 ||
tathāpi nānṛtapūrvaṃ kadācidvacmi keśava  |
satyavākyaṃ ca māṃ kurvanmatpṛṣṭhe hi padaṃ nyasa  || 73.51 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prasanno bhagavāṃstrayīmūrtiḥ surārcitaḥ  ||* 73.52 ||
{bhagavānuvāca̱ }
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te bhaktyā prīto'smi daityarāṭ || 73.53 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa tu prāha jagannāthaṃ na yāce tvāṃ trivikramam  |
sa tu prādātsvayaṃ viṣṇuḥ prītaḥ sanmanasepsitam  || 73.54 ||
rasātalapatitvaṃ ca bhāvi cendrapadaṃ punaḥ  |
ātmādhipatyaṃ ca hariravināśi yaśo vibhuḥ  || 73.55 ||
evaṃ dattvā baleḥ sarvaṃ sasutaṃ bhāryayānvitam  |
rasātale hariḥ sthāpya baliṃ tvamaravairiṇam  || 73.56 ||
śatakratostathā prādātsurarājyaṃ yathābhavam  |
etasminnantare tatra padaṃ prāgātsurārcitam  || 73.57 ||
dvitīyaṃ tatpadaṃ viṣṇoḥ piturmama mahāmate  |
yatpadaṃ samanuprāptaṃ gṛhaṃ dṛṣṭvāpyacintayam  || 73.58 ||
kiṃ kṛtyaṃ yacchubhaṃ me syātpade viṣṇoḥ samāgate  |
sarvasvaṃ ca samālokya śreṣṭho me syātkamaṇḍaluḥ  || 73.59 ||
tadvāri yatpuṇyatamaṃ dattaṃ ca tripurāriṇā  |
varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ varaṃ śāntikaraṃ param  || 73.60 ||
śubhaṃ ca śubhadaṃ nityaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam  |
mātṛsvarūpaṃ lokānāmamṛtaṃ bheṣajaṃ śuci  || 73.61 ||
pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ pūjyaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ guṇānvitam  |
smaraṇādeva lokānāṃ pāvanaṃ kiṃ nu darśanāt || 73.62 ||
tādṛgvāri śucirbhūtvā kalpaye'rghāya me pituḥ  |
iti saṃcintya tadvāri gṛhītvārghāya kalpitam  || 73.63 ||
viṣṇoḥ pāde tu patitamarghavāri sumantritam  |
tadvāri patitaṃ merau caturdhā vyagamadbhuvam  || 73.64 ||
pūrve tu dakṣiṇe caiva paścime cottare tathā  |
dakṣiṇe yattu patitaṃ jaṭābhiḥ śaṃkaro mune  || 73.65 ||
jagrāha paścime yattu punaḥ prāyātkamaṇḍalum  |
uttare patitaṃ yattu viṣṇurjagrāha tajjalam  || 73.66 ||
pūrvasminnṛṣayo devā pitaro lokapālakāḥ  |
jagṛhuḥ śubhadaṃ vāri tasmācchreṣṭhaṃ taducyate  || 73.67 ||
yā dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ prāptā āpo vai lokamātaraḥ  |
viṣṇupādaprasūtāstā brahmaṇyā lokamātaraḥ  || 73.68 ||
maheśvarajaṭāsaṃsthāḥ parvajātaśubhodayāḥ  |
tāsāṃ prabhāvasmaraṇātsarvakāmānavāpnuyāt || 73.69 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
kamaṇḍalusthitā devī maheśvarajaṭāgatā  |
śrutā deva yathā martyamāgatā tadbravītu me  || 74.1 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
maheśvarajaṭāsthā yā āpo devyo mahāmate  |
tāsāṃ ca dvividho bheda āharturdvayakāraṇāt || 74.2 ||
ekāṃśo brāhmaṇenātra vratadānasamādhinā  |
gotamena śivaṃ pūjya āhṛto lokaviśrutaḥ  || 74.3 ||
aparastu mahāprājña kṣatriyeṇa balīyasā  |
ārādhya śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ tapobhirniyamaistathā  || 74.4 ||
bhagīrathena bhūpena āhṛto'ṃśo'parastathā  |
evaṃ dvairūpyamabhavadgaṅgāyā munisattama  || 74.5 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
maheśvarajaṭāsthā yā hetunā kena gautamaḥ  |
āhartā kṣatriyeṇāpi āhṛtā kena tadvada  || 74.6 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yathānītā purā vatsa brāhmaṇenetareṇa vā  |
tatsarvaṃ vistareṇāhaṃ vadiṣye prītaye tava  || 74.7 ||
yasmin kāle sureśasya umā patnyabhavatpriyā  |
tasminnevābhavadgaṅgā priyā śaṃbhormahāmate  || 74.8 ||
mama doṣāpanodāya cintayānaḥ śivastadā  |
umayā sahitaḥ śrīmān devīṃ prekṣya viśeṣataḥ  || 74.9 ||
rasavṛttau sthito yasmānnirmame rasamuttamam  |
rasikatvātpriyatvācca straiṇatvātpāvanatvataḥ  || 74.10 ||
sarvābhyo hyadhikaprītirgaṅgābhūddvijasattama  |
saivodbhūtā jaṭāmārgātkasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare  |
sa tu saṃgopayāmāsa gaṅgāṃ śaṃbhurjaṭāgatām  || 74.12 ||
śirasā ca dhṛtāṃ jñātvā na śaśāka umā tadā  |
soḍhuṃ brahmañjaṭājūṭe sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ  || 74.13 ||
amarṣeṇa bhavaṃ gorī prerayasvetyabhāṣata  |
naivāsau prairayacchaṃbhū rasiko rasamuttamam  || 74.14 ||
jaṭāsveva tadā devīṃ gopāyantaṃ vimṛśya sā  |
vināyakaṃ jayāṃ skandaṃ raho vacanamabravīt || 74.15 ||
naivāyaṃ tridaśeśāno gaṅgāṃ tyajati kāmukaḥ  |
sāpi priyā śivasyādya kathaṃ tyajati tāṃ priyām  || 74.16 ||
evaṃ vimṛśya bahuśo gaurī cāha vināyakam  ||* 74.17 ||
{pārvatyuvāca̱ }
na devairnāsurairyakṣairna siddhairbhavatāpi ca  |
na rājabhirathānyairvā na gaṅgāṃ tyajati prabhuḥ  || 74.18 ||
punastapsyāmi vā gatvā himavantaṃ nagottamam  |
athavā brāhmaṇaiḥ puṇyaistapobhirhatakalmaṣaiḥ  || 74.19 ||
tairvā jaṭāsthitā gaṅgā prārthitā bhuvamāpnuyāt ||* 74.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā mātṛvākyaṃ mātaraṃ prāha vighnarāṭ |
bhrātrā skandena jayayā saṃmantryeha ca yujyate  || 74.21 ||
tatkurmo mastakādgaṅgāṃ yathā tyajati me pitā  |
etasminnantare brahmannanāvṛṣṭirajāyata  || 74.22 ||
dvirdvādaśa samā martye sarvaprāṇibhayāvahā  |
tato vinaṣṭamabhavajjagatsthāvarajaṅgamam  || 74.23 ||
vinā tu gautamaṃ puṇyamāśramaṃ sarvakāmadam  |
sraṣṭukāmaḥ purā putra sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā  || 74.24 ||
kṛto yajño mayā pūrvaṃ sa devayajano giriḥ  |
mannāmā tatra vikhyātastato brahmagiriḥ sadā  || 74.25 ||
tamāśritya nagaśreṣṭhaṃ sarvadāste sa gautamaḥ  |
tasyāśrame mahāpuṇye śreṣṭhe brahmagirau śubhe  || 74.26 ||
ādhayo vyādhayo vāpi durbhikṣaṃ vāpyavarṣaṇam  |
bhayaśokau ca dāridryaṃ na śrūyante kadācana  || 74.27 ||
tadāśramaṃ vinānyatra havyaṃ vā kavyameva ca  |
nāsti putra tathā dātā hotā yaṣṭā tathaiva ca  || 74.28 ||
yadaiva gautamo vipro dadāti ca juhoti ca  |
tadaivāpyayanaṃ svarge surāṇāmapi nānyataḥ  || 74.29 ||
devaloke'pi martye vā śrūyate gautamo muniḥ  |
hotā dātā ca bhoktā ca sa eveti janā viduḥ  || 74.30 ||
tacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve nānāśramanivāsinaḥ  |
gautamāśramamāpṛcchannāgacchantastapodhanāḥ  || 74.31 ||
teṣāṃ munīnāṃ sarveṣāmāgatānāṃ sa gautamaḥ  |
śiṣyavatputravadbhaktyā pitṛvatpoṣako'bhavat || 74.32 ||
yasya yathepsitaṃ kāmaṃ yathāyogyaṃ yathākramam  |
yathānurūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ śuśrūṣāmakaronmuniḥ  || 74.33 ||
ājñayā gautamasyāsannoṣadhyo lokamātaraḥ  |
ārādhitāḥ punastena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ  || 74.34 ||
jāyante ca tadauṣadhyo lūyante ca tadaiva hi  |
saṃpatsyante tadopyante gautamasya tapobalāt || 74.35 ||
sarvāḥ samṛddhayastasya saṃsidhyante manogatāḥ  |
pratyahaṃ vakti vinayādgautamastvāgatānmunīn  || 74.36 ||
putravacchiṣyavaccaiva preṣyavatkaravāṇi kim  |
pitṛvatpoṣayāmāsa saṃvatsaragaṇān bahūn  || 74.37 ||
evaṃ vasatsu muniṣu trailokye khyātirāśrayāt |
tato vināyakaḥ prāha mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ jayām  || 74.38 ||
{vināyaka uvāca̱ }
devānāṃ sadane mātargīyate gautamo dvijaḥ  |
yanna sādhyaṃ suragaṇairgautamaḥ kṛtavāniti  || 74.39 ||
evaṃ śrutaṃ mayā devi brāhmaṇasya tapobalam  |
sa vipraścālayedenāṃ mātargaṅgāṃ jaṭāgatām  || 74.40 ||
tapasā vānyato vāpi pūjayitvā trilocanam  |
sa eva cyāvayedenāṃ jaṭāsthāṃ me pitṛpriyām  || 74.41 ||
tatra nītirvidhātavyā tāṃ vipro yācayedyathā  |
tatprabhāvātsaricchreṣṭhā śiraso'vataratyapi  || 74.42 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā mātaraṃ bhrātrā jayayā saha vighnarāṭ |
jagāma gautamo yatra brahmasūtradharaḥ kṛśaḥ  || 74.43 ||
vasan katipayāhaḥsu gautamāśramamaṇḍale  |
uvāca brāhmaṇān sarvāṃstatra tatra ca vighnarāṭ || 74.44 ||
gacchāmaḥ svamadhiṣṭhānamāśramāṇi śucīni ca  |
puṣṭāḥ sma gautamānnena pṛcchāmo gautamaṃ munim  || 74.45 ||
iti saṃmantrya pṛcchanti munayo munisattamāḥ  |
sa tānnivārayāmāsa snehabuddhyā munīn pṛthak || 74.46 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
kṛtāñjaliḥ savinayamāsadhvamiha caiva hi  |
yuṣmaccaraṇaśuśrūṣāṃ karomi munipuṃgavāḥ  || 74.47 ||
śuśrūṣau putravannityaṃ mayi tiṣṭhati nocitam  |
bhavatāṃ bhūmidevānāmāśramāntarasevanam  || 74.48 ||
idamevāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ sarveṣāmiti me matiḥ  |
alamanyena munaya āśrameṇa gatena vā  || 74.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā munervākyaṃ vighnakṛtyamanusmaran  |
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā brāhmaṇān sa gaṇādhipaḥ  || 74.50 ||
{gaṇādhipa uvāca̱ }
annakrītā vayaṃ kiṃ no nivārayata gautamaḥ  |
sāmnā naiva vayaṃ śaktā gantuṃ svaṃ svaṃ niveśanam  || 74.51 ||
nāyamarhati daṇḍaṃ vā upakārī dvijottamaḥ  |
tasmādbuddhyā vyavasyāmi tatsarvairanumanyatām  || 74.52 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ sarve dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kriyatāmityanubruvan  |
etasya tūpakārāya lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 74.53 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śreyo yatsyāttathā kuru  |
brāhmaṇānāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā mene vākyaṃ gaṇādhipaḥ  || 74.54 ||
{vināyaka uvāca̱ }
kriyate guṇarūpaṃ yadgautamasya viśeṣataḥ  ||* 74.55 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
anumānya dvijān sarvān punaḥ punarudāradhīḥ  |
svayaṃ ca brāhmaṇo bhūtvā praṇamya brāhmaṇān punaḥ  |
māturmate sthito vidvāñjayāṃ prāha gaṇeśvaraḥ  || 74.56 ||
{vināyaka uvāca̱ }
yathā nānyo vijānīte tathā kuru śubhānane  |
gorūpadhāriṇī gaccha gautamo yatra tiṣṭhati  || 74.57 ||
śālīn khāda vināśyātha vikāraṃ kuru bhāmini  |
kṛte prahāre huṃkāre prekṣite cāpi kiṃcana  |
pata dīnaṃ svanaṃ kṛtvā na mriyasva na jīva ca  || 74.58 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathā cakāra vijayā vighneśvaramate sthitā  |
yatrāsīdgautamo vipro jayā gorūpadhāriṇī  || 74.59 ||
jagāma śālīn khādantī tāṃ dadarśa sa gautamaḥ  |
gāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtāṃ viprastāṃ tṛṇena nyavārayat || 74.60 ||
nivāryamāṇā sā tena svanaṃ kṛtvā papāta gauḥ  |
tasyāṃ tu patitāyāṃ ca hāhākāro mahānabhūt || 74.61 ||
svanaṃ śrutvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca gautamasya viceṣṭitam  |
vyathitā brāhmaṇāḥ prāhurvighnarājapuraskṛtāḥ  || 74.62 ||
{brāhmaṇā ūcu̱ḥ }
ito gacchāmahe sarve na sthātavyaṃ tavāśrame  |
putravatpoṣitāḥ sarve pṛṣṭo'si munipuṃgava  || 74.63 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā munirvākyaṃ viprāṇāṃ gacchatāṃ tadā  |
vajrāhata ivāsītsa viprāṇāṃ purato'patat || 74.64 ||
tamūcurbrāhmaṇāḥ sarve paśyemāṃ patitāṃ bhuvi  |
rudrāṇāṃ mātaraṃ devīṃ jagatāṃ pāvanīṃ priyām  || 74.65 ||
tīrthadevasvarūpiṇyāmasyāṃ gavi vidherbalāt |
patitāyāṃ muniśreṣṭha gantavyamavaśiṣyate  || 74.66 ||
cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ kṣayaṃ yāti yathā vāsastvadāśrame  |
vayaṃ nānyadhanā brahman kevalaṃ tu tapodhanāḥ  || 74.67 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
viprāṇāṃ purataḥ sthitvā vinītaḥ prāha gautamaḥ  ||* 74.68 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
bhavanta eva śaraṇaṃ pūtaṃ māṃ kartumarhatha  ||* 74.69 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ provāca bhagavān vighnarāḍbrāhmaṇairvṛtaḥ  ||* 74.70 ||
{vighnarāja uvāca̱ }
naiveyaṃ mriyate tatra naiva jīvati tatra kim  |
vadāmo'smin susaṃdigdhe niṣkṛtiṃ gatimeva vā  || 74.71 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
kathamutthāsyatīyaṃ gauratha cāsmiṃśca niṣkṛtim  |
vaktumarhatha tatsarvaṃ kariṣye'hamasaṃśayam  || 74.72 ||
{brāhmaṇā ūcu̱ḥ }
sarveṣāṃ ca matenāyaṃ vadiṣyati ca buddhimān  |
etadvākyamathāsmākaṃ pramāṇaṃ tava gautama  || 74.73 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
brāhmaṇaiḥ preryamāṇo'sau gautamena balīyasā  |
vighnakṛdbrahmavapuṣā prāha sarvānidaṃ vacaḥ  || 74.74 ||
{vighnarāja uvāca̱ }
sarveṣāṃ ca matenāhaṃ vadiṣyāmi yathārthavat |
anumanyantu munayo madvākyaṃ gautamo'pi ca  || 74.75 ||
maheśvarajaṭājūṭe brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ  |
kamaṇḍalusthitaṃ vāri tiṣṭhatīti hi śuśruma  || 74.76 ||
tadānayasva tarasā tapasā niyamena ca  |
tenābhiṣiñca gāmetāṃ bhagavan bhuvamāśritām  |
tato vatsyāmahe sarve pūrvavattava veśmani  || 74.77 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktavati viprendre brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃsadi  |
tatrāpatatpuṣpavṛṣṭirjayaśabdo vyavardhata  |
tataḥ kṛtāñjalirnamro gautamo vākyamabravīt || 74.78 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
tapasāgniprasādena devabrahmaprasādataḥ  |
bhavatāṃ ca prasādena matsaṃkalpo'nusidhyatām  || 74.79 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamastviti taṃ viprā āpṛcchanmunipuṃgavam  |
svāni sthānāni te jagmuḥ samṛddhānyannavāribhiḥ  || 74.80 ||
yāteṣu teṣu vipreṣu bhrātrā saha gaṇeśvaraḥ  |
jayayā saha suprītaḥ kṛtakṛtyo nyavartata  || 74.81 ||
gateṣu brahmavṛndeṣu gaṇeśe ca gate tathā  |
gautamo'pi muniśreṣṭhastapasā hatakalmaṣaḥ  || 74.82 ||
dhyāyaṃstadarthaṃ sa muniḥ kimidaṃ mama saṃsthitam  |
ityevaṃ bahuśo dhyāyañjñānena jñātavān dvija  || 74.83 ||
niścitya devakāryārthamātmanaḥ kilbiṣāṃ gatim  |
lokānāmupakāraṃ ca śaṃbhoḥ prīṇanameva ca  || 74.84 ||
umāyāḥ prīṇanaṃ cāpi gaṅgānayanameva ca  |
sarvaṃ śreyaskaraṃ manye mayi naiva ca kilbiṣam  || 74.85 ||
ityevaṃ manasā dhyāyan suprīto'bhūddvijottamaḥ  |
ārādhya jagatāmīśaṃ trinetraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam  || 74.86 ||
ānayiṣye saricchreṣṭhāṃ prītā'stu girijā mama  |
sapatnī jagadambāyā maheśvarajaṭāsthitā  || 74.87 ||
evaṃ hi saṃkalpya munipravīraḥ  74.88
sa gautamo brahmagirerjagāma  74.88
kailāsamādhiṣṭhitamugradhanvanā  74.88
surārcitaṃ priyayā brahmavṛndaiḥ  74.88
{nārada uvāca̱ }
kailāsaśikharaṃ gatvā gautamo bhagavānṛṣiḥ  |
kiṃ cakāra tapo vāpi kāṃ cakre stutimuttamām  || 75.1 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
giriṃ gatvā tato vatsa vācaṃ saṃyamya gautamaḥ  |
āstīrya sa kuśān prājñaḥ kailāse parvatottame  || 75.2 ||
upaviśya śucirbhūtvā stotraṃ cedaṃ tato jagau  |
apatatpuṣpavṛṣṭiśca stūyamāne maheśvare  || 75.3 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
bhogārthināṃ bhogamabhīpsitaṃ ca  75.4
dātuṃ mahāntyaṣṭavapūṃṣi dhatte  75.4
somo janānāṃ guṇavanti nityaṃ  75.4
devaṃ mahādevamiti stuvanti  75.4
kartuṃ svakīyairviṣayaiḥ sukhāni  75.5
bhartuṃ samastaṃ sacarācaraṃ ca  75.5
saṃpattaye hyasya vivṛddhaye ca  75.5
mahīmayaṃ rūpamitīśvarasya  75.5
sṛṣṭeḥ sthiteḥ saṃharaṇāya bhūmer 75.6
ādhāramādhātumapāṃ svarūpam  75.6
bheje śivaḥ śāntatanurjanānāṃ  75.6
sukhāya dharmāya jagatpratiṣṭhitam  75.6
kālavyavasthāmamṛtasravaṃ ca  75.7
jīvasthitiṃ sṛṣṭimatho vināśanam  75.7
mudaṃ prajānāṃ sukhamunnatiṃ ca  75.7
