cakre'rkacandrāgnimayaṃ śarīram  75.7
vṛddhiṃ gatiṃ śaktimathākṣarāṇi  75.8
jīvavyavasthāṃ mudamapyanekām  75.8
sraṣṭuṃ kṛtaṃ vāyuritīśarūpaṃ  75.8
tvaṃ vetsi nūnaṃ bhagavan bhavantam  75.8
bhedairvinā naiva kṛtirna dharmo  75.9
nātmīyamanyanna diśo'ntarikṣam  75.9
dyāvāpṛthivyau na ca bhuktimuktī  75.9
tasmādidaṃ vyomavapustaveśa  75.9
dharmaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ vyavasya  75.10
ṛksāmaśāstrāṇi yajuśca śākhāḥ  75.10
loke ca gāthāḥ smṛtayaḥ purāṇam  75.10
ityādiśabdātmakatāmupaiti  75.10
yaṣṭā kraturyānyapi sādhanāni  75.11
ṛtvikpradeśaṃ phaladeśakālāḥ  75.11
tvameva śaṃbho paramārthatattvaṃ  75.11
vadanti yajñāṅgamayaṃ vapuste  75.11
kartā pradātā pratibhūḥ pradānaṃ  75.12
sarvajñasākṣī puruṣaḥ paraśca  75.12
pratyātmabhūtaḥ paramārtharūpas 75.12
tvameva sarvaṃ kimu vāgvilāsaiḥ  75.12
na vedaśāstrairgurubhiḥ pradiṣṭo  75.13
na nāsi buddhyādibhirapradhṛṣyaḥ  75.13
ajo'prameyaḥ śivaśabdavācyas 75.13
tvamasti satyaṃ bhagavannamaste  75.13
ātmaikatāṃ svaprakṛtiṃ kadācid 75.14
aikṣacchivaḥ saṃpadiyaṃ mameti  75.14
pṛthaktadaivābhavadapratarkya  75.14
acintyaprabhāvo bahuviśvamūrtiḥ  75.14
bhāve'bhivṛddhā ca bhave bhave ca  75.15
svakāraṇaṃ kāraṇamāsthitā ca  75.15
nityā śivā sarvasulakṣaṇā vā  75.15
vilakṣaṇā viśvakarasya śaktiḥ  75.15
utpādanaṃ saṃsthitirannavṛddhi  75.16
layāḥ satāṃ yatra sanātanāste  75.16
ekaiva mūrtirna samasti kiṃcid 75.16
asādhyamasyā dayitā harasya  75.16
yadarthamannāni dhanāni jīvā  75.17
yacchanti kurvanti tapāṃsi dharmān  75.17
sāpīyamambā jagato janitrī  75.17
priyā tu somasya mahāsukīrtiḥ  75.17
yadīkṣitaṃ kāṅkṣati vāsavo'pi  75.18
yannāmato maṅgalamāpnuyācca  75.18
yā vyāpya viśvaṃ vimalīkaroti  75.18
somā sadā somasamānarūpā  75.18
brahmādijīvasya carācarasya  75.19
buddhyakṣicaitanyamanaḥsukhāni  75.19
yasyāḥ prasādātphalavanti nityaṃ  75.19
vāgīśvarī lokaguroḥ suramyā  75.19
caturmukhasyāpi mano malīnaṃ  75.20
kimanyajantoriti cintya mātā  75.20
gaṅgāvatāraṃ vividhairupāyaiḥ  75.20
sarvaṃ jagatpāvayituṃ cakāra  75.20
śrutīḥ samālakṣya haraprabhutvaṃ  75.21
viśvasya lokaḥ sakalaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ  75.21
kṛtvā ca dharmān bubhuje ca bhogān  75.21
vibhūtireṣā tu sadāśivasya  75.21
kāryakriyākārakasādhanānāṃ  75.22
vedoditānāmatha laukikānām  75.22
yatsādhyamutkṛṣṭatamaṃ priyaṃ ca  75.22
proktā ca sā siddhiranādikartuḥ  75.22
dhyātvā varaṃ brahma paraṃ pradhānaṃ  75.23
yatsārabhūtaṃ yadupāsitavyam  75.23
yatprāpya muktā na punarbhavanti  75.23
sadyogino muktirumāpatiḥ saḥ  75.23
yathā yathā śaṃbhurameyamāyā  75.24
rūpāṇi dhatte jagato hitāya  75.24
tadyogayogyāni tathaiva dhatse  75.24
pativratātvaṃ tvayi mātarevam  75.24
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityevaṃ stuvatastasya purastādvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ  |
umayā sahitaḥ śrīmān gaṇeśādigaṇairvṛtaḥ  || 75.25 ||
sākṣādāgatya taṃ śaṃbhuḥ prasanno vākyamabravīt ||* 75.26 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
kiṃ te gautama dāsyāmi bhaktistotravrataiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
parituṣṭo'smi yācasva devānāmapi duṣkaram  || 75.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā jaganmūrtervākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ  |
harṣabāṣpaparītāṅgo gautamaḥ paryacintayat || 75.28 ||
aho daivamaho dharmo hyaho vai viprapūjanam  |
aho lokagatiścitrā aho dhātarnamo'stu te  || 75.29 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
jaṭāsthitāṃ śubhāṃ gaṅgāṃ dehi me tridaśārcita  |
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa trayīdhāma namo'stu te  || 75.30 ||
{īśvara uvāca̱ }
trayāṇāmupakārārthaṃ lokānāṃ yācitaṃ tvayā  |
ātmanastūpakārāya tadyācasvākutobhayaḥ  || 75.31 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
stotreṇānena ye bhaktāstvāṃ ca devīṃ stuvanti vai  |
sarvakāmasamṛddhāḥ syuretaddhi varayāmyaham  || 75.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamastviti deveśaḥ parituṣṭo'bravīdvacaḥ  |
anyānapi varānmatto yācasva vigatajvaraḥ  || 75.33 ||
evamuktastu harṣeṇa gautamaḥ prāha śaṃkaram  ||* 75.34 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
imāṃ devīṃ jaṭāsaṃsthāṃ pāvanīṃ lokapāvanīm  |
tava priyāṃ jagannātha utsṛja brahmaṇo girau  || 75.35 ||
sarvāsāṃ tīrthabhūtā tu yāvadgacchati sāgaram  |
brahmahatyādipāpāni manovākkāyikāni ca  || 75.36 ||
snānamātreṇa sarvāṇi vilayaṃ yāntu śaṃkara  |
candrasūryoparāge ca ayane viṣuve tathā  || 75.37 ||
saṃkrāntau vaidhṛtau puṇya tīrtheṣvanyeṣu yatphalam  |
asyāstu smaraṇādeva tatpuṇyaṃ jāyatāṃ hara  || 75.38 ||
ślāghyaṃ kṛte tapaḥ proktaṃ tretāyāṃ yajñakarma ca  |
dvāpare yajñadāne ca dānameva kalau yuge  || 75.39 ||
yugadharmāśca ye sarve deśadharmāstathaiva ca  |
deśakālādisaṃyoge yo dharmo yatra śasyate  || 75.40 ||
yadanyatra kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ snānadānādisaṃyamaiḥ  |
asyāstu smaraṇādeva tatpuṇyaṃ jāyatāṃ hara  || 75.41 ||
yatra yatra tviyaṃ yāti yāvatsāgaragāminī  |
tatra tatra tvayā bhāvyameṣa cāstu varo varaḥ  || 75.42 ||
yojanānāṃ tūpari tu daśa yāvacca saṃkhyayā  |
tadantarapraviṣṭānāṃ mahāpātakināmapi  || 75.43 ||
tatpitṝṇāṃ ca teṣāṃ ca snānāyāgacchatāṃ śiva  |
snāne cāpyantare mṛtyormuktibhājo bhavantu vai  || 75.44 ||
ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni svargamartyarasātale  |
eṣā tebhyo viśiṣṭā tu alaṃ śaṃbho namo'stu te  || 75.45 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadgautamavacaḥ śrutvā tathāstvityabravīcchivaḥ  |
asyāḥ parataraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati  || 75.46 ||
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ vede ca pariniṣṭhitam  |
sarveṣāṃ gautamī puṇyā ityuktvāntaradhīyata  || 75.47 ||
tato gate bhagavati lokapūjite  75.48
tadājñayā pūrṇabalaḥ sa gautamaḥ  75.48
jaṭāṃ samādāya saridvarāṃ tāṃ  75.48
surairvṛto brahmagiriṃ viveśa  75.48
tatastu gautame prāpte jaṭāmādāya nārada  |
puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttatra samājagmuḥ sureśvarāḥ  || 75.49 ||
ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāstathā  |
jayaśabdena taṃ vipraṃ pūjayanto mudānvitāḥ  || 75.50 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
maheśvarajaṭājuṭādgaṅgāmādāya gautamaḥ  |
āgatya brahmaṇaḥ puṇye tataḥ kimakarodgirau  || 76.1 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ādāya gautamo gaṅgāṃ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ  |
pūjito devagandharvaistathā girinivāsibhiḥ  || 76.2 ||
girermūrdhni jaṭāṃ sthāpya smaran devaṃ trilocanam  |
uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā gaṅgāṃ sa dvijasattamaḥ  || 76.3 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
trilocanajaṭodbhūte sarvakāmapradāyini  |
kṣamasva mātaḥ śāntāsi sukhaṃ yāhi hitaṃ kuru  || 76.4 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktā gautamena gaṅgā provāca gautamam  |
divyarūpadharā devī divyasraganulepanā  || 76.5 ||
{gaṅgovāca̱ }
gaccheyaṃ devasadanamathavāpi kamaṇḍalum  |
rasātalaṃ vā gaccheyaṃ jātastvaṃ satyavāgasi  || 76.6 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
trayāṇāmupakārārthaṃ lokānāṃ yācitā mayā  |
śaṃbhunā ca tathā dattā devi tannānyathā bhavet || 76.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadgautamavacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgā mene dvijeritam  |
tredhātmānaṃ vibhajyātha svargamartyarasātale  || 76.8 ||
svarge caturdhā vyagamatsaptadhā martyamaṇḍale  |
rasātale caturdhaiva saivaṃ pañcadaśākṛtiḥ  || 76.9 ||
sarvatra sarvabhūtaiva sarvapāpavināśinī  |
sarvakāmapradā nityaṃ saiva vede pragīyate  || 76.10 ||
martyā martyagatāmeva paśyanti na talaṃ gatām  |
naiva svargagatāṃ martyāḥ paśyantyajñānabuddhayaḥ  || 76.11 ||
yāvatsāgaragā devī tāvaddevamayī smṛtā  |
utsṛṣṭā gautamenaiva prāyātpūrvārṇavaṃ prati  || 76.12 ||
tato devarṣibhirjuṣṭāṃ mātaraṃ jagataḥ śubhām  |
gautamo muniśārdūlaḥ pradakṣiṇamathākarot || 76.13 ||
trilocanaṃ sureśānaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya gautamaḥ  |
ubhayostīrayoḥ snānaṃ karomīti dadhe matim  || 76.14 ||
smṛtamātrastadā tatrā virāsītkaruṇārṇavaḥ  |
tatra snānaṃ kathaṃ sidhyedityevaṃ śarvamabravīt || 76.15 ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktinamrastrilocanam  ||* 76.16 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
devadeva maheśāna tīrthasnānavidhiṃ mama  |
brūhi samyaṅmaheśāna lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 76.17 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
maharṣe śṛṇu sarvaṃ ca vidhiṃ godāvarībhavam  |
pūrvaṃ nāndīmukhaṃ kṛtvā dehaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca  || 76.18 ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā ca teṣāmājñāṃ pragṛhya ca  |
brahmacaryeṇa gacchanti patitālāpavarjitāḥ  || 76.19 ||
yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaścaiva susaṃyatam  |
vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute  || 76.20 ||
bhāvaduṣṭiṃ parityajya svadharmapariniṣṭhitaḥ  |
śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ kurvan dadyādannaṃ yathocitam  || 76.21 ||
akiṃcanebhyaḥ sādhubhyo dadyādvastrāṇi kambalān  |
śṛṇvan harikathāṃ divyāṃ tathā gaṅgāsamudbhavām  |
anena vidhinā gacchan samyaktīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 76.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tryambakaśca iti prāha gautamaṃ munibhirvṛtam  ||* 77.1 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
dvihastamātre tīrthāni saṃbhaviṣyanti gautama  |
sarvatrāhaṃ saṃnihitaḥ sarvakāmapradastathā  || 77.2 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca tathā sāgarasaṃgame  |
eteṣu puṇyadā puṃsāṃ muktidā sā bhagīrathī  || 7.3 ||
narmadā tu saricchreṣṭhā parvate'marakaṇṭake  |
yamunā saṃgatā tatra prabhāse tu sarasvatī  || 77.4 ||
kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī caiva tuṅgabhadrā tu nārada  |
tisṛṇāṃ saṃgamo yatra tattīrthaṃ muktidaṃ nṛṇām  || 77.5 ||
payouṣṇī saṃgatā yatra tatratyā tacca muktidam  |
iyaṃ tu gautamī vatsa yatra kvāpi mamājñayā  || 77.6 ||
sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nṝṇāṃ snānānmuktiṃ pradāsyati  |
kiṃcitkāle puṇyatamaṃ kiṃcittīrthaṃ surāgame  || 77.7 ||
sarveṣāṃ sarvadā tīrthaṃ gautamī nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca yojanānāṃ śatadvaye  || 77.8 ||
tīrthāni muniśārdūla saṃbhaviṣyanti gautama  |
iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā gautamī vaiṣṇavīti ca  || 77.9 ||
brāhmī godāvarī nandā sunandā kāmadāyinī  |
brahmatejaḥsamānītā sarvapāpapraṇāśanī  || 77.10 ||
smaraṇādeva pāpaugha hantrī mama sadā priyā  |
pañcānāmapi bhūtānāmāpaḥ śreṣṭhatvamāgatāḥ  || 77.11 ||
tatrāpi tīrthabhūtāstu tasmādāpaḥ parāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
tāsāṃ bhāgīrathī śreṣṭhā tābhyo'pi gautamī tathā  || 77.12 ||
ānītā sajaṭā gaṅgā asyā nānyacchubhāvaham  |
svarge bhuvi tale vāpi tīrthaṃ sarvārthadaṃ mune  || 77.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityetatkathitaṃ putra gautamāya mahātmane  |
sākṣāddhareṇa tuṣṭena mayā tava niveditam  || 77.14 ||
evaṃ sā gautamī gaṅgā sarvebhyo'pyadhikā matā  |
tatsvarūpaṃ ca kathitaṃ kuto'nyā śravaṇaspṛhā  || 77.15 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
dvividhā saiva gaditā ekāpi surasattama  |
eko bhedastu kathito brāhmaṇenāhṛto yataḥ  || 78.1 ||
kṣatriyeṇāparo'pyaṃśo jaṭāsveva vyavasthitaḥ  |
bhavasya devadevasya āhṛtastadvadasva me  || 78.2 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vaivasvatānvaye jāta ikṣvākukulasaṃbhavaḥ  |
purā vai sagaro nāma rājāsīdatidhārmikaḥ  || 78.3 ||
yajvā dānaparo nityaṃ dharmācāravicāravān  |
tasya bhāryādvayaṃ cāsītpatibhaktiparāyaṇam  || 78.4 ||
tasya vai saṃtatirnābhūditi cintāparo'bhavat |
vasiṣṭhaṃ gṛhamāhūya saṃpūjya vidhivattataḥ  || 78.5 ||
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā saṃtateḥ kāraṇaṃ prati  |
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyātvā rājānamabravīt || 78.6 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
sapatnīkaḥ sadā rājannṛṣipūjāparo bhava  ||* 78.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā sa munirvipra yathāsthānaṃ jagāma ha  |
ekadā tasya rājarṣergṛhamāgāttaponidhiḥ  || 78.8 ||
tasyarṣeḥ pūjanaṃ cakre sa saṃtuṣṭo'bravīdvacam  |
varaṃ brūhi mahābhāgetyukte putrān sa cāvṛṇot || 78.9 ||
sa muniḥ prāha rājānamekasyāṃ vaṃśadhārakaḥ  |
putro bhūyāttathānyasyāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasrakaṃ sutāḥ  || 78.10 ||
varaṃ dattvā munau yāte putrā jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ  |
sa yajñān subahūṃścakre hayamedhān sudakṣiṇān  || 78.11 ||
ekasmin hayamedhe vai dīkṣito vidhivannṛpaḥ  |
putrānnyayojayadrājā sasainyān hayarakṣaṇe  || 78.12 ||
kvacidantaramāsādya hayaṃ jahre śatakratuḥ  |
mārgamāṇāśca te putrā naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā  || 78.13 ||
sahasrāṇāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭirnānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ  |
teṣu paśyatsu rakṣāṃsi putreṣu sagarasya hi  || 78.14 ||
prokṣitaṃ taddhayaṃ nītvā te rasātalamāgaman  |
rākṣasānmāyayā yuktānnaivāpaśyanta sāgarāḥ  || 78.15 ||
na dṛṣṭvā te hayaṃ putrāḥ sagarasya balīyasaḥ  |
itaścetaścarantaste naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā  || 78.16 ||
devalokaṃ tadā jagmuḥ parvatāṃśca sarāṃsi ca  |
vanāni ca vicinvanto naivāpaśyan hayaṃ tadā  || 78.17 ||
kṛtasvastyayano rājā ṛtvigbhiḥ kṛtamaṅgalaḥ  |
adṛṣṭvā tu paśuṃ ramyaṃ rājā cintāmupeyivān  || 78.18 ||
aṭantaḥ sāgarāḥ sarve devalokamupāgaman  |
hayaṃ tamanucinvantastatrāpi na hayo'bhavat || 78.19 ||
tato mahīṃ samājagmuḥ parvatāṃśca vanāni ca  |
tatrāpi ca hayaṃ naiva dṛṣṭavanto nṛpātmajāḥ  || 78.20 ||
etasminnantare tatra daivī vāgabhavattadā  |
rasātale hayo baddha āste nānyatra sāgarāḥ  || 78.21 ||
iti śrutvā tato vākyaṃ gantukāmā rasātalam  |
akhanan pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ paritaḥ sāgarāstataḥ  || 78.22 ||
te kṣudhārtā mṛdaṃ śuṣkāṃ bhakṣayantastvaharniśam  |
nyakhanaṃścāpi jagmuśca satvarāste rasātalam  || 78.23 ||
tānāgatān bhūpasutān sāgarān balinaḥ kṛtīn  |
śrutvā rakṣāṃsi saṃtrastā vyagaman kapilāntikam  || 78.24 ||
kapilo'pi mahāprājñastatra śete rasātale  |
purā ca sādhitaṃ tena devānāṃ kāryamuttamam  || 78.25 ||
vinidreṇa tataḥ śrāntaḥ siddhe kārye surān prati  |
abravītkapilaḥ śrīmānnidrāsthānaṃ prayacchatha  || 78.26 ||
rasātalaṃ dadustasmai punarāha surānmuniḥ  |
yo māmutthāpayenmando bhasmī bhūyācca satvaram  || 78.27 ||
tataḥ śaye talagato no cenna svapna eva hi  |
tathetyuktaḥ suragaṇaistatra śete rasātale  || 78.28 ||
tasya prabhāvaṃ te jñātvā rākṣasā māyayā yutāḥ  |
sāgarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vadhopāyaṃ pracakrire  || 78.29 ||
vinā yuddhena te bhītā rākṣasāḥ satvarāstadā  |
āgatya yatra sa muniḥ kapilaḥ kopano mahān  || 78.30 ||
śirodeśe hayaṃ te vai baddhvātha tvarayānvitāḥ  |
dūre sthitvā mauninaśca prekṣantaḥ kiṃ bhavediti  || 78.31 ||
tatastu sāgarāḥ sarve nirviśanto rasātalam  |
dadṛśuste hayaṃ baddhaṃ śayānaṃ puruṣaṃ tathā  || 78.32 ||
taṃ menire ca hartāraṃ kratuhantārameva ca  |
enaṃ hatvā mahāpāpaṃ nayāmo'śvaṃ nṛpāntikam  || 78.33 ||
kecidūcuḥ paśuṃ baddhaṃ nayāmo'nena kiṃ phalam  |
tadāhurapare śūrā rājānaḥ śāsakā vayam  || 78.34 ||
utthāpyainaṃ mahāpāpaṃ hanmaḥ kṣātreṇa varcasā  |
te taṃ jaghnurmuniṃ pādairbruvanto niṣṭhurāṇi ca  || 78.35 ||
tataḥ kopena mahatā kapilo munisattamaḥ  |
sāgarānīkṣayāmāsa tān kopādbhasmasātkarot || 78.36 ||
jajvaluste tatastatra sāgarāḥ sarva eva hi  |
tattu sarvaṃ na jānāti dīkṣitaḥ sagaro nṛpaḥ  || 78.37 ||
nāradaḥ kathayāmāsa sagarāya mahātmane  |
kapilasya tu saṃsthānaṃ hayasyāpi tu saṃsthitim  || 78.38 ||
rākṣasānāṃ tu vikṛtiṃ sāgarāṇāṃ ca nāśanam  |
tataścintāparo rājā kartavyaṃ nāvabudhyata  || 78.39 ||
aparo'pi sutaścāsīdasamañjā iti śrutaḥ  |
sa tu bālāṃstathā paurānmaurkhyātkṣipati cāmbhasi  || 78.40 ||
sagaro'pyatha vijñaptaḥ pauraiḥ saṃmilitaistadā  |
durnayaṃ tasya taṃ jñātvā tataḥ kruddho'bravīnnṛpaḥ  || 78.41 ||
svānamātyāṃstadā rājā deśatyāgaṃ karotvayam  |
asamañjāḥ kṣatradharma tyāgī vai bālaghātakaḥ  || 78.42 ||
sagarasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvāmātyāstvarānvitāḥ  |
tatyajurnṛpateḥ putramasamañjā gato vanam  || 78.43 ||
sāgarā brahmaśāpena naṣṭāḥ sarve rasātale  |
eko'pi ca vanaṃ prāpta idānīṃ kā gatirmama  || 78.44 ||
aṃśumāniti vikhyātaḥ putrastasyāsamañjasaḥ  |
ānāyya bālakaṃ rājā kāryaṃ tasmai nyavedayat || 78.45 ||
kapilaṃ ca samārādhya aṃśumānapi bālakaḥ  |
sagarāya hayaṃ prādāttataḥ pūrṇo'bhavatkratuḥ  || 78.46 ||
tasyāpi putrastejasvī dilīpa iti dhārmikaḥ  |
tasyāpi putro matimān bhagīratha iti śrutaḥ  || 78.47 ||
pitāmahānāṃ sarveṣāṃ gatiṃ śrutvā suduḥkhitaḥ  |
sagaraṃ nṛpaśārdūlaṃ papraccha vinayānvitaḥ  || 78.48 ||
sāgarāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ niṣkṛtistu kathaṃ bhavet |
bhagīrathaṃ nṛpaḥ prāha kapilo vetti putraka  || 78.49 ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bālaḥ prāyādrasātalam  |
kapilaṃ ca namaskṛtvā sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayat || 78.50 ||
sa munistu ciraṃ dhyātvā tapasārādhya śaṃkaram  |
jaṭājalena svapitṝnāplāvya nṛpasattama  || 78.51 ||
tataḥ kṛtārtho bhavitā tvaṃ ca te pitarastathā  |
tathā karomīti muniṃ praṇamya punarabravīt || 78.52 ||
kva gacche'haṃ muniśreṣṭha kartavyaṃ cāpi tadvada  ||* 78.53 ||
{kapila uvāca̱ }
kailāsaṃ taṃ naraśreṣṭha gatvā stuhi maheśvaram  |
tapaḥ kuru yathāśakti tataścepsitamāpsyasi  || 78.54 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā sa munervākyaṃ muniṃ natvā tvagānnagam  |
kailāsaṃ sa śucirbhūtvā bālo bālakriyānvitaḥ  |
tapase niścayaṃ kṛtvā uvāca sa bhagīrathaḥ  || 78.55 ||
{bhagīratha uvāca̱ }
bālo'haṃ bālabuddhiśca bālacandradhara prabho  |
nāhaṃ kimapi jānāmi tataḥ prīto bhava prabho  || 78.56 ||
vāgbhirmanobhiḥ kṛtibhiḥ kadācin  78.57
mamopakurvanti hite ratā ye  78.57
tebhyo hitārthaṃ tviha cāmareśa  78.57
somaṃ namasyāmi surādipūjyam  78.57
utpādito yairabhivardhitaśca  78.58
samānagotraśca samānadharmā  78.58
teṣāmabhīṣṭāni śivaḥ karotu  78.58
bālendumauliṃ praṇato'smi nityam  78.58
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ tu bruvatastasya purastādabhavacchivaḥ  |
vareṇa cchandayāno vai bhagīrathamuvāca ha  || 78.59 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
yanna sādhyaṃ suragaṇairdeyaṃ tatte mayā dhruvam  |
vadasva nirbhayo bhūtvā bhagīratha mahāmate  || 78.60 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhagīrathaḥ praṇamyeśaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ provāca śaṃkaram  ||* 78.61 ||
{bhagīratha uvāca̱ }
jaṭāsthitāṃ pitṝṇāṃ me pāvanāya saridvarām  |
tāmeva dehi deveśa sarvamāptaṃ tato bhavet || 78.62 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
maheśo'pi vihasyātha bhagīrathamuvāca ha  ||* 78.63 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
dattā mayeyaṃ te putra punastāṃ stuhi suvrata  ||* 78.64 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
taddevavacanaṃ śrutvā tadarthaṃ tu tapo mahat |
stutiṃ cakāra gaṅgāyā bhaktyā prayatamānasaḥ  || 78.65 ||
tasyā api prasādaṃ ca prāpya bālo'pyabālavat |
gaṅgāṃ maheśvarātprāptāmādāyāgādrasātalam  || 78.66 ||
nyavedayatsa munaye kapilāya mahātmane  |
yathoditaprakāreṇa gaṅgāṃ saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ  || 78.67 ||
pradakṣiṇamathāvartya kṛtāñjalipuṭo'bravīt ||* 78.68 ||
{bhagīratha uvāca̱ }
devi me pitaraḥ śāpātkapilasya mahāmuneḥ  |
prāptāste vigatiṃ mātastasmāttān pātumarhasi  || 78.69 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā suranadī sarveṣāmupakārikā  |
lokānāmupakārārthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ pāvanāya ca  || 78.70 ||
agastyapītasyāmbhodheḥ pūraṇāya viśeṣataḥ  |
smaraṇādeva pāpānāṃ nāśāya suranimnagā  || 78.71 ||
bhagīrathoditaṃ cakre rasātalatale sthitān  |
bhasmībhūtānnṛpasutān sāgarāṃśca viśeṣataḥ  || 78.72 ||
vinirdagdhānathāplāvya khātapūramathākarot |
tato meruṃ samāplāvya sthitāṃ bālo'bravīnnṛpaḥ  || 78.73 ||
karmabhūmau tvayā bhāvyaṃ tathetyāgāddhimālayam  |
himavatparvatātpuṇyādbhārataṃ varṣamabhyagāt || 78.74 ||
tanmadhyataḥ puṇyanadī prāyātpūrvārṇavaṃ prati  |
evameṣāpi te proktā gaṅgā kṣātrā mahāmune  || 78.75 ||
māheśvarī vaiṣṇavī ca saiva brāhmī ca pāvanī  |
bhāgīrathī devanadī himavacchikharāśrayā  || 78.76 ||
maheśvarajaṭāvāri evaṃ dvaividhyamāgatam  |
vindhyasya dakṣiṇe gaṅgā gautamī sā nigadyate  |
uttare sāpi vindhyasya bhāgīrathyabhidhīyate  || 78.77 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
na manastṛptimādhatte kathāḥ śṛṇvattvayeritāḥ  |
pṛthaktīrthaphalaṃ śrotuṃ pravṛttaṃ mama mānasam  || 79.1 ||
kramaśo brāhmaṇānītāṃ gaṅgāṃ me prathamaṃ vada  |
pṛthaktīrthaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ setihāsaṃ yathākramam  || 79.2 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tīrthānāṃ ca pṛthagbhāvaṃ phalaṃ māhātmyameva ca  |
sarvaṃ vaktuṃ na śaknomi na ca tvaṃ śravaṇe kṣamaḥ  || 79.3 ||
tathāpi kiṃcidvakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ  |
yānyuktāni ca tīrthāni śrutivākyāni yāni ca  || 79.4 ||
tāni vakṣyāmi saṃkṣepānnamaskṛtvā trilocanam  |
yatrāsau bhagavānāsītpratyakṣastryambako mune  || 79.5 ||
tryambakaṃ nāma tattīrthaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam  |
vārāhamaparaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam  || 79.6 ||
tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi nāma viṣṇoryathābhavat |
purā devān parābhūya yajñamādāya rākṣasaḥ  || 79.7 ||
rasātalamanuprāptaḥ sindhusena iti śrutaḥ  |
yajñe talamanuprāpte niryajñā hyabhavanmahī  || 79.8 ||
nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro yajñe naṣṭa itītvarāḥ  |
surāstameva viviśū rasātalamanudviṣam  || 79.9 ||
nāśaknuvaṃstu taṃ jetuṃ devā indrapurogamāḥ  |
viṣṇuṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ gatvā tasmai nyavedayan  || 79.10 ||
rākṣasasya tu tatkarma yajñabhraṃśamaśeṣataḥ  |
tataḥ provāca bhagavān vārāhaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ  || 79.11 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇirgatvā caiva rasātalam  |
ānayiṣye makhaṃ puṇyaṃ hatvā rākṣasapuṃgavān  || 79.12 ||
svaḥ prayāntu surāḥ sarve vyetu vo mānaso jvaraḥ  |
yena gaṅgā talaṃ prāptā pathā tenaiva cakradhṛk || 79.13 ||
jagāma tarasā putra bhuvaṃ bhittvā rasātalam  |
sa varāhavapuḥ śrīmān rasātalanivāsinaḥ  || 79.14 ||
rākṣasān dānavān hatvā mukhe dhṛtvā mahādhvaram  |
vārāharūpī bhagavānmakhamādāya yajñabhuk || 79.15 ||
yena prāpa talaṃ viṣṇuḥ pathā tenaiva śatrujit |
mukhe nyasya mahāyajñaṃ niścakrāma rasātalāt || 79.16 ||
tatra brahmagirau devāḥ pratīkṣāṃ cakrire hareḥ  |
pathastasmādviniḥsṛtya gaṅgāsravaṇamabhyagāt || 79.17 ||
prākṣālayacca svāṅgāni asṛgliptāni nārada  |
gaṅgāmbhasā tatra kuṇḍaṃ vārāhamabhavattataḥ  || 79.18 ||
mukhe nyastaṃ mahāyajñaṃ devānāṃ purato hariḥ  |
dattavāṃstridaśaśreṣṭho mukhādyajño'bhyajāyata  || 79.19 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti yajñāṅgaṃ pradhānaṃ sruva ucyate  |
vārāharūpamabhavadevaṃ vai kāraṇāntarāt || 79.20 ||
tasmātpuṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ vārāhaṃ sarvakāmadam  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam  || 79.21 ||
tatra sthito'pi yaḥ kaścitpitṝn smarati puṇyakṛt |
vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ pitaraḥ svargamāpnuyuḥ  || 79.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kuśāvartasya māhātmyamahaṃ vaktuṃ na te kṣamaḥ  |
tasya smaraṇamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ  || 80.1 ||
kuśāvartamiti khyātaṃ narāṇāṃ sarvakāmadam  |
kuśenāvartitaṃ yatra gautamena mahātmanā  || 80.2 ||
kuśenāvartayitvā tu ānayāmāsa tāṃ muniḥ  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidāyakam  || 80.3 ||
nīlagaṅgā saricchreṣṭhā niḥsṛtā nīlaparvatāt |
tatra snānādi yatkiṃcitkaroti prayato naraḥ  || 80.4 ||
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ vidyātpitṝṇāṃ tṛptidāyakam  |
viśrutaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kapotaṃ tīrthamuttamam  || 80.5 ||
tasya rūpaṃ ca vakṣyāmi mune śṛṇu mahāphalam  |
tatra brahmagirau kaścidvyādhaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ  || 80.6 ||
hinasti brāhmaṇān sādhūn yatīn gopakṣiṇo mṛgān  |
evaṃbhūtaḥ sa pāpātmā krodhano'nṛtabhāṣaṇaḥ  || 80.7 ||
bhīṣaṇākṛtiratyugro nīlākṣo hrasvabāhukaḥ  |
danturo naṣṭanāsākṣo hrasvapātpṛthukukṣikaḥ  || 80.8 ||
hrasvodaro hrasvabhujo vikṛto gardabhasvanaḥ  |
pāśahastaḥ pāpacittaḥ pāpiṣṭhaḥ sadhanuḥ sadā  || 80.9 ||
tasya bhāryā tathābhūtā apatyānyapi nārada  |
tayā tu preryamāṇo'sau viveśa gahanaṃ vanam  || 80.10 ||
sa jaghāna mṛgān pāpaḥ pakṣiṇo bahurūpiṇaḥ  |
pañjare prākṣipatkāṃścijjīvamānāṃstathetarān  || 80.11 ||
kṣudhayā paritaptāṅgo vihvalastṛṣayā tathā  |
bhrāntadeśo bahutaraṃ nyavartata gṛhaṃ prati  || 80.12 ||
tato'parāhṇe saṃprāpte nivṛtte madhumādhave  |
kṣaṇāttaḍidgarjitaṃ ca sābhraṃ caivābhavattadā  || 80.13 ||
vavau vāyuḥ sāśmavarṣo vāridhārātibhīṣaṇaḥ  |
sa gacchaṃllubdhakaḥ śrāntaḥ panthānaṃ nāvabudhyata  || 80.14 ||
jalaṃ sthalaṃ gartamatho panthānamathavā diśaḥ  |
na bubodha tadā pāpaḥ śrāntaḥ śaraṇamapyatha  || 80.15 ||
kva gacchāmi kva tiṣṭheyaṃ kiṃ karomītyacintayat |
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇānāhartāhaṃ yathāntakaḥ  || 80.16 ||
mamāpyantakaraṃ bhūtaṃ saṃprāptaṃ cāśmavarṣaṇam  |
trātāraṃ naiva paśyāmi śilāṃ vā vṛkṣamantike  || 80.17 ||
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ vyādho vicintyāpaśyadantike  |
vane vanaspatimiva nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathātrijam  || 80.18 ||
mṛgāṇāṃ ca yathā siṃhamāśramāṇāṃ gṛhādhipam  |
indriyāṇāṃ mana iva trātāraṃ prāṇināṃ nagam  || 80.19 ||
śreṣṭhaṃ viṭapinaṃ śubhraṃ śākhāpallavamaṇḍitam  |
tamāśrityopaviṣṭo'bhūtklinnavāsā sa lubdhakaḥ  || 80.20 ||
smaran bhāryāmapatyāni jīveyurathavā na vā  |
etasminnantare tatra cāstaṃ prāpto divākaraḥ  || 80.21 ||
tameva nagamāśritya kapoto bhāryayā saha  |
putrapautraiḥ parivṛto hyāste tatra nagottame  || 80.22 ||
sukhena nirbhayo bhūtvā sutṛptaḥ prīta eva ca  |
bahavo vatsarā yātā vasatastasya pakṣiṇaḥ  || 80.23 ||
pativratā tasya bhāryā suprītā tena caiva hi  |
koṭare tannage śreṣṭhe jalavāyvagnivarjite  || 80.24 ||
bhāryāputraiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvadāste kapotakaḥ  |
tasmin dine daivavaśātkapotaśca kapotakī  || 80.25 ||
bhakṣyārthaṃ tu ubhau yātau kapoto nagamabhyagāt |
sāpi daivavaśātputra pañjarasthaiva vartate  || 80.26 ||
gṛhītā lubdhakenātha jīvamāneva vartate  |
kapotako'pyapatyāni mātṛhīnānyudīkṣya ca  || 80.27 ||
varṣaṃ ca bhīṣaṇaṃ prāptamastaṃ yāto divākaraḥ  |
svakoṭaraṃ tayā hīnamālokya vilalāpa saḥ  || 80.28 ||
tāṃ baddhāṃ pañjarasthāṃ vā na bubodha kapotarāṭ |
anvārebhe kapoto vai priyāyā guṇakīrtanam  || 80.29 ||
nādyāpyāyāti kalyāṇī mama harṣavivardhinī  |
mama dharmasya jananī mama dehasya ceśvarī  || 80.30 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ saiva nityaṃ sahāyinī  |
tuṣṭe hasantī ruṣṭe ca mama duḥkhapramārjanī  || 80.31 ||
sakhī mantreṣu sā nityaṃ mama vākyaratā sadā  |
nādyāpyāyāti kalyāṇī saṃprayāte'pi bhāskare  || 80.32 ||
na jānāti vrataṃ mantraṃ daivaṃ dharmārthameva ca  |
pativratā patiprāṇā patimantrā patipriyā  || 80.33 ||
nādyāpyāyāti kalyāṇī kiṃ karomi kva yāmi vā  |
kiṃ me gṛhaṃ kānanaṃ ca tayā hīnaṃ hi dṛśyate  || 80.34 ||
tayā yuktaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ vāpi śobhanam  |
nādyāpyāyāti me kāntā yayā gṛhamudīritam  || 80.35 ||
vinānayā na jīviṣye tyaje vāpi priyāṃ tanum  |
kiṃ kurvantu tvapatyāni luptadharmastvahaṃ punaḥ  || 80.36 ||
evaṃ vilapatastasya bharturvākyaṃ niśamya sā  |
pañjarasthaiva sā vākyaṃ bhartāramidamabravīt || 80.37 ||
{kapotakyuvāca̱ }
atrāhamasmi baddhaiva vivaśāsmi khagottama  |
ānītāhaṃ lubdhakena baddhā pāśairmahāmate  || 80.38 ||
dhanyāsmyanugṛhītāsmi patirvakti guṇānmama  |
sato vāpyasato vāpi kṛtārthāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  || 80.39 ||
tuṣṭe bhartari nārīṇāṃ tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ  |
viparyaye tu nārīṇāmavaśyaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt || 80.40 ||
tvaṃ daivaṃ tvaṃ prabhurmahyaṃ tvaṃ suhṛttvaṃ parāyaṇam  |
tvaṃ vrataṃ tvaṃ paraṃ brahma svargo mokṣastvameva ca  || 80.41 ||
mā cintāṃ kuru kalyāṇa dharme buddhiṃ sthirāṃ kuru  |
tvatprasādācca bhuktā hi bhogāśca vividhā mayā  |
alaṃ khedena majjena dharme buddhiṃ kuru sthirām  || 80.43 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā priyāvākyamuttatāra nagottamāt |
yatra sā pañjarasthā tu kapotī vartate tvaram  || 80.44 ||
tāmāgatya priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtavaccāpi lubdhakam  |
mocayāmīti tāmāha niśceṣṭo lubdhako'dhunā  || 80.45 ||
mā muñcasva mahābhāga jñātvā saṃbandhamasthiram  |
lubdhānāṃ khecarā hyannaṃ jīvo jīvasya cāśanam  || 80.46 ||
nāparādhaṃ smarāmyasya dharmabuddhiṃ sthirāṃ kuru  |
gururagnirdvijātīnāṃ varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo guruḥ  || 80.47 ||
patireva guruḥ strīṇāṃ sarvasyābhyāgato guruḥ  |
abhyāgatamanuprāptaṃ vacanaistoṣayanti ye  || 80.48 ||
teṣāṃ vāgīśvarī devī tṛptā bhavati niścitam  |
tasyānnasya pradānena śakrastṛptimavāpnuyāt || 80.49 ||
pitaraḥ pādaśaucena annādyena prajāpatiḥ  |
tasyopacārādvai lakṣmīrviṣṇunā prītimāpnuyāt || 80.50 ||
śayane sarvadevāstu tasmātpūjyatamo'tithiḥ  |
abhyāgatamanuśrāntaṃ sūryoḍhaṃ gṛhamāgatam  |
taṃ vidyāddevarūpeṇa sarvakratuphalo hyasau  || 80.51 ||
abhyāgataṃ śrāntamanuvrajanti  80.52
devāśca sarve pitaro'gnayaśca  80.52
tasmin hi tṛpte mudamāpnuvanti  80.52
gate nirāśe'pi ca te nirāśāḥ  80.52
tasmātsarvātmanā kānta duḥkhaṃ tyaktvā śamaṃ vraja  |
kṛtvā tiṣṭha śubhāṃ buddhiṃ dharmakṛtyaṃ samācara  || 80.53 ||
upakāro'pakāraśca pravarāviti saṃmatau  |
upakāriṣu sarvo'pi karotyupakṛtiṃ punaḥ  || 80.54 ||
apakāriṣu yaḥ sādhuḥ puṇyabhāksa udāhṛtaḥ  ||* 80.55 ||
{kapota uvāca̱ }
āvayoranurūpaṃ ca tvayoktaṃ sādhu manyase  |
kiṃtu vaktavyamapyasti tacchṛṇuṣva varānane  || 80.56 ||
sahasraṃ bharate kaścicchatamanyo daśāparaḥ  |
ātmānaṃ ca sukhenānyo vayaṃ kaṣṭodaraṃbharāḥ  || 80.57 ||
gartadhānyadhanāḥ kecitkuśūladhanino'pare  |
ghaṭakṣiptadhanāḥ keciccañcukṣiptadhanā vayam  || 80.58 ||
pūjayāmi kathaṃ śrāntamabhyāgatamimaṃ śubhe  ||* 80.59 ||
{kapotyuvāca̱ }
agnirāpaḥ śubhā vāṇī tṛṇakāṣṭhādikaṃ ca yat |
etadapyarthine deyaṃ śītārto lubdhakastvayam  || 80.60 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā priyāvākyaṃ vṛkṣamāruhya pakṣirāṭ |
ālokayāmāsa tadā vahniṃ dūraṃ dadarśa ha  || 80.61 ||
sa tu gatvā vahnideśaṃ cañcunolmukamāharat |
puro'gniṃ jvālayāmāsa lubdhakasya kapotakaḥ  || 80.62 ||
śuṣkakāṣṭhāni parṇāni tṛṇāni ca punaḥ punaḥ  |
agnau nikṣepayāmāsa niśīthe sa kapotarāṭ || 80.63 ||
tamagniṃ jvalitaṃ dṛṣṭvā lubdhakaḥ śītaduḥkhitaḥ  |
avaśāni svakāṅgāni pratāpya sukhamāptavān  || 80.64 ||
kṣudhāgninā dahyamānaṃ vyādhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kapotakī  |
mā muñcasva mahābhāga iti bhartāramabravīt || 80.65 ||
svaśarīreṇa duḥkhārtaṃ lubdhakaṃ prīṇayāmi tam  |
iṣṭātithīnāṃ ye lokāstāṃstvaṃ prāpnuhi suvrata  || 80.66 ||
{kapota uvāca̱ }
mayi tiṣṭhati naivāyaṃ tava dharmo vidhīyate  |
iṣṭātithirbhavāmīha anujānīhi māṃ śubhe  || 80.67 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvāgniṃ trirāvartya smaran devaṃ caturbhujam  |
viśvātmakaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ śaraṇyaṃ bhaktavatsalam  || 80.68 ||
yathāsukhaṃ juṣasveti vadannagniṃ tathāviśat |
taṃ dṛṣṭvāgnau kṣiptajīvaṃ lubdhako vākyamabravīt || 80.69 ||
{lubdhaka uvāca̱ }
aho mānuṣadehasya dhigjīvitamidaṃ mama  |
yadidaṃ pakṣirājena madarthe sāhasaṃ kṛtam  || 80.70 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ bruvantaṃ taṃ lubdhaṃ pakṣiṇī vākyamabravīt ||* 80.71 ||
{kapotakyuvāca̱ }
māṃ tvaṃ muñca mahābhāga dūraṃ yātyeṣa me patiḥ  ||* 80.72 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pañjarasthāṃ kapotakīm  |
lubdhako mocayāmāsa tarasā bhītavattadā  || 80.73 ||
sāpi pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā patimagniṃ tadā jagau  ||* 80.74 ||
{kapotyuvāca̱ }
strīṇāmayaṃ paro dharmo yadbharturanuveśanam  |
vede ca vihito mārgaḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ  || 80.75 ||
vyālagrāhī yathā vyālaṃ bilāduddharate balāt |
evaṃ tvanugatā nārī saha bhartrā divaṃ vrajet || 80.76 ||
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca yāni romāṇi mānuṣe  |
tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge bhartāraṃ yānugacchati  || 80.77 ||
namaskṛtvā bhuvaṃ devān gaṅgāṃ cāpi vanaspatīn  |
āśvāsya tānyapatyāni lubdhakaṃ vākyamabravīt || 80.78 ||
{kapotyuvāca̱ }
tvatprasādānmahābhāga upapannaṃ mamedṛśam  |
apatyānāṃ kṣamasveha bhartrā yāmi triviṣṭapam  || 80.79 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā pakṣiṇī sādhvī praviveśa hutāśanam  |
praviṣṭāyāṃ hutavahe jayaśabdo nyavartata  || 80.80 ||
gagane sūryasaṃkāśaṃ vimānamatiśobhanam  |
tadārūḍhau suranibhau daṃpatī dadṛśe tataḥ  || 80.81 ||
harṣeṇa procaturubhau lubdhakaṃ vismayānvitam  ||* 80.82 ||
{daṃpatī ūcatu̱ḥ }
gacchāvastridaśasthānamāpṛṣṭo'si mahāmate  |
āvayoḥ svargasopānamatithistvaṃ namo'stu te  || 80.83 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vimānavaramārūḍhau tau dṛṣṭvā lubdhako'pi saḥ  |
sadhanuḥ pañjaraṃ tyaktvā kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata  || 80.84 ||
{lubdhaka uvāca̱ }
na tyaktavyo mahābhāgau deyaṃ kiṃcidajānate  |
ahamatrātithirmānyo niṣkṛtiṃ vaktumarhathaḥ  || 80.85 ||
{daṃpatī ūcatu̱ḥ }
gautamīṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te tasyāḥ pāpaṃ nivedaya  |
tatraivāplavanātpakṣaṃ sarvapāpairvimokṣyase  || 80.86 ||
muktapāpaḥ punastatra gaṅgāyāmavagāhane  |
aśvamedhaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpya puṇyo bhaviṣyasi  || 80.87 ||
saridvarāyāṃ gautamyāṃ brahmaviṣṇvīśasaṃbhuvi  |
punarāplavanādeva tyaktvā dehaṃ malīmasam  || 80.88 ||
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ svargaṃ gantāsyasaṃśayam  ||* 80.89 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tābhyāṃ tathā cakre sa lubdhakaḥ  |
vimānavaramārūḍho divyarūpadharo'bhavat || 80.90 ||
divyamālyāmbaradharaḥ pūjyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ  |
kapotaśca kapotī ca tṛtīyo lubdhakastathā  |
gaṅgāyāśca prabhāveṇa sarve vai divamākraman  || 80.91 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kāpotamiti viśrutam  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pitṛpūjanameva ca  || 80.92 ||
japayajñādikaṃ karma tadānantyāya kalpate  ||* 80.93 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kārttikeyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ kaumāramiti viśrutam  |
yannāmaśravaṇādeva kulavān rūpavān bhavet || 81.1 ||
nihate tārake daitye svasthe jāte triviṣṭape  |
kārttikeyaṃ sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ prītyā provāca pārvatī  || 81.2 ||
yathāsukhaṃ bhuṅkṣva bhogāṃstrailokye manasaḥ priyān  |
mamājñayā prītamanāḥ pituścaiva prasādataḥ  || 81.3 ||
evamuktaḥ sa vai mātrā viśākho devatāstriyaḥ  |
yathāsukhaṃ balādreme devapatnyo'pi remire  || 81.4 ||
tataḥ saṃbhujyamānāsu devapatnīṣu nārada  |
nāśaknuvan vārayituṃ kārttikeyaṃ divaukasaḥ  || 81.5 ||
tato nivedayāmāsuḥ pārvatyai putrakarma tat |
asakṛdvāryamāṇo'pi mātrā devaiḥ sa śaktidhṛk || 81.6 ||
naivāsāvakarodvākyaṃ strīṣvāsaktastu ṣaṇmukhaḥ  |
abhiśāpabhayādbhītā pārvatī paryacintayat || 81.7 ||
putrasnehāttathaiveśā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye  |
devapatnyaściraṃ rakṣyā iti matvā punaḥ punaḥ  || 81.8 ||
yasyāṃ tu ramate skandaḥ pārvatī tvapi tādṛśī  |
tadrūpamātmanaḥ kṛtvā vartayāmāsa pārvatī  || 81.9 ||
indrasya varuṇasyāpi bhāryāmāhūya ṣaṇmukhaḥ  |
yāvatpaśyati tasyāṃ tu mātṛrūpamapaśyata  || 81.10 ||
tāmapāsya namasyātha punaranyāmathāhvayat |
tasyāṃ tu mātṛrūpaṃ sa prekṣya lajjāmupeyivān  || 81.11 ||
evaṃ bahvīṣu tadrūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mātṛmayaṃ jagat |
iti saṃcintya gāṅgeyo vairāgyamagamattadā  || 81.12 ||
sa tu mātṛkṛtaṃ jñātvā pravṛttasya nivartanam  |
nivāryaścedahaṃ bhogātkiṃtu pūrvaṃ pravartitaḥ  || 81.13 ||
tasmānmātṛkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mama hāsyāspadaṃ tviti  |
lajjayā parayā yukto gautamīmagamattadā  || 81.14 ||
iyaṃ ca mātṛrūpā me śṛṇotu mama bhāṣitam  |
itaḥ strīnāmadheyaṃ yanmama mātṛsamaṃ matam  || 81.15 ||
evaṃ jñātvā lokanāthaḥ pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ  |
putraṃ nivārayāmāsa vṛttamityabravīdguruḥ  || 81.16 ||
tataḥ surapatiḥ prītaḥ kiṃ dadāmīti cintayan  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ skandaḥ pitaraṃ punarabravīt || 81.17 ||
{skanda uvāca̱ }
senāpatiḥ surapatistava putro'hamityapi  |
alametena deveśa kiṃ varaiḥ surapūjita  || 81.18 ||
athavā dātukāmo'si lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  |
yāce'haṃ nātmanā deva tadanujñātumarhasi  || 81.19 ||
mahāpātakinaḥ kecidgurudārābhigāminaḥ  |
atrāplavanamātreṇa dhautapāpā bhavantu te  || 81.20 ||
āpnuvantūttamāṃ jātiṃ tiryañco'pi sureśvara  |
kurūpo rūpasaṃpattimatra snānādavāpnuyāt || 81.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamastviti taṃ śaṃbhuḥ pratyanandatsuteritam  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kārttikeyamiti śrutam  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam  || 81.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yatkhyātaṃ kṛttikātīrthaṃ kārttikeyādanantaram  |
tasya śravaṇamātreṇa somapānaphalaṃ labhet || 82.1 ||
purā tārakanāśāya bhavareto'pibatkaviḥ  |
retogarbhaṃ kaviṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣipatnyo'spṛhanmune  || 82.2 ||
saptarṣīṇāmṛtusnātāṃ varjayitvā tvarundhatīm  |
tāsu garbhaḥ samabhavatṣaṭsu strīṣu tadāgnitaḥ  || 82.3 ||
tapyamānāstu śobhiṣṭhā ṛtusnātāstu tā mune  |
kiṃ kurmaḥ kva nu gacchāmaḥ kiṃ kṛtvā sukṛtaṃ bhavet || 82.4 ||
ityuktvā tā mitho gaṅgāṃ vyagrā gatvā vyapīḍayan  |
tābhyaste niḥsṛtā garbhāḥ phenarūpāstadāmbhasi  || 82.5 ||
ambhasā tvekatāṃ prāptā vāyunā sarva eva hi  |
ekarūpastadā tābhyaḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ samajāyata  || 82.6 ||
srāvayitvā tu tān garbhānṛṣipatnyo gṛhān yayuḥ  |
tāsāṃ vikṛtarūpāṇi dṛṣṭvā te ṛṣayo'bruvan  || 82.7 ||
gamyatāṃ gamyatāṃ śīghraṃ svairī vṛttirna yujyate  |
strīṇāmiti tato vatsa nirastāḥ patibhistu tāḥ  || 82.8 ||
tato duḥkhaṃ samāviṣṭāstyaktāḥ svapatibhiśca ṣaṭ |
tā dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha kārttikeyo harodbhavaḥ  || 82.9 ||
gāṅgeyo'gnibhavaśceti vikhyātastārakāntakaḥ  |
taṃ yāntu na cirādeva prīto bhogaṃ pradāsyati  || 82.10 ||
devarṣervacanādeva samabhyetya ca ṣaṇmukham  |
kṛttikāḥ svayamevaitadyathāvṛttaṃ nyavedayat || 82.11 ||
tābhyo vākyaṃ kṛttikābhyaḥ kārttikeyo'numanya ca  |
gautamīṃ yāntu sarvāśca snātvāpūjya maheśvaram  || 82.12 ||
eṣyāmi cāhaṃ tatraiva yāsyāmi suramandiram  |
tathetyuktvā kṛttikāśca snātvā gaṅgāṃ ca gautamīm  || 82.13 ||
deveśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya kārttikeyānuśāsanāt |
deveśvaraprasādena prayayuḥ suramandiram  || 82.14 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kṛttikātīrthamucyate  |
kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge tatra yaḥ snānamācaret || 82.15 ||
sarvakratuphalaṃ prāpya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ  |
tattīrthasmaraṇaṃ vāpi yaḥ karoti śṛṇoti ca  |
sarvapāpavinirmukto dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt || 82.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmune  |
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 83.1 ||
viśvakarmasutaḥ śrīmān viśvarūpo mahābalaḥ  |
tasyāpi prathamaḥ putrastatputro bhauvano vibhuḥ  || 83.2 ||
purodhāḥ kaśyapastasya sarvajñānaviśāradaḥ  |
tamapṛcchanmahābāhurbhauvanaḥ sārvabhauvanaḥ  || 83.3 ||
yakṣye'haṃ hayamedhaiśca yugapaddaśabhirmune  |
ityapṛcchadguruṃ vipraṃ kva yakṣyāmi surāniti  || 83.4 ||
so'vadaddevayajanaṃ tatra tatra nṛpottama  |
yatra yatra dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prāvartanta mahākratūn  || 83.5 ||
tatrābhavannṛṣigaṇā ārtvijye makhamaṇḍale  |
yugapaddaśamedhāni pravṛttāni purodhasā  || 83.6 ||
pūrṇatāṃ nāyayustāni dṛṣṭvā cintāparo nṛpaḥ  |
vihāya devayajanaṃ punaranyatra tān kratūn  || 83.7 ||
upākrāmattathā tatra vighnadoṣāstamāyayuḥ  |
dṛṣṭvāpūrṇāṃstato yajñān rājā gurumabhāṣata  || 83.8 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
deśadoṣātkāladoṣānmama doṣāttavāpi vā  |
pūrṇatāṃ nāpnuvanti sma daśamedhāni vājinaḥ  || 83.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataśca duḥkhito rājā kaśyapena purodhasā  |
gīṣpaterbhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ gatvā saṃvartamūcatuḥ  || 83.10 ||
{kaśyapabhauvanāvūcatu̱ḥ }
bhagavan yugapatkāryāṇyaśvamedhāni mānada  |
daśa saṃpūrṇatāṃ yānti taṃ deśaṃ taṃ guruṃ vada  || 83.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato dhyātvā ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ saṃvarto bhauvanaṃ tadā  |
abravīdgaccha brahmāṇaṃ guruṃ deśaṃ vadiṣyati  || 83.12 ||
bhauvano'pi mahāprājñaḥ kaśyapena mahātmanā  |
āgatya māmabravīcca guruṃ deśādikaṃ ca yat || 83.13 ||
tato'hamabravaṃ putra bhauvanaṃ kaśyapaṃ tathā  |
gautamīṃ gaccha rājendra sa deśaḥ kratupuṇyavān  || 83.14 ||
ayameva guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo vedapāragaḥ  |
gurorasya prasādena gautamyāśca prasādataḥ  || 83.15 ||
ekena hayamedhena tatra snānena vā punaḥ  |
setsyanti tatra yajñāśca daśamedhāni vājinaḥ  || 83.16 ||
tacchrutvā bhauvano rājā gautamītīramabhyagāt |
kaśyapena sahāyena hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ  || 83.17 ||
tataḥ pravṛtte yajñeśe hayamedhe mahākratau  |
saṃpūrṇe tu tadā rājā pṛthivīṃ dātumudyataḥ  || 83.18 ||
tato'ntarikṣe vāguccairuvāca nṛpasattamam  |
pūjayitvā sthitaṃ viprānṛtvijo'tha sadaspatīn  || 83.19 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
purodhase kaśyapāya saśailavanakānanām  |
pṛthivīṃ dātukāmena dattaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā nṛpa  || 83.20 ||
bhūmidānaspṛhāṃ tyaktvā annaṃ dehi mahāphalam  |
nānnadānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate  || 83.21 ||
viśeṣatastu gaṅgāyāḥ śraddhayā puline mune  |
tvayā tu hayamedho'yaṃ kṛtaḥ sabahudakṣiṇaḥ  |
kṛtakṛtyo'si bhadraṃ te nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 83.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathāpi dātukāmaṃ taṃ mahī provāca bhauvanam  ||* 83.23 ||
{pṛthivyuvāca̱ }
viśvakarmaja sārvabhauma mā māṃ dehi punaḥ punaḥ  |
nimajje'haṃ salilasya madhye tasmānna dīyatām  || 83.24 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataśca bhauvano bhītaḥ kiṃ deyamiti cābravīt |
punaścovāca sā pṛthvī bhauvanaṃ brāhmaṇairvṛtam  || 83.25 ||
{bhūmyuvāca̱ }
tilā gāvo dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yatkiṃcidgautamītaṭe  |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ dānaṃ kiṃ māṃ bhauvana dāsyasi  || 83.26 ||
gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritya grāsamekaṃ dadāti yaḥ  |
tenāhaṃ sakalā dattā kiṃ māṃ bhauvana dāsyasi  || 83.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadbhuvo vacanaṃ śrutvā bhauvanaḥ sārvabhauvanaḥ  |
tatheti matvā viprebhyo hyannaṃ prādātsuvistaram  || 83.28 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ daśāśvamedhikaṃ viduḥ  |
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ snānādavāpyate  || 83.29 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
paiśācaṃ tīrthamaparaṃ pūjitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ  |
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 84.1 ||
girirbrahmagireḥ pārśve añjano nāma nārada  |
tasmiñśaile munivara śāpabhraṣṭā varāpsarā  || 84.2 ||
añjanā nāma tatrāsīduttamāṅgena vānarī  |
kesarī nāma tadbhartā adriketi tathāparā  || 84.3 ||
sāpi kesariṇo bhāryā śāpabhraṣṭā varāpsarā  |
uttamāṅgena mārjārī sāpyāste'ñjanaparvate  || 84.4 ||
dakṣiṇārṇavamabhyāgātkesarī lokaviśrutaḥ  |
etasminnantare'gastyo'ñjanaṃ parvatamabhyagāt || 84.5 ||
añjanā cādrikā caiva agastyamṛṣisattamam  |
pūjayāmāsaturubhe yathānyāyaṃ yathāsukham  || 84.6 ||
tataḥ prasanno bhagavānāhobhe vriyatāṃ varaḥ  |
te āhaturubhe'gastyaṃ putrau dehi munīśvara  || 84.7 ||
sarvebhyo balinau śreṣṭhau sarvalokopakārakau  |
tathetyuktvā muniśreṣṭho jagāmāśāṃ sa dakṣiṇām  || 84.8 ||
tataḥ kadācitte kāle añjanā cādrikā tathā  |
gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca hāsyaṃ ca kurvatyau girimūrdhani  || 84.9 ||
vāyuśca nirṛtiścāpi te dṛṣṭvā sasmitau surau  |
kāmākrāntadhiyau cobhau tadā satvaramīyatuḥ  || 84.10 ||
bhārye bhavetāmubhayorāvāṃ devau varapradau  |
te apyūcaturastvetadremāte girimūrdhani  || 84.11 ||
añjanāyāṃ tathā vāyorhanumān samajāyata  |
adrikāyāṃ ca nirṛteradrirnāma piśācarāṭ || 84.12 ||
punaste āhaturubhe putrau jātau munervarāt |
āvayorvikṛtaṃ rūpamuttamāṅgena dūṣitam  || 84.13 ||
śāpācchacīpatestatra yuvāmājñātumarhathaḥ  |
tataḥ provāca bhagavān vāyuśca nirṛtistathā  || 84.14 ||
gautamyāṃ snānadānābhyāṃ śāpamokṣo bhaviṣyati  |
ityuktvā tāvubhau prītau tatraivāntaradhīyatām  || 84.15 ||
tato'ñjanāṃ samādāya adriḥ paiśācamūrtimān  |
bhrāturhanumataḥ prītyai snāpayāmāsa mātaram  || 84.16 ||
tathaiva hanumān gaṅgāmādāyādrimatitvaran  |
mārjārarūpiṇīṃ nītvā gautamyāstīramāptavān  || 84.17 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ paiśācaṃ cāñjanaṃ tathā  |
brahmaṇo girimāsādya sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  || 84.18 ||
yojanānāṃ tripañcāśanmārjāraṃ pūrvato bhavet |
mārjārasaṃjñitāttasmāddhanūmantaṃ vṛṣākapim  || 84.19 ||
phenāsaṃgamamākhyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  |
tasya svarūpaṃ vyuṣṭiśca tatraiva procyate śubhā  || 84.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kṣudhātīrthamiti khyātaṃ śṛṇu nārada tanmanāḥ  |
kathyamānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām  || 85.1 ||
ṛṣirāsītpurā kaṇvastapasvī vedavittamaḥ  |
paribhramannāśramāṇi kṣudhayā paripīḍitaḥ  || 85.2 ||
gautamasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ samṛddhaṃ cānnavāriṇā  |
ātmānaṃ ca kṣudhāyuktaṃ samṛddhaṃ cāpi gautamam  || 85.3 ||
vīkṣya kaṇvo'tha vaiṣamyaṃ vairāgyamagamattadā  |
gautamo'pi dvijaśreṣṭho hyahaṃ tapasi niṣṭhitaḥ  || 85.4 ||
samena yācñāyuktā syāttasmādgautamaveśmani  |
na bhokṣye'haṃ kṣudhārto'pi pīḍite'pi kalevare  || 85.5 ||
gaccheyaṃ gautamīṃ gaṅgāmarjayeyaṃ ca saṃpadam  |
iti niścitya medhāvī gatvā gaṅgāṃ ca pāvanīm  || 85.6 ||
snātvā śuciryatamanā upaviśya kuśāsane  |
tuṣṭāva gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ kṣudhāṃ ca paramāpadam  || 85.7 ||
{kaṇva uvāca̱ }
namo'stu gaṅge paramārtihāriṇi  85.8
namaḥ kṣudhe sarvajanārtikāriṇi  85.8
namo maheśānajaṭodbhave śubhe  85.8
namo mahāmṛtyumukhādvinisṛte  85.8
puṇyātmanāṃ śāntarūpe krodharūpe durātmanām  |
saridrūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ tāpapāpāpahāriṇi  || 85.9 ||
kṣudhārūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ tāpapāpaprade namaḥ  |
namaḥ śreyaskari devi namaḥ pāpapratardini  |
namaḥ śāntikari devi namo dāridryanāśini  || 85.10 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityevaṃ stuvatastasya purastādabhavaddvayam  |
ekaṃ gāṅgaṃ manohāri hyaparaṃ bhīṣaṇākṛti  |
punaḥ kṛtāñjalirbhūtvā namaskṛtvā dvijottamaḥ  || 85.11 ||
{kaṇva uvāca̱ }
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye brāhmi māheśvari śubhe  |
vaiṣṇavi tryambake devi godāvari namo'stu te  || 85.12 ||
tryambakasya jaṭodbhūte gautamasyāghanāśini  |
saptadhā sāgaraṃ yānti godāvari namo'stu te  || 85.13 ||
sarvapāpakṛtāṃ pāpe dharmakāmārthanāśini  |
duḥkhalobhamayi devi kṣudhe tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ  || 85.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatkaṇvavacanaṃ śrutvā suprīte āhaturdvijam  ||* 85.15 ||
{gaṅgākṣudhe ūcatu̱ḥ }
abhīṣṭaṃ vada kalyāṇa varān varaya suvrata  ||* 85.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
provāca praṇato gaṅgāṃ kaṇvaḥ kṣudhāṃ yathākramam  ||* 85.17 ||
{kaṇva uvāca̱ }
dehi devi manojñāni kāmāni vibhavaṃ mama  |
āyurvittaṃ ca bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ gaṅge prayaccha me  || 85.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ kṣudhāṃ cāha dvijottamaḥ  ||* 85.19 ||
{kaṇva uvāca̱ }
mayi madvaṃśaje cāpi kṣudhe tṛṣṇe daridriṇi  |
yāhi pāpatare rūkṣe na bhūyāstvaṃ kadācana  || 85.20 ||
anena stavena ye vai tvāṃ stuvanti kṣudhāturāḥ  |
teṣāṃ dāridryaduḥkhāni na bhaveyurvaro'paraḥ  || 85.21 ||
asmiṃstīrthe mahāpuṇye snānadānajapādikam  |
ye kurvanti narā bhaktyā lakṣmībhājo bhavantu te  || 85.22 ||
yastvidaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ tīrthe vā yadi vā gṛhe  |
tasya dāridryaduḥkhebhyo na bhayaṃ syādvaro'paraḥ  || 85.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamastviti coktvā te kaṇvaṃ yāte svamālayam  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kāṇvaṃ gāṅgaṃ kṣudhābhidham  |
sarvapāpaharaṃ vatsa pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam  || 85.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
asti brahmanmahātīrthaṃ cakratīrthamiti śrutam  |
tatra snānānnaro bhaktyā harerlokamavāpnuyāt || 86.1 ||
ekādaśyāṃ tu śuklāyāmupoṣya pṛthivīpate  |
gaṇikāsaṃgame snātvā prāpnuyādakṣayaṃ padam  || 86.2 ||
purā tatra yathā vṛttaṃ tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu  |
āsīdviśvadharo nāma vaiśyo bahudhanānvitaḥ  || 86.3 ||
uttare vayasi śreṣṭhastasya putro'bhavadṛṣe  |
guṇavān rūpasaṃpanno vilāsī śubhadarśanaḥ  || 86.4 ||
prāṇebhyo'pi priyaḥ putraḥ kāle pañcatvamāgataḥ  |
tathā dṛṣṭvā tu taṃ putraṃ daṃpatī duḥkhapīḍitau  || 86.5 ||
kurvāte sma tadā tena sahaiva maraṇe matim  |
hā putra hanta kālena pāpena sudurātmanā  || 86.6 ||
yauvane vartamāno'pi nīto'si guṇasāgara  |
āvayośca tathaiva tvaṃ prāṇebhyo'pi sudurlabhaḥ  || 86.7 ||
itthaṃ tu ruditaṃ śrutvā daṃpatyoḥ karuṇaṃ yamaḥ  |
tyaktvā nijapuraṃ tūrṇaṃ kṛpayāviṣṭamānasaḥ  || 86.8 ||
godāvaryāḥ śubhe tīre sthito dhyāyañjanārdanam  |
api svalpena kālena prajā vṛddhāḥ samantataḥ  || 86.9 ||
iyata iti me pṛthvī kathyatāṃ kena pūritā  |
na kaścinmriyate janturbhārākrāntā vasuṃdharā  || 86.10 ||
tato devī gatā tūrṇaṃ vasudhā munisattama  |
yatrāsti surasaṃyuktaḥ śakraḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā vasuṃdharāmindraḥ praṇipatyedamabravīt || 86.11 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
kimāgamanakāryaṃ ta iti me pṛthvi kathyatām  ||* 86.12 ||
{dharovāca̱ }
bhāreṇa guruṇā śakra pīḍitāhaṃ vinā vadham  |
kāraṇaṃ praṣṭumāyātā kimidaṃ kathyatāṃ mama  || 86.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā mahīvākyamindro vacanamabravīt ||* 86.14 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
kāraṇaṃ yadi nāma syāttadānīṃ jñāyate mayā  |
surāṇāṃ hi patiryasmādahaṃ sarvāsu medini  || 86.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
atha pṛthvī tadā vākyaṃ śrutvā cāha śacīpatim  |
yama ādiśyatāṃ tarhi yathā saṃharate prajāḥ  || 86.16 ||
iti śrutvā vaco mahyā ādiṣṭāḥ siddhakiṃnarāḥ  |
yamasyānayane śīghraṃ mahendreṇa mahāmune  || 86.17 ||
tataste satvaraṃ yātāḥ sarve vaivasvataṃ puram  |
naivāpaśyan yamaṃ tatra te siddhāḥ saha kiṃnaraiḥ  |
tathāgatya punarvegādvārttā śakre niveditā  || 86.18 ||
{siddhakiṃnarā ūcu̱ḥ }
yamo yamapure nātha asmābhirnāvalokitaḥ  |
mahatāpi suyatnena vīkṣyamāṇaḥ samantataḥ  || 86.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ pṛṣṭaḥ śakreṇa vai tadā  |
savitā sa pitā tasya yamaḥ kutrāsta ityatha  || 86.20 ||
{sūrya uvāca̱ }
śakra godāvarītīre kṛtānto vartate'dhunā  |
caraṃstatra tapastīvraṃ na jāne kiṃ nu kāraṇam  || 86.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā vaco bhānoḥ śakraḥ śaṅkāmupāviśat ||* 86.22 ||
{śakra uvāca̱ }
aho kaṣṭaṃ mahākaṣṭaṃ naṣṭā me suranāthatā  |
godāvaryāṃ tapaḥ kuryādyamo vai duṣṭaceṣṭitaḥ  |
jighṛkṣurmatpadaṃ nūnaṃ devā iti matirmama  || 86.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā sahasendreṇa āhūtaścāpsarogaṇaḥ  ||* 86.24 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
kā bhavatīṣu kālasya sthitasya tapasi dviṣaḥ  |
tapaḥpraṇāśane śaktā iti me śīghramucyatām  || 86.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śakravacaḥ śrutvā noce kāpi mahāmune  |
atha śakraḥ prakopeṇa pratyuvācāpsarogaṇam  || 86.26 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
uttaraṃ nābravītkiṃcidyāmastarhi vayaṃ svayam  |
sajjā bhavantu vibudhāḥ sainyairāyāntu mā ciram  |
ghātayāmo vayaṃ śatruṃ tapasā svargakāmukam  || 86.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityukte sati devānāṃ senā prādurbabhūva ha  |
itīndrahṛdayaṃ jñātvā hariṇā lokadhāriṇā  || 86.28 ||
preṣitaṃ cakriṇā cakraṃ rakṣaṇāya yamasya hi  |
cakraṃ yatrābhavattatra cakratīrthamanuttamam  || 86.29 ||
athendraṃ menakā prāha śaṅkiteti vacastadā  ||* 86.30 ||
{menakovāca̱ }
kālāvalokane nālaṃ kācidasti sureśvara  |
maraṇaṃ ca varaṃ deva bhavato na yamātpunaḥ  || 86.31 ||
rūpayauvanamatteyaṃ gaṇikāyācanaṃ prabho  |
preṣaṇaṃ tatprayacchaiṣā svāmitvaṃ manyate tvayā  || 86.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā vacastasyāḥ śakraḥ suravareśvaraḥ  |
ādideśābalāṃ kṣāmāṃ satkṛtya gaṇikāṃ tathā  || 86.33 ||
{śakra uvāca̱ }
gaṇike gaccha me kāryaṃ kuru sundari mā ciram  |
kṛtakṛtyāgatā bhūyo vallabhā me yathā śacī  || 86.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityākarṇya vacaḥ śakrādutpatya gaṇikā diśaḥ  |
kṣaṇena yamasāṃnidhyamāyātā cārurūpiṇī  || 86.35 ||
yamāntikamanuprāptā dyotayantī diśo daśa  |
salīlaṃ lalitaṃ bālā jagau hindolakaṅkalam  || 86.36 ||
tataścacāla kālasya mano lolaṃ calācalam  |
athonmīlya yamo netre kāmapāvakapūrite  || 86.37 ||
tasyāṃ vyāpārayāmāsa śreyaḥśatrau mahāmune  |
tato vilīya sā sadyaḥ sarittvamagamattadā  || 86.38 ||
gautamyāṃ tu samāgamya gaṇikāgaṇakiṃkaraiḥ  |
gīyamānā gatā svarge tasya tīrthaprabhāvataḥ  || 86.39 ||
gacchantīṃ gaṇikāṃ dṛṣṭvā vimānasthāṃ divaṃ prati  |
vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāptaḥ kālastaralalocanaḥ  |
athādityena cāgatya evamukto yamastadā  || 86.40 ||
{sūrya uvāca̱ }
kuru putra nijaṃ karma prajānāṃ tvaṃ parikṣayam  |
paśya vātaṃ sadā vāntaṃ sṛjantaṃ vedhasaṃ prajāḥ  |
paryaṭantaṃ trilokīṃ māṃ vahantīṃ vasudhāṃ prajāḥ  || 86.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā yamo vākyaṃ piturvacanamabravīt ||* 86.42 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
etanna garhitaṃ karma kuryāmahamidaṃ dhruvam  |
karmaṇyasminmahākrūre samādeṣṭuṃ na vārhasi  || 86.43 ||
iti śrutvā ca tadvākyaṃ bhānurvacanamabravīt |
kiṃ nāma garhitaṃ karma tava kartumalaṃ yama  || 86.44 ||
kiṃ na dṛṣṭā tvayā yāntī gaṇikā gaṇakiṃkaraiḥ  |
gīyamānā divaṃ sadyo gautamītoyamāplutā  || 86.45 ||
tvayā cātra tapastīvraṃ kṛtaṃ putra suduṣkaram  |
naivāntaṃ tasya paśyāmi tasmādgaccha nijaṃ puram  || 86.46 ||
ityuktvā bhagavān bhānustatra snātvā gato divam  |
yamo'pi saṃgame snātvā tato nijapuraṃ yayau  || 86.47 ||
bhūtahāpi tataḥ śaṅkāṃ tatyāja ca mahāmune  |
tathā dṛṣṭvā yamaṃ yāntaṃ cakre cakraṃ prayāṇakam  || 86.48 ||
bhagavān yatra govindo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ  |
iti yaḥ śṛṇuyānmartyaḥ paṭhedvāpi samāhitaḥ  || 86.49 ||
āpadastasya naśyanti dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt ||* 86.50 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ahalyāsaṃgamaṃ ceha tīrthaṃ trailokyapāvanam  |
śṛṇu samyaṅmuniśreṣṭha tatra vṛttamidaṃ yathā  || 87.1 ||
kautukenātimahatā mayā pūrvaṃ munīśvara  |
sṛṣṭā kanyā bahuvidhā rūpavatyo guṇānvitāḥ  || 87.2 ||
tāsāmekāṃ śreṣṭhatamāṃ nirmame śubhalakṣaṇām  |
tāṃ bālāṃ cārusarvāṅgīṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpaguṇānvitām  || 87.3 ||
ko vāsyāḥ poṣaṇe śakta iti me buddhirāviśat |
na daityānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca na munīnāṃ tathaiva ca  || 87.4 ||
nāstyasyāḥ poṣaṇe śaktiriti me buddhiranvabhūt |
guṇajyeṣṭhāya viprāya tapoyuktāya dhīmate  || 87.5 ||
sarvalakṣaṇayuktāya vedavedāṅgavedine  |
gautamāya mahāprājñāmadadāṃ poṣaṇāya tām  || 87.6 ||
pālayasva muniśreṣṭha yāvadāpsyati yauvanam  |
yauvanasthāṃ punaḥ sādhvīmānayethā mamāntikam  || 87.7 ||
evamuktvā gautamāya prādāṃ kanyāṃ sumadhyamām  |
tāmādāya muniśreṣṭha tapasā hatakalmaṣaḥ  || 87.8 ||
tāṃ poṣayitvā vidhivadalaṃkṛtya mamāntikam  |
nirvikāro muniśreṣṭho hyahalyāmānayattadā  || 87.9 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudhāḥ sarve śakrāgnivaruṇādayaḥ  |
mama deyā sureśāna ityūcuste pṛthakpṛthak || 87.10 ||
tathaiva munayaḥ sādhyā dānavā yakṣarākṣasāḥ  |
tān sarvānāgatān dṛṣṭvā kanyārthamatha saṃgatān  || 87.11 ||
indrasya tu viśeṣeṇa mahāṃścābhūttadā grahaḥ  |
gautamasya tu māhātmyaṃ gāmbhīryaṃ dhairyameva ca  || 87.12 ||
smṛtvā suvismito bhūtvā mamaivamabhavatsudhīḥ  |
deyeyaṃ gautamāyaiva nānyayogyā śubhānanā  || 87.13 ||
tasmāai eva tu tāṃ dāsye tathāpyevamacintayam  |
sarveṣāṃ ca matirdhairyaṃ mathitaṃ bālayānayā  || 87.14 ||
ahalyeti suraiḥ proktaṃ mayā ca ṛṣibhistadā  |
devānṛṣīṃstadā vīkṣya mayā tatroktamuccakaiḥ  || 87.15 ||
tasmai sā dīyate subhrūryaḥ pṛthivyāḥ pradakṣiṇām  |
kṛtvopatiṣṭhate pūrvaṃ na cānyasmai punaḥ punaḥ  || 87.16 ||
tataḥ sarve suragaṇāḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ mayeritam  |
ahalyārthaṃ surā jagmuḥ pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇe  || 87.17 ||
gateṣu surasaṃgheṣu gautamo'pi munīśvara  |
prayatnamakarotkiṃcidahalyārthamimaṃ tathā  || 87.18 ||
etasminnantare brahman surabhiḥ sarvakāmadhuk |
ardhaprasūtā hyabhavattāṃ dadarśa sa gautamaḥ  || 87.19 ||
tasyāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ cakre iyamurvīti saṃsmaran  |
liṅgasya ca sureśasya pradakṣiṇamathākarot || 87.20 ||
tayoḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā gautamo munisattamaḥ  |
sarveṣāṃ caiva devānāmekaṃ cāpi pradakṣiṇam  || 87.21 ||
naivābhavadbhuvo gantuḥ saṃjātaṃ dvitayaṃ mama  |
evaṃ niścitya sa munirmamāntikamathābhyagāt || 87.22 ||
namaskṛtvābravīdvākyaṃ gautamo māṃ mahāmatiḥ  |
kamalāsana viśvātmannamaste'stu punaḥ punaḥ  || 87.23 ||
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā brahmanmayeyaṃ vasudhākhilā  |
yadatra yuktaṃ deveśa jānīte tadbhavān svayam  || 87.24 ||
mayā tu dhyānayogena jñātvā gautamamabravam  |
tavaiva dīyate subhrūḥ pradakṣiṇamidaṃ kṛtam  || 87.25 ||
dharmaṃ jānīhi viprarṣe durjñeyaṃ nigamairapi  |
ardhaprasūtā surabhiḥ saptadvīpavatī mahī  || 87.26 ||
kṛtā pradakṣiṇā tasyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ sā kṛtā bhavet |
liṅgaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tadeva phalamāpnuyāt || 87.27 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena mune gautama suvrata  |
tuṣṭo'haṃ tava dhairyeṇa jñānena tapasā tathā  || 87.28 ||
datteyamṛṣiśārdūla kanyā lokavarā mayā  |
ityuktvāhaṃ gautamāya ahalyāmadadāṃ mune  || 87.29 ||
jāte vivāhe te devāḥ kṛtvelāyāḥ pradakṣiṇam  |
śanaiḥ śanairathāgatya dadṛśuḥ sarva eva te  || 87.30 ||
taṃ gautamamahalyāṃ ca dāṃpatyaṃ prītivardhanam  |
te cāgatyātha paśyanto vismitāścābhavan surāḥ  || 87.31 ||
atikrānte vivāhe tu surāḥ sarve divaṃ yayuḥ  |
samatsaraḥ śacībhartā tāmīkṣya ca divaṃ yayau  || 87.32 ||
tataḥ prītamanāstasmai gautamāya mahātmane  |
prādāṃ brahmagiriṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  || 87.33 ||
ahalyāyāṃ muniśreṣṭho reme tatra sa gautamaḥ  |
gautamasya kathāṃ puṇyāṃ śrutvā śakrastriviṣṭape  || 87.34 ||
tamāśramaṃ taṃ ca muniṃ tasya bhāryāmaninditām  |
bhūtvā brāhmaṇaveṣeṇa draṣṭumāgācchatakratuḥ  || 87.35 ||
sa dṛṣṭvā bhavanaṃ tasya bhāryāṃ ca vibhavaṃ tathā  |
pāpīyasīṃ matiṃ kṛtvā ahalyāṃ samudaikṣata  || 87.36 ||
nātmānaṃ na paraṃ deśaṃ kālaṃ śāpādṛṣerbhayam  |
na bubodha tadā vatsa kāmākṛṣṭaḥ śatakratuḥ  || 87.37 ||
taddhyānaparamo nityaṃ surarājyena garvitaḥ  |
saṃtaptāṅgaḥ kathaṃ kuryāṃ praveśo me kathaṃ bhavet || 87.38 ||
evaṃ vasan viprarūpo nāntaraṃ tvadhyagacchata  |
sa kadācinmahāprājñaḥ kṛtvā paurvāhṇikīṃ kriyām  || 87.39 ||
sahito gautamaḥ śiṣyairnirgataścāśramādbahiḥ  |
āśramaṃ gautamīṃ viprān dhānyāni vividhāni ca  || 87.40 ||
draṣṭuṃ gato munivara indrastaṃ samudaikṣata  |
idamantaramityuktvā cakre kāryaṃ manaḥpriyam  || 87.41 ||
rūpaṃ kṛtvā gautamasya priyepsuḥ sa śatakratuḥ  |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīmahalyāṃ vākyamabravīt || 87.42 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
ākṛṣṭo'haṃ tava guṇai rūpaṃ smṛtvā skhalatpadaḥ  |
iti bruvan hasan hastamādāyāntaḥ samāviśat || 87.43 ||
na bubodha tvahalyā taṃ jāraṃ mene tu gautamam  |
ramamāṇā yathāsaukhyaṃ prāgācchiṣyaiḥ sa gautamaḥ  || 87.44 ||
āgacchantaṃ nityameva ahalyā priyavādinī  |
pratiyāti priyaṃ vakti toṣayantī ca taṃ guṇaiḥ  || 87.45 ||
tāmadṛṣṭvā mahāprājño mene tanmahadadbhutam  |
dvārasthitaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ sarve paśyanti nārada  || 87.46 ||
agnihotrasya śālāyā rakṣiṇo gṛhakarmiṇaḥ  |
ūcurmunivaraṃ bhītā gautamaṃ vismayānvitāḥ  || 87.47 ||
{rakṣiṇa ūcu̱ḥ }
bhagavan kimidaṃ citraṃ bahirantaśca dṛśyase  |
priyayāntaḥ praviṣṭo'si tathaiva ca bahirbhavān  |
aho tapaḥprabhāvo'yaṃ nānārūpadharo bhavān  || 87.48 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā vismitastvantaḥ praviṣṭaḥ ko nu tiṣṭhati  |
priye ahalye bhavati kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase  |
ityṛṣervacanaṃ śrutvā ahalyā jāramabravīt || 87.50 ||
{ahalyovāca̱ }
ko bhavānmunirūpeṇa pāpaṃ tvaṃ kṛtavānasi  |
iti bruvatī śayanādutthitā satvaraṃ bhayāt || 87.51 ||
sa cāpi pāpakṛcchakro biḍālo'bhūnmunerbhayāt |
trastāṃ ca vikṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā svapriyāṃ dūṣitāṃ tadā  || 87.52 ||
uvāca sa muniḥ kopātkimidaṃ sāhasaṃ kṛtam  |
iti bruvantaṃ bhartāraṃ sāpi novāca lajjitā  || 87.53 ||
anveṣayaṃstu taṃ jāraṃ biḍālaṃ dadṛśe muniḥ  |
ko bhavāniti taṃ prāha bhasmīkuryāṃ mṛṣāvadan  || 87.54 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā caivamāha śacīpatiḥ  |
śacībhartā purāṃ bhettā tapodhana puruṣṭutaḥ  || 87.55 ||
mamedaṃ pāpamāpannaṃ satyamuktaṃ mayānagha  |
mahadvigarhitaṃ karma kṛtavānasmyahaṃ mune  || 87.56 ||
smarasāyakanirbhinna hṛdayāḥ kiṃ na kurvate  |
brahmanmayi mahāpāpe kṣamasva karuṇānidhe  || 87.57 ||
santaḥ kṛtāparādhe'pi na raukṣyaṃ jātu kurvate  |
niśamya tadvaco vipro harimāha ruṣānvitaḥ  || 87.58 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
bhagabhaktyā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sahasrabhagavān bhava  |
tāmapyāha muniḥ kopāttvaṃ ca śuṣkanadī bhava  || 87.59 ||
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa kathayantī tadākṛtim  ||* 87.60 ||
{ahalyovāca̱ }
manasāpyanyapuruṣaṃ pāpiṣṭhāḥ kāmayanti yāḥ  |
akṣayān yānti narakāṃstāsāṃ sarve'pi pūrvajāḥ  || 87.61 ||
bhūtvā prasanno bhagavannavadhāraya madvacaḥ  |
tava rūpeṇa cāgatya māmagātsākṣiṇastvime  || 87.62 ||
tatheti rakṣiṇaḥ procurahalyā satyavādinī  |
dhyānenāpi munirjñātvā śāntaḥ prāha pativratām  || 87.63 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
yadā tu saṃgatā bhadre gautamyā saridīśayā  |
nadī bhūtvā punā rūpaṃ prāpsyase priyakṛnmama  || 87.64 ||
ityṛṣervacanaṃ śrutvā tathā cakre pativratā  |
tayā tu saṃgatā devyā ahalyā gautamapriyā  || 87.65 ||
punastadrūpamabhavadyanmayā nirmitaṃ purā  |
tataḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ surarāṭprāha gautamam  || 87.66 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
māṃ pāhi muniśārdūla pāpiṣṭhaṃ gṛhamāgatam  |
pādayoḥ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayā prāha gautamaḥ  || 87.67 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
gautamīṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te snānaṃ kuru puraṃdara  |
kṣaṇānnirdhūtapāpastvaṃ sahasrākṣo bhaviṣyasi  || 87.68 ||
ubhayaṃ vismayakaraṃ dṛṣṭavānasmi nārada  |
ahalyāyāḥ punarbhāvaṃ śacībhartā sahasradṛk || 87.69 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamahalyāsaṃgamaṃ śubham  |
indratīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām  || 87.70 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasmādapyaparaṃ tīrthaṃ janasthānamiti śrutam  |
caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ smaraṇānmuktidaṃ nṛṇām  || 88.1 ||
vaivasvatānvaye jāto rājābhūjjanakaḥ purā  |
so'pāṃpatestu tanujāmupayeme guṇārṇavām  || 88.2 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ janakāṃ janako nṛpaḥ  |
anurūpaguṇatvācca tasya bhāryā guṇārṇavā  || 88.3 ||
yājñavalkyaśca viprendrastasya rājñaḥ purohitaḥ  |
tamapṛcchannṛpaśreṣṭho yājñavalkyaṃ purohitam  || 88.4 ||
{janaka uvāca̱ }
bhuktimuktī ubhe śreṣṭhe nirṇīte munisattamaiḥ  |
dāsīdāsebhaturaga rathādyairbhuktiruttamā  || 88.5 ||
kiṃtvantavirasā bhuktirmuktirekā niratyayā  |
bhuktermuktiḥ śreṣṭhatamā bhuktyā muktiṃ kathaṃ vrajet || 88.6 ||
sarvasaṅgaparityāgānmuktiprāptiḥ suduḥkhataḥ  |
tadbrūhi dvijaśārdūla sukhānmuktiḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 88.7 ||
{yājñavalkya uvāca̱ }
apāṃpatistava guruḥ śvaśuraḥ priyakṛttathā  |
taṃ gatvā pṛccha nṛpate upadekṣyati te hitam  || 88.8 ||
yājñavalkyaśca janako rājānaṃ varuṇaṃ tadā  |
gatvā cocaturavyagrau muktimārgaṃ yathākramam  || 88.9 ||
{varuṇa uvāca̱ }
dvidhā tu saṃsthitā muktiḥ karmadvāre'pyakarmaṇi  |
vede ca niścito mārgaḥ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ  || 88.10 ||
sarvaṃ ca karmaṇā baddhaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam  |
akarmaṇaivāpyata iti muktimārgo mṛṣocyate  || 88.11 ||
karmaṇā sarvadhānyāni setsyanti nṛpasattama  |
tasmātsarvātmanā karma kartavyaṃ vaidikaṃ nṛbhiḥ  || 88.12 ||
tena bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca prāpnuvantīha mānavāḥ  |
akarmaṇaḥ karma puṇyaṃ karma cāpyāśrameṣu ca  || 88.13 ||
jātyāśritaṃ ca rājendra tatrāpi śṛṇu dharmavit |
āśramāṇi ca catvāri karmadvārāṇi mānada  || 88.14 ||
caturṇāmāśramāṇāṃ ca gārhasthyaṃ puṇyadaṃ smṛtam  |
tasmādbhuktiśca muktiśca bhavatīti matirmama  || 88.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā tu janako yājñavalkyaśca buddhimān  |
varuṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu punarvacanamūcatuḥ  || 88.16 ||
ko deśaḥ kiṃ ca tīrthaṃ syādbhuktimuktipradāyakam  |
tadvadasva suraśreṣṭha sarvajño'si namo'stu te  || 88.17 ||
{varuṇa uvāca̱ }
pṛthivyāṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ daṇḍakaṃ tatra puṇyadam  |
tasmin kṣetre kṛtaṃ karma bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām  || 88.18 ||
tīrthānāṃ gautamī gaṅgā śreṣṭhā muktipradā nṛṇām  |
tatra yajñena dānena bhogānmuktimavāpsyati  || 88.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yājñavalkyaśca janako vācaṃ śrutvā hyapāṃpateḥ  |
varuṇena hyanujñātau svapurīṃ jagmatustadā  || 88.20 ||
aśvamedhādikaṃ karma cakāra janako nṛpaḥ  |
yājayāmāsa viprendro yājñavalkyaśca taṃ nṛpam  || 88.21 ||
gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritya yajñānmuktimavāpa rāṭ |
tathā janakarājāno bahavastatra karmaṇā  || 88.22 ||
muktiṃ prāpurmahābhāgā gautamyāśca prasādataḥ  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ janasthāneti viśrutam  || 88.23 ||
janakānāṃ yajñasado janasthānaṃ prakīrtitam  |
caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ smaraṇātsarvapāpanut || 88.24 ||
tatra snānena dānena pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇena tu  |
tīrthasya smaraṇādvāpi gamanādbhaktisevanāt || 88.25 ||
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti muktiṃ ca samavāpnuyāt ||* 88.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
aruṇā varuṇā caiva nadyau puṇyatare śubhe  |
tayośca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgāyāṃ munisattama  || 89.1 ||
tadutpattiṃ śṛṇuṣveha sarvapāpavināśinīm  |
kaśyapasya suto jyeṣṭha ādityo lokaviśrutaḥ  || 89.2 ||
trailokyacakṣustīkṣṇāṃśuḥ saptāśvo lokapūjitaḥ  |
tasya patnī uṣā khyātā tvāṣṭrī trailokyasundarī  || 89.3 ||
bhartuḥ pratāpatīvratvamasahantī sumadhyamā  |
cintayāmāsa kiṃ kṛtyaṃ mama syāditi bhāminī  || 89.4 ||
tasyāḥ putrau mahārājñau manurvaivasvato yamaḥ  |
yamunā ca nadī puṇyā śṛṇu vismayakāraṇam  || 89.5 ||
sākarodātmanaśchāyāmātmarūpeṇa yatnataḥ  |
tāmabravīttataścoṣā tvaṃ ca matsadṛśī bhava  || 89.6 ||
bhartāraṃ tvamapatyāni pālayasva mamājñayā  |
yāvadāgamanaṃ me syātpatyustāvatpriyā bhava  || 89.7 ||
nākhyātavyaṃ tvayā kvāpi apatyānāṃ tathā priye  |
tathetyāha ca sā chāyā nirjagāma gṛhāduṣā  || 89.8 ||
ityuktvā sā jagāmāśu śāntaṃ rūpamabhīpsatī  |
sā gatvoṣā gṛhaṃ tvaṣṭuḥ pitre sarvaṃ nyavedayat |
tvaṣṭāpi cakitaḥ prāha tāṃ sutāṃ sutavatsalaḥ  || 89.9 ||
{tvaṣṭovāca̱ }
naitadyuktaṃ bhartṛmatyā yatsvaireṇa pravartanam  |
apatyānāṃ kathaṃ vṛttirbharturvā savitustava  |
bibhemi bhadre śiṣṭo'haṃ bharturgehaṃ punarvraja  || 89.10 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktā tu pitrā sā netyuktvā vai punaḥ punaḥ  |
uttaraṃ ca kurordeśaṃ jagāma tapase tvarā  || 89.11 ||
tatra tepe tapastīvraṃ vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī  |
duṣprekṣaṃ taṃ svakaṃ kāntaṃ dhyāyantī niścalā uṣā  || 89.12 ||
etasminnantare tāta chāyā coṣāsvarūpiṇī  |
patyau sā vartayāmāsa apatyānyatha jajñire  || 89.13 ||
sāvarṇiśca śaniścaiva viṣṭiryā duṣṭakanyakā  |
sā chāyā vartayāmāsa vaiṣamyeṇaiva nityaśaḥ  || 89.14 ||
sveṣvapatyeṣu coṣāyā yamastatra cukopa ha  |
vaiṣamyeṇātha vartantīṃ chāyāṃ tāṃ mātaraṃ tadā  || 89.15 ||
tāḍayāmāsa pādena dakṣiṇāśāpatiryamaḥ  |
putradaurjanyasaṃkṣobhācchāyā vaivasvataṃ yamam  || 89.16 ||
śaśāpa pāpa te pādo viśīryatu mamājñayā  |
viśīrṇacaraṇo duḥkhādrudan pitaramabhyagāt |
savitre taṃ tu vṛttāntaṃ nyavedayadaśeṣataḥ  || 89.17 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
neyaṃ mātā suraśreṣṭha yayā śapto'hamīdṛśaḥ  |
apatyeṣu viruddheṣu jananī naiva kupyate  || 89.18 ||
yadbālyādabravaṃ kiṃcidathavā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam  |
naiva kupyati sā mātā tasmānneyaṃ mamāmbikā  || 89.19 ||
yadapatyakṛtaṃ kiṃcitsādhvasādhu yathā tathā  |
mātyasyāṃ sarvamapyetattasmānmāteti gīyate  || 89.20 ||
pradhakṣyantīva māṃ tāta nityaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā  |
vaktyagnikālasadṛśā vācā neyaṃ madambikā  || 89.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatputravacanaṃ śrutvā savitācintayattataḥ  |
iyaṃ chāyā nāsya mātā uṣā mātā tu sānyataḥ  || 89.22 ||
mama śāntimabhīpsantī deśe'nyasmiṃstaporatā  |
uttare ca kurau tvāṣṭrī vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī  || 89.23 ||
tatrāste sā iti jñātvā jagāmeśo divākaraḥ  |
yatra sā vartate kāntā aśvarūpaḥ svayaṃ tadā  || 89.24 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vaḍavārūpāṃ paryadhāvaddhayākṛtiḥ  |
kāmāturaṃ hayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutvā vai heṣitasvanam  || 89.25 ||
uṣā pativratopetā patidhyānaparāyaṇā  |
hayadharṣaṇasaṃbhītā ko nvayaṃ cetyajānatī  || 89.26 ||
apalāyatpatau prāpte dakṣiṇābhimukhī tvarā  |
ko nu me rakṣako'tra syādṛṣayo vāthavā surāḥ  || 89.27 ||
dhāvantīṃ tāṃ priyāmaśvāmaśvarūpadharaḥ svayam  |
paryadhāvadyato yāti uṣā bhānustatastataḥ  || 89.28 ||
smaragrahavaśe jātaḥ ko duśceṣṭaṃ na ceṣṭate  |
bhāgīrathīṃ nadīścānyā vanānyupavanāni ca  || 89.29 ||
narmadāṃ cātha vindhyaṃ ca dakṣiṇābhimukhāvubhau  |
atikramya bhayodvignā tvāṣṭryabhyagācca gautamīm  || 89.30 ||
trātāraḥ santi munayo janasthāna iti śrutam  |
ṛṣīṇāmāśramaṃ sāśvā praviṣṭā gautamīṃ tathā  || 89.31 ||
anuprāptastathā cāśvo bhānustadrūpavāṃstataḥ  |
aśvaṃ nivārayāmāsurjanasthā munidārakāḥ  |
tataḥ kopādṛṣīṃstāṃśca śaśāpoṣāpatiḥ prabhuḥ  || 89.32 ||
{bhānuruvāca̱ }
nivārayatha māṃ yasmādvaṭā yūyaṃ bhaviṣyatha  ||* 89.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
jñānadṛṣṭyā tu munayo menire'śvamuṣāpatim  |
stuvanto devadeveśaṃ bhānuṃ taṃ munayo mudā  || 89.34 ||
stūyamāno munigaṇairaśvāṃ bhānurathāgamat |
vaḍavāyā mukhe lagnaṃ mukhaṃ cāśvasvarūpiṇam  || 89.35 ||
jñātvā tvāṣṭrī ca bhartāraṃ mukhādvīryaṃ prasusruve  |
tayorvīryeṇa gaṅgāyāmaśvinau samajāyatām  || 89.36 ||
tatrāgacchan suragaṇāḥ siddhāśca munayastathā  |
nadyo gāvastathauṣadhyo devā jyotirgaṇāstathā  || 89.37 ||
saptāśvaśca rathaḥ puṇyo hyaruṇo bhānusārathiḥ  |
yamo manuśca varuṇaḥ śanirvaivasvatastathā  || 89.38 ||
yamunā ca nadī puṇyā tāpī caiva mahānadī  |
tattadrūpaṃ samāsthāya nadyastā vismayānmune  || 89.39 ||
draṣṭuṃ te vismayāviṣṭā ājagmuḥ śvaśurastathā  |
abhiprāyaṃ viditvā tu śvaśuraṃ bhānurabravīt || 89.40 ||
{bhānuruvāca̱ }
uṣāyāḥ prītaye tvaṣṭaḥ kurvatyāstapa uttamam  |
yantrārūḍhaṃ ca māṃ kṛtvā chindhi tejāṃsyanekaśaḥ  |
yāvatsaukhyaṃ bhavedasyāstāvacchindhi prajāpate  || 89.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā tatastvaṣṭā somanāthasya saṃnidhau  |
tejasāṃ chedanaṃ cakre prabhāsaṃ tu tato viduḥ  || 89.42 ||
bhartrā ca saṃgatā yatra gautamyāmaśvarūpiṇī  |
aśvinoryatra cotpattiraśvatīrthaṃ taducyate  || 89.43 ||
bhānutīrthaṃ tadākhyātaṃ tathā pañcavaṭāśramaḥ  |
tāpī ca yamunā caiva pitaraṃ draṣṭumāgate  || 89.44 ||
aruṇāvaruṇānadyorgaṅgāyāṃ saṃgamaḥ śubhaḥ  |
devānāṃ tatra tīrthānāmāgatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 89.45 ||
nava trīṇi sahasrāṇi tīrthāni guṇavanti ca  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvamakṣayapuṇyadam  || 89.46 ||
smaraṇātpaṭhanādvāpi śravaṇādapi nārada  |
sarvapāpavinirmukto dharmavān sa sukhī bhavet || 89.47 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
gāruḍaṃ nāma yattīrthaṃ sarvavighnapraśāntidam  |
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ  || 90.1 ||
maṇināga iti tvāsīccheṣaputro mahābalaḥ  |
garuḍasya bhayādbhaktyā toṣayāmāsa śaṃkaram  || 90.2 ||
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān parameṣṭhī maheśvaraḥ  |
tamuvāca mahānāgaṃ varaṃ varaya pannaga  || 90.3 ||
nāgaḥ prāha prabho mahyaṃ dehi me garuḍābhayam  |
tathetyāha ca taṃ śaṃbhurgaruḍādabhayaṃ bhavet || 90.4 ||
nirgato nirbhayo nāgo garuḍādaruṇānujāt |
kṣīrodaśāyī yatrāste kṣīrārṇavasamīpataḥ  || 90.5 ||
itaścetaśca carati nāgo'sau sukhaśītale  |
garuḍo'pi ca yatrāste taṃ deśamapi yātyasau  || 90.6 ||
garuḍaḥ pannagaṃ dṛṣṭvā carantaṃ nirbhayena tu  |
taṃ gṛhītvā mahānāgaṃ prākṣipatsvasya veśmani  || 90.7 ||
taṃ baddhvā gāruḍaiḥ pāśairgaruḍo nāgasattamam  |
etasminnantare nandī provāceśaṃ jagatprabhum  || 90.8 ||
{nandikeśvara uvāca̱ }
nūnaṃ nāgo na cāyāti bhakṣito baddha eva vā  |
garuḍena sureśāna jīvannāgo na saṃvrajet || 90.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
nandino vacanaṃ śrutvā jñātvā śaṃbhurathābravīt ||* 90.10 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
garuḍasya gṛhe nāgo baddhastiṣṭhati satvaram  |
gatvā taṃ jagatāmīśaṃ viṣṇuṃ stuhi janārdanam  || 90.11 ||
baddhaṃ nāgaṃ kāśyapena madvākyādānaya svayam  |
tatprabhorvacanaṃ śrutvā nandī gatvā śriyaḥ patim  || 90.12 ||
vyajñāpayatsvayaṃ vākyaṃ viṣṇuṃ lokaparāyaṇam  |
nārāyaṇaḥ prītamanā garuḍaṃ vākyamabravīt || 90.13 ||
{viṣṇuruvāca̱ }
vinatātmaja me vākyānnandine dehi pannagam  |
kampamānastadākarṇya netyuvāca vihaṃgamaḥ  |
viṣṇumapyabravītkopātsuparṇo nandino'ntike  || 90.14 ||
{garuḍa uvāca̱ }
yadyatpriyatamaṃ kiṃcidbhṛtyebhyaḥ prabhaviṣṇavaḥ  |
dāsyantyanye bhavānnaiva mayānītaṃ hariṣyati  || 90.15 ||
paśya devaṃ trinayanaṃ nāgaṃ mokṣyati nandinā  |
mayopapāditaṃ nāgaṃ tvaṃ tu dāsyasi nandine  || 90.16 ||
tvāṃ vahāmi sadā svāminmama deyaṃ sadā tvayā  |
mayopapāditaṃ nāgaṃ vaktuṃ dehīti nocitam  || 90.17 ||
satāṃ prabhūṇāṃ neyaṃ syādvṛttiḥ sadvṛttikāriṇām  |
santo dāsyanti bhṛtyebhyo madupāttaharo bhavān  || 90.18 ||
daityāñjayasi saṃgrāme madbalenaiva keśava  |
ahaṃ mahābalītyevaṃ mudhaiva ślāghate bhavān  || 90.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
garuḍasyeti tadvākyaṃ śrutvā cakragadādharaḥ  |
vihasya nandinaḥ pārśve paśyadbhirlokapālakaiḥ  || 90.20 ||
idamāha mahābuddhirmāṃ samuhya kṛśo bhavān  |
tvadbalādasurān sarvāñjeṣye'haṃ khagasattama  || 90.21 ||
ityuktvā śrīpatirbrahmañśāntakopo'bravīdidam  |
vahāṅguliṃ karasyāśu kaniṣṭhāṃ nandino'ntike  || 90.22 ||
garuḍasya tato mūrdhni nyasyedaṃ punarabravīt |
satyaṃ māṃ vahase nityaṃ paśya dharmaṃ vihaṃgama  || 90.23 ||
nyastāyāṃ ca tato'ṅgulyāṃ śiraḥ kukṣau samāviśat |
kukṣiśca caraṇasyāntaḥ prāviśaccūrṇito'bhavat |
tataḥ kṛtāñjalirdīno vyathito lajjayānvitaḥ  || 90.24 ||
{garuḍa uvāca̱ }
trāhi trāhi jagannātha bhṛtyaṃ māmaparādhinam  |
tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvalokānāṃ dhartā dhāryastvameva ca  || 90.25 ||
aparādhasahasrāṇi kṣamante prabhaviṣṇavaḥ  |
kṛtāparādhe'pi jane mahatī yasya vai kṛpā  || 90.26 ||
vadanti munayaḥ sarve tvāmeva karuṇākaram  |
rakṣasvārtaṃ jaganmātarmāmambujanivāsini  |
kamale bālakaṃ dīnamārtaṃ tanayavatsale  || 90.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ kṛpānvitā devī śrīrapyāha janārdanam  ||* 90.28 ||
{kamalovāca̱ }
rakṣa nātha svakaṃ bhṛtyaṃ garuḍaṃ vipadaṃ gatam  |
janārdana uvācedaṃ nandinaṃ śaṃbhuvāhanam  || 90.29 ||
{viṣṇuruvāca̱ }
naya nāgaṃ sagaruḍaṃ śaṃbhorantikameva ca  |
tatprasādācca garuḍo maheśvaranirīkṣitaḥ  |
ātmīyaṃ ca punā rūpaṃ garuḍaḥ samavāpsyati  || 90.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā ca vṛṣabho nāgena garuḍena ca  |
śanaiḥ sa śaṃkaraṃ gatvā sarvaṃ tasmai nyavedayat |
śaṃkaro'pi garutmantaṃ provāca śaśiśekharaḥ  || 90.31 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
yāhi gaṅgāṃ mahābāho gautamīṃ lokapāvanīm  |
sarvakāmapradāṃ śāntāṃ tāmāplutya punarvapuḥ  || 90.32 ||
prāpsyase sarvakāmāṃśca śatadhātha sahasradhā  |
sarvapāpopataptā ye durdaivonmūlitodyamāḥ  |
prāṇino'bhīṣṭadā teṣāṃ śaraṇaṃ khaga gautamī  || 90.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvākyaṃ praṇato bhūtvā śrutvā tu garuḍo'bhyagāt |
gaṅgāmāplutya garuḍaḥ śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ nanāma saḥ  || 90.34 ||
tataḥ svarṇamayaḥ pakṣī vajradeho mahābalaḥ  |
vegī bhavanmuniśreṣṭha punarviṣṇumiyātsudhīḥ  || 90.35 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ gāruḍaṃ sarvakāmadam  |
tatra snānādi yatkiṃcitkaroti prayato naraḥ  |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ vatsa śivaviṣṇupriyāvaham  || 90.36 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato govardhanaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  |
pitṝṇāṃ puṇyajananaṃ smaraṇādapi pāpanut || 91.1 ||
tasya prabhāva eṣa syānmayā dṛṣṭastu nārada  |
brāhmaṇaḥ karṣakaḥ kaścijjābāliriti viśrutaḥ  || 91.2 ||
na vimuñcatyanaḍvāhau madhyaṃ yāte'pi bhāskare  |
pratodena pratudati pṛṣṭhato'pi ca pārśvayoḥ  || 91.3 ||
tau gāvāvaśrupūrṇākṣau dṛṣṭvā gauḥ kāmadohinī  |
surabhirjagatāṃ mātā nandine sarvamabravīt || 91.4 ||
sa cāpi vyathito bhūtvā śaṃbhave tannyavedayat |
śaṃbhuśca vṛṣabhaṃ prāha sarvaṃ sidhyatu te vacaḥ  || 91.5 ||
śivājñāsahito nandī gojātaṃ sarvamāharat |
naṣṭeṣu goṣu sarveṣu svarge martye tatastvarā  || 91.6 ||
māmavocan suragaṇā vinā gobhirna jīvyate  |
tānavocaṃ surān sarvāñśaṃkaraṃ yāta yācata  || 91.7 ||
tathaiveśaṃ tu te sarve stutvā kāryaṃ nyavedayan  |
īśo'pi vibudhānāha jānāti vṛṣabho mama  || 91.8 ||
te vṛṣaṃ procuramarā dehi gā upakāriṇaḥ  |
vṛṣo'pi vibudhānāha gosavaḥ kriyatāṃ kratuḥ  || 91.9 ||
tataḥ prāpsyatha gāḥ sarvā yā divyā yāśca mānuṣāḥ  |
tataḥ pravartate yajño gosavo devanirmitaḥ  || 91.10 ||
gautamyāśca śubhe pārśve gāvo vavṛdhire tataḥ  |
govardhanaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ devānāṃ prītivardhanam  || 91.11 ||
tatra snānaṃ muniśreṣṭha gosahasraphalapradam  |
kiṃciddānādinā yatsyātphalaṃ tattu na vidmahe  || 91.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pāpapraṇāśanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ pāpabhayāpaham  |
nāmadheyaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ  || 92.1 ||
dhṛtavrata iti khyāto brāhmaṇo lokaviśrutaḥ  |
tasya bhāryā mahī nāma taruṇī lokasundarī  || 92.2 ||
tasya putraḥ sūryanibhaḥ sanājjāta iti śrutaḥ  |
dhṛtavrataṃ tathākarṣanmṛtyuḥ kālerito mune  || 92.3 ||
tataḥ sā bālavidhavā bālaputrā surūpiṇī  |
trātāraṃ naiva paśyantī gālavāśramamabhyagāt || 92.4 ||
tasmai putraṃ nivedyātha svairiṇī pāpamohitā  |
sā babhrāma bahūn deśān puṃskāmā kāmacāriṇī  || 92.5 ||
tatputro gālavagṛhe vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ  |
jāto'pi mātṛdoṣeṇa veśyeritamatistvabhūt || 92.6 ||
janasthānamiti khyātaṃ nānājātisamāvṛtam  |
tatrāsau paṇyaveṣeṇa adhyāste ca mahī tathā  || 92.7 ||
tatsuto'pi bahūn deśān paribabhrāma kāmukaḥ  |
so'pi kālavaśāttatra janasthāne'vasattadā  || 92.8 ||
striyamākāṅkṣate veśyāṃ dhṛtavratasuto dvijaḥ  |
mahī cāpi dhanaṃ dātṝn puruṣān samapekṣate  || 92.9 ||
mene na putramātmīyaṃ sa cāpi na tu mātaram  |
tayoḥ samāgamaścāsīdvidhinā mātṛputrayoḥ  || 92.10 ||
evaṃ bahutithe kāle putre mātari gacchati  |
tayoḥ parasparaṃ jñānaṃ naivāsīnmātṛputrayoḥ  || 92.11 ||
evaṃ pravartamānasya pitṛdharmeṇa sanmatiḥ  |
āsīttasyāpyasadvṛtteḥ śṛṇu nārada citravat || 92.12 ||
svairasthityā vartamāno nedaṃ sa parihātavān  |
brāhmīṃ saṃdhyāmanuṣṭhāya tadūrdhvaṃ tu dhanārjanam  || 92.13 ||
vidyābalena vittāni bahūnyārjya dadātyasau  |
tathā sa prātarutthāya gaṅgāṃ gatvā yathāvidhi  || 92.14 ||
śaucādi snānasaṃdhyādi sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yathākramam  |
kṛtvā tu brāhmaṇānnatvā tato'bhyeti svakarmasu  || 92.15 ||
prātaḥkāle gautamīṃ tu yadā yāti virūpavān  |
kuṣṭhasarvāṅgaśithilaḥ pūyaśoṇitaniḥsravaḥ  || 92.16 ||
snātvā tu gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ yadā yāti surūpadhṛk |
śāntaḥ sūryāgnisadṛśo mūrtimāniva bhāskaraḥ  || 92.17 ||
etadrūpadvayaṃ svasya naiva paśyati sa dvijaḥ  |
gālavo yatra bhagavāṃstapojñānaparāyaṇaḥ  || 92.18 ||
āśritya gautamīṃ devīṃ āste ca munibhirvṛtaḥ  |
brāhmaṇo'pi ca tatraiva nityaṃ tīrthaṃ sametya ca  || 92.19 ||
gālavaṃ ca namasyātha tato yāti svamandiram  |
gaṅgāyāḥ sevanātpūrvaṃ sanājjātasya yadvapuḥ  || 92.20 ||
snānasaṃdhyottare kāle punaryadapi taddvije  |
ubhayaṃ tasya tadrūpaṃ gālavo nityameva ca  || 92.21 ||
dṛṣṭvā savismayo mene kiṃcidastyatra kāraṇam  |
evaṃ savismayo bhūtvā gālavaḥ prāha taṃ dvijam  || 92.22 ||
gacchantaṃ tu namasyātha sanājjātaṃ gururgṛham  |
āhūya yatnato dhīmān kṛpayā vismayena ca  || 92.23 ||
{gālava uvāca̱ }
ko bhavān kva ca gantāsi kiṃ karoṣi kva bhokṣyasi  |
kiṃnāmā tvaṃ kva śayyā te kā te bhāryā vadasva me  || 92.24 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
gālavasya vacaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇo'pyāha taṃ munim  ||* 92.25 ||
{brāhmaṇa uvāca̱ }
śvaḥ kathyate mayā sarvaṃ jñātvā kāryavinirṇayam  ||* 92.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā gālavaṃ taṃ sanājjāto gṛhaṃ yayau  |
bhuktvā rātrau tayā samyakśayyāmāsādya bandhakīm  |
uvāca cakitaḥ smṛtvā gālavasya tu yadvacaḥ  || 92.27 ||
{brāhmaṇa uvāca̱ }
tvaṃ tu sarvaguṇopetā bandhakyapi pativratā  |
āvayoḥ sadṛśī prītiryāvajjīvaṃ pravartatām  || 92.28 ||
tathāpi kiṃcitpṛcchāmi kiṃnāmnī tvaṃ kva vā kulam  |
kiṃ nu sthānaṃ kva vā bandhurmama sarvaṃ nivedyatām  || 92.29 ||
{bandhakyuvāca̱ }
dhṛtavrata iti khyāto brāhmaṇo dīkṣitaḥ śuciḥ  |
tasya bhāryā mahī cāhaṃ matputro gālavāśrame  || 92.30 ||
utsṛṣṭo matimān bālaḥ sanājjāta iti śrutaḥ  |
ahaṃ tu pūrvadoṣeṇa tyaktvā dharmaṃ kulāgatam  |
svairiṇī tviha varte'haṃ viddhi māṃ brāhmaṇīṃ dvija  || 92.31 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā marmaviddha ivābhavat |
papāta sahasā bhūmau veśyā taṃ vākyamabravīt || 92.32 ||
{veśyovāca̱ }
kiṃ tu jātaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kva ca prītirgatā tava  |
kiṃ tu vākyaṃ mayā coktaṃ tava cittavirodhakṛt || 92.33 ||
ātmānamātmanāśvāsya brāhmaṇo vākyamabravīt ||* 92.34 ||
{brāhmaṇa uvāca̱ }
dhṛtavrataḥ pitā viprastatputro'haṃ sanādyataḥ  |
mātā mahī mama iyaṃ mama daivādupāgatā  || 92.35 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā tasya vākyaṃ sāpyabhūdatiduḥkhitā  |
tayostu śocatoḥ paścātprabhāte vimale ravau  |
gālavaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ gatvā vipro nyavedayat || 92.36 ||
{brāhmaṇa uvāca̱ }
dhṛtavratasuto brahmaṃstvayā pūrvaṃ tu pālitaḥ  |
upanītastvayā caiva mahī mātā mama prabho  || 92.37 ||
kiṃ karomi ca kiṃ kṛtvā niṣkṛtirmama vai bhavet ||* 92.38 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvipravacanaṃ śrutvā gālavaḥ prāha mā śucaḥ  |
tavedaṃ dvividhaṃ rūpaṃ nityaṃ paśyāmyapūrvavat || 92.39 ||
tataḥ pṛṣṭo'si vṛttāntaṃ śrutaṃ jñātaṃ mayā yathā  |
yatkṛtyaṃ tava tatsarvaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ pratyagātkṣayam  || 92.40 ||
asya tīrthasya māhātmyādasyā devyāḥ prasādataḥ  |
pūto'si pratyahaṃ vatsa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 92.41 ||
prabhāte tava rūpāṇi sapāpāni tvaharniśam  |
paśye'haṃ punarapyeva rūpaṃ tava guṇottamam  || 92.42 ||
āgacchantaṃ tvāgoyuktaṃ gacchantaṃ tvāmanāgasam  |
paśyāmi nityaṃ tasmāttvaṃ pūto devyā kṛto'dhunā  || 92.43 ||
tasmānna kāryaṃ te kiṃcidavaśiṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati  |
iyaṃ ca mātā te vipra jñātā yā caiva bandhakī  || 92.44 ||
paścāttāpaṃ gatātyantaṃ nivṛttā tvatha pātakāt |
bhūtānāṃ viṣaye prītirvatsa svābhāvikī yataḥ  || 92.45 ||
satsaṅgato mahāpuṇyānnivṛttirdaivato bhavet |
atyarthamanutapteyaṃ prāgācaritapuṇyataḥ  || 92.46 ||
snānaṃ kṛtvā cātra tīrthe tataḥ pūtā bhaviṣyati  |
tathā tau cakraturubhau mātāputrau ca nārada  || 92.47 ||
snānādbabhūvaturubhau gatapāpāvasaṃśayam  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ dhautapāpaṃ pracakṣate  || 92.48 ||
pāpapraṇāśanaṃ nāma gālavaṃ ceti viśrutam  |
mahāpātakamalpaṃ vā tathā yaccopapātakam  |
tatsarvaṃ nāśayedetaddhautapāpaṃ supuṇyadam  || 92.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yatra dāśarathī rāmaḥ sītayā sahito dvija  |
pitṝn saṃtarpayāmāsa pitṛtīrthaṃ tato viduḥ  || 93.1 ||
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā  |
sarvamakṣayatāmeti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 93.2 ||
yatra dāśarathī rāmo viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim  |
pūjayāmāsa rājendro munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ  || 93.3 ||
viśvāmitraṃ tu tattīrthamṛṣijuṣṭaṃ supuṇyadam  |
tatsvarūpaṃ ca vakṣyāmi paṭhitaṃ vedavādibhiḥ  || 93.4 ||
anāvṛṣṭirabhūtpūrvaṃ prajānāmatibhīṣaṇā  |
viśvāmitro mahāprājñaḥ saśiṣyo gautamīmagāt || 93.5 ||
śiṣyān putrāṃśca jāyāṃ ca kṛśān dṛṣṭvā kṣudhāturān  |
vyathitaḥ kauśikaḥ śrīmāñśiṣyānidamuvāca ha  || 93.6 ||
{viśvāmitra uvāca̱ }
yathā kathaṃcidyatkiṃcidyatra kvāpi yathā tathā  |
ānīyatāṃ kiṃtu bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ vā mā vilambyatām  |
idānīmeva gantavyamānetavyaṃ kṣaṇena tu  || 93.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ṛṣestadvacanācchiṣyāḥ kṣudhitāstvarayā yayuḥ  |
aṭamānā itaśceto mṛtaṃ dadṛśire śunam  || 93.8 ||
tamādāya tvarāyuktā ācāryāya nyavedayan  |
so'pi taṃ bhadramityuktvā pratijagrāha pāṇinā  || 93.9 ||
viśasadhvaṃ śvamāṃsaṃ ca kṣālayadhvaṃ ca vāriṇā  |
pacadhvaṃ mantravaccāpi hutvāgnau tu yathāvidhi  || 93.10 ||
devānṛṣīn pitṝnanyāṃstarpayitvātithīn gurūn  |
sarve bhokṣyāmahe śeṣamityuvāca sa kauśikaḥ  || 93.11 ||
viśvāmitravacaḥ śrutvā śiṣyāścakrustathaiva tat |
pacyamāne śvamāṃse tu devadūto'gnirabhyagāt |
devānāṃ sadane sarvaṃ devebhyastannyavedayat || 93.12 ||
{agniruvāca̱ }
devaiḥ śvamāṃsaṃ bhoktavyamāpannamṛṣikalpitam  ||* 93.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
agnestadvacanādindraḥ śyeno bhūtvā vihāyasi  |
sthālīmathāharatpūrṇāṃ māṃsena pihitāṃ tadā  || 93.14 ||
tatkarma dṛṣṭvā śiṣyāste ṛṣeḥ śyenaṃ nyavedayan  |
hṛtā sthālī muniśreṣṭha śyenenākṛtabuddhinā  || 93.15 ||
tataścukopa bhagavāñśaptukāmastadā harim  |
tato jñātvā surapatiḥ sthālīṃ cakre madhuplutām  || 93.16 ||
punarniveśayāmāsa ulkāsveva khago hariḥ  |
madhunā tu samāyuktāṃ viśvāmitraścukopa ha  |
sthālīṃ vīkṣya tataḥ kopādidamāha sa kauśikaḥ  || 93.17 ||
{viśvāmitra uvāca̱ }
śvamāṃsameva no dehi tvaṃ harāmṛtamuttamam  |
no cettvāṃ bhasmasātkuryāmindro bhītastadābravīt || 93.18 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
madhu hutvā yathānyāyaṃ piba putraiḥ samanvitaḥ  |
kimanena śvamāṃsena amedhyena mahāmune  || 93.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
viśvāmitro'pi netyāha bhuktenaikena kiṃ phalam  |
prajāḥ sarvāśca sīdanti kiṃ tena madhunā hare  || 93.20 ||
sarveṣāmamṛtaṃ cetsyādbhokṣye'hamamṛtaṃ śuci  |
athavā devapitaro bhokṣyantīdaṃ śvamāṃsakam  || 93.21 ||
paścādahaṃ tacca māṃsaṃ bhokṣye nānṛtamasti me  |
tato bhītaḥ sahasrākṣo meghānāhūya tatkṣaṇāt || 93.22 ||
vavarṣa cāmṛtaṃ vāri hyamṛtenārpitāḥ prajāḥ  |
paścāttadamṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ haridattaṃ yathāvidhi  || 93.23 ||
tarpayitvā surānādau tarpayitvā jagattrayam  |
vipraḥ saṃbhuktavāñśiṣyairviśvāmitraḥ svabhāryayā  || 93.24 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamākhyātaṃ cātipuṇyadam  |
yatrāgataḥ surapatirlokānāmamṛtārpaṇam  || 93.25 ||
saṃjātaṃ māṃsavarjaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ puṇyadaṃ nṛṇām  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam  || 93.26 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ viśvāmitramiti smṛtam  |
madhutīrthamathaindraṃ ca śyenaṃ parjanyameva ca  || 93.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śvetatīrthamiti khyātaṃ trailokye viśrutaṃ śubham  |
tasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 94.1 ||
śveto nāma purā vipro gautamasya priyaḥ sakhā  |
ātithyapūjānirato gautamītīramāśritaḥ  || 94.2 ||
manasā karmaṇā vācā śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ  |
dhyāyantaṃ taṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ pūjayantaṃ sadā śivam  || 94.3 ||
pūrṇāyuṣaṃ dvijavaraṃ śivabhaktiparāyaṇam  |
netuṃ dūtāḥ samājagmurdakṣiṇāśāpatestadā  || 94.4 ||
nāśaknuvan gṛhaṃ tasya praveṣṭumapi nārada  |
tadā kāle vyatikrānte citrako mṛtyumabravīt || 94.5 ||
{citraka uvāca̱ }
kiṃ nāyāti kṣīṇajīvo mṛtyo śvetaḥ kathaṃ tviti  |
nādyāpyāyānti dūtāste mṛtyornaivocitaṃ tu te  || 94.6 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataśca kupito mṛtyuḥ prāyācchvetagṛhaṃ svayam  |
bahiḥsthitāṃstadā paśyanmṛtyurdūtān bhayārditān  |
provāca kimidaṃ dūtā mṛtyumūcuśca dūtakāḥ  || 94.7 ||
{dūtā ūcu̱ḥ }
śivena rakṣitaṃ śvetaṃ vayaṃ no vīkṣituṃ kṣamāḥ  |
yeṣāṃ prasanno giriśasteṣāṃ kā nāma bhītayaḥ  || 94.8 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pāśapāṇistadā mṛtyuḥ prāviśadyatra sa dvijaḥ  |
nāsau vipro vijānāti mṛtyuṃ vā yamakiṃkarān  || 94.9 ||
śivaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā śvetasya tu samīpataḥ  |
mṛtyuṃ pāśadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā daṇḍī provāca vismitaḥ  || 94.10 ||
{daṇḍyuvāca̱ }
kimatra vīkṣase mṛtyo daṇḍinaṃ mṛtyurabravīt ||* 94.11 ||
{mṛtyuruvāca̱ }
śvetaṃ netumihāyātastasmādvīkṣe dvijottamam  ||* 94.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tvaṃ gacchetyabravīddaṇḍī mṛtyuḥ pāśānathākṣipat |
śvetāya muniśārdūla tato daṇḍī cukopa ha  || 94.13 ||
śivadattena daṇḍena daṇḍī mṛtyumatāḍayat |
tataḥ pāśadharo mṛtyuḥ papāta dharaṇītale  || 94.14 ||
tataste satvaraṃ dūtā hataṃ mṛtyumavekṣya ca  |
yamāya sarvamavadan vadhaṃ mṛtyostu daṇḍinā  || 94.15 ||
tataśca kupito dharmo yamo mahiṣavāhanaḥ  |
citraguptaṃ bahubalaṃ yamadaṇḍaṃ ca rakṣakam  || 94.16 ||
mahiṣaṃ bhūtavetālānādhivyādhīṃstathaiva ca  |
akṣirogān kukṣirogān karṇaśūlaṃ tathaiva ca  || 94.17 ||
jvaraṃ ca trividhaṃ pāpaṃ narakāṇi pṛthakpṛthak |
tvarantāmiti tānuktvā jagāma tvarito yamaḥ  || 94.18 ||
etairanyaiḥ parivṛto yatra śveto dvijottamaḥ  |
tamāyāntaṃ yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā nandī provāca sāyudhaḥ  || 94.19 ||
vināyakaṃ tathā skandaṃ bhūtanāthaṃ tu daṇḍinam  |
tatra tadyuddhamabhavatsarvalokabhayāvaham  || 94.20 ||
kārttikeyaḥ svayaṃ śaktyā bibheda yamakiṃkarān  |
dakṣiṇāśāpatiṃ cāpi nijaghāna balānvitam  || 94.21 ||
hatāvaśiṣṭā yāmyāste ādityāya nyavedayan  |
ādityo'pi suraiḥ sārdhaṃ śrutvā tanmahadadbhutam  || 94.22 ||
lokapālairanuvṛto mamāntikamupāgamat |
ahaṃ viṣṇuśca bhagavānindro'gnirvaruṇastathā  || 94.23 ||
candrādityāvaśvinau ca lokapālā marudgaṇāḥ  |
ete cānye ca bahavo vayaṃ yātā yamāntikam  || 94.24 ||
mṛta āste dakṣiṇeśo gaṅgātīre balānvitaḥ  |
samudrāśca nadā nāgā nānābhūtānyanekaśaḥ  || 94.25 ||
tatrājagmuḥ sureśānaṃ draṣṭuṃ vaivasvataṃ yamam  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā hatasainyaṃ ca yamaṃ devā bhayārditāḥ  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ śaṃbhumūcuḥ sarve punaḥ punaḥ  || 94.26 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
bhaktipriyatvaṃ te nityaṃ duṣṭahantṛtvameva ca  |
ādikartarnamastubhyaṃ nīlakaṇṭha namo'stu te  |
brahmapriya namaste'stu devapriya namo'stu te  || 94.27 ||
