śvetaṃ dvijaṃ bhaktamanāyuṣaṃ te  94.28
netuṃ yamādiḥ sakalo'samarthaḥ  94.28
saṃtoṣamāptāḥ paramaṃ samīkṣya  94.28
bhaktapriyatvaṃ tvayi nātha satyam  94.28
ye tvāṃ prapannāḥ śaraṇaṃ kṛpāluṃ  94.29
nālaṃ kṛtānto'pyanuvīkṣituṃ tān  94.29
evaṃ viditvā śiva eva sarve  94.29
tvāmeva bhaktyā parayā bhajante  94.29
tvameva jagatāṃ nātha kiṃ na smarasi śaṃkara  |
tvāṃ vinā kaḥ samartho'tra vyavasthāṃ kartumīśvaraḥ  || 94.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ tu stuvatāṃ teṣāṃ purastādabhavacchivaḥ  |
kiṃ dadāmīti tānāha idamūcuḥ surā api  || 94.31 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
ayaṃ vaivasvato dharmo niyantā sarvadehinām  |
dharmādharmavyavasthāyāṃ sthāpito lokapālakaḥ  || 94.32 ||
nāyaṃ vadhamavāpnoti nāparādhī na pāpakṛt |
vinā tena jagaddhāturnaiva kiṃcidbhaviṣyati  || 94.33 ||
tasmājjīvaya deveśa yamaṃ sabalavāhanam  |
prārthanā saphalā nātha mahatsu na vṛthā bhavet || 94.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ provāca bhagavāñjīvayeyamasaṃśayam  |
yamaṃ yadi vaco me'dya anumanyanti devatāḥ  || 94.35 ||
tataḥ procuḥ surāḥ sarve kurmo vākyaṃ tvayoditam  |
haribrahmādisahitaṃ vaśe yasyākhilaṃ jagat || 94.36 ||
tataḥ provāca bhagavānamarān samupāgatān  |
madbhakto na mṛtiṃ yātu netyūcuramarāḥ punaḥ  || 94.37 ||
amarāḥ syustato deva sarvalokāścarācarāḥ  |
amartyamartyabhedo'yaṃ na syāddeva jaganmaya  || 94.38 ||
punarapyāha tāñśaṃbhuḥ śṛṇvantu mama bhāṣitam  |
madbhaktānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ gautamīmanusevatām  || 94.39 ||
vayaṃ tu svāmino nityaṃ na mṛtyuḥ svāmyamarhati  |
vārttāpyeṣāṃ na kartavyā yamena tu kadācana  || 94.40 ||
ādhivyādhyādibhirjātu kāryo nābhibhavaḥ kvacit |
ye śivaṃ śaraṇaṃ yātāste muktāstatkṣaṇādapi  || 94.41 ||
sānugasya yamasyāto namasyāḥ sarva eva te  |
tathetyūcuḥ suragaṇā devadevaṃ śivaṃ prati  || 94.42 ||
tataśca bhagavānnātho nandinaṃ prāha vāhanam  ||* 94.43 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
gautamyā udakena tvamabhiṣiñca mṛtaṃ yamam  ||* 94.44 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato yamādayaḥ sarve abhiṣiktāstu nandinā  |
utthitāśca sajīvāste dakṣiṇāśāṃ tato gatāḥ  || 94.45 ||
uttare gautamītīre viṣṇvādyāḥ sarvadaivatāḥ  |
sthitā āsan pūjayanto devadevaṃ maheśvaram  || 94.46 ||
tatrāsannayutānyaṣṭa sahasrāṇi caturdaśa  |
tathā ṣaṭca sahasrāṇi punaḥ ṣaṭca tathaiva ca  || 94.47 ||
ṣaḍdakṣiṇe tathā tīre tīrthānāmayutatrayam  |
puṇyamākhyānametaddhi śvetatīrthasya nārada  || 94.48 ||
yatrāsau patito mṛtyurmṛtyutīrthaṃ taducyate  |
tasya śravaṇamātreṇa sahasraṃ jīvate samāḥ  || 94.49 ||
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  |
śravaṇaṃ paṭhanaṃ cāpi smaraṇaṃ ca malakṣayam  |
karoti sarvalokānāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam  || 94.50 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śukratīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām  |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam  || 95.1 ||
aṅgirāśca bhṛguścaiva ṛṣī paramadhārmikau  |
tayoḥ putrau mahāprājñau rūpabuddhivilāsinau  || 95.2 ||
jīvaḥ kaviriti khyātau mātāpitrorvaśe ratau  |
upanītau sutau dṛṣṭvā pitarāvūcaturmithaḥ  || 95.3 ||
{ṛṣī ūcatu̱ḥ }
āvayoreka evāstu śāstā nityaṃ ca putrayoḥ  |
tasmādekaḥ śāsitā syāttiṣṭhatveko yathāsukham  || 95.4 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā tataḥ śīghramaṅgirāḥ prāha bhārgavam  |
adhyāpayiṣye sadṛśaṃ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhatu bhārgavaḥ  || 95.5 ||
etacchrutvā cāṅgiraso vākyaṃ bhṛgukulodvahaḥ  |
tatheti matvāṅgirase śukraṃ tasmai nyavedayat || 95.6 ||
ubhāvapi sutau nityamadhyāpayati vai pṛthak |
vaiṣamyabuddhyā tau bālau cirācchukro'bravīdidam  || 95.7 ||
{śukra uvāca̱ }
vaiṣamyeṇa guro māṃ tvamadhyāpayasi nityaśaḥ  |
gurūṇāṃ nedamucitaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ putraśiṣyayoḥ  || 95.8 ||
vaiṣamyeṇa ca vartante mūḍhāḥ śiṣyeṣu deśikāḥ  |
naiṣā viṣamabuddhīnāṃ saṃkhyā pāpasya vidyate  || 95.9 ||
ācārya samyagjñāto'si namasye'haṃ punaḥ punaḥ  |
gaccheyaṃ gurumanyaṃ vai māmanujñātumarhasi  || 95.10 ||
gaccheyaṃ pitaraṃ brahman yadyasau viṣamo bhavet |
tato vānyatra gacchāmi svāmin pṛṣṭo'si gamyate  || 95.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
guruṃ bṛhaspatiṃ dṛṣṭvā anujñātastvagāttataḥ  |
avāptavidyaḥ pitaraṃ gaccheyaṃ cetyacintayat || 95.12 ||
tasmātkamanupṛccheyamutkṛṣṭaḥ ko gururbhavet |
iti smaranmahāprājñamapṛcchadvṛddhagautamam  || 95.13 ||
{śukra uvāca̱ }
ko guruḥ syānmuniśreṣṭha mama brūhi gururbhavet |
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ yo gurustaṃ vrajāmyaham  || 95.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa prāha jagatāmīśaṃ śaṃbhuṃ devaṃ jagadgurum  |
kvārādhayāmi giriśamityuktaḥ prāha gautamaḥ  || 95.15 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
gautamyāṃ tu śucirbhūtvā stotraistoṣaya śaṃkaram  |
tatastuṣṭo jagannāthaḥ sa te vidyāṃ pradāsyati  || 95.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
gautamasya tu tadvākyātprāgādgaṅgāṃ sa bhārgavaḥ  |
snātvā bhūtvā śuciḥ samyakstutiṃ cakre sa bālakaḥ  || 95.17 ||
{śukra uvāca̱ }
bālo'haṃ bālabuddhiśca bālacandradhara prabho  |
nāhaṃ jānāmi te kiṃcitstutiṃ kartuṃ namo'stu te  || 95.18 ||
parityaktasya guruṇā na mamāsti suhṛtsakhā  |
tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvabhāvena jagannātha namo'stu te  || 95.19 ||
gururgurumatāṃ deva mahatāṃ ca mahānasi  |
ahamalpataro bālo jaganmaya namo'stu te  || 95.20 ||
vidyārthaṃ hi sureśāna nāhaṃ vedmi bhavadgatim  |
māṃ tvaṃ ca kṛpayā paśya lokasākṣinnamo'stu te  || 95.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ tu stuvatastasya prasanno'bhūtsureśvaraḥ  ||* 95.22 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
kāmaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yaccāpi suradurlabham  ||* 95.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kavirapyāha deveśaṃ kṛtāñjalirudāradhīḥ  ||* 95.24 ||
{śukra uvāca̱ }
brahmādibhiśca ṛṣibhiryā vidyā naiva gocarā  |
tāṃ vidyāṃ nātha yāciṣye tvaṃ gururmama daivatam  || 95.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
mṛtasaṃjīvinīṃ vidyāmajñātāṃ tridaśairapi  |
tāṃ dattavān suraśreṣṭhastasmai śukrāya yācate  || 95.26 ||
itarā laukikī vidyā vaidikī cānyagocarā  |
kiṃ punaḥ śaṃkare tuṣṭe vicāryamavaśiṣyate  || 95.27 ||
sa tu labdhvā mahāvidyāṃ prāyātsvapitaraṃ gurum  |
daityānāṃ ca guruścāsīdvidyayā pūjitaḥ kaviḥ  || 95.28 ||
tataḥ kadācittāṃ vidyāṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare  |
kaco bṛhaspatisuto vidyāṃ prāptaḥ kavestu tām  || 95.29 ||
kacādbṛhaspatiścāpi tato devāḥ pṛthakpṛthak |
avāpurmahatīṃ vidyāṃ yāmāhurmṛtajīvinīm  || 95.30 ||
yatra sā kavinā prāptā vidyāpūjya maheśvaram  |
gautamyā uttare pāre śukratīrthaṃ taducyate  || 95.31 ||
mṛtasaṃjīvinītīrthamāyurārogyavardhanam  |
snānaṃ dānaṃ ca yatkiṃcitsarvamakṣayapuṇyadam  || 95.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
indratīrthamiti khyātaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam  |
smaraṇādapi pāpaugha kleśasaṃghavināśanam  || 96.1 ||
purā vṛtravadhe vṛtte brahmahatyā tu nārada  |
śacīpatiṃ cānugatā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītavaddhariḥ  || 96.2 ||
indrastato vṛtrahantā itaścetaśca dhāvati  |
yatra yatra tvasau yāti hatyā sāpīndragāminī  || 96.3 ||
sa mahatsara āviśya padmanālamupāgamat |
tatrāsau tantuvadbhūtvā vāsaṃ cakre śacīpatiḥ  || 96.4 ||
sarastīre'pi hatyāsīddivyaṃ varṣasahasrakam  |
etasminnantare devā nirindrā hyabhavanmune  || 96.5 ||
mantrayāmāsuravyagrāḥ kathamindro bhavediti  |
tatrāhamavadaṃ devān hatyāsthānaṃ prakalpya ca  || 96.6 ||
indrasya pāvanārthāya gautamyāmabhiṣicyatām  |
yatrābhiṣiktaḥ pūtātmā punarindro bhaviṣyati  || 96.7 ||
tathā te niścayaṃ kṛtvā gautamīṃ śīghramāgaman  |
tatra snātaṃ surapatiṃ devāśca ṛṣayastathā  || 96.8 ||
abhiṣektukāmāste sarve śacīkāntaṃ ca tasthire  |
abhiṣicyamānamindraṃ taṃ prakopādgautamo'bravīt || 96.9 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
abhiṣekṣyanti pāpiṣṭhaṃ mahendraṃ gurutalpagam  |
tān sarvān bhasmasātkuryāṃ śīghraṃ yāntvasurārayaḥ  || 96.10 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadṛṣervacanaṃ śrutvā parihṛtya ca gautamīm  |
narmadāmagaman sarva indramādāya satvarāḥ  || 96.11 ||
uttare narmadātīre abhiṣekāya tasthire  |
abhiṣekṣyamāṇamindraṃ taṃ māṇḍavyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ  || 96.12 ||
abravīdbhasmasātkuryāṃ yadi syādabhiṣecanam  |
pūjayāmāsuramarā māṇḍavyaṃ yuktibhiḥ stavaiḥ  || 96.13 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
ayamindraḥ sahasrākṣo yasmin deśe'bhiṣicyate  |
tatrātidāruṇaṃ vighnaṃ mune samupajāyate  || 96.14 ||
tacchāntiṃ kuru kalyāṇa prasīda varado bhava  |
malaniryātanaṃ yasmin kurmastasmin varān bahūn  || 96.15 ||
deśe dāsyāmahe sarve tadanujñātumarhasi  |
yasmin deśe surendrasya abhiṣeko bhaviṣyati  || 96.16 ||
sa sarvakāmadaḥ puṃsāṃ dhānyavṛkṣaphalairyutaḥ  |
nānāvṛṣṭirna durbhikṣaṃ bhavedatra kadācana  || 96.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
mene tato muniśreṣṭho māṇḍavyo lokapūjitaḥ  |
abhiṣekaḥ kṛtastatra malaniryātanaṃ tathā  || 96.18 ||
devaistadokto munibhiḥ sa deśo mālavastataḥ  |
abhiṣikte surapatau jāte ca vimale tadā  || 96.19 ||
ānīya gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ taṃ puṇyāyābhiṣecire  |
surāśca ṛṣayaścaiva ahaṃ viṣṇustathaiva ca  || 96.20 ||
vasiṣṭho gautamaścāpi agastyo'triśca kaśyapaḥ  |
ete cānye ca ṛṣayo devā yakṣāḥ sapannagāḥ  || 96.21 ||
snānaṃ tatpuṇyatoyena akurvannabhiṣecanam  |
mayā punaḥ śacībhartā kamaṇḍalubhavena ca  || 96.22 ||
vāriṇāpyabhiṣiktaśca tatra puṇyābhavannadī  |
siktā ceti ca tatrāsītte gaṅgāyāṃ ca saṃgate  || 96.23 ||
saṃgamau tatra vikhyātau sarvadā munisevitau  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ puṇyāsaṃgamamucyate  || 96.24 ||
siktāyāḥ saṃgame puṇyamaindraṃ tadabhidhīyate  |
tatra sapta sahasrāṇi tīrthānyāsañśubhāni ca  || 96.25 ||
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tu saṃgame  |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ vidyānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā  || 96.26 ||
yadetatpuṇyamākhyānaṃ yaḥ paṭhecca śṛṇoti vā  |
sarvapāpaiḥ sa mucyeta manovākkāyakarmajaiḥ  || 96.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
paulastyaṃ tīrthamākhyātaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām  |
prabhāvaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi bhraṣṭarājyapradāyakam  || 97.1 ||
uttarāśāpatiḥ pūrvamṛddhisiddhisamanvitaḥ  |
purā laṅkāpatiścāsījjyeṣṭho viśravasaḥ sutaḥ  || 97.2 ||
tasyaite bhrātaraścāsan balavanto'mitaprabhāḥ  |
sāpatnā rāvaṇaścaiva kumbhakarṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ  || 97.3 ||
te'pi viśravasaḥ putrā rākṣasyāṃ rākṣasāstu te  |
maddattena vimānena dhanado bhrātṛbhiḥ saha  || 97.4 ||
mamāntikaṃ bhaktiyukto nityameti tu yāti ca  |
rāvaṇasya tu yā mātā kupitā sābravītsutān  || 97.5 ||
{rāvaṇamātovāca̱ }
mariṣye na ca jīviṣye putrā vairūpyakāraṇāt |
devāśca dānavāścāsan sāpatnā bhrātaro mithaḥ  || 97.6 ||
anyonyavadhamīpsante jayaiśvaryavaśānugāḥ  |
tadbhavanto na puruṣā na śaktā na jayaiṣiṇaḥ  |
sāpatnyaṃ yo'numanyate tasya jīvo nirarthakaḥ  || 97.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tanmātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā bhrātaraste trayo mune  |
jagmuste tapase'raṇyaṃ kṛtavantastapo mahat || 97.8 ||
matto varānavāpuśca traya ete ca rākṣasāḥ  |
mātulena marīcena tathā mātāmahena tu  || 97.9 ||
tanmātṛvacanāccāpi tato laṅkāmayācata  |
rakṣobhāvānmātṛdoṣādbhrātrorvairamabhūnmahat || 97.10 ||
tatastadabhavadyuddhaṃ devadānavayoriva  |
yuddhe jitvāgrajaṃ śāntaṃ dhanadaṃ bhrātaraṃ tathā  || 97.11 ||
puṣpakaṃ ca purīṃ laṅkāṃ sarvaṃ caiva vyapāharat |
rāvaṇo ghoṣayāmāsa trailokye sacarācare  || 97.12 ||
yo dadyādāśrayaṃ bhrātuḥ sa ca vadhyo bhavenmama  |
bhrātrā nirasto vaiśravaṇo naiva prāpāśrayaṃ kvacit |
pitāmahaṃ pulastyaṃ taṃ gatvā natvābravīdvacaḥ  || 97.13 ||
{dhanada uvāca̱ }
bhrātrā nirasto duṣṭena kiṃ karomi vadasva me  |
āśrayaḥ śaraṇaṃ yatsyāddaivaṃ vā tīrthameva ca  || 97.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatpautravacanaṃ śrutvā pulastyo vākyamabravīt ||* 97.15 ||
{pulastya uvāca̱ }
gautamīṃ gaccha putra tvaṃ stuhi devaṃ maheśvaram  |
tatra nāsya praveśaḥ syādgaṅgāyā jalamadhyataḥ  || 97.16 ||
siddhiṃ prāpsyasi kalyāṇīṃ tathā kuru mayā saha  ||* 97.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā jagāmāsau sabhāryo dhanadastathā  |
pitrā mātrā ca vṛddhena pulastyena dhaneśvaraḥ  || 97.18 ||
gatvā tu gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ śuciḥ snātvā yatavrataḥ  |
tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śivam  || 97.19 ||
{dhanada uvāca̱ }
svāmī tvamevāsya carācarasya  97.20
viśvasya śaṃbho na paro'sti kaścit 97.20
tvāmapyavajñāya yadīha mohāt 97.20
pragalbhate kopi sa śocya eva  97.20
tvamaṣṭamūrtyā sakalaṃ bibharṣi  97.21
tvadājñayā vartata eva sarvam  97.21
tathāpi vedeti budho bhavantaṃ  97.21
na jātvavidvānmahimā purātanam  97.21
malaprasūtaṃ yadavocadambā  97.22
hāsyātsuto'yaṃ tava deva śūraḥ  97.22
tvatprekṣitādyaḥ sa ca vighnarājo  97.22
jajñe tvaho ceṣṭitamīśadṛṣṭeḥ  97.22
aśruplutāṅgī girijā samīkṣya  97.23
viyuktadāṃpatyamitīśamūce  97.23
manobhavo'bhūnmadano ratiśca  97.23
saubhāgyapūrvatvamavāpa somāt 97.23
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityādi stuvatastasya purato'bhūttrilocanaḥ  |
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa harṣānnovāca kiṃcana  || 97.24 ||
tūṣṇīṃbhūte tu dhanade pulastye ca maheśvare  |
punaḥ punarvarasveti śive vādini harṣite  || 97.25 ||
etasminnantare tatra vāguvācāśarīriṇī  |
prāptavyaṃ dhanapālatvaṃ vadantīdaṃ maheśvaram  || 97.26 ||
pulastyasya tu yaccittaṃ piturvaiśravaṇasya tu  |
viditveva tadā vāṇī śubhamarthamudīrayat || 97.27 ||
bhūtavadbhavitavyaṃ syāddāsyamānaṃ tu dattavat |
prāptavyaṃ prāptavattatra daivī vāgabhavacchubhā  || 97.28 ||
prabhūtaśatruḥ paribhūtaduḥkhaḥ  97.29
saṃpūjya someśvaramāpa liṅgam  97.29
digīśvaratvaṃ draviṇaprabhutvam  97.29
apāradātṛtvakalatraputrān  97.29
tāṃ vācaṃ dhanadaḥ śrutvā devadevaṃ triśūlinam  |
evaṃ bhavatu nāmeti dhanado vākyamabravīt || 97.30 ||
tathaivāstviti deveśo daivīṃ vācamamanyata  |
pulastyaṃ ca varaiḥ puṇyaistathā viśravasaṃ munim  || 97.31 ||
dhanapālaṃ ca deveśo hyabhinandya yayau śivaḥ  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ paulastyaṃ dhanadaṃ viduḥ  || 97.32 ||
tathā vaiśravasaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  |
teṣu snānādi yatkiṃcittatsarvaṃ bahupuṇyadam  || 97.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
agnitīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvakratuphalapradam  |
sarvavighnopaśamanaṃ tattīrthasya phalaṃ śṛṇu  || 98.1 ||
jātavedā iti khyāto agnerbhrātā sa havyavāṭ |
havyaṃ vahantaṃ devānāṃ gautamyāstīra eva tu  || 98.2 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ sattrasadane agnerbhrātaramuttamam  |
bhrātuḥ priyaṃ tathā dakṣaṃ madhurditisuto balī  || 98.3 ||
jaghāna ṛṣimukhyeṣu paśyatsu ca sureṣvapi  |
havyaṃ devā naiva cāpurmṛte vai jātavedasi  || 98.4 ||
mṛte bhrātari sa tvagniḥ priye vai jātavedasi  |
kopena mahatāviṣṭo gāṅgamambhaḥ samāviśat || 98.5 ||
gaṅgāmbhasi samāviṣṭe hyagnau devāśca mānuṣāḥ  |
jīvamutsarjayāmāsuragnijīvā yato matāḥ  || 98.6 ||
yatrāgnirjalamāviṣṭastaṃ deśaṃ sarva eva te  |
ājagmurvibudhāḥ sarva ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā  || 98.7 ||
vināgninā na jīvāmaḥ stuvanto'gniṃ viśeṣataḥ  |
agniṃ jalagataṃ dṛṣṭvā priyaṃ cocurdivaukasaḥ  || 98.8 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
devāñjīvaya havyena kavyena ca pitṝṃstathā  |
mānuṣānannapākena bījānāṃ kledanena ca  || 98.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
agnirapyāha tān devāñśakto yo me gato'nujaḥ  |
kriyamāṇe bhavatkārye yā gatirjātavedasaḥ  || 98.10 ||
sā vāpi syānmama surā notsahe kāryasādhane  |
kāryaṃ tu sarvatastasya bhavatāṃ jātavedasaḥ  || 98.11 ||
imāṃ sthitimanuprāpto na jāne me kathaṃ bhavet |
iha cāmutra ca vyāptau śaktirapyatra no bhavet || 98.12 ||
athāpi kriyamāṇe vai kārye saiva gatirmama  |
devāstamūcurbhāvena sarveṇa ṛṣayastathā  || 98.13 ||
āyuḥ karmaṇi ca prītirvyāptau śaktiśca dīyate  |
prayājānanuyājāṃśca dāsyāmo havyavāhana  || 98.14 ||
devānāṃ tvaṃ mukhaṃ śreṣṭhamāhutyaḥ prathamāstava  |
tvayā dattaṃ tu yaddravyaṃ bhokṣyāmaḥ surasattama  || 98.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatastuṣṭo'bhavadvahnirdevavākyādyathākramam  |
iha cāmutra ca vyāptau havye vā laukike tathā  || 98.16 ||
sarvatra vahnirabhayaḥ samartho'bhūtsurājñayā  |
jātavedā bṛhadbhānuḥ saptārcirnīlalohitaḥ  || 98.17 ||
jalagarbhaḥ śamīgarbho yajñagarbhaḥ sa ucyate  |
jalādākṛṣya vibudhā abhiṣicya vibhāvasum  || 98.18 ||
ubhayatra pade vāsaḥ sarvago'gnistato'bhavat |
yathāgataṃ surā jagmurvahnitīrthaṃ taducyate  || 98.19 ||
tatra sapta śatānyāsaṃstīrthāni guṇavanti ca  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yaḥ karoti jitātmavān  || 98.20 ||
aśvamedhaphalaṃ sāgraṃ prāpnotyavikalaṃ śubham  |
devatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva āgneyaṃ jātavedasam  || 98.21 ||
agnipratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ tatrāste'nekavarṇavat |
taddevadarśanādeva sarvakratuphalaṃ labhet || 98.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ṛṇapramocanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ vedavido viduḥ  |
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tanmanāḥ  || 99.1 ||
āsītpṛthuśravā nāma priyaḥ kakṣīvataḥ sutaḥ  |
na dārasaṃgrahaṃ lebhe vairāgyānnāgnipūjanam  || 99.2 ||
kanīyāṃstu samartho'pi parivittibhayānmune  |
nākaroddārakarmādi naivāgnīnāmupāsanam  || 99.3 ||
tataḥ procuḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ putraṃ kakṣīvataḥ śubham  |
jyeṣṭhaṃ caiva kaniṣṭhaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthagidaṃ vacaḥ  || 99.4 ||
{pitara ūcu̱ḥ }
ṛṇatrayāpanodāya kriyatāṃ dārasaṃgrahaḥ  ||* 99.5 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
netyuvāca tato jyeṣṭhaḥ kimṛṇaṃ kena yujyate  |
kanīyāṃstu pitṝn prāha na yogyo dārasaṃgrahaḥ  || 99.6 ||
jyeṣṭhe sati mahāprājñaḥ parivittibhayāditi  |
tāvubhau punarapyevamūcuste vai pitāmahāḥ  || 99.7 ||
{pitara ūcu̱ḥ }
yātāmubhau gautamīṃ tu puṇyāṃ kakṣīvataḥ sutau  |
kurutāṃ gautamīsnānaṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam  || 99.8 ||
gacchatāṃ gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ lokatritayapāvanīm  |
snānaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ tasyāṃ kurutāṃ śraddhayānvitau  || 99.9 ||
dṛṣṭāvanāmitā dhyātā gautamī sarvakāmadā  |
na deśakālajātyādi niyamo'trāvagāhane  |
jyeṣṭho'nṛṇastato bhūyātparivittirna cetaraḥ  || 99.10 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ pṛthuśravā jyeṣṭhaḥ kṛtvā snānaṃ satarpaṇam  |
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ kākṣīvato'nṛṇo'bhavat || 99.11 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamṛṇamocanamucyate  |
śrautasmārtaṛṇebhyaśca itarebhyaśca nārada  |
tatra snānena dānena ṛṇī muktaḥ sukhī bhavet || 99.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
suparṇāsaṃgamaṃ nāma kādravāsaṃgamaṃ tathā  |
maheśvaro yatra devo gaṅgāpulinamāśritaḥ  || 100.1 ||
agnikuṇḍaṃ ca tatraiva raudraṃ vaiṣṇavameva ca  |
sauraṃ saumyaṃ tathā brāhmaṃ kaumāraṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā  || 100.2 ||
apsarā ca nadī yatra saṃgatā gaṅgayā tathā  |
tattīrthasmaraṇādeva kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ  || 100.3 ||
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ śṛṇu yatnena nārada  |
indreṇa hiṃsitāḥ pūrvaṃ vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ  |
dattārdhatapasaḥ sarve procuste kāśyapaṃ munim  || 100.4 ||
{vālakhilyā ūcu̱ḥ }
putramutpādayānena indradarpaharaṃ śubham  |
tapaso'rdhaṃ tu dāsyāmastathetyāha munistu tān  || 100.5 ||
suparṇāyāṃ tato garbhamādadhe sa prajāpatiḥ  |
kadrvāṃ caiva śanairbrahman sarpāṇāṃ sarpamātari  || 100.6 ||
te garbhiṇyāvubhe āha gantukāmaḥ prajāpatiḥ  |
aparādho na ca kvāpi kāryo gamanameva ca  || 100.7 ||
anyatra gamanācchāpo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ  ||* 100.8 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā sa yayau patnyau gate bhartari te ubhe  |
tadaiva jagmatuḥ sattramṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām  || 100.9 ||
brahmavṛndasamākīrṇaṃ gaṅgātīrasamāśritam  |
unmatte te ubhe nityaṃ vayaḥsaṃpattigarvite  || 100.10 ||
nivāryamāṇe bahuśo munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ  |
vikurvatyau tatra sattre samāni ca havīṃṣi ca  || 100.11 ||
yoṣitāṃ durvilasitaṃ kaḥ saṃvaritumīśvaraḥ  |
te dṛṣṭvā cukṣubhurviprā apamārgarate ubhe  || 100.12 ||
apamārgasthite yasmādāpage hi bhaviṣyathaḥ  |
suparṇā caiva kadrūśca nadyau te saṃbabhūvatuḥ  || 100.13 ||
sa kadācidgṛhaṃ prāyātkaśyapo'tha prajāpatiḥ  |
ṛṣibhyastatra vṛttāntaṃ śāpaṃ tābhyāṃ savistaram  || 100.14 ||
śrutvā tu vismayāviṣṭaḥ kiṃ karomītyacintayat |
ṛṣibhyaḥ kathayāmāsa vālakhilyā iti śrutāḥ  || 100.15 ||
ta ūcuḥ kaśyapaṃ vipraṃ gatvā gaṅgāṃ tu gautamīm  |
tatra stuhi maheśānaṃ punarbhārye bhaviṣyataḥ  || 100.16 ||
brahmahatyābhayādeva yatra devo maheśvaraḥ  |
gaṅgāmadhye sadā hyāste madhyameśvarasaṃjñayā  || 100.17 ||
tathetyuktvā kaśyapo'pi snātvā gaṅgāṃ jitavrataḥ  |
tuṣṭāva stavanaiḥ puṇyairdevadevaṃ maheśvaram  || 100.18 ||
{kaśyapa uvāca̱ }
lokatrayaikādhipaterna yasya  100.19
kutrāpi vastunyabhimānaleśaḥ  100.19
sa siddhanātho'khilaviśvakartā  100.19
bhartā śivāyā bhavatu prasannaḥ  100.19
tāpatrayoṣṇadyutitāpitānām  100.20
itastato vai paridhāvatāṃ ca  100.20
śarīriṇāṃ sthāvarajaṅgamānāṃ  100.20
tvameva duḥkhavyapanodadakṣaḥ  100.20
sattvādiyogastrividho'pi yasya  100.21
śakrādibhirvaktumaśakya eva  100.21
vicitravṛttiṃ paricintya somaṃ  100.21
sukhī sadā dānaparo vareṇyaḥ  100.21
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityādistutibhirdevaḥ stuto gaurīpatiḥ śivaḥ  |
prasanno hyadadācchaṃbhuḥ kaśyapāya varān bahūn  || 100.22 ||
bhāryārthinaṃ tu taṃ prāha syātāṃ bhārye ubhe tu te  |
nadīsvarūpe patnyau ye gaṅgāṃ prāpya saridvarām  || 100.23 ||
tatsaṃgamanamātreṇa tābhyāṃ bhūyātsvakaṃ vapuḥ  |
te garbhiṇyau punarjāte gaṅgāyāśca prasādataḥ  || 100.24 ||
tataḥ prajāpatiḥ prīto bhārye prāpya mahāmanāḥ  |
āhvayāmāsa tān viprān gautamītīramāśritān  || 100.25 ||
sīmantonnayanaṃ cakre tābhyāṃ prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ  |
brāhmaṇān pūjayāmāsa vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā  || 100.26 ||
bhuktavatsvatha vipreṣu kaśyapasyātha mandire  |
bhartṛsamīpopaviṣṭā kadrūrviprānnirīkṣya ca  || 100.27 ||
tataḥ kadrūrṛṣīnakṣṇā prāhasatte ca cukṣubhuḥ  |
yenākṣṇā hasitā pāpe bhajyatāṃ te'kṣi pāpavat || 100.28 ||
kāṇābhavattataḥ kadrūḥ sarpamāteti yocyate  |
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa kaśyapo bhagavānṛṣīn  || 100.29 ||
tataḥ prasannāste procurgautamī saritāṃ varā  |
aparādhasahasrebhyo rakṣiṣyati ca sevanāt || 100.30 ||
bhāryānvitastathā cakre kaśyapo munisattamaḥ  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamubhayoḥ saṃgamaṃ viduḥ  |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakratuphalapradam  || 100.31 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
purūravasamākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ vedavido viduḥ  |
smaraṇādeva pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ kiṃ tu darśanāt || 101.1 ||
purūravā brahmasadaḥ prāpya tatra sarasvatīm  |
yadṛcchayā devanadīṃ hasantīṃ brahmaṇo'ntike  |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpasaṃpannāmurvaśīṃ prāha bhūpatiḥ  || 101.2 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
keyaṃ rūpavatī sādhvī sthiteyaṃ brahmaṇo'ntike  |
sarvāsāmuttamā yoṣiddīpayantī sabhāmimām  || 101.3 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
urvaśī prāha rājānamiyaṃ devanadī śubhā  |
sarasvatī brahmasutā nityameti ca yāti ca  |
tacchrutvā vismito rājā ānayemāṃ mamāntikam  || 101.4 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
urvaśī punarapyāha rājānaṃ bhūridakṣiṇam  ||* 101.5 ||
{urvaśyuvāca̱ }
ānīyate mahārāja tasyāḥ sarvaṃ nivedya ca  ||* 101.6 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatastāṃ prāhiṇottatra rājā prītyā tadorvaśīm  |
sā gatvā rājavacanaṃ nyavedayadathorvaśī  || 101.7 ||
sarasvatyapi tanmene urvaśyā yanniveditam  |
sā tatheti pratijñāya prāyādyatra purūravāḥ  || 101.8 ||
sarasvatyāstatastīre sa reme bahulāḥ samāḥ  |
sarasvānabhavatputro yasya putro bṛhadrathaḥ  || 101.9 ||
tāṃ gacchantīṃ nṛpagṛhaṃ nityameva sarasvatīm  |
sarasvantaṃ tato lakṣma jñātvānyeṣu tathā kṛtam  || 101.10 ||
tasyai dadāvahaṃ śāpaṃ bhūyā iti mahānadī  |
macchāpabhītā vāgīśā prāgāddevīṃ ca gautamīm  || 101.11 ||
kamaṇḍalubhavāṃ pūtāṃ mātaraṃ lokapāvanīm  |
tāpatrayopaśamanīmaihikāmuṣmikapradām  || 101.12 ||
sā gatvā gautamīṃ devīṃ prāha macchāpamāditaḥ  |
gaṅgāpi māmuvācedaṃ viśāpāṃ kartumarhasi  || 101.13 ||
na yuktaṃ yatsarasvatyāḥ śāpaṃ tvaṃ dattavānasi  |
strīṇāmeṣa svabhāvo vai puṃskāmā yoṣito yataḥ  || 101.14 ||
svabhāvacapalā brahman yoṣitaḥ sakalā api  |
tvaṃ kathaṃ tu na jānīṣe jagatsraṣṭāmbujāsana  || 101.15 ||
viḍambayati kaṃ vā na kāmo vāpi svabhāvataḥ  |
tato viśāpamavadaṃ dṛśyāpi syātsarasvatī  || 101.16 ||
tasmācchāpānnadī martye dṛśyādṛśyā sarasvatī  |
yatraiṣā saṃgatā devī gaṅgāyāṃ śāpavihvalā  || 101.17 ||
tatra prāyānnṛpavaro dhārmikaḥ sa purūravāḥ  |
tapastaptvā samārādhya devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ haram  || 101.18 ||
sarvān kāmānathāvāpa gaṅgāyāśca prasādataḥ  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ purūravasamucyate  || 101.19 ||
sarasvatīsaṃgamaṃ ca brahmatīrthaṃ taducyate  |
siddheśvaro yatra devaḥ sarvakāmapradaṃ tu tat || 101.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sāvitrī caiva gāyatrī śraddhā medhā sarasvatī  |
etāni pañca tīrthāni puṇyāni munayo viduḥ  || 102.1 ||
tatra snātvā tu pītvā tu mucyate sarvakalmaṣāt |
sāvitrī caiva gāyatrī śraddhā medhā sarasvatī  || 102.2 ||
etā mama sutā jyeṣṭhā dharmasaṃsthānahetavaḥ  |
sarvāsāmuttamāṃ kāṃcinnirmame lokasundarīm  || 102.3 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtā buddhirmamāsīnmunisattama  |
gṛhyamāṇā mayā bālā sā māṃ dṛṣṭvā palāyitā  || 102.4 ||
mṛgībhūtā tu sā bālā mṛgo'hamabhavaṃ tadā  |
mṛgavyādho'bhavacchaṃbhurdharmasaṃrakṣaṇāya ca  || 102.5 ||
tā madbhītāḥ pañca sutā gaṅgāmīyurmahānadīm  |
tato maheśvaraḥ prāyāddharmasaṃrakṣaṇāya saḥ  || 102.6 ||
dhanurgṛhītvā saśaramīśo'pi mṛgarūpiṇam  |
māmuvāca vadhiṣye tvāṃ mṛgavyādhastadā haraḥ  || 102.7 ||
tatkarmaṇo nivṛtto'haṃ prādāṃ kanyāṃ vivasvate  |
sāvitryādyāḥ pañca sutā nadīrūpeṇa saṃgatāḥ  || 102.8 ||
tā āgatāḥ punaścāpi svargaṃ lokaṃ mamāntikam  |
yatra tāḥ saṃgatā devyā pañca tīrthāni nārada  || 102.9 ||
saṃgatāni ca puṇyāni pañca nadyaḥ sarasvatī  |
teṣu snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ yatkiṃcitkurute naraḥ  || 102.10 ||
sarvakāmapradaṃ tatsyānnaiṣkarmyānmuktidaṃ smṛtam  |
tatrābhavanmṛgavyādhaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvārthadaṃ nṛṇām  |
svargamokṣaphalaṃ cānyadbrahmatīrthaphalaṃ smṛtam  || 102.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śamītīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpopaśāntidam  |
tasyākhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada  || 103.1 ||
āsītpriyavrato nāma kṣatriyo jayatāṃ varaḥ  |
gautamyā dakṣiṇe tīre dīkṣāṃ cakre purodhasā  || 103.2 ||
hayamedha upakrānte ṛtvigbhirṛṣibhirvṛte  |
tasya rājño mahābāhorvasiṣṭhastu purohitaḥ  || 103.3 ||
tadyajñavāṭamagamaddānavo'tha hiraṇyakaḥ  |
taṃ dānavamabhiprekṣya devāstvindrapurogamāḥ  || 103.4 ||
bhītāḥ keciddivaṃ jagmurhavyavāṭśamimāviśat |
aśvatthaṃ viṣṇuragamadbhānurarkaṃ vaṭaṃ śivaḥ  || 103.5 ||
somaḥ palāśamagamadgaṅgāmbho havyavāhanaḥ  |
aśvinau tu hayaṃ gṛhya vāyaso'bhūdyamaḥ svayam  || 103.6 ||
etasminnantare tatra vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ  |
yaṣṭimādāya daiteyānnyavārayadathājñayā  || 103.7 ||
tataḥ pravṛttaḥ punareva yajño  103.8
daityo gataḥ svena balena yuktaḥ  103.8
imāni tīrthāni tataḥ śubhāni  103.8
daśāśvamedhasya phalāni dadyuḥ  103.8
prathamaṃ tu śamītīrthaṃ dvitīyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viduḥ  |
ārkaṃ śaivaṃ ca saumyaṃ ca vāsiṣṭhaṃ sarvakāmadam  || 103.9 ||
devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarve nivṛtte makhavistare  |
tuṣṭāḥ procurvasiṣṭhaṃ taṃ yajamānaṃ priyavratam  || 103.10 ||
tāṃśca vṛkṣāṃstāṃ ca gaṅgāṃ mudā yuktāḥ punaḥ punaḥ  |
hayamedhasya niṣpattyai ete yātā itastataḥ  || 103.11 ||
hayamedhaphalaṃ dadyustīrthānītyavadan surāḥ  |
tasmātsnānena dānena teṣu tīrtheṣu nārada  |
hayamedhaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti na mṛṣā vacaḥ  || 103.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
viśvāmitraṃ hariścandraṃ śunaḥśepaṃ ca rohitam  |
vāruṇaṃ brāhmamāgneyamaindramaindavamaiśvaram  || 104.1 ||
maitraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva yāmyamāśvinamauśanam  |
eteṣāṃ puṇyatīrthānāṃ nāmadheyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me  || 104.2 ||
hariścandra iti tvāsīdikṣvākuprabhavo nṛpaḥ  |
tasya gṛhe munī prāptau nāradaḥ parvatastathā  |
kṛtvātithyaṃ tayoḥ samyagghariścandro'bravīdṛṣī  || 104.3 ||
{hariścandra uvāca̱ }
putrārthaṃ kliśyate lokaḥ kiṃ putreṇa bhaviṣyati  |
jñānī vāpyathavājñānī uttamo madhyamo'thavā  |
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ nityaṃ brūtāmṛṣivarāvubhau  || 104.4 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tāvūcaturhariścandraṃ parvato nāradastathā  ||* 104.5 ||
{nāradaparvatāvūcatu̱ḥ }
ekadhā daśadhā rājañśatadhā ca sahasradhā  |
uttaraṃ vidyate samyaktathāpyetadudīryate  || 104.6 ||
nāputrasya paro loko vidyate nṛpasattama  |
jāte putre pitā snānaṃ yaḥ karoti janādhipa  || 104.7 ||
daśānāmaśvamedhānāmabhiṣekaphalaṃ labhet |
ātmapratiṣṭhā putrātsyājjāyate cāmarottamaḥ  || 104.8 ||
amṛtenāmarā devāḥ putreṇa brāhmaṇādayaḥ  |
triṛṇānmocayetputraḥ pitaraṃ ca pitāmahān  || 104.9 ||
kiṃ tu mūlaṃ kimu jalaṃ kiṃ tu śmaśrūṇi kiṃ tapaḥ  |
vinā putreṇa rājendra svargo muktiḥ sutātsmṛtāḥ  || 104.10 ||
putra eva paro loko dharmaḥ kāmo'rtha eva ca  |
putro muktiḥ paraṃ jyotistārakaḥ sarvadehinām  || 104.11 ||
vinā putreṇa rājendra svargamokṣau sudurlabhau  |
putra eva paro loke dharmakāmārthasiddhaye  || 104.12 ||
vinā putreṇa yaddattaṃ vinā putreṇa yaddhutam  |
vinā putreṇa yajjanma vyarthaṃ tadavabhāti me  || 104.13 ||
tasmātputrasamaṃ kiṃcitkāmyaṃ nāsti jagattraye  |
tacchrutvā vismayavāṃstāvuvāca nṛpaḥ punaḥ  || 104.14 ||
{hariścandra uvāca̱ }
kathaṃ me syātsuto brūtāṃ yatra kvāpi yathātatham  |
yena kenāpyupāyena kṛtvā kiṃcittu pauruṣam  |
mantreṇa yāgadānābhyāmutpādyo'sau suto mayā  || 104.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tāvūcaturnṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ hariścandraṃ sutārthinam  |
dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ tathā samyaggautamīṃ yāhi mānada  || 104.16 ||
tatrāpāṃpatirutkṛṣṭaṃ dadāti manasīpsitam  |
varuṇaḥ sarvadātā vai munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ  || 104.17 ||
sa tu prītaḥ śanaiḥ kāle tava putraṃ pradāsyati  |
etacchrutvā nṛpaśreṣṭho munivākyaṃ tathākarot || 104.18 ||
toṣayāmāsa varuṇaṃ gautamītīramāśritaḥ  |
tataśca tuṣṭo varuṇo hariścandramuvāca ha  || 104.19 ||
{varuṇa uvāca̱ }
putraṃ dāsyāmi te rājaṃllokatrayavibhūṣaṇam  |
yadi yakṣyasi tenaiva tava putro bhaveddhruvam  || 104.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
hariścandro'pi varuṇaṃ yakṣye tenetyavocata  |
tato gatvā hariścandraścaruṃ kṛtvā tu vāruṇam  || 104.21 ||
bhāryāyai nṛpatiḥ prādāttato jātaḥ suto nṛpāt |
jāte putre apāmīśaḥ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ  || 104.22 ||
{varuṇa uvāca̱ }
adyaiva putro yaṣṭavyaḥ smarase vacanaṃ purā  ||* 104.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
hariścandro'pi varuṇaṃ provācedaṃ kramāgatam  ||* 104.24 ||
{hariścandra uvāca̱ }
nirdaśo medhyatāṃ yāti paśuryakṣye tato hyaham  ||* 104.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājño varuṇo'gātsvamālayam  |
nirdaśe punarabhyetya yajasvetyāha taṃ nṛpam  || 104.26 ||
rājāpi varuṇaṃ prāha nirdanto niṣphalaḥ paśuḥ  |
paśordanteṣu jāteṣu ehi gacchādhunāppate  || 104.27 ||
tacchrutvā rājavacanaṃ punaḥ prāyādapāṃpatiḥ  |
jāteṣu caiva danteṣu saptavarṣeṣu nārada  || 104.28 ||
punarapyāha rājānaṃ yajasveti tato'bravīt |
rājāpi varuṇaṃ prāha patsyantīme apāṃpate  || 104.29 ||
saṃpatsyanti tathā cānye tato yakṣye vrajādhunā  |
punaḥ prāyātsa varuṇaḥ punardanteṣu nārada  |
yajasveti nṛpaṃ prāha rājā prāha tvapāṃpatim  || 104.30 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
yadā tu kṣatriyo yajñe paśurbhavati vāripa  |
dhanurvedaṃ yadā vetti tadā syātpaśuruttamaḥ  || 104.31 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā rājavacanaṃ varuṇo'gātsvamālayam  |
yadāstreṣu ca śastreṣu samartho'bhūtsa rohitaḥ  || 104.32 ||
sarvavedeṣu śāstreṣu vettābhūtsa tvariṃdamaḥ  |
yuvarājyamanuprāpte rohite ṣoḍaśābdike  || 104.33 ||
prītimānagamattatra yatra rājā sarohitaḥ  |
āgatya varuṇaḥ prāha yajasvādya sutaṃ svakam  || 104.34 ||
omityuktvā nṛpavara ṛtvijaḥ prāha bhūpatiḥ  |
rohitaṃ ca sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ śṛṇvato varuṇasya ca  || 104.35 ||
{hariścandra uvāca̱ }
ehi putra mahāvīra yakṣye tvāṃ varuṇāya hi  ||* 104.36 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kimetadityathovāca rohitaḥ pitaraṃ prati  |
pitāpi tadyathāvṛttamācacakṣe savistaram  |
rohitaḥ pitaraṃ prāha śṛṇvato varuṇasya ca  || 104.37 ||
{rohita uvāca̱ }
ahaṃ pūrvaṃ mahārāja ṛtvigbhiḥ sapurohitaḥ  |
viṣṇave lokanāthāya yakṣye'haṃ tvaritaṃ śuciḥ  |
paśunā varuṇenātha tadanujñātumarhasi  || 104.38 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
rohitasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā vārīśvarastadā  |
kopena mahatāviṣṭo jalodaramathākarot || 104.39 ||
hariścandrasya nṛpate rohitaḥ sa vanaṃ yayau  |
gṛhītvā sa dhanurdivyaṃ rathārūḍho gatavyathaḥ  || 104.40 ||
yatra cārādhya varuṇaṃ hariścandro janeśvaraḥ  |
gaṅgāyāṃ prāptavān putraṃ tatrāgātso'pi rohitaḥ  || 104.41 ||
vyatītānyatha varṣāṇi pañca ṣaṣṭhe pravartati  |
tatra sthitvā nṛpasutaḥ śuśrāva nṛpate rujam  || 104.42 ||
mayā putreṇa jātena piturvai kleśakāriṇā  |
kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ nu kṛtyaṃ syādityevaṃ paryacintayat || 104.43 ||
tasyāstīre ṛṣīn puṇyānapaśyannṛpateḥ sutaḥ  |
gaṅgātīre vartamānamapaśyadṛṣisattamam  || 104.44 ||
ajīgartamiti khyātamṛṣestu vayasaḥ sutam  |
tribhiḥ putrairanuvṛtaṃ bhāryayā kṣīṇavṛttikam  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpateḥ putro namasyedaṃ vaco'bravīt || 104.45 ||
{rohita uvāca̱ }
kṣīṇavṛttiḥ kṛśaḥ kasmāddurmanā iva lakṣyase  ||* 104.46 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ajīgarto'pi covāca rohitaṃ nṛpateḥ sutam  ||* 104.47 ||
{ajīgarta uvāca̱ }
vartanaṃ nāsti dehasya bhoktāro bahavaśca me  |
vinānnena mariṣyāmo brūhi kiṃ karavāmahe  || 104.48 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā punarapyāha nṛpaputra ṛṣiṃ tadā  ||* 104.49 ||
{rohita uvāca̱ }
tava kiṃ vartate citte tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara  ||* 104.50 ||
{ajīgarta uvāca̱ }
hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ gāvo dhānyaṃ vastrādikaṃ na me  |
vidyate nṛpaśārdūla vartanaṃ nāsti me tataḥ  || 104.51 ||
sutā me santi bhāryā ca ahaṃ vai pañcamastathā  |
naiteṣāṃ katamasyāpi kretānnena nṛpottama  || 104.52 ||
{rohita uvāca̱ }
kiṃ krīṇāsi mahābuddhe'jīgarta satyameva me  |
vada nānyacca vaktavyaṃ viprā vai satyavādinaḥ  || 104.53 ||
{ajīgarta uvāca̱ }
trayāṇāmapi putrāṇāmekaṃ vā māṃ tathaiva ca  |
bhāryāṃ vāpi gṛhāṇemāṃ krītvā jīvāmahe vayam  || 104.54 ||
{rohita uvāca̱ }
kiṃ bhāryayā mahābuddhe kiṃ tvayā vṛddharūpiṇā  |
yuvānaṃ dehi putraṃ me putrāṇāṃ yaṃ tvamicchasi  || 104.55 ||
{ajīgarta uvāca̱ }
jyeṣṭhaputraṃ śunaḥpucchaṃ nāhaṃ krīṇāmi rohita  |
mātā kanīyasaṃ cāpi na krīṇāti tato'nayoḥ  |
madhyamaṃ tu śunaḥśepaṃ krīṇāmi vada taddhanam  || 104.56 ||
{rohita uvāca̱ }
varuṇāya paśuḥ kalpyaḥ puruṣo guṇavattaraḥ  |
yadi krīṇāsi mūlyaṃ tvaṃ vada satyaṃ mahāmune  || 104.57 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā tvajīgartaḥ putramūlyamakalpayat |
gavāṃ sahasraṃ dhānyānāṃ niṣkānāṃ cāpi vāsasām  |
rājaputra varaṃ dehi dāsyāmi svasutaṃ tava  || 104.58 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā rohito'pi prādātsavasanaṃ dhanam  |
dattvā jagāma pitaramṛṣiputreṇa rohitaḥ  |
pitre nivedayāmāsa krayakrītamṛṣeḥ sutam  || 104.59 ||
{rohita uvāca̱ }
varuṇāya yajasva tvaṃ paśunā tvamarugbhava  ||* 104.60 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathovāca hariścandraḥ putravākyādanantaram  ||* 104.61 ||
{hariścandra uvāca̱ }
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā rājñā pālyā iti śrutiḥ  |
viśeṣatastu varṇānāṃ guravo hi dvijottamāḥ  || 104.62 ||
viṣṇorapi hi ye pūjyā mādṛśāḥ kuta eva hi  |
avajñayāpi yeṣāṃ syānnṛpāṇāṃ svakulakṣayaḥ  || 104.63 ||
tān paśūn kṛtvā kṛpaṇaṃ kathaṃ rakṣitumutsahe  |
ahaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ kuryāṃ paśuṃ naitaddhi yujyate  || 104.64 ||
varaṃ hi jātu maraṇaṃ na kathaṃciddvijaṃ paśum  |
karomi tasmātputra tvaṃ brāhmaṇena sukhaṃ vraja  || 104.65 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etasminnantare tatra vāguvācāśarīriṇī  ||* 104.66 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
gautamīṃ gaccha rājendra ṛtvigbhiḥ sapurohitaḥ  |
paśunā vipraputreṇa rohitena sutena ca  || 104.67 ||
tvayā kāryaḥ kratuścaiva śunaḥśepavadhaṃ vinā  |
kratuḥ pūrṇo bhavettatra tasmādyāhi mahāmate  || 104.68 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ śīghraṃ gaṅgāmagānnṛpottamaḥ  |
viśvāmitreṇa ṛṣiṇā vasiṣṭhena purodhasā  || 104.69 ||
vāmadevena ṛṣiṇā tathānyairmunibhiḥ saha  |
prāpya gaṅgāṃ gautamīṃ tāṃ naramedhāya dīkṣitaḥ  || 104.70 ||
vedimaṇḍapakuṇḍādi yūpapaśvādi cākarot |
kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ tasmin yajñe pravartite  || 104.71 ||
śunaḥśepaṃ paśuṃ yūpe nibadhyātha samantrakam  |
vāribhiḥ prokṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā viśvāmitro'bravīdidam  || 104.72 ||
{viśvāmitra uvāca̱ }
devānṛṣīn hariścandraṃ rohitaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ  |
anujānantvimaṃ sarve śunaḥśepaṃ dvijottamam  || 104.73 ||
yebhyastvayaṃ havirdeyo devebhyo'yaṃ pṛthakpṛthak |
anujānantu te sarve śunaḥśepaṃ viśeṣataḥ  || 104.74 ||
vasābhirlomabhistvagbhirmāṃsaiḥ sanmantritairmakhe  |
agnau hoṣyaḥ paśuścāyaṃ śunaḥśepo dvijottamaḥ  || 104.75 ||
upāsitāḥ syurviprendrāste sarve tvanumanya mām  |
gautamīṃ yāntu viprendrāḥ snātvā devān pṛthakpṛthak || 104.76 ||
mantraiḥ stotraiḥ stuvantaste mudaṃ yāntu śive ratāḥ  |
enaṃ rakṣantu munayo devāśca haviṣo bhujaḥ  || 104.77 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyūcuśca munayo mene ca nṛpasattamaḥ  |
tato gatvā śunaḥśepo gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm  || 104.78 ||
snātvā tuṣṭāva tān devān ye tatra haviṣo bhujaḥ  |
tatastuṣṭāḥ suragaṇāḥ śunaḥśepaṃ ca te mune  |
avadanta surāḥ sarve viśvāmitrasya śṛṇvataḥ  || 104.79 ||
{surā ūcu̱ḥ }
kratuḥ pūrṇo bhavatveṣa śunaḥśepavadhaṃ vinā  ||* 104.80 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
viśeṣeṇātha varuṇaścāvadannṛpasattamam  |
tataḥ pūrṇo'bhavadrājño nṛmedho lokaviśrutaḥ  || 104.81 ||
devānāṃ ca prasādena munīnāṃ ca prasādataḥ  |
tīrthasya tu prasādena rājñaḥ pūrṇo'bhavatkratuḥ  || 104.82 ||
viśvāmitraḥ śunaḥśepaṃ pūjayāmāsa saṃsadi  |
akarodātmanaḥ putraṃ pūjayitvā surāntike  || 104.83 ||
jyeṣṭhaṃ cakāra putrāṇāmātmanaḥ sa tu kauśikaḥ  |
na menire ye ca putrā viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ  || 104.84 ||
śunaḥśepasya ca jyaiṣṭhyaṃ tāñśaśāpa sa kauśikaḥ  |
jyaiṣṭhyaṃ ye menire putrāḥ pūjayāmāsa tān sutān  || 104.85 ||
vareṇa muniśārdūlastadetatkathitaṃ mayā  |
etatsarvaṃ yatra jātaṃ gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 104.86 ||
tatra tīrthāni puṇyāni vikhyātāni surādibhiḥ  |
bahūni teṣāṃ nāmāni mattaḥ śṛṇu mahāmate  || 104.87 ||
hariścandraṃ śunaḥśepaṃ viśvāmitraṃ sarohitam  |
ityādyaṣṭa sahasrāṇi tīrthānyatha caturdaśa  || 104.88 ||
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca naramedhaphalapradam  |
ākhyātaṃ cāsya māhātmyaṃ tīrthasya munisattama  || 104.89 ||
yaḥ paṭhetpāṭhayedvāpi śṛṇuyādvāpi bhaktitaḥ  |
aputraḥ putramāpnoti yaccānyanmanasaḥ priyam  || 104.90 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
somatīrthamiti khyātaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam  |
tatra vṛttaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śṛṇu yatnena nārada  || 105.1 ||
somo rājāmṛtamayo gandharvāṇāṃ purābhavat |
na devānāṃ tadā devā māmabhyetyedamabruvan  || 105.2 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
gandharvairāhṛtaḥ somo devānāṃ prāṇadaḥ purā  |
tamadhyāyan suragaṇā ṛṣayastvatiduḥkhitāḥ  |
yathā syātsomo hyasmākaṃ tathā nītirvidhīyatām  || 105.3 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatra vāgvibudhānāha gandharvāḥ strīṣu kāmukāḥ  |
tebhyo dattvātha māṃ devāḥ somamāhartumarhatha  || 105.4 ||
vācaṃ pratyūcuramarāstvāṃ dātuṃ na kṣamā vayam  |
vinā tenāpi na sthātuṃ śakyaṃ naiva tvayā vinā  || 105.5 ||
punarvāgabravīddevān punareṣyāmyahaṃ tviha  |
atra buddhirvidhātavyā kriyatāṃ kraturuttamaḥ  || 105.6 ||
gautamyā dakṣiṇe tīre bhaveddevāgamo yadi  |
makhaṃ tu viṣayaṃ kṛtvā āyāntu surasattamāḥ  || 105.7 ||
gandharvāḥ strīpriyā nityaṃ paṇadhvaṃ taṃ mayā saha  |
tathetyuktvā suragaṇāḥ sarasvatyā vacaḥsthitāḥ  || 105.8 ||
devadūtaiḥ pṛthagdevān yakṣān gandharvapannagān  |
āhvānaṃ cakrire tatra puṇye devagirau tadā  || 105.9 ||
tato devagirirnāma parvatasyābhavanmune  |
tatrāgaman suragaṇā gandharvā yakṣakiṃnarāḥ  || 105.10 ||
devāḥ siddhāśca ṛṣayastathāṣṭau devayonayaḥ  |
ṛṣibhirgautamītīre kriyamāṇe mahādhvare  || 105.11 ||
tatra devaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sahasrākṣo'bhyabhāṣata  ||* 105.12 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
gandharvānatha saṃpūjya sarasvatyāḥ samīpataḥ  |
sarasvatyā paṇadhvaṃ no yuṣmākamamṛtātmanā  || 105.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchakravacanātte vai gandharvāḥ strīṣu kāmukāḥ  |
somaṃ dattvā surebhyastu jagṛhustāṃ sarasvatīm  || 105.14 ||
somo'bhavaccāmarāṇāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ sarasvatī  |
avasattatra vāgīśā tathāpi ca surāntike  || 105.15 ||
āyāti ca raho nityamupāṃśu kriyatāmiti  |
ata eva hi somasya krayo bhavati nārada  || 105.16 ||
upāṃśunā vartitavyaṃ somakrayaṇa eva hi  |
tato'bhavaddevatānāṃ somaścāpi sarasvatī  || 105.17 ||
gandharvāṇāṃ naiva somo naivāsīcca sarasvatī  |
tatrāgaman sarva eva somārthaṃ gautamītaṭam  || 105.18 ||
gāvo devāḥ parvatā yakṣarakṣāḥ  105.19
siddhāḥ sādhyā munayo guhyakāś 105.19
gandharvāste marutaḥ pannagāś 105.19
sarvauṣadhyo mātaro lokapālāḥ  105.19
rudrādityā vasavaścāśvinau ca  105.19
ye'nye devā yajñabhāgasya yogyāḥ  105.19
pañcaviṃśatinadyastu gaṅgāyāṃ saṃgatā mune  |
pūrṇāhutiryatra dattā pūrṇākhyānaṃ taducyate  || 105.20 ||
gautamyāṃ saṃgatā yāstu sarvāścāpi yathoditāḥ  |
tannāmadheyatīrthāni saṃkṣepācchṛṇu nārada  || 105.21 ||
somatīrthaṃ ca gāndharvaṃ devatīrthamataḥ param  |
pūrṇātīrthaṃ tataḥ śālaṃ śrīparṇāsaṃgamaṃ tathā  || 105.22 ||
svāgatāsaṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ kusumāyāśca saṃgamam  |
puṣṭisaṃgamamākhyātaṃ karṇikāsaṃgamaṃ śubham  || 105.23 ||
vaiṇavīsaṃgamaścaiva kṛśarāsaṃgamastathā  |
vāsavīsaṃgamaścaiva śivaśaryā tathā śikhī  || 105.24 ||
kusumbhikā upārathyā śāntijā devajā tadā  |
ajo vṛddhaḥ suro bhadro gautamyā saha saṃgatāḥ  || 105.25 ||
ete cānye ca bahavo nadīnadasahāyagāḥ  |
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni hyagaman devaparvate  || 105.26 ||
somārthaṃ vai tathā cānye'pyāgamanmakhamaṇḍapam  |
tāni tīrthāni gaṅgāyāṃ saṃgatāni yathākramam  || 105.27 ||
nadīrūpeṇa kānyeva nadarūpeṇa kānicit |
sarorūpeṇa kānyatra stavarūpeṇa kānicit || 105.28 ||
tānyeva sarvatīrthāni vikhyātāni pṛthakpṛthak |
teṣu snānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛtarpaṇameva ca  || 105.29 ||
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ bhuktidaṃ muktibhājanam  |
eteṣāṃ paṭhanaṃ cāpi smaraṇaṃ vā karoti yaḥ  |
sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇupuraṃ janaḥ  || 105.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pravarāsaṃgamo nāma śreṣṭhā caiva mahānadī  |
yatra siddheśvaro devaḥ sarvalokopakārakṛt || 106.1 ||
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca saṃgamo'bhūtsudāruṇaḥ  |
teṣāṃ parasparaṃ vāpi prītiścābhūnmahāmune  || 106.2 ||
te'pyevaṃ mantrayāmāsurdevā vai dānavā mithaḥ  |
meruparvatamāsādya parasparahitaiṣiṇaḥ  || 106.3 ||
{devadaityā ūcu̱ḥ }
amṛtenāmaratvaṃ syādutpādyāmṛtamuttamam  |
pibāmaḥ sarva evaite bhavāmaścāmarā vayam  || 106.4 ||
ekībhūtvā vayaṃ lokān pālayāmaḥ sukhāni ca  |
prāpsyāmaḥ saṃgaraṃ hitvā saṃgaro duḥkhakāraṇam  || 106.5 ||
prītyā caivārjitānarthān bhokṣyāmo gatamatsarāḥ  |
yataḥ snehena vṛttiryā sāsmākaṃ sukhadā sadā  || 106.6 ||
vaiparītyaṃ tu yadvṛttaṃ na smartavyaṃ kadācana  |
na ca trailokyarājye'pi kaivalye vā sukhaṃ manāk |
tadūrdhvamapi vā yattu nirvairatvādavāpyate  || 106.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ parasparaṃ prītāḥ santo devāśca dānavāḥ  |
ekībhūtāśca suprītā vimathya varuṇālayam  || 106.8 ||
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā rajjuṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim  |
devāśca dānavāḥ sarve mamanthurvaruṇālayam  || 106.9 ||
utpannaṃ ca tataḥ puṇyamamṛtaṃ suravallabham  |
niṣpanne cāmṛte puṇye te ca procuḥ parasparam  || 106.10 ||
yāmaḥ svaṃ svamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kṛtakāryāḥ śramaṃ gatāḥ  |
sarve samaṃ ca sarvebhyo yathāyogyaṃ vibhajyatām  || 106.11 ||
yadā sarvāgamo yatra yasmiṃllagne śubhāvahe  |
vibhajyatāmidaṃ puṇyamamṛtaṃ surasattamāḥ  || 106.12 ||
ityuktvā te yayuḥ sarve daityadānavarākṣasāḥ  |
gateṣu daityasaṃgheṣu devāḥ sarve'nvamantrayan  || 106.13 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
gatāste ripavo'smākaṃ daivayogādariṃdamāḥ  |
ripūṇāmamṛtaṃ naiva deyaṃ bhavati sarvathā  || 106.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bṛhaspatistathetyāha punarāha surānidam  ||* 106.15 ||
{bṛhaspatiruvāca̱ }
na jānanti yathā pāpā pibadhvaṃ ca tathāmṛtam  |
ayamevocito mantro yacchatrūṇāṃ parābhavaḥ  || 106.16 ||
dveṣyāḥ sarvātmanā dveṣyā iti nītivido viduḥ  |
na viśvāsyā na cākhyeyā naiva mantryāśca śatravaḥ  || 106.17 ||
tebhyo na deyamamṛtaṃ bhaveyuramarāstataḥ  |
amareṣu ca jāteṣu teṣu daityeṣu śatruṣu  |
tāñjetuṃ naiva śakṣyāmo na deyamamṛtaṃ tataḥ  || 106.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti saṃmantrya te devā vācaspatimathābruvan  ||* 106.19 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
kva yāmaḥ kutra mantraḥ syātkva pibāmaḥ kva saṃsthitiḥ  |
kurmastadeva prathamaṃ vada vācaspate tathā  || 106.20 ||
{bṛhaspatiruvāca̱ }
yāntu brahmāṇamamarāḥ pṛcchantvatra gatiṃ parām  |
sa tu jñātā ca vaktā ca dātā caiva pitāmahaḥ  || 106.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bṛhaspatervacaḥ śrutvā madantikamathāgaman  |
namasya māṃ surāḥ sarve yadvṛttaṃ tannyavedayan  || 106.22 ||
taddevavacanātputra taiḥ surairagamaṃ harim  |
viṣṇave kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃbhave viṣahāriṇe  || 106.23 ||
ahaṃ viṣṇuśca śaṃbhuśca devagandharvakiṃnaraiḥ  |
merukandaramāgatya na jānanti yathāsurāḥ  || 106.24 ||
rakṣakaṃ ca hariṃ kṛtvā somapānāya tasthire  |
ādityastatra vijñātā somabhojyānathetarān  || 106.25 ||
somo dātāmṛtaṃ bhāgaṃ cakradhṛgrakṣakastathā  |
naiva jānanti taddaityā danujā rākṣasāstathā  || 106.26 ||
vinā rāhuṃ mahāprājñaṃ saiṃhikeyaṃ ca somapam  |
kāmarūpadharo rāhurmarutāṃ madhyamāviśat || 106.27 ||
marudrūpaṃ samāsthāya pānapātradharastathā  |
jñātvā divākaro daityaṃ taṃ somāya nyavedayat || 106.28 ||
tadā tadamṛtaṃ tasmai daityāyādaityarūpiṇe  |
dattvā somaṃ tadā somo viṣṇave tannyavedayat || 106.29 ||
viṣṇuḥ pītāmṛtaṃ daityaṃ cakreṇodyamya tacchiraḥ  |
ciccheda tarasā vatsa tacchirastvamaraṃ tvabhūt || 106.30 ||
śiromātravihīnaṃ yaddehaṃ tadapatadbhuvi  |
dehaṃ tadamṛtaspṛṣṭaṃ patitaṃ dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 106.31 ||
gautamyā muniśārdūla kampayadvasudhātalam  |
dehaṃ cāpyamaraṃ putra tadadbhutamivābhavat || 106.32 ||
dehaṃ ca śiraso'pekṣi śiro dehamapekṣate  |
ubhayaṃ cāmaraṃ jātaṃ daityaścāyaṃ mahābalaḥ  || 106.33 ||
śiraḥ kāye samāviṣṭaṃ sarvān bhakṣayate surān  |
tasmāddehamidaṃ pūrvaṃ nāśayāmo mahīgatam  |
tataste śaṃkaraṃ prāhurdevāḥ sarve sasaṃbhramāḥ  || 106.34 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
mahīgataṃ daityadehaṃ nāśayasva surottama  |
tvaṃ deva karuṇāsindhuḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ  || 106.35 ||
śirasā naiva yujyeta daityadehaṃ tathā kuru  ||* 106.36 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
preṣayāmāsa ceśo'pi śreṣṭhāṃ śaktiṃ tadātmanaḥ  |
mātṛbhiḥ sahitāṃ devīṃ mātaraṃ lokapālinīm  || 106.37 ||
īśāyudhadharā devī īśaśaktisamanvitā  |
mahīgataṃ yatra dehaṃ tatrāgādbhakṣyakāṅkṣiṇī  || 106.38 ||
śiromātraṃ surāḥ sarve merau tatraiva sāntvayan  |
deho devyā punastatra yuyudhe bahavaḥ samāḥ  || 106.39 ||
rāhustatra surānāha bhittvā dehaṃ purā mama  |
atrāste rasamutkṛṣṭaṃ tadākṛṣya śarīrataḥ  || 106.40 ||
pṛthakbhūte rase dehaṃ pravare'mṛtamuttamam  |
bhasmībhūyātkṣaṇenaiva tasmātkurvantu tatpurā  || 106.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etadrāhuvacaḥ śrutvā prītāḥ sarve'surārayaḥ  |
abhyaṣiñcan grahāṇāṃ tvaṃ graho bhūyā mudānvitaḥ  || 106.42 ||
taddevavacanācchaktirīśvarī yā nigadyate  |
dehaṃ bhittvā daityapateḥ suraśaktisamanvitā  || 106.43 ||
ākṛṣya śīghramutkṛṣṭaṃ pravaraṃ cāmṛtaṃ bahiḥ  |
sthāpayitvā tu taddehaṃ bhakṣayāmāsa cāmbikā  || 106.44 ||
kālarātrirbhadrakālī procyate yā mahābalā  |
sthāpitaṃ rasamutkṛṣṭaṃ rasānāṃ pravaraṃ rasam  || 106.45 ||
vyasravatsthāpitaṃ tattu pravarā sābhavannadī  |
ākṛṣṭamamṛtaṃ caiva sthāpitaṃ sāpyabhakṣayat || 106.46 ||
tataḥ śreṣṭhā nadī jātā pravarā cāmṛtā śubhā  |
rāhudehasamudbhūtā rudraśaktisamanvitā  || 106.47 ||
nadīnāṃ pravarā ramyā cāmṛtā preritā tahā  |
tatra pañca sahasrāṇi tīrthāni guṇavanti ca  || 106.48 ||
tatra śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ tasthau sarvadā surapūjitaḥ  |
tasyai tuṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve devyai nadyai pṛthakpṛthak || 106.49 ||
varān dadurmudā yuktā yathā pūjāmavāpsyati  |
śaṃbhuḥ surapatirloke tathā pūjāmavāpsyasi  || 106.50 ||
nivāsaṃ kuru devi tvaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  |
sadā tiṣṭha raseśāni sarveṣāṃ sarvasiddhidā  || 106.51 ||
stavanātkīrtanāddhyānātsarvakāmapradāyinī  |
tvāṃ namasyanti ye bhaktyā kiṃcidāpekṣya sarvadā  || 106.52 ||
teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi bhaveyurdevatājñayā  |
śivaśaktyoryatastasminnivāso'bhūtsanātanaḥ  || 106.53 ||
ato vadanti munayo nivāsapuramityadaḥ  |
pravarāyāḥ purā devāḥ suprītāste varān daduḥ  || 106.54 ||
gaṅgāyāḥ saṃgamo yaste vikhyātaḥ suravallabhaḥ  |
tatrāplutānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhuktirvā muktireva ca  || 106.55 ||
yadvāpi manasaḥ kāmyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham  |
syātteṣāṃ sarvameveha evaṃ dattvā surā yayuḥ  || 106.56 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ pravarāsaṃgamaṃ viduḥ  |
preritā devadevena śaktiryā preritā tu sā  || 106.57 ||
amṛtā saiva vikhyātā pravaraivaṃ mahānadī  ||* 106.58 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vṛddhāsaṃgamamākhyātaṃ yatra vṛddheśvaraḥ śivaḥ  |
tasyākhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pāpapraṇāśanam  || 107.1 ||
gautamo vṛddha ityukto munirāsīnmahātapāḥ  |
yadā purābhavadbālo gautamasya suto dvijaḥ  || 107.2 ||
anāsaḥ sa purotpannastasmādvikṛtarūpadhṛk |
sa vairāgyājjagāmātha deśaṃ tīrthamitastataḥ  || 107.3 ||
upādhyāyena naivāsīllajjitasya samāgamaḥ  |
śiṣyairanyaiḥ sahādhyāyo lajjitasya ca nābhavat || 107.4 ||
upanītaḥ kathaṃcicca pitrā vai gautamena saḥ  |
etāvatā gautamo'pi vyagamaccarituṃ bahiḥ  || 107.5 ||
evaṃ bahutithe kāle brahmamātrā dhṛte dvije  |
naiva cādhyayanaṃ tasya saṃjātaṃ gautamasya hi  || 107.6 ||
naiva śāstrasya cābhyāso gautamasyābhavattadā  |
agnikāryaṃ tataścakre nityameva yatavrataḥ  || 107.7 ||
gāyatryabhyāsamātreṇa brāhmaṇo nāmadhārakaḥ  |
agnyupāsanamātraṃ ca gāyatryabhyasanaṃ tathā  || 107.8 ||
etāvatā brāhmaṇatvaṃ gautamasyābhavanmune  |
upāsato'gniṃ vidhivadgāyatrīṃ ca mahātmanaḥ  || 107.9 ||
tasyāyurvavṛdhe putra gautamasya cirāyuṣaḥ  |
na dārasaṃgrahaṃ lebhe naiva dātāsti kanyakām  || 107.10 ||
tathā caraṃstīrthadeśe vaneṣu vividheṣu ca  |
āśrameṣu ca puṇyeṣu aṭannāste sa gautamaḥ  || 107.11 ||
evaṃ bhramañśītagirimāśrityāste sa gautamaḥ  |
tatrāpaśyadguhāṃ ramyāṃ vallīviṭapamālinīm  || 107.12 ||
tatropaviśya viprendro vastuṃ samakaronmatim  |
cintayaṃstu praviṣṭo'sāvapaśyatstriyamuttamām  || 107.13 ||
śithilāṅgīmatha kṛśāṃ vṛddhāṃ ca tapasi sthitām  |
brahmacaryeṇa vartantīṃ virāgāṃ rahasi sthitām  || 107.14 ||
sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā muniśreṣṭho namaskārāya tasthivān  |
namasyantaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ taṃ gautamamavārayat || 107.15 ||
{vṛddhovāca̱ }
gurustvaṃ bhavitā mahyaṃ na māṃ vanditumarhasi  |
āyurvidyā dhanaṃ kīrtirdharmaḥ svargādikaṃ ca yat |
tasya naśyati vai sarvaṃ yaṃ namasyati vai guruḥ  || 107.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kṛtāñjalipuṭastāṃ vai gautamaḥ prāha vismitaḥ  ||* 107.17 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
tapasvinī tvaṃ vṛddhā ca guṇajyeṣṭhā ca bhāminī  |
alpavidyastvalpavayā ahaṃ tava guruḥ katham  || 107.18 ||
{vṛddhovāca̱ }
ārṣṭiṣeṇapriyaputra ṛtadhvaja iti śrutaḥ  |
guṇavānmatimāñśūraḥ kṣatradharmaparāyaṇaḥ  || 107.19 ||
sa kadācidvanaṃ prāyānmṛgayākṛṣṭacetanaḥ  |
viśrāmamakarodasyāṃ guhāyāṃ sa ṛtadhvajaḥ  || 107.20 ||
yuvā sa matimān dakṣo balena mahatā vṛtaḥ  |
taṃ viśrāntaṃ nṛpavaramapsarā dadṛśe tataḥ  || 107.21 ||
gandharvarājasya sutā suśyāmā iti viśrutā  |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cakame rājā rājānaṃ cakame ca sā  || 107.22 ||
iti krīḍā samabhavattayā rājño mahāmate  |
nivṛttakāmo rājendrastāmāpṛcchyāgamadgṛham  || 107.23 ||
utpannāhaṃ tatastasyāṃ suśyāmāyāṃ mahāmate  |
gacchantī māṃ tadā mātā idamāha tapodhana  || 107.24 ||
{suśyāmovāca̱ }
yastvasyāṃ praviśedbhadre sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati  ||* 107.25 ||
{vṛddhovāca̱ }
ityuktvā sā jagamātha mātā mama mahāmate  |
tasmādatra praviṣṭastvaṃ pumānnānyaḥ kadācana  || 107.26 ||
sahasrāṇi tathāśītiṃ kṛtvā rājyaṃ pitā mama  |
atraiva ca tapastaptvā tataḥ svargamupeyivān  || 107.27 ||
svargaṃ yāte'pi pitari sahasrāṇi tathā daśa  |
varṣāṇi muniśārdūla rājyaṃ kṛtvā tathā paraḥ  || 107.28 ||
svarge yāto mama bhrātā ahamatraiva saṃsthitā  |
ahaṃ brahmannānyavṛttā na mātā na pitā mama  || 107.29 ||
ahamātmeśvarī brahmanniviṣṭā kṣatrakanyakā  |
tasmādbhajasva māṃ brahman vratasthāṃ puruṣārthinīm  || 107.30 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
sahasrāyurahaṃ bhadre mattastvaṃ vayasādhikā  |
ahaṃ bālastvaṃ tu vṛddhā naivāyaṃ ghaṭate mithaḥ  || 107.31 ||
{vṛddhovāca̱ }
tvaṃ bhartā me purā diṣṭo nānyo bhartā mato mama  |
dhātrā dattastatastvaṃ māṃ na nirākartumarhasi  || 107.32 ||
athavā necchasi māṃ tvamapraduṣṭāmanuvratām  |
tatastyakṣyāmi jīvaṃ me idānīṃ tava paśyataḥ  || 107.33 ||
apekṣitāprāptito hi dehināṃ maraṇaṃ varam  |
anuraktajanatyāge pātakānto na vidyate  || 107.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vṛddhāyāstadvacaḥ śrutvā gautamo vākyamabravīt ||* 107.35 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
ahaṃ tapovirahito vidyāhīno hyakiṃcanaḥ  |
nāhaṃ varo hi yogyaste kurūpo bhogavarjitaḥ  || 107.36 ||
anāso'haṃ kiṃ karomi atapovidya eva ca  |
tasmātsurūpaṃ suvidyāmāpādya prathamaṃ śubhe  |
paścātte vacanaṃ kāryaṃ tato vṛddhābravīddvijam  || 107.37 ||
{vṛddhovāca̱ }
mayā sarasvatī devī toṣitā tapasā dvija  |
tathaivāpo rūpavatyo rūpadātāgnireva ca  || 107.38 ||
tasmādvāgīśvarī devī sā te vidyāṃ pradāsyati  |
agniśca rūpavān devastava rūpaṃ pradāsyati  || 107.39 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā gautamaṃ taṃ vṛddhovāca vibhāvasum  |
prārthayitvā suvidyaṃ taṃ surūpaṃ cākaronmunim  || 107.40 ||
tataḥ suvidyaḥ subhagaḥ sukānto  107.41
vṛddhāṃ sa patnīmakarotprītiyuktaḥ  107.41
tayā sa reme bahulā manojñayā  107.41
samāḥ sukhaṃ prītamanā guhāyām  107.41
kadācittatra vasatordaṃpatyormudatorgirau  |
guhāyāṃ muniśārdūla ājagmurmunayo'malāḥ  || 107.42 ||
vasiṣṭhavāmadevādyā ye cānye ca maharṣayaḥ  |
bhramantaḥ puṇyatīrthāni prāpnuvaṃstasya tāṃ guhām  || 107.43 ||
āgatāṃstānṛṣīñjñātvā gautamaḥ saha bhāryayā  |
satkāramakarotteṣāṃ jahasustaṃ ca kecana  || 107.44 ||
ye bālā yauvanonmattā vayasā ye ca madhyamāḥ  |
vṛddhāṃ ca gautamaṃ prekṣya jahasustatra kecana  || 107.45 ||
{ṛṣaya ūcu̱ḥ }
putro'yaṃ tava pautro vā vṛddhe ko gautamo'bhavat |
satyaṃ vadasva kalyāṇi ityevaṃ jahasurdvijāḥ  || 107.46 ||
viṣaṃ vṛddhasya yuvatī vṛddhāyā amṛtaṃ yuvā  |
iṣṭāniṣṭasamāyogo dṛṣṭo'smābhiraho cirāt || 107.47 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityevamūcire keciddaṃpatyoḥ śṛṇvatostadā  |
evamuktvā kṛtātithyā yayuḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ  || 107.48 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā ubhāvapi suduḥkhitau  |
lajjitau ca mahāprājñau gautamo bhāryayā saha  |
papraccha muniśārdūlamagastyamṛṣisattamam  || 107.49 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
ko deśaḥ kimu tīrthaṃ vā yatra śreyaḥ samāpyate  |
śīghrameva mahāprājña bhuktimuktipradāyakam  || 107.50 ||
{agastya uvāca̱ }
vadadbhirmunibhirbrahmanmayā śrutamidaṃ vacaḥ  |
sarve kāmāstatra pūrṇā gautamyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 107.51 ||
tasmādgaccha mahābuddhe gautamīṃ pāpanāśinīm  |
ahaṃ tvāmanuyāsyāmi yathecchasi tathā kuru  || 107.52 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvāgastyavākyaṃ vṛddhayā gautamo'bhyagāt |
tatra tepe tapastīvraṃ patnyā sa bhagavānṛṣiḥ  || 107.53 ||
stutiṃ cakāra devasya śaṃbhorviṣṇostathaiva ca  |
gaṅgāṃ ca toṣayāmāsa bhāryārthaṃ bhagavānṛṣiḥ  || 107.54 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
khinnātmanāmatra bhave tvameva śaraṇaṃ śivaḥ  |
marubhūmāvadhvagānāṃ viṭapīva priyāyutaḥ  || 107.55 ||
uccāvacānāṃ bhūtānāṃ sarvathā pāpanodanaḥ  |
sasyānāṃ ghanavatkṛṣṇa tvamavagrahaśoṣiṇām  || 107.56 ||
vaikuṇṭhadurganiḥśreṇistvaṃ pīyūṣataraṃgiṇī  |
adhogatānāṃ taptānāṃ śaraṇaṃ bhava gautami  || 107.57 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatastuṣṭāvadadvākyaṃ gautamaṃ vṛddhayā yutam  |
śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃ śaraṇyā gautamī mudā  || 107.58 ||
{gautamyuvāca̱ }
abhiṣiñcasva bhāryāṃ tvaṃ majjalairmantrasaṃyutaiḥ  |
kalaśairupacāraiśca tataḥ patnī tava priyā  || 107.59 ||
surūpā cārusarvāṅgī subhagā cārulocanā  |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇā ramyarūpamavāpsyati  || 107.60 ||
rūpavatyā punastvaṃ vai bhāryayā cābhiṣecitaḥ  |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ kāntaṃ rūpamavāpsyasi  || 107.61 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatheti gāṅgavacanādyathoktaṃ tau ca cakratuḥ  |
surūpatāmubhau prāptau gautamyāśca prasādataḥ  || 107.62 ||
abhiṣekodakaṃ yacca sā nadī samajāyata  |
tasyā nāmnā tu vikhyātā vṛddhāyā munisattama  || 107.63 ||
vṛddhā nadīti vikhyātā gautamo'pi tathocyate  |
vṛddhagautama ityukta ṛṣibhiḥ samavāsibhiḥ  |
vṛddhā tu gautamīṃ prāha gaṅgāṃ pratyakṣarūpiṇīm  || 107.64 ||
{vṛddhovāca̱ }
mannāmnīyaṃ nadī devi vṛddhā cetyabhidhīyatām  |
tvayā ca saṃgamastasyāstasyāstīrthamanuttamam  || 107.65 ||
rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpatti putrapautrapravardhanam  |
āyurārogyakalyāṇaṃ jayaprītivivardhanam  |
snānadānādihomaiśca pitṝṇāṃ pāvanaṃ param  || 107.66 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
astvityāha ca tāṃ gaṅgā suvṛddhāṃ gautamapriyām  |
gautamasthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ vṛddhānāmnaiva kīrtitam  || 107.67 ||
tatraiva ca mudaṃ prāpto vṛddhayā munisattamaḥ  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvābhīṣṭapradāyakam  || 107.68 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vṛddhāsaṃgamamucyate  ||* 107.69 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ilātīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām  |
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ pāvanaṃ sarvakāmadam  || 108.1 ||
vaivasvatānvaye jāta ilo nāma janeśvaraḥ  |
mahatyā senayā sārdhaṃ jagāma mṛgayāvanam  || 108.2 ||
paribabhrāma gahanaṃ bahuvyālasamākulam  |
nānākāradvijayutaṃ viṭapaiḥ pariśobhitam  || 108.3 ||
vanecaraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭho mṛgayāgatamānasaḥ  |
tatraiva matimādhatta ilo'mātyānathābravīt || 108.4 ||
{ila uvāca̱ }
gacchantu nagaraṃ sarve mama putreṇa pālitam  |
deśaṃ kośaṃ balaṃ rājyaṃ pālayantu punaśca tam  || 108.5 ||
vasiṣṭho'pi tathā yātu ādāyāgnīn piteva naḥ  |
patnībhiḥ sahito dhīmānaraṇye'haṃ vasāmyatha  || 108.6 ||
araṇyabhogabhugbhiśca vājivāraṇamānuṣaiḥ  |
mṛgayāśīlibhiḥ kaiścidyāntu sarva itaḥ purīm  || 108.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā yayuste'pi svayaṃ prāyācchanairgirim  |
himavantaṃ ratnamayaṃ vasaṃstatra ilo nṛpaḥ  || 108.8 ||
dadarśa kandaraṃ tatra nānāratnavicitritam  |
tatra yakṣeśvaraḥ kaścitsamanyuriti viśrutaḥ  || 108.9 ||
tasya bhāryā samānāmnī bhartṛvrataparāyaṇā  |
tasmin vasatyasau yakṣo ramaṇīye nagottame  || 108.10 ||
mṛgarūpeṇa vyacaradbhāryayā sa mahāmatiḥ  |
svecchayā svavane yakṣaḥ krīḍate nṛtyagītakaiḥ  || 108.11 ||
itthaṃ sa yakṣo jānāti mṛgarūpadharo'pi ca  |
ilastu taṃ na jānāti kandaraṃ yakṣapālitam  || 108.12 ||
yakṣasya gehaṃ vipulaṃ nānāratnavicitritam  |
tatropaviṣṭo nṛpatirmahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ  || 108.13 ||
vāsaṃ cakre sa tatraiva gehe yakṣasya dhīmataḥ  |
sa yakṣo'dharmakopena bhāryayā mṛgarūpadhṛk || 108.14 ||
ilaṃ jetuṃ na śaknomi yācito na dadāti ca  |
hṛtaṃ gehaṃ mamānena kiṃ karomītyacintayat || 108.15 ||
yudhi mattaṃ kathaṃ hanyāṃ ceti sthitvā sa yakṣarāṭ |
ātmīyān preṣayāmāsa yakṣāñśūrān dhanurdharān  || 108.16 ||
{yakṣa uvāca̱ }
yuddhe jitvā ca rājānamilamuddhatadantinam  |
gṛhādyathānyato yāti mama tatkartumarhatha  || 108.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yakṣeśvarasya tadvākyādyakṣāste yuddhadurmadāḥ  |
ilaṃ gatvābruvan sarve nirgacchāsmādguhālayāt || 108.18 ||
na cedyuddhātparibhraṣṭaḥ palāyya kva gamiṣyasi  |
tadyakṣavacanātkopādyuddhaṃ cakre sa rājarāṭ || 108.19 ||
jitvā yakṣān bahuvidhānuvāsa daśa śarvarīḥ  |
yakṣeśvaro mṛgo bhūtvā bhāryayāpi vane vasan  || 108.20 ||
hṛtageho vanaṃ prāpto hṛtabhṛtyaḥ sa yakṣiṇīm  |
prāha cintāparo bhūtvā mṛgīrūpadharāṃ priyām  || 108.21 ||
{yakṣa uvāca̱ }
rājā'yaṃ durmanāḥ kānte vyasanāsaktamānasaḥ  |
kathamāyāti vipadaṃ tatropāyo vicintyatām  || 108.22 ||
pāparddhivyasanāntāni rājyānyakhilabhūbhujām  |
prāpayomāvanaṃ subhrūrmṛgī bhūtvā manoharā  || 108.23 ||
praviśettatra rājāyaṃ strī bhaviṣyatyasaṃśayam  |
karaṇīyaṃ tvayā bhadre na caitadyujyate mama  |
ahaṃ tu puruṣo yena tvaṃ punaḥ strī ca yakṣiṇī  || 108.24 ||
{yakṣiṇyuvāca̱ }
kathaṃ tvayā na gantavyamumāvanamanuttamam  |
gate'pi tvayi ko doṣastanme kathaya tattvataḥ  || 108.25 ||
{yakṣa uvāca̱ }
himavatparvataśreṣṭha umayā sahitaḥ śivaḥ  |
devairgaṇairanuvṛto vicacāra yathāsukham  |
pārvatī śaṃkaraṃ prāha kadācidrahasi sthitam  || 108.26 ||
{pārvatyuvāca̱ }
strīṇāmeṣa svabhāvo'sti rataṃ gopāyitaṃ bhavet |
tasmānme niyataṃ deśamājñayā rakṣitaṃ tava  || 108.27 ||
dehi me tridaśeśāna umāvanamiti śrutam  |
vinā tvayā gaṇeśena kārttikeyena nandinā  || 108.28 ||
yastvatra praviśennātha strītvaṃ tasya bhavediti  ||* 108.29 ||
{yakṣa uvāca̱ }
ityājñomāvane dattā prasannenendumaulinā  |
kiṃ karomi pumān kānte tvayā praṇayanārditaḥ  |
tasmānmayā na gantavyamumāyā vanamuttamam  || 108.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadbhartṛvacanaṃ śrutvā yakṣiṇī kāmarūpiṇī  |
mṛgī bhūtvā viśālākṣī ilasya purato'bhavat || 108.31 ||
yakṣastu saṃsthitastatra dadarśelo mṛgīṃ tadā  |
mṛgayāsaktacitto vai mṛgīṃ dṛṣṭvā viśeṣataḥ  || 108.32 ||
eka eva hayārūḍho niryayau tāṃ mṛgīmanu  |
sākarṣata śanaistaṃ tu rājānaṃ mṛgayākulam  || 108.33 ||
śanairjagāma sā tatra yadumāvanamucyate  |
adṛśyā tu mṛgī tasmai darśayantī kvacitkvacit || 108.34 ||
tiṣṭhantī caiva gacchantī dhāvantī ca vibhītavat |
hariṇī capalākṣī sā tamākarṣadumāvanam  || 108.35 ||
anuprāpto hayārūḍhastatprāpa sa umāvanam  |
umāvanaṃ praviṣṭaṃ taṃ jñātvā sā yakṣiṇī tadā  || 108.36 ||
mṛgīrūpaṃ parityajya yakṣiṇī kāmarūpiṇī  |
divyarūpaṃ samāsthāya cāśokatarusaṃnidhau  || 108.37 ||
tacchākhālambitakarā divyagandhānulepanā  |
divyarūpadharā tanvī kṛtakāryā samā tadā  || 108.38 ||
hasantī nṛpatiṃ prekṣya śrāntaṃ hayagataṃ tadā  |
mṛgīmālokayantaṃ taṃ capalākṣamilaṃ tadā  || 108.39 ||
bhartṛvākyamaśeṣeṇa smarantī prāha bhūmipam  ||* 108.40 ||
{samovāca̱ }
hayārūḍhābalā tanvi kva ekaiva tu gacchasi  |
puruṣasya ca veṣeṇa ile kamanuyāsyasi  || 108.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ileti vacanaṃ śrutvā rājāsau krodhamūrchitaḥ  |
yakṣiṇīṃ bhartsayitvāsau tāmapṛcchanmṛgīṃ punaḥ  || 108.42 ||
tathāpi yakṣiṇī prāha ile kimanuvīkṣase  |
ileti vacanaṃ śrutvā dhṛtacāpo hayasthitaḥ  || 108.43 ||
kupito darśayāmāsa trailokyavijayī dhanuḥ  |
punaḥ sā prāha nṛpatiṃ mahātmānamile svayam  || 108.44 ||
prekṣasva paścānmāṃ brūhi asatyāṃ satyavādinīm  |
tadā cālokayadrājā stanau tuṅgau bhujāntare  || 108.45 ||
kimidaṃ mama saṃjātamityevaṃ cakito'bhavat ||* 108.46 ||
{ilovāca̱ }
kimidaṃ mama saṃjātaṃ jānīte bhavatī sphuṭam  |
vada sarvaṃ yathātathyaṃ tvaṃ kā vā vada suvrate  || 108.47 ||
{yakṣiṇyuvāca̱ }
himavatkandaraśreṣṭhe samanyurvasate patiḥ  |
yakṣāṇāmadhipaḥ śrīmāṃstadbhāryāhaṃ tu yakṣiṇī  || 108.48 ||
yatkandare bhavān rājā tūpaviṣṭaḥ suśītale  |
yasya yakṣā hatā mohāttvayā hi saṃgaraṃ vinā  || 108.49 ||
tato'haṃ nirgamārthaṃ te mṛgī bhūtvā umāvanam  |
praviṣṭā tvaṃ praviṣṭo'si purā prāha maheśvaraḥ  || 108.50 ||
yastvatra praviśenmandaḥ pumān strītvamavāpsyati  |
tasmātstrītvamavāpto'si na tvaṃ duḥkhitumarhasi  |
prauḍho'pi ko'tra jānāti vicitrabhavitavyatām  || 108.51 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yakṣiṇīvacanaṃ śrutvā hayārūḍhastadāpatat |
tamāśvāsya punaḥ saiva yakṣiṇī vākyamabravīt || 108.52 ||
{yakṣiṇyuvāca̱ }
strītvaṃ jātaṃ jātameva na puṃstvaṃ kartumarhasi  |
gṛhāṇa vidyāṃ strīyogyāṃ nṛtyaṃ gītamalaṃkṛtim  |
strīlālityaṃ strīvilāsaṃ strīkṛtyaṃ sarvameva tat || 108.53 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ilā sarvamathāvāpya yakṣiṇīṃ vākyamabravīt ||* 108.54 ||
{ilovāca̱ }
ko vā bhartā kiṃ tu kṛtyaṃ punaḥ puṃstvaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
etadvadasva kalyāṇī duḥkhārtāyā viśeṣataḥ  |
ārtānāmārtiśamanācchreyo nābhyadhikaṃ kvacit || 108.55 ||
{yakṣiṇyuvāca̱ }
budhaḥ somasuto nāma vanādasmācca pūrvataḥ  |
āśramastasya subhage pitaraṃ nityameṣyati  || 108.56 ||
anenaiva pathā somaṃ pitaraṃ sa budho grahaḥ  |
draṣṭuṃ yāti tato nityaṃ namaskartuṃ tathaiva ca  || 108.57 ||
yadā yāti budhaḥ śāntastadātmānaṃ ca darśaya  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ tu subhage sarvakāmānavāpsyasi  || 108.58 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tāmāśvāsya tataḥ subhrūryakṣiṇyantaradhīyata  |
yakṣiṇī sā tamācaṣṭa yakṣo'pi sukhamāptavān  || 108.59 ||
ilasainyaṃ ca tatrāsīttadgataṃ ca yathāsukham  |
umāvanasthitā celā gāyantī nṛtyatī punaḥ  || 108.60 ||
strībhāvamanuceṣṭantī smarantī karmaṇo gatim  |
kadācitkriyamāṇe tu ilayā nṛtyakarmaṇi  || 108.61 ||
tāmapaśyadbudho dhīmān pitaraṃ gantumudyataḥ  |
ilāṃ dṛṣṭvā gatiṃ tyaktvā tāmāgatyābravīdbudhaḥ  || 108.62 ||
{budha uvāca̱ }
bhāryā bhava mama svasthā sarvābhyastvaṃ priyā bhava  ||* 108.63 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
budhavākyamilā bhaktyā tvabhinandya tathākarot |
smṛtvā ca yakṣiṇīvākyaṃ tatastuṣṭābhavanmune  || 108.64 ||
budho reme tayā prītyā nītvā svasthānamuttamam  |
sā cāpi sarvabhāvena toṣayāmāsa taṃ patim  |
tato bahutithe kāle budhastuṣṭo'vadatpriyām  || 108.65 ||
{budha uvāca̱ }
kiṃ te deyaṃ mayā bhadre priyaṃ yanmanasi sthitam  ||* 108.66 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvākyasamakālaṃ tu putraṃ dehītyabhāṣata  |
ilā budhaṃ somasutaṃ prītimantaṃ priyaṃ tathā  || 108.67 ||
{budha uvāca̱ }
amoghametanmadvīryaṃ tathā prītisamudbhavam  |
putraste bhavitā tasmātkṣatriyo lokaviśrutaḥ  || 108.68 ||
somavaṃśakaraḥ śrīmānāditya iva tejasā  |
buddhyā bṛhaspatisamaḥ kṣamayā pṛthivīsamaḥ  || 108.69 ||
vīryeṇājau haririva kopena hutabhugyathā  ||* 108.70 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasminnutpadyamāne tu budhaputre mahātmani  |
jayaśabdaśca sarvatra tvāsīcca suraveśmani  || 108.71 ||
budhaputre samutpanne tatrājagmuḥ sureśvarāḥ  |
ahamapyāgamaṃ tatra mudā yukto mahāmate  || 108.72 ||
jātamātraḥ suto rāvamakarotsa pṛthusvaram  |
tena sarve'pyavocan vai saṃgatā ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ  || 108.73 ||
yasmātpurū ravo'syeti tasmādeṣa purūravāḥ  |
syādityevaṃ nāma cakruḥ sarve saṃtuṣṭamānasāḥ  || 108.74 ||
budho'pyadhyāpayāmāsa kṣātravidyāṃ sutaṃ śubhām  |
dhanurvedaṃ saprayogaṃ budhaḥ prādāttadātmaje  || 108.75 ||
sa śīghraṃ vṛddhimagamacchuklapakṣe yathā śaśī  |
sa mātaraṃ duḥkhayutāṃ samīkṣyelāṃ mahāmatiḥ  |
namasyātha vinītātmā ilāmailo'bravīdidam  || 108.76 ||
{aila uvāca̱ }
budho mātarmama pitā tava bhartā priyastathā  |
ahaṃ ca putraḥ karmaṇyaḥ kasmātte mānaso jvaraḥ  || 108.77 ||
{ilovāca̱ }
satyaṃ putra budho bhartā tvaṃ ca putro guṇākaraḥ  |
bhartṛputrakṛtā cintā na mamāsti kadācana  || 108.78 ||
tathāpi pūrvajaṃ kiṃcidduḥkhaṃ smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ  |
cintayeyaṃ mahābuddhe tato mātaramabravīt || 108.79 ||
{aila uvāca̱ }
nivedayasva me mātastadeva prathamaṃ mama  ||* 108.80 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ilā cainamuvācedaṃ rahovācaṃ kathaṃ vade  |
tathāpi putra te vacmi pitroḥ putro yato gatiḥ  |
magnānāṃ duḥkhapāthobdhau putraḥ pravahaṇaṃ param  || 108.81 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tanmātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā vinītaḥ prāha mātaram  |
pādayoḥ patitaścāpi vada mātaryathā tathā  || 108.82 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sā purūravasaṃ prāha ikṣvākūṇāṃ tathā kulam  |
tatrotpattiṃ svasya nāma rājyaprāptiṃ priyān sutān  || 108.83 ||
purodhasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca priyāṃ bhāryāṃ svakaṃ padam  |
vananiryāṇamevātha amātyānāṃ purodhasaḥ  || 108.84 ||
preṣaṇaṃ ca nagaryāṃ tāṃ mṛgayāsaktimeva ca  |
himavatkandaragatiṃ yakṣeśvaragṛhe gatim  || 108.85 ||
umāvanapraveśaṃ ca strītvaprāptimaśeṣataḥ  |
maheśvarājñayā tatra cāpraveśaṃ narasya tu  || 108.86 ||
yakṣiṇīvākyamapyasya varadānaṃ tathaiva ca  |
budhaprāptiṃ tathā prītiṃ putrotpattyādyaśeṣataḥ  || 108.87 ||
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ śrutvā mātaramabravīt |
purūravāḥ kiṃ karomi kiṃ kṛtvā sukṛtaṃ bhavet || 108.88 ||
etāvatā te tṛptiścedalametena cāmbike  |
yadapyanyanmanovarti tadapyājñāpayasva me  || 108.89 ||
{ilovāca̱ }
iccheyaṃ puṃstvamutkṛṣṭamiccheyaṃ rājyamuttamam  |
abhiṣekaṃ ca putrāṇāṃ tava cāpi viśeṣataḥ  || 108.90 ||
dānaṃ dātuṃ ca yaṣṭuṃ ca muktimārgasya vīkṣaṇam  |
sarvaṃ ca kartumicchāmi tava putra prasādataḥ  || 108.91 ||
{putra uvāca̱ }
upāyaṃ tvā tu pṛcchāmi yena puṃstvamavāpsyasi  |
tapaso vānyato vāpi vadasva mama tattvataḥ  || 108.92 ||
{ilovāca̱ }
budhaṃ tvaṃ pitaraṃ pṛccha gatvā putra yathārthavat |
sa tu sarvaṃ tu jānāti upadekṣyati te hitam  || 108.93 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tanmātṛvacanādailo gatvā pitaramañjasā  |
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā mātuḥ kṛtyaṃ tathātmanaḥ  || 108.94 ||
{budha uvāca̱ }
ilaṃ jāne mahāprājña ilāṃ jātāṃ punastathā  |
umāvanapraveśaṃ ca śaṃbhorājñāṃ tathaiva ca  || 108.95 ||
tasmācchaṃbhuprasādena umāyāśca prasādataḥ  |
viśāpo bhavitā putra tāvārādhya na cānyathā  || 108.96 ||
{purūravā uvāca̱ }
paśyeyaṃ taṃ kathaṃ devaṃ kathaṃ vā mātaraṃ śivām  |
tīrthādvā tapaso vāpi tatpitaḥ prathamaṃ vada  || 108.97 ||
{budha uvāca̱ }
gautamīṃ gaccha putra tvaṃ tatrāste sarvadā śivaḥ  |
umayā sahitaḥ śrīmāñśāpahantā varapradaḥ  || 108.98 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
purūravāḥ piturvākyaṃ śrutvā tu mudito'bhavat |
gautamīṃ tapase dhīmān gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm  || 108.99 ||
puṃstvamicchaṃstathā māturjagāma tapase tvaran  |
himavantaṃ giriṃ natvā mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum  || 108.100 ||
gacchantamanvagātputramilā somasutastathā  |
te sarve gautamīṃ prāptā himavatparvatottamāt || 108.101 ||
tatra snātvā tapaḥ kiṃcitkṛtvā cakruḥ stutiṃ parām  |
bhavasya devadevasya stutikramamimaṃ śṛṇu  || 108.102 ||
budhastuṣṭāva prathamamilā ca tadanantaram  |
tataḥ purūravāḥ putro gaurīṃ devīṃ ca śaṃkaram  || 108.103 ||
{budha uvāca̱ }
yau kuṅkumena svaśarīrajena  108.104
svabhāvahemapratimau sarūpau  108.104
yāvarcitau skandagaṇeśvarābhyāṃ  108.104
tau me śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ bhavetām  108.104
{ilovāca̱ }
saṃsāratāpatrayadāvadagdhāḥ  108.105
śarīriṇo yau paricintayantaḥ  108.105
sadyaḥ parāṃ nirvṛtimāpnuvanti  108.105
tau śaṃkarau me śaraṇaṃ bhavetām  108.105
ārtā hyahaṃ pīḍitamānasā te  108.106
kleśādigoptā na paro'sti kaścit 108.106
deva tvadīyau caraṇau supuṇyau  108.106
tau me śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ bhavetām  108.106
{purūravā uvāca̱ }
yayoḥ sakāśādidamabhyudaiti  108.107
prayāti cānte layameva sarvam  108.107
jagaccharaṇyau jagadātmakau tu  108.107
gaurīharau me śaraṇaṃ bhavetām  108.107
yau devavṛndeṣu mahotsave tu  108.108
pādau gṛhāṇeśa girīśaputryāḥ  108.108
proktaṃ dhṛtau prītivaśācchivena  108.108
tau me śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ bhavetām  108.108
{śrīdevyuvāca̱ }
kimabhīṣṭaṃ pradāsyāmi yuṣmabhyaṃ tadvadantu me  |
kṛtakṛtyāḥ stha bhadraṃ vo devānāmapi duṣkaram  || 108.109 ||
{purūravā uvāca̱ }
ilo rājā tavājñātvā vanaṃ prāviśadambike  |
tatkṣamasva sureśāni puṃstvaṃ dātuṃ tvamarhasi  || 108.110 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuvāca tān sarvān bhavasya tu mate sthitā  |
tataḥ sa bhagavānāha devīvākyarataḥ sadā  || 108.111 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
atrābhiṣekamātreṇa puṃstvaṃ prāpnotvayaṃ nṛpaḥ  ||* 108.112 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
snātāyā budhabhāryāyāḥ śarīrādvāri susruve  |
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca lāvaṇyaṃ yakṣiṇyā yadupārjitam  || 108.113 ||
tatsarvaṃ vāridhārābhirgaṅgāmbhasi samāviśat |
nṛtyā gītā ca saubhāgyā imā nadyo babhūvire  || 108.114 ||
tāścāpi saṃgatā gaṅgāṃ te puṇyāḥ saṃgamāstrayaḥ  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca surarājyaphalapradam  || 108.115 ||
ilā puṃstvamavāpyātha gaurīśaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ  |
mahābhyudayasiddhyarthaṃ vājimedhamathākarot || 108.116 ||
purodhasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca bhāryāṃ putrāṃstathaiva ca  |
amātyāṃśca balaṃ kośamānīya sa nṛpottamaḥ  || 108.117 ||
caturaṅgaṃ balaṃ rājyaṃ daṇḍake'sthāpayattadā  |
ilasya nāmnā vikhyātaṃ tatra tatpuramucyate  || 108.118 ||
pūrvajātānatho putrān sūryavaṃśakramāgate  |
rājye'bhiṣicya paścāttamailaṃ snehādasiñcayat || 108.119 ||
somavaṃśakaraḥ śrīmānayaṃ rājā bhavediti  |
sarvebhyo matimānebhyo jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭho'bhavanmune  || 108.120 ||
yatra ca kratavo vṛttā ilasya nṛpateḥ śubhāḥ  |
yatra puṃstvamavāpyātha yatra putrāḥ samāgatāḥ  || 108.121 ||
yakṣiṇīdattanṛtyādi gītasaubhāgyamaṅgalāḥ  |
nadyo bhūtvā yatra gaṅgāṃ saṃgatāstāni nārada  || 108.122 ||
tīrthāni śubhadānyāsan sahasrāṇyatha ṣoḍaśa  |
ubhayostīrayostāta tatra śaṃbhurileśvaraḥ  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam  || 108.123 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
cakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ brahmahatyādināśanam  |
yatra cakreśvaro devaścakramāpa yato hariḥ  || 109.1 ||
yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitvā cakrārthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ prabhuḥ  |
pūjayāmāsa tattīrthaṃ cakratīrthamudāhṛtam  || 109.2 ||
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  |
dakṣakratau pravṛtte tu devānāṃ ca samāgame  || 109.3 ||
dakṣeṇa dūṣite deve śive śarve maheśvare  |
anāhvāne sureśasya dakṣacitte malīmase  || 109.4 ||
dākṣāyaṇyā śrute vākye anāhvānasya kāraṇe  |
ahalyāyāṃ coktavatyāṃ kupitābhūtsureśvarī  || 109.5 ||
pitaraṃ nāśaye pāpaṃ kṣameyaṃ na kathaṃcana  |
śṛṇvatī doṣavākyāni pitrā coktāni bhartari  || 109.6 ||
patyuḥ śṛṇvanti yā nindāṃ tāsāṃ pāpāvadhiḥ kutaḥ  |
yādṛśastādṛśo vāpi patiḥ strīṇāṃ parā gatiḥ  || 109.7 ||
kiṃ punaḥ sakalādhīśo mahādevo jagadguruḥ  |
śrutaṃ tannindanaṃ tarhi dhārayāmi na dehakam  || 109.8 ||
tasmāttyakṣya imaṃ dehamityuktvā sā mahāsatī  |
kopena mahatāviṣṭā prajajvāla sureśvarī  || 109.9 ||
śivaikacetanā dehaṃ balādyogācca tatyaje  |
maheśvaro'pi sakalaṃ vṛttamākarṇya nāradāt || 109.10 ||
dṛṣṭvā cukopa papraccha jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ tathā  |
te ūcaturubhe devaṃ dakṣakratuvināśanam  || 109.11 ||
dākṣāyaṇyā iti śrutvā makhaṃ prāyānmaheśvaraḥ  |
bhīmairgaṇaiḥ parivṛto bhūtanāthaiḥ samaṃ yayau  || 109.12 ||
makhastairveṣṭitaḥ sarvo devabrahmapuraskṛtaḥ  |
dakṣeṇa yajamānena śuddhabhāvena rakṣitaḥ  || 109.13 ||
vasiṣṭhādibhiratyugrairmunibhiḥ parivāritaḥ  |
indrādityādyairvasubhiḥ sarvataḥparipālitaḥ  || 109.14 ||
ṛgyajuḥsāmavedaiśca svāhāśabdairalaṃkṛtaḥ  |
śraddhā puṣṭistathā tuṣṭiḥ śāntirlajjā sarasvatī  || 109.15 ||
bhūmirdyauḥ śarvarī kṣāntiruṣā āśā jayā matiḥ  |
etābhiśca tathānyābhiḥ sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ  || 109.16 ||
tvaṣṭrā mahātmanā cāpi kārito viśvakarmaṇā  |
surabhirnandinī dhenuḥ kāmadhukkāmadohinī  || 109.17 ||
etābhiḥ kāmavarṣābhiḥ sarvakāmasamṛddhimān  |
kalpavṛkṣaḥ pārijāto latāḥ kalpalatādikāḥ  || 109.18 ||
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcittatra tasminmakhe sthitam  |
svayaṃ maghavatā pūṣṇā hariṇā parirakṣitaḥ  || 109.19 ||
dīyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ vāpi kriyatāṃ sthīyatāṃ sukham  |
etaiśca sarvato vākyairdakṣasya pūjitaṃ makham  || 109.20 ||
ādau tu vīrabhadro'sau bhadrakālyā yuto yayau  |
śokakopaparītātmā paścācchūlapinākadhṛk || 109.21 ||
abhyāyayau mahādevo mahābhūtairalaṃkṛtaḥ  |
tāni bhūtāni parito makhe veṣṭya maheśvaram  || 109.22 ||
kratuṃ vidhvaṃsayāmāsustatra kṣobho mahānabhūt |
palāyanta tataḥ kecitkecidgatvā tataḥ śivam  || 109.23 ||
kecitstuvanti deveśaṃ kecitkupyanti śaṃkaram  |
evaṃ vidhvaṃsitaṃ yajñaṃ dṛṣṭvā pūṣā samabhyagāt || 109.24 ||
pūṣṇo dantānathotpāṭya indraṃ vyadrāvayatkṣaṇāt |
bhagasya cakṣuṣī vipra vīrabhadro vyapāṭayat || 109.25 ||
divākaraṃ punardorbhyāṃ paribhrāmya samākṣipat |
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve viṣṇuṃ te śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ  || 109.26 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
trāhi trāhi gadāpāṇe bhūtanāthakṛtādbhayāt |
maheśvaragaṇaḥ kaścitpramathānāṃ tu nāyakaḥ  |
tena dagdho makhaḥ sarvo vaiṣṇavaḥ paśyato hareḥ  || 109.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
hariṇā cakramutsṛṣṭaṃ bhūtanāthavadhaṃ prati  |
bhūtanātho'pi taccakramāpatacca tadāgrasat || 109.28 ||
graste cakre tato viṣṇorlokapālā bhayādyayuḥ  |
tathā sthitānavekṣyātha dakṣo yajñaṃ surānapi  |
tuṣṭāva śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ dakṣo bhaktyā prajāpatiḥ  || 109.29 ||
{dakṣa uvāca̱ }
jaya śaṃkara someśa jaya sarvajña śaṃbhave  |
jaya kalyāṇabhṛcchaṃbho jaya kālātmane namaḥ  || 109.30 ||
ādikartarnamaste'stu nīlakaṇṭha namo'stu te  |
brahmapriya namaste'stu brahmarūpa namo'stu te  || 109.31 ||
trimūrtaye namo deva tridhāma parameśvara  |
sarvamūrte namaste'stu trailokyādhāra kāmada  || 109.32 ||
namo vedāntavedyāya namaste paramātmane  |
yajñarūpa namaste'stu yajñadhāma namo'stu te  || 109.33 ||
yajñadāna namaste'stu havyavāha namo'stu te  |
yajñahartre namaste'stu phaladāya namo'stu te  || 109.34 ||
trāhi trāhi jagannātha śaraṇāgatavatsala  |
bhaktānāmapyabhaktānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ prabho  || 109.35 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ tu stuvatastasya prasanno'bhūnmaheśvaraḥ  |
kiṃ dadāmīti taṃ prāha kratuḥ pūrṇo'stu me prabho  || 109.36 ||
tathetyuvāca bhagavān devadevo maheśvaraḥ  |
śaṃkaraḥ sarvabhūtātmā karuṇāvaruṇālayaḥ  || 109.37 ||
kratuṃ kṛtvā tataḥ pūrṇaṃ tasya dakṣasya vai mune  |
evamuktvā sa bhagavān bhūtairantaradhīyata  || 109.38 ||
yathāgataṃ surā jagmuḥ svameva sadanaṃ prati  |
tataḥ kadāciddevānāṃ daityānāṃ vigraho mahān  || 109.39 ||
babhūva tatra daityebhyo bhītā devāḥ śriyaḥ patim  |
tuṣṭuvuḥ sarvabhāvena vacobhistaṃ janārdanam  || 109.40 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
śakrādayo'pi tridaśāḥ kaṭākṣam  109.41
avekṣya yasyāstapa ācaranti  109.41
sā cāpi yatpādaratā ca lakṣmīs 109.41
taṃ brahmabhūtaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye  109.41
yasmāttrilokyāṃ na paraḥ samāno  109.42
na cādhikastārkṣyarathānnṛsiṃhāt 109.42
sa devadevo'vatu naḥ samastān  109.42
mahābhayebhyaḥ kṛpayā prapannān  109.42
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prasanno bhagavāñśaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  |
kimarthamāgatāḥ sarve tatkartāsmītyuvāca tān  || 109.43 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
bhayaṃ ca tīvraṃ daityebhyo devānāṃ madhusūdana  |
tatastrāṇāya devānāṃ matiṃ kuru janārdana  || 109.44 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tānāgatān hariḥ prāha grastaṃ cakraṃ hareṇa me  |
kiṃ karomi gataṃ cakraṃ bhavantaścārtimāgatāḥ  |
yāntu sarve devagaṇā rakṣā vaḥ kriyate mayā  || 109.46 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato gateṣu deveṣu viṣṇuścakrārthamudyataḥ  |
godāvarīṃ tato gatvā śaṃbhoḥ pūjāṃ pracakrame  || 109.47 ||
suvarṇakamalairdivyaiḥ sugandhairdaśabhiḥ śataiḥ  |
bhaktito nityavatpūjāṃ cakre viṣṇurumāpateḥ  || 109.48 ||
evaṃ saṃpūjyamāne tu tayostattvamidaṃ śṛṇu  |
kamalānāṃ sahasre tu yadaikaṃ naiva pūryate  || 109.49 ||
tadāsurāriḥ svaṃ netramutpāṭyārghyamakalpayat |
arghyapātraṃ kare gṛhya sahasrakamalānvitam  |
dhyātvā śaṃbhuṃ dadāvarghyamananyaśaraṇo hariḥ  || 109.50 ||
{viṣṇuruvāca̱ }
tvameva deva jānīṣe bhāvamantargataṃ nṛṇām  |
tvameva śaraṇo'dhīśo'tra kā bhavedvicāraṇā  || 109.51 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vadannudaśrunayano nililye'sāvitīśvare  |
bhavānīsahitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ purastādabhavattadā  || 109.52 ||
gāḍhamāliṅgya vividhairvarairāpūrayaddharim  |
tadeva cakramabhavannetraṃ cāpi yathā purā  || 109.53 ||
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve tuṣṭuvurhariśaṃkarau  |
gaṅgāṃ cāpi saricchreṣṭhāṃ devaṃ ca vṛṣabhadhvajam  || 109.54 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ cakratīrthamiti smṛtam  |
yasyānuśravaṇenaiva mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ  || 109.55 ||
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryātpitṛtarpaṇam  |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ pitṛbhiḥ svargabhāgbhavet |
tattu cakrāṅkitaṃ tīrthamadyāpi paridṛśyate  || 109.56 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pippalaṃ tīrthamākhyātaṃ cakratīrthādanantaram  |
yatra cakreśvaro devaścakramāpa yato hariḥ  || 110.1 ||
yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitvā cakrārthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ vibhum  |
pūjayāmāsa tattīrthaṃ cakratīrthamudāhṛtam  || 110.2 ||
yatra prīto'bhavadviṣṇoḥ śaṃbhustatpippalaṃ viduḥ  |
mahimānaṃ yasya vaktuṃ na kṣamo'pyahināyakaḥ  || 110.3 ||
cakreśvaro pippaleśo nāmadheyasya kāraṇam  |
śṛṇu nārada tadbhaktyā sākṣādvedoditaṃ mayā  || 110.4 ||
dadhīciriti vikhyāto munirāsīdguṇānvitaḥ  |
tasya bhāryā mahāprājñā kulīnā ca pativratā  || 110.5 ||
lopāmudreti yā khyātā svasā tasyā gabhastinī  |
iti nāmnā ca vikhyātā vaḍaveti prakīrtitā  || 110.6 ||
dadhīceḥ sā priyā nityaṃ tapastepe tayā mahat |
dadhīciragnimānnityaṃ gṛhadharmaparāyaṇaḥ  || 110.7 ||
bhāgīrathīṃ samāśritya devātithiparāyaṇaḥ  |
svakalatrarataḥ śāntaḥ kumbhayonirivāparaḥ  || 110.8 ||
tasya prabhāvāttaṃ deśaṃ nārayo daityadānavāḥ  |
ājagmurmuniśārdūla yatrāgastyasya cāśramaḥ  || 110.9 ||
tatra devāḥ samājagmū rudrādityāstathāśvinau  |
indro viṣṇuryamo'gniśca jitvā daityānupāgatān  || 110.10 ||
jayena jātasaṃharṣāḥ stutāścaiva marudgaṇaiḥ  |
dadhīciṃ muniśārdūlaṃ dṛṣṭvā nemuḥ sureśvarāḥ  || 110.11 ||
dadhīcirjātasaṃharṣaḥ surān pūjya pṛthakpṛthak |
gṛhakṛtyaṃ tataścakre surebhyo bhāryayā saha  || 110.12 ||
pṛṣṭāśca kuśalaṃ tena kathāścakruḥ surā api  |
dadhīcimabruvan devā bhāryayā sukhitaṃ punaḥ  || 110.13 ||
āsīnaṃ hṛṣṭamanasa ṛṣiṃ natvā punaḥ punaḥ  ||* 110.14 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
kimadya durlabhaṃ loke ṛṣe'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati  |
tvādṛśaḥ sakṛpo yeṣu munirbhūkalpapādapaḥ  || 110.15 ||
etadeva phalaṃ puṃsāṃ jīvatāṃ munisattama  |
tīrthāplutirbhūtadayā darśanaṃ ca bhavādṛśām  || 110.16 ||
yatsnehāducyate'smābhiravadhāraya tanmune  |
jitvā daityāniha prāptā hatvā rākṣasapuṃgavān  || 110.17 ||
vayaṃ ca sukhino brahmaṃstvayi dṛṣṭe viśeṣataḥ  |
nāyudhaiḥ phalamasmākaṃ voḍhuṃ naiva kṣamā vayam  || 110.18 ||
sthāpyadeśaṃ na paśyāma āyudhānāṃ munīśvara  |
svarge suradviṣo jñātvā sthāpitāni haranti ca  || 110.19 ||
nayeyurāyudhānīti tathaiva ca rasātale  |
tasmāttavāśrame puṇye sthāpyante'strāṇi mānada  || 110.20 ||
naivātra kiṃcidbhayamasti vipra  110.21
na dānavebhyo rākṣasebhyaśca ghoram  110.21
tvadājñayā rakṣitapuṇyadeśo  110.21
na vidyate tapasā te samānaḥ  110.21
jitārayo brahmavidāṃ variṣṭhaṃ  110.22
vayaṃ ca pūrvaṃ nihatā daityasaṃghāḥ  110.22
astrairalaṃ bhārabhūtaiḥ kṛtārthaiḥ  110.22
sthāpyaṃ sthānaṃ te samīpe munīśa  110.22
divyān bhogān kāminībhiḥ sametān  110.23
devodyāne nandane saṃbhajāmaḥ  110.23
tato yāmaḥ kṛtakāryāḥ sahendrāḥ  110.23
svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ cāyudhānāṃ ca rakṣā  110.23
tvayā kṛtā jāyatāṃ tatpraśādhi  110.24
samarthastvaṃ rakṣaṇe dhāraṇe ca  110.24
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvākyamākarṇya dadhīcirevaṃ  110.25
vākyaṃ jagau vibudhānevamastu  110.25
nivāryamāṇaḥ priyaśīlayā striyā  110.25
kiṃ devakāryeṇa viruddhakāriṇā  110.25
ye jñātaśāstrāḥ paramārthaniṣṭhāḥ  110.26
saṃsāraceṣṭāsu gatānurāgāḥ  110.26
teṣāṃ parārthavyasanena kiṃ mune  110.26
yenātra vāmutra sukhaṃ na kiṃcit 110.26
devadviṣo dveṣamanuprayānti  110.27
datte sthāne vipravarya śṛṇuṣva  110.27
naṣṭe hṛte cāyudhānāṃ munīśa  110.27
kupyanti devā ripavaste bhavanti  110.27
tasmānnedaṃ vedavidāṃ variṣṭha  110.28
yuktaṃ dravye parakīye mamatvam  110.28
tāvacca maitrī dravyabhāvaśca tāvan  110.28
naṣṭe hṛte ripavaste bhavanti  110.28
cedasti śaktirdravyadāne tataste  110.29
dātavyamevārthine kiṃ vicāryam  110.29
no cetsantaḥ parakāryāṇi kuryur 110.29
vāgbhirmanobhiḥ kṛtibhistathaiva  110.29
parasvasaṃdhāraṇametadeva  110.30
sadbhirnirastaṃ tyaja kānta sadyaḥ  110.30
{brahmovāca̱ }

{brahmovāca̱ }

ityuktvā cātyajadbālaṃ bhartṛcittaparāyaṇā  |

agniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya yajñapātrasamanvitā  |

{vṛkṣā ūcu̱ḥ }
svargamāseduṣoḥ pitrostadapatyeṣvakṛtrimam  |

{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tadauṣadhyo vanaspatisamanvitāḥ  |

prīto bhavenmahādevaḥ sākṣātkāruṇikaḥ śivaḥ  |

cakreśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ jānantyoṣadhayastu tat |

{pippalāda uvāca̱ }

{īśvara uvāca̱ }
tṛtīyaṃ nayanaṃ draṣṭuṃ yadi śaknoṣi me'nagha  |

{brahmovāca̱ }

{īśvara uvāca̱ }

{brahmovāca̱ }

śivadhyānaikanirato bālo'pi balavāniva  |

{pippalāda uvāca̱ }

tadaiva pippalāḥ procurvaḍavāpi mahādyute  |

sa prāha kimidaṃ kṛtye sā cāpyāha tvayoditam  || 110.128 ||
devaiśca nirmitaṃ dehaṃ tato bhītaḥ śivaṃ yayau  |
tuṣṭāva devaṃ sa muniḥ kṛtyāṃ prāha tadā śivaḥ  || 110.129 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
yojanāntaḥsthitāñjīvānna gṛhāṇa madājñayā  |
