{brahmovāca̱ }
tīrthāttu pippalātpūrvaṃ yāvadyojanasaṃkhyayā  |
prātiṣṭhadvaḍavārūpā kṛtyā sā ṛṣinirmitā  || 110.131 ||
tasyāṃ jāto mahānagnirlokasaṃharaṇakṣamaḥ  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudhāḥ sarve trastāḥ śaṃbhumupāgaman  || 110.132 ||
cakreśvaraṃ pippaleśaṃ pippalādena toṣitam  |
stuvanto bhītamanasaḥ śaṃbhumūcurdivaukasaḥ  || 110.133 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
rakṣasva śaṃbho kṛtyāsmān bādhate tadbhavānalaḥ  |
śaraṇaṃ bhava sarveśa bhītānāmabhayaprada  || 110.134 ||
sarvataḥ paribhūtānāmārtānāṃ śrāntacetasām  |
sarveṣāmeva jantūnāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ śiva  || 110.135 ||
ṛṣiṇābhyarthitā kṛtyā tvaccakṣurvahninirgatā  |
sā jighāṃsati lokāṃstrīṃstvaṃ nastrātā na cetaraḥ  || 110.136 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tānabravījjagannātho yojanāntarnivāsinaḥ  |
na bādhate tvasau kṛtyā tasmādyūyamaharniśam  |
ihaivāsadhvamamarāstasyā vo na bhayaṃ bhavet || 110.137 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
punarūcuḥ sureśānaṃ tvayā dattaṃ triviṣṭapam  |
tattyaktvātra kathaṃ nātha vatsyāmastridaśārcita  || 110.138 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā śivo vākyamathābravīt ||* 110.140 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
devo'sau viśvataścakṣuryo devo viśvatomukhaḥ  |
yo raśmibhistu dhamate nityaṃ yo janako mataḥ  || 110.141 ||
sa sūrya eka evātra sākṣādrūpeṇa sarvadā  |
sthitiṃ karotu tanmūrtau bhaviṣyantyakhilāḥ sthitāḥ  || 110.142 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatheti śaṃbhuvacanātpārijātatarostadā  |
devā divākaraṃ cakrustvaṣṭā bhāskaramabravīt || 110.143 ||
{tvaṣṭovāca̱ }
ihaivāssva jagatsvāmin rakṣemān vibudhān svayam  |
svāṃśaiśca vayamapyatra tiṣṭhāmaḥ śaṃbhusaṃnidhau  || 110.144 ||
cakreśvarasya parito yāvadyojanasaṃkhyayā  |
gaṅgāyā ubhayaṃ tīramāsādyāsan surottamāḥ  || 110.145 ||
aṅgulyardhārdhamātraṃ tu gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritāḥ  |
tisraḥ koṭyastathā pañca śatāni munisattama  |
tīrthānāṃ tatra vyuṣṭiṃ ca kaḥ śṛṇoti bravīti vā  || 110.146 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve vinītāḥ śivamabruvan  ||* 110.147 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
pippalādaṃ sureśāna śamaṃ naya jaganmaya  ||* 110.148 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
omityuktvā jagannāthaḥ pippalādamavocata  ||* 110.149 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
nāśiteṣvapi deveṣu pitā te nāgamiṣyati  |
dattāḥ pitrā tava prāṇā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye  || 110.150 ||
dīnārtakaruṇābandhuḥ ko hi tādṛgbhave bhavet |
tathā yātā divaṃ tāta tava mātā pativratā  || 110.151 ||
samā kāpyatra matayā lopāmudrāpyarundhatī  |
yadasthibhiḥ surāḥ sarve jayinaḥ sukhinaḥ sadā  || 110.152 ||
tenāvāptaṃ yaśaḥ sphītaṃ tava mātrākṣayaṃ kṛtam  |
tvayā putreṇa sarvatra nātaḥ parataraṃ kṛtam  || 110.153 ||
tvatpratāpabhayātsvargāccyutāṃstvaṃ pātumarhasi  |
kāṃdiśīkāṃstava bhayādamarāṃstrātumarhasi  |
nārtatrāṇādabhyadhikaṃ sukṛtaṃ kvāpi vidyate  || 110.154 ||
yāvadyaśaḥ sphurati cāru manuṣyaloke  110.155
ahāni tāvanti divaṃ gatasya  110.155
dine dine varṣasaṃkhyā parasmiṃl 110.155
loke vāso jāyate nirvikāraḥ  110.155
mṛtāsta evātra yaśo na yeṣām  110.156
andhāsta eva śrutavarjitā ye  110.156
ye dānaśīlā na napuṃsakāste  110.156
ye dharmaśīlā na ta eva śocyāḥ  110.156
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhāṣitaṃ devadevasya śrutvā śānto'bhavanmuniḥ  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā natvā nāthamathābravīt || 110.157 ||
{pippalāda uvāca̱ }
vāgbhirmanobhiḥ kṛtibhiḥ kadācin  110.158
mamopakurvanti hite ratā ye  110.158
tebhyo hitārthaṃ tviha cāpareṣāṃ  110.158
somaṃ namasyāmi surādipūjyam  110.158
saṃrakṣito yairabhivardhitaśca  110.159
samānagotraśca samānadharmā  110.159
teṣāmabhīṣṭāni śivaḥ karotu  110.159
bālendumauliṃ praṇato'smi nityam  110.159
yairahaṃ vardhito nityaṃ mātṛvatpitṛvatprabho  |
tannāmnā jāyatāṃ tīrthaṃ devadeva jagattraye  || 110.160 ||
yaśastu teṣāṃ bhavitā tebhyo'hamanṛṇastataḥ  |
yāni kṣetrāṇi devānāṃ yāni tīrthāni bhūtale  || 110.161 ||
tebhyo yadidamadhikamanumanyantu devatāḥ  |
tataḥ kṣame'haṃ devānāmaparādhaṃ nirañjanaḥ  || 110.162 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ samakṣaṃ surasākṣarāṃ giraṃ  110.163
sahasracakṣuḥpramukhāṃstathāgrataḥ  110.163
uvāca devā api menire vaco  110.163
dadhīciputroditamādareṇa  110.163
bālasya buddhiṃ vinayaṃ ca vidyāṃ  110.164
śauryaṃ balaṃ sāhasaṃ satyavācam  110.164
pitrorbhaktiṃ bhāvaśuddhiṃ viditvā  110.164
tadāvādīcchaṃkaraḥ pippalādam  110.164
{śaṃkara uvāca̱ }
vatsa yadvai priyaṃ kāmaṃ yaccāpi suravallabham  |
prāpsyase vada kalyāṇaṃ nānyathā tvaṃ manaḥ kṛthāḥ  || 110.165 ||
{pippalāda uvāca̱ }
ye gaṅgāyāmāplutā dharmaniṣṭhāḥ  110.166
saṃpaśyanti tvatpadābjaṃ maheśa  110.166
sarvān kāmānāpnuvantu prasahya  110.166
dehānte te padamāyāntu śaivam  110.166
tātaḥ prāptastvatpadaṃ cāmbikā me  110.167
nātha prāptā pippalaścāmarāśca  110.167
sukhaṃ prāptā nāthanāthaṃ vilokya  110.167
tvāṃ paśyeyustvatpadaṃ te prayāntu  110.167
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā pippalādaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ  |
abhinandya ca taṃ devaiḥ sārdhaṃ vākyamathābravīt || 110.168 ||
devā api mudā yuktā nirbhayāstatkṛtādbhayāt |
idamūcuḥ sarva eva dādhīcaṃ śivasaṃnidhau  || 110.169 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
surāṇāṃ yadabhīṣṭaṃ ca tvayā kṛtamasaṃśayam  |
pālitā devadevasya ājñā trailokyamaṇḍanī  || 110.170 ||
yācitaṃ ca tvayā pūrvaṃ parārthaṃ nātmane dvija  |
tasmādanyatamaṃ brūhi kiṃciddāsyāmahe vayam  || 110.171 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
punaḥ punastadevocuḥ surasaṃghā dvijottamam  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ pūrvaṃ natvā śaṃbhusurānidam  |
uvāca pippalādaśca umāṃ natvā ca pippalān  || 110.172 ||
{pippalāda uvāca̱ }
pitarau draṣṭukāmo'smi sadā me śabdagocarau  |
te dhanyāḥ prāṇino loke mātāpitrorvaśe sthitāḥ  || 110.173 ||
śuśrūṣaṇaparā nityaṃ tatpādājñāpratīkṣakāḥ  |
indriyāṇi śarīraṃ ca kulaṃ śaktiṃ dhiyaṃ vapuḥ  || 110.174 ||
parilabhya tayoḥ kṛtye kṛtakṛtyo bhavetsvayam  |
paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ cāpi sulabhaṃ mātṛdarśanam  || 110.175 ||
durlabhaṃ mama taccāpi pṛcche pāpaphalaṃ nu kim  |
durlabhaṃ ca tathā cetsyātsarveṣāṃ yasya kasyacit || 110.176 ||
nopapadyeta sulabhaṃ matto nānyo'sti pāpakṛt |
tayordarśanamātraṃ ca yadi prāpsye surottamāḥ  || 110.177 ||
manovākkāyakarmabhyaḥ phalaṃ prāptaṃ bhaviṣyati  |
pitarau ye na paśyanti samutpannā na saṃsṛtau  |
teṣāṃ mahāpātakānāṃ kaḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartumīśvaraḥ  || 110.178 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadṛṣervacanaṃ śrutvā mithaḥ saṃmantrya te surāḥ  |
vimānavaramārūḍhau pitarau daṃpatī śubhau  || 110.179 ||
tava saṃdarśanākāṅkṣau drakṣyase vādya niścitam  |
viṣādaṃ lobhamohau ca tyaktvā cittaṃ śamaṃ naya  || 110.180 ||
paśya paśyeti taṃ prāhurdādhīcaṃ surasattamāḥ  |
vimānavaramārūḍhau svargiṇau svarṇabhūṣaṇau  || 110.181 ||
tava saṃdarśanākāṅkṣau pitarau daṃpatī śubhau  |
vījyamānau surastrībhiḥ stūyamānau ca kiṃnaraiḥ  || 110.182 ||
dṛṣṭvā sa mātāpitarau nanāma śivasaṃnidhau  |
harṣabāṣpāśrunayanau sa kathaṃciduvāca tau  || 110.183 ||
{putra uvāca̱ }
tārayantyeva pitarāvanye putrāḥ kulodvahāḥ  |
ahaṃ tu māturudare kevalaṃ bhedakāraṇam  |
evaṃbhūto'pi tau mohātpaśyeyamatidurmatiḥ  || 110.184 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tāvālokya tato duḥkhādvaktuṃ naiva śaśāka saḥ  |
devāśca mātāpitarau pippalādamathābruvan  || 110.185 ||
dhanyastvaṃ putra lokeṣu yasya kīrtirgatā divam  |
sākṣātkṛtastvayā tryakṣo devāścāśvāsitāstvayā  |
tvayā putreṇa sallokā na kṣīyante kadācana  || 110.186 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
puṣpavṛṣṭistadā svargātpapāta tasya mūrdhani  |
jayaśabdaḥ surairuktaḥ prādurbhūto mahāmune  || 110.187 ||
āśiṣaṃ tu sute dattvā dadhīciḥ saha bhāryayā  |
śaṃbhuṃ gaṅgāṃ surānnatvā putraṃ vākyamathābravīt || 110.188 ||
{dadhīciruvāca̱ }
prāpya bhāryāṃ śive bhaktiṃ kuru gaṅgāṃ ca sevaya  |
putrānutpādya vidhivadyajñāniṣṭvā sadakṣiṇān  |
kṛtakṛtyastato vatsa ākramasva ciraṃ divam  || 110.189 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
karomyevamiti prāha dadhīciṃ pippalāśanaḥ  |
dadhīciḥ putramāśvāsya bhāryayā ca punaḥ punaḥ  || 110.190 ||
anujñātaḥ suragaṇaiḥ punaḥ sa divamākramat |
devā apyūcire sarve pippalādaṃ sasaṃbhramāḥ  || 110.191 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
kṛtyāṃ śamaya bhadraṃ te tadutpannaṃ mahānalam  ||* 110.192 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pippalādastu tānāha na śakto'haṃ nivāraṇe  |
asatyaṃ naiva vaktāhaṃ yūyaṃ kṛtyāṃ tu brūta tām  || 110.193 ||
māṃ dṛṣṭvā sā mahāraudrā viparītaṃ kariṣyati  |
tāmeva gatvā vibudhāḥ procuste śāntikāraṇam  || 110.194 ||
analaṃ ca yathāprīti te ubhe netyavocatām  |
sarveṣāṃ bhakṣaṇāyaiva sṛṣṭā cāhaṃ dvijanmanā  || 110.195 ||
tathā ca matprasūto'gniranyathā tatkathaṃ bhavet |
mahābhūtāni pañcāpi sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ tathā  || 110.196 ||
sarvamasmanmukhe vidyādvaktavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate  |
mayā saṃmantrya te devāḥ punarūcurubhāvapi  || 110.197 ||
bhakṣayetāmubhau sarvaṃ yathānukramatastathā  |
vaḍavāpi surānevamuvāca śṛṇu nārada  || 110.198 ||
{vaḍavovāca̱ }
bhavatāmicchayā sarvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ me surasattamāḥ  ||* 110.199 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vaḍavā sā nadī jātā gaṅgayā saṃgatā mune  |
tadbhavastu mahānagnirya āsīdatibhīṣaṇaḥ  |
tamāhuramarā vahniṃ bhūtānāmādito viduḥ  || 110.200 ||
{surā ūcu̱ḥ }
āpo jyeṣṭhatamā jñeyāstathaiva prathamaṃ bhavān  |
tatrāpyapāṃpatiṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ samudramaśanaṃ kuru  |
yathaiva tu vayaṃ brūmo gaccha bhuṅkṣva yathāsukham  || 110.201 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
analastvamarānāha āpastatra kathaṃ tvaham  |
vrajeyaṃ yadi māṃ tatra prāpayantyudakaṃ mahat || 110.202 ||
bhavanta eva te'pyāhuḥ kathaṃ te'gne gatirbhavet |
agnirapyāha tān devān kanyā māṃ guṇaśālinī  || 110.203 ||
hiraṇyakalaśe sthāpya nayedyatra gatirmama  |
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kanyāmūcuḥ sarasvatīm  || 110.204 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
nayainamanalaṃ śīghraṃ śirasā varuṇālayam  ||* 110.205 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sarasvatī surānāha naikā śaktā ca dhāraṇe  |
yuktā catasṛbhiḥ śīghraṃ vaheyaṃ varuṇālayam  || 110.206 ||
sarasvatyā vacaḥ śrutvā gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ tathā  |
narmadāṃ tapatīṃ caiva surāḥ procuḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 110.207 ||
tābhiḥ samanvitovāha hiraṇyakalaśe'nalam  |
saṃsthāpya śirasādhārya tā jagmurvaruṇālayam  || 110.208 ||
saṃsthāpya yatra deveśaḥ somanātho jagatpatiḥ  |
adhyāste vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ prabhāse śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ  || 110.209 ||
prāpayāmāsuranalaṃ pañcanadyaḥ sarasvatī  |
adhyāste ca mahānagniḥ piban vāri śanaiḥ śanaiḥ  || 110.210 ||
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve śivamūcuḥ surottamam  ||* 110.211 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
asthnāṃ ca pāvanaṃ brūhi asmākaṃ ca gavāṃ tathā  ||* 110.212 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śivaḥ prāha tadā sarvān gaṅgāmāplutya yatnataḥ  |
devāśca gāvastatpāpānmucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 110.213 ||
prakṣālitāni cāsthīni ṛṣidehabhavānyatha  |
tāni prakṣālanādeva tatra prāptāni pūtatām  || 110.214 ||
yatra devā muktapāpāstattīrthaṃ pāpanāśanam  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca brahmahatyāvināśanam  || 110.215 ||
gavāṃ ca pāvanaṃ yatra gotīrthaṃ tadudāhṛtam  |
tatra snānānmahābuddhirgomedhaphalamāpnuyāt || 110.216 ||
yatra tadbrāhmaṇāsthīni āsan puṇyāni nārada  |
pitṛtīrthaṃ tu vai jñeyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam  || 110.217 ||
bhasmāsthinakharomāṇi prāṇino yasya kasyacit |
tatra tīrthe saṃkrameran yāvaccandrārkatārakam  || 110.218 ||
svarge vāso bhavettasya api duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ  |
tathā cakreśvarāttīrthāttrīṇi tīrthāni nārada  |
tataḥ pūtāḥ suragaṇā gāvaḥ śaṃbhumathābruvan  || 110.219 ||
{gosurā ūcu̱ḥ }
yāmaḥ svaṃ svamadhiṣṭhānamatra sūryaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ  |
asmin sthite dinakare surāḥ sarve pratiṣṭhitāḥ  || 110.220 ||
bhaveyurjagatāmīśa tadanujñātumarhasi  |
sūryo hyātmāsya jagatastasthuṣaśca sanātanaḥ  || 110.221 ||
divākaro devamayastatrāsmābhiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ  |
yatra gaṅgā jagaddhātrī yatra vai tryambakaḥ svayam  |
suravāsaṃ pratiṣṭhānaṃ bhavedyatra ca tryambakam  || 110.222 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
āpṛcchya pippalādaṃ taṃ surāḥ svaṃ sadanaṃ yayuḥ  |
pippalāḥ kālaparyāye svargaṃ jagmurathākṣayam  || 110.223 ||
pādapānāṃ padaṃ vipraḥ pippalādaḥ pratāpavān  |
kṣetrādhipatye saṃsthāpya pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram  || 110.224 ||
dadhīcisūnurmunirugratejā  110.225
avāpya bhāryāṃ gautamasyātmajāṃ ca  110.225
putrānathāvāpya śriyaṃ yaśaśca  110.225
suhṛjjanaiḥ svargamavāpa dhīraḥ  110.225
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ pippaleśvaramucyate  |
sarvakratuphalaṃ puṇyaṃ smaraṇādaghanāśanam  || 110.226 ||
kiṃ punaḥ snānadānābhyāmādityasya tu darśanāt |
cakreśvaraḥ pippaleśo devadevasya nāmanī  || 110.227 ||
sarahasyaṃ viditvā tu sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt |
sūryasya ca pratiṣṭhānātsuravāse pratiṣṭhite  |
pratiṣṭhānaṃ tu tatkṣetraṃ surāṇāmapi vallabham  || 110.228 ||
itīdamākhyānamatīva puṇyaṃ  110.229
paṭheta vā yaḥ śṛṇuyātsmaredvā  110.229
sa dīrghajīvī dhanavān dharmayuktaś 110.229
cānte smarañśaṃbhumupaiti nityam  110.229
{brahmovāca̱ }
nāgatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  |
yatra nāgeśvaro devaḥ śṛṇu tasyāpi vistaram  || 111.1 ||
pratiṣṭhānapure rājā śūrasena iti śrutaḥ  |
somavaṃśabhavaḥ śrīmānmatimān guṇasāgaraḥ  || 111.2 ||
putrārthaṃ sa mahāyatnamakarotpriyayā saha  |
tasya putraścirādāsītsarpo vai bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ  || 111.3 ||
putraṃ taṃ gopayāmāsa śūraseno mahīpatiḥ  |
rājñaḥ putraḥ sarpa iti na kaścidvindate janaḥ  || 111.4 ||
antarvartī paro vāpi mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vinā  |
dhātreyyapi na jānāti nāmātyo na purohitaḥ  || 111.5 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣaṇaṃ sarpaṃ sabhāryo nṛpasattamaḥ  |
saṃtāpaṃ nityamāpnoti sarpādvaramaputratā  || 111.6 ||
etadasti mahāsarpo vakti nityaṃ manuṣyavat |
sa sarpaḥ pitaraṃ prāha kuru cūḍāmapi kriyām  || 111.7 ||
tathopanayanaṃ cāpi vedādhyayanameva ca  |
yāvadvedaṃ na cādhīte tāvacchūdrasamo dvijaḥ  || 111.8 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā putravacaḥ śūraseno'tiduḥkhitaḥ  |
brāhmaṇaṃ kaṃcanānīya saṃskārādi tadākarot |
adhītavedaḥ sarpo'pi pitaraṃ cābravīdidam  || 111.9 ||
{sarpa uvāca̱ }
vivāhaṃ kuru me rājan strīkāmo'haṃ nṛpottama  |
anyathāpi ca kṛtyaṃ te na sidhyediti me matiḥ  || 111.10 ||
janayitvātmajān veda vidhinākhilasaṃskṛtīḥ  |
na kuryādyaḥ pitā tasya narakānnāsti niṣkṛtiḥ  || 111.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vismitaḥ sa pitā prāha sutaṃ tamuragākṛtim  ||* 111.12 ||
{śūrasena uvāca̱ }
yasya śabdādapi trāsaṃ yānti śūrāśca pūruṣāḥ  |
tasmai kanyāṃ tu ko dadyādvada putra karomi kim  || 111.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatpiturvacanaṃ śrutvā sarpaḥ prāha vicakṣaṇaḥ  ||* 111.14 ||
{sarpa uvāca̱ }
vivāhā bahavo rājan rājñāṃ santi janeśvara  |
prasahyāharaṇaṃ cāpi śastrairvaivāha eva ca  || 111.15 ||
jāte vivāhe putrasya pitāsau kṛtakṛdbhavet |
no cedatraiva gaṅgāyāṃ mariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 111.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatputraniścayaṃ jñātvā aputro nṛpasattamaḥ  |
vivāhārthamamātyāṃstānāhūyedaṃ vaco'bravīt || 111.17 ||
{śūrasena uvāca̱ }
nāgeśvaro mama suto yuvarājo guṇākaraḥ  |
guṇavānmatimāñśūro durjayaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ  || 111.18 ||
rathe nāge sa dhanuṣi pṛthivyāṃ nopamīyate  |
vivāhastasya kartavyo hyahaṃ vṛddhastathaiva ca  || 111.19 ||
rājyabhāraṃ sute nyasya niścinto'haṃ bhavāmyataḥ  |
na dārasaṃgraho yāvattāvatputro mama priyaḥ  || 111.20 ||
bālabhāvaṃ no jahāti tasmātsarve'numanya ca  |
vivāhāyātha kurvantu yatnaṃ mama hite ratāḥ  || 111.21 ||
na me kācittadā cintā kṛtodvāho yadātmajaḥ  |
sute nyastabharā yānti kṛtinastapase vanam  || 111.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
amātyā rājavacanaṃ śrutvā sarve vinītavat |
ūcuḥ prāñjalayo harṣādrājānaṃ bhūritejasam  || 111.23 ||
{amātyā ūcu̱ḥ }
tava putro guṇajyeṣṭhastvaṃ ca sarvatra viśrutaḥ  |
vivāhe tava putrasya kiṃ mantryaṃ kiṃ tu cintyate  || 111.24 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
amātyeṣu tathokteṣu gambhīro nṛpasattamaḥ  |
putraṃ sarpaṃ tvamātyānāṃ na cākhyāti na te viduḥ  || 111.25 ||
rājā punastānuvāca kā syātkanyā guṇādhikā  |
mahāvaṃśabhavaḥ śrīmān ko rājā syādguṇāśrayaḥ  || 111.26 ||
saṃbandhayogyaḥ śūraśca yatsaṃbandhaḥ praśasyate  |
tadrājavacanaṃ śrutvā amātyānāṃ mahāmatiḥ  || 111.27 ||
kulīnaḥ sādhuratyantaṃ rājakāryahite rataḥ  |
rājño matiṃ viditvā tu iṅgitajño'bravīdidam  || 111.28 ||
{amātya uvāca̱ }
pūrvadeśe mahārāja vijayo nāma bhūpatiḥ  |
vājivāraṇaratnānāṃ yasya saṃkhyā na vidyate  || 111.29 ||
aṣṭau putrā maheṣvāsā mahārājasya dhīmataḥ  |
teṣāṃ svasā bhogavatī sākṣāllakṣmīrivāparā  |
tava putrasya yogyā sā bhāryā rājanmayoditā  || 111.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vṛddhāmātyavacaḥ śrutvā rājā taṃ pratyabhāṣata  ||* 111.31 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
sutā tasya kathaṃ me'sya sutasya syādvadasva tat ||* 111.32 ||
{vṛddhāmātya uvāca̱ }
lakṣito'si mahārāja yatte manasi vartate  |
yacchūrasena kṛtyaṃ syādanujānīhi māṃ tataḥ  || 111.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vṛddhāmātyavacaḥ śrutvā bhūṣaṇācchādanoktibhiḥ  |
saṃpūjya preṣayāmāsa mahatyā senayā saha  || 111.34 ||
sa pūrvadeśamāgatya mahārājaṃ sametya ca  |
saṃpūjya vividhairvākyairupāyairnītisaṃbhavaiḥ  || 111.35 ||
mahārājasutāyāśca bhogavatyā mahāmatiḥ  |
śūrasenasya nṛpateḥ sūnornāgasya dhīmataḥ  || 111.36 ||
vivāhāyākarotsaṃdhiṃ mithyāmithyāvacouktibhiḥ  |
pūjayāmāsa nṛpatiṃ bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ  || 111.37 ||
avāpya pūjāṃ nṛpatirdadāmītyavadattadā  |
tata āgatya rājñe'sau vṛddhāmātyo mahāmatiḥ  || 111.38 ||
śūrasenāya tadvṛttaṃ vaivāhikamavedayat |
tato bahutithe kāle vṛddhāmātyo mahāmatiḥ  || 111.39 ||
punarbalena mahatā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ  |
jagāma tarasā sarvairanyaiśca sacivairvṛtaḥ  || 111.40 ||
vivāhāya mahāmātyo mahārājāya buddhimān  |
sarvaṃ provāca vṛddho'sāvamātyaḥ sacivairvṛtaḥ  || 111.41 ||
{vṛddhāmātya uvāca̱ }
atrāgantuṃ na cāyāti śūrasenasya bhūpateḥ  |
putro nāga iti khyāto buddhimān guṇasāgaraḥ  || 111.42 ||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ vivāhāśca bhaveyurbahudhā nṛpa  |
tasmācchastrairalaṃkārairvivāhaḥ syānmahāmate  || 111.43 ||
kṣatriyā brāhmaṇāścaiva satyāṃ vācaṃ vadanti hi  |
tasmācchastrairalaṃkārairvivāhastvanumanyatām  || 111.44 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vṛddhāmātyavacaḥ śrutvā vijayo rājasattamaḥ  |
mene vākyaṃ tathā satyamamātyaṃ bhūpatiṃ tadā  || 111.45 ||
vivāhamakarodrājā bhogavatyāḥ savistaram  |
śastreṇa ca yathāśāstraṃ preṣayāmāsa tāṃ punaḥ  || 111.46 ||
svānamātyāṃstathā gāśca hiraṇyaturagādikam  |
bahu dattvātha vijayo harṣeṇa mahatā yutaḥ  || 111.47 ||
tāmādāyātha sacivā vṛddhāmātyapurogamāḥ  |
pratiṣṭhānamathābhyetya śūrasenāya tāṃ snuṣām  || 111.48 ||
nyavedayaṃstathocuste vijayasya vaco bahu  |
bhūṣaṇāni vicitrāṇi dāsyo vastrādikaṃ ca yat || 111.49 ||
nivedya śūrasenāya kṛtakṛtyā babhūvire  |
vijayasya tu ye'mātyā bhogavatyā sahāgatāḥ  || 111.50 ||
tān pūjayitvā rājāsau bahumānapuraḥsaram  |
vijayāya yathā prītistathā kṛtvā vyasarjayat || 111.51 ||
vijayasya sutā bālā rūpayauvanaśālinī  |
śvaśrūśvaśurayornityaṃ śuśrūṣantī sumadhyamā  || 111.52 ||
bhogavatyāśca yo bhartā mahāsarpo'tibhīṣaṇaḥ  |
ekāntadeśe vijane gṛhe ratnasuśobhite  || 111.53 ||
sugandhakusumākīrṇe tatrāste sukhaśītale  |
sa sarpo mātaraṃ prāha pitaraṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ  || 111.54 ||
mama bhāryā rājaputrī kiṃ māṃ naivopasarpati  |
tatputravacanaṃ śrutvā sarpamātedamabravīt || 111.55 ||
{rājapatnyuvāca̱ }
dhātrike gaccha subhage śīghraṃ bhogavatīṃ vada  |
tava bhartā sarpa iti tataḥ sā kiṃ vadiṣyati  || 111.56 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
dhātrikā ca tathetyuktvā gatvā bhogavatīṃ tadā  |
rahogatā uvācedaṃ vinītavadapūrvavat || 111.57 ||
{dhātrikovāca̱ }
jāne'haṃ subhage bhadre bhartāraṃ tava daivatam  |
na cākhyeyaṃ tvayā kvāpi sarpo na puruṣo dhruvam  || 111.58 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhogavatyabravīdidam  ||* 111.59 ||
{bhogavatyuvāca̱ }
mānuṣīṇāṃ manuṣyo hi bhartā sāmānyato bhavet |
kiṃ punardevajātistu bhartā puṇyena labhyate  || 111.60 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhogavatyāstu tadvākyaṃ sā ca sarvaṃ nyavedayat |
sarpāya sarpamātre ca rājñe caiva yathākramam  || 111.61 ||
ruroda rājā tadvākyātsmṛtvā tāṃ karmaṇo gatim  |
bhogavatyapi tāṃ prāha uktapūrvāṃ punaḥ sakhīm  || 111.62 ||
{bhogavatyuvāca̱ }
kāntaṃ darśaya bhadraṃ te vṛthā yāti vayo mama  ||* 111.63 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ sā darśayāmāsa sarpaṃ tamatibhīṣaṇam  |
sugandhakusumākīrṇe śayane sā rahogatā  || 111.64 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīṣaṇaṃ sarpaṃ bhartāraṃ ratnabhūṣitam  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭā vākyamavadatkāntamañjasā  || 111.65 ||
{bhogavatyuvāca̱ }
dhanyāsmyanugṛhītāsmi yasyā me daivataṃ patiḥ  ||* 111.66 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā śayane sthitvā taṃ sarpaṃ sarpabhāvanaiḥ  |
khelayāmāsa tanvaṅgī gītaiścaivāṅgasaṃgamaiḥ  || 111.67 ||
sugandhakusumaiḥ pānaistoṣayāmāsa taṃ patim  |
tasyāścaiva prasādena sarpasyābhūtsmṛtirmune  |
smṛtvā sarvaṃ daivakṛtaṃ rātrau sarpo'bravītpriyām  || 111.68 ||
{sarpa uvāca̱ }
rājakanyāpi māṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhītāsi kathaṃ priye  |
sovāca daivavihitaṃ ko'tikramitumīśvaraḥ  |
patireva gatiḥ strīṇāṃ sarvadaiva viśeṣataḥ  || 111.69 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutveti hṛṣṭastāmāha nāgaḥ prahasitānanaḥ  ||* 111.70 ||
{sarpa uvāca̱ }
tuṣṭo'smi tava bhaktyāhaṃ kiṃ dadāmi tavepsitam  |
tava prasādāccārvaṅgi sarvasmṛtirabhūdiyam  || 111.71 ||
śapto'haṃ devadevena kupitena pinākinā  |
maheśvarakare nāgaḥ śeṣaputro mahābalaḥ  || 111.72 ||
so'haṃ patistvaṃ ca bhāryā nāmnā bhogavatī purā  |
umāvākyājjahāsoccaiḥ śaṃbhuḥ prīto rahogataḥ  || 111.73 ||
mamāpi cāgataṃ bhadre hāsyaṃ taddevasaṃnidhau  |
tatastu kupitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ prādācchāpaṃ mamedṛśam  || 111.74 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
manuṣyayonau tvaṃ sarpo bhavitā jñānavāniti  ||* 111.75 ||
{sarpa uvāca̱ }
tataḥ prasāditaḥ śaṃbhustvayā bhadre mayā saha  |
tataścoktaṃ tena bhadre gautamyāṃ mama pūjanam  || 111.76 ||
kurvato jñānamādhāsye yadā sarpākṛtestava  |
tadā viśāpo bhavitā bhogavatyāḥ prasādataḥ  || 111.77 ||
tasmādidaṃ mamāpannaṃ tava cāpi śubhānane  |
tasmānnītvā gautamīṃ māṃ pūjāṃ kuru mayā saha  || 111.78 ||
tato viśāpo bhavitā āvāṃ yāvaḥ śivaṃ punaḥ  |
sarveṣāṃ sarvadārtānāṃ śiva eva parā gatiḥ  || 111.79 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā bhartṛvacanaṃ sā bhartrā gautamīṃ yayau  |
tataḥ snātvā tu gautamyāṃ pūjāṃ cakre śivasya tu  || 111.80 ||
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān divyarūpaṃ dadau mune  |
āpṛcchya pitarau sarpo bhāryayā gantumudyataḥ  |
śivalokaṃ tato jñātvā pitā prāha mahāmatiḥ  || 111.81 ||
{pitovāca̱ }
yuvarājyadharo jyeṣṭhaḥ putra eko bhavāniti  |
tasmādrājyamaśeṣeṇa kṛtvotpādya sutān bahūn  |
yāte mayi paraṃ dhāma tato yāhi śivaṃ puram  || 111.82 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā pitṛvacastathetyāha sa nāgarāṭ |
kāmarūpamavāpyātha bhāryayā saha suvrataḥ  || 111.83 ||
pitrā mātrā tathā putrai rājyaṃ kṛtvā suvistaram  |
yāte pitari svarlokaṃ putrān sthāpya svake pade  || 111.84 ||
bhāryāmātyādisahitastataḥ śivapuraṃ yayau  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ nāgatīrthamiti śrutam  || 111.85 ||
yatra nāgeśvaro devo bhogavatyā pratiṣṭhitaḥ  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam  || 111.86 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
mātṛtīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām  |
ādhibhirmucyate jantustattīrthasmaraṇādapi  || 112.1 ||
devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca saṃgaro'bhūtsudāruṇaḥ  |
nāśaknuvaṃstadā jetuṃ devā dānavasaṃgaram  || 112.2 ||
tadāhamagamaṃ devaistiṣṭhantaṃ śūlapāṇinam  |
astavaṃ vividhairvākyaiḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ śanaiḥ  || 112.3 ||
saṃmantrya devairasuraiśca sarvair 112.4
yadāhṛtaṃ saṃmathituṃ samudram  112.4
yatkālakūṭaṃ samabhūnmaheśa  112.4
tattvāṃ vinā ko grasituṃ samarthaḥ  112.4
puṣpaprahāreṇa jagattrayaṃ yaḥ  112.5
svādhīnamāpādayituṃ samarthaḥ  112.5
māro hare'pyanyasurādivandyo  112.5
vitāyamāno vilayaṃ prayātaḥ  112.5
vimathya vārīśamanaṅgaśatro  112.6
yaduttamaṃ tattu divaukasebhyaḥ  112.6
dattvā viṣaṃ saṃharannīlakaṇṭha  112.6
ko vā dhartuṃ tvāmṛte vai samarthaḥ  112.6
tataśca tuṣṭo bhagavānādikartā trilocanaḥ  ||* 112.7 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
dāsye'haṃ yadabhīṣṭaṃ vo bruvantu surasattamāḥ  ||* 112.8 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
dānavebhyo bhayaṃ ghoraṃ tatraihi vṛṣabhadhvaja  |
jahi śatrūn surān pāhi nāthavantastvayā prabho  || 112.9 ||
niṣkāraṇaḥ suhṛcchaṃbho nābhaviṣyadbhavān yadi  |
tadākariṣyan kimiva duḥkhārtāḥ sarvadehinaḥ  || 112.10 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktastatkṣaṇātprāyādyatra te devaśatravaḥ  |
tatra tadyuddhamabhavacchaṃkareṇa suradviṣām  || 112.11 ||
tatastrilocanaḥ śrāntastamorūpadharaḥ śivaḥ  |
lalāṭādvyapataṃstasya yudhyataḥ svedabindavaḥ  || 112.12 ||
sa saṃharan daityagaṇāṃstāmasīṃ mūrtimāśritaḥ  |
tāṃ mūrtimasurā dṛṣṭvā merupṛṣṭhādbhuvaṃ yayuḥ  || 112.13 ||
sa saṃharan sarvadaityāṃstadāgacchadbhuvaṃ haraḥ  |
itaścetaśca bhītāste'dhāvan sarvāṃ mahīmimām  || 112.14 ||
tathaiva kopādrudro'pi śatrūṃstānanudhāvati  |
tathaiva yudhyataḥ śaṃbhoḥ patitāḥ svedabindavaḥ  || 112.15 ||
yatra yatra bhuvaṃ prāpto bindurmāheśvaro mune  |
tatra tatra śivākārā mātaro jajñire tataḥ  || 112.16 ||
procurmaheśvaraṃ sarvāḥ khādāmastvasurāniti  |
tataḥ provāca bhagavān sarvaiḥ suragaṇairvṛtaḥ  || 112.17 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
svargādbhuvamanuprāptā rākṣasāste rasātalam  |
anuprāptāstataḥ sarvāḥ śṛṇvantu mama bhāṣitam  || 112.18 ||
yatra yatra dviṣo yānti tatra gacchantu mātaraḥ  |
rasātalamanuprāptā idānīṃ madbhayāddviṣaḥ  |
bhavatyo'pyanugacchantu rasātalamanu dviṣaḥ  || 112.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tāśca jagmurbhuvaṃ bhittvā yatra te daityadānavāḥ  |
tān hatvā mātaraḥ sarvān devārīnatibhīṣaṇān  || 112.20 ||
punardevānupājagmuḥ pathā tenaiva mātaraḥ  |
gatāśca mātaro yāvadyāvacca punarāgatāḥ  || 112.21 ||
tāvaddevāḥ sthitā āsan gautamītīramāśritāḥ  |
prasthānāttatra mātṝṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca pratiṣṭhiteḥ  || 112.22 ||
pratiṣṭhānaṃ tu tatkṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ vijayavardhanam  |
mātṝṇāṃ yatra cotpattirmātṛtīrthaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 112.23 ||
tatra tatra bilānyāsan rasātalagatāni ca  |
surāstābhyo varān procurloke pūjāṃ yathā śivaḥ  || 112.24 ||
prāpnoti tadvanmātṛbhyaḥ pūjā bhavatu sarvadā  |
ityuktvāntardadhurdevā āsaṃstatraiva mātaraḥ  || 112.25 ||
yatra yatra sthitā devyo mātṛtīrthaṃ tato viduḥ  |
surāṇāmapi sevyāni kiṃ punarmānuṣādibhiḥ  || 112.26 ||
teṣu snānamatho dānaṃ pitṝṇāṃ caiva tarpaṇam  |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ śivasya vacanaṃ yathā  || 112.27 ||
yastvidaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ smaredapi paṭhettathā  |
ākhyānaṃ mātṛtīrthānāmāyuṣmān sa sukhī bhavet || 112.28 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
idamapyaparaṃ tīrthaṃ devānāmapi durlabham  |
brahmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām  || 113.1 ||
sthiteṣu devasainyeṣu praviṣṭeṣu rasātalam  |
daityeṣu ca muniśreṣṭha tathā mātṛṣu tānanu  || 113.2 ||
madīyaṃ pañcamaṃ vaktraṃ gardabhākṛti bhīṣaṇam  |
tadvaktraṃ devasainyeṣu mayi tiṣṭhatyuvāca ha  || 113.3 ||
he daityāḥ kiṃ palāyante na bhayaṃ vo'stu satvaram  |
āgacchantu surān sarvān bhakṣayiṣye kṣaṇāditi  || 113.4 ||
nivārayantaṃ māmevaṃ bhakṣaṇāyodyataṃ tathā  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudhāḥ sarve vitrastā viṣṇumabruvan  || 113.5 ||
trāhi viṣṇo jagannātha brahmaṇo'sya mukhaṃ luna  |
cakradhṛgvibudhānāha cchedmi cakreṇa vai śiraḥ  || 113.6 ||
kiṃ tu tacchinnamevedaṃ saṃharetsacarācaram  |
mantraṃ brūmo'tra vibudhāḥ śrūyatāṃ sarvameva hi  || 113.7 ||
trinetraḥ kaśiraśchettā sa ca dhatte na saṃśayaḥ  |
mayā ca śaṃbhuḥ sarvaiśca stutaḥ proktastathaiva ca  || 113.8 ||
yāgaḥ kṣaṇī dṛṣṭaphale'samarthaḥ  113.9
sa naiva kartuḥ phalatīti matvā  113.9
phalasya dāne pratibhūrjaṭīti  113.9
niścitya lokaḥ pratikarma yātaḥ  113.9
tataḥ sureśaḥ saṃtuṣṭo devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye  |
lokānāmupakārārthaṃ tathetyāha surān prati  || 113.10 ||
tadvaktraṃ pāparūpaṃ yadbhīṣaṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam  |
nikṛtya nakhaśastraiśca kva sthāpyaṃ cetyathābravīt || 113.11 ||
tatrelā vibudhānāha nāhaṃ voḍhuṃ śiraḥ kṣamā  |
rasātalamatho yāsye udadhiścāpyathābravīt || 113.12 ||
śoṣaṃ yāsye kṣaṇādeva punaścocuḥ śivaṃ surāḥ  |
tvayaivaitadbrahmaśiro dhāryaṃ lokānukampayā  || 113.13 ||
acchede jagatāṃ nāśaśchede doṣaśca tādṛśaḥ  |
evaṃ vimṛśya someśo dadhāra kaśirastadā  || 113.14 ||
taddṛṣṭvā duṣkaraṃ karma gautamīṃ prāpya pāvanīm  |
astuvañjagatāmīśaṃ praṇayādbhaktitaḥ surāḥ  || 113.15 ||
deveṣvamitraṃ kaśiro'tibhīmaṃ  113.16
tān bhakṣaṇāyopagataṃ nikṛtya  113.16
nakhāgrasūcyā śakalendumaulis 113.16
tyāge'pi doṣātkṛpayānudhatte  113.16
tatra te vibudhāḥ sarve sthitā ye brahmaṇo'ntike  |
tuṣṭuvurvibudheśānaṃ karma dṛṣṭvātidaivatam  || 113.17 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ brahmatīrthamiti śrutam  |

{śeṣa uvāca̱ }

aśvattho'śvattharūpeṇa pippalo brahmarūpadhṛk |
tāvubhāvantaraṃ prepsū yajñavidhvaṃsanāya tu  || 118.11 ||
kurutāṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ rūpaṃ dānavau pāpacetasau  |
aśvattho vṛkṣarūpeṇa pippalo brāhmaṇākṛtiḥ  || 118.12 ||
ubhau tau brāhmaṇānnityaṃ pīḍayetāṃ tapodhana  |
ālabhante ca ye'śvatthaṃ tāṃstānaśnātyasau taruḥ  || 118.13 ||
pippalaḥ sāmago bhūtvā śiṣyānaśnāti rākṣasaḥ  |
tasmādadyāpi vipreṣu sāmago'tīva niṣkṛpaḥ  || 118.14 ||
kṣīyamāṇān dvijān dṛṣṭvā munayo rākṣasāvimau  |
iti buddhvā mahāprājñā dakṣiṇaṃ tīramāśritam  || 118.15 ||
sauriṃ śanaiścaraṃ mandaṃ tapasyantaṃ dhṛtavratam  |
gatvā munigaṇāḥ sarve rakṣaḥkarma nyavedayan  || 118.16 ||
saurirmunigaṇānāha pūrṇe tapasi me dvijāḥ  |
rākṣasau hanmyapūrṇe tu tapasyakṣama eva hi  || 118.17 ||
punaḥ procurmunigaṇā dāsyāmaste tapo mahat |
ityukto brāhmaṇaiḥ sauriḥ kṛtamityāha tānapi  || 118.18 ||
saurirbrāhmaṇaveṣeṇa prāyādaśvattharūpiṇam  |
rākṣasaṃ brāhmaṇo bhūtvā pradakṣiṇamathākarot || 118.19 ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu kurvāṇaṃ mene brāhmaṇameva tam  |
nityavadrākṣasaḥ pāpo bhakṣayāmāsa māyayā  || 118.20 ||
tasya kāyaṃ samāviśya cakṣuṣāntrāṇyapaśyata  |
dṛṣṭaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ pāpo mandena ravisūnunā  || 118.21 ||
bhasmībhūtaḥ kṣaṇenaiva girirvajrahato yathā  |
aśvatthaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā anyaṃ brāhmaṇarūpiṇam  || 118.22 ||
rākṣasaṃ pāpanilayameka eva tamabhyagāt |
adhīyāno vipra iva śiṣyarūpo vinītavat || 118.23 ||
pippalaḥ pūrvavaccāpi bhakṣayāmāsa bhānujam  |
sa bhakṣitaḥ pūrvavacca kukṣāvantrāṇyavaikṣata  || 118.24 ||
tenālokitamātro'sau rākṣaso bhasmasādabhūt |
ubhau hatvā bhānusutaḥ kiṃ kṛtyaṃ me vadantvatha  || 118.25 ||
munayo jātasaṃharṣāḥ sarva eva tapasvinaḥ  |
tataḥ prasannā hyabhavannṛṣayo'gastyapūrvakāḥ  || 118.26 ||
varān daduryathākāmaṃ sauraye mandagāmine  |
sa prīto brāhmaṇānāha śaniḥ sūryasuto balī  || 118.27 ||
{sauriruvāca̱ }
maddvāre niyatā ye ca kurvantyaśvatthalambhanam  |
teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi syuḥ pīḍā madbhavā na ca  || 118.28 ||
tīrthe cāśvatthasaṃjñe vai snānaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ  |
teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi bhaveyuraparo varaḥ  || 118.29 ||
mandavāre tu ye'śvatthaṃ prātarutthāya mānavāḥ  |
ālabhante ca teṣāṃ vai grahapīḍā vyapohatu  || 118.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamaśvatthaṃ pippalaṃ viduḥ  |
tīrthaṃ śanaiścaraṃ tatra tatrāgastyaṃ ca sāttrikam  || 118.31 ||
yājñikaṃ cāpi tattīrthaṃ sāmagaṃ tīrthameva ca  |
ityādyaṣṭottarāṇyāsan sahasrāṇyatha ṣoḍaśa  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sattrayāgaphalapradam  || 118.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
somatīrthamiti khyātaṃ tadapyuktaṃ mahātmabhiḥ  |
tatra snānena dānena somapānaphalaṃ labhet || 119.1 ||
jagatāṃ mātaraḥ pūrvamoṣadhyo jīvasaṃmatāḥ  |
mamāpi mātaro devyaḥ pūrvāsāṃ pūrvavattarāḥ  || 119.2 ||
āsu pratiṣṭhito dharmaḥ svādhyāyo yajñakarma ca  |
ābhireva dhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram  || 119.3 ||
aśeṣarogopaśamo bhavatyābhirasaṃśayam  |
annametābhireva syādaśeṣaprāṇarakṣaṇam  |
atrauṣadhyo jagadvandyā māmūcuranahaṃkṛtāḥ  || 119.4 ||
{oṣadhya ūcu̱ḥ }
asmākaṃ tvaṃ patiṃ dehi rājānaṃ surasattama  ||* 119.5 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tāsāṃ mayoktā oṣadhīridam  |
patiṃ prāpsyatha sarvāśca rājānaṃ prītivardhanam  || 119.6 ||
rājānamiti tacchrutvā tā māmūcuḥ punarmune  |
gantavyaṃ kva punaścoktā gautamīṃ yāntu mātaraḥ  || 119.7 ||
tuṣṭāyāmatha tasyāṃ vo rājā syāllokapūjitaḥ  |
tāśca gatvā muniśreṣṭha tuṣṭuvurgautamīṃ nadīm  || 119.8 ||
{oṣadhya ūcu̱ḥ }
kiṃ vākariṣyan bhavavartino janā  119.9
nānāghasaṃghābhibhavācca duḥkhitāḥ  119.9
na cāgamiṣyadbhavatī bhuvaṃ cet 119.9
puṇyodake gautami śaṃbhukānte  119.9
ko vetti bhāgyaṃ naradehabhājāṃ  119.10
mahīgatānāṃ saritāmadhīśe  119.10
eṣāṃ mahāpātakasaṃghahantrī  119.10
tvamamba gaṅge sulabhā sadaiva  119.10
na te vibhūtiṃ nanu vetti ko'pi  119.11
trailokyavandye jagadamba gaṅge  119.11
gaurīsamāliṅgitavigraho'pi  119.11
dhatte smarāriḥ śirasāpi yattvām  119.11
namo'stu te mātarabhīṣṭadāyini  119.12
namo'stu te brahmamaye'ghanāśini  119.12
namo'stu te viṣṇupadābjaniḥsṛte  119.12
namo'stu te śaṃbhujaṭāviniḥsṛte  119.12
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityevaṃ stuvatāmīśā kiṃ dadāmītyavocata  ||* 119.13 ||
{oṣadhya ūcu̱ḥ }
patiṃ dehi jaganmātā rājānamatitejasam  ||* 119.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadovāca nadī gaṅgā oṣadhīstā idaṃ vacaḥ  ||* 119.15 ||
{gaṅgovāca̱ }
ahaṃ cāmṛtarūpāsmi oṣadhyo mātaro'mṛtāḥ  |
tādṛśaṃ cāmṛtātmānaṃ patiṃ somaṃ dadāmi vaḥ  || 119.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
devāśca ṛṣayo vākyaṃ menire soma eva ca  |
oṣadhyaścāpi tadvākyaṃ tato jagmuḥ svamālayam  || 119.17 ||
yatra cāpurmahauṣadhyo rājānamamṛtātmakam  |
somaṃ samastasaṃtāpa pāpasaṃghanivārakam  || 119.18 ||
somatīrthaṃ tu tatkhyātaṃ somapānaphalapradam  |
tatra snānena dānena pitaraḥ svargamāpnuyuḥ  || 119.19 ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedvā bhaktitaḥ smaret |
dīrghamāyuravāpnoti sa putrī dhanavān bhavet || 119.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
dhānyatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām  |
subhikṣaṃ kṣemadaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvāpadvinivāraṇam  || 120.1 ||
oṣadhyaḥ somarājānaṃ patiṃ prāpya mudānvitāḥ  |
ūcuḥ sarvasya lokasya gaṅgāyāścepsitaṃ vacaḥ  || 120.2 ||
{oṣadhya ūcu̱ḥ }
vaidikī puṇyagāthāsti yāṃ vai vedavido viduḥ  |
bhūmiṃ sasyavatīṃ kaścinmātaraṃ mātṛsaṃmitām  || 120.3 ||
gaṅgāsamīpe yo dadyātsarvakāmānavāpnuyāt |
bhūmiṃ sasyavatīṃ gāśca oṣadhīśca mudānvitaḥ  || 120.4 ||
viṣṇubrahmeśarūpāya yo dadyādbhaktimānnaraḥ  |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ vidyātsarvakāmānavāpnuyāt || 120.5 ||
oṣadhyaḥ somarājanyāḥ somaścāpyoṣadhīpatiḥ  |
iti jñātvā brahmavida oṣadhīryaḥ pradāsyati  || 120.6 ||
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti brahmaloke mahīyate  |
tā eva somarājanyāḥ prītāḥ procuḥ punaḥ punaḥ  || 120.7 ||
{oṣadhya ūcu̱ḥ }
yo'smān dadāti gaṅgāyāṃ taṃ rājan pārayāmasi  |
tvamuttamaścauṣadhīśa tvadadhīnaṃ carācaram  || 120.8 ||
oṣadhayaḥ saṃvadante somena saha rājñā  |
yo'smān dadāti viprebhyastaṃ rājan pārayāmasi  || 120.9 ||
vayaṃ ca brahmarūpiṇyaḥ prāṇarūpiṇya eva ca  |
yo'smān dadāti viprebhyastaṃ rājan pārayāmasi  || 120.10 ||
asmān dadāti yo nityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo jitavrataḥ  |
upāstirasti sāsmākaṃ taṃ rājan pārayāmasi  || 120.11 ||
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ kiṃcidasmābhirvyāpṛtaṃ jagat |
yo'smān dadāti viprebhyastaṃ rājan pārayāmasi  || 120.12 ||
havyaṃ kavyaṃ yadamṛtaṃ yatkiṃcidupabhujyate  |
tadgarīyaśca yo dadyāttaṃ rājan pārayāmasi  || 120.13 ||
ityetāṃ vaidikīṃ gāthāṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti smareta vā  |
paṭhate bhaktimāpannastaṃ rājan pārayāmasi  || 120.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yatraiṣā paṭhitā gāthā somena saha rājñā  |
gaṅgātīre cauṣadhībhirdhānyatīrthaṃ taducyate  || 120.15 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamauṣadhyaṃ saumyameva ca  |
amṛtaṃ vedagāthaṃ ca mātṛtīrthaṃ tathaiva ca  || 120.16 ||
eṣu snānaṃ japo homo dānaṃ ca pitṛtarpaṇam  |
annadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttadānantyāya kalpate  || 120.17 ||
ṣaṭśatādhikasāhasraṃ tīrthānāṃ tīrayordvayoḥ  |
sarvapāpanihantṝṇāṃ sarvasaṃpadvivardhanam  || 120.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vidarbhāsaṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ revatīsaṃgamaṃ tathā  |
tatra yadvṛttamākhyāsye yatpurāṇavido viduḥ  || 121.1 ||
bharadvāja iti khyāta ṛṣirāsīttapodhikaḥ  |
tasya svasā revatīti kurūpā vikṛtasvarā  || 121.2 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtāṃ bhrātā bharadvājaḥ pratāpavān  |
cintayā parayā yukto gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 121.3 ||
kasmai dadyāmimāṃ kanyāṃ svasāraṃ bhīṣaṇākṛtim  |
na kaścitpratigṛhṇāti dātavyā ca svasā tathā  || 121.4 ||
aho bhūyānna kasyāpi kanyā duḥkhaikakāraṇam  |
maraṇaṃ jīvato'pyasya prāṇinastu pade pade  || 121.5 ||
evaṃ vimṛśatastasya svāśrame cātiśobhane  |
draṣṭuṃ munivaraḥ prāyādbharadvājaṃ yatavratam  || 121.6 ||
dvyaṣṭavarṣaḥ śubhavapuḥ śānto dānto guṇākaraḥ  |
nāmnā kaṭha iti khyāto bharadvājaṃ nanāma saḥ  || 121.7 ||
vidhivatpūjya taṃ vipraṃ bharadvājaḥ kaṭhaṃ tadā  |
tasyāgamanakāryaṃ ca papraccha purataḥ sthitaḥ  || 121.8 ||
kaṭho'pyāha bharadvājaṃ vidyārthyahamupāgataḥ  |
tathā ca darśanākāṅkṣī yadyuktaṃ tadvidhīyatām  || 121.9 ||
bharadvājaḥ kaṭhaṃ prāha adhīṣva yadabhīpsitam  |
purāṇaṃ smṛtayo vedā dharmasthānānyanekaśaḥ  || 121.10 ||
sarvaṃ vedmi mahāprājña ruciraṃ vada mā ciram  |
kulīno dharmanirato guruśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ  |
abhimānī śrutadharaḥ śiṣyaḥ puṇyairavāpyate  || 121.11 ||
{kaṭha uvāca̱ }
adhyāpayasva bho brahmañśiṣyaṃ māṃ vītakalmaṣam  |
śuśrūṣaṇarataṃ bhaktaṃ kulīnaṃ satyavādinam  || 121.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā bharadvājaḥ prādādvidyāmaśeṣataḥ  |
prāptavidyaḥ kaṭhaḥ prīto bharadvājamathābravīt || 121.13 ||
{kaṭha uvāca̱ }
iccheyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dātuṃ guro tava manaḥpriyām  |
vadasva durlabhaṃ vāpi guro tubhyaṃ namo'stu te  || 121.14 ||
vidyāṃ prāpyāpi ye mohātsvaguroḥ pāritoṣikam  |
na prayacchanti nirayaṃ te yāntyācandratārakam  || 121.15 ||
{bharadvāja uvāca̱ }
gṛhāṇa kanyāṃ vidhivadbhāryāṃ kuru mama svasām  |
asyāṃ prītyā vartitavyaṃ yāceyaṃ dakṣiṇāmimām  || 121.16 ||
{kaṭha uvāca̱ }
bhrātṛvatputravaccāpi śiṣyaḥ syāttu guroḥ sadā  |
guruśca pitṛvacca syātsaṃbandho'tra kathaṃ bhavet || 121.17 ||
{bharadvāja uvāca̱ }
madvākyaṃ kuru satyaṃ tvaṃ mamājñā tava dakṣiṇā  |
sarvaṃ smṛtvā kaṭhādya tvaṃ revatīṃ bhara tanmanāḥ  || 121.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā gurorvākyātkaṭho jagrāha pāṇinā  |
revatīṃ vidhivaddattāṃ tāṃ samīkṣya kaṭhastvatha  || 121.19 ||
tatraiva pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tadā  |
revatyā rūpasaṃpattyai śivaprītyai ca revatī  || 121.20 ||
surūpā cārusarvāṅgī na rūpeṇopamīyate  |
abhiṣekodakaṃ tatra revatyā yadviniḥsṛtam  || 121.21 ||
sābhavattatra gaṅgāyāṃ tasmāttannāmato nadī  |
revatīti samākhyātā rūpasaubhāgyadāyinī  || 121.22 ||
punardarbhaiśca vividhairabhiṣekaṃ cakāra saḥ  |
puṇyarūpatvasaṃsiddhyai vidarbhā tadabhūnnadī  || 121.23 ||
śraddhayā saṃgame snātvā revatīgaṅgayornaraḥ  |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate  || 121.24 ||
tathā vidarbhāgautamyoḥ saṃgame śraddhayā mune  |
snānaṃ karotyasau yāti bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt || 121.25 ||
ubhayostīrayostatra tīrthānāṃ śatamuttamam  |
sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam  || 121.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pūrṇatīrthamiti khyātaṃ gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe  |
tatra snātvā naro'jñānāttathāpi śubhamāpnuyāt || 122.1 ||
pūrṇatīrthasya māhātmyaṃ varṇyate kena jantunā  |
svayaṃ saṃsthīyate yatra cakriṇā ca pinākinā  || 122.2 ||
purā dhanvantarirnāma kalpādāvāyuṣaḥ sutaḥ  |
iṣṭvā bahuvidhairyajñairaśvamedhapuraḥsaraiḥ  || 122.3 ||
dattvā dānānyanekāni bhuktvā bhogāṃśca puṣkalān  |
vijñāya bhogavaiṣamyaṃ paraṃ vairāgyamāśritaḥ  || 122.4 ||
giriśṛṅge'mbudheḥ pāre tathā gaṅgānadītaṭe  |
śivaviṣṇvorgṛhe vāpi viśeṣātpuṇyasaṃgame  || 122.5 ||
taptaṃ hutaṃ ca japtaṃ ca sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet |
dhanvantaririti jñātvā tatra tepe tapo mahat || 122.6 ||
jñānavairāgyasaṃpanno bhīmeśacaraṇāśrayaḥ  |
tapaścakāra vipulaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame  || 122.7 ||
purā ca nikṛto rājñā raṇaṃ hitvā mahāsuraḥ  |
sahasramekaṃ varṣāṇāṃ samudraṃ prāviśadbhayāt || 122.8 ||
dhanvantarau vanaṃ prāpte rājyaṃ prāpte tu tatsute  |
virāgaṃ ca gate rājñi tataḥ prāyādathārṇavāt || 122.9 ||
tapasyantaṃ tamo nāma balavānasuro mune  |
gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritya rājā dhanvantariryataḥ  || 122.10 ||
japahomarato nityaṃ brahmajñānaparāyaṇaḥ  |
taṃ ripuṃ nāśayāmīti tamaḥ prāyādathārṇavāt || 122.11 ||
nāśito bahuśo'nena rājñā balavatā tvaham  |
taṃ ripuṃ nāśayāmīti tamaḥ prāyādathārṇavāt || 122.12 ||
māyayā pramadārūpaṃ kṛtvā rājānamabhyagāt |
nṛtyagītavatī subhrūrhasantī cārudarśanā  || 122.13 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cārusarvāṅgīṃ bahukālaṃ nayānvitām  |
śāntāmanuvratāṃ bhaktāṃ kṛpayā cābravīnnṛpaḥ  || 122.14 ||
{nṛpa uvāca̱ }
kāsi tvaṃ kasya hetorvā vartase gahane vane  |
kaṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣasīva tvaṃ vada kalyāṇi pṛcchate  || 122.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pramadā cāpi tadvākyaṃ śrutvā rājānamabravīt ||* 122.16 ||
{pramadovāca̱ }
tvayi tiṣṭhati ko loke heturharṣasya me bhavet |
ahamindrasya yā lakṣmīstvāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmasaṃbhṛtam  || 122.17 ||
harṣāccarāmi purato rājaṃstava punaḥ punaḥ  |
agaṇyapuṇyavirahādahaṃ sarvasya durlabhā  || 122.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etadvaco niśamyāśu tapastyaktvā suduṣkaram  |
tāmeva manasā dhyāyaṃstanniṣṭhastatparāyaṇaḥ  || 122.19 ||
tadekaśaraṇo rājā babhūva sa yadā tamaḥ  |
antardhānaṃ gato brahmannāśayitvā tapo bṛhat || 122.20 ||
etasminnantare'haṃ vai varān dātuṃ samabhyagām  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vihvalībhūtaṃ tapobhraṣṭaṃ yathā mṛtam  || 122.21 ||
tamāśvāsyātha vividhairhetubhirnṛpasattamam  |
tava śatrustamo nāma kṛtvā tāṃ tapasaścyutim  || 122.22 ||
caritārtho gato rājanna tvaṃ śocitumarhasi  |
ānandayanti pramadāstāpayanti ca mānavam  || 122.23 ||
sarvā eva viśeṣeṇa kimu māyāmayī tu sā  |
tataḥ kṛtāñjalī rājā māmāha vigatabhramaḥ  || 122.24 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
kiṃ karomi kathaṃ brahmaṃstapasaḥ pāramāpnuyām  ||* 122.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatastasyottaraṃ prādāṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam  |
stuhi sarvaprayatnena tataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi  || 122.26 ||
sa hyaśeṣajagatsraṣṭā vedavedyaḥ purātanaḥ  |
sarvārthasiddhidaḥ puṃsāṃ nānyo'sti bhuvanatraye  || 122.27 ||
sa jagāma nagaśreṣṭhaṃ himavantaṃ nṛpottamaḥ  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktitaḥ  || 122.28 ||
{dhanvantariruvāca̱ }
jaya viṣṇo jayācintya jaya jiṣṇo jayācyuta  |
jaya gopāla lakṣmīśa jaya kṛṣṇa jaganmaya  || 122.29 ||
jaya bhūtapate nātha jaya pannagaśāyine  |
jaya sarvaga govinda jaya viśvakṛte namaḥ  || 122.30 ||
jaya viśvabhuje deva jaya viśvadhṛte namaḥ  |
jayeśa sadasattvaṃ vai jaya mādhava dharmiṇe  || 122.31 ||
jaya kāmada kāma tvaṃ jaya rāma guṇārṇava  |
jaya puṣṭida puṣṭīśa jaya kalyāṇadāyine  || 122.32 ||
jaya bhūtapa bhūteśa jaya mānavidhāyine  |
jaya karmada karma tvaṃ jaya pītāmbaracchada  || 122.33 ||
jaya sarveśa sarvastvaṃ jaya maṅgalarūpiṇe  |
jaya sattvādhināthāya jaya vedavide namaḥ  || 122.34 ||
jaya janmada janmistha paramātmannamo'stu te  |
jaya muktida muktistvaṃ jaya bhuktida keśava  || 122.35 ||
jaya lokada lokeśa jaya pāpavināśana  |
jaya vatsala bhaktānāṃ jaya cakradhṛte namaḥ  || 122.36 ||
jaya mānada mānastvaṃ jaya lokanamaskṛta  |
jaya dharmada dharmastvaṃ jaya saṃsārapāraga  || 122.37 ||
jaya annada annaṃ tvaṃ jaya vācaspate namaḥ  |
jaya śaktida śaktistvaṃ jaya jaitravaraprada  || 122.38 ||
jaya yajñada yajñastvaṃ jaya padmadalekṣaṇa  |
jaya dānada dānaṃ tvaṃ jaya kaiṭabhasūdana  || 122.39 ||
jaya kīrtida kīrtistvaṃ jaya mūrtida mūrtidhṛk |
jaya saukhyada saukhyātmañjaya pāvanapāvana  || 122.40 ||
jaya śāntida śāntistvaṃ jaya śaṃkarasaṃbhava  |
jaya pānada pānastvaṃ jaya jyotiḥsvarūpiṇe  || 122.41 ||
jaya vāmana vitteśa jaya dhūmapatākine  |
jaya sarvasya jagato dātṛmūrte namo'stu te  || 122.42 ||
tvameva lokatrayavartijīva  122.43
nikāyasaṃkleśavināśadakṣa  122.43
śrīpuṇḍarīkākṣa kṛpānidhe tvaṃ  122.43
nidhehi pāṇiṃ mama mūrdhni viṣṇo  122.43
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ stuvantaṃ bhagavāñśaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  |
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa sarvakāmasamṛddhidaḥ  || 122.44 ||
dhanvantariḥ prītamanā varadānena cakriṇaḥ  |
varadānāya deveśaṃ govindaṃ saṃsthitaṃ puraḥ  || 122.45 ||
tamāha nṛpatiḥ prahvaḥ surarājyaṃ mamepsitam  |
tacca dattaṃ tvayā viṣṇo prāpto'smi kṛtakṛtyatām  || 122.46 ||
stutaḥ saṃpūjito viṣṇustatraivāntaradhīyata  |
tathaiva tridaśeśatvamavāpa nṛpatiḥ kramāt || 122.47 ||
prāgarjitānekakarma paripākavaśāttataḥ  |
triḥkṛtvo nāśamagamatsahasrākṣaḥ svakātpadāt || 122.48 ||
nahuṣādvṛtrahatyāyāḥ sindhusenavadhāttataḥ  |
ahalyāyāṃ ca gamanādyena kena ca hetunā  || 122.49 ||
smāraṃ smāraṃ tattadindraścintāsaṃtāpadurmanāḥ  |
tataḥ surapatiḥ prāha vācaspatimidaṃ vacaḥ  || 122.50 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
hetunā kena vāgīśa bhraṣṭarājyo bhavāmyaham  |
madhye madhye padabhraṃśādvaraṃ niḥśrīkatā nṛṇām  || 122.51 ||
gahanāṃ karmaṇāṃ jīva gatiṃ ko vetti tattvataḥ  |
rahasyaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ jñātuṃ nānyaḥ pragalbhate  || 122.52 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bṛhaspatirhariṃ prāha brahmāṇaṃ pṛccha gaccha tam  |
sa tu jānāti yadbhūtaṃ bhaviṣyaccāpi vartanam  || 122.53 ||
sa tu vakṣyati yenedaṃ jātaṃ tacca mahāmate  |
tāvāgatya mahāprājñau namaskṛtya mamāntikam  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā māmūcaturidaṃ vacaḥ  || 122.54 ||
{indrabṛhaspatī ūcatu̱ḥ }
bhagavan kena doṣeṇa śacībhartā udāradhīḥ  |
rājyātprabhraśyate nātha saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi  || 122.55 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadāhamabravaṃ brahmaṃściraṃ dhyātvā bṛhaspatim  |
khaṇḍadharmākhyadoṣeṇa tena rājyapadāccyutaḥ  || 122.56 ||
deśakālādidoṣeṇa śraddhāmantraviparyayāt |
yathāvaddakṣiṇādānādasaddravyapradānataḥ  || 122.57 ||
devabhūdevatāvajñā pātakācca viśeṣataḥ  |
yatkhaṇḍatvaṃ svadharmasya dehināmupajāyate  || 122.58 ||
tenātimānasastāpaḥ padahāniśca dustyajā  |
kṛto'pi dharmo'niṣṭāya jāyate kṣubdhacetasā  || 122.59 ||
kāryasya na bhavetsiddhyai tasmādavyākulāya ca  |
asaṃpūrṇe svadharme hi kimaniṣṭaṃ na jāyate  || 122.60 ||
tābhyāṃ yatpūrvavṛttāntaṃ tadapyuktaṃ mayānagha  |
āyuṣastu sutaḥ śrīmān dhanvantarirudāradhīḥ  || 122.61 ||
tamasā ca kṛtaṃ vighnaṃ viṣṇunā tacca nāśitam  |
pūrvajanmasu vṛttāntamityādi parikīrtitam  || 122.62 ||
tacchrutvā vismitau cobhau māmeva punarūcatuḥ  ||* 122.63 ||
{indrabṛhaspatī ūcatu̱ḥ }
taddoṣapratibandhastu kena syātsurasattama  ||* 122.64 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
punardhyātvā tāvavadaṃ śrūyatāṃ doṣakārakam  |
kāraṇaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ duḥkhasaṃsāratāraṇam  || 122.65 ||
śaraṇaṃ taptacittānāṃ nirvāṇaṃ jīvatāmapi  |
gatvā tu gautamīṃ devīṃ stūyetāṃ hariśaṃkarau  || 122.66 ||
nopāyo'nyo'sti saṃśuddhyai tau tāṃ hitvā jagattraye  |
tadaiva jagmaturubhau gautamīṃ munisattama  |
snātau kṛtakṣaṇau cobhau devau tuṣṭuvaturmudā  || 122.67 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
namo matsyāya kūrmāya varāhāya namo namaḥ  |
narasiṃhāya devāya vāmanāya namo namaḥ  || 122.68 ||
namo'stu hayarūpāya trivikrama namo'stu te  |
namo'stu buddharūpāya rāmarūpāya kalkine  || 122.69 ||
anantāyācyutāyeśa jāmadagnyāya te namaḥ  |
varuṇendrasvarūpāya yamarūpāya te namaḥ  || 122.70 ||
parameśāya devāya namastrailokyarūpiṇe  |
bibhratsarasvatīṃ vaktre sarvajño'si namo'stu te  || 122.71 ||
lakṣmīvānasyato lakṣmīṃ bibhradvakṣasi cānagha  |
bahubāhūrupādastvaṃ bahukarṇākṣiśīrṣakaḥ  |
tvāmeva sukhinaṃ prāpya bahavaḥ sukhino'bhavan  || 122.72 ||
tāvanniḥśrīkatā puṃsāṃ mālinyaṃ dainyameva vā  |
yāvanna yānti śaraṇaṃ hare tvāṃ karuṇārṇavam  || 122.73 ||
{bṛhaspatiruvāca̱ }
sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ jotiranantarūpam  122.74
oṃkāramātraṃ prakṛteḥ paraṃ yat 122.74
cidrūpamānandamayaṃ samastam  122.74
evaṃ vadantīśa mumukṣavastvām  122.74
ārādhayantyatra bhavantamīśaṃ  122.75
mahāmakhaiḥ pañcabhirapyakāmāḥ  122.75
saṃsārasindhoḥ paramāptakāmā  122.75
viśanti divyaṃ bhuvanaṃ vapuste  122.75
sarveṣu sattveṣu samatvabuddhyā  122.76
saṃvīkṣya ṣaṭsūrmiṣu śāntabhāvāḥ  122.76
jñānena te karmaphalāni hitvā  122.76
dhyānena te tvāṃ praviśanti śaṃbho  122.76
na jātidharmāṇi na vedaśāstraṃ  122.77
na dhyānayogo na samādhidharmaḥ  122.77
rudraṃ śivaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śānticittaṃ  122.77
bhaktyā devaṃ somamahaṃ namasye  122.77
mūrkho'pi śaṃbho tava pādabhaktyā  122.78
samāpnuyānmuktimayīṃ tanuṃ te  122.78
jñāneṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva  122.78
dhyāneṣu homeṣu mahāphaleṣu  122.78
saṃpannametatphalamuttamaṃ yat 122.79
someśvare bhaktiraharniśaṃ yat 122.79
sarvasya jīvasya sadā priyasya  122.79
phalasya dṛṣṭasya tathā śrutasya  122.79
svargasya mokṣasya jagannivāsa  122.80
sopānapaṅktistava bhaktireṣā  122.80
tvatpādasaṃprāptiphalāptaye tu  122.80
sopānapaṅktiṃ na vadanti dhīrāḥ  122.80
tasmāddayālo mama bhaktirastu  122.81
naivāstyupāyastava rūpasevā  122.81
ātmīyamālokya mahattvamīśa  122.81
pāpeṣu cāsmāsu kuru prasādam  122.81
sthūlaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ tvamanādi nityaṃ  122.82
pitā ca mātā yadasacca sacca  122.82
evaṃ stuto yaḥ śrutibhiḥ purāṇair 122.82
namāmi someśvaramīśitāram  122.82
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prītau hariharāvūcatustridaśeśvarau  ||* 122.83 ||
{hariharāvūcatu̱ḥ }
vriyatāṃ yanmanobhīṣṭaṃ yadvaraṃ cātidurlabham  ||* 122.84 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
indraḥ prāha sureśānaṃ madrājyaṃ tu punaḥ punaḥ  |
jāyate bhraśyate caiva tatpāpamupaśāmyatām  || 122.85 ||
yathā sthiro'haṃ rājye syāṃ sarvaṃ syānniścalaṃ mama  |
suprītau yadi deveśau sarvaṃ syānniścalaṃ sadā  || 122.86 ||
tatheti harivākyaṃ tāvabhinandyedamūcatuḥ  |
paraṃ prasādamāpannau tāvālokya smitānanau  || 122.87 ||
nirapāyanirādhāra nirvikārasvarūpiṇau  |
śaraṇyau sarvalokānāṃ bhuktimuktipradāvubhau  || 122.88 ||
{hariharāvūcatu̱ḥ }
tridaivatyaṃ mahātīrthaṃ gautamī vāñchitapradā  |
tasyāmanena mantreṇa kurutāṃ snānamādarāt || 122.89 ||
abhiṣekaṃ mahendrasya maṅgalāya bṛhaspatiḥ  |
karotu saṃsmarannāvāṃ saṃpadāṃ sthairyasiddhaye  || 122.90 ||
iha janmani pūrvasmin yatkiṃcitsukṛtaṃ kṛtam  |
tatsarvaṃ pūrṇatāmetu godāvari namo'stu te  || 122.91 ||
evaṃ smṛtvā tu yaḥ kaścidgautamyāṃ snānamācaret |
āvābhyāṃ tu prasādena dharmaḥ saṃpūrṇatāmiyāt |
pūrvajanmakṛtāddoṣātsa muktaḥ puṇyavān bhavet || 122.92 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatheti cakratuḥ prītau surendradhiṣaṇau tataḥ  |
mahābhiṣekamindrasya cakāra dyusadāṃ guruḥ  || 122.93 ||
tenābhūdyā nadī puṇyā maṅgaletyuditā tu sā  |
tayā ca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgāyāḥ śubhadastvasau  || 122.94 ||
indreṇa saṃstuto viṣṇuḥ pratyakṣo'bhūjjaganmayaḥ  |
trilokasaṃmitāṃ śakro bhūmiṃ lebhe jagatpateḥ  || 122.95 ||
tannāmnā cāpi vikhyāto govinda iti tatra ca  |
trilokasaṃmitā labdhā tena gaurvajradhāriṇā  || 122.96 ||
dattā ca hariṇā tatra govindastadabhūddhariḥ  |
trailokyarājyaṃ yatprāptaṃ hariṇā ca harermune  || 122.97 ||
niścalaṃ yena saṃjātaṃ devadevānmaheśvarāt |
bṛhaspatirdevagururyatrāstauṣīnmaheśvaram  || 122.98 ||
rājyasya sthirabhāvāya devendrasya mahātmanaḥ  |
siddheśvarastatra devo liṅgaṃ tu tridaśārcitam  || 122.99 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ govindamiti viśrutam  |
maṅgalāsaṃgamaṃ caiva pūrṇatīrthaṃ tataḥ param  || 122.100 ||
indratīrthamiti khyātaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ ca viśrutam  |
yatra siddheśvaro devo viṣṇurgovinda eva ca  || 122.101 ||
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca yatkiṃcitsukṛtārjanam  |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ vidyātpitṝṇāmativallabham  || 122.102 ||
śṛṇoti yaścāpi paṭhedyaśca smarati nityaśaḥ  |
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ bhraṣṭarājyapradāyakam  || 122.103 ||
saptatriṃśatsahasrāṇi tīrthānāṃ tīrayordvayoḥ  |
ubhayormuniśārdūla sarvasiddhipradāyinām  || 122.104 ||
na pūrṇatīrthasadṛśaṃ tīrthamasti mahāphalam  |
niṣphalaṃ tasya janmādi yo na seveta tannaraḥ  || 122.105 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
rāmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ bhrūṇahatyāvināśanam  |
tasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 123.1 ||
ikṣvākuvaṃśaprabhavaḥ kṣatriyo lokaviśrutaḥ  |
balavānmatimāñśūro yathā śakraḥ puraṃdaraḥ  || 123.2 ||
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ kurvannāste yathā baliḥ  |
tasya tisro mahiṣyaḥ syū rājño daśarathasya hi  || 123.3 ||
kauśalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca mahāmate  |
etāḥ kulīnāḥ subhagā rūpalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ  || 123.4 ||
tasmin rājani rājye tu sthite'yodhyāpatau mune  |
vasiṣṭhe brahmavicchreṣṭhe purodhasi viśeṣataḥ  || 123.5 ||
na ca vyādhirna durbhikṣaṃ na cāvṛṣṭirna cādhayaḥ  |
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ nityaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ  || 123.6 ||
āśramāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāmānando'bhūtpṛthakpṛthak |
tasmiñśāsati rājendra ikṣvākūṇāṃ kulodvahe  || 123.7 ||
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ tu rājyārthe vigraho'bhavat |
kvāpi tatra jayaṃ prāpurdevāḥ kvāpi tathetare  || 123.8 ||
evaṃ pravartamāne tu trailokyamatipīḍitam  |
abhūnnārada tatrāhamavadaṃ daityadānavān  || 123.9 ||
devāṃścāpi viśeṣeṇa na kṛtaṃ tairmadīritam  |
punaśca saṃgarasteṣāṃ babhūva sumahānmithaḥ  || 123.10 ||
viṣṇuṃ gatvā surāḥ procustatheśānaṃ jaganmayam  |
tāvūcaturubhau devānasurān daityadānavān  || 123.11 ||
tapasā balino yāntu punaḥ kurvantu saṃgaram  |
tathetyāhuryayuḥ sarve tapase niyatavratāḥ  || 123.12 ||
yayustu rākṣasān devāḥ punaste matsarānvitāḥ  |
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca saṃgaro'bhūtsudāruṇaḥ  || 123.13 ||
na tatra devā jetāro naiva daityāśca dānavāḥ  |
saṃyuge vartamāne tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī  || 123.14 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
yeṣāṃ daśaratho rājā te jetāro na cetare  ||* 123.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā jayāyobhau jagmaturdevadānavau  |
tatra vāyustvaran prāpto rājānamavadattadā  || 123.16 ||
{vāyuruvāca̱ }
āgantavyaṃ tvayā rājan devadānavasaṃgare  |
yatra rājā daśaratho jayastatreti viśrutam  || 123.17 ||
tasmāttvaṃ devapakṣe syā bhaveyurjayinaḥ surāḥ  ||* 123.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvāyuvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā daśaratho nṛpaḥ  |
āgamyate mayā satyaṃ gaccha vāyo yathāsukham  || 123.19 ||
gate vāyau tadā daityā ājagmurbhūpatiṃ prati  |
te'pyūcurbhagavannasmatsāhāyyaṃ kartumarhasi  || 123.20 ||
rājan daśaratha śrīman vijayastvayi saṃsthitaḥ  |
tasmāttvaṃ vai daityapateḥ sāhāyyaṃ kartumarhasi  || 123.21 ||
tataḥ provāca nṛpatirvāyunā prārthitaḥ purā  |
pratijñātaṃ mayā tacca yāntu daityāśca dānavāḥ  || 123.22 ||
sa tu rājā tathā cakre gatvā caiva triviṣṭapam  |
yuddhaṃ cakre tathā daityairdānavaiḥ saha rākṣasaiḥ  || 123.23 ||
paśyatsu devasaṃgheṣu namucerbhrātarastadā  |
vividhurniśitairbāṇairathākṣaṃ nṛpatestathā  || 123.24 ||
bhinnākṣaṃ taṃ rathaṃ rājā na jānāti sa saṃbhramāt |
rājāntike sthitā subhrūḥ kaikeyyājñāyi nārada  || 123.25 ||
na jñāpitaṃ tayā rājñe svayamālokya suvratā  |
bhagnamakṣaṃ samālakṣya cakre hastaṃ tadā svakam  || 123.26 ||
akṣavanmuniśārdūla tadetanmahadadbhutam  |
rathena rathināṃ śreṣṭhastayā dattakareṇa ca  || 123.27 ||
jitavān daityadanujān devaiḥ prāpya varān bahūn  |
tato devairanujñātastvayodhyāṃ punarabhyagāt || 123.28 ||
sa tu madhye mahārājo mārge vīkṣya tadā priyām  |
kaikeyyāḥ karma taddṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ  || 123.29 ||
tatastasyai varān prādāttrīṃstu nārada sā api  |
anumānya nṛpaproktaṃ kaikeyī vākyamabravīt || 123.30 ||
{kaikeyyuvāca̱ }
tvayi tiṣṭhantu rājendra tvayā dattā varā amī  ||* 123.31 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vibhūṣaṇāni rājendro dattvā sa priyayā saha  |
rathena vijayī rājā yayau svanagaraṃ sukhī  || 123.32 ||
yoṣitāṃ kimadeyaṃ hi priyāṇāmucitāgame  |
sa kadāciddaśaratho mṛgayāśīlibhirvṛtaḥ  || 123.33 ||
aṭannaraṇye śarvaryāṃ vāribandhamathākarot |
saptavyasanahīnena bhavitavyaṃ tu bhūbhujā  || 123.34 ||
iti jānannapi ca taccakāra tu vidhervaśāt |
gartaṃ praviśya pānārthamāgatānniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ  || 123.35 ||
mṛgān hanti mahābāhuḥ śṛṇu kālaviparyayam  |
gartaṃ praviṣṭe nṛpatau tasminneva nagottame  || 123.36 ||
vṛddho vaiśravaṇo nāma na śṛṇoti na paśyati  |
tasya bhāryā tathābhūtā tāvabrūtāṃ tadā sutam  || 123.37 ||
{mātāpitarāvūcatu̱ḥ }
āvāṃ tṛṣārtau rātriśca kṛṣṇā cāpi pravartate  |
vṛddhānāṃ jīvitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ bālastvamasi putraka  || 123.38 ||
andhānāṃ badhirāṇāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ dhikca jīvitam  |
jarājarjaradehānāṃ dhigdhikputraka jīvitam  || 123.39 ||
tāvatpuṃbhirjīvitavyaṃ yāvallakṣmīrdṛḍhaṃ vapuḥ  |
yāvadājñāpratihatā tīrthādāvanyathā mṛtiḥ  || 123.40 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛddhayorguruvatsalaḥ  |
putraḥ provāca tadduḥkhaṃ girā madhurayā haran  || 123.41 ||
{putra uvāca̱ }
mayi jīvati kiṃ nāma yuvayorduḥkhamīdṛśam  |
na haratyātmajaḥ pitroryaścaritrairmanorujam  || 123.42 ||
tena kiṃ tanujeneha kulodvegavidhāyinā  ||* 123.43 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā pitarau natvā tāvāśvāsya mahāmanāḥ  |
taruskandhe samāropya vṛddhau ca pitarau tadā  || 123.44 ||
haste gṛhītvā kalaśaṃ jagāma ṛṣiputrakaḥ  |
sa ṛṣirna tu rājānaṃ jānāti nṛpatirdvijam  || 123.45 ||
ubhau sarabhasau tatra dvijo vāri samāviśat |
satvaraṃ kalaśe nyubje vāri gṛhṇantamāśugaiḥ  || 123.46 ||
dvijaṃ rājā dvipaṃ matvā vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ  |
vanadvipo'pi bhūpānāmavadhyastadvidannapi  || 123.47 ||
vivyādha taṃ nṛpaḥ kuryānna kiṃ kiṃ vidhivañcitaḥ  |
sa viddho marmadeśe tu duḥkhito vākyamabravīt || 123.48 ||
{dvija uvāca̱ }
kenedaṃ duḥkhadaṃ karma kṛtaṃ sadbrāhmaṇasya me  |
maitro brāhmaṇa ityukto nāparādho'sti kaścana  || 123.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadetadvacanaṃ śrutvā munerārtasya bhūpatiḥ  |
niśceṣṭaśca nirutsāho śanaistaṃ deśamabhyagāt || 123.50 ||
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dvijavaraṃ jvalantamiva tejasā  |
asāvapyabhavattatra saśalya iva mūrcchitaḥ  || 123.51 ||
ātmānamātmanā kṛtvā sthiraṃ rājābravīdidam  ||* 123.52 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
ko bhavān dvijaśārdūla kimarthamiha cāgataḥ  |
vada pāpakṛte mahyaṃ vada me niṣkṛtiṃ parām  || 123.53 ||
brahmahā varṇibhiḥ kiṃtu śvapacairapi jātucit |
na spraṣṭavyo mahābuddhe draṣṭavyo na kadācana  || 123.54 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadrājavacanaṃ śrutvā muniputro'bravīdvacaḥ  ||* 123.55 ||
{muniputra uvāca̱ }
utkramiṣyanti me prāṇā ato vakṣyāmi kiṃcana  |
svacchandavṛttitājñāne viddhi pākaṃ ca karmaṇām  || 123.56 ||
ātmārthaṃ tu na śocāmi vṛddhau tu pitarau mama  |
tayoḥ śuśrūṣakaḥ kaḥ syādandhayorekaputrayoḥ  || 123.57 ||
vinā mayā mahāraṇye kathaṃ tau jīvayiṣyataḥ  |
mamābhāgyamaho kīdṛkpitṛśuśrūṣaṇe kṣatiḥ  || 123.58 ||
jātā me'dya vinā prāṇairhā vidhe kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā  |
tathāpi gaccha tatra tvaṃ gṛhītakalaśastvaran  || 123.59 ||
tābhyāṃ dehyudapānaṃ tvaṃ yathā tau na mariṣyataḥ  ||* 123.60 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityevaṃ bruvatastasya gatāḥ prāṇā mahāvane  |
visṛjya saśaraṃ cāpamādāya kalaśaṃ nṛpaḥ  || 123.61 ||
tatrāgātsa tu vegena yatra vṛddhau mahāvane  |
vṛddhau cāpi tadā rātrau tāvanyonyaṃ samūcatuḥ  || 123.62 ||
{vṛddhāvūcatu̱ḥ }
udvignaḥ kupito vā syādathavā bhakṣitaḥ katham  |
na prāptaścāvayoryaṣṭiḥ kiṃ kurmaḥ kā gatirbhavet || 123.63 ||
na kopi tādṛśaḥ putro vidyate sacarācare  |
yaḥ pitroranyathā vākyaṃ na karotyapi ninditaḥ  || 123.64 ||
vajrādapi kaṭhoraṃ vā jīvitaṃ tamapaśyatoḥ  |
śīghraṃ na yānti yatprāṇāstadekāyattajīvayoḥ  || 123.65 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ bahuvidhā vāco vṛddhayorvadatorvane  |
tadā daśaratho rājā śanaistaṃ deśamabhyagāt || 123.66 ||
pādasaṃcāraśabdena menāte sutamāgatam  ||* 123.67 ||
{vṛddhāvūcatu̱ḥ }
kuto vatsa cirātprāptastvaṃ dṛṣṭistvaṃ parāyaṇam  |
na brūṣe kiṃtu ruṣṭo'si vṛddhayorandhayoḥ sutaḥ  || 123.68 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
saśalya iva duḥkhārtaḥ śocan duṣkṛtamātmanaḥ  |
sa bhīta iva rājendrastāvuvācātha nārada  || 123.69 ||
udapānaṃ ca kurutāṃ tacchrutvā nṛpabhāṣitam  |
nāyaṃ vaktā suto'smākaṃ ko bhavāṃstatpurā vada  || 123.70 ||
paścātpibāvaḥ pānīyaṃ tato rājābravīcca tau  ||* 123.71 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
tatra tiṣṭhati vāṃ putro yatra vārisamāśrayaḥ  ||* 123.72 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvocaturārtau tau satyaṃ brūhi na cānyathā  |
ācacakṣe tato rājā sarvameva yathātatham  || 123.73 ||
tatastu patitau vṛddhau tatrāvāṃ naya mā spṛśa  |
brahmaghnasparśanaṃ pāpaṃ na kadācidvinaśyati  || 123.74 ||
ninye vai śravaṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ sabhāryaṃ nṛpasattamaḥ  |
yatrāsau patitaḥ putrastaṃ spṛṣṭvā tau vilepatuḥ  || 123.75 ||
{vṛddhāvūcatu̱ḥ }
yathā putraviyogena mṛtyurnau vihitastathā  |
tvaṃ cāpi pāpa putrasya viyogānmṛtyumāpsyasi  || 123.76 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ tu jalpatorbrahman gatāḥ prāṇāstato nṛpaḥ  |
agninā yojayāmāsa vṛddhau ca ṛṣiputrakam  || 123.77 ||
tato jagāma nagaraṃ duḥkhito nṛpatirmune  |
vasiṣṭhāya ca tatsarvaṃ nyavedayadaśeṣataḥ  || 123.78 ||
nṛpāṇāṃ sūryavaṃśyānāṃ vasiṣṭho hi parā gatiḥ  |
vasiṣṭho'pi dvijaśreṣṭhaiḥ saṃmantryāha ca niṣkṛtim  || 123.79 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
gālavaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca jābālimatha kaśyapam  |
etānanyān samāhūya hayamedhāya yatnataḥ  || 123.80 ||
yajasva hayamedhaiśca bahubhirbahudakṣiṇaiḥ  ||* 123.81 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
akaroddhayamedhāṃśca rājā daśaratho dvijaiḥ  |
etasminnantare tatra vāguvācāśarīriṇī  || 123.82 ||
{ākāśavāṇyuvāca̱ }
pūtaṃ śarīramabhavadrājño daśarathasya hi  |
vyavahāryaśca bhavitā bhaviṣyanti tathā sutāḥ  |
jyeṣṭhaputraprasādena rājāpāpo bhaviṣyati  || 123.83 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato bahutithe kāle ṛṣyaśṛṅgānmunīśvarāt |
devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ sutā āsan suropamāḥ  || 123.84 ||
kauśalyāyāṃ tathā rāmaḥ sumitrāyāṃ ca lakṣmaṇaḥ  |
śatrughnaścāpi kaikeyyāṃ bharato matimattaraḥ  || 123.85 ||
te sarve matimantaśca priyā rājño vaśe sthitāḥ  |
taṃ rājānamṛṣiḥ prāpya viśvāmitraḥ prajāpatiḥ  || 123.86 ||
rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ cāpi ayācata mahāmate  |
yajñasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya jñātatanmahimā muniḥ  || 123.87 ||
ciraprāptasuto vṛddho rājā naivetyabhāṣata  ||* 123.88 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
mahatā daivayogena kathaṃcidvārdhake mune  |
jātāvānandasaṃdoha dāyakau mama bālakau  || 123.89 ||
saśarīramidaṃ rājyaṃ dāsye naiva sutāvimau  ||* 123.90 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vasiṣṭhena tadā prokto rājā daśarathastviti  ||* 123.91 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
raghavaḥ prārthanābhaṅgaṃ na rājan kvāpi śikṣitāḥ  ||* 123.92 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva kathaṃcidavadannṛpaḥ  ||* 123.93 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
viśvāmitrasya brahmarṣeḥ kurutāṃ yajñarakṣaṇam  ||* 123.94 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vadanniti sutau soṣṇaṃ niśvasan glapitādharaḥ  |
putrau samarpayāmāsa viśvāmitrasya śāstrakṛt || 123.95 ||
tathetyuktvā daśarathaṃ namasya ca punaḥ punaḥ  |
jagmatū rakṣaṇārthāya viśvāmitreṇa tau mudā  || 123.96 ||
tataḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ sa munirmudā prādāttadobhayoḥ  |
māheśvarīṃ mahāvidyāṃ dhanurvidyāpuraḥsarām  || 123.97 ||
śāstrīmāstrīṃ laukikīṃ ca rathavidyāṃ gajodbhavām  |
aśvavidyāṃ gadāvidyāṃ mantrāhvānavisarjane  || 123.98 ||
sarvavidyāmathāvāpya ubhau tau rāmalakṣmaṇau  |
vanaukasāṃ hitārthāya jaghnatustāṭakāṃ vane  || 123.99 ||
ahalyāṃ śāpanirmuktāṃ pādasparśācca cakratuḥ  |
yajñavidhvaṃsanāyātāñjaghnatustatra rākṣasān  || 123.100 ||
kṛtavidyau dhanuṣpāṇī cakraturyajñarakṣaṇam  |
tato mahāmakhe vṛtte viśvāmitro munīśvaraḥ  || 123.101 ||
putrābhyāṃ sahito rājño janakaṃ draṣṭumabhyagāt |
citrāmadarśayattatra rājamadhye nṛpātmajaḥ  || 123.102 ||
rāmaḥ saumitrisahito dhanurvidyāṃ gurormatām  |
tatprīto janakaḥ prādātsītāṃ lakṣmīmayonijām  || 123.103 ||
tathaiva lakṣmaṇasyāpi bharatasyānujasya ca  |
śatrughnabharatādīnāṃ vasiṣṭhādimate sthitaḥ  || 123.104 ||
rājā daśarathaḥ śrīmān vivāhamakaronmune  |
tato bahutithe kāle rājyaṃ tasya prayacchati  || 123.105 ||
nṛpatau sarvalokānāmanumatyā gurorapi  |
mantharātmakadurdaiva preritā matsarākulā  || 123.106 ||
kaikeyī vighnamātasthe vanapravrājanaṃ tathā  |
bharatasya ca tadrājyaṃ rājā naiva ca dattavān  || 123.107 ||
pitaraṃ satyavākyaṃ taṃ kurvan rāmo mahāvanam  |
viveśa sītayā sārdhaṃ tathā saumitriṇā saha  || 123.108 ||
satāṃ ca mānasaṃ śuddhaṃ sa viveśa svakairguṇaiḥ  |
tasmin vinirgate rāme vanavāsāya dīkṣite  || 123.109 ||
samaṃ lakṣmaṇasītābhyāṃ rājyatṛṣṇāvivarjite  |
taṃ rāmaṃ cāpi saumitriṃ sītāṃ ca guṇaśālinīm  || 123.110 ||
duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭo brahmaśāpaṃ ca saṃsmaran  |
tadā daśaratho rājā prāṇāṃstatyāja duḥkhitaḥ  || 123.111 ||
kṛtakarmavipākena rājā nīto yamānugaiḥ  |
tasmai rājñe mahāprājña yāvatsthāvarajaṅgame  || 123.112 ||
yamasadmanyanekāni tāmisrādīni nārada  |
narakāṇyatha ghorāṇi bhīṣaṇāni bahūni ca  || 123.113 ||
tatra kṣiptastadā rājā narakeṣu pṛthakpṛthak |
pacyate chidyate rājā piṣyate cūrṇyate tathā  || 123.114 ||
śoṣyate daśyate bhūyo dahyate ca nimajjyate  |
evamādiṣu ghoreṣu narakeṣu sa pacyate  || 123.115 ||
rāmo'pi gacchannadhvānaṃ citrakūṭamathāgamat |
tatraiva trīṇi varṣāṇi vyatītāni mahāmate  || 123.116 ||
punaḥ sa dakṣiṇāmāśāmākrāmaddaṇḍakaṃ vanam  |
vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu deśānāṃ taddhi puṇyadam  || 123.117 ||
prāviśattanmahāraṇyaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ daityasevitam  |
tadbhayādṛṣibhistyaktaṃ hatvā daityāṃstu rākṣasān  || 123.118 ||
vicaran daṇḍakāraṇye ṛṣisevyamathākarot |
tatredaṃ vṛttamākhyāsye śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ  || 123.119 ||
tāvacchanaistvagādrāmo yāvadyojanapañcakam  |
gautamīṃ samanuprāpto rājāpi narake sthitaḥ  || 123.120 ||
yamaḥ svakiṃkarānāha rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ  |
gautamīmabhito yāti pitaraṃ tasya dhīmataḥ  || 123.121 ||
ākarṣantvatha rājānaṃ narakānnātra saṃśayaḥ  |
uttīrya gautamīṃ yāti yāvadyojanapañcakam  || 123.122 ||
rāmastāvattasya pitā narake naiva pacyatām  |
yadetanmadvacaḥ puṇyaṃ na kuryuryadi dūtakāḥ  || 123.123 ||
tataśca narake ghore yūyaṃ sarve nimajjatha  |
yā kāpyuktā parā śaktiḥ śivasya samavāyinī  || 123.124 ||
tāmeva gautamīṃ santo vadantyambhaḥsvarūpiṇīm  |
haribrahmamaheśānāṃ mānyā vandyā ca saiva yat || 123.125 ||
nistīryate na kenāpi tadatikramajaṃ tvagham  |
pāpino'pyātmajaḥ kaścidyaśca gaṅgāmanusmaret || 123.126 ||
so'nekadurganirayānnirgato muktatāṃ vrajet |
kiṃ punastādṛśaḥ putro gautamīnikaṭe sthitaḥ  || 123.127 ||
yasyāsau narake paktuṃ na kairapi hi śakyate  |
dakṣiṇāśāpatervākyaṃ niśamya yamakiṃkarāḥ  || 123.128 ||
narake pacyamānaṃ tamayodhyādhipatiṃ nṛpam  |
uttārya ghoranarakādvacanaṃ cedamabruvan  || 123.129 ||
{yamakiṃkarā ūcu̱ḥ }
dhanyo'si nṛpaśārdūla yasya putraḥ sa tādṛśaḥ  |
iha cāmutra viśrāntiḥ suputraḥ kena labhyate  || 123.130 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa viśrāntaḥ śanai rājā kiṃkarān vākyamabravīt ||* 123.131 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
narakeṣvatha ghoreṣu pacyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ  |
kathaṃ tvākarṣitaḥ śīghraṃ tanme vaktumihārhatha  || 123.132 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatra kaścicchāntamanā rājānamidamabravīt ||* 123.133 ||
{yamadūta uvāca̱ }
vedaśāstrapurāṇādāvetadgopyaṃ prayatnataḥ  |
prakāśyate tadapi te sāmarthyaṃ putratīrthayoḥ  || 123.134 ||
rāmastava sutaḥ śrīmān gautamītīramāgataḥ  |
tasmāttvaṃ narakādghorādākṛṣṭo'si narottama  || 123.135 ||
yadi tvāṃ tatra gautamyāṃ smaredrāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ  |
snānaṃ kṛtvātha piṇḍādi te dadyātsa nṛpottama  |
tatastvaṃ sarvapāpebhyo mukto yāsi triviṣṭapam  || 123.136 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
tatra gatvā bhavadvākyamākhyāsye svasutau prati  |
bhavanta eva śaraṇamanujñāṃ dātumarhatha  || 123.137 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadrājavacanaṃ śrutvā kṛpayā yamakiṃkarāḥ  |
ājñāṃ ca pradadustasmai rājā prāgātsutau prati  || 123.138 ||
bhīṣaṇaṃ yātanādehamāpanno niḥśvasanmuhuḥ  |
nirīkṣya svaṃ lajjamānaḥ kṛtaṃ karma ca saṃsmaran  || 123.139 ||
svecchayā viharan gaṅgāmāsasāda ca rāghavaḥ  |
gautamyāstaṭamāśritya rāmo lakṣmaṇa eva ca  || 123.140 ||
sītayā saha vaidehyā sasnau caiva yathāvidhi  |
naiva tatrābhavadbhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vā gautamītaṭe  || 123.141 ||
taddine tatra vasatāṃ gautamītīravāsinām  |
taddṛṣṭvā duḥkhito bhrātā lakṣmaṇo rāmamabravīt || 123.142 ||
{lakṣmaṇa uvāca̱ }
putrau daśarathasyāvāṃ tavāpi balamīdṛśam  |
nāsti bhojyamathāsmākaṃ gaṅgātīranivāsinām  || 123.143 ||
{rāma uvāca̱ }
bhrātaryadvihitaṃ karma naiva taccānyathā bhavet |
pṛthivyāmannapūrṇāyāṃ vayamannābhilāṣiṇaḥ  || 123.144 ||
saumitre nūnamasmābhirna brāhmaṇamukhe hutam  |
avajñayā mahīdevāṃstarpayantyarcayanti na  || 123.145 ||
te ye lakṣmaṇa jāyante sarvadaiva bubhukṣitāḥ  |
snātvā devānathābhyarcya hotavyaśca hutāśanaḥ  |
tataḥ svasamaye devo vidhāsyatyaśanaṃ tu nau  || 123.146 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhrātroḥ saṃjalpatorevaṃ paśyatoḥ karmaṇo gatim  |
śanairdaśaratho rājā taṃ deśamupajagmivān  || 123.147 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaḥ śīghraṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt |
dhanurākṛṣya kopena rakṣastvaṃ dānavo'thavā  || 123.148 ||
āsannaṃ ca punardṛṣṭvā yāhi yāhyatra puṇyabhāk |
rāmo dāśarathī rājā dharmabhākpaśya vartate  || 123.149 ||
gurubhaktaḥ satyasaṃdho devabrāhmaṇasevakaḥ  |
trailokyarakṣādakṣo'sau vartate yatra rāghavaḥ  || 123.150 ||
na tatra tvādṛśāmasti praveśaḥ pāpakarmaṇām  |
yadi praviśase pāpa tato vadhamavāpsyasi  || 123.151 ||
tatputravacanaṃ śrutvā śanairāhūya vācayā  |
uvācādhomukho bhūtvā snuṣāṃ putrau kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
muhurantarvinidhyāyan gatiṃ duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ  || 123.152 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
ahaṃ daśaratho rājā putrau me śṛṇutaṃ vacaḥ  |
tisṛbhirbrahmahatyābhirvṛto'haṃ duḥkhamāgataḥ  |
chinnaṃ paśyata me dehaṃ narakeṣu ca pātitam  || 123.153 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ kṛtāñjalī rāmaḥ sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca  |
bhūmau praṇemuste sarve vacanaṃ caitadabruvan  || 123.154 ||
{sītārāmalakṣmaṇā ūcu̱ḥ }
kasyedaṃ karmaṇastāta phalaṃ nṛpatisattama  ||* 123.155 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa ca prāha yathāvṛttaṃ brahmahatyātrayaṃ tathā  ||* 123.156 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
niṣkṛtirbrahmahantṝṇāṃ putrau kvāpi na vidyate  ||* 123.157 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato duḥkhena mahatā vṛtāḥ sarve bhuvaṃ gatāḥ  |
rājānaṃ vanavāsaṃ ca mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā  || 123.158 ||
duḥkhāgamaṃ karmagatiṃ narake pātanaṃ tathā  |
evamādyatha saṃsmṛtya mumoha nṛpateḥ sutaḥ  |
visaṃjñaṃ nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā sītā vākyamathābravīt || 123.159 ||
{sītovāca̱ }
na śocanti mahātmānastvādṛśā vyasanāgame  |
cintayanti pratīkāraṃ daivyamapyatha mānuṣam  || 123.160 ||
śocadbhiryugasāhasraṃ vipattirnaiva tīryate  |
vyāmohamāpnuvantīha na kadācidvicakṣaṇāḥ  || 123.161 ||
kimanenātra duḥkhena niṣphalena janeśvara  |
dehi hatyāṃ prathamato yā jātā hyatibhīṣaṇā  || 123.162 ||
pitṛbhaktaḥ puṇyaśīlo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ  |
anāgā yo hato viprastatpāpasyātra niṣkṛtim  || 123.163 ||
ācarāmi yathāśāstraṃ mā śokaṃ kurutaṃ yuvām  |
dvitīyāṃ lakṣmaṇo hatyāṃ gṛhṇātu tvaparāṃ bhavān  || 123.164 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etaddharmayutaṃ vākyaṃ sītayā bhāṣitaṃ dṛḍham  |
tatheti cāhaturubhau tato daśaratho'bravīt || 123.165 ||
{daśaratha uvāca̱ }
tvaṃ hi brahmavidaḥ kanyā janakasya tvayonijā  |
bhāryā rāmasya kiṃ citraṃ yadyuktamanubhāṣase  || 123.166 ||
na kopi bhavatāṃ kiṃtu śramaḥ svalpo'pi vidyate  |
gautamyāṃ snānadānena piṇḍanirvapaṇena ca  || 123.167 ||
tisṛbhirbrahmahatyābhirmukto yāmi triviṣṭapam  |
tvayā janakasaṃbhūte svakulocitamīritam  || 123.168 ||
prāpayanti paraṃ pāraṃ bhavābdheḥ kulayoṣitaḥ  |
godāvaryāḥ prasādena kiṃ nāmāstyatra durlabham  || 123.169 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatheti kriyamāṇe tu piṇḍadānāya śatruhā  |
naivāpaśyadbhakṣyabhojyaṃ tato lakṣmaṇamabravīt || 123.170 ||
lakṣmaṇaḥ prāha vinayādiṅgudyāśca phalāni ca  |
santi teṣāṃ ca piṇyākamānītaṃ tatkṣaṇādiva  || 123.171 ||
piṇyākenātha gaṅgāyāṃ piṇḍaṃ dātuṃ tathā pituḥ  |
manaḥ kurvaṃstato rāmo mando'bhūdduḥkhitastadā  || 123.172 ||
daivī vāgabhavattatra duḥkhaṃ tyaja nṛpātmaja  |
rājyabhraṣṭo vanaṃ prāptaḥ kiṃ vai niṣkiṃcano bhavān  || 123.173 ||
aśaṭho dharmanirato na śocitumihārhasi  |
vittaśāṭhyena yo dharmaṃ karoti sa tu pātakī  || 123.174 ||
śrūyate sarvaśāstreṣu yadrāma śṛṇu yatnataḥ  |
yadannaḥ puruṣo rājaṃstadannāstasya devatāḥ  || 123.175 ||
piṇḍe nipatite bhūmau nāpaśyatpitaraṃ tadā  |
śavaṃ ca patitaṃ yatra śavatīrthamanuttamam  || 123.176 ||
mahāpātakasaṃghāta vighātakṛdanusmṛtiḥ  |
tatrāgacchaṃllokapālā rudrādityāstathāśvinau  || 123.177 ||
svaṃ svaṃ vimānamārūḍhāsteṣāṃ madhye'tidīptimān  |
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ stūyamānaśca kiṃnaraiḥ  || 123.178 ||
ādityasadṛśākārasteṣāṃ madhye babhau pitā  |
tamadṛṣṭvā svapitaraṃ devān dṛṣṭvā vimāninaḥ  || 123.179 ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭo rāmaḥ pitā me kvetyabhāṣata  |
iti divyābhavadvāṇī rāmaṃ saṃbodhya sītayā  || 123.180 ||
tisṛbhirbrahmahatyābhirmukto daśaratho nṛpaḥ  |
vṛtaṃ paśya suraistāta devā apyūcire ca tam  || 123.181 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
dhanyo'si kṛtakṛtyo'si rāma svargaṃ gataḥ pitā  |
nānānirayasaṃghātātpūrvajānuddharettu yaḥ  || 123.182 ||
sa dhanyo'laṃkṛtaṃ tena kṛtinā bhuvanatrayam  |
enaṃ paśya mahābāho muktapāpaṃ raviprabham  || 123.183 ||
sarvasaṃpattiyukto'pi pāpī dagdhadrumopamaḥ  |
niṣkiṃcano'pi sukṛtī dṛśyate candramaulivat || 123.184 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
dṛṣṭvābravītsutaṃ rājā āśīrbhirabhinandya ca  ||* 123.185 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
kṛtakṛtyo'si bhadraṃ te tārito'haṃ tvayānagha  |
dhanyaḥ sa putro loke'smin pitṝṇāṃ yastu tārakaḥ  || 123.186 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ procurdevānāṃ kāryasiddhaye  |
rāmaṃ ca puruṣaśreṣṭhaṃ gaccha tāta yathāsukham  |
tatastadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmastānabravītsurān  || 123.187 ||
{rāma uvāca̱ }
gurau pitari me devāḥ kiṃ kṛtyamavaśiṣyate  ||* 123.188 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
nadī na gaṅgayā tulyā na tvayā sadṛśaḥ sutaḥ  |
na śivena samo devo na tāreṇa samo manuḥ  || 123.189 ||
tvayā rāma gurūṇāṃ ca kāryaṃ sarvamanuṣṭhitam  |
tāritāḥ pitaro rāma tvayā putreṇa mānada  |
gacchantu sarve svasthānaṃ tvaṃ ca gaccha yathāsukham  || 123.190 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
taddevavacanāddhṛṣṭaḥ sītayā lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ  |
taddṛṣṭvā gaṅgāmāhātmyaṃ vismito vākyamabravīt || 123.191 ||
{rāma uvāca̱ }
aho gaṅgāprabhāvo'yaṃ trailokye nopamīyate  |
vayaṃ dhanyā yato gaṅgā dṛṣṭāsmābhistripāvanī  || 123.192 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
harṣeṇa mahatā yukto devaṃ sthāpya maheśvaram  |
taṃ ṣoḍaśabhirīśānamupacāraiḥ prayatnataḥ  || 123.193 ||
saṃpūjyāvaraṇairyuktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatkalamīśvaram  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā rāmastuṣṭāva śaṃkaram  || 123.194 ||
{rāma uvāca̱ }
namāmi śaṃbhuṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ  123.195
namāmi sarvajñamapārabhāvam  123.195
namāmi rudraṃ prabhumakṣayaṃ taṃ  123.195
namāmi śarvaṃ śirasā namāmi  123.195
namāmi devaṃ paramavyayaṃ tam  123.196
umāpatiṃ lokaguruṃ namāmi  123.196
namāmi dāridryavidāraṇaṃ taṃ  123.196
namāmi rogāpaharaṃ namāmi  123.196
namāmi kalyāṇamacintyarūpaṃ  123.197
namāmi viśvodbhavabījarūpam  123.197
namāmi viśvasthitikāraṇaṃ taṃ  123.197
namāmi saṃhārakaraṃ namāmi  123.197
namāmi gaurīpriyamavyayaṃ taṃ  123.198
namāmi nityaṃ kṣaramakṣaraṃ tam  123.198
namāmi cidrūpamameyabhāvaṃ  123.198
trilocanaṃ taṃ śirasā namāmi  123.198
namāmi kāruṇyakaraṃ bhavasya  123.199
bhayaṃkaraṃ vāpi sadā namāmi  123.199
namāmi dātāramabhīpsitānāṃ  123.199
namāmi someśamumeśamādau  123.199
namāmi vedatrayalocanaṃ taṃ  123.200
namāmi mūrtitrayavarjitaṃ tam  123.200
namāmi puṇyaṃ sadasadvyatītaṃ  123.200
namāmi taṃ pāpaharaṃ namāmi  123.200
namāmi viśvasya hite rataṃ taṃ  123.201
namāmi rūpāṇi bahūni dhatte  123.201
yo viśvagoptā sadasatpraṇetā  123.201
namāmi taṃ viśvapatiṃ namāmi  123.201
yajñeśvaraṃ saṃprati havyakavyaṃ  123.202
tathā gatiṃ lokasadāśivo yaḥ  123.202
ārādhito yaśca dadāti sarvaṃ  123.202
namāmi dānapriyamiṣṭadevam  123.202
namāmi someśvaramasvatantram  123.203
umāpatiṃ taṃ vijayaṃ namāmi  123.203
namāmi vighneśvaranandināthaṃ  123.203
putrapriyaṃ taṃ śirasā namāmi  123.203
namāmi devaṃ bhavaduḥkhaśoka  123.204
vināśanaṃ candradharaṃ namāmi  123.204
namāmi gaṅgādharamīśamīḍyam  123.204
umādhavaṃ devavaraṃ namāmi  123.204
namāmyajādīśapuraṃdarādi  123.205
surāsurairarcitapādapadmam  123.205
namāmi devīmukhavādanānām  123.205
īkṣārthamakṣitritayaṃ ya aicchat 123.205
pañcāmṛtairgandhasudhūpadīpair 123.206
vicitrapuṣpairvividhaiśca mantraiḥ  123.206
annaprakāraiḥ sakalopacāraiḥ  123.206
saṃpūjitaṃ somamahaṃ namāmi  123.206
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ sa bhagavānāha rāmaṃ śaṃbhuḥ salakṣmaṇam  |
varān vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te rāmaḥ prāha vṛṣadhvajam  || 123.207 ||
{rāma uvāca̱ }
stotreṇānena ye bhaktyā toṣyanti tvāṃ surottama  |
teṣāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi siddhiṃ yāntu maheśvara  || 123.208 ||
yeṣāṃ ca pitaraḥ śaṃbho patitā narakārṇave  |
teṣāṃ piṇḍādidānena pūtā yāntu triviṣṭapam  || 123.209 ||
janmaprabhṛti pāpāni manovākkāyikaṃ tvagham  |
atra tu snānamātreṇa tatsadyo nāśamāpnuyāt || 123.210 ||
atra ye bhaktitaḥ śaṃbho dadatyarthibhya aṇvapi  |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ śaṃbho dātṝṇāṃ phalakṛdbhavet || 123.211 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamastviti taṃ rāmaṃ śaṃkaro hṛṣito'bravīt |
gate tasmin suraśreṣṭhe rāmo'pyanucaraiḥ saha  || 123.212 ||
gautamī yatra cotpannā śanaistaṃ deśamabhyagāt |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ rāmatīrthamudāhṛtam  || 123.213 ||
dayālorapatattatra lakṣmaṇasya karāccharaḥ  |
tadbāṇatīrthamabhavatsarvāpadvinivāraṇam  || 123.214 ||
yatra saumitriṇā snānaṃ śaṃkarasyārcanaṃ kṛtam  |
tattīrthaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ jātaṃ tathā sītāsamudbhavam  || 123.215 ||
nānāvidhāśeṣapāpa saṃghanirmūlanakṣamam  |
yadaṅghrisaṃgādabhavadgaṅgā trailokyapāvanī  || 123.216 ||
sa yatra snānamakarottadvaiśiṣṭyaṃ kimucyate  |
tadrāmatīrthasadṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ kvāpi na vidyate  || 123.217 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
putratīrthamiti khyātaṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ taducyate  |
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti yanmahimnaḥ śruterapi  || 124.1 ||
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada  |
diteḥ putrāśca danujāḥ parikṣīṇā yadābhavan  |
aditestu sutā jyeṣṭhāḥ sarvabhāvena nārada  || 124.2 ||
tadā ditiḥ putraviyogaduḥkhāt 124.3
saṃspardhamānā danumājagāma  124.3
{ditiruvāca̱ }
kṣīṇāḥ sutā āvayoreva bhadre  124.4
kiṃ kurmahe karma loke garīyaḥ  124.4
paśyāditervaṃśamabhinnamuttamaṃ  124.4
saurājyayuktaṃ yaśasā jayaśriyā  124.4
jitārimabhyunnatakīrtidharmaṃ  124.5
maccittasaṃharṣavināśadakṣam  124.5
samānabhartṛtvasamānadharme  124.5
samānagotre'pi samānarūpe  124.5
na jīvayeyaṃ śriyamunnatiṃ ca  124.6
jīrṇāsmi dṛṣṭvā tvaditiprasūtān  124.6
kāmapyavasthāmanuyāmi duḥsthā  124.6
'ditervilokyātha parāṃ samṛddhim  124.6
dāvapraveśo'pi sukhāya nūnaṃ  124.6
svapne'pyavekṣyā na sapatnalakṣmīḥ  124.6
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ bruvāṇāmatidīnavaktrāṃ  124.7
viniśvasantīṃ parameṣṭhiputraḥ  124.7
kṛtābhipūjo vigataśramastāṃ  124.7
sa sāntvayannāha manobhirāmām  124.7
{parameṣṭhiputra uvāca̱ }
khedo na kāryaḥ samabhīpsitaṃ yat 124.8
tatprāpyate puṇyata eva bhadre  124.8
tatsādhanaṃ vetti mahānubhāvaḥ  124.8
prajāpatiste sa tu vakṣyatīti  124.8
sādhvyetatsarvabhāvena praśrayāvanatā satī  ||* 124.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ bruvāṇāṃ ca ditiṃ danuḥ provāca nārada  ||* 124.10 ||
{danuruvāca̱ }
bhartāraṃ kaśyapaṃ bhadre toṣayasva nijairguṇaiḥ  |
tuṣṭo yadi bhavedbhartā tataḥ kāmānavāpsyasi  || 124.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā sarvabhāvaistoṣayāmāsa kaśyapam  |
ditiṃ provāca bhagavān kaśyapo'tha prajāpatiḥ  || 124.12 ||
{kaśyapa uvāca̱ }
kiṃ dadāmi vadābhīṣṭaṃ dite varaya suvrate  ||* 124.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ditirapyāha bhartāraṃ putraṃ bahuguṇānvitam  |
jetāraṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam  || 124.14 ||
yena jātena loke'smin bhaveyaṃ vīraputriṇī  |
taṃ vareyaṃ surapitarityāha vinayānvitā  || 124.15 ||
{kaśyapa uvāca̱ }
upadekṣye vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dvādaśābdaphalapradam  |
tata āgatya te garbhamādhāsye yanmanogatam  |
niṣpāpatāyāṃ jātāyāṃ sidhyanti hi manorathāḥ  || 124.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhartṛvākyādditiḥ prītā taṃ namasyāyatekṣaṇā  |
upadiṣṭaṃ vrataṃ cakre bhartrādiṣṭaṃ yathāvidhi  || 124.17 ||
tīrthasevāpātradāna vratacaryādivarjitāḥ  |
kathamāsādayiṣyanti prāṇino'tra manorathān  || 124.18 ||
tataścīrṇe vrate tasyāṃ dityāṃ garbhamadhārayat |
punaḥ kāntāmathovāca kaśyapastāṃ ditiṃ rahaḥ  || 124.19 ||
{kaśyapa uvāca̱ }
na prāpnuvanti yatkāmānmunayo'pi tapassthitāḥ  |
yathāvihitakarmāṅga avajñayā tacchucismite  || 124.20 ||
ninditaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ saṃdhyayorubhayorapi  |
na svaptavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ muktakeśī ca no bhava  || 124.21 ||
bhoktavyaṃ subhage naiva kṣutaṃ vā jṛmbhaṇaṃ tathā  |
saṃdhyākāle na kartavyaṃ bhūtasaṃghasamākule  || 124.22 ||
sāntardhānaṃ sadā kāryaṃ hasitaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ  |
gṛhāntadeśe saṃdhyāsu na sthātavyaṃ kadācana  || 124.23 ||
muśalolūkhalādīni śūrpapīṭhapidhānakam  |
naivātikramaṇīyāni divā rātrau sadā priye  || 124.24 ||
udakśīrṣaṃ tu śayanaṃ na saṃdhyāsu viśeṣataḥ  |
vaktavyaṃ nānṛtaṃ kiṃcinnānyagehāṭanaṃ tathā  || 124.25 ||
kāntādanyo na vīkṣyastu prayatnena naraḥ kvacit |
ityādiniyamairyuktā yadi tvamanuvartase  |
tataste bhavitā putrastrailokyaiśvaryabhājanam  || 124.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatheti pratijajñe sā bhartāraṃ lokapūjitam  |
gataśca kaśyapo brahmannitaścetaḥ surān prati  || 124.27 ||
ditergarbho'pi vavṛdhe balavān puṇyasaṃbhavaḥ  |
etatsarvaṃ mayo daityo māyayā vetti tattvataḥ  || 124.28 ||
indrasya sakhyamabhavanmayena prītipūrvakam  |
mayo gatvā rahaḥ prāha indraṃ sa vinayānvitaḥ  || 124.29 ||
diterdanorabhiprāyaṃ vrataṃ garbhasya vardhanam  |
tasya vīryaṃ ca vividhaṃ prītyendrāya nyavedayat || 124.30 ||
viśvāsaikagṛhaṃ mitramapāyatrāsavarjitam  |
arjitaṃ sukṛtaṃ nānā vidhaṃ cettadavāpyate  || 124.31 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
namuceśca priyo bhrātā mayo daityo mahābalaḥ  |
bhrātṛhantrā kathaṃ maitryaṃ mayasyāsītsureśvara  || 124.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
daityānāmadhipaścāsīdbalavānnamuciḥ purā  |
indreṇa vairamabhavadbhīṣaṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam  || 124.33 ||
yuddhaṃ hitvā kadācidbho gacchantaṃ tu śatakratum  |
dṛṣṭvā daityapatiḥ śūro namuciḥ pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt || 124.34 ||
tamāyāntamabhiprekṣya śacībhartā bhayāturaḥ  |
airāvataṃ gajaṃ tyaktvā indraḥ phenamathāviśat || 124.35 ||
sa vajrapāṇistarasā phenenaivāhanadripum  |
namucirnāśamagamattasya bhrātā mayo'nujaḥ  || 124.36 ||
bhrātṛhantṛvināśāya tapastepe mayo mahat |
māyāṃ ca vividhāmāpa devānāmatibhīṣaṇām  || 124.37 ||
varāṃścāvāpya tapasā viṣṇorlokaparāyaṇāt |
dānaśauṇḍaḥ priyālāpī tadābhavadasau mayaḥ  || 124.38 ||
agnīṃśca brāhmaṇān pūjya jetumindraṃ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ  |
dātāraṃ ca tadārthibhyaḥ stūyamānaṃ ca bandibhiḥ  || 124.39 ||
viditvā maghavā vāyormayaṃ māyāvinaṃ ripum  |
upakrāntaṃ suyuddhāya vipro bhūtvā tamabhyagāt |
śacībhartā mayaṃ daityaṃ provācedaṃ punaḥ punaḥ  || 124.40 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
dehi daityapate mahyamarthine'pekṣitaṃ varam  |
tvāṃ śrutvā dātṛtilakamāgato'haṃ dvijottamaḥ  || 124.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
mayo'pi brāhmaṇaṃ matvā'vadaddattaṃ mayā tava  |
vicārayanti kṛtino bahvalpaṃ vā puro'rthini  || 124.42 ||
ityukte tu hariḥ prāha sakhyamicche hyahaṃ tvayā  |
indraṃ mayaḥ punaḥ prāha kimanena dvijottama  || 124.43 ||
na tvayā mama vairaṃ bhoḥ svastītyāha harirmayam  |
tattvaṃ vadeti sa harirdaityenoktaḥ svakaṃ vapuḥ  || 124.44 ||
darśayāmāsa daityāya sahasrākṣaṃ yaducyate  |
tataḥ savismayo daityo mayo harimuvāca ha  || 124.45 ||
{maya uvāca̱ }
kimidaṃ vajrapāṇistvaṃ tavāyogyā kṛtiḥ sakhe  ||* 124.46 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pariṣvajya vihasyātha vṛttamityabravīddhariḥ  |
kenāpi sādhayantyatra paṇḍitāśca samīhitam  || 124.47 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti śakrasya mayena mahatī hyabhūt |
suprītirmuniśārdūla mayo harihitaḥ sadā  || 124.48 ||
indrasya bhavanaṃ gatvā tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat |
kiṃ me kṛtyamiti prāha mayaṃ māyāvinaṃ hariḥ  || 124.49 ||
haraye ca mayo māyāṃ prādātprītyā tathā hariḥ  |
prāptaḥ saṃprītimānāha kiṃ kṛtyaṃ maya tadvada  || 124.50 ||
{maya uvāca̱ }
agastyasyāśramaṃ gaccha tatrāste garbhiṇī ditiḥ  |
tasyāḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kurvannāssva tatra kiyanti ca  || 124.51 ||
ahāni maghavaṃstasyā garbhamāviśya vajradhṛk |
vardhamānaṃ ca taṃ chindhi yāvadvaśyo'thavā mṛtim  |
prāpnoti tāvadvajreṇa tato na bhavitā ripuḥ  || 124.52 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā mayaṃ pūjya maghavāneka eva hi  124.53
vinītavattadā prāyādditiṃ mātaramañjasā  124.53
śuśrūṣamāṇastāṃ devīṃ śakro daiteyamātaram  124.53
sā na jānāti taccittaṃ śakrasya dviṣato ditiḥ  124.53
garbhe sthitaṃ tu yadbhūtaṃ devendrasya viceṣṭitam  |
amoghaṃ tanmunestejaḥ kaśyapasya durāsadam  || 124.54 ||
tataḥ pragṛhya kuliśaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ puraṃdaraḥ  |
antaḥpraveśakāmo'sau bahukālaṃ samāvasan  || 124.55 ||
saṃdhyodakśīrṣanidrāṃ tāmavekṣya kuliśāyudhaḥ  |
idamantaramityuktvā dityāḥ kukṣiṃ samāviśat || 124.56 ||
antarvarti ca yadbhūtamindraṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛtāyudham  |
hantukāmaṃ tadovāca punaḥ punarabhītavat || 124.57 ||
{garbhastha uvāca̱ }
kiṃ māṃ na rakṣase vajrin bhrātaraṃ tvaṃ jighāṃsasi  |
nāraṇe māraṇādanyatpātakaṃ vidyate mahat || 124.58 ||
ṛte yuddhānmahābāho śakra yudhyasva nirgate  |
mayi tasmānnaitadevaṃ tava yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati  || 124.59 ||
śatakratuḥ sahasrākṣaḥ śacībhartā puraṃdaraḥ  |
vajrapāṇiḥ surendrastvaṃ te na yuktaṃ bhavetprabho  || 124.60 ||
athavā yuddhakāmastvaṃ mama niṣkramaṇaṃ yathā  |
tathā kuru mahābāho mārgādasmādapāsara  || 124.61 ||
kumārge na pravartante mahānto'pi vipadgatāḥ  |
avidyaścāpyaśastraśca naiva cāyudhasaṃgrahaḥ  || 124.62 ||
tvaṃ vidyāvān vajrapāṇe māṃ nighnan kiṃ na lajjase  |
kurvanti garhitaṃ karma na kulīnāḥ kadācana  || 124.63 ||
hatvā vā kiṃ tu jāyeta yaśo vā puṇyameva vā  |
vadhyante bhrātaraḥ kāmādgarbhasthāḥ kiṃ nu pauruṣam  || 124.64 ||
yadi vā yuddhabhaktiste mayi bhrātarasaṃśayam  |
tato muṣṭiṃ puraskṛtya vajriṇe'sau vyavasthitaḥ  || 124.65 ||
bālaghātī brahmaghātī tathā viśvāsaghātakaḥ  |
evaṃbhūtaṃ phalaṃ śakra kasmānmāṃ hantumudyataḥ  || 124.66 ||
yasyājñayā sarvamidaṃ vartate sacarācaram  |
