sa hantā bālakaṃ māṃ vai kiṃ yaśaḥ kiṃ tu pauruṣam  || 124.67 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ bruvantaṃ taṃ garbhaṃ ciccheda kuliśena saḥ  |
krodhāndhānāṃ lobhināṃ ca na ghṛṇā kvāpi vidyate  || 124.68 ||
na mamāra tato duḥkhādāhuste bhrātaro vayam  |
punaściccheda tān khaṇḍānmā vadhīriti cābruvan  || 124.69 ||
viśvastānmātṛgarbhasthānnijabhrātṝñśatakrato  |
dveṣavidhvastabuddhīnāṃ na citte karuṇākaṇaḥ  || 124.70 ||
evaṃ tu khaṇḍitaṃ khaṇḍaṃ hastapādādijīvavat |
nirvikāraṃ tato dṛṣṭvā saptasapta suvismitaḥ  || 124.71 ||
ekavadbahurūpāṇi garbhasthāni śubhāni ca  |
rudanti bahurūpāṇi mā rutetyabravīddhariḥ  || 124.72 ||
tataste maruto jātā balavanto mahaujasaḥ  |
garbhasthā eva te'nyonyamūcuḥ śakraṃ gatabhramāḥ  || 124.73 ||
agastyaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ mātā yasyāśrame sthitā  |
asmatpitā tava bhrātā sakhyaṃ te bahu manyate  || 124.74 ||
asmānupari sasnehaṃ manaste vidmahe mune  |
na yatkaroti śvapacaḥ pravṛttastatra vajradhṛk || 124.75 ||
ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā agastyo'gātsasaṃbhramaḥ  |
ditiṃ saṃbodhayāmāsa vyathitāṃ garbhavedanāt || 124.76 ||
tatrāgastyaḥ śacīkāntamaśapatkupito bhṛśam  ||* 124.77 ||
{agastya uvāca̱ }
saṃgrāme ripavaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ paśyeyuste sadā hare  |
jīvatāmeva maraṇametadeva hi māninām  |
pṛṣṭhaṃ palāyamānānāṃ yatpaśyantyahitā raṇe  || 124.78 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sāpi taṃ garbhasaṃsthaṃ ca śaśāpendraṃ ruṣā ditiḥ  ||* 124.79 ||
{ditiruvāca̱ }
na pauruṣaṃ kṛtaṃ tasmācchāpo'yaṃ bhavitā tava  |
strībhiḥ paribhavaṃ prāpya rājyātprabhraśyase hare  || 124.80 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etasminnantare tatra kaśyapo vai prajāpatiḥ  |
prāyācca vyathito'gastyācchrutvā śakraviceṣṭitam  |
garbhāntaragataḥ śakraḥ pitaraṃ prāha bhītavat || 124.81 ||
{śakra uvāca̱ }
agastyācca diteścaiva bibhemi kramituṃ bahiḥ  ||* 124.82 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etasminnantare prāpya kaśyapo'pi prajāpatiḥ  |
putrakarma ca taddṛṣṭvā garbhāntaḥsthitimeva ca  |
ditiśāpamagastyasya śrutvāsau duḥkhito'bhavat || 124.83 ||
{kaśyapa uvāca̱ }
nirgaccha śakra putraitatpāpaṃ kiṃ kṛtavānasi  |
na nirmalakulotpannā manaḥ kurvanti pātake  || 124.84 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa nirgato vajrapāṇiḥ savrīḍo'dhomukho'bravīt |
tanmūrtireva vadati sadasacceṣṭitaṃ nṛṇām  || 124.85 ||
{śakra uvāca̱ }
yaduktamatra śreyaḥ syāttatkartāhamasaṃśayam  ||* 124.86 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato mamāntikaṃ prāyāllokapālaiḥ sa kaśyapaḥ  |
sarvaṃ vṛttamathovāca punaḥ papraccha māṃ suraiḥ  || 124.87 ||
ditigarbhasya vai śāntiṃ sahasrākṣaviśāpatām  |
garbhasthānāṃ ca sarveṣāmindreṇa saha mitratām  || 124.88 ||
teṣāmārogyatāṃ cāpi śacībharturadoṣatām  |
agastyadattaśāpasya viśāpatvamapi kramāt || 124.89 ||
tato'hamabravaṃ vākyaṃ kaśyapaṃ vinayānvitam  |
prajāpate kaśyapa tvaṃ vasubhirlokapālakaiḥ  || 124.90 ||
indreṇa sahitaḥ śīghraṃ gautamīṃ yāhi mānada  |
tatra snātvā maheśānaṃ stuhi sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ  || 124.91 ||
tataḥ śivaprasādena sarvaṃ śreyo bhavediti  |
tathetyuktvā jagāmāsau kaśyapo gautamīṃ tadā  || 124.92 ||
snātvā tuṣṭāva deveśamebhireva padakramaiḥ  |
sarvaduḥkhāpanodāya dvayameva prakīrtitam  |
gautamī vā puṇyanadī śivo vā karuṇākaraḥ  || 124.93 ||
{kaśyapa uvāca̱ }
pāhi śaṃkara deveśa pāhi lokanamaskṛta  |
pāhi pāvana vāgīśa pāhi pannagabhūṣaṇa  || 124.94 ||
pāhi dharma vṛṣārūḍha pāhi vedatrayekṣaṇa  |
pāhi godhara lakṣmīśa pāhi śarva gajāmbara  || 124.95 ||
pāhi tripurahannātha pāhi somārdhabhūṣaṇa  |
pāhi yajñeśa someśa pāhyabhīṣṭapradāyaka  || 124.96 ||
pāhi kāruṇyanilaya pāhi maṅgaladāyaka  |
pāhi prabhava sarvasya pāhi pālaka vāsava  || 124.97 ||
pāhi bhāskara vitteśa pāhi brahmanamaskṛta  |
pāhi viśveśa siddheśa pāhi pūrṇa namo'stu te  || 124.98 ||
ghorasaṃsārakāntāra saṃcārodvignacetasām  |
śarīriṇāṃ kṛpāsindho tvameva śaraṇaṃ śiva  || 124.99 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ saṃstuvatastasya purato'bhūdvṛṣadhvajaḥ  |
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa kaśyapaṃ taṃ prajāpatim  || 124.100 ||
kaśyapo'pi śivaṃ prāha vinītavadidaṃ vacaḥ  |
sa prāha vistareṇātha indrasya tu viceṣṭitam  || 124.101 ||
śāpaṃ nāśaṃ ca putrāṇāṃ parasparamamitratām  |
pāpaprāptiṃ tu śakrasya śāpaprāptiṃ tathaiva ca  |
tato vṛṣākapiḥ prāha ditiṃ cāgastyameva ca  || 124.102 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
maruto ye bhavatputrāḥ pañcāśaccaikavarjitāḥ  |
sarve bhaveyuḥ subhagā bhaveyuryajñabhāginaḥ  || 124.103 ||
indreṇa sahitā nityaṃ vartayeyurmudānvitāḥ  ||* 124.104 ||
indrasya tu havirbhāgo yatra yatra makhe bhavet |
ādau tu marutastatra bhaveyurnātra saṃśayaḥ  || 124.105 ||
marudbhiḥ sahitaṃ śakraṃ na jayeyuḥ kadācana  |
jetā bhavetsarvadaiva sukhaṃ tiṣṭha prajāpate  || 124.106 ||
adyaprabhṛti ye kuryuranayādbhrātṛghātanam  |
vaṃśacchedo vipattiśca nityaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati  || 124.107 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
agastyamṛṣiśārdūlaṃ śaṃbhurapyāha yatnataḥ  ||* 124.108 ||
{śaṃbhuruvāca̱ }
na kuryāstvaṃ ca kopaṃ ca śacībhartari vai mune  |
śamaṃ vraja mahāprājña marutastvamarā bhavan  || 124.109 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ditiṃ cāpi śivaḥ prāha prasanno vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ  ||* 124.110 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
eko bhūyānmama sutastrailokyaiśvaryamaṇḍitaḥ  |
ityevaṃ cintayantī tvaṃ tapase niyatābhavaḥ  || 124.111 ||
tadetatsaphalaṃ te'dya putrā bahuguṇāḥ śubhāḥ  |
abhavan balinaḥ śūrāstasmājjahi manorujam  |
anyānapi varān subhrūryācasva gatasaṃbhramā  || 124.112 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadetadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevasya sā ditiḥ  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭā natvā śaṃbhuṃ vākyamathābravīt || 124.113 ||
{ditiruvāca̱ }
loke yadetatparamaṃ yatpitroḥ putradarśanam  |
viśeṣeṇa tu tanmātuḥ priyaṃ syātsurapūjita  || 124.114 ||
tatrāpi rūpasaṃpatti śauryavikramavān bhavet |
eko'pi tanayaḥ kiṃtu bahavaścetkimucyate  || 124.115 ||
matputrāste prabhāvācca jetāro balino dhruvam  |
indrasya bhrātaraḥ satyaṃ putrāścaiva prajāpateḥ  || 124.116 ||
agastyasya prasādācca gaṅgāyāśca prasādataḥ  |
yatra deva prasādaste tacchubhaṃ ko'tra saṃśayaḥ  || 124.117 ||
kṛtārthāhaṃ tathāpi tvāṃ bhaktyā vijñāpayāmyaham  |
śṛṇuṣva deva vacanaṃ kuruṣva ca jagaddhitam  || 124.118 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vadetyuktā jagaddhātrā ditirnamrābravīdidam  ||* 124.119 ||
{ditiruvāca̱ }
saṃtatiprāpaṇaṃ loke durlabhaṃ suravandita  |
viśeṣeṇa priyaṃ mātuḥ putraścetkiṃ nu varṇyate  || 124.120 ||
sa cāpi guṇavāñśrīmānāyuṣmān yadi jāyate  |
kiṃ tu svargeṇa deveśa pārameṣṭhyapadena vā  || 124.121 ||
sarveṣāmapi bhūtānāmihāmutra phalaiṣiṇām  |
guṇavatputrasaṃprāptirabhīṣṭā sarvadaiva ca  |
tasmādāplavanādatra kriyatāṃ samanugrahaḥ  || 124.122 ||
{śaṃkara uvāca̱ }
mahāpāpaphalaṃ cedaṃ yadetadanapatyatā  |
striyā vā puruṣasyāpi vandhyatvaṃ yadi jāyate  || 124.123 ||
tadatra snānamātreṇa taddoṣo nāśamāpnuyāt |
snātvā tatra phalaṃ dadyātstotrametacca yaḥ paṭhet || 124.124 ||
sa tu putramavāpnoti trimāsasnānadānataḥ  |
aputriṇī tvatra snānaṃ kṛtvā putramavāpnuyāt || 124.125 ||
ṛtusnātā tu yā kācittatra snātā sutāṃllabhet |
trimāsābhyantaraṃ yā tu gurviṇī bhaktitastviha  || 124.126 ||
phalaiḥ snātvā tu māṃ paśyetstotreṇa stauti māṃ tathā  |
tasyāḥ śakrasamaḥ putro jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 124.127 ||
pitṛdoṣaiśca ye putraṃ na labhante dite śṛṇu  |
dhanāpahāradoṣaiśca tatraiṣā niṣkṛtiḥ parā  || 124.128 ||
tatraiṣāṃ piṇḍadānena pitṝṇāṃ prīṇanena ca  |
kiṃcitsuvarṇadānena tataḥ putro bhaveddhruvam  || 124.129 ||
ye nyāsādyapahartāro ratnāpahnavakārakāḥ  |
śrāddhakarmavihīnāśca teṣāṃ vaṃśo na vardhate  || 124.130 ||
doṣiṇāṃ tu paretānāṃ gatireṣā bhavediti  |
saṃtatirjāyatāṃ ślāghyā jīvatāṃ tīrthasevanāt || 124.131 ||
saṃgame ditigaṅgāyāḥ snātvā siddheśvaraṃ prabhum  |
anādyapāramajaraṃ citsadānandavigraham  || 124.132 ||
devarṣisiddhagandharva yogīśvaraniṣevitam  |
liṅgātmakaṃ mahādevaṃ jyotirmayamanāmayam  || 124.133 ||
pūjayitvopacāraiśca nityaṃ bhaktyā yatavrataḥ  |
stotreṇānena yaḥ stauti caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca  || 124.134 ||
yathāśaktyā svarṇadānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam  |
yaḥ karotyatra gaṅgāyāṃ sa putraśatamāpnuyāt || 124.135 ||
saṃprāpya sakalān kāmānante śivapuraṃ vrajet |
stotreṇānena yaḥ kaścidyatra kvāpi stavīti mām  |
ṣaṇmāsātputramāpnoti api vandhyāpyaśaṅkitam  || 124.136 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ putratīrthamudāhṛtam  |
tatra tu snānadānādyaiḥ sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt || 124.137 ||
marudbhiḥ saha maitryeṇa mitratīrthaṃ taducyate  |
niṣpāpatvena cendrasya śakratīrthaṃ taducyate  || 124.138 ||
aindrīṃ śriyaṃ yatra lebhe tattīrthaṃ kamalābhidham  |
etāni sarvatīrthāni sarvābhīṣṭapradāni hi  || 124.139 ||
sarvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā śivaścāntaradhīyata  |
kṛtakṛtyāśca te jagmuḥ sarva eva yathāgatam  |
tīrthānāṃ puṇyadaṃ tatra lakṣamekaṃ prakīrtitam  || 124.140 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yamatīrthamiti khyātaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam  |
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣṭadaṃ sarva devarṣigaṇasevitam  || 125.1 ||
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  |
anuhrāda iti khyātaḥ kapoto balavānabhūt || 125.2 ||
tasya bhāryā hetināmnī pakṣiṇī kāmarūpiṇī  |
mṛtyoḥ pautro hyanuhrādo dauhitrī hetireva ca  || 125.3 ||
kālenātha tayoḥ putrāḥ pautrāścaiva babhūvire  |
tasya śatruśca balavānulūko nāma pakṣirāṭ || 125.4 ||
tasya putrāśca pautrāśca āgneyāste balotkaṭāḥ  |
tayośca vairamabhavadbahukālaṃ dvijanmanoḥ  || 125.5 ||
gaṅgāyā uttare tīre kapotasyāśramo'bhavat |
tasyāśca dakṣiṇe kūla ulūko nāma pakṣirāṭ || 125.6 ||
vāsaṃ cakre tatra putraiḥ pautraiśca dvijasattama  |
tayośca yuddhamabhavadbahukālaṃ viruddhayoḥ  || 125.7 ||
putraiḥ pautraiśca vṛtayorbalinorbalibhiḥ saha  |
ulūko vā kapoto vā naivāpnoti jayājayau  || 125.8 ||
kapoto yamamārādhya mṛtyuṃ paitāmahaṃ tathā  |
yāmyamastramavāpyātha sarvebhyo'pyadhiko'bhavat || 125.9 ||
tatholūko'gnimārādhya balavānabhavadbhṛśam  |
varairunmattayoryuddhamabhavaccātibhīṣaṇam  || 125.10 ||
tatrāgneyamulūko'pi kapotāyāstramākṣipat |
kapoto'pyatha pāśān vai yāmyānākṣipya śatrave  || 125.11 ||
ulūkāyātha daṇḍaṃ ca mṛtyupāśānavāsṛjat |
punastadabhavadyuddhaṃ purāḍibakayoryathā  || 125.12 ||
hetiḥ kapotakī dṛṣṭvā jvalanaṃ prāptamantike  |
pativratā mahāyuddhe bhartuḥ sā duḥkhavihvalā  || 125.13 ||
agninā veṣṭyamānāṃśca putrān dṛṣṭvā viśeṣataḥ  |
sā gatvā jvalanaṃ hetistuṣṭāva vividhoktibhiḥ  || 125.14 ||
{hetiruvāca̱ }
rūpaṃ na dānaṃ na parokṣamasti  125.15
yasyātmabhūtaṃ ca padārthajātam  125.15
aśnanti havyāni ca yena devāḥ  125.15
svāhāpatiṃ yajñabhujaṃ namasye  125.15
mukhabhūtaṃ ca devānāṃ devānāṃ havyavāhanam  |
hotāraṃ cāpi devānāṃ devānāṃ dūtameva ca  || 125.16 ||
taṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi ādidevaṃ vibhāvasum  |
antaḥ sthitaḥ prāṇarūpo bahiścānnaprado hi yaḥ  |
yo yajñasādhanaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ taṃ dhanaṃjayam  || 125.17 ||
{agniruvāca̱ }
amoghametadastraṃ me nyastaṃ yuddhe kapotaki  |
yatra viśramayedastraṃ tanme brūhi pativrate  || 125.18 ||
{kapotyuvāca̱ }
mayi viśramyatāmastraṃ na putre na ca bhartari  |
satyavāgbhava havyeśa jātavedo namo'stu te  || 125.19 ||
{jātavedā uvāca̱ }
tuṣṭo'smi tava vākyena bhartṛbhaktyā pativrate  |
tavāpi bhartṛputrāṇāṃ heti kṣemaṃ dadāmyaham  || 125.20 ||
āgneyametadastraṃ me na bhartāraṃ sutānapi  |
na tvāṃ dahettato yāhi sukhena tvaṃ kapotaki  || 125.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etasminnantare tatra ulūkī dadṛśe patim  |
veṣṭyamānaṃ yāmyapāśairyamadaṇḍena tāḍitam  |
ulūkī duḥkhitā bhūtvā yamaṃ prāyādbhayāturā  || 125.22 ||
{ulūkyuvāca̱ }
tvadbhītā anudravante janās 125.23
tvadbhītā brahmacaryaṃ caranti  125.23
tvadbhītāḥ sādhu caranti dhīrās 125.23
tvadbhītāḥ karmaniṣṭhā bhavanti  125.23
tvadbhītā anāśakamācaranti  125.24
grāmādaraṇyamabhi yaccaranti  125.24
tvadbhītāḥ saumyatāmāśrayante  125.24
tvadbhītāḥ somapānaṃ bhajante  125.24
tvadbhītāścānnagodānaniṣṭhās 125.24
tvadbhītā brahmavādaṃ vadanti  125.24
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ bruvatyāṃ tasyāṃ tāmāha dakṣiṇadikpatiḥ  ||* 125.25 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te dāsye'haṃ manasaḥ priyam  ||* 125.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yamasyeti vacaḥ śrutvā sā tamāha pativratā  ||* 125.27 ||
{ulūkyuvāca̱ }
bhartā me veṣṭitaḥ pāśairdaṇḍenābhihatastava  |
tasmādrakṣa suraśreṣṭha putrān bhartārameva ca  || 125.28 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvākyātkṛpayā yukto yamaḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ  ||* 125.29 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
pāśānāṃ cāpi daṇḍasya sthānaṃ vada śubhānane  ||* 125.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sā provāca yamaṃ devaṃ mayi pāśāstvayeritāḥ  |
āviśantu jagannātha daṇḍo mayyeva saṃviśet |
tataḥ provāca bhagavān yamastāṃ kṛpayā punaḥ  || 125.31 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
tava bhartā ca putrāśca sarve jīvantu vijvarāḥ  ||* 125.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
nyavārayadyamaḥ pāśānāgneyāstraṃ tu havyavāṭ |
kapotolūkayoścāpi prītiṃ vai cakratuḥ surau  |
āhatuśca dvijanmānau vriyatāṃ vara īpsitaḥ  || 125.33 ||
{pakṣiṇāvūcatu̱ḥ }
bhavatordarśanaṃ labdhaṃ vairavyājena duṣkaram  |
vayaṃ ca pakṣiṇaḥ pāpāḥ kiṃ vareṇa surottamau  || 125.34 ||
atha deyo varo'smākaṃ bhavadbhyāṃ prītipūrvakam  |
nātmārthamanuyācāvo dīyamānaṃ varaṃ śubham  || 125.35 ||
ātmārthaṃ yastu yāceta sa śocyo hi sureśvarau  |
jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ tasya yaḥ parārthodyataḥ sadā  || 125.36 ||
agnirāpo raviḥ pṛthvī dhānyāni vividhāni ca  |
parārthaṃ vartanaṃ teṣāṃ satāṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ  || 125.37 ||
brahmādayo'pi hi yato yujyante mṛtyunā saha  |
evaṃ jñātvā tu deveśau vṛthā svārthapariśramaḥ  || 125.38 ||
janmanā saha yatpuṃsāṃ vihitaṃ parameṣṭhinā  |
kadācinnānyathā tadvai vṛthā kliśyanti jantavaḥ  || 125.39 ||
tasmādyācāvahe kiṃciddhitāya jagatāṃ śubham  |
guṇadāyi tu sarveṣāṃ tadyuvāmanumanyatām  || 125.40 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tāvāhaturubhau devau pakṣiṇau lokaviśrutau  |
dharmasya yaśaso'vāptye lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 125.41 ||
{pakṣiṇāvūcatu̱ḥ }
āvābhyāmāśramau tīrthe gaṅgāyā ubhaye taṭe  |
bhavetāṃ jagatāṃ nāthāveṣa eva paro varaḥ  || 125.42 ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṝṇāṃ cāpi pūjanam  |
sukṛtī duṣkṛtī vāpi yaḥ karoti yathā tathā  |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ syādityeṣa paro varaḥ  || 125.43 ||
{devāvūcatu̱ḥ }
evamastu tathā cānyatsuprītau tu bravāvahai  ||* 125.44 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
uttare gautamītīre yamastotraṃ paṭhanti ye  |
teṣāṃ saptasu vaṃśeṣu nākāle mṛtyumāpnuyāt || 125.45 ||
puruṣo bhājanaṃ ca syātsarvadā sarvasaṃpadām  |
yastvidaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ mṛtyustotraṃ jitātmavān  || 125.46 ||
aṣṭāśītisahasraiśca vyādhibhirna sa bādhyate  |
asmiṃstīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhau trimāsādgurviṇī satī  || 125.47 ||
arvāgvandhyā ca ṣaṇmāsātsaptāhaṃ snānamācaret |
vīrasūḥ sā bhavennārī śatāyuḥ sa suto bhavet || 125.48 ||
lakṣmīvānmatimāñśūraḥ putrapautravivardhanaḥ  |
tatra piṇḍādidānena pitaro muktimāpnuyuḥ  |
manovākkāyajātpāpātsnānānmukto bhavennaraḥ  || 125.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yamavākyādanu tathā havyavāḍāha pakṣiṇau  ||* 125.50 ||
{agniruvāca̱ }
matstotraṃ dakṣiṇe tīre ye paṭhanti yatavratāḥ  |
teṣāmārogyamaiśvaryaṃ lakṣmīṃ rūpaṃ dadāmyaham  || 125.51 ||
idaṃ stotraṃ tu yaḥ kaścidyatra kvāpi paṭhennaraḥ  |
naivāgnito bhayaṃ tasya likhite'pi gṛhe sthite  || 125.52 ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādagnitīrthe śucirnaraḥ  |
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ  || 125.53 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ yāmyamāgneyameva ca  |
kapotaṃ ca tatholūkaṃ hetyulūkaṃ vidurbudhāḥ  || 125.54 ||
tatra trīṇi sahasrāṇi tāvantyeva śatāni ca  |
punarnavatitīrthāni pratyekaṃ muktibhājanam  || 125.55 ||
teṣu snānena dānena pretībhūtāśca ye narāḥ  |
pūtāste putravittāḍhyā ākrameyurdivaṃ śubhāḥ  || 125.56 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tapastīrthamiti khyātaṃ tapovṛddhikaraṃ mahat |
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam  || 126.1 ||
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yadvṛttaṃ śṛṇu pāpapraṇāśanam  |
apāmagneśca saṃvādamṛṣīṇāṃ ca parasparam  || 126.2 ||
apo jyeṣṭhatamāḥ kecinmenire'gniṃ tathāpare  |
evaṃ bruvanto munayaḥ saṃvādaṃ cāgnivāriṇoḥ  || 126.3 ||
vināgniṃ jīvanaṃ kva syājjīvabhūto yato'nalaḥ  |
ātmabhūto havyabhūtaścāgninā jāyate'khilam  || 126.4 ||
agninā dhriyate loko hyagnirjyotirmayaṃ jagat |
tasmādagneḥ paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ daivataṃ mahat || 126.5 ||
antarjyotiḥ sa evoktaḥ paraṃ jyotiḥ sa eva hi  |
vināgninā kiṃcidasti yasya dhāma jagattrayam  || 126.6 ||
tasmādagneḥ paraṃ nāsti bhūtānāṃ jyaiṣṭhyabhājanam  |
yoṣitkṣetre'rpitaṃ bījaṃ puruṣeṇa yathā tathā  || 126.7 ||
tasya dehādikā śaktiḥ kṛśānoreva nānyathā  |
devānāṃ hi mukhaṃ vahnistasmānnātaḥ paraṃ viduḥ  || 126.8 ||
apare tu hyapāṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ menire vedavādinaḥ  |
adbhiḥ saṃpatsyate hyannaṃ śuciradbhiḥ prajāyate  || 126.9 ||
adbhireva dhṛtaṃ sarvamāpo vai mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ  |
trailokyajīvanaṃ vāri vadantīti purāvidaḥ  || 126.10 ||
utpannamamṛtaṃ hyadbhyastābhyaścauṣadhisaṃbhavaḥ  |
agnirjyeṣṭha iti prāhurāpo jyeṣṭhatamāḥ pare  || 126.11 ||
evaṃ mīmāṃsamānāste ṛṣayo vedavādinaḥ  |
viruddhavādino māṃ ca samabhyetyedamabruvan  || 126.12 ||
{ṛṣaya ūcu̱ḥ }
agnerapāṃ vada jyaiṣṭhyaṃ trailokyasya bhavān prabhuḥ  ||* 126.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ahamapyabravaṃ prāptānṛṣīn sarvān yatavratān  |
ubhau pūjyatamau loka ubhābhyāṃ jāyate jagat || 126.14 ||
ubhābhyāṃ jāyate havyaṃ kavyaṃ cāmṛtameva ca  |
ubhābhyāṃ jīvanaṃ loke śarīrasya ca dhāraṇam  || 126.15 ||
nānayośca viśeṣo'sti tato jyaiṣṭhyaṃ samaṃ matam  |
tato madvacanājjyaiṣṭhyamubhayornaiva kasyacit || 126.16 ||
jyaiṣṭhyamanyatarasyeti menire ṛṣisattamāḥ  |
na tṛptā mama vākyena jagmurvāyuṃ tapasvinaḥ  || 126.17 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kasya jyaiṣṭhyaṃ bhavān prāṇo vāyo satyaṃ tvayi sthitam  ||* 126.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vāyurāhānalo jyeṣṭhaḥ sarvamagnau pratiṣṭhitam  |
netyuktvānyonyamṛṣayo jagmuste'pi vasuṃdharām  || 126.19 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
satyaṃ bhūme vada jyaiṣṭhyamādhārāsi carācare  ||* 126.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhūmirapyāha vinayādāgatāṃstānṛṣīnidam  ||* 126.21 ||
{bhūmiruvāca̱ }
mamāpyādhārabhūtāḥ syurāpo devyaḥ sanātanāḥ  |
adbhyastu jāyate sarvaṃ jyaiṣṭhyamapsu pratiṣṭhitam  || 126.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
netyuktvānyonyamṛṣayo jagmuḥ kṣīrodaśāyinam  |
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraiḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharam  || 126.23 ||
{ṛṣaya ūcu̱ḥ }
yo veda sarvaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyad 126.24
yajjāyamānaṃ ca guhāniviṣṭam  126.24
lokatrayaṃ citravicitrarūpam  126.24
ante samastaṃ ca yamāviveśa  126.24
yadakṣaraṃ śāśvatamaprameyaṃ  126.25
yaṃ vedavedyamṛṣayo vadanti  126.25
yamāśritāḥ svepsitamāpnuvanti  126.25
tadvastu satyaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ  126.25
bhūtaṃ mahābhūtajagatpradhānaṃ  126.26
na vindate yogino viṣṇurūpam  126.26
tadvaktumete ṛṣayo'tra yātāḥ  126.26
satyaṃ vadasveha jagannivāsa  126.26
tvamantarātmākhiladehabhājāṃ  126.27
tvameva sarvaṃ tvayi sarvamīśa  126.27
tathāpi jānanti na keapi kutrāpi  126.27
aho bhavantaṃ prakṛtiprabhāvāt 126.27
antarbahiḥ sarvata eva santaṃ  126.27
viśvātmanā saṃparivartamānam  126.27
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prāha jagaddhātrī daivī vāgaśarīriṇī  ||* 126.28 ||
{daivī vāguvāca̱ }
ubhāvārādhya tapasā bhaktyā ca niyamena ca  |
yasya syātprathamaṃ siddhistadbhūtaṃ jyeṣṭhamucyate  || 126.29 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetytathā yayuḥ sarve ṛṣayo lokapūjitāḥ  |
śrāntāḥ khinnāntarātmānaḥ paraṃ vairāgyamāśritāḥ  || 126.30 ||
sarvalokaikajananīṃ bhuvanatrayapāvanīm  |
gautamīmagaman sarve tapastaptuṃ yatavratāḥ  || 126.31 ||
abdaivataṃ tathāgniṃ ca pūjanāyodyatāstadā  |
agneśca pūjakā ye ca apāṃ vai pūjane sthitāḥ  |
tatra vāgabravīddaivī vedamātā sarasvatī  || 126.32 ||
{daivī vāguvāca̱ }
agnerāpastathā yoniradbhiḥ śaucamavāpyate  |
agneśca pūjakā ye ca vinādbhiḥ pūjanaṃ katham  || 126.33 ||
apsu jātāsu sarvatra karmaṇyadhikṛto bhavet |
tāvatkarmaṇyanarho'yamaśucirmalino naraḥ  || 126.34 ||
na magnaḥ śraddhayā yāvadapsu śītāsu vedavit |
tasmādāpo variṣṭhāḥ syurmātṛbhūtā yataḥ smṛtāḥ  |
tasmājjyaiṣṭhyamapāmeva jananyo'gnerviśeṣataḥ  || 126.35 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etadvacaḥ śuśruvuste ṛṣayo vedavādinaḥ  |
niścayaṃ ca tataścakrurbhavejjyaiṣṭhyamapāmiti  || 126.36 ||
yatra tīrthe vṛttamidamṛṣisattre ca nārada  |
tapastīrthaṃ tu tatproktaṃ sattratīrthaṃ taducyate  || 126.37 ||
agnitīrthaṃ ca tatproktaṃ tathā sārasvataṃ viduḥ  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  || 126.38 ||
caturdaśa śatānyatra tīrthānāṃ puṇyadāyinām  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca svargamokṣapradāyakam  || 126.39 ||
kṛtaṃ saṃdehaharaṇamṛṣīṇāṃ yatra bhāṣayā  |
sarasvatyabhavattatra gaṅgayā saṃgatā nadī  |
māhātmyaṃ tasya ko vaktuṃ saṃgamasya kṣamo naraḥ  || 126.40 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
devatīrthamiti khyātaṃ gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe  |
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  || 127.1 ||
ārṣṭiṣeṇa iti khyāto rājā sarvaguṇānvitaḥ  |
tasya bhāryā jayā nāma sākṣāllakṣmīrivāparā  || 127.2 ||
tasya putro bharo nāma matimān pitṛvatsalaḥ  |
dhanurvede ca vede ca niṣṇāto dakṣa eva ca  || 127.3 ||
tasya bhāryā rūpavatī suprabhetyabhiviśrutā  |
ārṣṭiṣeṇastato rājā putre rājyaṃ niveśya saḥ  || 127.4 ||
purodhasā ca mukhyena dīkṣāṃ cakre nareśvaraḥ  |
sarasvatyāstatastīre hayamedhāya yatnavān  || 127.5 ||
ṛtvigbhirṛṣimukhyaiśca vedaśāstraparāyaṇaiḥ  |
dīkṣitaṃ taṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇāgnisamīpataḥ  || 127.6 ||
mithurdānavarāṭśūraḥ pāpabuddhiḥ pratāpavān  |
makhaṃ vidhvasya nṛpatiṃ sabhāryaṃ sapurohitam  || 127.7 ||
ādāya vegātsa prāgādrasātalatalaṃ mune  |
nīte tasminnṛpavare yajñe naṣṭe tato'marāḥ  || 127.8 ||
ṛtvijaśca yayuḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ makhāttataḥ  |
purohitasuto rājño devāpiriti viśrutaḥ  || 127.9 ||
bālastāṃ mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā ātmanaḥ pitaraṃ na ca  |
dṛṣṭvā savismayo bhūtvā duḥkhito'tīva cābhavat || 127.10 ||
sa mātaraṃ tu papraccha pitā me kva gato'mbike  |
pitṛhīno na jīveyaṃ mātaḥ satyaṃ vadasva me  || 127.11 ||
dhigdhikpitṛvihīnānāṃ jīvitaṃ pāpakarmaṇām  |
na vakṣi yadi me mātarjalamagnimathāviśe  || 127.12 ||
putraṃ provāca sā mātā rājño bhāryā purodhasaḥ  |
dānavena talaṃ nīto rājñā saha pitā tava  || 127.13 ||
{devāpiruvāca̱ }
kva nītaḥ kena vā nītaḥ kathaṃ nītaḥ kva karmaṇi  |
keṣu paśyatsu kiṃ sthānaṃ dānavasya vadasva me  || 127.14 ||
{mātovāca̱ }
dīkṣitaṃ yajñasadasi sabhāryaṃ sapurodhasam  |
rājānaṃ taṃ mithurdaityo nītavān sa rasātalam  |
paśyatsu devasaṃgheṣu vahnibrāhmaṇasaṃnidhau  || 127.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tanmātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā devāpiḥ kṛtyamasmarat |
devān paśye'thavāgniṃ vā ṛtvijo vāsurāṃstathā  || 127.16 ||
eteṣveva pitānveṣyo nānyatreti matirmama  |
iti niścitya devāpirbharaṃ prāha nṛpātmajam  || 127.17 ||
{devāpiruvāca̱ }
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa vratena niyamena ca  |
ānetavyā mayā sarve nītā ye ca rasātalam  || 127.18 ||
jāte parābhave ghore yo na kuryātpratikriyām  |
narādhamena kiṃ tena jīvatā vā mṛtena vā  || 127.19 ||
tvaṃ praśādhi mahīṃ kṛtsnāmārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ pitā yathā  |
mātā mama tvayā pālyā rājan yāvanmamāgatiḥ  |
bhavecca kṛtakāryasya anujānīhi māṃ bhara  || 127.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhareṇoktaḥ sa devāpiḥ sarvaṃ niścitya yatnataḥ  ||* 127.21 ||
{bhara uvāca̱ }
siddhiṃ kuru sukhaṃ yāhi mā cintāmalpikāṃ bhaja  ||* 127.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato devāpiramara rājāṅghridhyānatatparaḥ  |
ṛtvijo'nveṣya yatnena natvā tānṛtvijaḥ pṛthak |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bālo devāpirvākyamabravīt || 127.23 ||
{devāpiruvāca̱ }
bhavadbhiśca makho rakṣyo yajamānaśca dīkṣitaḥ  |
purodhāśca tathā rakṣyaḥ patnī yā dīkṣitasya tu  || 127.24 ||
bhavatsu tatra paśyatsu yajñaṃ vidhvasya daityarāṭ |
rājādayastena nītāstanna yuktatamaṃ bhavet || 127.25 ||
athāpyetadahaṃ manye bhavantastānarogiṇaḥ  |
dātumarhanti tān sarvānanyathā śāpamarhatha  || 127.26 ||
{ṛtvija ūcu̱ḥ }
makhe'gniḥ prathamaṃ pūjyo hyagnirevātra daivatam  |
tasmādvayaṃ na jānīmo hyagnīnāṃ paricārakāḥ  || 127.27 ||
sa eva dātā bhoktā ca hartā kartā ca havyavāṭ ||* 127.28 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ṛtvijaḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā devāpirjātavedasam  |
pūjayitvā yathānyāyamagnaye tannyavedayat || 127.29 ||
{agniruvāca̱ }
yathartvijastathā cāhaṃ devānāṃ paricārakaḥ  |
havyaṃ vahāmi devānāṃ bhoktāro rakṣakāśca te  || 127.30 ||
{devāpiruvāca̱ }
devānāhūya yatnena havirbhāgān pṛthakpṛthak |
dāsye'hameṣa doṣo me tasmādyāhi surān prati  || 127.31 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
devāpiḥ sa surān prāpya natvā tebhyaḥ pṛthakpṛthak |
ṛtvigvākyaṃ cāgnivākyaṃ śāpaṃ cāpi nyavedayat || 127.32 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
āhūtā vaidikairmantrairṛtvigbhiśca yathākramam  |
bhokṣyāmahe havirbhāgānna svatantrā dvijottama  || 127.33 ||
tasmādvedānugā nityaṃ vayaṃ vedena coditāḥ  |
paratantrāstato vipra vedebhyastannivedaya  || 127.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa devāpiḥ śucirbhūtvā vedānāhūya yatnataḥ  |
dhyānena tapasā yukto vedāścāpi puro'bhavan  || 127.35 ||
vedānuvāca devāpirnamasya tu punaḥ punaḥ  |
ṛtvigvākyaṃ cāgnivākyaṃ devavākyaṃ nyavedayat || 127.36 ||
{vedā ūcu̱ḥ }
paratantrā vayaṃ tāta īśvarasya vaśānugāḥ  |
aśeṣajagadādhāro nirādhāro nirañjanaḥ  || 127.37 ||
sarvaśaktyaikasadanaṃ nidhānaṃ sarvasaṃpadām  |
sa tu kartā mahādevaḥ saṃhartā sa maheśvaraḥ  || 127.38 ||
vayaṃ śabdamayā brahman vadāmo vidma eva ca  |
asmākametatkṛtyaṃ syādvadāmo yattu pṛcchasi  || 127.39 ||
kena nītāstasya nāma tatpuraṃ tadbalaṃ tathā  |
bhakṣitāḥ kiṃ tu no naṣṭā etajjānīmahe vayam  || 127.40 ||
yathā ca tava sāmarthyaṃ yamārādhya ca yatra ca  |
syādityetacca jānīmo yathā prāpsyasi tān puraḥ  || 127.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvāvadadvedān vicārya suciraṃ hṛdi  ||* 127.42 ||
{devāpiruvāca̱ }
vedā vadantvetadeva sarvameva yathārthataḥ  |
sarvān prāpsye talaṃ nītānalaṃ tebhyo namo'stu vaḥ  || 127.43 ||
{vedā ūcu̱ḥ }
gautamīṃ gaccha devāpe tatra stuhi maheśvaram  |
suprasannastavābhīṣṭaṃ dāsyatyeva kṛpākaraḥ  || 127.44 ||
bhaveddevaḥ śivaḥ prītaḥ stutaḥ satyaṃ mahāmate  |
ārṣṭiṣeṇaśca nṛpatistasya jāyā jayā satī  || 127.45 ||
pitā tavāpyupamanyustale tiṣṭhantyarogiṇaḥ  |
varadānānmaheśasya mithuṃ hatvā ca rākṣasam  |
yaśaḥ prāpsyasi dharmaṃ ca etacchakyaṃ na cetarat || 127.46 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvedavacanādbālo devāpirgautamīṃ gataḥ  |
snātvā kṛtakṣaṇo viprastuṣṭāva ca maheśvaram  || 127.47 ||
{devāpiruvāca̱ }
bālo'haṃ devadeveśa gurūṇāṃ tvaṃ gururmama  |
na me śaktistvatstavane tubhyaṃ śaṃbho namo'stu te  || 127.48 ||
na tvāṃ jānanti nigamā na devā munayo na ca  |
na brahmā nāpi vaikuṇṭho yo'si so'si namo'stu te  || 127.49 ||
ye'nāthā ye ca kṛpaṇā ye daridrāśca rogiṇaḥ  |
pāpātmāno ye ca loke tāṃstvaṃ pāsi maheśvara  || 127.50 ||
tapasā niyamairmantraiḥ pūjitāstridivaukasaḥ  |
tvayā dattaṃ phalaṃ tebhyo dāsyanti jagatāṃ pate  || 127.51 ||
yācitāraśca dātārastebhyo yadyanmanīṣitam  |
bhavatīti na citraṃ syāttvaṃ viparyayakārakaḥ  || 127.52 ||
ye'jñānino ye ca pāpā ye magnā narakārṇave  |
śiveti vacanānnātha tān pāsi tvaṃ jagadguro  || 127.53 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ tu stuvatastasya puraḥ prāha trilocanaḥ  ||* 127.54 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
varaṃ brūhyatha devāpe alaṃ dainyena bālaka  ||* 127.55 ||
{devāpiruvāca̱ }
rājānaṃ rājapatnīṃ ca pitaraṃ ca guruṃ mama  |
prāptumicche jagannātha nidhanaṃ ca ripormama  || 127.56 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
devāpivacanaṃ śrutvā tathetyāhākhileśvaraḥ  |
devāpeḥ sarvamabhavadājñayā śaṃkarasya tat || 127.57 ||
punarapyāha taṃ śaṃbhurdevāpikaruṇākaraḥ  |
nandinaṃ preṣayāmāsa śaṃbhuḥ śūlena nārada  || 127.58 ||
rasātalaṃ mithuṃ nandī hatvā cāsurapuṃgavān  |
tatpitrādīn samānīya tasmai tān sa nyavedayat || 127.59 ||
hayamedhaśca tatrāsīdārṣṭiṣeṇasya dhīmataḥ  |
agniśca ṛtvijo devā vedāśca ṛṣayo'bruvan  || 127.60 ||
{agnyādaya ūcu̱ḥ }
yatra sākṣādabhūcchaṃbhurdevāpe bhaktavatsalaḥ  |
devadevo jagannātho devatīrthamabhūcca tat || 127.61 ||
sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām  |
puṇyadaṃ tīrthametatsyāttava kīrtiśca śāśvatī  || 127.62 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
aśvamedhe nivṛtte tu surāstebhyo varān daduḥ  |
snātvā kṛtārthā gaṅgāyāṃ tataste divamākraman  || 127.63 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tatrāsaṃstīrthāni daśa pañca ca  |
sahasrāṇi śatānyaṣṭāvubhayorapi tīrayoḥ  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca hyatīva phaladaṃ viduḥ  || 127.64 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tapovanamiti khyātaṃ nandinīsaṃgamaṃ tathā  |
siddheśvaraṃ tatra tīrthaṃ gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 128.1 ||
śārdūlaṃ ceti vikhyātaṃ teṣāṃ vṛttamidaṃ śṛṇu  |
yasyākarṇanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 128.2 ||
agnirhotā purā tvāsīddevānāṃ havyavāhanaḥ  |
bhāryāṃ prāpto dakṣasutāṃ svāhānāmnīṃ surūpiṇīm  || 128.3 ||
sānapatyā purā cāsītputrārthaṃ tapa āviśat |
tapaścarantīṃ vipulaṃ toṣayantīṃ hutāśanam  |
sa bhartā hutabhukprāha bhāryāṃ svāhāmaninditām  || 128.4 ||
{agniruvāca̱ }
apatyāni bhaviṣyanti mā tapaḥ kuru śobhane  ||* 128.5 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā bhartṛvākyaṃ nivṛttā tapaso'bhavat |
strīṇāmabhīṣṭadaṃ nānyadbhartṛvākyaṃ vinā kvacit || 128.6 ||
tataḥ katipaye kāle tārakādbhaya āgate  |
anutpanne kārttikeye cirakālarahogate  || 128.7 ||
maheśvare bhavānyā ca trastā devāḥ samāgatāḥ  |
devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthamagniṃ procurdivaukasaḥ  || 128.8 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
deva gaccha mahābhāga śaṃbhuṃ trailokyapūjitam  |
tārakādbhayamutpannaṃ śaṃbhave tvaṃ nivedaya  || 128.9 ||
{agniruvāca̱ }
na gantavyaṃ tatra deśe daṃpatyoḥ sthitayo rahaḥ  |
sāmānyamātrato nyāyaḥ kiṃ punaḥ śūlapāṇini  || 128.10 ||
ekāntasthitayoḥ svairaṃ jalpatoryaḥ sarāgayoḥ  |
daṃpatyoḥ śṛṇuyādvākyaṃ nirayāttasya noddhṛtiḥ  || 128.11 ||
sa svāmyakhilalokānāṃ mahākālastriśūlavān  |
nirīkṣaṇīyaḥ kena syādbhavānyā rahasi sthitaḥ  || 128.12 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
mahābhaye cānugate nyāyaḥ ko'nvatra varṇyate  |
tārakādbhaya utpanne gaccha tvaṃ tārako bhavān  || 128.13 ||
mahābhayābdhau sādhūnāṃ yatparārthāya jīvitam  |
rūpeṇānyena vā gaccha vācaṃ vada yathā tathā  || 128.14 ||
viśrāvya devavacanaṃ śaṃbhumāgaccha satvaraḥ  |
tato dāsyāmahe pūjāmubhayorlokayoḥ kave  || 128.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śuko bhūtvā jagāmāśu devavākyāddhutāśanaḥ  |
yatrāsījjagatāṃ nātho ramamāṇastadomayā  || 128.16 ||
sa bhītavadatha prāyācchuko bhūtvā tadānalaḥ  |
nāśakaddvāradeśe tu praveṣṭuṃ havyavāhanaḥ  || 128.17 ||
tato gavākṣadeśe tu tasthau dhunvannadhomukhaḥ  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā prahasañśaṃbhurumāṃ prāha rahogataḥ  || 128.18 ||
{śaṃbhuruvāca̱ }
paśya devi śukaṃ prāptaṃ devavākyāddhutāśanam  ||* 128.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
lajjitā cāvadaddevamalaṃ deveti pārvatī  |
puraścarantaṃ deveśo hyagniṃ taṃ dvijarūpiṇam  || 128.20 ||
āhūya bahuśaścāpi jñāto'syagne'tra mā vada  |
vidārayasva svamukhaṃ gṛhāṇedaṃ nayasva tat || 128.21 ||
ityuktvā tasya cāsye'gne retaḥ sa prākṣipadbahu  |
retogarbhastadā cāgnirgantuṃ naiva ca śaktavān  || 128.22 ||
suranadyāstatastīraṃ śrānto'gnirupatasthivān  |
kṛttikāsu ca tadretaḥ prakṣepātkārttiko'bhavat || 128.23 ||
avaśiṣṭaṃ ca yatkiṃcidagnerdehe ca śāṃbhavam  |
tadeva reto vahnistu svabhāryāyāṃ dvidhākṣipat || 128.24 ||
svāhāyāṃ priyabhūtāyāṃ putrārthinyāṃ viśeṣataḥ  |
purā sāśvāsitā tena saṃtatiste bhaviṣyati  || 128.25 ||
tadvahninātha saṃsmṛtya tatkṣiptaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ mahaḥ  |
tadagne retasastasyāṃ jajñe mithunamuttamam  || 128.26 ||
suvarṇaśca suvarṇā ca rūpeṇāpratimaṃ bhuvi  |
agneḥ prītikaraṃ nityaṃ lokānāṃ prītivardhanam  || 128.27 ||
agniḥ prītyā suvarṇāṃ tāṃ prādāddharmāya dhīmate  |
suvarṇasyātha putrasya saṃkalpāmakarotpriyām  |
evaṃ putrasya putryāśca vivāhamakarotkaviḥ  || 128.28 ||
anyonyaretovyatiṣaṅgadoṣād 128.29
agnerapatyamubhayaṃ tathaiva  128.29

indrasya vāyordhanadasya bhāryāṃ  128.30
jaleśvarasyāpi munīśvarāṇām  128.30
bhāryāstu gacchatyaniśaṃ suvarṇo  128.30
yasyāḥ priyaṃ yacca vapuḥ sa kṛtvā  128.30
yāti kvaciccāpi kavestanūjas 128.31
tadbhartṛrūpaṃ ca pativratāsu  128.31
kṛtvāniśaṃ tābhirudārabhāvaḥ  128.31
kurvan kṛtārthaṃ madanaṃ sa reme  128.31
kṛtvā gatā kvāpi caivaṃ suvarṇā  128.32
dharmasya bhāryāpi suvarṇanāmnī  128.32
svāhāsutā svairiṇī sā babhūva  128.32
yasyāpi yasyāpi manogatā yā  128.32
bhāryāsvarūpā saiva bhūtvā suvarṇā  128.33
reme patīnmānuṣānāsurāṃśca  128.33
devānṛṣīn pitṛrūpāṃstathānyān  128.33
rūpaudāryasthairyagāmbhīryayuktān  128.33
yābhipretā yasya devasya bhāryā  128.34
tadrūpā sā ramate tena sārdham  128.34
nānābhedaiḥ karaṇaiścāpyanekair 128.34
ākarṣantī tanmanaḥ kāmasiddhim  128.34
evaṃ suvarṇasya nirīkṣya ceṣṭām  128.35
agneḥ sūnoḥ putrikāyāstathāgneḥ  128.35
sarve ca śepuḥ kupitāstadāgneḥ  128.35
putraṃ ca putrīṃ ca surāsurāste  128.35
{surāsurā ūcu̱ḥ }
kṛtaṃ yadetadvyabhicārarūpaṃ  128.36
yacchadmanā vartanaṃ pāparūpam  128.36
tasmātsutaste vyabhicāravāṃśca  128.36
sarvatra gāmī jāyatāṃ havyavāha  128.36
tathā suvarṇāpi na caikaniṣṭhā  128.37
bhūyādagne naikatṛptā bahūṃśca  128.37
nānājātīnninditān dehabhājo  128.37
bhajitrī syādeṣa doṣaśca putryāḥ  128.37
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityetacchāpavacanaṃ śrutvāgniratibhītavat |
māmabhyetya tadovāca niṣkṛtiṃ vada putrayoḥ  || 128.38 ||
tadāhamabravaṃ vahne gautamīṃ gaccha śaṃkaram  |
stutvā tatra mahābāho nivedaya jagatpateḥ  || 128.39 ||
māheśvareṇa vīryeṇa tava dehasthitena ca  |
evaṃvidhaṃ tvapatyaṃ te jātaṃ vahne tato bhavān  || 128.40 ||
nivedayasva devāya devānāṃ śāpamīdṛśam  |
svāpatyarakṣaṇāyāsau śaṃbhuḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyati  || 128.41 ||
stuhi devaṃ ca devīṃ ca bhaktyā prīto bhavecchivaḥ  |
tatastvapatyaviṣaye priyān kāmānavāpsyasi  || 128.42 ||
tato madvacanādagnirgaṅgāṃ gatvā maheśvaram  |
tuṣṭāva niyato vākyaiḥ stutibhirvedasaṃmitaiḥ  || 128.43 ||
{agniruvāca̱ }
viśvasya jagato dhātā viśvamūrtirnirañjanaḥ  |
ādikartā svayaṃbhūśca taṃ namāmi jagatpatim  || 128.44 ||
yo'gnirbhūtvā saṃharati sraṣṭā vai jalarūpataḥ  |
sūryarūpeṇa yaḥ pāti taṃ namāmi ca tryambakam  || 128.45 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prasanno bhagavānanantaḥ śaṃbhuravyayaḥ  |
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa pāvakaṃ surapūjitam  || 128.46 ||
sa vinītaḥ śivaṃ prāha tava vīryaṃ mayi sthitam  |
tena jātaḥ suto ramyaḥ suvarṇo lokaviśrutaḥ  || 128.47 ||
tathā suvarṇā putrī ca tasmādeva jagatprabho  |
anyonyavīryasaṅgācca taddoṣādubhayaṃ tvidam  || 128.48 ||
vyabhicārātsadoṣaṃ ca apatyamabhavacchiva  |
śāpaṃ daduḥ surāḥ sarve tayoḥ śāntiṃ kuru prabho  || 128.49 ||
tadagnivacanācchaṃbhuḥ provācedaṃ śubhodayam  ||* 128.50 ||
{śaṃbhuruvāca̱ }
madvīryādabhavattvattaḥ suvarṇo bhūrivikramaḥ  |
samagrā ṛddhayaḥ sarvāḥ suvarṇe'smin samāhitāḥ  || 128.51 ||
bhaviṣyanti na saṃdeho vahne śṛṇu vaco mama  |
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ pāvanaḥ sa bhaviṣyati  || 128.52 ||
sa eva cāmṛtaṃ loke sa eva suravallabhaḥ  |
sa eva bhuktimuktī ca sa eva makhadakṣiṇā  || 128.53 ||
sa eva rūpaṃ sarvasya gurūṇāmapyasau guruḥ  |
vīryaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ vidyādvīryaṃ matto yaduttamam  || 128.54 ||
viśeṣatastvayi kṣiptaṃ tasya kā syādvicāraṇā  |
hīnaṃ tena vinā sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇāstena saṃpadaḥ  || 128.55 ||
jīvanto'pi mṛtāḥ sarve suvarṇena vinā narāḥ  |
nirguṇo'pi dhanī mānyaḥ saguṇo'pyadhano nahi  || 128.56 ||
tasmānnātaḥ paraṃ kiṃcitsuvarṇāddhi bhaviṣyati  |
tathā caiṣā suvarṇāpi syādutkṛṣṭāpi cañcalā  || 128.57 ||
anayā vīkṣitaṃ sarvaṃ nyūnaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati  |
tapasā japahomaiśca yeyaṃ prāpyā jagattraye  || 128.58 ||
tasyāḥ prabhāvaṃ prāśastyamagne kiṃcicca kīrtyate  |
sarvatra yā tu saṃtiṣṭhedāyātu vicariṣyati  || 128.59 ||
suvarṇā kamalā sākṣātpavitrā ca bhaviṣyati  |
adya prabhṛtyātmajayostathā svairaṃ viceṣṭatoḥ  || 128.60 ||
tathāpi caitayoḥ puṇyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati  ||* 128.61 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ sākṣāttatrābhavacchivaḥ  |
liṅgarūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 128.62 ||
varān prāpya sutābhyāṃ sa agnistuṣṭo'bhavattataḥ  |
svabhartrā ca suvarṇā sā dharmeṇāgnisutā mudā  || 128.63 ||
vartayāmāsa putro'pi vahneḥ saṃkalpayā mudā  |
etasminnantare svarṇāmagnerduhitaraṃ mune  || 128.64 ||
paribhūya ca dharmaṃ taṃ śārdūlo dānaveśvaraḥ  |
aharadbhāgyasaubhāgya vilāsavasatiṃ chalāt || 128.65 ||
nītā rasātalaṃ tena suvarṇā lokaviśrutā  |
jāmātāgneḥ sa dharmaśca agniścaiva sa havyavāṭ || 128.66 ||
viṣṇave lokanāthāya stutvā caiva punaḥ punaḥ  |
kāryavijñāpanaṃ cobhau cakratuḥ prabhaviṣṇave  || 128.67 ||
tataścakreṇa ciccheda śārdūlasya śiro hariḥ  |
sānītā viṣṇunā devī suvarṇā lokasundarī  || 128.68 ||
maheśvarasutā caiva agneścaiva tathā priyā  |
maheśvarāya tāṃ viṣṇurdarśayāmāsa nārada  || 128.69 ||
prīto'bhavanmaheśo'pi sasvaje tāṃ punaḥ punaḥ  |
cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ yatra śārdūlacchedi dīptimat || 128.70 ||
cakratīrthaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ śārdūlaṃ ceti tadviduḥ  |
yatra nītā suvarṇā sā viṣṇunā śaṃkarāntikam  || 128.71 ||
tattīrthaṃ śāṃkaraṃ jñeyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ siddhameva tu  |
yatrānandamanuprāpto hyagnirdharmaśca śāśvataḥ  || 128.72 ||
ānandāśrūṇi nyapatan yatrāgnermunisattama  |
ānandeti nadī jātā tathā vai nandinīti ca  || 128.73 ||
tasyāśca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgāyāṃ tatra vai śivaḥ  |
tatraiva saṃgame sākṣātsuvarṇādyāpi saṃsthitā  || 128.74 ||
dākṣāyaṇī saiva śivā āgneyī ceti viśrutā  |
ambikā jagadādhārā śivā kātyāyanīśvarī  || 128.75 ||
bhaktābhīṣṭapradā nityamalaṃkṛtyobhayaṃ taṭam  |
tapastepe yatra cāgnistattīrthaṃ tu tapovanam  || 128.76 ||
evamādīni tīrthāni tīrayorubhayormune  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  || 128.77 ||
uttare caiva pāre ca sahasrāṇi caturdaśa  |
dakṣiṇe ca tathā pāre sahasrāṇyatha ṣoḍaśa  || 128.78 ||
tatra tatra ca tīrthāni sābhijñānāni santi vai  |
nāmāni ca pṛthaksanti saṃkṣepāttanmayocyate  || 128.79 ||
etāni yaśca śṛṇuyādyaśca vā paṭhati smaret |
sarveṣu tatra kāmyeṣu paripūrṇo bhavennaraḥ  || 128.80 ||
etadvṛttaṃ tu yo jñātvā tatra snānādikaṃ caret |
lakṣmīvāñjāyate nityaṃ dharmavāṃśca viśeṣataḥ  || 128.81 ||
abjakātpaścime tīrthaṃ tacchārdūlamudāhṛtam  |
vārāṇasyāditīrthebhyaḥ sarvebhyo hyadhikaṃ bhavet || 128.82 ||
tatra snātvā pitṝn devān vandate tarpayatyapi  |
sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate  || 128.83 ||
tapovanācca śārdūlānmadhye tīrthānyaśeṣataḥ  |
tasyaikaikasya māhātmyaṃ na kenāpyatra varṇyate  || 128.84 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
indratīrthamiti khyātaṃ tatraiva ca vṛṣākapam  |
phenāyāḥ saṃgamo yatra hanūmataṃ tathaiva ca  || 129.1 ||
abjakaṃ cāpi yatproktaṃ yatra devastrivikramaḥ  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca punarāvṛttidurlabham  || 129.2 ||
tatra vṛttānyathākhyāsye gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  |
indreśvaraṃ cottare ca śṛṇu bhaktyā yatavrataḥ  || 129.3 ||
namucirbalavānāsīdindraśatrurmadotkaṭaḥ  |
tasyendreṇābhavadyuddhaṃ phenenendro'haracchiraḥ  || 129.4 ||
apāṃ ca namuceḥ śatrostatphenavajrarūpadhṛk |
śiraśchittvā tacca phenaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 129.5 ||
nyapatadbhūmiṃ bhittvā tu rasātalamathāviśat |
rasātalabhavaṃ gāṅgaṃ vāri yadviśvapāvanam  || 129.6 ||
vajrādiṣṭena mārgeṇa vyagamadbhūmimaṇḍalam  |
tajjalaṃ phenanāmnā tu nadī pheneti gadyate  || 129.7 ||
tasyāstu saṃgamaḥ puṇyo gaṅgayā lokaviśrutaḥ  |
sarvapāpakṣayakaro gaṅgāyamunayoriva  || 129.8 ||
hanūmadupamātā vai yatrāplavanamātrataḥ  |
mārjāratvādabhūnmuktā viṣṇugaṅgāprasādataḥ  || 129.9 ||
mārjāraṃ ceti tattīrthaṃ purā proktaṃ mayā tava  |
hanūmataṃ ca tatproktaṃ tatrākhyānaṃ puroditam  || 129.10 ||
vṛṣākapaṃ cābjakaṃ ca tatredaṃ prayataḥ śṛṇu  |
hiraṇya iti vikhyāto daityānāṃ pūrvajo balī  || 129.11 ||
tapastaptvā suraiḥ sarvairajeyo'bhūtsudāruṇaḥ  |
tasyāpi balavān putro devānāṃ durjayaḥ sadā  || 129.12 ||
mahāśaniriti khyātastasya bhāryā parājitā  |
tenendrasyābhavadyuddhaṃ bahukālaṃ nirantaram  || 129.13 ||
mahāśanirmahāvīryaḥ satataṃ raṇamūrdhani  |
jitvā nāgena sahitaṃ śakraṃ pitre nyavedayat || 129.14 ||
baddhvā hastisamāyuktaṃ svasāraṃ vīkṣya tāṃ tadā  |
vihāya krūratāṃ daityo hiraṇyāya nyavedayat || 129.15 ||
mahāśanipitā daityaḥ pūrveṣāṃ pūrvavattaraḥ  |
śacīkāntaṃ tale sthāpya tasya rakṣāmathākarot || 129.16 ||
mahāśanirhariṃ jitvā jetuṃ varuṇamabhyagāt |
varuṇo'pi mahābuddhiḥ prādātkanyāṃ mahāśaneḥ  || 129.17 ||
udadhiṃ svālayaṃ prādādvaruṇastu mahāśaneḥ  |
tayośca sakhyamabhavadvaruṇasya mahāśaneḥ  || 129.18 ||
vāruṇī cāpi yā kanyā sā priyābhūnmahāśaneḥ  |
vīryeṇa yaśasā cāpi śauryeṇa ca balena ca  || 129.19 ||
mahāśanirmahādaityastrailokye nopamīyate  |
nirindratvaṃ gate loke devāḥ sarve nyamantrayan  || 129.20 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
viṣṇurevendradātā syāddaityahantā sa eva ca  |
mantradṛgvā sa eva syādindraṃ cānyaṃ kariṣyati  || 129.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ saṃmantrya te devā viṣṇormantraṃ nyavedayan  |
mamāvadhyo mahādaityo mahāśaniriti bruvan  || 129.22 ||
prāyādvārīśvaraṃ viṣṇuḥ śvaśuraṃ varuṇaṃ tadā  |
keśavo varuṇaṃ gatvā prāhendrasya parābhavam  || 129.23 ||
tathā tvayaitatkartavyaṃ yathāyāti puraṃdaraḥ  |
tadviṣṇuvacanācchīghraṃ yayau jalapatirmune  || 129.24 ||
sutāpatiṃ hiraṇyasutaṃ vikrāntaṃ taṃ mahāśanim  |
atisaṃmānitastena jāmātrā varuṇaḥ prabhuḥ  || 129.25 ||
papracchāgamanaṃ daityo vinayācchvaśuraṃ tadā  |
varuṇaḥ prāha taṃ daityaṃ yadāgamanakāraṇam  || 129.26 ||
{varuṇa uvāca̱ }
indraṃ dehi mahābāho yastvayā nirjitaḥ purā  |
baddhaṃ rasātalasthaṃ taṃ devānāmadhipaṃ sakhe  || 129.27 ||
asmākaṃ sarvadā mānyaṃ dehi tvaṃ mama śatruhan  |
baddhvā vimokṣaṇaṃ śatrormahate yaśase satām  || 129.28 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā kathaṃcitsa daityeśo varuṇāya tam  |
prādādindraṃ śacīkāntaṃ vāraṇena samanvitam  || 129.29 ||
sa daityamadhye'tivirājamāno  129.30
hariṃ tadovāca jaleśasaṃnidhau  129.30
saṃpūjya caivātha mahopacārair 129.30
mahāśanirmaghavantaṃ babhāṣe  129.30
{mahāśaniruvāca̱ }
kena tvamindro'dya kṛto'si kena  129.31
vīryaṃ tavedṛgbahu bhāṣase ca  129.31
tvaṃ saṃgare śatrubhirbādhyase ca  129.31
tathāpi cendro bhavasīti citram  129.31
athāpi baddhā puruṣeṇa kācit 129.32
tasyāḥ patistāṃ mocayatīti yuktam  129.32
striyo'svatantrāḥ puruṣapradhānās 129.32
tvaṃ vai pumān bhavitā śakra sādho  129.32
baddho mayā saṃgare vāhanena  129.33
kvāpyastraṃ te vajramuddāmaśakti  129.33
cintāratnaṃ nandanaṃ yoṣitastā  129.33
yaśo balaṃ devarājopabhogyam  129.33
sarvaṃ hi tvā kiṃ tu mukto jaleśād 129.33
ākāṅkṣase jīvitaṃ dhiktavedam  129.33
tajjīvanaṃ yattu yaśonidhānaṃ  129.34
sa eva mṛtyuryaśaso yadvirodhi  129.34
evaṃ jānañśakra kathaṃ jaleśān  129.34
muktiṃ prāpto naiva lajjāṃ bhajethāḥ  129.34
triviṣṭapasthaḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ san  129.35
sarvaiḥ suraiḥ kāntayā vījyamānaḥ  129.35
saṃstūyamānaśca tathāpsarobhir 129.35
nūnaṃ lajjā te bibhetīti manye  129.35
tvaṃ vṛtrahā namuceścāpi hantā  129.36
purāṃ bhettā gotrabhidvajrabāhuḥ  129.36
evaṃ surāstvāṃ paripūjayantīty 129.36
ato jiṣṇo sarvametattyajasva  129.36
vikāramāpyāpyahitodbhavaṃ ye  129.37
jīvanti lokānanusaṃviśanti  129.37
bhavādṛśāṃ duścyavanābjajanmā  129.37
kathaṃ na hṛdbhedamavāpa kartā  129.37
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tu daityeśo varuṇāya mahātmane  |
prādādindraṃ punaścedaṃ vacanaṃ tadabhāṣata  || 129.38 ||
{mahāśaniruvāca̱ }
adya prabhṛtyasau śiṣya indraḥ syādvaruṇo guruḥ  |
śvaśuro mama yena tvaṃ muktimāpto'si vāsava  || 129.39 ||
tathā tvaṃ bhṛtyabhāvena vartethā varuṇaṃ prati  |
no cedbaddhvā punastvāṃ vai kṣepsye caiva rasātalam  || 129.40 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ nirbhartsya taṃ śakraṃ hasaṃścāpi punaḥ punaḥ  |
abravīdgaccha gaccheti varuṇaṃ cānumanya tu  || 129.41 ||
sa tu prāptaḥ svanilayaṃ lajjayā kaluṣīkṛtaḥ  |
paulomyāṃ prāha tatsarvaṃ yattacchatruparābhavam  || 129.42 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
evamuktaḥ kṛtaścaiva śatruṇāhaṃ varānane  |
nirvāpayāmi yena svamātmānaṃ subhage vada  || 129.43 ||
{indrāṇyuvāca̱ }
dānavānāmathodbhūtiṃ śakra māyāṃ parābhavam  |
varadānaṃ tathā mṛtyuṃ jāne'haṃ balasūdana  || 129.44 ||
tasmādyasmāttasya mṛtyurathavāpi parābhavaḥ  |
jāyeta śṛṇu tatsarvaṃ vakṣye'haṃ prītaye tava  || 129.45 ||
hiraṇyasya suto vīraḥ pitṛvyasya suto balī  |
tasmānmama syātsa bhrātā varadānācca darpitaḥ  || 129.46 ||
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa tapasā niyamena ca  |
īdṛśaṃ balamāpannaṃ tapasā kiṃ na sidhyati  || 129.47 ||
tasmāttvayā cittarāgo vismayo vā kathaṃcana  |
na kāryaḥ śṛṇu tatredaṃ kāryaṃ yattu kramāgatam  || 129.48 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tu paulomī prāhendraṃ vinayānvitā  ||* 129.49 ||
{indrāṇyuvāca̱ }
nāsādhyamasti tapaso nāsādhyaṃ yajñakarmaṇaḥ  |
nāsādhyaṃ lokanāthasya viṣṇorbhaktyā harasya ca  || 129.50 ||
punaścedaṃ mayā kānta śrutamastyatiśobhanam  |
strīṇāṃ svabhāvaṃ jānanti striya eva surādhipa  || 129.51 ||
tasmādbhūmestathā cāpāṃ nāsādhyaṃ vidyate prabho  |
tapo vā yajñakarmādi tābhyāmeva yato bhavet || 129.52 ||
tatrāpi tīrthabhūtā tu yā bhūmistāṃ vrajedbhavān  |
tatra viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ pūjya sarvān kāmānavāpsyasi  || 129.53 ||
śrutamasti punaścedaṃ striyo yāśca pativratāḥ  |
tā eva sarvaṃ jānanti dhṛtaṃ tābhiścarācaram  || 129.54 ||
pṛthivyāṃ sārabhūtaṃ syāttanmadhye daṇḍakaṃ vanam  |
tatra gaṅgā jagaddhātrī tatreśaṃ pūjaya prabho  || 129.55 ||
viṣṇuṃ vā jagatāmīśaṃ dīnārtārtiharaṃ vibhum  |
anāthānāmiha nṛṇāṃ majjatāṃ duḥkhasāgare  || 129.56 ||
haro harirvā gaṅgā vā kvāpyanyaccharaṇaṃ nahi  |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena toṣayaitān samāhitaḥ  || 129.57 ||
bhaktyā stotraiśca tapasā kuru caiva mayā saha  |
tataḥ prāpsyasi kalyāṇamīśaviṣṇuprasādajam  || 129.58 ||
ajñātvaikaguṇaṃ karma phalaṃ dāsyati karmiṇaḥ  |
jñātvā śataguṇaṃ tatsyādbhāryayā ca tadakṣayam  || 129.59 ||
puṃsaḥ sarveṣu kāryeṣu bhāryaiveha sahāyinī  |
svalpānāmapi kāryāṇāṃ nahi siddhistayā vinā  || 129.60 ||
ekena yatkṛtaṃ karma tasmādardhaphalaṃ bhavet |
jāyayā tu kṛtaṃ nātha puṣkalaṃ puruṣo labhet || 129.61 ||
tasmādetatsuviditamardho jāyā iti śruteḥ  |
śrūyate daṇḍakāraṇye saricchreṣṭhāsti gautamī  || 129.62 ||
aśeṣāghapraśamanī sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinī  |
tasmādgaccha mayā tatra kuru puṇyaṃ mahāphalam  || 129.63 ||
tataḥ śatrūnnihatyājau mahatsukhamavāpsyasi  ||* 129.64 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā sa guruṇā bhāryayā ca śatakratuḥ  |
yayau gaṅgāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ gautamīṃ ceti viśrutām  || 129.65 ||
daṇḍakāraṇyamadhyasthāṃ yayau sa prītimān hariḥ  |
tapaḥ kartuṃ manaścakre devadevāya śaṃbhave  || 129.66 ||
gaṅgāṃ natvā tu prathamaṃ snātvā ca sa kṛtāñjaliḥ  |
śivaikaśaraṇo bhūtvā stotraṃ cedaṃ tato'bravīt || 129.67 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
svamāyayā yo hyakhilaṃ carācaraṃ  129.68
sṛjatyavatyatti na sajjate'smin  129.68
ekaḥ svatantro'dvayacitsukhātmakaḥ  129.68
sa naḥ prasanno'stu pinākapāṇiḥ  129.68
na yasya tattvaṃ sanakādayo'pi  129.69
jānanti vedāntarahasyavijñāḥ  129.69
sa pārvatīśaḥ sakalābhilāṣa  129.69
dātā prasanno'stu mamāndhakāriḥ  129.69
sṛṣṭvā svayaṃbhūrbhagavān viriñciṃ  129.70
bhayaṃkaraṃ cāsya śiro'nvapaśyat 129.70
chittvā nakhāgrairnakhasaktametac 129.70
cikṣepa tasmādabhavattrivargaḥ  129.70
pāpaṃ daridraṃ tvatha lobhayācñe  129.71
moho vipacceti tato'pyanantam  129.71
jātaprabhāvaṃ bhavaduḥkharūpaṃ  129.71
babhūva tairvyāptamidaṃ samastam  129.71
avekṣya sarvaṃ cakitaḥ sureśo  129.72
devīmavocajjagadastameti  129.72
tvaṃ pāhi lokeśvari lokamātar 129.72
ume śaraṇye subhage subhadre  129.72
jagatpratiṣṭhe varade jaya tvaṃ  129.73
bhuktiḥ samādhiḥ paramā ca muktiḥ  129.73
svāhā svadhā svastiranādisiddhir 129.73
gīrbuddhirāsīrajarāmare tvam  129.73
vidyādirūpeṇa jagattraye tvaṃ  129.74
rakṣāṃ karoṣyeva madājñayā ca  129.74
tvayaiva sṛṣṭaṃ bhuvanatrayaṃ syād 129.74
yataḥ prakṛtyaiva tathaiva citram  129.74
ityevamuktā dayitā hareṇa  129.75
saṃśleṣasaṃlāpaparā babhūva  129.75
śrāntā bhavasyārdhatanau sulagnā  129.75
cikṣepa ca svedajalaṃ karāgraiḥ  129.75
tasmādbabhūva prathamaṃ sa dharmo  129.76
lakṣmīratho dānamatho suvṛṣṭiḥ  129.76
sattvaṃ susaṃpannadharaṃ sarāṃsi  129.76
dhānyāni puṣpāṇi phalāni caiva  129.76
saubhāgyavastūni vapuḥ suveṣaḥ  129.77
śṛṅgārabhājīni mahauṣadhāni  129.77
nṛtyāni gītānyamṛtaṃ purāṇaṃ  129.77
śrutismṛtī nītirathānnapāne  129.77
śastrāṇi śāstrāṇi gṛhopayogyāny 129.78
astrāṇi tīrthāni ca kānanāni  129.78
iṣṭāni pūrtāni ca maṅgalāni  129.78
yānāni śubhrābharaṇāsanāni  129.78
bhavāṅgasaṃsargasusaṃprahāsa  129.79
susvedasaṃlāparahaḥprakāraiḥ  129.79
tathaiva jātaṃ sacarācaraṃ ca  129.79
apāpakaṃ devi tataśca jātam  129.79
sukhaṃ prabhūtaṃ ca śubhaṃ ca nityaṃ  129.80
virāji caitattava devi bhāvāt 129.80
tasmāttu māṃ rakṣa jagajjanitri  129.80
bhītaṃ bhayebhyo jagatāṃ pradhāne  129.80
eke tarkairvimuhyanti līyante tatra cāpare  |
śivaśaktyostadādvaitaṃ sundaraṃ naumi vigraham  || 129.81 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ tu stuvatastasya purastādabhavacchivaḥ  ||* 129.82 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
kimabhīṣṭaṃ varayase hare vada parāyaṇam  ||* 129.83 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
balavānme ripuścāsīddarśanaiśca śaniryathā  |
tena baddhastalaṃ nītaḥ paribhūtastvanekadhā  || 129.84 ||
vāksāyakaistathā viddhastadvadhāya tviyaṃ kṛtiḥ  |
tadarthaṃ jagatāmīśa yena jeṣye ripuṃ prabho  || 129.85 ||
tadeva dehi vīryaṃ me yaccānyadripunāśanam  |
jātaḥ parābhavo yasmāttadvināśe kṛte sati  |
punarjātamahaṃ manye varaṃ kīrtirjayaśriyoḥ  || 129.86 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa śivaḥ śakramāhedaṃ na mayaikena te ripuḥ  |
vadhamāpnoti tasmāttvaṃ viṣṇumapyavyayaṃ harim  || 129.87 ||
ārādhayasva paulomyā saha devaṃ janārdanam  |
lokatrayaikaśaraṇaṃ nārāyaṇamananyadhīḥ  || 129.88 ||
tataḥ prāpsyasi tasmācca mattaścāpi priyaṃ hare  |
punaścovāca bhagavānādikartā maheśvaraḥ  || 129.89 ||
mantrābhyāsastapo vāpi yogābhyasanameva ca  |
saṃgame yatra kutrāpi siddhidaṃ munayo viduḥ  || 129.90 ||
kiṃ punaḥ saṃgame vipra gautamīsindhuphenayoḥ  |
girīṇāṃ gahvare yadvā saritāmatha saṃgame  || 129.91 ||
vipro dhiyaiva bhavati mukundāṅghriniviṣṭayā  |
gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe tīra āpastambo munīśvaraḥ  || 129.92 ||
āste tasyāpyahaṃ toṣamagamaṃ balasūdana  |
tena tvaṃ bhāryayā caiva toṣayasva gadādharam  || 129.93 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
āpastambena sahito gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  |
tuṣṭāva devaṃ prayataḥ snātvā puṇye'tha saṃgame  || 129.94 ||
phenāyāścaiva gaṅgāyāstatra devaṃ janārdanam  |
vaidikairvividhairmantraistapasātoṣayattadā  || 129.95 ||
tatastuṣṭo'bhavadviṣṇuḥ kiṃ deyaṃ cetyabhāṣata  |
dehi me śatruhantāramityāha bhagavān hariḥ  || 129.96 ||
dattamityeva jānīhi tamuvāca janārdanaḥ  |
tatrābhavacchivasyaiva gaṅgāviṣṇvoḥ prasādataḥ  || 129.97 ||
ambhasā puruṣo jātaḥ śivaviṣṇusvarūpadhṛk |
cakrapāṇiḥ śūladharaḥ sa gatvā tu rasātalam  || 129.98 ||
nijaghāna tadā daityamindraśatruṃ mahāśanim  |
sakhābhavatsa cendrasya abjakaḥ sa vṛṣākapiḥ  || 129.99 ||
divistho'pi sadā cendrastamanveti vṛṣākapim  |
kupitā praṇayenābhūdanyāsaktaṃ vilokya tam  |
śacīṃ tāṃ sāntvayannāha śatamanyurhasannidam  || 129.100 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
nāhamindrāṇi śaraṇamṛte sakhyurvṛṣākapeḥ  |
vāri vāpi haviryasya agneḥ priyakaraṃ sadā  || 129.101 ||
nāhamanyatra gantāsmi priye cāṅgena te śape  |
tasmānnārhasi māṃ vaktuṃ śaṅkayānyatra bhāmini  || 129.102 ||
pativratā priyā me tvaṃ dharme mantre sahāyinī  |
sāpatyā ca kulīnā ca tvatto'nyā kā priyā mama  || 129.103 ||
tasmāttavopadeśena gaṅgāṃ prāpya mahānadīm  |
prasādāddevadevasya viṣṇorvai cakrapāṇinaḥ  || 129.104 ||
tathā śivasya devasya prasādācca vṛṣākapeḥ  |
jalodbhavācca me mitrādabjakāllokaviśrutāt || 129.105 ||
uttīrṇaduḥkhaḥ subhage ita indro'hamacyutaḥ  |
kiṃ na sādhyaṃ yatra bhāryā bhartṛcittānugāminī  || 129.106 ||
duṣkarā tatra no muktiḥ kiṃtvarthāditrayaṃ śubhe  |
jāyaiva paramaṃ mitraṃ lokadvayahitaiṣiṇī  || 129.107 ||
sā cetkulīnā priyabhāṣiṇī ca  129.108
pativratā rūpavatī guṇāḍhyā  129.108
saṃpatsu cāpatsu samānarūpā  129.108
tayā hyasādhyaṃ kimiha trilokyām  129.108
tasmāttava dhiyā kānte mamedaṃ śubhamāgatam  |
itastavoditaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ nānyadasti me  || 129.109 ||
paraloke ca dharme ca satputrasadṛśaṃ na ca  |
ārtasya puruṣasyeha bhāryāvadbheṣajaṃ nahi  || 129.110 ||
niḥśreyasapadaprāptyai tathā pāpasya muktaye  |
gaṅgayā sadṛśaṃ nāsti śṛṇu cānyadvarānane  || 129.111 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prāptaye pāpamuktaye  |
śivaviṣṇvorananyatva jñānānnāstyatra muktaye  || 129.112 ||
tasmāttava dhiyā sādhvi sarvametanmanogatam  |
avāptaṃ ca śivādviṣṇorgaṅgāyāśca prasādataḥ  || 129.113 ||
indratvaṃ me sthiraṃ ceto manye mitrabalātpunaḥ  |
vṛṣākapirmama sakhā yo jātastvapsu bhāmini  || 129.114 ||
tvaṃ ca priyasakhī nityaṃ nānyatpriyataraṃ mama  |
tīrthānāṃ gautamī gaṅgā devānāṃ hariśaṃkarau  || 129.115 ||
tasmādebhyaḥ prasādena sarvaṃ cepsitamāptavān  |
mama prītikaraṃ cedaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  || 129.116 ||
tasmādetaddhi yāciṣye devān sarvānanukramāt |
anumanyantu ṛṣayo gaṅgā ca hariśaṃkarau  || 129.117 ||
indreśvare cābjake ca ubhayostīrayoḥ surāḥ  |
ekatra śaṃkaro devo hyaparatra janārdanaḥ  || 129.118 ||
pāvayan daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ sākṣādviṣṇustrivikramaḥ  |
antare yāni tīrthāni sarvapuṇyapradāni ca  || 129.119 ||
atra tu snānamātreṇa sarve te muktimāpnuyuḥ  |
pāpiṣṭhāḥ pāpato muktimāpnuyurye ca dharmiṇaḥ  || 129.120 ||
teṣāṃ tu paramā muktiḥ pitṛbhiḥ pañcapañcabhiḥ  |
atra kiṃcicca ye dadyurarthibhyastilamātrakam  || 129.121 ||
dātṛbhyo hyakṣayaṃ tatsyātkāmadaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā  |
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamārogyaṃ puṇyavardhanam  || 129.122 ||
ākhyānaṃ viṣṇuśaṃbhvośca jñātvā snānācca muktidam  |
asya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti paṭhanti ca  || 129.123 ||
puṇyabhājo bhaveyuste tebhyo'traiva smṛtirbhavet |
śivaviṣṇvoraśeṣāgha saṃghavicchedakāriṇī  |
yāṃ prārthayanti munayo vijitendriyamānasāḥ  || 129.124 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhaviṣyatyevameveti taṃ devā ṛṣayo'bruvan  |
gautamyā uttare pāre tīrthānāṃ mokṣadāyinām  || 129.125 ||
devarṣisiddhasevyānāṃ sahasrāṇyatha sapta vai  |
tathaiva dakṣiṇe tīre tīrthānyekādaśaiva tu  || 129.126 ||
abjakaṃ hṛdayaṃ proktaṃ godāvaryā munīśvaraiḥ  |
viśrāmasthānamīśasya viṣṇorbrahmaṇa eva ca  || 129.127 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
āpastambamiti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  |
smaraṇādapyaśeṣāgha saṃghavidhvaṃsanakṣamam  || 130.1 ||
āpastambo mahāprājño munirāsīnmahāyaśāḥ  |
tasya bhāryākṣasūtreti patidharmaparāyaṇā  || 130.2 ||
tasya putro mahāprājñaḥ karkināmātha tattvavit |
tasyāśramamanuprāpto hyagastyo munisattamaḥ  || 130.3 ||
tamagastyaṃ pūjayitvā āpastambo munīśvaraḥ  |
śiṣyairanugato dhīmāṃstaṃ praṣṭumupacakrame  || 130.4 ||
{āpastamba uvāca̱ }
trayāṇāṃ ko nu pūjyaḥ syāddevānāṃ munisattama  |
bhuktirmuktiśca kasmādvā syādanādiśca ko bhavet || 130.5 ||
anantaścāpi ko vipra devānāmapi daivatam  |
yajñaiḥ ka ijyate devaḥ ko vedeṣvanugīyate  |
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chettuṃ vadāgastya mahāmune  || 130.6 ||
{agastya uvāca̱ }
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ pramāṇaṃ śabda ucyate  |
tatrāpi vaidikaḥ śabdaḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ mataḥ  || 130.7 ||
vedena gīyate yastu puruṣaḥ sa parātparaḥ  |
mṛto'paraḥ sa vijñeyo hyamṛtaḥ para ucyate  || 130.8 ||
yo'mūrtaḥ sa paro jñeyo hyaparo mūrta ucyate  |
guṇābhivyāptibhedena mūrto'sau trividho bhavet || 130.9 ||
brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivaśceti eka eva tridhocyate  |
trayāṇāmapi devānāṃ vedyamekaṃ paraṃ hi tat || 130.10 ||
ekasya bahudhā vyāptirguṇakarmavibhedataḥ  |
lokānāmupakārārthamākṛtitritayaṃ bhavet || 130.11 ||
yastattvaṃ vetti paramaṃ sa ca vidvānna cetaraḥ  |
tatra yo bhedamācaṣṭe liṅgabhedī sa ucyate  || 130.12 ||
prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti yaścaiṣāṃ vyāharedbhidam  |
trayāṇāmapi devānāṃ mūrtibhedaḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 130.13 ||
vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ sarvatra sākāreṣu pṛthakpṛthak |
nirākāraṃ ca yattvekaṃ tattebhyaḥ paramaṃ matam  || 130.14 ||
{āpastamba uvāca̱ }
nānena nirṇayaḥ kaścinmayātra vidito bhavet |
tatrāpyatra rahasyaṃ yattadvimṛśyāśu kīrtyatām  |
niḥsaṃśayaṃ nirvikalpaṃ bhājanaṃ sarvasaṃpadām  || 130.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etadākarṇya bhagavānagastyo vākyamabravīt ||* 130.16 ||
{agastya uvāca̱ }
yadyapyeṣāṃ na bhedo'sti devānāṃ tu parasparam  |
tathāpi sarvasiddhiḥ syācchivādeva sukhātmanaḥ  || 130.17 ||
prapañcasya nimittaṃ yattajjyotiśca paraṃ śivaḥ  |
tameva sādhaya haraṃ bhaktyā paramayā mune  |
gautamyāṃ sakalāghaugha saṃhartā daṇḍake vane  || 130.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā munervākyaṃ parāṃ prītimupāgataḥ  |
bhuktido muktidaḥ puṃsāṃ sākāro'tha nirākṛtiḥ  || 130.19 ||
sṛṣṭyākārastataḥ śaktaḥ pālanākāra eva ca  |
dātā ca hanti sarvaṃ yo yasmādetatsamāpyate  || 130.20 ||
{agastya uvāca̱ }
brahmākṛtiḥ kartṛrūpā vaiṣṇavī pālanī tathā  |
rudrākṛtirnihantrī sā sarvavedeṣu paṭhyate  || 130.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
āpastambastadā gaṅgāṃ gatvā snātvā yatavrataḥ  |
tuṣṭāva śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ stotreṇānena nārada  || 130.22 ||
{āpastamba uvāca̱ }
kāṣṭheṣu vahniḥ kusumeṣu gandho  130.23
bījeṣu vṛkṣādi dṛṣatsu hema  130.23
bhūteṣu sarveṣu tathāsti yo vai  130.23
taṃ somanāthaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi  130.23
yo līlayā viśvamidaṃ cakāra  130.24
dhātā vidhātā bhuvanatrayasya  130.24
yo viśvarūpaḥ sadasatparo yaḥ  130.24
someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi  130.24
yaṃ smṛtya dāridryamahābhiśāpa  130.25
rogādibhirna spṛśyate śarīrī  130.25
yamāśritāścepsitamāpnuvanti  130.25
someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi  130.25
yena trayīdharmamavekṣya pūrvaṃ  130.26
brahmādayastatra samīhitāśca  130.26
evaṃ dvidhā yena kṛtaṃ śarīraṃ  130.26
someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi  130.26
yasmai namo gacchati mantrapūtaṃ  130.27
hutaṃ haviryā ca kṛtā ca pūjā  130.27
dattaṃ haviryena surā bhajante  130.27
someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi  130.27
yasmātparaṃ nānyadasti praśastaṃ  130.28
yasmātparaṃ naiva susūkṣmamanyat 130.28
yasmātparaṃ no mahatāṃ mahacca  130.28
someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi  130.28
yasyājñayā viśvamidaṃ vicitram  130.29
acintyarūpaṃ vividhaṃ mahacca  130.29
ekakriyaṃ yadvadanuprayāti  130.29
someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi  130.29
yasmin vibhūtiḥ sakalādhipatyaṃ  130.30
kartṛtvadātṛtvamahattvameva  130.30
prītiryaśaḥ saukhyamanādidharmaḥ  130.30
someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi  130.30
nityaṃ śaraṇyaḥ sakalasya pūjyo  130.31
nityaṃ priyo yaḥ śaraṇāgatasya  130.31
nityaṃ śivo yaḥ sakalasya rūpaṃ   130.31
someśvaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi  130.31
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prasanno bhagavānāha nārada taṃ munim  |
ātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca āpastambo'bravīcchivam  || 130.32 ||
sarvān kāmānāpnuyuste ye snātvā devamīśvaram  |
paśyeyurjagatāmīśamastvityāha śivo munim  || 130.33 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamāpastambamudāhṛtam  |
anādyavidyātimira vrātanirmūlanakṣamam  || 130.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yamatīrthamiti khyātaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanam  |
aśeṣapāpaśamanaṃ tatra vṛttamidaṃ śṛṇu  || 131.1 ||
tatrākhyānamidaṃ tvāsīditihāsaṃ purātanam  |
sarameti prasiddhāsti nāmnā devaśunī mune  || 131.2 ||
tasyāḥ putrau mahāśreṣṭhau śvānau nityaṃ janānanu  |
gāminau pavanāhārau caturakṣau yamapriyau  || 131.3 ||
gā rakṣati sma devānāṃ yajñārthaṃ kalpitān paśūn  |
rakṣantīmanujagmuste rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ  || 131.4 ||
rakṣantīṃ tāṃ mahāprājñāḥ śvānayormātaraṃ śunīm  |
pralobhayitvā vividhairvākyairdānaiśca yatnataḥ  || 131.5 ||
hṛtā gā rākṣasaiḥ pāpaiḥ paśvarthe kalpitāḥ śubhāḥ  |
tata āgatya sā devānidamāha kramācchunī  || 131.6 ||
{saramovāca̱ }
māṃ baddhvā rākṣasaiḥ pāśaistāḍayitvā prahārakaiḥ  |
nītā gā yajñasiddhyarthaṃ kalpitāḥ paśavaḥ surāḥ  || 131.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasyā vācaṃ niśamyāśu surān prāha bṛhaspatiḥ  ||* 131.8 ||
{bṛhaspatiruvāca̱ }
iyaṃ vikṛtarūpāste asyāḥ pāpaṃ ca lakṣaye  |
asyā matena tā gāvo nītā nānyena hetunā  |
pāpeyaṃ sukṛtīveti lakṣyate dehaceṣṭitaiḥ  || 131.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadgurorvacanācchakraḥ padā tāṃ prāharacchunīm  |
padāghātāttadā tasyā mukhātkṣīraṃ prasusruve  || 131.10 ||
punaḥ prāha śacībhartā kṣīraṃ pītaṃ tvayā śuni  |
rākṣasaiśca tadā dattaṃ tasmānnītāstu gā mama  || 131.11 ||
{saramovāca̱ }
nāparādho'sti me nātha na cānyasyāpi kasyacit |
nāparādho na copekṣā mamāsti tridaśeśvara  |
tasmādruṣṭo'si kiṃ nātha ripavo balinastu te  || 131.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato dhyātvā devagururjñātvā tasyā viceṣṭitam  |
satyaṃ śakra tviyaṃ duṣṭā ripūṇāṃ pakṣakāriṇī  || 131.13 ||
tataḥ śaśāpa tāṃ śakraḥ pāpiṣṭhe tvaṃ śunī bhava  |
martyaloke pāpabhūtā ajñānātpāpakāriṇī  || 131.14 ||
tadendrasya tu śāpena mānuṣe sā vyajāyata  |
yathā śaptā maghavatā pāpātsā hyatibhīṣaṇā  || 131.15 ||
gāvo yā rākṣasairnītāstāsāmānayanāya ca  |
yatnaṃ kurvan surapatirviṣṇave tannyavedayat || 131.16 ||
viṣṇurdaityāṃśca danujān gohartṝṃścaiva rākṣasān  |
hantuṃ prayatnamakarojjagṛhe ca mahaddhanuḥ  || 131.17 ||
śārṅgaṃ yallokavikhyātaṃ daityanāśanameva ca  |
jitāriḥ pūjito devaiḥ svayaṃ sthitvā janārdanaḥ  || 131.18 ||
yatra vai daṇḍakāraṇye śārṅgapāṇirjagatprabhuḥ  |
tatrasthān daityadanujān rākṣasāṃśca balīyasaḥ  || 131.19 ||
punarjaghne sa vai viṣṇurgā yairnītāśca rākṣasaiḥ  |
tatra vai daṇḍakāraṇye śārṅgapāṇiriti śrutaḥ  || 131.20 ||
yudhyamānastato viṣṇurditijai rākṣasaiḥ saha  |
te jagmurdakṣiṇāmāśāṃ viṣṇostrāsānmahāmune  || 131.21 ||
anvagacchattato viṣṇustāneva parameśvaraḥ  |
garutmatā tānavāpya śārṅgamuktairmanojavaiḥ  || 131.22 ||
bāṇaistān vyāhanadviṣṇurgaṅgāyā uttare taṭe  |
devārayaḥ kṣayaṃ nītā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā  || 131.23 ||
śārṅgamuktairmahāvegaiḥ susvanaiśca sumantritaiḥ  |
kṣayaṃ prāptā viṣṇubāṇaistataste devaśatravaḥ  || 131.24 ||
gāvo labdhā yatra devairbāṇatīrthaṃ taducyate  |
vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaviditaṃ gotīrthaṃ ceti viśrutam  || 131.25 ||
paśvarthe kalpitā gāvo gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  |
pradrutāste surāḥ sarve gaṅgāyāṃ saṃnyaveśayan  || 131.26 ||
tanmadhye kārayāmāsurdvīpaṃ caivāśrayaṃ gavām  |
tairgobhistatra gaṅgāyāṃ surayajño vyajāyata  || 131.27 ||
yajñatīrthaṃ tu tatproktaṃ godvīpaṃ gāṅgamadhyataḥ  |
devānāṃ yajanaṃ tacca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  || 131.28 ||
svayaṃ mūrtimatī bhūtvā gaṅgāśaktirmahādyute  |
asārāpārasaṃsāra sāgarottaraṇe tariḥ  || 131.29 ||
viśveśvarī yogamāyā sadbhaktābhayadāyinī  |
gorakṣaṃ tu tatastīrthaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 131.30 ||
tau śvānau saramāputrau caturakṣau yamapriyau  |
mātuḥ śāpaṃ cāparādhaṃ sarvaṃ cāpi savistaram  || 131.31 ||
nivedya tu yathānyāyaṃ kāryaṃ cāpi sukhapradam  |
viśāpakaraṇaṃ cāpi papracchaturubhau yamam  || 131.32 ||
sa tābhyāṃ sahitaḥ sauriḥ pitre sūryāya cābravīt |
śrutvā sūryaḥ sutaṃ prāha gaṅgāyāṃ surasattama  || 131.33 ||
lokatrayaikapāvanyāṃ gautamyāṃ daṇḍake vane  |
śraddhayā parayā vatsa susnātaḥ susamāhitaḥ  || 131.34 ||
brahmāṇaṃ caiva viṣṇuṃ ca māmīśaṃ ca yathākramam  |
stuhi tvaṃ sarvabhāvena bhṛtyau prītimavāpsyataḥ  || 131.35 ||
tatpiturvacanaṃ śrutvā yamaḥ prītamanāstadā  |
tayośca prītaye prāyāddevatarpaṇayoryamaḥ  || 131.36 ||
gautamyāmaghahāriṇyāṃ susamāhitamānasaḥ  |
tathaiva toṣayāmāsa gaṅgāyāṃ surasattamān  || 131.37 ||
śvabhyāṃ ca sahitaḥ śrīmān dakṣiṇāśāpatiḥ prabhuḥ  |
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa bhānuṃ vai dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 131.38 ||
īśānamuttare viṣṇuṃ svayaṃ dharmaḥ pratāpavān  |
dattavanto varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ saramāyā viśāpakam  |
varānayācata bahūṃllokānāmupakārakān  || 131.39 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
eṣu snānaṃ tu ye kuryurbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ  |
ātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca te kāmānāpnuyuḥ śubhān  || 131.40 ||
bāṇatīrthe tu ye snātvā śārṅgapāṇiṃ smaranti vai  |
tebhyo dāridryaduḥkhāni na bhaveyuryuge yuge  || 131.41 ||
gotīrthe brahmatīrthe vā yastu snātvā yatavrataḥ  |
brahmāṇaṃ taṃ namasyātha dvīpasyāpi pradakṣiṇam  || 131.42 ||
yaḥ kuryāttena pṛthivī saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā  |
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tatra kiṃciddattvā vasu dvijam  || 131.43 ||
taddevayajanaṃ prāpya kiṃciddhutvā hutāśane  |
aśvamedhādiyajñānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam  || 131.44 ||
yaḥ sakṛttatra paṭhati gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram  |
adhītāstena vedā vai niṣkāmo muktibhājanam  || 131.45 ||
snātvā tu dakṣiṇe kūle śaktiṃ devīṃ tu bhaktitaḥ  |
pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 131.46 ||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ śaktirmātā trayīmayī  |
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti putravān dhanavān bhavet || 131.47 ||
ādityaṃ bhaktito yastu dakṣiṇe niyato naraḥ  |
snātvā paśyeta teneṣṭā yajñā vividhadakṣiṇāḥ  || 131.48 ||
kūle yaścottare caiva gaṅgāyā daityasūdanam  |
snātvā paśyeta taṃ natvā tasya viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam  || 131.49 ||
yameśvaraṃ tato yastu yamatīrthe tu pūjitam  |
snātaḥ paśyati yuktātmā sa karotyacireṇa hi  || 131.50 ||
pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ phaladaṃ kīrtivardhanam  |
tatra snānena dānena japena stavanena ca  |
api duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ pitaro mokṣamāpnuyuḥ  || 131.51 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityādyaṣṭa sahasrāṇi tīrthāni trīṇi nārada  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvamakṣayapuṇyadam  || 131.52 ||
eteṣāṃ smaraṇaṃ puṇyaṃ nānājanmāghanāśanam  |
śravaṇātpitṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ paṭhanātsvakulaiḥ saha  || 131.53 ||
teṣāmapyatipāpāni nāśaṃ yānti mamājñayā  |
tatra snānādi yaḥ kṛtvā kiṃciddattvā yatātmavān  || 131.54 ||
pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānādi kṛtvā natvā surānimān  |
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ yaśo vīryamāyurārogyasaṃpadaḥ  || 131.55 ||
putrān pautrān priyāṃ bhāryāṃ labdhvā cānyanmanīṣitam  |
aviyuktaḥ prītamanā bandhubhiścātimānitaḥ  || 131.56 ||
narakasthānapi pitṝṃstārayitvā kulāni ca  |
pāvayitvā priyairyukto hyante viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ smaret |
tato muktipadaṃ gaccheddevānāṃ vacanaṃ yathā  || 131.57 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yakṣiṇīsaṃgamaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ sarvaphalapradam  |
tatra snānena dānena sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 132.1 ||
yatra yakṣeśvaro devo darśanādbhuktimuktidaḥ  |
tatra ca snānamātreṇa sattrayāgaphalaṃ labhet || 132.2 ||
viśvāvasoḥ svasā nāmnā pippalā guruhāsinī  |
ṛṣīṇāṃ sattramagamadgautamītīravartinām  || 132.3 ||
dṛṣṭvā tatra ṛṣīn kṣāmān sā jahāsātigarvitā  |
yā gatvāśrāvaya vauṣaḍastu śrauṣaḍiti sthiram  || 132.4 ||
visvareṇa bruvatī tāṃ te śepuḥ srāviṇī bhava  |
tato nadyabhavattatra yakṣiṇīti suviśrutā  || 132.5 ||
tato viśvāvasuḥ pūjya ṛṣīn devaṃ trilocanam  |
saṃgamya caiva gautamyā tāṃ viśāpāmathākarot || 132.6 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ yakṣiṇīsaṃgamaṃ smṛtam  |
tatra snānādidānena sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt || 132.7 ||
viśvāvasoḥ prasanno'bhūdyatra śaṃbhuḥ śivānvitaḥ  |
śaivaṃ tatparamaṃ tīrthaṃ durgātīrthaṃ ca viśrutam  || 132.8 ||
sarvapāpaughaharaṇaṃ sarvadurgatināśanam  |
sarveṣāṃ tīrthamukhyānāṃ taddhi sāraṃ mahāmune  |
tīrthaṃ munivaraiḥ khyātaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṛṇām  || 132.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śuklatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām  |
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt || 133.1 ||
bharadvāja iti khyāto muniḥ paramadhārmikaḥ  |
tasya paiṭhīnasī nāma bhāryā sukalabhūṣaṇā  || 133.2 ||
gautamītīramadhyāste pativrataparāyaṇā  |
agnīṣomīyamaindrāgnaṃ puroḍāśamakalpayat || 133.3 ||
puroḍāśe śrapyamāṇe dhūmātkaścidajāyata  |
puroḍāśaṃ bhakṣayitvā lokatritayabhīṣaṇaḥ  || 133.4 ||
yajñaṃ me hyatra ko haṃsi kopāttvamiti taṃ muniḥ  |
provāca satvaraṃ kruddho bharadvājo dvijottamaḥ  |
tadṛṣervacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasaḥ pratyuvāca tam  || 133.5 ||
{rākṣasa uvāca̱ }
havyaghna iti vikhyātaṃ bharadvāja nibodha mām  |
saṃdhyāsuto'haṃ jyeṣṭhaśca sutaḥ prācīnabarhiṣaḥ  || 133.6 ||
brahmaṇā me varo datto yajñān khāda yathāsukham  |
mamānujaḥ kaliścāpi balavānatibhīṣaṇaḥ  || 133.7 ||
ahaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pitā kṛṣṇo mātā kṛṣṇā tathānujaḥ  |
ahaṃ makhaṃ haniṣyāmi yūpaṃ chedmi kṛtāntakaḥ  || 133.8 ||
{bharadvāja uvāca̱ }
rakṣyatāṃ me tvayā yajñaḥ priyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ  |
jāne tvāṃ yajñahantāraṃ saddvijaṃ rakṣa me kratum  || 133.9 ||
{yajñaghna uvāca̱ }
bharadvāja nibodhedaṃ vākyaṃ mama samāsataḥ  |
brahmaṇāhaṃ purā śapto devadānavasaṃnidhau  || 133.10 ||
tataḥ prasādito devo mayā lokapitāmahaḥ  |
amṛtaiḥ prokṣayiṣyanti yadā tvāṃ munisattamāḥ  || 133.11 ||
tadā viśāpo bhavitā havyaghna tvaṃ na cānyathā  |
evaṃ kariṣyasi yadā tataḥ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati  || 133.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bharadvājaḥ punaḥ prāha sakhā me'si mahāmate  |
makhasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ yena syānme vada karomi tat || 133.13 ||
saṃbhūya devā daiteyā mamanthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram  |
alabhantāmṛtaṃ kaṣṭāttadasmatsulabhaṃ katham  || 133.14 ||
prītyā yadi prasanno'si sulabhaṃ yadvadasva tat |
tadṛṣervacanaṃ śrutvā rakṣaḥ prāha tadā mudā  || 133.15 ||
{rakṣa uvāca̱ }
amṛtaṃ gautamīvāri amṛtaṃ svarṇamucyate  |
amṛtaṃ gobhavaṃ cājyamamṛtaṃ soma eva ca  || 133.16 ||
etairmāmabhiṣiñcasva athavaitaistathā tribhiḥ  |
gaṅgāyā vāriṇājyena hiraṇyena tathaiva ca  |
sarvebhyo'pyadhikaṃ divyamamṛtaṃ gautamījalam  || 133.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etadākarṇya sa ṛṣiḥ paraṃ saṃtoṣamāgataḥ  |
pāṇāvādāya gaṅgāyāḥ salilāmṛtamādarāt || 133.18 ||
tenākarodṛṣī rakṣo hyabhiṣiktaṃ tadā makhe  |
punaśca yūpe ca paśāvṛtvikṣu makhamaṇḍale  || 133.19 ||
sarvamevābhavacchuklamabhiṣekānmahātmanaḥ  |
tadrakṣo'pi tadā śuklo bhūtvotpanno mahābalaḥ  || 133.20 ||
yaḥ purā kṛṣṇarūpo'bhūtsa tu śuklo'bhavatkṣaṇāt |
yajñaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyātha bharadvājaḥ pratāpavān  || 133.21 ||
ṛtvijo'pi visṛjyātha yūpaṃ gaṅgodake'kṣipat |
gaṅgāmadhye taddhi yūpamadyāpyāste mahāmate  || 133.22 ||
abhiṣiktaṃ cāmṛtena abhijñānaṃ tu tanmahat |
tatra tīrthe punā rakṣo bharadvājamuvāca ha  || 133.23 ||
{rakṣa uvāca̱ }
ahaṃ yāmi bharadvāja kṛtaḥ śuklastvayā punaḥ  |
tasmāttavātra tīrthe ye snānadānādipūjanam  || 133.24 ||
kuryusteṣāmabhīṣṭāni bhaveyuryatphalaṃ makhe  |
smaraṇādapi pāpāni nāśaṃ yāntu sadā mune  || 133.25 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ śuklatīrthamiti smṛtam  |
gautamyāṃ daṇḍakāraṇye svargadvāramapāvṛtam  || 133.26 ||
ubhayostīrayoḥ sapta sahasrāṇyaparāṇi ca  |
tīrthānāṃ muniśārdūla sarvasiddhipradāyinām  || 133.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
cakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ smaraṇātpāpanāśanam  |
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada  || 134.1 ||
ṛṣayaḥ sapta vikhyātā vasiṣṭhapramukhā mune  |
gautamyāstīramāśritya sattrayajñamupāsate  || 134.2 ||
tatra vighna upakrānte rakṣobhiratibhīṣaṇe  |
māmabhyetyātha munayo rakṣaḥkṛtyaṃ nyavedayan  || 134.3 ||
tadāhaṃ pramadārūpaṃ māyayāsṛjya nārada  |
yasyāśca darśanādeva nāśaṃ yāntyatha rākṣasāḥ  || 134.4 ||
evamuktvā tu tāṃ prādāmṛṣibhyaḥ pramadāṃ mune  |
madvākyādṛṣayo māyāmādāya punarāgaman  || 134.5 ||
ajaikā yā samākhyātā kṛṣṇalohitarūpiṇī  |
muktakeśītyabhidhayā sāste'dyāpi svarūpiṇī  || 134.6 ||
lokatritayasaṃmoha dāyinī kāmarūpiṇī  |
tadbalātsvasthamanasaḥ sarve ca munipuṃgavaḥ  || 134.7 ||
gautamīṃ saritāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ punaryajñāya dīkṣitāḥ  |
punastanmakhanāśāya rākṣasāḥ samupāgaman  || 134.8 ||
yakṣavāṭāntike māyāṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasapuṃgavāḥ  |
tato nṛtyanti gāyanti hasanti ca rudanti ca  || 134.9 ||
māheśvarī mahāmāyā prabhāveṇātidarpitā  |
teṣāṃ madhye daityapatiḥ śambaro nāma vīryavān  || 134.10 ||
māyārūpāṃ tu pramadāṃ bhakṣayāmāsa nārada  |
tadadbhutamatīvāsīttanmāyābaladarśinām  || 134.11 ||
makhe vidhvaṃsyamāne tu te viṣṇuṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ  |
prādādviṣṇuścakramatho munīnāṃ rakṣaṇāya tu  || 134.12 ||
cakraṃ tadrākṣasānājau daityāṃśca danujāṃstathā  |
ciccheda tadbhayādeva mṛtā rākṣasapuṃgavāḥ  || 134.13 ||
ṛṣibhistanmahāsattraṃ saṃpūrṇamabhavattadā  |
viṣṇoḥ prakṣālitaṃ cakraṃ gaṅgāmbhobhiḥ sudarśanam  || 134.14 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ cakratīrthamudāhṛtam  |
tatra snānena dānena sattrayāgaphalaṃ labhet || 134.15 ||
tatra pañca śatānyāsaṃstīrthānāṃ pāpahāriṇām  |
teṣu snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ pratyekaṃ muktidāyakam  || 134.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vāṇīsaṃgamamākhyātaṃ yatra vāgīśvaro haraḥ  |
tattīrthaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ mocanaṃ sarvakāmadam  || 135.1 ||
tatra snānena dānena brahmahatyādināśanam  |
brahmaviṣṇvośca saṃvāde mahattve ca parasparam  || 135.2 ||
tayormadhye mahādevo jyotirmūrtirabhūtkila  |
tatraiva vāguvācedaṃ daivī putra tayoḥ śubhā  || 135.3 ||
ahamasmi mahāṃstatra ahamasmīti vai mithaḥ  |
daivī vāktāvubhau prāha yastvasyāntaṃ tu paśyati  || 135.4 ||
sa tu jyeṣṭho bhavettasmānmā vādaṃ kartumarhathaḥ  |
tadvākyādviṣṇuragamadadho'haṃ cordhvameva ca  || 135.5 ||
tato viṣṇuḥ śīghrametya jyotiḥpārśva upāviśat |
aprāpyāntamahaṃ prāyāṃ dūrāddūrataraṃ mune  || 135.6 ||
tataḥ śrānto nivṛtto'haṃ draṣṭumīśaṃ tu taṃ prabhum  |
tadaivaṃ mama dhīrāsīddṛṣṭaścānto mayā bhṛśam  || 135.7 ||
asya devasya tadviṣṇormama jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sphuṭaṃ bhavet |
punaścāpi mama tvevaṃ matirāsīnmahāmate  || 135.8 ||
satyairvaktraiḥ kathaṃ vakṣye pīḍito'pyanṛtaṃ vacaḥ  |
nānāvidheṣu pāpeṣu nānṛtātpātakaṃ param  || 135.9 ||
satyairvaktrairasatyāṃ vā vācaṃ vakṣye kathaṃ tviti  |
tato'haṃ pañcamaṃ vaktraṃ gardabhākṛtibhīṣaṇam  || 135.10 ||
kṛtvā tenānṛtaṃ vakṣya iti dhyātvā ciraṃ tadā  |
abravaṃ taṃ hariṃ tatra āsīnaṃ jagatāṃ prabhum  || 135.11 ||
asya cānto mayā dṛṣṭastena jyaiṣṭhyaṃ janārdana  |
mameti vadataḥ pārśve ubhau tau hariśaṃkarau  || 135.12 ||
ekarūpatvamāpannau sūryācandramasāviva  |
tau dṛṣṭvā vismito bhītaścāstavaṃ tāvubhāvapi  |
tataḥ kruddhau jagannāthau vācaṃ tāmidamūcatuḥ  || 135.13 ||
{hariharāvūcatu̱ḥ }
duṣṭe tvaṃ nimnagā bhūyā nānṛtādasti pātakam  ||* 135.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ sā vihvalā bhūtvā nadībhāvamupāgatā  |
taddṛṣṭvā vismito bhītastāmabravamahaṃ tadā  || 135.15 ||
yasmādasatyamuktāsi brahmavāci sthitā satī  |
tasmādadṛśyā tvaṃ bhūyāḥ pāparūpāsyasaṃśayam  || 135.16 ||
etacchāpaṃ viditvā tu tau devau praṇatā tadā  |
viśāpatvaṃ prārthayantī tuṣṭāva ca punaḥ punaḥ  || 135.17 ||
tatastuṣṭau devadevau prārthitau tridaśārcitau  |
prītyā hariharāvevaṃ vācaṃ vācamathocatuḥ  || 135.18 ||
{hariharāvūcatu̱ḥ }
gaṅgayā saṃgatā bhadre yadā tvaṃ lokapāvanī  |
tadā punarvapuste syātpavitraṃ hi suśobhane  || 135.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā sāpi devī gaṅgayā saṃgatābhavat |
bhāgīrathī gautamī ca tataścāpi svakaṃ vapuḥ  || 135.20 ||
devī sā vyagamadbrahman devānāmapi durlabham  |
gautamyāṃ saiva vikhyātā nāmnā vāṇīti puṇyadā  || 135.21 ||
bhāgīrathyāṃ saiva devī sarasvatyabhidhīyate  |
ubhayatrāpi vikhyātaḥ saṃgamo lokapūjitaḥ  || 135.22 ||
sarasvatīsaṃgamaśca vāṇīsaṃgama eva ca  |
gautamyā saṃgatā devī vāṇī vācā sarasvatī  || 135.23 ||
sarvatra pūjitaṃ tīrthaṃ tatra vācā śivaṃ prabhum  |
deveśvaraṃ pūjayitvā viśāpamagamadyataḥ  || 135.24 ||
brahmā vidhūya vāgdauṣṭyaṃ svaṃ ca dhāmāgamatpunaḥ  |
tasmāttatra śucirbhūtvā snātvā tatra ca saṃgame  || 135.25 ||
vāgīśvaraṃ tato dṛṣṭvā tāvatā muktimāpnuyāt |
dānahomādikaṃ kiṃcidupavāsādikāṃ kriyām  || 135.26 ||
yaḥ kuryātsaṃgame puṇye saṃsāre na bhavetpunaḥ  |
ekonaviṃśatiśataṃ tīrthānāṃ tīrayordvayoḥ  |
nānājanmārjitāśeṣa pāpakṣayavidhāyinām  || 135.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
viṣṇutīrthamiti khyātaṃ tatra vṛttamidaṃ śṛṇu  |
maudgalya iti vikhyāto mudgalasya suto ṛṣiḥ  || 136.1 ||
tasya bhāryā tu jābālā nāmnā khyātā suputriṇī  |
pitā ṛṣistathā vṛddho mudgalo lokaviśrutaḥ  || 136.2 ||
tasya bhāryā tathā khyātā nāmnā bhāgīrathī śubhā  |
sa maudgalyaḥ prātareva gaṅgāṃ snāti yatavrataḥ  || 136.3 ||
nityameva tvidaṃ karma tasyāsīnmunisattama  |
gaṅgātīre kuśairmṛdbhiḥ śamīpuṣpairaharniśam  || 136.4 ||
gurūditena mārgeṇa svamānasasaroruhe  |
āvāhanaṃ nityameva viṣṇoścakre sa maudgaliḥ  || 136.5 ||
tenāhūtastvaranneti lakṣmībhartā jagatpatiḥ  |
vainateyamathāruhya śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  || 136.6 ||
pūjitastena ṛṣiṇā sa maudgalyena yatnataḥ  |
prabrūte ca kathāścitrā maudgalyāya jagatprabhuḥ  || 136.7 ||
tato'parāhṇasamaye viṣṇuḥ prāha sa maudgalim  |
yāhi vatsa svabhavanaṃ śrānto'sīti punaḥ punaḥ  || 136.8 ||
evamuktaḥ sa devena viṣṇunā yāti sa dvijaḥ  |
jagatprabhustato yāti devairyuktaḥ svamandiram  || 136.9 ||
maudgalyo'pi tathābhyetya kiṃcidādāya nityaśaḥ  |
svameva bhavanaṃ vidvān bhāryāyai svārjitaṃ dhanam  || 136.10 ||
dadāti sa mahāviṣṇu caraṇābjaparāyaṇaḥ  |
maudgalyasya priyā sāpi pativrataparāyaṇā  || 136.11 ||
śākaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ vāpi bhartrānītaṃ tu yatnataḥ  |
susaṃskṛtyāpyatithīnāṃ bālānāṃ bhartureva ca  || 136.12 ||
dattvā tu bhojanaṃ tebhyaḥ paścādbhuṅkte yatavratā  |
bhuktavatsvatha sarveṣu rātrau nityaṃ sa maudgaliḥ  || 136.13 ||
viṣṇoḥ śrutāḥ kathāścitrāstebhyo vaktyatha harṣitaḥ  |
evaṃ bahutithe kāle vyatīte cātivismitā  |
maudgalyasya raho bhāryā bhartāraṃ vākyamabravīt || 136.14 ||
{jābālovāca̱ }
yadi te viṣṇurabhyeti samīpaṃ tridaśārcitaḥ  |
tathāpi kaṣṭamasmākaṃ kasmāditi jagatprabhum  || 136.15 ||
tatpṛccha tvaṃ mahāprājña yadāsau viṣṇureti ca  |
yasmiṃśca smṛtamātre tu jarājanmarujo mṛtiḥ  |
nāśaṃ yānti kuto dṛṣṭe tasmātpṛccha jagatpatim  || 136.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā priyāvākyānmaudgalyo nityavaddharim  |
pūjayitvā vinītaśca papraccha sa kṛtāñjaliḥ  || 136.17 ||
{maudgalya uvāca̱ }
tvayi smṛte jagannātha śokadāridryaduṣkṛtam  |
nāśaṃ yāti vipattirme tvayi dṛṣṭe kathaṃ sthitā  || 136.18 ||
{śrīviṣṇuruvāca̱ }
svakṛtaṃ bhujyate bhūtaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvatra sarvadā  |
na kopi kasyacitkiṃcitkarotyatra hitāhite  || 136.19 ||
yādṛśaṃ copyate bījaṃ phalaṃ bhavati tādṛśam  |
rasālaḥ syānna nimbasya bījājjātvapi kutracit || 136.20 ||
na kṛtā gautamīsevā nārcitau hariśaṃkarau  |
na dattaṃ yaiśca viprebhyaste kathaṃ bhājanaṃ śriyaḥ  || 136.21 ||
tvayā na dattaṃ kiṃcicca brāhmaṇebhyo mamāpi ca  |
yaddīyate tadeveha parasmiṃścopatiṣṭhati  || 136.22 ||
mṛdbhirvārbhiḥ kuśairmantraiḥ śucikarma sadaiva yat |
karoti tasmātpūtātmā śarīrasya ca śoṣaṇāt || 136.23 ||
vinā dānena na kvāpi bhogāvāptirnṛṇāṃ bhavet |
satkarmācaraṇācchuddho viraktaḥ syāttato naraḥ  || 136.24 ||
tato'pratihatajñāno jīvanmuktastato bhavet |
sarveṣāṃ sulabhā muktirmadbhaktyā ceha pūrtataḥ  || 136.25 ||
bhuktirdānādinā sarva bhūtaduḥkhanibarhaṇāt |
athavā lapsyase muktiṃ bhaktyā bhuktiṃ na lapsyase  || 136.26 ||
{maudgalya uvāca̱ }
bhaktyā muktiḥ kathaṃ bhūyādbhuktermuktiḥ sudurlabhā  |
jātā ceddehināṃ muktiḥ kimanyena prayojanam  || 136.27 ||
bhaktyā muktiḥ sarvapūjyā tāmiccheyaṃ jaganmaya  ||* 136.28 ||
{viṣṇuruvāca̱ }
etadevāntaraṃ brahman dīyate māmanusmaran  |
brāhmaṇāyāthavārthibhyastadevākṣayatāṃ vrajet || 136.29 ||
māmadhyātvātha yaddadyāttattanmātraphalapradam  |
tatpunardattameveha na bhogāyātra kalpate  || 136.30 ||
tasmāddehi mahābuddhe bhojyaṃ kiṃcinmama dhruvam  |
athavā vipramukhyāya gautamītīramāśritaḥ  || 136.31 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
maudgalyaḥ prāha taṃ viṣṇuṃ deyaṃ mama na vidyate  |
nānyatkiṃcana dehādi yattattvayi samarpitam  || 136.32 ||
tato viṣṇurgarutmantaṃ prāha śīghraṃ jagatpatiḥ  |
ihānayasva kaṇiśaṃ mamāyaṃ cārpayiṣyati  || 136.33 ||
tato yogyānayaṃ bhogān prāpsyate manasaḥ priyān  |
ākarṇya svāminādiṣṭaṃ tathā cakre sa pakṣirāṭ || 136.34 ||
viṣṇuhaste kaṇān prādātsa maudgalyo yatavrataḥ  |
etasminnantare viṣṇurviśvakarmāṇamabravīt || 136.35 ||
{viṣṇuruvāca̱ }
yāvaccāsya kule sapta puruṣāstāvadeva tu  |
bhavitāro mahābuddhe tāvatkāmā manīṣitāḥ  |
gāvo hiraṇyaṃ dhānyāni vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca  || 136.36 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yacca kiṃcinmanaḥprītyai loke bhavati bhūṣaṇam  |
tatsarvamāpa maudgalyo viṣṇugaṅgāprabhāvataḥ  || 136.37 ||
gṛhaṃ gaccheti maudgalyo viṣṇunoktastato yayau  |
āśrame svasya sarvarddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣirabhāṣata  || 136.38 ||
{ṛṣiruvāca̱ }
aho dānaprabhāvo'yamaho viṣṇoranusmṛtiḥ  |
aho gaṅgāprabhāvaśca kairvicāryo mahānayam  || 136.39 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
maudgalyo bhāryayā sārdhaṃ putraiḥ pautraiśca bandhubhiḥ  |
pitṛbhyāṃ bubhuje bhogān bhuktiṃ muktimavāpa ca  || 136.40 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ maudgalyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca bhuktimuktiphalapradam  || 136.41 ||
tatra śrutiḥ smṛtirvāpi tīrthasya syātkathaṃcana  |
tasya viṣṇurbhavetprītaḥ pāpairmuktaḥ sukhī bhavet || 136.42 ||
ekādaśa sahasrāṇi tīrthānāṃ tīrayordvayoḥ  |
sarvārthadāyināṃ tatra snānadānajapādibhiḥ  || 136.43 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
lakṣmītīrthamiti khyātaṃ sākṣāllakṣmīvivardhanam  |
alakṣmīnāśanaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ śṛṇu nārada  || 137.1 ||
saṃvādaśca purā tvāsīllakṣmyāḥ putra daridrayā  |
parasparavirodhinyāvubhe viśvaṃ samīyatuḥ  || 137.2 ||
tābhyāmavyāpṛtaṃ vastu tannāsti bhuvanatraye  |
mama jyaiṣṭhyaṃ mama jyaiṣṭhyamityūcaturubhe mithaḥ  |
ahaṃ pūrvaṃ samudbhūtā ityāha śriyamojasā  || 137.3 ||
{śrīlakṣmīruvāca̱ }
kulaṃ śīlaṃ jīvitaṃ vā dehināmahameva tu  |
mayā vinā dehabhājo jīvanto'pi mṛtā iva  || 137.4 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
daridrayā ca sā proktā sarvebhyo hyadhikā hyaham  |
muktirmadāśritā nityaṃ daridraivaṃ vaco'bravīt || 137.5 ||
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca mado mātsaryameva ca  |
yatrāhamasmi tatraite na tiṣṭhanti kadācana  || 137.6 ||
na bhayodbhūtirunmāda īrṣyā uddhatavṛttitā  |
yatrāhamasmi tatraite na tiṣṭhanti kadācana  || 137.7 ||
daridrāyā vacaḥ śrutvā lakṣmīstāṃ pratyabhāṣata  ||* 137.8 ||
{lakṣmīruvāca̱ }
alaṃkṛto mayā jantuḥ sarvo bhavati pūjitaḥ  |
nirdhanaḥ śivatulyo'pi sarvairapyabhibhūyate  || 137.9 ||
dehīti vacanadvārā dehasthāḥ pañca devatāḥ  |
sadyo nirgatya gacchanti dhīśrīhrīśāntikīrtayaḥ  || 137.10 ||
tāvadguṇā gurutvaṃ ca yāvannārthayate param  |
arthī cetpuruṣo jātaḥ kva guṇāḥ kva ca gauravam  || 137.11 ||
tāvatsarvottamo jantustāvatsarvaguṇālayaḥ  |
namasyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ yāvannārthayate param  || 137.12 ||
kaṣṭametanmahāpāpaṃ nirdhanatvaṃ śarīriṇām  |
na mānayati no vakti na spṛśatyadhanaṃ janaḥ  || 137.13 ||
ahameva tataḥ śreṣṭhā daridre śṛṇu me vacaḥ  ||* 137.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tallakṣmīvacanaṃ śrutvā daridrā vākyamabravīt ||* 137.15 ||
{daridrovāca̱ }
vaktuṃ na lakṣmīrjyeṣṭhāhamiti vai lajjase muhuḥ  |
pāpeṣu ramase nityaṃ vihāya puruṣottamam  || 137.16 ||
viśvastavañcakā nityaṃ bhavatī ślāghase katham  |
sukhaṃ na tādṛktvatprāptau paścāttāpo yathā guruḥ  || 137.17 ||
na tathā jāyate puṃsāṃ surayā dāruṇo madaḥ  |
tvatsaṃnidhānamātreṇa yathā vai viduṣāmapi  || 137.18 ||
sadaiva ramase lakṣmīḥ prāyastvaṃ pāpakāriṣu  |
ahaṃ vasāmi yogyeṣu dharmaśīleṣu sarvadā  || 137.19 ||
śivaviṣṇvanurakteṣu kṛtajñeṣu mahatsu ca  |
sadācāreṣu śānteṣu gurusevodyateṣu ca  || 137.20 ||
satsu vidvatsu śūreṣu kṛtabuddhiṣu sādhuṣu  |
nivasāmi sadā lakṣmīstasmājjyaiṣṭhyaṃ mayi sthitam  || 137.21 ||
brāhmaṇeṣu śuciṣmatsu vratacāriṣu bhikṣuṣu  |
nirbhayeṣu vasiṣyāmi lakṣmīstvaṃ śṛṇu te sthitim  || 137.22 ||
rājavartiṣu pāpeṣu niṣṭhureṣu khaleṣu ca  |
piśuneṣu ca lubdheṣu vikṛteṣu śaṭheṣu ca  || 137.23 ||
anāryeṣu kṛtaghneṣu dharmaghātiṣu sarvadā  |
mitradrohiṣvaniṣṭeṣu bhagnacitteṣu vartase  || 137.24 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ vivadamāne te jagmaturmāmubhe api  |
tayorvākyamupaśrutya mayokte te ubhe api  || 137.25 ||
mattaḥ pūrvatarā pṛthvī āpaḥ pūrvatarāstataḥ  |
strīṇāṃ vivādaṃ tā eva striyo jānanti netare  || 137.26 ||
viśeṣataḥ punastābhyaḥ kamaṇḍalubhavāśca yāḥ  |
tatrāpi gautamī devī niścayaṃ kathayiṣyati  || 137.27 ||
saiva sarvārtisaṃhartrī saiva saṃdehakartarī  |
te madvākyādbhuvaṃ gatvā bhūmyā ca sahite api  || 137.28 ||
adbhiśca sahitāḥ sarvā gautamīṃ yayurāpagām  |
bhūmirāpastayorvākyaṃ gautamyai kramaśaḥ sphuṭam  || 137.29 ||
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsuryathāvṛttaṃ praṇamya tām  |
daridrāyāśca lakṣmyāśca vākyaṃ madhyasthavattadā  || 137.30 ||
śṛṇvatsu lokapāleṣu śṛṇvatyāṃ bhuvi nārada  |
śṛṇvatīṣvapsu sā gaṅgā daridrāṃ vākyamabravīt |
saṃpraśasya tathā lakṣmīṃ gautamī vākyamabravīt || 137.31 ||
{gautamyuvāca̱ }
brahmaśrīśca tapaḥśrīśca yajñaśrīḥ kīrtisaṃjñitā  |
dhanaśrīśca yaśaśrīśca vidyā prajñā sarasvatī  || 137.32 ||
bhuktiśrīścātha muktiśca smṛtirlajjā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā  |
siddhistuṣṭistathā puṣṭiḥ śāntirāpastathā mahī  || 137.33 ||
ahaṃśaktirathauṣadhyaḥ śrutiḥ śuddhirvibhāvarī  |
dyaurjyotsnā āśiṣaḥ svastirvyāptirmāyā uṣā śivā  || 137.34 ||
yatkiṃcidvidyate loke lakṣmyā vyāptaṃ carācaram  |
brāhmaṇeṣvatha dhīreṣu kṣamāvatsvatha sādhuṣu  || 137.35 ||
vidyāyukteṣu cānyeṣu bhuktimuktyanusāriṣu  |
yadyadramyaṃ sundaraṃ vā tattallakṣmīvijṛmbhitam  || 137.36 ||
kimatra bahunoktena sarvaṃ lakṣmīmayaṃ jagat |
yasmin kasmiṃśca yatkiṃcidutkṛṣṭaṃ paridṛśyate  || 137.37 ||
lakṣmīmayaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ tayā hīnaṃ na kiṃcana  |
atremāṃ sundarīṃ devīṃ spardhayantī na lajjase  || 137.38 ||
gaccha gaccheti tāṃ gaṅgā daridrāṃ vākyamabravīt |
tataḥ prabhṛti gaṅgāmbho daridrāvairakāryabhūt || 137.39 ||
tāvaddaridrābhibhavo gaṅgā yāvanna sevyate  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamalakṣmīnāśanaṃ śubham  || 137.40 ||
tatra snānena dānena lakṣmīvān puṇyavān bhavet |
tīrthānāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi tasmiṃstīrthe mahāmate  |
devarṣimunijuṣṭānāṃ sarvasiddhipradāyinām  || 137.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
