bhānutīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām  |
tatredaṃ vṛttamākhyāsye mahāpātakanāśanam  || 138.1 ||
śaryātiriti vikhyāto rājā paramadhārmikaḥ  |
tasya bhāryā sthaviṣṭheti rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi  || 138.2 ||
madhucchandā iti khyāto vaiśvāmitro dvijottamaḥ  |
purodhāstasya nṛpaterbrahmarṣiḥ śamināṃ prabhuḥ  || 138.3 ||
diśo vijetuṃ sa jagāma rājā  138.4
purodhasā tena nṛpapravīraḥ  138.4
purodhasaṃ prāha mahānubhāvaṃ  138.4
jitvā diśaścādhvani saṃniviṣṭaḥ  138.4
papracchedaṃ kena khedaṃ gato'si  138.5
hetuṃ vadasveti mahānubhāva  138.5
tvameva rājye mama sarvamānyaḥ  138.5
samastavidyāniravadyabodhaḥ  138.5
vidhūtapāpaḥ paritāpaśūnyaḥ  138.6
kimanyacetā iva lakṣyase tvam  138.6
jiteyamurvī vijitā narendrā  138.6
harṣasya hetau mahatīha jāte  138.6
kiṃ tvaṃ kṛśo me vada satyameva  138.7
dvijātivaryātimahānubhāva  138.7
saṃbodhya śaryātimuvāca vipraś 138.7
chandomadhuḥ premamayīṃ priyoktim  138.7
{madhucchandā uvāca̱ }
śṛṇu bhūpāla madvākyaṃ bhāryayā yadudīritam  |
sthite yāme vayaṃ yāmo yāminī cārdhagāminī  || 138.8 ||
svāminī cāsya dehasya kāminī māṃ pratīkṣate  |
smṛtvā tatkāminīvākyaṃ śoṣaṃ yāti kalevaram  |
vikāre smarasaṃjāte jīvāturnalinānanā  || 138.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vihasya cābravīdrājā purodhasamariṃdamaḥ  ||* 138.10 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
tvaṃ gururmama mitraṃ ca kimātmānaṃ viḍambase  |
kimanena mahāprājña mama vākyena mānada  |
kṣaṇavidhvaṃsini sukhe kā nāmāsthā mahātmanām  || 138.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etadākarṇya matimānmadhucchandā vaco'bravīt ||* 138.12 ||
{madhucchandā uvāca̱ }
yatrānukūlyaṃ daṃpatyostrivargastatra vardhate  |
na cedaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ rājan bhūṣaṇaṃ cātimanyatām  || 138.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ājagāma svakaṃ deśaṃ mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ  |
parīkṣārthaṃ ca tatprema puryāṃ vārttāmadīdiśat || 138.14 ||
diśo vijetuṃ śaryātau yāte rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ  |
hatvā rasātalaṃ yāto rājānaṃ sapurodhasam  || 138.15 ||
rājño bhāryā niścayāya pravṛttā munisattama  |
vārttāṃ śrutvā dūtamukhānmadhucchandaḥpriyā punaḥ  || 138.16 ||
tadaivābhūdgataprāṇā tadvicitramivābhavat |
tasyā vṛttaṃ tu te dṛṣṭvā dūtā rājñe nyavedayan  || 138.17 ||
yatkṛtaṃ rājapatnībhiḥ priyayā ca purodhasaḥ  |
vismito duḥkhito rājā punardūtānabhāṣata  || 138.18 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
śīghraṃ gacchantu he dūtā brāhmaṇyā yatkalevaram  |
rakṣantu vārttāṃ kuruta rājāgantā purodhasā  || 138.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti cintāture rājñi vāguvācāśarīriṇī  ||* 138.20 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
vidhāsyatyakhilaṃ gaṅgā rājaṃstava samīhitam  |
sarvābhiṣaṅgaśamanī pāvanī bhuvi gautamī  || 138.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā sa śaryātirgautamītaṭamāśritaḥ  |
brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā tarpayitvā pitṝn dvijān  || 138.22 ||
purohitaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ preṣayitvā dhanānvitam  |
anyatra tīrthe sārtheṣu dānaṃ dehi prayatnataḥ  || 138.23 ||
etatsarvaṃ na jānāti rājñaḥ kṛtyaṃ purohitaḥ  |
gate tasmin gurau rājā vaiśvāmitre mahātmani  || 138.24 ||
sarvaṃ balaṃ preṣayitvā gaṅgātīre'gnimāviśat |
ityuktvā sa tu rājendro gaṅgāṃ bhānuṃ surānapi  || 138.25 ||
yadi dattaṃ yadi hutaṃ yadi trātā prajā mayā  |
tena satyena sā sādhvī mamāyuṣyeṇa jīvatu  || 138.26 ||
ityuktvāgnau praviṣṭe tu śaryātau nṛpasattame  |
tadaiva jīvitā bhāryā rājñastasya purodhasaḥ  || 138.27 ||
agnipraviṣṭaṃ rājānaṃ śrutvā vismayakāraṇam  |
pativratāṃ tathā bhāryāṃ mṛtāṃ jīvānvitāṃ punaḥ  || 138.28 ||
tadarthaṃ cāpi rājānaṃ tyaktātmānaṃ viśeṣataḥ  |
ātmanaśca punaḥ kṛtyamasmarannṛpaterguruḥ  || 138.29 ||
ahamapyagnimāvekṣya uta yāsye priyāntikam  |
athaveha tapastapsye tato niścayavān dvijaḥ  || 138.30 ||
etadevātmanaḥ kṛtyaṃ manye sukṛtameva ca  |
jīvayāmi ca rājānaṃ tato yāmi priyāṃ punaḥ  || 138.31 ||
etadeva śubhaṃ me syāttatastuṣṭāva bhāskaram  |
na hyanyaḥ kopi devo'sti sarvābhīṣṭaprado raveḥ  || 138.32 ||
{madhucchandā uvāca̱ }
namo'stu tasmai sūryāya muktaye'mitatejase  |
chandomayāya devāya oṃkārārthāya te namaḥ  || 138.33 ||
virūpāya surūpāya triguṇāya trimūrtaye  |
sthityutpattivināśānāṃ hetave prabhaviṣṇave  || 138.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prasannaḥ sūryo'bhūdvarayasvetyabhāṣata  ||* 138.35 ||
{madhucchandā uvāca̱ }
rājānaṃ dehi deveśa bhāryāṃ ca priyavādinīm  |
ātmanaśca śubhān putrān rājñaścaiva śubhān varān  || 138.36 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prādājjagannāthaḥ śaryātiṃ ratnabhūṣitam  |
tāṃ ca bhāryāṃ varānanyān sarvaṃ kṣemamayaṃ tathā  || 138.37 ||
tato yātaḥ priyāviṣṭaḥ prītena ca purodhasā  |
yayau sukhī svakaṃ deśaṃ tattu tīrthaṃ śubhaṃ smṛtam  || 138.38 ||
tatra trīṇi sahasrāṇi tīrthāni guṇavanti ca  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ bhānutīrthamudāhṛtam  || 138.39 ||
mṛtasaṃjīvanaṃ caiva śāryātaṃ ceti viśrutam  |
mādhucchandasamākhyātaṃ smaraṇātpāpanunmune  || 138.40 ||
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam  |
mṛtasaṃjīvanaṃ tatsyādāyurārogyavardhanam  || 138.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
khaḍgatīrthamiti khyātaṃ gautamyā uttare taṭe  |
tatra snānena dānena muktibhāgī bhavennaraḥ  || 139.1 ||
tatra vṛttaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ  |
pailūṣa iti vikhyātaḥ kavaṣasya suto dvijaḥ  || 139.2 ||
kuṭumbabhārātparito hyarthārthī paridhāvati  |
na kimapyāsasādāsau tato vairāgyamāsthitaḥ  || 139.3 ||
atyantavimukhe daive vyarthībhūte tu pauruṣe  |
na vairāgyādanyadasti paṇḍitasyāvalambanam  || 139.4 ||
iti saṃcintayāmāsa tadāsau niḥśvasanmuhuḥ  |
kramāgataṃ dhanaṃ nāsti poṣyāśca bahavo mama  || 139.5 ||
mānī cātmā na kaṣṭārho hā dhigdurdaivaceṣṭitam  |
sa kadācidvṛttiyuto vṛttibhiḥ parivartayan  || 139.6 ||
na lebhe taddhanaṃ vṛttervirāgamagamattadā  |
sevā niṣiddhā yā kācidgahanā duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ  || 139.7 ||
balādākarṣatīyaṃ māṃ tṛṣṇā sarvatra duṣkṛte  |
tvayāpakṛtamajñānāttasmāttṛṣṇe namo'stu te  || 139.8 ||
evaṃ vicintya medhāvī tṛṣṇāchedāya kiṃ bhavet |
ityālocya sa pailūṣaḥ pitaraṃ vākyamabravīt || 139.9 ||
{pailūṣa uvāca̱ }
jñānāsinā krodhalobhau saṃsṛtiṃ cātidustarām  |
chedmīmāṃ kena he tāta tamupāyaṃ vada prabho  || 139.10 ||
{kavaṣa uvāca̱ }
īśvarājjñānamanvicchedityeṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ  |
tasmādārādhayeśānaṃ tato jñānamavāpsyasi  || 139.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā sa pailūṣo jñānāyeśvaramārcayat |
tatastuṣṭo maheśāno jñānaṃ prādāddvijātaye  |
prāptajñāno mahābuddhirgāthāḥ provāca muktidāḥ  || 139.12 ||
{pailūṣa uvāca̱ }
krodhastu prathamaṃ śatrurniṣphalo dehanāśanaḥ  |
jñānakhaḍgena taṃ chittvā paramaṃ sukhamāpnuyāt || 139.13 ||
tṛṣṇā bahuvidhā māyā bandhanī pāpakāriṇī  |
chittvaitāṃ jñānakhaḍgena sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ  || 139.14 ||
saṅgastu paramo'dharmo devādīnāmiti śrutiḥ  |
asaṅgasyātmano hyasya saṅgo'yaṃ paramo ripuḥ  || 139.15 ||
chittvainaṃ jñānakhaḍgena śivaikatvamavāpnuyāt |
saṃśayaḥ paramo nāśo dharmārthānāṃ vināśakṛt || 139.16 ||
chittvainaṃ saṃśayaṃ jantuḥ paramepsitamāpnuyāt |
piśācīva viśatyāśā nirdahatyakhilaṃ sukham  |
pūrṇāhantāsinā chittvā jīvanmuktimavāpnuyāt || 139.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato jñānamavāpyāsau gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritaḥ  |
jñānakhaḍgena nirmohastato muktimavāpa saḥ  || 139.18 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khaḍgatīrthamiti smṛtam  |
jñānatīrthaṃ ca kavaṣaṃ pailūṣaṃ sarvakāmadam  || 139.19 ||
ityādiṣaṭsahasrāṇi tīrthānyāhurmaharṣayaḥ  |
aśeṣapāpatāpaugha harāṇīṣṭapradāni ca  || 139.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ātreyamiti vikhyātamanvindraṃ tīrthamuttamam  |
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi bhraṣṭarājyapradāyakam  || 140.1 ||
gautamyā uttare tīra ātreyo bhagavānṛṣiḥ  |
anvārebhe'tha sattrāṇi ṛtvigbhirmunibhirvṛtaḥ  || 140.2 ||
tasya hotābhavattvagnirhavyavāhana eva ca  |
evaṃ sattre tu saṃpūrṇa iṣṭiṃ māheśvarīṃ punaḥ  || 140.3 ||
kṛtvaiśvaryamagādvipraḥ sarvatra gatimeva ca  |
indrasya bhavanaṃ ramyaṃ svargalokaṃ rasātalam  || 140.4 ||
svecchayā yāti viprendraḥ prabhāvāttapasaḥ śubhāt |
sa kadāciddivaṃ gatvā indralokamagātpunaḥ  || 140.5 ||
tatrāpaśyatsahasrākṣaṃ suraiḥ parivṛtaṃ śubhaiḥ  |
stūyamānaṃ siddhasādhyaiḥ prekṣantaṃ nṛtyamuttamam  |
śṛṇvānaṃ madhuraṃ gītamapsarobhiśca vījitam  || 140.6 ||
upopaviṣṭaiḥ suranāyakaistaiḥ  140.7
saṃpūjyamānaṃ mahadāsanastham  140.7
jayantamaṅke vinidhāya sūnuṃ  140.7
śacyā yutaṃ prāptaratiṃ mahiṣṭham  140.7
satāṃ śaraṇyaṃ varadaṃ mahendraṃ  140.8
samīkṣya viprādhipatirmahātmā  140.8
vimohito'sau munirindralakṣmyā  140.8
samīhayāmāsa tadindrarājyam  140.8
saṃpūjito devagaṇairyathāvat 140.9
svamāśramaṃ vai punarājagāma  140.9
samīkṣya tāṃ śakrapurīṃ suramyāṃ  140.9
ratnairyutāṃ puṇyaguṇaiḥ supūrṇām  140.9
svamāśramaṃ niṣprabhahemavarjyaṃ  140.10
samīkṣya vipro viramaṃ jagāma  140.10
samīhamānaḥ surarājyamāśu  140.10
priyāṃ tadovāca mahātriputraḥ  140.10
{ātreya uvāca̱ }
bhoktuṃ na śakto'smi phalāni mūlāny 140.11
anuttamānyapyatisaṃskṛtāni  140.11
smṛtvāmṛtaṃ puṇyatamaṃ ca tatra  140.11
bhakṣyaṃ ca bhojyaṃ ca varāsanāni  140.11
stutiṃ ca dānaṃ ca sabhāṃ śubhāṃ ca  140.11
astraṃ ca vāsāṃsi purīṃ vanāni  140.11
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato mahātmā tapasaḥ prabhāvāt 140.12
tvaṣṭāramāhūya vaco babhāṣe  140.12
{ātreya uvāca̱ }
iccheyamindratvamahaṃ mahātman  140.13
kuruṣva śīghraṃ padamaindramatra  140.13
brūṣe'nyathā cenmadudīritaṃ tvaṃ  140.13
bhasmīkaromyeva na saṃśayo'tra  140.13
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadatrivākyāttvaritaḥ prajānāṃ  140.14
sraṣṭā vibhurviśvakarmā tadaiva  140.14
cakāra meruṃ ca purīṃ surāṇāṃ  140.14
kalpadrumān kalpalatāṃ ca dhenum  140.14
cakāra vajrādivibhūṣitāni  140.15
gṛhāṇi śubhrāṇyaticitritāni  140.15
cakāra sarvāvayavānavadyāṃ  140.15
śacīṃ smarasyeva vihāraśālām  140.15
sabhāṃ sudharmāṇamaho kṣaṇena  140.16
tathā cakārāpsaraso manojñāḥ  140.16
cakāra coccaiḥśravasaṃ gajaṃ ca  140.16
vajrādi cāstrāṇi surānaśeṣān  140.16
nivāryamāṇaḥ priyayātriputraḥ  140.17
śacīsamāmātmavadhūṃ cakāra  140.17
tadātriputro'trimukhaiḥ sameto  140.17
vajrādirūpaṃ ca cakāra cāstram  140.17
nṛtyādi gītādi ca sarvameva  140.18
cakāra śakrasya pure ca dṛṣṭam  140.18
tatsarvamāsādya tadā munīndraḥ  140.18
prahṛṣṭacetāḥ sutarāṃ babhūva  140.18
āpātaramyeṣvapi kasya nāma  140.19
bhavatyapekṣā nahi gocareṣu  140.19
śrutvā ca daityā danujāḥ sametā  140.19
rakṣāṃsi kopena yutāni sadyaḥ  140.19
svargaṃ parityajya kuto harirbhuvaṃ  140.20
samāgato nveṣa mithaḥ sukhāya  140.20
tasmādvayaṃ yāma ito nu yoddhuṃ  140.20
vṛtrasya hantāramadīrghasattram  140.20
tataḥ samāgatya tadātriputraṃ  140.21
saṃveṣṭayāmāsurathāsurāste  140.21
saṃveṣṭayitvā puramatriputra  140.21
kṛtaṃ tathā cendrapurābhidhānam  140.21
tairvadhyamānaḥ śastrapātairmahadbhis 140.21
tato bhīto vākyamidaṃ jagāda  140.21
{ātreya uvāca̱ }
yo jāta eva prathamo manasvān  140.22
devo devān kratunā paryabhūṣat 140.22
yasya śuṣmādrodasī abhyasetāṃ  140.22
nṛmṇasya mahnā sa janāsa indraḥ  140.22
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityādisūktena ripūnuvāca  140.23
hariṃ ca tuṣṭāva tadātriputraḥ  140.23
{ātreya uvāca̱ }
nāhaṃ harirnaiva śacī madīyā  140.24
neyaṃ purī naiva vanaṃ tadaindram  140.24
sa eva cendro vṛtrahantā sa vajrī  140.24
sahasrākṣo gotrabhidvajrabāhuḥ  140.24
ahaṃ tu vipro vedavidbrahmavṛndaiḥ  140.25
samāviṣṭo gautamītīrasaṃsthaḥ  140.25
yatrāyatyāṃ nādya vā saukhyahetus 140.25
taccākārṣaṃ karma durdaivayogāt 140.25
{asurā ūcu̱ḥ }
saṃharasvedamātreya yadindrasya viḍambanam  |
kṣemaste bhavitā satyaṃ nānyathā munisattama  || 140.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadātreyo'bravīdvākyaṃ yathā vakṣyanti māmiha  |
karomyeva mahābhāgāḥ satyenāgniṃ samālabhe  || 140.27 ||
evamuktvā sa daiteyāṃstvaṣṭāraṃ punarabravīt ||* 140.28 ||
{ātreya uvāca̱ }
yatkṛtaṃ tvatra matprītyāai aindraṃ tvaṣṭaḥ padaṃ tvayā  |
saṃharasva punaḥ śīghraṃ rakṣa māṃ brāhmaṇaṃ munim  || 140.29 ||
punardehi padaṃ mahyamāśramaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ  |
vṛkṣāṃśca vāri yatrāsīnna me divyaiḥ prayojanam  |
sarvamakramamāyātaṃ na sukhāya manīṣiṇām  || 140.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā prajānāthastvaṣṭā saṃhṛtavāṃstadā  |
daityāśca jagmuḥ svasthānaṃ kṛtvā deśamakaṇṭakam  || 140.31 ||
tvaṣṭā cāpi yayau sthānaṃ svakaṃ saṃprahasanniva  |
ātreyo'pi tadā śiṣyaiḥ saṃvṛtaḥ saha bhāryayā  || 140.32 ||
gautamītīramāśritya taponiṣṭho'khilairvṛtaḥ  |
vartamāne mahāyajñe lajjito vākyamabravīt || 140.33 ||
{ātreya uvāca̱ }
aho mohasya mahimā mamāpi bhrāntacittatā  |
kiṃ mahendrapadaṃ labdhaṃ kiṃ mayātra purā kṛtam  || 140.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ vadantamātreyaṃ lajjitaṃ prābruvan surāḥ  ||* 140.35 ||
{surā ūcu̱ḥ }
lajjāṃ jahi mahābāho bhavitā khyātiruttamā  |
ātreyatīrthe ye snānaṃ prāṇinaḥ kuryurañjasā  || 140.36 ||
indrāste bhavitāro vai smaraṇātsukhabhāginaḥ  |
tatra pañca sahasrāṇi tīrthānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  || 140.37 ||
anvindrātreyadaiteya nāmabhiḥ kīrtitāni ca  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvamakṣayapuṇyadam  || 140.38 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā vibudhā yātāḥ saṃtuṣṭaścābhavanmuniḥ  ||* 140.39 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kapilāsaṃgamaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  |
tatra nārada vakṣyāmi kathāṃ puṇyāmanuttamām  || 141.1 ||
kapilo nāma tattvajño munirāsīnmahāyaśāḥ  |
krūraścāpi prasannaśca tapovrataparāyaṇaḥ  || 141.2 ||
tapasyantaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ gautamītīramāśritam  |
tamāgatya mahātmānaṃ vāmadevādayo'bruvan  || 141.3 ||
hatvā venaṃ brahmaśāpairnaṣṭadharme tvarājake  |
kapilaṃ siddhamācāryamūcurmunigaṇāstadā  || 141.4 ||
{munigaṇā ūcu̱ḥ }
gate vede gate dharme kiṃ kartavyaṃ munīśvara  ||* 141.5 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato'bravīnmunirdhyātvā kapilastvāgatānmunīn  ||* 141.6 ||
{kapila uvāca̱ }
venasyorurvimathyo'bhūttataḥ kaścidbhaviṣyati  ||* 141.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathaiva cakrurmunayo venasyoruṃ vimathya vai  |
tatrotpanno mahāpāpaḥ kṛṣṇo raudraparākramaḥ  || 141.8 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayo bhītā niṣīdasveti cābruvan  |
niṣādaḥ so'bhavattasmānniṣādāścābhavaṃstataḥ  || 141.9 ||
venabāhuṃ mamanthuste dakṣiṇaṃ dharmasaṃhitam  |
tataḥ pṛthusvaraścaiva sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ  || 141.10 ||
rājābhavatpṛthuḥ śrīmān brahmasāmarthyasaṃyutaḥ  |
tamāgatya surāḥ sarve abhinandya varāñśubhān  || 141.11 ||
tasmai dadustathāstrāṇi mantrāṇi guṇavanti ca  |
tato'bruvanmunigaṇāstaṃ pṛthuṃ kapilena ca  || 141.12 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
āhāraṃ dehi jīvebhyo bhuvā grastauṣadhīrapi  ||* 141.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ sa dhanurādāya bhuvamāha nṛpottamaḥ  ||* 141.14 ||
{pṛthuruvāca̱ }
oṣadhīrdehi yā grastāḥ prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā  ||* 141.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tamuvāca mahī bhītā pṛthuṃ taṃ pṛthulocanam  ||* 141.16 ||
{mahyuvāca̱ }
mayi jīrṇā mahauṣadhyaḥ kathaṃ dātumahaṃ kṣamā  ||* 141.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ sakopo nṛpatistāmāha pṛthivīṃ punaḥ  ||* 141.18 ||
{pṛthuruvāca̱ }
no ceddadāsyadya tvāṃ vai hatvā dāsye mahauṣadhīḥ  ||* 141.19 ||
{bhūmiruvāca̱ }
kathaṃ haṃsi striyaṃ rājañjñānī bhūtvā nṛpottama  |
vinā mayā kathaṃ cemāḥ prajāḥ saṃdhārayiṣyasi  || 141.20 ||
{pṛthuruvāca̱ }
yatropakāro'nekānāmekanāśe bhaviṣyati  |
na doṣastatra pṛthivi tapasā dhāraye prajāḥ  || 141.21 ||
na doṣamatra paśyāmi nācakṣe'narthakaṃ vacaḥ  |
yasminnipātite saukhyaṃ bahūnāmupajāyate  |
munayastadvadhaṃ prāhuraśvamedhaśatādhikam  || 141.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sāntvayitvā nṛpottamam  |
mahīṃ ca mātaraṃ devīmūcuḥ suragaṇāstadā  || 141.23 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
bhūme gorūpiṇī bhūtvā payorūpā mahauṣadhīḥ  |
dehi tvaṃ pṛthave rājñe tataḥ prīto bhavennṛpaḥ  |
prajāsaṃrakṣaṇaṃ ca syāttataḥ kṣemaṃ bhaviṣyati  || 141.24 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato gorūpamāsthāya bhūmyāsītkapilāntike  |
dudoha ca mahauṣadhyo rājā venakarodbhavaḥ  || 141.25 ||
yatra devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ kapilo muniḥ  |
mahīṃ gorūpamāpannāṃ narmadāyāṃ mahāmune  || 141.26 ||
sarasvatyāṃ bhāgīrathyāṃ godāvaryāṃ viśeṣataḥ  |
mahānadīṣu sarvāsu duduhe'sau payo mahat || 141.27 ||
sā duhyamānā pṛthunā puṇyatoyābhavannadī  |
gautamyā saṃgatā cābhūttadadbhutamivābhavat || 141.28 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kapilāsaṃgamaṃ viduḥ  |
tatrāṣṭāśītiḥ pūjyāni sahasrāṇi mahāmate  || 141.29 ||
tīrthānyāhurmunigaṇāḥ smaraṇādapi nārada  |
pāvanāni jagatyasmiṃstāni sarvāṇyanukramāt || 141.30 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
devasthānamiti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  |
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada  || 142.1 ||
purā kṛtayugasyādau devadānavasaṃgare  |
pravṛtte vā siṃhiketi vikhyātā daityasundarī  || 142.2 ||
tasyāḥ putro mahādaityo rāhurnāma mahābalaḥ  |
amṛte tu samutpanne saiṃhikeye ca bhedite  || 142.3 ||
tasya putro mahādaityo meghahāsa iti śrutaḥ  |
pitaraṃ ghātitaṃ śrutvā tapastepe'tiduḥkhitaḥ  || 142.4 ||
tapasyantaṃ rāhusutaṃ gautamītīramāśritam  |
devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarve tamūcuratibhītavat || 142.5 ||
{devarṣaya ūcu̱ḥ }
tapo jahi mahābāho yatte manasi saṃsthitam  |
sarvaṃ bhavatu nāmedaṃ śivagaṅgāprasādataḥ  |
śivagaṅgāprasādena kiṃ nāmāstyatra durlabham  || 142.6 ||
{meghahāsa uvāca̱ }
paribhūtaḥ pitā pūjyo yuṣmābhirmama daivatam  |
tasyāpi mama cātyantaṃ prītiśca kriyate yadi  || 142.7 ||
bhavadbhistapaso'smācca ahaṃ vairānnivartaye  |
vairaniryātanaṃ kāryaṃ putreṇa piturādarāt |
prārthayante bhavantaścetpūrṇāstanme manorathāḥ  || 142.8 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve rāhuṃ cakrurgrahānugam  |
taṃ cāpi meghahāsaṃ te cakrū rākṣasapuṃgavam  || 142.9 ||
tato'bhavadrāhusuto nairṛtādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ  |
punaścāha surān daityo mama khyātiryathā bhavet || 142.10 ||
tīrthasyāsya prabhāvaśca dātavya iti me matiḥ  |
tathetyuktvā dadurdevāḥ sarvameva manogatam  || 142.11 ||
daityeśvarasya devarṣe tannāmnā tīrthamucyate  |
devā yato'bhavan sarve tatra sthāne mahāmate  || 142.12 ||
devasthānaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ devānāmapi durlabham  |
yatra deveśvaro devo devatīrthaṃ tataḥ smṛtam  || 142.13 ||
tatrāṣṭādaśa tīrthāni daityapūjyāni nārada  |
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca mahāpātakanāśanam  || 142.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
siddhatīrthamiti khyātaṃ yatra siddheśvaro haraḥ  |
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvasiddhikaraṃ nṛṇām  || 143.1 ||
pulastyavaṃśasaṃbhūto rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ  |
diśo vijitya sarvāśca somalokamajīgamat || 143.2 ||
somena saha yotsyantaṃ daśāsyamahamabravam  |
mantraṃ dāsye nivartasva somayuddhāddaśānana  || 143.3 ||
ityuktvāṣṭottaraṃ mantraṃ śatanāmabhiranvitam  |
śivasya rākṣasendrāya prādāṃ nārada śāntaye  || 143.4 ||
niḥśrīkāṇāṃ vipannānāṃ nānākleśajuṣāṃ nṛṇām  |
śaraṇaṃ śiva evātra saṃsāre'nyo na kaścana  || 143.5 ||
tato nivṛttaḥ sa ha mantriyuktas 143.6
tatsomalokājjayamāpya rakṣaḥ  143.6
sa puṣpakārūḍhagatiḥ sagarvo  143.6
lokān punaḥ prāpa javāddaśāsyaḥ  143.6
sa prekṣamāṇo devamantarikṣaṃ  143.7
bhuvaṃ ca nāgāṃśca gajāṃśca viprān  143.7
ālokayāmāsa nagaṃ mahāntaṃ  143.7
kailāsamāvāsa umāpateryaḥ  143.7
dṛṣṭvā smayotphulladṛgadrirājaṃ  143.8
sa mantriṇau rāvaṇa ityuvāca  143.8
{rāvaṇa uvāca̱ }
ko vā girāvatra vasenmahātmā  143.9
giriṃ nayāmyenamathādhi bhūmeḥ  143.9
laṅkāgato'yaṃ girirāśu śobhāṃ  143.9
laṅkāpi satyaṃ śriyamātanoti  143.9
{brahmovāca̱ }
itthaṃ vaco rākṣasamantriṇau tau  143.10
niśamya rakṣodhipateśca bhāvam  143.10
na yuktamityūcaturiṣṭabuddhyā  143.10
niśācarastadvacanaṃ na mene  143.10
saṃsthāpya tatpuṣpakamāśu rakṣaḥ  143.11
puplāva kailāsagireśca mūle  143.11
hindolayāmāsa giriṃ daśāsyo  143.11
jñātvā bhavaḥ kṛtyamidaṃ cakāra  143.11
jitvā digīśāṃśca sagarvitasya  143.12
kailāsamāndolayataḥ surāreḥ  143.12
aṅguṣṭhakṛtyaiva rasātalādi  143.12
lokāṃśca yātasya daśānanasya  143.12
ālūnakāyasya giraṃ niśamya  143.13
vihasya devyā saha dattamiṣṭam  143.13
tasmai prasannaḥ kupito'pi śaṃbhur 143.13
ayuktadāteti na saṃśayo'tra  143.13
tato'yamāvāpya varān suvīro  143.14
bhavaprasādātkusumaṃ jagāma  143.14
gacchan sa laṅkāṃ bhavapūjanāya  143.14
gaṅgāmagācchaṃbhujaṭāprasūtām  143.14
saṃpūjayitvā vividhaiśca mantrair 143.15
gaṅgājalaiḥ śaṃbhumadīnasattvaḥ  143.15
asiṃ sa lebhe śaśikhaṇḍabhūṣāt 143.15
siddhiṃ ca sarvarddhimabhīpsitāṃ ca  143.15
maddattamantraṃ śaśirakṣaṇāya  143.16
sa sādhayāmāsa bhavaṃ prapūjya  143.16
siddhe tu mantre punareva laṅkām  143.16
ayātsa rakṣodhipatiḥ sa tuṣṭaḥ  143.16
tataḥ prabhṛtyetadatiprabhāvaṃ  143.17
tīrthaṃ mahāsiddhidamiṣṭadaṃ ca  143.17
samastapāpaughavināśanaṃ ca  143.17
siddhairaśeṣaiḥ parisevitaṃ ca  143.17
{brahmovāca̱ }
paruṣṇīsaṃgamaṃ ceti tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  |
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pāpavināśanam  || 144.1 ||
atrirārādhayāmāsa brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān  |
teṣu tuṣṭeṣu sa prāha putrā yūyaṃ bhaviṣyatha  || 144.2 ||
tathā caikā rūpavatī kanyā mama bhavetsurāḥ  |
tathā putratvamāpuste brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ  || 144.3 ||
kanyāṃ ca janayāmāsa śubhātreyīti nāmataḥ  |
dattaḥ somo'tha durvāsāḥ putrāstasya mahātmanaḥ  || 144.4 ||
agneraṅgiraso jāto hyaṅgārairaṅgirā yataḥ  |
tasmādaṅgirase prādādātreyīmatirociṣam  || 144.5 ||
agneḥ prabhāvātparuṣamātreyīṃ sarvadāvadat |
ātreyyapi ca śuśrūṣāṃ kurvatī sarvadābhavat || 144.6 ||
tasyāmāṅgirasā jātā mahābalaparākramāḥ  |
aṅgirāḥ paruṣaṃ vādīdātreyīṃ nityameva ca  || 144.7 ||
putrāstvāṅgirasā nityaṃ pitaraṃ śamayanti te  |
sā kadācidbhartṛvākyādudvignā paruṣākṣarāt |
kṛtāñjalipuṭā dīnā prābravīcchvaśuraṃ gurum  || 144.8 ||
{ātreyyuvāca̱ }
atrijāhaṃ havyavāha bhāryā tava sutasya vai  |
śuśrūṣaṇaparā nityaṃ putrāṇāṃ bhartureva ca  || 144.9 ||
patirmāṃ paruṣaṃ vakti vṛthaivodvīkṣate ruṣā  |
praśādhi māṃ surajyeṣṭha bhartāraṃ mama daivatam  || 144.10 ||
{jvalana uvāca̱ }
aṅgārebhyaḥ samudbhūto bhartā te hyaṅgirā ṛṣiḥ  |
yathā śānto bhavedbhadre tathā nītirvidhīyatām  || 144.11 ||
āgneyo'gniṃ samāyāto tava bhartā varānane  |
tadā tvaṃ jalarūpeṇa plāvayethā madājñayā  || 144.12 ||
{ātreyyuvāca̱ }
saheyaṃ paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ mā bhartāgniṃ samāviśet |
bhartari pratikūlānāṃ yoṣitāṃ jīvanena kim  || 144.13 ||
iccheyaṃ śāntivākyāni bhartāraṃ labhate tathā  ||* 144.14 ||
{jvalana uvāca̱ }
agnistvapsu śarīreṣu sthāvare jaṅgame tathā  |
tava bharturahaṃ dhāma nityaṃ ca janako mataḥ  || 144.15 ||
yo'haṃ so'hamiti jñātvā na cintāṃ kartumarhasi  |
kiṃ cāpo mātaro devyo hyagniḥ śvaśura ityapi  |
iti buddhyā viniścitya mā viṣaṇṇā bhava snuṣe  || 144.16 ||
{snuṣovāca̱ }
āpo jananya iti yadbabhāṣe  144.17
agnerahaṃ tava putrasya bhāryā  144.17
kathaṃ bhūtvā jananī cāpi bhāryā  144.17
viruddhametajjalarūpeṇa nātha  144.17
{jvalana uvāca̱ }
ādau tu patnī bharaṇāttu bhāryā  144.18
janestu jāyā svaguṇaiḥ kalatram  144.18
ityādirūpāṇi bibharṣi bhadre  144.18
kuruṣva vākyaṃ madudīritaṃ yat 144.18
yo'syāṃ prajātaḥ sa tu putra eva  144.19
sā tasya mātaiva na saṃśayo'tra  144.19
tasmādvadanti śrutitattvavijñāḥ  144.19
sā naiva yoṣittanaye'bhijāte  144.19
{brahmovāca̱ }
śvaśurasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvātreyī tadaiva tat |
āgneyaṃ rūpamāpannamambhasāplāvayatpatim  || 144.20 ||
ubhau tau daṃpatī brahman saṃgatau gāṅgavāriṇā  |
śāntarūpadharau cobhau daṃpatī saṃbabhūvatuḥ  || 144.21 ||
lakṣmyā yukto yathā viṣṇurumayā śaṃkaro yathā  |
rohiṇyā ca yathā candrastathābhūnmithunaṃ tadā  || 144.22 ||
bhartāraṃ plāvayantī sā dadhārāmbumayaṃ vapuḥ  |
paruṣṇī ceti vikhyātā gaṅgayā saṃgatā nadī  || 144.23 ||
gośatārpaṇajaṃ puṇyaṃ paruṣṇīsnānato bhavet |
tatra cāṅgirasāścakruryajñāṃśca bahudakṣiṇān  || 144.24 ||
tatra trīṇi sahasrāṇi tīrthānyāhuḥ purāṇagāḥ  |
ubhayostīrayostāta pṛthagyāgaphalaṃ viduḥ  || 144.25 ||
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca vājapeyādhikaṃ matam  |
viśeṣatastu gaṅgāyāḥ paruṣṇyā saha saṃgame  || 144.26 ||
snānadānādibhiḥ puṇyaṃ yattadvaktuṃ na śakyate  ||* 144.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
mārkaṇḍeyaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ sarvapāpavimocanam  |
sarvakratuphalaṃ puṇyamaghaughavinivāraṇam  || 145.1 ||
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ  |
mārkaṇḍeyo bharadvājo vasiṣṭho'triśca gautamaḥ  || 145.2 ||
yājñavalkyaśca jābālirmunayo'nye'pi nārada  |
ete śāstrapraṇetāro vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ  || 145.3 ||
purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsā kathāsu pariniṣṭhitāḥ  |
mithaḥ samūcurvidvāṃso muktiṃ prati yathāmati  || 145.4 ||
kecijjñānaṃ praśaṃsanti kecitkarma tathobhayam  |
evaṃ vivadamānāste māmūcurubhayaṃ matam  || 145.5 ||
madīyaṃ tu mataṃ jñātvā yayuścakragadādharam  |
tasya cāpi mataṃ jñātvā ṛṣayaste mahaujasaḥ  || 145.6 ||
punarvivadamānāste śaṃkaraṃ praṣṭumudyatāḥ  |
gaṅgāyāṃ ca bhavaṃ pūjya tamevārthaṃ śaśaṃsire  || 145.7 ||
karmaṇastu pradhānatvamuvāca tripurāntakaḥ  |
kriyārūpaṃ ca tajjñānaṃ kriyā saiva taducyate  || 145.8 ||
tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni karmaṇā siddhimāpnuyuḥ  |
karmaiva viśvatovyāpi tadṛte nāsti kiṃcana  || 145.9 ||
vidyābhyāso yajñakṛtiryogābhyāsaḥ śivārcanam  |
sarvaṃ karmaiva nākarmī prāṇī kvāpyatra vidyate  || 145.10 ||
karmaiva kāraṇaṃ tasmādanyadunmattaceṣṭitam  |
ṛṣīṇāṃ yatra saṃvādo yatra devo maheśvaraḥ  || 145.11 ||
cakāra nirṇayaṃ sarvaṃ karmaṇāvāpyate nṛbhiḥ  |
mārkaṇḍaṃ mukhyataḥ kṛtvā tato mārkaṇḍamucyate  || 145.12 ||
tīrthamṛṣigaṇākīrṇaṃ gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe  |
pitṝṇāṃ pāvanaṃ puṇyaṃ smaraṇādapi sarvadā  || 145.13 ||
tatrāṣṭau navatistāta tīrthānyāha jaganmayaḥ  |
vedena cāpi tatproktamṛṣayo menire ca tat || 145.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yāyātamaparaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra kālañjaraḥ śivaḥ  |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ tadvṛttamucyate mayā  || 146.1 ||
yayātirnāhuṣo rājā sākṣādindra ivāparaḥ  |
tasya bhāryādvayaṃ cāsītkulalakṣaṇabhūṣitam  || 146.2 ||
jyeṣṭhā tu devayānīti nāmnā śukrasutā śubhā  |
śarmiṣṭheti dvitīyā sā sutā syādvṛṣaparvaṇaḥ  || 146.3 ||
brāhmaṇyapi mahāprājñā devayānī sumadhyamā  |
yayāterabhavadbhāryā sā tu śukraprasādataḥ  || 146.4 ||
śarmiṣṭhā cāpi tasyaiva bhāryā yā vṛṣaparvajā  |
devayānī śukrasutā dvau putrau samajījanat || 146.5 ||
yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ caiva devaputrasamāvubhau  |
śarmiṣṭhā ca nṛpāllebhe trīn putrān devasaṃnibhān  || 146.6 ||
druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca yayāternṛpasattamāt |
devayānyāḥ sutau brahman sadṛśau śukrarūpataḥ  || 146.7 ||
śarmiṣṭhāyāstu tanayāḥ śakrāgnivaruṇaprabhāḥ  |
devayānī kadācittu pitaraṃ prāha duḥkhitā  || 146.8 ||
{devayānyuvāca̱ }
mama tvapatyadvitayamabhāgyāyā bhṛgūdvaha  |
mama dāsyāḥ sabhāgyāyā apatyatritayaṃ pitaḥ  || 146.9 ||
tadetadanumṛśyāyaṃ duḥkhamatyantamāgatā  |
mariṣye dānavaguro yayātikṛtavipriyāt |
mānabhaṅgādvaraṃ tāta maraṇaṃ hi manasvinām  || 146.10 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadetatputrikāvākyaṃ śrutvā śukraḥ pratāpavān  |
kupito'bhyāyayau śīghraṃ yayātimidamabravīt || 146.11 ||
{śukra uvāca̱ }
yadidaṃ vipriyaṃ me tvaṃ sutāyāḥ kṛtavānasi  |
rūponmattena rājendra tasmādvṛddho bhaviṣyasi  || 146.12 ||
na ca bhoktuṃ na ca tyaktuṃ śaknoti viṣayāturaḥ  |
spṛhayanmanasaivāste niḥśvāsocchvāsanaṣṭadhīḥ  || 146.13 ||
vṛddhatvameva maraṇaṃ jīvatāmapi dehinām  |
tasmācchīghraṃ prayāhi tvaṃ jarāṃ bhūpātidurdharām  || 146.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā yayātistu śāpaṃ śukrasya dhīmataḥ  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo rājā yayātiḥ śukramabravīt || 146.15 ||
{yayātiruvāca̱ }
nāparādhye na saṃkupye naivādharmaṃ pravartaye  |
adharmakāriṇaḥ pāpāḥ śāsyā eva mahātmanām  || 146.16 ||
dharmameva carantaṃ vai kathaṃ māṃ śaptavānasi  |
devayānī dvijaśreṣṭha vṛthā māṃ vakti kiṃcana  || 146.17 ||
tasmānna mama viprendra śāpaṃ dātuṃ tvamarhasi  |
vidvāṃso'pi hi nirdoṣe yadi kupyanti mohitāḥ  |
tadā na doṣo mūrkhāṇāṃ dveṣāgnipluṣṭacetasām  || 146.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yayātivākyācchukro'pi sasmāra sutayā kṛtam  |
asakṛdvipriyaṃ tasya divā rātrau pracaṇḍayā  || 146.19 ||
gatakopo'hamityuktvā kāvyo rājānamabravīt ||* 146.20 ||
{śukra uvāca̱ }
jñātaṃ mayānayākāri vipriyaṃ na vade'nṛtam  |
śāpasyemaṃ kariṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvānugrahaṃ nṛpa  || 146.21 ||
yasmai putrāya saṃdātuṃ jarāmicchasi mānada  |
tasya sā yātviyaṃ rājañjarā putrāya madvarāt || 146.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
punaryayātiḥ śvaśuraṃ śukraṃ prāha vinītavat ||* 146.23 ||
{yayātiruvāca̱ }
yo gṛhṇāti mayā dattāṃ jarāṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ  |
sa rājā syāddaityaguro tadetadanumanyatām  || 146.24 ||
yo madvākyaṃ nābhinandetsuto daityaguro dṛḍham  |
taṃ śapeyamanujñātra dātavyaiva tvayā guro  || 146.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamastviti rājānamuvāca bhṛgunandanaḥ  |
tato yayātiḥ svaṃ putramāhūyedaṃ vaco'bravīt || 146.26 ||
{yayātiruvāca̱ }
yado gṛhāṇa me śāpājjarāṃ jātāṃ suto bhavān  |
jyeṣṭhaḥ sarvārthavitprauḍhaḥ putrāṇāṃ dhuri saṃsthitaḥ  |
putrī tenaiva janako yastadājñāvaśe sthitaḥ  || 146.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
netyuvāca yadustātaṃ yayātiṃ bhūridakṣiṇam  |
yayātiśca yaduṃ śaptvā turvasuṃ kāmamabravīt || 146.28 ||
nāgṛhṇātturvasuścāpi pitrā dattāṃ jarāṃ tadā  |
taṃ śaptvā cābravīddruhyuṃ gṛhāṇemāṃ jarāṃ mama  || 146.29 ||
druhyuśca naicchattāṃ dattāṃ jarāṃ rūpavināśinīm  |
anumapyabravīdrājā gṛhāṇemāṃ jarāṃ mama  || 146.30 ||
anurneti tadovāca śaptvā taṃ pūrumabravīt |
abhinandya tadā pūrurjarāṃ tāṃ jagṛhe pituḥ  || 146.31 ||
sahasramekaṃ varṣāṇāṃ yāvatprīto'bhavatpitā  |
yauvane yāni bhogyāni vastūni vividhāni ca  || 146.32 ||
putrayauvanasaṃtuṣṭo yayātirbubhuje sukham  |
tatastṛpto'bhavadrājā sarvabhogeṣu nāhuṣaḥ  |
tato harṣātsamāhūya pūruṃ putramathābravīt || 146.33 ||
{yayātiruvāca̱ }
tṛpto'smi sarvabhogeṣu yauvanena tavānagha  |
gṛhāṇa yauvanaṃ putra jarāṃ me dehi kaśmalām  || 146.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
netyuvāca tadā pūrurjarayā kṣīyate mayā  |
vikārāstāta bhāvānāṃ durnivārāḥ śarīriṇām  || 146.35 ||
balātkālāgatā sahyā jarāpyakhiladehibhiḥ  |
sā cedgurūpakārāya gṛhītā tyajyate katham  || 146.36 ||
svīkṛtatyāgapāpāddhi dehināṃ maraṇaṃ varam  |
athavā tu jarāṃ rājaṃstapasā nāśayāmyaham  || 146.37 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tu pitaraṃ yayau gaṅgāmanuttamām  |
gautamyā dakṣiṇe pāre tatastepe tapo mahat || 146.38 ||
tataḥ prīto'bhavaddevaḥ kālena mahatā śivaḥ  |
lokātītamahodāra guṇasanmaṇibhūṣitam  |
kiṃ dadāmīti taṃ prāha pūruṃ sa surasattamaḥ  || 146.39 ||
{pūruruvāca̱ }
śāpaprāptāṃ jarāṃ nātha piturmama surādhipa  |
tāṃ nāśayasva deveśa pitṛśaptāṃśca kopataḥ  |
madbhrātṝñśāpato muktān kuruṣva surapūjita  || 146.40 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā jagannāthaḥ śāpājjātāṃ jarāṃ tathā  |
anāśayajjagannātho bhrātṝṃścakre viśāpinaḥ  || 146.41 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ jarārogavināśanam  |
akālajajarādīnāṃ smaraṇādapi nāśanam  || 146.42 ||
tannāmnā cāpi vikhyātaṃ kālañjaramudāhṛtam  |
yāyātaṃ nāhuṣaṃ pauraṃ śaukraṃ śārmiṣṭhameva ca  || 146.43 ||
evamādīni tīrthāni tatrāṣṭottarameva ca  |
śataṃ vidyānmahābuddhe sarvasiddhikaraṃ tathā  || 146.44 ||
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ paṭhanaṃ tathā  |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ bhavet || 146.45 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
apsaroyugamākhyātamapsarāsaṃgamaṃ tataḥ  |
tīre ca dakṣiṇe puṇyaṃ smaraṇātsubhago bhavet || 147.1 ||
mukto bhavatyasaṃdehaṃ tatra snānādinā naraḥ  |
strī satī saṃgame tasminnṛtusnātā ca nārada  || 147.2 ||
vandhyāpi janayetputraṃ trimāsātpatinā saha  |
snānadānena vartantī nānyathā madvaco bhavet || 147.3 ||
apsaroyugamākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ yena ca hetunā  |
tatredaṃ kāraṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ  || 147.4 ||
spardhāsīnmahatī brahman viśvāmitravasiṣṭhayoḥ  |
tapasyantaṃ gādhisutaṃ brāhmaṇyārthe yatavratam  || 147.5 ||
gaṅgādvāre samāsīnaṃ preritendreṇa menakā  |
taṃ gatvā tapaso bhraṣṭaṃ kuru bhadre mamājñayā  || 147.6 ||
tadoktendreṇa sā menā viśvāmitraṃ tapaścyutam  |
kṛtvā kanyāṃ tathā dattvā jagāmendrapuraṃ punaḥ  || 147.7 ||
tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ sasmāra gādhiputro'khilaṃ kṛtam  |
taṃ tu deśaṃ parityajya tīrthaṃ tu suravallabham  || 147.8 ||
jagāma dakṣiṇāṃ gaṅgāṃ yatra kālañjaro haraḥ  |
tapasyantaṃ tadovāca punarindraḥ sahasradṛk || 147.9 ||
urvaśīṃ ca tato menāṃ rambhāṃ cāpi tilottamām  |
naivetyūcurbhayatrastāḥ punarāha śacīpatiḥ  || 147.10 ||
gambhīrāṃ cātigambhīrāmubhe ye garvite tadā  |
te ūcaturubhe devaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ puraṃdaram  || 147.11 ||
{gambhīrātigambhīre ūcatu̱ḥ }
āvāṃ gatvā tapasyantaṃ gādhiputraṃ mahādyutim  |
cyāvayāvo nṛtyagītai rūpayauvanasaṃpadā  || 147.12 ||
yāsāmapāṅge hasite vāci vibhramasaṃpadi  |
nityaṃ vasati pañceṣustābhiḥ ko'tra na jīyate  || 147.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyukte sahasrākṣe te āgatya mahānadīm  |
dadṛśāte tapasyantaṃ viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim  || 147.14 ||
mṛtyorapi durādharṣaṃ bhūmisthamiva dhūrjaṭim  |
sahasramekaṃ varṣāṇāmīkṣituṃ na ca śaknutaḥ  || 147.15 ||
dūre sthite nṛtyagīta cāṭukārarate tadā  |
vilokya muniśārdūlastataḥ kopākulo'bhavat || 147.16 ||
pratīpācaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā krodhaḥ kasya na jāyate  |
nispṛho'pi mahābāhustamindraṃ prahasanniva  || 147.17 ||
ābhyāṃ muktaḥ sahasrākṣo hyapsarobhyāṃ bruvanniva  |
śaśāpa te sa gādheyo dravarūpe bhaviṣyathaḥ  || 147.18 ||
dravituṃ māṃ samāyāte yatastviha tato laghu  |
tataḥ prasāditastābhyāṃ śāpamokṣaṃ cakāra saḥ  || 147.19 ||
bhavetāṃ divyarūpe vāṃ gaṅgayā saṃgate yadā  |
tacchāpātte nadīrūpe tatkṣaṇātsaṃbabhūvatuḥ  || 147.20 ||
apsaroyugamākhyātaṃ nadīdvayamato'bhavat |
tābhyāṃ parasparaṃ cāpi tābhyāṃ gaṅgāsusaṃgamaḥ  || 147.21 ||
sarvalokeṣu vikhyāto bhuktimuktipradaḥ śivaḥ  |
tatrāste dṛṣṭa evāsau sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ  || 147.22 ||
tatra snātvā tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate sarvabandhanāt ||* 147.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
koṭitīrthamiti khyātaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  |
yasyānusmaraṇādeva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 148.1 ||
yatra koṭīśvaro devaḥ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet |
koṭidvayaṃ tatra pūrṇaṃ tīrthānāṃ śubhadāyinām  || 148.2 ||
tatra vyuṣṭiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tanmanāḥ  |
kaṇvasya tu suto jyeṣṭho bāhlīka iti viśrutaḥ  || 148.3 ||
kāṇvaśceti janaiḥ khyāto vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ  |
iṣṭīḥ pārvāyaṇānīryāḥ sabhāryo vedapāragaḥ  || 148.4 ||
kurvannāste sa gautamyāstīrastho lokapūjitaḥ  |
prātaḥkāle sabhāryo'sau juhvadagnau samāhitaḥ  || 148.5 ||
sarvadāste kadācittu havanāya samudyataḥ  |
ekāhutiṃ sa hutvā tu samiddhe havyavāhane  || 148.6 ||
āhutyantaradānāya havirdravyaṃ kare'grahīt |
etasminnantare vahnirupaśānto'bhavattadā  || 148.7 ||
tataścintāparaḥ kāṇvaḥ kartavyaṃ kiṃ bhavediti  |
antarvicārayāmāsa viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ  || 148.8 ||
āhutyośca dvayormadhya upaśānto hutāśanaḥ  |
agnyantaramupādeyaṃ vaidikaṃ laukikaṃ tathā  || 148.9 ||
kva hoṣyaṃ syāddvitīyaṃ tu āhutyantarameva ca  |
evaṃ mīmāṃsamāne tu daivī vāgabravīttadā  || 148.10 ||
agnyantaraṃ naiva te'tra upādeyaṃ bhaviṣyati  |
yāni tatra bhaviṣyanti śakalāni samīpataḥ  || 148.11 ||
ardhadagdheṣu kāṣṭheṣu viprarāja prahūyatām  |
netyuvāca tadā kāṇvaḥ saiva vāgabravītpunaḥ  || 148.12 ||
agneḥ putro hiraṇyastu pitā putraḥ sa eva tu  |
putre dattaṃ priyāyaiva pituḥ prītyai bhaviṣyati  || 148.13 ||
pitre deyaṃ sute dadyātkoṭiprītiguṇaṃ bhavet |
daivī vāgabravīdevaṃ tataḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ  || 148.14 ||
niścitya dharmasarvasvaṃ tathā cakruryathoditam  |
etajjñātvā jagatyatra putre dattaṃ piturbhavet || 148.15 ||
apatyādyupakāreṇa pitroḥ prītiryathā bhavet |
tathā nānyena kenāpi jagatyetaddhi viśrutam  || 148.16 ||
suprasiddhaṃ jagatyetatsarvalokeṣu pūjitam  |
tasmin datte bhavetpuṇyaṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ suta  || 148.17 ||
manoglāninivṛttiśca jāyate ca mahatsukham  |
punarapyāha sā vāṇī kāṇve'smiṃstīrtha uttame  || 148.18 ||
abhavattanmahattīrthaṃ kāṇva puṇyaprabhāvataḥ  |
lokatrayāśrayāśeṣa tīrthebhyo'pi mahāphalam  || 148.19 ||
snānadānādikaṃ kiṃcidbhaktyā kurvan samāhitaḥ  |
phalaṃ prāpsyasyaśeṣeṇa sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ mune  || 148.20 ||
yatkiṃcitkriyate cātra snānadānādikaṃ naraiḥ  |
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ vidyātkoṭitīrthaṃ tato viduḥ  || 148.21 ||
yatraitadvṛttamāgneyaṃ kāṇvaṃ pautraṃ hiraṇyakam  |
vāṇīsaṃjñaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaphalaṃ yataḥ  || 148.22 ||
koṭitīrthasya māhātmyamatra vaktuṃ na śakyate  |
vācaspatiprabhṛtibhirathavānyaiḥ surairapi  || 148.23 ||
yatrānuṣṭhīyamānaṃ hi sarvaṃ karma yathā tathā  |
godāvaryāḥ prasādena sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 148.24 ||
koṭitīrthe dvijāgryāya gāmekāṃ yaḥ prayacchati  |
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyādgokoṭiphalamaśnute  || 148.25 ||
tasmiṃstīrthe śucirbhūtvā bhūmidānaṃ karoti yaḥ  |
śraddhāyuktena manasā syāttatkoṭiguṇottaram  || 148.26 ||
sarvatra gautamītīre pitṝṇāṃ dānamuttamam  |
viśeṣataḥ koṭitīrthe tadanantaphalapradam  |
atraikanyūnapañcāśattīrthāni munayo viduḥ  || 148.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
nārasiṃhamiti khyātaṃ gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe  |
tasyānubhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvarakṣāvidhāyakam  || 149.1 ||
hiraṇyakaśipuḥ pūrvamabhavadbalināṃ varaḥ  |
tapasā vikrameṇāpi devānāmaparājitaḥ  || 149.2 ||
haribhaktātmajadveṣa kaluṣīkṛtamānasaḥ  |
āvirbhūya sabhāstambhādviśvātmatvaṃ pradarśayan  || 149.3 ||
taṃ hatvā narasiṃhastatsainyamadrāvayattadā  |
sarvān hatvā mahādaityān krameṇājau mahāmṛgaḥ  || 149.4 ||
rasātalasthāñśatrūṃśca jitvā svarlokamīyivān  |
tatra jitvā bhuvaṃ gatvā daityān hatvā nagasthitān  || 149.5 ||
samudrasthānnadīsaṃsthān grāmasthān vanavāsinaḥ  |
nānārūpadharān daityānnijaghāna mṛgākṛtiḥ  || 149.6 ||
ākāśagān vāyusaṃsthāñjyotirlokamupāgatān  |
vajrapātādhikanakhaḥ samuddhūtamahāsaṭaḥ  || 149.7 ||
daityagarbhasrāvigarjī nirjitāśeṣarākṣasaḥ  |
mahānādairvīkṣitaiśca pralayānalasaṃnibhaiḥ  || 149.8 ||
capeṭairaṅgavikṣepairasurān paryacūrṇayat |
evaṃ hatvā bahuvidhān gautamīmagamaddhariḥ  || 149.9 ||
svapadāmbujasaṃbhūtāṃ manonayananandinīm  |
tatrāmbarya iti khyāto daṇḍakādhipate ripuḥ  || 149.10 ||
devānāṃ durjayo yoddhā balena mahatāvṛtaḥ  |
tenābhavanmahāraudraṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam  || 149.11 ||
śastrāstravarṣaṇaṃ yuddhaṃ hariṇā daityasūnunā  |
nijaghāna hariḥ śrīmāṃstaṃ ripuṃ hyuttare taṭe  || 149.12 ||
gaṅgāyāṃ nārasiṃhaṃ tu tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  |
snānadānādikaṃ tatra sarvapāpagrahārdanam  || 149.13 ||
sarvarakṣākaraṃ nityaṃ jarāmaraṇavāraṇam  |
yathā surāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ na kopi hariṇā samaḥ  || 149.14 ||
tīrthānāmapyaśeṣāṇāṃ tathā tattīrthamuttamam  |
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā kuryānnṛharipūjanam  || 149.15 ||
svarge martye tale vāpi tasya kiṃcinna durlabham  |
ityādyaṣṭau mune tatra mahātīrthāni nārada  || 149.16 ||
pṛthakpṛthaktīrthakoṭi phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  |
aśraddhayāpi yannāmni smṛte sarvāghasaṃkṣayaḥ  || 149.17 ||
bhavetsākṣānnṛsiṃho'sau sarvadā yatra saṃsthitaḥ  |
tattīrthasevāsaṃjātaṃ phalaṃ kairiha varṇyate  || 149.18 ||
yathā na devo nṛhareradhikaḥ kvāpi vartate  |
tathā nṛsiṃhatīrthena samaṃ tīrthaṃ na kutracit || 149.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
paiśācaṃ tīrthamākhyātaṃ gaṅgāyā uttare taṭe  |
piśācatvātpurā vipro muktimāpa mahāmate  || 150.1 ||
suyavasyātmajo loke jīgartiriti viśrutaḥ  |
kuṭumbabhāraduḥkhārto durbhikṣeṇa tu pīḍitaḥ  || 150.2 ||
madhyamaṃ tu śunaḥśepaṃ putraṃ brahmavidāṃ varam  |
vikrītavān kṣatriyāya vadhāya bahulairdhanaiḥ  || 150.3 ||
kiṃ nāmāpadgataḥ pāpaṃ nācaratyapi paṇḍitaḥ  |
śamitṛtve dhanaṃ cāpi jagṛhe bahulaṃ muniḥ  || 150.4 ||
vidāraṇārthaṃ ca dhanaṃ jagṛhe brāhmaṇādhamaḥ  |
tato'pratisamādheya mahāroganipīḍitaḥ  || 150.5 ||
sa mṛtaḥ kālaparyāye narakeṣvatha pātitaḥ  |
bhogādṛte na kṣayo'sti prāktanānāmihāṃhasām  || 150.6 ||
kiṃkarairyamavākyena bahuyonyantaraṃ gataḥ  |
tataḥ piśāco hyabhavaddāruṇo dāruṇākṛtiḥ  || 150.7 ||
śuṣkakāṣṭheṣvathāraṇye nirjale nirjane tathā  |
grīṣme grīṣmadavavyāpte kṣipyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ  || 150.8 ||
kanyāputramahīvāji gavāṃ vikrayakāriṇaḥ  |
narakānna nivartante yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  || 150.9 ||
svakṛtāghavipākena dāruṇairyamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
saṃghāte pacyamāno'sau rurodoccaiḥ kṛtaṃ smaran  || 150.10 ||
pathi gacchan kadācitsa jīgartermadhyamaḥ sutaḥ  |
śuśrāva rudato vāṇīṃ piśācasya muhurmuhuḥ  || 150.11 ||
putrakreturbrahmahanturjīgartestu pitustadā  |
pāpinaḥ putravikreturbrahmahantuḥ pituśca tām  || 150.12 ||
śunaḥśepastadovāca ko bhavānatiduḥkhitaḥ  |
jīgartirabravīdduḥkhācchunaḥśepapitā hyaham  || 150.13 ||
pāpīyasīṃ kriyāṃ kṛtvā yoniṃ prāpto'smi dāruṇām  |
narakeṣvatha pakvaśca punaḥ prāpto'ntarālakam  |
ye ye duṣkṛtakarmāṇasteṣāṃ teṣāmiyaṃ gatiḥ  || 150.14 ||
jīgartiputrastamuvāca duḥkhāt 150.15
so'haṃ sutaste mama doṣeṇa tāta  150.15
vikrītvā māṃ narakānevamāptas 150.15
tataḥ kariṣye svargataṃ tvāmidānīm  150.15
evaṃ pratijñāya sa gādhiputra  150.16
putratvamāpto'tha munipravīraḥ  150.16
gaṅgāmabhidhyāya pituśca lokān  150.16
anuttamānīhamāno jagāma  150.16
aśeṣaduḥkhānaladhūpitānāṃ  150.17
nimajjatāṃ mohamahāsamudre  150.17
śarīriṇāṃ nānyadaho trilokyām  150.17
ālambanaṃ viṣṇupadīṃ vihāya  150.17
evaṃ viniścitya munirmahātmā  150.18
samuddidhīrṣuḥ pitaraṃ sa durgateḥ  150.18
śucistato gautamīmāśu gatvā  150.18
tatra snātvā saṃsmarañchaṃbhuviṣṇū  150.18
dadau jalaṃ pretarūpāya pitre  150.19
piśācarūpāya suduḥkhitāya  150.19
taddānamātreṇa tadaiva pūto  150.19
jīgartirāvāpa vapuḥ supuṇyam  150.19
vimānayuktaḥ surasaṃghajuṣṭaṃ  150.20
viṣṇoḥ padaṃ prāpa sutaprabhāvāt 150.20
gaṅgāprabhāvācca hareśca śaṃbhor 150.20
vidhāturarkāyutatulyatejāḥ  150.20
tataḥ prabhṛtyetadatiprasiddhaṃ  150.21
paiśācanāśaṃ ca mahāgadaṃ ca  150.21
mahānti pāpāni ca nāśamāśu  150.21
prayānti yasya smaraṇena puṃsām  150.21
tīrthasya cedaṃ gaditaṃ tavādya  150.22
māhātmyametattriśatāni yatra  150.22
tīrthānyathānyāni bhavanti bhukti  150.22
muktipradāyīni kimanyadatra  150.22
sarvasiddhidamākhyātamityādyatra śatatrayam  |
tīrthānāṃ munijuṣṭānāṃ smaraṇādapyabhīṣṭadam  || 150.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
nimnabhedamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  |
gaṅgāyā uttare pāre tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  || 151.1 ||
yasya saṃsmaraṇenāpi sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet |
vedadvīpaśca tatraiva darśanādvedavidbhavet || 151.2 ||
urvaśīṃ cakame rājā ailaḥ paramadhārmikaḥ  |
ko na mohamupāyāti vilokya madirekṣaṇām  || 151.3 ||
sā prāyādyatra rājāsau ghṛtaṃ stokaṃ samaśnute  |
ānagnadarśanātkṛtvā tasyāḥ kālāvadhiṃ nṛpaḥ  || 151.4 ||
tāṃ svīcakāra lalanāṃ yūnāṃ ramyāṃ navāṃ navām  |
suptāyāṃ śayane tasyāṃ samuttasthau purūravāḥ  || 151.5 ||
vilokya taṃ vivasanaṃ tadaivāsau vinirgatā  |
vidyuccañcalacittānāṃ kva sthairyaṃ nanu yoṣitām  || 151.6 ||
īkṣāṃ cakre sa śarvaryāṃ vivastro vismito mahān  |
etasminnantare rājā yuddhāyāgādripūn prati  || 151.7 ||
tāñjitvā punarapyāgāddevalokaṃ supūjitam  |
sa cāgatya mahārājo vasiṣṭhācca purodhasaḥ  || 151.8 ||
urvaśyā gamanaṃ śrutvā tato duḥkhasamanvitaḥ  |
na juhoti na cāśnāti na śṛṇoti na paśyati  || 151.9 ||
etasminnantare tatra mṛtāvasthaṃ nṛpottamam  |
bodhayāmāsa vākyaiśca hetubhūtaiḥ purohitaḥ  || 151.10 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
sā mṛtādya mahārāja mā vyathasva mahāmate  |
evaṃ sthitaṃ tu mā tvāṃ vai aśivāḥ spṛśyurāśugāḥ  || 151.11 ||
na vai straiṇāni jānīṣe hṛdayāni mahāmate  |
śālāvṛkāṇāṃ yādṝṃśi tasmāttvaṃ bhūpa mā śucaḥ  || 151.12 ||
ko nāma loke rājendra kāminībhirna vañcitaḥ  |
vañcakatvaṃ nṛśaṃsatvaṃ cañcalatvaṃ kuśīlatā  || 151.13 ||
iti svābhāvikaṃ yāsāṃ tāḥ kathaṃ sukhahetavaḥ  |
kālena ko na nihataḥ ko'rthī gauravamāgataḥ  || 151.14 ||
śriyā na bhrāmitaḥ ko vā yoṣidbhiḥ ko na khaṇḍitaḥ  |
svapnamāyopamā rājanmadaviplutacetasaḥ  || 151.15 ||
sukhāya yoṣitaḥ kasya jñātvaitadvijvaro bhava  |
vihāya śaṃkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ gautamīṃ vā mahāmate  |
duḥkhināṃ śaraṇaṃ nānyadvidyate bhuvanatraye  || 151.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā tato rājā duḥkhaṃ saṃhṛtya yatnataḥ  |
gautamyā madhyasaṃstho'sāvailaḥ paramadhārmikaḥ  || 151.17 ||
tatra cārādhayāmāsa śivaṃ devaṃ janārdanam  |
brahmāṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaṅgāṃ devānanyāṃśca yatnataḥ  || 151.18 ||
yo vipanno na tīrthāni devatāśca na sevate  |
sa kālavaśago jantuḥ kāṃ daśāmanuyāsyati  || 151.19 ||
tadīśvaraikaśaraṇo gautamīsevanotsukaḥ  |
parāṃ śraddhāmupagataḥ saṃsārāsthāparāṅmukhaḥ  || 151.20 ||
īje yajñāṃśca bahulānṛtvigbhirbahudakṣiṇān  |
vedadvīpo'bhavattena yajñadvīpaḥ sa ucyate  || 151.21 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ tatrāyāti sadorvaśī  |
tasya dīpasya yaḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇamatho naraḥ  || 151.22 ||
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī sāgarāmbarā  |
vedānāṃ smaraṇaṃ tatra yajñānāṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā  || 151.23 ||
sukṛtī tatra yaḥ kuryādvedayajñaphalaṃ labhet |
ailatīrthaṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ tadeva ca purūravam  || 151.24 ||
vāsiṣṭhaṃ cāpi tattu syānnimnabhedaṃ taducyate  |
aile rājñi na kiṃcitsyānnimnaṃ sarveṣu karmasu  || 151.25 ||
yadetannimnamurvaśyāṃ sarvabhāvena vartanam  |
taccāpi bheditaṃ nimnaṃ vasiṣṭhena ca gaṅgayā  || 151.26 ||
nimnabhedamabhūttena dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣṭasiddhidam  |
tatra sapta śatānyāhustīrthāni guṇavanti ca  || 151.27 ||
teṣu snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakratuphalapradam  |
snānaṃ kṛtvā nimnabhede yaḥ paśyati surānimān  || 151.28 ||
iha cāmutra vā nimnaṃ na kiṃcittasya vidyate  |
sarvonnatimavāpyāsau modate divi śakravat || 151.29 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
nandītaṭamiti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ vedavido viduḥ  |
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena nārada  || 152.1 ||
atriputro mahātejāścandramā iti viśrutaḥ  |
sarvān vedāṃśca vidhivaddhanurvedaṃ yathāvidhi  || 152.2 ||
adhītya jīvātsarvāśca vidyāścānyā mahāmate  |
gurupūjāṃ karomīti jīvamāha sa candramāḥ  |
bṛhaspatistadā prāha candraṃ śiṣyaṃ mudānvitaḥ  || 152.3 ||
{bṛhaspatiruvāca̱ }
mama priyā tu jānīte tārā ratisamaprabhā  ||* 152.4 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
praṣṭuṃ tāṃ ca tadā prāyādantarveśma sa candramāḥ  |
tārāṃ tārāmukhīṃ dṛṣṭvā jagṛhe tāṃ kareṇa saḥ  || 152.5 ||
svaveśma prati tāṃ lobhādbalādākarṣayattadā  |
tāvaddhairyanidhirjñānī matimān vijitendriyaḥ  || 152.6 ||
yāvanna kāminīnetra vāgurābhirnibadhyate  |
viśeṣato rahaḥsaṃsthāṃ kāminīmāyatekṣaṇām  || 152.7 ||
vilokya na mano yāti kasya kāmeṣu vaśyatām  |
ata evānyapuruṣa darśanaṃ na kadācana  || 152.8 ||
kulavadhvā rahaḥ kāryaṃ bhītayā śīlavipluteḥ  |
vijñāya tatparijanātsahasotthāya nirgataḥ  || 152.9 ||
dṛṣṭvā tadduṣkṛtaṃ karma bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ  |
śaśāpa kopāccākṣipya vāgbhirvipriyakāribhiḥ  || 152.10 ||
parābhibhūtāmālokya kāntāṃ kaḥ soḍhumīśvaraḥ  |
yuyudhe tena jīvo'pi devaścandramasā ruṣā  || 152.11 ||
na śāpairhanyate candro nāyudhaiḥ suramantritaiḥ  |
bṛhaspatipraṇītaiśca na mantrairhanyate śaśī  || 152.12 ||
tadā candrastu tāṃ tārāṃ nītvā saṃsthāpya mandire  |
bubhuje bahuvarṣāṇi rohiṇīṃ cākutobhayaḥ  || 152.13 ||
na jīyeta tadā devairna kopaiḥ śāpamantrakaiḥ  |
na rājabhirna ṛṣibhirna sāmnā bhedadaṇḍanaiḥ  || 152.14 ||
yadā bhāryāṃ na lebhe'sau guruḥ sarvaprayatnataḥ  |
sarvopāyakṣaye jīvastadā nītimathāsmarat || 152.15 ||
apamānaṃ puraskṛtya mānaṃ kṛtvā tu pṛṣṭhataḥ  |
svārthamuddharate prājñaḥ svārthabhraṃśo hi mūrkhatā  || 152.16 ||
sādhyaṃ kenāpyupāyena jānadbhiḥ puruṣaiḥ phalam  |
vṛthābhimāninaḥ śīghraṃ vipadyante vimohitāḥ  || 152.17 ||
evaṃ niścitya medhāvī śukraṃ gatvā nyavedayat |
tamāgataṃ kavirjñātvā saṃmānenābhyanandayat || 152.18 ||
upaviṣṭaṃ suviśrāntaṃ pūjitaṃ ca yathāvidhi  |
paryapṛcchaddaityagurustadāgamanakāraṇam  || 152.19 ||
gṛhāgatasya vimukhāḥ śatravo'pyuttamā nahi  |
tasmai sa vistareṇāha bhāryāharaṇamāditaḥ  || 152.20 ||
bṛhaspatestadā vākyaṃ śrutvā kopānvitaḥ kaviḥ  |
aparādhaṃ tu candrasya mene śiṣyasya nārada  |
atikramamimaṃ śrutvā kopātkavirathābravīt || 152.21 ||
{śukra uvāca̱ }
tadā bhokṣye tadā pāsye tadā svapsye tadā vade  |
yadānaye priyāṃ bhrātastava bhāryāṃ parārditām  || 152.22 ||
tāmānīya bhavaṃ pūjya candraṃ śaptvā gurudruham  |
paścādbhokṣye mahābāho śṛṇu vācaṃ graheśvara  || 152.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā sa jīvena daityācāryo jagāma ha  |
śivamārādhya yatnena paraṃ sāmarthyamāptavān  || 152.24 ||
varānavāpya vividhāñśaṃkarādbhāvapūjitāt |
śivaprasādātkiṃ nāma dehināmiha durlabham  || 152.25 ||
jagāma śukro jīvena tārayā yatra candramāḥ  |
vartate taṃ śaśāpoccaiḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ candra me vacaḥ  || 152.26 ||
yasmātpāpataraṃ karma tvayā pāpa madātkṛtam  |
kuṣṭhī bhūyāstataścandraṃ śaśāpaivaṃ ruṣā kaviḥ  || 152.27 ||
kaviśāpapradagdho'bhūttadaiva mṛgalāñchanaḥ  |
prāpuḥ kṣayaṃ na ke nāma gurusvāmisakhidruhaḥ  || 152.28 ||
tatyāja tāṃ sa candro'pi tāṃ tārāṃ jagṛhe kaviḥ  |
śukro'pi devānāhūya ṛṣīn pitṛgaṇāṃstathā  || 152.29 ||
nadīrnadāṃśca vividhānoṣadhīśca pativratāḥ  |
tataḥ saṃpraṣṭumārebhe tārāvṛttaviniṣkrayam  || 152.30 ||
tataḥ śrutiḥ surānāha gautamyāṃ bhaktitastviyam  |
snānaṃ karotu jīvena tārā pūtā bhaviṣyati  || 152.31 ||
rahasyametatparamaṃ na kathyaṃ yasya kasyacit |
sarvāsvapi daśāsveha śaraṇaṃ gautamī nṛṇām  || 152.32 ||
tathākaroccaiva tārā bhartrā snānaṃ yathāvidhi  |
puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttatra jayaśabdo vyavartata  || 152.33 ||
punarvai devā adaduḥ punarmanuṣyā uta  |
rājānaḥ satyaṃ kṛṇvānā brahmajāyāṃ punardaduḥ  || 152.34 ||
punardattvā brahmajāyāṃ kṛtāṃ devairakalmaṣām  |
sarvaṃ kṣemamabhūttatra tasmāttīrthaṃ mahāmune  || 152.35 ||
punardattvā brahmajāyāṃ kṛtāṃ devairakalmaṣām  152.36
sarvaṃ kṣemamabhūttatra tasmāttīrthaṃ mahāmune  152.36
tadabhūtsakalāghaughadhvaṃsanaṃ sarvakāmadam  152.36
ānandaṃ kṣemamabhavatsurāṇāmasurāriṇām  152.36
bṛhaspateśca śukrasya tārāyāśca viśeṣataḥ  |
paramānandamāpanno gururgaṅgāmabhāṣata  || 152.37 ||
{gururuvāca̱ }
tvaṃ gautami sadā pūjyā sarveṣāmapi muktidā  |
viśeṣatastu siṃhasthe mayi trailokyapāvanī  || 152.38 ||
bhaviṣyasi saricchreṣṭhe sarvatīrthaiḥ samanvitā  |
yāni kāni ca tīrthāni svargamṛtyurasātale  |
tvāṃ snātuṃ tāni yāsyanti mayi siṃhasthite'mbike  || 152.39 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamārogyaśrīvivardhanam  |
saubhāgyaiśvaryajananaṃ tīrthamānandanāmakam  || 152.40 ||
tatra pañca sahasrāṇi tīrthānyāha sa gautamaḥ  |
smaraṇātpaṭhanādvāpi iṣṭaiḥ saṃyujyate sadā  || 152.41 ||
śivasyātra niviṣṭasya nandī gaṅgātaṭe'niśam  |
sākṣāccaratyasau dharmastasmānnandītaṭaṃ smṛtam  |
ānandamapi tattīrthaṃ sarvānandavivardhanāt || 152.42 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhāvatīrthamiti proktaṃ yatra sākṣādbhavaḥ sthitaḥ  |
aśeṣajagadantastho bhūtātmā saccidākṛtiḥ  || 153.1 ||
tatremāṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi kathāṃ puṇyatamāṃ śubhām  |
sūryavaṃśakaraḥ śrīmān kṣatriyāṇāṃ dhuraṃdharaḥ  || 153.2 ||
prācīnabarhirākhyātaḥ sarvadharmeṣu pāragaḥ  |
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca varṣāṇāṃ rājya āsthitaḥ  || 153.3 ||
tasyedṛśaṃ vrataṃ cāsīdyadahaṃ yauvanacyutaḥ  |
bhaveyaṃ priyayā vāpi putrairvā priyavastubhiḥ  || 153.4 ||
viyujyeyaṃ tato rājyaṃ tyakṣye'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
vivekināṃ kulīnānāmidamevocitaṃ nṛṇām  || 153.5 ||
sthīyate vijane kvāpi viraktairvibhavakṣaye  |
tasmin praśāsati mahīṃ na viyogaḥ priyaiḥ kvacit || 153.6 ||
nādhivyādhī na durbhikṣaṃ na bandhukalaho nṛṇām  |
tasmiñśāsati rājyaṃ tu na ca kaścidviyujyate  || 153.7 ||
tataḥ putrārthamakarodyajñaṃ rājā mahāmatiḥ  |
tataḥ prasanno bhagavān varaṃ prādādyathepsitam  || 153.8 ||
gautamītīrasaṃsthāya rājñe devo maheśvaraḥ  |
putraṃ dehīti rājā vai bhavaṃ prāha sa bhāryayā  || 153.9 ||
bhavaḥ prāha nṛpaṃ prītyā paśya netraṃ tṛtīyakam  |
tataḥ paśyati rājendre bhavasyākṣi tu mānada  || 153.10 ||
cakṣurdīptyābhavatputro mahimā nāma viśrutaḥ  |
yenākāri stutiḥ puṇyā mahimna iti viśrutā  || 153.11 ||
kimalabhyaṃ bhagavati prasanne tripurāntake  |
yaṃ nityamanuvartante haribrahmādayaḥ surāḥ  || 153.12 ||
prāptaputraśca nṛpatistīrthaśraiṣṭhyamayācata  |
mahāpāpamahāroga mahāvyasanināṃ nṛṇām  || 153.13 ||
nānāvipadgaṇārtānāṃ sarvābhimatalabdhaye  |
prādājjyaiṣṭhyaṃ bhavaścāpi bhāvatīrthaṃ taducyate  || 153.14 ||
tatra snānena dānena sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt |
bhavaprasādādabhavatsutaḥ prācīnabarhiṣaḥ  || 153.15 ||
mahimā gautamītīre bhāvatīrthaṃ taducyate  |
tatra saptati tīrthāni puṇyānyakhiladāni ca  || 153.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sahasrakuṇḍamākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ vedavido viduḥ  |
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sukhī saṃpadyate naraḥ  || 154.1 ||
purā dāśarathī rāmaḥ setuṃ baddhvā mahārṇave  |
laṅkāṃ dagdhvā ripūn hatvā rāvaṇādīn raṇe śaraiḥ  || 154.2 ||
vaidehīṃ ca samāsādya rāmo vacanamabravīt |
paśyatsu lokapāleṣu tasyācārye puraḥ sthite  || 154.3 ||
agnau śuddhigatāṃ sītāṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇasaṃnidhau  |
ehi vaidehi śuddhāsi aṅkamāroḍhumarhasi  || 154.4 ||
netyuvāca tadā śrīmānaṅgado hanumāṃstathā  |
ayodhyāyāṃ tu vaidehi sārdhaṃ yāmaḥ suhṛjjanaiḥ  || 154.5 ||
tatra śuddhimavāpyātha punarbhrātṛṣu mātṛṣu  |
laukikeṣvapi paśyatsu tataḥ śuddhā nṛpātmajā  || 154.6 ||
ayodhyāyāṃ supuṇye'hni aṅkamāroḍhumarhasi  |
asyāścaritraviṣaye saṃdehaḥ kasya jāyate  || 154.7 ||
lokāpavādastadapi nirasyaḥ svajaneṣu hi  |
tayorvākyamanādṛtya lakṣmaṇaḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ  || 154.8 ||
rāmaśca jāmbavāṃścaiva tāmāhvayannṛpātmajām  |
svastītyuktā devatābhī rājño'ṅkaṃ cāruroha sā  || 154.9 ||
muditāste yayuḥ śīghraṃ puṣpakeṇa virājatā  |
ayodhyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpya tathā rājyaṃ svakaṃ tu yat || 154.10 ||
muditāste'bhavan sarve sadā rāmānuvartinaḥ  |
tataḥ katipayāheṣu anāryebhyo virūpikām  || 154.11 ||
vācaṃ śrutvā sa tatyāja gurviṇīṃ tāmayonijām  |
mithyāpavādamapi hi na sahante kulonnatāḥ  || 154.12 ||
vālmīkermunimukhyasya āśramasya samīpataḥ  |
tatyāja lakṣmaṇaḥ sītāmaduṣṭāṃ rudatīṃ rudan  || 154.13 ||
nollaṅghyājñā gurūṇāmityasau tadakarodbhiyā  |
tataḥ katipayāheṣu vyatīteṣu nṛpātmajaḥ  || 154.14 ||
rāmaḥ saumitriṇā sārdhaṃ hayamedhāya dīkṣitaḥ  |
tatraivājagmaturubhau rāmaputrau yaśasvinau  || 154.15 ||
lavaḥ kuśaśca vikhyātau nāradāviva gāyakau  |
rāmāyaṇaṃ samagraṃ tadgandharvāviva susvarau  || 154.16 ||
rāmasya caritaṃ sarvaṃ gāyamānau samīyatuḥ  |
yajñavāṭaṃ rājasutau hetubhirlakṣitau tadā  || 154.17 ||
rāmaputrāvubhau śūrau vaidehyāstanayāviti  |
tāvānīya tataḥ putrāvabhiṣicya yathākramam  || 154.18 ||
aṅkārūḍhau tataḥ kṛtvā sasvaje tau punaḥ punaḥ  |
saṃsāraduḥkhakhinnānāmagatīnāṃ śarīriṇām  || 154.19 ||
putrāliṅganamevātra paraṃ viśrāntikāraṇam  |
muhurāliṅgya tau putrau muhuḥ svajati cumbati  || 154.20 ||
kimapyantardhyāyati ca niḥśvasatyapi vai muhuḥ  |
etasminnantare prāptā rākṣasā laṅkavāsinaḥ  || 154.21 ||
sugrīvo hanumāṃścaiva aṅgado jāmbavāṃstathā  |
anye ca vānarāḥ sarve vibhīṣaṇapuraḥsarāḥ  || 154.22 ||
te cāgatya nṛpaṃ prāptāḥ siṃhāsanamupasthitam  |
sītāmadṛṣṭvā hanumānaṅgadaḥ kanakāṅgadaḥ  || 154.23 ||
kva gatāyonijā mātā eko rāmo'tra dṛśyate  |
rāmeṇa sā parityaktā ityūcurdvārapālakāḥ  || 154.24 ||
paśyatsu lokapāleṣu ārye tatra pravādini  |
agnau śuddhigatāṃ sītāṃ kiṃ tu rājā niraṅkuśaḥ  || 154.25 ||
utpannairlaukikairvākyai rāmastyajati tāṃ priyām  |
mariṣyāva iti hyuktvā gautamīṃ punarīyatuḥ  || 154.26 ||
rāmastau pṛṣṭhato'bhyetya ayodhyāvāsibhiḥ saha  |
āgatya gautamīṃ tatra'kurvaṃste paramaṃ tapaḥ  || 154.27 ||
smāraṃ smāraṃ niśvasantastāṃ sītāṃ lokamātaram  |
saṃsārāsthāvirahitā gautamīsevanotsukāḥ  || 154.28 ||
lokatrayapatiḥ sākṣādrāmo'nujasamanvitaḥ  |
prāptaḥ snātvā ca gautamyāṃ śivārādhanatatparaḥ  || 154.29 ||
paritāpaṃ jahau sarvaṃ sahasraparivāritaḥ  |
yatra cāsītsa vṛttāntaḥ sahasrakuṇḍamucyate  || 154.30 ||
daśāparāṇi tīrthāni tatra sarvārthadāni ca  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sahasraphaladāyakam  || 154.31 ||
yatra śrīgautamītīre vasiṣṭhādimunīśvaraiḥ  |
sarvāpattārakaṃ homamakārayadaghāntakam  || 154.32 ||
sahasrasaṃkhyāyukteṣu kuṇḍeṣu vasudhārayā  |
sarvānapekṣitān kāmānavāpāsau mahātapāḥ  || 154.33 ||
gautamyāḥ saridambāyāḥ prasādādrākṣasāntakaḥ  |
sahasrakuṇḍābhidhaṃ tadabhūttīrthaṃ mahāphalam  || 154.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kapilatīrthamākhyātaṃ tadevāṅgirasaṃ smṛtam  |
tadevādityamākhyātaṃ saiṃhikeyaṃ taducyate  || 155.1 ||
gautamyā dakṣiṇe pāre ādityānmunisattama  |
ayājayannaṅgiraso dakṣiṇāṃ te bhuvaṃ daduḥ  || 155.2 ||
aṅgirobhyastadādityāstapase'ṅgiraso yayuḥ  |
sā bhūmiḥ saiṃhikī bhūtvā janān sarvānabhakṣayat || 155.3 ||
tatrasuste janāḥ sarve aṅgirobhyo nyavedayan  |
vibhītā jñānato jñātvā bhuvaṃ tāṃ saiṃhikīmiti  || 155.4 ||
ādityānanugatvātha vācamaṅgiraso'bruvan  |
bhuvaṃ gṛhṇantu yā dattā netyādityāstadābruvan  || 155.5 ||
nivṛttāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ naiva pratigṛhṇanti sūrayaḥ  |
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā yo hareta vasuṃdharām  || 155.6 ||
ṣaṣṭirvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ  |
bhūmeḥ svaparadattāyā haraṇānnādhikaṃ kvacit || 155.7 ||
pāpamasti mahāraudraṃ na svīkurmaḥ punastu tām  |
evaṃ yadā svadattāyā haraṇe kiṃ tadā bhavet || 155.8 ||
tathāpi krayarūpeṇa gṛhṇīmo dakṣiṇāṃ bhuvam  |
tathetyukte tu te devāḥ kapilāṃ śubhalakṣaṇām  || 155.9 ||
gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe pāre bhuvaḥ sthāne tu tāṃ daduḥ  |
bhuktimuktipradaḥ sākṣādviṣṇustiṣṭhati mūrtimān  || 155.10 ||
kapilāsaṃgamaṃ tacca sarvāghaughavināśanam  |
tatrābhavaddānatoyādāpagā kapilābhidhā  || 155.11 ||
sasyavatyā api bhuvo dānādgodānamuttamam  |
lokarakṣāṃ cakārāsau kṛtvā vinimayaṃ muniḥ  || 155.12 ||
yatra tīrthe ca tadvṛttaṃ gotīrthaṃ tadudāhṛtam  |
puṇyadaṃ tatra tīrthānāṃ śatamuktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ  || 155.13 ||
tatra snānena dānena bhūmidānaphalaṃ labhet |
saṃgatā gaṅgayā tacca kapilāsaṃgamaṃ viduḥ  || 155.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śaṅkhahradaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ yatra śaṅkhagadādharaḥ  |
tatra snātvā ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate bhavabandhanāt || 156.1 ||
tatredaṃ vṛttamākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāyakam  |
purā kṛtayugasyādau brahmaṇaḥ sāmagāyinaḥ  || 156.2 ||
brahmāṇḍāgārasaṃbhūtā rākṣasā bahurūpiṇaḥ  |
brahmāṇaṃ khādituṃ prāptā balonmattā dhṛtāyudhāḥ  || 156.3 ||
tadāhamabravaṃ viṣṇuṃ rakṣaṇāya jagadgurum  |
sa viṣṇustāni rakṣāṃsi hantuṃ cakreṇa codyataḥ  || 156.4 ||
chittvā cakreṇa rakṣāṃsi śaṅkhamāpūrayattadā  |
niṣkaṇṭakaṃ talaṃ kṛtvā svargaṃ nirvairameva ca  || 156.5 ||
tato harṣaprakarṣeṇa śaṅkhamāpūrayaddhariḥ  |
tato rakṣāṃsi sarvāṇi hyanīnaśuraśeṣataḥ  || 156.6 ||
yatraitadvṛttamakhilaṃ viṣṇuśaṅkhaprabhāvataḥ  |
śaṅkhatīrthaṃ tu tatproktaṃ sarvakṣemakaraṃ nṛṇām  || 156.7 ||
sarvābhīṣṭapradaṃ puṇyaṃ smaraṇānmaṅgalapradam  |
āyurārogyajananaṃ lakṣmīputrapravardhanam  || 156.8 ||
smaraṇātpaṭhanādvāpi sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt |
tīrthānāmayutaṃ tatra sarvapāpanudaṃ mune  || 156.9 ||
tīrthānyayutasaṃkhyāni sarvapāpaharāṇi ca  |
yeṣāṃ prabhāvaṃ jānāti vaktuṃ devo maheśvaraḥ  || 156.10 ||
pāpakṣayapratinidhirnaitebhyo'styaparaḥ kvacit ||* 156.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kiṣkindhātīrthamākhyātaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām  |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ yatra saṃnihito bhavaḥ  || 157.1 ||
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi yatnena śṛṇu nārada  |
purā dāśarathī rāmo rāvaṇaṃ lokarāvaṇam  || 157.2 ||
kiṣkindhāvāsibhiḥ sārdhaṃ jaghāna raṇamūrdhani  |
saputraṃ sabalaṃ hatvā sītāmādāya śatruhā  || 157.3 ||
bhrātrā saumitriṇā sārdhaṃ vānaraiśca mahābalaiḥ  |
vibhīṣaṇena balinā devaiḥ pratyāgato nṛpaḥ  || 157.4 ||
kṛtasvastyayanaḥ śrīmān puṣpakeṇa virājitaḥ  |
yadāsīddhanarājasya kāmagenāśugāminā  || 157.5 ||
ayodhyāmagaman sarve gacchan gaṅgāmapaśyata  |
rāmo virāmaḥ śatrūṇāṃ śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇārthinām  || 157.6 ||
gautamīṃ tu jagatpuṇyāṃ sarvakāmapradāyinīm  |
manonayanasaṃtāpa nivāraṇaparāyaṇām  || 157.7 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpatiḥ śrīmān gaṅgātīramathāviśat |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha nṛpatirharṣagadgadayā girā  |
harīn sarvānathāmantrya hanumatpramukhānmune  || 157.8 ||
{rāma uvāca̱ }
asyāḥ prabhāvāddharayo yo'sau mama pitā prabhuḥ  |
sarvapāpavinirmuktastato yātastriviṣṭapam  || 157.9 ||
iyaṃ janitrī sakalasya jantor 157.10
bhuktipradā muktimathāpi dadyāt 157.10
pāpāni hanyādapi dāruṇāni  157.10
kānyānayāstyatra nadī samānā  157.10
hatāni śaśvadduritāni caiva  157.11
asyāḥ prabhāvādarayaḥ sakhāyaḥ  157.11
vibhīṣaṇo maitramupaiti nityaṃ  157.11
sītā ca labdhā hanumāṃśca bandhuḥ  157.11
laṅkā ca bhagnā sagaṇaṃ hi rakṣo  157.12
hataṃ hi yasyāḥ parisevanena  157.12
yāṃ gautamo devavaraṃ prapūjya  157.12
śivaṃ śaraṇyaṃ sajaṭāmavāpa  157.12
seyaṃ janitrī sakalepsitānām  157.13
amaṅgalānāmapi saṃnihantrī  157.13
jagatpavitrīkaraṇaikadakṣā  157.13
dṛṣṭādya sākṣātsaritāṃ savitrī  157.13
kāyena vācā manasā sadaināṃ  157.14
vrajāmi gaṅgāṃ śaraṇaṃ śaraṇyām  157.14
{brahmovāca̱ }
etatsamākarṇya vaco nṛpasya  157.15
tatrāplavan harayaḥ sarva eva  157.15
pūjāṃ cakrurvidhivatte pṛthakca  157.15
puṣpairanekaiḥ sarvalokopahāraiḥ  157.15
saṃpūjya śarvaṃ nṛpatiryathāvat 157.16
stutvā vākyaiḥ sarvabhāvopayuktaiḥ  157.16
te vānarā muditāḥ sarva eva  157.16
nṛtyaṃ ca gītaṃ ca tathaiva cakruḥ  157.16
sukhoṣitastāṃ rajanīṃ mahātmā  157.17
priyānuyuktaḥ saṃvṛtaḥ premavadbhiḥ  157.17
duḥkhaṃ jahau sarvamamitrasaṃbhavaṃ  157.17
kiṃ nāpyate gautamīsevanena  157.17
savismayaḥ paśyati bhṛtyavargaṃ  157.18
godāvarīṃ stauti ca saṃprahṛṣṭaḥ  157.18
saṃmānayan bhṛtyagaṇaṃ samagram  157.18
avāpa rāmaḥ kamapi pramodam  157.18
punaḥ prabhāte vimale tu sūrye  157.18
vibhīṣaṇo dāśarathiṃ babhāṣe  157.18
{vibhīṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
nādyāpi tṛptāstu bhavāma tīrthe  157.19
kaṃcicca kālaṃ nivasāma cātra  157.19
vatsyāma cātraiva parāścatasro  157.19
rātrīratho yāma vṛtāstvayodhyām  157.19
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasyātha vākyaṃ harayo'numenire  157.20
tathaiva rātrīraparāścatasraḥ  157.20
saṃpūjya devaṃ sakaleśvaraṃ taṃ  157.20
bhrātṛpriyaṃ tīrthamatho jagāma  157.20
siddheśvaraṃ nāma jagatprasiddhaṃ  157.21
yasya prabhāvātprabalo daśāsyaḥ  157.21
evaṃ tu pañcāhamathoṣire te  157.21
svaṃ svaṃ pratiṣṭhāpitaliṅgamarcya  157.21
śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tatra karoti vāyoḥ  157.22
suto'nugāmī hanumānnṛpasya  157.22
gacchannṛpendro hanumantamāha  157.22
liṅgāni sarvāṇi visarjayasva  157.22
matsthāpitānyuttamamantravidbhis 157.23
tathetaraiḥ śaṃkarakiṃkaraiśca  157.23
nodvāsya pūjāṃ paraśaṃkareṇa  157.23
bāhyaṃ samāyojyamaho bhavasya  157.23
tiṣṭhanti susthāstadanādareṇa  157.24
te khaḍgapattrādiṣu saṃbhavanti  157.24
ye'śraddadhānāḥ śivaliṅgapūjāṃ  157.24
vidhāya kṛtyaṃ na samācaranti  157.24
yathocitaṃ te yamakiṃkarairhi  157.25
pacyanta evākhiladurgatīṣu  157.25
rāmājñayā vāyusuto jagāma  157.25
dorbhyāṃ na cotpāṭayituṃ śaśāka  157.25
tataḥ svapucchena grahītukāmaḥ  157.26
saṃveṣṭya liṅgaṃ tu visṛṣṭakāmaḥ  157.26
naivāśakattanmahadadbhutaṃ syāt 157.26
kapīśvarāṇāṃ nṛpatestathaiva  157.26
kaścālayellabdhamahānubhāvaṃ  157.27
maheśaliṅgaṃ puruṣo manasvī  157.27
tanniścalaṃ prekṣya mahānubhāvo  157.27
nṛpapravīraḥ sahasā jagāma  157.27
viprānathāmantrya vidhāya pūjāṃ  157.28
pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ca rāmacandraḥ  157.28
śuddhātiśuddhena hṛdākhilaistair 157.28
liṅgāni sarvāṇi nanāma rāmaḥ  157.28
kiṣkindhavāsipravarairaśeṣaiḥ  157.29
saṃsevitaṃ tīrthamato babhūva  157.29
atrāplavādeva mahānti pāpāny 157.29
api kṣayaṃ yānti na saṃśayo'tra  157.29
punaśca gaṅgāṃ praṇanāma bhaktyā  157.30
prasīda mātarmama gautamīti  157.30
jalpanmuhurvismitacittavṛttir 157.30
vilokayan praṇaman gautamīṃ tām  157.30
tataḥ prabhṛtyetadatīva puṇyaṃ  157.31
kiṣkindhatīrthaṃ vibudhā vadanti  157.31
paṭhetsmaredvāpi śṛṇoti bhaktyā  157.31
pāpāpahaṃ kiṃ punaḥ snānadānaiḥ  157.31
{brahmovāca̱ }
vyāsatīrthamiti khyātaṃ prācetasamataḥ param  |
nātaḥ parataraṃ kiṃcitpāvanaṃ sarvasiddhidam  || 158.1 ||
daśa me mānasāḥ putrāḥ sraṣṭāro jagatāmapi  |
antaṃ jijñāsavaste vai pṛthivyā jagmurojasā  || 158.2 ||
punaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ punaste'pi yātāstān samavekṣitum  |
naiva te'pi samāyātā ye gatāste gatā gatāḥ  || 158.3 ||
tadotpannā mahāprājñā divyā āṅgiraso mune  |
vedavedāṅgatattvajñāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ  || 158.4 ||
te'nujñātā aṅgirasā guruṃ natvā tapodhanāḥ  |
tapase niścitāḥ sarve naiva pṛṣṭvā tu mātaram  || 158.5 ||
sarvebhyo hyadhikā mātā gurubhyo gauraveṇa hi  |
tadā nārada kopena sā śaśāpa tadātmajān  || 158.6 ||
{mātovāca̱ }
māmanādṛtya ye putrāḥ pravṛttāścarituṃ tapaḥ  |
sarvairapi prakāraistanna teṣāṃ siddhimeṣyati  || 158.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
nānādeśāṃśca cinvānāstapaḥsiddhiṃ na yānti ca  |
vighnamanveti tān sarvānitaścetaśca dhāvataḥ  || 158.8 ||
kvāpi tadrākṣasairvighnaṃ kvāpi tanmānuṣairabhūt |
pramadābhiḥ kvaciccāpi kvāpi taddehadoṣataḥ  || 158.9 ||
evaṃ tu bhramamāṇāste yayuḥ sarve taponidhim  |
agastyaṃ tapatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kumbhayoniṃ jagadgurum  || 158.10 ||
namaskṛtvā hyāṅgirasā hyagnivaṃśasamudbhavāḥ  |
dakṣiṇāśāpatiṃ śāntaṃ vinītāḥ praṣṭumudyatāḥ  || 158.11 ||
{āṅgirasā ūcu̱ḥ }
bhagavan kena doṣeṇa tapo'smākaṃ na sidhyati  |
nānāvidhairapyupāyaiḥ kurvatāṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ  || 158.12 ||
kiṃ kurmaḥ kaḥ prakāro'tra tapasyeva bhavāma kim  |
upāyaṃ brūhi viprendra jyeṣṭho'si tapasā dhruvam  || 158.13 ||
jñātāsi jñānināṃ brahman vaktāsi vadatāṃ varaḥ  |
śānto'si yamināṃ nityaṃ dayāvān priyakṛttathā  || 158.14 ||
akrodhanaśca na dveṣṭā tasmādbrūhi vivakṣitam  |
sāhaṃkārā dayāhīnā gurusevāvivarjitāḥ  |
asatyavādinaḥ krūrā na te tattvaṃ vijānate  || 158.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
agastyaḥ prāha tān sarvān kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ  ||* 158.16 ||
{agastya uvāca̱ }
śāntātmāno bhavanto vai sraṣṭāro brahmaṇā kṛtāḥ  |
na paryāptaṃ tapaścābhūtsmaradhvaṃ smayakāraṇam  || 158.17 ||
brahmaṇā nirmitāḥ pūrvaṃ ye gatāḥ sukhamedhate  |
ye gatāḥ punaranveṣṭuṃ te ca tvāṅgiraso'bhavan  || 158.18 ||
te yūyaṃ ca punaḥ kāle yātā yātāḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ  |
prajāpaterapyadhikā bhavitāro na saṃśayaḥ  || 158.19 ||
ito yāntu tapastaptuṃ gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm  |
nopāyo'nyo'sti saṃsāre vinā gaṅgāṃ śivapriyām  || 158.20 ||
tatrāśrame puṇyadeśe jñānadaṃ pūjayiṣyatha  |
sa cchedayiṣyatyakhilaṃ saṃśayaṃ vo mahāmatiḥ  |
na siddhiḥ kvāpi keṣāṃcidvinā sadguruṇā yataḥ  || 158.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
te tamūcurmunivaraṃ jñānadaḥ ko'bhidhīyate  |
brahmā viṣṇurmaheśo vā ādityo vāpi candramāḥ  || 158.22 ||
agniśca varuṇaḥ kaḥ syājjñānado munisattama  |
agastyaḥ punarapyāha jñānadaḥ śrūyatāmayam  || 158.23 ||
yā āpaḥ so'gnirityukto yo'gniḥ sūryaḥ sa ucyate  |
yaśca sūryaḥ sa vai viṣṇuryaśca viṣṇuḥ sa bhāskaraḥ  || 158.24 ||
yaśca brahmā sa vai rudro yo rudraḥ sarvameva tat |
yasya sarvaṃ tu tajjñānaṃ jñānadaḥ so'tra kīrtyate  || 158.25 ||
deśikaprerakavyākhyā kṛdupādhyāyadehadāḥ  |
guravaḥ santi bahavasteṣāṃ jñānaprado mahān  || 158.26 ||
tadeva jñānamatroktaṃ yena bhedo vihanyate  |
eka evādvayaḥ śaṃbhurindramitrāgnināmabhiḥ  |
vadanti bahudhā viprā bhrāntopakṛtihetave  || 158.27 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā munervākyaṃ gāthā gāyanta eva te  |
jagmuḥ pañcottarāṃ gaṅgāṃ pañca jagmuśca dakṣiṇām  || 158.28 ||
agastyenoditān devān pūjayanto yathāvidhi  |
āsaneṣu viśeṣeṇa hyāsīnāstattvacintakāḥ  || 158.29 ||
teṣāṃ sarve suragaṇāḥ prītimanto'bhavanmune  |
sraṣṭṛtvaṃ tu yugādau yatkalpitaṃ viśvayoninā  || 158.30 ||
adharmāṇāṃ nivṛttyarthaṃ vedānāṃ sthāpanāya ca  |
lokānāmupakārārthaṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye  || 158.31 ||
purāṇasmṛtivedārtha dharmaśāstrārthaniścaye  |
sraṣṭṛtvaṃ jagatāmiṣṭaṃ tādṛgrūpā bhaviṣyatha  || 158.32 ||
prajāpatitvaṃ teṣāṃ vai bhaviṣyati śanaiḥ kramāt |
yadā hyadharmo bhavitā vedānāṃ ca parābhavaḥ  || 158.33 ||
vedānāṃ vyasanaṃ tebhyo bhāvivyāsāstatastu te  |
yadā yadā tu dharmasya glānirvedasya dṛśyate  || 158.34 ||
tadā tadā tu te vyāsā bhaviṣyantyupakāriṇaḥ  |
teṣāṃ yattapasaḥ sthānaṃ gaṅgāyāstīramuttamam  || 158.35 ||
tatra tatra śivo viṣṇurahamāditya eva ca  |
agnirāpaḥ sarvamiti tatra saṃnihitaṃ sadā  || 158.36 ||
naitebhyaḥ pāvanaṃ kiṃcinnaitebhyastvadhikaṃ kvacit |
tattadākāratāṃ prāptaṃ paraṃ brahmaiva kevalam  || 158.37 ||
sarvātmakaḥ śivo vyāpī sarvabhāvasvarūpadhṛk |
viśeṣatastatra tīrthe sarvaprāṇyanukampayā  || 158.38 ||
sarvairdevairanuvṛtastadanugrahakārakaḥ  |
dharmavyāsāstu te jñeyā vedavyāsāstathaiva ca  || 158.39 ||
teṣāṃ tīrthaṃ tena nāmnā vyapadiṣṭaṃ jagattraye  |
pāpapaṅkakṣālanāmbho mohadhvāntamadāpaham  |
sarvasiddhipradaṃ puṃsāṃ vyāsatīrthamanuttamam  || 158.40 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vañjarāsaṃgamaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam  |
ṛṣibhiḥ sevitaṃ nityaṃ siddhai rājarṣibhistathā  || 159.1 ||
dāsatvamagamatpūrvaṃ nāgānāṃ garuḍaḥ khagaḥ  |
mātṛdāsyāttadā duḥkha parisaṃtaptamānasaḥ  |
kadāciccintayāmāsa rahaḥ sthitvā viniśvasan  || 159.2 ||
{garuḍa uvāca̱ }
ta eva dhanyā loke'smin kṛtapuṇyāsta eva hi  |
nānyasevā kṛtā yaistu na yeṣāṃ vyasanāgamaḥ  || 159.3 ||
sukhaṃ tiṣṭhanti gāyanti svapanti ca hasanti ca  |
svadehaprabhavo dhanyā dhigdhiganyavaśe sthitān  || 159.4 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti cintāsamāviṣṭo jananīmetya duḥkhitaḥ  |
paryapṛcchadameyātmā vainateyo'tha mātaram  || 159.5 ||
{garuḍa uvāca̱ }
kasyāparādhānmātastvaṃ piturvā mama vānyataḥ  |
dāsītvamāptā vada tatkāraṇaṃ mama pṛcchataḥ  || 159.6 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sābravītputramātmīyamaruṇasyānujaṃ priyam  ||* 159.7 ||
{vinatovāca̱ }
naiva kasyāparādho'sti svāparādho mayoditaḥ  |
yasyā vākyaṃ viparyeti sā dāsī syānmayoditam  || 159.8 ||
kadrūścāpi tathaivāhaṃ sā mayā saṃyutā yayau  |
kadrvā mamābhavadvādaśchadmanāhaṃ tayā jitā  || 159.9 ||
vidhirhi balavāṃstāta kāṃ kāṃ ceṣṭāṃ na ceṣṭate  |
evaṃ dāsītvamagamaṃ kadrvāḥ kaśyapanandana  |
yadā dāsī tu jātāhaṃ dāso'bhūstvaṃ dvijanmaja  || 159.10 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tūṣṇīṃ tadā babhūvāsau garuḍo'tīva duḥkhitaḥ  |
na kiṃcidūce jananīṃ cintayan bhavitavyatām  || 159.11 ||
kadrūḥ kadācitsā prāha putrāṇāṃ hitamicchatī  |
ātmano bhūtimicchantī vinatāṃ khagamātaram  || 159.12 ||
{kadrūruvāca̱ }
putraḥ sūryaṃ namaskartuṃ tava yātyanivāritaḥ  |
aho lokatraye'pyasmin dhanyāsi bata dāsyapi  || 159.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
svaduḥkhaṃ gūhamānā sā kadrūṃ prāha suvismitā  ||* 159.14 ||
{vinatovāca̱ }
tava putrāstu kimiti raviṃ draṣṭuṃ na yānti ca  ||* 159.15 ||
{kadrūruvāca̱ }
putrānmadīyān subhage naya nāgālayaṃ prati  |
samudrasya samīpe tu tadāste śītalaṃ saraḥ  || 159.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
suparṇastvavahannāgān kadrūṃ ca vinatā tathā  |
tataḥ provāca muditā vainateyasya mātaram  || 159.17 ||
surāṇāṃ netu nilayaṃ garuḍo matsutāniti  |
punaḥ prāha sarpamātā garuḍaṃ vinayānvitam  || 159.18 ||
{sarpamātovāca̱ }
putrā me draṣṭumicchanti haṃsaṃ trijagatāṃ gurum  |
namaskṛtvā tataḥ sūryameṣyanti nilayaṃ mama  |
haṇḍe tvaṃ naya putrānme sūryamaṇḍalamanvaham  || 159.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sā vepamānā vinatā dīnā kadrūmabhāṣata  ||* 159.20 ||
{vinatovāca̱ }
nāhaṃ kṣamā sarpamātaḥ putro me neṣyate sutān  |
dṛṣṭvā dinakaraṃ devaṃ punareva prayāntu te  || 159.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vinatā svasutaṃ prāha vihagānāmadhīśvaram  |
namaskartumathecchanti nāgāḥ svāmitvamāgatāḥ  || 159.22 ||
bhāsvantamityuvāceyaṃ māṃ sarpajananī haṭhāt |
tathetyuktvā sa garuḍo māmārohantu pannagāḥ  || 159.23 ||
tadārūḍhaṃ sarpasainyaṃ garuḍaṃ vihagādhipam  |
śanaiḥ śanairupagamadyatra devo divākaraḥ  |
te dahyamānāstīkṣṇena bhānutāpena vivyathuḥ  || 159.24 ||
{sarpā ūcu̱ḥ }
nivartasva mahāprājña pataṃgāya namo namaḥ  |
alaṃ sūryasya sadanaṃ dagdhāḥ sūryasya tejasā  |
yāmastvayā vā garuḍa vihāya tvāmathāpi vā  || 159.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ nāgairucyamāna ādityaṃ darśayāmi vaḥ  |
ityuktvā gaganaṃ śīghraṃ jagāmādityasaṃmukhaḥ  || 159.26 ||
dagdhabhogā nipetuste dvīpaṃ taṃ vīraṇaṃ prati  |
bahavaḥ śatasāhasrāḥ pīḍitā dagdhavigrahāḥ  || 159.27 ||
putrāṇāmārtasaṃnādaṃ patitānāṃ mahītale  |
āśvāsituṃ samāyātā tān sā kadrūḥ suvihvalā  || 159.28 ||
uvāca vinatāṃ kadrūstava putro'tiduṣkṛtam  |
kṛtavānatidurmedhā yeṣāṃ śāntirna vidyate  || 159.29 ||
nānyathā kartumāyāti svāmivākyaṃ phaṇīśvaraḥ  |
sa kāśyapo bṛhattejā yadyatra syādanāmayam  || 159.30 ||
bhaveccaivaṃ kathaṃ śāntiḥ putrāṇāṃ mama bhāmini  |
kadrvāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā vinatā hyatibhītavat || 159.31 ||
putramāha mahātmānaṃ garuḍaṃ vihagādhipam  ||* 159.32 ||
{vinatovāca̱ }
nedaṃ yuktataraṃ putra bhūṣaṇaṃ vinayena hi  |
vartituṃ yuktamityuktaṃ vaiparītyaṃ na yujyate  || 159.33 ||
nāmitreṣvapi kartavyaṃ sadbhirjihmaṃ kadācana  |
śrotriye cāntyaje vāpi samaṃ candraḥ prakāśate  || 159.34 ||
kurvantyaniṣṭaṃ kapaṭaista eva mama putraka  |
prasahya kartuṃ ye sākṣādaśaktāḥ puruṣādhamāḥ  || 159.35 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vinatā ca tataḥ prāha kadrūṃ tāṃ sarpamātaram  ||* 159.36 ||
{vinatovāca̱ }
kiṃ kṛtvā śāntirabhyeti putrāṇāṃ te karomi tat |
jarayā tu gṛhītāste vada śāntiṃ karomi tat || 159.37 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kadrūrapyāha vinatāṃ rasātalagataṃ payaḥ  |
tenābhiṣecitānāṃ me putrāṇāṃ śāntireṣyati  || 159.38 ||
kadrvāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā rasātalagataṃ payaḥ  |
kṣaṇenaiva samānīya nāgāṃstānabhyaṣecayat |
tataḥ provāca garuḍo maghavānaṃ śatakratum  || 159.39 ||
{garuḍa uvāca̱ }
meghāścāpyatra varṣantu trailokyasyopakāriṇaḥ  ||* 159.40 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathā vavarṣa parjanyo nāgānāmabhavacchivam  |
rasātalabhavaṃ gāṅgaṃ nāgasaṃjīvanaṃ payaḥ  || 159.41 ||
jarāśokavināśārthamānītaṃ garuḍena yat |
yatrābhiṣecitā nāgāstannāgālayamucyate  || 159.42 ||
garuḍena yato vāri ānītaṃ tadrasātalāt |
tadgāṅgaṃ vāri sarveṣāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  || 159.43 ||
jarāyā vāraṇaṃ yasmānnāgānāmabhavacchivam  |
rasātalabhavaṃ gāṅgaṃ nāgasaṃjīvanaṃ yataḥ  || 159.44 ||
jarāśokavināśārthaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  |
sākṣādamṛtasaṃvāhā vañjarā sābhavannadī  || 159.45 ||
jarādāridryasaṃtāpa hāriṇī kleśavāriṇī  |
rasātalabhavā gaṅgā martyalokabhavā tu yā  || 159.46 ||
tayośca saṃgamo yaḥ syātkiṃ punastatra varṇyate  |
yasyānusmaraṇādeva nāśaṃ yāntyaghasaṃcayāḥ  || 159.47 ||
tatra ca snānadānānāṃ phalaṃ ko vaktumīśvaraḥ  |
sapādaṃ tatra tīrthānāṃ lakṣamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  || 159.48 ||
sarvasaṃpattidātṝṇāṃ sarvapāpaughahāriṇām  |
vañjarāsaṃgamasamaṃ tīrthaṃ kvāpi na vidyate  |
yadanusmaraṇenāpi vipadyante vipattayaḥ  || 159.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
devāgamaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śivam  |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam  || 160.1 ||
tatra vṛttaṃ samākhyāsye tava yatnena nārada  |
devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca spardhābhūddhanahetave  || 160.2 ||
svargaḥ surāṇāmabhavadasurāṇāmilābhavat |
karmabhūmimavaṣṭabhya asurāḥ sarvato'bhavan  || 160.3 ||
devānāṃ yajñabhāgāṃśca dātṝn ghnantyasurāstataḥ  |
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve yajñabhāgairvinā kṛtāḥ  || 160.4 ||
vyathitā māmupājagmuḥ kiṃ kṛtyamiti cābruvan  |
mayā coktāḥ suragaṇā yuddhe jitvāsurān balāt || 160.5 ||
bhuvaṃ prāpsyatha karmāṇi havīṃṣi ca yaśāṃsi ca  |
tathetyuktvā gatā devā bhūmiṃ te samarārthinaḥ  || 160.6 ||
daityāśca dānavāścaiva rākṣasā baladarpitāḥ  |
ekībhūtvā yayuste'pi jayino yuddhakāṅkṣiṇaḥ  || 160.7 ||
ahirvṛtro balistvāṣṭrirnamuciḥ śambaro mayaḥ  |
ete cānye ca bahavo yoddhāro baladarpitāḥ  || 160.8 ||
agnirindro'tha varuṇastvaṣṭā pūṣā tathāśvinau  |
maruto lokapālāśca nānāyuddhaviśāradāḥ  || 160.9 ||
te dānavāḥ sarva eva yāmyāṃ vai diśi saṃgare  |
akurvanta mahāyatnaṃ dakṣiṇārṇavasaṃsthitāḥ  || 160.10 ||
trikūṭaḥ parvataśreṣṭho rākṣasānāṃ purābhavat |
tadvanena yayuḥ sarve taiḥ sārdhaṃ dakṣiṇārṇavam  || 160.11 ||
sarveṣāṃ melanaṃ yatra parvato malayastu saḥ  |
malayasyāpi deśo'sau devārīṇāmabhūttadā  || 160.12 ||
devānāṃ gautamītīre tatra saṃnihitaḥ śivaḥ  |
iti teṣāṃ samāyogo devānāmabhavatkila  || 160.13 ||
devāḥ svarathamārūḍhāstatra tatra samāgaman  |
gautamyāḥ saridambāyāḥ puline vimalāśayāḥ  || 160.14 ||
prasannābhīṣṭadā yā syātpitṝṇāmakhilasya tu  |
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve stutvā devaṃ maheśvaram  |
abhayaṃ cintayāmāsuste sarve'tha parasparam  || 160.15 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
atrāpyupāyaḥ ko'smākaṃ nirjitānāṃ parairhaṭhāt |
ekamevātra naḥ śreyo vijayo vāthavā mṛtiḥ  |
sapatnairabhibhūtānāṃ jīvitaṃ dhiṅmanasvinām  || 160.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etasminnantare putra vāguvācāśarīriṇī  ||* 160.17 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
kleśenālaṃ suragaṇā gautamīmāśu gacchata  |
bhaktyā hariharau tatra samārādhayateśvarau  || 160.18 ||
godāvaryāstayoścaiva prasādātkiṃ tu duṣkaram  ||* 160.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
prasannābhyāṃ harīśābhyāṃ devā jayamabhīpsitam  |
avāpya sarvato jagmuḥ pālayanto divaukasaḥ  || 160.20 ||
yatra devāgamo jātastattīrthaṃ tena viśrutam  |
devāgamaṃ praśaṃsanti munayastattvadarśinaḥ  || 160.21 ||
tatrāśītisahasrāṇi śivaliṅgāni nārada  |
devāgamaḥ parvato'sau priya ityapi kathyate  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ devapriyamato viduḥ  || 160.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kuśatarpaṇamākhyātaṃ praṇītāsaṃgamaṃ tathā  |
tīrthaṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu bhuktimuktipradāyakam  || 161.1 ||
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu pāpaharaṃ śubham  |
vindhyasya dakṣiṇe pārśve sahyo nāma mahāgiriḥ  || 161.2 ||
yadaṅghribhyo'bhavannadyo godābhīmarathīmukhāḥ  |
yatrābhavattadvirajamekavīrā ca yatra sā  || 161.3 ||
na tasya mahimā kaiścidapi śakyo'nuvarṇitum  |
tasmin girau puṇyadeśe śṛṇu nārada yatnataḥ  || 161.4 ||
guhyādguhyataraṃ vakṣye sākṣādvedoditaṃ śubham  |
yanna jānanti munayo devāśca pitaro'surāḥ  || 161.5 ||
tadahaṃ prītaye vakṣye śravaṇātsarvakāmadam  |
paraḥ sa puruṣo jñeyo hyavyakto'kṣara eva tu  || 161.6 ||
aparaśca kṣarastasmātprakṛtyanvita eva ca  |
nirākārātsāvayavaḥ puruṣaḥ samajāyata  || 161.7 ||
tasmādāpaḥ samudbhūtā adbhyaśca puruṣastathā  |
tābhyāmabjaṃ samudbhūtaṃ tatrāhamabhavaṃ mune  || 161.8 ||
pṛthivī vāyurākāśa āpo jyotistathaiva ca  |
ete mattaḥ pūrvatarā ekadaivābhavanmune  || 161.9 ||
etāneva prapaśyāmi nānyatsthāvarajaṅgamam  |
naiva vedāstadā cāsannāhaṃ draṣṭāsmi kiṃcana  || 161.10 ||
yasmādahaṃ samudbhūto na paśyeyaṃ tamapyatha  |
tūṣṇīṃ sthite mayi tadā aśrauṣaṃ vācamuttamām  || 161.11 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
brahman kuru jagatsṛṣṭiṃ sthāvarasya carasya ca  ||* 161.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tato'hamabravaṃ vācaṃ paruṣāṃ tatra nārada  |
kathaṃ srakṣye kva vā srakṣye kena srakṣya idaṃ jagat || 161.13 ||
saiva vāgabravīddaivī prakṛtiryābhidhīyate  |
viṣṇunā preritā mātā jagadīśā jaganmayī  || 161.14 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
yajñaṃ kuru tataḥ śaktiste bhavitrī na saṃśayaḥ  |
yajño vai viṣṇurityeṣā śrutirbrahman sanātanī  || 161.15 ||
kiṃ yajvanāmasādhyaṃ syādiha loke paratra ca  ||* 161.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
punastāmabravaṃ devīṃ kva vā keneti tadvada  |
yajñaḥ kāryo mahābhāge tataḥ sovāca māṃ prati  || 161.17 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
oṃkārabhūtā yā devī mātṛkalpā jaganmayī  |
karmabhūmau yajasveha yajñeśaṃ yajñapūruṣam  || 161.18 ||
sa eva sādhanaṃ te syāttena taṃ yaja suvrata  |
yajñaḥ svāhā svadhā mantrā brāhmaṇā havirādikam  || 161.19 ||
harirevākhilaṃ tena sarvaṃ viṣṇoravāpyate  ||* 161.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
punastāmabravaṃ devīṃ karmabhūḥ kva vidhīyate  |
tadā nārada naivāsīdbhāgīrathyatha narmadā  || 161.21 ||
yamunā naiva tāpī sā sarasvatyatha gautamī  |
samudro vā nadaḥ kaścinna saraḥ sarito'malāḥ  |
sā śaktiḥ punarapyevaṃ māmuvāca punaḥ punaḥ  || 161.22 ||
{daivī vāguvāca̱ }
sumerordakṣiṇe pārśve tathā himavato gireḥ  |
dakṣiṇe cāpi vindhyasya sahyāccaivātha dakṣiṇe  |
sarvasya sarvakāle tu karmabhūmiḥ śubhodayā  || 161.23 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tattu vākyamatho śrutvā tyaktvā meruṃ mahāgirim  |
taṃ pradeśamathāgatya sthātavyaṃ kvetyacintayam  |
tato māmabravītsaiva viṣṇorvāṇyaśarīriṇī  || 161.24 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
ito gaccha itastiṣṭha tathopaviśa cātra hi  |
saṃkalpaṃ kuru yajñasya sa te yajñaḥ samāpyate  || 161.25 ||
kṛte caivātha saṃkalpe yajñārthe surasattama  |
yadvadantyakhilā vedā vidhe tattatsamācara  || 161.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
itihāsapurāṇāni yadanyacchabdagocaram  |
svato mukhe mama prāyādabhūcca smṛtigocaram  || 161.27 ||
vedārthaśca mayā sarvo jñāto'sau tatkṣaṇena ca  |
tataḥ puruṣasūktaṃ tadasmaraṃ lokaviśrutam  || 161.28 ||
yajñopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ taduktaṃ ca tvakalpayam  |
taduktena prakāreṇa yajñapātrāṇyakalpayam  || 161.29 ||
ahaṃ sthitvā yatra deśe śucirbhūtvā yatātmavān  |
dīkṣito vipradeśo'sau mannāmnā tu prakīrtitaḥ  || 161.30 ||
maddevayajanaṃ puṇyaṃ nāmnā brahmagiriḥ smṛtaḥ  |
caturaśītiparyantaṃ yojanāni mahāmune  || 161.31 ||
maddevayajanaṃ puṇyaṃ pūrvato brahmaṇo gireḥ  |
tatra madhye vedikā syādgārhapatyo'sya dakṣiṇe  || 161.32 ||
tatra cāhavanīyasya evamagnīṃstvakalpayam  |
vinā patnyā na sidhyeta yajñaḥ śrutinidarśanāt || 161.33 ||
śarīramātmano'haṃ vai dvedhā cākaravaṃ mune  |
pūrvārdhena tataḥ patnī mamābhūdyajñasiddhaye  || 161.34 ||
uttareṇa tvahaṃ tadvadardho jāyā iti śruteḥ  |
kālaṃ vasantamutkṛṣṭamājyarūpeṇa nārada  || 161.35 ||
akalpayaṃ tathā cedhmaṃ grīṣmaṃ cāpi śaraddhaviḥ  |
ṛtuṃ ca prāvṛṣaṃ putra tadā barhirakalpayam  || 161.36 ||
chandāṃsi sapta vai tatra tadā paridhayo'bhavan  |
kalākāṣṭhānimeṣā hi samitpātrakuśāḥ smṛtāḥ  || 161.37 ||
yo'nādiśca tvanantaśca svayaṃ kālo'bhavattadā  |
yūparūpeṇa devarṣe yoktraṃ ca paśubandhanam  || 161.38 ||
sattvāditriguṇāḥ pāśā naiva tatrābhavatpaśuḥ  |
tato'hamabravaṃ vācaṃ vaiṣṇavīmaśarīriṇīm  || 161.39 ||
vinaiva paśunā nāyaṃ yajñaḥ parisamāpyate  |
tato māmavadaddevī saiva nityāśarīriṇī  || 161.40 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
pauruṣeṇātha sūktena stuhi taṃ puruṣaṃ param  ||* 161.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā stūyamāne devadeve janārdane  |
mama cotpādake bhaktyā sūktena puruṣasya hi  || 161.42 ||
sā ca māmabravīddevī brahmanmāṃ tvaṃ paśuṃ kuru  |
tadā vijñāya puruṣaṃ janakaṃ mama cāvyayam  || 161.43 ||
kālayūpasya pārśve taṃ guṇapāśairniveśitam  |
barhisthitamahaṃ praukṣaṃ puruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ  || 161.44 ||
etasminnantare tatra tasmātsarvamabhūdidam  |
brāhmaṇāstu mukhāttasya'bhavan bāhvośca kṣatriyāḥ  || 161.45 ||
mukhādindrastathāgniśca śvasanaḥ prāṇato'bhavat |
diśaḥ śrotrāttathā śīrṣṇaḥ sarvaḥ svargo'bhavattadā  || 161.46 ||
manasaścandramā jātaḥ sūryo'bhūccakṣuṣastathā  |
antarikṣaṃ tathā nābherūrubhyāṃ viśa eva ca  || 161.47 ||
padbhyāṃ śūdraśca saṃjātastathā bhūmirajāyata  |
ṛṣayo romakūpebhya oṣadhyaḥ keśato'bhavan  || 161.48 ||
grāmyāraṇyāśca paśavo nakhebhyaḥ sarvato'bhavan  |
kṛmikīṭapataṃgādi pāyūpasthādajāyata  || 161.49 ||
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ kiṃciddṛśyādṛśyaṃ ca kiṃcana  |
tasmātsarvamabhūddevā mattaścāpyabhavan punaḥ  |
etasminnantare saiva viṣṇorvāgabravīcca mām  || 161.50 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇamabhavatsṛṣṭirjātā tathepsitā  |
idānīṃ juhudhi hyagnau pātrāṇi ca samāni ca  || 161.51 ||
visarjaya tathā yūpaṃ praṇītāṃ ca kuśāṃstathā  |
ṛtvigrūpaṃ yajñarūpamuddeśyaṃ dhyeyameva ca  || 161.52 ||
sruvaṃ ca puruṣaṃ pāśān sarvaṃ brahman visarjaya  ||* 161.53 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvākyasamakālaṃ tu kramaśo yajñayoniṣu  |
gārhapatye dakṣiṇāgnau tathā caiva mahāmune  || 161.54 ||
pūrvasminnapi caivāgnau kramaśo juhvatastadā  |
tatra tatra jagadyonimanusaṃdhāya pūruṣam  || 161.55 ||
mantrapūtaṃ śuciḥ samyagyajñadevo jaganmayaḥ  |
lokanātho viśvakartā kuṇḍānāṃ tatra saṃnidhau  || 161.56 ||
śuklarūpadharo viṣṇurbhavedāhavanīyake  |
śyāmo viṣṇurdakṣiṇāgneḥ pīto gṛhapateḥ kaveḥ  || 161.57 ||
sarvakālaṃ teṣu viṣṇurato deśeṣu saṃsthitaḥ  |
na tena rahitaṃ kiṃcidviṣṇunā viśvayoninā  || 161.58 ||
praṇītāyāḥ praṇayanaṃ mantraiścākaravaṃ tataḥ  |
praṇītodakamapyetatpraṇīteti nadī śubhā  || 161.59 ||
vyasarjayaṃ praṇītāṃ tāṃ mārjayitvā kuśairatha  |
mārjane kriyamāṇe tu praṇītodakabindavaḥ  || 161.60 ||
patitāstatra tīrthāni jātāni guṇavanti ca  |
saṃjātā muniśārdūla snānātkratuphalapradā  || 161.61 ||
yālaṃkṛtā sarvakālaṃ devadevena śārṅgiṇā  |
sopānapaṅktiḥ sarveṣāṃ vaikuṇṭhārohaṇāya sā  || 161.62 ||
saṃmārjitāḥ kuśā yatra patitā bhūtale śubhe  |
kuśatarpaṇamākhyātaṃ bahupuṇyaphalapradam  || 161.63 ||
kuśaiśca tarpitāḥ sarve kuśatarpaṇamucyate  |
paścācca saṃgatā tatra gautamī kāraṇāntarāt || 161.64 ||
praṇītāyāṃ mahābuddhe praṇītāsaṃgamo'bhavat |
kuśatarpaṇadeśe tu tattīrthaṃ kuśatarpaṇam  || 161.65 ||
tatraiva kalpito yūpo mayā vindhyasya cottare  |
visṛṣṭo lokapūjyo'sau viṣṇorāsītsamāśrayaḥ  || 161.66 ||
akṣayaścābhavacchrīmānakṣayo'sau vaṭo'bhavat |
nityaśca kālarūpo'sau smaraṇātkratupuṇyadaḥ  || 161.67 ||
maddevayajanaṃ cedaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyamucyate  |
saṃpūrṇe tu kratau viṣṇurmayā bhaktyā prasāditaḥ  || 161.68 ||
yo virāḍucyate vede yasmānmūrtamajāyata  |
yasmācca mama cotpattiryasyedaṃ vikṛtaṃ jagat || 161.69 ||
tamahaṃ devadeveśamabhivandya vyasarjayam  |
yojanāni caturviṃśanmaddevayajanaṃ śubham  || 161.70 ||
tasmādadyāpi kuṇḍāni santi ca trīṇi nārada  |
yajñeśvarasvarūpāṇi viṣṇorvai cakrapāṇinaḥ  || 161.71 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti cākhyātaṃ maddevayajanaṃ ca tat |
tatrasthaḥ kṛmikīṭādiḥ so'pyante muktibhājanam  || 161.72 ||
dharmabījaṃ muktibījaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyamucyate  |
viśeṣādgautamīśliṣṭo deśaḥ puṇyatamo'bhavat || 161.73 ||
praṇītāsaṃgame cāpi kuśatarpaṇa eva vā  |
