snānadānādi yaḥ kuryātsa gacchetparamaṃ padam  || 161.74 ||
smaraṇaṃ paṭhanaṃ vāpi śravaṇaṃ cāpi bhaktitaḥ  |
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ viduḥ  || 161.75 ||
ubhayostīrayostatra tīrthānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  |
ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi teṣu puṇyaṃ puroditam  || 161.76 ||
vārāṇasyā api mune kuśatarpaṇamuttamam  |
nānena sadṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ vidyate sacarācare  || 161.77 ||
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ smaraṇādapi nāśanam  |
tīrthametanmune proktaṃ svargadvāraṃ mahītale  || 161.78 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
manyutīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  |
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ smaraṇādaghanāśanam  || 162.1 ||
tasya prabhāvaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāvahito mune  |
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca saṃgaro'bhūnmithaḥ purā  || 162.2 ||
tatrājayannaiva surā dānavā jayino'bhavan  |
parāṅmukhāḥ suragaṇāḥ saṃgarādgatacetasaḥ  || 162.3 ||
māmabhyetya samūcuste dehi no'bhayakāraṇam  |
tānahaṃ pratyavocaṃ vai gaṅgāṃ gacchata sarvaśaḥ  || 162.4 ||
tatra vai gautamītīre stutvā devaṃ maheśvaram  |
anapāyanirāyāsa sahajānandasundaram  || 162.5 ||
lapsyate sarvavibudhā jayaheturmaheśvarāt |
tathetyuktvā suragaṇāḥ stuvanti sma maheśvaram  || 162.6 ||
tapo'tapyanta kecidvai nanṛtuśca tathāpare  |
asnāpayaṃśca kecicca'pūjayaṃśca tathāpare  || 162.7 ||
tataḥ prasanno bhagavāñśūlapāṇirmaheśvaraḥ  |
devānathābravīttuṣṭo vriyatāṃ yadabhīpsitam  || 162.8 ||
devā ūcuḥ surapatiṃ vijayāya dadasva naḥ  |
puruṣaṃ paramaślāghyaṃ raṇeṣu purataḥ sthitam  || 162.9 ||
yadbāhubalamāśritya bhavāmaḥ sukhino vayam  |
tathetyuvāca bhagavān devān prati maheśvaraḥ  || 162.10 ||
ātmanastejasā kaścinnirmitaḥ parameṣṭhinā  |
manyunāmānamatyugraṃ devasainyapurogamam  || 162.11 ||
taṃ natvā tridaśāḥ sarve śivaṃ natvā svamālayam  |
manyunā saha cābhyetya punaryuddhāya tasthire  || 162.12 ||
yuddhe sthitvā tu danujairdaiteyaiśca mahābalaiḥ  |
vibudhā jātasaṃnaddhā manyumūcuḥ puraḥ sthitāḥ  || 162.13 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
sāmarthyaṃ tava paśyāmaḥ paścādyotsyāmahe paraiḥ  |
tasmāddarśaya cātmānaṃ manyo'smākaṃ yuyutsatām  || 162.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
taddevavacanaṃ śrutvā manyurāha smayanniva  ||* 162.15 ||
{manyuruvāca̱ }
janitā mama deveśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadṛkprabhuḥ  |
yaḥ sarvaṃ vetti sarveṣāṃ dhāmanāma manaḥsthitam  || 162.16 ||
naiva kaścicca taṃ vetti yaḥ sarvaṃ vetti sarvadā  |
amūrtaṃ mūrtamapyetadvetti kartā jaganmayaḥ  || 162.17 ||
paro'sau bhagavān sākṣāttathā divyantarikṣagaḥ  |
kastasya rūpaṃ yo veda kasya kartā jaganmayaḥ  || 162.18 ||
evaṃvidhādahaṃ jāto māṃ kathaṃ vettumarhatha  |
athavā draṣṭukāmā vai bhavanto mānupaśyata  || 162.19 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktvā darśayāmāsa manyū rūpaṃ svakaṃ mahat |
tārtīyacakṣuṣodbhūtaṃ bhavasya parameṣṭhinaḥ  || 162.20 ||
tejasā saṃbhṛtaṃ rūpaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ taducyate  |
pauruṣaṃ puruṣeṣveva ahaṃkāraśca jantuṣu  || 162.21 ||
krodhaḥ sarvasya yo bhīma upasaṃhārakṛdbhavet |
taṃ śaṃkarapratinidhiṃ jvalantaṃ nijatejasā  || 162.22 ||
sarvāyudhadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇemuḥ sarvadevatāḥ  |
vitresurdaityadanujāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ surāḥ  || 162.23 ||
bhūtvā manyumathocuste tvaṃ senānīḥ prabho bhava  |
tvayā dattamidaṃ rājyaṃ manyo bhokṣyāmahe vayam  || 162.24 ||
tasmātsarveṣu kāryeṣu jetā tvaṃ jayavardhanaḥ  |
tvamindrastvaṃ ca varuṇo lokapālāstvameva ca  || 162.25 ||
asmāsu sarvadeveṣu praviśa tvaṃ jayāya vai  |
manyuḥ provāca tān sarvān vinā matto na kiṃcana  || 162.26 ||
sarveṣvantaḥ praviṣṭo'haṃ na māṃ jānāti kaścana  |
sa eva bhagavānmanyustato jātaḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 162.27 ||
sa eva rudrarūpī syādrudro manyuḥ śivo'bhavat |
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ hi manyunā  || 162.28 ||
tamavāpya surāḥ sarve jayamāpuśca saṃgare  |
jayo manyuśca śauryaṃ ca īśatejaḥsamudbhavam  || 162.29 ||
manyunā jayamāpyātha kṛtvā daityaiśca saṃgamam  |
yathāgataṃ yayuḥ sarve manyunā parirakṣitāḥ  || 162.30 ||
yatra vai gautamītīre śivamārādhya te surāḥ  |
manyumāpurjayaṃ caiva manyutīrthaṃ taducyate  || 162.31 ||
utpattiṃ ca tathā manyoryo naraḥ prayataḥ smaret |
vijayo jāyate tasya na kaiścitparibhūyate  || 162.32 ||
na manyutīrthasadṛśaṃ pāvanaṃ hi mahāmune  |
yatra sākṣānmanyurūpī sarvadā śaṃkaraḥ sthitaḥ  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca smaraṇaṃ sarvakāmadam  || 162.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sārasvataṃ nāma tīrthaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  || 163.1 ||
sarvarogapraśamanaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam  |
tatremaṃ śṛṇu vṛttāntaṃ vistareṇātha nārada  || 163.2 ||
puṣpotkaṭātpūrvabhāge parvato lokaviśrutaḥ  |
śubhro nāma giriśreṣṭho gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 163.3 ||
śākalya iti vikhyāto muniḥ paramanaiṣṭhikaḥ  |
tasmiñśubhre puṇyagirau tapastepe hyanuttamam  || 163.4 ||
tapasyantaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ gautamītīramāśritam  |
sarve bhūtagaṇā nityaṃ praṇamanti stuvanti tam  || 163.5 ||
agniśuśrūṣaṇaparaṃ vedādhyayanatatparam  |
ṛṣigandharvasumanaḥ sevite tatra parvate  || 163.6 ||
tasmin girau mahāpuṇye devadvijabhayaṃkaraḥ  |
yajñadveṣī brahmahantā paraśurnāma rākṣasaḥ  || 163.7 ||
kāmarūpī vicarati nānārūpadharo vane  |
kṣaṇaṃ ca brahmarūpeṇa kadācidvyāghrarūpadhṛk || 163.8 ||
kadāciddevarūpeṇa kadācitpaśurūpadhṛk |
kadācitpramadārūpaḥ kadācinmṛgarūpataḥ  || 163.9 ||
kadācidbālarūpeṇa evaṃ carati pāpakṛt |
yatrāste brāhmaṇo vidvāñśākalyo munisattamaḥ  || 163.10 ||
tamāyāti mahāpāpī paraśū rākṣasādhamaḥ  |
śuciṣmantaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ paraśurnityameva ca  || 163.11 ||
netuṃ hantuṃ pravṛtto'pi na śaśāka sa pāpakṛt |
sa kadāciddvijaśreṣṭho devānabhyarcya yatnataḥ  || 163.12 ||
bhoktukāmaḥ kilāyātastatrāyātparaśurmune  |
brahmarūpadharo bhūtvā śithilaḥ palito'balī  |
kanyāmādāya kāṃcicca śākalyaṃ vākyamabravīt || 163.13 ||
{paraśuruvāca̱ }
bhojanasyārthinaṃ viddhi māṃ ca kanyāmimāṃ dvija  |
ātithyakāle saṃprāptaṃ kṛtakṛtyo'si mānada  || 163.14 ||
ta eva dhanyā loke'smin yeṣāmatithayo gṛhāt |
pūrṇābhilāṣā niryānti jīvanto'pi mṛtāḥ pare  || 163.15 ||
bhojane tūpaviṣṭe tu ātmārthaṃ kalpitaṃ tu yat |
atithibhyastu yo dadyāddattā tena vasuṃdharā  || 163.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā tu śākalyo dadāmītyevamabravīt |
āsane copaveśyāthā jñānāttaṃ paraśuṃ dvijam  || 163.17 ||
yathānyāyaṃ pūjayitvā śākalyo bhojanaṃ dadau  |
āpośanaṃ kare kṛtvā paraśurvākyamabravīt || 163.18 ||
{paraśuruvāca̱ }
dūrādabhyāgataṃ śrāntamanugacchanti devatāḥ  |
tasmiṃstṛpte tu tṛptāḥ syuratṛpte tu viparyayaḥ  || 163.19 ||
atithiścāpavādī ca dvāvetau viśvabāndhavau  |
apavādī haretpāpamatithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ  || 163.20 ||
abhyāgataṃ pathi śrāntaṃ sāvajñaṃ yo'bhivīkṣate  |
tatkṣaṇādeva naśyanti tasya dharmayaśaḥśriyaḥ  || 163.21 ||
tasmādabhyāgataḥ śrānto yāce'haṃ tvāṃ dvijottama  |
dāsyase yadi me kāmaṃ tadbhokṣye'haṃ na cānyathā  || 163.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
dattamityeva śākalyo bhuṅkṣvetyevāha rākṣasam  |
tataḥ provāca paraśurahaṃ rākṣasasattamaḥ  || 163.23 ||
nāhaṃ dvijastava ripurna vṛddhaḥ palitaḥ kṛśaḥ  |
bahūni me vyatītāni varṣāṇi tvāṃ prapaśyataḥ  || 163.24 ||
śuṣyanti mama gātrāṇi grīṣme svalpodakaṃ yathā  |
tasmānneṣye sānugaṃ tvāṃ bhakṣayiṣye dvijottama  || 163.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śrutvā paraśuvākyaṃ tacchākalyo vākyamabravīt ||* 163.26 ||
{śākalya uvāca̱ }
ye mahākulasaṃbhūtā vijñātasakalāgamāḥ  |
tatpratiśrutamabhyeti na jātvatra viparyayam  || 163.27 ||
yathocitaṃ kuru sakhe tathāpi śṛṇu me vacaḥ  |
nihantumapyudyateṣu vaktavyaṃ hitamuttamaiḥ  || 163.28 ||
brāhmaṇo'haṃ vajratanuḥ sarvato rakṣako hariḥ  |
pādau rakṣatu me viṣṇuḥ śiro devo janārdanaḥ  || 163.29 ||
bāhū rakṣatu vārāhaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ rakṣatu kūrmarāṭ |
hṛdayaṃ rakṣatātkṛṣṇo hyaṅgulī rakṣatānmṛgaḥ  || 163.30 ||
mukhaṃ rakṣatu vāgīśo netre rakṣatu pakṣigaḥ  |
śrotraṃ rakṣatu vitteśaḥ sarvato rakṣatādbhavaḥ  |
nānāpatsvekaśaraṇaṃ devo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam  || 163.31 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tu śākalyo naya vā bhakṣa vā sukham  |
māṃ rākṣasendra paraśo tvamidānīmatandritaḥ  || 163.32 ||
rākṣasastasya vacanādbhakṣaṇāya samudyataḥ  |
nāstyeva hṛdaye nūnaṃ pāpināṃ karuṇākaṇaḥ  || 163.33 ||
daṃṣṭrākarālavadano gatvā tasyāntikaṃ tadā  |
brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ nirīkṣyaivaṃ paraśurvākyamabravīt || 163.34 ||
{paraśuruvāca̱ }
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ tvāṃ paśye'haṃ dvijottama  |
sahasrapādaśirasaṃ sahasrākṣakaraṃ vibhum  || 163.35 ||
sarvabhūtaikanilayaṃ chandorūpaṃ jaganmayam  |
tvāmadya vipra paśyāmi nāsti te pūrvakaṃ vapuḥ  || 163.36 ||
tasmātprasādaye vipra tvameva śaraṇaṃ bhava  |
jñānaṃ dehi mahābuddhe tīrthaṃ brūhyaghaniṣkṛtim  || 163.37 ||
mahatāṃ darśanaṃ brahmañjāyate nahi niṣphalam  |
dveṣādajñānato vāpi prasaṅgādvā pramādataḥ  || 163.38 ||
ayasaḥ sparśasaṃsparśo rukmatvāyaiva jāyate  ||* 163.39 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etadvākyaṃ samākarṇya rākṣasena samīritam  |
śākalyaḥ kṛpayā prāha varadā sā sarasvatī  || 163.40 ||
tavācirāddaityapate tataḥ stuhi janārdanam  |
manorathaphalaprāptau nānyannārāyaṇastuteḥ  || 163.41 ||
kiṃcidapyasti loke'smin kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu rākṣasa  |
prasannā tava sā devī madvākyācca bhaviṣyati  || 163.42 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā sa paraśurgaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm  |
snātvā śuciryatamanā gaṅgāmabhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ  || 163.43 ||
tatrāpaśyaddivyarūpāṃ divyagandhānulepanām  |
sarasvatīṃ jagaddhātrīṃ śākalyavacane sthitām  || 163.44 ||
jagajjāḍyaharāṃ viśva jananīṃ bhuvaneśvarīm  |
tāmuvāca vinītātmā paraśurgatakalmaṣaḥ  || 163.45 ||
{paraśuruvāca̱ }
guruḥ śākalya ityāha mākāntaṃ stuhi vidhvajam  |
tava prasādātsā śaktiryathā me syāttathā kuru  || 163.46 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathāstviti ca sā prāha paraśuṃ śrīsarasvatī  |
sarasvatyāḥ prasādena paraśustaṃ janārdanam  || 163.47 ||
tuṣṭāva vividhairvākyaistatastuṣṭo'bhavaddhariḥ  |
varaṃ prādādrākṣasāya kṛpāsindhurjanārdanaḥ  || 163.48 ||
{janārdana uvāca̱ }
yadyanmanogataṃ rakṣastattatsarvaṃ bhaviṣyati  ||* 163.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śākalyasya prasādena gautamyāśca prasādataḥ  |
sarasvatyāḥ prasādena narasiṃhaprasādataḥ  || 163.50 ||
pāpiṣṭho'pi tadā rakṣaḥ paraśurdivameyivān  |
sarvatīrthāṅghripadmasya prasādācchārṅgadhanvanaḥ  || 163.51 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ sārasvatamiti śrutam  |
tatra snānena dānena viṣṇuloke mahīyate  || 163.52 ||
vāgjavaiṣṇavaśākalya paraśuprabhavāṇi hi  |
bahūnyabhūvaṃstīrthāni tasmin vai śvetaparvate  || 163.53 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ciccikātīrthamityuktaṃ sarvarogavināśanam  |
sarvacintāpraharaṇaṃ sarvaśāntikaraṃ nṛṇām  || 164.1 ||
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śubhre tasminnagottame  |
gaṅgāyā uttare pāre yatra devo gadādharaḥ  || 164.2 ||
ciccikaḥ pakṣirāṭtatra bheruṇḍo yo'bhidhīyate  |
sadā vasati tatraiva māṃsāśī śvetaparvate  || 164.3 ||
nānāpuṣpaphalākīrṇaiḥ sarvartukusumairnagaiḥ  |
sevite dvijamukhyaiśca gautamyā copaśobhite  || 164.4 ||
siddhacāraṇagandharva kiṃnarāmarasaṃkule  |
tatsamīpe nagaḥ kaściddvipadāṃ ca catuṣpadām  || 164.5 ||
rogārtikṣuttṛṣācintā maraṇānāṃ na bhājanam  |
evaṃ guṇānvite śaile nānāmunigaṇāvṛte  || 164.6 ||
pūrvadeśādhipaḥ kaścitpavamāna iti śrutaḥ  |
kṣatradharmarataḥ śrīmān devabrāhmaṇapālakaḥ  || 164.7 ||
balena mahatā yuktaḥ sapurodhā vanaṃ yayau  |
reme strībhirmanojñābhirnṛtyavāditrajaiḥ sukhaiḥ  || 164.8 ||
sa ca evaṃ dhanuṣpāṇirmṛgayāśīlibhirvṛtaḥ  |
evaṃ bhraman kadācitsa śrānto drumamupāgataḥ  || 164.9 ||
gautamītīrasaṃbhūtaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇairvṛtam  |
āśramāṇāṃ gṛhapatiṃ dharmajñamiva sevitam  || 164.10 ||
tamāśritya nagaśreṣṭhaṃ pavamāno nṛpottamaḥ  |
sa viśrānto janavṛta īkṣāṃ cakre nagottamam  || 164.11 ||
tatrāpaśyaddvijaṃ sthūlaṃ dvimukhaṃ śobhanākṛtim  |
cintāviṣṭaṃ tathā śrāntaṃ tamapṛcchannṛpottamaḥ  || 164.12 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
ko bhavān dvimukhaḥ pakṣī cintāvāniva lakṣyase  |
naivātra kaścidduḥkhārtaḥ kasmāttvaṃ duḥkhamāgataḥ  || 164.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ provāca nṛpatiṃ pavamānaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ  |
samāśvastamanāḥ pakṣī cicciko niḥśvasanmuhuḥ  || 164.14 ||
{ciccika uvāca̱ }
matto bhayaṃ na cānyeṣāṃ mama vānyopapāditam  |
nānāpuṣpaphalākīrṇaṃ munibhiḥ parisevitam  || 164.15 ||
paśyeyaṃ śūnyamevādriṃ tataḥ śocāmi māmaham  |
na labhāmi sukhaṃ kiṃcinna tṛpyāmi kadācana  |
nidrāṃ prāpnomi na kvāpi na viśrāntiṃ na nirvṛtim  || 164.16 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
dvimukhasya dvijasyoktaṃ śrutvā rājātivismitaḥ  ||* 164.17 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
ko bhavān kiṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kasmācchūnyaśca parvataḥ  |
ekenāsyena tṛpyanti prāṇino'tra nagottame  || 164.18 ||
kimutāsyadvayena tvaṃ na tṛptimupayāsyasi  |
kiṃ vā te duṣkṛtaṃ prāptamiha janmanyatho purā  || 164.19 ||
tatsarvaṃ śaṃsa me satyaṃ trāsye tvāṃ mahato bhayāt ||* 164.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
rājānaṃ taṃ dvijaḥ prāha niḥśvasannatha ciccikaḥ  ||* 164.21 ||
{ciccika uvāca̱ }
vakṣye'haṃ tvāṃ pūrvavṛttaṃ pavamāna śṛṇuṣva tat |
ahaṃ dvijātipravaro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ  || 164.22 ||
kulīno viditaprājñaḥ kāryahantā kalipriyaḥ  |
vade purastathā pṛṣṭhe anyadanyacca jantuṣu  || 164.23 ||
paravṛddhyā sadā duḥkhī māyayā viśvavañcakaḥ  |
kṛtaghnaḥ satyarahitaḥ paranindāvicakṣaṇaḥ  || 164.24 ||
mitrasvāmigurudrohī dambhācāro'tinirghṛṇaḥ  |
manasā karmaṇā vācā tāpayāmi janān bahūn  || 164.25 ||
ayameva vinodo me sadā yatparahiṃsanam  |
yugmabhedaṃ gaṇocchedaṃ maryādābhedanaṃ sadā  || 164.26 ||
karomi nirvicāro'haṃ vidvatsevāparāṅmukhaḥ  |
na mayā sadṛśaḥ kaścitpātakī bhavanatraye  || 164.27 ||
tenāhaṃ dvimukho jātastāpanādduḥkhabhāgyaham  |
tasmādduḥkhena saṃtaptaḥ śūnyo'yaṃ parvato mama  || 164.28 ||
anyacca śṛṇu bhūpāla vākyaṃ dharmārthasaṃhitam  |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ tadvinā tadavāpyate  || 164.29 ||
kṣatriyaḥ saṃgaraṃ gatvā athavānyatra saṃgarāt |
palāyantaṃ nyastaśastraṃ viśvastaṃ ca parāṅmukham  || 164.30 ||
avijñātaṃ copaviṣṭaṃ bibhemīti ca vādinam  |
taṃ yadi kṣatriyo hanyātsa tu syādbrahmaghātakaḥ  || 164.31 ||
adhītaṃ vismarati yastvaṃ karoti tathottamam  |
anādaraṃ ca guruṣu tamāhurbrahmaghātakam  || 164.32 ||
pratyakṣe ca priyaṃ vakti parokṣe paruṣāṇi ca  |
anyaddhṛdi vacasyanyatkarotyanyatsadaiva yaḥ  || 164.33 ||
gurūṇāṃ śapathaṃ kartā dveṣṭā brāhmaṇanindakaḥ  |
mithyā vinītaḥ pāpātmā sa tu syādbrahmaghātakaḥ  || 164.34 ||
devaṃ vedamathādhyātmaṃ dharmabrāhmaṇasaṃgatim  |
etānnindati yo dveṣātsa tu syādbrahmaghātakaḥ  || 164.35 ||
evaṃ bhūto'pyahaṃ rājan dambhārthaṃ lajjayā tathā  |
sadvṛtta iva varte'haṃ tasmādrājan dvijo'bhavam  || 164.36 ||
evaṃ bhūto'pi satkarma kiṃcitkartāsmi kutracit |
tenāhaṃ karmaṇā rājan svataḥ smartā purā kṛtam  || 164.37 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacciccikavacaḥ śrutvā pavamānaḥ suvismitaḥ  |
karmaṇā kena te muktirityāha nṛpatirdvijam  || 164.38 ||
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā nṛpatiṃ prāha pakṣirāṭ ||* 164.39 ||
{ciccika uvāca̱ }
asminneva nagaśreṣṭhe gautamyā uttare taṭe  |
gadādharaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tatra māṃ naya suvrata  || 164.40 ||
taddhi tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  |
sarvakāmapradaṃ ceti mahadbhirmunibhiḥ śrutam  || 164.41 ||
na gautamyāstathā viṣṇoraparaṃ kleśanāśanam  |
sarvabhāvena tattīrthaṃ paśyeyamiti me matiḥ  || 164.42 ||
matkṛtena prayatnena naitacchakyaṃ kadācana  |
kathamākāṅkṣitaprāptirbhavedduṣkṛtakarmaṇām  || 164.43 ||
saprayatno'pyahaṃ vīra na paśye tatsuduṣkaram  |
tasmāttava prasādācca paśyeyaṃ hi gadādharam  || 164.44 ||
avijñāpitaduḥkhajñaṃ karuṇāvaruṇālayam  |
yasmin dṛṣṭe bhavakleśā na dṛśyante punarnaraiḥ  || 164.45 ||
dṛṣṭvaiva taṃ divaṃ yāsye prasādāttava suvrata  ||* 164.46 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktaḥ sa nṛpatiściccikena dvijanmanā  |
darśayāmāsa taṃ devaṃ tāṃ ca gaṅgāṃ dvijanmane  || 164.47 ||
tataḥ sa ciccikaḥ snātvā gaṅgāṃ trailokyapāvanīm  ||* 164.48 ||
{ciccika uvāca̱ }
gaṅge gautami yāvattvāṃ trijagatpāvanīṃ naraḥ  |
na paśyatyucyate tāvadihāmutrāpi pātakī  || 164.49 ||
tasmātsarvāgasamapi māmuddhara saridvare  |
saṃsāre dehināmanyā na gatiḥ kāpi kutracit |
tvāṃ vinā viṣṇucaraṇa saroruhasamudbhave  || 164.50 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śraddhāviśuddhātmā gaṅgaikaśaraṇo dvijaḥ  |
snānaṃ cakre smarannantargaṅge trāyasva māmiti  || 164.51 ||
gadādharaṃ tato natvā paśyatsu nagavāsiṣu  |
pavamānābhyanujñātastadaiva divamākramat || 164.52 ||
pavamānaḥ svanagaraṃ prayayau sānugastataḥ  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ pāvamānaṃ saciccikam  || 164.53 ||
gadādharaṃ koṭitīrthamiti vedavido viduḥ  |
koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ karma kṛtaṃ tatra bhavennṛṇām  || 164.54 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhadratīrthamiti proktaṃ sarvāniṣṭanivāraṇam  |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ mahāśāntipradāyakam  || 165.1 ||
ādityasya priyā bhāryā uṣā tvāṣṭrī pativratā  |
chāyāpi bhāryā savitustasyāḥ putraḥ śanaiścaraḥ  || 165.2 ||
tasya svasā viṣṭiriti bhīṣaṇā pāparūpiṇī  |
tāṃ kanyāṃ savitā kasmai dadāmīti matiṃ dadhe  || 165.3 ||
yasmai yasmai dātukāmaḥ sūryo lokaguruḥ prabhuḥ  |
tacchrutvā bhīṣaṇā ceti kiṃ kurmo bhāryayānayā  |
evaṃ tu vartamāne sā pitaraṃ prāha duḥkhitā  || 165.4 ||
{viṣṭiruvāca̱ }
bālāmeva pitā yastu dadyātkanyāṃ surūpiṇe  |
sa kṛtārtho bhavelloke na cedduṣkṛtavān pitā  || 165.6 ||
caturthādvatsarādūrdhvaṃ yāvanna daśamātyayaḥ  |
tāvadvivāhaḥ kanyāyāḥ pitrā kāryaḥ prayatnataḥ  || 165.7 ||
śrīmate viduṣe yūne kulīnāya yaśasvine  |
udārāya sanāthāya kanyā deyā varāya vai  || 165.8 ||
etaccedanyathā kuryātpitā sa nirayī sadā  |
dharmasya sādhanaṃ kanyā viduṣāmapi bhāskara  || 165.9 ||
narakasyeva mūrkhāṇāṃ kāmopahatacetasām  |
ekataḥ pṛthivī kṛtsnā saśailavanakānanā  || 165.10 ||
svalaṃkṛtopādhihīnā sukanyā caikataḥ smṛtā  |
vikrīṇīte yaśca kanyāmaśvaṃ vā gāṃ tilānapi  || 165.11 ||
na tasya rauravādibhyaḥ kadācinniṣkṛtirbhavet |
vivāhātikramaḥ kāryo na kanyāyāḥ kadācana  || 165.12 ||
tasmin kṛte yatpituḥ syātpāpaṃ tatkena kathyate  |
yāvallajjāṃ na jānāti yāvatkrīḍati pāṃśubhiḥ  || 165.13 ||
tāvatkanyā pradātavyā no cetpitroradhogatiḥ  |
pituḥ svarūpaṃ putraḥ syādyaḥ pitā putra eva saḥ  || 165.14 ||
ātmanaḥ sukhitāṃ loke ko na kuryātkaroti ca  |
yatkanyāyāṃ pitā kuryāddānaṃ pūjanamīkṣaṇam  || 165.15 ||
yatkṛtaṃ tatkṛtaṃ vidyāttāsu dattaṃ tadakṣayam  |
yaddattaṃ tāsu kanyāsu tadānantyāya kalpate  || 165.16 ||
putreṣu caiva pautreṣu ko na kuryātsukhaṃ rave  |
karoti yaḥ kanyakānāṃ sa saṃpadbhājanaṃ bhavet || 165.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ tāṃ vādinīṃ kanyāṃ viṣṭiṃ provāca bhāskaraḥ  ||* 165.18 ||
{sūrya uvāca̱ }
kiṃ karomi na gṛhṇāti tvāṃ kaścidbhīṣaṇākṛtim  |
kulaṃ rūpaṃ vayo vittaṃ vidyāṃ vṛttaṃ suśīlatām  || 165.19 ||
mithaḥ paśyanti saṃbandhe vivāhe strīṣu puṃsu ca  |
asmāsu sarvamapyasti vinā tava guṇaiḥ śubhe  |
kiṃ karomi kva dāsyāmi vṛthā māṃ dhikkaroṣi kim  || 165.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā punastāṃ ca viṣṭiṃ provāca bhāskaraḥ  ||* 165.21 ||
{sūrya uvāca̱ }
yasmai kasmai ca dātavyā tvaṃ vai yadyanumanyase  |
dīyase'dya mayā viṣṭe anujānīhi māṃ tataḥ  || 165.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pitaraṃ prāha sā viṣṭirbhartā putrā dhanaṃ sukham  |
āyū rūpaṃ ca saṃprītirjāyate prāktanānugam  || 165.23 ||
yatpurā vihitaṃ karma prāṇinā sādhvasādhu vā  |
phalaṃ tadanurodhena prāpyate'pi bhavāntare  || 165.24 ||
svadoṣa eva tatpitrā parihartavya ādarāt |
tādṛgeva phalaṃ tu syādyādṛgācaritaṃ purā  || 165.25 ||
tasmāttaddānasaṃbandhaṃ svavaṃśānugataṃ pitā  |
karoti śeṣaṃ daivena yadbhāvyaṃ tadbhaviṣyati  || 165.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tacchrutvā duhiturvākyaṃ tvaṣṭuḥ putrāya bhīṣaṇām  |
viśvarūpāya tāṃ prādādviṣṭiṃ lokabhayaṃkarīm  || 165.27 ||
viśvarūpo'pi tadvacca bhīṣaṇo bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ  |
evaṃ mithaḥ saṃcaratoḥ śīlarūpasamānayoḥ  || 165.28 ||
prītiḥ kadācidvaiṣamyaṃ daṃpatyorabhavanmithaḥ  |
gaṇḍo nāmābhavatputro hyatigaṇḍastathaiva ca  || 165.29 ||
raktākṣaḥ krodhanaścaiva vyayo durmukha eva ca  |
tebhyaḥ kanīyānabhavaddharṣaṇo nāma puṇyabhāk || 165.30 ||
sutaḥ suśīlaḥ subhagaḥ śāntaḥ śuddhamatiḥ śuciḥ  |
sa kadācidyamagṛhaṃ draṣṭuṃ mātulamabhyagāt || 165.31 ||
sa dadarśa bahūñjantūn svargasthāniva duḥkhinaḥ  |
sa mātulaṃ tu papraccha natvā dharmaṃ sanātanam  || 165.32 ||
{harṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
ka ime sukhinastāta pacyante narake ca ke  ||* 165.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ pṛṣṭo dharmarājaḥ sarvaṃ prāha yathārthavat |
tatkarmaṇāṃ gatiṃ sarvāmaśeṣeṇa nyavedayat || 165.34 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
vihitasya na kurvanti ye kadācidatikramam  |
na te paśyanti nirayaṃ kadācidapi mānavāḥ  || 165.35 ||
na mānayanti ye śāstraṃ nācāraṃ na bahuśrutān  |
vihitātikramaṃ kuryurye te narakagāminaḥ  || 165.36 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa tu śrutvā dharmavākyaṃ harṣaṇaḥ punarabravīt ||* 165.37 ||
{harṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
pitā tvāṣṭro bhīṣaṇaśca mātā viṣṭiśca bhīṣaṇā  |
bhrātaraśca mahātmāno yena te śāntabuddhayaḥ  || 165.38 ||
surūpāśca bhaviṣyanti nirdoṣā maṅgalapradāḥ  |
tanme karma vadasvādya tatkartāsmi surottama  || 165.39 ||
anyathā tānna gaccheyamityuktaḥ prāha dharmarāṭ |
harṣaṇaṃ śuddhabuddhiṃ taṃ harṣaṇo'si na saṃśayaḥ  || 165.40 ||
bahavaḥ syuḥ sutāḥ kecinnaiva te kulatantavaḥ  |
eka eva sutaḥ kaścidyena taddhriyate kulam  || 165.41 ||
kulasyādhārabhūto yo yaḥ pitroḥ priyakārakaḥ  |
yaḥ pūrvajānuddharati sa putrastvitaro gadaḥ  || 165.42 ||
yasmāttvayānurūpaṃ me proktaṃ mātāmaha priyam  |
tasmāttvaṃ gautamīṃ gaccha snātvā niyatamānasaḥ  || 165.43 ||
stuhi viṣṇuṃ jagadyoniṃ śāntaṃ prītena cetasā  |
sa tu prīto yadi bhavetsarvamiṣṭaṃ pradāsyati  || 165.44 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti śrutvā dharmavākyaṃ harṣaṇo gautamīṃ yayau  |
śucistuṣṭāva deveśaṃ hariṃ prīto'bhavaddhariḥ  || 165.45 ||
harṣaṇāya tataḥ prādātkulabhadraṃ tatastu saḥ  |
sarvābhadrapraśamana pūrvakaṃ bhadramastu te  || 165.46 ||
tadbhadrā procyate viṣṭiḥ pitā bhadrastathā sutāḥ  |
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ bhadratīrthaṃ taducyate  || 165.47 ||
sarvamaṅgaladaṃ puṃsāṃ tatra bhadrapatirhariḥ  |
tattīrthasevināṃ puṃsāṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam  |
maṅgalaikanidhiḥ sākṣāddevadevo janārdanaḥ  || 165.48 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
patatritīrthamākhyātaṃ rogaghnaṃ pāpanāśanam  |
tasya śravaṇamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ  || 166.1 ||
babhūvatuḥ kaśyapasya sutāvaruṇāvīśvarau  |
saṃpātiśca jaṭāyuśca saṃbhavetāṃ tadanvaye  || 166.2 ||
tārkṣyaprajāpateḥ putrāvaruṇo garuḍastathā  |
tadanvaye saṃbhūtaḥ ca saṃpātiḥ patagottamaḥ  || 166.3 ||
jaṭāyuriti vikhyāto hyaparaḥ sodaro'nujaḥ  |
anyonyaspardhayā yuktāvunmattau svabalena tau  || 166.4 ||
saṃjagmaturdinakaraṃ namaskartuṃ vihāyasi  |
yāvatsūryasya sāmīpyaṃ prāptau tau vihagottamau  || 166.5 ||
dagdhapakṣāvubhau śrāntau patitau girimūrdhani  |
bāndhavau patitau dṛṣṭvā niśceṣṭau gatacetasau  || 166.6 ||
tāvadduḥkhābhibhūto'sāvaruṇaḥ prāha bhāskaram  |
tau dṛṣṭvā tvaruṇaḥ sūry.aṃ prāhedaṃ patitau bhuvi  |
āśvāsayaitau tigmāṃśo yāvannaitau mariṣyataḥ  || 166.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā dinakaro jīvayāmāsa tau khagau  |
garuḍo'pi tayoḥ śrutvā avasthāṃ saha viṣṇunā  || 166.8 ||
āgatyāśvāsayāmāsa sukhaṃ cakre ca nārada  |
sarva eva tadā jagmurgaṅgāṃ tāpāpanuttaye  || 166.9 ||
jaṭāyuścāruṇaścaiva saṃpātirgaruḍastathā  |
sūryo viṣṇustatprayayau tattīrthaṃ bahupuṇyadam  || 166.10 ||
patatritīrthamākhyātaṃ viṣaghnaṃ sarvakāmadam  |
svayaṃ sūryastathā viṣṇuḥ suparṇenāruṇena ca  || 166.11 ||
āsate gautamītīre tathaiva vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ  |
trayāṇāmapi devānāṃ sthitestattīrthamuttamam  || 166.12 ||
tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā namaskuryātsurānimān  |
ādhivyādhivinirmuktaḥ sa paraṃ saukhyamāpnuyāt || 166.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vipratīrthamiti khyātaṃ tathā nārāyaṇaṃ viduḥ  |
tasyākhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu vismayakārakam  || 167.1 ||
antarvedyāṃ dvijaḥ kaścidbrāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ  |
tasya putrā mahāprājñā guṇarūpadayānvitāḥ  || 167.2 ||
teṣāṃ kanīyān yo bhrātā śānto guṇagaṇairvṛtaḥ  |
āsandiva iti khyātaḥ sarvajñāno mahāmatiḥ  || 167.3 ||
vivāhāya pitā tasmāai āsandivāya yatnavān  |
etasminnantare rātrau suptaṃ taṃ dvijaputrakam  || 167.4 ||
aviṣṇusmaraṇaṃ saumya śiraskamasamāhitam  |
āsandivaṃ krūrarūpā rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī  || 167.5 ||
tamādāyāgamacchīghraṃ gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  |
śrīgireruttare pāre bahubrāhmaṇasevitam  || 167.6 ||
nagaraṃ dharmanilayaṃ lakṣmyā nilayameva ca  |
tatra rājā bṛhatkīrtiḥ sarvakṣatraguṇānvitaḥ  || 167.7 ||
tasyāmitakṣemasubhikṣayuktaṃ  167.8
niśāvasāne dvijaputrayuktā  167.8
sā rākṣasī tatpuramāsasāda  167.8
manojñarūpāṇi bibharti nityam  167.8
sā kāmarūpeṇa caratyaśeṣāṃ  167.9
mahīmimāṃ tena samaṃ dvijena  167.9
godāvarīdakṣiṇatīrabhāge  167.9
vṛddhākṛtistaṃ dvijamāha bhīmā  167.9
{rākṣasyuvāca̱ }
eṣā tu gaṅgā dvijamukhya saṃdhyā  167.10
upāsyatāṃ vipravaraiḥ sametya  167.10
yathocitaṃ vipravarāstu kāle  167.10
nopāsate yatnata eva saṃdhyām  167.10
nīcāsta evābhihitāḥ sureśair 167.11
antyāvasāyipravarāsta ete  167.11
ahaṃ janitrī tava ceti vācyaṃ  167.11
no cedidānīṃ tvamupaiṣi nāśam  167.11
madvākyakartāsi yadi dvijendra  167.12
sukhaṃ kariṣye tava yatpriyaṃ ca  167.12
punaśca deśaṃ nilayaṃ gurūṃśca  167.12
saṃprāpayiṣye nanu satyametat 167.12
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa prāha kā tvaṃ dvijapuṃgavo'pi  167.13
sovāca taṃ rākṣasī kāmarūpā  167.13
viśvāsayantī śapathairanekais 167.13
taṃ bhrāntacittaṃ munirājaputram  167.13
kaṅkālinī nāma jagatprasiddhā  167.14
vipro'pi tāmāha niveditaṃ yat 167.14
tadeva kartāsmi na saṃśayo'tra  167.14
yattatpriyaṃ vacmi karomi caiva  167.14
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadvipravacanaṃ śrutvā rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī  |
vṛddhā tathāpi cārvaṅgī divyālaṃkārabhūṣaṇā  || 167.15 ||
dvijamādāya sarvatra matsuto'yaṃ guṇākaraḥ  |
evaṃ vadantī sarvatra yāti vakti karoti ca  || 167.16 ||
taṃ vipraṃ rūpasaubhāgya vayovidyāvibhūṣitam  |
tāṃ ca vṛddhāṃ guṇopetāmasya māteti menire  || 167.17 ||
tatra dvijavaraḥ kaścitsvāṃ kanyāṃ bhūṣaṇānvitām  |
rākṣasīṃ tāṃ puraskṛtya prādāttasmai dvijātaye  || 167.18 ||
sā kanyā taṃ patiṃ prāpya kṛtārthāsmītyacintayat |
sa dvijo'pi guṇairyuktāṃ patnīṃ dṛṣṭvā suduḥkhitaḥ  || 167.19 ||
{dvija uvāca̱ }
māmiyaṃ bhakṣayedeva rākṣasī pāparūpiṇī  |
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kasyaitatkathayāmi vā  || 167.20 ||
mahatsaṃkaṭamāpannaṃ rakṣayiṣyati ko'tra mām  |
bhāryā mameyaṃ kalyāṇī guṇarūpavayoyutā  |
enāmapyaśubhākasmādbhakṣayiṣyati rākṣasī  || 167.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etasminnantare tatra bhāryā sā guṇaśālinī  |
vṛddhāpyatidurādharṣā sā gatā kutracittadā  || 167.22 ||
praśrayāvanatā bhūtvā bālā cāpi pativratā  |
bhartāraṃ duḥkhitaṃ jñātvā patiṃ prāha rahaḥ śanaiḥ  || 167.23 ||
{bhāryovāca̱ }
kasmātte duḥkhamāpannaṃ svāmiṃstattvaṃ vadasva me  ||* 167.24 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śanaiḥ provāca tāṃ bhāryāṃ yathāvatpūrvavistaram  |
kimakathyaṃ priye mitre kulīnāyāṃ ca yoṣiti  || 167.25 ||
bhartṛvākyaṃ niśamyedaṃ provāca vadatāṃ varā  ||* 167.26 ||
{bhāryovāca̱ }
anātmanaḥ sarvato'pi bhayamasti gṛheṣvapi  |
kuto bhayaṃ hyātmavatāṃ kiṃ punargautamītaṭe  || 167.27 ||
vasatāṃ viṣṇubhaktānāṃ viraktānāṃ vivekinām  |
atra snātvā śucirbhūtvā stuhi devamanāmayam  || 167.28 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etadākarṇya gaṅgāyāṃ snātvā vigatakalmaṣaḥ  |
tuṣṭāva gautamītīre dvijo nārāyaṇaṃ tathā  || 167.29 ||
{dvija uvāca̱ }
tvamantarātmā jagato'sya nātha  167.30
tvameva kartāsya mukunda hartā  167.30
tvaṃ pālakaḥ pālayase na dīnam  167.30
anāthabandho narasiṃha kasmāt 167.30
śrutvaitatprārthanaṃ tasya jagacchokanivāraṇaḥ  |
nārāyaṇo'pi tāṃ pāpāṃ nijaghāna sa rākṣasīm  || 167.31 ||
sudarśanena cakreṇa sahasrāreṇa bhāsvatā  |
tasmai prādādvarāniṣṭān prāpayacca guruṃ prabhuḥ  || 167.32 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vipraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ viduḥ  |
snānadānena pūjādyairyatra sidhyati vāñchitam  || 167.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhānutīrthamiti khyātaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ māheśvaraṃ tathā  |
aindraṃ yāmyaṃ tathāgneyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  || 168.1 ||
abhiṣṭuta iti khyāto rājāsītpriyadarśanaḥ  |
hayamedhena puṇyena yaṣṭumārabdhavān surān  || 168.2 ||
tatrartvijaḥ ṣoḍaśa syurvasiṣṭhātripurogamāḥ  |
kṣatriye yajamāne tu yajñabhūmiḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 168.3 ||
brāhmaṇe dīkṣite rājā bhuvaṃ dāsyati yajñiyām  |
bhūpatau dīkṣite dātā ko bhavetko nu yācate  || 168.4 ||
yācñeyamakhilāśarma jananī pāparūpiṇī  |
kenāpyato na kāryaiva kṣatriyeṇa viśeṣataḥ  || 168.5 ||
evaṃ mīmāṃsamāneṣu brāhmaṇeṣu parasparam  |
tatra prāha mahāprājño vasiṣṭho dharmavittamaḥ  || 168.6 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
rājñi dīkṣāyamāṇe tu sūryo yācyo bhuvaṃ prati  |
dehi me deva savitaryajanaṃ devatocitam  || 168.7 ||
daivaṃ kṣatramasi brahman bhūtanātha namo'stu te  |
yācitaḥ savitā rājñā devānāṃ yajanaṃ śubham  || 168.8 ||
dadātyeva tato rājan prārthayeśaṃ divākaram  ||* 168.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvābhiṣṭuto'pi devadevaṃ divākaram  |
śraddhayā prārthayāmāsa harīśājātmakaṃ ravim  || 168.10 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
devānāṃ yajanaṃ dehi savitaste namo'stu te  ||* 168.11 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kṣatraṃ daivaṃ yataḥ sūryo dattā bhūrbhūpatestataḥ  |
savitā devadeveśo dadāmītyabhyabhāṣata  || 168.12 ||
evaṃ karoti yo yajñaṃ tasya riṣṭirna kācana  |
tathā vājimakhe sattre brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ  || 168.13 ||
prārabdhe'bhiṣṭutā rājñā yatrāgādbhūpatiṃ raviḥ  |
devānāṃ yajanaṃ dātuṃ bhānutīrthaṃ taducyate  || 168.14 ||
taṃ devakratumutkṛṣṭaṃ hayamedhaṃ surairyutam  |
daityāśca danujāścaiva tathānye yajñaghātakāḥ  || 168.15 ||
brahmaveṣadharāḥ sarve gāyantaḥ sāmagā iva  |
te'pi tatra mahāprājñāḥ prāviśannanivāritāḥ  || 168.16 ||
camasāni ca pātrāṇi somaṃ caṣālameva ca  |
somapānaṃ havistyāgamṛtvijo bhūpatiṃ tathā  || 168.17 ||
nindanti nikṣipantyanye hasantyanye tathāsurāḥ  |
teṣāṃ ceṣṭāṃ na jānanti viśvarūpaṃ vinā mune  || 168.18 ||
viśvarūpo'pi pitaraṃ prāha daityā ime iti  |
tatputravacanaṃ śrutvā tvaṣṭā prāha surānidam  || 168.19 ||
{tvaṣṭovāca̱ }
gṛhītvā vāridarbhāṃśca prokṣayadhvaṃ samantataḥ  |
ye nindanti makhaṃ puṇyaṃ camasaṃ somameva ca  || 168.20 ||
mayā tvapahatāḥ sarva ityuktvā pariṣiñcata  ||* 168.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathā cakruḥ suragaṇāstvaṣṭā cāpi tathākarot |
bhasmībhūtāstataḥ sarve kāṃdiśīkāstato'bhavan  || 168.22 ||
hatā mayā mahāpāpā ityuktvā vāryavākṣipat |
tataḥ kṣīṇāyuṣo daityāḥ prātiṣṭhan kupitāstataḥ  || 168.23 ||
yatraitatprākṣipadvāri tvaṣṭā lokaprajāpatiḥ  |
tvāṣṭraṃ tīrthaṃ tadākhyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  || 168.24 ||
tvaṣṭurvākyāccyutān daityānnijaghāna yamastadā  |
kāladaṇḍena cakreṇa kālapāśena manyunā  || 168.25 ||
yatra te nihatā daityāstattīrthaṃ yāmyamucyate  |
yatrābhavatkratuḥ pūrṇo hutvāgnau cāmṛtaṃ bahu  || 168.26 ||
dhārābhiḥ śaramānābhirakhaṇḍābhirmahādhvare  |
yatrābhavaddhavyavāhastṛptastasya hyabhiṣṭutaḥ  || 168.27 ||
agnitīrthaṃ tadākhyātamaśvamedhaphalapradam  |
indro marudbhirnṛpatiṃ prāhedaṃ vacanaṃ śubham  || 168.28 ||
tvaṃ saṃrāḍbhavitā rājannubhayorapi lokayoḥ  |
sakhā mama priyo nityaṃ bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 168.29 ||
sa kṛtārtho martyaloka indratīrthe ca tarpaṇam  |
kuryātpitṝṇāṃ prītyarthaṃ yamatīrthe viśeṣataḥ  || 168.30 ||
māheśvaraṃ tu tattīrthaṃ pūjito'bhiṣṭutaḥ śivaḥ  |
bhaktiyuktena vipraiśca sarvakarmaviśāradaiḥ  || 168.31 ||
vaidikairlaukikaiścaiva mantraiḥ pūjyaṃ maheśvaram  |
nṛtyairgītaistathā vādyairamṛtaiḥ pañcasaṃbhavaiḥ  || 168.32 ||
upacāraiśca bahubhirdaṇḍapātapradakṣiṇaiḥ  |
dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaiḥ puṣpairgandhaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ  || 168.33 ||
pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaṃbhuṃ dhiyaikayā  |
tataḥ prasannau deveśau varān dadaturojasā  || 168.34 ||
abhiṣṭute narendrāya bhuktimuktī ubhe api  |
māhātmyamasya tīrthasya tathā dadaturuttamam  || 168.35 ||
tataḥprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ śaivaṃ vaiṣṇavamucyate  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakāmapradaṃ viduḥ  || 168.36 ||
imāni sarvatīrthāni smaredapi paṭheta vā  |
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivaviṣṇupuraṃ vrajet || 168.37 ||
bhānutīrthe viśeṣeṇa snānaṃ sarvārthasiddhidam  |
tatra tīrthe mahāpuṇyaṃ tīrthānāṃ śatamatra hi  || 168.38 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
bhillatīrthamiti khyātaṃ rogaghnaṃ pāpanāśanam  |
mahādevapadāmbhoja yugabhaktipradāyakam  || 169.1 ||
tatrāpyevaṃvidhāṃ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ śṛṇu mahāmate  |
gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe tīre śrīgireruttare taṭe  || 169.2 ||
ādikeśa iti khyāta ṛṣibhiḥ paripūjitaḥ  |
mahādevo liṅgarūpī sadāste sarvakāmadaḥ  || 169.3 ||
sindhudvīpa iti khyāto muniḥ paramadhārmikaḥ  |
tasya bhrātā veda iti sa cāpi paramo ṛṣiḥ  || 169.4 ||
tamādikeśaṃ vai devaṃ tripurāriṃ trilocanam  |
nityaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā prāpte madhyaṃdine ravau  || 169.5 ||
bhikṣāṭanāya vedo'pi yāti grāmaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ  |
yāte tasmin dvijavare vyādhaḥ paramadhārmikaḥ  || 169.6 ||
tasmin girivare puṇye mṛgayāṃ yāti nityaśaḥ  |
aṭitvā vividhān deśānmṛgān hatvā yathāsukham  || 169.7 ||
mukhe gṛhītvā pānīyamabhiṣekāya śūlinaḥ  |
nyasya māṃsaṃ dhanuṣkoṭyāṃ śrānto vyādhaḥ śivaṃ prabhum  || 169.8 ||
ādikeśaṃ samāgatya nyasya māṃsaṃ tato bahiḥ  |
gaṅgāṃ gatvā mukhe vāri gṛhītvāgatya taṃ śivam  || 169.9 ||
yasya kasyāpi pattrāṇi kareṇādāya bhaktitaḥ  |
apareṇa ca māṃsāni naivedyārthaṃ ca tanmanāḥ  || 169.10 ||
ādikeśaṃ samāgatya vedenārcitamojasā  |
pādenāhatya tāṃ pūjāṃ mukhānītena vāriṇā  || 169.11 ||
snāpayitvā śivaṃ devamarcayitvā tu pattrakaiḥ  |
kalpayitvā tu tanmāṃsaṃ śivo me prīyatāmiti  || 169.12 ||
naiva kiṃcitsa jānāti śivabhaktiṃ vinā śubhām  |
tato yāti svakaṃ sthānaṃ māṃsena tu yathāgatam  || 169.13 ||
karotyetādṛgāgatyā gatya pratyahameva saḥ  |
tathāpīśastutoṣāsya vicitrā hīśvarasthitiḥ  || 169.14 ||
yāvannāyātyasau bhillaḥ śivastāvanna saukhyabhāk |
bhaktānukampitāṃ śaṃbhormānātītāṃ tu vetti kaḥ  || 169.15 ||
saṃpūjayatyādikeśamumayā pratyahaṃ śivam  |
evaṃ bahutithe kāle yāte vedaścukopa ha  || 169.16 ||
pūjāṃ mantravatīṃ citrāṃ śivabhaktisamanvitām  |
ko nu vidhvaṃsate pāpo mattaḥ sa vadhamāpnuyāt || 169.17 ||
gurudevadvijasvāmi drohī vadhyo munerapi  |
sarvasyāpi vadhārho'sau śivasya drohakṛnnaraḥ  || 169.18 ||
evaṃ niścitya medhāvī vedaḥ sindhostathānujaḥ  |
kasyeyaṃ pāpaceṣṭā syātpāpiṣṭhasya durātmanaḥ  || 169.19 ||
puṣpairvanyabhavairdivyaiḥ kandairmūlaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ  |
kṛtāṃ pūjāṃ sa vidhvasya hyanyāṃ pūjāṃ karoti yaḥ  || 169.20 ||
māṃsena tarupattraiśca sa ca vadhyo bhavenmama  |
evaṃ saṃcintya medhāvī gopayitvā tanuṃ tadā  || 169.21 ||
taṃ paśyeyamahaṃ pāpaṃ pūjākartāramīśvare  |
etasminnantare prāyādvyādho devaṃ yathā purā  || 169.22 ||
nityavatpūjayantaṃ tamādikeśastadābravīt ||* 169.23 ||
{ādikeśa uvāca̱ }
bho bho vyādha mahābuddhe śrānto'sīti punaḥ punaḥ  |
cirāya kathamāyātastvāṃ vinā tāta duḥkhitaḥ  |
na vindāmi sukhaṃ kiṃcitsamāśvasihi putraka  || 169.24 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tamevaṃvādinaṃ devaṃ vedaḥ śrutvā vilokya tu  |
cukopa vismayāviṣṭo na ca kiṃciduvāca ha  || 169.25 ||
vyādhaśca nityavatpūjāṃ kṛtvā svabhavanaṃ yayau  |
vedaśca kupito bhūtvā āgatyeśamuvāca ha  || 169.26 ||
{veda uvāca̱ }
ayaṃ vyādhaḥ pāparataḥ kriyājñānavivarjitaḥ  |
prāṇihiṃsārataḥ krūro nirdayaḥ sarvajantuṣu  || 169.27 ||
hīnajātirakiṃcijjño gurukramavivarjitaḥ  |
sadānucitakārī cā nirjitākhilagogaṇaḥ  || 169.28 ||
tasyātmānaṃ darśitavānna māṃ kiṃcana vakṣyasi  |
pūjāṃ mantravidhānena karomīśa yatavrataḥ  || 169.29 ||
tvadekaśaraṇo nityaṃ bhāryāputravivarjitaḥ  |
vyādho māṃsena duṣṭena pūjāṃ tava karotyasau  || 169.30 ||
tasya prasanno bhagavānna mameti mahādbhutam  |
śāstimasya kariṣyāmi bhillasya hyapakāriṇaḥ  || 169.31 ||
mṛdoḥ kopi bhavetprītaḥ kopi tadvaddurātmanaḥ  |
tasmādahaṃ mūrdhni śilāṃ pātayeyamasaṃśayam  || 169.32 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ityuktavati vai vede vihasyeśo'bravīdidam  ||* 169.33 ||
{ādikeśa uvāca̱ }
śvaḥ pratīkṣasva paścānme śilāṃ pātaya mūrdhani  ||* 169.34 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā sa vedo'pi śilāṃ saṃtyajya bāhunā  |
upasaṃhṛtya taṃ kopaṃ śvaḥ karomītyuvāca ha  || 169.35 ||
tataḥ prātaḥ samāgatya kṛtvā snānādikarma ca  |
vedo'pi nityavatpūjāṃ kurvan paśyati mastake  || 169.36 ||
liṅgasya savraṇāṃ bhīmāṃ dhārāṃ ca rudhiraplutām  |
vedaḥ sa vismito bhūtvā kimidaṃ liṅgamūrdhani  || 169.37 ||
mahotpāto bhavetkasya sūcayedityacintayat |
mṛdbhiśca gomayenāpi kuśaistaṃ gāṅgavāribhiḥ  || 169.38 ||
prakṣālayitvā tāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtavānnityavattadā  |
etasminnantare prāyādvyādho vigatakalmaṣaḥ  || 169.39 ||
mūrdhānaṃ vraṇasaṃyuktaṃ saraktaṃ liṅgamastake  |
śaṃkarasyādikeśasya dadṛśe'ntargatastadā  || 169.40 ||
dṛṣṭvaiva kimidaṃ citramityuktvā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ  |
ātmānaṃ bhedayāmāsa śatadhā ca sahasradhā  || 169.41 ||
svāmino vaikṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaḥ kṣametottamāśayaḥ  |
muhurnininda cātmānaṃ mayi jīvatyabhūdidam  || 169.42 ||
kaṣṭamāpatitaṃ kīdṛgaho durvidhivaiśasāt |
tatkarma tasya saṃvīkṣya mahādevo'tivismitaḥ  |
tataḥ provāca bhagavān vedaṃ vedavidāṃ varam  || 169.43 ||
{ādikeśa uvāca̱ }
paśya vyādhaṃ mahābuddhe bhaktaṃ bhāvena saṃyutam  |
tvaṃ tu mṛdbhiḥ kuśairvārbhirmūrdhānaṃ spṛṣṭavānasi  || 169.44 ||
anena sahasā brahmanmamātmāpi niveditaḥ  |
bhaktiḥ premāthavā śaktirvicāro yatra vidyate  |
tasmādasmai varān dāsye paścāttubhyaṃ dvijottama  || 169.45 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa vyādhaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ  |
vyādhaḥ provāca deveśaṃ nirmālyaṃ tava yadbhavet || 169.46 ||
tadasmākaṃ bhavennātha mannāmnā tīrthamucyatām  |
sarvakratuphalaṃ tīrthaṃ smaraṇādeva jāyatām  || 169.47 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuvāca deveśastatastattīrthamuttamam  |
bhillatīrthaṃ samastāgha saṃghavicchedakāraṇam  || 169.48 ||
śrīmahādevacaraṇa mahābhaktividhāyakam  |
abhavatsnānadānādyairbhuktimuktipradāyakam  |
vedasyāpi varān prādācchivo nānāvidhān bahūn  || 169.49 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
cakṣustīrthamiti khyātaṃ rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam  |
yatra yogeśvaro devo gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  || 170.1 ||
puraṃ bhauvanamākhyātaṃ girimūrdhnyabhidhīyate  |
yatrāsau bhauvano rājā kṣatradharmaparāyaṇaḥ  || 170.2 ||
tasmin puravare kaścidbrāhmaṇo vṛddhakauśikaḥ  |
tatputro gautama iti khyāto vedaviduttamaḥ  || 170.3 ||
tasya māturmanodoṣādviparīto'bhavaddvijaḥ  |
sakhā tasya vaṇikkaścinmaṇikuṇḍala ucyate  || 170.4 ||
tena sakhyaṃ dvijasyāsīdviṣamaṃ dvijavaiśyayoḥ  |
śrīmaddaridrayornityaṃ parasparahitaiṣiṇoḥ  || 170.5 ||
kadācidgautamo vaiśyaṃ vitteśaṃ maṇikuṇḍalam  |
prāhedaṃ vacanaṃ prītyā rahaḥ sthitvā punaḥ punaḥ  || 170.6 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
gacchāmo dhanamādātuṃ parvatānudadhīnapi  |
yauvanaṃ tadvṛthā jñeyaṃ vinā saukhyānukūlyataḥ  |
dhanaṃ vinā tatkathaṃ syādaho dhiṅnirdhanaṃ naram  || 170.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kuṇḍalo dvijamāhedaṃ matpitropārjitaṃ dhanam  |
bahvasti kiṃ dhanenādya kariṣye dvijasattama  |
dvijaḥ punaruvācedaṃ maṇikuṇḍalamojasā  || 170.8 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
dharmārthajñānakāmānāṃ ko nu tṛptaḥ praśasyate  |
utkarṣaprāptirevaiṣāṃ sakhe ślāghyā śarīriṇām  || 170.9 ||
svenaiva vyavasāyena dhanyā jīvanti jantavaḥ  |
paradattārthasaṃtuṣṭāḥ kaṣṭajīvina eva te  || 170.10 ||
sa putraḥ śasyate loke pitṛbhiścābhinandyate  |
yaḥ paitryamabhilipseta na vācāpi tu kuṇḍala  || 170.11 ||
svabāhubalamāśritya yo'rthānarjayate sutaḥ  |
sa kṛtārtho bhavelloke paitryaṃ vittaṃ na tu spṛśet || 170.12 ||
svayamārjya suto vittaṃ pitre dāsyati bandhave  |
taṃ tu putraṃ vijānīyāditaro yonikīṭakaḥ  || 170.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā tu tadvākyaṃ brāhmaṇasyābhilāṣiṇaḥ  |
tatheti matvā tadvākyaṃ ratnānyādāya satvaraḥ  || 170.14 ||
ātmakīyāni vittāni gautamāya nyavedayat |
dhanenaitena deśāṃśca paribhramya yathāsukham  || 170.15 ||
dhanānyādāya vittāni punareṣyāmahe gṛham  |
satyameva vaṇigvakti sa tu vipraḥ pratārakaḥ  || 170.16 ||
pāpātmā pāpacittaṃ ca na bubodha vaṇigdvijam  |
tau parasparamāmantrya mātāpitrorajānatoḥ  || 170.17 ||
deśāddeśāntaraṃ yātau dhanārthaṃ tau vaṇigdvijau  |
vaṇigghastasthitaṃ vittaṃ brāhmaṇo hartumicchati  || 170.18 ||
{brāhmaṇa uvāca̱ }
yena kenāpyupāyena taddhanaṃ hi samāhare  |
aho pṛthivyāṃ ramyāṇi nagarāṇi sahasraśaḥ  || 170.19 ||
iṣṭapradātryaḥ kāmasya devatā iva yoṣitaḥ  |
manoharāstatra tatra santi kiṃ kriyate mayā  || 170.20 ||
dhanamāhṛtya yatnena yoṣidbhyo yadi dīyate  |
bhujyante tāstato nityaṃ saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ hi tat || 170.21 ||
nṛtyagītarato nityaṃ paṇyastrībhiralaṃkṛtaḥ  |
bhokṣye kathaṃ tu tadvittaṃ vaiśyānmaddhastamāgatam  || 170.22 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ cintayamāno'sau gautamaḥ prahasanniva  |
maṇikuṇḍalamāhedamadharmādeva jantavaḥ  || 170.23 ||
vṛddhiṃ sukhamabhīṣṭāni prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ  |
dharmiṣṭhāḥ prāṇino loke dṛśyante duḥkhabhāginaḥ  || 170.24 ||
tasmāddharmeṇa kiṃ tena duḥkhaikaphalahetunā  ||* 170.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
netyuvāca tato vaiśyaḥ sukhaṃ dharme pratiṣṭhitam  |
pāpe duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śoko dāridryaṃ kleśa eva ca  |
yato dharmastato muktiḥ svadharmaḥ kiṃ vinaśyati  || 170.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ vivadatostatra saṃparāyastayorabhūt |
yasya pakṣo bhavejjyāyān sa parārthamavāpnuyāt || 170.27 ||
pṛcchāvaḥ kasya prābalyaṃ dharmiṇo vāpyadharmiṇaḥ  |
vedāttu laukikaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ loke dharmātsukhaṃ bhavet || 170.28 ||
evaṃ vivadamānau tāvūcatuḥ sakalāñjanān  |
dharmasya vāpyadharmasya prābalyamanayorbhuvi  || 170.29 ||
tadvadantu yathāvṛttamevamūcaturojasā  |
evaṃ tatrocire kecidye dharmeṇānuvartinaḥ  || 170.30 ||
tairduḥkhamanubhūyate pāpiṣṭhāḥ sukhino janāḥ  |
saṃparāye dhanaṃ sarvaṃ jitaṃ vipre nyavedayat || 170.31 ||
maṇimān dharmavicchreṣṭhaḥ punardharmaṃ praśaṃsati  |
maṇimantaṃ dvijaḥ prāha kiṃ dharmamanuśaṃsasi  |
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatheti cetyāha vaiśyo brāhmaṇaḥ punarabravīt || 170.32 ||
{brāhmaṇa uvāca̱ }
jitaṃ mayā dhanaṃ vaiśya nirlajjaḥ kiṃ nu bhāṣase  |
mayaiva vijito dharmo yatheṣṭacaraṇātmanā  || 170.33 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadbrāhmaṇavacaḥ śrutvā vaiśyaḥ sasmita ūcivān  ||* 170.34 ||
{vaiśya uvāca̱ }
pulākā iva dhānyeṣu puttikā iva pakṣiṣu  |
tathaiva tān sakhe manye yeṣāṃ dharmo na vidyate  || 170.35 ||
caturṇāṃ puruṣārthānāṃ dharmaḥ prathama ucyate  |
paścādarthaśca kāmaśca sa dharmo mayi tiṣṭhati  |
kathaṃ brūṣe dvijaśreṣṭha mayā vijitamityadaḥ  || 170.36 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
dvijo vaiśyaṃ punaḥ prāha hastābhyāṃ jāyatāṃ paṇaḥ  |
tatheti manyate vaiśyastau gatvā punarūcatuḥ  || 170.37 ||
pūrvavallaukikān gatvā jitamityabravīddvijaḥ  |
karau chittvā tataḥ prāha kathaṃ dharmaṃ tu manyase  |
ākṣipto brāhmaṇenaivaṃ vaiśyo vacanamabravīt || 170.38 ||
{vaiśya uvāca̱ }
dharmameva paraṃ manye prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairapi  |
mātā pitā suhṛdbandhurdharma eva śarīriṇām  || 170.39 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ vivadamānau tāvarthavān brāhmaṇo'bhavat |
vimukto vaiśyakastatra bāhubhyāṃ ca dhanena ca  || 170.40 ||
evaṃ bhramantau saṃprāptau gaṅgāṃ yogeśvaraṃ harim  |
yadṛcchayā muniśreṣṭha mithastāvūcatuḥ punaḥ  || 170.41 ||
vaiśyo gaṅgāṃ tu yogeśaṃ dharmameva praśaṃsati  |
atikopāddvijo vaiśyamākṣipan punarabravīt || 170.42 ||
{brāhmaṇa uvāca̱ }
gataṃ dhanaṃ karau chinnāvavaśiṣṭo śubhirbhavān  |
tvamanyathā yadi brūṣa āhariṣye'sinā śiraḥ  || 170.43 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vihasya punarāhedaṃ vaiśyo gautamamañjasā  ||* 170.44 ||
{vaiśya uvāca̱ }
dharmameva paraṃ manye yathecchasi tathā kuru  |
brāhmaṇāṃśca gurūn devān vedān dharmaṃ janārdanam  || 170.45 ||
yastu nindayate pāpo nāsau spṛśyo'tha pāpakṛt |
upekṣaṇīyo durvṛttaḥ pāpātmā dharmadūṣakaḥ  || 170.46 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prāha sa kopena dharmaṃ yadyanuśaṃsasi  |
āvayoḥ prāṇayoratra paṇaḥ syāditi vai mune  || 170.47 ||
evamukte gautamena tathetyāha vaṇiktadā  |
punarapyūcaturubhau lokāṃllokāstathocire  || 170.48 ||
yogeśvarasya purato gautamyā dakṣiṇe taṭe  |
taṃ nipātya viśaṃ vipraścakṣurutpāṭya cābravīt || 170.49 ||
{vipra uvāca̱ }
gato'sīmāṃ daśāṃ vaiśya nityaṃ dharmapraśaṃsayā  |
gataṃ dhanaṃ gataṃ cakṣuścheditau karapallavau  |
pṛṣṭo'si mitra gacchāmi maivaṃ brūyāḥ kathāntare  || 170.50 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasmin prayāte vaiśyo'sau cintayāmāsa cetasi  |
hā kaṣṭaṃ me kimabhavaddharmaikamanaso hare  || 170.51 ||
sa kuṇḍalo vaṇikśreṣṭho nirdhano gatabāhukaḥ  |
gatanetraḥ śucaṃ prāpto dharmamevānusaṃsmaran  || 170.52 ||
evaṃ bahuvidhāṃ cintāṃ kurvannāste mahītale  |
niśceṣṭo'tha nirutsāhaḥ patitaḥ śokasāgare  || 170.53 ||
dināvasāne śarvaryāmudite candramaṇḍale  |
ekādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe tatrāyāti vibhīṣaṇaḥ  || 170.54 ||
sa tu yogeśvaraṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā yathāvidhi  |
snātvā tu gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ saputro rākṣasairvṛtaḥ  || 170.55 ||
vibhīṣaṇasya hi suto vibhīṣaṇa ivāparaḥ  |
vaibhīṣaṇiriti khyātastamapaśyaduvāca ha  || 170.56 ||
vaiśyasya vacanaṃ śrutvā yathāvṛttaṃ sa dharmavit |
pitre nivedayāmāsa laṅkeśāya mahātmane  |
sa tu laṅkeśvaraḥ prāha putraṃ prītyā guṇākaram  || 170.57 ||
{vibhīṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
śrīmān rāmo mama gurustasya mānyaḥ sakhā mama  |
hanumāniti vikhyātastenānīto girirmahān  || 170.58 ||
purā kāryāntare prāpte sarvauṣadhyāśrayo'calaḥ  |
jāte kārye tamādāya himavantamathāgamat || 170.59 ||
viśalyakaraṇī ceti mṛtasaṃjīvanīti ca  |
tadānīya mahābuddhī rāmāyākliṣṭakarmaṇe  || 170.60 ||
nivedayitvā tatsādhyaṃ tasmin vṛtte samāgataḥ  |
punargiriṃ samādāya āgacchaddevaparvatam  || 170.61 ||
tāmānīyāsya hṛdaye niveśaya hariṃ smaran  |
tataḥ prāpsyatyayaṃ sarvamapekṣitamudāradhīḥ  || 170.62 ||
gacchatastasya vegena viśalyakaraṇī punaḥ  |
apatadgautamītīre yatra yogeśvaro hariḥ  || 170.63 ||
{vaibhīṣaṇiruvāca̱ }
tāmoṣadhīṃ mama pitardarśayāśu vilamba mā  |
parārtiśamanādanyacchreyo na bhuvanatraye  || 170.64 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
vibhīṣaṇastathetyuktvā tāṃ putrasyāpyadarśayat |
iṣe tvetyasya vṛkṣasya śākhāṃ ciccheda tatsutaḥ  |
vaiśyasya cāpi vai prītyā santaḥ parahite ratāḥ  || 170.65 ||
{vibhīṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
yatrāpatannage cāsmin sa vṛkṣastu pratāpavān  |
tasya śākhāṃ samādāya hṛdaye'sya niveśaya  |
tatspṛṣṭamātra evāsau svakaṃ rūpamavāpnuyāt || 170.66 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā piturvākyaṃ vaibhīṣaṇirudāradhīḥ  |
tathā cakāra vai samyakkāṣṭhakhaṇḍaṃ nyaveśayat || 170.67 ||
hṛdaye sa tu vaiśyo'pi sacakṣuḥ sakaro'bhavat |
maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ hi vīryaṃ ko'pi na budhyate  || 170.68 ||
tadeva kāṣṭhamādāya dharmamevānusaṃsmaran  |
snātvā tu gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ tathā yogeśvaraṃ harim  || 170.69 ||
namaskṛtvā punaragātkāṣṭhakhaṇḍena vaiśyakaḥ  |
paribhramannṛpapuraṃ mahāpuramiti śrutam  || 170.70 ||
mahārāja iti khyātastatra rājā mahābalaḥ  |
tasya nāsti sutaḥ kaścitputrikā naṣṭalocanā  || 170.71 ||
saiva tasya sutā putrastasyāpi vratamīdṛśam  |
devo vā dānavo vāpi brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo bhavet || 170.72 ||
vaiśyo vā śūdrayonirvā saguṇo nirguṇo'pi vā  |
tasmai deyā iyaṃ putrī yo netre āhariṣyati  || 170.73 ||
rājyena saha deyeyamiti rājā hyaghoṣayat |
aharniśamasau vaiśyaḥ śrutvā ghoṣamathābravīt || 170.74 ||
{vaiśya uvāca̱ }
ahaṃ netre āhariṣye rājaputryā asaṃśayam  ||* 170.75 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
taṃ vaiśyaṃ tarasādāya mahārājñe nyavedayat |
tatkāṣṭhasparśamātreṇa sanetrābhūnnṛpātmajā  || 170.76 ||
tataḥ savismayo rājā ko bhavāniti cābravīt |
vaiśyo rājñe yathāvṛttaṃ nyavedayadaśeṣataḥ  || 170.77 ||
{vaiśya uvāca̱ }
brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādena dharmasya tapasastathā  |
dānaprabhāvādyajñaiśca vividhairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ  |
divyauṣadhiprabhāvena mama sāmarthyamīdṛśam  || 170.78 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etadvaiśyavacaḥ śrutvā vismito'bhūnmahīpatiḥ  ||* 170.79 ||
{rājovāca̱ }
aho mahānubhāvo'yaṃ prāyo vṛndārako bhavet |
anyathaitādṛganyasya sāmarthyaṃ dṛśyate katham  |
tasmādasmai tu tāṃ kanyāṃ pradāsye rājyapūrvikām  || 170.80 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
iti saṃkalpya manasi kanyāṃ rājyaṃ ca dattavān  |
vihārārthaṃ gataḥ svairaṃ paraṃ khedamupāgataḥ  || 170.81 ||
na mitreṇa vinā rājyaṃ na mitreṇa vinā sukham  |
tameva satataṃ vipraṃ cintayan vaiśyanandanaḥ  || 170.82 ||
etadeva sujātānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhuvi dehinām  |
kṛpārdraṃ yanmano nityaṃ teṣāmapyahiteṣu hi  || 170.83 ||
mahānṛpo vanaṃ prāyātsa rājā maṇikuṇḍalaḥ  |
tasmiñśāsati rājyaṃ tu kadācidgautamaṃ dvijam  || 170.84 ||
hṛtasvaṃ dyūtakaiḥ pāpairapaśyanmaṇikuṇḍalaḥ  |
tamādāya dvijaṃ mitraṃ pūjayāmāsa dharmavit || 170.85 ||
dharmāṇāṃ tu prabhāvaṃ taṃ tasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayat |
snāpayāmāsa gaṅgāyāṃ taṃ sarvāghanivṛttaye  || 170.86 ||
tena vipreṇa sarvaistaiḥ svakīyairgotrajairvṛtaḥ  |
vaiśyaiḥ svadeśasaṃbhūtairbrāhmaṇasya tu bāndhavaiḥ  || 170.87 ||
vṛddhakauśikamukhyaiśca tasmin yogeśvarāntike  |
yajñāniṣṭvā surān pūjya tataḥ svargamupeyivān  || 170.88 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ mṛtasaṃjīvanaṃ viduḥ  |
cakṣustīrthaṃ sayogeśaṃ smaraṇādapi puṇyadam  |
manaḥprasādajananaṃ sarvadurbhāvanāśanam  || 170.89 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
urvaśītīrthamākhyātamaśvamedhaphalapradam  |
snānadānamahādeva vāsudevārcanādibhiḥ  || 171.1 ||
maheśvaro yatra devo yatra śārṅgadharo hariḥ  |
pramatirnāma rājāsītsārvabhaumaḥ pratāpavān  || 171.2 ||
ripūñjitvā jagāmāśu indralokaṃ surairvṛtam  |
tatrāpaśyatsurapatiṃ marudbhiḥ saha nārada  || 171.3 ||
jahāsendraṃ pāśahastaṃ pramatiḥ kṣatriyarṣabhaḥ  |
taṃ hasantamathālakṣya hariḥ pramatimabravīt || 171.4 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
devālaye mahābuddhe marudbhiḥ krīḍitairalam  |
diśo jitvā divaṃ prāptaḥ kuru krīḍāṃ mayā saha  || 171.5 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sakaṣāyaṃ harivaco niśamya pramatirnṛpaḥ  |
tathetyuvāca devendraṃ niṣkṛtiṃ kāṃ tu manyase  |
tacchrutvā pramatervākyaṃ surarāṇnṛpamabravīt || 171.6 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
urvaśyeva paṇo'smākaṃ prāpyā yā nikhilairmakhaiḥ  ||* 171.7 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvendravacanaṃ pramatiḥ prāha garvitaḥ  |
urvaśīṃ niṣkṛtiṃ manye tvaṃ rājan kiṃ nu manyase  || 171.8 ||
yadbravīṣi sureśāna tanmanye'haṃ śatakrato  |
prāhendraṃ pramatistadvanniṣkṛtyai dakṣiṇaṃ karam  |
savarma saśaraṃ dharmyaṃ dehi dīvyāmahe vayam  || 171.9 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tāvevaṃ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā devanāyopatasthatuḥ  |
pramatirjitavāṃstatra urvaśīṃ daivatastriyam  |
tāṃ jitvā pramatiḥ prāha saṃrambhāttaṃ śatakratum  || 171.10 ||
{pramatiruvāca̱ }
niṣkṛtyai punaranyanme paścāddīvye tvayā vibho  ||* 171.11 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
devayogyamatho vajraṃ jaitraṃ sarathamuttamam  |
dīvye'haṃ tena nṛpate kareṇāpyavicārayan  || 171.12 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sa gṛhītvā tadā pāśānanyāṃśca maṇibhūṣitān  |
jitamityabravīcchakraṃ pramatiḥ prahasaṃstadā  || 171.13 ||
etasminnantare prāyādakṣajñastatra nārada  |
viśvāvasuriti khyāto gandharvāṇāṃ maheśvaraḥ  || 171.14 ||
{viśvāvasuruvāca̱ }
gandharvavidyayā rājaṃstayā dīvyāmahe tvayā  |
tathetyuktvā sa nṛpatirjitamityabravīttadā  || 171.15 ||
tau jitvā nṛpatirmaurkhyāddevendraṃ prāha kaśmalam  ||* 171.16 ||
{pramatiruvāca̱ }
raṇe vā devane vāpi na tvaṃ jetā kathaṃcana  |
mahendra satataṃ tasmādasmadārādhako bhava  |
vada kena prakāreṇa jātā devendratā tava  || 171.17 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathā prāhorvaśīṃ garvādgaccha karmakarī bhava  |
urvaśī prāha deveṣu yathā varte tathā tvayi  |
varteya sarvabhāvena na māṃ dhikkartumarhasi  || 171.18 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatastāṃ pramatiḥ prāha tvādṛśyaḥ santi cārikāḥ  |
tvaṃ kiṃ vilajjase bhadre gaccha karmakarī bhava  || 171.19 ||
etacchrutvā nṛpeṇoktaṃ gandharvādhipatistadā  |
citrasena iti khyātaḥ suto viśvāvasorbalī  || 171.20 ||
{citrasena uvāca̱ }
dīvye'haṃ vai tvayā rājan sarveṇānena bhūpate  |
rājyena jīvitenāpi madīyena tavāpi ca  || 171.21 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā punarubhau citrasenanṛpottamau  |
dīvyetāmabhisaṃrabdhau citraseno'jayattadā  || 171.22 ||
gāndharvaistaṃ mahāpāśairbabandha nṛpatiṃ tadā  |
citraseno'jayatsarvamurvaśīmukhyataḥ paṇaiḥ  || 171.23 ||
rājyaṃ kośaṃ balaṃ caiva yadanyadvasu kiṃcana  |
citrasenasya tajjātaṃ yadāsītpramaterdhanam  || 171.24 ||
tasya putro bāla eva purodhasamuvāca ha  |
vaiśvāmitraṃ mahāprājñaṃ madhucchandasamojasā  || 171.25 ||
{pramatiputra uvāca̱ }
kiṃ me pitrā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kva vā baddho mahāmatiḥ  |
kathameṣyati svaṃ sthānaṃ kathaṃ pāśairvimokṣyate  || 171.26 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sumatervacanaṃ śrutvā dhyātvā sa munisattamaḥ  |
madhucchandā jagādedaṃ pramatervartanaṃ tadā  || 171.27 ||
{madhucchandā uvāca̱ }
devaloke tava pitā baddha āste mahāmate  |
kaitavairbahudoṣaiśca bhraṣṭarājyo babhūva ha  || 171.28 ||
yo yāti kaitavasabhāṃ sa cāpi kleśabhāgbhavet |
dyūtamadyāmiṣādīni vyasanāni nṛpātmaja  || 171.29 ||
pāpināmeva jāyante sadā pāpātmakāni hi  |
ekaikamapyanarthāya pāpāya narakāya ca  || 171.30 ||
yānāsanābhilāpādyaiḥ kṛtaiḥ kaitavavartibhiḥ  |
kulīnāḥ kaluṣībhūtāḥ kiṃ punaḥ kitavo janaḥ  || 171.31 ||
kitavasya tu yā jāyā tapyate nityameva sā  |
sa cāpi kitavaḥ pāpo yoṣitaṃ vīkṣya tapyate  || 171.32 ||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vigatānando nityaṃ vadati pāpakṛt |
aho saṃsāracakre'sminmayā tulyo na pātakī  || 171.33 ||
na kiṃcidapi yasyāste loke viṣayajaṃ sukham  |
lokadvaye'pi na sukhī kitavaḥ kopi dṛśyate  || 171.34 ||
vibhāti ca tathā nityaṃ lajjayā dagdhamānasaḥ  |
gatadharmo nirānando grastagarvastathāṭati  || 171.35 ||
akaitavī ca yā vṛttiḥ sā praśastā dvijanmanām  |
kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyamapi kuryānna kaitavam  || 171.36 ||
yastu kaitavavṛttyā hi dhanamāhartumicchati  |
dharmārthakāmābhijanaiḥ sa vimucyeta pauruṣāt || 171.37 ||
vede'pi dūṣitaṃ karma tava pitrā tadādṛtam  |
tasmātkiṃ kurmahe vatsa yaduktaṃ te vidhīyate  || 171.38 ||
vidhātṛvihitaṃ mārgaṃ ko nu vātyeti paṇḍitaḥ  ||* 171.39 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etatpurodhaso vākyaṃ śrutvā sumatirabravīt ||* 171.40 ||
{sumatiruvāca̱ }
kiṃ kṛtvā pramatistātaḥ punā rājyamavāpnuyāt ||* 171.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
punardhyātvā madhucchandāḥ sumatiṃ cedamabravīt ||* 171.42 ||
{madhucchandā uvāca̱ }
gautamīṃ yāhi vatsa tvaṃ tatra pūjaya śaṃkaram  |
aditiṃ varuṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ tataḥ pāśādvimokṣyate  || 171.43 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā jagāmāśu gaṅgāṃ natvā janārdanam  |
pūjayāmāsa śaṃbhuṃ ca tapastepe yatavrataḥ  || 171.44 ||
sahasramekaṃ varṣāṇāṃ baddhaṃ pitaramātmanaḥ  |
mocayāmāsa devebhyaḥ punā rājyamavāpa saḥ  || 171.45 ||
śiveśābhyāṃ muktapāśo rājyaṃ prāpa sutātsvakāt |
avāpya vidyāṃ gāndharvīṃ priyaścāsīcchatakratoḥ  || 171.46 ||
śāṃbhavaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ caiva urvaśītīrthameva ca  |
tataḥprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kaitavaṃ ceti viśrutam  || 171.47 ||
śivaviṣṇusarinmātu prasādādāpyate na kim  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca bahupuṇyaphalapradam  |
pāpapāśavimokṣaṃ tu sarvadurgatināśanam  || 171.48 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
sāmudraṃ tīrthamākhyātaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam  |
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada tanmanāḥ  || 172.1 ||
visṛṣṭā gautamenāsau gaṅgā pāpapraṇāśanī  |
lokānāmupakārārthaṃ prāyātpūrvārṇavaṃ prati  || 172.2 ||
āgacchantī devanadī kamaṇḍaludhṛtā mayā  |
śirasā ca dhṛtā devī śaṃbhunā paramātmanā  || 172.3 ||
viṣṇupādātprasūtāṃ tāṃ brāhmaṇena mahātmanā  |
ānītāṃ martyabhavanaṃ smaraṇādaghanāśanīm  || 172.4 ||
gurorgurutamāṃ sindhurdṛṣṭvā kṛtyamacintayat |
yā vandyā jagatāmīśā brahmeśādyairnamaskṛtā  || 172.5 ||
tāmahaṃ pratigaccheyaṃ no cetsyāddharmadūṣaṇam  |
āgacchantaṃ mahātmānaṃ yo mohānnopatiṣṭhate  || 172.6 ||
na tasya kopi trātāsti pāpino lokayordvayoḥ  |
evaṃ vimṛśya ratneśo mūrtimān vinayānvitaḥ  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭo gaṅgāmāhedaṃ saritāṃpatiḥ  || 172.7 ||
{sindhuruvāca̱ }
rasātalagataṃ vāri pṛthivyāṃ yannabhastale  |
tanmāmevātra viśatu nāhaṃ vakṣyāmi kiṃcana  || 172.8 ||
mayi ratnāni pīyūṣaṃ parvatā rākṣasāsurāḥ  |
etānapyakhilānanyān bhīmān saṃdhārayāmyaham  || 172.9 ||
mamāntaḥ kamalāyukto viṣṇuḥ svapiti nityadā  |
mamāśakyaṃ na kimapi vidyate sacarācare  || 172.10 ||
mahatyabhyāgate kuryātpratyutthānaṃ na yo madāt |
sa dharmādiparibhraṣṭo nirayaṃ tu samāpnuyāt || 172.11 ||
na tānme bibhrataḥ khedo vināgastyaparābhavāt |
kiṃ tu tvaṃ gauraveṇaiṣāmatiriktā tatastvaham  || 172.12 ||
bravīmi devi gaṅge māṃ tvaṃ sāmyātsaṃgatā bhava  |
naikarūpāmahaṃ śaktaḥ saṃgantuṃ bahudhā yadi  || 172.13 ||
saṅgameṣyasi devi tvaṃ saṃgacche'haṃ na cānyathā  |
gaṅge sameṣyasi yadi bahudhā tadvicāraye  || 172.14 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tamevaṃvādinaṃ sindhumapāmīśaṃ tadābravīt |
gaṅgā sā gautamī devī kuru caitadvaco mama  || 172.15 ||
saptarṣīṇāṃ ca yā bhāryā arundhatipurogamāḥ  |
bhartṛbhiḥ sahitāḥ sarvā ānaya tvaṃ tadā tvaham  || 172.16 ||
alpabhūtā bhaviṣyāmi tataḥ syāṃ tava saṃgatā  |
tathetyuktvā saptarṣīṇāṃ bhāryābhirṛṣibhirvṛtaḥ  || 172.17 ||
ānayāmāsa tāṃ devī saptadhā sā vyabhajyata  |
sā ceyaṃ gautamī gaṅgā saptadhā sāgaraṃ gatā  || 172.18 ||
saptarṣīṇāṃ tu nāmnā tu sapta gaṅgāstato'bhavan  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ paṭhanaṃ tathā  || 172.19 ||
smaraṇaṃ cāpi yadbhaktyā sarvakāmapradaṃ bhavet |
nāsmādanyatparaṃ tīrthaṃ samudrādbhuvanatraye  |
pāpahānau bhuktimukti prāptau ca manaso mude  || 172.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ṛṣisattramiti khyātamṛṣayaḥ sapta nārada  |
niṣedustapase yatra yatra bhīmeśvaraḥ śivaḥ  || 173.1 ||
tatredaṃ vṛttamākhyāsye devarṣipitṛbṛṃhitam  |
śṛṇu yatnena vakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  || 173.2 ||
saptadhā vyabhajan gaṅgāmṛṣayaḥ sapta nārada  |
vāsiṣṭhī dākṣiṇeyī syādvaiśvāmitrī taduttarā  || 173.3 ||
vāmadevyaparā jñeyā gautamī madhyataḥ śubhā  |
bhāradvājī smṛtā cānyā ātreyī cetyathāparā  || 173.4 ||
jāmadagnī tathā cānyā vyapadiṣṭā tu saptadhā  |
taiḥ sarvairṛṣibhistatra yaṣṭumiṣṭairmahātmabhiḥ  || 173.5 ||
niṣpāditaṃ mahāsattramṛṣibhiḥ pāradarśibhiḥ  |
etasminnantare tatra devānāṃ prabalo ripuḥ  || 173.6 ||
viśvarūpa iti khyāto munīnāṃ sattramabhyagāt |
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā tānārādhya yathāvidhi  |
vinayenātha papraccha ṛṣīn sarvānanukramāt || 173.7 ||
{viśvarūpa uvāca̱ }
dhruvaṃ sarve yathākāmaṃ mama svāsthyena hetunā  |
yathā syādbalavān putro devānāmapi durdharaḥ  |
yajñairvā tapasā vāpi munayo vaktumarhatha  || 173.8 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tatra prāha mahābuddhirviśvāmitro mahāmanāḥ  ||* 173.9 ||
{viśvāmitra uvāca̱ }
karmaṇā tāta labhyante phalāni vividhāni ca  |
trayāṇāṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca karma prathamakāraṇam  || 173.10 ||
tataśca kāraṇaṃ kartā tataścānyatprakīrtitam  |
upādānaṃ tathā bījaṃ na ca karma vidurbudhāḥ  || 173.11 ||
karmaṇāṃ kāraṇatvaṃ ca kāraṇe puṣkale sati  |
bhāvābhāvau phale dṛṣṭau tasmātkarmāśritaṃ phalam  || 173.12 ||
karmāpi dvividhaṃ jñeyaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ tathā kṛtam  |
kartavyaṃ kriyamāṇasya sādhanaṃ yadyaducyate  || 173.13 ||
tadbhāvāḥ karmasiddhau ca ubhayatrāpi kāraṇam  |
yadyadbhāvayate jantuḥ karma kurvan vicakṣaṇaḥ  || 173.14 ||
tadbhāvanānurūpeṇa phalaniṣpattirucyate  |
karoti karma vidhivadvinā bhāvanayā yadi  || 173.15 ||
anyathā syātphalaṃ sarvaṃ tasya bhāvānurūpataḥ  |
tasmāttapo vrataṃ dānaṃ japayajñādikāḥ kriyāḥ  || 173.16 ||
karmaṇastvanurūpeṇa phalaṃ dāsyanti bhāvataḥ  |
tasmādbhāvānurūpeṇa karma vai dāsyate phalam  || 173.17 ||
bhāvastu trividho jñeyaḥ sāttviko rājasastathā  |
tāmasastu tathā jñeyaḥ phalaṃ karmānusārataḥ  || 173.18 ||
bhāvanānuguṇaṃ ceti vicitrā karmaṇāṃ sthitiḥ  |
tasmādicchānusāreṇa bhāvaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ  || 173.19 ||
paścātkarmāpi kartavyaṃ phaladātāpi tadvidham  |
phalaṃ dadāti phalināṃ phale yadi pravartate  || 173.20 ||
karmakāro na tatrāsti kuryātkarma svabhāvataḥ  |
tadeva copadānādi sattvādiguṇabhedataḥ  || 173.21 ||
bhāvātprārabhate tadvadbhāvaiḥ phalamavāpyate  |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ karma caiva hi kāraṇam  || 173.22 ||
bhāvasthitaṃ bhavetkarma muktidaṃ bandhakāraṇam  |
svabhāvānuguṇaṃ karma svasyaiveha paratra ca  || 173.23 ||
phalāni vividhānyāśu karoti samatānugam  |
eka eva padārtho'sau bhāvairbhedaḥ pradṛśyate  || 173.24 ||
kriyate bhujyate vāpi tasmādbhāvo viśiṣyate  |
yathābhāvaṃ karma kuru yathepsitamavāpsyasi  || 173.25 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
etacchrutvā ṛṣervākyaṃ viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ  |
tapastaptvā bahukālaṃ tāmasaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ  || 173.26 ||
viśvarūpaḥ karma bhīmaṃ cakāra surabhīṣaṇam  |
paśyatsu ṛṣimukhyeṣu vāryamāṇo'pi nityaśaḥ  || 173.27 ||
ātmakopānusāreṇa bhīmaṃ karma tathākarot |
bhīṣaṇe kuṇḍakhāte tu bhīṣaṇe jātavedasi  || 173.28 ||
bhīṣaṇaṃ raudrapuruṣaṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ guhāśayam  |
evaṃ tapantamālakṣya vāguvācāśarīriṇī  || 173.29 ||
jaṭājūṭaṃ vinātmānaṃ na ca vṛtro vyajīyata  |
vṛthātmānaṃ viśvarūpo juhuyājjātavedasi  || 173.30 ||
sa evendraḥ sa varuṇaḥ sa ca syātsarvameva ca  |
tyaktvātmānaṃ jaṭāmātraṃ hutavān vṛjinodbhavaḥ  || 173.31 ||
vṛtra ityucyate vede sa cāpi vṛjino'bhavat |
bhīmasya mahimānaṃ ko jānāti jagadīśituḥ  || 173.32 ||
sṛjatyaśeṣamapi yo na ca saṅgena lipyate  |
virarāmeti saṃkīrtya sā vāṇyenaṃ munīśvarāḥ  || 173.33 ||
bhīmeśvaraṃ namaskṛtya jagmuḥ svaṃ svamathāśramam  |
viśvarūpo mahābhīmo bhīmakarmā tathākṛtiḥ  || 173.34 ||
bhīmabhāvo bhīmatanuṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ juhāva ha  |
tasmādbhīmeśvaro devaḥ purāṇe paripaṭhyate  |
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca muktidaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 173.35 ||
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti yaśca bhaktyā  173.36
vibudhapatiṃ śivamatra bhīmarūpam  173.36
jagati viditamaśeṣapāpahāri  173.36
smṛtipadaśaraṇena muktidaśca  173.36
godāvarī tāvadaśeṣapāpa  173.37
samūhahantrī paramārthadātrī  173.37
sadaiva sarvatra viśeṣatastu  173.37
yatrāmburāśiṃ samanupraviṣṭā  173.37
snātvā tu tasmin sukṛtī śarīrī  173.38
godāvarīvāridhisaṃgame yaḥ  173.38
uddhṛtya tīvrānnirayādaśeṣāt 173.38
sa pūrvajān yāti puraṃ purāreḥ  173.38
vedāntavedyaṃ yadupāsitavyaṃ  173.39
tadbrahma sākṣātkhalu bhīmanāthaḥ  173.39
dṛṣṭe hi tasminna punarviśanti  173.39
śarīriṇaḥ saṃsmṛtimugraduḥkhām  173.39
{brahmovāca̱ }
sā saṃgatā pūrvamapāṃpatiṃ taṃ  174.1
gaṅgā surāṇāmapi vandanīyā  174.1
devaiśca sarvairanugamyamānā  174.1
saṃstūyamānā munibhirmarudbhiḥ  174.1
vasiṣṭhajābālisayājñavalkya  174.2
kratvaṅgirodakṣamarīcivaiṣṇavāḥ  174.2
śātātapaḥ śaunakadevarāta  174.2
bhṛgvagniveśyātrimarīcimukhyāḥ  174.2
sudhūtapāpā manugautamādayaḥ  174.3
sakauśikāstumbaruparvatādyāḥ  174.3
agastyamārkaṇḍasapippalādyāḥ  174.3
sagālavā yogaparāyaṇāśca  174.3
savāmadevāṅgiraso'tha bhārgavāḥ  174.4
smṛtipravīṇāḥ śrutibhirmanojñāḥ  174.4
sarve purāṇārthavido bahujñās 174.4
te gautamīṃ devanadīṃ tu gatvā  174.4
stoṣyanti mantraiḥ śrutibhiḥ prabhūtair 174.5
hṛdyaiśca tuṣṭairmuditairmanobhiḥ  174.5
tāṃ saṃgatāṃ vīkṣya śivo hariśca  174.5
ātmānamādarśayatāṃ munibhyaḥ  174.5
tathāmarāstau pitṛbhiśca dṛṣṭau  174.6
stuvanti devau sakalārtihāriṇau  174.6
ādityā vasavo rudrā maruto lokapālakāḥ  |
kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ sarve stuvanti hariśaṃkarau  || 174.7 ||
saṃgameṣu prasiddheṣu nityaṃ saptasu nārada  |
samudrasya ca gaṅgāyā nityaṃ devau pratiṣṭhitau  || 174.8 ||
gautameśvara ākhyāto yatra devo maheśvaraḥ  |
nityaṃ saṃnihitastatra mādhavo ramayā saha  || 174.9 ||
brahmeśvara iti khyāto mayaiva sthāpitaḥ śivaḥ  |
lokānāmupakārārthamātmanaḥ kāraṇāntare  || 174.10 ||
cakrapāṇiriti khyātaḥ stuto devairmayā saha  |
tatra saṃnihito viṣṇurdevaiḥ saha marudgaṇaiḥ  || 174.11 ||
aindratīrthamiti khyātaṃ tadeva hayamūrdhakam  |
hayamūrdhā tatra viṣṇustanmūrdhani surā api  |
somatīrthamiti khyātaṃ yatra someśvaraḥ śivaḥ  || 174.12 ||
indrasya somaśravaso devaiśca ṛṣibhistathā  |
prārthitaḥ soma evādāvindrāyendo parisrava  || 174.13 ||
sapta diśo nānāsūryāḥ sapta hotāra ṛtvijaḥ  |
devā ādityā ye sapta tebhiḥ somābhirakṣa na  || 174.14 ||
indrāyendo parisrava  174.14
yatte rājañchṛtaṃ havistena somābhirakṣa naḥ  |
arātīvā mā nastārīnmo ca naḥ kiṃcanāmamad || 174.15 ||
indrāyendo parisrava  174.15
ṛṣe mantrakṛtāṃ stomaiḥ kaśyapodvardhayan giraḥ  |
somaṃ namasya rājānaṃ yo jajñe vīrudhāṃ patir || 174.16 ||
indrāyendo parisrava  174.16
kārurahaṃ tato bhiṣagupalaprakṣiṇī nanā  |
nānādhiyo vasūyavo'nu gā iva tasthima  || 174.17 ||
indrāyendo parisrava  174.17
evamuktvā ca ṛṣibhiḥ somaṃ prāpya ca vajriṇe  |
tebhyo dattvā tato yajñaḥ pūrṇo jātaḥ śatakratoḥ  || 174.18 ||
tatsomatīrthamākhyātamāgneyaṃ puratastu tat |
agniriṣṭvā mahāyajñairmāmārādhya manīṣitam  || 174.19 ||
saṃprāptavānmatprasādādahaṃ tatraiva nityaśaḥ  |
sthito lokopakārārthaṃ tatra viṣṇuḥ śivastathā  || 174.20 ||
tasmādāgneyamākhyātamādityaṃ tadanantaram  |
yatrādityo vedamayo nityameti upāsitum  || 174.21 ||
rūpāntareṇa madhyāhne draṣṭuṃ māṃ śaṃkaraṃ harim  |
namaskāryastatra sadā madhyāhne sakalo janaḥ  || 174.22 ||
rūpeṇa kena savitā samāyātītyaniścayāt |
tasmādādityamākhyātaṃ bārhaspatyamanantaram  || 174.23 ||
bṛhaspatiḥ suraiḥ pūjāṃ tasmāttīrthādavāpa ha  |
īje ca yajñān vividhān bārhaspatyaṃ tato viduḥ  || 174.24 ||
tattīrthasmaraṇādeva grahaśāntirbhaviṣyati  |
tasmādapyaparaṃ tīrthamindragope nagottame  || 174.25 ||
pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare  |
himālayena tattīrthamadritīrthaṃ taducyate  || 174.26 ||
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham  |
evaṃ sā gautamī gaṅgā brahmādreśca viniḥsṛtā  || 174.27 ||
yāvatsāgaragā devī tatra tīrthāni kānicit |
saṃkṣepeṇa mayoktāni rahasyāni śubhāni ca  || 174.28 ||
vede purāṇe ṛṣibhiḥ prasiddhā  174.29
yā gautamī lokanamaskṛtā ca  174.29
vaktuṃ kathaṃ tāmatisuprabhāvām  174.29
aśeṣato nārada kasya śaktiḥ  174.29
bhaktyā pravṛttasya yathākathaṃcin  174.30
naivāparādho'sti na saṃśayo'tra  174.30
tasmācca diṅmātramatiprayāsāt 174.30
saṃsūcitaṃ lokahitāya tasyāḥ  174.30
kastasyāḥ pratitīrthaṃ tu prabhāvaṃ vaktumīśvaraḥ  |
api lakṣmīpatirviṣṇuralaṃ someśvaraḥ śivaḥ  || 174.31 ||
kvacitkasmiṃśca tīrthāni kālayoge bhavanti hi  |
guṇavanti mahāprājña gautamī tu sadā nṛṇām  || 174.32 ||
sarvatra sarvadā puṇyā ko nvasyā guṇakīrtanam  |
vaktuṃ śaktastatastasyai nama ityeva yujyate  || 174.33 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
tridaivatyāṃ sureśāna gaṅgāṃ brūṣe sureśvara  |
brāhmaṇenāhṛtāṃ puṇyāṃ jagataḥ pāvanīṃ śubhām  || 175.1 ||
ādimadhyāvasāne ca ubhayostīrayorapi  |
yā vyāptā viṣṇuneśena tvayā ca surasattama  |
punaḥ saṃkṣepato brūhi na me tṛptiḥ prajāyate  || 175.2 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
kamaṇḍalusthitā pūrvaṃ tato viṣṇupadānugā  |
maheśvarajaṭājūṭe sthitā saiva namaskṛtā  || 175.3 ||
brahmatejaḥprabhāveṇa śivamārādhya yatnataḥ  |
tataḥ prāptā giriṃ puṇyaṃ tataḥ pūrvārṇavaṃ prati  || 175.4 ||
āgatya saṃgatā devī sarvatīrthamayī nṛṇām  |
īpsitānāṃ tathā dātrī prabhāvo'syā viśiṣyate  || 175.5 ||
etasyā nādhikaṃ manye kiṃcittīrthaṃ jagattraye  |
asyāścaiva prabhāveṇa bhāvyaṃ yacca manaḥsthitam  || 175.6 ||
adyāpyasyā hi māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ kaiścinna śakyate  |
bhaktito vakṣyate nityaṃ yā brahma paramārthataḥ  || 175.7 ||
tasyāḥ parataraṃ tīrthaṃ na syāditi matirmama  |
anyatīrthena sādharmyaṃ na yujyeta kathaṃcana  || 175.8 ||
śrutvā madvākyapīyūṣairgaṅgāyā guṇakīrtanam  |
sarveṣāṃ na matiḥ kasmāttatraivoparatiṃ gatā  |
iti bhāti vicitraṃ me mune khalu jagattraye  || 175.9 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ tvaṃ vettā copadeśakaḥ  |
chandāṃsi sarahasyāni purāṇasmṛtayo'pi ca  || 175.10 ||
dharmaśāstrāṇi yaccānyattava vākye pratiṣṭhitam  |
tīrthānāmatha dānānāṃ yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ tathā  || 175.11 ||
devatāmantrasevānāmadhikaṃ kiṃ vada prabho  |
yadbrūṣe bhagavan bhaktyā tathā bhāvyaṃ na cānyathā  || 175.12 ||
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ brahman vākyāttvaṃ chettumarhasi  |
iṣṭaṃ manogataṃ śrutvā tasmādvismayamāgataḥ  || 175.13 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ dharmamuttamam  |
caturvidhāni tīrthāni tāvantyeva yugāni ca  || 175.14 ||
guṇāstrayaśca puruṣāstrayo devāḥ sanātanāḥ  |
vedāśca smṛtibhiryuktāścatvāraste prakīrtitāḥ  || 175.15 ||
puruṣārthāśca catvāro vāṇī cāpi caturvidhā  |
guṇā hyapi tu catvāraḥ samatveneti nārada  || 175.16 ||
sarvatra dharmaḥ sāmānyo yato dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ  |
sādhyasādhanabhāvena sa eva bahudhā mataḥ  || 175.17 ||
tasyāśrayaśca dvividho deśaḥ kālaśca sarvadā  |
kālāśrayaśca yo dharmo hīyate vardhate sadā  || 175.18 ||
yugānāmanurūpeṇa pādaḥ pādo'sya hīyate  |
dharmasyeti mahāprājña deśāpekṣā tathobhayam  || 175.19 ||
kālena cāśrito dharmo deśe nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ  |
yugeṣu kṣīyamāṇeṣu na deśeṣu sa hīyate  || 175.20 ||
ubhayatra vihīne ca dharmasya syādabhāvatā  |
tasmāddeśāśrito dharmaścatuṣpātsupratiṣṭhitaḥ  || 175.21 ||
sa cāpi dharmo deśeṣu tīrtharūpeṇa tiṣṭhati  |
kṛte deśaṃ ca kālaṃ ca dharmo'vaṣṭabhya tiṣṭhati  || 175.22 ||
tretāyāṃ pādahīnena sa tu pādaḥ pradeśataḥ  |
dvāpare cārdhataḥ kāle dharmo deśe samāsthitaḥ  || 175.23 ||
kalau pādena caikena dharmaścalati saṃkaṭam  |
evaṃvidhaṃ tu yo dharmaṃ vetti tasya na hīyate  || 175.24 ||
yugānāmanubhāvena jātibhedāśca saṃsthitāḥ  |
guṇebhyo guṇakartṛbhyo vicitrā dharmasaṃsthitiḥ  || 175.25 ||
guṇānāmanubhāvena udbhavābhibhavau tathā  |
tīrthānāmapi varṇānāṃ vedānāṃ svargamokṣayoḥ  || 175.26 ||
tādṛgrūpapravṛttyā tu tadeva ca viśiṣyate  |
kālo'bhivyañjakaḥ prokto deśo'bhivyaṅgya ucyate  || 175.27 ||
yadā yadā abhivyaktiṃ kālo dhatte tadā tadā  |
tadeva vyañjanaṃ brahmaṃstasmānnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ  || 175.28 ||
yugānurūpā mūrtiḥ syāddevānāṃ vaidikī tathā  |
karmaṇāmapi tīrthānāṃ jātīnāmāśramasya tu  || 175.29 ||
tridaivatyaṃ satyayuge tīrthaṃ lokeṣu pūjyate  |
dvidaivatyaṃ yuge'nyasmin dvāpare caikadaivikam  || 175.30 ||
kalau na kiṃcidvijñeyamathānyadapi tacchṛṇu  |
daivaṃ kṛtayuge tīrthaṃ tretāyāmāsuraṃ viduḥ  || 175.31 ||
ārṣaṃ ca dvāpare proktaṃ kalau mānuṣamucyate  |
athānyadapi vakṣyāmi śṛṇu nārada kāraṇam  || 175.32 ||
gautamyāṃ yattvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi vistarāt |
yadā ceyaṃ haraśiraḥ prāptā gaṅgā mahāmune  || 175.33 ||
tadā prabhṛti sā gaṅgā śaṃbhoḥ priyatarābhavat |
taddevasya mataṃ jñātvā gajavaktramuvāca sā  || 175.34 ||
umā lokatrayeśānā mātā ca jagato hitā  |
śāntā śrutiriti khyātā bhuktimuktipradāyinī  || 175.35 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tanmāturvacanaṃ śrutvā gajavaktro'bhyabhāṣata  ||* 175.36 ||
{gajavaktra uvāca̱ }
kiṃ kṛtyaṃ śādhi māṃ mātastatkartāhamasaṃśayam  ||* 175.37 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
umā sutamuvācedaṃ maheśvarajaṭāsthitā  |
tvayāvatāryatāṃ gaṅgā satyamīśapriyā satī  || 175.38 ||
punaśceśastatra citramadhyāste sarvadā suta  |
śivo yatra surāstatra tatra vedāḥ sanātanāḥ  || 175.39 ||
tatraiva ṛṣayaḥ sarve manuṣyāḥ pitarastathā  |
tasmānnivartayeśānaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram  || 175.40 ||
tasyā nivartite deve gaṅgāyāḥ sarva eva hi  |
nivṛttāste bhaviṣyanti śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama  |
nivartaya tatastasyāḥ sarvabhāvena śaṃkaram  || 175.41 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
mātustadvacanaṃ śrutvā punarāha gaṇeśvaraḥ  ||* 175.42 ||
{gaṇeśvara uvāca̱ }
naiva śakyaḥ śivo devo mayā tasyā nivartitum  |
anivṛtte śive tasyā devā api nivartitum  || 175.43 ||
na śakyā jagatāṃ mātarathānyaccāpi kāraṇam  |
gaṅgāvatāritā pūrvaṃ gautamena mahātmanā  || 175.44 ||
ṛṣiṇā lokapūjyena trailokyahitakāriṇā  |
sāmopāyena tadvākyātpūjyena brahmatejasā  || 175.45 ||
ārādhayitvā deveśaṃ tapobhiḥ stutibhirbhavam  |
tuṣṭena śaṃkareṇedamukto'sau gautamastadā  || 175.46 ||
{śaṃkara uvāca̱ }
varān varaya puṇyāṃśca priyāṃśca manasepsitān  |
yadyadicchasi tatsarvaṃ dātā te'dya mahāmate  || 175.47 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktaḥ śivenāsau gautamo mayi śṛṇvati  |
idameva tadovāca sajaṭāṃ dehi śaṃkara  |
gaṅgāṃ me yācate puṇyāṃ kimanyena vareṇa me  || 175.48 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
punaḥ provāca taṃ śaṃbhuḥ sarvalokopakārakaḥ  ||* 175.49 ||
{śaṃbhuruvāca̱ }
uktaṃ na cātmanaḥ kiṃcittasmādyācasva duṣkaram  ||* 175.50 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
gautamo'dīnasattvastaṃ bhavamāha kṛtāñjaliḥ  ||* 175.51 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
etadeva ca sarveṣāṃ duṣkaraṃ tava darśanam  |
mayā tadadya saṃprāptaṃ kṛpayā tava śaṃkara  || 175.52 ||
smaraṇādeva te padbhyāṃ kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ  |
bhavanti kiṃ punaḥ sākṣāttvayi dṛṣṭe maheśvare  || 175.53 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamukte gautamena bhavo harṣasamanvitaḥ  |
trayāṇāmupakārārthaṃ lokānāṃ yācitaṃ tvayā  || 175.54 ||
na cātmano mahābuddhe yācetyāha śivo dvijam  |
evaṃ proktaḥ punarvipro dhyātvā prāha śivaṃ tathā  || 175.55 ||
vinītavadadīnātmā śivabhaktisamanvitaḥ  |
sarvalokopakārāya punaryācitavānidam  |
śṛṇvatsu lokapāleṣu jagādedaṃ sa gautamaḥ  || 175.56 ||
{gautama uvāca̱ }
yāvatsāgaragā devī nisṛṣṭā brahmaṇo gireḥ  |
sarvatra sarvadā tasyāṃ sthātavyaṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja  || 175.57 ||
phalepsūnāṃ phalaṃ dātā tvameva jagataḥ prabho  |
tīrthānyanyāni deveśa kvāpi kvāpi śubhāni ca  || 175.58 ||
yatra te saṃnidhirnityaṃ tadeva śubhadaṃ viduḥ  |
yatra gaṅgā tvayā dattā jaṭāmukuṭasaṃsthitā  |
sarvatra tava sāṃnidhyātsarvatīrthāni śaṃkara  || 175.59 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadgautamavacaḥ śrutvā punarharṣācchivo'bravīt ||* 175.60 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
yatra kvāpi ca yatkiṃcidyo vā bhavati bhaktitaḥ  |
yātrāṃ snānamatho dānaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vāpi tarpaṇam  || 175.61 ||
śravaṇaṃ paṭhanaṃ vāpi smaraṇaṃ vāpi gautama  |
yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā godāvaryā yatavrataḥ  || 175.62 ||
saptadvīpavatī pṛthvī saśailavanakānanā  |
saratnā sauṣadhī ramyā sārṇavā dharmabhūṣitā  || 175.63 ||
dattvā bhavati yo dharmaḥ sa bhavedgautamīsmṛteḥ  |
evaṃvidhā ilā vipra godānādyābhidhīyate  || 175.64 ||
candrasūryagrahe kāle matsāṃnidhye yatavrataḥ  |
bhūbhṛte viṣṇave bhaktyā sarvakālaṃ kṛtā sudhīḥ  || 175.65 ||
gāḥ sundarāḥ savatsāśca saṃgame lokaviśrute  |
yo dadāti dvijaśreṣṭha tatra yatpuṇyamāpnuyāt || 175.66 ||
tasmādvaraṃ puṇyameti snānadānādinā naraḥ  |
gautamyāṃ viśvavandyāyāṃ mahānadyāṃ tu bhaktitaḥ  || 175.67 ||
tasmādgodāvarī gaṅgā tvayā nītā bhaviṣyati  |
sarvapāpakṣayakarī sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinī  || 175.68 ||
{gaṇeśvara uvāca̱ }
etacchrutaṃ mayā mātarvadato gautamaṃ śivāt |
etasmātkāraṇācchaṃbhurgaṅgāyāṃ niyataḥ sthitaḥ  || 175.69 ||
ko nivartayituṃ śaktastamamba karuṇodadhim  |
athāpi mātaretatsyānmānuṣā vighnapāśakaiḥ  || 175.70 ||
vinibaddhā na gacchanti godāmapyantikasthitām  |
na namanti śivaṃ devaṃ na smaranti stuvanti na  || 175.71 ||
tathā mātaḥ kariṣyāmi tava saṃtoṣahetave  |
saṃniroddhumatho kleśastava vākyaṃ kṣamasva me  || 175.72 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tataḥ prabhṛti vighneśo mānuṣān prati kiṃcana  |
vighnamācarate yastu tamupāsya pravartate  || 175.73 ||
atho vighnamanādṛtya gautamīṃ yāti bhaktitaḥ  |
sa kṛtārtho bhavelloke na kṛtyamavaśiṣyate  || 175.74 ||
vighnānyanekāni bhavanti gehān  175.75
nirgantukāmasya narādhamasya  175.75
nidhāya tanmūrdhni padaṃ prayāti  175.75
gaṅgāṃ na kiṃ tena phalaṃ pralabdham  175.75
asyāḥ prabhāvaṃ ko brūyādapi sākṣātsadāśivaḥ  |
saṃkṣepeṇa mayā proktamitihāsapadānugam  || 175.76 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ yaccarācare  |
tadatra vidyate sarvamitihāse savistare  || 175.77 ||
vedoditaṃ śrutisakalarahasyamuktaṃ  175.78
satkāraṇaṃ samabhidhānamidaṃ sadaiva  175.78
samyakca dṛṣṭaṃ jagatāṃ hitāya  175.78
proktaṃ purāṇaṃ bahudharmayuktam  175.78
asya ślokaṃ padaṃ vāpi bhaktitaḥ śṛṇuyātpaṭhet |
gaṅgā gaṅgeti vā vākyaṃ sa tu puṇyamavāpnuyāt || 175.79 ||
kalikalaṅkavināśanadakṣamidaṃ  175.80
sakalasiddhikaraṃ śubhadaṃ śivam  175.80
jagati pūjyamabhīṣṭaphalapradaṃ  175.80
gāṅgametadudīritamuttamam  175.80
sādhu gautama bhadraṃ te ko'nyo'sti sadṛśastvayā  |
ya enāṃ gautamīṃ gaṅgāṃ daṇḍakāraṇyamāpnuyāt || 175.81 ||
gaṅgā gaṅgeti yo brūyādyojanānāṃ śatairapi  |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  || 175.82 ||
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca tīrthāni bhuvanatraye  |
tāni snātuṃ samāyānti gaṅgāyāṃ siṃhage gurau  || 175.83 ||
ṣaṣṭirvarṣasahasrāṇi bhāgīrathyavagāhanam  |
sakṛdgodāvarīsnānaṃ siṃhayukte bṛhaspatau  || 175.84 ||
iyaṃ tu gautamī putra yatra kvāpi mamājñayā  |
sarveṣāṃ sarvadā nṝṇāṃ snānānmuktiṃ pradāsyati  || 175.85 ||
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca  |
kṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti tadasya śravaṇādbhavet || 175.86 ||
yasyaitattiṣṭhati gṛhe purāṇaṃ brahmaṇoditam  |
na bhayaṃ vidyate tasya kalikālasya nārada  || 175.87 ||
yasya kasyāpi nākhyeyaṃ purāṇamidamuttamam  |
śraddadhānāya śāntāya vaiṣṇavāya mahātmane  || 175.88 ||
idaṃ kīrtyaṃ bhuktimukti dāyakaṃ pāpanāśakam  |
etacchravaṇamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ  || 175.89 ||
likhitvā pustakamidaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati  |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ punargarbhaṃ na saṃviśet || 175.90 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
nahi nastṛptirastīha śṛṇvatāṃ bhagavatkathām  |
punareva paraṃ guhyaṃ vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ  || 176.1 ||
anantavāsudevasya na samyagvarṇitaṃ tvayā  |
śrotumicchāmahe deva vistareṇa vadasva naḥ  || 176.2 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
pravakṣyāmi muniśreṣṭhāḥ sārātsārataraṃ param  |
anantavāsudevasya māhātmyaṃ bhuvi durlabham  || 176.3 ||
ādikalpe purā viprāstvahamavyaktajanmavān  |
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya vacanaṃ proktavānidam  || 176.4 ||
variṣṭhaṃ devaśilpīndraṃ viśvakarmāgrakarmiṇam  |
pratimāṃ vāsudevasya kuru śailamayīṃ bhuvi  || 176.5 ||
yāṃ prekṣya vidhivadbhaktāḥ sendrā vai mānuṣādayaḥ  |
yena dānavarakṣobhyo vijñāya sumahadbhayam  || 176.6 ||
tridivaṃ samanuprāpya sumeruśikharaṃ ciram  |
vāsudevaṃ samārādhya nirātaṅkā vasanti te  || 176.7 ||
mama tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvakarmā tu tatkṣaṇāt |
cakāra pratimāṃ śuddhāṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharām  || 176.8 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ puṇḍarīkāyatekṣaṇām  |
śrīvatsalakṣmasaṃyuktāmatyugrāṃ pratimottamām  || 176.9 ||
vanamālāvṛtoraskāṃ mukuṭāṅgadadhāriṇīm  |
pītavastrāṃ supīnāṃsāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāmalaṃkṛtām  || 176.10 ||
evaṃ sā pratimā divyā guhyamantraistadā svayam  |
pratiṣṭhākālamāsādya mayāsau nirmitā purā  || 176.11 ||
tasmin kāle tadā śakro devarāṭkhecaraiḥ saha  |
jagāma brahmasadanamāruhya gajamuttamam  || 176.12 ||
prasādya pratimāṃ śakraḥ snānadānaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ  |
pratimāṃ tāṃ samārādhya svapuraṃ punarāgamat || 176.13 ||
tāṃ samārādhya suciraṃ yatavākkāyamānasaḥ  |
vṛtrādyānasurān krūrānnamucipramukhān sa ca  || 176.14 ||
nihatya dānavān bhīmān bhuktavān bhuvanatrayam  |
dvitīye ca yuge prāpte tretāyāṃ rākṣasādhipaḥ  || 176.15 ||
babhūva sumahāvīryo daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān  |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ  || 176.16 ||
cacāra vratamatyugraṃ tapaḥ paramaduścaram  |
tapasā tena tuṣṭo'haṃ varaṃ tasmai pradattavān  || 176.17 ||
avadhyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ sa daityoragarakṣasām  |
śāpapraharaṇairugrairavadhyo yamakiṃkaraiḥ  || 176.18 ||
varaṃ prāpya tadā rakṣo yakṣān sarvagaṇānimān  |
dhanādhyakṣaṃ vinirjitya śakraṃ jetuṃ samudyataḥ  || 176.19 ||
saṃgrāmaṃ sumahāghoraṃ kṛtvā devaiḥ sa rākṣasaḥ  |
devarājaṃ vinirjitya tadā indrajiteti vai  || 176.20 ||
rākṣasastatsuto nāma meghanādaḥ pralabdhavān  |
amarāvatīṃ tataḥ prāpya devarājagṛhe śubhe  || 176.21 ||
dadarśāñjanasaṃkāśāṃ rāvaṇastu balānvitaḥ  |
pratimāṃ vāsudevasya sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām  || 176.22 ||
śrīvatsalakṣmasaṃyuktāṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇām  |
vanamālāvṛtoraskāṃ mukuṭāṅgadabhūṣitām  || 176.23 ||
śaṅkhacakragadāhastāṃ pītavastrāṃ caturbhujām  |
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām  || 176.24 ||
vihāya ratnasaṃghāṃśca pratimāṃ śubhalakṣaṇām  |
puṣpakeṇa vimānena laṅkāṃ prāsthāpayaddrutam  || 176.25 ||
purādhyakṣaḥ sthitaḥ śrīmān dharmātmā sa vibhīṣaṇaḥ  |
rāvaṇasyānujo mantrī nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ  || 176.26 ||
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ pratimāṃ divyāṃ devendrabhavanacyutām  |
romāñcitatanurbhūtvā vismayaṃ samapadyata  || 176.27 ||
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā  |
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ  || 176.28 ||
ityuktvā sa tu dharmātmā praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ  |
jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramāsādya kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata  || 176.29 ||
rājan pratimayā tvaṃ me prasādaṃ kartumarhasi  |
yāmārādhya jagannātha nistareyaṃ bhavārṇavam  || 176.30 ||
bhrāturvacanamākarṇya rāvaṇastaṃ tadābravīt |
gṛhāṇa pratimāṃ vīra tvanayā kiṃ karomyaham  || 176.31 ||
svayaṃbhuvaṃ samārādhya trailokyaṃ vijaye tvaham  |
nānāścaryamayaṃ devaṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam  || 176.32 ||
vibhīṣaṇo mahābuddhistadā tāṃ pratimāṃ śubhām  |
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ cābdaṃ samārādhya janārdanam  || 176.33 ||
ajarāmaraṇaṃ prāptamaṇimādiguṇairyutam  |
rājyaṃ laṅkādhipatyaṃ ca bhogān bhuṅkte yathepsitān  || 176.34 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
aho no vismayo jātaḥ śrutvedaṃ paramāmṛtam  |
anantavāsudevasya saṃbhavaṃ bhuvi durlabham  || 176.35 ||
śrotumicchāmahe deva vistareṇa yathātatham  |
tasya devasya māhātmyaṃ vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ  || 176.36 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tadā sa rākṣasaḥ krūro devagandharvakiṃnarān  |
lokapālān samanujānmunisiddhāṃśca pāpakṛt || 176.37 ||
vijitya samare sarvānājahāra tadaṅganāḥ  |
saṃsthāpya nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ punaḥ sītārthamohitaḥ  || 176.38 ||
śaṅkito mṛgarūpeṇa sauvarṇena ca rāvaṇaḥ  |
tataḥ kruddhena rāmeṇa raṇe saumitriṇā saha  || 176.39 ||
rāvaṇasya vadhārthāya hatvā vāliṃ manojavam  |
abhiṣiktaśca sugrīvo yuvarājo'ṅgadastathā  || 176.40 ||
hanumānnalanīlaśca jāmbavān panasastathā  |
gavayaśca gavākṣaśca pāṭhīnaḥ paramaujasaḥ  || 176.41 ||
etaiścānyaiśca bahubhirvānaraiḥ samahābalaiḥ  |
samāvṛto mahāghorai rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ  || 176.42 ||
girīṇāṃ sarvasaṃghātaiḥ setuṃ baddhvā mahodadhau  |
balena mahatā rāmaḥ samuttīrya mahodadhim  || 176.43 ||
saṃgrāmamatulaṃ cakre rakṣogaṇasamanvitaḥ  |
yamahastaṃ prahastaṃ ca nikumbhaṃ kumbhameva ca  || 176.44 ||
narāntakaṃ mahāvīryaṃ tathā caiva yamāntakam  |
mālāḍhyaṃ mālikāḍhyaṃ ca hatvā rāmastu vīryavān  || 176.45 ||
punarindrajitaṃ hatvā kumbhakarṇaṃ sarāvaṇam  |
vaidehīṃ cāgnināśodhya dattvā rājyaṃ vibhīṣaṇe  || 176.46 ||
vāsudevaṃ samādāya yānaṃ puṣpakamāruhat |
līlayā samanuprāpadayodhyāṃ pūrvapālitām  || 176.47 ||
kaniṣṭhaṃ bharataṃ snehācchatrughnaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ  |
abhiṣicya tadā rāmaḥ sarvarājye'dhirājavat || 176.48 ||
purātanīṃ svamūrtiṃ ca samārādhya tato hariḥ  |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi daśa varṣaśatāni ca  || 176.49 ||
bhuktvā sāgaraparyantāṃ medinīṃ sa tu rāghavaḥ  |
rājyamāsādya sugatiṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāviśat || 176.50 ||
tāṃ cāpi pratimāṃ rāmaḥ samudreśāya dattavān  |
dhanyo rakṣayitāsi tvaṃ toyaratnasamanvitaḥ  || 176.51 ||
dvāparaṃ yugamāsādya yadā devo jagatpatiḥ  |
dharaṇyāścānurodhena bhāvaśaithilyakāraṇāt || 176.52 ||
avatīrṇaḥ sa bhagavān vasudevakule prabhuḥ  |
kaṃsādīnāṃ vadhārthāya saṃkarṣaṇasahāyavān  || 176.53 ||
tadā tāṃ pratimāṃ viprāḥ sarvavāñchāphalapradām  |
sarvalokahitārthāya kasyacitkāraṇāntare  || 176.54 ||
tasmin kṣetravare puṇye durlabhe puruṣottame  |
ujjahāra svayaṃ toyātsamudraḥ saritāṃ patiḥ  || 176.55 ||
tadā prabhṛti tatraiva kṣetre muktiprade dvijāḥ  |
āste sa devo devānāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ  || 176.56 ||
ye saṃśrayanti cānantaṃ bhaktyā sarveśvaraṃ prabhum  |
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhirnityaṃ te yānti paramaṃ padam  || 176.57 ||
dṛṣṭvānantaṃ sakṛdbhaktyā saṃpūjya praṇipatya ca  |
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ labhet || 176.58 ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhena kāmagena suvarcasā  |
vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā  || 176.59 ||
triḥsaptakulamuddhṛtya divyastrīgaṇasevitaḥ  |
upagīyamāno gandharvairnaro viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet || 176.60 ||
tatra bhuktvā varān bhogāñjarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ  |
divyarūpadharaḥ śrīmān yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  || 176.61 ||
puṇyakṣayādihāyātaścaturvedī dvijottamaḥ  |
vaiṣṇavaṃ yogamāsthāya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 176.62 ||
evaṃ mayā tvananto'sau kīrtito munisattamāḥ  |
kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ tasya varṣaśatairapi  || 176.63 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evaṃ vo'nantamāhātmyaṃ kṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamam  |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ mayā proktaṃ sudurlabham  || 177.1 ||
yatrāste puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  |
pītāmbaradharaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kaṃsakeśiniṣūdanaḥ  || 177.2 ||
ye tatra kṛṣṇaṃ paśyanti surāsuranamaskṛtam  |
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ subhadrāṃ ca dhanyāste nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 177.3 ||
trailokyādhipatiṃ devaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam  |
ye dhyāyanti sadā kṛṣṇaṃ muktāste nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 177.4 ||
kṛṣṇe ratāḥ kṛṣṇamanusmaranti  177.5
rātrau ca kṛṣṇaṃ punarutthitā ye  177.5
te bhinnadehāḥ praviśanti kṛṣṇaṃ  177.5
haviryathā mantrahutaṃ hutāśam  177.5
tasmātsadā muniśreṣṭhāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kamalalocanaḥ  |
tasmin kṣetre prayatnena draṣṭavyo mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ  || 177.6 ||
śayanotthāpane kṛṣṇaṃ ye paśyanti manīṣiṇaḥ  |
halāyudhaṃ subhadrāṃ ca hareḥ sthānaṃ vrajanti te  || 177.7 ||
sarvakāle'pi ye bhaktyā paśyanti puruṣottamam  |
rauhiṇeyaṃ subhadrāṃ ca viṣṇulokaṃ vrajanti te  || 177.8 ||
āste yaścaturo māsān vārṣikān puruṣottame  |
pṛthivyāstīrthayātrāyāḥ phalaṃ prāpnoti cādhikam  || 177.9 ||
ye sarvakālaṃ tatraiva nivasanti manīṣiṇaḥ  |
jitendriyā jitakrodhā labhante tapasaḥ phalam  || 177.10 ||
