tapastaptvānyatīrtheṣu varṣāṇāmayutaṃ naraḥ  |
yadāpnoti tadāpnoti māsena puruṣottame  || 177.11 ||
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa saṅgatyāgena yatphalam  |
tatphalaṃ satataṃ tatra prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ  || 177.12 ||
sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ snānadānena kīrtitam  |
tatphalaṃ satataṃ tatra prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ  || 177.13 ||
samyaktīrthena yatproktaṃ vratena niyamena ca  |
tatphalaṃ labhate tatra pratyahaṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ  || 177.14 ||
yastu nānāvidhairyajñairyatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ  |
tatphalaṃ labhate tatra pratyahaṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ  || 177.15 ||
dehaṃ tyajanti puruṣāstatra ye puruṣottame  |
kalpavṛkṣaṃ samāsādya muktāste nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 177.16 ||
vaṭasāgarayormadhye ye tyajanti kalevaram  |
te durlabhaṃ paraṃ mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ  || 177.17 ||
anicchannapi yastatra prāṇāṃstyajati mānavaḥ  |
so'pi duḥkhavinirmukto muktiṃ prāpnoti durlabhām  || 177.18 ||
kṛmikīṭapataṃgādyāstiryagyonigatāśca ye  |
tatra dehaṃ parityajya te yānti paramāṃ gatim  || 177.19 ||
bhrāntiṃ lokasya paśyadhvamanyatīrthaṃ prati dvijāḥ  |
puruṣākhyena yatprāptamanyatīrthaphalādikam  || 177.20 ||
sakṛtpaśyati yo martyaḥ śraddhayā puruṣottamam  |
puruṣāṇāṃ sahasreṣu sa bhaveduttamaḥ pumān  || 177.21 ||
prakṛteḥ sa paro yasmātpuruṣādapi cottamaḥ  |
tasmādvede purāṇe ca loke'smin puruṣottamaḥ  || 177.22 ||
yo'sau purāṇe vedānte paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ  |
āste viśvopakārāya tenāsau puruṣottamaḥ  || 177.23 ||
pāthe śmaśāne gṛhamaṇḍape vā  177.24
rathyāpradeśeṣvapi yatra kutra  177.24
icchannanicchannapi tatra dehaṃ  177.24
saṃtyajya mokṣaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ  177.24
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tasmin kṣetre dvijottamāḥ  |
dehatyāgo naraiḥ kāryaḥ samyaṅmokṣābhikāṅkṣibhiḥ  || 177.25 ||
puruṣākhyasya māhātmyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati  |
tyaktvā yatra naro dehaṃ muktiṃ prāpnoti durlabhām  || 177.26 ||
guṇānāmekadeśo'yaṃ mayā kṣetrasya kīrtitaḥ  |
kaḥ samastān guṇān vaktuṃ śakto varṣaśatairapi  || 177.27 ||
yadi yūyaṃ muniśreṣṭhā mokṣamicchatha śāśvatam  |
tasmin kṣetravare puṇye nivasadhvamatandritāḥ  || 177.28 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
te tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ  |
nivāsaṃ cakrire tatra avāpuḥ paramaṃ padam  || 177.29 ||
tasmādyūyaṃ prayatnena nivasadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
puruṣākhye vare kṣetre yadi muktimabhīpsatha  || 177.30 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tasmin kṣetre muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvasattvasukhāvahe  |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phalade puruṣottame  || 178.1 ||
kaṇḍurnāma mahātejā ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ  |
satyavādī śucirdāntaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ  || 178.2 ||
jitendriyo jitakrodho vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ  |
avāpa paramāṃ siddhimārādhya puruṣottamam  || 178.3 ||
anye'pi tatra saṃsiddhā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ  |
sarvabhūtahitā dāntā jitakrodhā vimatsarāḥ  || 178.4 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
ko'sau kaṇḍuḥ kathaṃ tatra jagāma paramāṃ gatim  |
śrotumicchāmahe tasya caritaṃ brūhi sattama  || 178.5 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ kathāṃ tasya manoharām  |
pravakṣyāmi samāsena munestasya viceṣṭitam  || 178.6 ||
pavitre gomatītīre vijane sumanohare  |
kandamūlaphalaiḥ pūrṇe samitpuṣpakuśānvitaiḥ  || 178.7 ||
nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite  |
nānāpakṣirute ramye nānāmṛgagaṇānvite  || 178.8 ||
tatrāśramapadaṃ kaṇḍorbabhūva munisattamāḥ  |
sarvartuphalapuṣpāḍhyaṃ kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam  || 178.9 ||
tapastepe munistatra sumahatparamādbhutam  |
vratopavāsairniyamaiḥ snānamaunasusaṃyamaiḥ  || 178.10 ||
grīṣme pañcatapā bhūtvā varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ  |
ārdravāsāstu hemante sa tepe sumahattapaḥ  || 178.11 ||
dṛṣṭvā tu tapaso vīryaṃ munestasya suvismitāḥ  |
babhūvurdevagandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharāstathā  || 178.12 ||
bhūmiṃ tathāntarikṣaṃ ca divaṃ ca munisattamāḥ  |
kaṇḍuḥ saṃtāpayāmāsa trailokyaṃ tapaso balāt || 178.13 ||
aho'sya paramaṃ dhairyamaho'sya paramaṃ tapaḥ  |
ityabruvaṃstadā dṛṣṭvā devāstaṃ tapasi sthitam  || 178.14 ||
mantrayāmāsuravyagrāḥ śakreṇa sahitāstadā  |
bhayāttasya samudvignāstapovighnamabhīpsavaḥ  || 178.15 ||
jñātvā teṣāmabhiprāyaṃ śakrastribhuvaneśvaraḥ  |
pramlocākhyāṃ varārohāṃ rūpayauvanagarvitām  || 178.16 ||
sumadhyāṃ cārujaṅghāṃ tāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām  |
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ provāca phalasūdanaḥ  || 178.17 ||
{śakra uvāca̱ }
pramloce gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ yadāsau tapyate muniḥ  |
vighnārthaṃ tasya tapasaḥ kṣobhayasvāṃśu suprabhe  || 178.18 ||
{pramlocovāca̱ }
tava vākyaṃ suraśreṣṭha karomi satataṃ prabho  |
kiṃtu śaṅkā mamaivātra jīvitasya ca saṃśayaḥ  || 178.19 ||
bibhemi taṃ munivaraṃ brahmacaryavrate sthitam  |
atyugraṃ dīptatapasaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham  || 178.20 ||
jñātvā māṃ sa muniḥ krodhādvighnārthaṃ samupāgatām  |
kaṇḍuḥ paramatejasvī śāpaṃ dāsyati duḥsaham  || 178.21 ||
urvaśī menakā rambhā ghṛtācī puñjikasthalā  |
viśvācī sahajanyā ca pūrvacittistilottamā  || 178.22 ||
alambuṣā miśrakeśī śaśilekhā ca vāmanā  |
anyāścāpsarasaḥ santi rūpayauvanagarvitāḥ  || 178.23 ||
sumadhyāścāruvadanāḥ pīnonnatapayodharāḥ  |
kāmapradhānakuśalāstāstatra saṃniyojaya  || 178.24 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā punaḥ prāha śacīpatiḥ  |
tiṣṭhantu nāma cānyāstāstvaṃ cātra kuśalā śubhe  || 178.25 ||
kāmaṃ vasantaṃ vāyuṃ ca sahāyārthe dadāmi te  |
taiḥ sārdhaṃ gaccha suśroṇi yatrāste sa mahāmuniḥ  || 178.26 ||
śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tadā sā cārulocanā  |
jagāmākāśamārgeṇa taiḥ sārdhaṃ cāśramaṃ muneḥ  || 178.27 ||
gatvā sā tatra ruciraṃ dadarśa vanamuttamam  |
muniṃ ca dīptatapasamāśramasthamakalmaṣam  || 178.28 ||
apaśyatsā vanaṃ ramyaṃ taiḥ sārdhaṃ nandanopamam  |
sarvartuvarapuṣpāḍhyaṃ śākhāmṛgagaṇākulam  || 178.29 ||
puṇyaṃ padmabalopetaṃ sapallavamahābalam  |
śrotraramyān sumadhurāñśabdān khagamukheritān  || 178.30 ||
sarvartuphalabhārāḍhyān sarvartukusumojjvalān  |
apaśyatpādapāṃścaiva vihaṃgairanunāditān  || 178.31 ||
āmrānāmrātakān bhavyānnārikerān satindukān  |
atha bilvāṃstathā jīvān dāḍimān bījapūrakān  || 178.32 ||
panasāṃllakucānnīpāñśirīṣān sumanoharān  |
pārāvatāṃstathā kolānarimedāmlavetasān  || 178.33 ||
bhallātakānāmalakāñśataparṇāṃśca kiṃśukān  |
iṅgudān karavīrāṃśca harītakīvibhītakān  || 178.34 ||
etānanyāṃśca sā vṛkṣān dadarśa pṛthulocanā  |
tathaivāśokapuṃnāga ketakībakulānatha  || 178.35 ||
pārijātān kovidārānmandārendīvarāṃstathā  |
pāṭalāḥ puṣpitā ramyā devadārudrumāṃstathā  || 178.36 ||
śālāṃstālāṃstamālāṃśca niculāṃllomakāṃstathā  |
anyāṃśca pādapaśreṣṭhānapaśyatphalapuṣpitān  || 178.37 ||
cakoraiḥ śatapattraiśca bhṛṅgarājaistathā śukaiḥ  |
kokilaiḥ kalaviṅkaiśca hārītairjīvajīvakaiḥ  || 178.38 ||
priyaputraiścātakaiśca tathānyairvividhaiḥ khagaiḥ  |
śrotraramyaṃ sumadhuraṃ kūjadbhiścāpyadhiṣṭhitam  || 178.39 ||
sarāṃsi ca manojñāni prasannasalilāni ca  |
kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiśca tathā nīlotpalaiḥ śubhaiḥ  || 178.40 ||
kahlāraiḥ kamalaiścaiva ācitāni samantataḥ  |
kādambaiścakravākaiśca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ  || 178.41 ||
kāraṇḍavairbakairhaṃsaiḥ kūrmairmadgubhireva ca  |
etaiścānyaiśca kīrṇāni samantājjalacāribhiḥ  || 178.42 ||
krameṇaiva tathā sā tu vanaṃ babhrāma taiḥ saha  |
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā vanaṃ ramyaṃ taiḥ sārdhaṃ paramādbhutam  || 178.43 ||
vismayotphullanayanā sā babhūva varāṅganā  |
provāca vāyuṃ kāmaṃ ca vasantaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  || 178.44 ||
{pramlocovāca̱ }
kurudhvaṃ mama sāhāyyaṃ yūyaṃ sarve pṛthakpṛthak ||* 178.45 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
evamuktvā tadā sā tu tathetyuktā surairdvijāḥ  |
pratyuvācādya yāsyāmi yatrāsau saṃsthito muniḥ  || 178.46 ||
adya taṃ dehayantāraṃ prayuktendriyavājinam  |
smaraśastragaladraśmiṃ kariṣyāmi kusārathim  || 178.47 ||
brahmā janārdano vāpi yadi vā nīlalohitaḥ  |
tathāpyadya kariṣyāmi kāmabāṇakṣatāntaram  || 178.48 ||
ityuktvā prayayau sātha yatrāsau tiṣṭhate muniḥ  |
munestapaḥprabhāveṇa praśāntaśvāpadāśramam  || 178.49 ||
sā puṃskokilamādhurye nadītīre vyavasthitā  |
stokamātraṃ sthitā tasmādagāyata varāpsarāḥ  || 178.50 ||
tato vasantaḥ sahasā balaṃ samakarottadā  |
kokilārāvamadhuramakālikamanoharam  || 178.51 ||
vavau gandhavahaścaiva malayādriniketanaḥ  |
puṣpānuccāvacānmedhyān pātayaṃśca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ  || 178.52 ||
puṣpabāṇadharaścaiva gatvā tasya samīpataḥ  |
muneśca kṣobhayāmāsa kāmastasyāpi mānasam  || 178.53 ||
tato gītadhvaniṃ śrutvā munirvismitamānasaḥ  |
jagāma yatra sā subhrūḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ  || 178.54 ||
dṛṣṭvā tāmāha saṃdṛṣṭo vismayotphullalocanaḥ  |
bhraṣṭottarīyo vikalaḥ pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ  || 178.55 ||
{ṛṣiruvāca̱ }
kāsi kasyāsi suśroṇi subhage cāruhāsini  |
mano harasi me subhru brūhi satyaṃ sumadhyame  || 178.56 ||
{pramlocovāca̱ }
tava karmakarā cāhaṃ puṣpārthamahamāgatā  |
ādeśaṃ dehi me kṣipraṃ kiṃ karomi tavājñayā  || 178.57 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasyāstyaktvā dhairyaṃ vimohitaḥ  |
ādāya haste tāṃ bālāṃ praviveśa svamāśramam  || 178.58 ||
tataḥ kāmaśca vāyuśca vasantaśca dvijottamāḥ  |
jagmuryathāgataṃ sarve kṛtakṛtyāstriviṣṭapam  || 178.59 ||
śaśaṃsuśca hariṃ gatvā tasyāstasya ca ceṣṭitam  |
śrutvā śakrastadā devāḥ prītāḥ sumanaso'bhavan  || 178.60 ||
sa ca kaṇḍustayā sārdhaṃ praviśanneva cāśramam  |
ātmanaḥ paramaṃ rūpaṃ cakāra madanākṛti  || 178.61 ||
rūpayauvanasaṃpannamatīva sumanoharam  |
divyālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ ṣoḍaśavatsarākṛti  || 178.62 ||
divyavastradharaṃ kāntaṃ divyasraggandhabhūṣitam  |
sarvopabhogasaṃpannaṃ sahasā tapaso balāt || 178.63 ||
dṛṣṭvā sā tasya tadvīryaṃ paraṃ vismayamāgatā  |
aho'sya tapaso vīryamityuktvā muditābhavat || 178.64 ||
snānaṃ saṃdhyāṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ devatārcanam  |
vratopavāsaniyamaṃ dhyānaṃ ca munisattamāḥ  || 178.65 ||
tyaktvā sa reme muditastayā sārdhamaharniśam  |
manmathāviṣṭahṛdayo na bubodha tapaḥkṣayam  || 178.66 ||
saṃdhyārātridivāpakṣa māsartvayanahāyanam  |
na bubodha gataṃ kālaṃ viṣayāsaktamānasaḥ  || 178.67 ||
sā ca taṃ kāmajairbhāvairvidagdhā rahasi dvijāḥ  |
varayāmāsa suśroṇiḥ pralāpakuśalā tadā  || 178.68 ||
evaṃ kaṇḍustayā sārdhaṃ varṣāṇāmadhikaṃ śatam  |
atiṣṭhanmandaradroṇyāṃ grāmyadharmarato muniḥ  || 178.69 ||
sā taṃ prāha mahābhāgaṃ gantumicchāmyahaṃ divam  |
prasādasumukho brahmannanujñātuṃ tvamarhasi  || 178.70 ||
tayaivamuktaḥ sa munistasyāmāsaktamānasaḥ  |
dināni katicidbhadre sthīyatāmityabhāṣata  || 178.71 ||
evamuktā tatastena sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ punaḥ  |
bubhuje viṣayāṃstanvī tena sārdhaṃ mahātmanā  || 178.72 ||
anujñāṃ dehi bhagavan vrajāmi tridaśālayam  |
uktastayeti sa punaḥ sthīyatāmityabhāṣata  || 178.73 ||
punargate varṣaśate sādhike sā śubhānanā  |
yāmyahaṃ tridivaṃ brahman praṇayasmitaśobhanam  || 178.74 ||
uktastayaivaṃ sa muniḥ punarāhāyatekṣaṇām  |
ihāsyatāṃ mayā subhru ciraṃ kālaṃ gamiṣyasi  || 178.75 ||
tacchāpabhītā suśroṇī saha tenarṣiṇā punaḥ  |
śatadvayaṃ kiṃcidūnaṃ varṣāṇāṃ samatiṣṭhata  || 178.76 ||
gamanāya mahābhāgo devarājaniveśanam  |
proktaḥ proktastayā tanvyā sthīyatāmityabhāṣata  || 178.77 ||
tasya śāpabhayādbhīrurdākṣiṇyena ca dakṣiṇā  |
proktā praṇayabhaṅgārti vedinī na jahau munim  || 178.78 ||
tayā ca ramatastasya paramarṣeraharniśam  |
navaṃ navamabhūtprema manmathāsaktacetasaḥ  || 178.79 ||
ekadā tu tvarāyukto niścakrāmoṭajānmuniḥ  |
niṣkrāmantaṃ ca kutreti gamyate prāha sā śubhā  || 178.80 ||
ityuktaḥ sa tayā prāha parivṛttamahaḥ śubhe  |
saṃdhyopāstiṃ kariṣyāmi kriyālopo'nyathā bhavet || 178.81 ||
tataḥ prahasya muditā sā taṃ prāha mahāmunim  |
kimadya sarvadharmajña parivṛttamahastava  |
gatametanna kurute vismayaṃ kasya kathyate  || 178.82 ||
{muniruvāca̱ }
prātastvamāgatā bhadre nadītīramidaṃ śubham  |
mayā dṛṣṭāsi suśroṇi praviṣṭā ca mamāśramam  || 178.83 ||
iyaṃ ca vartate saṃdhyā pariṇāmamaho gatam  |
avahāsaḥ kimartho'yaṃ sadbhāvaḥ kathyatāṃ mama  || 178.84 ||
{pramlocovāca̱ }
pratyūṣasyāgatā brahman satyametanna me mṛṣā  |
kiṃtvadya tasya kālasya gatānyabdaśatāni te  || 178.85 ||
tataḥ sasādhvaso viprastāṃ papracchāyatekṣaṇām  |
kathyatāṃ bhīru kaḥ kālastvayā me ramataḥ sadā  || 178.86 ||
{pramlocovāca̱ }
saptottarāṇyatītāni navavarṣaśatāni ca  |
māsāśca ṣaṭtathaivānyatsamatītaṃ dinatrayam  || 178.87 ||
{ṛṣiruvāca̱ }
satyaṃ bhīru vadasyetatparihāso'thavā śubhe  |
dinamekamahaṃ manye tvayā sārdhamihoṣitam  || 178.88 ||
{pramlocovāca̱ }
vadiṣyāmyanṛtaṃ brahman kathamatra tavāntike  |
viśeṣādadya bhavatā pṛṣṭā mārgānugāminā  || 178.89 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
niśamya tadvacastasyāḥ sa munirdvijasattamāḥ  |
dhigdhiṅmāmityanācāraṃ vinindyātmānamātmanā  || 178.90 ||
{muniruvāca̱ }
tapāṃsi mama naṣṭāni hataṃ brahmavidāṃ dhanam  |
hṛto vivekaḥ kenāpi yoṣinmohāya nirmitā  || 178.91 ||
ūrmiṣaṭkātigaṃ brahma jñeyamātmajayena me  |
gatireṣā kṛtā yena dhiktaṃ kāmamahāgraham  || 178.92 ||
vratāni sarvavedāśca kāraṇānyakhilāni ca  |
narakagrāmamārgeṇa kāmenādya hatāni me  || 178.93 ||
vinindyetthaṃ sa dharmajñaḥ svayamātmānamātmanā  178.94
tāmapsarasamāsīnāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt 178.94
{ṛṣiruvāca̱ }
gaccha pāpe yathākāmaṃ yatkāryaṃ tattvayā kṛtam  178.94
devarājasya yatkṣobhaṃ kurvantyā bhāvaceṣṭitaiḥ  178.94
na tvāṃ karomyahaṃ bhasma krodhatīvreṇa vahninā  |
satāṃ sāptapadaṃ maitryamuṣito'haṃ tvayā saha  || 178.95 ||
athavā tava doṣaḥ kaḥ kiṃ vā kuryāmahaṃ tava  |
mamaiva doṣo nitarāṃ yenāhamajitendriyaḥ  || 178.96 ||
yathā śakrapriyārthinyā kṛto mattapaso vyayaḥ  |
tvayā dṛṣṭimahāmoha manunāhaṃ jugupsitaḥ  || 178.97 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
yāvaditthaṃ sa viprarṣistāṃ bravīti sumadhyamām  |
tāvatskhalatsvedajalā sā babhūvātivepathuḥ  || 178.98 ||
pravepamānāṃ sa ca tāṃ svinnagātralatāṃ satīm  |
gaccha gaccheti sakrodhamuvāca munisattamaḥ  || 178.99 ||
sā tu nirbhartsitā tena viniṣkramya tadāśramāt |
ākāśagāminī svedaṃ mamārja tarupallavaiḥ  || 178.100 ||
vṛkṣādvṛkṣaṃ yayau bālā udagrāruṇapallavaiḥ  |
nirmamārja ca gātrāṇi galatsvedajalāni vai  || 178.101 ||
ṛṣiṇā yastadā garbhastasyā dehe samāhitaḥ  |
nirjagāma saromāñca svedarūpī tadaṅgataḥ  || 178.102 ||
taṃ vṛkṣā jagṛhurgarbhamekaṃ cakre ca mārutaḥ  |
somenāpyāyito gobhiḥ sa tadā vavṛddhe śanaiḥ  || 178.103 ||
māriṣā nāma kanyābhūdvṛkṣāṇāṃ cārulocanā  |
prācetasānāṃ sā bhāryā dakṣasya jananī dvijāḥ  || 178.104 ||
sa cāpi bhagavān kaṇḍuḥ kṣīṇe tapasi sattamaḥ  |
puruṣottamākhyaṃ bho viprā viṣṇorāyatanaṃ yayau  || 178.105 ||
dadarśa paramaṃ kṣetraṃ muktidaṃ bhuvi durlabham  |
dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre sarvakāmaphalapradam  || 178.106 ||
suramyaṃ vālukākīrṇaṃ ketakīvanaśobhitam  |
nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāpakṣirutaṃ śivam  || 178.107 ||
sarvatra sukhasaṃcāraṃ sarvartukusumānvitam  |
sarvasaukhyapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanyaṃ sarvaguṇākaram  || 178.108 ||
bhṛgvādyaiḥ sevitaṃ pūrvaṃ munisiddhavaraistathā  |
gandharvaiḥ kiṃnarairyakṣaistathānyairmokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ  || 178.109 ||
dadarśa ca hariṃ tatra devaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtam  |
brāhmaṇādyaistathā varṇairāśramasthairniṣevitam  || 178.110 ||
dṛṣṭvaiva sa tadā kṣetraṃ devaṃ ca puruṣottamam  |
kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mene sa munisattamaḥ  || 178.111 ||
tatraikāgramanā bhūtvā cakārārādhanaṃ hareḥ  |
brahmapāramayaṃ kurvañjapamekāgramānasaḥ  |
ūrdhvabāhurmahāyogī sthitvāsau munisattamaḥ  || 178.112 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
brahmapāraṃ mune śrotumicchāmaḥ paramaṃ śubham  |
japatā kaṇḍunā devo yenārādhyata keśavaḥ  || 178.113 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
pāraṃ paraṃ viṣṇurapārapāraḥ  178.114
paraḥ parebhyaḥ paramātmarūpaḥ  178.114
sa brahmapāraḥ parapārabhūtaḥ  178.114
paraḥ parāṇāmapi pārapāraḥ  178.114
sa kāraṇaṃ kāraṇasaṃśrito'pi  178.115
tasyāpi hetuḥ parahetuhetuḥ  178.115
kāryo'pi caiṣa saha karmakartṛ  178.115
rūpairanekairavatīha sarvam  178.115
brahma prabhurbrahma sa sarvabhūto  178.116
brahma prajānāṃ patiracyuto'sau  178.116
brahmāvyayaṃ nityamajaṃ sa viṣṇur 178.116
apakṣayādyairakhilairasaṅgaḥ  178.116
brahmākṣaramajaṃ nityaṃ yathāsau puruṣottamaḥ  |
tathā rāgādayo doṣāḥ prayāntu praśamaṃ mama  || 178.117 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śrutvā tasya munerjāpyaṃ brahmapāraṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
bhaktiṃ ca paramāṃ jñātvā sudṛḍhāṃ puruṣottamaḥ  || 178.118 ||
prītyā sa parayā devastadāsau bhaktavatsalaḥ  |
gatvā tasya samīpaṃ tu provāca madhusūdanaḥ  || 178.119 ||
meghagambhīrayā vācā diśaḥ saṃnādayanniva  |
āruhya garuḍaṃ viprā vinatākulanandanam  || 178.120 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
mune brūhi paraṃ kāryaṃ yatte manasi vartate  |
varado'hamanuprāpto varaṃ varaya suvrata  || 178.121 ||
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasya devadevasya cakriṇaḥ  |
cakṣurunmīlya sahasā dadarśa purato harim  || 178.122 ||
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam  |
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ mukuṭāṅgadadhāriṇam  || 178.123 ||
caturbāhumudārāṅgaṃ pītavastradharaṃ śubham  |
śrīvatsalakṣmasaṃyuktaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam  || 178.124 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam  |
divyacandanaliptāṅgaṃ divyamālyavibhūṣitam  || 178.125 ||
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo romāñcitatanūruhaḥ  |
daṇḍavatpraṇipatyorvyāṃ praṇāmamakarottadā  || 178.126 ||
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ  |
ityuktvā muniśārdūlāstaṃ stotumupacakrame  || 178.127 ||
{kaṇḍuruvāca̱ }
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīvatsāṅka jagatpate  |
jagadbīja jagaddhāma jagatsākṣinnamo'stu te  || 178.128 ||
avyakta jiṣṇo prabhava pradhānapuruṣottama  |
puṇḍarīkākṣa govinda lokanātha namo'stu te  || 178.129 ||
hiraṇyagarbha śrīnātha padmanātha sanātana  |
bhūgarbha dhruva īśāna hṛṣīkeśa namo'stu te  || 178.130 ||
anādyantāmṛtājeya jaya tvaṃ jayatāṃ vara  |
ajitākhaṇḍa śrīkṛṣṇa śrīnivāsa namo'stu te  || 178.131 ||
parjanyadharmakartā ca duṣpāra duradhiṣṭhita  |
duḥkhārtināśana hare jalaśāyinnamo'stu te  || 178.132 ||
bhūtapāvyakta bhūteśa bhūtatattvairanākula  |
bhūtādhivāsa bhūtātman bhūtagarbha namo'stu te  || 178.133 ||
yajñayajvan yajñadhara yajñadhātābhayaprada  |
yajñagarbha hiraṇyāṅga pṛśnigarbha namo'stu te  || 178.134 ||
kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrabhṛtkṣetrī kṣetrahā kṣetrakṛdvaśī  |
kṣetrātman kṣetrarahita kṣetrasraṣṭre namo'stu te  || 178.135 ||
guṇālaya guṇāvāsa guṇāśraya guṇāvaha  |
guṇabhoktṛ guṇārāma guṇatyāginnamo'stu te  || 178.136 ||
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ hariścakrī tvaṃ jiṣṇustvaṃ janārdanaḥ  |
tvaṃ bhūtastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvaṃ bhavyastvaṃ bhavatprabhuḥ  || 178.137 ||
tvaṃ bhūtakṛttvamavyaktastvaṃ bhavo bhūtabhṛdbhavān  |
tvaṃ bhūtabhāvano devastvāmāhurajamīśvaram  || 178.138 ||
tvamanantaḥ kṛtajñastvaṃ prakṛtistvaṃ vṛṣākapiḥ  |
tvaṃ rudrastvaṃ durādharṣastvamamoghastvamīśvaraḥ  || 178.139 ||
tvaṃ viśvakarmā jiṣṇustvaṃ tvaṃ śaṃbhustvaṃ vṛṣākṛtiḥ  |
tvaṃ śaṃkarastvamuśanā tvaṃ satyaṃ tvaṃ tapo janaḥ  || 178.140 ||
tvaṃ viśvajetā tvaṃ śarma tvaṃ śaraṇyastvamakṣaram  |
tvaṃ śaṃbhustvaṃ svayaṃbhūśca tvaṃ jyeṣṭhastvaṃ parāyaṇaḥ  || 178.141 ||
tvamādityastvamoṃkārastvaṃ prāṇastvaṃ tamisrahā  |
tvaṃ parjanyastvaṃ prathitastvaṃ vedhāstvaṃ sureśvaraḥ  || 178.142 ||
tvamṛgyajuḥ sāma caiva tvamātmā saṃmato bhavān  |
tvamagnistvaṃ ca pavanastvamāpo vasudhā bhavān  || 178.143 ||
tvaṃ sraṣṭā tvaṃ tathā bhoktā hotā tvaṃ ca haviḥ kratuḥ  |
tvaṃ prabhustvaṃ vibhuḥ śreṣṭhastvaṃ lokapatiracyutaḥ  || 178.144 ||
tvaṃ sarvadarśanaḥ śrīmāṃstvaṃ sarvadamano'rihā  |
tvamahastvaṃ tathā rātristvāmāhurvatsaraṃ budhāḥ  || 178.145 ||
tvaṃ kālastvaṃ kalā kāṣṭhā tvaṃ muhūrtaḥ kṣaṇā lavāḥ  |
tvaṃ bālastvaṃ tathā vṛddhastvaṃ pumān strī napuṃsakaḥ  || 178.146 ||
tvaṃ viśvayonistvaṃ cakṣustvaṃ sthāṇustvaṃ śuciśravāḥ  |
tvaṃ śāśvatastvamajitastvamupendrastvamuttamaḥ  || 178.147 ||
tvaṃ sarvaviśvasukhadastvaṃ vedāṅgaṃ tvamavyayaḥ  |
tvaṃ vedavedastvaṃ dhātā vidhātā tvaṃ samāhitaḥ  || 178.148 ||
tvaṃ jalanidhirāmūlaṃ tvaṃ dhātā tvaṃ punarvasuḥ  |
tvaṃ vaidyastvaṃ dhṛtātmā ca tvamatīndriyagocaraḥ  || 178.149 ||
tvamagraṇīrgrāmaṇīstvaṃ tvaṃ suparṇastvamādimān  |
tvaṃ saṃgrahastvaṃ sumahattvaṃ dhṛtātmā tvamacyutaḥ  || 178.150 ||
tvaṃ yamastvaṃ ca niyamastvaṃ prāṃśustvaṃ caturbhujaḥ  |
tvamevānnāntarātmā tvaṃ paramātmā tvamucyate  || 178.151 ||
tvaṃ gurustvaṃ gurutamastvaṃ vāmastvaṃ pradakṣiṇaḥ  |
tvaṃ pippalastvamagamastvaṃ vyaktastvaṃ prajāpatiḥ  || 178.152 ||
hiraṇyanābhastvaṃ devastvaṃ śaśī tvaṃ prajāpatiḥ  |
anirdeśyavapustvaṃ vai tvaṃ yamastvaṃ surārihā  || 178.153 ||
tvaṃ ca saṃkarṣaṇo devastvaṃ kartā tvaṃ sanātanaḥ  |
tvaṃ vāsudevo'meyātmā tvameva guṇavarjitaḥ  || 178.154 ||
tvaṃ jyeṣṭhastvaṃ variṣṭhastvaṃ tvaṃ sahiṣṇuśca mādhavaḥ  |
sahasraśīrṣā tvaṃ devastvamavyaktaḥ sahasradṛk || 178.155 ||
sahasrapādastvaṃ devastvaṃ virāṭtvaṃ suraprabhuḥ  |
tvameva tiṣṭhase bhūyo devadeva daśāṅgulaḥ  || 178.156 ||
yadbhūtaṃ tattvamevoktaḥ puruṣaḥ śakra uttamaḥ  |
yadbhāvyaṃ tattvamīśānastvamṛtastvaṃ tathāmṛtaḥ  || 178.157 ||
tvatto rohatyayaṃ loko mahīyāṃstvamanuttamaḥ  |
tvaṃ jyāyān puruṣastvaṃ ca tvaṃ deva daśadhā sthitaḥ  || 178.158 ||
viśvabhūtaścaturbhāgo navabhāgo'mṛto divi  |
navabhāgo'ntarikṣasthaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ sanātanaḥ  || 178.159 ||
bhāgadvayaṃ ca bhūsaṃsthaṃ caturbhāgo'pyabhūdiha  |
tvatto yajñāḥ saṃbhavanti jagato vṛṣṭikāraṇam  || 178.160 ||
tvatto virāṭsamutpanno jagato hṛdi yaḥ pumān  |
so'tiricyata bhūtebhyastejasā yaśasā śriyā  || 178.161 ||
tvattaḥ surāṇāmāhāraḥ pṛṣadājyamajāyata  |
grāmyāraṇyāścauṣadhayastvattaḥ paśumṛgādayaḥ  || 178.162 ||
dhyeyadhyānaparastvaṃ ca kṛtavānasi cauṣadhīḥ  |
tvaṃ devadeva saptāsya kālākhyo dīptavigrahaḥ  || 178.163 ||
jaṅgamājaṅgamaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram  |
tvattaḥ sarvamidaṃ jātaṃ tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  || 178.164 ||
aniruddhastvaṃ mādhavastvaṃ pradyumnaḥ surārihā  |
deva sarvasuraśreṣṭha sarvalokaparāyaṇa  || 178.165 ||
trāhi māmaravindākṣa nārāyaṇa namo'stu te  |
namaste bhagavan viṣṇo namaste puruṣottama  || 178.166 ||
namaste sarvalokeśa namaste kamalālaya  |
guṇālaya namaste'stu namaste'stu guṇākara  || 178.167 ||
vāsudeva namaste'stu namaste'stu surottama  |
janārdana namaste'stu namaste'stu sanātana  || 178.168 ||
namaste yogināṃ gamya yogāvāsa namo'stu te  |
gopate śrīpate viṣṇo namaste'stu marutpate  || 178.169 ||
jagatpate jagatsūte namaste jñānināṃ pate  |
divaspate namaste'stu namaste'stu mahīpate  || 178.170 ||
namaste madhuhantre ca namaste puṣkarekṣaṇa  |
kaiṭabhaghna namaste'stu subrahmaṇya namo'stu te  || 178.171 ||
namo'stu te mahāmīna śrutipṛṣṭhadharācyuta  |
samudrasalilakṣobha padmajāhlādakāriṇe  || 178.172 ||
aśvaśīrṣa mahāghoṇa mahāpuruṣavigraha  |
madhukaiṭabhahantre ca namaste turagānana  || 178.173 ||
mahākamaṭhabhogāya pṛthivyuddharaṇāya ca  |
vidhṛtādrisvarūpāya mahākūrmāya te namaḥ  || 178.174 ||
namo mahāvarāhāya pṛthivyuddhārakāriṇe  |
namaścādivarāhāya viśvarūpāya vedhase  || 178.175 ||
namo'nantāya sūkṣmāya mukhyāya ca varāya ca  |
paramāṇusvarūpāya yogigamyāya te namaḥ  || 178.176 ||
tasmai namaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya  178.177
yogīndravṛttanilayāya sudurvidāya  178.177
kṣīrārṇavāśritamahāhisutalpagāya  178.177
tubhyaṃ namaḥ kanakaratnasukuṇḍalāya  178.177
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
itthaṃ stutastadā tena prītaḥ provāca mādhavaḥ  |
kṣipraṃ brūhi muniśreṣṭha matto yadabhivāñchasi  || 178.178 ||
{kaṇḍuruvāca̱ }
saṃsāre'smiñjagannātha dustare lomaharṣaṇe  |
anitye duḥkhabahule kadalīdalasaṃnibhe  || 178.179 ||
nirāśraye nirālambe jalabudbudacañcale  |
sarvopadravasaṃyukte dustare cātibhairave  || 178.180 ||
bhramāmi suciraṃ kālaṃ māyayā mohitastava  |
na cāntamabhigacchāmi viṣayāsaktamānasaḥ  || 178.181 ||
tvāmahaṃ cādya deveśa saṃsārabhayapīḍitaḥ  |
gato'smi śaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇa māmuddhara bhavārṇavāt || 178.182 ||
gantumicchāmi paramaṃ padaṃ yatte sanātanam  |
prasādāttava deveśa punarāvṛttidurlabham  || 178.183 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
bhakto'si me muniśreṣṭha māmārādhaya nityaśaḥ  |
matprasādāddhruvaṃ mokṣaṃ prāpyasi tvaṃ samīhitam  || 178.184 ||
madbhaktāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāntyajātijāḥ  |
prāpnuvanti parāṃ siddhiṃ kiṃ punastvaṃ dvijottama  || 178.185 ||
śvapāko'pi ca madbhaktaḥ samyakśraddhāsamanvitaḥ  |
prāpnotyabhimatāṃ siddhimanyeṣāṃ tatra kā kathā  || 178.186 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evamuktvā tu taṃ viprāḥ sa devo bhaktavatsalaḥ  |
durvijñeyagatirviṣṇustatraivāntaradhīyata  || 178.187 ||
gate tasminmuniśreṣṭhāḥ kaṇḍuḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ  |
sarvān kāmān parityajya svasthacitto bhavatpunaḥ  || 178.188 ||
sarvendriyāṇi saṃyamya nirmamo nirahaṃkṛtiḥ  |
ekāgramānasaḥ samyagdhyātvā taṃ puruṣottamam  || 178.189 ||
nirlepaṃ nirguṇaṃ śāntaṃ sattāmātravyavasthitam  |
avāpa paramaṃ mokṣaṃ surāṇāmapi durlabham  || 178.190 ||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi kathāṃ kaṇḍormahātmanaḥ  |
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ svargalokaṃ sa gacchati  || 178.191 ||
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhāḥ karmabhūmirudāhṛtā  |
mokṣakṣetraṃ ca paramaṃ devaṃ ca puruṣottamam  || 178.192 ||
ye paśyanti vibhuṃ stuvanti varadaṃ dhyāyanti muktipradaṃ  |
bhaktyā śrīpuruṣottamākhyamajaraṃ saṃsāraduḥkhāpaham  || 178.193 ||
te bhuktvā manujendrabhogamamalāḥ svarge ca divyaṃ sukhaṃ  |
paścādyānti samastadoṣarahitāḥ sthānaṃ hareravyayam  || 178.194 ||
{lomaharṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
vyāsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā munayaḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ  |
prītā babhūvuḥ saṃhṛṣṭā vismitāśca punaḥ punaḥ  || 179.1 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
aho bhāratavarṣasya tvayā saṃkīrtitā guṇāḥ  |
tadvacchrīpuruṣākhyasya kṣetrasya puruṣottama  || 179.2 ||
vismayo hi na caikasya śrutvā māhātmyamuttamam  |
puruṣākhyasya kṣetrasya prītiśca vadatāṃ vara  || 179.3 ||
cirātprabhṛti cāsmākaṃ saṃśayo hṛdi vartate  |
tvadṛte saṃśayasyāsya cchettā nānyo'sti bhūtale  || 179.4 ||
utpattiṃ baladevasya kṛṣṇasya ca mahītale  |
bhadrāyāścaiva kārtsnyena pṛcchāmastvāṃ mahāmune  || 179.5 ||
kimarthaṃ tau samutpannau kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāvubhau  |
vasudevasutau vīrau sthitau nandagṛhe mune  || 179.6 ||
niḥsāre mṛtyuloke'smin duḥkhaprāye'ticañcale  |
jalabudbudasaṃkāśe bhairave lomaharṣaṇe  || 179.7 ||
viṇmūtrapicchalaṃ kaṣṭaṃ saṃkaṭaṃ duḥkhadāyakam  |
kathaṃ ghorataraṃ teṣāṃ garbhavāsamarocata  || 179.8 ||
yāni karmāṇi cakruste samutpannā mahītale  |
vistareṇa mune tāni brūhi no vadatāṃ vara  || 179.9 ||
samagraṃ caritaṃ teṣāmadbhutaṃ cātimānuṣam  |
kathaṃ sa bhagavān devaḥ sureśaḥ surasattamaḥ  || 179.10 ||
vasudevakule dhīmān vāsudevatvamāgataḥ  |
amaraiścāvṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyakṛdbhiralaṃkṛtam  || 179.11 ||
devalokaṃ kimutsṛjya martyaloka ihāgataḥ  |
devamānuṣayornetā dyorbhuvaḥ prabhavo'vyayaḥ  || 179.12 ||
kimarthaṃ divyamātmānaṃ mānuṣeṣu nyayojayat |
yaścakraṃ vartayatyeko mānuṣāṇāmanāmayam  || 179.13 ||
sa mānuṣye kathaṃ buddhiṃ cakre cakragadādharaḥ  |
gopāyanaṃ yaḥ kurute jagataḥ sārvabhautikam  || 179.14 ||
sa kathaṃ gāṃ gato viṣṇurgopatvamakarotprabhuḥ  |
mahābhūtāni bhūtātmā yo dadhāra cakāra ca  || 179.15 ||
śrīgarbhaḥ sa kathaṃ garbhe striyā bhūcarayā dhṛtaḥ  |
yena lokān kramairjitvā tribhirvai tridaśepsayā  || 179.16 ||
sthāpitā jagato mārgāstrivargāścābhavaṃstrayaḥ  |
yo'ntakāle jagatpītvā kṛtvā toyamayaṃ vapuḥ  || 179.17 ||
lokamekārṇavaṃ cakre dṛśyādṛśyena cātmanā  |
yaḥ purāṇaḥ purāṇātmā vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ  || 179.18 ||
viṣāṇāgreṇa vasudhāmujjahārārisūdanaḥ  |
yaḥ purā puruhūtārthe trailokyamidamavyayam  || 179.19 ||
dadau jitvā vasumatīṃ surāṇāṃ surasattamaḥ  |
yena saiṃhavapuḥ kṛtvā dvidhā kṛtvā ca tatpunaḥ  || 179.20 ||
pūrvadaityo mahāvīryo hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ  |
yaḥ purā hyanalo bhūtvā aurvaḥ saṃvartako vibhuḥ  || 179.21 ||
pātālastho'rṇavarasaṃ papau toyamayaṃ hariḥ  |
sahasracaraṇaṃ brahma sahasrāṃśusahasradam  || 179.22 ||
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ yamāhurvai yuge yuge  |
nābhyāṃ padmaṃ samudbhūtaṃ yasya paitāmahaṃ gṛham  || 179.23 ||
ekārṇave nāgaloke saddhiraṇmayapaṅkajam  |
yena te nihatā daityāḥ saṃgrāme tārakāmaye  || 179.24 ||
yena devamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvāyudhadharaṃ vapuḥ  |
guhāsaṃsthena cotsiktaḥ kālanemirnipātitaḥ  || 179.25 ||
uttarānte samudrasya kṣīrodasyāmṛtodadhau  |
yaḥ śete śāśvataṃ yogamāsthāya timiraṃ mahat || 179.26 ||
surāraṇī garbhamadhatta divyaṃ  179.27
tapaḥprakarṣādaditiḥ purāṇam  179.27
śakraṃ ca yo daityagaṇāvaruddhaṃ  179.27
garbhāvadhānena kṛtaṃ cakāra  179.27
padāni yo yogamayāni kṛtvā  179.28
cakāra daityān salileśayasthān  179.28
kṛtvā ca devāṃstridaśeśvarāṃstu  179.28
cakre sureśaṃ puruhūtameva  179.28
gārhapatyena vidhinā anvāhāryeṇa karmaṇā  |
agnimāhavanīyaṃ ca vedaṃ dīkṣāṃ samiddhruvam  || 179.29 ||
prokṣaṇīyaṃ sruvaṃ caiva āvabhṛthyaṃ tathaiva ca  |
avākpāṇistu yaścakre havyabhāgabhujastathā  || 179.30 ||
havyādāṃśca surāṃścakre kavyādāṃśca pitṝnatha  |
bhogārthe yajñavidhinā'yojayadyajñakarmaṇi  || 179.31 ||
pātrāṇi dakṣiṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ carūṃścolūkhalāni ca  |
yūpaṃ samitsruvaṃ somaṃ pavitrān paridhīnapi  || 179.32 ||
yajñiyāni ca dravyāṇi camasāṃśca tathāparān  |
sadasyān yajamānāṃśca medhādīṃśca kratūttamān  || 179.33 ||
vibabhāja purā yastu pārameṣṭhyena karmaṇā  |
yugānurūpaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā lokānanuparākramāt || 179.34 ||
kṣaṇā nimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhāśca kalāstraikālyameva ca  |
muhūrtāstithayo māsā dinaṃ saṃvatsarastathā  || 179.35 ||
ṛtavaḥ kālayogāśca pramāṇaṃ trividhaṃ triṣu  |
āyuḥkṣetrāṇyupacayo lakṣaṇaṃ rūpasauṣṭhavam  || 179.36 ||
trayo lokāstrayo devāstraividyaṃ pāvakāstrayaḥ  |
traikālyaṃ trīṇi karmāṇi trayo varṇāstrayo guṇāḥ  || 179.37 ||
sṛṣṭā lokāḥ purā sarve yenānantena karmaṇā  |
sarvabhūtagataḥ sraṣṭā sarvabhūtaguṇātmakaḥ  || 179.38 ||
nṛṇāmindriyapūrveṇa yogena ramate ca yaḥ  |
gatāgatābhyāṃ yogena ya eva vidhirīśvaraḥ  || 179.39 ||
yo gatirdharmayuktānāmagatiḥ pāpakarmaṇām  |
cāturvarṇyasya prabhavaścāturvarṇyasya rakṣitā  || 179.40 ||
cāturvidyasya yo vettā cāturāśramyasaṃśrayaḥ  |
digantaraṃ nabho bhūmirvāyurvāpi vibhāvasuḥ  || 179.41 ||
candrasūryamayaṃ jyotiryugeśaḥ kṣaṇadācaraḥ  |
yaḥ paraṃ śrūyate jyotiryaḥ paraṃ śrūyate tapaḥ  || 179.42 ||
yaṃ paraṃ prāhuraparaṃ yaḥ paraḥ paramātmavān  |
ādityānāṃ tu yo devo yaśca daityāntako vibhuḥ  || 179.43 ||
yugānteṣvantako yaśca yaśca lokāntakāntakaḥ  |
seturyo lokasetūnāṃ medhyo yo medhyakarmaṇām  || 179.44 ||
vedyo yo vedaviduṣāṃ prabhuryaḥ prabhavātmanām  |
somabhūtaśca saumyānāmagnibhūto'gnivarcasām  || 179.45 ||
yaḥ śakrāṇāmīśabhūtastapobhūtastapasvinām  |
vinayo nayavṛttīnāṃ tejastejasvināmapi  || 179.46 ||
vigraho vigrahārhāṇāṃ gatirgatimatāmapi  |
ākāśaprabhavo vāyurvāyoḥ prāṇāddhutāśanaḥ  || 179.47 ||
divo hutāśanaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇo'gnirmadhusūdanaḥ  |
rasācchoṇitasaṃbhūtiḥ śoṇitānmāṃsamucyate  || 179.48 ||
māṃsāttu medaso janma medaso'sthi nirucyate  |
asthno majjā samabhavanmajjātaḥ śukrasaṃbhavaḥ  || 179.49 ||
śukrādgarbhaḥ samabhavadrasamūlena karmaṇā  |
tatrāpāṃ prathamo bhāgaḥ sa saumyo rāśirucyate  || 179.50 ||
garbhoṣmasaṃbhavo jñeyo dvitīyo rāśirucyate  |
śukraṃ somātmakaṃ vidyādārtavaṃ pāvakātmakam  || 179.51 ||
bhāvā rasānugāścaiṣāṃ bīje ca śaśipāvakau  |
kaphavarge bhavecchukraṃ pittavarge ca śoṇitam  || 179.52 ||
kaphasya hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ nābhyāṃ pittaṃ pratiṣṭhitam  |
dehasya madhye hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ tanmanasaḥ smṛtam  || 179.53 ||
nābhikoṣṭhāntaraṃ yattu tatra devo hutāśanaḥ  |
manaḥ prajāpatirjñeyaḥ kaphaḥ somo vibhāvyate  || 179.54 ||
pittamagniḥ smṛtaṃ tvevamagnisomātmakaṃ jagat |
evaṃ pravartite garbhe vardhite'rbudasaṃnibhe  || 179.55 ||
vāyuḥ praveśaṃ saṃcakre saṃgataḥ paramātmanaḥ  |
sa pañcadhā śarīrastho bhidyate vartate punaḥ  || 179.56 ||
prāṇāpānau samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca  |
prāṇo'sya paramātmānaṃ vardhayan parivartate  || 179.57 ||
apānaḥ paścimaṃ kāyamudāno'rdhaṃ śarīriṇaḥ  |
vyānastu vyāpyate yena samānaḥ saṃnivartate  || 179.58 ||
bhūtāvāptistatastasya jāyetendriyagocarā  |
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotiśca pañcamam  || 179.59 ||
tasyendriyaniviṣṭāni svaṃ svaṃ bhāgaṃ pracakrire  |
pārthivaṃ dehamāhustu prāṇātmānaṃ ca mārutam  || 179.60 ||
chidrāṇyākāśayonīni jalātsrāvaḥ pravartate  |
jyotiścakṣūṃṣi tejaśca ātmā teṣāṃ manaḥ smṛtam  || 179.61 ||
grāmāśca viṣayāścaiva yasya vīryātpravartitāḥ  |
ityetān puruṣaḥ sarvān sṛjaṃllokān sanātanaḥ  || 179.62 ||
naidhane'smin kathaṃ loke naratvaṃ viṣṇurāgataḥ  |
eṣa naḥ saṃśayo brahmanneṣa no vismayo mahān  || 179.63 ||
kathaṃ gatirgatimatāmāpanno mānuṣīṃ tanum  |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ viṣṇurdevairdaityaiśca kathyate  || 179.64 ||
viṣṇorutpattimāścaryaṃ kathayasva mahāmune  |
prakhyātabalavīryasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ  || 179.65 ||
karmaṇāścaryabhūtasya viṣṇostattvamihocyatām  |
kathaṃ sa devo devānāmārtihā puruṣottamaḥ  || 179.66 ||
sarvavyāpī jagannāthaḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ  |
sargasthityantakṛddevaḥ sarvalokasukhāvahaḥ  || 179.67 ||
akṣayaḥ śāśvato'nantaḥ kṣayavṛddhivivarjitaḥ  |
nirlepo nirguṇaḥ sūkṣmo nirvikāro nirañjanaḥ  || 179.68 ||
sarvopādhivinirmuktaḥ sattāmātravyavasthitaḥ  |
avikārī vibhurnityaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ  || 179.69 ||
acalo nirmalo vyāpī nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ  |
viśuddhaṃ śrūyate yasya haritvaṃ ca kṛte yuge  || 179.70 ||
vaikuṇṭhatvaṃ ca deveṣu kṛṣṇatvaṃ mānuṣeṣu ca  |
īśvarasya hi tasyemāṃ gahanāṃ karmaṇo gatim  || 179.71 ||
samatītāṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca śrotumicchā pravartate  |
avyakto vyaktaliṅgastho ya eṣa bhagavān prabhuḥ  || 179.72 ||
nārāyaṇo hyanantātmā prabhavo'vyaya eva ca  |
eṣa nārāyaṇo bhūtvā harirāsītsanātanaḥ  || 179.73 ||
brahmā śakraśca rudraśca dharmaḥ śukro bṛhaspatiḥ  |
pradhānātmā purā hyeṣa brahmāṇamasṛjatprabhuḥ  || 179.74 ||
so'sṛjatpūrvapuruṣaḥ purā kalpe prajāpatīn  |
evaṃ sa bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ  |
kimarthaṃ martyaloke'smin yāto yadukule hariḥ  || 179.75 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
namaskṛtvā sureśāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave  |
puruṣāya purāṇāya śāśvatāyāvyayāya ca  || 180.1 ||
caturvyūhātmane tasmai nirguṇāya guṇāya ca  |
variṣṭhāya gariṣṭhāya vareṇyāyāmitāya ca  || 180.2 ||
yajñāṅgāyākhilāṅgāya devādyairīpsitāya ca  |
yasmādaṇutaraṃ nāsti yasmānnāsti bṛhattaram  || 180.3 ||
yena viśvamidaṃ vyāptamajena sacarācaram  |
āvirbhāvatirobhāva dṛṣṭādṛṣṭavilakṣaṇam  || 180.4 ||
vadanti yatsṛṣṭamiti tathaivāpyupasaṃhṛtam  |
brahmaṇe cādidevāya namaskṛtya samādhinā  || 180.5 ||
avikārāya śuddhāya nityāya paramātmane  |
sadaikarūparūpāya jiṣṇave viṣṇave namaḥ  || 180.6 ||
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya haraye śaṃkarāya ca  |
vāsudevāya tārāya sargasthityantakāriṇe  || 180.7 ||
ekānekasvarūpāya sthūlasūkṣmātmane namaḥ  |
avyaktavyaktabhūtāya viṣṇave muktihetave  || 180.8 ||
sargasthitivināśānāṃ jagato yo jaganmayaḥ  |
mūlabhūto namastasmai viṣṇave paramātmane  || 180.9 ||
ādhārabhūtaṃ viśvasyāpyaṇīyāṃsamaṇīyasām  |
praṇamya sarvabhūtasthamacyutaṃ puruṣottamam  || 180.10 ||
jñānasvarūpamatyantaṃ nirmalaṃ paramārthataḥ  |
tamevārthasvarūpeṇa bhrāntidarśanataḥ sthitam  || 180.11 ||
viṣṇuṃ grasiṣṇuṃ viśvasya sthitisarge tathā prabhum  |
anādiṃ jagatāmīśamajamakṣayamavyayam  || 180.12 ||
kathayāmi yathā pūrvaṃ yakṣādyairmunisattamaiḥ  |
pṛṣṭaḥ provāca bhagavānabjayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ  || 180.13 ||
ṛksāmānyudgiran vaktrairyaḥ punāti jagattrayam  |
praṇipatya tatheśānamekārṇavavinirgatam  || 180.14 ||
yasyāsuragaṇā yajñān vilumpanti na yājinām  |
pravakṣyāmi mataṃ kṛtsnaṃ brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ  || 180.15 ||
yena sṛṣṭiṃ samuddiśya dharmādyāḥ prakaṭīkṛtāḥ  |
āpo nārā iti proktā munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ  || 180.16 ||
ayanaṃ tasya tāḥ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
sa devo bhagavān sarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ  || 180.17 ||
caturdhā saṃsthito brahmā saguṇo nirguṇastathā  |
ekā mūrtiranuddeśyā śuklāṃ paśyanti tāṃ budhāḥ  || 180.18 ||
jvālāmālāvanaddhāṅgī niṣṭhā sā yogināṃ parā  |
dūrasthā cāntikasthā ca vijñeyā sā guṇātigā  || 180.19 ||
vāsudevābhidhānāsau nirmamatvena dṛśyate  |
rūpavarṇādayastasyā na bhāvāḥ kalpanāmayāḥ  || 180.20 ||
āste ca sā sadā śuddhā supratiṣṭhaikarūpiṇī  |
dvitīyā pṛthivīṃ mūrdhnā śeṣākhyā dhārayatyadhaḥ  || 180.21 ||
tāmasī sā samākhyātā tiryaktvaṃ samupāgatā  |
tṛtīyā karma kurute prajāpālanatatparā  || 180.22 ||
sattvodriktā tu sā jñeyā dharmasaṃsthānakāriṇī  |
caturthī jalamadhyasthā śete pannagatalpagā  || 180.23 ||
rajastasyā guṇaḥ sargaṃ sā karoti sadaiva hi  |
yā tṛtīyā harermūrtiḥ prajāpālanatatparā  || 180.24 ||
sā tu dharmavyavasthānaṃ karoti niyataṃ bhuvi  |
proddhatānasurān hanti dharmavyucchittikāriṇaḥ  || 180.25 ||
pāti devān sagandharvān dharmarakṣāparāyaṇān  |
yadā yadā ca dharmasya glāniḥ samupajāyate  || 180.26 ||
abhyutthānamadharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjatyasau  |
bhūtvā purā varāheṇa tuṇḍenāpo nirasya ca  || 180.27 ||
ekayā daṃṣṭrayotkhātā nalinīva vasuṃdharā  |
kṛtvā nṛsiṃharūpaṃ ca hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ  || 180.28 ||
vipracittimukhāścānye dānavā vinipātitāḥ  |
vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya baliṃ saṃyamya māyayā  || 180.29 ||
trailokyaṃ krāntavāneva vinirjitya diteḥ sutān  |
bhṛgorvaṃśe samutpanno jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān  || 180.30 ||
jaghāna kṣatriyān rāmaḥ piturvadhamanusmaran  |
tathātritanayo bhūtvā dattātreyaḥ pratāpavān  || 180.31 ||
yogamaṣṭāṅgamācakhyāvalarkāya mahātmane  |
rāmo dāśarathirbhūtvā sa tu devaḥ pratāpavān  || 180.32 ||
jaghāna rāvaṇaṃ saṃkhye trailokyasya bhayaṃkaram  |
yadā caikārṇave supto devadevo jagatpatiḥ  || 180.33 ||
sahasrayugaparyantaṃ nāgaparyaṅkago vibhuḥ  |
yoganidrāṃ samāsthāya sve mahimni vyavasthitaḥ  || 180.34 ||
trailokyamudare kṛtvā jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam  |
janalokagataiḥ siddhaiḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ  || 180.35 ||
tasya nābhau samutpannaṃ padmaṃ dikpattramaṇḍitam  |
marutkiñjalkasaṃyuktaṃ gṛhaṃ paitāmahaṃ varam  || 180.36 ||
yatra brahmā samutpanno devadevaścaturmukhaḥ  |
tadā karṇamalodbhūtau dānavau madhukaiṭabhau  || 180.37 ||
mahābalau mahāvīryau brahmāṇaṃ hantumudyatau  |
jaghāna tau durādharṣau utthāya śayanodadheḥ  || 180.38 ||
evamādīṃstathaivānyānasaṃkhyātumihotsahe  |
avatāro hyajasyeha māthuraḥ sāṃpratastvayam  || 180.39 ||
iti sā sāttvikī mūrtiravatāraṃ karoti ca  |
pradyumneti samākhyātā rakṣākarmaṇyavasthitā  || 180.40 ||
devatve'tha manuṣyatve tiryagyonau ca saṃsthitā  |
gṛhṇāti tatsvabhāvaśca vāsudevecchayā sadā  || 180.41 ||
dadātyabhimatān kāmān pūjitā sā dvijottamāḥ  |
evaṃ mayā samākhyātaḥ kṛtakṛtyo'pi yaḥ prabhuḥ  |
mānuṣatvaṃ gato viṣṇuḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ cottaraṃ punaḥ  || 180.42 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmi samāsataḥ  |
avatāraṃ hareścātra bhārāvataraṇecchayā  || 181.1 ||
yadā yadā tvadharmasya vṛddhirbhavati bho dvijāḥ  |
dharmaśca hrāsamabhyeti tadā devo janārdanaḥ  || 181.2 ||
avatāraṃ karotyatra dvidhā kṛtvātmanastanum  |
sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya dharmasaṃsthāpanāya ca  || 181.3 ||
duṣṭānāṃ nigrahārthāya anyeṣāṃ ca suradviṣām  |
prajānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya jāyate'sau yuge yuge  || 181.4 ||
purā kila mahī viprā bhūribhārāvapīḍitā  |
jagāma dharaṇī merau samāje tridivaukasām  || 181.5 ||
sabrahmakān surān sarvān praṇipatyātha medinī  |
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ khedātkaruṇabhāṣiṇī  || 181.6 ||
{dharaṇyuvāca̱ }
agniḥ suvarṇasya gururgavāṃ sūryo'paro guruḥ  |
mamāpyakhilalokānāṃ vandyo nārāyaṇo guruḥ  || 181.7 ||
tatsāṃpratamime daityāḥ kālanemipurogamāḥ  |
martyalokaṃ samāgamya bādhante'harniśaṃ prajāḥ  || 181.8 ||
kālanemirhato yo'sau viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā  |
ugrasenasutaḥ kaṃsaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ sumahāsuraḥ  || 181.9 ||
ariṣṭo dhenukaḥ keśī pralambo narakastathā  |
sundo'surastathātyugro bāṇaścāpi baleḥ sutaḥ  || 181.10 ||
tathānye ca mahāvīryā nṛpāṇāṃ bhavaneṣu ye  |
samutpannā durātmānastānna saṃkhyātumutsahe  || 181.11 ||
akṣauhiṇyo hi bahulā divyamūrtidhṛtāḥ surāḥ  |
mahābalānāṃ dṛptānāṃ daityendrāṇāṃ mamopari  || 181.12 ||
tadbhūribhārapīḍārtā na śaknomyamareśvarāḥ  |
vibhartumātmānamahamiti vijñāpayāmi vaḥ  || 181.13 ||
kriyatāṃ tanmahābhāgā mama bhārāvatāraṇam  |
yathā rasātalaṃ nāhaṃ gaccheyamativihvalā  || 181.14 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityākarṇya dharāvākyamaśeṣaistridaśaistataḥ  |
bhuvo bhārāvatārārthaṃ brahmā prāha ca coditaḥ  || 181.15 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
yadāha vasudhā sarvaṃ satyametaddivaukasaḥ  |
ahaṃ bhavo bhavantaśca sarvaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam  || 181.16 ||
vibhūtayastu yāstasya tāsāmeva parasparam  |
ādhikyaṃ nyūnatā bādhya bādhakatvena vartate  || 181.17 ||
tadāgacchata gacchāmaḥ kṣīrābdhestaṭamuttamam  |
tatrārādhya hariṃ tasmai sarvaṃ vijñāpayāma vai  || 181.18 ||
sarvadaiva jagatyarthe sa sarvātmā jaganmayaḥ  |
svalpāṃśenāvatīryorvyāṃ dharmasya kurute sthitim  || 181.19 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā prayayau tatra saha devaiḥ pitāmahaḥ  |
samāhitamanā bhūtvā tuṣṭāva garuḍadhvajam  || 181.20 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
namo namaste'stu sahasramūrte  181.21
sahasrabāho bahuvaktrapāda  181.21
namo namaste jagataḥ pravṛtti  181.21
vināśasaṃsthānaparāprameya  181.21
sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ ca bṛhatpramāṇaṃ  181.22
garīyasāmapyatigauravātman  181.22
pradhānabuddhīndriyavākpradhāna  181.22
mūlāparātman bhagavan prasīda  181.22
eṣā mahī deva mahīprasūtair 181.23
mahāsuraiḥ pīḍitaśailabandhā  181.23
parāyaṇaṃ tvāṃ jagatāmupaiti  181.23
bhārāvatārārthamapārapāram  181.23
ete vayaṃ vṛtraripustathāyaṃ  181.24
nāsatyadasrau varuṇastathaiṣaḥ  181.24
ime ca rudrā vasavaḥ sasūryāḥ  181.24
samīraṇāgnipramukhāstathānye  181.24
surāḥ samastāḥ suranātha kāryam  181.25
ebhirmayā yacca tadīśa sarvam  181.25
ājñāpayājñāṃ pratipālayantas 181.25
tavaiva tiṣṭhāma sadāstadoṣāḥ  181.25
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu bhagavān parameśvaraḥ  |
ujjahārātmanaḥ keśau sitakṛṣṇau dvijottamāḥ  || 181.26 ||
uvāca ca surānetau matkeśau vasudhātale  |
avatīrya bhuvo bhāra kleśahāniṃ kariṣyataḥ  || 181.27 ||
surāśca sakalāḥ svāṃśairavatīrya mahītale  |
kurvantu yuddhamunmattaiḥ pūrvotpannairmahāsuraiḥ  || 181.28 ||
tataḥ kṣayamaśeṣāste daiteyā dharaṇītale  |
prayāsyanti na saṃdeho nānāyudhavicūrṇitāḥ  || 181.29 ||
vasudevasya yā patnī devakī devatopamā  |
tasyā garbho'ṣṭamo'yaṃ tu matkeśo bhavitā surāḥ  || 181.30 ||
avatīrya ca tatrāyaṃ kaṃsaṃ ghātayitā bhuvi  |
kālanemisamudbhūtamityuktvāntardadhe hariḥ  || 181.31 ||
adṛśyāya tataste'pi praṇipatya mahātmane  |
merupṛṣṭhaṃ surā jagmuravateruśca bhūtale  || 181.32 ||
kaṃsāya cāṣṭamo garbho devakyā dharaṇītale  |
bhaviṣyatītyācacakṣe bhagavānnārado muniḥ  || 181.33 ||
kaṃso'pi tadupaśrutya nāradātkupitastataḥ  |
devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca gṛhe guptāvadhārayat || 181.34 ||
jātaṃ jātaṃ ca kaṃsāya tenaivoktaṃ yathā purā  |
tathaiva vasudevo'pi putramarpitavān dvijāḥ  || 181.35 ||
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāḥ ṣaḍgarbhā iti viśrutāḥ  |
viṣṇuprayuktā tānnidrā kramādgarbhe nyayojayat || 181.36 ||
yoganidrā mahāmāyā vaiṣṇavī mohitaṃ yayā  |
avidyayā jagatsarvaṃ tāmāha bhagavān hariḥ  || 181.37 ||
{viṣṇuruvāca̱ }
gaccha nidre mamādeśātpātālatalasaṃśrayān  |
ekaikaśyena ṣaḍgarbhān devakījaṭhare naya  || 181.38 ||
hateṣu teṣu kaṃsena śeṣākhyo'ṃśastato'naghaḥ  |
aṃśāṃśenodare tasyāḥ saptamaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati  || 181.39 ||
gokule vasudevasya bhāryā vai rohiṇī sthitā  |
tasyāḥ prasūtisamaye garbho neyastvayodaram  || 181.40 ||
saptamo bhojarājasya bhayādrodhoparodhataḥ  |
devakyāḥ patito garbha iti loko vadiṣyati  || 181.41 ||
garbhasaṃkarṣaṇātso'tha loke saṃkarṣaṇeti vai  |
saṃjñāmavāpsyate vīraḥ śvetādriśikharopamaḥ  || 181.42 ||
tato'haṃ saṃbhaviṣyāmi devakījaṭhare śubhe  |
garbhe tvayā yaśodāyā gantavyamavilambitam  || 181.43 ||
prāvṛṭkāle ca nabhasi kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāmahaṃ niśi  |
utpatsyāmi navamyāṃ ca prasūtiṃ tvamavāpsyasi  || 181.44 ||
yaśodāśayane māṃ tu devakyāstvāmanindite  |
macchaktipreritamatirvasudevo nayiṣyati  || 181.45 ||
kaṃsaśca tvāmupādāya devi śailaśilātale  |
prakṣepsyatyantarikṣe ca tvaṃ sthānaṃ samavāpsyasi  || 181.46 ||
tatastvāṃ śatadhā śakraḥ praṇamya mama gauravāt |
praṇipātānataśirā bhaginītve grahīṣyati  || 181.47 ||
tataḥ śumbhaniśumbhādīn hatvā daityān sahasraśaḥ  |
sthānairanekaiḥ pṛthivīmaśeṣāṃ maṇḍayiṣyasi  || 181.48 ||
tvaṃ bhūtiḥ saṃnatiḥ kīrtiḥ kāntirvai pṛthivī dhṛtiḥ  |
lajjā puṣṭiruṣā yā ca kācidanyā tvameva sā  || 181.49 ||
ye tvāmāryeti durgeti vedagarbhe'mbiketi ca  |
bhadreti bhadrakālīti kṣemyā kṣemaṃkarīti ca  || 181.50 ||
prātaścaivāparāhṇe ca stoṣyantyānamramūrtayaḥ  |
teṣāṃ hi vāñchitaṃ sarvaṃ matprasādādbhaviṣyati  || 181.51 ||
surāmāṃsopahāraistu bhakṣyabhojyaiśca pūjitā  |
nṛṇāmaśeṣakāmāṃstvaṃ prasannāyāṃ pradāsyasi  || 181.52 ||
te sarve sarvadā bhadrā matprasādādasaṃśayam  |
asaṃdigdhaṃ bhaviṣyanti gaccha devi yathoditam  || 181.53 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
yathoktaṃ sā jagaddhātrī devadevena vai purā  |
ṣaḍgarbhagarbhavinyāsaṃ cakre cānyasya karṣaṇam  || 182.1 ||
saptame rohiṇīṃ prāpte garbhe garbhe tato hariḥ  |
lokatrayopakārāya devakyāḥ praviveśa vai  || 182.2 ||
yoganidrā yaśodāyāstasminneva tato dine  |
saṃbhūtā jaṭhare tadvadyathoktaṃ parameṣṭhinā  || 182.3 ||
tato grahagaṇaḥ samyakpracacāra divi dvijāḥ  |
viṣṇoraṃśe mahīṃ yāta ṛtavo'pyabhavañśubhāḥ  || 182.4 ||
notsehe devakīṃ draṣṭuṃ kaścidapyatitejasā  |
jājvalyamānāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manāṃsi kṣobhamāyayuḥ  || 182.5 ||
adṛṣṭāṃ puruṣaiḥ strībhirdevakīṃ devatāgaṇāḥ  |
bibhrāṇāṃ vapuṣā viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭuvustāmaharniśam  || 182.6 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
tvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā vidyā sudhā tvaṃ jyotireva ca  |
tvaṃ sarvalokarakṣārthamavatīrṇā mahītale  || 182.7 ||
prasīda devi sarvasya jagatastvaṃ śubhaṃ kuru  |
prītyarthaṃ dhārayeśānaṃ dhṛtaṃ yenākhilaṃ jagat || 182.8 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ saṃstūyamānā sā devairdevamadhārayat |
garbheṇa puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ jagatāṃ trāṇakāraṇam  || 182.9 ||
tato'khilajagatpadma bodhāyācyutabhānunā  |
devakyāḥ pūrvasaṃdhyāyāmāvirbhūtaṃ mahātmanā  || 182.10 ||
madhyarātre'khilādhāre jāyamāne janārdane  |
mandaṃ jagarjurjaladāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭimucaḥ surāḥ  || 182.11 ||
phullendīvarapattrābhaṃ caturbāhumudīkṣya tam  |
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ jātaṃ tuṣṭāvānakadundubhiḥ  || 182.12 ||
abhiṣṭūya ca taṃ vāgbhiḥ prasannābhirmahāmatiḥ  |
vijñāpayāmāsa tadā kaṃsādbhīto dvijottamāḥ  || 182.13 ||
{vasudeva uvāca̱ }
jñāto'si devadeveśa śaṅkhacakragadādhara  |
divyaṃ rūpamidaṃ deva prasādenopasaṃhara  || 182.14 ||
adyaiva deva kaṃso'yaṃ kurute mama yātanām  |
avatīrṇamiti jñātvā tvāmasminmandire mama  || 182.15 ||
{devakyuvāca̱ }
yo'nantarūpo'khilaviśvarūpo  182.16
garbhe'pi lokān vapuṣā bibharti  182.16
prasīdatāmeṣa sa devadevaḥ  182.16
svamāyayāviṣkṛtabālarūpaḥ  182.16
upasaṃhara sarvātman rūpametaccaturbhujam  |
jānātu māvatāraṃ te kaṃso'yaṃ ditijāntaka  || 182.17 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
stuto'haṃ yattvayā pūrvaṃ putrārthinyā tadadya te  |
saphalaṃ devi saṃjātaṃ jāto'haṃ yattavodarāt || 182.18 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā bhagavāṃstūṣṇīṃ babhūva munisattamāḥ  |
vasudevo'pi taṃ rātrāvādāya prayayau bahiḥ  || 182.19 ||
mohitāścābhavaṃstatra rakṣiṇo yoganidrayā  |
mathurādvārapālāśca vrajatyānakadundubhau  || 182.20 ||
varṣatāṃ jaladānāṃ ca tattoyamulbaṇaṃ niśi  |
saṃchādya taṃ yayau śeṣaḥ phaṇairānakadundubhim  || 182.21 ||
yamunāṃ cātigambhīrāṃ nānāvartaśatākulām  |
vasudevo vahan viṣṇuṃ jānumātravahāṃ yayau  || 182.22 ||
kaṃsasya karamādāya tatraivābhyāgatāṃstaṭe  |
nandādīn gopavṛddhāṃśca yamunāyāṃ dadarśa saḥ  || 182.23 ||
tasmin kāle yaśodāpi mohitā yoganidrayā  |
tāmeva kanyāṃ munayaḥ prāsūta mohite jane  || 182.24 ||
vasudevo'pi vinyasya bālamādāya dārikām  |
yaśodāśayane tūrṇamājagāmāmitadyutiḥ  || 182.25 ||
dadarśa ca vibuddhvā sā yaśodā jātamātmajam  |
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ tato'tyarthaṃ mudaṃ yayau  || 182.26 ||
ādāya vasudevo'pi dārikāṃ nijamandiram  |
devakīśayane nyasya yathāpūrvamatiṣṭhata  || 182.27 ||
tato bāladhvaniṃ śrutvā rakṣiṇaḥ sahasotthitāḥ  |
kaṃsamāvedayāmāsurdevakīprasavaṃ dvijāḥ  || 182.28 ||
kaṃsastūrṇamupetyaināṃ tato jagrāha bālikām  |
muñca muñceti devakyā sannakaṇṭhaṃ nivāritaḥ  || 182.29 ||
cikṣepa ca śilāpṛṣṭhe sā kṣiptā viyati sthitim  |
avāpa rūpaṃ ca mahatsāyudhāṣṭamahābhujam  |
prajahāsa tathaivoccaiḥ kaṃsaṃ ca ruṣitābravīt || 182.30 ||
{yogamāyovāca̱ }
kiṃ mayākṣiptayā kaṃsa jāto yastvāṃ haniṣyati  |
sarvasvabhūto devānāmāsīnmṛtyuḥ purā sa te  |
tadetatsaṃpradhāryāśu kriyatāṃ hitamātmanaḥ  || 182.31 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā prayayau devī divyasraggandhabhūṣaṇā  |
paśyato bhojarājasya stutā siddhairvihāyasā  || 182.32 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
kaṃsastvathodvignamanāḥ prāha sarvānmahāsurān  |
pralambakeśipramukhānāhūyāsurapuṃgavān  || 183.1 ||
{kaṃsa uvāca̱ }
he pralamba mahābāho keśin dhenuka pūtane  |
ariṣṭādyaistathā cānyaiḥ śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama  || 183.2 ||
māṃ hantumamarairyatnaḥ kṛtaḥ kila durātmabhiḥ  |
madvīryatāpitān vīrānna tvetān gaṇayāmyaham  || 183.3 ||
āścaryaṃ kanyayā coktaṃ jāyate daityapuṃgavāḥ  |
hāsyaṃ me jāyate vīrāsteṣu yatnapareṣvapi  || 183.4 ||
tathāpi khalu duṣṭānāṃ teṣāmapyadhikaṃ mayā  |
apakārāya daityendrā yatanīyaṃ durātmanām  || 183.5 ||
utpannaścāpi mṛtyurme bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ  |
ityetadbālikā prāha devakīgarbhasaṃbhavā  || 183.6 ||
tasmādbāleṣu paramo yatnaḥ kāryo mahītale  |
yatrodriktaṃ balaṃ bāle sa hantavyaḥ prayatnataḥ  || 183.7 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityājñāpyāsurān kaṃsaḥ praviśyātmagṛhaṃ tataḥ  |
uvāca vasudevaṃ ca devakīmavirodhataḥ  || 183.8 ||
{kaṃsa uvāca̱ }
yuvayorghātitā garbhā vṛthaivaite mayādhunā  |
ko'pyanya eva nāśāya bālo mama samudgataḥ  || 183.9 ||
tadalaṃ paritāpena nūnaṃ yadbhāvino hi te  |
arbhakā yuvayoḥ ko vā āyuṣo'nte na hanyate  || 183.10 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityāśvāsya vimucyaiva kaṃsastau paritoṣya ca  |
antargṛhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ praviveśa punaḥ svakam  || 183.11 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
vimukto vasudevo'pi nandasya śakaṭaṃ gataḥ  |
prahṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭavānnandaṃ putro jāto mameti vai  || 184.1 ||
vasudevo'pi taṃ prāha diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti sādaram  |
vārdhake'pi samutpannastanayo'yaṃ tavādhunā  || 184.2 ||
datto hi vārṣikaḥ sarvo bhavadbhirnṛpateḥ karaḥ  |
yadarthamāgatastasmānnātra stheyaṃ mahātmanā  || 184.3 ||
yadarthamāgataḥ kāryaṃ tanniṣpannaṃ kimāsyate  |
bhavadbhirgamyatāṃ nanda tacchīghraṃ nijagokulam  || 184.4 ||
mamāpi bālakastatra rohiṇīprasavo hi yaḥ  |
sa rakṣaṇīyo bhavatā yathāyaṃ tanayo nijaḥ  || 184.5 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktāḥ prayayurgopā nandagopapurogamāḥ  |
śakaṭāropitairbhāṇḍaiḥ karaṃ dattvā mahābalāḥ  || 184.6 ||
vasatāṃ gokule teṣāṃ pūtanā bālaghātinī  |
suptaṃ kṛṣṇamupādāya rātrau ca pradadau stanam  || 184.7 ||
yasmai yasmai stanaṃ rātrau pūtanā saṃprayacchati  |
tasya tasya kṣaṇenāṅgaṃ bālakasyopahanyate  || 184.8 ||
kṛṣṇastasyāḥ stanaṃ gāḍhaṃ karābhyāmatipīḍitam  |
gṛhītvā prāṇasahitaṃ papau krodhasamanvitaḥ  || 184.9 ||
sā vimuktamahārāvā vicchinnasnāyubandhanā  |
papāta pūtanā bhūmau mriyamāṇātibhīṣaṇā  || 184.10 ||
tannādaśrutisaṃtrāsādvibuddhāste vrajaukasaḥ  |
dadṛśuḥ pūtanotsaṅge kṛṣṇaṃ tāṃ ca nipātitām  || 184.11 ||
ādāya kṛṣṇaṃ saṃtrastā yaśodā ca tato dvijāḥ  |
gopucchabhrāmaṇādyaiśca bāladoṣamapākarot || 184.12 ||
gopurīṣamupādāya nandagopo'pi mastake  |
kṛṣṇasya pradadau rakṣāṃ kurvannidamudairayat || 184.13 ||
{nandagopa uvāca̱ }
rakṣatu tvāmaśeṣāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhavo hariḥ  |
yasya nābhisamudbhūtātpaṅkajādabhavajjagat || 184.14 ||
yena daṃṣṭrāgravidhṛtā dhārayatyavanī jagat |
varāharūpadhṛgdevaḥ sa tvāṃ rakṣatu keśavaḥ  || 184.15 ||
guhyaṃ sa jaṭharaṃ viṣṇurjaṅghāpādau janārdanaḥ  |
vāmano rakṣatu sadā bhavantaṃ yaḥ kṣaṇādabhūt || 184.16 ||
trivikramakramākrānta trailokyasphuradāyudhaḥ  |
śiraste pātu govindaḥ kaṇṭhaṃ rakṣatu keśavaḥ  || 184.17 ||
mukhabāhū prabāhū ca manaḥ sarvendriyāṇi ca  |
rakṣatvavyāhataiśvaryastava nārāyaṇo'vyayaḥ  || 184.18 ||
tvāṃ dikṣu pātu vaikuṇṭho vidikṣu madhusūdanaḥ  |
hṛṣīkeśo'mbare bhūmau rakṣatu tvāṃ mahīdharaḥ  || 184.19 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ kṛtasvastyayano nandagopena bālakaḥ  |
śāyitaḥ śakaṭasyādho bālaparyaṅkikātale  || 184.20 ||
te ca gopā mahaddṛṣṭvā pūtanāyāḥ kalevaram  |
mṛtāyāḥ paramaṃ trāsaṃ vismayaṃ ca tadā yayuḥ  || 184.21 ||
kadācicchakaṭasyādhaḥ śayāno madhusūdanaḥ  |
cikṣepa caraṇāvūrdhvaṃ stanārthī praruroda ca  || 184.22 ||
tasya pādaprahāreṇa śakaṭaṃ parivartitam  |
vidhvastabhāṇḍakumbhaṃ tadviparītaṃ papāta vai  || 184.23 ||
tato hāhākṛtaḥ sarvo gopagopījano dvijāḥ  |
ājagāma tadā jñātvā bālamuttānaśāyinam  || 184.24 ||
gopāḥ keneti jagaduḥ śakaṭaṃ parivartitam  |
tatraiva bālakāḥ procurbālenānena pātitam  || 184.25 ||
rudatā dṛṣṭamasmābhiḥ pādavikṣepatāḍitam  |
śakaṭaṃ parivṛttaṃ vai naitadanyasya ceṣṭitam  || 184.26 ||
tataḥ punaratīvāsan gopā vismitacetasaḥ  |
nandagopo'pi jagrāha bālamatyantavismitaḥ  || 184.27 ||
yaśodā vismayārūḍhā bhagnabhāṇḍakapālakam  |
śakaṭaṃ cārcayāmāsa dadhipuṣpaphalākṣataiḥ  || 184.28 ||
gargaśca gokule tatra vasudevapracoditaḥ  |
pracchanna eva gopānāṃ saṃskāramakarottayoḥ  || 184.29 ||
jyeṣṭhaṃ ca rāmamityāha kṛṣṇaṃ caiva tathāparam  |
gargo matimatāṃ śreṣṭho nāma kurvanmahāmatiḥ  || 184.30 ||
alpenaiva hi kālena vijñātau tau mahābalau  |
ghṛṣṭajānukarau viprā babhūvaturubhāvapi  || 184.31 ||
karīṣabhasmadigdhāṅgau bhramamāṇāvitastataḥ  |
na nivārayituṃ śaktā yaśodā tau na rohiṇī  || 184.32 ||
govāṭamadhye krīḍantau vatsavāṭagatau punaḥ  |
tadaharjātagovatsa pucchākarṣaṇatatparau  || 184.33 ||
yadā yaśodā tau bālāvekasthānacarāvubhau  |
śaśāka no vārayituṃ krīḍantāvaticañcalau  || 184.34 ||
dāmnā baddhvā tadā madhye nibabandha ulūkhale  |
kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakarmāṇamāha cedamamarṣitā  || 184.35 ||
{yaśodovāca̱ }
yadi śakto'si gaccha tvamaticañcalaceṣṭita  ||* 184.36 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā ca nijaṃ karma sā cakāra kuṭumbinī  |
vyagrāyāmatha tasyāṃ sa karṣamāṇa ulūkhalam  || 184.37 ||
yamalārjunayormadhye jagāma kamalekṣaṇaḥ  |
karṣatā vṛkṣayormadhye tiryagevamulūkhalam  || 184.38 ||
bhagnāvuttuṅgaśākhāgrau tena tau yamalārjunau  |
tataḥ kaṭakaṭāśabda samākarṇanakātaraḥ  || 184.39 ||
ājagāma vrajajano dadṛśe ca mahādrumau  |
bhagnaskandhau nipātitau bhagnaśākhau mahītale  || 184.40 ||
dadarśa cālpadantāsyaṃ smitahāsaṃ ca bālakam  |
tayormadhyagataṃ baddhaṃ dāmnā gāḍhaṃ tathodare  || 184.41 ||
tataśca dāmodaratāṃ sa yayau dāmabandhanāt |
gopavṛddhāstataḥ sarve nandagopapurogamāḥ  || 184.42 ||
mantrayāmāsurudvignā mahotpātātibhīravaḥ  |
sthāneneha na naḥ kāryaṃ vrajāmo'nyanmahāvanam  || 184.43 ||
utpātā bahavo hyatra dṛśyante nāśahetavaḥ  |
pūtanāyā vināśaśca śakaṭasya viparyayaḥ  || 184.44 ||
vinā vātādidoṣeṇa drumayoḥ patanaṃ tathā  |
vṛndāvanamitaḥ sthānāttasmādgacchāma mā ciram  || 184.45 ||
yāvadbhaumamahotpāta doṣo nābhibhavedvrajam  |
iti kṛtvā matiṃ sarve gamane te vrajaukasaḥ  || 184.46 ||
ūcuḥ svaṃ svaṃ kulaṃ śīghraṃ gamyatāṃ mā vilambyatām  |
tataḥ kṣaṇena prayayuḥ śakaṭairgodhanaistathā  || 184.47 ||
yūthaśo vatsapālīśca kālayanto vrajaukasaḥ  |
sarvāvayavanirdhūtaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇa tattadā  || 184.48 ||
kākakākīsamākīrṇaṃ vrajasthānamabhūddvijāḥ  |
vṛndāvanaṃ bhagavatā kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā  || 184.49 ||
śubhena manasā dhyātaṃ gavāṃ vṛddhimabhīpsatā  |
tatastatrātirukṣe'pi dharmakāle dvijottamāḥ  || 184.50 ||
prāvṛṭkāla ivābhūcca navaśaṣpaṃ samantataḥ  |
sa samāvāsitaḥ sarvo vrajo vṛndāvane tataḥ  || 184.51 ||
śakaṭīvāṭaparyanta candrārdhākārasaṃsthitiḥ  |
vatsabālau ca saṃvṛttau rāmadāmodarau tataḥ  || 184.52 ||
tatra sthitau tau ca goṣṭhe ceraturbālalīlayā  |
barhipattrakṛtāpīḍau vanyapuṣpāvataṃsakau  || 184.53 ||
gopaveṇukṛtātodya pattravādyakṛtasvanau  |
kākapakṣadharau bālau kumārāviva pāvakau  || 184.54 ||
hasantau ca ramantau ca ceratustanmahadvanam  |
kvaciddhasantāvanyonyaṃ krīḍamānau tathā paraiḥ  || 184.55 ||
gopaputraiḥ samaṃ vatsāṃścārayantau viceratuḥ  |
kālena gacchatā tau tu saptavarṣau babhūvatuḥ  || 184.56 ||
sarvasya jagataḥ pālau vatsapālau mahāvraje  |
prāvṛṭkālastato'tīva meghaughasthagitāmbaraḥ  || 184.57 ||
babhūva vāridhārābhiraikyaṃ kurvan diśāmiva  |
prarūḍhanavapuṣpāḍhyā śakragopavṛtā mahī  || 184.58 ||
yathā mārakate vāsītpadmarāgavibhūṣitā  |
ūhurunmārgagāmīni nimnagāmbhāṃsi sarvataḥ  || 184.59 ||
manāṃsi durvinītānāṃ prāpya lakṣmīṃ navāmiva  |
vikāle ca yathākāmaṃ vrajametya mahābalau  |
gopaiḥ samānaiḥ sahitau cikrīḍāte'marāviva  || 184.60 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ekadā tu vinā rāmaṃ kṛṣṇo vṛndāvanaṃ yayau  |
vicacāra vṛto gopairvanyapuṣpasragujjvalaḥ  || 185.1 ||
sa jagāmātha kālindīṃ lolakallolaśālinīm  |
tīrasaṃlagnaphenaughairhasantīmiva sarvataḥ  || 185.2 ||
tasyāṃ cātimahābhīmaṃ viṣāgnikaṇadūṣitam  |
hradaṃ kālīyanāgasya dadarśātivibhīṣaṇam  || 185.3 ||
viṣāgninā visaratā dagdhatīramahātarum  |
vātāhatāmbuvikṣepa sparśadagdhavihaṃgamam  || 185.4 ||
tamatīva mahāraudraṃ mṛtyuvaktramivāparam  |
vilokya cintayāmāsa bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ  || 185.5 ||
asmin vasati duṣṭātmā kālīyo'sau viṣāyudhaḥ  |
yo mayā nirjitastyaktvā duṣṭo naṣṭaḥ payonidhau  || 185.6 ||
teneyaṃ dūṣitā sarvā yamunā sāgaraṃgamā  |
na narairgodhanairvāpi tṛṣārtairupabhujyate  || 185.7 ||
tadasya nāgarājasya kartavyo nigraho mayā  |
nityatrastāḥ sukhaṃ yena careyurvrajavāsinaḥ  || 185.8 ||
etadarthaṃ nṛloke'sminnavatāro mayā kṛtaḥ  |
yadeṣāmutpathasthānāṃ kāryā śāstirdurātmanām  || 185.9 ||
tadetannātidūrasthaṃ kadambamuruśākhinam  |
adhiruhyotpatiṣyāmi hrade'smiñjīvanāśinaḥ  || 185.10 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
itthaṃ vicintya baddhvā ca gāḍhaṃ parikaraṃ tataḥ  |
nipapāta hrade tatra sarparājasya vegataḥ  || 185.11 ||
tenāpi patatā tatra kṣobhitaḥ sa mahāhradaḥ  |
atyarthadūrajātāṃśca tāṃścāsiñcanmahīruhān  || 185.12 ||
te'hiduṣṭaviṣajvālā taptāmbutapanokṣitāḥ  |
jajvaluḥ pādapāḥ sadyo jvālāvyāptadigantarāḥ  || 185.13 ||
āsphoṭayāmāsa tadā kṛṣṇo nāgahradaṃ bhujaiḥ  |
tacchabdaśravaṇāccātha nāgarājo'bhyupāgamat || 185.14 ||
ātāmranayanaḥ kopādviṣajvālākulaiḥ phaṇaiḥ  |
vṛto mahāviṣaiścānyairaruṇairanilāśanaiḥ  || 185.15 ||
nāgapatnyaśca śataśo hārihāropaśobhitāḥ  |
prakampitatanūtkṣepa calatkuṇḍalakāntayaḥ  || 185.16 ||
tataḥ praveṣṭitaḥ sarpaiḥ sa kṛṣṇo bhogabandhanaiḥ  |
dadaṃśuścāpi te kṛṣṇaṃ viṣajvālāvilairmukhaiḥ  || 185.17 ||
taṃ tatra patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāgabhoganipīḍitam  |
gopā vrajamupāgatya cukruśuḥ śokalālasāḥ  || 185.18 ||
{gopā ūcu̱ḥ }
eṣa kṛṣṇo gato moha magno vai kāliye hrade  |
bhakṣyate sarparājena tadāgacchata mā ciram  || 185.19 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
etacchrutvā tato gopā vajrapātopamaṃ vacaḥ  |
gopyaśca tvaritā jagmuryaśodāpramukhā hradam  || 185.20 ||
hā hā kvāsāviti jano gopīnāmativihvalaḥ  |
yaśodayā samaṃ bhrānto drutaḥ praskhalito yayau  || 185.21 ||
nandagopaśca gopāśca rāmaścādbhutavikramaḥ  |
tvaritaṃ yamunāṃ jagmuḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ  || 185.22 ||
dadṛśuścāpi te tatra sarparājavaśaṃgatam  |
niṣprayatnaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sarpabhogena veṣṭitam  || 185.23 ||
nandagopaśca niśceṣṭaḥ paśyan putramukhaṃ bhṛśam  |
yaśodā ca mahābhāgā babhūva munisattamāḥ  || 185.24 ||
gopyastvanyā rudatyaśca dadṛśuḥ śokakātarāḥ  |
procuśca keśavaṃ prītyā bhayakātaragadgadam  || 185.25 ||
sarvā yaśodayā sārdhaṃ viśāmo'tra mahāhrade  |
nāgarājasya no gantumasmākaṃ yujyate vraje  || 185.26 ||
divasaḥ ko vinā sūryaṃ vinā candreṇa kā niśā  |
vinā dugdhena kā gāvo vinā kṛṣṇena ko vrajaḥ  |
vinākṛtā na yāsyāmaḥ kṛṣṇenānena gokulam  || 185.27 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
iti gopīvacaḥ śrutvā rauhiṇeyo mahābalaḥ  |
uvāca gopān vidhurān vilokya stimitekṣaṇaḥ  || 185.28 ||
nandaṃ ca dīnamatyarthaṃ nyastadṛṣṭiṃ sutānane  |
mūrchākulāṃ yaśodāṃ ca kṛṣṇamāhātmyasaṃjñayā  || 185.29 ||
{balarāma uvāca̱ }
kimayaṃ devadeveśa bhāvo'yaṃ mānuṣastvayā  |
vyajyate svaṃ tamātmānaṃ kimanyaṃ tvaṃ na vetsi yat || 185.30 ||
tvamasya jagato nābhiḥ surāṇāmeva cāśrayaḥ  |
kartāpahartā pātā ca trailokyaṃ tvaṃ trayīmayaḥ  || 185.31 ||
atrāvatīrṇayoḥ kṛṣṇa gopā eva hi bāndhavāḥ  |
gopyaśca sīdataḥ kasmāttvaṃ bandhūn samupekṣase  || 185.32 ||
darśito mānuṣo bhāvo darśitaṃ bālaceṣṭitam  |
tadayaṃ damyatāṃ kṛṣṇa durātmā daśanāyudhaḥ  || 185.33 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
iti saṃsmāritaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ smitabhinnauṣṭhasaṃpuṭaḥ  |
āsphālya mocayāmāsa svaṃ dehaṃ bhogabandhanāt || 185.34 ||
ānāmya cāpi hastābhyāmubhābhyāṃ madhyamaṃ phaṇam  |
āruhya bhugnaśirasaḥ prananartoruvikramaḥ  || 185.35 ||
vraṇāḥ phaṇe'bhavaṃstasya kṛṣṇasyāṅghrivikuṭṭanaiḥ  |
yatronnatiṃ ca kurute nanāmāsya tataḥ śiraḥ  || 185.36 ||
mūrchāmupāyayau bhrāntyā nāgaḥ kṛṣṇasya kuṭṭanaiḥ  |
daṇḍapātanipātena vavāma rudhiraṃ bahu  || 185.37 ||
taṃ nirbhugnaśirogrīvamāsyaprasrutaśoṇitam  |
vilokya śaraṇaṃ jagmustatpatnyo madhusūdanam  || 185.38 ||
{nāgapatnya ūcu̱ḥ }
jñāto'si devadeveśa sarveśastvamanuttama  |
paraṃ jyotiracintyaṃ yattadaṃśaḥ parameśvaraḥ  || 185.39 ||
na samarthāḥ sura stotuṃ yamananyabhavaṃ prabhum  |
svarūpavarṇanaṃ tasya kathaṃ yoṣitkariṣyati  || 185.40 ||
yasyākhilamahīvyoma jalāgnipavanātmakam  |
brahmāṇḍamalpakāṃśāṃśaḥ stoṣyāmastaṃ kathaṃ vayam  || 185.41 ||
tataḥ kuru jagatsvāmin prasādamavasīdataḥ  |
prāṇāṃstyajati nāgo'yaṃ bhartṛbhikṣā pradīyatām  || 185.42 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityukte tābhirāśvāsya klāntadeho'pi pannagaḥ  |
prasīda devadeveti prāha vākyaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ  || 185.43 ||
{kālīya uvāca̱ }
tavāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ nātha svābhāvikaṃ param  |
nirastātiśayaṃ yasya tasya stoṣyāmi kiṃ nvaham  || 185.44 ||
tvaṃ parastvaṃ parasyādyaḥ paraṃ tvaṃ tatparātmakam  |
parasmātparamo yastvaṃ tasya stoṣyāmi kiṃ nvaham  || 185.45 ||
yathāhaṃ bhavatā sṛṣṭo jātyā rūpeṇa ceśvaraḥ  |
svabhāvena ca saṃyuktastathedaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ mayā  || 185.46 ||
yadyanyathā pravarteya devadeva tato mayi  |
nyāyyo daṇḍanipātaste tavaiva vacanaṃ yathā  || 185.47 ||
tathāpi yaṃ jagatsvāmī daṇḍaṃ pātitavānmayi  |
sa soḍho'yaṃ varo daṇḍastvatto nānyo'stu me varaḥ  || 185.48 ||
hatavīryo hataviṣo damito'haṃ tvayācyuta  |
jīvitaṃ dīyatāmekamājñāpaya karomi kim  || 185.49 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
nātra stheyaṃ tvayā sarpa kadācidyamunājale  |
sabhṛtyaparivārastvaṃ samudrasalilaṃ vraja  || 185.50 ||
matpadāni ca te sarpa dṛṣṭvā mūrdhani sāgare  |
garuḍaḥ pannagaripustvayi na prahariṣyati  || 185.51 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā sarparājānaṃ mumoca bhagavān hariḥ  |
praṇamya so'pi kṛṣṇāya jagāma payasāṃ nidhim  || 185.52 ||
paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sabhṛtyāpatyabandhavaḥ  |
samastabhāryāsahitaḥ parityajya svakaṃ hradam  || 185.53 ||
gate sarpe pariṣvajya mṛtaṃ punarivāgatam  |
gopā mūrdhani govindaṃ siṣicurnetrajairjalaiḥ  || 185.54 ||
kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakarmāṇamanye vismitacetasaḥ  |
tuṣṭuvurmuditā gopā dṛṣṭvā śivajalāṃ nadīm  || 185.55 ||
gīyamāno'tha gopībhiścaritaiścāruceṣṭitaiḥ  |
saṃstūyamāno gopālaiḥ kṛṣṇo vrajamupāgamat || 185.56 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
gāḥ pālayantau ca punaḥ sahitau rāmakeśavau  |
bhramamāṇau vane tatra ramyaṃ tālavanaṃ gatau  || 186.1 ||
tacca tālavanaṃ nityaṃ dhenuko nāma dānavaḥ  |
nṛgomāṃsakṛtāhāraḥ sadādhyāste kharākṛtiḥ  || 186.2 ||
tatra tālavanaṃ ramyaṃ phalasaṃpatsamanvitam  |
dṛṣṭvā spṛhānvitā gopāḥ phalādāne'bruvan vacaḥ  || 186.3 ||
{gopā ūcu̱ḥ }
he rāma he kṛṣṇa sadā dhenukenaiva rakṣyate  |
bhūpradeśo yatastasmāttyaktānīmāni santi vai  || 186.4 ||
phalāni paśya tālānāṃ gandhamodayutāni vai  |
vayametānyabhīpsāmaḥ pātyantāṃ yadi rocate  || 186.5 ||
iti gopakumārāṇāṃ śrutvā saṃkarṣaṇo vacaḥ  |
kṛṣṇaśca pātayāmāsa bhuvi tālaphalāni vai  || 186.6 ||
tālānāṃ patatāṃ śabdamākarṇyāsurarāṭtataḥ  |
ājagāma sa duṣṭātmā kopāddaiteyagardabhaḥ  || 186.7 ||
padbhyāmubhābhyāṃ sa tadā paścimābhyāṃ ca taṃ balī  |
jaghānorasi tābhyāṃ ca sa ca tenāpyagṛhyata  || 186.8 ||
gṛhītvā bhrāmaṇenaiva cāmbare gatajīvitam  |
tasminneva pracikṣepa vegena tṛṇarājani  || 186.9 ||
tataḥ phalānyanekāni tālāgrānnipatan kharaḥ  |
pṛthivyāṃ pātayāmāsa mahāvāto'mbudāniva  || 186.10 ||
anyānapyasya vai jñātīnāgatān daityagardabhān  |
kṛṣṇaścikṣepa tālāgre balabhadraśca līlayā  || 186.11 ||
kṣaṇenālaṃkṛtā pṛthvī pakvaistālaphalaistadā  |
daityagardabhadehaiśca munayaḥ śuśubhe'dhikam  || 186.12 ||
tato gāvo nirābādhāstasmiṃstālavane dvijāḥ  |
navaśaṣpaṃ sukhaṃ ceruryatra bhuktamabhūtpurā  || 186.13 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tasmin rāsabhadaiteye sānuje vinipātite  |
sarvagopālagopīnāṃ ramyaṃ tālavanaṃ babhau  || 187.1 ||
tatastau jātaharṣau tu vasudevasutāvubhau  |
śuśubhāte mahātmānau bālaśṛṅgāvivarṣabhau  || 187.2 ||
cārayantau ca gā dūre vyāharantau ca nāmabhiḥ  |
niyogapāśaskandhau tau vanamālāvibhūṣitau  || 187.3 ||
suvarṇāñjanacūrṇābhyāṃ tadā tau bhūṣitāmbarau  |
mahendrāyudhasaṃkāśau śvetakṛṣṇāvivāmbudau  || 187.4 ||
ceraturlokasiddhābhiḥ krīḍābhiritaretaram  |
samastalokanāthānāṃ nāthabhūtau bhuvaṃ gatau  || 187.5 ||
manuṣyadharmābhiratau mānayantau manuṣyatām  |
tajjātiguṇayuktābhiḥ krīḍābhiśceraturvanam  || 187.6 ||
tatastvāndolikābhiśca niyuddhaiśca mahābalau  |
vyāyāmaṃ cakratustatra kṣepaṇīyaistathāśmabhiḥ  || 187.7 ||
tallipsurasurastatra ubhayo ramamāṇayoḥ  |
ājagāma pralambākhyo gopaveṣatirohitaḥ  || 187.8 ||
so'vagāhata niḥśaṅkaṃ teṣāṃ madhyamamānuṣaḥ  |
mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya pralambo dānavottamaḥ  || 187.9 ||
tayośchidrāntaraprepsuratiśīghramamanyata  |
kṛṣṇaṃ tato rauhiṇeyaṃ hantuṃ cakre manoratham  || 187.10 ||
hariṇā krīḍanaṃ nāma bālakrīḍanakaṃ tataḥ  |
prakrīḍitāstu te sarve dvau dvau yugapadutpatan  || 187.11 ||
śrīdāmnā saha govindaḥ pralambena tathā balaḥ  |
gopālairaparaiścānye gopālāḥ saha pupluvuḥ  || 187.12 ||
śrīdāmānaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pralambaṃ rohiṇīsutaḥ  |
jitavān kṛṣṇapakṣīyairgopairanyaiḥ parājitāḥ  || 187.13 ||
te vāhayantastvanyonyaṃ bhāṇḍīraskandhametya vai  |
punarnivṛttāste sarve ye ye tatra parājitāḥ  || 187.14 ||
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tu skandhena śīghramutkṣipya dānavaḥ  |
na tasthau prajagāmaiva sacandra iva vāridaḥ  || 187.15 ||
aśakto vahane tasya saṃrambhāddānavottamaḥ  |
vavṛdhe sumahākāyaḥ prāvṛṣīva balāhakaḥ  || 187.16 ||
saṃkarṣaṇastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā dagdhaśailopamākṛtim  |
sragdāmalambābharaṇaṃ mukuṭāṭopamastakam  || 187.17 ||
raudraṃ śakaṭacakrākṣaṃ pādanyāsacalatkṣitim  |
hriyamāṇastataḥ kṛṣṇamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 187.18 ||
{balarāma uvāca̱ }
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hriye tveṣa parvatodagramūrtinā  |
kenāpi paśya daityena gopālacchadmarūpiṇā  || 187.19 ||
yadatra sāṃprataṃ kāryaṃ mayā madhuniṣūdana  |
tatkathyatāṃ prayātyeṣa durātmātitvarānvitaḥ  || 187.20 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tamāha rāmaṃ govindaḥ smitabhinnauṣṭhasaṃpuṭaḥ  |
mahātmā rauhiṇeyasya balavīryapramāṇavit || 187.21 ||
{kṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
kimayaṃ mānuṣo bhāvo vyaktamevāvalambyate  |
sarvātman sarvaguhyānāṃ guhyādguhyātmanā tvayā  || 187.22 ||
smarāśeṣajagadīśa kāraṇaṃ kāraṇāgraja  |
ātmānamekaṃ tadvacca jagatyekārṇave ca yaḥ  || 187.23 ||
bhavānahaṃ ca viśvātmannekameva hi kāraṇam  |
jagato'sya jagatyarthe bhedenāvāṃ vyavasthitau  || 187.24 ||
tatsmaryatāmameyātmaṃstvayātmā jahi dānavam  |
mānuṣyamevamālambya bandhūnāṃ kriyatāṃ hitam  || 187.25 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
iti saṃsmārito viprāḥ kṛṣṇena sumahātmanā  |
vihasya pīḍayāmāsa pralambaṃ balavān balaḥ  || 187.26 ||
muṣṭinā cāhanmūrdhni kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ  |
tena cāsya prahāreṇa bahiryāte vilocane  || 187.27 ||
sa niṣkāsitamastiṣko mukhācchoṇitamudvaman  |
nipapāta mahīpṛṣṭhe daityavaryo mamāra ca  || 187.28 ||
pralambaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā balenādbhutakarmaṇā  |
prahṛṣṭāstuṣṭuvurgopāḥ sādhu sādhviti cābruvan  || 187.29 ||
saṃstūyamāno rāmastu gopairdaitye nipātite  |
pralambe saha kṛṣṇena punargokulamāyayau  || 187.30 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tayorviharatorevaṃ rāmakeśavayorvraje  |
prāvṛḍvyatītā vikasatsarojā cābhavaccharat || 187.31 ||
vimalāmbaranakṣatre kāle cābhyāgate vrajam  |
dadarśendrotsavārambha pravṛttān vrajavāsinaḥ  || 187.32 ||
kṛṣṇastānutsukān dṛṣṭvā gopānutsavalālasān  |
kautūhalādidaṃ vākyaṃ prāha vṛddhānmahāmatiḥ  || 187.33 ||
{kṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
ko'yaṃ śakramaho nāma yena vo harṣa āgataḥ  |
prāha taṃ nandagopaśca pṛcchantamatisādaram  || 187.34 ||
{nanda uvāca̱ }
meghānāṃ payasāmīśo devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ  |
yena saṃcoditā meghā varṣantyambumayaṃ rasam  || 187.35 ||
tadvṛṣṭijanitaṃ sasyaṃ vayamanye ca dehinaḥ  |
vartayāmopabhuñjānāstarpayāmaśca devatāḥ  || 187.36 ||
kṣīravatya imā gāvo vatsavatyaśca nirvṛtāḥ  |
tena saṃvardhitaiḥ sasyaiḥ puṣṭāstuṣṭā bhavanti vai  || 187.37 ||
nāsasyā nānṛṇā bhūmirna bubhukṣārdito janaḥ  |
dṛśyate yatra dṛśyante vṛṣṭimanto balāhakāḥ  || 187.38 ||
bhaumametatpayo gobhirdhatte sūryasya vāridaḥ  |
parjanyaḥ sarvalokasya bhavāya bhuvi varṣati  || 187.39 ||
tasmātprāvṛṣi rājānaḥ śakraṃ sarve mudānvitāḥ  |
mahe sureśamarghanti vayamanye ca dehinaḥ  || 187.40 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
nandagopasya vacanaṃ śrutvetthaṃ śakrapūjane  |
kopāya tridaśendrasya prāha dāmodarastadā  || 187.41 ||
{kṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
na vayaṃ kṛṣikartāro vaṇijyājīvino na ca  |
gāvo'smaddaivataṃ tāta vayaṃ vanacarā yataḥ  || 187.42 ||
ānvīkṣikī trayī vārttā daṇḍanītistathāparā  |
vidyācatuṣṭayaṃ tvetadvārttāmatra śṛṇuṣva me  || 187.43 ||
kṛṣirvaṇijyā tadvacca tṛtīyaṃ paśupālanam  |
vidyā hyetā mahābhāgā vārttā vṛttitrayāśrayā  || 187.44 ||
karṣakāṇāṃ kṛṣirvṛttiḥ paṇyaṃ tu paṇajīvinām  |
asmākaṃ gāḥ parā vṛttirvārttā bhedairiyaṃ tribhiḥ  || 187.45 ||
vidyayā yo yayā yuktastasya sā daivataṃ mahat |
saiva pūjyārcanīyā ca saiva tasyopakārikā  || 187.46 ||
yo'nyasyāḥ phalamaśnan vai pūjayatyaparāṃ naraḥ  |
iha ca pretya caivāsau tāta nāpnoti śobhanam  || 187.47 ||
pūjyantāṃ prathitāḥ sīmāḥ sīmāntaṃ ca punarvanam  |
vanāntā girayaḥ sarve sā cāsmākaṃ parā gatiḥ  || 187.48 ||
giriyajñastvayaṃ tasmādgoyajñaśca pravartyatām  |
kimasmākaṃ mahendreṇa gāvaḥ śailāśca devatāḥ  || 187.49 ||
mantrayajñaparā viprāḥ sīrayajñāśca karṣakāḥ  |
girigoyajñaśīlāśca vayamadrivanāśrayāḥ  || 187.50 ||
tasmādgovardhanaḥ śailo bhavadbhirvividhārhaṇaiḥ  |
arcyatāṃ pūjyatāṃ medhyaṃ paśuṃ hatvā vidhānataḥ  || 187.51 ||
sarvaghoṣasya saṃdohā gṛhyantāṃ mā vicāryatām  |
bhojyantāṃ tena vai viprāstathānye cāpi vāñchakāḥ  || 187.52 ||
tamarcitaṃ kṛte home bhojiteṣu dvijātiṣu  |
śaratpuṣpakṛtāpīḍāḥ parigacchantu gogaṇāḥ  || 187.53 ||
etanmama mataṃ gopāḥ saṃprītyā kriyate yadi  |
tataḥ kṛtā bhavetprītirgavāmadrestathā mama  || 187.54 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā nandādyāste vrajaukasaḥ  |
prītyutphullamukhā viprāḥ sādhu sādhvityathābruvan  || 187.55 ||
śobhanaṃ te mataṃ vatsa yadetadbhavatoditam  |
tatkariṣyāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ giriyajñaḥ pravartyatām  || 187.56 ||
tathā ca kṛtavantaste giriyajñaṃ vrajaukasaḥ  |
dadhipāyasamāṃsādyairdaduḥ śailabaliṃ tataḥ  || 187.57 ||
dvijāṃśca bhojayāmāsuḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ  |
gāvaḥ śailaṃ tataścakrurarcitāstaṃ pradakṣiṇam  || 187.58 ||
vṛṣabhāścābhinardantaḥ satoyā jaladā iva  |
girimūrdhani govindaḥ śailo'hamiti mūrtimān  || 187.59 ||
bubhuje'nnaṃ bahuvidhaṃ gopavaryāhṛtaṃ dvijāḥ  |
kṛṣṇastenaiva rūpeṇa gopaiḥ saha gireḥ śiraḥ  || 187.60 ||
adhiruhyārcayāmāsa dvitīyāmātmanastanum  |
antardhānaṃ gate tasmin gopā labdhvā tato varān  |
kṛtvā girimahaṃ goṣṭhaṃ nijamabhyāyayuḥ punaḥ  || 187.61 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
mahe pratihate śakro bhṛśaṃ kopasamanvitaḥ  |
saṃvartakaṃ nāma gaṇaṃ toyadānāmathābravīt || 188.1 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
bho bho meghā niśamyaitadvadato vacanaṃ mama  |
ājñānantaramevāśu kriyatāmavicāritam  || 188.2 ||
nandagopaḥ sudurbuddhirgopairanyaiḥ sahāyavān  |
kṛṣṇāśrayabalādhmāto mahabhaṅgamacīkarat || 188.3 ||
ājīvo yaḥ paraṃ teṣāṃ gopatvasya ca kāraṇam  |
tā gāvo vṛṣṭipātena pīḍyantāṃ vacanānmama  || 188.4 ||
ahamapyadriśṛṅgābhaṃ tuṅgamāruhya vāraṇam  |
sāhāyyaṃ vaḥ kariṣyāmi vāyūnāṃ saṃgamena ca  || 188.5 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityājñaptāḥ surendreṇa mumucuste balāhakāḥ  |
vātavarṣaṃ mahābhīmamabhāvāya gavāṃ dvijāḥ  || 188.6 ||
tataḥ kṣaṇena dharaṇī kakubho'mbarameva ca  |
ekaṃ dhārāmahāsāra pūraṇenābhavaddvijāḥ  || 188.7 ||
gāvastu tena patatā varṣavātena veginā  |
dhutāḥ prāṇāñjahuḥ sarvāstiryaṅmukhaśirodharāḥ  || 188.8 ||
kroḍena vatsānākramya tasthuranyā dvijottamāḥ  |
gāvo vivatsāśca kṛtā vāripūreṇa cāparāḥ  || 188.9 ||
vatsāśca dīnavadanāḥ pavanākampikaṃdharāḥ  |
trāhi trāhītyalpaśabdāḥ kṛṣṇamūcurivārtakāḥ  || 188.10 ||
tatastadgokulaṃ sarvaṃ gogopīgopasaṃkulam  |
atīvārtaṃ harirdṛṣṭvā trāṇāyācintayattadā  || 188.11 ||
etatkṛtaṃ mahendreṇa mahabhaṅgavirodhinā  |
tadetadakhilaṃ goṣṭhaṃ trātavyamadhunā mayā  || 188.12 ||
imamadrimahaṃ vīryādutpāṭyoruśilātalam  |
dhārayiṣyāmi goṣṭhasya pṛthucchattramivopari  || 188.13 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
iti kṛtvā matiṃ kṛṣṇo govardhanamahīdharam  |
utpāṭyaikakareṇaiva dhārayāmāsa līlayā  || 188.14 ||
gopāṃścāha jagannāthaḥ samutpāṭitabhūdharaḥ  |
viśadhvamatra sahitāḥ kṛtaṃ varṣanivāraṇam  || 188.15 ||
sunirvāteṣu deśeṣu yathāyogyamihāsyatām  |
praviśya nātra bhetavyaṃ giripātasya nirbhayaiḥ  || 188.16 ||
ityuktāstena te gopā viviśurgodhanaiḥ saha  |
śakaṭāropitairbhāṇḍairgopyaścāsārapīḍitāḥ  || 188.17 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi taṃ dadhāraivaṃ śailamatyantaniścalam  |
vrajaukovāsibhirharṣa vismitākṣairnirīkṣitaḥ  || 188.18 ||
gopagopījanairhṛṣṭaiḥ prītivistāritekṣaṇaiḥ  |
saṃstūyamānacaritaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śailamadhārayat || 188.19 ||
saptarātraṃ mahāmeghā vavarṣurnandagokule  |
indreṇa coditā meghā gopānāṃ nāśakāriṇā  || 188.20 ||
tato dhṛte mahāśaile paritrāte ca gokule  |
mithyāpratijño balabhidvārayāmāsa tān ghanān  || 188.21 ||
vyabhre nabhasi devendre vitathe śakramantrite  |
niṣkramya gokulaṃ hṛṣṭaḥ svasthānaṃ punarāgamat || 188.22 ||
mumoca kṛṣṇo'pi tadā govardhanamahāgirim  |
svasthāne vismitamukhairdṛṣṭastairvrajavāsibhiḥ  || 188.23 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
dhṛte govardhane śaile paritrāte ca gokule  |
rocayāmāsa kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ  || 188.24 ||
so'dhiruhya mahānāgamairāvatamamitrajit |
govardhanagirau kṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa tridaśādhipaḥ  || 188.25 ||
cārayantaṃ mahāvīryaṃ gāśca gopavapurdharam  |
kṛtsnasya jagato gopaṃ vṛtaṃ gopakumārakaiḥ  || 188.26 ||
garuḍaṃ ca dadarśoccairantardhānagataṃ dvijāḥ  |
kṛtacchāyaṃ harermūrdhni pakṣābhyāṃ pakṣipuṃgavam  || 188.27 ||
avaruhya sa nāgendrādekānte madhusūdanam  |
śakraḥ sasmitamāhedaṃ prītivisphāritekṣaṇaḥ  || 188.28 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa śṛṇuṣvedaṃ yadarthamahamāgataḥ  |
tvatsamīpaṃ mahābāho naitaccintyaṃ tvayānyathā  || 188.29 ||
bhārāvataraṇārdhāya pṛthivyāḥ pṛthivītalam  |
avatīrṇo'khilādhārastvameva parameśvara  || 188.30 ||
mahabhaṅgaviruddhena mayā gokulanāśakāḥ  |
samādiṣṭā mahāmeghāstaiścaitatkadanaṃ kṛtam  || 188.31 ||
trātāstāpāttvayā gāvaḥ samutpāṭya mahāgirim  |
tenāhaṃ toṣito vīra karmaṇātyadbhutena te  || 188.32 ||
sādhitaṃ kṛṣṇa devānāmadya manye prayojanam  |
tvayāyamadripravaraḥ kareṇaikena coddhṛtaḥ  || 188.33 ||
gobhiśca noditaḥ kṛṣṇa tvatsamīpamihāgataḥ  |
tvayā trātābhiratyarthaṃ yuṣmatkāraṇakāraṇāt || 188.34 ||
sa tvāṃ kṛṣṇābhiṣekṣyāmi gavāṃ vākyapracoditaḥ  |
upendratve gavāmindro govindastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi  || 188.35 ||
athopavāhyādādāya ghaṇṭāmairāvatādgajāt |
abhiṣekaṃ tayā cakre pavitrajalapūrṇayā  || 188.36 ||
kriyamāṇe'bhiṣeke tu gāvaḥ kṛṣṇasya tatkṣaṇāt |
prasravodbhūtadugdhārdrāṃ sadyaścakrurvasuṃdharām  || 188.37 ||
abhiṣicya gavāṃ vākyāddevendro vai janārdanam  |
prītyā sapraśrayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ punarāha śacīpatiḥ  || 188.38 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
gavāmetatkṛtaṃ vākyāttathānyadapi me śṛṇu  |
yadbravīmi mahābhāga bhārāvataraṇecchayā  || 188.39 ||
mamāṃśaḥ puruṣavyāghraḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīdhara  |
avatīrṇo'rjuno nāma sa rakṣyo bhavatā sadā  || 188.40 ||
bhārāvataraṇe sakhyaṃ sa te vīraḥ kariṣyati  |
sa rakṣaṇīyo bhavatā yathātmā madhusūdana  || 188.41 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
jānāmi bhārate vaṃśe jātaṃ pārthaṃ tavāṃśataḥ  |
tamahaṃ pālayiṣyāmi yāvadasmi mahītale  || 188.42 ||
yāvanmahītale śakra sthāsyāmyahamariṃdama  |
na tāvadarjunaṃ kaściddevendra yudhi jeṣyati  || 188.43 ||
kaṃso nāma mahābāhurdaityo'riṣṭastathā paraḥ  |
keśī kuvalayāpīḍo narakādyāstathāpare  || 188.44 ||
hateṣu teṣu devendra bhaviṣyati mahāhavaḥ  |
tatra viddhi sahasrākṣa bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtam  || 188.45 ||
sa tvaṃ gaccha na saṃtāpaṃ putrārthe kartumarhasi  |
nārjunasya ripuḥ kaścinmamāgre prabhaviṣyati  || 188.46 ||
arjunārthe tvahaṃ sarvān yudhiṣṭhirapurogamān  |
nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe kuntyai dāsyāmi vikṣatān  || 188.47 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ saṃpariṣvajya devarājo janārdanam  |
āruhyairāvataṃ nāgaṃ punareva divaṃ yayau  || 188.48 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi sahito gobhirgopālaiśca punarvrajam  |
ājagāmātha gopīnāṃ dṛṣṭapūtena vartmanā  || 188.49 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
gate śakre tu gopālāḥ kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakāriṇam  |
ūcuḥ prītyā dhṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā tena govardhanācalam  || 189.1 ||
{gopā ūcu̱ḥ }
vayamasmānmahābhāga bhavatā mahato bhayāt |
gāvaśca bhavatā trātā giridhāraṇakarmaṇā  || 189.2 ||
bālakrīḍeyamatulā gopālatvaṃ jugupsitam  |
divyaṃ ca karma bhavataḥ kimetattāta kathyatām  || 189.3 ||
kāliyo damitastoye pralambo vinipātitaḥ  |
dhṛto govardhanaścāyaṃ śaṅkitāni manāṃsi naḥ  || 189.4 ||
satyaṃ satyaṃ hareḥ pādau śrayāmo'mitavikrama  |
yathā tvadvīryamālokya na tvāṃ manyāmahe naram  || 189.5 ||
devo vā dānavo vā tvaṃ yakṣo gandharva eva vā  |
kiṃ cāsmākaṃ vicāreṇa bāndhavo'sti namo'stu te  || 189.6 ||
prītiḥ sastrīkumārasya vrajasya tava keśava  |
karma cedamaśakyaṃ yatsamastaistridaśairapi  || 189.7 ||
bālatvaṃ cātivīryaṃ ca janma cāsmāsvaśobhanam  |
cintyamānamameyātmañśaṅkāṃ kṛṣṇa prayacchati  || 189.8 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
kṣaṇaṃ bhūtvā tvasau tūṣṇīṃ kiṃcitpraṇayakopavān  |
ityevamuktastairgopairāha kṛṣṇo dvijottamāḥ  || 189.9 ||
{śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
matsaṃbandhena vo gopā yadi lajjā na jāyate  |
ślāghyo vāhaṃ tataḥ kiṃ vo vicāreṇa prayojanam  || 189.10 ||
yadi vo'sti mayi prītiḥ ślāghyo'haṃ bhavatāṃ yadi  |
tadarghā bandhusadṛśī bāndhavāḥ kriyatāṃ mayi  || 189.11 ||
nāhaṃ devo na gandharvo na yakṣo na ca dānavaḥ  |
ahaṃ vo bāndhavo jāto nātaścintyamato'nyathā  || 189.12 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
iti śrutvā harervākyaṃ baddhamaunāstato balam  |
yayurgopā mahābhāgāstasmin praṇayakopini  || 189.13 ||
kṛṣṇastu vimalaṃ vyoma śaraccandrasya candrikām  |
tathā kumudinīṃ phullāmāmoditadigantarām  || 189.14 ||
vanarājīṃ tathā kūjadbhṛṅgamālāmanoramām  |
vilokya saha gopībhirmanaścakre ratiṃ prati  || 189.15 ||
saha rāmeṇa madhuramatīva vanitāpriyam  |
jagau kamalapādo'sau nāma tatra kṛtavrataḥ  || 189.16 ||
ramyaṃ gītadhvaniṃ śrutvā saṃtyajyāvasathāṃstadā  |
ājagmustvaritā gopyo yatrāste madhusūdanaḥ  || 189.17 ||
śanaiḥ śanairjagau gopī kācittasya padānugā  |
dattāvadhānā kācicca tameva manasāsmarat || 189.18 ||
kācitkṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti coktvā lajjāmupāyayau  |
yayau ca kācitpremāndhā tatpārśvamavilajjitā  || 189.19 ||
kācidāvasathasyāntaḥ sthitvā dṛṣṭvā bahirgurum  |
tanmayatvena govindaṃ dadhyau mīlitalocanā  || 189.20 ||
gopīparivṛto rātriṃ śaraccandramanoramām  |
mānayāmāsa govindo rāsārambharasotsukaḥ  || 189.21 ||
gopyaśca vṛndaśaḥ kṛṣṇa ceṣṭābhyāyattamūrtayaḥ  |
anyadeśagate kṛṣṇe cerurvṛndāvanāntaram  || 189.22 ||
babhramustāstato gopyaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ  |
kṛṣṇasya caraṇaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭvā vṛndāvane dvijāḥ  || 189.23 ||
evaṃ nānāprakārāsu kṛṣṇaceṣṭāsu tāsu ca  |
gopyo vyagrāḥ samaṃ cerū ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam  || 189.24 ||
nivṛttāstāstato gopyo nirāśāḥ kṛṣṇadarśane  |
yamunātīramāgamya jagustaccaritaṃ dvijāḥ  || 189.25 ||
tato dadṛśurāyāntaṃ vikāśimukhapaṅkajam  |
gopyastrailokyagoptāraṃ kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakāriṇam  || 189.26 ||
kācidālokya govindamāyāntamatiharṣitā  |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti prāhotphullavilocanā  || 189.27 ||
kācidbhrūbhaṅguraṃ kṛtvā lalāṭaphalakaṃ harim  |
vilokya netrabhṛṅgābhyāṃ papau tanmukhapaṅkajam  || 189.28 ||
kācidālokya govindaṃ nimīlitavilocanā  |
tasyaiva rūpaṃ dhyāyantī yogārūḍheva sā babhau  || 189.29 ||
tataḥ kāṃcitpriyālāpaiḥ kāṃcidbhrūbhaṅgavīkṣitaiḥ  |
ninye'nunayamanyāśca karasparśena mādhavaḥ  || 189.30 ||
tābhiḥ prasannacittābhirgopībhiḥ saha sādaram  |
rarāma rāsagoṣṭhībhirudāracarito hariḥ  || 189.31 ||
rāsamaṇḍalabaddho'pi kṛṣṇapārśvamanūdgatā  |
gopījano na caivābhūdekasthānasthirātmanā  || 189.32 ||
haste pragṛhya caikaikāṃ gopikāṃ rāsamaṇḍalam  |
cakāra ca karasparśa nimīlitadṛśaṃ hariḥ  || 189.33 ||
tataḥ pravavṛte ramyā caladvalayanisvanaiḥ  |
anuyātaśaratkāvya geyagītiranukramām  || 189.34 ||
kṛṣṇaḥ śaraccandramasaṃ kaumudīkumudākaram  |
jagau gopījanastvekaṃ kṛṣṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ  || 189.35 ||
parivṛttā śrameṇaikā caladvalayatāpinī  |
dadau bāhulatāṃ skandhe gopī madhuvighātinaḥ  || 189.36 ||
kācitpravilasadbāhuḥ parirabhya cucumba tam  |
gopī gītastutivyāja nipuṇā madhusūdanam  || 189.37 ||
gopīkapolasaṃśleṣamabhipadya harerbhujau  |
pulakodgamaśasyāya svedāmbughanatāṃ gatau  || 189.38 ||
rāsageyaṃ jagau kṛṣṇo yāvattārataradhvaniḥ  |
sādhu kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti tāvattā dviguṇaṃ jaguḥ  || 189.39 ||
gate'nugamanaṃ cakrurvalane saṃmukhaṃ yayuḥ  |
pratilomānulomena bhejurgopāṅganā harim  || 189.40 ||
sa tadā saha gopībhī rarāma madhusūdanaḥ  |
sa varṣakoṭipratimaḥ kṣaṇastena vinābhavat || 189.41 ||
tā vāryamāṇāḥ pitṛbhiḥ patibhirbhrātṛbhistathā  |
kṛṣṇaṃ gopāṅganā rātrau ramayanti ratipriyāḥ  || 189.42 ||
so'pi kaiśorakavayā mānayanmadhusūdanaḥ  |
reme tābhirameyātmā kṣapāsu kṣapitāhitaḥ  || 189.43 ||
tadbhartṛṣu tathā tāsu sarvabhūteṣu ceśvaraḥ  |
ātmasvarūparūpo'sau vyāpya sarvamavasthitaḥ  || 189.44 ||
yathā samastabhūteṣu nabho'gniḥ pṛthivī jalam  |
vāyuścātmā tathaivāsau vyāpya sarvamavasthitaḥ  || 189.45 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
pradoṣārdhe kadācittu rāsāsakte janārdane  |
trāsayan samado goṣṭhānariṣṭaḥ samupāgataḥ  || 189.46 ||
satoyatoyadākārastīkṣṇaśṛṅgo'rkalocanaḥ  |
khurāgrapātairatyarthaṃ dārayan dharaṇītalam  || 189.47 ||
lelihānaḥ saniṣpeṣaṃ jihvayauṣṭhau punaḥ punaḥ  |
saṃrambhākṣiptalāṅgūlaḥ kaṭhinaskandhabandhanaḥ  || 189.48 ||
udagrakakudābhogaḥ pramāṇādduratikramaḥ  |
viṇmūtrāliptapṛṣṭhāṅgo gavāmudvegakārakaḥ  || 189.49 ||
pralambakaṇṭho'bhimukhastarughātāṅkitānanaḥ  |
pātayan sa gavāṃ garbhān daityo vṛṣabharūpadhṛk || 189.50 ||
sūdayaṃstarasā sarvān vanānyaṭati yaḥ sadā  |
tatastamatighorākṣamavekṣyātibhayāturāḥ  || 189.51 ||
gopā gopastriyaścaiva kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti cukruśuḥ  |
siṃhanādaṃ tataścakre talaśabdaṃ ca keśavaḥ  || 189.52 ||
tacchabdaśravaṇāccāsau dāmodaramukhaṃ yayau  |
agranyastaviṣāṇāgraḥ kṛṣṇakukṣikṛtekṣaṇaḥ  || 189.53 ||
abhyadhāvata duṣṭātmā daityo vṛṣabharūpadhṛk |
āyāntaṃ daityavṛṣabhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇo mahābalam  || 189.54 ||
na cacāla tataḥ sthānādavajñāsmitalīlayā  |
āsannaṃ caiva jagrāha grāhavanmadhusūdanaḥ  || 189.55 ||
jaghāna jānunā kukṣau viṣāṇagrahaṇācalam  |
tasya darpabalaṃ hatvā gṛhītasya viṣāṇayoḥ  || 189.56 ||
āpīḍayadariṣṭasya kaṇṭhaṃ klinnamivāmbaram  |
utpāṭya śṛṅgamekaṃ ca tenaivātāḍayattataḥ  || 189.57 ||
mamāra sa mahādaityo mukhācchoṇitamudvaman  |
tuṣṭuvurnihate tasmin gopā daitye janārdanam  |
jambhe hate sahasrākṣaṃ purā devagaṇā yathā  || 189.58 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
kakudmini hate'riṣṭe dhenuke ca nipātite  |
pralambe nidhanaṃ nīte dhṛte govardhanācale  || 190.1 ||
damite kāliye nāge bhagne tuṅgadrumadvaye  |
hatāyāṃ pūtanāyāṃ ca śakaṭe parivartite  || 190.2 ||
kaṃsāya nāradaḥ prāha yathāvṛttamanukramāt |
yaśodādevakīgarbha parivartādyaśeṣataḥ  || 190.3 ||
śrutvā tatsakalaṃ kaṃso nāradāddevadarśanāt |
vasudevaṃ prati tadā kopaṃ cakre sa durmatiḥ  || 190.4 ||
so'tikopādupālabhya sarvayādavasaṃsadi  |
jagarhe yādavāṃścāpi kāryaṃ caitadacintayat || 190.5 ||
yāvanna balamārūḍhau balakṛṣṇau subālakau  |
tāvadeva mayā vadhyāvasādhyau rūḍhayauvanau  || 190.6 ||
cāṇūro'tra mahāvīryo muṣṭikaśca mahābalaḥ  |
etābhyāṃ mallayuddhe tau ghātayiṣyāmi durmadau  || 190.7 ||
dhanurmahamahāyāga vyājenānīya tau vrajāt |
tathā tathā kariṣyāmi yāsyataḥ saṃkṣayaṃ yathā  || 190.8 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityālocya sa duṣṭātmā kaṃso rāmajanārdanau  |
