hantuṃ kṛtamatirvīramakrūraṃ vākyamabravīt || 190.9 ||
{kaṃsa uvāca̱ }
bho bho dānapate vākyaṃ kriyatāṃ prītaye mama  |
itaḥ syandanamāruhya gamyatāṃ nandagokulam  || 190.10 ||
vasudevasutau tatra viṣṇoraṃśasamudbhavau  |
nāśāya kila saṃbhūtau mama duṣṭau pravardhataḥ  || 190.11 ||
dhanurmahamahāyāgaścaturdaśyāṃ bhaviṣyati  |
āneyau bhavatā tau tu mallayuddhāya tatra vai  || 190.12 ||
cāṇūramuṣṭikau mallau niyuddhakuśalau mama  |
tābhyāṃ sahānayoryuddhaṃ sarvaloko'tra paśyatu  || 190.13 ||
nāgaḥ kuvalayāpīḍo mahāmātrapracoditaḥ  |
sa tau nihaṃsyate pāpau vasudevātmajau śiśū  || 190.14 ||
tau hatvā vasudevaṃ ca nandagopaṃ ca durmatim  |
haniṣye pitaraṃ caiva ugrasenaṃ ca durmatim  || 190.15 ||
tataḥ samastagopānāṃ godhanānyakhilānyaham  |
vittaṃ cāpahariṣyāmi duṣṭānāṃ madvadhaiṣiṇām  || 190.16 ||
tvāmṛte yādavāśceme duṣṭā dānapate mama  |
eteṣāṃ ca vadhāyāhaṃ prayatiṣyāmyanukramāt || 190.17 ||
tato niṣkaṇṭakaṃ sarvaṃ rājyametadayādavam  |
prasādhiṣye tvayā tasmānmatprītyā vīra gamyatām  || 190.18 ||
yathā ca māhiṣaṃ sarpirdadhi cāpyupahārya vai  |
gopāḥ samānayantyāśu tvayā vācyāstathā tathā  || 190.19 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityājñaptastadākrūro mahābhāgavato dvijāḥ  |
prītimānabhavatkṛṣṇaṃ śvo drakṣyāmīti satvaraḥ  || 190.20 ||
tathetyuktvā tu rājānaṃ rathamāruhya satvaraḥ  |
niścakrāma tadā puryā mathurāyā madhupriyaḥ  || 190.21 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
keśī cāpi balodagraḥ kaṃsadūtaḥ pracoditaḥ  |
kṛṣṇasya nidhanākāṅkṣī vṛndāvanamupāgamat || 190.22 ||
sa khurakṣatabhūpṛṣṭhaḥ saṭākṣepadhutāmbudaḥ  |
punarvikrāntacandrārka mārgo gopāntamāgamat || 190.23 ||
tasya hreṣitaśabdena gopālā daityavājinaḥ  |
gopyaśca bhayasaṃvignā govindaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ  || 190.24 ||
trāhi trāhīti govindasteṣāṃ śrutvā tu tadvacaḥ  |
satoyajaladadhvāna gambhīramidamuktavān  || 190.25 ||
{govinda uvāca̱ }
alaṃ trāsena gopālāḥ keśinaḥ kiṃ bhayāturaiḥ  |
bhavadbhirgopajātīyairvīravīryaṃ vilopyate  || 190.26 ||
kimanenālpasāreṇa hreṣitāropakāriṇā  |
daiteyabalavāhyena valgatā duṣṭavājinā  || 190.27 ||
ehyehi duṣṭa kṛṣṇo'haṃ pūṣṇastviva pinākadhṛk |
pātayiṣyāmi daśanān vadanādakhilāṃstava  || 190.28 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā sa tu govindaḥ keśinaḥ saṃmukhaṃ yayau  |
vivṛtāsyaśca so'pyenaṃ daiteyaśca upādravat || 190.29 ||
bāhumābhoginaṃ kṛtvā mukhe tasya janārdanaḥ  |
praveśayāmāsa tadā keśino duṣṭavājinaḥ  || 190.30 ||
keśino vadanaṃ tena viśatā kṛṣṇabāhunā  |
śātitā daśanāstasya sitābhrāvayavā iva  || 190.31 ||
kṛṣṇasya vavṛdhe bāhuḥ keśidehagato dvijāḥ  |
vināśāya yathā vyādhirāptabhūtairupekṣitaḥ  || 190.32 ||
vipāṭitauṣṭho bahulaṃ saphenaṃ rudhiraṃ vaman  |
sṛkkaṇī vivṛte cakre viśliṣṭe muktabandhane  || 190.33 ||
jagāma dharaṇīṃ pādaiḥ śakṛnmūtraṃ samutsṛjan  |
svedārdragātraḥ śrāntaśca niryatnaḥ so'bhavattataḥ  || 190.34 ||
vyāditāsyo mahāraudraḥ so'suraḥ kṛṣṇabāhunā  |
nipapāta dvidhābhūto vaidyutena yathā drumaḥ  || 190.35 ||
dvipādapṛṣṭhapucchārdha śravaṇaikākṣanāsike  |
keśinaste dvidhā bhūte śakale ca virejatuḥ  || 190.36 ||
hatvā tu keśinaṃ kṛṣṇo muditairgopakairvṛtaḥ  |
anāyastatanuḥ svastho hasaṃstatraiva saṃsthitaḥ  || 190.37 ||
tato gopāśca gopyaśca hate keśini vismitāḥ  |
tuṣṭuvuḥ puṇḍarīkākṣamanurāgamanoramam  || 190.38 ||
āyayau tvarito vipro nārado jaladasthitaḥ  |
keśinaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣanirbharamānasaḥ  || 190.39 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
sādhu sādhu jagannātha līlayaiva yadacyuta  |
nihato'yaṃ tvayā keśī kleśadastridivaukasām  || 190.40 ||
sukarmāṇyavatāre tu kṛtāni madhusūdana  |
yāni vai vismitaṃ cetastoṣametena me gatam  || 190.41 ||
turagasyāsya śakro'pi kṛṣṇa devāśca bibhyati  |
dhutakesarajālasya hreṣato'bhrāvalokinaḥ  || 190.42 ||
yasmāttvayaiṣa duṣṭātmā hataḥ keśī janārdana  |
tasmātkeśavanāmnā tvaṃ loke geyo bhaviṣyasi  || 190.43 ||
svastyastu te gamiṣyāmi kaṃsayuddhe'dhunā punaḥ  |
paraśvo'haṃ sameṣyāmi tvayā keśiniṣūdana  || 190.44 ||
ugrasenasute kaṃse sānuge vinipātite  |
bhārāvatārakartā tvaṃ pṛthivyā dharaṇīdhara  || 190.45 ||
tatrānekaprakāreṇa yuddhāni pṛthivīkṣitām  |
draṣṭavyāni mayā yuṣmatpraṇītāni janārdana  || 190.46 ||
so'haṃ yāsyāmi govinda devakāryaṃ mahatkṛtam  |
tvayā sabhājitaścāhaṃ svasti te'stu vrajāmyaham  || 190.47 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
nārade tu gate kṛṣṇaḥ saha gopairavismitaḥ  |
viveśa gokulaṃ gopī netrapānaikabhājanam  || 190.48 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
akrūro'pi viniṣkramya syandanenāśugāminā  |
kṛṣṇasaṃdarśanāsaktaḥ prayayau nandagokule  || 191.1 ||
cintayāmāsa cākrūro nāsti dhanyataro mayā  |
yo'hamaṃśāvatīrṇasya mukhaṃ drakṣyāmi cakriṇaḥ  || 191.2 ||
adya me saphalaṃ janma suprabhātā ca me niśā  |
yadunnidrābjapattrākṣaṃ viṣṇordrakṣyāmyahaṃ mukham  || 191.3 ||
pāpaṃ harati yatpuṃsāṃ smṛtaṃ saṃkalpanāmayam  |
tatpuṇḍarīkanayanaṃ viṣṇordrakṣyāmyahaṃ mukham  || 191.4 ||
nirjagmuśca yato vedā vedāṅgānyakhilāni ca  |
drakṣyāmi yatparaṃ dhāma devānāṃ bhagavanmukham  || 191.5 ||
yajñeṣu yajñapuruṣaḥ puruṣaiḥ puruṣottamaḥ  |
ijyate yo'khilādhārastaṃ drakṣyāmi jagatpatim  || 191.6 ||
iṣṭvā yamindro yajñānāṃ śatenāmararājatām  |
avāpa tamanantādimahaṃ drakṣyāmi keśavam  || 191.7 ||
na brahmā nendrarudrāśvi vasvādityamarudgaṇāḥ  |
yasya svarūpaṃ jānanti spṛśatyadya sa me hariḥ  || 191.8 ||
sarvātmā sarvagaḥ sarvaḥ sarvabhūteṣu saṃsthitaḥ  |
yo bhavatyavyayo vyāpī sa vīkṣyate mayādya ha  || 191.9 ||
matsyakūrmavarāhādyaiḥ siṃharūpādibhiḥ sthitam  |
cakāra yogato yogaṃ sa māmālāpayiṣyati  || 191.10 ||
sāṃprataṃ ca jagatsvāmī kāryajāte vraje sthitim  |
kartuṃ manuṣyatāṃ prāptaḥ svecchādehadhṛgavyayaḥ  || 191.11 ||
yo'nantaḥ pṛthivīṃ dhatte śikharasthitisaṃsthitām  |
so'vatīrṇo jagatyarthe māmakrūreti vakṣyati  || 191.12 ||
pitṛbandhusuhṛdbhrātṛ mātṛbandhumayīmimām  |
yanmāyāṃ nālamuddhartuṃ jagattasmai namo namaḥ  || 191.13 ||
tarantyavidyāṃ vitatāṃ hṛdi yasminniveśite  |
yogamāyāmimāṃ martyāstasmai vidyātmane namaḥ  || 191.14 ||
yajvabhiryajñapuruṣo vāsudevaśca śāśvataiḥ  |
vedāntavedibhirviṣṇuḥ procyate yo nato'smi tam  || 191.15 ||
tathā yatra jagaddhāmni dhāryate ca pratiṣṭhitam  |
sadasattvaṃ sa sattvena mayyasau yātu saumyatām  || 191.16 ||
smṛte sakalakalyāṇa bhājanaṃ yatra jāyate  |
puruṣapravaraṃ nityaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ harim  || 191.17 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
itthaṃ sa cintayan viṣṇuṃ bhaktinamrātmamānasaḥ  |
akrūro gokulaṃ prāptaḥ kiṃcitsūrye virājati  || 191.18 ||
sa dadarśa tadā tatra kṛṣṇamādohane gavām  |
vatsamadhyagataṃ phulla nīlotpaladalacchavim  || 191.19 ||
praphullapadmapattrākṣaṃ śrīvatsāṅkitavakṣasam  |
pralambabāhumāyāma tuṅgorasthalamunnasam  || 191.20 ||
savilāsasmitādhāraṃ bibhrāṇaṃ mukhapaṅkajam  |
tuṅgaraktanakhaṃ padbhyāṃ dharaṇyāṃ supratiṣṭhitam  || 191.21 ||
bibhrāṇaṃ vāsasī pīte vanyapuṣpavibhūṣitam  |
sāndranīlalatāhastaṃ sitāmbhojāvataṃsakam  || 191.22 ||
haṃsendukundadhavalaṃ nīlāmbaradharaṃ dvijāḥ  |
tasyānu balabhadraṃ ca dadarśa yadunandanam  || 191.23 ||
prāṃśumuttuṅgabāhuṃ ca vikāśimukhapaṅkajam  |
meghamālāparivṛtaṃ kailāsādrimivāparam  || 191.24 ||
tau dṛṣṭvā vikasadvaktra sarojaḥ sa mahāmatiḥ  |
pulakāñcitasarvāṅgastadākrūro'bhavaddvijāḥ  || 191.25 ||
ya etatparamaṃ dhāma etattatparamaṃ padam  |
abhavadvāsudevo'sau dvidhā yo'yaṃ vyavasthitaḥ  || 191.26 ||
sāphalyamakṣṇoryugapanmamāstu  191.27
dṛṣṭe jagaddhātari hāsamuccaiḥ  191.27
apyaṅgametadbhagavatprasādād 191.27
dattāṅgasaṅge phalavartma tatsyāt 191.27
adyaiva spṛṣṭvā mama hastapadmaṃ  191.28
kariṣyati śrīmadanantamūrtiḥ  191.28
yasyāṅgulisparśahatākhilāghair 191.28
avāpyate siddhiranuttamā naraiḥ  191.28
tathāśvirudrendravasupraṇītā  191.29
devāḥ prayacchanti varaṃ prahṛṣṭāḥ  191.29
cakraṃ ghnatā daityapaterhṛtāni  191.29
daityāṅganānāṃ nayanāntarāṇi  191.29
yatrāmbu vinyasya balirmanobhyām  191.30
avāpa bhogān vasudhātalasthaḥ  191.30
tathāmareśastridaśādhipatyaṃ  191.30
manvantaraṃ pūrṇamavāpa śakraḥ  191.30
atheśa māṃ kaṃsaparigraheṇa  191.31
doṣāspadībhūtamadoṣayuktam  191.31
kartā na mānopahitaṃ dhigastu  191.31
yasmānmanaḥ sādhubahiṣkṛto yaḥ  191.31
jñānātmakasyākhilasattvarāśer 191.32
vyāvṛttadoṣasya sadāsphuṭasya  191.32
kiṃ vā jagatyatra samastapuṃsām  191.32
ajñātamasyāsti hṛdi sthitasya  191.32
tasmādahaṃ bhaktivinamragātro  191.33
vrajāmi viśveśvaramīśvarāṇām  191.33
aṃśāvatāraṃ puruṣottamasya  191.33
anādimadhyāntamajasya viṣṇoḥ  191.33
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
cintayanniti govindamupagamya sa yādavaḥ  |
akrūro'smīti caraṇau nanāma śirasā hareḥ  || 192.1 ||
so'pyenaṃ dhvajavajrābja kṛtacihnena pāṇinā  |
saṃspṛśyākṛṣya ca prītyā sugāḍhaṃ pariṣasvaje  || 192.2 ||
kṛtasaṃvadanau tena yathāvadbalakeśavau  |
tataḥ praviṣṭau sahasā tamādāyātmamandiram  || 192.3 ||
saha tābhyāṃ tadākrūraḥ kṛtasaṃvandanādikaḥ  |
bhuktabhojyo yathānyāyamācacakṣe tatastayoḥ  || 192.4 ||
yathā nirbhartsitastena kaṃsenānakadundubhiḥ  |
yathā ca devakī devī dānavena durātmanā  || 192.5 ||
ugrasene yathā kaṃsaḥ sa durātmā ca vartate  |
yaṃ caivārthaṃ samuddiśya kaṃsena sa visarjitaḥ  || 192.6 ||
tatsarvaṃ vistarācchrutvā bhagavān keśisūdanaḥ  |
uvācākhilametattu jñātaṃ dānapate mayā  || 192.7 ||
kariṣye ca mahābhāga yadatraupāyikaṃ matam  |
vicintyaṃ nānyathaitatte viddhi kaṃsaṃ hataṃ mayā  || 192.8 ||
ahaṃ rāmaśca mathurāṃ śvo yāsyāvaḥ samaṃ tvayā  |
gopavṛddhāśca yāsyanti ādāyopāyanaṃ bahu  || 192.9 ||
niśeyaṃ nīyatāṃ vīra na cintāṃ kartumarhasi  |
trirātrābhyantare kaṃsaṃ haniṣyāmi sahānugam  || 192.10 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
samādiśya tato gopānakrūro'pi sakeśavaḥ  |
suṣvāpa balabhadraśca nandagopagṛhe gataḥ  || 192.11 ||
tataḥ prabhāte vimale rāmakṛṣṇau mahābalau  |
akrūreṇa samaṃ gantumudyatau mathurāṃ purīm  || 192.12 ||
dṛṣṭvā gopījanaḥ sāsraḥ ślathadvalayabāhukaḥ  |
niśvasaṃścātiduḥkhārtaḥ prāha cedaṃ parasparam  || 192.13 ||
mathurāṃ prāpya govindaḥ kathaṃ gokulameṣyati  |
nāgarastrīkalālāpa madhu śrotreṇa pāsyati  || 192.14 ||
vilāsivākyajāteṣu nāgarīṇāṃ kṛtāspadam  |
cittamasya kathaṃ grāmya gopagopīṣu yāsyati  || 192.15 ||
sāraṃ samastagoṣṭhasya vidhinā haratā harim  |
prahṛtaṃ gopayoṣitsu nighṛṇena durātmanā  || 192.16 ||
bhāvagarbhasmitaṃ vākyaṃ vilāsalalitā gatiḥ  |
nāgarīṇāmatīvaitatkaṭākṣekṣitameva tu  || 192.17 ||
grāmyo harirayaṃ tāsāṃ vilāsanigaḍairyataḥ  |
bhavatīnāṃ punaḥ pārśvaṃ kayā yuktyā sameṣyati  || 192.18 ||
eṣo hi rathamāruhya mathurāṃ yāti keśavaḥ  |
akrūrakrūrakeṇāpi hatāśena pratāritaḥ  || 192.19 ||
kiṃ na vetti nṛśaṃso'yamanurāgaparaṃ janam  |
yenemamakṣarāhlādaṃ nayatyanyatra no harim  || 192.20 ||
eṣa rāmeṇa sahitaḥ prayātyatyantanirghṛṇaḥ  |
rathamāruhya govindastvaryatāmasya vāraṇe  || 192.21 ||
gurūṇāmagrato vaktuṃ kiṃ bravīṣi na naḥ kṣamam  |
guravaḥ kiṃ kariṣyanti dagdhānāṃ virahāgninā  || 192.22 ||
nandagopamukhā gopā gantumete samudyatāḥ  |
nodyamaṃ kurute kaścidgovindavinivartane  || 192.23 ||
suprabhātādya rajanī mathurāvāsiyoṣitām  |
yāsāmacyutavaktrābje yāti netrālibhogyatām  || 192.24 ||
dhanyāste pathi ye kṛṣṇamito yāntamavāritāḥ  |
udvahiṣyanti paśyantaḥ svadehaṃ pulakāñcitam  || 192.25 ||
mathurānagarīpaura nayanānāṃ mahotsavaḥ  |
govindavadanālokādatīvādya bhaviṣyati  || 192.26 ||
ko nu svapnaḥ sabhāgyābhirdṛṣṭastābhiradhokṣajam  |
vistārikāntanayanā yā drakṣyantyanivāritam  || 192.27 ||
aho gopījanasyāsya darśayitvā mahānidhim  |
uddhṛtānyadya netrāṇi vidhātrākaruṇātmanā  || 192.28 ||
anurāgeṇa śaithilyamasmāsu vrajato hareḥ  |
śaithilyamupayāntyāśu kareṣu valayānyapi  || 192.29 ||
akrūraḥ krūrahṛdayaḥ śīghraṃ prerayate hayān  |
evamārtāsu yoṣitsu ghṛṇā kasya na jāyate  || 192.30 ||
he he kṛṣṇa rathasyoccaiścakrareṇurnirīkṣyatām  |
dūrīkṛto hariryena so'pi reṇurna lakṣyate  || 192.31 ||
ityevamatihārdena gopījananirīkṣitaḥ  |
tatyāja vrajabhūbhāgaṃ saha rāmeṇa keśavaḥ  || 192.32 ||
gacchanto javanāśvena rathena yamunātaṭam  |
prāptā madhyāhnasamaye rāmākrūrajanārdanāḥ  || 192.33 ||
athāha kṛṣṇamakrūro bhavadbhyāṃ tāvadāsyatām  |
yāvatkaromi kālindyāmāhnikārhaṇamambhasi  || 192.34 ||
tathetyukte tataḥ snātaḥ svācāntaḥ sa mahāmatiḥ  |
dadhyau brahma paraṃ viprāḥ praviśya yamunājale  || 192.35 ||
phaṇāsahasramālāḍhyaṃ balabhadraṃ dadarśa saḥ  |
kundāmalāṅgamunnidra padmapattrāyatekṣaṇam  || 192.36 ||
vṛtaṃ vāsukiḍimbhaughairmahadbhiḥ pavanāśibhiḥ  |
saṃstūyamānamudgandhi vanamālāvibhūṣitam  || 192.37 ||
dadhānamasite vastre cārurūpāvataṃsakam  |
cārukuṇḍalinaṃ mattamantarjalatale sthitam  || 192.38 ||
tasyotsaṅge ghanaśyāmamātāmrāyatalocanam  |
caturbāhumudārāṅgaṃ cakrādyāyudhabhūṣaṇam  || 192.39 ||
pīte vasānaṃ vasane citramālyavibhūṣitam  |
śakracāpataḍinmālā vicitramiva toyadam  || 192.40 ||
śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ cāru keyūramukuṭojjvalam  |
dadarśa kṛṣṇamakliṣṭaṃ puṇḍarīkāvataṃsakam  || 192.41 ||
sanandanādyairmunibhiḥ siddhayogairakalmaṣaiḥ  |
saṃcintyamānaṃ manasā nāsāgranyastalocanaiḥ  || 192.42 ||
balakṛṣṇau tadākrūraḥ pratyabhijñāya vismitaḥ  |
acintayadatho śīghraṃ kathamatrāgatāviti  || 192.43 ||
vivakṣoḥ stambhayāmāsa vācaṃ tasya janārdanaḥ  |
tato niṣkramya salilādrathamabhyāgataḥ punaḥ  || 192.44 ||
dadarśa tatra caivobhau rathasyopari saṃsthitau  |
rāmakṛṣṇau yathā pūrvaṃ manuṣyavapuṣānvitau  || 192.45 ||
nimagnaśca punastoye dadṛśe sa tathaiva tau  |
saṃstūyamānau gandharvairmunisiddhamahoragaiḥ  || 192.46 ||
tato vijñātasadbhāvaḥ sa tu dānapatistadā  |
tuṣṭāva sarvavijñāna mayamacyutamīśvaram  || 192.47 ||
{akrūra uvāca̱ }
tanmātrarūpiṇe'cintya mahimne paramātmane  |
vyāpine naikarūpaika svarūpāya namo namaḥ  || 192.48 ||
śabdarūpāya te'cintya havirbhūtāya te namaḥ  |
namo vijñānarūpāya parāya prakṛteḥ prabho  || 192.49 ||
bhūtātmā cendriyātmā ca pradhānātmā tathā bhavān  |
ātmā ca paramātmā ca tvamekaḥ pañcadhā sthitaḥ  || 192.50 ||
prasīda sarvadharmātman kṣarākṣara maheśvara  |
brahmaviṣṇuśivādyābhiḥ kalpanābhirudīritaḥ  || 192.51 ||
anākhyeyasvarūpātmannanākhyeyaprayojana  |
anākhyeyābhidhāna tvāṃ nato'smi parameśvaram  || 192.52 ||
na yatra nātha vidyante nāmajātyādikalpanāḥ  |
tadbrahma paramaṃ nityamavikāri bhavānajaḥ  || 192.53 ||
na kalpanāmṛte'rthasya sarvasyādhigamo yataḥ  |
tataḥ kṛṣṇācyutānanta viṣṇusaṃjñābhirīḍyase  || 192.54 ||
sarvātmaṃstvamaja vikalpanābhiretair 192.55
devāstvaṃ jagadakhilaṃ tvameva viśvam  192.55
viśvātmaṃstvamativikārabhedahīnaḥ  192.55
sarvasminnahi bhavato'sti kiṃcidanyat 192.55
tvaṃ brahmā paśupatiraryamā vidhātā  192.56
tvaṃ dhātā tridaśapatiḥ samīraṇo'gniḥ  192.56
toyeśo dhanapatirantakastvameko  192.56
bhinnātmā jagadapi pāsi śaktibhedaiḥ  192.56
viśvaṃ bhavān sṛjati hanti gabhastirūpo  192.57
viśvaṃ ca te guṇamayo'yamaja prapañcaḥ  192.57
rūpaṃ paraṃ saditivācakamakṣaraṃ yaj 192.57
jñānātmane sadasate praṇato'smi tasmai  192.57
oṃ namo vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca  |
pradyumnāya namastubhyamaniruddhāya te namaḥ  || 192.58 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evamantarjale kṛṣṇamabhiṣṭūya sa yādavaḥ  |
arghayāmāsa sarveśaṃ dhūpapuṣpairmanomayaiḥ  || 192.59 ||
parityajyānyaviṣayaṃ manastatra niveśya saḥ  |
brahmabhūte ciraṃ sthitvā virarāma samādhitaḥ  || 192.60 ||
kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ manyamāno dvijottamāḥ  |
ājagāma rathaṃ bhūyo nirgamya yamunāmbhasaḥ  || 192.61 ||
rāmakṛṣṇau dadarśātha yathāpūrvamavasthitau  |
vismitākṣaṃ tadākrūraṃ taṃ ca kṛṣṇo'bhyabhāṣata  || 192.62 ||
{śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
kiṃ tvayā dṛṣṭamāścaryamakrūra yamunājale  |
vismayotphullanayano bhavān saṃlakṣyate yataḥ  || 192.63 ||
{akrūra uvāca̱ }
antarjale yadāścaryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tatra mayācyuta  |
tadatraiva hi paśyāmi mūrtimatpurataḥ sthitam  || 192.64 ||
jagadetanmahāścarya rūpaṃ yasya mahātmanaḥ  |
tenāścaryapareṇāhaṃ bhavatā kṛṣṇa saṃgataḥ  || 192.65 ||
tatkimetena mathurāṃ prayāmo madhusūdana  |
bibhemi kaṃsāddhigjanma parapiṇḍopajīvinaḥ  || 192.66 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā codayāmāsa tān hayān vātaraṃhasaḥ  |
saṃprāptaścāpi sāyāhne so'krūro mathurāṃ purīm  |
vilokya mathurāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ cāha sa yādavaḥ  || 192.67 ||
{akrūra uvāca̱ }
padbhyāṃ yātaṃ mahāvīryau rathenaiko viśāmyaham  |
gantavyaṃ vasudevasya no bhavadbhyāṃ tathā gṛhe  |
yuvayorhi kṛte vṛddhaḥ kaṃsena sa nirasyate  || 192.68 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā praviveśāsāvakrūro mathurāṃ purīm  |
praviṣṭau rāmakṛṣṇau ca rājamārgamupāgatau  || 192.69 ||
strībhirnaraiśca sānanda locanairabhivikṣitau  |
jagmaturlīlayā vīrau prāptau bālagajāviva  || 192.70 ||
bhramamāṇau tu tau dṛṣṭvā rajakaṃ raṅgakārakam  |
ayācetāṃ svarūpāṇi vāsāṃsi rucirāṇi tau  || 192.71 ||
kaṃsasya rajakaḥ so'tha prasādārūḍhavismayaḥ  |
bahūnyākṣepavākyāni prāhoccai rāmakeśavau  || 192.72 ||
tatastalaprahāreṇa kṛṣṇastasya durātmanaḥ  |
pātayāmāsa kopena rajakasya śiro bhuvi  || 192.73 ||
hatvādāya ca vastrāṇi pītanīlāmbarau tataḥ  |
kṛṣṇarāmau mudāyuktau mālākāragṛhaṃ gatau  || 192.74 ||
vikāsinetrayugalo mālākāro'tivismitaḥ  |
etau kasya kuto yātau manasācintayattataḥ  || 192.75 ||
pītanīlāmbaradharau dṛṣṭvātisumanoharau  |
sa tarkayāmāsa tadā bhuvaṃ devāvupāgatau  || 192.76 ||
vikāśimukhapadmābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ puṣpāṇi yācitaḥ  |
bhuvaṃ viṣṭabhya hastābhyāṃ pasparśa śirasā mahīm  || 192.77 ||
prasādasumukhau nāthau mama gehamupāgatau  |
dhanyo'hamarcayiṣyāmītyāha tau mālyajīvikaḥ  || 192.78 ||
tataḥ prahṛṣṭavadanastayoḥ puṣpāṇi kāmataḥ  |
cārūṇyetāni caitāni pradadau sa vilobhayan  || 192.79 ||
punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyāsau mālākārottamo dadau  |
puṣpāṇi tābhyāṃ cārūṇi gandhavantyamalāni ca  || 192.80 ||
mālākārāya kṛṣṇo'pi prasannaḥ pradadau varam  |
śrīstvāṃ matsaṃśrayā bhadra na kadācittyajiṣyati  || 192.81 ||
balahānirna te saumya dhanahānirathāpi vā  |
yāvaddharaṇisūryau ca saṃtatiḥ putrapautrikī  || 192.82 ||
bhuktvā ca vipulān bhogāṃstvamante matprasādataḥ  |
mamānusmaraṇaṃ prāpya divyalokamavāpsyasi  || 192.83 ||
dharme manaśca te bhadra sarvakālaṃ bhaviṣyati  |
yuṣmatsaṃtatijātānāṃ dīrghamāyurbhaviṣyati  || 192.84 ||
nopasargādikaṃ doṣaṃ yuṣmatsaṃtatisaṃbhavaḥ  |
avāpsyati mahābhāga yāvatsūryo bhaviṣyati  || 192.85 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā tadgṛhātkṛṣṇo baladevasahāyavān  |
nirjagāma muniśreṣṭhā mālākāreṇa pūjitaḥ  || 192.86 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
rājamārge tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sānulepanabhājanām  |
dadarśa kubjāmāyāntīṃ navayauvanagocarām  || 193.1 ||
tāmāha lalitaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kasyedamanulepanam  |
bhavatyā nīyate satyaṃ vadendīvaralocane  || 193.2 ||
sakāmenaiva sā proktā sānurāgā hariṃ prati  |
prāha sā lalitaṃ kubjā dadarśa ca balāttataḥ  || 193.3 ||
{kubjovāca̱ }
kānta kasmānna jānāsi kaṃsenāpi niyojitā  |
naikavakreti vikhyātāmanulepanakarmaṇi  || 193.4 ||
nānyapiṣṭaṃ hi kaṃsasya prītaye hyanulepanam  |
bhavatyahamatīvāsya prasādadhanabhājanam  || 193.5 ||
{śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
sugandhametadrājārhaṃ ruciraṃ rucirānane  |
āvayorgātrasadṛśaṃ dīyatāmanulepanam  || 193.6 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śrutvā tamāha sā kṛṣṇaṃ gṛhyatāmiti sādaram  |
anulepaṃ ca pradadau gātrayogyamathobhayoḥ  || 193.7 ||
bhakticchedānuliptāṅgau tatastau puruṣarṣabhau  |
sendracāpau virājantau sitakṛṣṇāvivāmbudau  || 193.8 ||
tatastāṃ cibuke śaurirullāpanavidhānavit |
ullāpya tolayāmāsa dvyaṅgulenāgrapāṇinā  || 193.9 ||
cakarṣa padbhyāṃ ca tadā ṛjutvaṃ keśavo'nayat |
tataḥ sā ṛjutāṃ prāptā yoṣitāmabhavadvarā  || 193.10 ||
vilāsalalitaṃ prāha premagarbhabharālasam  |
vastre pragṛhya govindaṃ vraja gehaṃ mameti vai  || 193.11 ||
āyāsye bhavatīgehamiti tāṃ prāha keśavaḥ  |
visasarja jahāsoccai rāmasyālokya cānanam  || 193.12 ||
bhakticchedānuliptāṅgau nīlapītāmbarāvubhau  |
dhanuḥśālāṃ tato yātau citramālyopaśobhitau  || 193.13 ||
adhyāsya ca dhanūratnaṃ tābhyāṃ pṛṣṭaistu rakṣibhiḥ  |
ākhyātaṃ sahasā kṛṣṇo gṛhītvāpūrayaddhanuḥ  || 193.14 ||
tataḥ pūrayatā tena bhajyamānaṃ balāddhanuḥ  |
cakārātimahāśabdaṃ mathurā tena pūritā  || 193.15 ||
anuyuktau tatastau ca bhagne dhanuṣi rakṣibhiḥ  |
rakṣisainyaṃ nikṛtyobhau niṣkrāntau kārmukālayāt || 193.16 ||
akrūrāgamavṛttāntamupalabhya tathā dhanuḥ  |
bhagnaṃ śrutvātha kaṃso'pi prāha cāṇūramuṣṭikau  || 193.17 ||
{kaṃsa uvāca̱ }
gopāladārakau prāptau bhavadbhyāṃ tau mamāgrataḥ  |
mallayuddhena hantavyau mama prāṇaharau hi tau  || 193.18 ||
niyuddhe tadvināśena bhavadbhyāṃ toṣito hyaham  |
dāsyāmyabhimatān kāmānnānyathaitanmahābalau  || 193.19 ||
nyāyato'nyāyato vāpi bhavadbhyāṃ tau mamāhitau  |
hantavyau tadvadhādrājyaṃ sāmānyaṃ vo bhaviṣyati  || 193.20 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityādiśya sa tau mallau tataścāhūya hastipam  |
provācoccaistvayā mattaḥ samājadvāri kuñjaraḥ  || 193.21 ||
sthāpyaḥ kuvalayāpīḍastena tau gopadārakau  |
ghātanīyau niyuddhāya raṅgadvāramupāgatau  || 193.22 ||
tamājñāpyātha dṛṣṭvā ca mañcān sarvānupāhṛtān  |
āsannamaraṇaḥ kaṃsaḥ sūryodayamudaikṣata  || 193.23 ||
tataḥ samastamañceṣu nāgaraḥ sa tadā janaḥ  |
rājamañceṣu cārūḍhāḥ saha bhṛtyairmahībhṛtaḥ  || 193.24 ||
mallaprāśnikavargaśca raṅgamadhye samīpagaḥ  |
kṛtaḥ kaṃsena kaṃso'pi tuṅgamañce vyavasthitaḥ  || 193.25 ||
antaḥpurāṇāṃ mañcāśca yathānye parikalpitāḥ  |
anye ca vāramukhyānāmanye nagarayoṣitām  || 193.26 ||
nandagopādayo gopā mañceṣvanyeṣvavasthitāḥ  |
akrūravasudevau ca mañcaprānte vyavasthitau  || 193.27 ||
nagarīyoṣitāṃ madhye devakī putragardhinī  |
antakāle'pi putrasya drakṣyāmīti mukhaṃ sthitā  || 193.28 ||
vādyamāneṣu tūryeṣu cāṇūre cātivalgati  |
hāhākārapare loka āsphoṭayati muṣṭike  || 193.29 ||
hatvā kuvalayāpīḍaṃ hastyārohapracoditam  |
madāsṛganuliptāṅgau gajadantavarāyudhau  || 193.30 ||
mṛgamadhye yathā siṃhau garvalīlāvalokinau  |
praviṣṭau sumahāraṅgaṃ baladevajanārdanau  || 193.31 ||
hāhākāro mahāñjajñe sarvaraṅgeṣvanantaram  |
kṛṣṇo'yaṃ balabhadro'yamiti lokasya vismayāt || 193.32 ||
so'yaṃ yena hatā ghorā pūtanā sā niśācarī  |
prakṣiptaṃ śakaṭaṃ yena bhagnau ca yamalārjunau  || 193.33 ||
so'yaṃ yaḥ kāliyaṃ nāgaṃ nanartāruhya bālakaḥ  |
dhṛto govardhano yena saptarātraṃ mahāgiriḥ  || 193.34 ||
ariṣṭo dhenukaḥ keśī līlayaiva mahātmanā  |
hato yena ca durvṛtto dṛśyate so'yamacyutaḥ  || 193.35 ||
ayaṃ cāsya mahābāhurbaladevo'grajo'grataḥ  |
prayāti līlayā yoṣinmanonayananandanaḥ  || 193.36 ||
ayaṃ sa kathyate prājñaiḥ purāṇārthāvalokibhiḥ  |
gopālo yādavaṃ vaṃśaṃ magnamabhyuddhariṣyati  || 193.37 ||
ayaṃ sa sarvabhūtasya viṣṇorakhilajanmanaḥ  |
avatīrṇo mahīmaṃśo nūnaṃ bhāraharo bhuvaḥ  || 193.38 ||
ityevaṃ varṇite paurai rāme kṛṣṇe ca tatkṣaṇāt |
urastatāpa devakyāḥ snehasnutapayodharam  || 193.39 ||
mahotsavamivālokya putrāveva vilokayan  |
yuveva vasudevo'bhūdvihāyābhyāgatāṃ jarām  || 193.40 ||
vistāritākṣiyugalā rājāntaḥpurayoṣitaḥ  |
nāgarastrīsamūhaśca draṣṭuṃ na virarāma tau  || 193.41 ||
{striya ūcu̱ḥ }
sakhyaḥ paśyata kṛṣṇasya mukhamapyambujekṣaṇam  |
gajayuddhakṛtāyāsa svedāmbukaṇikāñcitam  || 193.42 ||
vikāsīva sarombhojamavaśyāyajalokṣitam  |
paribhūtākṣaraṃ janma saphalaṃ kriyatāṃ dṛśaḥ  || 193.43 ||
śrīvatsāṅkaṃ jagaddhāma bālasyaitadvilokyatām  |
vipakṣakṣapaṇaṃ vakṣo bhujayugmaṃ ca bhāmini  || 193.44 ||
valgatā muṣṭikenaiva cāṇūreṇa tathā paraiḥ  |
kriyate balabhadrasya hāsyamīṣadvilokyatām  || 193.45 ||
sakhyaḥ paśyata cāṇūraṃ niyuddhārthamayaṃ hariḥ  |
samupaiti na santyatra kiṃ vṛddhā yuktakāriṇaḥ  || 193.46 ||
kva yauvanonmukhībhūtaḥ sukumāratanurhariḥ  |
kva vajrakaṭhinābhoga śarīro'yaṃ mahāsuraḥ  || 193.47 ||
imau sulalitau raṅge vartete navayauvanau  |
daiteyamallāścāṇūra pramukhāstvatidāruṇāḥ  || 193.48 ||
niyuddhaprāśnikānāṃ tu mahāneṣa vyatikramaḥ  |
yadbālabalinoryuddhaṃ madhyasthaiḥ samupekṣyate  || 193.49 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
itthaṃ purastrīlokasya vadataścālayan bhuvam  |
vavarṣa harṣotkarṣaṃ ca janasya bhagavān hariḥ  || 193.50 ||
balabhadro'pi cāsphoṭya vavalga lalitaṃ yadā  |
pade pade tadā bhūmirna śīrṇā yattadadbhutam  || 193.51 ||
cāṇūreṇa tataḥ kṛṣṇo yuyudhe'mitavikramaḥ  |
niyuddhakuśalo daityo baladevena muṣṭikaḥ  || 193.52 ||
saṃnipātāvadhūtaiśca cāṇūreṇa samaṃ hariḥ  |
kṣepaṇairmuṣṭibhiścaiva kīlāvajranipātanaiḥ  || 193.53 ||
pādodbhūtaiḥ pramṛṣṭābhistayoryuddhamabhūnmahat |
aśastramatighoraṃ tattayoryuddhaṃ sudāruṇam  || 193.54 ||
svabalaprāṇaniṣpādyaṃ samājotsavasaṃnidhau  |
yāvadyāvacca cāṇūro yuyudhe hariṇā saha  || 193.55 ||
prāṇahānimavāpāgryāṃ tāvattāvanna bāndhavam  |
kṛṣṇo'pi yuyudhe tena līlayaiva jaganmayaḥ  || 193.56 ||
khedāccālayatā kopānnijaśeṣakare karam  |
balakṣayaṃ vivṛddhiṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cāṇūrakṛṣṇayoḥ  || 193.57 ||
vārayāmāsa tūryāṇi kaṃsaḥ kopaparāyaṇaḥ  |
mṛdaṅgādiṣu vādyeṣu pratiṣiddheṣu tatkṣaṇāt || 193.58 ||
khasaṃgatānyavādyanta daivatūryāṇyanekaśaḥ  |
jaya govinda cāṇūraṃ jahi keśava dānavam  || 193.59 ||
ityantardhigatā devāstuṣṭuvuste praharṣitāḥ  |
cāṇūreṇa ciraṃ kālaṃ krīḍitvā madhusūdanaḥ  || 193.60 ||
utpāṭya bhrāmayāmāsa tadvadhāya kṛtodyamaḥ  |
bhrāmayitvā śataguṇaṃ daityamallamamitrajit || 193.61 ||
bhūmāvāsphoṭayāmāsa gagane gatajīvitam  |
bhūmāvāsphoṭitastena cāṇūraḥ śatadhā bhavan  || 193.62 ||
raktasrāvamahāpaṅkāṃ cakāra sa tadā bhuvam  |
baladevastu tatkālaṃ muṣṭikena mahābalaḥ  || 193.63 ||
yuyudhe daityamallena cāṇūreṇa yathā hariḥ  |
so'pyenaṃ muṣṭinā mūrdhni vakṣasyāhatya jānunā  || 193.64 ||
pātayitvā dharāpṛṣṭhe niṣpipeṣa gatāyuṣam  |
kṛṣṇastośalakaṃ bhūyo mallarājaṃ mahābalam  || 193.65 ||
vāmamuṣṭiprahāreṇa pātayāmāsa bhūtale  |
cāṇūre nihate malle muṣṭike ca nipātite  || 193.66 ||
nīte kṣayaṃ tośalake sarve mallāḥ pradudruvuḥ  |
vavalgatustadā raṅge kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇāvubhau  || 193.67 ||
samānavayaso gopān balādākṛṣya harṣitau  |
kaṃso'pi koparaktākṣaḥ prāhoccairvyāyatānnarān  || 193.68 ||
gopāvetau samājaughānniṣkramyetāṃ balāditaḥ  |
nando'pi gṛhyatāṃ pāpo nigaḍairāśu badhyatām  || 193.69 ||
avṛddhārheṇa daṇḍena vasudevo'pi vadhyatām  |
valganti gopāḥ kṛṣṇena ye ceme sahitāḥ punaḥ  || 193.70 ||
gāvo hriyantāmeṣāṃ ca yaccāsti vasu kiṃcana  |
evamājñāpayantaṃ taṃ prahasya madhusūdanaḥ  || 193.71 ||
utpatyāruhya tanmañcaṃ kaṃsaṃ jagrāha vegitaḥ  |
keśeṣvākṛṣya vigalatkirīṭamavanītale  || 193.72 ||
sa kaṃsaṃ pātayāmāsa tasyopari papāta ca  |
niḥśeṣajagadādhāra guruṇā patatopari  || 193.73 ||
kṛṣṇena tyājitaḥ prāṇānnugrasenātmajo nṛpaḥ  |
mṛtasya keśeṣu tadā gṛhītvā madhusūdanaḥ  || 193.74 ||
cakarṣa dehaṃ kaṃsasya raṅgamadhye mahābalaḥ  |
gauraveṇātimahatā paripātena kṛṣyatā  || 193.75 ||
kṛtā kaṃsasya dehena vegitena mahātmanā  |
kaṃse gṛhīte kṛṣṇena tadbhrātābhyāgato ruṣā  || 193.76 ||
sunāmā balabhadreṇa līlayaiva nipātitaḥ  |
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvamāsīttadraṅgamaṇḍalam  || 193.77 ||
avajñayā hataṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇena mathureśvaram  |
kṛṣṇo'pi vasudevasya pādau jagrāha satvaram  || 193.78 ||
devakyāśca mahābāhurbaladevasahāyavān  |
utthāpya vasudevastu devakī ca janārdanam  |
smṛtajanmoktavacanau tāveva praṇatau sthitau  || 193.79 ||
{vasudeva uvāca̱ }
prasīda devadeveśa devānāṃ pravara prabho  |
tathāvayoḥ prasādena kṛtābhyuddhāra keśava  || 193.80 ||
ārādhito yadbhagavānavatīrṇo gṛhe mama  |
durvṛttanidhanārthāya tena naḥ pāvitaṃ kulam  || 193.81 ||
tvamantaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitaḥ  |
vartate ca samastātmaṃstvatto bhūtabhaviṣyatī  || 193.82 ||
yajñe tvamijyase'cintya sarvadevamayācyuta  |
tvameva yajño yajvā ca yajñānāṃ parameśvara  || 193.83 ||
sāpahnavaṃ mama mano yadetattvayi jāyate  |
devakyāścātmaja prītyā tadatyantaviḍambanā  || 193.84 ||
tvaṃ kartā sarvabhūtānāmanādinidhano bhavān  |
kva ca me mānuṣasyaiṣā jihvā putreti vakṣyati  || 193.85 ||
jagadetajjagannātha saṃbhūtamakhilaṃ yataḥ  |
kayā yuktyā vinā māyāṃ so'smattaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati  || 193.86 ||
yasmin pratiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam  |
sa koṣṭhotsaṅgaśayano manuṣyājjāyate katham  || 193.87 ||
sa tvaṃ prasīda parameśvara pāhi viśvam  193.88
aṃśāvatārakaraṇairna mamāsi putraḥ  193.88
ābrahmapādapamayaṃ jagadīśa sarvaṃ  193.88
citte vimohayasi kiṃ parameśvarātman  193.88
māyāvimohitadṛśā tanayo mameti  193.89
kaṃsādbhayaṃ kṛtavatā tu mayātitīvram  193.89
nīto'si gokulamarātibhayākulasya  193.89
vṛddhiṃ gato'si mama caiva gavāmadhīśa  193.89
karmāṇi rudramarudaśviśatakratūnāṃ  193.90
sādhyāni yāni na bhavanti nirīkṣitāni  193.90
tvaṃ viṣṇurīśajagatāmupakārahetoḥ  193.90
prāpto'si naḥ parigataḥ paramo vimohaḥ  193.90
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tau samutpannavijñānau bhagavatkarmadarśanāt |
devakīvasudevau tu dṛṣṭvā māyāṃ punarhariḥ  || 194.1 ||
mohāya yaducakrasya vitatāna sa vaiṣṇavīm  |
uvāca cāmba bhostāta cirādutkaṇṭhitena tu  || 194.2 ||
bhavantau kaṃsabhītena dṛṣṭau saṃkarṣaṇena ca  |
kurvatāṃ yāti yaḥ kālo mātāpitrorapūjanam  || 194.3 ||
sa vṛthā kleśakārī vai sādhūnāmupajāyate  |
gurudevadvijātīnāṃ mātāpitrośca pūjanam  || 194.4 ||
kurvataḥ saphalaṃ janma dehinastāta jāyate  |
tatkṣantavyamidaṃ sarvamatikramakṛtaṃ pitaḥ  |
kaṃsavīryapratāpābhyāmāvayoḥ paravaśyayoḥ  || 194.5 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvātha praṇamyobhau yaduvṛddhānanukramāt |
pādānatibhiḥ sasnehaṃ cakratuḥ pauramānasam  || 194.6 ||
kaṃsapatnyastataḥ kaṃsaṃ parivārya hataṃ bhuvi  |
vilepurmātaraścāsya śokaduḥkhapariplutāḥ  || 194.7 ||
bahuprakāramasvasthāḥ paścāttāpāturā hariḥ  |
tāḥ samāśvāsayāmāsa svayamasrāvilekṣaṇaḥ  || 194.8 ||
ugrasenaṃ tato bandhānmumoca madhusūdanaḥ  |
abhyaṣiñcattathaivainaṃ nijarājye hatātmajam  || 194.9 ||
rājye'bhiṣiktaḥ kṛṣṇena yadusiṃhaḥ sutasya saḥ  |
cakāra pretakāryāṇi ye cānye tatra ghātitāḥ  || 194.10 ||
kṛtordhvadaihikaṃ cainaṃ siṃhāsanagataṃ hariḥ  |
uvācājñāpaya vibho yatkāryamaviśaṅkayā  || 194.11 ||
yayātiśāpādvaṃśo'yamarājyārho'pi sāṃpratam  |
mayi bhṛtye sthite devānājñāpayatu kiṃ nṛpaiḥ  || 194.12 ||
ityuktvā cograsenaṃ tu vāyuṃ prati jagāda ha  |
nṛvācā caiva bhagavān keśavaḥ kāryamānuṣaḥ  || 194.13 ||
{śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
gacchendraṃ brūhi vāyo tvamalaṃ garveṇa vāsava  |
dīyatāmugrasenāya sudharmā bhavatā sabhā  || 194.14 ||
kṛṣṇo bravīti rājārhametadratnamanuttamam  |
sudharmākhyā sabhā yuktamasyāṃ yadubhirāsitum  || 194.15 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ pavano gatvā sarvamāha śacīpatim  |
dadau so'pi sudharmākhyāṃ sabhāṃ vāyoḥ puraṃdaraḥ  || 194.16 ||
vāyunā cāhṛtāṃ divyāṃ te sabhāṃ yadupuṃgavāḥ  |
bubhujuḥ sarvaratnāḍhyāṃ govindabhujasaṃśrayāḥ  || 194.17 ||
viditākhilavijñānau sarvajñānamayāvapi  |
śiṣyācāryakramaṃ vīrau khyāpayantau yadūttamau  || 194.18 ||
tataḥ sāṃdīpaniṃ kāśyamavantipuravāsinam  |
astrārthaṃ jagmaturvīrau baladevajanārdanau  || 194.19 ||
tasya śiṣyatvamabhyetya guruvṛttiparau hi tau  |
darśayāṃ cakraturvīrāvācāramakhile jane  || 194.20 ||
sarahasyaṃ dhanurvedaṃ sasaṃgrahamadhīyatām  |
ahorātraiścatuḥṣaṣṭyā tadadbhutamabhūddvijāḥ  || 194.21 ||
sāṃdīpanirasaṃbhāvyaṃ tayoḥ karmātimānuṣam  |
vicintya tau tadā mene prāptau candradivākarau  || 194.22 ||
astragrāmamaśeṣaṃ ca proktamātramavāpya tau  |
ūcaturvriyatāṃ yā te dātavyā gurudakṣiṇā  || 194.23 ||
so'pyatīndriyamālokya tayoḥ karma mahāmatiḥ  |
ayācata mṛtaṃ putraṃ prabhāse lavaṇārṇave  || 194.24 ||
gṛhītāstrau tatastau tu gatvā taṃ lavaṇodadhim  |
ūcutuśca guroḥ putro dīyatāmiti sāgaram  || 194.25 ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭaścābdhistāvatha dvijasattamāḥ  |
uvāca na mayā putro hṛtaḥ sāṃdīpaneriti  || 194.26 ||
daityaḥ pañcajano nāma śaṅkharūpaḥ sa bālakam  |
jagrāha so'sti salile mamaivāsurasūdana  || 194.27 ||
ityukto'ntarjalaṃ gatvā hatvā pañcajanaṃ tathā  |
kṛṣṇo jagrāha tasyāsthi prabhavaṃ śaṅkhamuttamam  || 194.28 ||
yasya nādena daityānāṃ balahāniḥ prajāyate  |
devānāṃ vardhate tejo yātyadharmaśca saṃkṣayam  || 194.29 ||
taṃ pāñcajanyamāpūrya gatvā yamapurīṃ hariḥ  |
baladevaśca balavāñjitvā vaivasvataṃ yamam  || 194.30 ||
taṃ bālaṃ yātanāsaṃsthaṃ yathāpūrvaśarīriṇam  |
pitre pradattavān kṛṣṇo balaśca balināṃ varaḥ  || 194.31 ||
mathurāṃ ca punaḥ prāptāvugrasenena pālitām  |
prahṛṣṭapuruṣastrīkāvubhau rāmajanārdanau  || 194.32 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
jarāsaṃdhasute kaṃsa upayeme mahābalaḥ  |
astiḥ prāptiśca bho viprāstayorbhartṛhaṇaṃ harim  || 195.1 ||
mahābalaparīvāro māgadhādhipatirbalī  |
hantumabhyāyayau kopājjarāsaṃdhaḥ sayādavam  || 195.2 ||
upetya mathurāṃ so'tha rurodha magadheśvaraḥ  |
akṣauhiṇībhiḥ sainyasya trayoviṃśatibhirvṛtaḥ  || 195.3 ||
niṣkramyālpaparīvārāvubhau rāmajanārdanau  |
yuyudhāte samaṃ tasya balinau balisainikaiḥ  || 195.4 ||
tato balaśca kṛṣṇaśca matiṃ cakre mahābalaḥ  |
āyudhānāṃ purāṇānāmādāne munisattamāḥ  || 195.5 ||
anantaraṃ cakraśārṅge tūṇau cāpyakṣayau śaraiḥ  |
ākāśādāgatau vīrau tadā kaumodakī gadā  || 195.6 ||
halaṃ ca balabhadrasya gaganādāgamatkaram  |
balasyābhimataṃ viprāḥ sunandaṃ muśalaṃ tathā  || 195.7 ||
tato yuddhe parājitya svasainyaṃ magadhādhipam  |
purīṃ viviśaturvīrāvubhau rāmajanārdanau  || 195.8 ||
jite tasmin sudurvṛtte jarāsaṃdhe dvijottamāḥ  |
jīvamāne gate tatra kṛṣṇo mene na taṃ jitam  || 195.9 ||
punarapyājagāmātha jarāsaṃdho balānvitaḥ  |
jitaśca rāmakṛṣṇābhyāmapakṛtya dvijottamāḥ  || 195.10 ||
daśa cāṣṭau ca saṃgrāmānevamatyantadurmadaḥ  |
yadubhirmāgadho rājā cakre kṛṣṇapurogamaiḥ  || 195.11 ||
sarveṣveva ca yuddheṣu yadubhiḥ sa parājitaḥ  |
apakrānto jarāsaṃdhaḥ svalpasainyairbalādhikaḥ  || 195.12 ||
tadbalaṃ yādavānāṃ vai rakṣitaṃ yadanekaśaḥ  |
tattu saṃnidhimāhātmyaṃ viṣṇoraṃśasya cakriṇaḥ  || 195.13 ||
manuṣyadharmaśīlasya līlā sā jagataḥ pateḥ  |
astrāṇyanekarūpāṇi yadarātiṣu muñcati  || 195.14 ||
manasaiva jagatsṛṣṭi saṃhāraṃ tu karoti yaḥ  |
tasyāripakṣakṣapaṇe kiyānudyamavistaraḥ  || 195.15 ||
tathāpi ca manuṣyāṇāṃ dharmastadanuvartanam  |
kurvan balavatā saṃdhiṃ hīnairyuddhaṃ karotyasau  || 195.16 ||
sāma copapradānaṃ ca tathā bhedaṃ ca darśayan  |
karoti daṇḍapātaṃ ca kvacideva palāyanam  || 195.17 ||
manuṣyadehināṃ ceṣṭāmityevamanuvartate  |
līlā jagatpatestasya cchandataḥ saṃpravartate  || 195.18 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
gārgyaṃ goṣṭhe dvijo śyālaḥ ṣaṇḍha ityuktavān dvijāḥ  |
yadūnāṃ saṃnidhau sarve jahasuryādavāstadā  || 196.1 ||
tataḥ kopasamāviṣṭo dakṣiṇāpathametya saḥ  |
sutamicchaṃstapastepe yaducakrabhayāvaham  || 196.2 ||
ārādhayanmahādevaṃ so'yaścūrṇamabhakṣayat |
dadau varaṃ ca tuṣṭo'sau varṣe dvādaśake haraḥ  || 196.3 ||
saṃbhāvayāmāsa sa taṃ yavaneśo hyanātmajam  |
tadyoṣitsaṃgamāccāsya putro'bhūdalisaprabhaḥ  || 196.4 ||
taṃ kālayavanaṃ nāma rājye sve yavaneśvaraḥ  |
abhiṣicya vanaṃ yāto vajrāgrakaṭhinorasam  || 196.5 ||
sa tu vīryamadonmattaḥ pṛthivyāṃ balino nṛpān  |
papraccha nāradaścāsmai kathayāmāsa yādavān  || 196.6 ||
mlecchakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ sahasraiḥ so'pi saṃvṛtaḥ  |
gajāśvarathasaṃpannaiścakāra paramodyamam  || 196.7 ||
prayayau cātavacchinnaiḥ prayāṇaiḥ sa dine dine  |
yādavān prati sāmarṣo munayo mathurāṃ purīm  || 196.8 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi cintayāmāsa kṣapitaṃ yādavaṃ balam  |
yavanena samālokya māgadhaḥ saṃprayāsyati  || 196.9 ||
māgadhasya balaṃ kṣīṇaṃ sa kālayavano balī  |
hantā tadidamāyātaṃ yadūnāṃ vyasanaṃ dvidhā  || 196.10 ||
tasmāddurgaṃ kariṣyāmi yadūnāmatidurjayam  |
striyo'pi yatra yudhyeyuḥ kiṃ punarvṛṣṇiyādavāḥ  || 196.11 ||
mayi matte pramatte vā supte pravasite'pi vā  |
yādavābhibhavaṃ duṣṭā mā kurvan vairiṇo'dhikam  || 196.12 ||
iti saṃcintya govindo yojanāni mahodadhim  |
yayāce dvādaśa purīṃ dvārakāṃ tatra nirmame  || 196.13 ||
mahodyānāṃ mahāvaprāṃ taḍāgaśataśobhitām  |
prākāraśatasaṃbādhāmindrasyevāmarāvatīm  || 196.14 ||
mathurāvāsinaṃ lokaṃ tatrānīya janārdanaḥ  |
āsanne kālayavane mathurāṃ ca svayaṃ yayau  || 196.15 ||
bahirāvāsite sainye mathurāyā nirāyudhaḥ  |
nirjagāma sa govindo dadarśa yavanaśca tam  || 196.16 ||
sa jñātvā vāsudevaṃ taṃ bāhupraharaṇo nṛpaḥ  |
anuyāto mahāyogi cetobhiḥ prāpyate na yaḥ  || 196.17 ||
tenānuyātaḥ kṛṣṇo'pi praviveśa mahāguhām  |
yatra śete mahāvīryo mucukundo nareśvaraḥ  || 196.18 ||
so'pi praviṣṭo yavano dṛṣṭvā śayyāgataṃ naram  |
pādena tāḍayāmāsa kṛṣṇaṃ matvā sa durmatiḥ  || 196.19 ||
dṛṣṭamātraśca tenāsau jajvāla yavano'gninā  |
tatkrodhajena munayo bhasmībhūtaśca tatkṣaṇāt || 196.20 ||
sa hi devāsure yuddhe gatvā jitvā mahāsurān  |
nidrārtaḥ sumahākālaṃ nidrāṃ vavre varaṃ surān  || 196.21 ||
proktaśca devaiḥ saṃsuptaṃ yastvāmutthāpayiṣyati  |
dehajenāgninā sadyaḥ sa tu bhasmībhaviṣyati  || 196.22 ||
evaṃ dagdhvā sa taṃ pāpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca madhusūdanam  |
kastvamityāha so'pyāha jāto'haṃ śaśinaḥ kule  || 196.23 ||
vasudevasya tanayo yaduvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ  |
mucukundo'pi tacchrutvā vṛddhagārgyavacaḥ smaran  || 196.24 ||
saṃsmṛtya praṇipatyainaṃ sarvaṃ sarveśvaraṃ harim  |
prāha jñāto bhavān viṣṇoraṃśastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ  || 196.25 ||
purā gārgyeṇa kathitamaṣṭāviṃśatime yuge  |
dvāparānte harerjanma yaduvaṃśe bhaviṣyati  || 196.26 ||
sa tvaṃ prāpto na saṃdeho martyānāmupakārakṛt |
tathā hi sumahattejo nālaṃ soḍhumahaṃ tava  || 196.27 ||
tathā hi sumahāmbhoda dhvanidhīrataraṃ tataḥ  |
vākyaṃ tamiti hovāca yuṣmatpādasulālitam  || 196.28 ||
devāsure mahāyuddhe daityāśca sumahābhaṭāḥ  |
na śekuste mahattejastattejo na sahāmyaham  || 196.29 ||
saṃsārapatitasyaiko jantostvaṃ śaraṇaṃ param  |
saṃprasīda prapannārti hartā hara mamāśubham  || 196.30 ||
tvaṃ payonidhayaḥ śailāḥ saritaśca vanāni ca  |
medinī gaganaṃ vāyurāpo'gnistvaṃ tathā pumān  || 196.31 ||
puṃsaḥ parataraṃ sarvaṃ vyāpya janma vikalpavat |
śabdādihīnamajaraṃ vṛddhikṣayavivarjitam  || 196.32 ||
tvatto'marāstu pitaro yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ  |
siddhāścāpsarasastvatto manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ khagāḥ  || 196.33 ||
sarīsṛpā mṛgāḥ sarve tvattaścaiva mahīruhāḥ  |
yacca bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyadvā kiṃcidatra carācare  || 196.34 ||
amūrtaṃ mūrtamathavā sthūlaṃ sūkṣmataraṃ tathā  |
tatsarvaṃ tvaṃ jagatkartarnāsti kiṃcittvayā vinā  || 196.35 ||
mayā saṃsāracakre'smin bhramatā bhagavan sadā  |
tāpatrayābhibhūtena na prāptā nirvṛtiḥ kvacit || 196.36 ||
duḥkhānyeva sukhānīti mṛgatṛṣṇājalāśayaḥ  |
mayā nātha gṛhītāni tāni tāpāya me'bhavan  || 196.37 ||
rājyamurvī balaṃ kośo mitrapakṣastathātmajāḥ  |
bhāryā bhṛtyajanā ye ca śabdādyā viṣayāḥ prabho  || 196.38 ||
sukhabuddhyā mayā sarvaṃ gṛhītamidamavyaya  |
pariṇāme ca deveśa tāpātmakamabhūnmama  || 196.39 ||
devalokagatiṃ prāpto nātha devagaṇo'pi hi  |
mattaḥ sāhāyyakāmo'bhūcchāśvatī kutra nirvṛtiḥ  || 196.40 ||
tvāmanārādhya jagatāṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhavāspadam  |
śāśvatī prāpyate kena parameśvara nirvṛtiḥ  || 196.41 ||
tvanmāyāmūḍhamanaso janmamṛtyujarādikān  |
avāpya pāpān paśyanti pretarājānamantarā  || 196.42 ||
tataḥ pāśaśatairbaddhā narakeṣvatidāruṇam  |
prāpnuvanti mahadduḥkhaṃ viśvarūpamidaṃ tava  || 196.43 ||
ahamatyantaviṣayī mohitastava māyayā  |
mamatvāgādhagartānte bhramāmi parameśvara  || 196.44 ||
so'haṃ tvāṃ śaraṇamapāramīśamīḍyaṃ  196.45
saṃprāptaḥ paramapadaṃ yato na kiṃcit 196.45
saṃsāraśramaparitāpataptacetā  196.45
nirviṇṇe pariṇatadhāmni sābhilāṣaḥ  196.45
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
itthaṃ stutastadā tena mucukundena dhīmatā  |
prāheśaḥ sarvabhūtānāmanādinidhano hariḥ  || 197.1 ||
{śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
yathābhivāñchitāṃllokān divyān gaccha nareśvara  |
avyāhataparaiśvaryo matprasādopabṛṃhitaḥ  || 197.2 ||
bhuktvā divyānmahābhogān bhaviṣyasi mahākule  |
jātismaro matprasādāttato mokṣamavāpsyasi  || 197.3 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ praṇipatyeśaṃ jagatāmacyutaṃ nṛpaḥ  |
guhāmukhādviniṣkrānto dadṛśe so'lpakānnarān  || 197.4 ||
tataḥ kaliyugaṃ jñātvā prāptaṃ taptuṃ tato nṛpaḥ  |
naranārāyaṇasthānaṃ prayayau gandhamādanam  || 197.5 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi ghātayitvārimupāyena hi tadbalam  |
jagrāha mathurāmetya hastyaśvasyandanojjvalam  || 197.6 ||
ānīya cograsenāya dvāravatyāṃ nyavedayat |
parābhibhavaniḥśaṅkaṃ babhūva ca yadoḥ kulam  || 197.7 ||
baladevo'pi viprendrāḥ praśāntākhilavigrahaḥ  |
jñātidarśanasotkaṇṭhaḥ prayayau nandagokulam  || 197.8 ||
tato gopāśca gopyaśca yathāpūrvamamitrajit |
tathaivābhyavadatpremṇā bahumānapuraḥsaram  || 197.9 ||
kaiścāpi saṃpariṣvaktaḥ kāṃścitsa pariṣasvaje  |
hāsaṃ cakre samaṃ kaiścidgopagopījanaistathā  || 197.10 ||
priyāṇyanekānyavadan gopāstatra halāyudham  |
gopyaśca premamuditāḥ procuḥ serṣyamathāparāḥ  || 197.11 ||
gopyaḥ papracchuraparā nāgarījanavallabhaḥ  |
kaccidāste sukhaṃ kṛṣṇaścalatpremarasākulaḥ  || 197.12 ||
asmacceṣṭopahasanaṃ na kaccitpurayoṣitām  |
saubhāgyamānamadhikaṃ karoti kṣaṇasauhṛdaḥ  || 197.13 ||
kaccitsmarati naḥ kṛṣṇo gītānugamanaṃ kṛtam  |
apyasau mātaraṃ draṣṭuṃ sakṛdapyāgamiṣyati  || 197.14 ||
athavā kiṃ tadālāpaiḥ kriyantāmaparāḥ kathāḥ  |
yadasmābhirvinā tena vināsmākaṃ bhaviṣyati  || 197.15 ||
pitā mātā tathā bhrātā bhartā bandhujanaśca kaḥ  |
na tyaktastatkṛte śmābhirakṛtajñastato hi saḥ  || 197.16 ||
tathāpi kaccidātmīyamihāgamanasaṃśrayam  |
karoti kṛṣṇo vaktavyaṃ bhavatā vacanāmṛtam  || 197.17 ||
dāmodaro'sau govindaḥ purastrīsaktamānasaḥ  |
apetaprītirasmāsu durdarśaḥ pratibhāti naḥ  || 197.18 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
āmantritaḥ sa kṛṣṇeti punardāmodareti ca  |
jahasuḥ susvaraṃ gopyo hariṇā kṛṣṭacetasaḥ  || 197.19 ||
saṃdeśaiḥ saumyamadhuraiḥ premagarbhairagarvitaiḥ  |
rāmeṇāśvāsitā gopyaḥ kṛṣṇasyātimadhusvaraiḥ  || 197.20 ||
gopaiśca pūrvavadrāmaḥ parihāsamanoharaiḥ  |
kathāścakāra premṇā ca saha tairvrajabhūmiṣu  || 197.21 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
vane viharatastasya saha gopairmahātmanaḥ  |
mānuṣacchadmarūpasya śeṣasya dharaṇībhṛtaḥ  || 198.1 ||
niṣpāditorukāryasya kāryeṇaivāvatāriṇaḥ  |
upabhogārthamatyarthaṃ varuṇaḥ prāha vāruṇīm  || 198.2 ||
{varuṇa uvāca̱ }
abhīṣṭāṃ sarvadā hyasya madire tvaṃ mahaujasaḥ  |
anantasyopabhogāya tasya gaccha mude śubhe  || 198.3 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktā vāruṇī tena saṃnidhānamathākarot |
vṛndāvanataṭotpanna kadambatarukoṭare  || 198.4 ||
vicaran baladevo'pi madirāgandhamuddhatam  |
āghrāya madirāharṣamavāpātha purātanam  || 198.5 ||
tataḥ kadambātsahasā madyadhārāṃ sa lāṅgalī  |
patantīṃ vīkṣya munayaḥ prayayau paramāṃ mudam  || 198.6 ||
papau ca gopagopībhiḥ samaveto mudānvitaḥ  |
upagīyamāno lalitaṃ gītavādyaviśāradaiḥ  || 198.7 ||
śramato'tyantagharmāmbhaḥ kaṇikāmauktikojjvalaḥ  |
āgaccha yamune snātumicchāmītyāha vihvalaḥ  || 198.8 ||
tasya vācaṃ nadī sā tu mattoktāmavamanya vai  |
nājagāma tataḥ kruddho halaṃ jagrāha lāṅgalī  || 198.9 ||
gṛhītvā tāṃ taṭenaiva cakarṣa madavihvalaḥ  |
pāpe nāyāsi nāyāsi gamyatāmicchayānyataḥ  || 198.10 ||
sā kṛṣṭā tena sahasā mārgaṃ saṃtyajya nimnagā  |
yatrāste baladevo'sau plāvayāmāsa tadvanam  || 198.11 ||
śarīriṇī tathopetya trāsavihvalalocanā  |
prasīdetyabravīdrāmaṃ muñca māṃ muśalāyudha  || 198.12 ||
so'bravīdavajānāsi mama śauryabalaṃ yadi  |
so'haṃ tvāṃ halapātena nayiṣyāmi sahasradhā  || 198.13 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktayātisaṃtrastastayā nadyā prasāditaḥ  |
bhūbhāge plāvite tatra mumoca yamunāṃ balaḥ  || 198.14 ||
tataḥ snātasya vai kāntirājagāma mahāvane  |
avataṃsotpalaṃ cāru gṛhītvaikaṃ ca kuṇḍalam  || 198.15 ||
varuṇaprahitāṃ cāsmai mālāmamlānapaṅkajām  |
samudrārhe tathā vastre nīle lakṣmīrayacchata  || 198.16 ||
kṛtāvataṃsaḥ sa tadā cārukuṇḍalabhūṣitaḥ  |
nīlāmbaradharaḥ sragvī śuśubhe kāntisaṃyutaḥ  || 198.17 ||
itthaṃ vibhūṣito reme tatra rāmastadā vraje  |
māsadvayena yātaśca punaḥ sa mathurāṃ purīm  || 198.18 ||
revatīṃ caiva tanayāṃ raivatasya mahīpateḥ  |
upayeme balastasyāṃ jajñāte niśaṭholmukau  || 198.19 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
bhīṣmakaḥ kuṇḍine rājā vidarbhaviṣaye'bhavat |
rukmiṇī tasya duhitā rukmī caiva suto dvijāḥ  || 199.1 ||
rukmiṇīṃ cakame kṛṣṇaḥ sā ca taṃ cāruhāsinī  |
na dadau yācate caināṃ rukmī dveṣeṇa cakriṇe  || 199.2 ||
dadau sa śiśupālāya jarāsaṃdhapracoditaḥ  |
bhīṣmako rukmiṇā sārdhaṃ rukmiṇīmuruvikramaḥ  || 199.3 ||
vivāhārthaṃ tataḥ sarve jarāsaṃdhamukhā nṛpāḥ  |
bhīṣmakasya puraṃ jagmuḥ śiśupālaśca kuṇḍinam  || 199.4 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi balabhadrādyairyadubhiḥ parivāritaḥ  |
prayayau kuṇḍinaṃ draṣṭuṃ vivāhaṃ caidyabhūpateḥ  || 199.5 ||
śvobhāvini vivāhe tu tāṃ kanyāṃ hṛtavān hariḥ  |
vipakṣabhāvamāsādya rāmādyeṣveva bandhuṣu  || 199.6 ||
tataśca pauṇḍrakaḥ śrīmān dantavaktro vidūrathaḥ  |
śiśupālo jarāsaṃdhaḥ śālvādyāśca mahībhṛtaḥ  || 199.7 ||
kupitāste hariṃ hantuṃ cakrurudyogamuttamam  |
nirjitāśca samāgamya rāmādyairyadupuṃgavaiḥ  || 199.8 ||
kuṇḍinaṃ na pravekṣyāmi ahatvā yudhi keśavam  |
kṛtvā pratijñāṃ rukmī ca hantuṃ kṛṣṇamabhidrutaḥ  || 199.9 ||
hatvā balaṃ sa nāgāśva pattisyandanasaṃkulam  |
nirjitaḥ pātitaścorvyāṃ līlayaiva sa cakriṇā  || 199.10 ||
nirjitya rukmiṇaṃ samyagupayeme sa rukmiṇīm  |
rākṣasena vidhānena saṃprāpto madhusūdanaḥ  || 199.11 ||
tasyāṃ jajñe ca pradyumno madanāṃśaḥ sa vīryavān  |
jahāra śambaro yaṃ vai yo jaghāna ca śambaram  || 199.12 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
śambareṇa hṛto vīraḥ pradyumnaḥ sa kathaṃ punaḥ  |
śambaraśca mahāvīryaḥ pradyumnena kathaṃ hataḥ  || 200.1 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ṣaṣṭhe'hni jātamātre tu pradyumnaṃ sūtikāgṛhāt |
mamaiṣa hanteti dvijā hṛtavān kālaśambaraḥ  || 200.2 ||
nītvā cikṣepa caivainaṃ grāho'gre lavaṇārṇave  |
kallolajanitāvarte sughore makarālaye  || 200.3 ||
patitaṃ caiva tatraiko matsyo jagrāha bālakam  |
na mamāra ca tasyāpi jaṭharānaladīpitaḥ  || 200.4 ||
matsyabandhaiśca matsyo'sau matsyairanyaiḥ saha dvijāḥ  |
ghātito'suravaryāya śambarāya niveditaḥ  || 200.5 ||
tasya māyāvatī nāma patnī sarvagṛheśvarī  |
kārayāmāsa sūdānāmādhipatyamaninditā  || 200.6 ||
dārite matsyajaṭhare dadṛśe sātiśobhanam  |
kumāraṃ manmathatarordagdhasya prathamāṅkuram  || 200.7 ||
ko'yaṃ kathamayaṃ matsya jaṭhare samupāgataḥ  |
ityevaṃ kautukāviṣṭāṃ tāṃ tanvīṃ prāha nāradaḥ  || 200.8 ||
{nārada uvāca̱ }
ayaṃ samastajagatāṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇā  |
śambareṇa hṛtaḥ kṛṣṇa tanayaḥ sūtikāgṛhāt || 200.9 ||
kṣiptaḥ samudre matsyena nigīrṇaste vaśaṃ gataḥ  |
nararatnamidaṃ subhru viśrabdhā paripālaya  || 200.10 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
nāradenaivamuktā sā pālayāmāsa taṃ śiśum  |
bālyādevātirāgeṇa rūpātiśayamohitā  || 200.11 ||
sa yadā yauvanābhoga bhūṣito'bhūddvijottamāḥ  |
sābhilāṣā tadā sā tu babhūva gajagāminī  || 200.12 ||
māyāvatī dadau cāsmai māyā sarvā mahātmane  |
pradyumnāyātmabhūtāya tannyastahṛdayekṣaṇā  |
prasajjantīṃ tu tāmāha sa kārṣṇiḥ kamalalocanaḥ  || 200.13 ||
{pradyumna uvāca̱ }
mātṛbhāvaṃ vihāyaiva kimarthaṃ vartase'nyathā  ||* 200.14 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sā cāsmai kathayāmāsa na putrastvaṃ mameti vai  |
tanayaṃ tvāmayaṃ viṣṇorhṛtavān kālaśambaraḥ  || 200.15 ||
kṣiptaḥ samudre matsyasya saṃprāpto jaṭharānmayā  |
sā tu roditi te mātā kāntādyāpyativatsalā  || 200.16 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ śambaraṃ yuddhe pradyumnaḥ sa samāhvayat |
krodhākulīkṛtamanā yuyudhe ca mahābalaḥ  || 200.17 ||
hatvā sainyamaśeṣaṃ tu tasya daityasya mādhaviḥ  |
sapta māyā vyatikramya māyāṃ saṃyuyuje'ṣṭamīm  || 200.18 ||
tayā jaghāna taṃ daityaṃ māyayā kālaśambaram  |
utpatya ca tayā sārdhamājagāma pituḥ puram  || 200.19 ||
antaḥpure ca patitaṃ māyāvatyā samanvitam  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭasaṃkalpā babhūvuḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ  |
rukmiṇī cābravītpremṇā āsaktadṛṣṭiraninditā  || 200.20 ||
{rukmiṇyuvāca̱ }
dhanyāyāḥ khalvayaṃ putro vartate navayauvane  |
asmin vayasi putro me pradyumno yadi jīvati  || 200.21 ||
sabhāgyā jananī vatsa tvayā kāpi vibhūṣitā  |
athavā yādṛśaḥ sneho mama yādṛgvapuśca te  |
harerapatyaṃ suvyaktaṃ bhavān vatsa bhaviṣyati  || 200.22 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
etasminnantare prāptaḥ saha kṛṣṇena nāradaḥ  |
antaḥpuravarāṃ devīṃ rukmiṇīṃ prāha harṣitaḥ  || 200.23 ||
{śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
eṣa te tanayaḥ subhru hatvā śambaramāgataḥ  |
hṛto yenābhavatpūrvaṃ putraste sūtikāgṛhāt || 200.24 ||
iyaṃ māyāvatī bhāryā tanayasyāsya te satī  |
śambarasya na bhāryeyaṃ śrūyatāmatra kāraṇam  || 200.25 ||
manmathe tu gate nāśaṃ tadudbhavaparāyaṇā  |
śambaraṃ mohayāmāsa māyārūpeṇa rukmiṇi  || 200.26 ||
vivāhādyupabhogeṣu rūpaṃ māyāmayaṃ śubham  |
darśayāmāsa daityasya tasyeyaṃ madirekṣaṇā  || 200.27 ||
kāmo'vatīrṇaḥ putraste tasyeyaṃ dayitā ratiḥ  |
viśaṅkā nātra kartavyā snuṣeyaṃ tava śobhanā  || 200.28 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tato harṣasamāviṣṭau rukmiṇīkeśavau tadā  |
nagarī ca samastā sā sādhu sādhvityabhāṣata  || 200.29 ||
ciraṃ naṣṭena putreṇa saṃgatāṃ prekṣya rukmiṇīm  |
avāpa vismayaṃ sarvo dvāravatyāṃ janastadā  || 200.30 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
cārudeṣṇaṃ sudeṣṇaṃ ca cārudehaṃ ca śobhanam  |
suṣeṇaṃ cāruguptaṃ ca bhadracāruṃ tathāparam  || 201.1 ||
cāruvindaṃ sucāruṃ ca cāruṃ ca balināṃ varam  |
rukmiṇyajanayatputrān kanyāṃ cārumatīṃ tathā  || 201.2 ||
anyāśca bhāryāḥ kṛṣṇasya babhūvuḥ sapta śobhanāḥ  |
kālindī mitravindā ca satyā nāgnajitī tathā  || 201.3 ||
devī jāmbavatī cāpi sadā tuṣṭā tu rohiṇī  |
madrarājasutā cānyā suśīlā śīlamaṇḍalā  || 201.4 ||
sātrājitī satyabhāmā lakṣmaṇā cāruhāsinī  |
ṣoḍaśātra sahasrāṇi strīṇāmanyāni cakriṇaḥ  || 201.5 ||
pradyumno'pi mahāvīryo rukmiṇastanayāṃ śubhām  |
svayaṃvarasthāṃ jagrāha sāpi taṃ tanayaṃ hareḥ  || 201.6 ||
tasyāmasyābhavatputro mahābalaparākramaḥ  |
aniruddho raṇe ruddho vīryodadhirariṃdamaḥ  || 201.7 ||
tasyāpi rukmiṇaḥ pautrīṃ varayāmāsa keśavaḥ  |
dauhitrāya dadau rukmī spardhayannapi śauriṇā  || 201.8 ||
tasyā vivāhe rāmādyā yādavā hariṇā saha  |
rukmiṇo nagaraṃ jagmurnāmnā bhojakaṭaṃ dvijāḥ  || 201.9 ||
vivāhe tatra nirvṛtte prādyumneḥ sumahātmanaḥ  |
kaliṅgarājapramukhā rukmiṇaṃ vākyamabruvan  || 201.10 ||
{kaliṅgādaya ūcu̱ḥ }
anakṣajño halī dyūte tathāsya vyasanaṃ mahat |
tannayāmo balaṃ tasmāddyūtenaiva mahādyute  || 201.11 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tatheti tānāha nṛpān rukmī balasamanvitaḥ  |
sabhāyāṃ saha rāmeṇa cakre dyūtaṃ ca vai tadā  || 201.12 ||
sahasramekaṃ niṣkāṇāṃ rukmiṇā vijito balaḥ  |
dvitīye divase cānyatsahasraṃ rukmiṇā jitaḥ  || 201.13 ||
tato daśa sahasrāṇi niṣkāṇāṃ paṇamādade  |
balabhadraprapannāni rukmī dyūtavidāṃ varaḥ  || 201.14 ||
tato jahāsātha balaṃ kaliṅgādhipatirdvijāḥ  |
dantān vidarśayanmūḍho rukmī cāha madoddhataḥ  || 201.15 ||
{rukmyuvāca̱ }
avidyo'yaṃ mahādyūte balabhadraḥ parājitaḥ  |
mṛṣaivākṣāvalepatvādyo'yaṃ mene'kṣakovidam  || 201.16 ||
dṛṣṭvā kaliṅgarājaṃ tu prakāśadaśanānanam  |
rukmiṇaṃ cāpi durvākyaṃ kopaṃ cakre halāyudhaḥ  || 201.17 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tataḥ kopaparītātmā niṣkakoṭiṃ halāyudhaḥ  |
glahaṃ jagrāha rukmī ca tatastvakṣānapātayat || 201.18 ||
ajayadbaladevo'tha prāhoccaistaṃ jitaṃ mayā  |
mameti rukmī prāhoccairalīkoktairalaṃ balam  || 201.19 ||
tvayokto'yaṃ glahaḥ satyaṃ na mamaiṣo'numoditaḥ  |
evaṃ tvayā cedvijitaṃ na mayā vijitaṃ katham  || 201.20 ||
tato'ntarikṣe vāguccaiḥ prāha gambhīranādinī  |
baladevasya taṃ kopaṃ vardhayantī mahātmanaḥ  || 201.21 ||
{ākāśavāguvāca̱ }
jitaṃ tu baladevena rukmiṇā bhāṣitaṃ mṛṣā  |
anuktvā vacanaṃ kiṃcitkṛtaṃ bhavati karmaṇā  || 201.22 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tato balaḥ samutthāya krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ  |
jaghānāṣṭāpadenaiva rukmiṇaṃ sa mahābalaḥ  || 201.23 ||
kaliṅgarājaṃ cādāya visphurantaṃ balādbalaḥ  |
babhañja dantān kupito yaiḥ prakāśaṃ jahāsa saḥ  || 201.24 ||
ākṛṣya ca mahāstambhaṃ jātarūpamayaṃ balaḥ  |
jaghāna ye tatpakṣāstān bhūbhṛtaḥ kupito balaḥ  || 201.25 ||
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ palāyanaparaṃ dvijāḥ  |
tadrājamaṇḍalaṃ sarvaṃ babhūva kupite bale  || 201.26 ||
balena nihataṃ śrutvā rukmiṇaṃ madhusūdanaḥ  |
novāca vacanaṃ kiṃcidrukmiṇībalayorbhayāt || 201.27 ||
tato'niruddhamādāya kṛtodvāhaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
dvārakāmājagāmātha yaducakraṃ sakeśavam  || 201.28 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
dvāravatyāṃ tataḥ śauriṃ śakrastribhuvaneśvaraḥ  |
ājagāmātha munayo mattairāvatapṛṣṭhagaḥ  || 202.1 ||
praviśya dvārakāṃ so'tha samīpe ca harestadā  |
kathayāmāsa daityasya narakasya viceṣṭitam  || 202.2 ||
{indra uvāca̱ }
tvayā nāthena devānāṃ manuṣyatve'pi tiṣṭhatā  |
praśamaṃ sarvaduḥkhāni nītāni madhusūdana  || 202.3 ||
tapasvijanarakṣāyai so'riṣṭo dhenukastathā  |
pralambādyāstathā keśī te sarve nihatāstvayā  || 202.4 ||
kaṃsaḥ kuvalayāpīḍaḥ pūtanā bālaghātinī  |
nāśaṃ nītāstvayā sarve ye'nye jagadupadravāḥ  || 202.5 ||
yuṣmaddordaṇḍasaṃbuddhi paritrāte jagattraye  |
yajñe yajñahaviḥ prāśya tṛptiṃ yānti divaukasaḥ  || 202.6 ||
so'haṃ sāṃpratamāyāto yannimittaṃ janārdana  |
tacchrutvā tatpratīkāra prayatnaṃ kartumarhasi  || 202.7 ||
bhaumo'yaṃ narako nāma prāgjyotiṣapureśvaraḥ  |
karoti sarvabhūtānāmapaghātamariṃdama  || 202.8 ||
devasiddhasurādīnāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca janārdana  |
hatvā tu so'suraḥ kanyā rurodha nijamandire  || 202.9 ||
chattraṃ yatsalilasrāvi tajjahāra pracetasaḥ  |
mandarasya tathā śṛṅgaṃ hṛtavānmaṇiparvatam  || 202.10 ||
amṛtasrāviṇī divye māturme'mṛtakuṇḍale  |
jahāra so'suro'dityā vāñchatyairāvataṃ dvipam  || 202.11 ||
durnītametadgovinda mayā tasya tavoditam  |
yadatra pratikartavyaṃ tatsvayaṃ parimṛśyatām  || 202.12 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
iti śrutvā smitaṃ kṛtvā bhagavān devakīsutaḥ  |
gṛhītvā vāsavaṃ haste samuttasthau varāsanāt || 202.13 ||
saṃcintitamupāruhya garuḍaṃ gaganecaram  |
satyabhāmāṃ samāropya yayau prāgjyotiṣaṃ puram  || 202.14 ||
āruhyairāvataṃ nāgaṃ śakro'pi tridaśālayam  |
tato jagāma sumanāḥ paśyatāṃ dvārakaukasām  || 202.15 ||
prāgjyotiṣapurasyāsya samantācchatayojanam  |
ācitaṃ bhairavaiḥ pāśaiḥ parasainyanivāraṇe  || 202.16 ||
tāṃściccheda hariḥ pāśān kṣiptvā cakraṃ sudarśanam  |
tato muraḥ samuttasthau taṃ jaghāna ca keśavaḥ  || 202.17 ||
murostu tanayān sapta sahasrāstāṃstato hariḥ  |
cakradhārāgninirdagdhāṃścakāra śalabhāniva  || 202.18 ||
hatvā muraṃ hayagrīvaṃ tathā pañcajanaṃ dvijāḥ  |
prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ dhīmāṃstvarāvān samupādravat || 202.19 ||
narakenāsya tatrābhūnmahāsainyena saṃyugaḥ  |
kṛṣṇasya yatra govindo jaghne daityān sahasraśaḥ  || 202.20 ||
śastrāstravarṣaṃ muñcantaṃ sa bhaumaṃ narakaṃ balī  |
kṣiptvā cakraṃ dvidhā cakre cakrī daiteyacakrahā  || 202.21 ||
hate tu narake bhūmirgṛhītvāditikuṇḍale  |
upatasthe jagannāthaṃ vākyaṃ cedamathābravīt || 202.22 ||
{dharaṇyuvāca̱ }
yadāhamuddhṛtā nātha tvayā śūkaramūrtinā  |
tvatsaṃsparśabhavaḥ putrastadāyaṃ mayyajāyata  || 202.23 ||
so'yaṃ tvayaiva datto me tvayaiva vinipātitaḥ  |
gṛhāṇa kuṇḍale ceme pālayāsya ca saṃtatim  || 202.24 ||
bhārāvataraṇārthāya mamaiva bhagavānimam  |
aṃśena lokamāyātaḥ prasādasumukha prabho  || 202.25 ||
tvaṃ kartā ca vikartā ca saṃhartā prabhavo'vyayaḥ  |
jagatsvarūpo yaśca tvaṃ stūyase'cyuta kiṃ mayā  || 202.26 ||
vyāpī vyāpyaḥ kriyā kartā kāryaṃ ca bhagavān sadā  |
sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā stūyase'cyuta kiṃ mayā  || 202.27 ||
paramātmā tvamātmā ca bhūtātmā cāvyayo bhavān  |
yadā tadā stutirnāsti kimarthaṃ te pravartatām  || 202.28 ||
prasīda sarvabhūtātmannarakena kṛtaṃ ca yat |
tatkṣamyatāmadoṣāya matsutaḥ sa nipātitaḥ  || 202.29 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tatheti coktvā dharaṇīṃ bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ  |
ratnāni narakāvāsājjagrāha munisattamāḥ  || 202.30 ||
kanyāpure sa kanyānāṃ ṣoḍaśātulavikramaḥ  |
śatādhikāni dadṛśe sahasrāṇi dvijottamāḥ  || 202.31 ||
caturdaṃṣṭrān gajāṃścogrān ṣaṭsahasrāṇi dṛṣṭavān  |
kāmbojānāṃ tathāśvānāṃ niyutānyekaviṃśatim  || 202.32 ||
kanyāstāśca tathā nāgāṃstānaśvān dvārakāṃ purīm  |
prāpayāmāsa govindaḥ sadyo narakakiṃkaraiḥ  || 202.33 ||
dadṛśe vāruṇaṃ chattraṃ tathaiva maṇiparvatam  |
āropayāmāsa harirgaruḍe patageśvare  || 202.34 ||
āruhya ca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ satyabhāmāsahāyavān  |
adityāḥ kuṇḍale dātuṃ jagāma tridaśālayam  || 202.35 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
garuḍo vāruṇaṃ chattraṃ tathaiva maṇiparvatam  |
sabhāryaṃ ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ līlayaiva vahan yayau  || 203.1 ||
tataḥ śaṅkhamupādhmāya svargadvāraṃ gato hariḥ  |
upatasthustato devāḥ sārghapātrā janārdanam  || 203.2 ||
sa devairarcitaḥ kṛṣṇo devamāturniveśanam  |
sitābhraśikharākāraṃ praviśya dadṛśe'ditim  || 203.3 ||
sa tāṃ praṇamya śakreṇa sahitaḥ kuṇḍalottame  |
dadau narakanāśaṃ ca śaśaṃsāsyai janārdanaḥ  || 203.4 ||
tataḥ prītā jaganmātā dhātāraṃ jagatāṃ harim  |
tuṣṭāvāditiravyagraṃ kṛtvā tatpravaṇaṃ manaḥ  || 203.5 ||
{aditiruvāca̱ }
namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa bhaktānāmabhayaṃkara  |
sanātanātman bhūtātman sarvātman bhūtabhāvana  || 203.6 ||
praṇetarmanaso buddherindriyāṇāṃ guṇātmaka  |
sitadīrghādiniḥśeṣa kalpanāparivarjita  || 203.7 ||
janmādibhirasaṃspṛṣṭa svapnādivārivarjitaḥ  |
saṃdhyā rātriraharbhūmirgaganaṃ vāyurambu ca  || 203.8 ||
hutāśano mano buddhirbhūtādistvaṃ tathācyuta  |
sṛṣṭisthitivināśānāṃ kartā kartṛpatirbhavān  || 203.9 ||
brahmaviṣṇuśivākhyābhirātmamūrtibhirīśvaraḥ  |
māyābhiretadvyāptaṃ te jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam  || 203.10 ||
anātmanyātmavijñānaṃ sā te māyā janārdana  |
ahaṃ mameti bhāvo'tra yayā samupajāyate  || 203.11 ||
saṃsāramadhye māyāyāstavaitannātha ceṣṭitam  |
yaiḥ svadharmaparairnātha narairārādhito bhavān  || 203.12 ||
te tarantyakhilāmetāṃ māyāmātmavimuktaye  |
brahmādyāḥ sakalā devā manuṣyāḥ paśavastathā  || 203.13 ||
viṣṇumāyāmahāvarte mohāndhatamasāvṛtāḥ  |
ārādhya tvāmabhīpsante kāmānātmabhavakṣaye  || 203.14 ||
pade te puruṣā baddhā māyayā bhagavaṃstava  |
mayā tvaṃ putrakāminyā vairipakṣakṣayāya ca  || 203.15 ||
ārādhito na mokṣāya māyāvilasitaṃ hi tat |
kaupīnācchādanaprāyā vāñchā kalpadrumādapi  || 203.16 ||
jāyate yadapuṇyānāṃ so'parādhaḥ svadoṣajaḥ  |
tatprasīdākhilajaganmāyāmohakarāvyaya  || 203.17 ||
ajñānaṃ jñānasadbhāva bhūtabhūteśa nāśaya  |
namaste cakrahastāya śārṅgahastāya te namaḥ  || 203.18 ||
gadāhastāya te viṣṇo śaṅkhahastāya te namaḥ  |
etatpaśyāmi te rūpaṃ sthūlacihnopaśobhitam  |
na jānāmi paraṃ yatte prasīda parameśvara  || 203.19 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
adityaivaṃ stuto viṣṇuḥ prahasyāha surāraṇim  ||* 203.20 ||
{śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca̱ }
mātā devi tvamasmākaṃ prasīda varadā bhava  ||* 203.21 ||
{aditiruvāca̱ }
evamastu yathecchā te tvamaśeṣasurāsuraiḥ  |
ajeyaḥ puruṣavyāghra martyaloke bhaviṣyasi  || 203.22 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tato'nantaramevāsya śakrāṇīsahitāṃ ditim  |
satyabhāmā praṇamyāha prasīdeti punaḥ punaḥ  || 203.23 ||
{aditiruvāca̱ }
matprasādānna te subhru jarā vairūpyameva ca  |
bhaviṣyatyanavadyāṅgi sarvakāmā bhaviṣyasi  || 203.24 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
adityā tu kṛtānujño devarājo janārdanam  |
yathāvatpūjayāmāsa bahumānapuraḥsaram  || 203.25 ||
tato dadarśa kṛṣṇo'pi satyabhāmāsahāyavān  |
devodyānāni sarvāṇi nandanādīni sattamāḥ  || 203.26 ||
dadarśa ca sugandhāḍhyaṃ mañjarīpuñjadhāriṇam  |
śaityāhlādakaraṃ divyaṃ tāmrapallavaśobhitam  || 203.27 ||
mathyamāne'mṛte jātaṃ jātarūpasamaprabham  |
pārijātaṃ jagannāthaḥ keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha govindaṃ satyabhāmā dvijottamāḥ  || 203.28 ||
{satyabhāmovāca̱ }
kasmānna dvārakāmeṣa nīyate kṛṣṇa pādapaḥ  |
yadi te tadvacaḥ satyaṃ satyātyarthaṃ priyeti me  || 203.29 ||
madgṛhe niṣkuṭārthāya tadayaṃ nīyatāṃ taruḥ  |
na me jāmbavatī tādṛgabhīṣṭā na ca rukmiṇī  || 203.30 ||
satye yathā tvamityuktaṃ tvayā kṛṣṇāsakṛtpriyam  |
satyaṃ tadyadi govinda nopacārakṛtaṃ vacaḥ  || 203.31 ||
tadastu pārijāto'yaṃ mama gehavibhūṣaṇam  |
bibhratī pārijātasya keśapāśena mañjarīm  |
sapatnīnāmahaṃ madhye śobheyamiti kāmaye  || 203.32 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ sa prahasyainaṃ pārijātaṃ garutmati  |
āropayāmāsa haristamūcurvanarakṣiṇaḥ  || 203.33 ||
{vanapālā ūcu̱ḥ }
bhoḥ śacī devarājasya mahiṣī tatparigraham  |
pārijātaṃ na govinda hartumarhasi pādapam  || 203.34 ||
śacīvibhūṣaṇārthāya devairamṛtamanthane  |
utpādito'yaṃ na kṣemī gṛhītvainaṃ gamiṣyasi  || 203.35 ||
mauḍhyātprārthayase kṣemī gṛhītvainaṃ ca ko vrajet |
avaśyamasya devendro vikṛtiṃ kṛṣṇa yāsyati  || 203.36 ||
vajrodyatakaraṃ śakramanuyāsyanti cāmarāḥ  |
tadalaṃ sakalairdevairvigraheṇa tavācyuta  |
vipākakaṭu yatkarma na tacchaṃsanti paṇḍitāḥ  || 203.37 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityukte tairuvācaitān satyabhāmātikopinī  ||* 203.38 ||
{satyabhāmovāca̱ }
kā śacī pārijātasya ko vā śakraḥ surādhipaḥ  |
sāmānyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ yadyeṣo'mṛtamanthane  || 203.39 ||
samutpannaḥ purā kasmādeko gṛhṇāti vāsavaḥ  |
yathā surā yathā cenduryathā śrīrvanarakṣiṇaḥ  || 203.40 ||
sāmānyaḥ sarvalokasya pārijātastathā drumaḥ  |
bhartṛbāhumahāgarvādruṇaddhyenamatho śacī  || 203.41 ||
tatkathyatāṃ drutaṃ gatvā paulomyā vacanaṃ mama  |
satyabhāmā vadatyevaṃ bhartṛgarvoddhatākṣaram  || 203.42 ||
yadi tvaṃ dayitā bharturyadi tasya priyā hyasi  |
madbharturharato vṛkṣaṃ tatkāraya nivāraṇam  || 203.43 ||
jānāmi te patiṃ śakraṃ jānāmi tridaśeśvaram  |
pārijātaṃ tathāpyenaṃ mānuṣī hārayāmi te  || 203.44 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktā rakṣiṇo gatvā proccaiḥ procuryathoditam  |
śacī cotsāhayāmāsa tridaśādhipatiṃ patim  || 203.45 ||
tataḥ samastadevānāṃ sainyaiḥ parivṛto harim  |
pravṛktaḥ pārijātārthamindro yodhayituṃ dvijāḥ  || 203.46 ||
tataḥ parighanistriṃśa gadāśūladharāyudhāḥ  |
babhūvustridaśāḥ sajjāḥ śakre vajrakare sthite  || 203.47 ||
tato nirīkṣya govindo nāgarājopari sthitam  |
śakraṃ devaparīvāraṃ yuddhāya samupasthitam  || 203.48 ||
cakāra śaṅkhanirghoṣaṃ diśaḥ śabdena pūrayan  |
mumoca ca śaravrātaṃ sahasrāyutasaṃmitam  || 203.49 ||
tato diśo nabhaścaiva dṛṣṭvā śaraśatācitam  |
mumucustridaśāḥ sarve śastrāṇyastrāṇyanekaśaḥ  || 203.50 ||
ekaikamastraṃ śastraṃ ca devairmuktaṃ sahasradhā  |
ciccheda līlayaiveśo jagatāṃ madhusūdanaḥ  || 203.51 ||
pāśaṃ salilarājasya samākṛṣyoragāśanaḥ  |
cacāla khaṇḍaśaḥ kṛttvā bālapannagadehavat || 203.52 ||
yamena prahitaṃ daṇḍaṃ gadāprakṣepakhaṇḍitam  |
pṛthivyāṃ pātayāmāsa bhagavān devakīsutaḥ  || 203.53 ||
śibikāṃ ca dhaneśasya cakreṇa tilaśo vibhuḥ  |
cakāra śaurirarkendū dṛṣṭipātahataujasau  || 203.54 ||
nīto'gniḥ śataśo bāṇairdrāvitā vasavo diśaḥ  |
cakravicchinnaśūlāgrā rudrā bhuvi nipātitāḥ  || 203.55 ||
sādhyā viśve ca maruto gandharvāścaiva sāyakaiḥ  |
śārṅgiṇā preritāḥ sarve vyomni śālmalitūlavat || 203.56 ||
garuḍaścāpi vaktreṇa pakṣābhyāṃ ca nakhāṅkuraiḥ  |
bhakṣayannahanaddevān dānavāṃśca sadā khagaḥ  || 203.57 ||
tataḥ śarasahasreṇa devendramadhusūdanau  |
parasparaṃ vavarṣāte dhārābhiriva toyadau  || 203.58 ||
airāvatena garuḍo yuyudhe tatra saṃkule  |
devaiḥ sametairyuyudhe śakreṇa ca janārdanaḥ  || 203.59 ||
chinneṣu śīryamāṇeṣu śastreṣvastreṣu satvaram  |
jagrāha vāsavo vajraṃ kṛṣṇaścakraṃ sudarśanam  || 203.60 ||
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram  |
vajracakradharau dṛṣṭvā devarājajanārdanau  || 203.61 ||
kṣiptaṃ vajramathendreṇa jagrāha bhagavān hariḥ  |
na mumoca tadā cakraṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt || 203.62 ||
pranaṣṭavajraṃ devendraṃ garuḍakṣatavāhanam  |
satyabhāmābravīdvākyaṃ palāyanaparāyaṇam  || 203.63 ||
{satyabhāmovāca̱ }
trailokyeśvara no yuktaṃ śacībhartuḥ palāyanam  |
pārijātasragābhogāttvāmupasthāsyate śacī  || 203.64 ||
kīdṛśaṃ deva rājyaṃ te pārijātasragujjvalām  |
apaśyato yathāpūrvaṃ praṇayābhyāgatāṃ śacīm  || 203.65 ||
alaṃ śakra prayāsena na vrīḍāṃ yātumarhasi  |
nīyatāṃ pārijāto'yaṃ devāḥ santu gatavyathāḥ  || 203.66 ||
patigarvāvalepena bahumānapuraḥsaram  |
na dadarśa gṛhāyātāmupacāreṇa māṃ śacī  || 203.67 ||
strītvādagurucittāhaṃ svabhartuḥ ślāghanāparā  |
tataḥ kṛtavatī śakra bhavatā saha vigraham  || 203.68 ||
tadalaṃ pārijātena parasvena hṛtena vā  |
rūpeṇa yaśasā caiva bhavetstrī kā na garvitā  || 203.69 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityukte vai nivavṛte devarājastayā dvijāḥ  |
prāha caināmalaṃ caṇḍi sakhi khedātivistaraiḥ  || 203.70 ||
na cāpi sargasaṃhāra sthitikartākhilasya yaḥ  |
jitasya tena me vrīḍā jāyate viśvarūpiṇā  || 203.71 ||
yasmiñjagatsakalametadanādimadhye  203.72
yasmādyataśca na bhaviṣyati sarvabhūtāt 203.72
tenodbhavapralayapālanakāraṇena  203.72
vrīḍā kathaṃ bhavati devi nirākṛtasya  203.72
sakalabhuvanamūrtiralpā susūkṣmā  203.73
viditasakalavedairjñāyate yasya nānyaiḥ  203.73
tamajamakṛtamīśaṃ śāśvataṃ svecchayainaṃ  203.73
jagadupakṛtimādyaṃ ko vijetuṃ samarthaḥ  203.73
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
saṃstuto bhagavānitthaṃ devarājena keśavaḥ  |
prahasya bhāvagambhīramuvācedaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 204.1 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
devarājo bhavānindro vayaṃ martyā jagatpate  |
kṣantavyaṃ bhavataivaitadaparādhakṛtaṃ mama  || 204.2 ||
pārijātataruścāyaṃ nīyatāmucitāspadam  |
gṛhīto'yaṃ mayā śakra satyāvacanakāraṇāt || 204.3 ||
vajraṃ cedaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ prahitaṃ tvayā  |
tavaivaitatpraharaṇaṃ śakra vairividāraṇam  || 204.4 ||
{śakra uvāca̱ }
vimohayasi māmīśa martyo'hamiti kiṃ vadan  |
jānīmastvāṃ bhagavato'nantasaukhyavido vayam  || 204.5 ||
yo'si so'si jagannātha pravṛttau nātha saṃsthitaḥ  |
jagataḥ śalyaniṣkarṣaṃ karoṣyasurasūdana  || 204.6 ||
nīyatāṃ pārijāto'yaṃ kṛṣṇa dvāravatīṃ purīm  |
martyaloke tvayā mukte nāyaṃ saṃsthāsyate bhuvi  || 204.7 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tathetyuktvā tu devendramājagāma bhuvaṃ hariḥ  |
prayuktaiḥ siddhagandharvaiḥ stūyamānastvatharṣibhiḥ  || 204.8 ||
jagāma kṛṣṇaḥ sahasā gṛhītvā pādapottamam  |
tataḥ śaṅkhamupādhmāya dvārakopari saṃsthitaḥ  || 204.9 ||
harṣamutpādayāmāsa dvārakāvāsināṃ dvijāḥ  |
avatīryātha garuḍātsatyabhāmāsahāyavān  || 204.10 ||
niṣkuṭe sthāpayāmāsa pārijātaṃ mahātarum  |
yamabhyetya janaḥ sarvo jātiṃ smarati paurvikīm  || 204.11 ||
vāsyate yasya puṣpāṇāṃ gandhenorvī triyojanam  |
tataste yādavāḥ sarve devagandhānamānuṣān  || 204.12 ||
dadṛśuḥ pādape tasmin kurvato mukhadarśanam  |
kiṃkaraiḥ samupānītaṃ hastyaśvādi tato dhanam  || 204.13 ||
striyaśca kṛṣṇo jagrāha narakasya parigrahāt |
tataḥ kāle śubhe prāpta upayeme janārdanaḥ  || 204.14 ||
tāḥ kanyā narakāvāsātsarvato yāḥ samāhṛtāḥ  |
ekasminneva govindaḥ kālenāsāṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 204.15 ||
jagrāha vidhivatpāṇīn pṛthagdehe svadharmataḥ  |
ṣoḍaśa strīsahasrāṇi śatamekaṃ tathādhikam  || 204.16 ||
tāvanti cakre rūpāṇi bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ  |
ekaikaśaśca tāḥ kanyā menire madhusūdanam  || 204.17 ||
mamaiva pāṇigrahaṇaṃ govindaḥ kṛtavāniti  |
niśāsu jagataḥ sraṣṭā tāsāṃ geheṣu keśavaḥ  |
uvāsa viprāḥ sarvāsāṃ viśvarūpadharo hariḥ  || 204.18 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
pradyumnādyā hareḥ putrā rukmiṇyāṃ kathitā dvijāḥ  |
bhānvādikāṃśca vai putrān satyabhāmā vyajāyata  || 205.1 ||
dīptimantaḥ prapakṣādyā rohiṇyāstanayā hareḥ  |
babhūvurjāmbavatyāśca sāmbādyā bāhuśālinaḥ  || 205.2 ||
tanayā bhadravindādyā nāgnajityāṃ mahābalāḥ  |
saṃgrāmajitpradhānāstu śaibyāyāṃ cābhavan sutāḥ  || 205.3 ||
vṛkādyāstu sutā mādrī gātravatpramukhān sutān  |
avāpa lakṣmaṇā putrān kālindyāśca śrutādayaḥ  || 205.4 ||
anyāsāṃ caiva bhāryāṇāṃ samutpannāni cakriṇaḥ  |
aṣṭāyutāni putrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi śataṃ tathā  || 205.5 ||
pradyumnaḥ pramukhasteṣāṃ rukmiṇyāstu sutastataḥ  |
pradyumnādaniruddho'bhūdvajrastasmādajāyata  || 205.6 ||
aniruddho raṇe ruddho baleḥ pautrīṃ mahābalaḥ  |
bāṇasya tanayāmūṣāmupayeme dvijottamāḥ  || 205.7 ||
yatra yuddhamabhūdghoraṃ hariśaṃkarayormahat |
chinnaṃ sahasraṃ bāhūnāṃ yatra bāṇasya cakriṇā  || 205.8 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kathaṃ yuddhamabhūdbrahmannuṣārthe harakṛṣṇayoḥ  |
kathaṃ kṣayaṃ ca bāṇasya bāhūnāṃ kṛtavān hariḥ  || 205.9 ||
etatsarvaṃ mahābhāga vaktumarhasi no'khilam  |
mahatkautūhalaṃ jātaṃ śrotumetāṃ kathāṃ śubhām  || 205.10 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
uṣā bāṇasutā viprāḥ pārvatīṃ śaṃbhunā saha  |
krīḍantīmupalakṣyoccaiḥ spṛhāṃ cakre tadā svayam  |
tataḥ sakalacittajñā gaurī tāmāha bhāminīm  || 205.11 ||
{gauryuvāca̱ }
alamityanutāpena bhartrā tvamapi raṃsyase  ||* 205.12 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktā sā tadā cakre kadeti matimātmanaḥ  |
ko vā bhartā mametyenāṃ punarapyāha pārvatī  || 205.13 ||
{pārvatyuvāca̱ }
vaiśākhe śukladvādaśyāṃ svapne yo'bhibhavaṃ tava  |
kariṣyati sa te bhartā rājaputri bhaviṣyati  || 205.14 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tasyāṃ tithau pumān svapne yathā devyā udīritaḥ  |
tathaivābhibhavaṃ cakre rāgaṃ cakre ca tatra sā  |
tataḥ prabuddhā puruṣamapaśyantī tamutsukā  || 205.15 ||
{uṣovāca̱ }
kva gato'sīti nirlajjā dvijāścoktavatī sakhīm  |
bāṇasya mantrī kumbhāṇḍaścitralekhā tu tatsutā  || 205.16 ||
tasyāḥ sakhyabhavatsā ca prāha ko'yaṃ tvayocyate  |
yadā lajjākulā nāsya kathayāmāsa sā sakhī  || 205.17 ||
tadā viśvāsamānīya sarvamevānvavedayat |
viditāyāṃ tu tāmāha punarūṣā yathoditam  |
devyā tathaiva tatprāptau yo'bhyupāyaḥ kuruṣva tam  || 205.18 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tataḥ paṭe surān daityān gandharvāṃśca pradhānataḥ  |
manuṣyāṃścābhilikhyāsau citralekhāpyadarśayat || 205.19 ||
apāsya sā tu gandharvāṃstathoragasurāsurān  |
manuṣyeṣu dadau dṛṣṭiṃ teṣvapyandhakavṛṣṇiṣu  || 205.20 ||
kṛṣṇarāmau vilokyāsītsubhrūrlajjāyatekṣaṇā  |
pradyumnadarśane vrīḍā dṛṣṭiṃ ninye tato dvijāḥ  || 205.21 ||
dṛṣṭvāniruddhaṃ ca tato lajjā kvāpi nirākṛtā  |
so'yaṃ so'yaṃ mametyukte tayā sā yogagāminī  |
yayau dvāravatīmūṣāṃ samāśvāsya tataḥ sakhī  || 205.22 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
bāṇo'pi praṇipatyāgre tataścāha trilocanam  ||* 206.1 ||
{bāṇa uvāca̱ }
deva bāhusahasreṇa nirviṇṇo'haṃ vināhavam  |
kaccinmamaiṣāṃ bāhūnāṃ sāphalyakaraṇo raṇaḥ  |
bhaviṣyati vinā yuddhaṃ bhārāya mama kiṃ bhujaiḥ  || 206.2 ||
{śaṃkara uvāca̱ }
mayūradhvajabhaṅgaste yadā bāṇa bhaviṣyati  |
piśitāśijanānandaṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ tadā raṇam  || 206.3 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tataḥ praṇamya muditaḥ śaṃbhumabhyāgato gṛhāt |
bhagnaṃ dhvajamathālokya hṛṣṭo harṣaṃ paraṃ yayau  || 206.4 ||
etasminneva kāle tu yogavidyābalena tam  |
aniruddhamathāninye citralekhā varā sakhī  || 206.5 ||
kanyāntaḥpuramadhye taṃ ramamāṇaṃ sahoṣayā  |
vijñāya rakṣiṇo gatvā śaśaṃsurdaityabhūpateḥ  || 206.6 ||
vyādiṣṭaṃ kiṃkarāṇāṃ tu sainyaṃ tena mahātmanā  |
jaghāna parighaṃ lauhamādāya paravīrahā  || 206.7 ||
hateṣu teṣu bāṇo'pi rathasthastadvadhodyataḥ  |
yudhyamāno yathāśakti yadā vīreṇa nirjitaḥ  || 206.8 ||
māyayā yuyudhe tena sa tadā mantracoditaḥ  |
tataśca pannagāstreṇa babandha yadunandanam  || 206.9 ||
dvāravatyāṃ kva yāto'sāvaniruddheti jalpatām  |
yadūnāmācacakṣe taṃ baddhaṃ bāṇena nāradaḥ  || 206.10 ||
taṃ śoṇitapure śrutvā nītaṃ vidyāvidagdhayā  |
yoṣitā pratyayaṃ jagmuryādavā nāma vairiti  || 206.11 ||
tato garuḍamāruhya smṛtamātrāgataṃ hariḥ  |
balapradyumnasahito bāṇasya prayayau puram  || 206.12 ||
purīpraveśe pramathairyuddhamāsīnmahābalaiḥ  |
yayau bāṇapurābhyāśaṃ nītvā tān saṃkṣayaṃ hariḥ  || 206.13 ||
tatastripādastriśirā jvaro māheśvaro mahān  |
bāṇarakṣārthamatyarthaṃ yuyudhe śārṅgadhanvanā  || 206.14 ||
tadbhasmasparśasaṃbhūta tāpaṃ kṛṣṇāṅgasaṃgamāt |
avāpa baladevo'pi samaṃ saṃmīlitekṣaṇaḥ  || 206.15 ||
tataḥ saṃyudhyamānastu saha devena śārṅgiṇā  |
vaiṣṇavena jvareṇāśu kṛṣṇadehānnirākṛtaḥ  || 206.16 ||
nārāyaṇabhujāghāta paripīḍanavihvalam  |
taṃ vīkṣya kṣamyatāmasyetyāha devaḥ pitāmahaḥ  || 206.17 ||
tataśca kṣāntameveti procya taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ jvaram  |
ātmanyeva layaṃ ninye bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ  || 206.18 ||
mama tvayā samaṃ yuddhaṃ ye smariṣyanti mānavāḥ  |
vijvarāste bhaviṣyantītyuktvā cainaṃ yayau hariḥ  || 206.19 ||
tato'gnīn bhagavān pañca jitvā nītvā kṣayaṃ tathā  |
dānavānāṃ balaṃ viṣṇuścūrṇayāmāsa līlayā  || 206.20 ||
tataḥ samastasainyena daiteyānāṃ baleḥ sutaḥ  |
yuyudhe śaṃkaraścaiva kārttikeyaśca śauriṇā  || 206.21 ||
hariśaṃkarayoryuddhamatīvāsītsudāruṇam  |
cukṣubhuḥ sakalā lokāḥ śastrāstrairbahudhārditāḥ  || 206.22 ||
pralayo'yamaśeṣasya jagato nūnamāgataḥ  |
menire tridaśā yatra vartamāne mahāhave  || 206.23 ||
jṛmbhaṇāstreṇa govindo jṛmbhayāmāsa śaṃkaram  |
tataḥ praṇeśurdaiteyāḥ pramathāśca samantataḥ  || 206.24 ||
jṛmbhābhibhūtaśca haro rathopasthamupāviśat |
na śaśāka tadā yoddhuṃ kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā  || 206.25 ||
garuḍakṣatabāhuśca pradyumnāstreṇa pīḍitaḥ  |
kṛṣṇahuṃkāranirdhūta śaktiścāpayayau guhaḥ  || 206.26 ||
jṛmbhite śaṃkare naṣṭe daityasainye guhe jite  |
nīte pramathasainye ca saṃkṣayaṃ śārṅgadhanvanā  || 206.27 ||
nandīśasaṃgṛhītāśvamadhirūḍho mahāratham  |
bāṇastatrāyayau yoddhuṃ kṛṣṇakārṣṇibalaiḥ saha  || 206.28 ||
balabhadro mahāvīryo bāṇasainyamanekadhā  |
vivyādha bāṇaiḥ pradyumno dharmataścāpalāyataḥ  || 206.29 ||
ākṛṣya lāṅgalāgreṇa muśalena ca pothitam  |
balaṃ balena dadṛśe bāṇo bāṇaiśca cakriṇaḥ  || 206.30 ||
tataḥ kṛṣṇasya bāṇena yuddhamāsītsamāsataḥ  |
parasparaṃ tu saṃdīptān kāyatrāṇavibhedinaḥ  || 206.31 ||
kṛṣṇaściccheda bāṇāṃstān bāṇena prahitāñśaraiḥ  |
bibheda keśavaṃ bāṇo bāṇaṃ vivyādha cakradhṛk || 206.32 ||
mumucāte tathāstrāṇi bāṇakṛṣṇau jigīṣayā  |
parasparakṣatiparau parighāṃśca tato dvijāḥ  || 206.33 ||
chidyamāneṣvaśeṣeṣu śastreṣvastre ca sīdati  |
prācuryeṇa harirbāṇaṃ hantuṃ cakre tato manaḥ  || 206.34 ||
tato'rkaśatasaṃbhūta tejasā sadṛśadyuti  |
jagrāha daityacakrārirhariścakraṃ sudarśanam  || 206.35 ||
muñcato bāṇanāśāya taccakraṃ madhuvidviṣaḥ  |
nagnā daiteyavidyābhūtkoṭarī purato hareḥ  || 206.36 ||
tāmagrato harirdṛṣṭvā mīlitākṣaḥ sudarśanam  |
mumoca bāṇamuddiśya chettuṃ bāhuvanaṃ ripoḥ  || 206.37 ||
krameṇāsya tu bāhūnāṃ bāṇasyācyutacoditam  |
chedaṃ cakre'surasyāśu śastrāstrakṣepaṇāddrutam  || 206.38 ||
chinne bāhuvane tattu karasthaṃ madhusūdanaḥ  |
mumukṣurbāṇanāśāya vijñātastripuradviṣā  || 206.39 ||
sa utpatyāha govindaṃ sāmapūrvamumāpatiḥ  |
vilokya bāṇaṃ dordaṇḍa cchedāsṛksrāvavarṣiṇam  || 206.40 ||
{rudra uvāca̱ }
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa jagannātha jāne tvāṃ puruṣottamam  |
pareśaṃ paramātmānamanādinidhanaṃ param  || 206.41 ||
devatiryaṅmanuṣyeṣu śarīragrahaṇātmikā  |
līleyaṃ tava ceṣṭā hi daityānāṃ vadhalakṣaṇā  || 206.42 ||
tatprasīdābhayaṃ dattaṃ bāṇasyāsya mayā prabho  |
tattvayā nānṛtaṃ kāryaṃ yanmayā vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ  || 206.43 ||
asmatsaṃśrayavṛddho'yaṃ nāparādhastavāvyaya  |
mayā dattavaro daityastatastvāṃ kṣamayāmyaham  || 206.44 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ prāha govindaḥ śūlapāṇimumāpatim  |
prasannavadano bhūtvā gatāmarṣo'suraṃ prati  || 206.45 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
yuṣmaddattavaro bāṇo jīvatādeṣa śaṃkara  |
tvadvākyagauravādetanmayā cakraṃ nivartitam  || 206.46 ||
tvayā yadabhayaṃ dattaṃ taddattamabhayaṃ mayā  |
matto'vibhinnamātmānaṃ draṣṭumarhasi śaṃkara  || 206.47 ||
yo'haṃ sa tvaṃ jagaccedaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam  |
avidyāmohitātmānaḥ puruṣā bhinnadarśinaḥ  || 206.48 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā prayayau kṛṣṇaḥ prādyumniryatra tiṣṭhati  |
tadbandhaphaṇino neśurgaruḍānilaśoṣitāḥ  || 206.49 ||
tato'niruddhamāropya sapatnīkaṃ garutmati  |
ājagmurdvārakāṃ rāma kārṣṇidāmodarāḥ purīm  || 206.50 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
cakre karma mahacchaurirbibhradyo mānuṣīṃ tanum  |
jigāya śakraṃ śarvaṃ ca sarvadevāṃśca līlayā  || 207.1 ||
yaccānyadakarotkarma divyaceṣṭāvighātakṛt |
kathyatāṃ tanmuniśreṣṭha paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 207.2 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
gadato me muniśreṣṭhāḥ śrūyatāmidamādarāt |
narāvatāre kṛṣṇena dagdhā vārāṇasī yathā  || 207.3 ||
pauṇḍrako vāsudevaśca vāsudevo'bhavadbhuvi  |
avatīrṇastvamityukto janairajñānamohitaiḥ  || 207.4 ||
sa mene vāsudevo'hamavatīrṇo mahītale  |
naṣṭasmṛtistataḥ sarvaṃ viṣṇucihnamacīkarat |
dūtaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa sa kṛṣṇāya dvijottamāḥ  || 207.5 ||
{dūta uvāca̱ }
tyaktvā cakrādikaṃ cihnaṃ madīyaṃ nāma mātmanaḥ  |
vāsudevātmakaṃ mūḍha muktvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ  || 207.6 ||
ātmano jīvitārthaṃ ca tathā me praṇatiṃ vraja  ||* 207.7 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ sa prahasyaiva dūtaṃ prāha janārdanaḥ  ||* 207.8 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
nijacihnamahaṃ cakraṃ samutsrakṣye tvayīti vai  |
vācyaśca pauṇḍrako gatvā tvayā dūta vaco mama  || 207.9 ||
jñātastvadvākyasadbhāvo yatkāryaṃ tadvidhīyatām  |
gṛhītacihna evāhamāgamiṣyāmi te puram  || 207.10 ||
utsrakṣyāmi ca te cakraṃ nijacihnamasaṃśayam  |
ājñāpūrvaṃ ca yadidamāgaccheti tvayoditam  || 207.11 ||
saṃpādayiṣye śvastubhyaṃ tadapyeṣo'vilambitam  |
śaraṇaṃ te samabhyetya kartāsmi nṛpate tathā  |
yathā tvatto bhayaṃ bhūyo naiva kiṃcidbhaviṣyati  || 207.12 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityukte'pagate dūte saṃsmṛtyābhyāgataṃ hariḥ  |
garutmantaṃ samāruhya tvaritaṃ tatpuraṃ yayau  || 207.13 ||
tasyāpi keśavodyogaṃ śrutvā kāśipatistadā  |
sarvasainyaparīvāra pārṣṇigrāhamupāyayau  || 207.14 ||
tato balena mahatā kāśirājabalena ca  |
pauṇḍrako vāsudevo'sau keśavābhimukhaṃ yayau  || 207.15 ||
taṃ dadarśa harirdūrādudārasyandane sthitam  |
cakraśaṅkhagadāpāṇiṃ pāṇinā vidhṛtāmbujam  || 207.16 ||
sragdharaṃ dhṛtaśārṅgaṃ ca suparṇaracanādhvajam  |
vakṣasthalakṛtaṃ cāsya śrīvatsaṃ dadṛśe hariḥ  || 207.17 ||
kirīṭakuṇḍaladharaṃ pītavāsaḥsamanvitam  |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ bhāvagambhīraṃ jahāsa madhusūdanaḥ  || 207.18 ||
yuyudhe ca balenāsya hastyaśvabalinā dvijāḥ  |
nistriṃśarṣṭigadāśūla śaktikārmukaśālinā  || 207.19 ||
kṣaṇena śārṅganirmuktaiḥ śarairagnividāraṇaiḥ  |
gadācakrātipātaiśca sūdayāmāsa tadbalam  || 207.20 ||
kāśirājabalaṃ caiva kṣayaṃ nītvā janārdanaḥ  |
uvāca pauṇḍrakaṃ mūḍhamātmacihnopalakṣaṇam  || 207.21 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
pauṇḍrakoktaṃ tvayā yattaddūtavaktreṇa māṃ prati  |
samutsṛjeti cihnāni tatte saṃpādayāmyaham  || 207.22 ||
cakrametatsamutsṛṣṭaṃ gadeyaṃ te visarjitā  |
garutmāneṣa nirdiṣṭaḥ samārohatu te dhvajam  || 207.23 ||
ityuccārya vimuktena cakreṇāsau vidāritaḥ  |
pothito gadayā bhagno garutmāṃśca garutmatā  || 207.24 ||
tato hāhākṛte loke kāśīnāmadhipastadā  |
yuyudhe vāsudevena mitrasyāpacitau sthitaḥ  || 207.25 ||
tataḥ śārṅgavinirmuktaiśchittvā tasya śaraiḥ śiraḥ  |
kāśipuryāṃ sa cikṣepa kurvaṃllokasya vismayam  || 207.26 ||
hatvā tu pauṇḍrakaṃ śauriḥ kāśirājaṃ ca sānugam  |
reme dvāravatīṃ prāpto'maraḥ svargagato yathā  || 207.27 ||
tacchiraḥ patitaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā kāśipateḥ pure  |
janaḥ kimetadityāha kenetyatyantavismitaḥ  || 207.28 ||
jñātvā taṃ vāsudevena hataṃ tasya sutastataḥ  |
purohitena sahitastoṣayāmāsa śaṃkaram  || 207.29 ||
avimukte mahākṣetre toṣitastena śaṃkaraḥ  |
varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti tadā taṃ provāca nṛpātmajam  || 207.30 ||
sa vavre bhagavan kṛtyā piturhanturvadhāya me  |
samuttiṣṭhatu kṛṣṇasya tvatprasādānmaheśvara  || 207.31 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyukte dakṣiṇāgneranantaram  |
mahākṛtyā samuttasthau tasyaivāgniniveśanāt || 207.32 ||
tato jvālākarālāsyā jvalatkeśakalāpikā  |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kupitā kṛtvā dvāravatīṃ yayau  || 207.33 ||
tāmavekṣya janaḥ sarvo raudrāṃ vikṛtalocanām  |
yayau śaraṇyaṃ jagatāṃ śaraṇaṃ madhusūdanam  || 207.34 ||
{janā ūcu̱ḥ }
kāśirājasuteneyamārādhya vṛṣabhadhvajam  |
utpāditā mahākṛtyā vadhāya tava cakriṇaḥ  |
jahi kṛtyāmimāmugrāṃ vahnijvālājaṭākulām  || 207.35 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
cakramutsṛṣṭamakṣeṣu krīḍāsaktena līlayā  |
tadagnimālājaṭilaṃ jvālodgārātibhīṣaṇam  || 207.36 ||
kṛtyāmanujagāmāśu viṣṇucakraṃ sudarśanam  |
tataḥ sā cakravidhvastā kṛtyā māheśvarī tadā  || 207.37 ||
jagāma veginī vegāttadapyanujagāma tām  |
kṛtyā vārāṇasīmeva praviveśa tvarānvitā  || 207.38 ||
viṣṇucakrapratihata prabhāvā munisattamāḥ  |
tataḥ kāśibalaṃ bhūri pramathānāṃ tathā balam  || 207.39 ||
samastaśastrāstrayutaṃ cakrasyābhimukhaṃ yayau  |
śastrāstramokṣabahulaṃ dagdhvā tadbalamojasā  || 207.40 ||
kṛtvākṣemāmaśeṣāṃ tāṃ purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ yayau  |
prabhūtabhṛtyapaurāṃ tāṃ sāśvamātaṅgamānavām  || 207.41 ||
aśeṣadurgakoṣṭhāṃ tāṃ durnirīkṣyāṃ surairapi  |
jvālāparivṛtāśeṣa gṛhaprākāratoraṇām  || 207.42 ||
dadāha tāṃ purīṃ cakraṃ sakalāmeva satvaram  |
akṣīṇāmarṣamatyalpa sādhyasādhananispṛham  |
taccakraṃ prasphuraddīpti viṣṇorabhyāyayau karam  || 207.43 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
śrotumicchāmahe bhūyo balabhadrasya dhīmataḥ  |
mune parākramaṃ śauryaṃ tanno vyākhyātumarhasi  || 208.1 ||
yamunākarṣaṇādīni śrutānyasmābhiratra vai  |
tatkathyatāṃ mahābhāga yadanyatkṛtavān balaḥ  || 208.2 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ karma yadrāmeṇābhavatkṛtam  |
anantenāprameyena śeṣeṇa dharaṇībhṛtā  || 208.3 ||
duryodhanasya tanayāṃ svayaṃvarakṛtekṣaṇām  |
balādādattavān vīraḥ sāmbo jāmbavatīsutaḥ  || 208.4 ||
tataḥ kruddhā mahāvīryāḥ karṇaduryodhanādayaḥ  |
bhīṣmadroṇādayaścaiva babandhuryudhi nirjitam  || 208.5 ||
tacchrutvā yādavāḥ sarve krodhaṃ duryodhanādiṣu  |
munayaḥ praticakruśca tān vihantuṃ mahodyamam  || 208.6 ||
tānnivārya balaḥ prāha madalolākulākṣaram  |
mokṣyanti te madvacanādyāsyāmyeko hi kauravān  || 208.7 ||
baladevastato gatvā nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam  |
bāhyopavanamadhye'bhūnna viveśa ca tatpuram  || 208.8 ||
balamāgatamājñāya tadā duryodhanādayaḥ  |
gāmarghamudakaṃ caiva rāmāya pratyavedayan  |
gṛhītvā vidhivatsarvaṃ tatastānāha kauravān  || 208.9 ||
{baladeva uvāca̱ }
ājñāpayatyugrasenaḥ sāmbamāśu vimuñcata  ||* 208.10 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tatastadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhīṣmadroṇādayo dvijāḥ  |
karṇaduryodhanādyāśca cukrudhurdvijasattamāḥ  || 208.11 ||
ūcuśca kupitāḥ sarve bāhlikādyāśca bhūmipāḥ  |
arājārhaṃ yadorvaṃśamavekṣya muśalāyudham  || 208.12 ||
{kauravā ūcu̱ḥ }
bho bhoḥ kimetadbhavatā balabhadreritaṃ vacaḥ  |
ājñāṃ kurukulotthānāṃ yādavaḥ kaḥ pradāsyati  || 208.13 ||
ugraseno'pi yadyājñāṃ kauravāṇāṃ pradāsyati  |
tadalaṃ pāṇḍuraiśchattrairnṛpayogyairalaṃkṛtaiḥ  || 208.14 ||
tadgaccha balabhadra tvaṃ sāmbamanyāyaceṣṭitam  |
vimokṣyāmo na bhavato nograsenasya śāsanāt || 208.15 ||
praṇatiryā kṛtāsmākaṃ mānyānāṃ kukurāndhakaiḥ  |
na nāma sā kṛtā keyamājñā svāmini bhṛtyataḥ  || 208.16 ||
garvamāropitā yūyaṃ samānāsanabhojanaiḥ  |
ko doṣo bhavatāṃ nītiryatprīṇātyanapekṣitā  || 208.17 ||
asmābhirarcyo bhavatā yo'yaṃ bala niveditaḥ  |
premṇaiva na tadasmākaṃ kulādyuṣmatkulocitam  || 208.18 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā kuravaḥ sarve nāmuñcanta hareḥ sutam  |
kṛtaikaniścayāḥ sarve viviśurgajasāhvayam  || 208.19 ||
mattaḥ kopena cāghūrṇaṃ tato'dhikṣepajanmanā  |
utthāya pārṣṇyā vasudhāṃ jaghāna sa halāyudhaḥ  || 208.20 ||
tato vidāritā pṛthvī pārṣṇighātānmahātmanaḥ  |
āsphoṭayāmāsa tadā diśaḥ śabdena pūrayan  |
uvāca cātitāmrākṣo bhrukuṭīkuṭilānanaḥ  || 208.21 ||
{baladeva uvāca̱ }
aho mahāvalepo'yamasārāṇāṃ durātmanām  |
kauravāṇāmādhipatyamasmākaṃ kila kālajam  || 208.22 ||
ugrasenasya ye nājñāṃ manyante cāpyalaṅghanām  |
ājñāṃ pratīccheddharmeṇa saha devaiḥ śacīpatiḥ  || 208.23 ||
sadādhyāste sudharmāṃ tāmugrasenaḥ śacīpateḥ  |
dhiṅmanuṣyaśatocchiṣṭe tuṣṭireṣāṃ nṛpāsane  || 208.24 ||
pārijātataroḥ puṣpa mañjarīrvanitājanaḥ  |
bibharti yasya bhṛtyānāṃ so'pyeṣāṃ na mahīpatiḥ  || 208.25 ||
samastabhūbhujāṃ nātha ugrasenaḥ sa tiṣṭhatu  |
adya niṣkauravāmurvīṃ kṛtvā yāsyāmi tāṃ purīm  || 208.26 ||
karṇaṃ duryodhanaṃ droṇamadya bhīṣmaṃ sabāhlikam  |
duḥśāsanādīn bhūriṃ ca bhūriśravasameva ca  || 208.27 ||
somadattaṃ śalaṃ bhīmamarjunaṃ sayudhiṣṭhiram  |
yamajau kauravāṃścānyān hanyāṃ sāśvarathadvipān  || 208.28 ||
vīramādāya taṃ sāmbaṃ sapatnīkaṃ tataḥ purīm  |
dvārakāmugrasenādīn gatvā drakṣyāmi bāndhavān  || 208.29 ||
athavā kauravādīnāṃ samastaiḥ kurubhiḥ saha  |
bhārāvataraṇe śīghraṃ devarājena coditaḥ  || 208.30 ||
bhāgīrathyāṃ kṣipāmyāśu nagaraṃ nāgasāhvayam  ||* 208.31 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā krodharaktākṣastālāṅko'dhomukhaṃ halam  |
prākāravapre vinyasya cakarṣa muśalāyudhaḥ  || 208.32 ||
āghūrṇitaṃ tatsahasā tato vai hastināpuram  |
dṛṣṭvā saṃkṣubdhahṛdayāścukruśuḥ sarvakauravāḥ  || 208.33 ||
{kauravā ūcu̱ḥ }
rāma rāma mahābāho kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāṃ tvayā  |
upasaṃhriyatāṃ kopaḥ prasīda muśalāyudha  || 208.34 ||
eṣa sāmbaḥ sapatnīkastava niryātito bala  |
avijñātaprabhāvāṇāṃ kṣamyatāmaparādhinām  || 208.35 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tato niryātayāmāsuḥ sāmbaṃ patnyā samanvitam  |
niṣkramya svapurīṃ tūrṇaṃ kauravā munisattamāḥ  || 208.36 ||
bhīṣmadroṇakṛpādīnāṃ praṇamya vadatāṃ priyam  |
kṣāntameva mayetyāha balo balavatāṃ varaḥ  || 208.37 ||
