adyāpyāghūrṇitākāraṃ lakṣyate tatpuraṃ dvijāḥ  |
eṣa prabhāvo rāmasya balaśauryavato dvijāḥ  || 208.38 ||
tatastu kauravāḥ sāmbaṃ saṃpūjya halinā saha  |
preṣayāmāsurudvāha dhanabhāryāsamanvitam  || 208.39 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve balasya balaśālinaḥ  |
kṛtaṃ yadanyadevābhūttadapi śrūyatāṃ dvijāḥ  || 209.1 ||
narakasyāsurendrasya devapakṣavirodhinaḥ  |
sakhābhavanmahāvīryo dvivido nāma vānaraḥ  || 209.2 ||
vairānubandhaṃ balavān sa cakāra surān prati  ||* 209.3 ||
{dvivida uvāca̱ }
narakaṃ hatavān kṛṣṇo baladarpasamanvitam  |
kariṣye sarvadevānāṃ tasmādeṣa pratikriyām  || 209.4 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
yajñavidhvaṃsanaṃ kurvanmartyalokakṣayaṃ tathā  |
tato vidhvaṃsayāmāsa yajñānajñānamohitaḥ  || 209.5 ||
bibheda sādhumaryādāṃ kṣayaṃ cakre ca dehinām  |
dadāha capalo deśaṃ puragrāmāntarāṇi ca  || 209.6 ||
kvacicca parvatakṣepādgrāmādīn samacūrṇayat |
śailānutpāṭya toyeṣu mumocāmbunidhau tathā  || 209.7 ||
punaścārṇavamadhyasthaḥ kṣobhayāmāsa sāgaram  |
tenātikṣobhitaścābdhirudvelo jāyate dvijāḥ  || 209.8 ||
plāvayaṃstīrajān grāmān purādīnativegavān  |
kāmarūpaṃ mahārūpaṃ kṛtvā sasyānyanekaśaḥ  || 209.9 ||
luṭhan bhramaṇasaṃmardaiḥ saṃcūrṇayati vānaraḥ  |
tena viprakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaddurātmanā  || 209.10 ||
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ dvijāścāsītsuduḥkhitam  |
kadācidraivatodyāne papau pānaṃ halāyudhaḥ  || 209.11 ||
revatī ca mahābhāgā tathaivānyā varastriyaḥ  |
udgīyamāno vilasallalanāmaulimadhyagaḥ  || 209.12 ||
reme yaduvaraśreṣṭhaḥ kubera iva mandare  |
tataḥ sa vānaro'bhyetya gṛhītvā sīriṇo halam  || 209.13 ||
muśalaṃ ca cakārāsya saṃmukhaḥ sa viḍambanām  |
tathaiva yoṣitāṃ tāsāṃ jahāsābhimukhaṃ kapiḥ  || 209.14 ||
pānapūrṇāṃśca karakāṃścikṣepāhatya vai tadā  |
tataḥ kopaparītātmā bhartsayāmāsa taṃ balam  || 209.15 ||
tathāpi tamavajñāya cakre kilakilādhvanim  |
tataḥ samutthāya balo jagṛhe muśalaṃ ruṣā  || 209.16 ||
so'pi śailaśilāṃ bhīmāṃ jagrāha plavagottamaḥ  |
cikṣepa ca sa tāṃ kṣiptāṃ muśalena sahasradhā  || 209.17 ||
bibheda yādavaśreṣṭhaḥ sā papāta mahītale  |
apatanmuśalaṃ cāsau samullaṅghya plavaṃgamaḥ  || 209.18 ||
vegenāyamya roṣeṇa balenorasyatāḍayat |
tato balena kopena muṣṭinā mūrdhni tāḍitaḥ  || 209.19 ||
papāta rudhirodgārī dvividaḥ kṣīṇajīvitaḥ  |
patatā taccharīreṇa gireḥ śṛṅgamaśīryata  || 209.20 ||
munayaḥ śatadhā vajri vajreṇeva hi tāḍitam  |
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tato devā rāmasyopari cikṣipuḥ  || 209.21 ||
praśaśaṃsustadābhyetya sādhvetatte mahatkṛtam  |
anena duṣṭakapinā daityapakṣopakāriṇā  |
jagannirākṛtaṃ vīra diṣṭyā sa kṣayamāgataḥ  || 209.22 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃvidhānyanekāni baladevasya dhīmataḥ  |
karmāṇyaparimeyāni śeṣasya dharaṇībhṛtaḥ  || 209.23 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ daityavadhaṃ kṛṣṇo baladevasahāyavān  |
cakre duṣṭakṣitīśānāṃ tathaiva jagataḥ kṛte  || 210.1 ||
kṣiteśca bhāraṃ bhagavān phālgunena samaṃ vibhuḥ  |
avatārayāmāsa hariḥ samastākṣauhiṇīvadhāt || 210.2 ||
kṛtvā bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhuvo hatvākhilānnṛpān  |
śāpavyājena viprāṇāmupasaṃhṛtavān kulam  || 210.3 ||
utsṛjya dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇastyaktvā mānuṣyamātmabhūḥ  |
svāṃśo viṣṇumayaṃ sthānaṃ praviveśa punarnijam  || 210.4 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
sa vipraśāpavyājena saṃjahre svakulaṃ katham  |
kathaṃ ca mānuṣaṃ dehamutsasarja janārdanaḥ  || 210.5 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
viśvāmitrastathā kaṇvo nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ  |
piṇḍārake mahātīrthe dṛṣṭā yadukumārakaiḥ  || 210.6 ||
tataste yauvanonmattā bhāvikāryapracoditāḥ  |
sāmbaṃ jāmbavatīputraṃ bhūṣayitvā striyaṃ yathā  |
prasṛtāstānmunīnūcuḥ praṇipātapuraḥsaram  || 210.7 ||
{kumārā ūcu̱ḥ }
iyaṃ strī putrakāmā tu prabho kiṃ janayiṣyati  ||* 210.8 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
divyajñānopapannāste vipralabdhā kumārakaiḥ  |
śāpaṃ dadustadā viprāsteṣāṃ nāśāya suvratāḥ  || 210.9 ||
munayaḥ kupitāḥ procurmuśalaṃ janayiṣyati  |
yenākhilakulotsādo yādavānāṃ bhaviṣyati  || 210.10 ||
ityuktāstaiḥ kumārāsta ācacakṣuryathātatham  |
ugrasenāya muśalaṃ jajñe sāmbasya codarāt || 210.11 ||
tadugraseno muśalamayaścūrṇamakārayat |
jajñe taccairakā cūrṇaṃ prakṣiptaṃ vai mahodadhau  || 210.12 ||
musalasyātha lauhasya cūrṇitasyāndhakairdvijāḥ  |
khaṇḍaṃ cūrṇayituṃ śekurnaiva te tomarākṛti  || 210.13 ||
tadapyambunidhau kṣiptaṃ matsyo jagrāha jālibhiḥ  |
ghātitasyodarāttasya lubdho jagrāha tajjarā  || 210.14 ||
vijñātaparamārtho'pi bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ  |
naicchattadanyathā kartuṃ vidhinā yatsamāhṛtam  || 210.15 ||
devaiśca prahito dūtaḥ praṇipatyāha keśavam  |
rahasyevamahaṃ dūtaḥ prahito bhagavan suraiḥ  || 210.16 ||
vasvaśvimarudāditya rudrasādhyādibhiḥ saha  |
vijñāpayati vaḥ śakrastadidaṃ śrūyatāṃ prabho  || 210.17 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
bhārāvataraṇārthāya varṣāṇāmadhikaṃ śatam  |
bhagavānavatīrṇo'tra tridaśaiḥ saṃprasāditaḥ  || 210.18 ||
durvṛttā nihatā daityā bhuvo bhāro'vatāritaḥ  |
tvayā sanāthāstridaśā vrajantu tridiveśatām  || 210.19 ||
tadatītaṃ jagannātha varṣāṇāmadhikaṃ śatam  |
idānīṃ gamyatāṃ svargo bhavatā yadi rocate  || 210.20 ||
devairvijñāpito devo'pyathātraiva ratistava  |
tatsthīyatāṃ yathākālamākhyeyamanujīvibhiḥ  || 210.21 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
yattvamātthākhilaṃ dūta vedmi caitadahaṃ punaḥ  |
prārabdha eva hi mayā yādavānāmapi kṣayaḥ  || 210.22 ||
bhuvo nāmātibhāro'yaṃ yādavairanibarhitaiḥ  |
avatāraṃ karomyasya saptarātreṇa satvaraḥ  || 210.23 ||
yathāgṛhītaṃ cāmbhodhau hṛtvāhaṃ dvārakāṃ punaḥ  |
yādavānupasaṃhṛtya yāsyāmi tridaśālayam  || 210.24 ||
manuṣyadehamutsṛjya saṃkarṣaṇasahāyavān  |
prāpta evāsmi mantavyo devendreṇa tathā suraiḥ  || 210.25 ||
jarāsaṃdhādayo ye'nye nihatā bhārahetavaḥ  |
kṣitestebhyaḥ sa bhāro hi yadūnāṃ samadhīyata  || 210.26 ||
tadetatsumahābhāramavatārya kṣiteraham  |
yāsyāmyamaralokasya pālanāya bravīhi tān  || 210.27 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityukto vāsudevena devadūtaḥ praṇamya tam  |
dvijāḥ sa divyayā gatyā devarājāntikaṃ yayau  || 210.28 ||
bhagavānapyathotpātān divyān bhaumāntarikṣagān  |
dadarśa dvārakāpuryāṃ vināśāya divāniśam  || 210.29 ||
tān dṛṣṭvā yādavānāha paśyadhvamatidāruṇān  |
mahotpātāñśamāyaiṣāṃ prabhāsaṃ yāma mā ciram  || 210.30 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
mahābhāgavataḥ prāha praṇipatyoddhavo harim  ||* 210.31 ||
{uddhava uvāca̱ }
bhagavan yanmayā kāryaṃ tadājñāpaya sāṃpratam  |
manye kulamidaṃ sarvaṃ bhagavān saṃhariṣyati  |
nāśāyāsya nimittāni kulasyācyuta lakṣaye  || 210.32 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
gaccha tvaṃ divyayā gatyā matprasādasamutthayā  |
badarīmāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ gandhamādanaparvate  || 210.33 ||
naranārāyaṇasthāne pavitritamahītale  |
manmanā matprasādena tatra siddhimavāpsyasi  || 210.34 ||
ahaṃ svargaṃ gamiṣyāmi upasaṃhṛtya vai kulam  |
dvārakāṃ ca mayā tyaktāṃ samudraḥ plāvayiṣyati  || 210.35 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktaḥ praṇipatyainaṃ jagāma sa tadoddhavaḥ  |
naranārāyaṇasthānaṃ keśavenānumoditaḥ  || 210.36 ||
tataste yādavāḥ sarve rathānāruhya śīghragān  |
prabhāsaṃ prayayuḥ sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇarāmādibhirdvijāḥ  || 210.37 ||
prāpya prabhāsaṃ prayatā prītāste kukkurāndhakāḥ  |
cakrustatra surāpānaṃ vāsudevānumoditāḥ  || 210.38 ||
pibatāṃ tatra vai teṣāṃ saṃgharṣeṇa parasparam  |
yādavānāṃ tato jajñe kalahāgniḥ kṣayāvahaḥ  || 210.39 ||
jaghnuḥ parasparaṃ te tu śastrairdaivabalātkṛtāḥ  |
kṣīṇaśastrāstu jagṛhuḥ pratyāsannāmathairakām  || 210.40 ||
erakā tu gṛhītā tairvajrabhūteva lakṣyate  |
tayā parasparaṃ jaghnuḥ saṃprahāraiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ  || 210.41 ||
pradyumnasāmbapramukhāḥ kṛtavarmātha sātyakiḥ  |
aniruddhādayaścānye pṛthurvipṛthureva ca  || 210.42 ||
cāruvarmā sucāruśca tathākrūrādayo dvijāḥ  |
erakārūpibhirvajraiste nijaghnuḥ parasparam  || 210.43 ||
nivārayāmāsa hariryādavāste ca keśavam  |
sahāyaṃ menire prāptaṃ te nijaghnuḥ parasparam  || 210.44 ||
kṛṣṇo'pi kupitasteṣāmerakāmuṣṭimādade  |
vadhāya teṣāṃ muśalaṃ muṣṭilohamabhūttadā  || 210.45 ||
jaghāna tena niḥśeṣānātatāyī sa yādavān  |
jaghnuśca sahasābhyetya tathānye tu parasparam  || 210.46 ||
tataścārṇavamadhyena jaitro'sau cakriṇo rathaḥ  |
paśyato dārukasyāśu hṛto'śvairdvijasattamāḥ  || 210.47 ||
cakraṃ gadā tathā śārṅgaṃ tūṇau śaṅkho'sireva ca  |
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā jagmurādityavartmanā  || 210.48 ||
kṣaṇamātreṇa vai tatra yādavānāmabhūtkṣayaḥ  |
ṛte kṛṣṇaṃ mahābāhuṃ dārukaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  || 210.49 ||
caṅkramyamāṇau tau rāmaṃ vṛkṣamūlakṛtāsanam  |
dadṛśāte mukhāccāsya niṣkrāmantaṃ mahoragam  || 210.50 ||
niṣkramya sa mukhāttasya mahābhogo bhujaṃgamaḥ  |
prayātaścārṇavaṃ siddhaiḥ pūjyamānastathoragaiḥ  || 210.51 ||
tamarghyamādāya tadā jaladhiḥ saṃmukhaṃ yayau  |
praviveśa ca tattoyaṃ pūjitaḥ pannagottamaiḥ  |
dṛṣṭvā balasya niryāṇaṃ dārukaṃ prāha keśavaḥ  || 210.52 ||
{śrībhagavānuvāca̱ }
idaṃ sarvaṃ tvamācakṣva vasudevograsenayoḥ  |
niryāṇaṃ baladevasya yādavānāṃ tathā kṣayam  || 210.53 ||
yoge sthitvāhamapyetatparityajya kalevaram  |
vācyaśca dvārakāvāsī janaḥ sarvastathāhukaḥ  || 210.54 ||
yathemāṃ nagarīṃ sarvāṃ samudraḥ plāvayiṣyati  |
tasmādrathaiḥ susajjaistu pratīkṣyo hyarjunāgamaḥ  || 210.55 ||
na stheyaṃ dvārakāmadhye niṣkrānte tatra pāṇḍave  |
tenaiva saha gantavyaṃ yatra yāti sa kauravaḥ  || 210.56 ||
gatvā ca brūhi kaunteyamarjunaṃ vacanaṃ mama  |
pālanīyastvayā śaktyā jano'yaṃ matparigrahaḥ  || 210.57 ||
ityarjunena sahito dvāravatyāṃ bhavāñjanam  |
gṛhītvā yātu vajraśca yadurājo bhaviṣyati  || 210.58 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityukto dārukaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ  |
pradakṣiṇaṃ ca bahuśaḥ kṛtvā prāyādyathoditam  || 211.1 ||
sa ca gatvā tathā cakre dvārakāyāṃ tathārjunam  |
ānināya mahābuddhiṃ vajraṃ cakre tathā nṛpam  || 211.2 ||
bhagavānapi govindo vāsudevātmakaṃ param  |
brahmātmani samāropya sarvabhūteṣvadhārayat || 211.3 ||
sa mānayan dvijavaco durvāsā yaduvāca ha  |
yogayukto'bhavatpādaṃ kṛtvā jānuni sattamāḥ  || 211.4 ||
saṃprāpto vai jarā nāma tadā tatra sa lubdhakaḥ  |
muśalaśeṣalohasya sāyakaṃ dhārayan param  || 211.5 ||
sa tatpādaṃ mṛgākāraṃ samavekṣya vyavasthitaḥ  |
tato vivyādha tenaiva tomareṇa dvijottamāḥ  || 211.6 ||
gataśca dadṛśe tatra caturbāhudharaṃ naram  |
praṇipatyāha caivainaṃ prasīdeti punaḥ punaḥ  || 211.7 ||
ajānatā kṛtamidaṃ mayā hariṇaśaṅkayā  |
kṣamyatāmātmapāpena dagdhaṃ mā dagdhumarhasi  || 211.8 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tatastaṃ bhagavānāha nāsti te bhayamaṇvapi  |
gaccha tvaṃ matprasādena lubdha svargeśvarāspadam  || 211.9 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
vimānamāgataṃ sadyastadvākyasamanantaram  |
āruhya prayayau svargaṃ lubdhakastatprasādataḥ  || 211.10 ||
gate tasmin sa bhagavān saṃyojyātmānamātmani  |
brahmabhūte'vyaye'cintye vāsudevamaye'male  || 211.11 ||
ajanmanyajare'nāśinyaprameye'khilātmani  |
tyaktvā sa mānuṣaṃ dehamavāpa trividhāṃ gatim  || 211.12 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
arjuno'pi tadānviṣya kṛṣṇarāmakalevare  |
saṃskāraṃ lambhayāmāsa tathānyeṣāmanukramāt || 212.1 ||
aṣṭau mahiṣyaḥ kathitā rukmiṇīpramukhāstu yāḥ  |
upagṛhya harerdehaṃ viviśustā hutāśanam  || 212.2 ||
revatī caiva rāmasya dehamāśliṣya sattamāḥ  |
viveśa jvalitaṃ vahniṃ tatsaṅgāhlādaśītalam  || 212.3 ||
ugrasenastu tacchrutvā tathaivānakadundubhiḥ  |
devakī rohiṇī caiva viviśurjātavedasam  || 212.4 ||
tato'rjunaḥ pretakāryaṃ kṛtvā teṣāṃ yathāvidhi  |
niścakrāma janaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhītvā vajrameva ca  || 212.5 ||
dvāravatyā viniṣkrāntāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ sahasraśaḥ  |
vajraṃ janaṃ ca kaunteyaḥ pālayañśanakairyayau  || 212.6 ||
sabhā sudharmā kṛṣṇena martyaloke samāhṛtā  |
svargaṃ jagāma bho viprāḥ pārijātaśca pādapaḥ  || 212.7 ||
yasmin dine hariryāto divaṃ saṃtyajya medinīm  |
tasmin dine'vatīrṇo'yaṃ kālakāyaḥ kaliḥ kila  || 212.8 ||
plāvayāmāsa tāṃ śūnyāṃ dvārakāṃ ca mahodadhiḥ  |
yaduśreṣṭhagṛhaṃ tvekaṃ nāplāvayata sāgaraḥ  || 212.9 ||
nātikrāmati bho viprāstadadyāpi mahodadhiḥ  |
nityaṃ saṃnihitastatra bhagavān keśavo yataḥ  || 212.10 ||
tadatīva mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam  |
viṣṇukrīḍānvitaṃ sthānaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpātpramucyate  || 212.11 ||
pārthaḥ pañcanade deśe bahudhānyadhanānvite  |
cakāra vāsaṃ sarvasya janasya munisattamāḥ  || 212.12 ||
tato lobhaḥ samabhavatpārthenaikena dhanvinā  |
dṛṣṭvā striyo nīyamānā dasyūnāṃ nihateśvarāḥ  || 212.13 ||
tataste pāpakarmāṇo lobhopahatacetasaḥ  |
ābhīrā mantrayāmāsuḥ sametyātyantadurmadāḥ  || 212.14 ||
{ābhīrā ūcu̱ḥ }
ayameko'rjuno dhanvī strījanaṃ nihateśvaram  |
nayatyasmānatikramya dhigetatkriyatāṃ balam  || 212.15 ||
hatvā garvasamārūḍho bhīṣmadroṇajayadrathān  |
karṇādīṃśca na jānāti balaṃ grāmanivāsinām  || 212.16 ||
balajyeṣṭhānnarānanyān grāmyāṃścaiva viśeṣataḥ  |
sarvānevāvajānāti kiṃ vo bahubhiruttaraiḥ  || 212.17 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tato yaṣṭipraharaṇā dasyavo loṣṭahāriṇaḥ  |
sahasraśo'bhyadhāvanta taṃ janaṃ nihateśvaram  |
tato nivṛttaḥ kaunteyaḥ prāhābhīrān hasanniva  || 212.18 ||
{arjuna uvāca̱ }
nivartadhvamadharmajñā yadīto na mumūrṣavaḥ  ||* 212.19 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
avajñāya vacastasya jagṛhuste tadā dhanam  |
strījanaṃ cāpi kaunteyādviṣvaksenaparigraham  || 212.20 ||
tato'rjuno dhanurdivyaṃ gāṇḍīvamajaraṃ yudhi  |
āropayitumārebhe na śaśāka sa vīryavān  || 212.21 ||
cakāra sajjaṃ kṛcchrāttu tadabhūcchithilaṃ punaḥ  |
na sasmāra tathāstrāṇi cintayannapi pāṇḍavaḥ  || 212.22 ||
śarānmumoca caiteṣu pārthaḥ śeṣān sa harṣitaḥ  |
na bhedaṃ te paraṃ cakrurastā gāṇḍīvadhanvanā  || 212.23 ||
vahninā cākṣayā dattāḥ śarāste'pi kṣayaṃ yayuḥ  |
yudhyataḥ saha gopālairarjunasyābhavatkṣayaḥ  || 212.24 ||
acintayattu kaunteyaḥ kṛṣṇasyaiva hi tadbalam  |
yanmayā śarasaṃghātaiḥ sabalā bhūbhṛto jitāḥ  || 212.25 ||
miṣataḥ pāṇḍuputrasya tatastāḥ pramadottamāḥ  |
apākṛṣyanta cābhīraiḥ kāmāccānyāḥ pravavrajuḥ  || 212.26 ||
tataḥ śareṣu kṣīṇeṣu dhanuṣkoṭyā dhanaṃjayaḥ  |
jaghāna dasyūṃste cāsya prahārāñjahasurdvijāḥ  || 212.27 ||
paśyatastveva pārthasya vṛṣṇyandhakavarastriyaḥ  |
jagmurādāya te mlecchāḥ samantānmunisattamāḥ  || 212.28 ||
tataḥ sa duḥkhito jiṣṇuḥ kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭamiti bruvan  |
aho bhagavatā tena mukto'smīti ruroda vai  || 212.29 ||
{arjuna uvāca̱ }
taddhanustāni cāstrāṇi sa rathaste ca vājinaḥ  |
sarvamekapade naṣṭaṃ dānamaśrotriye yathā  || 212.30 ||
aho cāti balaṃ daivaṃ vinā tena mahātmanā  |
yadasāmarthyayukto'haṃ nīcairnītaḥ parābhavam  || 212.31 ||
tau bāhū sa ca me muṣṭiḥ sthānaṃ tatso'smi cārjunaḥ  |
puṇyeneva vinā tena gataṃ sarvamasāratām  || 212.32 ||
mamārjunatvaṃ bhīmasya bhīmatvaṃ tatkṛtaṃ dhruvam  |
vinā tena yadābhīrairjito'haṃ kathamanyathā  || 212.33 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
itthaṃ vadan yayau jiṣṇurindraprasthaṃ purottamam  |
cakāra tatra rājānaṃ vajraṃ yādavanandanam  || 212.34 ||
sa dadarśa tato vyāsaṃ phālgunaḥ kānanāśrayam  |
tamupetya mahābhāgaṃ vinayenābhyavādayat || 212.35 ||
taṃ vandamānaṃ caraṇāvavalokya suniścitam  |
uvāca pārthaṃ vicchāyaḥ kathamatyantamīdṛśaḥ  || 212.36 ||
ajārajonugamanaṃ brahmahatyāthavā kṛtā  |
jayāśābhaṅgaduḥkhī vā bhraṣṭacchāyo'si sāṃpratam  || 212.37 ||
sāṃtānikādayo vā te yācamānā nirākṛtāḥ  |
agamyastrīratirvāpi tenāsi vigataprabhaḥ  || 212.38 ||
bhuṅkte pradāya viprebhyo miṣṭamekamatho bhavān  |
kiṃ vā kṛpaṇavittāni hṛtāni bhavatārjuna  || 212.39 ||
kaccinna sūryavātasya gocaratvaṃ gato'rjuna  |
duṣṭacakṣurhato vāpi niḥśrīkaḥ kathamanyathā  || 212.40 ||
spṛṣṭo nakhāmbhasā vāpi ghaṭāmbhaḥprokṣito'pi vā  |
tenātīvāsi vicchāyo nyūnairvā yudhi nirjitaḥ  || 212.41 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tataḥ pārtho viniḥśvasya śrūyatāṃ bhagavanniti  |
prokto yathāvadācaṣṭa viprā ātmaparābhavam  || 212.42 ||
{arjuna uvāca̱ }
yadbalaṃ yacca nastejo yadvīryaṃ yatparākramaḥ  |
yā śrīśchāyā ca naḥ so'smān parityajya harirgataḥ  || 212.43 ||
itareṇeva mahatā smitapūrvābhibhāṣiṇā  |
hīnā vayaṃ mune tena jātāstṛṇamayā iva  || 212.44 ||
astrāṇāṃ sāyakānāṃ ca gāṇḍīvasya tathā mama  |
sāratā yābhavanmūrtā sa gataḥ puruṣottamaḥ  || 212.45 ||
yasyāvalokanādasmāñśrīrjayaḥ saṃpadunnatiḥ  |
na tatyāja sa govindastyaktvāsmān bhagavān gataḥ  || 212.46 ||
bhīṣmadroṇāṅgarājādyāstathā duryodhanādayaḥ  |
yatprabhāvena nirdagdhāḥ sa kṛṣṇastyaktavān bhuvam  || 212.47 ||
niryauvanā hataśrīkā bhraṣṭacchāyeva me mahī  |
vibhāti tāta naiko'haṃ virahe tasya cakriṇaḥ  || 212.48 ||
yasyānubhāvādbhīṣmādyairmayyagnau śalabhāyitam  |
vinā tenādya kṛṣṇena gopālairasmi nirjitaḥ  || 212.49 ||
gāṇḍīvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu khyātaṃ yadanubhāvataḥ  |
mama tena vinābhīrairlaguḍaistu tiraskṛtam  || 212.50 ||
strīsahasrāṇyanekāni hyanāthāni mahāmune  |
yatato mama nītāni dasyubhirlaguḍāyudhaiḥ  || 212.51 ||
ānīyamānamābhīraiḥ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇāvarodhanam  |
hṛtaṃ yaṣṭipraharaṇaiḥ paribhūya balaṃ mama  || 212.52 ||
niḥśrīkatā na me citraṃ yajjīvāmi tadadbhutam  |
nīcāvamānapaṅkāṅkī nirlajjo'smi pitāmaha  || 212.53 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śrutvāhaṃ tasya tadvākyamabravaṃ dvijasattamāḥ  |
duḥkhitasya ca dīnasya pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ  || 212.54 ||
alaṃ te vrīḍayā pārtha na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi  |
avehi sarvabhūteṣu kālasya gatirīdṛśī  || 212.55 ||
kālo bhavāya bhūtānāmabhavāya ca pāṇḍava  |
kālamūlamidaṃ jñātvā kuru sthairyamato'rjuna  || 212.56 ||
nadyaḥ samudrā girayaḥ sakalā ca vasuṃdharā  |
devā manuṣyāḥ paśavastaravaśca sarīsṛpāḥ  || 212.57 ||
sṛṣṭāḥ kālena kālena punaryāsyanti saṃkṣayam  |
kālātmakamidaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā śamamavāpnuhi  || 212.58 ||
yathāttha kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ tattathaiva dhanaṃjaya  |
bhārāvatārakāryārthamavatīrṇaḥ sa medinīm  || 212.59 ||
bhārākrāntā dharā yātā devānāṃ saṃnidhau purā  |
tadarthamavatīrṇo'sau kāmarūpī janārdanaḥ  || 212.60 ||
tacca niṣpāditaṃ kāryamaśeṣā bhūbhṛto hatāḥ  |
vṛṣṇyandhakakulaṃ sarvaṃ tathā pārthopasaṃhṛtam  || 212.61 ||
na kiṃcidanyatkartavyamasya bhūmitale'rjuna  |
tato gataḥ sa bhagavān kṛtakṛtyo yathecchayā  || 212.62 ||
sṛṣṭiṃ sarge karotyeṣa devadevaḥ sthitiṃ sthitau  |
ante tāpasamartho'yaṃ sāṃprataṃ vai yathā kṛtam  || 212.63 ||
tasmātpārtha na saṃtāpastvayā kāryaḥ parābhavāt |
bhavanti bhavakāleṣu puruṣāṇāṃ parākramāḥ  || 212.64 ||
yatastvayaikena hatā bhīṣmadroṇādayo nṛpāḥ  |
teṣāmarjuna kālotthaḥ kiṃ nyūnābhibhavo na saḥ  || 212.65 ||
viṣṇostasyānubhāvena yathā teṣāṃ parābhavaḥ  |
tvattastathaiva bhavato dasyubhyo'nte tadudbhavaḥ  || 212.66 ||
sa devo'nyaśarīrāṇi samāviśya jagatsthitim  |
karoti sarvabhūtānāṃ nāśaṃ cānte jagatpatiḥ  || 212.67 ||
bhavodbhave ca kaunteya sahāyaste janārdanaḥ  |
bhavānte tvadvipakṣāste keśavenāvalokitāḥ  || 212.68 ||
kaḥ śraddadhyātsagāṅgeyān hanyāstvaṃ sarvakauravān  |
ābhīrebhyaśca bhavataḥ kaḥ śraddadhyātparābhavam  || 212.69 ||
pārthaitatsarvabhūteṣu harerlīlāviceṣṭitam  |
tvayā yatkauravā dhvastā yadābhīrairbhavāñjitaḥ  || 212.70 ||
gṛhītā dasyubhiryacca rakṣitā bhavatā striyaḥ  |
tadapyahaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ kathayāmi tavārjuna  || 212.71 ||
aṣṭāvakraḥ purā vipra udavāsarato'bhavat |
bahūn varṣagaṇān pārtha gṛṇan brahma sanātanam  || 212.72 ||
jiteṣvasurasaṃgheṣu merupṛṣṭhe mahotsavaḥ  |
babhūva tatra gacchantyo dadṛśustaṃ surastriyaḥ  || 212.73 ||
rambhātilottamādyāśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ  |
tuṣṭuvustaṃ mahātmānaṃ praśaśaṃsuśca pāṇḍava  || 212.74 ||
ākaṇṭhamagnaṃ salile jaṭābhāradharaṃ munim  |
vinayāvanatāścaiva praṇemuḥ stotratatparāḥ  || 212.75 ||
yathā yathā prasanno'bhūttuṣṭuvustaṃ tathā tathā  |
sarvāstāḥ kauravaśreṣṭha variṣṭhaṃ taṃ dvijanmanām  || 212.76 ||
{aṣṭāvakra uvāca̱ }
prasanno'haṃ mahābhāgā bhavatīnāṃ yadiṣyate  |
mattastadvriyatāṃ sarvaṃ pradāsyāmyapi durlabham  || 212.77 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
rambhātilottamādyāśca divyāścāpsaraso'bruvan  ||* 212.78 ||
{apsarasa ūcu̱ḥ }
prasanne tvayyasaṃprāptaṃ kimasmākamiti dvijāḥ  ||* 212.79 ||
itarāstvabruvan vipra prasanno bhagavan yadi  |
tadicchāmaḥ patiṃ prāptuṃ viprendra puruṣottamam  || 212.80 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā uttatāra jalānmuniḥ  |
tamuttīrṇaṃ ca dadṛśurvirūpaṃ vakramaṣṭadhā  || 212.81 ||
taṃ dṛṣṭvā gūhamānānāṃ yāsāṃ hāsaḥ sphuṭo'bhavat |
tāḥ śaśāpa muniḥ kopamavāpya kurunandana  || 212.82 ||
{aṣṭāvakra uvāca̱ }
yasmādvirūparūpaṃ māṃ matvā hāsāvamānanā  |
bhavatībhiḥ kṛtā tasmādeṣa śāpaṃ dadāmi vaḥ  || 212.83 ||
matprasādena bhartāraṃ labdhvā tu puruṣottamam  |
macchāpopahatāḥ sarvā dasyuhastaṃ gamiṣyatha  || 212.84 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityudīritamākarṇya munistābhiḥ prasāditaḥ  |
punaḥ surendralokaṃ vai prāha bhūyo gamiṣyatha  || 212.85 ||
evaṃ tasya muneḥ śāpādaṣṭāvakrasya keśavam  |
bhartāraṃ prāpya tāḥ prāptā dasyuhastaṃ varāṅganāḥ  || 212.86 ||
tattvayā nātra kartavyaḥ śoko'lpo'pi hi pāṇḍava  |
tenaivākhilanāthena sarvaṃ tadupasaṃhṛtam  || 212.87 ||
bhavatāṃ copasaṃhāramāsannaṃ tena kurvatā  |
balaṃ tejastathā vīryaṃ māhātmyaṃ copasaṃhṛtam  || 212.88 ||
jātasya niyato mṛtyuḥ patanaṃ ca tathonnateḥ  |
viprayogāvasānaṃ tu saṃyogaḥ saṃcayaḥ kṣayaḥ  || 212.89 ||
vijñāya na budhāḥ śokaṃ na harṣamupayānti ye  |
teṣāmevetare ceṣṭāṃ śikṣantaḥ santi tādṛśāḥ  || 212.90 ||
tasmāttvayā naraśreṣṭha jñātvaitadbhrātṛbhiḥ saha  |
parityajyākhilaṃ rājyaṃ gantavyaṃ tapase vanam  || 212.91 ||
tadgaccha dharmarājāya nivedyaitadvaco mama  |
paraśvo bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ gatiṃ vīra yathā kuru  || 212.92 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityukto dharmarājaṃ tu samabhyetya tathoktavān  |
dṛṣṭaṃ caivānubhūtaṃ vā kathitaṃ tadaśeṣataḥ  || 212.93 ||
vyāsavākyaṃ ca te sarve śrutvārjunasamīritam  |
rājye parīkṣitaṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ pāṇḍusutā vanam  || 212.94 ||
ityevaṃ vo muniśreṣṭhā vistareṇa mayoditam  |
jātasya ca yadorvaṃśe vāsudevasya ceṣṭitam  || 212.95 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
aho kṛṣṇasya māhātmyamadbhutaṃ cātimānuṣam  |
rāmasya ca muniśreṣṭha tvayoktaṃ bhuvi durlabham  || 213.1 ||
na tṛptimadhigacchāmaḥ śṛṇvanto bhagavatkathām  |
tasmādbrūhi mahābhāga bhūyo devasya ceṣṭitam  || 213.2 ||
prādurbhāvaḥ purāṇeṣu viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ  |
satāṃ kathayatāmeva varāha iti naḥ śrutam  || 213.3 ||
na jānīmo'sya caritaṃ na vidhiṃ na ca vistaram  |
na karmaguṇasadbhāvaṃ na hetutvamanīṣitam  || 213.4 ||
kimātmako varāho'sau kā mūrtiḥ kā ca devatā  |
kimācāraprabhāvo vā kiṃ vā tena tadā kṛtam  || 213.5 ||
yajñārthe samavetānāṃ miṣatāṃ ca dvijanmanām  |
mahāvarāhacaritaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham  || 213.6 ||
yathā nārāyaṇo brahman vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ  |
daṃṣṭrayā gāṃ samudrasthāmujjahārārimardanaḥ  || 213.7 ||
vistareṇaiva karmāṇi sarvāṇi ripughātinaḥ  |
śrotuṃ no vartate buddhirhareḥ kṛṣṇasya dhīmataḥ  || 213.8 ||
karmaṇāmānupūrvyā ca prādurbhāvāśca ye vibho  |
yā vāsya prakṛtirbrahmaṃstāścākhyātuṃ tvamarhasi  || 213.9 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
praśnabhāro mahāneṣa bhavadbhiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ  |
yathāśaktyā tu vakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yaśaḥ  || 213.10 ||
viṣṇoḥ prabhāvaśravaṇe diṣṭyā vo matirutthitā  |
tasmādviṣṇoḥ samastā vai śṛṇudhvaṃ yāḥ pravṛttayaḥ  || 213.11 ||
sahasrāsyaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ sahasracaraṇaṃ ca yam  |
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ sahasrakaramavyayam  || 213.12 ||
sahasrajihvaṃ bhāsvantaṃ sahasramukuṭaṃ prabhum  |
sahasradaṃ sahasrādiṃ sahasrabhujamavyayam  || 213.13 ||
havanaṃ savanaṃ caiva hotāraṃ havyameva ca  |
pātrāṇi ca pavitrāṇi vediṃ dīkṣāṃ samitsruvam  || 213.14 ||
sruksomasūryamuśalaṃ prokṣaṇīṃ dakṣiṇāyanam  |
adhvaryuṃ sāmagaṃ vipraṃ sadasyaṃ sadanaṃ sadaḥ  || 213.15 ||
yūpaṃ cakraṃ dhruvāṃ darvīṃ carūṃścolūkhalāni ca  |
prāgvaṃśaṃ yajñabhūmiṃ ca hotāraṃ ca paraṃ ca yat || 213.16 ||
hrasvāṇyatipramāṇāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca  |
prāyaścittāni vārghyaṃ ca sthaṇḍilāni kuśāstathā  || 213.17 ||
mantrayajñavahaṃ vahniṃ bhāgaṃ bhāgavahaṃ ca yat |
agrāsinaṃ somabhujaṃ hutārciṣamudāyudham  || 213.18 ||
āhurvedavido viprā yaṃ yajñe śāśvataṃ prabhum  |
tasya viṣṇoḥ sureśasya śrīvatsāṅkasya dhīmataḥ  || 213.19 ||
prādurbhāvasahasrāṇi samatītānyanekaśaḥ  |
bhūyaścaiva bhaviṣyanti hyevamāha pitāmahaḥ  || 213.20 ||
yatpṛcchadhvaṃ mahābhāgā divyāṃ puṇyāmimāṃ kathām  |
prādurbhāvāśritāṃ viṣṇoḥ sarvapāpaharāṃ śivām  || 213.21 ||
śṛṇudhvaṃ tāṃ mahābhāgāstadgatenāntarātmanā  |
pravakṣyāmyānupūrvyeṇa yatpṛcchadhvaṃ mamānaghāḥ  || 213.22 ||
vāsudevasya māhātmyaṃ caritaṃ ca mahāmateḥ  |
hitārthaṃ suramartyānāṃ lokānāṃ prabhavāya ca  || 213.23 ||
bahuśaḥ sarvabhūtātmā prādurbhavati vīryavān  |
prādurbhāvāṃśca vakṣyāmi puṇyān divyān guṇānvitān  || 213.24 ||
supto yugasahasraṃ yaḥ prādurbhavati kāryataḥ  |
pūrṇe yugasahasre'tha devadevo jagatpatiḥ  || 213.25 ||
brahmā ca kapilaścaiva tryambakastridaśāstathā  |
devāḥ saptarṣayaścaiva nāgāścāpsarasastathā  || 213.26 ||
sanatkumāraśca mahānubhāvo  213.27
manurmahātmā bhagavān prajākaraḥ  213.27
purāṇadevo'tha purāṇi cakre  213.27
pradīptavaiśvānaratulyatejāḥ  213.27
yo'sau cārṇavamadhyastho naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame  |
naṣṭe devāsuranare pranaṣṭoragarākṣase  || 213.28 ||
yoddhukāmau durādharṣau tāvubhau madhukaiṭabhau  |
hatau bhagavatā tena tayordattvāmitaṃ varam  || 213.29 ||
purā kamalanābhasya svapataḥ sāgarāmbhasi  |
puṣkare tatra saṃbhūtā devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstathā  || 213.30 ||
eṣa pauṣkarako nāma prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ  |
purāṇaṃ kathyate yatra devaśrutisamāhitam  || 213.31 ||
vārāhastu śrutimukhaḥ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ  |
yatra viṣṇuḥ suraśreṣṭho vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ  || 213.32 ||
vedapādo yūpadaṃṣṭraḥ kratudantaścitīmukhaḥ  |
agnijihvo darbharomā brahmaśīrṣo mahātapāḥ  || 213.33 ||
ahorātrekṣaṇo divyo vedāṅgaḥ śrutibhūṣaṇaḥ  |
ājyanāsaḥ sruvatuṇḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvaro mahān  || 213.34 ||
satyadharmamayaḥ śrīmān kramavikramasatkṛtaḥ  |
prāyaścittanakho ghoraḥ paśujānurmukhākṛtiḥ  || 213.35 ||
udgatāntro homaliṅgo bījauṣadhimahāphalaḥ  |
vādyantarātmā mantrasphigvikṛtaḥ somaśoṇitaḥ  || 213.36 ||
vediskandho havirgandho havyakavyātivegavān  |
prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimānnānādīkṣābhiranvitaḥ  || 213.37 ||
dakṣiṇāhṛdayo yogī mahāsattramayo mahān  |
upākarmāṣṭarucakaḥ pravargāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ  || 213.38 ||
nānācchandogatipatho guhyopaniṣadāsanaḥ  |
chāyāpatnīsahāyo'sau maṇiśṛṅga ivotthitaḥ  || 213.39 ||
mahīṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ saśailavanakānanām  |
ekārṇavajalabhraṣṭāmekārṇavagataḥ prabhuḥ  || 213.40 ||
daṃṣṭrayā yaḥ samuddhṛtya lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  |
sahasraśīrṣo lokādiścakāra jagatīṃ punaḥ  || 213.41 ||
evaṃ yajñavarāheṇa bhūtvā bhūtahitārthinā  |
uddhṛtā pṛthivī devī sāgarāmbudharā purā  || 213.42 ||
vārāha eṣa kathito nārasiṃhastato dvijāḥ  |
yatra bhūtvā mṛgendreṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ  || 213.43 ||
purā kṛtayuge nāma surārirbaladarpitaḥ  |
daityānāmādipuruṣaścakāra sumahattapaḥ  || 213.44 ||
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi śatāni daśa pañca ca  |
japopavāsaniratastasthau maunavratasthitaḥ  || 213.45 ||
tataḥ śamadamābhyāṃ ca brahmacaryeṇa caiva hi  |
prīto'bhavattatastasya tapasā niyamena ca  || 213.46 ||
taṃ vai svayaṃbhūrbhagavān svayamāgamya bho dvijāḥ  |
vimānenārkavarṇena haṃsayuktena bhāsvatā  || 213.47 ||
ādityairvasubhiḥ sārdhaṃ marudbhirdaivataistathā  |
rudrairviśvasahāyaiśca yakṣarākṣasakiṃnaraiḥ  || 213.48 ||
diśābhiḥ pradiśābhiśca nadībhiḥ sāgaraistathā  |
nakṣatraiśca muhūrtaiśca khecaraiśca mahāgrahaiḥ  || 213.49 ||
devarṣibhistapovṛddhaiḥ siddhairvidvadbhireva ca  |
rājarṣibhiḥ puṇyatamairgandharvairapsarogaṇaiḥ  || 213.50 ||
carācaraguruḥ śrīmān vṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ suraistathā  |
brahmā brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭho daityaṃ vacanamabravīt || 213.51 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
prīto'smi tava bhaktasya tapasānena suvrata  |
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuhi  || 213.52 ||
{hiraṇyakaśipuruvāca̱ }
na devāsuragandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ  |
ṛṣayo vātha māṃ śāpaiḥ kruddhā lokapitāmaha  || 213.53 ||
śapeyustapasā yuktā vara eṣa vṛto mayā  |
na śastreṇa na vāstreṇa giriṇā pādapena vā  || 213.54 ||
na śuṣkeṇa na cārdreṇa na caivordhvaṃ na cāpyadhaḥ  |
pāṇiprahāreṇaikena sabhṛtyabalavāhanam  || 213.55 ||
yo māṃ nāśayituṃ śaktaḥ sa me mṛtyurbhaviṣyati  |
bhaveyamahamevārkaḥ somo vāyurhutāśanaḥ  || 213.56 ||
salilaṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca ākāśaṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ  |
ahaṃ krodhaśca kāmaśca varuṇo vāsavo yamaḥ  |
dhanadaśca dhanādhyakṣo yakṣaḥ kiṃpuruṣādhipaḥ  || 213.57 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
ete divyā varāstāta mayā dattāstavādbhutāḥ  |
sarvān kāmānimāṃstāta prāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  || 213.58 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evamuktvā tu bhagavāñjagāmāśu pitāmahaḥ  |
vairājaṃ brahmasadanaṃ brahmarṣigaṇasevitam  || 213.59 ||
tato devāśca nāgāśca gandharvā munayastathā  |
varapradānaṃ śrutvaiva pitāmahamupasthitāḥ  || 213.60 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
vareṇānena bhagavan bādhiṣyati sa no'suraḥ  |
tatprasīdāśu bhagavan vadho'pyasya vicintyatām  || 213.61 ||
bhagavan sarvabhūtānāṃ svayaṃbhūrādikṛtprabhuḥ  |
sraṣṭā ca havyakavyānāmavyaktaṃ prakṛtirdhruvam  || 213.62 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tato lokahitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā devaḥ prajāpatiḥ  |
provāca bhagavān vākyaṃ sarvadevagaṇāṃstathā  || 213.63 ||
{brahmovāca̱ }
avaśyaṃ tridaśāstena prāptavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam  |
tapaso'nte ca bhagavān vadhaṃ viṣṇuḥ kariṣyati  || 213.64 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
etacchrutvā surāḥ sarve vākyaṃ paṅkajajanmanaḥ  |
svāni sthānāni divyāni jagmuste vai mudānvitāḥ  || 213.65 ||
labdhamātre vare cāpi sarvāḥ so'bādhata prajāḥ  |
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo varadānena darpitaḥ  || 213.66 ||
āśrameṣu mahābhāgānmunīn vai saṃśitavratān  |
satyadharmaratān dāntāṃstadā dharṣitavāṃstathā  || 213.67 ||
tridivasthāṃstathā devān parājitya mahābalaḥ  |
trailokyaṃ vaśamānīya svarge vasati so'suraḥ  || 213.68 ||
yadā varamadonmatto vicaran dānavo bhuvi  |
yajñīyānakaroddaityānayajñīyāśca devatāḥ  || 213.69 ||
ādityā vasavaḥ sādhyā viśve ca marutastathā  |
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ viṣṇumupatasthurmahābalam  || 213.70 ||
devabrahmamayaṃ yajñaṃ brahmadevaṃ sanātanam  |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca prabhuṃ lokanamaskṛtam  |
nārāyaṇaṃ vibhuṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ  || 213.71 ||
{devā ūcu̱ḥ }
trāyasva no'dya deveśa hiraṇyakaśiporbhayāt |
tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo devastvaṃ hi naḥ paramo guruḥ  || 213.72 ||
tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo dhātā brahmādīnāṃ surottama  |
utphullāmalapattrākṣa śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkara  |
kṣayāya ditivaṃśasya śaraṇaṃ tvaṃ bhavasva naḥ  || 213.73 ||
{vāsudeva uvāca̱ }
bhayaṃ tyajadhvamamarā abhayaṃ vo dadāmyaham  |
tathaiva tridivaṃ devāḥ pratilapsyatha mā ciram  || 213.74 ||
eṣo'haṃ sagaṇaṃ daityaṃ varadānena darpitam  |
avadhyamamarendrāṇāṃ dānavendraṃ nihanmi tam  || 213.75 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evamuktvā tu bhagavān visṛjya tridaśeśvarān  |
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sthānamājagāma mahābalaḥ  || 213.76 ||
narasyārdhatanuṃ kṛtvā siṃhasyārdhatanuṃ prabhuḥ  |
nārasiṃhena vapuṣā pāṇiṃ saṃspṛśya pāṇinā  || 213.77 ||
ghanajīmūtasaṃkāśo ghanajīmūtanisvanaḥ  |
ghanajīmūtadīptaujā jīmūta iva vegavān  || 213.78 ||
daityaṃ so'tibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛptaśārdūlavikramaḥ  |
dṛptairdaityagaṇairguptaṃ hatavānekapāṇinā  || 213.79 ||
nṛsiṃha eṣa kathito bhūyo'yaṃ vāmanaḥ paraḥ  |
yatra vāmanamāsthāya rūpaṃ daityavināśanam  || 213.80 ||
balerbalavato yajñe balinā viṣṇunā purā  |
vikramaistribhirakṣobhyāḥ kṣobhitāste mahāsurāḥ  || 213.81 ||
vipracittiḥ śivaḥ śaṅkurayaḥśaṅkustathaiva ca  |
ayaḥśirā aśvaśirā hayagrīvaśca vīryavān  || 213.82 ||
vegavān ketumānugraḥ sogravyagro mahāsuraḥ  |
puṣkaraḥ puṣkalaścaiva śāśvo'śvapatireva ca  || 213.83 ||
prahlādo'śvapatiḥ kumbhaḥ saṃhrādo gamanapriyaḥ  |
anuhrādo harihayo vārāhaḥ saṃharo'nujaḥ  || 213.84 ||
śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva kupathaḥ krodhanaḥ krathaḥ  |
bṛhatkīrtirmahājihvaḥ śaṅkukarṇo mahāsvanaḥ  || 213.85 ||
dīptajihvo'rkanayano mṛgapādo mṛgapriyaḥ  |
vāyurgariṣṭho namuciḥ sambaro viskaro mahān  || 213.86 ||
candrahantā krodhahantā krodhavardhana eva ca  |
kālakaḥ kālakopaśca vṛtraḥ krodho virocanaḥ  || 213.87 ||
gariṣṭhaśca variṣṭhaśca pralambanarakāvubhau  |
indratāpanavātāpī ketumān baladarpitaḥ  || 213.88 ||
asilomā pulomā ca bāṣkalaḥ pramado madaḥ  |
svamiśraḥ kālavadanaḥ karālaḥ keśireva ca  || 213.89 ||
ekākṣaścandramā rāhuḥ saṃhrādaḥ sambaraḥ svanaḥ  |
śataghnīcakrahastāśca tathā muśalapāṇayaḥ  || 213.90 ||
aśvayantrāyudhopetā bhindipālāyudhāstathā  |
śūlolūkhalahastāśca paraśvadhadharāstathā  || 213.91 ||
pāśamudgarahastāśca tathā parighapāṇayaḥ  |
mahāśilāpraharaṇāḥ śūlahastāśca dānavāḥ  || 213.92 ||
nānāpraharaṇā ghorā nānāveśā mahābalāḥ  |
kūrmakukkuṭavaktrāśca śaśolūkamukhāstathā  || 213.93 ||
kharoṣṭravadanāścaiva varāhavadanāstathā  |
mārjāraśikhivaktrāśca mahāvaktrāstathā pare  || 213.94 ||
nakrameṣānanāḥ śūrā gojāvimahiṣānanāḥ  |
godhāśallakivaktrāśca kroṣṭuvaktrāśca dānavāḥ  || 213.95 ||
ākhudarduravaktrāśca ghorā vṛkamukhāstathā  |
bhīmā makaravaktrāśca krauñcavaktrāśca dānavāḥ  || 213.96 ||
aśvānanāḥ kharamukhā mayūravadanāstathā  |
gajendracarmavasanāstathā kṛṣṇājināmbarāḥ  || 213.97 ||
cīrasaṃvṛtagātrāśca tathā nīlakavāsasaḥ  |
uṣṇīṣiṇo mukuṭinastathā kuṇḍalino'surāḥ  || 213.98 ||
kirīṭino lambaśikhāḥ kambugrīvāḥ suvarcasaḥ  |
nānāveśadharā daityā nānāmālyānulepanāḥ  || 213.99 ||
svānyāyudhāni saṃgṛhya pradīptāni ca tejasā  |
kramamāṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśamupāvartanta sarvaśaḥ  || 213.100 ||
pramathya sarvān daiteyān pādahastatalairvibhuḥ  |
rūpaṃ kṛtvā mahābhīmaṃ jahārāśu sa medinīm  || 213.101 ||
tasya vikramato bhūmiṃ candrādityau stanāntare  |
nabhaḥ prakramamāṇasya nābhyāṃ kila tathā sthitau  || 213.102 ||
paramākramamāṇasya jānudeśe vyavasthitau  |
viṣṇoramitavīryasya vadantyevaṃ dvijātayaḥ  || 213.103 ||
hṛtvā sa medinīṃ kṛtsnāṃ hatvā cāsurapuṃgavān  |
dadau śakrāya vasudhāṃ viṣṇurbalavatāṃ varaḥ  || 213.104 ||
eṣa vo vāmano nāma prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ  |
vedavidbhirdvijairetatkathyate vaiṣṇavaṃ yaśaḥ  || 213.105 ||
bhūyo bhūtātmano viṣṇoḥ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ  |
dattātreya iti khyātaḥ kṣamayā parayā yutaḥ  || 213.106 ||
tena naṣṭeṣu vedeṣu prakriyāsu makheṣu ca  |
cāturvarṇye ca saṃkīrṇe dharme śithilatāṃ gate  || 213.107 ||
ativardhati cādharme satye naṣṭe'nṛte sthite  |
prajāsu śīryamāṇāsu dharme cākulatāṃ gate  || 213.108 ||
sayajñāḥ sakriyā vedāḥ pratyānītā hi tena vai  |
cāturvarṇyamasaṃkīrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tena mahātmanā  || 213.109 ||
tena haihayarājasya kārtavīryasya dhīmataḥ  |
varadena varo datto dattātreyeṇa dhīmatā  || 213.110 ||
etadbāhudvayaṃ yatte tatte mama kṛte nṛpa  |
śatāni daśa bāhūnāṃ bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ  || 213.111 ||
pālayiṣyasi kṛtsnāṃ ca vasudhāṃ vasudheśvara  |
durnirīkṣyo'rivṛndānāṃ yuddhasthaśca bhaviṣyasi  || 213.112 ||
eṣa vo vaiṣṇavaḥ śrīmān prādurbhāvo'dbhutaḥ śubhaḥ  |
bhūyaśca jāmadagnyo'yaṃ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ  || 213.113 ||
yatra bāhusahasreṇa dviṣatāṃ durjayaṃ raṇe  |
rāmo'rjunamanīkasthaṃ jaghāna nṛpatiṃ prabhuḥ  || 213.114 ||
rathasthaṃ pārthivaṃ rāmaḥ pātayitvārjunaṃ bhuvi  |
dharṣayitvārjunaṃ rāmaḥ krośamānaṃ ca meghavat || 213.115 ||
kṛtsnaṃ bāhusahasraṃ ca ciccheda bhṛgunandanaḥ  |
paraśvadhena dīptena jñātibhiḥ sahitasya vai  || 213.116 ||
kīrṇā kṣatriyakoṭībhirmerumandarabhūṣaṇā  |
triḥ saptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivī tena niḥkṣatriyā kṛtā  || 213.117 ||
kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ caināṃ bhārgavaḥ sumahāyaśāḥ  |
sarvapāpavināśāya vājimedhena ceṣṭavān  || 213.118 ||
yasmin yajñe mahādāne dakṣiṇāṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ  |
mārīcāya dadau prītaḥ kaśyapāya vasuṃdharām  || 213.119 ||
vāraṇāṃsturagāñśubhrān rathāṃśca rathināṃ varaḥ  |
hiraṇyamakṣayaṃ dhenurgajendrāṃśca mahīpatiḥ  || 213.120 ||
dadau tasminmahāyajñe vājimedhe mahāyaśāḥ  |
adyāpi ca hitārthāya lokānāṃ bhṛgunandanaḥ  || 213.121 ||
caramāṇastapo ghoraṃ jāmadagnyaḥ punaḥ prabhuḥ  |
āste vai devavacchrīmānmahendre parvatottame  || 213.122 ||
eṣa viṣṇoḥ sureśasya śāśvatasyāvyayasya ca  |
jāmadagnya iti khyātaḥ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ  || 213.123 ||
caturviṃśe yuge vāpi viśvāmitrapuraḥsaraḥ  |
jajñe daśarathasyātha putraḥ padmāyatekṣaṇaḥ  || 213.124 ||
kṛtvātmānaṃ mahābāhuścaturdhā prabhurīśvaraḥ  |
loke rāma iti khyātastejasā bhāskaropamaḥ  || 213.125 ||
prasādanārthaṃ lokasya rakṣasāṃ nigrahāya ca  |
dharmasya ca vivṛddhyarthaṃ jajñe tatra mahāyaśāḥ  || 213.126 ||
tamapyāhurmanuṣyendraṃ sarvabhūtahite ratam  |
yaḥ samāḥ sarvadharmajñaścaturdaśa vane'vasat || 213.127 ||
lakṣmaṇānucaro rāmaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ  |
caturdaśa vane taptvā tapo varṣāṇi rāghavaḥ  || 213.128 ||
rūpiṇī tasya pārśvasthā sīteti prathitā jane  |
pūrvoditā tu yā lakṣmīrbhartāramanugacchati  || 213.129 ||
janasthāne vasan kāryaṃ tridaśānāṃ cakāra saḥ  |
tasyāpakāriṇaṃ krūraṃ paulastyaṃ manujarṣabhaḥ  || 213.130 ||
sītāyāḥ padamanvicchannijaghāna mahāyaśāḥ  |
devāsuragaṇānāṃ ca yakṣarākṣasabhoginām  || 213.131 ||
yatrāvadhyaṃ rākṣasendraṃ rāvaṇaṃ yudhi durjayam  |
yuktaṃ rākṣasakoṭībhirnīlāñjanacayopamam  || 213.132 ||
trailokyadrāvaṇaṃ krūraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram  |
durjayaṃ durdharaṃ dṛptaṃ śārdūlasamavikramam  || 213.133 ||
durnirīkṣyaṃ suragaṇairvaradānena darpitam  |
jaghāna sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ sasainyaṃ rāvaṇaṃ yudhi  || 213.134 ||
mahābhragaṇasaṃkāśaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahābalam  |
rāvaṇaṃ nijaghānāśu rāmo bhūtapatiḥ purā  || 213.135 ||
sugrīvasya kṛte yena vānarendro mahābalaḥ  |
vālī vinihataḥ saṃkhye sugrīvaścābhiṣecitaḥ  || 213.136 ||
madhośca tanayo dṛpto lavaṇo nāma dānavaḥ  |
hato madhuvane vīro varamatto mahāsuraḥ  || 213.137 ||
yajñavighnakarau yena munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām  |
mārīcaśca subāhuśca balena balināṃ varau  || 213.138 ||
nihatau ca nirāśau ca kṛtau tena mahātmanā  |
samare yuddhaśauṇḍena tathānye cāpi rākṣasāḥ  || 213.139 ||
virādhaśca kabandhaśca rākṣasau bhīmavikramau  |
jaghāna puruṣavyāghro gandharvau śāpamohitau  || 213.140 ||
hutāśanārkāṃśutaḍidguṇābhaiḥ  213.141
prataptajāmbūnadacitrapuṅkhaiḥ  213.141
mahendravajrāśanitulyasārai  213.141
ripūn sa rāmaḥ samare nijaghne  213.141
tasmai dattāni śastrāṇi viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā  |
vadhārthaṃ devaśatrūṇāṃ durdharṣāṇāṃ surairapi  || 213.142 ||
vartamāne makhe yena janakasya mahātmanaḥ  |
bhagnaṃ māheśvaraṃ cāpaṃ krīḍatā līlayā purā  || 213.143 ||
etāni kṛtvā karmāṇi rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ  |
daśāśvamedhāñjārūthyānājahāra nirargalān  || 213.144 ||
nāśrūyantāśubhā vāco nākulaṃ māruto vavau  |
na vittaharaṇaṃ cāsīdrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati  || 213.145 ||
paridevanti vidhavā nānarthāśca kadācana  |
sarvamāsīcchubhaṃ tatra rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati  || 213.146 ||
na prāṇināṃ bhayaṃ cāsījjalāgnyanilaghātajam  |
na cāpi vṛddhā bālānāṃ pretakāryāṇi cakrire  || 213.147 ||
brahmacaryaparaṃ kṣatraṃ viśastu kṣatriye ratāḥ  |
śūdrāścaiva hi varṇāṃstrīñśuśrūṣantyanahaṃkṛtāḥ  || 213.148 ||
nāryo nātyacaran bhartṝn bhāryāṃ nātyacaratpatiḥ  |
sarvamāsījjagaddāntaṃ nirdasyurabhavanmahī  || 213.149 ||
rāma eko'bhavadbhartā rāmaḥ pālayitābhavat |
āsan varṣasahasrāṇi tathā putrasahasriṇaḥ  || 213.150 ||
arogāḥ prāṇinaścāsan rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati  |
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ  || 213.151 ||
pṛthivyāṃ samavāyo'bhūdrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati  |
gāthāmapyatra gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ  || 213.152 ||
rāme nibaddhatattvārthā māhātmyaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ  |
śyāmo yuvā lohitākṣo dīptāsyo mitabhāṣitaḥ  || 213.153 ||
ājānubāhuḥ sumukhaḥ siṃhaskandho mahābhujaḥ  |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi rāmo rājyamakārayat || 213.154 ||
ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ ghoṣo jyāghoṣaśca mahātmanaḥ  |
avyucchinno'bhavadrāṣṭre dīyatāṃ bhujyatāmiti  || 213.155 ||
sattvavān guṇasaṃpanno dīpyamānaḥ svatejasā  |
ati candraṃ ca sūryaṃ ca rāmo dāśarathirbabhau  || 213.156 ||
īje kratuśataiḥ puṇyaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ  |
hitvāyodhyāṃ divaṃ yāto rāghavo hi mahābalaḥ  || 213.157 ||
evameva mahābāhurikṣvākukulanandanaḥ  |
rāvaṇaṃ sagaṇaṃ hatvā divamācakrame vibhuḥ  || 213.158 ||
aparaḥ keśavasyāyaṃ prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ  |
vikhyāto māthure kalpe sarvalokahitāya vai  || 213.159 ||
yatra śālvaṃ ca caidyaṃ ca kaṃsaṃ dvividameva ca  |
ariṣṭaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ keśiṃ pūtanāṃ daityadārikām  || 213.160 ||
nāgaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ cāṇūraṃ muṣṭikaṃ tathā  |
daityānmānuṣadehena sūdayāmāsa vīryavān  || 213.161 ||
chinnaṃ bāhusahasraṃ ca bāṇasyādbhutakarmaṇaḥ  |
narakaśca hataḥ saṃkhye yavanaśca mahābalaḥ  || 213.162 ||
hṛtāni ca mahīpānāṃ sarvaratnāni tejasā  |
durācārāśca nihitāḥ pārthivā ye mahītale  || 213.163 ||
eṣa lokahitārthāya prādurbhāvo mahātmanaḥ  |
kalkī viṣṇuyaśā nāma śambhalagrāmasaṃbhavaḥ  || 213.164 ||
sarvalokahitārthāya bhūyo devo mahāyaśāḥ  |
ete cānye ca bahavo divyā devagaṇairvṛtāḥ  || 213.165 ||
prādurbhāvāḥ purāṇeṣu gīyante brahmavādibhiḥ  |
yatra devā vimuhyanti prādurbhāvānukīrtane  || 213.166 ||
purāṇaṃ vartate yatra vedaśrutisamāhitam  |
etaduddeśamātreṇa prādurbhāvānukīrtanam  || 213.167 ||
kīrtitaṃ kīrtanīyasya sarvalokagurorvibhoḥ  |
prīyante pitarastasya prādurbhāvānukīrtanāt || 213.168 ||
viṣṇoramitavīryasya yaḥ śṛṇoti kṛtāñjaliḥ  ||* 213.169 ||
etāśca yogeśvarayogamāyāḥ  213.170
śrutvā naro mucyati sarvapāpaiḥ  213.170
ṛddhiṃ samṛddhiṃ vipulāṃśca bhogān  213.170
prāpnoti śīghraṃ bhagavatprasādāt 213.170
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhā viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ  |
sarvapāpaharāḥ puṇyāḥ prādurbhāvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ  || 213.171 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
na tṛptimadhigacchāmaḥ puṇyadharmāmṛtasya ca  |
mune tvanmukhagītasya tathā kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 214.1 ||
utpattiṃ pralayaṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ karmaṇo gatim  |
vetsi sarvaṃ mune tena pṛcchāmastvāṃ mahāmatim  || 214.2 ||
śrūyate yamalokasya mārgaḥ paramadurgamaḥ  |
duḥkhakleśakaraḥ śaśvatsarvabhūtabhayāvahaḥ  || 214.3 ||
kathaṃ tena narā yānti mārgeṇa yamasādanam  |
pramāṇaṃ caiva mārgasya brūhi no vadatāṃ vara  || 214.4 ||
mune pṛcchāma sarvajña brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ  |
kathaṃ narakaduḥkhāni nāpnuvanti narānmune  || 214.5 ||
kenopāyena dānena dharmeṇa niyamena ca  |
mānuṣasya ca yāmyasya lokasya kiyadantaram  || 214.6 ||
kathaṃ ca svargatiṃ yānti narakaṃ kena karmaṇā  |
svargasthānāni kiyanti kiyanti narakāṇi ca  || 214.7 ||
kathaṃ sukṛtino yānti kathaṃ duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ  |
kiṃ rūpaṃ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ vā ko varṇastūbhayorapi  |
jīvasya nīyamānasya yamalokaṃ bravīhi naḥ  || 214.8 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlā vadato mama suvratāḥ  |
saṃsāracakramajaraṃ sthitiryasya na vidyate  || 214.9 ||
so'haṃ vadāmi vaḥ sarvaṃ yamamārgasya nirṇayam  |
utkrāntikālādārabhya yathā nānyo vadiṣyati  || 214.10 ||
svarūpaṃ caiva mārgasya yanmāṃ pṛcchatha sattamāḥ  |
yamalokasya cādhvānamantaraṃ mānuṣasya ca  || 214.11 ||
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ṣaḍaśītistadantaram  |
taptatāmramivātaptaṃ tadadhvānamudāhṛtam  || 214.12 ||
tadavaśyaṃ hi gantavyaṃ prāṇibhirjīvasaṃjñakaiḥ  |
puṇyān puṇyakṛto yānti pāpān pāpakṛto'dhamāḥ  || 214.13 ||
dvāviṃśatiśca narakā yamasya viṣaye sthitāḥ  |
yeṣu duṣkṛtakarmāṇo vipacyante pṛthakpṛthak || 214.14 ||
narako rauravo raudraḥ śūkarastāla eva ca  |
kumbhīpāko mahāghoraḥ śālmalo'tha vimohanaḥ  || 214.15 ||
kīṭādaḥ kṛmibhakṣaśca nālābhakṣo bhramastathā  |
nadyaḥ pūyavahāścānyā rudhirāmbhastathaiva ca  || 214.16 ||
agnijvālo mahāghoraḥ saṃdaṃśaḥ śunabhojanaḥ  |
ghorā vaitaraṇī caiva asipattravanaṃ tathā  || 214.17 ||
na tatra vṛkṣacchāyā vā na taḍāgāḥ sarāṃsi ca  |
na vāpyo dīrghikā vāpi na kūpo na prapā sabhā  || 214.18 ||
na maṇḍapo nāyatanaṃ na nadyo na ca parvatāḥ  |
na kiṃcidāśramasthānaṃ vidyate tatra vartmani  || 214.19 ||
yatra viśramate śrāntaḥ puruṣo'tīvakarṣitaḥ  |
avaśyameva gantavyaḥ sa sarvaistu mahāpathaḥ  || 214.20 ||
prāpte kāle tu saṃtyajya suhṛdbandhudhanādikam  |
jarāyujāṇḍajāścaiva svedajāścodbhijāstathā  || 214.21 ||
jaṅgamājaṅgamāścaiva gamiṣyanti mahāpatham  |
devāsuramanuṣyaiśca vaivasvatavaśānugaiḥ  || 214.22 ||
strīpuṃnapuṃsakaiścaiva pṛthivyāṃ jīvasaṃjñitaiḥ  |
pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇe vā madhyāhne vā tathā punaḥ  || 214.23 ||
saṃdhyākāle'rdharātre vā pratyūṣe vāpyupasthite  |
vṛddhairvā madhyamairvāpi yauvanasthaistathaiva ca  || 214.24 ||
garbhavāse'tha bālye vā gantavyaḥ sa mahāpathaḥ  |
pravāsasthairgṛhasthairvā parvatasthaiḥ sthale'pi vā  || 214.25 ||
kṣetrasthairvā jalasthairvā gṛhamadhyagataistathā  |
āsīnaiścāsthitairvāpi śayanīyagataistathā  || 214.26 ||
jāgradbhirvā prasuptairvā gantavyaḥ sa mahāpathaḥ  |
ihānubhūya nirdiṣṭamāyurjantuḥ svayaṃ tadā  || 214.27 ||
tasyānte ca svayaṃ prāṇairanicchannapi mucyate  |
jalamagnirviṣaṃ śastraṃ kṣudvyādhiḥ patanaṃ gireḥ  || 214.28 ||
nimittaṃ kiṃcidāsādya dehī prāṇairvimucyate  |
vihāya sumahatkṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam  || 214.29 ||
anyaccharīramādatte yātanīyaṃ svakarmajam  |
dṛḍhaṃ śarīramāpnoti sukhaduḥkhopabhuktaye  || 214.30 ||
tena bhuṅkte sa kṛcchrāṇi pāpakartā naro bhṛśam  |
sukhāni dhārmiko hṛṣṭa iha nīto yamakṣaye  || 214.31 ||
ūṣmā prakupitaḥ kāye tīvravāyusamīritaḥ  |
bhinatti marmasthānāni dīpyamāno nirandhanaḥ  || 214.32 ||
udāno nāma pavanastataścordhvaṃ pravartate  |
bhujyatāmambubhakṣyāṇāmadhogatinirodhakṛt || 214.33 ||
tato yenāmbudānāni kṛtānyannarasāstathā  |
dattāḥ sa tasyāmāhlādamāpadi pratipadyate  || 214.34 ||
annāni yena dattāni śraddhāpūtena cetasā  |
so'pi tṛptimavāpnoti vināpyannena vai tadā  || 214.35 ||
yenānṛtāni noktāni prītibhedaḥ kṛto na ca  |
āstikaḥ śraddadhānaśca sukhamṛtyuṃ sa gacchati  || 214.36 ||
devabrāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ niratāścānasūyakāḥ  |
śuklā vadānyā hrīmantaste narāḥ sukhamṛtyavaḥ  || 214.37 ||
yaḥ kāmānnāpi saṃrambhānna dveṣāddharmamutsṛjet |
yathoktakārī saumyaśca sa sukhaṃ mṛtyumṛcchati  || 214.38 ||
vāridāstṛṣitānāṃ ye kṣudhitānnapradāyinaḥ  |
prāpnuvanti narāḥ kāle mṛtyuṃ sukhasamanvitam  || 214.39 ||
śītaṃ jayanti dhanadāstāpaṃ candanadāyinaḥ  |
prāṇaghnīṃ vedanāṃ kaṣṭāṃ ye cānyodvegadhāriṇaḥ  || 214.40 ||
mohaṃ jñānapradātārastathā dīpapradāstamaḥ  |
kūṭasākṣī mṛṣāvādī yo gururnānuśāsti vai  || 214.41 ||
te mohamṛtyavaḥ sarve tathā ye vedanindakāḥ  |
vibhīṣaṇāḥ pūtigandhāḥ kūṭamudgarapāṇayaḥ  || 214.42 ||
āgacchanti durātmāno yamasya puruṣāstathā  |
prāpteṣu dṛkpathaṃ teṣu jāyate tasya vepathuḥ  || 214.43 ||
krandatyavirataḥ so'tha bhrātṛmātṛpitṛṃstathā  |
sā tu vāgasphuṭā viprā ekavarṇā vibhāvyate  || 214.44 ||
dṛṣṭirvibhrāmyate trāsātkāsāvṛṣṭyatyathānanam  |
tataḥ sa vedanāviṣṭaṃ taccharīraṃ vimuñcati  || 214.45 ||
vāyvagrasārī tadrūpa dehamanyatprapadyate  |
tatkarmayātanārthe ca na mātṛpitṛsaṃbhavam  || 214.46 ||
tatpramāṇavayovasthā saṃsthānaiḥ prāpyate vyathā  |
tato dūto yamasyātha pāśairbadhnāti dāruṇaiḥ  || 214.47 ||
jantoḥ saṃprāptakālasya vedanārtasya vai bhṛśam  |
bhūtaiḥ saṃtyaktadehasya kaṇṭhaprāptānilasya ca  || 214.48 ||
śarīrāccyāvito jīvo roravīti tatholbaṇam  |
nirgato vāyubhūtastu ṣāṭkauśikakalevare  || 214.49 ||
mātṛbhiḥ pitṛbhiścaiva bhrātṛbhirmātulaistathā  |
dāraiḥ putrairvayasyaiśca gurubhistyajyate bhuvi  || 214.50 ||
dṛśyamānaśca tairdīnairaśrupūrṇekṣaṇairbhṛśam  |
svaśarīraṃ samutsṛjya vāyubhūtastu gacchati  || 214.51 ||
andhakāramapāraṃ ca mahāghoraṃ tamovṛtam  |
sukhaduḥkhapradātāraṃ durgamaṃ pāpakarmaṇām  || 214.52 ||
duḥsahaṃ ca durantaṃ ca durnirīkṣaṃ durāsadam  |
durāpamatidurgaṃ ca pāpiṣṭhānāṃ sadāhitam  || 214.53 ||
kṛṣyamāṇāśca tairbhūtairyāmyaiḥ pāśaistu saṃyatāḥ  |
mudgaraistāḍyamānāśca nīyante taṃ mahāpatham  || 214.54 ||
kṣīṇāyuṣaṃ samālokya prāṇinaṃ cāyuṣakṣaye  |
ninīṣavaḥ samāyānti yamadūtā bhayaṃkarāḥ  || 214.55 ||
ārūḍhā yānakāle tu ṛkṣavyāghrakhareṣu ca  |
uṣṭreṣu vānareṣvanye vṛścikeṣu vṛkeṣu ca  || 214.56 ||
ulūkasarpamārjāraṃ tathānye gṛdhravāhanāḥ  |
śyenaśṛgālamārūḍhāḥ saraghākaṅkavāhanāḥ  || 214.57 ||
varāhapaśuvetāla mahiṣāsyāstathā pare  |
nānārūpadharā ghorāḥ sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkarāḥ  || 214.58 ||
dīrghamuṣkāḥ karālāsyā vakranāsāstrilocanāḥ  |
mahāhanukapolāsyāḥ pralambadaśanacchadāḥ  || 214.59 ||
nirgatairvikṛtākārairdaśanairaṅkuropamaiḥ  |
māṃsaśoṇitadigdhāṅgā daṃṣṭrābhirbhṛśamulbaṇaiḥ  || 214.60 ||
mukhaiḥ pātālasadṛśairjvalajjihvairbhayaṃkaraiḥ  |
netraiḥ suvikṛtākārairjvalatpiṅgalacañcalaiḥ  || 214.61 ||
mārjārolūkakhadyota śakragopavaduddhataiḥ  |
kekaraiḥ saṃkulaisstabdhairlocanaiḥ pāvakopamaiḥ  || 214.62 ||
bhṛśamābharaṇairbhīmairābaddhairbhujagopamaiḥ  |
śoṇāsaralagātraiśca muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitaiḥ  || 214.63 ||
kaṇṭhasthakṛṣṇasarpaiśca phūtkāraravabhīṣaṇaiḥ  |
vahnijvālopamaiḥ keśaiḥ stabdharukṣairbhayaṃkaraiḥ  || 214.64 ||
babhrupiṅgalalolaiśca kadruśmaśrubhirāvṛtāḥ  |
bhujadaṇḍairmahāghoraiḥ pralambaiḥ parighopamaiḥ  || 214.65 ||
keciddvibāhavastatra tathānye ca caturbhujāḥ  |
dviraṣṭabāhavaścānye daśaviṃśabhujāstathā  || 214.66 ||
asaṃkhyātabhujāścānye kecidbāhusahasriṇaḥ  |
āyudhairvikṛtākāraiḥ prajvaladbhirbhayānakaiḥ  || 214.67 ||
śaktitomaracakrādyaiḥ sudīptairvividhāyudhaiḥ  |
pāśaśṛṅkhaladaṇḍaiśca bhīṣayanto mahābalāḥ  || 214.68 ||
āgacchanti mahāraudrā martyānāmāyuṣaḥ kṣaye  |
grahītuṃ prāṇinaḥ sarve yamasyājñākarāstathā  || 214.69 ||
yattaccharīramādatte yātanīyaṃ svakarmajam  |
tadasya nīyate jantoryamasya sadanaṃ prati  || 214.70 ||
baddhvā tatkālapāśaiśca nigaḍairvajraśṛṅkhalaiḥ  |
tāḍayitvā bhṛśaṃ kruddhairnīyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ  || 214.71 ||
praskhalantaṃ rudantaṃ ca ākrośantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ  |
hā tāta mātaḥ putreti vadantaṃ karmadūṣitam  || 214.72 ||
āhatya niśitaiḥ śūlairmudgarairniśitairghanaiḥ  |
khaḍgaśaktiprahāraiśca vajradaṇḍaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ  || 214.73 ||
bhartsyamāno mahārāvairvajraśaktisamanvitaiḥ  |
ekaikaśo bhṛśaṃ kruddhaistāḍayadbhiḥ samantataḥ  || 214.74 ||
sa muhyamāno duḥkhārtaḥ pratapaṃśca itastataḥ  |
ākṛṣya nīyate janturadhvānaṃ subhayaṃkaraiḥ  || 214.75 ||
kuśakaṇṭakavalmīka śaṅkupāṣāṇaśarkare  |
tathā pradīptajvalane kṣāravajraśatotkaṭe  || 214.76 ||
pradīptādityataptena dahyamānastadaṃśubhiḥ  |
kṛṣyate yamadūtaiśca śivāsaṃnādabhīṣaṇaiḥ  || 214.77 ||
vikṛṣyamāṇastairghorairbhakṣyamāṇaḥ śivāśataiḥ  |
prayāti dāruṇe mārge pāpakarmā yamālayam  || 214.78 ||
kvacidbhītaiḥ kvacittrastaiḥ praskhaladbhiḥ kvacitkvacit |
duḥkhenākrandamānaiśca gantavyaḥ sa mahāpathaḥ  || 214.79 ||
nirbhartsyamānairudvignairvidrutairbhayavihvalaiḥ  |
kampamānaśarīraistu gantavyaṃ jīvasaṃjñakaiḥ  || 214.80 ||
kaṇṭakākīrṇamārgeṇa saṃtaptasikatena ca  |
dahyamānaistu gantavyaṃ narairdānavivarjitaiḥ  || 214.81 ||
medaḥśoṇitadurgandhairbastagātraiśca pūgaśaḥ  |
dagdhasphuṭatvacākīrṇairgantavyaṃ jīvaghātakaiḥ  || 214.82 ||
kūjadbhiḥ krandamānaiśca vikrośadbhiśca visvaram  |
vedanārtaiśca sadbhiśca gantavyaṃ jīvaghātakaiḥ  || 214.83 ||
śaktibhirbhindipālaiśca khaḍgatomarasāyakaiḥ  |
bhidyadbhistīkṣṇaśūlāgrairgantavyaṃ jīvaghātakaiḥ  || 214.84 ||
śvānairvyāghrairvṛkaiḥ kaṅkairbhakṣyamāṇaiśca pāpibhiḥ  ||* 214.85 ||
kṛntadbhiḥ krakacāghātairgantavyaṃ māṃsakhādibhiḥ  |
mahiṣarṣabhaśṛṅgāgrairbhidyamānaiḥ samantataḥ  || 214.86 ||
ullikhadbhiḥ śūkaraiśca gantavyaṃ māṃsakhādakaiḥ  |
sūcībhramarakākola makṣikābhiśca saṃghaśaḥ  || 214.87 ||
bhujyamānaiśca gantavyaṃ pāpiṣṭhairmadhughātakaiḥ  |
viśvastaṃ svāminaṃ mitraṃ striyaṃ vā yastu ghātayet || 214.88 ||
śastrairnikṛtyamānaiśca gantavyaṃ cāturairnaraiḥ  |
ghātayanti ca ye jantūṃstāḍayanti nirāgasaḥ  || 214.89 ||
rākṣasairbhakṣyamāṇāste yānti yāmyapathaṃ narāḥ  |
ye haranti parastrīṇāṃ varaprāvaraṇāni ca  || 214.90 ||
te yānti vidrutā nagnāḥ pretībhūtā yamālayam  |
vāso dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā gṛhakṣetramathāpi vā  || 214.91 ||
ye haranti durātmānaḥ pāpiṣṭhāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ  |
pāṣāṇairlaguḍairdaṇḍaistāḍyamānaistu jarjaraiḥ  || 214.92 ||
vahadbhiḥ śoṇitaṃ bhūri gantavyaṃ tu yamālayam  |
brahmasvaṃ ye harantīha narā narakanirbhayāḥ  || 214.93 ||
tāḍayanti tathā viprānākrośanti narādhamāḥ  |
śuṣkakāṣṭhanibaddhāste chinnakarṇākṣināsikāḥ  || 214.94 ||
pūyaśoṇitadigdhāste kālagṛdhraiśca jambukaiḥ  |
kiṃkarairbhīṣaṇaiścaṇḍaistāḍyamānāśca dāruṇaiḥ  || 214.95 ||
vikrośamānā gacchanti pāpinaste yamālayam  |
evaṃ paramadurdharṣamadhvānaṃ jvalanaprabham  || 214.96 ||
rauravaṃ durgaviṣamaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ mānuṣasya ca  |
prataptatāmravarṇābhaṃ vahnijvālāsphuliṅgavat || 214.97 ||
kuraṇṭakaṇṭakākīrṇaṃ pṛthuvikaṭatāḍanaiḥ  |
śaktivajraiśca saṃkīrṇamujjvalaṃ tīvrakaṇṭakam  || 214.98 ||
aṅgāravālukāmiśraṃ vahnikīṭakadurgamam  |
jvālāmālākulaṃ raudraṃ sūryaraśmipratāpitam  || 214.99 ||
adhvānaṃ nīyate dehī kṛṣyamāṇaḥ suniṣṭhuraiḥ  |
yadaiva krandate janturduḥkhārtaḥ patitaḥ kvacit || 214.100 ||
tadaivāhanyate sarvairāyudhairyamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
evaṃ saṃtāḍyamānaśca lubdhaḥ pāpeṣu yo'nayaḥ  || 214.101 ||
avaśo nīyate janturdurdharairyamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
sarvaireva hi gantavyamadhvānaṃ tatsudurgamam  || 214.102 ||
nīyate vividhairghorairyamadūtairavajñayā  |
nītvā sudāruṇaṃ mārgaṃ prāṇinaṃ yamakiṃkaraiḥ  || 214.103 ||
praveśyate purīṃ ghorāṃ tāmrāyasamayīṃ dvijāḥ  |
sā purī vipulākārā lakṣayojanamāyatā  || 214.104 ||
caturasrā vinirdiṣṭā caturdvāravatī śubhā  |
prākārāḥ kāñcanāstasyā yojanāyutamucchritāḥ  || 214.105 ||
indranīlamahānīla padmarāgopaśobhitā  |
sā purī vividhaiḥ saṃghairghorā ghoraiḥ samākulā  || 214.106 ||
devadānavagandharvairyakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ  |
pūrvadvāraṃ śubhaṃ tasyāḥ patākāśataśobhitam  || 214.107 ||
vajrendranīlavaidūrya muktāphalavibhūṣitam  |
gītanṛtyaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ  || 214.108 ||
praveśastena devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ yogināṃ tathā  |
gandharvasiddhayakṣāṇāṃ vidyādharavisarpiṇām  || 214.109 ||
uttaraṃ nagaradvāraṃ ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam  |
chattracāmaravinyāsaṃ nānāratnairalaṃkṛtam  || 214.110 ||
vīṇāreṇuravai ramyairgītamaṅgalanāditaiḥ  |
ṛgyajuḥsāmanirghoṣairmunivṛndasamākulam  || 214.111 ||
viśanti yena dharmajñāḥ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ  |
grīṣme vāripradā ye ca śīte cāgnipradā narāḥ  || 214.112 ||
śrāntasaṃvāhakā ye ca priyavādaratāśca ye  |
ye ca dānaratāḥ śūrā mātāpitṛparāśca ye  || 214.113 ||
dvijaśuśrūṣaṇe yuktā nityaṃ ye'tithipūjakāḥ  |
paścimaṃ tu mahādvāraṃ puryā ratnairvibhūṣitam  || 214.114 ||
vicitramaṇisopānaṃ tomaraiḥ samalaṃkṛtam  |
bherīmṛdaṅgasaṃnādaiḥ śaṅkhakāhalanāditam  || 214.115 ||
siddhavṛndaiḥ sadā hṛṣṭairmaṅgalaiḥ praṇināditam  |
praveśastena hṛṣṭānāṃ śivabhaktimatāṃ nṛṇām  || 214.116 ||
sarvatīrthaplutā ye ca pañcāgnerye ca sevakāḥ  |
prasthāne ye mṛtā vīrā mṛtāḥ kālañjare girau  || 214.117 ||
agnau vipannā ye vīrāḥ sādhitaṃ yairanāśakam  |
ye svāmimitralokārthe gograhe saṃkule hatāḥ  || 214.118 ||
te viśanti narāḥ śūrāḥ paścimena tapodhanāḥ  |
puryāṃ tasyā mahāghoraṃ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaram  || 214.119 ||
hāhākārasamākruṣṭaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dvāramīdṛśam  |
andhakārasamāyuktaṃ tīkṣṇaśṛṅgaiḥ samanvitam  || 214.120 ||
kaṇṭakairvṛścikaiḥ sarpairvajrakīṭaiḥ sudurgamaiḥ  |
vilumpadbhirvṛkairvyāghrairṛkṣaiḥ siṃhaiḥ sajambukaiḥ  || 214.121 ||
śvānamārjāragṛdhraiśca sajvālakavalairmukhaiḥ  |
praveśastena vai nityaṃ sarveṣāmapakāriṇām  || 214.122 ||
ye ghātayanti viprān gā bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ tathāturam  |
śaraṇāgataṃ viśvastaṃ striyaṃ mitraṃ nirāyudham  || 214.123 ||
ye'gamyāgāmino mūḍhāḥ paradravyāpahāriṇaḥ  |
nikṣepasyāpahartāro viṣavahnipradāśca ye  || 214.124 ||
parabhūmiṃ gṛhaṃ śayyāṃ vastrālaṃkārahāriṇaḥ  |
pararandhreṣu ye krūrā ye sadānṛtavādinaḥ  || 214.125 ||
grāmarāṣṭrapurasthāne mahāduḥkhapradā hi ye  |
kūṭasākṣipradātāraḥ kanyāvikrayakārakāḥ  || 214.126 ||
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaratā ye gacchanti sutāṃ snuṣām  |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva ye vadanti ca pauruṣam  || 214.127 ||
anye ye caiva nirdiṣṭā mahāpātakakāriṇaḥ  |
dakṣiṇena tu te sarve dvāreṇa praviśanti vai  || 214.128 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
na tṛptimadhigacchāmaḥ puṇyadharmāmṛtasya ca  |
mune tvanmukhagītasya tathā kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 214*.1 ||
utpattiṃ pralayaṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ karmaṇo gatim  |
vetsi sarvaṃ mune tena pṛcchāmastvāṃ mahāmatim  || 214*.2 ||
śrūyate yamalokasya mārgaḥ paramadurgamaḥ  |
duḥkhakleśakaraḥ śaśvatsarvabhūtabhayāvahaḥ  || 214*.3 ||
kathaṃ tena narā yānti mārgeṇa yamasādanam  |
pramāṇaṃ caiva mārgasya brūhi no vadatāṃ vara  || 214*.4 ||
mune pṛcchāma sarvajña brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ  |
kathaṃ narakaduḥkhāni nāpnuvanti narānmune  || 214*.5 ||
kenopāyena dānena dharmeṇa niyamena ca  |
mānuṣasya ca yāmyasya lokasya kiyadantaram  || 214*.6 ||
kathaṃ ca svargatiṃ yānti narakaṃ kena karmaṇā  |
svargasthānāni kiyanti kiyanti narakāṇi ca  || 214*.7 ||
kathaṃ sukṛtino yānti kathaṃ duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ  |
kiṃ rūpaṃ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ vā ko varṇastūbhayorapi  |
jīvasya nīyamānasya yamalokaṃ bravīhi naḥ  || 214*.8 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlā vadato mama suvratāḥ  |
saṃsāracakramajaraṃ sthitiryasya na vidyate  || 214*.9 ||
so'haṃ vadāmi vaḥ sarvaṃ yamamārgasya nirṇayam  |
utkrāntikālādārabhya yathā nānyo vadiṣyati  || 214*.10 ||
svarūpaṃ caiva mārgasya yanmāṃ pṛcchatha sattamāḥ  |
yamalokasya cādhvānamantaraṃ mānuṣasya ca  || 214*.11 ||
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ṣaḍaśītistadantaram  |
taptatāmramivātaptaṃ tadadhvānamudāhṛtam  || 214*.12 ||
tadavaśyaṃ hi gantavyaṃ prāṇibhirjīvasaṃjñakaiḥ  |
puṇyān puṇyakṛto yānti pāpān pāpakṛto'dhamāḥ  || 214*.13 ||
dvāviṃśatiśca narakā yamasya viṣaye sthitāḥ  |
yeṣu duṣkṛtakarmāṇo vipacyante pṛthakpṛthak || 214*.14 ||
narako rauravo raudraḥ śūkarastāla eva ca  |
kumbhīpāko mahāghoraḥ śālmalo'tha vimohanaḥ  || 214*.15 ||
kīṭādaḥ kṛmibhakṣaśca nālābhakṣo bhramastathā  |
nadyaḥ pūyavahāścānyā rudhirāmbhastathaiva ca  || 214*.16 ||
agnijvālo mahāghoraḥ saṃdaṃśaḥ śunabhojanaḥ  |
ghorā vaitaraṇī caiva asipattravanaṃ tathā  || 214*.17 ||
na tatra vṛkṣacchāyā vā na taḍāgāḥ sarāṃsi ca  |
na vāpyo dīrghikā vāpi na kūpo na prapā sabhā  || 214*.18 ||
na maṇḍapo nāyatanaṃ na nadyo na ca parvatāḥ  |
na kiṃcidāśramasthānaṃ vidyate tatra vartmani  || 214*.19 ||
yatra viśramate śrāntaḥ puruṣo'tīvakarṣitaḥ  |
avaśyameva gantavyaḥ sa sarvaistu mahāpathaḥ  || 214*.20 ||
prāpte kāle tu saṃtyajya suhṛdbandhudhanādikam  |
jarāyujāṇḍajāścaiva svedajāścodbhijāstathā  || 214*.21 ||
jaṅgamājaṅgamāścaiva gamiṣyanti mahāpatham  |
devāsuramanuṣyaiśca vaivasvatavaśānugaiḥ  || 214*.22 ||
strīpuṃnapuṃsakaiścaiva pṛthivyāṃ jīvasaṃjñitaiḥ  |
pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇe vā madhyāhne vā tathā punaḥ  || 214*.23 ||
saṃdhyākāle'rdharātre vā pratyūṣe vāpyupasthite  |
vṛddhairvā madhyamairvāpi yauvanasthaistathaiva ca  || 214*.24 ||
garbhavāse'tha bālye vā gantavyaḥ sa mahāpathaḥ  |
pravāsasthairgṛhasthairvā parvatasthaiḥ sthale'pi vā  || 214*.25 ||
kṣetrasthairvā jalasthairvā gṛhamadhyagataistathā  |
āsīnaiścāsthitairvāpi śayanīyagataistathā  || 214*.26 ||
jāgradbhirvā prasuptairvā gantavyaḥ sa mahāpathaḥ  |
ihānubhūya nirdiṣṭamāyurjantuḥ svayaṃ tadā  || 214*.27 ||
tasyānte ca svayaṃ prāṇairanicchannapi mucyate  |
jalamagnirviṣaṃ śastraṃ kṣudvyādhiḥ patanaṃ gireḥ  || 214*.28 ||
nimittaṃ kiṃcidāsādya dehī prāṇairvimucyate  |
vihāya sumahatkṛtsnaṃ śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam  || 214*.29 ||
anyaccharīramādatte yātanīyaṃ svakarmajam  |
dṛḍhaṃ śarīramāpnoti sukhaduḥkhopabhuktaye  || 214*.30 ||
tena bhuṅkte sa kṛcchrāṇi pāpakartā naro bhṛśam  |
sukhāni dhārmiko hṛṣṭa iha nīto yamakṣaye  || 214*.31 ||
ūṣmā prakupitaḥ kāye tīvravāyusamīritaḥ  |
bhinatti marmasthānāni dīpyamāno nirandhanaḥ  || 214*.32 ||
udāno nāma pavanastataścordhvaṃ pravartate  |
bhujyatāmambubhakṣyāṇāmadhogatinirodhakṛt || 214*.33 ||
tato yenāmbudānāni kṛtānyannarasāstathā  |
dattāḥ sa tasyāmāhlādamāpadi pratipadyate  || 214*.34 ||
annāni yena dattāni śraddhāpūtena cetasā  |
so'pi tṛptimavāpnoti vināpyannena vai tadā  || 214*.35 ||
yenānṛtāni noktāni prītibhedaḥ kṛto na ca  |
āstikaḥ śraddadhānaśca sukhamṛtyuṃ sa gacchati  || 214*.36 ||
devabrāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ niratāścānasūyakāḥ  |
śuklā vadānyā hrīmantaste narāḥ sukhamṛtyavaḥ  || 214*.37 ||
yaḥ kāmānnāpi saṃrambhānna dveṣāddharmamutsṛjet |
yathoktakārī saumyaśca sa sukhaṃ mṛtyumṛcchati  || 214*.38 ||
vāridāstṛṣitānāṃ ye kṣudhitānnapradāyinaḥ  |
prāpnuvanti narāḥ kāle mṛtyuṃ sukhasamanvitam  || 214*.39 ||
śītaṃ jayanti dhanadāstāpaṃ candanadāyinaḥ  |
prāṇaghnīṃ vedanāṃ kaṣṭāṃ ye cānyodvegadhāriṇaḥ  || 214*.40 ||
mohaṃ jñānapradātārastathā dīpapradāstamaḥ  |
kūṭasākṣī mṛṣāvādī yo gururnānuśāsti vai  || 214*.41 ||
te mohamṛtyavaḥ sarve tathā ye vedanindakāḥ  |
vibhīṣaṇāḥ pūtigandhāḥ kūṭamudgarapāṇayaḥ  || 214*.42 ||
āgacchanti durātmāno yamasya puruṣāstathā  |
prāpteṣu dṛkpathaṃ teṣu jāyate tasya vepathuḥ  || 214*.43 ||
krandatyavirataḥ so'tha bhrātṛmātṛpitṛṃstathā  |
sā tu vāgasphuṭā viprā ekavarṇā vibhāvyate  || 214*.44 ||
dṛṣṭirvibhrāmyate trāsātkāsāvṛṣṭyatyathānanam  |
tataḥ sa vedanāviṣṭaṃ taccharīraṃ vimuñcati  || 214*.45 ||
vāyvagrasārī tadrūpa dehamanyatprapadyate  |
tatkarmayātanārthe ca na mātṛpitṛsaṃbhavam  || 214*.46 ||
tatpramāṇavayovasthā saṃsthānaiḥ prāpyate vyathā  |
tato dūto yamasyātha pāśairbadhnāti dāruṇaiḥ  || 214*.47 ||
jantoḥ saṃprāptakālasya vedanārtasya vai bhṛśam  |
bhūtaiḥ saṃtyaktadehasya kaṇṭhaprāptānilasya ca  || 214*.48 ||
śarīrāccyāvito jīvo roravīti tatholbaṇam  |
nirgato vāyubhūtastu ṣāṭkauśikakalevare  || 214*.49 ||
mātṛbhiḥ pitṛbhiścaiva bhrātṛbhirmātulaistathā  |
dāraiḥ putrairvayasyaiśca gurubhistyajyate bhuvi  || 214*.50 ||
dṛśyamānaśca tairdīnairaśrupūrṇekṣaṇairbhṛśam  |
svaśarīraṃ samutsṛjya vāyubhūtastu gacchati  || 214*.51 ||
andhakāramapāraṃ ca mahāghoraṃ tamovṛtam  |
sukhaduḥkhapradātāraṃ durgamaṃ pāpakarmaṇām  || 214*.52 ||
duḥsahaṃ ca durantaṃ ca durnirīkṣaṃ durāsadam  |
durāpamatidurgaṃ ca pāpiṣṭhānāṃ sadāhitam  || 214*.53 ||
kṛṣyamāṇāśca tairbhūtairyāmyaiḥ pāśaistu saṃyatāḥ  |
mudgaraistāḍyamānāśca nīyante taṃ mahāpatham  || 214*.54 ||
kṣīṇāyuṣaṃ samālokya prāṇinaṃ cāyuṣakṣaye  |
ninīṣavaḥ samāyānti yamadūtā bhayaṃkarāḥ  || 214*.55 ||
ārūḍhā yānakāle tu ṛkṣavyāghrakhareṣu ca  |
uṣṭreṣu vānareṣvanye vṛścikeṣu vṛkeṣu ca  || 214*.56 ||
ulūkasarpamārjāraṃ tathānye gṛdhravāhanāḥ  |
śyenaśṛgālamārūḍhāḥ saraghākaṅkavāhanāḥ  || 214*.57 ||
varāhapaśuvetāla mahiṣāsyāstathā pare  |
nānārūpadharā ghorāḥ sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkarāḥ  || 214*.58 ||
dīrghamuṣkāḥ karālāsyā vakranāsāstrilocanāḥ  |
mahāhanukapolāsyāḥ pralambadaśanacchadāḥ  || 214*.59 ||
nirgatairvikṛtākārairdaśanairaṅkuropamaiḥ  |
māṃsaśoṇitadigdhāṅgā daṃṣṭrābhirbhṛśamulbaṇaiḥ  || 214*.60 ||
mukhaiḥ pātālasadṛśairjvalajjihvairbhayaṃkaraiḥ  |
netraiḥ suvikṛtākārairjvalatpiṅgalacañcalaiḥ  || 214*.61 ||
mārjārolūkakhadyota śakragopavaduddhataiḥ  |
kekaraiḥ saṃkulaisstabdhairlocanaiḥ pāvakopamaiḥ  || 214*.62 ||
bhṛśamābharaṇairbhīmairābaddhairbhujagopamaiḥ  |
śoṇāsaralagātraiśca muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitaiḥ  || 214*.63 ||
kaṇṭhasthakṛṣṇasarpaiśca phūtkāraravabhīṣaṇaiḥ  |
vahnijvālopamaiḥ keśaiḥ stabdharukṣairbhayaṃkaraiḥ  || 214*.64 ||
babhrupiṅgalalolaiśca kadruśmaśrubhirāvṛtāḥ  |
bhujadaṇḍairmahāghoraiḥ pralambaiḥ parighopamaiḥ  || 214*.65 ||
keciddvibāhavastatra tathānye ca caturbhujāḥ  |
dviraṣṭabāhavaścānye daśaviṃśabhujāstathā  || 214*.66 ||
asaṃkhyātabhujāścānye kecidbāhusahasriṇaḥ  |
āyudhairvikṛtākāraiḥ prajvaladbhirbhayānakaiḥ  || 214*.67 ||
śaktitomaracakrādyaiḥ sudīptairvividhāyudhaiḥ  |
pāśaśṛṅkhaladaṇḍaiśca bhīṣayanto mahābalāḥ  || 214*.68 ||
āgacchanti mahāraudrā martyānāmāyuṣaḥ kṣaye  |
grahītuṃ prāṇinaḥ sarve yamasyājñākarāstathā  || 214*.69 ||
yattaccharīramādatte yātanīyaṃ svakarmajam  |
tadasya nīyate jantoryamasya sadanaṃ prati  || 214*.70 ||
baddhvā tatkālapāśaiśca nigaḍairvajraśṛṅkhalaiḥ  |
tāḍayitvā bhṛśaṃ kruddhairnīyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ  || 214*.71 ||
praskhalantaṃ rudantaṃ ca ākrośantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ  |
hā tāta mātaḥ putreti vadantaṃ karmadūṣitam  || 214*.72 ||
āhatya niśitaiḥ śūlairmudgarairniśitairghanaiḥ  |
khaḍgaśaktiprahāraiśca vajradaṇḍaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ  || 214*.73 ||
bhartsyamāno mahārāvairvajraśaktisamanvitaiḥ  |
ekaikaśo bhṛśaṃ kruddhaistāḍayadbhiḥ samantataḥ  || 214*.74 ||
sa muhyamāno duḥkhārtaḥ pratapaṃśca itastataḥ  |
ākṛṣya nīyate janturadhvānaṃ subhayaṃkaraiḥ  || 214*.75 ||
kuśakaṇṭakavalmīka śaṅkupāṣāṇaśarkare  |
tathā pradīptajvalane kṣāravajraśatotkaṭe  || 214*.76 ||
pradīptādityataptena dahyamānastadaṃśubhiḥ  |
kṛṣyate yamadūtaiśca śivāsaṃnādabhīṣaṇaiḥ  || 214*.77 ||
vikṛṣyamāṇastairghorairbhakṣyamāṇaḥ śivāśataiḥ  |
prayāti dāruṇe mārge pāpakarmā yamālayam  || 214*.78 ||
kvacidbhītaiḥ kvacittrastaiḥ praskhaladbhiḥ kvacitkvacit |
duḥkhenākrandamānaiśca gantavyaḥ sa mahāpathaḥ  || 214*.79 ||
nirbhartsyamānairudvignairvidrutairbhayavihvalaiḥ  |
kampamānaśarīraistu gantavyaṃ jīvasaṃjñakaiḥ  || 214*.80 ||
kaṇṭakākīrṇamārgeṇa saṃtaptasikatena ca  |
dahyamānaistu gantavyaṃ narairdānavivarjitaiḥ  || 214*.81 ||
medaḥśoṇitadurgandhairbastagātraiśca pūgaśaḥ  |
dagdhasphuṭatvacākīrṇairgantavyaṃ jīvaghātakaiḥ  || 214*.82 ||
kūjadbhiḥ krandamānaiśca vikrośadbhiśca visvaram  |
vedanārtaiśca sadbhiśca gantavyaṃ jīvaghātakaiḥ  || 214*.83 ||
śaktibhirbhindipālaiśca khaḍgatomarasāyakaiḥ  |
bhidyadbhistīkṣṇaśūlāgrairgantavyaṃ jīvaghātakaiḥ  || 214*.84 ||
śvānairvyāghrairvṛkaiḥ kaṅkairbhakṣyamāṇaiśca pāpibhiḥ  ||* 214*.85 ||
kṛntadbhiḥ krakacāghātairgantavyaṃ māṃsakhādibhiḥ  |
mahiṣarṣabhaśṛṅgāgrairbhidyamānaiḥ samantataḥ  || 214*.86 ||
ullikhadbhiḥ śūkaraiśca gantavyaṃ māṃsakhādakaiḥ  |
sūcībhramarakākola makṣikābhiśca saṃghaśaḥ  || 214*.87 ||
bhujyamānaiśca gantavyaṃ pāpiṣṭhairmadhughātakaiḥ  |
viśvastaṃ svāminaṃ mitraṃ striyaṃ vā yastu ghātayet || 214*.88 ||
śastrairnikṛtyamānaiśca gantavyaṃ cāturairnaraiḥ  |
ghātayanti ca ye jantūṃstāḍayanti nirāgasaḥ  || 214*.89 ||
rākṣasairbhakṣyamāṇāste yānti yāmyapathaṃ narāḥ  |
ye haranti parastrīṇāṃ varaprāvaraṇāni ca  || 214*.90 ||
te yānti vidrutā nagnāḥ pretībhūtā yamālayam  |
vāso dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā gṛhakṣetramathāpi vā  || 214*.91 ||
ye haranti durātmānaḥ pāpiṣṭhāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ  |
pāṣāṇairlaguḍairdaṇḍaistāḍyamānaistu jarjaraiḥ  || 214*.92 ||
vahadbhiḥ śoṇitaṃ bhūri gantavyaṃ tu yamālayam  |
brahmasvaṃ ye harantīha narā narakanirbhayāḥ  || 214*.93 ||
tāḍayanti tathā viprānākrośanti narādhamāḥ  |
śuṣkakāṣṭhanibaddhāste chinnakarṇākṣināsikāḥ  || 214*.94 ||
pūyaśoṇitadigdhāste kālagṛdhraiśca jambukaiḥ  |
kiṃkarairbhīṣaṇaiścaṇḍaistāḍyamānāśca dāruṇaiḥ  || 214*.95 ||
vikrośamānā gacchanti pāpinaste yamālayam  |
evaṃ paramadurdharṣamadhvānaṃ jvalanaprabham  || 214*.96 ||
rauravaṃ durgaviṣamaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ mānuṣasya ca  |
prataptatāmravarṇābhaṃ vahnijvālāsphuliṅgavat || 214*.97 ||
kuraṇṭakaṇṭakākīrṇaṃ pṛthuvikaṭatāḍanaiḥ  |
śaktivajraiśca saṃkīrṇamujjvalaṃ tīvrakaṇṭakam  || 214*.98 ||
aṅgāravālukāmiśraṃ vahnikīṭakadurgamam  |
jvālāmālākulaṃ raudraṃ sūryaraśmipratāpitam  || 214*.99 ||
adhvānaṃ nīyate dehī kṛṣyamāṇaḥ suniṣṭhuraiḥ  |
yadaiva krandate janturduḥkhārtaḥ patitaḥ kvacit || 214*.100 ||
tadaivāhanyate sarvairāyudhairyamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
evaṃ saṃtāḍyamānaśca lubdhaḥ pāpeṣu yo'nayaḥ  || 214*.101 ||
avaśo nīyate janturdurdharairyamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
sarvaireva hi gantavyamadhvānaṃ tatsudurgamam  || 214*.102 ||
nīyate vividhairghorairyamadūtairavajñayā  |
nītvā sudāruṇaṃ mārgaṃ prāṇinaṃ yamakiṃkaraiḥ  || 214*.103 ||
praveśyate purīṃ ghorāṃ tāmrāyasamayīṃ dvijāḥ  |
sā purī vipulākārā lakṣayojanamāyatā  || 214*.104 ||
caturasrā vinirdiṣṭā caturdvāravatī śubhā  |
prākārāḥ kāñcanāstasyā yojanāyutamucchritāḥ  || 214*.105 ||
indranīlamahānīla padmarāgopaśobhitā  |
sā purī vividhaiḥ saṃghairghorā ghoraiḥ samākulā  || 214*.106 ||
devadānavagandharvairyakṣarākṣasapannagaiḥ  |
pūrvadvāraṃ śubhaṃ tasyāḥ patākāśataśobhitam  || 214*.107 ||
vajrendranīlavaidūrya muktāphalavibhūṣitam  |
gītanṛtyaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ  || 214*.108 ||
praveśastena devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ yogināṃ tathā  |
gandharvasiddhayakṣāṇāṃ vidyādharavisarpiṇām  || 214*.109 ||
uttaraṃ nagaradvāraṃ ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam  |
chattracāmaravinyāsaṃ nānāratnairalaṃkṛtam  || 214*.110 ||
vīṇāreṇuravai ramyairgītamaṅgalanāditaiḥ  |
ṛgyajuḥsāmanirghoṣairmunivṛndasamākulam  || 214*.111 ||
viśanti yena dharmajñāḥ satyavrataparāyaṇāḥ  |
grīṣme vāripradā ye ca śīte cāgnipradā narāḥ  || 214*.112 ||
śrāntasaṃvāhakā ye ca priyavādaratāśca ye  |
ye ca dānaratāḥ śūrā mātāpitṛparāśca ye  || 214*.113 ||
dvijaśuśrūṣaṇe yuktā nityaṃ ye'tithipūjakāḥ  |
paścimaṃ tu mahādvāraṃ puryā ratnairvibhūṣitam  || 214*.114 ||
vicitramaṇisopānaṃ tomaraiḥ samalaṃkṛtam  |
bherīmṛdaṅgasaṃnādaiḥ śaṅkhakāhalanāditam  || 214*.115 ||
siddhavṛndaiḥ sadā hṛṣṭairmaṅgalaiḥ praṇināditam  |
praveśastena hṛṣṭānāṃ śivabhaktimatāṃ nṛṇām  || 214*.116 ||
sarvatīrthaplutā ye ca pañcāgnerye ca sevakāḥ  |
prasthāne ye mṛtā vīrā mṛtāḥ kālañjare girau  || 214*.117 ||
agnau vipannā ye vīrāḥ sādhitaṃ yairanāśakam  |
ye svāmimitralokārthe gograhe saṃkule hatāḥ  || 214*.118 ||
te viśanti narāḥ śūrāḥ paścimena tapodhanāḥ  |
puryāṃ tasyā mahāghoraṃ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaram  || 214*.119 ||
hāhākārasamākruṣṭaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ dvāramīdṛśam  |
andhakārasamāyuktaṃ tīkṣṇaśṛṅgaiḥ samanvitam  || 214*.120 ||
kaṇṭakairvṛścikaiḥ sarpairvajrakīṭaiḥ sudurgamaiḥ  |
vilumpadbhirvṛkairvyāghrairṛkṣaiḥ siṃhaiḥ sajambukaiḥ  || 214*.121 ||
śvānamārjāragṛdhraiśca sajvālakavalairmukhaiḥ  |
praveśastena vai nityaṃ sarveṣāmapakāriṇām  || 214*.122 ||
ye ghātayanti viprān gā bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ tathāturam  |
śaraṇāgataṃ viśvastaṃ striyaṃ mitraṃ nirāyudham  || 214*.123 ||
ye'gamyāgāmino mūḍhāḥ paradravyāpahāriṇaḥ  |
nikṣepasyāpahartāro viṣavahnipradāśca ye  || 214*.124 ||
parabhūmiṃ gṛhaṃ śayyāṃ vastrālaṃkārahāriṇaḥ  |
pararandhreṣu ye krūrā ye sadānṛtavādinaḥ  || 214*.125 ||
grāmarāṣṭrapurasthāne mahāduḥkhapradā hi ye  |
kūṭasākṣipradātāraḥ kanyāvikrayakārakāḥ  || 214*.126 ||
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaratā ye gacchanti sutāṃ snuṣām  |
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva ye vadanti ca pauruṣam  || 214*.127 ||
anye ye caiva nirdiṣṭā mahāpātakakāriṇaḥ  |
dakṣiṇena tu te sarve dvāreṇa praviśanti vai  || 214*.128 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kathaṃ dakṣiṇamārgeṇa viśanti pāpinaḥ puram  |
śrotumicchāma tadbrūhi vistareṇa tapodhana  || 215.1 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sughoraṃ tanmahāghoraṃ dvāraṃ vakṣyāmi bhīṣaṇam  |
nānāśvāpadasaṃkīrṇaṃ śivāśatanināditam  || 215.2 ||
phetkāraravasaṃyuktamagamyaṃ lomaharṣaṇam  |
bhūtapretapiśācaiśca vṛtaṃ cānyaiśca rākṣasaiḥ  || 215.3 ||
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā sudūrānte dvāraṃ duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ  |
mohaṃ gacchanti sahasā trāsādvipralapanti ca  || 215.4 ||
tatastāñśṛṅkhalaiḥ pāśairbaddhvā karṣanti nirbhayāḥ  |
tāḍayanti ca daṇḍaiśca bhartsayanti punaḥ punaḥ  || 215.5 ||
labdhasaṃjñāstataste vai rudhireṇa pariplutāḥ  |
vrajanti dakṣiṇaṃ dvāraṃ praskhalantaḥ pade pade  || 215.6 ||
tīvrakaṇṭakayuktena śarkarānicitena ca  |
kṣuradhārānibhaistīkṣṇaiḥ pāṣāṇairnicitena ca  || 215.7 ||
kvacitpaṅkena nicitā niruttāraiśca khātakaiḥ  |
lohasūcīnibhairdantaiḥ saṃchannena kvacitkvacit || 215.8 ||
taṭaprapātaviṣamaiḥ parvatairvṛkṣasaṃkulaiḥ  |
prataptāṅgārayuktena yānti mārgeṇa duḥkhitāḥ  || 215.9 ||
kvacidviṣamagartābhiḥ kvacilloṣṭaiḥ supicchalaiḥ  |
sutaptavālukābhiśca tathā tīkṣṇaiśca śaṅkubhiḥ  || 215.10 ||
ayaḥśṛṅgāṭakaistaptaiḥ kvaciddāvāgninā yutam  |
kvacittaptaśilābhiśca kvacidvyāptaṃ himena ca  || 215.11 ||
kvacidvālukayā vyāptamākaṇṭhāntaḥpraveśayā  |
kvacidduṣṭāmbunā vyāptaṃ kvacitkarṣāgninā punaḥ  || 215.12 ||
kvacitsiṃhairvṛkairvyāghrairdaśakīṭaiśca dāruṇaiḥ  |
kvacinmahājalaukābhiḥ kvacidajagaraiḥ punaḥ  || 215.13 ||
makṣikābhiśca raudrābhiḥ kvacitsarpaviṣolbaṇaiḥ  |
kvacidduṣṭagajaiścaiva balonmattaiḥ pramāthibhiḥ  || 215.14 ||
panthānamullikhadbhiśca tīkṣṇaśṛṅgairmahāvṛṣaiḥ  |
mahāśṛṅgaiśca mahiṣairuṣṭrairmattaiśca khādanaiḥ  || 215.15 ||
ḍākinībhiśca raudrābhirvikarālaiśca rākṣasaiḥ  |
vyādhibhiśca mahāraudraiḥ pīḍyamānā vrajanti te  || 215.16 ||
mahādhūlivimiśreṇa mahācaṇḍena vāyunā  |
mahāpāṣāṇavarṣeṇa hanyamānā nirāśrayāḥ  || 215.17 ||
kvacidvidyunnipātena dīryamāṇā vrajanti te  |
mahatā bāṇavarṣeṇa bhidyamānāśca sarvaśaḥ  || 215.18 ||
patadbhirvajranirghātairulkāpātaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ  |
pradīptāṅgāravarṣeṇa dahyamānā viśanti ca  || 215.19 ||
mahatā pāṃśuvarṣeṇa pūryamāṇā rudanti ca  |
meghāravaiḥ sughoraiśca vitrāsyante muhurmuhuḥ  || 215.20 ||
niḥśeṣāḥ śaravarṣeṇa cūrṇyamāṇāśca sarvataḥ  |
mahākṣārāmbudhārābhiḥ sicyamānā vrajanti ca  || 215.21 ||
mahāśītena marutā rūkṣeṇa paruṣeṇa ca  |
samantāddīryamāṇāśca śuṣyante saṃkucanti ca  || 215.22 ||
itthaṃ mārgeṇa puruṣāḥ pātheyarahitena ca  |
nirālambena durgeṇa nirjalena samantataḥ  || 215.23 ||
atiśrameṇa mahatā nirgatenāśramāya vai  |
nīyante dehinaḥ sarve ye mūḍhāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ  || 215.24 ||
yamadūtairmahāghoraistadājñākāribhirbalāt |
ekākinaḥ parādhīnā mitrabandhuvivarjitāḥ  || 215.25 ||
śocantaḥ svāni karmāṇi rudanti ca muhurmuhuḥ  |
pretībhūtā niṣiddhāste śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ  || 215.26 ||
kṛśāṅgā bhītabhītāśca dahyamānāḥ kṣudhāgninā  |
baddhāḥ śṛṅkhalayā kecitkeciduttānapādayoḥ  || 215.27 ||
ākṛṣyante śuṣyamāṇā yamadūtairbalotkaṭaiḥ  |
narā adhomukhāścānye kṛṣyamāṇāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ  || 215.28 ||
annapānīyarahitā yācamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ  |
dehi dehīti bhāṣantaḥ sāśrugadgadayā girā  || 215.29 ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭā dīnāḥ kṣuttṛṣṇāparipīḍitāḥ  |
bhakṣyānuccāvacān dṛṣṭvā bhojyān peyāṃśca puṣkalān  || 215.30 ||
sugandhadravyasaṃyuktān yācamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ  |
dadhikṣīraghṛtonmiśraṃ dṛṣṭvā śālyodanaṃ tathā  || 215.31 ||
pānāni ca sugandhīni śītalānyudakāni ca  |
tān yācamānāṃste yāmyā bhartsayantastadābruvan  |
vacobhiḥ paruṣairbhīmāḥ krodharaktāntalocanāḥ  || 215.32 ||
{yāmyā ūcu̱ḥ }
na bhavadbhirhutaṃ kāle na dattaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu ca  |
prasabhaṃ dīyamānaṃ ca vāritaṃ ca dvijātiṣu  || 215.33 ||
tasya pāpasya ca phalaṃ bhavatāṃ samupāgatam  |
nāgnau dagdhaṃ jale naṣṭaṃ na hṛtaṃ nṛpataskaraiḥ  || 215.34 ||
kuto vā sāṃprataṃ vipre yanna dattaṃ purādhamāḥ  |
yairdattāni tu dānāni sādhubhiḥ sāttvikāni tu  || 215.35 ||
teṣāmete pradṛśyante kalpitā hyannaparvatāḥ  |
bhakṣyabhojyāśca peyāśca lehyāścoṣyāśca saṃvṛtāḥ  || 215.36 ||
na yūyamabhilapsyadhve na dattaṃ ca kathaṃcana  |
yaistu dattaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇāścaiva pūjitāḥ  || 215.37 ||
teṣāmannaṃ samānīya iha nikṣipyate sadā  |
parasvaṃ kathamasmābhirdātuṃ śakyeta nārakāḥ  || 215.38 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
kiṃkarāṇāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā niḥspṛhāḥ kṣuttṛṣārditāḥ  |
tataste dāruṇaiścāstraiḥ pīḍyante yamakiṃkaraiḥ  || 215.39 ||
mudgarairlohadaṇḍaiśca śaktitomarapaṭṭiśaiḥ  |
parighairbhindipālaiśca gadāparaśubhiḥ śaraiḥ  || 215.40 ||
pṛṣṭhato hanyamānyāśca yamadūtaiḥ sunirdayaiḥ  |
agrataḥ siṃhavyāghrādyairbhakṣyante pāpakāriṇaḥ  || 215.41 ||
na praveṣṭuṃ na nirgantuṃ labhante duḥkhitā bhṛśam  |
svakarmopahatāḥ pāpāḥ krandamānāḥ sudāruṇāḥ  || 215.42 ||
tatra saṃpīḍya subhṛśaṃ praveśaṃ yamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
nīyante pāpinastatra yatra tiṣṭhetsvayaṃ yamaḥ  || 215.43 ||
dharmātmā dharmakṛddevaḥ sarvasaṃyamano yamaḥ  |
evaṃ pathātikaṣṭena prāptāḥ pretapuraṃ narāḥ  || 215.44 ||
prajñāpitāstadā dūtairniveśyante yamāgrataḥ  |
tataste pāpakarmāṇastaṃ paśyanti bhayānakam  || 215.45 ||
pāpāpaviddhanayanā viparītātmabuddhayaḥ  |
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ bhrukūṭīkuṭilekṣaṇam  || 215.46 ||
ūrdhvakeśaṃ mahāśmaśruṃ prasphuradadharottaram  |
aṣṭādaśabhujaṃ kruddhaṃ nīlāñjanacayopamam  || 215.47 ||
sarvāyudhodyatakaraṃ tīvradaṇḍena saṃyutam  |
mahāmahiṣamārūḍhaṃ dīptāgnisamalocanam  || 215.48 ||
raktamālyāmbaradharaṃ mahāmeghamivocchritam  |
pralayāmbudanirghoṣaṃ pibanniva mahodadhim  || 215.49 ||
grasantamiva trailokyamudgirantamivānalam  |
mṛtyuṃ ca tatsamīpasthaṃ kālānalasamaprabham  || 215.50 ||
pralayānalasaṃkāśaṃ kṛtāntaṃ ca bhayānakam  |
mārīcogrā mahāmārī kālarātrī ca dāruṇā  || 215.51 ||
vividhā vyādhayaḥ kaṣṭā nānārūpā bhayāvahāḥ  |
śaktiśūlāṅkuśadharāḥ pāśacakrāsidhāriṇaḥ  || 215.52 ||
vajradaṇḍadharā raudrāḥ kṣuratūṇadhanurdharāḥ  |
asaṃkhyātā mahāvīryāḥ krūrāścāñjanasaprabhāḥ  || 215.53 ||
sarvāyudhodyatakarā yamadūtā bhayānakāḥ  |
anena parivāreṇa mahāghoreṇa saṃvṛtam  || 215.54 ||
yamaṃ paśyanti pāpiṣṭhāścitraguptaṃ vibhīṣaṇam  |
nirbhartsayati cātyarthaṃ yamastān pāpakāriṇaḥ  || 215.55 ||
citraguptastu bhagavān dharmavākyaiḥ prabodhayan  ||* 215.56 ||
{citragupta uvāca̱ }
bho bho duṣkṛtakarmāṇaḥ paradravyāpahāriṇaḥ  |
garvitā rūpavīryeṇa paradāravimardakāḥ  || 215.57 ||
yatsvayaṃ kriyate karma tatsvayaṃ bhujyate punaḥ  |
tatkimātmopaghātārthaṃ bhavadbhirduṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam  || 215.58 ||
idānīṃ kiṃ nu śocadhvaṃ pīḍyamānāḥ svakarmabhiḥ  |
bhuñjadhvaṃ svāni duḥkhāni nahi doṣo'sti kasyacit || 215.59 ||
ya ete pṛthivīpālāḥ saṃprāptā matsamīpataḥ  |
svakīyaiḥ karmabhirghorairduṣprajñā balagarvitāḥ  || 215.60 ||
bho bho nṛpā durācārāḥ prajāvidhvaṃsakāriṇaḥ  |
alpakālasya rājyasya kṛte kiṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam  || 215.61 ||
rājyalobhena mohena balādanyāyataḥ prajāḥ  |
yaddaṇḍitāḥ phalaṃ tasya bhuñjadhvamadhunā nṛpāḥ  || 215.62 ||
kuto rājyaṃ kalatraṃ ca yadarthamaśubhaṃ kṛtam  |
tatsarvaṃ saṃparityajya yūyamekākinaḥ sthitāḥ  || 215.63 ||
paśyāmo na balaṃ sarvaṃ yena vidhvaṃsitāḥ prajāḥ  |
yamadūtaiḥ pāṭyamānā adhunā kīdṛśaṃ phalam  || 215.64 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ bahuvidhairvākyairupālabdhā yamena te  |
śocantaḥ svāni karmāṇi tūṣṇīṃ tiṣṭhanti pārthivāḥ  || 215.65 ||
iti karma samādiśya nṛpāṇāṃ dharmarāṭsvayam  |
tatpātakaviśuddhyarthamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 215.66 ||
{yama uvāca̱ }
bho bhoścaṇḍa mahācaṇḍa gṛhītvā nṛpatīnimān  |
viśodhayadhvaṃ pāpebhyaḥ krameṇa narakāgniṣu  || 215.67 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tataḥ śīghraṃ samutthāya nṛpān saṃgṛhya pādayoḥ  |
bhrāmayitvā tu vegena kṣiptvā cordhvaṃ pragṛhya ca  || 215.68 ||
tattatpāpapramāṇena yamadūtāḥ śilātale  |
āsphoṭayanti tarasā vajreṇeva mahādrumam  || 215.69 ||
tatastu raktaṃ srotobhiḥ sravate jarjarīkṛtaḥ  |
niḥsaṃjñaḥ sa tadā dehī niśceṣṭaśca prajāyate  || 215.70 ||
tataḥ sa vāyunā spṛṣṭaḥ śanairujjīvate punaḥ  |
tataḥ pāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ kṣipanti narakārṇave  || 215.71 ||
anyāṃśca te tadā dūtāḥ pāpakarmaratānnarān  |
nivedayanti viprendrā yamāya bhṛśaduḥkhitān  || 215.72 ||
{yamadūtā ūcu̱ḥ }
eṣa deva tavādeśādasmābhirmohito bhṛśam  |
ānīto dharmavimukhaḥ sadā pāparataḥ paraḥ  || 215.73 ||
eṣa lubdho durācāro mahāpātakasaṃyutaḥ  |
upapātakakartā ca sadā hiṃsārato śuciḥ  || 215.74 ||
agamyāgāmī duṣṭātmā paradravyāpahārakaḥ  |
kanyākrayī kūṭasākṣī kṛtaghno mitravañcakaḥ  || 215.75 ||
anena madamattena sadā dharmo vininditaḥ  |
pāpamācaritaṃ karma martyaloke durātmanā  || 215.76 ||
idānīmasya deveśa nigrahānugrahau vada  |
prabhurasya kriyāyoge vayaṃ vā paripanthinaḥ  || 215.77 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ nyasyāgre pāpakāriṇam  |
narakāṇāṃ sahasreṣu lakṣakoṭiśateṣu ca  || 215.78 ||
kiṃkarāste tato yānti grahītumaparānnarān  |
pratipanne kṛte doṣe yamo vai pāpakāriṇām  || 215.79 ||
samādiśati tān ghorānnigrahāya svakiṃkarān  |
yathā yasya vinirdiṣṭo vasiṣṭhādyairvinigrahaḥ  || 215.80 ||
pāpasya tadbhṛśaṃ kruddhāḥ kurvanti yamakiṃkarāḥ  |
aṅkuśairmudgarairdaṇḍaiḥ krakacaiḥ śaktitomaraiḥ  || 215.81 ||
khaḍgaśūlanipātaiśca bhidyante pāpakāriṇaḥ  |
narakāṇāṃ sahasreṣu lakṣakoṭiśateṣu ca  || 215.82 ||
svakarmopārjitairdoṣaiḥ pīḍyante yamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
śṛṇudhvaṃ narakāṇāṃ ca svarūpaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram  || 215.83 ||
nāmāni ca pramāṇaṃ ca yena yānti narāśca tān  |
mahāvācīti vikhyātaṃ narakaṃ śoṇitaplutam  || 215.84 ||
vajrakaṇṭakasaṃmiśraṃ yojanāyutavistṛtam  |
tatra saṃpīḍyate magno bhidyate vajrakaṇṭake  || 215.85 ||
varṣalakṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ goghātī narake naraḥ  |
yojanānāṃ śataṃ lakṣaṃ kumbhīpākaṃ sudāruṇam  || 215.86 ||
tāmrakumbhavatī dīptā vālukāṅgārasaṃvṛtā  |
brahmahā bhūmihartā ca nikṣepasyāpahārakaḥ  || 215.87 ||
dahyante tatra saṃkṣiptā yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  |
rauravo vajranārācaiḥ prajvaladbhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ  || 215.88 ||
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭirāyāmavistaraiḥ  |
bhidyante tatra nārācaiḥ sajvālairnarake narāḥ  || 215.89 ||
ikṣuvattatra pīḍyante ye narāḥ kūṭasākṣiṇaḥ  |
ayomayaṃ prajvalitaṃ mañjūṣaṃ narakaṃ smṛtam  || 215.90 ||
nikṣiptāstatra dahyante bandigrāhakṛtāśca ye  |
apratiṣṭheti narakaṃ pūyamūtrapurīṣakam  || 215.91 ||
adhomukhaḥ patettatra brāhmaṇasyopapīḍakaḥ  |
lākṣāprajvalitaṃ ghoraṃ narakaṃ tu vilepakam  || 215.92 ||
nimagnāstatra dahyante madyapāne dvijottamāḥ  |
mahāprabheti narakaṃ dīptaśūlamahocchrayam  || 215.93 ||
tatra śūlena bhidyante patibhāryopabhedinaḥ  |
narakaṃ ca mahāghoraṃ jayantī cāyasī śilā  || 215.94 ||
tayā cākramyate pāpaḥ paradāropasevakaḥ  |
narakaṃ śālmalākhyaṃ tu pradīptadṛḍhakaṇṭakam  || 215.95 ||
tayā liṅgati duḥkhārtā nārī bahunaraṃgamā  |
ye vadanti sadāsatyaṃ paramarmāvakartanam  || 215.96 ||
jihvā cocchriyate teṣāṃ sadasyairyamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
ye tu rāgaiḥ kaṭākṣaiśca vīkṣante parayoṣitam  || 215.97 ||
teṣāṃ cakṣūṃṣi nārācairvidhyante yamakiṃkaraiḥ  ||* 215.98 ||
mātaraṃ ye'pi gacchanti bhaginīṃ duhitaraṃ snuṣām  |
strībālavṛddhahantāro yāvadindrāścaturdaśa  |
jvālāmālākulaṃ raudraṃ mahārauravasaṃjñitam  || 215.99 ||
narakaṃ yojanānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi caturdaśa  |
puraṃ kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ grāmaṃ yo dīpayati vahninā  || 215.100 ||
sa tatra dahyate mūḍho yāvatkalpasthitirnaraḥ  |
tāmisramiti vikhyātaṃ lakṣayojanavistṛtam  || 215.101 ||
nipatadbhiḥ sadā raudraḥ khaḍgapaṭṭiśamudgaraiḥ  |
tatra caurā narāḥ kṣiptāstāḍyante yamakiṃkaraiḥ  || 215.102 ||
śūlaśaktigadākhaḍgairyāvatkalpaśatatrayam  |
tāmisrāddviguṇaṃ proktaṃ mahātāmisrasaṃjñitam  || 215.103 ||
jalaukāsarpasaṃpūrṇāṃ nirālokaṃ suduḥkhadam  |
mātṛhā pitṛhā caiva mitravisrambhaghātakaḥ  || 215.104 ||
tiṣṭhanti takṣyamāṇāśca yāvattiṣṭhati medinī  |
asipattravanaṃ nāma narakaṃ bhūriduḥkhadam  || 215.105 ||
yojanāyutavistāraṃ jvalatkhaḍgaiḥ samākulam  |
pātitastatra taiḥ khaḍgaiḥ śatadhā tu samāhataḥ  || 215.106 ||
mitraghnaḥ kṛtyate tāvadyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam  |
karambhavālukā nāma narakaṃ yojanāyutam  || 215.107 ||
kūpākāraṃ vṛtaṃ dīptairvālukāṅgārakaṇṭakaiḥ  |
dahyate bhidyate varṣa lakṣāyutaśatatrayam  || 215.108 ||
yena dagdho jano nityaṃ mithyopāyaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ  |
kākolaṃ nāma narakaṃ kṛmipūyapariplutam  || 215.109 ||
kṣipyate tatra duṣṭātmā ekākī miṣṭabhuṅnaraḥ  |
kuḍmalaṃ nāma narakaṃ pūrṇaṃ viṇmūtraśoṇitaiḥ  || 215.110 ||
pañcayajñakriyāhīnāḥ kṣipyante tatra vai narāḥ  |
sudurgandhaṃ mahābhīmaṃ māṃsaśoṇitasaṃkulam  || 215.111 ||
abhakṣyānne ratāste'tra nipatanti narādhamāḥ  |
krimikīṭasamākīrṇaṃ śavapūrṇaṃ mahāvaṭam  || 215.112 ||
adhomukhaḥ patettatra kanyāvikrayakṛnnaraḥ  |
nāmnā vai tilapāketi narakaṃ dāruṇaṃ smṛtam  || 215.113 ||
tilavattatra pīḍyante parapīḍāratāśca ye  |
narakaṃ tailapāketi jvalattailamahīplavam  || 215.114 ||
pacyate tatra mitraghno hantā ca śaraṇāgatam  |
nāmnā vajrakapāṭeti vajraśṛṅkhalayānvitam  || 215.115 ||
pīḍyante nirdayaṃ tatra yaiḥ kṛtaḥ kṣīravikrayaḥ  |
nirucchvāsa iti proktaṃ tamondhaṃ vātavarjitam  || 215.116 ||
niśceṣṭaṃ kṣipyate tatra vipradānanirodhakṛt |
aṅgāropacayaṃ nāma dīptāṅgārasamujjvalam  || 215.117 ||
dahyate tatra yenoktaṃ dānaṃ viprāya nārpitam  |
mahāpāyīti narakaṃ lakṣayojanamāyatam  || 215.118 ||
pātyante'dhomukhāstatra ye jalpanti sadānṛtam  |
mahājvāleti narakaṃ jvālābhāsvarabhīṣaṇam  || 215.119 ||
dahyate tatra suciraṃ yaḥ pāpe buddhikṛnnaraḥ  |
narakaṃ krakacākhyātaṃ pīḍyante tatra vai narāḥ  || 215.120 ||
krakacairvajradhārograiragamyāgamane ratāḥ  |
narakaṃ guḍapāketi jvaladguḍahradairvṛtam  || 215.121 ||
nikṣipto dahyate tasmin varṇasaṃkarakṛnnaraḥ  |
kṣuradhāreti narakaṃ tīkṣṇakṣurasamāvṛtam  || 215.122 ||
chidyante tatra kalpāntaṃ viprabhūmiharā narāḥ  |
narakaṃ cāmbarīṣākhyaṃ pralayānaladīpitam  || 215.123 ||
kalpakoṭiśataṃ tatra dahyate svarṇahārakaḥ  |
nāmnā vajrakuṭhāreti narakaṃ vajrasaṃkulam  || 215.124 ||
chidyante tatra chettāro drumāṇāṃ pāpakāriṇaḥ  |
