narakaṃ paritāpākhyaṃ pralayānaladīpitam  || 215.125 ||
garado madhuhartā ca pacyate tatra pāpakṛt |
narakaṃ kālasūtraṃ ca vajrasūtravinirmitam  || 215.126 ||
bhramantastatra cchidyante parasasyopaluṇṭhakāḥ  |
narakaṃ kaśmalaṃ nāma śleṣmaśiṅghāṇakāvṛtam  || 215.127 ||
tatra saṃkṣipyate kalpaṃ sadā māṃsarucirnaraḥ  |
narakaṃ cogragandheti lālāmūtrapurīṣavat || 215.128 ||
kṣipyante tatra narake pitṛpiṇḍāprayacchakāḥ  |
narakaṃ durdharaṃ nāma jalaukāvṛścikākulam  || 215.129 ||
utkocabhakṣakastatra tiṣṭhate varṣakāyutam  |
yacca vajramahāpīḍā narakaṃ vajranirmitam  || 215.130 ||
tatra prakṣipya dahyante pīḍyante yamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā parakīyaṃ haranti ye  || 215.131 ||
yamadūtaiśca caurāste chidyante lavaśaḥ kṣuraiḥ  |
ye hatvā prāṇinaṃ mūḍhāḥ khādante kākagṛdhravat || 215.132 ||
bhojyante ca svamāṃsaṃ te kalpāntaṃ yamakiṃkaraiḥ  |
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ vastraṃ parakīyaṃ haranti ye  || 215.133 ||
yamadūtaiśca te mūḍhā bhidyante śaktitomaraiḥ  |
phalaṃ pattraṃ nṛṇāṃ vāpi hṛtaṃ yaistu kubuddhibhiḥ  || 215.134 ||
yamadūtaiśca te kruddhairdahyante tṛṇavahnibhiḥ  |
paradravye kalatre ca yaḥ sadā duṣṭadhīrnaraḥ  || 215.135 ||
yamadūtairjvalattasya hṛdi śūlaṃ nikhanyate  |
karmaṇā manasā vācā ye dharmavimukhā narāḥ  || 215.136 ||
yamaloke tu te ghorā labhante pariyātanāḥ  |
evaṃ śatasahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatāni ca  || 215.137 ||
narakāṇi naraistatra bhujyante pāpakāribhiḥ  |
iha kṛtvā svalpamapi naraḥ karmāśubhātmakam  || 215.138 ||
prāpnoti narake ghore yamalokeṣu yātanām  |
na śṛṇvanti narā mūḍhā dharmoktaṃ sādhu bhāṣitam  || 215.139 ||
dṛṣṭaṃ keneti pratyakṣaṃ pratyuktyaivaṃ vadanti te  |
divā rātrau prayatnena pāpaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ  || 215.140 ||
nācaranti hi te dharmaṃ pramādenāpi mohitāḥ  |
ihaiva phalabhoktāraḥ paratra vimukhāśca ye  || 215.141 ||
te patanti sughoreṣu narakeṣu narādhamāḥ  |
dāruṇo narake vāsaḥ svargavāsaḥ sukhapradaḥ  |
naraiḥ saṃprāpyate tatra karma kṛtvā śubhāśubham  || 215.142 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
aho'tiduḥkhaṃ ghoraṃ ca yamamārge tvayoditam  |
narakāṇi ca ghorāṇi dvāraṃ yāmyaṃ ca sattama  || 216.1 ||
astyupāyo na vā brahman yamamārge'tibhīṣaṇe  |
brūhi yena narā yānti sukhena yamasādanam  || 216.2 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
iha ye dharmasaṃyuktāstvahiṃsāniratā narāḥ  |
guruśuśrūṣaṇe yuktā devabrāhmaṇapūjakāḥ  || 216.3 ||
yasminmanuṣyalokāste sabhāryāḥ sasutāstathā  |
tamadhvānaṃ ca gacchanti yathā tatkathayāmi vaḥ  || 216.4 ||
vimānairvividhairdivyaiḥ kāñcanadhvajaśobhitaiḥ  |
dharmarājapuraṃ yānti sevamānāpsarogaṇaiḥ  || 216.5 ||
brāhmaṇebhyastu dānāni nānārūpāṇi bhaktitaḥ  |
ye prayacchanti te yānti sukhenaiva mahāpathe  || 216.6 ||
annaṃ ye tu prayacchanti brāhmaṇebhyaḥ susaṃkṛtam  |
śrotriyebhyo viśeṣeṇa bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ  || 216.7 ||
taruṇībhirvarastrībhiḥ sevyamānāḥ prayatnataḥ  |
dharmarājapuraṃ yānti vimānairabhyalaṃkṛtaiḥ  || 216.8 ||
ye ca satyaṃ prabhāṣante bahirantaśca nirmalāḥ  |
te'pi yāntyamaraprakhyā vimānairyamamandiram  || 216.9 ||
godānāni pavitrāṇi viṣṇumuddiśya sādhuṣu  |
ye prayacchanti dharmajñāḥ kṛśeṣu kṛśavṛttiṣu  || 216.10 ||
te yānti divyavarṇābhairvimānairmaṇicitritaiḥ  |
dharmarājapuraṃ śrīmān sevyamānāpsarogaṇaiḥ  || 216.11 ||
upānadyugalaṃ chattraṃ śayyāsanamathāpi vā  |
ye prayacchanti vastrāṇi tathaivābharaṇāni ca  || 216.12 ||
te yāntyaśvai rathaiścaiva kuñjaraiścāpyalaṃkṛtāḥ  |
dharmarājapuraṃ divyaṃ chattraiḥ sauvarṇarājataiḥ  || 216.13 ||
ye ca bhaktyā prayacchanti guḍapānakamarcitam  |
odanaṃ ca dvijāgryebhyo viśuddhenāntarātmanā  || 216.14 ||
te yānti kāñcanairyānairvividhaistu yamālayam  |
varastrībhiryathākāmaṃ sevyamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ  || 216.15 ||
ye ca kṣīraṃ prayacchanti ghṛtaṃ dadhi guḍaṃ madhu  |
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayatnena śuddhyopetaṃ susaṃskṛtam  || 216.16 ||
cakravākaprayuktaiśca vimānaistu hiraṇmayaiḥ  |
yānti gandharvavāditraiḥ sevyamānā yamālayam  || 216.17 ||
ye phalāni prayacchanti puṣpāṇi surabhīṇi ca  |
haṃsayuktairvimānaistu yānti dharmapuraṃ narāḥ  || 216.18 ||
ye tilāṃstiladhenuṃ ca ghṛtadhenumathāpi vā  |
śrotriyebhyaḥ prayacchanti viprebhyaḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ  || 216.19 ||
somamaṇḍalasaṃkāśairyānaiste yānti nirmalaiḥ  |
gandharvairupagīyante pure vaivasvatasya te  || 216.20 ||
yeṣāṃ vāpyaśca kūpāśca taḍāgāni sarāṃsi ca  |
dīrghikāḥ puṣkariṇyaśca śītalāśca jalāśayāḥ  || 216.21 ||
yānaiste hemacandrābhairdivyaghaṇṭānināditaiḥ  |
vyajanaistālavṛntaiśca vījyamānā mahāprabhāḥ  || 216.22 ||
yeṣāṃ devakulānyatra citrāṇyāyatanāni ca  |
ratnaiḥ prasphuramāṇāni manojñāni śubhāni ca  || 216.23 ||
te yānti lokapālaistu vimānairvātaraṃhasaiḥ  |
dharmarājapuraṃ divyaṃ nānājanasamākulam  || 216.24 ||
pānīyaṃ ye prayacchanti sarvaprāṇyupajīvitam  |
te vitṛṣṇāḥ sukhaṃ yānti vimānaistaṃ mahāpatham  || 216.25 ||
kāṣṭhapādukayānāni pīṭhakānyāsanāni ca  |
yairdattāni dvijātibhyaste'dhvānaṃ yānti vai sukham  || 216.26 ||
sauvarṇamaṇipīṭheṣu pādau kṛtvottameṣu ca  |
te prayānti vimānaistu apsarogaṇamaṇḍitaiḥ  || 216.27 ||
ārāmāṇi vicitrāṇi puṣpāḍhyānīha mānavāḥ  |
ropayanti phalāḍhyāni narāṇāmupakāriṇaḥ  || 216.28 ||
vṛkṣacchāyāsu ramyāsu śītalāsu svalaṃkṛtāḥ  |
varastrīgītavādyaiśca sevyamānā vrajanti te  || 216.29 ||
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi vidrumaṃ mauktikaṃ tathā  |
ye prayacchanti te yānti vimānaiḥ kanakojjvalaiḥ  || 216.30 ||
bhūmidā dīpyamānāśca sarvakāmaistu tarpitāḥ  |
uditādityasaṃkāśairvimānairbhṛśanāditaiḥ  || 216.31 ||
kanyāṃ tu ye prayacchanti brahmadeyāmalaṃkṛtām  |
divyakanyāvṛtā yānti vimānaiste yamālayam  || 216.32 ||
sugandhāgurukarpūrān puṣpadhūpān dvijottamāḥ  |
prayacchanti dvijātibhyo bhaktyā paramayānvitāḥ  || 216.33 ||
te sugandhāḥ suveśāśca suprabhāḥ suvibhūṣitāḥ  |
yānti dharmapuraṃ yānairvicitrairabhyalaṃkṛtāḥ  || 216.34 ||
dīpadā yānti yānaiśca dīpayanto diśo daśa  |
ādityasadṛśairyānairdīpyamānā yathāgnayaḥ  || 216.35 ||
gṛhāvasathadātāro gṛhaiḥ kāñcanamaṇḍitaiḥ  |
vrajanti bālārkanibhairdharmarājagṛhaṃ narāḥ  || 216.36 ||
jalabhājanadātāraḥ kuṇḍikākarakapradāḥ  |
pūjamānāpsarobhiśca yānti dṛptā mahāgajaiḥ  || 216.37 ||
pādābhyaṅgaṃ śirobhyaṅgaṃ snānapānodakaṃ tathā  |
ye prayacchanti viprebhyaste yāntyaśvairyamālayam  || 216.38 ||
viśrāmayanti ye viprāñśrāntānadhvani karśitān  |
cakravākaprayuktena yānti yānena te sukham  || 216.39 ||
svāgatena ca yo vipraṃ pūjayedāsanena ca  |
sa gacchati tamadhvānaṃ sukhaṃ paramanirvṛtaḥ  || 216.40 ||
namo brahmaṇyadeveti yo hariṃ cābhivādayet |
gāṃ ca pāpaharetyuktvā sukhaṃ yānti ca tatpatham  || 216.41 ||
anantarāśino ye ca dambhānṛtavivarjitāḥ  |
te'pi sārasayuktaistu yānti yānaiśca tatpatham  || 216.42 ||
vartante hyekabhaktena śāṭhyadambhavivarjitāḥ  |
haṃsayuktairvimānaistu sukhaṃ yānti yamālayam  || 216.43 ||
caturthenaikabhaktena vartante ye jitendriyāḥ  |
te yānti dharmanagaraṃ yānairbarhiṇayojitaiḥ  || 216.44 ||
tṛtīye divase ye tu bhuñjate niyatavratāḥ  |
te'pi hastirathairdivyairyānti yānaiśca tatpadam  || 216.45 ||
ṣaṣṭhe'nnabhakṣako yastu śaucanityo jitendriyaḥ  |
sa yāti kuñjarasthastu śacīpatiriva svayam  || 216.46 ||
dharmarājapuraṃ divyaṃ nānāmaṇivibhūṣitam  |
nānāsvarasamāyuktaṃ jayaśabdaravairyutam  || 216.47 ||
pakṣopavāsino yānti yānaiḥ śārdūlayojitaiḥ  |
puraṃ taddharmarājasya sevyamānāḥ surāsuraiḥ  || 216.48 ||
ye ca māsopavāsaṃ tu kurvate saṃyatendriyāḥ  |
te'pi sūryapradīptaistu yānti yānairyamālayam  || 216.49 ||
mahāprasthānamekāgro yaḥ prayāti dṛḍhavrataḥ  |
sevyamānastu gandharvairyāti yānairyamālayam  || 216.50 ||
śarīraṃ sādhayedyastu vaiṣṇavenāntarātmanā  |
sa rathenāgnivarṇena yātīha tridaśālayam  || 216.51 ||
agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryānnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ  |
sa yātyagniprakāśena vimānena yamālayam  || 216.52 ||
prāṇāṃstyajati yo martyaḥ smaran viṣṇuṃ sanātanam  |
yānenārkaprakāśena yāti dharmapuraṃ naraḥ  || 216.53 ||
praviṣṭo'ntarjalaṃ yastu prāṇāṃstyajati mānavaḥ  |
somamaṇḍalakalpena yāti yānena vai sukham  || 216.54 ||
svaśarīraṃ hi gṛdhrebhyo vaiṣṇavo yaḥ prayacchati  |
sa yāti rathamukhyena kāñcanena yamālayam  || 216.55 ||
strīgrahe gograhe vāpi yuddhe mṛtyumupaiti yaḥ  |
sa yātyamarakanyābhiḥ sevyamāno raviprabhaḥ  || 216.56 ||
vaiṣṇavā ye ca kurvanti tīrthayātrāṃ jitendriyāḥ  |
tatpathaṃ yānti te ghoraṃ sukhayānairalaṃkṛtāḥ  || 216.57 ||
ye yajanti dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kratubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ  |
taptahāṭakasaṃkāśairvimānairyānti te sukham  || 216.58 ||
parapīḍāmakurvanto bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇādikam  |
kurvanti te sukhaṃ yānti vimānaiḥ kanakojjvalaiḥ  || 216.59 ||
ye kṣāntāḥ sarvabhūteṣu prāṇināmabhayapradāḥ  |
krodhamohavinirmuktā nirmadāḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ  || 216.60 ||
pūrṇacandraprakāśena vimānena mahāprabhāḥ  |
yānti vaivasvatapuraṃ devagandharvasevitāḥ  || 216.61 ||
ekabhāvena ye viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ tryambakaṃ ravim  |
pūjayanti hi te yānti vimānairbhāskaraprabhaiḥ  || 216.62 ||
ye ca māṃsaṃ na khādanti satyaśaucasamanvitāḥ  |
te'pi yānti sukhenaiva dharmarājapuraṃ narāḥ  || 216.63 ||
māṃsānmiṣṭataraṃ nāsti bhakṣyabhojyādikeṣu ca  |
tasmānmāṃsaṃ na bhuñjīta nāsti miṣṭaiḥ sukhodayaḥ  || 216.64 ||
gosahasraṃ tu yo dadyādyastu māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet |
samāvetau purā prāha brahmā vedavidāṃ varaḥ  || 216.65 ||
sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam  |
amāṃsabhakṣaṇe viprāstacca tacca ca tatsamam  || 216.66 ||
evaṃ sukhena te yānti yamalokaṃ ca dhārmikāḥ  |
dānavrataparā yānairyatra devo raveḥ sutaḥ  || 216.67 ||
dṛṣṭvā tān dhārmikān devaḥ svayaṃ saṃmānayedyamaḥ  |
svāgatāsanadānena pādyārghyeṇa priyeṇa tu  || 216.68 ||
dhanyā yūyaṃ mahātmāna ātmano hitakāriṇaḥ  |
yena divyasukhārthāya bhavadbhiḥ sukṛtaṃ kṛtam  || 216.69 ||
idaṃ vimānamāruhya divyastrībhogabhūṣitāḥ  |
svargaṃ gacchadhvamatulaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam  || 216.70 ||
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānante puṇyaparikṣayāt |
yatkiṃcidalpamaśubhaṃ phalaṃ tadiha bhokṣyatha  || 216.71 ||
ye tu taṃ dharmarājānaṃ narāḥ puṇyānubhāvataḥ  |
paśyanti saumyamanasaṃ pitṛbhūtamivātmanaḥ  || 216.72 ||
tasmāddharmaḥ sevitavyaḥ sadā muktiphalapradaḥ  |
dharmādarthastathā kāmo mokṣaśca parikīrtyate  || 216.73 ||
dharmo mātā pitā bhrātā dharmo nāthaḥ suhṛttathā  |
dharmaḥ svāmī sakhā goptā tathā dhātā ca poṣakaḥ  || 216.74 ||
dharmādartho'rthataḥ kāmaḥ kāmādbhogaḥ sukhāni ca  |
dharmādaiśvaryamekāgryaṃ dharmātsvargagatiḥ parā  || 216.75 ||
dharmastu sevito viprāstrāyate mahato bhayāt |
devatvaṃ ca dvijatvaṃ ca dharmātprāpnotyasaṃśayam  || 216.76 ||
yadā ca kṣīyate pāpaṃ narāṇāṃ pūrvasaṃcitam  |
tadaiṣāṃ bhajate buddhirdharmaṃ cātra dvijottamāḥ  || 216.77 ||
janmāntarasahasreṣu mānuṣyaṃ prāpya durlabham  |
yo hi nācarate dharmaṃ bhavetsa khalu vañcitaḥ  || 216.78 ||
kutsitā ye daridrāśca virūpā vyādhitāstathā  |
parapreṣyāśca mūrkhāśca jñeyā dharmavivarjitāḥ  || 216.79 ||
ye hi dīrghāyuṣaḥ śūrāḥ paṇḍitā bhogino'rthinaḥ  |
arogā rūpavantaśca taistu dharmaḥ purā kṛtaḥ  || 216.80 ||
evaṃ dharmaratā viprā gacchanti gatimuttamām  |
adharmaṃ sevamānāstu tiryagyoniṃ vrajanti te  || 216.81 ||
ye narā narakadhvaṃsi vāsudevamanuvratāḥ  |
te svapne'pi na paśyanti yamaṃ vā narakāṇi vā  || 216.82 ||
anādinidhanaṃ devaṃ daityadānavadāraṇam  |
ye namanti narā nityaṃ nahi paśyanti te yamam  || 216.83 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā ye'cyutaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ  |
na samartho yamasteṣāṃ te muktiphalabhāginaḥ  || 216.84 ||
ye janā jagatāṃ nāthaṃ nityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dvijāḥ  |
namanti nahi te viṣṇoḥ sthānādanyatra gāminaḥ  || 216.85 ||
na te dūtānna tanmārgaṃ na yamaṃ na ca tāṃ purīm  |
praṇamya viṣṇuṃ paśyanti narakāṇi kathaṃcana  || 216.86 ||
kṛtvāpi bahuśaḥ pāpaṃ narā mohasamanvitāḥ  |
na yānti narakaṃ natvā sarvapāpaharaṃ harim  || 216.87 ||
śāṭhyenāpi narā nityaṃ ye smaranti janārdanam  |
te'pi yānti tanuṃ tyaktvā viṣṇulokamanāmayam  || 216.88 ||
atyantakrodhasakto'pi kadācitkīrtayeddharim  |
so'pi doṣakṣayānmuktiṃ labheccedipatiryathā  || 216.89 ||
{lomaharṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
śrutvaivaṃ yamamārgaṃ te narakeṣu ca yātanām  |
papracchuśca punarvyāsaṃ saṃśayaṃ munisattamāḥ  || 217.1 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada  |
martyasya kaḥ sahāyo vai pitā mātā suto guruḥ  || 217.2 ||
jñātisaṃbandhivargaśca mitravargastathaiva ca  |
gṛhaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ  |
gacchantyamutra loke vai kaśca tānanugacchati  || 217.3 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ekaḥ prasūyate viprā eka eva hi naśyati  |
ekastarati durgāṇi gacchatyekastu durgatim  || 217.4 ||
asahāyaḥ pitā mātā tathā bhrātā suto guruḥ  |
jñātisaṃbandhivargaśca mitravargastathaiva ca  || 217.5 ||
mṛtaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ  |
muhūrtamiva roditvā tato yānti parāṅmukhāḥ  || 217.6 ||
taistaccharīramutsṛṣṭaṃ dharma eko'nugacchati  |
tasmāddharmaḥ sahāyaśca sevitavyaḥ sadā nṛbhiḥ  || 217.7 ||
prāṇī dharmasamāyukto gacchetsvargagatiṃ parām  |
tathaivādharmasaṃyukto narakaṃ copapadyate  || 217.8 ||
tasmātpāpāgatairarthairnānurajyeta paṇḍitaḥ  |
dharma eko manuṣyāṇāṃ sahāyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ  || 217.9 ||
lobhānmohādanukrośādbhayādvātha bahuśrutaḥ  |
naraḥ karotyakāryāṇi parārthe lobhamohitaḥ  || 217.10 ||
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca tritayaṃ jīvataḥ phalam  |
etattrayamavāptavyamadharmaparivarjitam  || 217.11 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
śrutaṃ bhagavato vākyaṃ dharmayuktaṃ paraṃ hitam  |
śarīranicayaṃ jñātuṃ buddhirno'tra prajāyate  || 217.12 ||
mṛtaṃ śarīraṃ hi nṛṇāṃ sūkṣmamavyaktatāṃ gatam  |
acakṣurviṣayaṃ prāptaṃ kathaṃ dharmo'nugacchati  || 217.13 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotirmanontaram  |
buddhirātmā ca sahitā dharmaṃ paśyanti nityadā  || 217.14 ||
prāṇināmiha sarveṣāṃ sākṣibhūtā divāniśam  |
etaiśca saha dharmo hi taṃ jīvamanugacchati  || 217.15 ||
tvagasthi māṃsaṃ śukraṃ ca śoṇitaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  |
śarīraṃ varjayantyete jīvitena vivarjitam  || 217.16 ||
tato dharmasamāyuktaḥ sa jīvaḥ sukhamedhate  |
ihaloke pare caiva kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi vaḥ  || 217.17 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
taddarśitaṃ bhagavatā yathā dharmo'nugacchati  |
etattu jñātumicchāmaḥ kathaṃ retaḥ pravartate  || 217.18 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
annamaśnanti ye devāḥ śarīrasthā dvijottamāḥ  |
pṛthivī vāyurākāśamāpo jyotirmanastathā  || 217.19 ||
tatastṛpteṣu bho viprāsteṣu bhūteṣu pañcasu  |
manaḥṣaṣṭheṣu śuddhātmā retaḥ saṃpadyate mahat || 217.20 ||
tato garbhaḥ saṃbhavati śleṣmā strīpuṃsayordvijāḥ  |
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha  || 217.21 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
ākhyātaṃ no bhagavatā garbhaḥ saṃjāyate yathā  |
yathā jātastu puruṣaḥ prapadyate taducyatām  || 217.22 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
āsannamātrapuruṣastairbhūtairabhibhūyate  |
viprayuktastu tairbhūtaiḥ punaryātyaparāṃ gatim  || 217.23 ||
sa ca bhūtasamāyuktaḥ prāpnoti jīvameva hi  |
tato'sya karma paśyanti śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham  |
devatāḥ pañcabhūtasthāḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha  || 217.24 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
tvagasthi māṃsamutsṛjya taistu bhūtairvivarjitaḥ  |
jīvaḥ sa bhagavan kvasthaḥ sukhaduḥkhe samaśnute  || 217.25 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
jīvaḥ karmasamāyuktaḥ śīghraṃ retaḥsamāgataḥ  |
strīṇāṃ puṣpaṃ samāsādya tataḥ kālena bho dvijāḥ  || 217.26 ||
yamasya puruṣaiḥ kleśo yamasya puruṣairvadhaḥ  |
duḥkhaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ ca naraḥ kleśaṃ ca vindati  || 217.27 ||
iha loke sa tu prāṇī janmaprabhṛti bho dvijāḥ  |
sukṛtaṃ karma vai bhuṅkte dharmasya phalamāśritaḥ  || 217.28 ||
yadi dharmaṃ samāyujya janmaprabhṛti sevate  |
tataḥ sa puruṣo bhūtvā sevate nityadā sukham  || 217.29 ||
athāntarāntaraṃ dharmamadharmamupasevate  |
sukhasyānantaraṃ duḥkhaṃ sa jīvo'pyadhigacchati  || 217.30 ||
adharmeṇa samāyukto yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ  |
mahāduḥkhaṃ samāsādya tiryagyonau prajāyate  || 217.31 ||
karmaṇā yena yeneha yasyāṃ yonau prajāyate  |
jīvo mohasamāyuktastanme śṛṇuta sāṃpratam  || 217.32 ||
yadetaducyate śāstraiḥ setihāsaiśca chandasi  |
yamasya viṣayaṃ ghoraṃ martyalokaṃ pravartate  || 217.33 ||
iha sthānāni puṇyāni devatulyāni bho dvijāḥ  |
tiryagyonyatiriktāni gatimanti ca sarvaśaḥ  || 217.34 ||
yamasya bhavane divye brahmalokasame guṇaiḥ  |
karmabhirniyatairbaddho janturduḥkhānyupāśnute  || 217.35 ||
yena yena hi bhāvena yena vai karmaṇā gatim  |
prayāti puruṣo ghorāṃ tathā vakṣyāmyataḥ param  || 217.36 ||
adhītya caturo vedān dvijo mohasamanvitaḥ  |
patitātpratigṛhyātha kharayonau prajāyate  || 217.37 ||
kharo jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bho dvijāḥ  |
kharo mṛto balīvardaḥ sapta varṣāṇi jīvati  || 217.38 ||
balīvardo mṛtaścāpi jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ  |
brahmarakṣastu māsāṃstrīṃstato jāyeta brāhmaṇaḥ  || 217.39 ||
patitaṃ yājayitvā tu kṛmiyonau prajāyate  |
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bho dvijāḥ  || 217.40 ||
krimibhāvādvinirmuktastato jāyeta gardabhaḥ  |
gardabhaḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi śūkaraḥ  || 217.41 ||
kukkuṭaḥ pañca varṣāṇi pañca varṣāṇi jambukaḥ  |
śvā varṣamekaṃ bhavati tato jāyeta mānavaḥ  || 217.42 ||
upādhyāyasya yaḥ pāpaṃ śiṣyaḥ kuryādabuddhimān  |
sa janmānīha saṃsāre trīnāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ  || 217.43 ||
prākśvā bhavati bho viprāstataḥ kravyāttataḥ kharaḥ  |
pretya ca parikliṣṭeṣu paścājjāyeta brāhmaṇaḥ  || 217.44 ||
manasāpi gurorbhāryāṃ yaḥ śiṣyo yāti pāpakṛt |
udagrān praiti saṃsārānadharmeṇeha cetasā  || 217.45 ||
śvayonau tu sa saṃbhūtastrīṇi varṣāṇi jīvati  |
tatrāpi nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ krimiyonau prajāyate  || 217.46 ||
kṛmibhāvamanuprāpto varṣamekaṃ tu jīvati  |
tatastu nidhanaṃ prāpya brahmayonau prajāyate  || 217.47 ||
yadi putrasamaṃ śiṣyaṃ gururhanyādakāraṇam  |
ātmanaḥ kāmakāreṇa so'pi hiṃsraḥ prajāyate  || 217.48 ||
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva yastu putro'vamanyate  |
so'pi viprā mṛto jantuḥ pūrvaṃ jāyeta gardabhaḥ  || 217.49 ||
gardabhatvaṃ tu saṃprāpya daśa varṣāṇi jīvati  |
saṃvatsaraṃ tu kumbhīrastato jāyeta mānavaḥ  || 217.50 ||
putrasya mātāpitarau yasya ruṣṭāvubhāvapi  |
gurvapadhyānataḥ so'pi mṛto jāyeta gardabhaḥ  || 217.51 ||
kharo jīvati māsāṃśca daśa cāpi caturdaśa  |
biḍālaḥ sapta māsāṃstu tato jāyeta mānavaḥ  || 217.52 ||
mātāpitarāvākruśya sārīkaḥ saṃprajāyate  |
tāḍayitvā tu tāveva jāyate kacchapo dvijāḥ  || 217.53 ||
kacchapo daśa varṣāṇi trīṇi varṣāṇi śalyakaḥ  |
vyālo bhūtvā tu ṣaṇmāsāṃstato jāyeta mānuṣaḥ  || 217.54 ||
bhartṛpiṇḍamupāśnīno rājadviṣṭāni sevate  |
so'pi mohasamāpanno mṛto jāyeta vānaraḥ  || 217.55 ||
vānaro daśa varṣāṇi sapta varṣāṇi mūṣakaḥ  |
śvā ca bhūtvā tu ṣaṇmāsāṃstato jāyeta mānavaḥ  || 217.56 ||
nyāsāpahartā tu naro yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ  |
saṃsārāṇāṃ śataṃ gatvā kṛmiyonau prajāyate  || 217.57 ||
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bho dvijāḥ  |
duṣkṛtasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyeta mānuṣaḥ  || 217.58 ||
asūyako naraścāpi mṛto jāyeta śārṅgakaḥ  |
viśvāsahartā ca naro mīno jāyeta durmatiḥ  || 217.59 ||
bhūtvā mīno'ṣṭa varṣāṇi mṛgo jāyeta bho dvijāḥ  |
mṛgastu caturo māsāṃstataśchāgaḥ prajāyate  || 217.60 ||
chāgastu nidhanaṃ prāpya pūrṇe saṃvatsare tataḥ  |
kīṭaḥ saṃjāyate jantustato jāyeta mānuṣaḥ  || 217.61 ||
dhānyān yavāṃstilānmāṣān kulitthān sarṣapāṃścaṇān  |
kalāyānatha mudgāṃśca godhūmānatasīstathā  || 217.62 ||
sasyānyanyāni hartā ca martyo mohādacetanaḥ  |
saṃjāyate muniśreṣṭhā mūṣiko nirapatrapaḥ  || 217.63 ||
tataḥ pretya muniśreṣṭhā mṛto jāyeta śūkaraḥ  |
śūkaro jātamātrastu rogeṇa mriyate punaḥ  || 217.64 ||
śvā tato jāyate mūkaḥ karmaṇā tena mānavaḥ  |
bhūtvā śvā pañca varṣāṇi tato jāyeta mānavaḥ  || 217.65 ||
paradārābhimarśaṃ tu kṛtvā jāyeta vai vṛkaḥ  |
śvā śṛgālastato gṛdhro vyālaḥ kaṅko bakastathā  || 217.66 ||
bhrāturbhāryāṃ tu pāpātmā yo dharṣayati mohitaḥ  |
puṃskokilatvamāpnoti so'pi saṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ  || 217.67 ||
sakhibhāryāṃ gurorbhāryāṃ rājabhāryāṃ tathaiva ca  |
pradharṣayitvā kāmātmā mṛto jāyeta śūkaraḥ  || 217.68 ||
śūkaraḥ pañca varṣāṇi daśa varṣāṇi vai bakaḥ  |
pipīlikastu māsāṃstrīn kīṭaḥ syānmāsameva ca  || 217.69 ||
etānāsādya saṃsārān kṛmiyonau prajāyate  |
tatra jīvati māsāṃstu kṛmiyonau caturdaśa  || 217.70 ||
naro'dharmakṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyeta mānuṣaḥ  |
pūrvaṃ dattvā tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dvitīye dātumicchati  || 217.71 ||
so'pi viprā mṛto jantuḥ krimiyonau prajāyate  |
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi trayodaśa dvijottamāḥ  || 217.72 ||
adharmasaṃkṣaye muktastato jāyeta mānuṣaḥ  |
devakāryamakṛtvā tu pitṛkāryamathāpi vā  || 217.73 ||
anirvāpya pitṝn devānmṛto jāyeta vāyasaḥ  |
vāyasaḥ śatavarṣāṇi tato jāyeta kukkuṭaḥ  || 217.74 ||
jāyate vyālakaścāpi māsaṃ tasmāttu mānuṣaḥ  |
jyeṣṭhaṃ pitṛsamaṃ cāpi bhrātaraṃ yo'vamanyate  || 217.75 ||
so'pi mṛtyumupāgamya krauñcayonau prajāyate  |
krauñco jīvati varṣāṇi daśa jāyeta jīvakaḥ  || 217.76 ||
tato nidhanamāpnoti mānuṣatvamavāpnuyāt |
vṛṣalo brāhmaṇīṃ gatvā kṛmiyonau prajāyate  || 217.77 ||
tataḥ saṃprāpya nidhanaṃ jāyate śūkaraḥ punaḥ  |
śūkaro jātamātrastu rogeṇa mriyate dvijāḥ  || 217.78 ||
śvā ca vai jāyate mūḍhaḥ karmaṇā tena bho dvijāḥ  |
śvā bhūtvā kṛtakarmāsau jāyate mānuṣastataḥ  || 217.79 ||
tatrāpatyaṃ samutpādya mṛto jāyeta mūṣikaḥ  |
kṛtaghnastu mṛto viprā yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ  || 217.80 ||
yamasya viṣaye krūrairbaddhaḥ prāpnoti vedanām  |
daṇḍakaṃ mudgaraṃ śūlamagnidaṇḍaṃ ca dāruṇam  || 217.81 ||
asipattravanaṃ ghoraṃ vālukāṃ kūṭaśālmalīm  |
etāścānyāśca bahavo yamasya viṣayaṃ gatāḥ  || 217.82 ||
yātanāḥ prāpya ghorāstu tato yāti ca bho dvijāḥ  |
saṃsāracakramāsādya krimiyonau prajāyate  || 217.83 ||
krimirbhavati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bho dvijāḥ  |
tato garbhaṃ samāsādya tatraiva mriyate naraḥ  || 217.84 ||
tato garbhaśatairjanturbahuśaḥ saṃprapadyate  |
saṃsārān subahūn gatvā tatastiryakprajāyate  || 217.85 ||
tato duḥkhamanuprāpya bahuvarṣagaṇāni vai  |
sa punarbhavasaṃyuktastataḥ kūrmaḥ prajāyate  || 217.86 ||
dadhi hṛtvā bakaścāpi plavo matsyānasaṃskṛtān  |
corayitvā tu durbuddhirmadhudaṃśaḥ prajāyate  || 217.87 ||
phalaṃ vā mūlakaṃ hṛtvā pūpaṃ vāpi pipīlikaḥ  |
corayitvā tu niṣpāvaṃ jāyate phalamūṣakaḥ  || 217.88 ||
pāyasaṃ corayitvā tu tittiratvamavāpnuyāt |
hṛtvā piṣṭamayaṃ pūpaṃ kumbholūkaḥ prajāyate  || 217.89 ||
apo hṛtvā tu durbuddhirvāyaso jāyate naraḥ  |
kāṃsyaṃ hṛtvā tu durbuddhirhārīto jāyate naraḥ  || 217.90 ||
rājataṃ bhājanaṃ hṛtvā kapotaḥ saṃprajāyate  |
hṛtvā tu kāñcanaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ kṛmiyonau prajāyate  || 217.91 ||
pattrorṇaṃ corayitvā tu kuraratvaṃ niyacchati  |
kośakāraṃ tato hṛtvā naro jāyeta nartakaḥ  || 217.92 ||
aṃśukaṃ corayitvā tu śuko jāyeta mānavaḥ  |
corayitvā dukūlaṃ tu mṛto haṃsaḥ prajāyate  || 217.93 ||
krauñcaḥ kārpāsikaṃ hṛtvā mṛto jāyeta mānavaḥ  |
corayitvā naraḥ paṭṭaṃ tvāvikaṃ caiva bho dvijāḥ  || 217.94 ||
kṣaumaṃ ca vastramāhṛtya śaśo jantuḥ prajāyate  |
cūrṇaṃ tu hṛtvā puruṣo mṛto jāyeta barhiṇaḥ  || 217.95 ||
hṛtvā raktāni vastrāṇi jāyate jīvajīvakaḥ  |
varṇakādīṃstathā gandhāṃścorayitveha mānavaḥ  || 217.96 ||
cucchundaritvamāpnoti vipro lobhaparāyaṇaḥ  |
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi tato daśa ca pañca ca  || 217.97 ||
adharmasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyeta mānavaḥ  |
corayitvā payaścāpi balākā saṃprajāyate  || 217.98 ||
yastu corayate tailaṃ naro mohasamanvitaḥ  |
so'pi viprā mṛto jantustailapāyī prajāyate  || 217.99 ||
aśastraṃ puruṣaṃ hatvā saśastraḥ puruṣādhamaḥ  |
arthārthaṃ yadi vā vairī mṛto jāyeta vai kharaḥ  || 217.100 ||
kharo jīvati varṣe dve tataḥ śastreṇa vadhyate  |
sa mṛto mṛgayonau tu nityodvigno'bhijāyate  || 217.101 ||
mṛgo vidhyeta śastreṇa gate saṃvatsare tataḥ  |
hato mṛgastato mīnaḥ so'pi jālena badhyate  || 217.102 ||
māse caturthe saṃprāpte śvāpadaḥ saṃprajāyate  |
śvāpado daśa varṣāṇi dvīpī varṣāṇi pañca ca  || 217.103 ||
tatastu nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ kālaparyāyacoditaḥ  |
adharmasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā mānuṣatvamavāpnuyāt || 217.104 ||
vādyaṃ hṛtvā tu puruṣo lomaśaḥ saṃprajāyate  |
tathā piṇyākasaṃmiśramannaṃ yaścorayennaraḥ  || 217.105 ||
sa jāyate babhrusaṭo dāruṇo mūṣiko naraḥ  |
daśan vai mānuṣānnityaṃ pāpātmā sa dvijottamāḥ  || 217.106 ||
ghṛtaṃ hṛtvā tu durbuddhiḥ kāko madguḥ prajāyate  |
matsyamāṃsamatho hṛtvā kāko jāyeta mānavaḥ  || 217.107 ||
lavaṇaṃ corayitvā tu cirikākaḥ prajāyate  |
viśvāsena tu nikṣiptaṃ yo'panihnoti mānavaḥ  || 217.108 ||
sa gatāyurnarastena matsyayonau prajāyate  |
matsyayonimanuprāpya mṛto jāyeta mānuṣaḥ  || 217.109 ||
mānuṣatvamanuprāpya kṣīṇāyurupajāyate  |
pāpāni tu naraḥ kṛtvā tiryagjāyeta bho dvijāḥ  || 217.110 ||
na cātmanaḥ pramāṇaṃ tu dharmaṃ jānāti kiṃcana  |
ye pāpāni narāḥ kṛtvā nirasyanti vrataiḥ sadā  || 217.111 ||
sukhaduḥkhasamāyuktā vyādhimanto bhavantyuta  |
asaṃvītāḥ prajāyante mlecchāścāpi na saṃśayaḥ  || 217.112 ||
narāḥ pāpasamācārā lobhamohasamanvitāḥ  |
varjayanti hi pāpāni janmaprabhṛti ye narāḥ  || 217.113 ||
arogā rūpavantaśca dhaninaste bhavantyuta  |
striyo'pyetena kalpena kṛtvā pāpamavāpnuyuḥ  || 217.114 ||
eteṣāmeva pāpānāṃ bhāryātvamupayānti tāḥ  |
prāyeṇa haraṇe doṣāḥ sarva eva prakīrtitāḥ  || 217.115 ||
etadvai leśamātreṇa kathitaṃ vo dvijarṣabhāḥ  |
aparasmin kathāyoge bhūyaḥ śroṣyatha bho dvijāḥ  || 217.116 ||
etanmayā mahābhāgā brahmaṇo vadataḥ purā  |
surarṣīṇāṃ śrutaṃ madhye pṛṣṭaṃ cāpi yathā tathā  || 217.117 ||
mayāpi tubhyaṃ kārtsnyena yathāvadanuvarṇitam  |
etacchrutvā muniśreṣṭhā dharme kuruta mānasam  || 217.118 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
adharmasya gatirbrahman kathitā nastvayānagha  |
dharmasya ca gatiṃ śrotumicchāmo vadatāṃ vara  || 218.1 ||
kṛtvā pāpāni karmāṇi kathaṃ yāntyaśubhāṃ gatim  |
karmaṇā ca kṛteneha kena yānti śubhāṃ gatim  || 218.2 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
kṛtvā pāpāni karmāṇi tvadharmavaśamāgataḥ  |
manasā viparītena nirayaṃ pratipadyate  || 218.3 ||
mohādadharmaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā punaḥ samanutapyate  |
manaḥsamādhisaṃyukto na sa seveta duṣkṛtam  || 218.4 ||
yadi viprāḥ kathayate viprāṇāṃ dharmavādinām  |
tato'dharmakṛtātkṣipramaparādhātpramucyate  || 218.5 ||
yathā yathā naraḥ samyagadharmamanubhāṣate  |
samāhitena manasā vimuñcati tathā tathā  || 218.6 ||
yathā yathā manastasya duṣkṛtaṃ karma garhate  |
tathā tathā śarīraṃ tu tenādharmeṇa mucyate  || 218.7 ||
bhujaṃga iva nirmokān pūrvabhuktāñjahāti tān  |
dattvā viprasya dānāni vividhāni samāhitaḥ  || 218.8 ||
manaḥsamādhisaṃyuktaḥ svargatiṃ pratipadyate  |
dānāni tu pravakṣyāmi yāni dattvā dvijottamāḥ  || 218.9 ||
naraḥ kṛtvāpyakāryāṇi tato dharmeṇa yujyate  |
sarveṣāmeva dānānāmannaṃ śreṣṭhamudāhṛtam  || 218.10 ||
sarvamannaṃ pradātavyamṛjunā dharmamicchatā  |
prāṇā hyannaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tasmājjantuḥ prajāyate  || 218.11 ||
anne pratiṣṭhitā lokāstasmādannaṃ praśasyate  |
annameva praśaṃsanti devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ  || 218.12 ||
annasya hi pradānena svargamāpnoti mānavaḥ  |
nyāyalabdhaṃ pradātavyaṃ dvijātibhyo'nnamuttamam  || 218.13 ||
svādhyāyasamupetebhyaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā  |
yasya tvannamupāśnanti brāhmaṇāśca sakṛddaśa  || 218.14 ||
hṛṣṭena manasā dattaṃ na sa tiryaggatirbhavet |
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi daśābhojya dvijottamāḥ  || 218.15 ||
naro'dharmātpramucyeta pāpeṣvabhirataḥ sadā  |
bhaikṣeṇānnaṃ samāhṛtya vipro vedapuraskṛtaḥ  || 218.16 ||
svādhyāyanirate vipre dattveha sukhamedhate  |
ahiṃsan brāhmaṇasvāni nyāyena paripālya ca  || 218.17 ||
kṣatriyastarasā prāptamannaṃ yo vai prayacchati  |
dvijebhyo vedamukhyebhyaḥ prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ  || 218.18 ||
tenāpohati dharmātmā duṣkṛtaṃ karma bho dvijāḥ  |
ṣaḍbhāgapariśuddhaṃ ca kṛṣerbhāgamupārjitam  || 218.19 ||
vaiśyo dadaddvijātibhyaḥ pāpebhyaḥ parimucyate  |
avāpya prāṇasaṃdehaṃ kārkaśyena samārjitam  || 218.20 ||
annaṃ dattvā dvijātibhyaḥ śūdraḥ pāpātpramucyate  |
aurasena balenānnamarjayitvā vihiṃsakaḥ  || 218.21 ||
yaḥ prayacchati viprebhyo na sa durgāṇi sevate  |
nyāyenāvāptamannaṃ tu naro harṣasamanvitaḥ  || 218.22 ||
dvijebhyo vedavṛddhebhyo dattvā pāpātpramucyate  |
annamūrjaskaraṃ loke dattvorjasvī bhavennaraḥ  || 218.23 ||
satāṃ panthānamāvṛtya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate  |
dānavidbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ  || 218.24 ||
teṣvapyannasya dātārastebhyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ  |
sarvāvasthaṃ manuṣyeṇa nyāyenānnamupārjitam  || 218.25 ||
kāryānnyāyāgataṃ nityamannaṃ hi paramā gatiḥ  |
annasya hi pradānena naro yāti parāṃ gatim  || 218.26 ||
sarvakāmasamāyuktaḥ pretya cāpyaśnute sukham  |
evaṃ puṇyasamāyukto naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate  || 218.27 ||
tasmādannaṃ pradātavyamanyāyaparivarjitam  |
yastu prāṇāhutīpūrvamannaṃ bhuṅkte gṛhī sadā  || 218.28 ||
avandhyaṃ divasaṃ kuryādannadānena mānavaḥ  |
bhojayitvā śataṃ nityaṃ naro vedavidāṃ varam  || 218.29 ||
nyāyaviddharmaviduṣāmitihāsavidāṃ tathā  |
na yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃsāraṃ na ca sevate  || 218.30 ||
sarvakāmasamāyuktaḥ pretya cāpyaśnute sukham  |
evaṃ karmasamāyukto ramate vigatajvaraḥ  || 218.31 ||
rūpavān kīrtimāṃścaiva dhanavāṃścopajāyate  |
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātamannadānaphalaṃ mahat |
mūlametattu dharmāṇāṃ pradānānāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  || 218.32 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
paralokagatānāṃ tu svakarmasthānavāsinām  |
teṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ kathaṃ jñeyaṃ putraiścānyaiśca bandhubhiḥ  || 219.1 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
namaskṛtya jagannāthaṃ vārāhaṃ lokabhāvanam  |
śṛṇudhvaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrāddhakalpaṃ yathoditam  || 219.2 ||
purā kokājale magnān pitṝnuddhṛtavān vibhuḥ  |
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tadā devo yathā tatra dvijottamāḥ  || 219.3 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kimarthaṃ te tu kokāyāṃ nimagnāḥ pitaro'mbhasi  |
kathaṃ tenoddhṛtāste vai vārāheṇa dvijottama  || 219.4 ||
tasmin kokāmukhe tīrthe bhuktimuktiphalaprade  |
śrotumicchāmahe brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 219.5 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tretādvāparayoḥ saṃdhau pitaro divyamānuṣāḥ  |
purā merugireḥ pṛṣṭhe viśvairdevaiḥ saha sthitāḥ  || 219.6 ||
teṣāṃ samupaviṣṭānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ somasaṃbhavā  |
kanyā kāntimatī divyā purataḥ prāñjaliḥ sthitā  |
tāmūcuḥ pitaro divyā ye tatrāsan samāgatāḥ  || 219.7 ||
{pitara ūcu̱ḥ }
kāsi bhadre prabhuḥ ko vā bhavatyā vaktumarhasi  ||* 219.8 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sā provāca pitṝn devān kalā cāndramasīti ha  |
prabhutve bhavatāmeva varayāmi yadīcchatha  || 219.9 ||
ūrjā nāmāsti prathamaṃ svadhā ca tadanantaram  |
bhavadbhiścādyaiva kṛtaṃ nāma koketi bhāvitam  || 219.10 ||
te hi tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā pitaro divyamānuṣāḥ  |
tasyā mukhaṃ nirīkṣanto na tṛptimadhijagmire  || 219.11 ||
viśvedevāśca tāñjñātvā kanyāmukhanirīkṣakān  |
yogacyutānnirīkṣyaiva vihāya tridivaṃ gatāḥ  || 219.12 ||
bhagavānapi śītāṃśurūrjāṃ nāpaśyadātmajām  |
samākulamanā dadhyau kva gateti mahāyaśāḥ  || 219.13 ||
sa viveda tadā somaḥ prāptāṃ pitṝṃśca kāmataḥ  |
taiścāvalokitāṃ hārdātsvīkṛtāṃ ca tapobalāt || 219.14 ||
tataḥ krodhaparītātmā pitṝñśaśadharo dvijāḥ  |
śaśāpa nipatiṣyadhvaṃ yogabhraṣṭā vicetasaḥ  || 219.15 ||
yasmādadattāṃ matkanyāṃ kāmayadhvaṃ subāliśāḥ  |
yasmāddhṛtavatī ceyaṃ patīn pitṛmatī satī  || 219.16 ||
svatantrā dharmamutsṛjya tasmādbhavatu nimnagā  |
koketi prathitā loke śiśirādrisamāśritā  || 219.17 ||
itthaṃ śaptāścandramasā pitaro divyamānuṣāḥ  |
yogabhraṣṭā nipatitā himavatpādabhūtale  || 219.18 ||
ūrjā tatraiva patitā girirājasya vistṛte  |
prasthe tīrthaṃ samāsādya saptasāmudramuttamam  || 219.19 ||
kokā nāma tato vegānnadī tīrthaśatākulā  |
plāvayantī gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ sarpaṇāttu saritsmṛtā  || 219.20 ||
atha te pitaro viprā yogahīnā mahānadīm  |
dadṛśuḥ śītasalilāṃ na vidustāṃ sulocanām  || 219.21 ||
tatastu girirāḍdṛṣṭvā pitṝṃstāṃstu kṣudhārditān  |
badarīmādideśātha dhenuṃ caikāṃ madhusravām  || 219.22 ||
kṣīraṃ madhu ca taddivyaṃ kokāmbho badarīphalam  |
idaṃ girivareṇaiṣāṃ poṣaṇāya nirūpitam  || 219.23 ||
tayā vṛttyā tu vasatāṃ pitṝṇāṃ munisattamāḥ  |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi yayurekamaho yathā  || 219.24 ||
evaṃ loke vipitari tathaiva vigatasvadhe  |
daityā babhūvurbalino yātudhānāśca rākṣasāḥ  || 219.25 ||
te tān pitṛgaṇān daityā yātudhānāśca vegitāḥ  |
viśvairdevairvirahitān sarvataḥ samupādravan  || 219.26 ||
daiteyān yātudhānāṃśca dṛṣṭvaivāpatato dvijāḥ  |
kokātaṭasthāmuttuṅgāṃ śilāṃ te jagṛhū ruṣā  || 219.27 ||
gṛhītāyāṃ śilāyāṃ tu kokā vegavatī pitṝn  |
chādayāmāsa toyena plāvayantī himācalam  || 219.28 ||
pitṝnantarhitān dṛṣṭvā daiteyā rākṣasāstathā  |
vibhītakaṃ samāruhya nirāhārāstirohitāḥ  || 219.29 ||
salilena viṣīdantaḥ pitaraḥ kṣudbhramāturāḥ  |
viṣīdamānamātmānaṃ samīkṣya salilāśayāḥ  |
jagurjanārdanaṃ devaṃ pitaraḥ śaraṇaṃ harim  || 219.30 ||
{pitara ūcu̱ḥ }
jayasva govinda jagannivāsa  219.31
jayo'stu naḥ keśava te prasādāt 219.31
janārdanāsmān salilāntarasthān  219.31
uddhartumarhasyanaghapratāpa  219.31
niśācarairdāruṇadarśanaiḥ prabho  219.32
vareṇya vaikuṇṭha varāha viṣṇo  219.32
nārāyaṇāśeṣamaheśvareśa  219.32
prayāhi bhītāñjaya padmanābha  219.32
upendra yoginmadhukaiṭabhaghna  219.33
viṣṇo anantācyuta vāsudeva  219.33
śrīśārṅgacakrāmbujaśaṅkhapāṇe  219.33
rakṣasva deveśvara rākṣasebhyaḥ  219.33
tvaṃ pitā jagataḥ śaṃbho nānyaḥ śaktaḥ prabādhitum  |
niśācaragaṇaṃ bhīmamatastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ  || 219.34 ||
tvannāmasaṃkīrtanato niśācarā  219.35
dravanti bhūtānyapayānti cārayaḥ  219.35
nāśaṃ tathā saṃprati yānti viṣṇo  219.35
dharmādi satyaṃ bhavatīha mukhyam  219.35
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
itthaṃ stutaḥ sa pitṛbhirdharaṇīdharastu  219.36
tuṣṭastadāviṣkṛtadivyamūrtiḥ  219.36
kokāmukhe pitṛgaṇaṃ salile nimagnaṃ  219.36
devo dadarśa śirasātha śilāṃ vahantam  219.36
taṃ dṛṣṭvā salile magnaṃ kroḍarūpī janārdanaḥ  |
bhītaṃ pitṛgaṇaṃ viṣṇuruddhartuṃ matirādadhe  || 219.37 ||
daṃṣṭrāgreṇa samāhatya śilāṃ cikṣepa śūkaraḥ  |
pitṝnādāya ca vibhurujjahāra śilātalāt || 219.38 ||
varāhadaṃṣṭrāsaṃlagnāḥ pitaraḥ kanakojjvalāḥ  |
kokāmukhe gatabhayāḥ kṛtā devena viṣṇunā  || 219.39 ||
uddhṛtya ca pitṝn devo viṣṇutīrthe tu śūkaraḥ  |
dadau samāhitastebhyo viṣṇurlohārgale jalam  || 219.40 ||
tataḥ svaromasaṃbhūtān kuśānādāya keśavaḥ  |
svedodbhavāṃstilāṃścaiva cakre colmukamuttamam  || 219.41 ||
jyotiḥ sūryaprabhaṃ kṛtvā pātraṃ tīrthaṃ ca kāmikam  |
sthitaḥ koṭivaṭasyādho vāri gaṅgādharaṃ śuci  || 219.42 ||
tuṅgakūṭātsamādāya yajñīyānoṣadhīrasān  |
madhukṣīrarasān gandhān puṣpadhūpānulepanān  || 219.43 ||
ādāya dhenuṃ saraso ratnānyādāya cārṇavāt |
daṃṣṭrayollikhya dharaṇīmabhyukṣya salilena ca  || 219.44 ||
gharmodbhavenopalipya kuśairullikhya tāṃ punaḥ  |
pariṇīyolmukenaināmabhyukṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ  || 219.45 ||
kuśānādāya prāgagrāṃllomakūpāntarasthitān  |
ṛṣīnāhūya papraccha kariṣye pitṛtarpaṇam  || 219.46 ||
tairapyukte kuruṣveti viśvān devāṃstato vibhuḥ  |
āhūya mantratasteṣāṃ viṣṭarāṇi dadau prabhuḥ  || 219.47 ||
āhūya mantratasteṣāṃ vedoktavidhinā hariḥ  |
akṣatairdaivatārakṣāṃ cakre cakragadādharaḥ  || 219.48 ||
akṣatāstu yavauṣadhyaḥ sarvadevāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ  |
rakṣanti sarvatra diśo rakṣārthaṃ nirmitā hi te  || 219.49 ||
devadānavadaityeṣu yakṣarakṣaḥsu caiva hi  |
nahi kaścitkṣayaṃ teṣāṃ kartuṃ śaktaścarācare  || 219.50 ||
na kenacitkṛtaṃ yasmāttasmātte hyakṣatāḥ kṛtāḥ  |
devānāṃ te hi rakṣārthaṃ niyuktā viṣṇunā purā  || 219.51 ||
kuśagandhayavaiḥ puṣpairarghyaṃ kṛtvā ca śūkaraḥ  |
viśvebhyo devebhya iti tatastān paryapṛcchata  || 219.52 ||
pitṝnāvāhayiṣyāmi ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ  |
āvāhayasveti ca tairuktastvāvāhayecchuciḥ  || 219.53 ||
śliṣṭamūlāgradarbhāṃstu satilān veda vedavit |
jānāvāropya hastaṃ tu dadau savyena cāsanam  || 219.54 ||
tathaiva jānusaṃsthena kareṇaikena tān pitṝn  |
vārāhaḥ pitṛviprāṇāmāyāntu na itīrayan  || 219.55 ||
apahatetyuvācaiva rakṣaṇaṃ cāpasavyataḥ  |
kṛtvā cāvāhanaṃ cakre pitṝṇāṃ nāmagotrataḥ  || 219.56 ||
tatpitaro manojarānāgacchata itīrayan  |
saṃvatsarairityudīrya tato'rghyaṃ teṣu vinyaset || 219.57 ||
yāstiṣṭhantyamṛtā vāco yanmaiti ca pituḥ pituḥ  |
yanme pitāmahāityevaṃ dadāvarghyaṃ pitāmaha  || 219.58 ||
yanme prapitāmahāiti dadau ca prapitāmahe  |
kuśagandhatilonmiśraṃ sapuṣpamapasavyataḥ  || 219.59 ||
tadvanmātāmahebhyastu vidhiṃ cakre janārdanaḥ  |
tānarcya bhūyo gandhādyairdhūpaṃ dattvā tu bhaktitaḥ  || 219.60 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā ityuccārya jagatprabhuḥ  |
tataścānnaṃ samādāya sarpistilakuśākulam  || 219.61 ||
vidhāya pātre taccaiva paryapṛcchattato munīn  |
agnau kariṣya iti taiḥ kuruṣveti ca coditaḥ  || 219.62 ||
āhutitritayaṃ dadyātsomāyāgneryamāya ca  |
ye māmakāiti ca japedyajuḥsaptakamacyutam  || 219.63 ||
hutāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca dadau nāmagotrasamanvitam  |
trirāhutikamekaikaṃ pitaraṃ tu prati dvijāḥ  || 219.64 ||
ato'vaśiṣṭamannādyaṃ piṇḍapātre tu nikṣipet |
tato'nnaṃ sarasaṃ svādu dadau pāyasapūrvakam  || 219.65 ||
pratyagramekadā svinnamaparyuṣitamuttamam  |
alpaśākaṃ bahuphalaṃ ṣaḍrasamamṛtopamam  || 219.66 ||
yadbrāhmaṇeṣu pradadau piṇḍapātre pitṝṃstathā  |
vedapūrvaṃ pitṛsvannamājyaplutaṃ madhūkṣitam  || 219.67 ||
mantritaṃ pṛthivītyevaṃ madhuvātātṛcaṃ jagau  |
bhuñjāneṣu tu vipreṣu japan vai mantrapañcakam  || 219.68 ||
yatte prakāramārabhya nādhikaṃ te tato jagau  |
trimadhu trisuparṇaṃ ca bṛhadāraṇyakaṃ tathā  || 219.69 ||
jajāpa vaiṣāṃ jāpyaṃ tu sūktaṃ sauraṃ sapauruṣam  |
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu pṛṣṭvā tṛptā stha ityuta  || 219.70 ||
tṛptāḥ smeti sakṛttoyaṃ dadau maunavimocanam  |
piṇḍapātraṃ samādāya cchāyāyai pradadau tataḥ  || 219.71 ||
sā tadannaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā tridhaikaikamathākarot |
vārāho bhūmathollikhya samācchādya kuśairapi  || 219.72 ||
dakṣiṇāgrān kuśān kṛtvā teṣāmupari cāsanam  |
satileṣu samūleṣu kuśeṣveva tu saṃśrayaḥ  || 219.73 ||
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ piṇḍaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ  |
pṛthivī dadhīrityuktvā tataḥ piṇḍaṃ pradattavān  || 219.74 ||
pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahāstatheti cāntarikṣataḥ  |
mātāmahānāmapyevaṃ dadau piṇḍān sa śūkaraḥ  || 219.75 ||
piṇḍanirvāpaṇocchiṣṭamannaṃ lepabhujeṣvadāt |
etadvaḥ pitarityuktvā dadau vāsāṃsi bhaktitaḥ  || 219.76 ||
dvyaṅgulajāni śuklāni dhautānyabhinavāni ca  |
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ dattvā kṛtvā caiṣāṃ pradakṣiṇām  || 219.77 ||
ācamyācāmayedviprān paitrānādau tataḥ surān  |
tatastvabhyukṣya tāṃ bhūmiṃ dattvāpaḥ sumanokṣatān  || 219.78 ||
satilāmbu pitṛṣvādau dattvā deveṣu sākṣatam  |
akṣayyaṃ nastviti pitṝn prīyatāmiti devatāḥ  || 219.79 ||
prīṇayitvā parāvṛtya trirjapeccāghamarṣaṇam  |
tato nivṛtya tu japedyanme nāma itīrayan  || 219.80 ||
gṛhānnaḥ pitaro datta dhanadhānyaprapūritān  |
arghyapātrāṇi piṇḍānāmantare sa pavitrakān  || 219.81 ||
nikṣipyorjaṃ vahantīti kokātoyamatho'japat |
himakṣīraṃ madhutilān pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ dadau  || 219.82 ||
svastītyukte paitṛkaistu sorāhne pnāvatarpayan  |
rajataṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā viprān devo gadādharaḥ  || 219.83 ||
saṃvibhāgaṃ manuṣyebhyo dadau svaditi cābruvan  |
kaścitsaṃpannamityuktvā pratyuktastairdvijottamāḥ  || 219.84 ||
abhiramyatāmityuvāca procuste'bhiratāḥ sma vai  |
śiṣṭamannaṃ ca papraccha tairiṣṭaiḥ saha coditaḥ  || 219.85 ||
pāṇāvādāya tān viprān kuryādanugatastadā  |
vāje vāje iti paṭhan bahirvedi vinirgataḥ  || 219.86 ||
koṭitīrthajalenāsāvapasavyaṃ samutkṣipan  |
alagnān vipulān vālān prārthayāmāsa cāśiṣam  || 219.87 ||
dātāro no'bhivardhantāṃ taistatheti samīritaḥ  |
pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya kṛtvā pādābhivādanam  || 219.88 ||
āsanāni dadau caiṣāṃ chādayāmāsa śūkaraḥ  |
viśrāmyatāṃ praviśyātha piṇḍaṃ jagrāha madhyamam  || 219.89 ||
chāyāmayī mahī patnī tasyai piṇḍamadātprabhuḥ  |
ādhatta pitaro garbhamityuktvā sāpi rūpiṇī  || 219.90 ||
piṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā viprāṇāṃ cakre pādābhivandanam  |
visarjanaṃ pitṝṇāṃ sa kartukāmaśca śūkaraḥ  || 219.91 ||
kokā ca pitaraścaiva procuḥ svārthakaraṃ vacaḥ  |
śaptāśca bhagavan pūrvaṃ divasthā himabhānunā  || 219.92 ||
yogabhraṣṭā bhaviṣyadhvaṃ sarva eva divaścyutāḥ  |
tadevaṃ bhavatā trātāḥ praviśanto rasātalam  || 219.93 ||
yogabhraṣṭāṃśca viśveśāstatyajuryogarakṣiṇaḥ  |
tatte bhūyo'bhirakṣantu viśve devā hi naḥ sadā  || 219.94 ||
svargaṃ yāsyāmaśca vibho prasādāttava śūkara  |
somo'dhidevo'smākaṃ ca bhavatvacyuta yogadhṛk || 219.95 ||
yogādhārastathā somastrāyate na kadācana  |
divi bhūmau sadā vāso bhavatvasmāsu yogataḥ  || 219.96 ||
antarikṣe ca keṣāṃcinmāsaṃ puṣṭistathāstu naḥ  |
ūrjā ceyaṃ hi naḥ patnī svadhānāmnā tu viśrutā  || 219.97 ||
bhavatveṣaiva yogāḍhyā yogamātā ca khecarī  |
ityevamuktaḥ pitṛbhirvārāho bhūtabhāvanaḥ  || 219.98 ||
provācātha pitṝn viṣṇustāṃ ca kokāṃ mahānadīm  |
yaduktaṃ tu bhavadbhirme sarvametadbhaviṣyati  || 219.99 ||
yamo'dhidevo bhavatāṃ somaḥ svādhyāya īritaḥ  |
adhiyajñastathaivāgnirbhavatāṃ kalpanā tviyam  || 219.100 ||
agnirvāyuśca sūryaśca sthānaṃ hi bhavatāmiti  |
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca bhavatāmadhipūruṣāḥ  || 219.101 ||
ādityā vasavo rudrā bhavatāṃ mūrtayastvimāḥ  |
yogino yogadehāśca yogadhārāśca suvratāḥ  || 219.102 ||
kāmato vicariṣyadhvaṃ phaladāḥ sarvajantuṣu  |
svargasthānnarakasthāṃśca bhūmisthāṃśca carācarān  || 219.103 ||
nijayogabalenaivā pyāyayiṣyadhvamuttamāḥ  |
iyamūrjā śaśisutā kīlālamadhuvigrahā  || 219.104 ||
bhaviṣyati mahābhāgā dakṣasya duhitā svadhā  |
tatreyaṃ bhavatāṃ patnī bhaviṣyati varānanā  || 219.105 ||
kokānadīti vikhyātā girirājasamāśritā  |
tīrthakoṭimahāpuṇyā madrūpaparipālitā  || 219.106 ||
asyāmadya prabhṛti vai nivatsyāmyaghanāśakṛt |
varāhadarśanaṃ puṇyaṃ pūjanaṃ bhuktimuktidam  || 219.107 ||
kokāsalilapānaṃ ca mahāpātakanāśanam  |
tīrtheṣvāplavanaṃ puṇyamupavāsaśca svargadaḥ  || 219.108 ||
dānamakṣayyamuditaṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham  |
māghe māsyasite pakṣe bhavadbhiruḍupakṣaye  || 219.109 ||
kokāmukhamupāgamya sthātavyaṃ dinapañcakam  |
tasmin kāle tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nirvapiṣyati  || 219.110 ||
prāguktaphalabhāgī sa bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ  |
ekādaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ ca stheyamatra mayā sadā  || 219.111 ||
yastatropavaseddhīmān sa prāguktaphalaṃ labhet |
tadvrajadhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ sthānamiṣṭaṃ yatheṣṭataḥ  || 219.112 ||
ahamapyatra vatsyāmītyuktvā so'ntaradhīyata  |
gate varāhe pitaraḥ kokāmāmantrya te yayuḥ  || 219.113 ||
kokāpi tīrthasahitā saṃsthitā girirājani  |
chāyā mahīmayī kroḍī piṇḍaprāśanabṛṃhitā  || 219.114 ||
garbhamādāya saśraddhā vārāhasyaiva sundarī  |
tato'syāḥ prābhavatputro bhaumastu narakāsuraḥ  |
prāgjyotiṣaṃ ca nagaramasya dattaṃ ca viṣṇunā  || 219.115 ||
evaṃ mayoktaṃ varadasya viṣṇoḥ  219.116
kokāmukhe divyavarāharūpam  219.116
śrutvā narastyaktamalo vipāpmā  219.116
daśāśvamedheṣṭiphalaṃ labheta  219.116
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
bhūyaḥ prabrūhi bhagavañśrāddhakalpaṃ suvistarāt |
kathaṃ kva ca kadā keṣu kaistadbrūhi tapodhana  || 220.1 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ śrāddhakalpaṃ suvistarāt |
yathā yatra yadā yeṣu yairdravyaistadvadāmyaham  || 220.2 ||
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śrāddhaṃ svavaraṇoditam  |
kuladharmamanutiṣṭhadbhirdātavyaṃ mantrapūrvakam  || 220.3 ||
strībhirvarṇāvaraiḥ śūdrairviprāṇāmanuśāsanāt |
amantrakaṃ vidhipūrvaṃ vahniyāgavivarjitam  || 220.4 ||
puṣkarādiṣu tīrtheṣu puṇyeṣvāyataneṣu ca  |
śikhareṣu girīndrāṇāṃ puṇyadeśeṣu bho dvijāḥ  || 220.5 ||
saritsu puṇyatoyāsu nadeṣu ca saraḥsu ca  |
saṃgameṣu nadīnāṃ ca samudreṣu ca saptasu  || 220.6 ||
svanulipteṣu geheṣu sveṣvanujñāpiteṣu ca  |
divyapādapamūleṣu yajñiyeṣu hradeṣu ca  || 220.7 ||
śrāddhameteṣu dātavyaṃ varjyameteṣu cocyate  |
kirāteṣu kaliṅgeṣu koṅkaṇeṣu kṛmiṣvapi  || 220.8 ||
daśārṇeṣu kumāryeṣu taṅgaṇeṣu kratheṣvapi  |
sindhoruttarakūleṣu narmadāyāśca dakṣiṇe  || 220.9 ||
pūrveṣu karatoyāyā na deyaṃ śrāddhamucyate  |
śrāddhaṃ deyamuśantīha māsi māsyuḍupakṣaye  || 220.10 ||
paurṇamāseṣu śrāddhaṃ ca kartavyamṛkṣagocare  |
nityaśrāddhamadaivaṃ ca manuṣyaiḥ saha gīyate  || 220.11 ||
naimittikaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ nityaṃ naimittikaṃ tathā  |
kāmyānyanyāni śrāddhāni pratisaṃvatsaraṃ dvijaiḥ  || 220.12 ||
vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ jātakarmādikeṣu ca  |
tatra yugmān dvijānāhurmantrapūrvaṃ tu vai dvijāḥ  || 220.13 ||
kanyāṃ gate savitari dināni daśa pañca ca  |
pūrveṇaiveha vidhinā śrāddhaṃ tatra vidhīyate  || 220.14 ||
pratipaddhanalābhāya dvitīyā dvipadapradā  |
putrārthinī tṛtīyā tu caturthī śatrunāśinī  || 220.15 ||
śriyaṃ prāpnoti pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pūjyo bhavennaraḥ  |
gaṇādhipatyaṃ saptamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ buddhimuttamām  || 220.16 ||
striyo navamyāṃ prāpnoti daśamyāṃ pūrṇakāmatām  |
vedāṃstathāpnuyātsarvānekādaśyāṃ kriyāparaḥ  || 220.17 ||
dvādaśyāṃ jayalābhaṃ ca prāpnoti pitṛpūjakaḥ  |
prajāvṛddhiṃ paśuṃ medhāṃ svātantryaṃ puṣṭimuttamām  || 220.18 ||
dīrghāyurathavaiśvaryaṃ kurvāṇastu trayodaśīm  |
avāpnoti na saṃdehaḥ śrāddhaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ  || 220.19 ||
yathāsaṃbhavinānnena śrāddhaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ  |
yuvānaḥ pitaro yasya mṛtāḥ śastreṇa vā hatāḥ  || 220.20 ||
tena kāryaṃ caturdaśyāṃ teṣāṃ tṛptimabhīpsatā  |
śrāddhaṃ kurvannamāvāsyāṃ yatnena puruṣaḥ śuciḥ  || 220.21 ||
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti svargaṃ cānantamaśnute  |
ataḥparaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ vadato mama  || 220.22 ||
pitṝṇāṃ prītaye yatra yaddeyaṃ prītikāriṇā  |
māsaṃ tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu haviṣyānnena jāyate  || 220.23 ||
māsadvayaṃ matsyamāṃsaistṛptiṃ yānti pitāmahāḥ  |
trīnmāsān hāriṇaṃ māṃsaṃ vijñeyaṃ pitṛtṛptaye  || 220.24 ||
puṣṇāti caturo māsāñśaśasya piśitaṃ pitṝn  |
śākunaṃ pañca vai māsān ṣaṇmāsāñśūkarāmiṣam  || 220.25 ||
chāgalaṃ sapta vai māsānaiṇeyaṃ cāṣṭamāsakān  |
karoti tṛptiṃ nava vai rurumāṃsaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  || 220.26 ||
gavyaṃ māṃsaṃ pitṛtṛptiṃ karoti daśamāsikīm  |
tathaikādaśa māsāṃstu aurabhraṃ pitṛtṛptidam  || 220.27 ||
saṃvatsaraṃ tathā gavyaṃ payaḥ pāyasameva ca  |
vādhrīnamāmiṣaṃ lohaṃ kālaśākaṃ tathā madhu  || 220.28 ||
rohitāmiṣamannaṃ ca dattānyātmakulodbhavaiḥ  |
anantaṃ vai prayacchanti tṛptiyogaṃ sutāṃstathā  || 220.29 ||
pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃdeho gayāśrāddhaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  |
yo dadāti guḍonmiśrāṃstilān vā śrāddhakarmaṇi  || 220.30 ||
madhu vā madhumiśraṃ vā akṣayaṃ sarvameva tat |
api naḥ sa kule bhūyādyo no dadyājjalāñjalim  || 220.31 ||
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca  |
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko'pi gayāṃ vrajet || 220.32 ||
gaurīṃ vāpyudvahetkanyāṃ nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet |
kṛttikāsu pitṝnarcya svargamāpnoti mānavaḥ  || 220.33 ||
apatyakāmo rohiṇyāṃ saumye tejasvitāṃ labhet |
śauryamārdrāsu cāpnoti kṣetrāṇi ca punarvasau  || 220.34 ||
puṣye tu dhanamakṣayyamāśleṣe cāyuruttamam  |
maghāsu ca prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ saubhāgyaṃ phālgunīṣu ca  || 220.35 ||
pradhānaśīlo bhavati sāpatyaścottarāsu ca  |
prayāti śreṣṭhatāṃ śāstre haste śrāddhaprado naraḥ  || 220.36 ||
rūpaṃ tejaśca citrāsu tathāpatyamavāpnuyāt |
vāṇijyalābhadā svātī viśākhā putrakāmadā  || 220.37 ||
kurvantāṃ cānurādhāsu tā dadyuścakravartitām  |
ādhipatyaṃ ca jyeṣṭhāsu mūle cārogyamuttamam  || 220.38 ||
āṣāḍhāsu yaśaḥprāptiruttarāsu viśokatā  |
śravaṇena śubhāṃllokān dhaniṣṭhāsu dhanaṃ mahat || 220.39 ||
vedavittvamabhijiti bhiṣaksiddhiṃ ca vāruṇe  |
ajāvikaṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ vindedgāvastathottare  || 220.40 ||
revatīṣu tathā kupyamaśvinīṣu turaṃgamān  |
śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃstathāpnoti bharaṇīṣvāyuruttamam  || 220.41 ||
evaṃ phalamavāpnoti ṛkṣeṣveteṣu tattvavit |
tasmātkāmyāni śrāddhāni deyāni vidhivaddvijāḥ  || 220.42 ||
kanyārāśigate sūrye phalamatyantamicchatā  |
yān yān kāmānabhidhyāyan kanyārāśigate ravau  || 220.43 ||
śrāddhaṃ kurvanti manujāstāṃstān kāmāṃllabhanti te  |
nāndīmukhānāṃ kartavyaṃ kanyārāśigate ravau  || 220.44 ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu kartavyaṃ vārāhavacanaṃ yathā  |
divyabhaumāntarikṣāṇi sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca  || 220.45 ||
piṇḍamicchanti pitaraḥ kanyārāśigate ravau  |
kanyāṃ gate savitari yānyahāni tu ṣoḍaśa  || 220.46 ||
kratubhistāni tulyāni devo nārāyaṇo'bravīt |
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ ya iccheddurlabhaṃ phalam  || 220.47 ||
apyambuśākamūlādyaiḥ pitṝn kanyāgate'rcayet |
uttarāhastanakṣatra gate tīkṣṇāṃśumālini  || 220.48 ||
yo'rcayetsvapitṝn bhaktyā tasya vāsastriviṣṭape  |
hastarkṣage dinakare pitṛrājānuśāsanāt || 220.49 ||
tāvatpitṛpurī śūnyā yāvadvṛścikadarśanam  |
vṛścike samatikrānte pitaro daivataiḥ saha  || 220.50 ||
niḥśvasya pratigacchanti śāpaṃ dattvā suduḥsaham  |
aṣṭakāsu ca kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ manvantarāsu vai  || 220.51 ||
anvaṣṭakāsu kramaśo mātṛpūrvaṃ tadiṣyate  |
grahaṇe ca vyatīpāte ravicandrasamāgame  || 220.52 ||
janmarkṣe grahapīḍāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ pārvaṇamucyate  |
ayanadvitaye śrāddhaṃ viṣuvadvitaye tathā  || 220.53 ||
saṃkrāntiṣu ca kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ vidhivaduttamam  |
eṣu kāryaṃ dvijāḥ śrāddhaṃ piṇḍanirvāpaṇādṛte  || 220.54 ||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ navamyāṃ kārttikasya ca  |
śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tu śuklāyāṃ saṃkrāntividhinā naraiḥ  || 220.55 ||
trayodaśyāṃ bhādrapade māghe candrakṣaye'hani  |
śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ pāyasena dakṣiṇāyanavacca tat || 220.56 ||
yadā ca śrotriyo'bhyeti gehaṃ vedavidagnimān  |
tenaikena ca kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ vidhivaduttamam  || 220.57 ||
śrāddhīyadravyasaṃprāptiryadā syātsādhusaṃmatā  |
pārvaṇena vidhānena śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tathā dvijaiḥ  || 220.58 ||
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ mātāpitrormṛte'hani  |
pitṛvyasyāpyaputrasya bhrāturjyeṣṭhasya caiva hi  || 220.59 ||
pārvaṇaṃ devapūrvaṃ syādekoddiṣṭaṃ surairvinā  |
dvau daive pitṛkārye trīnekaikamubhayatra vā  || 220.60 ||
mātāmahānāmapyevaṃ sarvamūhena kīrtitam  |
pretībhūtasya satataṃ bhuvi piṇḍaṃ jalaṃ tathā  || 220.61 ||
satilaṃ sakuśaṃ dadyādbahirjalasamīpataḥ  |
tṛtīye'hni ca kartavyaṃ pretāsthicayanaṃ dvijaiḥ  || 220.62 ||
daśāhe brāhmaṇaḥ śuddho dvādaśāhena kṣatriyaḥ  |
vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śudhyati  || 220.63 ||
sūtakānte gṛhe śrāddhamekoddiṣṭaṃ pracakṣate  |
dvādaśe'hani māse ca tripakṣe ca tataḥ param  || 220.64 ||
māsi māsi ca kartavyaṃ yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ  |
tata parataraṃ kāryaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kramāt || 220.65 ||
kṛte sapiṇḍīkaraṇe pārvaṇaṃ procyate punaḥ  |
tataḥ prabhṛti nirmuktāḥ pretatvātpitṛtāṃ gatāḥ  || 220.66 ||
amūrtā mūrtimantaśca pitaro dvividhāḥ smṛtāḥ  |
nāndīmukhāstvamūrtāḥ syurmūrtimanto'tha pārvaṇāḥ  |
ekoddiṣṭāśinaḥ pretāḥ pitṝṇāṃ nirṇayastridhā  || 220.67 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kathaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ dvijasattama  |
pretībhūtasya vidhivadbrūhi no vadatāṃ vara  || 220.68 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ viprāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ vadato mama  |
taccāpi devarahitamekārghaikapavitrakam  || 220.69 ||
naivāgnau karaṇaṃ tatra taccāvāhanavarjitam  |
apasavyaṃ ca tatrāpi bhojayedayujo dvijān  || 220.70 ||
viśeṣastatra cānyo'sti pratimāsakriyādikaḥ  |
taṃ kathyamānamekāgrāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ me dvijottamāḥ  || 220.71 ||
tilagandhodakairyuktaṃ tatra pātracatuṣṭayam  |
kuryātpitṝṇāṃ tritayamekaṃ pretasya ca dvijāḥ  || 220.72 ||
pātratraye pretapātrādarghaṃ caiva prasecayet |
ye samānā iti japan pūrvavaccheṣamācaret || 220.73 ||
strīṇāmapyevameva syādekoddiṣṭamudāhṛtam  |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tāsāṃ putrābhāve na vidyate  || 220.74 ||
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryamekoddiṣṭaṃ naraiḥ striyāḥ  |
mṛtāhani ca tatkāryaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vidhicoditam  || 220.75 ||
putrābhāve sapiṇḍāstu tadabhāve sahodarāḥ  |
kuryuretaṃ vidhiṃ samyakputrasya ca sutāḥ sutāḥ  || 220.76 ||
kuryānmātāmahānāṃ tu putrikātanayastathā  |
dvyāmuṣyāyaṇasaṃjñāstu mātāmahapitāmahān  || 220.77 ||
pūjayeyuryathānyāyaṃ śrāddhairnaimittikairapi  |
sarvābhāve striyaḥ kuryuḥ svabhartṝṇāmamantrakam  || 220.78 ||
tadabhāve ca nṛpatiḥ kārayettvakuṭumbinām  |
tajjātīyairnaraiḥ samyagvāhādyāḥ sakalāḥ kriyāḥ  || 220.79 ||
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ bāndhavo nṛpatiryataḥ  |
etā vaḥ kathitā viprā nityā naimittikāstathā  || 220.80 ||
vakṣye śrāddhāśrayāmanyāṃ nityanaimittikāṃ kriyām  |
darśastatra nimittaṃ tu vidyādindukṣayānvitaḥ  || 220.81 ||
nityastu niyataḥ kālastasmin kuryādyathoditam  |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇādūrdhvaṃ pituryaḥ prapitāmahaḥ  || 220.82 ||
sa tu lepabhujaṃ yāti praluptaḥ pitṛpiṇḍataḥ  |
teṣāṃ hi yaścaturtho'nyaḥ sa tu lepabhujo bhavet || 220.83 ||
so'pi saṃbandhato hīnamupabhogaṃ prapadyate  |
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ  || 220.84 ||
piṇḍasaṃbandhino hyete vijñeyāḥ puruṣāstrayaḥ  |
lepasaṃbandhinaścānye pitāmahapitāmahāt || 220.85 ||
prabhṛtyuktāstrayasteṣāṃ yajamānaśca saptamaḥ  |
ityeṣa munibhiḥ proktaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sāptapauruṣaḥ  || 220.86 ||
yajamānātprabhṛtyūrdhvamanulepabhujastathā  |
tato'nye pūrvajāḥ sarve ye cānye narakaukasaḥ  || 220.87 ||
ye'pi tiryaktvamāpannā ye ca bhūtādisaṃsthitāḥ  |
tān sarvān yajamāno vai śrāddhaṃ kurvan yathāvidhi  || 220.88 ||
sa samāpyāyate viprā yena yena vadāmi tat |
annaprakiraṇaṃ yattu manuṣyaiḥ kriyate bhuvi  || 220.89 ||
tena tṛptimupāyānti ye piśācatvamāgatāḥ  |
yadambu snānavastrotthaṃ bhūmau patati bho dvijāḥ  || 220.90 ||
tena ye tarutāṃ prāptāsteṣāṃ tṛptiḥ prajāyate  |
yāstu gandhāmbukaṇikāḥ patanti dharaṇītale  || 220.91 ||
tābhirāpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ devatvaṃ ye kule gatāḥ  |
uddhṛteṣvatha piṇḍeṣu yāścāmbukaṇikā bhuvi  || 220.92 ||
tābhirāpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ ye tiryaktvaṃ kule gatāḥ  |
ye cādantāḥ kule bālāḥ kriyāyogādbahiṣkṛtāḥ  || 220.93 ||
vipannāstvanadhikārāḥ saṃmārjitajalāśinaḥ  |
bhuktvā cācāmatāṃ yacca yajjalaṃ cāṅghriśaucajam  || 220.94 ||
brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaivānyattena tṛptiṃ prayānti vai  |
evaṃ yo yajamānasya yaśca teṣāṃ dvijanmanām  || 220.95 ||
kaścijjalānnavikṣepaḥ śucirucchiṣṭa eva vā  |
tenānnena kule tatra ye ca yonyantaraṃ gatāḥ  || 220.96 ||
prayāntyāpyāyanaṃ viprāḥ samyakśrāddhakriyāvatām  |
anyāyopārjitairarthairyacchrāddhaṃ kriyate naraiḥ  || 220.97 ||
tṛpyante te na cāṇḍāla pulkasādyāsu yoniṣu  |
evamāpyāyanaṃ viprā bahūnāmeva bāndhavaiḥ  || 220.98 ||
śrāddhaṃ kurvadbhiratrāmbu vikṣepaiḥ saṃprajāyate  |
tasmācchrāddhaṃ naro bhaktyā śākenāpi yathāvidhi  || 220.99 ||
kurvīta kurvataḥ śrāddhaṃ kule kaścinna sīdati  |
śrāddhaṃ deyaṃ tu vipreṣu saṃyateṣvagnihotriṣu  || 220.100 ||
avadāteṣu vidvatsu śrotriyeṣu viśeṣataḥ  |
triṇāciketastrimadhustrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit || 220.101 ||
mātāpitṛparaścaiva svasrīyaḥ sāmavedavit |
ṛtvikpurohitācāryamupādhyāyaṃ ca bhojayet || 220.102 ||
mātulaḥ śvaśuraḥ śyālaḥ saṃbandhī droṇapāṭhakaḥ  |
maṇḍalabrāhmaṇo yastu purāṇārthaviśāradaḥ  || 220.103 ||
akalpaḥ kalpasaṃtuṣṭaḥ pratigrahavivarjitaḥ  |
ete śrāddhe niyoktavyā brāhmaṇāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ  || 220.104 ||
nimantrayeta pūrvedyuḥ pūrvoktān dvijasattamān  |
daive niyoge pitrye ca tāṃstathaivopakalpayet || 220.105 ||
taiśca saṃyamibhirbhāvyaṃ yastu śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati  |
śrāddhaṃ dattvā ca bhuktvā ca maithunaṃ yo'dhigacchati  || 220.106 ||
pitarastasya vai māsaṃ tasmin retasi śerate  |
gatvā ca yoṣitaṃ śrāddhe yo bhuṅkte yastu gacchati  || 220.107 ||
retomūtrakṛtāhārāstaṃ māsaṃ pitarastayoḥ  |
tasmāttvaprathamaṃ kāryaṃ prājñenopanimantraṇam  || 220.108 ||
aprāptau taddine vāpi varjyā yoṣitprasaṅginaḥ  |
bhikṣārthamāgatāṃścāpi kālena saṃyatān yatīn  || 220.109 ||
bhojayetpraṇipātādyaiḥ prasādya yatamānasaḥ  |
yoginaśca tadā śrāddhe bhojanīyā vipaścitā  || 220.110 ||
yogādhārā hi pitarastasmāttān pūjayetsadā  |
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi eko yogī bhavedyadi  || 220.111 ||
yajamānaṃ ca bhoktṝṃśca naurivāmbhasi tārayet |
pitṛgāthā tathaivātra gīyate brahmavādibhiḥ  || 220.112 ||
yā gītā pitṛbhiḥ pūrvamailasyāsīnmahīpateḥ  |
kadā naḥ saṃtatāvagryaḥ kasyacidbhavitā sutaḥ  || 220.113 ||
yo yogibhuktaśeṣānno bhuvi piṇḍān pradāsyati  |
gayāyāmathavā piṇḍaṃ khaḍgamāṃsaṃ tathā haviḥ  || 220.114 ||
kālaśākaṃ tilājyaṃ ca tṛptaye kṛsaraṃ ca naḥ  |
vaiśvadevaṃ ca saumyaṃ ca khaḍgamāṃsaṃ paraṃ haviḥ  || 220.115 ||
viṣāṇavarjaṃ śirasa ā pādādāśiṣāmahe  |
dadyācchrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca yathāvidhi  || 220.116 ||
madhusarpiḥsamāyuktaṃ pāyasaṃ dakṣiṇāyane  |
tasmātsaṃpūjayedbhaktyā svapitṝn vidhivannaraḥ  || 220.117 ||
kāmānabhīpsan sakalān pāpādātmavimocanam  |
vasūn rudrāṃstathādityānnakṣatragrahatārakāḥ  || 220.118 ||
prīṇayanti manuṣyāṇāṃ pitaraḥ śrāddhatarpitāḥ  |
āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhāni ca  || 220.119 ||
prayacchanti tathā rājyaṃ pitaraḥ śrāddhatarpitāḥ  |
tathāparāhṇaḥ pūrvāhṇātpitṝṇāmatiricyate  || 220.120 ||
saṃpūjya svāgatenaitān sadane'bhyāgatān dvijān  |
pavitrapāṇirācāntānāsaneṣūpaveśayet || 220.121 ||
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena saṃbhojya ca dvijottamān  |
visarjayetpriyāṇyuktvā praṇipatya ca bhaktitaḥ  || 220.122 ||
ādvāramanugacchecca āgacchedanumoditaḥ  |
tato nityakriyāṃ kuryādbhojayecca tathātithīn  || 220.123 ||
nityakriyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca kecidicchanti sattamāḥ  |
na pitṝṇāṃ tathaivānye śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret || 220.124 ||
pṛthaktvena vadantyanye kecitpūrvaṃ ca pūrvavat |
tatastadannaṃ bhuñjīta saha bhṛtyādibhirnaraḥ  || 220.125 ||
evaṃ kurvīta dharmajñaḥ śrāddhaṃ pitryaṃ samāhitaḥ  |
yathā ca vipramukhyānāṃ paritoṣo'bhijāyate  || 220.126 ||
idānīṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi varjanīyān dvijādhamān  |
mitradhrukkunakhī klībaḥ kṣayī śuklī vaṇikpathaḥ  || 220.127 ||
śyāvadanto'tha khalvāṭaḥ kāṇo'ndho badhiro jaḍaḥ  |
mūkaḥ paṅguḥ kuṇiḥ ṣaṇḍho duścarmā vyaṅgakekarau  || 220.128 ||
kuṣṭhī raktekṣaṇaḥ kubjo vāmano vikaṭo'lasaḥ  |
mitraśatrurduṣkulīnaḥ paśupālo nirākṛtiḥ  || 220.129 ||
parivittiḥ parivettā parivedanikāsutaḥ  |
vṛṣalīpatistatsutaśca na bhavecchrāddhabhugdvijaḥ  || 220.130 ||
vṛṣalīputrasaṃskartā anūḍho didhiṣūpatiḥ  |
bhṛtakādhyāpako yastu bhṛtakādhyāpitaśca yaḥ  || 220.131 ||
sūtakānnopajīvī ca mṛgayuḥ somavikrayī  |
abhiśastastathā stenaḥ patito vārddhuṣiḥ śaṭhaḥ  || 220.132 ||
piśuno vedasaṃtyāgī dānāgnityāganiṣṭhuraḥ  |
rājñaḥ purohito bhṛtyo vidyāhīno'tha matsarī  || 220.133 ||
vṛddhadviḍdurdharaḥ krūro mūḍho devalakastathā  |
nakṣatrasūcakaścaiva parvakāraśca garhitaḥ  || 220.134 ||
ayājyayājakaḥ ṣaṇḍho garhitā ye ca ye'dhamāḥ  |
na te śrāddhe niyoktavyā dṛṣṭvāmī paṅktidūṣakāḥ  || 220.135 ||
asatāṃ pragraho yatra satāṃ caivāvamānanā  |
daṇḍo devakṛtastatra sadyaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ  || 220.136 ||
hitvāgamaṃ suvihitaṃ bāliśaṃ yastu bhojayet |
ādidharmaṃ samutsṛjya dātā tatra vinaśyati  || 220.137 ||
yastvāśritaṃ dvijaṃ tyaktvā anyamānīya bhojayet |
tanniḥśvāsāgninirdagdhastatra dātā vinaśyati  || 220.138 ||
vastrābhāve kriyā nāsti yajñā vedāstapāṃsi ca  |
tasmādvāsāṃsi deyāni śrāddhakāle viśeṣataḥ  || 220.139 ||
kauśeyaṃ kṣaumakārpāsaṃ dukūlamahataṃ tathā  |
śrāddhe tvetāni yo dadyātkāmānāpnoti cottamān  || 220.140 ||
yathā goṣu prabhūtāsu vatso vindati mātaram  |
tathānnaṃ tatra viprāṇāṃ janturyatrāvatiṣṭhate  || 220.141 ||
nāmagotraṃ ca mantrāṃśca dattamannaṃ na yanti te  |
api ye nidhanaṃ prāptāstṛptistānupatiṣṭhate  || 220.142 ||
devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca mahāyogibhya eva ca  |
namaḥ svāhāyai svadhāyai nityameva bhavantviti  || 220.143 ||
ādyāvasāne śrāddhasya trirāvṛttyā japettadā  |
piṇḍanirvapaṇe vāpi japedevaṃ samāhitaḥ  || 220.144 ||
kṣipramāyānti pitaro rākṣasāḥ pradravanti ca  |
prīyante triṣu lokeṣu mantro'yaṃ tārayatyuta  || 220.145 ||
kṣaumasūtraṃ navaṃ dadyācchāṇaṃ kārpāsikaṃ tathā  |
pattrorṇaṃ paṭṭasūtraṃ ca kauśeyaṃ ca vivarjayet || 220.146 ||
varjayeccādaśaṃ prājño yadyapyavyāhataṃ bhavet |
na prīṇayantyathaitāni dātuścāpyanayo bhavet || 220.147 ||
na nivedyo bhavetpiṇḍaḥ pitṝṇāṃ yastu jīvati  |
iṣṭenānnena bhakṣyeṇa bhojayettaṃ yathāvidhi  || 220.148 ||
piṇḍamagnau sadā dadyādbhogārthī satataṃ naraḥ  |
patnyai dadyātprajārthī ca madhyamaṃ mantrapūrvakam  || 220.149 ||
uttamāṃ dyutimanvicchan piṇḍaṃ goṣu prayacchati  |
prajñāṃ caiva yaśaḥ kīrtimapsu caiva nivedayet || 220.150 ||
prārthayan dīrghamāyuśca vāyasebhyaḥ prayacchati  |
kumāraśālāmanvicchan kukkuṭebhyaḥ prayacchati  || 220.151 ||
eke viprāḥ punaḥ prāhuḥ piṇḍoddharaṇamagrataḥ  |
anujñātastu vipraistaiḥ kāmamuddhriyatāmiti  || 220.152 ||
tasmācchrāddhaṃ tathā kāryaṃ yathoktamṛṣibhiḥ purā  |
anyathā tu bhaveddoṣaḥ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhati  || 220.153 ||
yavairvrīhitilairmāṣairgodhūmaiścaṇakaistathā  |
saṃtarpayetpitṝnmudgaiḥ śyāmākaiḥ sarṣapadravaiḥ  || 220.154 ||
nīvārairhastiśyāmākaiḥ priyaṅgubhistathārghayet |
prasātikāṃ satūlikāṃ dadyācchrāddhe vicakṣaṇaḥ  || 220.155 ||
āmramāmrātakaṃ bilvaṃ dāḍimaṃ bījapūrakam  |
prācīnāmalakaṃ kṣīraṃ nārikelaṃ parūṣakam  || 220.156 ||
nāraṅgaṃ ca sakharjūraṃ drākṣānīlakapitthakam  |
paṭolaṃ ca priyālaṃ ca karkandhūbadarāṇi ca  || 220.157 ||
vikaṅkataṃ vatsakaṃ ca kastvārurvārakānapi  |
etāni phalajātāni śrāddhe deyāni yatnataḥ  || 220.158 ||
guḍaśarkaramatsyaṇḍī deyaṃ phāṇitamūrmuram  |
gavyaṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ ca tilasaṃbhavam  || 220.159 ||
saindhavaṃ sāgarotthaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ sārasaṃ tathā  |
nivedayecchucīn gandhāṃścandanāgurukuṅkumān  || 220.160 ||
kālaśākaṃ tandulīyaṃ vāstukaṃ mūlakaṃ tathā  |
śākamāraṇyakaṃ cāpi dadyātpuṣpāṇyamūni ca  || 220.161 ||
jāticampakalodhrāśca mallikābāṇabarbarī  |
vṛntāśokāṭarūṣaṃ ca tulasī tilakaṃ tathā  || 220.162 ||
pāvantīṃ śatapattrāṃ ca gandhaśephālikāmapi  |
kubjakaṃ tagaraṃ caiva mṛgamāraṇyaketakīm  || 220.163 ||
yūthikāmatimuktaṃ ca śrāddhayogyāni bho dvijāḥ  |
kamalaṃ kumudaṃ padmaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca yatnataḥ  || 220.164 ||
indīvaraṃ kokanadaṃ kahlāraṃ ca niyojayet |
kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī vālakaṃ ca kukkuṭī jātipattrakam  || 220.165 ||
nalikośīramustaṃ ca granthiparṇī ca sundarī  |
punarapyevamādīni gandhayogyāni cakṣate  || 220.166 ||
gugguluṃ candanaṃ caiva śrīvāsamaguruṃ tathā  |
dhūpāni pitṛyogyāni ṛṣiguggulameva ca  || 220.167 ||
rājamāṣāṃśca caṇakānmasūrān koradūṣakān  |
vipruṣānmarkaṭāṃścaiva kodravāṃścaiva varjayet || 220.168 ||
māhiṣaṃ cāmaraṃ mārgamāvikaikaśaphodbhavam  |
straiṇamauṣṭramāvikaṃ ca dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tyajet || 220.169 ||
tālaṃ varuṇakākolau bahupattrārjunīphalam  |
jambīraṃ raktabilvaṃ ca śālasyāpi phalaṃ tyajet || 220.170 ||
matsyasūkarakūrmāśca gāvo varjyā viśeṣataḥ  |
pūtikaṃ mṛganābhiṃ ca rocanāṃ padmacandanam  || 220.171 ||
kāleyakaṃ tūgragandhaṃ turuṣkaṃ cāpi varjayet |
pālaṅkaṃ ca kumārīṃ ca kirātaṃ piṇḍamūlakam  || 220.172 ||
gṛñjanaṃ cukrikāṃ cukraṃ varumāṃ canapattrikām  |
jīvaṃ ca śatapuṣpāṃ ca nālikāṃ gandhaśūkaram  || 220.173 ||
halabhṛtyaṃ sarṣapaṃ ca palāṇḍuṃ laśunaṃ tyajet |
mānakandaṃ viṣakandaṃ vajrakandaṃ gadāsthikam  || 220.174 ||
puruṣālvaṃ sapiṇḍāluṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi varjayet |
alābuṃ tiktaparṇāṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍaṃ kaṭukatrayam  || 220.175 ||
vārtākaṃ śivajātaṃ ca lomaśāni vaṭāni ca  |
kālīyaṃ raktavāṇāṃ ca balākā lakucaṃ tathā  || 220.176 ||
śrāddhakarmaṇi varjyāni vibhītakaphalaṃ tathā  |
āranālaṃ ca śuktaṃ ca śīrṇaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tathā  || 220.177 ||
nogragandhaṃ ca dātavyaṃ kovidārakaśigrukau  |
atyamlaṃ picchilaṃ sūkṣmaṃ yātayāmaṃ ca sattamāḥ  || 220.178 ||
na ca deyaṃ gatarasaṃ madyagandhaṃ ca yadbhavet |
hiṅgūgragandhaṃ phaṇiśaṃ bhūnimbaṃ nimbarājike  || 220.179 ||
kustumburuṃ kaliṅgotthaṃ varjayedamlavetasam  |
dāḍimaṃ māgadhīṃ caiva nāgarārdrakatittiḍīḥ  || 220.180 ||
āmrātakaṃ jīvakaṃ ca tumburuṃ ca niyojayet |
pāyasaṃ śālmalīmudgānmodakādīṃśca bhaktitaḥ  || 220.181 ||
pānakaṃ ca rasālaṃ ca gokṣīraṃ ca nivedayet |
yāni cābhyavahāryāṇi svādusnigdhāni bho dvijāḥ  || 220.182 ||
īṣadamlakaṭūnyeva deyāni śrāddhakarmaṇi  |
atyamlaṃ cātilavaṇamatiriktakaṭūni ca  || 220.183 ||
āsurāṇīha bhojyāni tānyato dūratastyajet |
mṛṣṭasnigdhāni yāni syurīṣatkaṭvamlakāni ca  || 220.184 ||
svādūni devabhojyāni tāni śrāddhe niyojayet |
chāgamāṃsaṃ vārtikaṃ ca taittiraṃ śaśakāmiṣam  || 220.185 ||
śivālāvakarājīva māṃsaṃ śrāddhe niyojayet |
vāghrīṇasaṃ raktaśivaṃ lohaṃ śalkasamanvitam  || 220.186 ||
siṃhatuṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ ca śrāddhe yojyaṃ tathocyate  |
yadapyuktaṃ hi manunā rohitaṃ pratiyojayet || 220.187 ||
yoktavyaṃ havyakavyeṣu tathā na viprayojayet |
evamuktaṃ mayā viprā vārāheṇāvalokitam  || 220.188 ||
mayā niṣiddhaṃ bhuñjāno rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet |
etāni ca niṣiddhāni vārāheṇa tapodhanāḥ  || 220.189 ||
abhakṣyāṇi dvijātīnāṃ na deyāni pitṛṣvapi  |
rohitaṃ śūkaraṃ kūrmaṃ godhāhaṃsaṃ ca varjayet || 220.190 ||
cakravākaṃ ca madguṃ ca śalkahīnāṃśca matsyakān  |
kuraraṃ ca nirasthiṃ ca vāsahātaṃ ca kukkuṭān  || 220.191 ||
kalaviṅkamayūrāṃśca bhāradvājāṃśca śārṅgakān  |
nakulolūkamārjārāṃllopānanyān sudurgrahān  || 220.192 ||
ṭiṭṭibhān sārdhajambūkān vyāghraṛkṣatarakṣukān  |
etānanyāṃśca saṃduṣṭān yo bhakṣayati durmatiḥ  || 220.193 ||
sa mahāpāpakārī tu rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet |
pitṛṣvetāṃstu yo dadyātpāpātmā garhitāmiṣān  || 220.194 ||
sa svargasthānapi pitṝnnarake pātayiṣyati  |
kusumbhaśākaṃ jambīraṃ sigrukaṃ kovidārakam  || 220.195 ||
piṇyākaṃ vipruṣaṃ caiva masūraṃ gṛñjanaṃ śaṇam  |
kodravaṃ kokilākṣaṃ ca cukraṃ kambukapadmakam  || 220.196 ||
cakoraśyenamāṃsaṃ ca vartulālābutālinīm  |
phalaṃ tālatarūṇāṃ ca bhuktyā narakamṛcchati  || 220.197 ||
dattvā pitṛṣu taiḥ sārdhaṃ vrajetpūyavahaṃ naraḥ  |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena nāharettu vicakṣaṇaḥ  || 220.198 ||
niṣiddhāni varāheṇa svayaṃ pitrarthamādarāt |
varamevātmamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇaṃ munayaḥ kṛtam  || 220.199 ||
na tveva hi niṣiddhānāmādānaṃ puṃbhirādarāt |
ajñānādvā pramādādvā sakṛdetāni ca dvijāḥ  || 220.200 ||
bhakṣitāni niṣiddhāni prāyaścittaṃ tataścaret |
phalamūladadhikṣīra takragomūtrayāvakaiḥ  || 220.201 ||
bhojyānnabhojyasaṃbhukte pratyekaṃ dinasaptakam  |
evaṃ niṣiddhācaraṇe kṛte sakṛdapi dvijaiḥ  || 220.202 ||
śuddhiṃ neyaṃ śarīraṃ tu viṣṇubhaktairviśeṣataḥ  |
niṣiddhaṃ varjayeddravyaṃ yathoktaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  || 220.203 ||
samāhṛtya tataḥ śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ nijaśaktitaḥ  |
evaṃ vidhānataḥ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā svavibhavocitam  |
ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ jagatprīṇāti mānavaḥ  || 220.204 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
pitā jīvati yasyātha mṛtau dvau pitarau pituḥ  |
kathaṃ śrāddhaṃ hi kartavyametadvistaraśo vada  || 220.205 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
yasmai dadyātpitā śrāddhaṃ tasmai dadyātsutaḥ svayam  |
evaṃ na hīyate dharmo laukiko vaidikastathā  || 220.206 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
mṛtaḥ pitā jīvati ca yasya brahman pitāmahaḥ  |
sa hi śrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kuryādetattvaṃ vaktumarhasi  || 220.207 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
pituḥ piṇḍaṃ pradadyācca bhojayecca pitāmaham  |
prapitāmahasya piṇḍaṃ vai hyayaṃ śāstreṣu nirṇayaḥ  || 220.208 ||
mṛteṣu piṇḍaṃ dātavyaṃ jīvantaṃ cāpi bhojayet |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ nāsti na ca pārvaṇamiṣyate  || 220.209 ||
ācāramācaredyastu pitṛmedhāśritaṃ naraḥ  |
āyuṣā dhanaputraiśca vardhatyāśu na saṃśayaḥ  || 220.210 ||
pitṛmedhādhyāyamimaṃ śrāddhakāleṣu yaḥ paṭhet |
tadannamasya pitaro'śnanti ca triyugaṃ dvijāḥ  || 220.211 ||
evaṃ mayoktaḥ pitṛmedhakalpaḥ  220.212
pāpāpahaḥ puṇyavivardhanaśca  220.212
śrotavya eṣa prayatairnaraiśca  220.212
śrāddheṣu caivāpyanukīrtayeta  220.212
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ samyaggṛhasthena devatāḥ pitarastathā  |
saṃpūjyā havyakavyābhyāmannenātithibāndhavāḥ  || 221.1 ||
bhūtāni bhṛtyāḥ sakalāḥ paśupakṣipipīlikāḥ  |
bhikṣavo yācamānāśca ye cānye pānthakā gṛhe  || 221.2 ||
sadācāraratā viprāḥ sādhunā gṛhamedhinā  |
pāpaṃ bhuṅkte samullaṅghya nityanaimittikīḥ kriyāḥ  || 221.3 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kathitaṃ bhavatā vipra nityanaimittikaṃ ca yat |
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ trividhaṃ karma pauruṣam  || 221.4 ||
sadācāraṃ mune śrotumicchāmo vadatastava  |
yaṃ kurvan sukhamāpnoti paratreha ca mānavaḥ  || 221.5 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
gṛhasthena sadā kāryamācāraparirakṣaṇam  |
na hyācāravihīnasya bhadramatra paratra vā  || 221.6 ||
yajñadānatapāṃsīha puruṣasya na bhūtaye  |
bhavanti yaḥ sadācāraṃ samullaṅghya pravartate  || 221.7 ||
durācāro hi puruṣo nehāyurvindate mahat |
kāryo dharmaḥ sadācāra ācārasyaiva lakṣaṇam  || 221.8 ||
tasya svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi sadācārasya bho dvijāḥ  |
ātmanaikamanā bhūtvā tathaiva paripālayet || 221.9 ||
trivargasādhane yatnaḥ kartavyo gṛhamedhinā  |
tatsaṃsiddhau gṛhasthasya siddhiratra paratra ca  || 221.10 ||
pādenāpyasya pāratryaṃ kuryācchreyaḥ svamātmavān  |
ardhena cātmabharaṇaṃ nityanaimittikāni ca  || 221.11 ||
pādenaiva tathāpyasya mūlabhūtaṃ vivardhayet |
evamācarato viprā arthaḥ sāphalyamṛcchati  || 221.12 ||
tadvatpāpaniṣedhārthaṃ dharmaḥ kāryo vipaścitā  |
paratrārthastathaivānyaḥ kāryo'traiva phalapradaḥ  || 221.13 ||
pratyavāyabhayātkāmastathānyaścāvirodhavān  |
dvidhā kāmo'pi racitastrivargāyāvirodhakṛt || 221.14 ||
parasparānubandhāṃśca sarvānetān vicintayet |
viparītānubandhāṃśca budhyadhvaṃ tān dvijottamāḥ  || 221.15 ||
dharmo dharmānubandhārtho dharmo nātmārthapīḍakaḥ  |
ubhābhyāṃ ca dvidhā kāmaṃ tena tau ca dvidhā punaḥ  || 221.16 ||
brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dharmārthāvanucintayet |
samutthāya tathācamya prasnāto niyataḥ śuciḥ  || 221.17 ||
pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ sanakṣatrāṃ paścimāṃ sadivākarām  |
upāsīta yathānyāyaṃ naināṃ jahyādanāpadi  || 221.18 ||
asatpralāpamanṛtaṃ vākpāruṣyaṃ ca varjayet |
asacchāstramasadvādamasatsevāṃ ca vai dvijāḥ  || 221.19 ||
sāyaṃprātastathā homaṃ kurvīta niyatātmavān  |
nodayāstamane caivamudīkṣeta vivasvataḥ  || 221.20 ||
keśaprasādhanādarśa dantadhāvanamañjanam  |
pūrvāhṇa eva kāryāṇi devatānāṃ ca tarpaṇam  || 221.21 ||
grāmāvasathatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ caiva vartmani  |
na viṇmūtramanuṣṭheyaṃ na ca kṛṣṭe na govraje  || 221.22 ||
nagnāṃ parastriyaṃ nekṣenna paśyedātmanaḥ śakṛt |
udakyādarśanasparśamevaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tathā  || 221.23 ||
nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā maithunaṃ vā samācaret |
nādhitiṣṭhecchakṛnmūtre keśabhasmasapālikāḥ  || 221.24 ||
tuṣāṅgāraviśīrṇāni rajjuvastrādikāni ca  |
nādhitiṣṭhettathā prājñaḥ pathi vastrāṇi vā bhuvi  || 221.25 ||
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca tathārcanam  |
kṛtvā vibhavataḥ paścādgṛhastho bhoktumarhati  || 221.26 ||
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi svācānto vāgyataḥ śuciḥ  |
bhuñjīta cānnaṃ taccitto hyantarjānuḥ sadā naraḥ  || 221.27 ||
upaghātamṛte doṣānnānnasyodīrayedbudhaḥ  |
pratyakṣalavaṇaṃ varjyamannamucchiṣṭameva ca  || 221.28 ||
na gacchanna ca tiṣṭhan vai viṇmūtrotsargamātmavān  |
kurvīta caivamucchiṣṭaṃ na kiṃcidapi bhakṣayet || 221.29 ||
ucchiṣṭo nālapetkiṃcitsvādhyāyaṃ ca vivarjayet |
na paśyecca raviṃ cenduṃ nakṣatrāṇi ca kāmataḥ  || 221.30 ||
bhinnāsanaṃ ca śayyāṃ ca bhājanaṃ ca vivarjayet |
gurūṇāmāsanaṃ deyamabhyutthānādisatkṛtam  || 221.31 ||
anukūlaṃ tathālāpamabhikurvīta buddhimān  |
tatrānugamanaṃ kuryātpratikūlaṃ na saṃcaret || 221.32 ||
naikavastraśca bhuñjīta na kuryāddevatārcanam  |
nāvāhayeddvijānagnau homaṃ kurvīta buddhimān  || 221.33 ||
na snāyīta naro nagno na śayīta kadācana  |
na pāṇibhyāmubhābhyāṃ tu kaṇḍūyeta śirastathā  || 221.34 ||
na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ kāryaṃ niṣkāraṇaṃ budhaiḥ  |
śiraḥsnātaśca tailena nāṅgaṃ kiṃcidupaspṛśet || 221.35 ||
anadhyāyeṣu sarveṣu svādhyāyaṃ ca vivarjayet |
brāhmaṇānalagosūryānnāvamanyetkadācana  || 221.36 ||
udaṅmukho divā rātrāvutsargaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ  |
ābādhāsu yathākāmaṃ kuryānmūtrapurīṣayoḥ  || 221.37 ||
duṣkṛtaṃ na gurorbrūyātkruddhaṃ cainaṃ prasādayet |
parivādaṃ na śṛṇuyādanyeṣāmapi kurvatām  || 221.38 ||
panthā deyo brāhmaṇānāṃ rājño duḥkhāturasya ca  |
vidyādhikasya garbhiṇyā rogārtasya mahīyataḥ  || 221.39 ||
mūkāndhabadhirāṇāṃ ca mattasyonmattakasya ca  |
devālayaṃ caidyataruṃ tathaiva ca catuṣpatham  || 221.40 ||
vidyādhikaṃ guruṃ caiva budhaḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇam  |
upānadvastramālyādi dhṛtamanyairna dhārayet || 221.41 ||
caturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ ca parvasu  |
tailābhyaṅgaṃ tathā bhogaṃ yoṣitaśca vivarjayet || 221.42 ||
notkṣiptabāhujaṅghaśca prājñastiṣṭhetkadācana  |
na cāpi vikṣipetpādau pādaṃ pādena nākramet || 221.43 ||
puṃścalyāḥ kṛtakāryasya bālasya patitasya ca  |
marmābhighātamākrośaṃ paiśunyaṃ ca vivarjayet || 221.44 ||
dambhābhimānaṃ taikṣṇyaṃ ca na kurvīta vicakṣaṇaḥ  |
mūrkhonmattavyasanino virūpānapi vā tathā  || 221.45 ||
nyūnāṅgāṃścādhanāṃścaiva nopahāsena dūṣayet |
parasya daṇḍaṃ nodyacchecchikṣārthaṃ śiṣyaputrayoḥ  || 221.46 ||
tadvannopaviśetprājñaḥ pādenākṛṣya cāsanam  |
saṃyāvaṃ kṛśaraṃ māṃsaṃ nātmārthamupasādhayet || 221.47 ||
sāyaṃ prātaśca bhoktavyaṃ kṛtvā cātithipūjanam  |
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi vāgyato dantadhāvanam  || 221.48 ||
kurvīta satataṃ viprā varjayedvarjyavīrudham  |
nodakśirāḥ svapejjātu na ca pratyakśirā naraḥ  || 221.49 ||
śirastvāgastyāmādhāya śayītātha puraṃdarīm  |
na tu gandhavatīṣvapsu śayīta na tathoṣasi  || 221.50 ||
uparāge paraṃ snānamṛte dinamudāhṛtam  |
apamṛjyānna vastrāntairgātrāṇyambarapāṇibhiḥ  || 221.51 ||
na cāvadhūnayetkeśān vāsasī na ca nirdhunet |
anulepanamādadyānnāsnātaḥ karhicidbudhaḥ  || 221.52 ||
na cāpi raktavāsāḥ syāccitrāsitadharo'pi vā  |
na ca kuryādviparyāsaṃ vāsasornāpi bhūṣayoḥ  || 221.53 ||
varjyaṃ ca vidaśaṃ vastramatyantopahataṃ ca yat |
kīṭakeśāvapannaṃ ca tathā śvabhiravekṣitam  || 221.54 ||
avalīḍhaṃ śunā caiva sāroddharaṇadūṣitam  |
pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ vṛthāmāṃsaṃ varjyamāṃsaṃ ca varjayet || 221.55 ||
na bhakṣayecca satataṃ pratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ naraḥ  |
varjyaṃ ciroṣitaṃ viprāḥ śuṣkaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yat || 221.56 ||
piṣṭaśākekṣupayasāṃ vikārā dvijasattamāḥ  |
tathā māṃsavikārāśca naiva varjyāściroṣitāḥ  || 221.57 ||
udayāstamane bhānoḥ śayanaṃ ca vivarjayet |
nāsnāto naiva saṃviṣṭo na caivānyamanā naraḥ  || 221.58 ||
na caiva śayane norvyāmupaviṣṭo na śabdakṛt |
preṣyāṇāmapradāyātha na bhuñjīta kadācana  || 221.59 ||
bhuñjīta puruṣaḥ snātaḥ sāyaṃprātaryathāvidhi  |
paradārā na gantavyāḥ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā  || 221.60 ||
iṣṭāpūrtāyuṣāṃ hantrī paradāragatirnṛṇām  |
nahīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke kiṃcana vidyate  || 221.61 ||
yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradārābhimarśanam  |
devāgnipitṛkāryāṇi tathā gurvabhivādanam  || 221.62 ||
kurvīta samyagācamya tadvadannabhujikriyām  |
aphenaśabdagandhābhiradbhiracchābhirādarāt || 221.63 ||
ācāmeccaiva tadvacca prāṅmukhodaṅmukho'pi vā  |
antarjalādāvasathādvalmīkānmūṣikāsthalāt || 221.64 ||
kṛtaśaucāvaśiṣṭāśca varjayetpañca vai mṛdaḥ  |
prakṣālya hastau pādau ca samabhyukṣya samāhitaḥ  || 221.65 ||
antarjānustathācāmettriścaturvāpi vai naraḥ  |
parimṛjya dvirāvartya khāni mūrdhānameva ca  || 221.66 ||
samyagācamya toyena kriyāṃ kurvīta vai śuciḥ  |
kṣute'valīḍhe vāte ca tathā niṣṭhīvanādiṣu  || 221.67 ||
kuryādācamanaṃ sparśe vāspṛṣṭasyārkadarśanam  |
kurvītālambhanaṃ cāpi dakṣiṇaśravaṇasya ca  || 221.68 ||
yathāvibhavato hyetatpūrvābhāve tataḥ param  |
na vidyamāne pūrvokta uttaraprāptiriṣyate  || 221.69 ||
na kuryāddantasaṃgharṣaṃ nātmano dehatāḍanam  |
svāpe'dhvani tathā bhuñjan svādhyāyaṃ ca vivarjayet || 221.70 ||
saṃdhyāyāṃ maithunaṃ cāpi tathā prasthānameva ca  |
tathāparāhṇe kurvīta śraddhayā pitṛtarpaṇam  || 221.71 ||
śiraḥsnānaṃ ca kurvīta daivaṃ pitryamathāpi ca  |
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi śmaśrukarma ca kārayet || 221.72 ||
vyaṅginīṃ varjayetkanyāṃ kulajāṃ vāpyarogiṇīm  |
udvahetpitṛmātrośca saptamīṃ pañcamīṃ tathā  || 221.73 ||
rakṣeddārāṃstyajedīrṣyāṃ tathāhni svapnamaithune  |
paropatāpakaṃ karma jantupīḍāṃ ca sarvadā  || 221.74 ||
udakyā sarvavarṇānāṃ varjyā rātricatuṣṭayam  |
strījanmaparihārārthaṃ pañcamīṃ cāpi varjayet || 221.75 ||
tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrajedrātryāṃ jyeṣṭhayugmāsu rātriṣu  |
yugmāsu putrā jāyante striyo'yugmāsu rātriṣu  || 221.76 ||
vidharmiṇo vai parvādau saṃdhyākāleṣu ṣaṇḍhakāḥ  |
kṣurakarmaṇi riktāṃ vai varjayīta vicakṣaṇaḥ  || 221.77 ||
bruvatāmavinītānāṃ na śrotavyaṃ kadācana  |
na cotkṛṣṭāsanaṃ deyamanutkṛṣṭasya cādarāt || 221.78 ||
kṣurakarmaṇi cānte ca strīsaṃbhoge ca bho dvijāḥ  |
snāyīta cailavān prājñaḥ kaṭabhūmimupetya ca  || 221.79 ||
devavedadvijātīnāṃ sādhusatyamahātmanām  |
guroḥ pativratānāṃ ca brahmayajñatapasvinām  || 221.80 ||
parivādaṃ na kurvīta parihāsaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  |
dhavalāmbarasaṃvītaḥ sitapuṣpavibhūṣitaḥ  || 221.81 ||
sadā māṅgalyaveṣaḥ syānna vāmāṅgalyavān bhavet |
noddhatonmattamūḍhaiśca nāvinītaiśca paṇḍitaḥ  || 221.82 ||
gacchenmaitrīmaśīlena na vayojātidūṣitaiḥ  |
na cātivyayaśīlaiśca puruṣairnaiva vairibhiḥ  || 221.83 ||
kāryākṣamairninditairna na caiva viṭasaṅgibhiḥ  |
nisvairna vādaikaparairnaraiścānyaistathādhamaiḥ  || 221.84 ||
suhṛddīkṣitabhūpāla snātakaśvaśuraiḥ saha  |
uttiṣṭhedvibhavāccainānarcayedgṛhamāgatān  || 221.85 ||
yathāvibhavato viprāḥ pratisaṃvatsaroṣitān  |
samyaggṛhe'rcanaṃ kṛtvā yathāsthānamanukramāt || 221.86 ||
saṃpūjayettathā vahnau pradadyāccāhutīḥ kramāt |
prathamāṃ brahmaṇe dadyātprajānāṃ pataye tataḥ  || 221.87 ||
tṛtīyāṃ caiva gṛhyebhyaḥ kaśyapāya tathāparām  |
tato'numataye dadyāddadyādbahubaliṃ tataḥ  || 221.88 ||
pūrvaṃ khyātā mayā yā tu nityakramavidhau kriyā  |
vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryādvadata śṛṇuta dvijāḥ  || 221.89 ||
yathāsthānavibhāgaṃ tu devānuddiśya vai pṛthak |
parjanyāpodharitrīṇāṃ dadyāttu maṇike trayam  || 221.90 ||
vāyave ca pratidiśaṃ digbhyaḥ prācyādiṣu kramāt |
brahmaṇe cāntarikṣāya sūryāya ca yathākramāt || 221.91 ||
viśvebhyaścaiva devebhyo viśvabhūtebhya eva ca  |
uṣase bhūtapataye dadyādvottarataḥ śuciḥ  || 221.92 ||
svadhā ca nama ityuktvā pitṛbhyaścaiva dakṣiṇe  |
kṛtvāpasavyaṃ vāyavyāṃ yakṣmaitattaiti saṃvadan  || 221.93 ||
annāvaśeṣamiśraṃ vai toyaṃ dadyādyathāvidhi  |
devānāṃ ca tataḥ kuryādbrāhmaṇānāṃ namaskriyām  || 221.94 ||
aṅguṣṭhottarato rekhā pāṇeryā dakṣiṇasya ca  |
etadbrāhmamiti khyātaṃ tīrthamācamanāya vai  || 221.95 ||
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayorantaḥ pitryaṃ tīrthamudāhṛtam  |
pitṝṇāṃ tena toyāni dadyānnāndīmukhādṛte  || 221.96 ||
aṅgulyagre tathā daivaṃ tena divyakriyāvidhiḥ  |
tīrthaṃ kaniṣṭhikāmūle kāyaṃ tatra prajāpateḥ  || 221.97 ||
evamebhiḥ sadā tīrthairvidhānaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha  |
sadā kāryāṇi kurvīta nānyatīrthaḥ kadācana  || 221.98 ||
brāhmeṇācamanaṃ śastaṃ paitryaṃ pitryeṇa sarvadā  |
devatīrthena devānāṃ prājāpatyaṃ jitena ca  || 221.99 ||
nāndīmukhānāṃ kurvīta prājñaḥ piṇḍodakakriyām  |
prājāpatyena tīrthena yacca kiṃcitprajāpateḥ  || 221.100 ||
yugapajjalamagniṃ ca bibhṛyānna vicakṣaṇaḥ  |
gurudevapitṝn viprānna ca pādau prasārayet || 221.101 ||
nācakṣīta dhayantīṃ gāṃ jalaṃ nāñjalinā pibet |
śaucakāleṣu sarveṣu guruṣvalpeṣu vā punaḥ  |
na vilambeta medhāvī na mukhenānalaṃ dhamet || 221.102 ||
tatra viprā na vastavyaṃ yatra nāsti catuṣṭayam  |
ṛṇapradātā vaidyaśca śrotriyaḥ sajalā nadī  || 221.103 ||
jitabhṛtyo nṛpo yatra balavān dharmatatparaḥ  |
tatra nityaṃ vasetprājñaḥ kutaḥ kunṛpatau sukham  || 221.104 ||
paurāḥ susaṃhatā yatra satataṃ nyāyavartinaḥ  |
śāntāmatsariṇo lokāstatra vāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ  || 221.105 ||
yasmin kṛṣīvalā rāṣṭre prāyaśo nātimāninaḥ  |
yatrauṣadhānyaśeṣāṇi vasettatra vicakṣaṇaḥ  || 221.106 ||
tatra viprā na vastavyaṃ yatraitattritayaṃ sadā  |
jigīṣuḥ pūrvavairaśca janaśca satatotsavaḥ  || 221.107 ||
vasennityaṃ suśīleṣu sahacāriṣu paṇḍitaḥ  |
yatrāpradhṛṣyo nṛpatiryatra sasyapradā mahī  || 221.108 ||
ityetatkathitaṃ viprā mayā vo hitakāmyayā  |
ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhakṣyabhojyavidhikriyām  || 221.109 ||
bhojyamannaṃ paryuṣitaṃ snehāktaṃ cirasaṃbhṛtam  |
asnehā api godhūma yavagorasavikriyāḥ  || 221.110 ||
śaśakaḥ kacchapo godhā śvāvinmatsyo'tha śalyakaḥ  |
bhakṣyāścaite tathā varjyau grāmaśūkarakukkuṭau  || 221.111 ||
pitṛdevādiśeṣaṃ ca śrāddhe brāhmaṇakāmyayā  |
prokṣitaṃ cauṣadhārthaṃ ca khādanmāṃsaṃ na duṣyati  || 221.112 ||
śaṅkhāśmasvarṇarūpyāṇāṃ rajjūnāmatha vāsasām  |
śākamūlaphalānāṃ ca tathā vidalacarmaṇām  || 221.113 ||
maṇivastrapravālānāṃ tathā muktāphalasya ca  |
pātrāṇāṃ camasānāṃ ca ambunā śaucamiṣyate  || 221.114 ||
tathāśmakānāṃ toyena aśmasaṃgharṣaṇena ca  |
sasnehānāṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ śuddhiruṣṇena vāriṇā  || 221.115 ||
śūrpāṇāmajinānāṃ ca muśalolūkhalasya ca  |
saṃhatānāṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇātsaṃcayasya ca  || 221.116 ||
valkalānāmaśeṣāṇāmambumṛcchaucamiṣyate  |
āvikānāṃ samastānāṃ keśānāṃ caivamiṣyate  || 221.117 ||
siddhārthakānāṃ kalkena tilakalkena vā punaḥ  |
śodhanaṃ caiva bhavati upaghātavatāṃ sadā  || 221.118 ||
tathā kārpāsikānāṃ ca śuddhiḥ syājjalabhasmanā  |
dārudantāsthiśṛṅgāṇāṃ takṣaṇācchuddhiriṣyate  || 221.119 ||
punaḥ pākena bhāṇḍānāṃ pārthivānāmamedhyatā  |
śuddhaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ kāruhastaḥ paṇyaṃ yoṣinmukhaṃ tathā  || 221.120 ||
rathyāgamanavijñānaṃ dāsavargeṇa saṃskṛtam  |
prākpraśastaṃ cirātītamanekāntaritaṃ laghu  || 221.121 ||
antaḥ prabhūtaṃ bālaṃ ca vṛddhāntaraviceṣṭitam  |
karmāntāgāraśālāśca stanadvayaṃ śuci striyāḥ  || 221.122 ||
śucayaśca tathaivāpaḥ sravantyo gandhavarjitāḥ  |
bhūmirviśudhyate kālāddāhamārjanagokulaiḥ  || 221.123 ||
lepādullekhanātsekādveśma saṃmārjanādinā  |
keśakīṭāvapanne ca goghrāte makṣikānvite  || 221.124 ||
mṛdambu bhasma cāpyanne prakṣeptavyaṃ viśuddhaye  |
audumbarāṇāmamlena vāriṇā trapusīsayoḥ  || 221.125 ||
bhasmāmbubhiśca kāṃsyānāṃ śuddhiḥ plāvo dravasya ca  |
amedhyāktasya mṛttoyairgandhāpaharaṇena ca  || 221.126 ||
anyeṣāṃ caiva dravyāṇāṃ varṇagandhāṃśca hārayet |
śuci māṃsaṃ tu cāṇḍāla kravyādairvinipātitam  || 221.127 ||
rathyāgataṃ ca tailādi śuci gotṛptidaṃ payaḥ  |
rajo'gniraśvagochāyā raśmayaḥ pavano mahī  || 221.128 ||
vipluṣo makṣikādyāśca duṣṭasaṅgādadoṣiṇaḥ  |
ajāśvaṃ mukhato medhyaṃ na gorvatsasya cānanam  || 221.129 ||
mātuḥ prasravaṇe medhyaṃ śakuniḥ phalapātane  |
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ taṭau nadyāstṛṇāni ca  || 221.130 ||
somasūryāṃśupavanaiḥ śudhyante tāni paṇyavat |
rathyāpasarpaṇe snāne kṣutpānānāṃ ca karmasu  || 221.131 ||
ācāmeta yathānyāyaṃ vāsasaḥ paridhāpane  |
spṛṣṭānāmatha saṃsparśairdvirathyākardamāmbhasi  || 221.132 ||
pakveṣṭakacitānāṃ ca medhyatā vāyusaṃśrayāt |
prabhūtopahatādannādagramuddhṛtya saṃtyajet || 221.133 ||
śeṣasya prokṣaṇaṃ kuryādācamyādbhistathā mṛdā  |
upavāsastrirātraṃ tu duṣṭabhaktāśino bhavet || 221.134 ||
ajñāne jñānapūrve tu taddoṣopaśame na tu  |
udakyāṃ vāvalagnāṃ ca sūtikāntyāvasāyinaḥ  || 221.135 ||
spṛṣṭvā snāyīta śaucārthaṃ tathaiva mṛtahāriṇaḥ  |
nāraṃ spṛṣṭvāsthi sasnehaṃ snātvā vipro viśudhyati  || 221.136 ||
ācamyaiva tu niḥsnehaṃ gāmālabhyārkamīkṣya vā  |
na laṅghayettathaivātha ṣṭhīvanodvartanāni ca  || 221.137 ||
gṛhāducchiṣṭaviṇmūtraṃ pādāmbhastatkṣipedbahiḥ  |
pañcapiṇḍānanuddhṛtya na snāyātparavāriṇi  || 221.138 ||
snāyīta devakhāteṣu gaṅgāhradasaritsu ca  |
nodyānādau vikāleṣu prājñastiṣṭhetkadācana  || 221.139 ||
nālapejjanavidviṣṭān vīrahīnāstathā striyaḥ  |
devatāpitṛsacchāstra yajvisaṃnyāsinindakaiḥ  || 221.140 ||
kṛtvā tu sparśanālāpaṃ śudhyatyarkāvalokanāt |
avalokya tathodakyāṃ saṃnyastaṃ patitaṃ śavam  || 221.141 ||
vidharmisūtikāṣaṇḍha vivastrāntyāvasāyinaḥ  |
mṛtaniryātakāṃścaiva paradāraratāśca ye  || 221.142 ||
etadeva hi kartavyaṃ prājñaiḥ śodhanamātmanaḥ  |
abhojyabhikṣupākhaṇḍa mārjārakharakukkuṭān  || 221.143 ||
patitāpaviddhacāṇḍāla mṛtāhārāṃśca dharmavit |
saṃspṛśya śudhyate snānādudakyāgrāmaśūkarau  || 221.144 ||
tadvacca sūtikāśauca dūṣitau puruṣāvapi  |
yasya cānudinaṃ hānirgṛhe nityasya karmaṇaḥ  || 221.145 ||
yaśca brāhmaṇasaṃtyaktaḥ kilbiṣāśī narādhamaḥ  |
nityasya karmaṇo hāniṃ na kurvīta kadācana  || 221.146 ||
tasya tvakaraṇaṃ vakṣye kevalaṃ mṛtajanmasu  |
daśāhaṃ brāhmaṇastiṣṭheddānahomavivarjitaḥ  || 221.147 ||
kṣatriyo dvādaśāhaṃ ca vaiśyo māsārdhameva ca  |
śūdraśca māsamāsīta nijakarmavivarjitaḥ  || 221.148 ||
tataḥ paraṃ nijaṃ karma kuryuḥ sarve yathocitam  |
pretāya salilaṃ deyaṃ bahirgatvā tu gotrakaiḥ  || 221.149 ||
prathame'hni caturthe ca saptame navame tathā  |
tasyāsthisaṃcayaḥ kāryaścaturthe'hani gotrakaiḥ  || 221.150 ||
ūrdhvaṃ saṃcayanātteṣāmaṅgasparśo vidhīyate  |
gotrakaistu kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kāryāḥ saṃcayanātparam  || 221.151 ||
sparśa eva sapiṇḍānāṃ mṛtāhani tathobhayoḥ  |
anvarthamicchayā śastra rajjubandhanavahniṣu  || 221.152 ||
viṣapratāpādimṛte prāyānāśakayorapi  |
bāle deśāntarasthe ca tathā pravrajite mṛte  || 221.153 ||
