sadyaḥ śaucaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tryahamuktamaśaucakam  |
sapiṇḍānāṃ sapiṇḍastu mṛte'nyasminmṛto yadi  || 221.154 ||
pūrvaśaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ kāryāstatra dinakriyāḥ  |
eṣa eva vidhirdṛṣṭo janmanyapi hi sūtake  || 221.155 ||
sapiṇḍānāṃ sapiṇḍeṣu yathāvatsodakeṣu ca  |
putre jāte pituḥ snānaṃ sacailasya vidhīyate  || 221.156 ||
tatrāpi yadi vānyasminnanuyātastataḥ param  |
tatrāpi śuddhiruditā pūrvajanmavato dinaiḥ  || 221.157 ||
daśadvādaśamāsārdha māsasaṃkhyairdinairgataiḥ  |
svāḥ svāḥ karmakriyāḥ kuryuḥ sarve varṇā yathāvidhi  || 221.158 ||
pretamuddiśya kartavyamekoddiṣṭamataḥ param  |
dānāni caiva deyāni brāhmaṇebhyo manīṣibhiḥ  || 221.159 ||
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccāsya dayitaṃ gṛhe  |
tattadguṇavate deyaṃ tadevākṣayamicchatā  || 221.160 ||
pūrṇaistu divasaiḥ spṛṣṭvā salilaṃ vāhanāyudhaiḥ  |
dattapretodapiṇḍāśca sarve varṇāḥ kṛtakriyāḥ  || 221.161 ||
kuryuḥ samagrāḥ śucinaḥ paratreha ca bhūtaye  |
adhyetavyā trayī nityaṃ bhavitavyaṃ vipaścitā  || 221.162 ||
dharmato dhanamāhāryaṃ yaṣṭavyaṃ cāpi yatnataḥ  |
yena prakupito nātmā jugupsāmeti bho dvijāḥ  || 221.163 ||
tatkartavyamaśaṅkena yanna gopyaṃ mahājanaiḥ  |
evamācarato viprāḥ puruṣasya gṛhe sataḥ  || 221.164 ||
dharmārthakāmaṃ saṃprāpya paratreha ca śobhanam  |
idaṃ rahasyamāyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ buddhivivardhanam  || 221.165 ||
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīpuṣṭyārogyadaṃ śivam  |
yaśaḥkīrtipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ tejobalavivardhanam  || 221.166 ||
anuṣṭheyaṃ sadā puṃbhiḥ svargasādhanamuttamam  |
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiśca munisattamāḥ  || 221.167 ||
jñātavyaṃ suprayatnena samyakśreyobhikāṅkṣibhiḥ  |
jñātvaiva yaḥ sadā kālamanuṣṭhānaṃ karoti vai  || 221.168 ||
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate  |
sārātsārataraṃ cedamākhyātaṃ dvijasattamāḥ  || 221.169 ||
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit |
na nāstikāya dātavyaṃ na duṣṭamataye dvijāḥ  |
na dāmbhikāya mūrkhāya na kutarkapralāpine  || 221.170 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
śrotumicchāmahe brahman varṇadharmān viśeṣataḥ  |
caturāśramadharmāṃśca dvijavarya bravīhi tān  || 222.1 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca yathākramam  |
śṛṇudhvaṃ saṃyatā bhūtvā varṇadharmānmayoditān  || 222.2 ||
dānadayātapodeva yajñasvādhyāyatatparaḥ  |
nityodakī bhavedvipraḥ kuryāccāgniparigraham  || 222.3 ||
vṛttyarthaṃ yājayettvanyān dvijānadhyāpayettathā  |
kuryātpratigrahādānaṃ yajñārthaṃ jñānato dvijāḥ  || 222.4 ||
sarvalokahitaṃ kuryānnāhitaṃ kasyaciddvijāḥ  |
maitrī samastasattveṣu brāhmaṇasyottamaṃ dhanam  || 222.5 ||
gavi ratne ca pārakye samabuddhirbhaveddvijāḥ  |
ṛtāvabhigamaḥ patnyāṃ śasyate vāsya bho dvijāḥ  || 222.6 ||
dānāni dadyādicchāto dvijebhyaḥ kṣatriyo'pi hi  |
yajecca vividhairyajñairadhīyīta ca bho dvijāḥ  || 222.7 ||
śastrājīvo mahīrakṣā pravarā tasya jīvikā  |
tasyāpi prathame kalpe pṛthivīparipālanam  || 222.8 ||
dharitrīpālanenaiva kṛtakṛtyā narādhipāḥ  |
bhavanti nṛpate rakṣā yato yajñādikarmaṇām  || 222.9 ||
duṣṭānāṃ śāsanādrājā śiṣṭānāṃ paripālanāt |
prāpnotyabhimatāṃllokān varṇasaṃsthāpako nṛpaḥ  || 222.10 ||
pāśupālyaṃ vaṇijyāṃ ca kṛṣiṃ ca munisattamāḥ  |
vaiśyāya jīvikāṃ brahmā dadau lokapitāmahaḥ  || 222.11 ||
tasyāpyadhyayanaṃ yajño dānaṃ dharmaśca śasyate  |
nityanaimittikādīnāmanuṣṭhānaṃ ca karmaṇām  || 222.12 ||
dvijātisaṃśrayaṃ karma tadarthaṃ tena poṣaṇam  |
krayavikrayajairvāpi dhanaiḥ kārubhavaistu vā  || 222.13 ||
dānaṃ dadyācca śūdro'pi pākayajñairyajeta ca  |
pitryādikaṃ ca vai sarvaṃ śūdraḥ kurvīta tena vai  || 222.14 ||
bhṛtyādibharaṇārthāya sarveṣāṃ ca parigrahāḥ  |
ṛtukālābhigamanaṃ svadāreṣu dvijottamāḥ  || 222.15 ||
dayā samastabhūteṣu titikṣā nābhimānitā  |
satyaṃ śaucamanāyāso maṅgalaṃ priyavāditā  || 222.16 ||
maitrī caivāspṛhā tadvadakārpaṇyaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
anasūyā ca sāmānyā varṇānāṃ kathitā guṇāḥ  || 222.17 ||
āśramāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāmete sāmānyalakṣaṇāḥ  |
guṇāstathopadharmāśca viprādīnāmime dvijāḥ  || 222.18 ||
kṣātraṃ karma dvijasyoktaṃ vaiśyakarma tathāpadi  |
rājanyasya ca vaiśyoktaṃ śūdrakarmāṇi caitayoḥ  || 222.19 ||
sasāmarthye sati tyājyamubhābhyāmapi ca dvijāḥ  |
tadevāpadi kartavyaṃ na kuryātkarmasaṃkaram  || 222.20 ||
ityete kathitā viprā varṇadharmā mayādya vai  |
dharmamāśramiṇāṃ samyagbruvato'pi nibodhata  || 222.21 ||
bālaḥ kṛtopanayano vedāharaṇatatparaḥ  |
gurorgehe vasan viprā brahmacārī samāhitaḥ  || 222.22 ||
śaucācāraratastatra kāryaṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ guroḥ  |
vratāni caratā grāhyo vedaśca kṛtabuddhinā  || 222.23 ||
ubhe saṃdhye raviṃ viprāstathaivāgniṃ samāhitaḥ  |
upatiṣṭhettathā kuryādgurorapyabhivādanam  || 222.24 ||
sthite tiṣṭhedvrajedyāti nīcairāsīta cāsite  |
śiṣyo gurau dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ pratikūlaṃ ca saṃtyajet || 222.25 ||
tenaivoktaṃ paṭhedvedaṃ nānyacittaḥ purasthitaḥ  |
anujñātaṃ ca bhikṣānnamaśnīyādguruṇā tataḥ  || 222.26 ||
avagāhedapaḥ pūrvamācāryeṇāvagāhitāḥ  |
samijjalādikaṃ cāsya kalyakalyamupānayet || 222.27 ||
gṛhītagrāhyavedaśca tato'nujñāmavāpya vai  |
gārhasthyamāvasetprājño niṣpannaguruniṣkṛtiḥ  || 222.28 ||
vidhināvāptadārastu dhanaṃ prāpya svakarmaṇā  |
gṛhasthakāryamakhilaṃ kuryādviprāḥ svaśaktitaḥ  || 222.29 ||
nirvāpeṇa pitṝnarcya yajñairdevāṃstathātithīn  |
annairmunīṃśca svādhyāyairapatyena prajāpatim  || 222.30 ||
balikarmaṇā bhūtāni vāksatyenākhilaṃ jagat |
prāpnoti lokān puruṣo nijakarmasamārjitān  || 222.31 ||
bhikṣābhujaśca ye kecitparivrāḍbrahmacāriṇaḥ  |
te'pyatra pratitiṣṭhanti gārhasthyaṃ tena vai param  || 222.32 ||
vedāharaṇakāryeṇa tīrthasnānāya ca dvijāḥ  |
aṭanti vasudhāṃ viprāḥ pṛthivīdarśanāya ca  || 222.33 ||
aniketā hyanāhārā ye tu sāyaṃgṛhāstu te  |
teṣāṃ gṛhasthaḥ satataṃ pratiṣṭhā yonirucyate  || 222.34 ||
teṣāṃ svāgatadānāni vaktavyaṃ madhuraṃ sadā  |
gṛhāgatānāṃ dadyācca śayanāsanabhojanam  || 222.35 ||
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinivartate  |
sa dattvā duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati  || 222.36 ||
avajñānamahaṃkāro dambhaścāpi gṛhe sataḥ  |
parivādopaghātau ca pāruṣyaṃ ca na śasyate  || 222.37 ||
yaśca samyakkarotyevaṃ gṛhasthaḥ paramaṃ vidhim  |
sarvabandhavinirmukto lokānāpnoti cottamān  || 222.38 ||
vayaḥpariṇatau viprāḥ kṛtakṛtyo gṛhāśramī  |
putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya vanaṃ gacchetsahaiva vā  || 222.39 ||
parṇamūlaphalāhāraḥ keśaśmaśrujaṭādharaḥ  |
bhūmiśāyī bhavettatra muniḥ sarvātithirdvijāḥ  || 222.40 ||
carmakāśakuśaiḥ kuryātparidhānottarīyake  |
tadvattriṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ śastamasya dvijottamāḥ  || 222.41 ||
devatābhyarcanaṃ homaḥ sarvābhyāgatapūjanam  |
bhikṣā balipradānaṃ tu śastamasya praśasyate  || 222.42 ||
vanyasnehena gātrāṇāmabhyaṅgaścāpi śasyate  |
tapasyā tasya viprendrāḥ śītoṣṇādisahiṣṇutā  || 222.43 ||
yastvetā niyataścaryā vānaprasthaścarenmuniḥ  |
sa dahatyagnivaddoṣāñjayellokāṃśca śāśvatān  || 222.44 ||
caturthaścāśramo bhikṣoḥ procyate yo manīṣibhiḥ  |
tasya svarūpaṃ gadato budhyadhvaṃ mama sattamāḥ  || 222.45 ||
putradravyakalatreṣu tyajetsnehaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
caturthamāśramasthānaṃ gacchennirdhūtamatsaraḥ  || 222.46 ||
traivarṇikāṃstyajetsarvānārambhān dvijasattamāḥ  |
mitrādiṣu samo maitraḥ samasteṣveva jantuṣu  || 222.47 ||
jarāyujāṇḍajādīnāṃ vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥ kvacit |
yuktaḥ kurvīta na drohaṃ sarvasaṅgāṃśca varjayet || 222.48 ||
ekarātrasthitirgrāme pañcarātrasthitiḥ pure  |
tathā prītirna tiryakṣu dveṣo vā nāsya jāyate  || 222.49 ||
prāṇayātrānimittaṃ ca vyaṅgāre'bhuktavajjane  |
kāle praśastavarṇānāṃ bhikṣārthī paryaṭedgṛhān  || 222.50 ||
alābhe na viṣādī syāllābhe naiva ca harṣayet |
prāṇayātrikamātraḥ syānmātrāsaṅgādvinirgataḥ  || 222.51 ||
atipūjitalābhāṃstu jugupsaṃ caiva sarvataḥ  |
atipūjitalābhaistu yatirmukto'pi badhyate  || 222.52 ||
kāmaḥ krodhastathā darpo lobhamohādayaśca ye  |
tāṃstu doṣān parityajya parivrāṇnirmamo bhavet || 222.53 ||
abhayaṃ sarvasattvebhyo dattvā yaścarate mahīm  |
tasya dehādvimuktasya bhayaṃ notpadyate kvacit || 222.54 ||
kṛtvāgnihotraṃ svaśarīrasaṃsthaṃ  222.55
śārīramagniṃ svamukhe juhoti  222.55
viprastu bhikṣopagatairhavirbhiś 222.55
citāgninā sa vrajati sma lokān  222.55
mokṣāśramaṃ yaścarate yathoktaṃ  222.56
śuciśca saṃkalpitabuddhiyuktaḥ  222.56
anindhanaṃ jyotiriva praśāntaṃ  222.56
sa brahmalokaṃ vrajati dvijātiḥ  222.56
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
sarvajñastvaṃ mahābhāga sarvabhūtahite rataḥ  |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca na te'styaviditaṃ mune  || 223.1 ||
karmaṇā kena varṇānāmadhamā jāyate gatiḥ  |
uttamā ca bhavetkena brūhi teṣāṃ mahāmate  || 223.2 ||
śūdrastu karmaṇā kena brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca gacchati  |
śrotumicchāmahe kena brāhmaṇaḥ śūdratāmiyāt || 223.3 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
himavacchikhare ramye nānādhātuvibhūṣite  |
nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāścaryasamanvite  || 223.4 ||
tatra sthitaṃ mahādevaṃ tripuraghnaṃ trilocanam  |
śailarājasutā devī praṇipatya sureśvaram  || 223.5 ||
imaṃ praśnaṃ purā viprā apṛcchaccārulocanā  |
tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ mama sattamāḥ  || 223.6 ||
{umovāca̱ }
bhagavan bhaganetraghna pūṣṇo dantavināśana  |
dakṣakratuhara tryakṣa saṃśayo me mahānayam  || 223.7 ||
cāturvarṇyaṃ bhagavatā pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā  |
kena karmavipākena vaiśyo gacchati śūdratām  || 223.8 ||
vaiśyo vā kṣatriyaḥ kena dvijo vā kṣatriyo bhavet |
pratilome kathaṃ deva śakyo dharmo nivartitum  || 223.9 ||
kena vā karmaṇā vipraḥ śūdrayonau prajāyate  |
kṣatriyaḥ śūdratāmeti kena vā karmaṇā vibho  || 223.10 ||
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva vada bhūtapate'nagha  |
trayo varṇāḥ prakṛtyeha kathaṃ brāhmaṇyamāpnuyuḥ  || 223.11 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
brāhmaṇyaṃ devi duṣprāpaṃ nisargādbrāhmaṇaḥ śubhe  |
kṣatriyo vaiśyaśūdrau vā nisargāditi me matiḥ  || 223.12 ||
karmaṇā duṣkṛteneha sthānādbhraśyati sa dvijaḥ  |
śreṣṭhaṃ varṇamanuprāpya tasmādākṣipyate punaḥ  || 223.13 ||
sthito brāhmaṇadharmeṇa brāhmaṇyamupajīvati  |
kṣatriyo vātha vaiśyo vā brahmabhūyaṃ sa gacchati  || 223.14 ||
yaśca vipratvamutsṛjya kṣatradharmānniṣevate  |
brāhmaṇyātsa paribhraṣṭaḥ kṣatrayonau prajāyate  || 223.15 ||
vaiśyakarma ca yo vipro lobhamohavyapāśrayaḥ  |
brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya karotyalpamatiḥ sadā  || 223.16 ||
sa dvijo vaiśyatāmeti vaiśyo vā śūdratāmiyāt |
svadharmātpracyuto viprastataḥ śūdratvamāpnuyāt || 223.17 ||
tatrāsau nirayaṃ prāpto varṇabhraṣṭo bahiṣkṛtaḥ  |
brahmalokātparibhraṣṭaḥ śūdrayonau prajāyate  || 223.18 ||
kṣatriyo vā mahābhāge vaiśyo vā dharmacāriṇi  |
svāni karmāṇyapākṛtya śūdrakarma niṣevate  || 223.19 ||
svasthānātsa paribhraṣṭo varṇasaṃkaratāṃ gataḥ  |
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdratvaṃ yāti tādṛśaḥ  || 223.20 ||
yastu śūdraḥ svadharmeṇa jñānavijñānavāñśuciḥ  |
dharmajño dharmanirataḥ sa dharmaphalamaśnute  || 223.21 ||
idaṃ caivāparaṃ devi brahmaṇā samudāhṛtam  |
adhyātmaṃ naiṣṭhikī siddhirdharmakāmairniṣevyate  || 223.22 ||
ugrānnaṃ garhitaṃ devi gaṇānnaṃ śrāddhasūtakam  |
ghuṣṭānnaṃ naiva bhoktavyaṃ śūdrānnaṃ naiva vā kvacit || 223.23 ||
śūdrānnaṃ garhitaṃ devi sadā devairmahātmabhiḥ  |
pitāmahamukhotsṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇamiti me matiḥ  || 223.24 ||
śūdrānnenāvaśeṣeṇa jaṭhare mriyate dvijaḥ  |
āhitāgnistathā yajvā sa śūdragatibhāgbhavet || 223.25 ||
tena śūdrānnaśeṣeṇa brahmasthānādapākṛtaḥ  |
brāhmaṇaḥ śūdratāmeti nāsti tatra vicāraṇā  || 223.26 ||
yasyānnenāvaśeṣeṇa jaṭhare mriyate dvijaḥ  |
tāṃ tāṃ yoniṃ vrajedvipro yasyānnamupajīvati  || 223.27 ||
brāhmaṇatvaṃ sukhaṃ prāpya durlabhaṃ yo'vamanyate  |
abhojyānnāni vāśnāti sa dvijatvātpateta vai  || 223.28 ||
surāpo brahmahā steyī cauro bhagnavrato'śuciḥ  |
svādhyāyavarjitaḥ pāpo lubdho naikṛtikaḥ śaṭhaḥ  || 223.29 ||
avratī vṛṣalībhartā kuṇḍāśī somavikrayī  |
vihīnasevī vipro hi patate brahmayonitaḥ  || 223.30 ||
gurutalpī gurudveṣī gurukutsāratiśca yaḥ  |
brahmadviḍvāpi patati brāhmaṇo brahmayonitaḥ  || 223.31 ||
ebhistu karmabhirdevi śubhairācaritaistathā  |
śūdro brāhmaṇatāṃ gacchedvaiśyaḥ kṣatriyatāṃ vrajet || 223.32 ||
śūdraḥ karmāṇi sarvāṇi yathānyāyaṃ yathāvidhi  |
sarvātithyamupātiṣṭhañśeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ  || 223.33 ||
śuśrūṣāṃ paricaryāṃ yo jyeṣṭhavarṇe prayatnataḥ  |
kuryādavimanāḥ śreṣṭhaḥ satataṃ satpathe sthitaḥ  || 223.34 ||
devadvijātisatkartā sarvātithyakṛtavrataḥ  |
ṛtukālābhigāmī ca niyato niyatāśanaḥ  || 223.35 ||
dakṣaḥ śiṣṭajanānveṣī śeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ  |
vṛthā māṃsaṃ na bhuñjīta śūdro vaiśyatvamṛcchati  || 223.36 ||
ṛtavāganahaṃvādī nirdvaṃdvaḥ sāmakovidaḥ  |
yajate nityayajñaiśca svādhyāyaparamaḥ śuciḥ  || 223.37 ||
dānto brāhmaṇasatkartā sarvavarṇānasūyakaḥ  |
gṛhasthavratamātiṣṭhan dvikālakṛtabhojanaḥ  || 223.38 ||
śeṣāśī vijitāhāro niṣkāmo nirahaṃvadaḥ  |
agnihotramupāsīno juhvānaśca yathāvidhi  || 223.39 ||
sarvātithyamupātiṣṭhañśeṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ  |
tretāgnimātravihitaṃ vaiśyo bhavati ca dvijaḥ  || 223.40 ||
sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyakule śucirmahati jāyate  |
sa vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyo jāto janmaprabhṛti saṃskṛtaḥ  || 223.41 ||
upanīto vrataparo dvijo bhavati saṃskṛtaḥ  |
dadāti yajate yajñaiḥ samṛddhairāptadakṣiṇaiḥ  || 223.42 ||
adhītya svargamanvicchaṃstretāgniśaraṇaḥ sadā  |
ārdrahastaprado nityaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan  || 223.43 ||
satyaḥ satyāni kurute nityaṃ yaḥ śuddhidarśanaḥ  |
dharmadaṇḍena nirdagdho dharmakāmārthasādhakaḥ  || 223.44 ||
yantritaḥ kāryakaraṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhāgakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ  |
grāmyadharmānna seveta svacchandenārthakovidaḥ  || 223.45 ||
ṛtukāle tu dharmātmā patnīmupāśrayetsadā  |
sadopavāsī niyataḥ svādhyāyanirataḥ śuciḥ  || 223.46 ||
vahiskāntarite nityaṃ śayāno'sti sadā gṛhe  |
sarvātithyaṃ trivargasya kurvāṇaḥ sumanāḥ sadā  || 223.47 ||
śūdrāṇāṃ cānnakāmānāṃ nityaṃ siddhamiti bruvan  |
svārthādvā yadi vā kāmānna kiṃcidupalakṣayet || 223.48 ||
pitṛdevātithikṛte sādhanaṃ kurute ca yat |
svaveśmani yathānyāyamupāste bhaikṣyameva ca  || 223.49 ||
dvikālamagnihotraṃ ca juhvāno vai yathāvidhi  |
gobrāhmaṇahitārthāya raṇe cābhimukho hataḥ  || 223.50 ||
tretāgnimantrapūtena samāviśya dvijo bhavet |
jñānavijñānasaṃpannaḥ saṃskṛto vedapāragaḥ  || 223.51 ||
vaiśyo bhavati dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ svena karmaṇā  |
etaiḥ karmaphalairdevi nyūnajātikulodbhavaḥ  || 223.52 ||
śūdro'pyāgamasaṃpanno dvijo bhavati saṃskṛtaḥ  |
brāhmaṇo vāpyasadvṛttaḥ sarvasaṃkarabhojanaḥ  || 223.53 ||
sa brāhmaṇyaṃ samutsṛjya śūdro bhavati tādṛśaḥ  |
karmabhiḥ śucibhirdevī śuddhātmā vijitendriyaḥ  || 223.54 ||
śūdro'pi dvijavatsevya iti brahmābravītsvayam  |
svabhāvakarmaṇā caiva yatra śūdro'dhitiṣṭhati  || 223.55 ||
viśuddhaḥ sa dvijātibhyo vijñeya iti me matiḥ  |
na yonirnāpi saṃskāro na śrutirna ca saṃtatiḥ  || 223.56 ||
kāraṇāni dvijatvasya vṛttameva tu kāraṇam  |
sarvo'yaṃ brāhmaṇo loke vṛttena tu vidhīyate  || 223.57 ||
vṛtte sthitaśca śūdro'pi brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca gacchati  |
brahmasvabhāvaḥ suśroṇi samaḥ sarvatra me mataḥ  || 223.58 ||
nirguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ brahma yatra tiṣṭhati sa dvijaḥ  |
ete ye vimalā devi sthānabhāvanidarśakāḥ  || 223.59 ||
svayaṃ ca varadenoktā brahmaṇā sṛjatā prajāḥ  |
brahmaṇo hi mahatkṣetraṃ loke carati pādavat || 223.60 ||
yattatra bījaṃ patati sā kṛṣiḥ pretya bhāvinī  |
saṃtuṣṭena sadā bhāvyaṃ satpathālambinā sadā  || 223.61 ||
brāhmaṃ hi mārgamākramya vartitavyaṃ bubhūṣatā  |
saṃhitādhyāyinā bhāvyaṃ gṛhe vai gṛhamedhinā  || 223.62 ||
nityaṃ svādhyāyayuktena na cādhyayanajīvinā  |
evaṃbhūto hi yo vipraḥ satataṃ satpathe sthitaḥ  || 223.63 ||
āhitāgniradhīyāno brahmabhūyāya kalpate  |
brāhmaṇyaṃ devi saṃprāpya rakṣitavyaṃ yatātmanā  || 223.64 ||
yonipratigrahādānaiḥ karmabhiśca śucismite  |
etatte guhyamākhyātaṃ yathā śūdro bhaveddvijaḥ  |
brāhmaṇo vā cyuto dharmādyathā śūdratvamāpnuyāt || 223.65 ||
{umovāca̱ }
bhagavan sarvabhūteśa surāsuranamaskṛta  |
dharmādharme nṛṇāṃ deva brūhi me saṃśayaṃ vibho  || 224.1 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā trividhairdehinaḥ sadā  |
badhyante bandhanaiḥ kairvā mucyante vā kathaṃ vada  || 224.2 ||
kena śīlena vai deva karmaṇā kīdṛśena vā  |
samācārairguṇaiḥ kairvā svargaṃ yāntīha mānavāḥ  || 224.3 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
devi dharmārthatattvajñe dharmanitye ume sadā  |
sarvaprāṇihitaḥ praśnaḥ śrūyatāṃ buddhivardhanaḥ  || 224.4 ||
satyadharmaratāḥ śāntāḥ sarvaliṅgavivarjitāḥ  |
nādharmeṇa na dharmeṇa badhyante chinnasaṃśayāḥ  || 224.5 ||
pralayotpattitattvajñāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ  |
vītarāgā vimucyante puruṣāḥ karmabandhanaiḥ  || 224.6 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā ye na hiṃsanti kiṃcana  |
ye na majjanti kasmiṃścitte na badhnanti karmabhiḥ  || 224.7 ||
prāṇātipātādviratāḥ śīlavanto dayānvitāḥ  |
tulyadveṣyapriyā dāntā mucyante karmabandhanaiḥ  || 224.8 ||
sarvabhūtadayāvanto viśvāsyāḥ sarvajantuṣu  |
tyaktahiṃsrasamācārāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.9 ||
parasvanirmamā nityaṃ paradāravivarjikāḥ  |
dharmalabdhārthabhoktāraste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.10 ||
mātṛvatsvasṛvaccaiva nityaṃ duhitṛvacca ye  |
paradāreṣu vartante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.11 ||
svadāraniratā ye ca ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ  |
agrāmyasukhabhogāśca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.12 ||
stainyānnivṛttāḥ satataṃ saṃtuṣṭāḥ svadhanena ca  |
svabhāgyānyupajīvanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.13 ||
paradāreṣu ye nityaṃ cāritrāvṛtalocanāḥ  |
jitendriyāḥ śīlaparāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.14 ||
eṣa daivakṛto mārgaḥ sevitavyaḥ sadā naraiḥ  |
akaṣāyakṛtaścaiva mārgaḥ sevyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ  || 224.15 ||
avṛthāpakṛtaścaiva mārgaḥ sevyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ  |
dānakarmatapoyuktaḥ śīlaśaucadayātmakaḥ  |
svargamārgamabhīpsadbhirna sevyastvata uttaraḥ  || 224.16 ||
{umovāca̱ }
vācā tu badhyate yena mucyate hyathavā punaḥ  |
tāni karmāṇi me deva vada bhūtapate'nagha  || 224.17 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
ātmahetoḥ parārthe vā adharmāśritameva ca  |
ye mṛṣā na vadantīha te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.18 ||
vṛttyarthaṃ dharmahetorvā kāmakārāttathaiva ca  |
anṛtaṃ ye na bhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.19 ||
ślakṣṇāṃ vāṇīṃ svacchavarṇāṃ madhurāṃ pāpavarjitām  |
svagatenābhibhāṣante te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.20 ||
paruṣaṃ ye na bhāṣante kaṭukaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ tathā  |
na paiśunyaratāḥ santaste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.21 ||
piśunaṃ na prabhāṣante mitrabhedakaraṃ tathā  |
parapīḍākaraṃ caiva te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.22 ||
ye varjayanti paruṣaṃ paradrohaṃ ca mānavāḥ  |
sarvabhūtasamā dāntāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.23 ||
śaṭhapralāpādviratā viruddhaparivarjakāḥ  |
saumyapralāpino nityaṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.24 ||
na kopādvyāharante ye vācaṃ hṛdayadāriṇīm  |
śāntiṃ vindanti ye kruddhāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.25 ||
eṣa vāṇīkṛto devi dharmaḥ sevyaḥ sadā naraiḥ  |
śubhasatyaguṇairnityaṃ varjanīyā mṛṣā budhaiḥ  || 224.26 ||
{umovāca̱ }
manasā badhyate yena karmaṇā puruṣaḥ sadā  |
tanme brūhi mahābhāga devadeva pinākadhṛk || 224.27 ||
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
mānaseneha dharmeṇa saṃyuktāḥ puruṣāḥ sadā  |
svargaṃ gacchanti kalyāṇi tanme kīrtayataḥ śṛṇu  || 224.28 ||
duṣpraṇītena manasā duṣpraṇītāntarākṛtiḥ  |
naro badhyeta yeneha śṛṇu vā taṃ śubhānane  || 224.29 ||
araṇye vijane nyastaṃ parasvaṃ dṛśyate yadā  |
manasāpi na gṛhṇanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.30 ||
tathaiva paradārān ye kāmavṛttā rahogatāḥ  |
manasāpi na hiṃsanti te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.31 ||
śatruṃ mitraṃ ca ye nityaṃ tulyena manasā narāḥ  |
bhajanti maitryaṃ saṃgamya te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.32 ||
śrutavanto dayāvantaḥ śucayaḥ satyasaṃgarāḥ  |
svairarthaiḥ parisaṃtuṣṭāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.33 ||
avairā ye tvanāyāsā maitracittaratāḥ sadā  |
sarvabhūtadayāvantaste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.34 ||
jñātavantaḥ kriyāvantaḥ kṣamāvantaḥ suhṛtpriyāḥ  |
dharmādharmavido nityaṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.35 ||
śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ phalasaṃcaye  |
nirākāṅkṣāśca ye devi te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.36 ||
pāpopetān varjayanti devadvijaparāḥ sadā  |
samutthānamanuprāptāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ  || 224.37 ||
śubhaiḥ karmaphalairdevi mayaite parikīrtitāḥ  |
svargamārgaparā bhūyaḥ kiṃ tvaṃ śrotumihecchasi  || 224.38 ||
{umovāca̱ }
mahānme saṃśayaḥ kaścinmartyān prati maheśvara  |
tasmāttvaṃ nipuṇenādya mama vyākhyātumarhasi  || 224.39 ||
kenāyurlabhate dīrghaṃ karmaṇā puruṣaḥ prabho  |
tapasā vāpi deveśa kenāyurlabhate mahat || 224.40 ||
kṣīṇāyuḥ kena bhavati karmaṇā bhuvi mānavaḥ  |
vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ deva vaktumarhasyanindita  || 224.41 ||
apare ca mahābhāgyā mandabhāgyāstathā pare  |
akulīnāḥ kulīnāśca saṃbhavanti tathā pare  || 224.42 ||
durdarśāḥ kecidābhānti narāḥ kāṣṭhamayā iva  |
priyadarśāstathā cānye darśanādeva mānavāḥ  || 224.43 ||
duṣprajñāḥ kecidābhānti kecidābhānti paṇḍitāḥ  |
mahāprajñāstathā cānye jñānavijñānabhāvinaḥ  || 224.44 ||
alpavācāstathā kecinmahāvācāstathā pare  |
dṛśyante puruṣā deva tato vyākhyātumarhasi  || 224.45 ||
{śiva uvāca̱ }
hanta te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi devi karmaphalodayam  |
martyaloke naraḥ sarvo yena svaṃ phalamaśnute  || 224.46 ||
prāṇātipātī yogīndro daṇḍahasto naraḥ sadā  |
nityamudyataśastraśca hanti bhūtagaṇānnaraḥ  || 224.47 ||
nirdayaḥ sarvabhūtebhyo nityamudvegakārakaḥ  |
api kīṭapataṃgānāmaśaraṇyaḥ sunirghṛṇaḥ  || 224.48 ||
evaṃbhūto naro devi nirayaṃ pratipadyate  |
viparītastu dharmātmā svarūpeṇābhijāyate  || 224.49 ||
nirayaṃ yāti hiṃsātmā yāti svargamahiṃsakaḥ  |
yātanāṃ niraye raudrāṃ sakṛcchrāṃ labhate naraḥ  || 224.50 ||
yaḥ kaścinnirayāttasmātsamuttarati karhicit |
mānuṣyaṃ labhate vāpi hīnāyustatra jāyate  || 224.51 ||
pāpena karmaṇā devi yukto hiṃsādibhiryataḥ  |
ahitaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hīnāyurupajāyate  || 224.52 ||
śubhena karmaṇā devi prāṇighātavivarjitaḥ  |
śubhena karmaṇā devi prāṇighātavivarjitaḥ  |
nikṣiptaśastro nirdaṇḍo na hiṃsati kadācana  || 224.53 ||
na ghātayati no hanti ghnantaṃ naivānumodate  |
sarvabhūteṣu sasneho yathātmani tathā pare  || 224.54 ||
īdṛśaḥ puruṣo nityaṃ devi devatvamaśnute  |
upapannān sukhān bhogān sadāśnāti mudā yutaḥ  || 224.55 ||
atha cenmānuṣe loke kadācidupapadyate  |
eṣa dīrghāyuṣāṃ mārgaḥ suvṛttānāṃ sukarmaṇām  |
prāṇihiṃsāvimokṣeṇa brahmaṇā samudīritaḥ  || 224.56 ||
{umovāca̱ }
kiṃśīlaḥ kiṃsamācāraḥ puruṣaḥ kaiśca karmabhiḥ  |
svargaṃ samabhipadyeta saṃpradānena kena vā  || 225.1 ||
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
dātā brāhmaṇasatkartā dīnārtakṛpaṇādiṣu  |
bhakṣabhojyānnapānānāṃ vāsasāṃ ca mahāmatiḥ  || 225.2 ||
pratiśrayān sabhāḥ kuryātprapāḥ puṣkariṇīstathā  |
nityakādīni karmāṇi karoti prayataḥ śuciḥ  || 225.3 ||
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ gṛhaṃ ratnaṃ dhanaṃ tathā  |
sasyajātāni sarvāṇi sakṣetrāṇyatha yoṣitaḥ  || 225.4 ||
supraśāntamanā nityaṃ yaḥ prayacchati mānavaḥ  |
evaṃbhūto naro devi devaloke'bhijāyate  || 225.5 ||
tatroṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān  |
sahāpsarobhirmudito ramitvā nandanādiṣu  || 225.6 ||
tasmāccyuto maheśāni mānuṣeṣūpajāyate  |
mahābhāgakule devi dhanadhānyasamācite  || 225.7 ||
tatra kāmaguṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samupeto mudānvitaḥ  |
mahākāryo mahābhogo dhanī bhavati mānavaḥ  || 225.8 ||
ete devi mahābhāgāḥ prāṇino dānaśālinaḥ  |
brahmaṇā vai purā proktāḥ sarvasya priyadarśanāḥ  || 225.9 ||
apare mānavā devi pradānakṛpaṇā dvijāḥ  |
ye'nnāni na prayacchanti vidyamāne'pyabuddhayaḥ  || 225.10 ||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇān dṛṣṭvā bhikṣukānatithīnapi  |
yācyamānā nivartante jihvālobhasamanvitāḥ  || 225.11 ||
na dhanāni na vāsāṃsi na bhogānna ca kāñcanam  |
na gāśca nānnavikṛtiṃ prayacchanti kadācana  || 225.12 ||
apralubdhāśca ye lubdhā nāstikā dānavarjitaḥ  |
evaṃbhūtā narā devi nirayaṃ yāntyabuddhayaḥ  || 225.13 ||
te vai manuṣyatāṃ yānti yadā kālasya paryayāt |
dhanarikte kule janma labhante svalpabuddhayaḥ  || 225.14 ||
kṣutpipāsāparītāśca sarvalokabahiṣkṛtāḥ  |
nirāśāḥ sarvabhogebhyo jīvantyadharmajīvikāḥ  || 225.15 ||
alpabhogakule jātā alpabhogaratā narāḥ  |
anena karmaṇā devi bhavantyadhanino narāḥ  || 225.16 ||
apare dambhino nityaṃ māninaḥ parato ratāḥ  |
āsanārhasya ye pīṭhaṃ na yacchantyalpacetasaḥ  || 225.17 ||
mārgārhasya ca ye mārgaṃ na prayacchantyabuddhayaḥ  |
arghārhānna ca saṃskārairarcayanti yathāvidhi  || 225.18 ||
pādyamācamanīyaṃ vā prayacchantyabhibuddhayaḥ  |
śubhaṃ cābhimataṃ premṇā guruṃ nābhivadanti ye  || 225.19 ||
abhimānapravṛddhena lobhena samamāsthitāḥ  |
saṃmānyāṃścāvamanyante vṛddhān paribhavanti ca  || 225.20 ||
evaṃvidhā narā devi sarve nirayagāminaḥ  |
te cedyadi narāstasmānnirayāduttaranti ca  || 225.21 ||
varṣapūgaistato janma labhante kutsite kule  |
śvapākapulkasādīnāṃ kutsitānāmacetasām  || 225.22 ||
kuleṣu te'bhijāyante guruvṛddhopatāpinaḥ  |
na dambhī na ca mānī yo devatātithipūjakaḥ  || 225.23 ||
lokapūjyo namaskartā prasūto madhuraṃ vacaḥ  |
sarvakarmapriyakaraḥ sarvabhūtapriyaḥ sadā  || 225.24 ||
adveṣī sumukhaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdhavāṇīpradaḥ sadā  |
svāgatenaiva sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ  || 225.25 ||
yathārthaṃ satkriyāpūrvamarcayannavatiṣṭhate  |
mārgārhāya dadanmārgaṃ gurumabhyarcayan sadā  || 225.26 ||
atithipragraharatastathābhyāgatapūjakaḥ  |
evaṃbhūto naro devi svargatiṃ pratipadyate  || 225.27 ||
tato mānuṣyamāsādya viśiṣṭakulajo bhavet |
tatrāsau vipulairbhogaiḥ sarvaratnasamāyutaḥ  || 225.28 ||
yathārhadātā cārheṣu dharmacaryāparo bhavet |
saṃmataḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ  || 225.29 ||
svakarmaphalamāpnoti svayameva naraḥ sadā  |
eṣa dharmo mayā prokto vidhātrā svayamīritaḥ  || 225.30 ||
yastu raudrasamācāraḥ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaraḥ  |
hastābhyāṃ yadi vā padbhyāṃ rajjvā daṇḍena vā punaḥ  || 225.31 ||
loṣṭaiḥ stambhairupāyairvā jantūn bādheta śobhane  |
hiṃsārthaṃ niṣkṛtiprajñaḥ prodvejayati caiva hi  || 225.32 ||
upakrāmati jantūṃśca udvegajananaḥ sadā  |
evaṃ śīlasamācāro nirayaṃ pratipadyate  || 225.33 ||
sa cenmanuṣyatāṃ gacchedyadi kālasya paryayāt |
bahvābādhāparikliṣṭe kule jayati so'dhame  || 225.34 ||
lokadviṣṭo'dhamaḥ puṃsāṃ svayaṃ karmakṛtaiḥ phalaiḥ  |
eṣa devi manuṣyeṣu boddhavyo jñātibandhuṣu  || 225.35 ||
aparaḥ sarvabhūtāni dayāvānanupaśyati  |
maitrī dṛṣṭiḥ pitṛsamo nirvairo niyatendriyaḥ  || 225.36 ||
nodvejayati bhūtāni na ca hanti dayāparaḥ  |
hastapādaiśca niyatairviśvāsyaḥ sarvajantuṣu  || 225.37 ||
na rajjvā na ca daṇḍena na loṣṭairnāyudhena ca  |
udvejayati bhūtāni śubhakarmā dayāparaḥ  || 225.38 ||
evaṃ śīlasamācāraḥ svarge samupajāyate  |
tatrāsau bhavane divye mudā vasati devavat || 225.39 ||
sa cetsvargakṣayānmartyo manuṣyeṣūpajāyate  |
alpāyāso nirātaṅkaḥ sa jātaḥ sukhamedhate  || 225.40 ||
sukhabhāgī nirāyāso nirudvegaḥ sadā naraḥ  |
eṣa devi satāṃ mārgo bādhā yatra na vidyate  || 225.41 ||
{umovāca̱ }
ime manuṣyā dṛśyante ūhāpohaviśāradāḥ  |
jñānavijñānasaṃpannāḥ prajñāvanto'rthakovidāḥ  || 225.42 ||
duṣprajñāścāpare deva jñānavijñānavarjitāḥ  |
kena karmavipākena prajñāvān puruṣo bhavet || 225.43 ||
alpaprajño virūpākṣa kathaṃ bhavati mānavaḥ  |
evaṃ tvaṃ saṃśayaṃ chindhi sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara  || 225.44 ||
jātyandhāścāpare deva rogārtāścāpare tathā  |
narāḥ klībāśca dṛśyante kāraṇaṃ brūhi tatra vai  || 225.45 ||
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
brāhmaṇān vedaviduṣaḥ siddhān dharmavidastathā  |
paripṛcchantyaharahaḥ kuśalākuśalaṃ sadā  || 225.46 ||
varjayanto'śubhaṃ karma sevamānāḥ śubhaṃ tathā  |
labhante svargatiṃ nityamiha loke yathāsukham  || 225.47 ||
sa cenmanuṣyatāṃ yāti medhāvī tatra jāyate  |
śrutaṃ yajñānugaṃ yasya kalyāṇamupajāyate  || 225.48 ||
paradāreṣu ye cāpi cakṣurduṣṭaṃ prayuñjate  |
tena duṣṭasvabhāvena jātyandhāste bhavanti hi  || 225.49 ||
manasāpi praduṣṭena nagnāṃ paśyanti ye striyam  |
rogārtāste bhavantīha narā duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ  || 225.50 ||
ye tu mūḍhā durācārā viyonau maithune ratāḥ  |
puruṣeṣu suduṣprajñāḥ klībatvamupayānti te  || 225.51 ||
paśūṃśca ye vai badhnanti ye caiva gurutalpagāḥ  |
prakīrṇamaithunā ye ca klībā jāyanti vai narāḥ  || 225.52 ||
{umovāca̱ }
avadyaṃ kiṃ tu vai karma niravadyaṃ tathaiva ca  |
śreyaḥ kurvannavāpnoti mānavo devasattama  || 225.53 ||
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
śreyāṃsaṃ mārgamanvicchan sadā yaḥ pṛcchati dvijān  |
dharmānveṣī guṇākāṅkṣī sa svargaṃ samupāśnute  || 225.54 ||
yadi mānuṣyatāṃ devi kadācitsaṃniyacchati  |
medhāvī dhāraṇāyuktaḥ prājñastatrāpi jāyate  || 225.55 ||
eṣa devi satāṃ dharmo gantavyo bhūtikārakaḥ  |
nṛṇāṃ hitārthāya sadā mayā caivamudāhṛtaḥ  || 225.56 ||
{umovāca̱ }
apare svalpavijñānā dharmavidveṣiṇo narāḥ  |
brāhmaṇān vedaviduṣo necchanti parisarpitum  || 225.57 ||
vratavanto narāḥ kecicchraddhādamaparāyaṇāḥ  |
avratā bhraṣṭaniyamāstathānye rākṣasopamāḥ  || 225.58 ||
yajvānaśca tathaivānye nirmohāśca tathā pare  |
kena karmavipākena bhavantīha vadasva me  || 225.59 ||
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
āgamālokadharmāṇāṃ maryādāḥ pūrvanirmitāḥ  |
pramāṇenānuvartante dṛśyante ha dṛḍhavratāḥ  || 225.60 ||
adharmaṃ dharmamityāhurye ca mohavaśaṃ gatāḥ  |
avratā naṣṭamaryādāste narā brahmarākṣasāḥ  || 225.61 ||
ye vai kālakṛtodyogātsaṃbhavantīha mānavāḥ  |
nirhomā nirvaṣaṭkārāste bhavanti narādhamāḥ  || 225.62 ||
eṣa devi mayā sarva saṃśayacchedanāya te  |
kuśalākuśalo nṝṇāṃ vyākhyāto dharmasāgaraḥ  || 225.63 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śrutvaivaṃ sā jaganmātā bharturvacanamāditaḥ  |
hṛṣṭā babhūva suprītā vismitā ca tadā dvijāḥ  || 226.1 ||
ye tatrāsanmunivarāstripurāreḥ samīpataḥ  |
tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena gatāstasmin girau dvijāḥ  || 226.2 ||
te'pi saṃpūjya taṃ devaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ praṇamya ca  |
papracchuḥ saṃśayaṃ caiva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 226.3 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
trilocana namaste'stu dakṣakratuvināśana  |
pṛcchāmastvāṃ jagannātha saṃśayaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam  || 226.4 ||
saṃsāre'sminmahāghore bhairave lomaharṣaṇe  |
bhramanti suciraṃ kālaṃ puruṣāścālpamedhasaḥ  || 226.5 ||
yenopāyena mucyante janmasaṃsārabandhanāt |
brūhi tacchrotumicchāmaḥ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 226.6 ||
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
karmapāśanibaddhānāṃ narāṇāṃ duḥkhabhāginām  |
nānyopāyaṃ prapaśyāmi vāsudevātparaṃ dvijāḥ  || 226.7 ||
ye pūjayanti taṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam  |
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥ samyakte yānti paramāṃ gatim  || 226.8 ||
kiṃ teṣāṃ jīviteneha paśuvacceṣṭitena ca  |
yeṣāṃ na pravaṇaṃ cittaṃ vāsudeve jaganmaye  || 226.9 ||
{ṛṣaya ūcu̱ḥ }
pinākin bhaganetraghna sarvalokanamaskṛta  |
māhātmyaṃ vāsudevasya śrotumicchāma śaṃkara  || 226.10 ||
{maheśvara uvāca̱ }
pitāmahādapi varaḥ śāśvataḥ puruṣo hariḥ  |
kṛṣṇo jāmbūnadābhāso vyabhre sūrya ivoditaḥ  || 226.11 ||
daśabāhurmahātejā devatāriniṣūdanaḥ  |
śrīvatsāṅko hṛṣīkeśaḥ sarvadaivatayūthapaḥ  || 226.12 ||
brahmā tasyodarabhavastasyāhaṃ ca śirobhavaḥ  |
śiroruhebhyo jyotīṃṣi romabhyaśca surāsurāḥ  || 226.13 ||
ṛṣayo dehasaṃbhūtāstasya lokāśca śāśvatāḥ  |
pitāmahagṛhaṃ sākṣātsarvadevagṛhaṃ ca saḥ  || 226.14 ||
so'syāḥ pṛthivyāḥ kṛtsnāyāḥ sraṣṭā tribhuvaneśvaraḥ  |
saṃhartā caiva bhūtānāṃ sthāvarasya carasya ca  || 226.15 ||
sa hi devadevaḥ sākṣāddevanāthaḥ paraṃtapaḥ  |
sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃsraṣṭā sarvagaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ  || 226.16 ||
na tasmātparamaṃ bhūtaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiṃcana  |
sanātano mahābhāgo govinda iti viśrutaḥ  || 226.17 ||
sa sarvān pārthivān saṃkhye ghātayiṣyati mānadaḥ  |
surakāryārthamutpanno mānuṣyaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ  || 226.18 ||
nahi devagaṇāḥ śaktāstrivikramavinākṛtāḥ  |
bhuvane devakāryāṇi kartuṃ nāyakavarjitaḥ  || 226.19 ||
nāyakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtaḥ  |
etasya devanāthasya kāryasya ca parasya ca  || 226.20 ||
brahmabhūtasya satataṃ brahmarṣiśaraṇasya ca  |
brahmā vasati nābhisthaḥ śarīre'haṃ ca saṃsthitaḥ  || 226.21 ||
sarvāḥ sukhaṃ saṃsthitāśca śarīre tasya devatāḥ  |
sa devaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śrīgarbhaḥ śrīsahoṣitaḥ  || 226.22 ||
śārṅgacakrāyudhaḥ khaḍgī sarvanāgaripudhvajaḥ  |
uttamena suśīlena śaucena ca damena ca  || 226.23 ||
parākrameṇa vīryeṇa vapuṣā darśanena ca  |
ārohaṇapramāṇena vīryeṇārjavasaṃpadā  || 226.24 ||
ānṛśaṃsyena rūpeṇa balena ca samanvitaḥ  |
astraiḥ samuditaḥ sarvairdivyairadbhutadarśanaiḥ  || 226.25 ||
yogamāyāsahasrākṣo virūpākṣo mahāmanāḥ  |
vācā mitrajanaślāghī jñātibandhujanapriyaḥ  || 226.26 ||
kṣamāvāṃścānahaṃvādī sa devo brahmadāyakaḥ  |
bhayahartā bhayārtānāṃ mitrānandavivardhanaḥ  || 226.27 ||
śaraṇyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dīnānāṃ pālane rataḥ  |
śrutavānatha saṃpannaḥ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtaḥ  || 226.28 ||
samāśritānāmupakṛcchatrūṇāṃ bhayakṛttathā  |
nītijño nītisaṃpanno brahmavādī jitendriyaḥ  || 226.29 ||
bhavārthameva devānāṃ buddhyā paramayā yutaḥ  |
prājāpatye śubhe mārge mānave dharmasaṃskṛte  || 226.30 ||
samutpatsyati govindo manorvaṃśe mahātmanaḥ  |
aṃśo nāma manoḥ putro hyantardhāmā tataḥ param  || 226.31 ||
antardhāmno havirdhāmā prajāpatiraninditaḥ  |
prācīnabarhirbhavitā havirdhāmnaḥ suto dvijāḥ  || 226.32 ||
tasya pracetaḥpramukhā bhaviṣyanti daśātmajāḥ  |
prācetasastathā dakṣo bhaviteha prajāpatiḥ  || 226.33 ||
dākṣāyaṇyastathādityo manurādityatastataḥ  |
manośca vaṃśaja ilā sudyumnaśca bhaviṣyati  || 226.34 ||
budhātpurūravāścāpi tasmādāyurbhaviṣyati  |
nahuṣo bhavitā tasmādyayātistasya cātmajaḥ  || 226.35 ||
yadustasmānmahāsattvaḥ kroṣṭā tasmādbhaviṣyati  |
kroṣṭuścaiva mahān putro vṛjinīvān bhaviṣyati  || 226.36 ||
vṛjinīvataśca bhavitā uṣaṅguraparājitaḥ  |
uṣaṅgorbhavitā putraḥ śūraścitrarathastathā  || 226.37 ||
tasya tvavarajaḥ putraḥ śūro nāma bhaviṣyati  |
teṣāṃ vikhyātavīryāṇāṃ cāritraguṇaśālinām  || 226.38 ||
yajvināṃ ca viśuddhānāṃ vaṃśe brāhmaṇasattamāḥ  |
sa śūraḥ kṣatriyaśreṣṭho mahāvīryo mahāyaśāḥ  || 226.39 ||
svavaṃśavistārakaraṃ janayiṣyati mānadam  |
vasudevamiti khyātaṃ putramānakadundubhim  || 226.40 ||
tasya putraścaturbāhurvāsudevo bhaviṣyati  |
dātā brāhmaṇasatkartā brahmabhūto dvijapriyaḥ  || 226.41 ||
rājño baddhān sa sarvān vai mokṣayiṣyati yādavaḥ  |
jarāsaṃdhaṃ tu rājānaṃ nirjitya girigahvare  || 226.42 ||
sarvapārthivaratnāḍhyo bhaviṣyati sa vīryavān  |
pṛthivyāmapratihato vīryeṇāpi bhaviṣyati  || 226.43 ||
vikrameṇa ca saṃpannaḥ sarvapārthivapārthivaḥ  |
śūraḥ saṃhanano bhūto dvārakāyāṃ vasan prabhuḥ  || 226.44 ||
pālayiṣyati gāṃ devīṃ vinirjitya durāśayān  |
taṃ bhavantaḥ samāsādya brāhmaṇairarhaṇairvaraiḥ  || 226.45 ||
arcayantu yathānyāyaṃ brahmāṇamiva śāśvatam  |
yo hi māṃ draṣṭumiccheta brahmāṇaṃ ca pitāmaham  || 226.46 ||
draṣṭavyastena bhagavān vāsudevaḥ pratāpavān  |
dṛṣṭe tasminnahaṃ dṛṣṭo na me'trāsti vicāraṇā  || 226.47 ||
pitāmaho vāsudeva iti vitta tapodhanāḥ  |
sa yasya puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ prītiyukto bhaviṣyati  || 226.48 ||
tasya devagaṇaḥ prīto brahmapūrvo bhaviṣyati  |
yastu taṃ mānavo loke saṃśrayiṣyati keśavam  || 226.49 ||
tasya kīrtiryaśaścaiva svargaścaiva bhaviṣyati  |
dharmāṇāṃ deśikaḥ sākṣādbhaviṣyati sa dharmavān  || 226.50 ||
dharmavidbhiḥ sa deveśo namaskāryaḥ sadācyutaḥ  |
dharma eva sadā hi syādasminnabhyarcite vibhau  || 226.51 ||
sa hi devo mahātejāḥ prajāhitacikīrṣayā  |
dharmārthaṃ puruṣavyāghra ṛṣikoṭīḥ sasarja ca  || 226.52 ||
tāḥ sṛṣṭāstena vidhinā parvate gandhamādane  |
sanatkumārapramukhāstiṣṭhanti tapasānvitāḥ  || 226.53 ||
tasmātsa vāgmī dharmajño namasyo dvijapuṃgavāḥ  |
vandito hi sa vandeta mānito mānayīta ca  || 226.54 ||
dṛṣṭaḥ paśyedaharahaḥ saṃśritaḥ pratisaṃśrayet |
arcitaścārcayennityaṃ sa devo dvijasattamāḥ  || 226.55 ||
evaṃ tasyānavadyasya viṣṇorvai paramaṃ tapaḥ  |
ādidevasya mahataḥ sajjanācaritaṃ sadā  || 226.56 ||
bhuvane'bhyarcito nityaṃ devairapi sanātanaḥ  |
abhayenānurūpeṇa prapadya tamanuvratāḥ  || 226.57 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā sa namasyo dvijaiḥ sadā  |
yatnavadbhirupasthāya draṣṭavyo devakīsutaḥ  || 226.58 ||
eṣa vai vihito mārgo mayā vai munisattamāḥ  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvadeveśaṃ dṛṣṭāḥ syuḥ surasattamāḥ  || 226.59 ||
mahāvarāhaṃ taṃ devaṃ sarvalokapitāmaham  |
ahaṃ caiva namasyāmi nityameva jagatpatim  || 226.60 ||
tatra ca tritayaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ  |
samastā hi vayaṃ devāstasya dehe vasāmahe  || 226.61 ||
tasyaiva cāgrajo bhrātā sitādrinicayaprabhaḥ  |
halī bala iti khyāto bhaviṣyati dharādharaḥ  || 226.62 ||
triśirāstasya devasya dṛṣṭo'nanta iti prabhoḥ  |
suparṇo yasya vīryeṇa kaśyapasyātmajo balī  || 226.63 ||
antaṃ naivāśakaddraṣṭuṃ devasya paramātmanaḥ  |
sa ca śeṣo vicarate parayā vai mudā yutaḥ  || 226.64 ||
antarvasati bhogena parirabhya vasuṃdharām  |
ya eṣa viṣṇuḥ so'nanto bhagavān vasudhādharaḥ  || 226.65 ||
yo rāmaḥ sa hṛṣīkeśo'cyutaḥ sarvadharādharaḥ  |
tāvubhau puruṣavyāghrau divyau divyaparākramau  || 226.66 ||
draṣṭavyau mānanīyau ca cakralāṅgaladhāriṇau  |
eṣa vo'nugrahaḥ prokto mayā puṇyastapodhanāḥ  |
tadbhavanto yaduśreṣṭhaṃ pūjayeyuḥ prayatnataḥ  || 226.67 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
aho kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ śrutamasmābhiradbhutam  |
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ dhanyaṃ saṃsāranāśanam  || 227.1 ||
saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā vāsudevaṃ mahāmune  |
kāṃ gatiṃ yānti manujā vāsudevārcane ratāḥ  || 227.2 ||
kiṃ prāpnuvanti te mokṣaṃ kiṃ vā svargaṃ mahāmune  |
athavā kiṃ muniśreṣṭha prāpnuvantyubhayaṃ phalam  || 227.3 ||
chettumarhasi sarvajña saṃśayaṃ no hṛdi sthitam  |
chettā nānyo'sti loke'smiṃstvadṛte munisattama  || 227.4 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sādhu sādhu muniśreṣṭhā bhavadbhiryadudāhṛtam  |
śṛṇudhvamānupūrvyeṇa vaiṣṇavānāṃ sukhāvaham  || 227.5 ||
dīkṣāmātreṇa kṛṣṇasya narā mokṣaṃ vrajanti vai  |
kiṃ punarye sadā bhaktyā pūjayantyacyutaṃ dvijāḥ  || 227.6 ||
na teṣāṃ durlabhaḥ svargo mokṣaśca munisattamāḥ  |
labhante vaiṣṇavāḥ kāmān yān yān vāñchanti durlabhān  || 227.7 ||
ratnaparvatamāruhya naro ratnaṃ yathādadet |
svecchayā muniśārdūlāstathā kṛṣṇānmanorathān  || 227.8 ||
kalpavṛkṣaṃ samāsādya phalāni svecchayā yathā  |
gṛhṇāti puruṣo viprāstathā kṛṣṇānmanorathān  || 227.9 ||
śraddhayā vidhivatpūjya vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum  |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prāpnuvanti narāḥ phalam  || 227.10 ||
ārādhya taṃ jagannāthaṃ viśuddhenāntarātmanā  |
prāpnuvanti narāḥ kāmān surāṇāmapi durlabhān  || 227.11 ||
ye'rcayanti sadā bhaktyā vāsudevākhyamavyayam  |
na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcidvidyate bhuvanatraye  || 227.12 ||
dhanyāste puruṣā loke ye'rcayanti sadā harim  |
sarvapāpaharaṃ devaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam  || 227.13 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāntyajātayaḥ  |
saṃpūjya taṃ suravaraṃ prāpnuvanti parāṃ gatim  || 227.14 ||
tasmācchṛṇudhvaṃ munayo yatpṛcchata mamānaghāḥ  |
pravakṣyāmi samāsena gatiṃ teṣāṃ mahātmanām  || 227.15 ||
tyaktvā mānuṣyakaṃ dehaṃ rogāyatanamadhruvam  |
jarāmaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ jalabudbudasaṃnibham  || 227.16 ||
māṃsaśoṇitadurgandhaṃ viṣṭhāmūtrādibhiryutam  |
asthisthūṇamamedhyaṃ ca snāyucarmaśirānvitam  || 227.17 ||
kāmagena vimānena divyagandharvanādinā  |
taruṇādityavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā  || 227.18 ||
upagīyamānā gandharvairapsarobhiralaṃkṛtāḥ  |
vrajanti lokapālānāṃ bhavanaṃ tu pṛthakpṛthak || 227.19 ||
manvantarapramāṇaṃ tu bhuktvā kālaṃ pṛthakpṛthak |
bhuvanāni pṛthakteṣāṃ sarvabhogairalaṃkṛtāḥ  || 227.20 ||
tato'ntarikṣaṃ lokaṃ te yānti sarvasukhapradam  |
tatra bhuktvā varān bhogān daśamanvantaraṃ dvijāḥ  || 227.21 ||
tasmādgandharvalokaṃ tu yānti vai vaiṣṇavā dvijāḥ  |
viṃśanmanvantaraṃ kālaṃ tatra bhuktvā manoramān  || 227.22 ||
bhogānādityalokaṃ tu tasmādyānti supūjitāḥ  |
triṃśanmanvantaraṃ tatra bhogān bhuktvātidaivatān  || 227.23 ||
tasmādvrajanti te viprāścandralokaṃ sukhapradam  |
manvantarāṇāṃ te tatra catvāriṃśadguṇānvitam  || 227.24 ||
kālaṃ bhuktvā śubhān bhogāñjarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ  |
tasmānnakṣatralokaṃ tu vimānaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam  || 227.25 ||
vrajanti te muniśreṣṭhā guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṃkṛtāḥ  |
manvantarāṇāṃ pañcāśadbhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān  || 227.26 ||
tasmādvrajanti te viprā devalokaṃ sudurlabham  |
ṣaṣṭimanvantaraṃ yāvattatra bhuktvā sudurlabhān  || 227.27 ||
bhogānnānāvidhān viprā ṛgdvyaṣṭakasamanvitān  |
śakralokaṃ punastasmādgacchanti surapūjitāḥ  || 227.28 ||
manvantarāṇāṃ tatraiva bhuktvā kālaṃ ca saptatim  |
bhogānuccāvacān divyānmanasaḥ prītivardhanān  || 227.29 ||
tasmādvrajanti te lokaṃ prājāpatyamanuttamam  |
bhuktvā tatrepsitān bhogān sarvakāmaguṇānvitān  || 227.30 ||
manvantaramaśītiṃ ca kālaṃ sarvasukhapradam  |
tasmātpaitāmahaṃ lokaṃ yānti te vaiṣṇavā dvijāḥ  || 227.31 ||
manvantarāṇāṃ navati krīḍitvā tatra vai sukham  |
ihāgatya punastasmādviprāṇāṃ pravare kule  || 227.32 ||
jāyante yogino viprā vedaśāstrārthapāragāḥ  |
evaṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān  || 227.33 ||
ihāgatya punaryānti uparyupari ca kramāt |
saṃbhave saṃbhave te tu śatavarṣaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 227.34 ||
bhuktvā yathepsitān bhogān yānti lokāntaraṃ tataḥ  |
daśajanma yadā teṣāṃ krameṇaivaṃ prapūryate  || 227.35 ||
tadā lokaṃ harerdivyaṃ brahmalokādvrajanti te  |
gatvā tatrākṣayān bhogān bhuktvā sarvaguṇānvitān  || 227.36 ||
manvantaraśataṃ yāvajjanmamṛtyuvivarjitāḥ  |
gacchanti bhuvanaṃ paścādvārāhasya dvijottamāḥ  || 227.37 ||
divyadehāḥ kuṇḍalino mahākāyā mahābalāḥ  |
krīḍanti tatra viprendrāḥ kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam  || 227.38 ||
daśa koṭisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ dvijasattamāḥ  |
tiṣṭhanti śāśvate bhāve sarvairdevairnamaskṛtāḥ  || 227.39 ||
tato yānti tu te dhīrā narasiṃhagṛhaṃ dvijāḥ  |
krīḍante tatra muditā varṣakoṭyayutāni ca  || 227.40 ||
tadante vaiṣṇavaṃ yānti puraṃ siddhaniṣevitam  |
krīḍante tatra saukhyena varṣāṇāmayutāni ca  || 227.41 ||
brahmaloke punarviprā gacchanti sādhakottamāḥ  |
tatra sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ varṣakoṭiśatān bahūn  || 227.42 ||
nārāyaṇapuraṃ yānti tataste sādhakeśvarāḥ  |
bhuktvā bhogāṃśca vividhān varṣakoṭyarbudāni ca  || 227.43 ||
aniruddhapuraṃ paścāddivyarūpā mahābalāḥ  |
gacchanti sādhakavarāḥ stūyamānāḥ surāsuraiḥ  || 227.44 ||
tatra koṭisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ ca caturdaśa  |
tiṣṭhanti vaiṣṇavāstatra jarāmaraṇavarjitāḥ  || 227.45 ||
pradyumnasya puraṃ paścādgacchanti vigatajvarāḥ  |
tatra tiṣṭhanti te viprā lakṣakoṭiśatatrayam  || 227.46 ||
svacchandagāmino hṛṣṭā balaśaktisamanvitāḥ  |
gacchanti yoginaḥ paścādyatra saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ  || 227.47 ||
tatroṣitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ bhuktvā bhogān sahasraśaḥ  |
viśanti vāsudevaiti virūpākhye nirañjane  || 227.48 ||
vinirmuktāḥ pare tattve jarāmaraṇavarjite  |
tatra gatvā vimuktāste bhaveyurnātra saṃśayaḥ  || 227.49 ||
evaṃ krameṇa bhuktiṃ te prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ  |
muktiṃ ca muniśārdūlā vāsudevārcane ratāḥ  || 227.50 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ekādaśyāmubhe pakṣe nirāhāraḥ samāhitaḥ  |
snātvā samyagvidhānena dhautavāsā jitendriyaḥ  || 228.1 ||
saṃpūjya vidhivadviṣṇuṃ śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ  |
puṣpairgandhaistathā dīpairdhūpairnaivedyakaistathā  || 228.2 ||
upahārairbahuvidhairjapyairhomapradakṣiṇaiḥ  |
stotrairnānāvidhairdivyairgītavādyairmanoharaiḥ  || 228.3 ||
daṇḍavatpraṇipātaiśca jayaśabdaistathottamaiḥ  |
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadrātrau kṛtvā prajāgaram  || 228.4 ||
kathāṃ vā gītikāṃ viṣṇorgāyan viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ  |
yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ naro nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ  || 228.5 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
prajāgare gītikāyāḥ phalaṃ viṣṇormahāmune  |
brūhi tacchrotumicchāmaḥ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 228.6 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ  |
gītikāyāḥ phalaṃ viṣṇorjāgare yadudāhṛtam  || 228.7 ||
avantī nāma nagarī babhūva bhuvi viśrutā  |
tatrāste bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ  || 228.8 ||
tasyā nagaryāḥ paryante cāṇḍālo gītikovidaḥ  |
sadvṛttyotpāditadhano bhṛtyānāṃ bharaṇe rataḥ  || 228.9 ||
viṣṇubhaktaḥ sa cāṇḍālo māsi māsi dṛḍhavrataḥ  |
ekādaśyāṃ samāgamya sopavāso'tha gāyati  || 228.10 ||
gītikā viṣṇunāmāṅkāḥ prādurbhāvasamāśritāḥ  |
gāndhāraṣaḍjanaiṣāda svarapañcamadhaivataiḥ  || 228.11 ||
rātrijāgaraṇe viṣṇuṃ gāthābhirupagāyati  |
prabhāte ca praṇamyeśaṃ dvādaśyāṃ gṛhametya ca  || 228.12 ||
jāmātṛbhāgineyāṃśca bhojayitvā sakanyakāḥ  |
tataḥ saparivārastu paścādbhuṅkte dvijottamāḥ  || 228.13 ||
evaṃ tasyāsatastatra kurvato viṣṇuprīṇanam  |
gītikābhirvicitrābhirvayaḥ pratigataṃ bahu  || 228.14 ||
ekadā caitramāse tu kṛṣṇaikādaśigocare  |
viṣṇuśuśrūṣaṇārthāya yayau vanamanuttamam  || 228.15 ||
vanajātāni puṣpāṇi grahītuṃ bhaktitatparaḥ  |
kṣiprātaṭe mahāraṇye vibhītakataroradhaḥ  || 228.16 ||
dṛṣṭaḥ sa rākṣasenātha gṛhītaścāpi bhakṣitum  |
cāṇḍālastamathovāca nādya bhakṣyastvayā hyaham  || 228.17 ||
prātarbhokṣyasi kalyāṇa satyameṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ  |
adya kāryaṃ mama mahattasmānmuñcasva rākṣasa  || 228.18 ||
śvaḥ satyena sameṣyāmi tataḥ khādasi māmiti  |
viṣṇuśuśrūṣaṇārthāya rātrijāgaraṇaṃ mayā  |
kāryaṃ na vratavighnaṃ me kartumarhasi rākṣasa  || 228.19 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
taṃ rākṣasaḥ pratyuvāca daśarātramabhojanam  |
mamābhūdadya ca bhavānmayā labdho mataṅgaja  || 228.20 ||
na mokṣye bhakṣayiṣyāmi kṣudhayā pīḍito bhṛśam  |
niśācaravacaḥ śrutvā mātaṅgastamuvāca ha  |
sāntvayañślakṣṇayā vācā sa satyavacanairdṛḍhaiḥ  || 228.21 ||
{mātaṅga uvāca̱ }
satyamūlaṃ jagatsarvaṃ brahmarākṣasa tacchṛṇu  |
satyenāhaṃ śapiṣyāmi punarāgamanāya ca  || 228.22 ||
ādityaścandramā vahnirvāyurbhūrdyaurjalaṃ manaḥ  |
ahorātraṃ yamaḥ saṃdhye dve vidurnaraceṣṭitam  || 228.23 ||
paradāreṣu yatpāpaṃ yatparadravyahāriṣu  |
yacca brahmahanaḥ pāpaṃ surāpe gurutalpage  || 228.24 ||
vandhyāpateśca yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ vṛṣalīpateḥ  |
yacca devalake pāpaṃ matsyamāṃsāśinaśca yat || 228.25 ||
kroḍamāṃsāśino yacca kūrmamāṃsāśinaśca yat |
vṛthā māṃsāśino yacca pṛṣṭhamāṃsāśinaśca yat || 228.26 ||
kṛtaghne mitraghātake yatpāpaṃ didhiṣūpatau  |
sūtakasya ca yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ krūrakarmaṇaḥ  || 228.27 ||
kṛpaṇasya ca yatpāpaṃ yacca vandhyātitherapi  |
amāvāsyāṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī kṛṣṇaśuklacaturdaśī  || 228.28 ||
tāsu yadgamanātpāpaṃ yadvipro vrajati striyam  |
rajasvalāṃ tathā paścācchrāddhaṃ kṛtvā striyaṃ vrajet || 228.29 ||
sarvasvasnātabhojyānāṃ yatpāpaṃ malabhojane  |
mitrabhāryāṃ gacchatāṃ ca yatpāpaṃ piśunasya ca  || 228.30 ||
dambhamāyānurakte ca yatpāpaṃ madhughātinaḥ  |
brāhmaṇasya pratiśrutya yatpāpaṃ tadayacchataḥ  || 228.31 ||
yacca kanyānṛte pāpaṃ yacca gośvatarānṛte  |
strībālahanturyatpāpaṃ yacca mithyābhibhāṣiṇaḥ  || 228.32 ||
devavedadvijanṛpa putramitrasatīstriyaḥ  |
yacca nindayatāṃ pāpaṃ gurumithyāpacārataḥ  || 228.33 ||
agnityāgiṣu yatpāpamagnidāyiṣu yadvane  |
gṛheṣṭyā pātake yacca yadgoghne yaddvijādhame  || 228.34 ||
yatpāpaṃ parivitte ca yatpāpaṃ parivedinaḥ  |
tayordātṛgrahītrośca yatpāpaṃ bhrūṇaghātinaḥ  || 228.35 ||
kiṃ cātra bahubhiḥ proktaiḥ śapathaistava rākṣasa  |
śrūyatāṃ śapathaṃ bhīmaṃ durvācyamapi kathyate  || 228.36 ||
svakanyājīvinaḥ pāpaṃ gūḍhasatyena sākṣiṇaḥ  |
ayājyayājake ṣaṇḍhe yatpāpaṃ śravaṇe'dhame  || 228.37 ||
pravrajyāvasite yacca brahmacāriṇi kāmuke  |
etaistu pāpairlipye'haṃ yadi naiṣyāmi te'ntikam  || 228.38 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
mātaṅgavacanaṃ śrutvā vismito brahmarākṣasaḥ  |
prāha gacchasva satyena samayaṃ caiva pālaya  || 228.39 ||
ityuktaḥ kuṇapāśena śvapākaḥ kusumāni tu  |
samādāyāgamaccaiva viṣṇoḥ sa nilayaṃ gataḥ  || 228.40 ||
tāni prādādbrāhmaṇāya so'pi prakṣālya cāmbhasā  |
viṣṇumabhyarcya nilayaṃ jagāma sa tapodhanāḥ  || 228.41 ||
so'pi mātaṅgadāyādaḥ sopavāsastu tāṃ niśām  |
gāyan hi bāhyabhūmiṣṭhaḥ prajāgaramupākarot || 228.42 ||
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ snātvā devaṃ namasya ca  |
satyaṃ sa samayaṃ kartuṃ pratasthe yatra rākṣasaḥ  || 228.43 ||
taṃ vrajantaṃ pathi naraḥ prāha bhadra kva gacchasi  |
sa tathākathayatsarvaṃ so'pyenaṃ punarabravīt || 228.44 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śarīraṃ sādhanaṃ yataḥ  |
mahatā tu prayatnena śarīraṃ pālayedbudhaḥ  || 228.45 ||
jīvadharmārthasukhaṃ  228.46
narastathāpnoti mokṣagatimagryām  228.46
jīvan kīrtimupaiti ca  228.46
bhavati mṛtasya kā kathā loke  228.46
mātaṅgastadvacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvācātha hetumat ||* 228.47 ||
{mātaṅga uvāca̱ }
bhadra satyaṃ puraskṛtya gacchāmi śapathāḥ kṛtāḥ  ||* 228.48 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
taṃ bhūyaḥ pratyuvācātha kimevaṃ mūḍhadhīrbhavān  |
kiṃ na śrutaṃ tvayā sādho manunā yadudīritam  || 228.49 ||
gostrīdvijānāṃ parirakṣaṇārthaṃ  228.50
vivāhakāle surataprasaṅge  228.50
prāṇātyaye sarvadhanāpahāre  228.50
pañcānṛtānyāhurapātakāni  228.50
dharmavākyaṃ na ca strīṣu na vivāhe tathā ripau  |
vañcane cārthahānau ca svanāśe'nṛtake tathā  |
evaṃ tadvākyamākarṇya mātaṅgaḥ pratyuvāca ha  || 228.51 ||
{mātaṅga uvāca̱ }
maivaṃ vadasva bhadraṃ te satyaṃ lokeṣu pūjyate  |
satyenāvāpyate saukhyaṃ yatkiṃcijjagatīgatam  || 228.52 ||
satyenārkaḥ pratapati satyenāpo rasātmikāḥ  |
jvalatyagniśca satyena vāti satyena mārutaḥ  || 228.53 ||
dharmārthakāmasaṃprāptirmokṣaprāptiśca durlabhā  |
satyena jāyate puṃsāṃ tasmātsatyaṃ na saṃtyajet || 228.54 ||
satyaṃ brahma paraṃ loke satyaṃ yajñeṣu cottamam  |
satyaṃ svargasamāyātaṃ tasmātsatyaṃ na saṃtyajet || 228.55 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā so'tha mātaṅgastaṃ prakṣipya narottamam  |
jagāma tatra yatrāste prāṇihā brahmarākṣasaḥ  || 228.56 ||
tamāgataṃ samīkṣyāsau cāṇḍālaṃ brahmarākṣasaḥ  |
vismayotphullanayanaḥ śiraḥkampaṃ tamabravīt || 228.57 ||
{brahmarākṣasa uvāca̱ }
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga satyavākyānupālaka  |
na mātaṅgamahaṃ manye bhavantaṃ satyalakṣaṇam  || 228.58 ||
karmaṇānena manye tvāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śucimavyayam  |
yatkiṃcittvāṃ bhadramukhaṃ pravakṣye dharmasaṃśrayam  |
kiṃ tatra bhavatā rātrau kṛtaṃ viṣṇugṛhe vada  || 228.59 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tamabhyuvāca mātaṅgaḥ śṛṇu viṣṇugṛhe mayā  |
yatkṛtaṃ rajanībhāge yathātathyaṃ vadāmi te  || 228.60 ||
viṣṇordevakulasyādhaḥ sthitenānamramūrtinā  |
prajāgaraḥ kṛto rātrau gāyatā viṣṇugītikām  || 228.61 ||
taṃ brahmarākṣasaḥ prāha kiyantaṃ kālamucyatām  |
prajāgaro viṣṇugṛhe kṛtaṃ bhaktimatā vada  || 228.62 ||
tamabhyuvāca prahasan viṃśatyabdāni rākṣasa  |
ekādaśyāṃ māsi māsi kṛtastatra prajāgaraḥ  |
mātaṅgavacanaṃ śrutvā provāca brahmarākṣasaḥ  || 228.63 ||
{brahmarākṣasa uvāca̱ }
yadadya tvāṃ pravakṣyāmi tadbhavān vaktumarhati  |
ekarātrikṛtaṃ sādho mama dehi prajāgaram  || 228.64 ||
evaṃ tvāṃ mokṣayiṣyāmi mokṣayiṣyāmi nānyathā  |
triḥ satyena mahābhāga ityuktvā virarāma ha  || 228.65 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
mātaṅgastamuvācātha mayātmā te niśācara  |
niveditaḥ kimuktena khādasva svecchayāpi mām  || 228.66 ||
tamāha rākṣaso bhūyo yāmadvayaprajāgaram  |
sagītaṃ me prayacchasva kṛpāṃ kartuṃ tvamarhasi  || 228.67 ||
mātaṅgo rākṣasaṃ prāha kimasaṃbaddhamucyate  |
khādasva svecchayā māṃ tvaṃ na pradāsye prajāgaram  |
mātaṅgavacanaṃ śrutvā prāha taṃ brahmarākṣasaḥ  || 228.68 ||
{brahmarākṣasa uvāca̱ }
ko hi duṣṭamatirmando bhavantaṃ draṣṭumutsahet |
dharṣayituṃ pīḍayituṃ rakṣitaṃ dharmakarmaṇā  || 228.69 ||
dīnasya pāpagrastasya viṣayairmohitasya ca  |
narakārtasya mūḍhasya sādhavaḥ syurdayānvitāḥ  || 228.70 ||
tanmama tvaṃ mahābhāga kṛpāṃ kṛtvā prajāgaram  |
yāmasyaikasya me dehi gaccha vā nilayaṃ svakam  || 228.71 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
taṃ punaḥ prāha cāṇḍālo na yāsyāmi nijaṃ gṛham  |
na cāpi tava dāsyāmi kathaṃcidyāmajāgaram  |
taṃ prahasyātha cāṇḍālaṃ provāca brahmarākṣasaḥ  || 228.72 ||
{brahmarākṣasa uvāca̱ }
rātryavasāne yā gītā gītikā kautukāśrayā  |
tasyāḥ phalaṃ prayacchasva trāhi pāpātsamuddhara  || 228.73 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evamuccārite tena mātaṅgastamuvāca ha  ||* 228.74 ||
{mātaṅga uvāca̱ }
kiṃ pūrvaṃ bhavatā karma vikṛtaṃ kṛtamañjasā  |
yena tvaṃ doṣajātena saṃbhūto brahmarākṣasaḥ  || 228.75 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tasya tadvākyamākarṇya mātaṅgaṃ brahmarākṣasaḥ  |
provāca duḥkhasaṃtaptaḥ saṃsmṛtya svakṛtaṃ kṛtam  || 228.76 ||
{brahmarākṣasa uvāca̱ }
śrūyatāṃ yo'hamāsaṃ vai pūrvaṃ yacca mayā kṛtam  |
yasmin kṛte pāpayoniṃ gatavānasmi rākṣasīm  || 228.77 ||
somaśarma iti khyātaḥ pūrvamāsamahaṃ dvijaḥ  |
putro'dhyayanaśīlasya devaśarmasya yajvanaḥ  || 228.78 ||
kasyacidyajamānasya sūtramantrabahiṣkṛtaḥ  |
nṛpasya karmasaktena yūpakarmasuniṣṭhitaḥ  || 228.79 ||
āgnīdhraṃ cākarodyajñe lobhamohaprapīḍitaḥ  |
tasmin parisamāpte tu maurkhyāddambhamanuṣṭhitaḥ  || 228.80 ||
yaṣṭumārabdhavānasmi dvādaśāhaṃ mahākratum  |
pravartamāne tasmiṃstu kukṣiśūlo'bhavanmama  || 228.81 ||
saṃpūrṇe daśarātre tu na samāpte tathā kratau  |
virūpākṣasya dīyantyāmāhutyāṃ rākṣase kṣaṇe  || 228.82 ||
mṛto'haṃ tena doṣeṇa saṃbhūto brahmarākṣasaḥ  |
mūrkheṇa mantrahīnena sūtrasvaravivarjitam  || 228.83 ||
ajānatā yajñavidyāṃ yadiṣṭaṃ yājitaṃ ca yat |
tena karmavipākena saṃbhūto brahmarākṣasaḥ  || 228.84 ||
tanmāṃ pāpamahāmbhodhau nimagnaṃ tvaṃ samuddhara  |
prajāgare gītikaikāṃ paścimāṃ dātumarhasi  || 228.85 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
tamuvācātha cāṇḍālo yadi prāṇivadhādbhavān  |
nivṛttiṃ kurute dadyāṃ tataḥ paścimagītikām  || 228.86 ||
bāḍhamityavadatso'pi mātaṅgo'pi dadau tadā  |
gītikāphalamāmantrya muhūrtārdhaprajāgaram  || 228.87 ||
tasmin gītiphale datte mātaṅgaṃ brahmarākṣasaḥ  |
praṇamya prayayau hṛṣṭastīrthavaryaṃ pṛthūdakam  || 228.88 ||
tatrānaśanasaṃkalpaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāñjahau dvijāḥ  |
rākṣasatvādvinirmukto gītikāphalabṛṃhitaḥ  || 228.89 ||
pṛthūdakaprabhāvācca brahmalokaṃ ca durlabham  |
daśa varṣasahasrāṇi nirātaṅko'vasattataḥ  || 228.90 ||
tasyānte brāhmaṇo jāto babhūva smṛtimān vaśī  |
tasyāhaṃ caritaṃ bhūyaḥ kathayiṣyāmi bho dvijāḥ  || 228.91 ||
mātaṅgasya kathāśeṣaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama  |
rākṣase tu gate dhīmān gṛhametya yatātmavān  || 228.92 ||
tadvipracaritaṃ smṛtvā nirviṇṇaḥ śucirapyasau  |
putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya dadau bhūmyāḥ pradakṣiṇām  || 228.93 ||
kokāmukhātsamārabhya yāvadvai skandadarśanam  |
dṛṣṭvā skandaṃ yayau dhārā cakre cāpi pradakṣiṇam  || 228.94 ||
tato'drivaramāgamya vindhyamuccaśiloccayam  |
pāpapramocanaṃ tīrthamāsasāda sa tu dvijāḥ  || 228.95 ||
snānaṃ pāpaharaṃ cakre sa tu cāṇḍālavaṃśajaḥ  |
vimuktapāpaḥ sasmāra pūrvajātīranekaśaḥ  || 228.96 ||
sa pūrvajanmanyabhavadbhikṣuḥ saṃyatavāṅmanāḥ  |
yatakāyaśca matimān vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ  || 228.97 ||
ekadā goṣu nagarāddhriyamāṇāsu taskaraiḥ  |
bhikṣāvadhūtā rajasā muktā tenātha bhikṣuṇā  || 228.98 ||
sa tenādharmadoṣeṇa cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāgataḥ  |
pāpapramocane snātaḥ sa mṛto narmadātaṭe  || 228.99 ||
mūrkho'bhūdbrāhmaṇavaro vārāṇasyāṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  |
tatrāsya vasato'bdaistu triṃśadbhiḥ siddhapūruṣaḥ  || 228.100 ||
virūparūpī babhrāma yogamālābalānvitaḥ  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sopahāsārthamabhivādyābhyuvāca ha  || 228.101 ||
kuśalaṃ siddhapuruṣaṃ kutastvāgamyate tvayā  ||* 228.102 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ saṃbhāṣitastena jñāto'hamiti cintya tu  |
pratyuvācātha vandyastaṃ svargalokādupāgataḥ  || 228.103 ||
taṃ siddhaṃ prāha mūrkho'sau kiṃ tvaṃ vetsi triviṣṭape  |
nārāyaṇoruprabhavāmurvaśīmapsarovarām  || 228.104 ||
siddhastamāha tāṃ vedmi śakracāmaradhāriṇīm  |
svargasyābharaṇaṃ mukhyamurvaśīṃ sādhusaṃbhavām  || 228.105 ||
vipraḥ siddhamuvācātha ṛjumārgavivarjitaḥ  |
tanmitra matkṛte vārttāmurvaśyā bhavatādarāt || 228.106 ||
kathanīyā yacca sā te brūyādākhyāsyate bhavān  |
bāḍhamityabravītsiddhaḥ so'pi vipro mudānvitaḥ  || 228.107 ||
babhūva siddho'pi yayau merupṛṣṭhaṃ surālayam  |
sametya corvaśīṃ prāha yadukto'sau dvijena tu  || 228.108 ||
sā prāha taṃ siddhavaraṃ nāhaṃ kāśipatiṃ dvijam  |
jānāmi satyamuktaṃ te na cetasi mama sthitam  || 228.109 ||
ityuktaḥ prayayau so'pi kālena bahunā punaḥ  |
vārāṇasīṃ yayau siddho dṛṣṭo mūrkheṇa vai punaḥ  || 228.110 ||
dṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ kila bhūyaḥ kimāhorubhavā tava  |
siddho'bravīnna jānāmi māmuvācorvaśī svayam  || 228.111 ||
siddhavākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā smitabhinnauṣṭhasaṃpuṭaḥ  |
punaḥ prāha kathaṃ vetsītyevaṃ vācyā tvayorvaśī  || 228.112 ||
bāḍhamevaṃ kariṣyāmītyuktvā siddho divaṃ gataḥ  |
dadarśa śakrabhavanānniṣkrāmantīmathorvaśīm  || 228.113 ||
provāca tāṃ siddhavaraḥ sā ca taṃ siddhamabravīt |
niyamaṃ kaṃcidapi hi karotu dvijasattamaḥ  || 228.114 ||
yenāhaṃ karmaṇā siddha taṃ jānāmi na cānyathā  |
tadurvaśīvaco'bhyetya tasmai mūrkhadvijāya tu  || 228.115 ||
kathayāmāsa siddhastu so'pīmaṃ niyamaṃ jagau  |
tavāgre siddhapuruṣa niyamo'yaṃ kṛto mayā  || 228.116 ||
na bhokṣye'dyaprabhṛti vai śakaṭaṃ satyamīritam  |
ityuktaḥ prayayau siddhaḥ svarge dṛṣṭvorvaśīmatha  || 228.117 ||
prāhāsau śakaṭaṃ bhokṣye nādyaprabhṛti karhicit |
taṃ siddhamurvaśī prāha jñāto'sau sāṃprataṃ mayā  || 228.118 ||
niyamagrahaṇādeva mūrkho māmupahāsakaḥ  |
ityuktvā prayayau śīghraṃ vāsaṃ nārāyaṇātmajā  || 228.119 ||
siddho'pi vicacārāsau kāmacārī mahītalam  |
urvaśyapi varārohā gatvā vārāṇasīṃ purīm  || 228.120 ||
matsyodarījale snānaṃ cakre divyavapurdharā  |
athāsāvapi mūrkhastu nadīṃ matsyodarīṃ mune  || 228.121 ||
jagāmātha dadarśāsau snāyamānāmathorvaśīm  |
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vavṛdhe'thāsya manmathaḥ kṣobhakṛddṛḍham  || 228.122 ||
cakāra mūrkhaśceṣṭāśca taṃ vivedorvaśī svayam  |
taṃ mūrkhaṃ siddhagaditaṃ jñātvā sasmitamāha tam  || 228.123 ||
{urvaśyuvāca̱ }
kimicchasi mahābhāga mattaḥ śīghramihocyatām  |
kariṣyāmi vacastubhyaṃ tvaṃ viśrabdhaṃ kariṣyasi  || 228.124 ||
{mūrkhabrāhmaṇa uvāca̱ }
ātmapradānena mama prāṇān rakṣa śucismite  ||* 228.125 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
taṃ prāhāthorvaśī vipraṃ niyamasthāsmi sāṃpratam  |
tvaṃ tiṣṭhasva kṣaṇamatha pratīkṣasvāgataṃ mama  || 228.126 ||
sthito'smītyabravīdvipraḥ sāpi svargaṃ jagāma ha  |
māsamātreṇa sāyātā dadarśa taṃ kṛśaṃ dvijam  || 228.127 ||
sthitaṃ māsaṃ nadītīre nirāhāraṃ surāṅganā  |
taṃ dṛṣṭvā niścayayutaṃ bhūtvā vṛddhavapustataḥ  || 228.128 ||
sā cakāra nadītīre śakaṭaṃ śarkarāvṛtam  |
ghṛtena madhunā caiva nadīṃ matsyodarīṃ gatā  || 228.129 ||
snātvātha bhūmau vasantī śakaṭaṃ ca yathārthataḥ  |
taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ samāhūya vākyamāha sulocanā  || 228.130 ||
{urvaśyuvāca̱ }
mayā tīvraṃ vrataṃ vipra cīrṇaṃ saubhāgyakāraṇāt |
vratānte niṣkṛtiṃ dadyāṃ pratigṛhṇīṣva bho dvija  || 228.131 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sa prāha kimidaṃ loke dīyate śarkarāvṛtam  |
kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhaḥ pṛcchāmi sādhu bhadre samīraya  || 228.132 ||
sā prāha śakaṭo vipra śarkarāpiṣṭasaṃyutaḥ  |
imaṃ tvaṃ samupādāya prāṇaṃ tarpaya mā ciram  || 228.133 ||
sa tacchrutvātha saṃsmṛtya kṣudhayā pīḍito'pi san  |
prāha bhadre na gṛhṇāmi niyamo hi kṛto mayā  || 228.134 ||
purataḥ siddhavargasya na bhokṣye śakaṭaṃ tviti  |
parijñānārthamurvaśyā dadasvānyasya kasyacit || 228.135 ||
sābravīnniyamo bhadra kṛtaḥ kāṣṭhamaye tvayā  |
nāsau kāṣṭhamayo bhuṅkṣva kṣudhayā cātipīḍitaḥ  || 228.136 ||
tāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ pratyuvāca na mayā tadviśeṣaṇam  |
kṛtaṃ bhadre'tha niyamaḥ sāmānyenaiva me kṛtaḥ  || 228.137 ||
taṃ bhūyaḥ prāha sā tanvī na cedbhokṣyasi brāhmaṇa  |
gṛhaṃ gṛhītvā gacchasva kuṭumbaṃ tava bhokṣyati  || 228.138 ||
sa tāmuvāca sudati na tāvadyāmi mandiram  |
ihāyātā varārohā trailokye'pyadhikā guṇaiḥ  || 228.139 ||
sā mayā madanārtena prārthitāśvāsitastayā  |
sthīyatāṃ kṣaṇamityevaṃ sthāsyāmīti mayoditam  || 228.140 ||
māsamātraṃ gatāyāstu tasyā bhadre sthitasya ca  |
mama satyānuraktasya saṃgamāya dhṛtavrate  || 228.141 ||
tasya sā vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtvā svaṃ rūpamuttamam  |
vihasya bhāvagambhīramurvaśī prāha taṃ dvijam  || 228.142 ||
{urvaśyuvāca̱ }
sādhu satyaṃ tvayā vipra vrataṃ niṣṭhitacetasā  |
niṣpāditaṃ haṭhādeva mama darśanamicchatā  || 228.143 ||
ahamevorvaśī vipra tvāṃ jijñāsārthamāgatā  |
parīkṣito niścitavān bhavān satyatapā ṛṣiḥ  || 228.144 ||
gaccha śūkaravoddeśaṃ rūpatīrtheti viśrutam  |
siddhiṃ yāsyasi viprendra tatastvaṃ māmavāpsyasi  || 228.145 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ityuktvā divamutpatya sā jagāmorvaśī dvijāḥ  |
sa ca satyatapā vipro rūpatīrthaṃ jagāma ha  || 228.146 ||
tatra śāntiparo bhūtvā niyamavratadhṛkśuciḥ  |
dehotsarge jagāmāsau gāndharvaṃ lokamuttamam  || 228.147 ||
tatra manvantaraśataṃ bhogān bhuktvā yathārthataḥ  |
babhūva sukule rājā prajārañjanatatparaḥ  || 228.148 ||
sa yajvā vividhairyajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ  |
putreṣu rājyaṃ nikṣipya yayau śaukaravaṃ punaḥ  || 228.149 ||
rūpatīrthe mṛto bhūyaḥ śakralokamupāgataḥ  |
tatra manvantaraśataṃ bhogān bhuktvā tataścyutaḥ  || 228.150 ||
pratiṣṭhāne puravare budhaputraḥ purūravāḥ  |
babhūva tatra corvaśyāḥ saṃgamāya tapodhanāḥ  || 228.151 ||
evaṃ purā satyatapā dvijātis 228.152
tīrthe prasiddhe sa hi rūpasaṃjñe  228.152
ārādhya janmanyatha cārcya viṣṇum  228.152
avāpya bhogānatha muktimeti  228.152
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
śrutaṃ phalaṃ gītikāyā asmābhiḥ suprajāgare  |
kṛṣṇasya yena cāṇḍālo gato'sau paramāṃ gatim  || 229.1 ||
yathā viṣṇau bhavedbhaktistanno brūhi mahāmate  |
tapasā karmaṇā yena śrotumicchāma sāṃpratam  || 229.2 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlāḥ pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ  |
yathā kṛṣṇe bhavedbhaktiḥ puruṣasya mahāphalā  || 229.3 ||
saṃsāre'sminmahāghore sarvabhūtabhayāvahe  |
mahāmohakare nṝṇāṃ nānāduḥkhaśatākule  || 229.4 ||
tiryagyonisahasreṣu jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ  |
kathaṃcillabhate janma dehī mānuṣyakaṃ dvijāḥ  || 229.5 ||
mānuṣatve'pi vipratvaṃ vipratve'pi vivekitā  |
vivekāddharmabuddhistu buddhyā tu śreyasāṃ grahaḥ  || 229.6 ||
yāvatpāpakṣayaṃ puṃsāṃ na bhavejjanma saṃcitam  |
tāvanna jāyate bhaktirvāsudeve jaganmaye  || 229.7 ||
tasmādvakṣyāmi bho viprā bhaktiḥ kṛṣṇe yathā bhavet |
anyadeveṣu yā bhaktiḥ puruṣasyeha jāyate  || 229.8 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā tadgatenāntarātmanā  |
tena tasya bhavedbhaktiryajane munisattamāḥ  || 229.9 ||
sa karoti tato viprā bhaktiṃ cāgneḥ samāhitaḥ  |
tuṣṭe hutāśane tasya bhaktirbhavati bhāskare  || 229.10 ||
pūjāṃ karoti satatamādityasya tato dvijāḥ  |
prasanne bhāskare tasya bhaktirbhavati śaṃkare  || 229.11 ||
pūjāṃ karoti vidhivatsa tu śaṃbhoḥ prayatnataḥ  |
tuṣṭe trilocane tasya bhaktirbhavati keśave  || 229.12 ||
saṃpūjya taṃ jagannāthaṃ vāsudevākhyamavyayam  |
tato bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca sa prāpnoti dvijottamāḥ  || 229.13 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
avaiṣṇavā narā ye tu dṛśyante ca mahāmune  |
kiṃ te viṣṇuṃ nārcayanti brūhi tatkāraṇaṃ dvija  || 229.14 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
dvau bhūtasargau vikhyātau loke'sminmunisattamāḥ  |
āsuraśca tathā daivaḥ purā sṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā  || 229.15 ||
daivīṃ prakṛtimāsādya pūjayanti tato'cyutam  |
āsurīṃ yonimāpannā dūṣayanti narā harim  || 229.16 ||
māyayā hatavijñānā viṣṇoste tu narādhamāḥ  |
aprāpya taṃ hariṃ viprāstato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim  || 229.17 ||
tasya yā gahvarī māyā durvijñeyā surāsuraiḥ  |
mahāmohakarī nṝṇāṃ dustarā cākṛtātmabhiḥ  || 229.18 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
icchāmastāṃ mahāmāyāṃ jñātuṃ viṣṇoḥ sudustarām  |
vaktumarhasi dharmajña paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ  || 229.19 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
svapnendrajālasaṃkāśā māyā sā lokakarṣaṇī  |
kaḥ śaknoti harermāyāṃ jñātuṃ tāṃ keśavādṛte  || 229.20 ||
yā vṛttā brāhmaṇasyāsīnmāyārthe nāradasya ca  |
viḍambanāṃ tu tāṃ viprāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ gadato mama  || 229.21 ||
prāgāsīnnṛpatiḥ śrīmānāgnīdhra iti viśrutaḥ  |
nagare kāmadamanastasyātha tanayaḥ śuciḥ  || 229.22 ||

{putra uvāca̱ }
śṛṇu tāta vaco mahyaṃ tattvavākyaṃ sahetukam  |

mayā janmasahasrāṇi jarāmṛtyuśatāni ca  |
prāptāni dārasaṃyoga viyogāni ca sarvaśaḥ  || 229.32 ||

itastṛtīye yadvṛttaṃ mama janmani tacchṛṇu  |

{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
asmābhistu śrutaṃ vyāsa yattvayā samudāhṛtam  |
prādurbhāvāśritaṃ puṇyaṃ māyā viṣṇośca durvidā  || 230.1 ||
śrotumicchāmahe tvatto yathāvadupasaṃhṛtim  |
mahāpralayasaṃjñāṃ ca kalpānte ca mahāmune  || 230.2 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śrūyatāṃ bho muniśreṣṭhā yathāvadanusaṃhṛtiḥ  |
kalpānte prākṛte caiva pralaye jāyate yathā  || 230.3 ||
ahorātraṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu māso'bdaṃ tridivaukasām  |
caturyugasahasre tu brahmaṇo'hardvijottamāḥ  || 230.4 ||
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam  |
daivairvarṣasahasraistu taddvādaśābhirucyate  || 230.5 ||
caturyugāṇyaśeṣāṇi sadṛśāni svarūpataḥ  |
ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ proktaṃ munayo'ntyaṃ tathā kalim  || 230.6 ||
ādye kṛtayuge sargo brahmaṇā kriyate yataḥ  |
kriyate copasaṃhārastathānte'pi kalau yuge  || 230.7 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kaleḥ svarūpaṃ bhagavan vistarādvaktumarhasi  |
dharmaścatuṣpādbhagavān yasmin vaikalyamṛcchati  || 230.8 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
kalisvarūpaṃ bho viprā yatpṛcchadhvaṃ mamānaghāḥ  |
nibodhadhvaṃ samāsena vartate yanmahattaram  || 230.9 ||
varṇāśramācāravatī pravṛttirna kalau nṛṇām  |
na sāmaṛgyajurveda viniṣpādanahaitukī  || 230.10 ||
vivāhā na kalau dharmā na śiṣyā gurusaṃsthitāḥ  |
na putrā dhārmikāścaiva na ca vahnikriyākramaḥ  || 230.11 ||
yatra tatra kule jāto balī sarveśvaraḥ kalau  |
sarvebhya eva varṇebhyo naraḥ kanyopajīvanaḥ  || 230.12 ||
yena tenaiva yogena dvijātirdīkṣitaḥ kalau  |
yaiva saiva ca viprendrāḥ prāyaścittakriyā kalau  || 230.13 ||
sarvameva kalau śāstraṃ yasya yadvacanaṃ dvijāḥ  |
devatāśca kalau sarvāḥ sarvaḥ sarvasya cāśramaḥ  || 230.14 ||
upavāsastathāyāso vittotsargastathā kalau  |
dharmo yathābhirucitairanuṣṭhānairanuṣṭhitaḥ  || 230.15 ||
vittena bhavitā puṃsāṃ svalpenaiva madaḥ kalau  |
strīṇāṃ rūpamadaścaiva keśaireva bhaviṣyati  || 230.16 ||
suvarṇamaṇiratnādau vastre copakṣayaṃ gate  |
kalau striyo bhaviṣyanti tadā keśairalaṃkṛtāḥ  || 230.17 ||
parityakṣyanti bhartāraṃ vittahīnaṃ tathā striyaḥ  |
bhartā bhaviṣyati kalau vittavāneva yoṣitām  || 230.18 ||
yo yo dadāti bahulaṃ sa sa svāmī tadā nṛṇām  |
svāmitvahetusaṃbandho bhavitābhijanastadā  || 230.19 ||
gṛhāntā dravyasaṃghātā dravyāntā ca tathā matiḥ  |
arthāścāthopabhogāntā bhaviṣyanti tadā kalau  || 230.20 ||
striyaḥ kalau bhaviṣyanti svairiṇyo lalitaspṛhāḥ  |
anyāyāvāptavitteṣu puruṣeṣu spṛhālavaḥ  || 230.21 ||
abhyarthito'pi suhṛdā svārthahāniṃ tu mānavaḥ  |
paṇasyārdhārdhamātre'pi kariṣyati tadā dvijāḥ  || 230.22 ||
sadā sapauruṣaṃ ceto bhāvi vipra tadā kalau  |
kṣīrapradānasaṃbandhi bhāti goṣu ca gauravam  || 230.23 ||
anāvṛṣṭibhayātprāyaḥ prajāḥ kṣudbhayakātarāḥ  |
bhaviṣyanti tadā sarvā gaganāsaktadṛṣṭayaḥ  || 230.24 ||
mūlaparṇaphalāhārāstāpasā iva mānavāḥ  |
ātmānaṃ ghātayiṣyanti tadāvṛṣṭyābhiduḥkhitāḥ  || 230.25 ||
durbhikṣameva satataṃ sadā kleśamanīśvarāḥ  |
prāpsyanti vyāhatasukhaṃ pramādānmānavāḥ kalau  || 230.26 ||
asnātabhojino nāgni devatātithipūjanam  |
kariṣyanti kalau prāpte na ca piṇḍodakakriyām  || 230.27 ||
lolupā hrasvadehāśca bahvannādanatatparāḥ  |
bahuprajālpabhāgyāśca bhaviṣyanti kalau striyaḥ  || 230.28 ||
ubhābhyāmatha pāṇibhyāṃ śiraḥkaṇḍūyanaṃ striyaḥ  |
kurvatyo gurubhartṝṇāmājñāṃ bhetsyantyanāvṛtāḥ  || 230.29 ||
svapoṣaṇaparāḥ kruddhā dehasaṃskāravarjitāḥ  |
paruṣānṛtabhāṣiṇyo bhaviṣyanti kalau striyaḥ  || 230.30 ||
duḥśīlā duṣṭaśīleṣu kurvatyaḥ satataṃ spṛhām  |
asadvṛttā bhaviṣyanti puruṣeṣu kulāṅganāḥ  || 230.31 ||
vedādānaṃ kariṣyanti vaḍavāśca tathāvratāḥ  |
gṛhasthāśca na hoṣyanti na dāsyantyucitānyapi  || 230.32 ||
bhaveyurvanavāsā vai grāmyāhāraparigrahāḥ  |
bhikṣavaścāpi putrā hi snehasaṃbandhayantrakāḥ  || 230.33 ||
arakṣitāro hartāraḥ śulkavyājena pārthivāḥ  |
hāriṇo janavittānāṃ saṃprāpte ca kalau yuge  || 230.34 ||
yo yo'śvarathanāgāḍhyaḥ sa sa rājā bhaviṣyati  |
yaśca yaścābalaḥ sarvaḥ sa sa bhṛtyaḥ kalau yuge  || 230.35 ||
vaiśyāḥ kṛṣivaṇijyādi saṃtyajya nijakarma yat |
śūdravṛttyā bhaviṣyanti kārukarmopajīvinaḥ  || 230.36 ||
bhaikṣyavratāstathā śūdrāḥ pravrajyāliṅgino'dhamāḥ  |
pākhaṇḍasaṃśrayāṃ vṛttimāśrayiṣyantyasaṃskṛtāḥ  || 230.37 ||
durbhikṣakarapīḍābhiratīvopadrutā janāḥ  |
godhūmānnayavānnādyān deśān yāsyanti duḥkhitāḥ  || 230.38 ||
vedamārge pralīne ca pākhaṇḍāḍhye tato jane  |
adharmavṛddhyā lokānāmalpamāyurbhaviṣyati  || 230.39 ||
aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyamāneṣu vai tapaḥ  |
nareṣu nṛpadoṣeṇa bālamṛtyurbhaviṣyati  || 230.40 ||
bhavitrī yoṣitāṃ sūtiḥ pañcaṣaṭsaptavārṣikī  |
navāṣṭadaśavarṣāṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tathā kalau  || 230.41 ||
palitodgamaśca bhavitā tadā dvādaśavārṣikaḥ  |
na jīviṣyati vai kaścitkalau varṣāṇi viṃśatim  || 230.42 ||
alpaprajñā vṛthāliṅgā duṣṭāntaḥkaraṇāḥ kalau  |
yatastato vinaśyanti kālenālpena mānavāḥ  || 230.43 ||
yadā yadā hi pākhaṇḍa vṛttiratropalakṣyate  |
tadā tadā kalervṛddhiranumeyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ  || 230.44 ||
yadā yadā satāṃ hānirvedamārgānusāriṇām  |
tadā tadā kalervṛddhiranumeyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ  || 230.45 ||
prārambhāścāvasīdanti yadā dharmakṛtāṃ nṛṇām  |
tadānumeyaṃ prādhānyaṃ kalerviprā vicakṣaṇaiḥ  || 230.46 ||
yadā yadā na yajñānāmīśvaraḥ puruṣottamaḥ  |
ijyate puruṣairyajñaistadā jñeyaṃ kalerbalam  || 230.47 ||
na prītirvedavādeṣu pākhaṇḍeṣu yadā ratiḥ  |
kalervṛddhistadā prājñairanumeyā dvijottamāḥ  || 230.48 ||
kalau jagatpatiṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvasraṣṭāramīśvaram  |
nārcayiṣyanti bho viprāḥ pākhaṇḍopahatā narāḥ  || 230.49 ||
kiṃ devaiḥ kiṃ dvijairvedaiḥ kiṃ śaucenāmbujalpanā  |
ityevaṃ pralapiṣyanti pākhaṇḍopahatā narāḥ  || 230.50 ||
alpavṛṣṭiśca parjanyaḥ svalpaṃ sasyaphalaṃ tathā  |
phalaṃ tathālpasāraṃ ca viprāḥ prāpte kalau yuge  || 230.51 ||
jānuprāyāṇi vastrāṇi śamīprāyā mahīruhāḥ  |
śūdraprāyāstathā varṇā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge  || 230.52 ||
aṇuprāyāṇi dhānyāni ājaprāyaṃ tathā payaḥ  |
bhaviṣyati kalau prāpta auśīraṃ cānulepanam  || 230.53 ||
śvaśrūśvaśurabhūyiṣṭhā guravaśca nṛṇāṃ kalau  |
śālādyāhāribhāryāśca suhṛdo munisattamāḥ  || 230.54 ||
kasya mātā pitā kasya yadā karmātmakaḥ pumān  |
iti codāhariṣyanti śvaśurānugatā narāḥ  || 230.55 ||
vāṅmanaḥkāyajairdoṣairabhibhūtāḥ punaḥ punaḥ  |
narāḥ pāpānyanudinaṃ kariṣyantyalpamedhasaḥ  || 230.56 ||
niḥsatyānāmaśaucānāṃ nirhrīkāṇāṃ tathā dvijāḥ  |
yadyadduḥkhāya tatsarvaṃ kalikāle bhaviṣyati  || 230.57 ||
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāre svadhāsvāhāvivarjite  |
tadā praviralo vipraḥ kaścilloke bhaviṣyati  || 230.58 ||
tatrālpenaiva kālena puṇyaskandhamanuttamam  |
karoti yaḥ kṛtayuge kriyate tapasā hi yaḥ  || 230.59 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kasmin kāle'lpako dharmo dadāti sumahāphalam  |
vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa śrotuṃ vāñchā pravartate  || 230.60 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
dhanye kalau bhavedviprāstvalpakleśairmahatphalam  |
tathā bhavetāṃ strīśūdrau dhanyau cānyannibodhata  || 230.61 ||
yatkṛte daśabhirvarṣaistretāyāṃ hāyanena tat |
dvāpare tacca māsena ahorātreṇa tatkalau  || 230.62 ||
tapaso brahmacaryasya japādeśca phalaṃ dvijāḥ  |
prāpnoti puruṣastena kalau sādhviti bhāṣitum  || 230.63 ||
dhyāyan kṛte yajan yajñaistretāyāṃ dvāpare'rcayan  |
yadāpnoti tadāpnoti kalau saṃkīrtya keśavam  || 230.64 ||
dharmotkarṣamatīvātra prāpnoti puruṣaḥ kalau  |
svalpāyāsena dharmajñāstena tuṣṭo'smyahaṃ kalau  || 230.65 ||
vratacaryāparairgrāhyā vedāḥ pūrvaṃ dvijātibhiḥ  |
tatastu dharmasaṃprāptairyaṣṭavyaṃ vidhivaddhanaiḥ  || 230.66 ||
vṛthā kathā vṛthā bhojyaṃ vṛthā svaṃ ca dvijanmanām  |
patanāya tathā bhāvyaṃ taistu saṃyatibhiḥ saha  || 230.67 ||
asamyakkaraṇe doṣāsteṣāṃ sarveṣu vastuṣu  |
bhojyapeyādikaṃ caiṣāṃ necchāprāptikaraṃ dvijāḥ  || 230.68 ||
pāratantryātsamasteṣu teṣāṃ kāryeṣu vai tataḥ  |
lokān kleśena mahatā yajanti vinayānvitāḥ  || 230.69 ||
dvijaśuśrūṣaṇenaiva pākayajñādhikāravān  |
nijaṃ jayati vai lokaṃ śūdro dhanyatarastataḥ  || 230.70 ||
bhakṣyābhakṣyeṣu nāśāsti yeṣāṃ pāpeṣu vā yataḥ  |
niyamo muniśārdūlāstenāsau sādhvitīritam  || 230.71 ||
svadharmasyāvirodhena narairlabhyaṃ dhanaṃ sadā  |
pratipādanīyaṃ pātreṣu yaṣṭavyaṃ ca yathāvidhi  || 230.72 ||
tasyārjane mahān kleśaḥ pālanena dvijottamāḥ  |
tathā sadviniyogāya vijñeyaṃ gahanaṃ nṛṇām  || 230.73 ||
ebhiranyaistathā kleśaiḥ puruṣā dvijasattamāḥ  |
nijāñjayanti vai lokān prājāpatyādikān kramāt || 230.74 ||
yoṣicchuśrūṣaṇādbhartuḥ karmaṇā manasā girā  |
etadviṣayamāpnoti tatsālokyaṃ yato dvijāḥ  || 230.75 ||
nātikleśena mahatā tāneva puruṣo yathā  |
tṛtīyaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ tena mayā sādhviti yoṣitaḥ  || 230.76 ||
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ viprā yannimittamihāgatāḥ  |
tatpṛcchadhvaṃ yathākāmamahaṃ vakṣyāmi vaḥ sphuṭam  || 230.77 ||
alpenaiva prayatnena dharmaḥ sidhyati vai kalau  |
narairātmaguṇāmbhobhiḥ kṣālitākhilakilbiṣaiḥ  || 230.78 ||
śūdraiśca dvijaśuśrūṣā tatparairmunisattamāḥ  |
tathā strībhiranāyāsātpatiśuśrūṣayaiva hi  || 230.79 ||
tatastritayamapyetanmama dhanyatamaṃ matam  |
dharmasaṃrādhane kleśo dvijātīnāṃ kṛtādiṣu  || 230.80 ||
tathā svalpena tapasā siddhiṃ yāsyanti mānavāḥ  |
dhanyā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte munisattamāḥ  || 230.81 ||
bhavadbhiryadabhipretaṃ tadetatkathitaṃ mayā  |
apṛṣṭenāpi dharmajñāḥ kimanyatkriyatāṃ dvijāḥ  || 230.82 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
āsannaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ vā yadi kālaṃ na vidmahe  |
tato dvāparavidhvaṃsaṃ yugāntaṃ spṛhayāmahe  || 231.1 ||
prāptā vayaṃ hi tatkālamanayā dharmatṛṣṇayā  |
ādadyāma paraṃ dharmaṃ sukhamalpena karmaṇā  || 231.2 ||
saṃtrāsodvegajananaṃ yugāntaṃ samupasthitam  |
pranaṣṭadharmaṃ dharmajña nimittairvaktumarhasi  || 231.3 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
arakṣitāro hartāro balibhāgasya pārthivāḥ  |
yugānte prabhaviṣyanti svarakṣaṇaparāyaṇāḥ  || 231.4 ||
akṣatriyāśca rājāno viprāḥ śūdropajīvinaḥ  |
śūdrāśca brāhmaṇācārā bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye  || 231.5 ||
śrotriyāḥ kāṇḍapṛṣṭhāśca niṣkarmāṇi havīṃṣi ca  |
ekapaṅktyāmaśiṣyanti yugānte munisattamāḥ  || 231.6 ||
aśiṣṭavanto'rthaparā narā madyāmiṣapriyāḥ  |
mitrabhāryāṃ bhajiṣyanti yugānte puruṣādhamāḥ  || 231.7 ||
rājavṛttisthitāścaurā rājānaścauraśīlinaḥ  |
bhṛtyā hyanirdiṣṭabhujo bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye  || 231.8 ||
dhanāni ślāghanīyāni satāṃ vṛttamapūjitam  |
akutsanā ca patite bhaviṣyati yugakṣaye  || 231.9 ||
pranaṣṭanāsāḥ puruṣā muktakeśā virūpiṇaḥ  |
ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣāśca prasoṣyanti tathā striyaḥ  || 231.10 ||
aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ  |
pramadāḥ keśaśūlāśca bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye  || 231.11 ||
sarve brahma vadiṣyanti dvijā vājasaneyikāḥ  |
śūdrābhā vādinaścaiva brāhmaṇāścāntyavāsinaḥ  || 231.12 ||
śukladantā jitākṣāśca muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ  |
śūdrā dharmaṃ vadiṣyanti śāṭhyabuddhyopajīvinaḥ  || 231.13 ||
śvāpadapracuratvaṃ ca gavāṃ caiva parikṣayaḥ  |
sādhūnāṃ parivṛttiśca vidyādantagate yuge  || 231.14 ||
antyā madhye nivatsyanti madhyāścāntanivāsinaḥ  |
nirhrīkāśca prajāḥ sarvā naṣṭāstatra yugakṣaye  || 231.15 ||
tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijottamāḥ  |
ṛtavo viparītāśca bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye  || 231.16 ||
tathā dvihāyanā damyāḥ kalau lāṅgaladhāriṇaḥ  |
citravarṣī ca parjanyo yuge kṣīṇe bhaviṣyati  || 231.17 ||
sarve śūrakule jātāḥ kṣamānāthā bhavanti hi  |
yathā nimnāḥ prajāḥ sarvā bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye  || 231.18 ||
pitṛdeyāni dattāni bhaviṣyanti tathā sutāḥ  |
na ca dharmaṃ cariṣyanti mānavā nirgate yuge  || 231.19 ||
ūṣarā bahulā bhūmiḥ panthānastaskarāvṛtāḥ  |
sarve ... vāṇikāścaiva bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye  || 231.20 ||
pitṛdāyādadattāni vibhajanti tathā sutāḥ  |
haraṇe yatnavanto'pi lobhādibhirvirodhinaḥ  || 231.21 ||
saukumārye tathā rūpe ratne copakṣayaṃ gate  |
bhaviṣyanti yugasyānte nāryaḥ keśairalaṃkṛtāḥ  || 231.22 ||
nirvīryasya ratistatra gṛhasthasya bhaviṣyati  |
yugānte samanuprāpte nānyā bhāryāsamā ratiḥ  || 231.23 ||
kuśīlānāryabhūyiṣṭhā vṛthārūpasamanvitāḥ  |
puruṣālpaṃ bahustrīkaṃ tadyugāntasya lakṣaṇam  || 231.24 ||
bahuyācanako loko na dāsyati parasparam  |
rājacaurāgnidaṇḍādi kṣīṇaḥ kṣayamupaiṣyati  || 231.25 ||
aphalāni ca sasyāni taruṇā vṛddhaśīlinaḥ  |
aśīlāḥ sukhino loke bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye  || 231.26 ||
varṣāsu paruṣā vātā nīcāḥ śarkaravarṣiṇaḥ  |
saṃdigdhaḥ paralokaśca bhaviṣyati yugakṣaye  || 231.27 ||
vaiśyā iva ca rājanyā dhanadhānyopajīvinaḥ  |
yugāpakramaṇe pūrvaṃ bhaviṣyanti na bāndhavāḥ  || 231.28 ||
apravṛttāḥ prapaśyanti samayāḥ śapathāstathā  |
ṛṇaṃ savinayabhraṃśaṃ yuge kṣīṇe bhaviṣyati  || 231.29 ||
bhaviṣyatyaphalo harṣaḥ krodhaśca saphalo nṛṇām  |
ajāścāpi nirotsyanti payaso'rthe yugakṣaye  || 231.30 ||
aśāstravihito yajña evameva bhaviṣyati  |
apramāṇaṃ kariṣyanti narāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ  || 231.31 ||
śāstroktasyāpravaktāro bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ  |
sarvaḥ sarvaṃ vijānāti vṛddhānanupasevya vai  || 231.32 ||
na kaścidakavirnāma yugānte samupasthite  |
nakṣatrāṇi viyogāni na karmasthā dvijātayaḥ  || 231.33 ||
cauraprāyāśca rājāno yugānte samupasthite  |
kuṇḍīvṛṣā naikṛtikāḥ surāpā brahmavādinaḥ  || 231.34 ||
aśvamedhena yakṣyante yugānte dvijasattamāḥ  |
yājayiṣyantyayājyāṃstu tathābhakṣyasya bhakṣiṇaḥ  || 231.35 ||
brāhmaṇā dhanatṛṣṇārtā yugānte samupasthite  |
bhoḥśabdamabhidhāsyanti na ca kaścitpaṭhiṣyati  || 231.36 ||
ekaśaṅkhāstathā nāryo gavedhukapinaddhakāḥ  |
nakṣatrāṇi vivarṇāni viparitā diśo daśa  || 231.37 ||
saṃdhyārāgo vidagdhāṅgo bhaviṣyati yugakṣaye  |
preṣayanti pitṝn putrā vadhūḥ śvaśrūḥ svakarmasu  || 231.38 ||
yugeṣvevaṃ nivatsyanti pramadāśca narāstathā  |
akṛtvāgrāṇi bhokṣyanti dvijāścaivāhutāgnayaḥ  || 231.39 ||
bhikṣāṃ balimadattvā ca bhokṣyanti puruṣāḥ svayam  |
vañcayitvā patīn suptān gamiṣyanti striyo'nyataḥ  || 231.40 ||
na vyādhitānnāpyarūpānnodyatānnāpyasūyakān  |
kṛte na pratikartā ca yuge kṣīṇe bhaviṣyati  || 231.41 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
evaṃ vilambite dharme mānuṣāḥ karapīḍitāḥ  |
kutra deśe nivatsyanti kimāhāravihāriṇaḥ  || 231.42 ||
kiṃkarmāṇaḥ kimīhantaḥ kiṃpramāṇāḥ kimāyuṣaḥ  |
kāṃ ca kāṣṭhāṃ samāsādya prapatsyanti kṛtaṃ yugam  || 231.43 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ata ūrdhvaṃ cyute dharme guṇahīnāḥ prajāstathā  |
śīlavyasanamāsādya prāpsyanti hrāsamāyuṣaḥ  || 231.44 ||
āyurhānyā balagnānirbalagnānyā vivarṇatā  |
vaivarṇyādvyādhisaṃpīḍā nirvedo vyādhipīḍanāt || 231.45 ||
nirvedādātmasaṃbodhaḥ saṃbodhāddharmaśīlatā  |
evaṃ gatvā parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ prapatsyanti kṛtaṃ yugam  || 231.46 ||
uddeśato dharmaśīlāḥ kecinmadhyasthatāṃ gatāḥ  |
kiṃdharmaśīlāḥ kecittu kecidatra kutūhalāḥ  || 231.47 ||
pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca pramāṇamiti niścitāḥ  |
apramāṇaṃ kariṣyanti sarvamityapare janāḥ  || 231.48 ||
nāstikyaparatāścāpi keciddharmavilopakāḥ  |
bhaviṣyanti narā mūḍhā dvijāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ  || 231.49 ||
tadātvamātraśraddheyā śāstrajñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ  |
dāmbhikāste bhaviṣyanti narā jñānavilopitāḥ  || 231.50 ||
tathā vilulite dharme janāḥ śreṣṭhapuraskṛtāḥ  |
śubhān samācariṣyanti dānaśīlaparāyaṇāḥ  || 231.51 ||
sarvabhakṣāḥ svayaṃguptā nirghṛṇā nirapatrapāḥ  |
bhaviṣyanti tadā loke tatkaṣāyasya lakṣaṇam  || 231.52 ||
kaṣāyopaplave kāle jñānaniṣṭhāpraṇāśane  |
siddhimalpena kālena prāpsyanti nirupaskṛtāḥ  || 231.53 ||
viprāṇāṃ śāśvatīṃ vṛttiṃ yadā varṇāvare janāḥ  |
saṃśrayiṣyanti bho viprāstatkaṣāyasya lakṣaṇam  || 231.54 ||
mahāyuddhaṃ mahāvarṣaṃ mahāvātaṃ mahātapaḥ  |
bhaviṣyati yuge kṣīṇe tatkaṣāyasya lakṣaṇam  || 231.55 ||
viprarūpeṇa yakṣāṃsi rājānaḥ karṇavedinaḥ  |
pṛthivīmupabhokṣyanti yugānte samupasthite  || 231.56 ||
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārāḥ kunetāro'bhimāninaḥ  |
kravyādā brahmarūpeṇa sarvabhakṣyā vṛthāvratāḥ  || 231.57 ||
mūrkhāścārthaparā lubdhāḥ kṣudrāḥ kṣudraparicchadāḥ  |
vyavahāropavṛttāśca cyutā dharmāśca śāśvatāt || 231.58 ||
hartāraḥ pararatnānāṃ paradārapradharṣakāḥ  |
kāmātmāno durātmānaḥ sopadhāḥ priyasāhasāḥ  || 231.59 ||
teṣu prabhavamāṇeṣu janeṣvapi ca sarvaśaḥ  |
abhāvino bhaviṣyanti munayo bahurūpiṇaḥ  || 231.60 ||
kalau yuge samutpannāḥ pradhānapuruṣāśca ye  |
kathāyogena tān sarvān pūjayiṣyanti mānavāḥ  || 231.61 ||
sasyacaurā bhaviṣyanti tathā cailāpahāriṇaḥ  |
bhokṣyabhojyaharāścaiva karaṇḍānāṃ ca hāriṇaḥ  || 231.62 ||
caurāścaurasya hartāro hantā hanturbhaviṣyati  |
cauraiścaurakṣaye cāpi kṛte kṣemaṃ bhaviṣyati  || 231.63 ||
niḥsāre kṣubhite kāle niṣkriye saṃvyavasthite  |
narā vanaṃ śrayiṣyanti karabhāraprapīḍitāḥ  || 231.64 ||
yajñakarmaṇyuparate rakṣāṃsi śvāpadāni ca  |
kīṭamūṣikasarpāśca dharṣayiṣyanti mānavān  || 231.65 ||
kṣemaṃ subhikṣamārogyaṃ sāmagryaṃ caiva bandhuṣu  |
uddeśeṣu narāḥ śreṣṭhā bhaviṣyanti yugakṣaye  || 231.66 ||
svayaṃpālāḥ svayaṃ caurāḥ plavasaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtāḥ  |
maṇḍalaiḥ saṃbhaviṣyanti deśe deśe pṛthakpṛthak || 231.67 ||
svadeśebhyaḥ paribhraṣṭā niḥsārāḥ saha bandhubhiḥ  |
narāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti tadā kālaparikṣayāt || 231.68 ||
tataḥ sarve samādāya kumārān pradrutā bhayāt |
kauśikīṃ saṃtariṣyanti narāḥ kṣudbhayapīḍitāḥ  || 231.69 ||
aṅgān vaṅgān kaliṅgāṃśca kāśmīrānatha kośalān  |
ṛṣikāntagiridroṇīḥ saṃśrayiṣyanti mānavāḥ  || 231.70 ||
kṛtsnaṃ ca himavatpārśvaṃ kūlaṃ ca lavaṇāmbhasaḥ  |
vividhaṃ jīrṇapattraṃ ca valkalānyajināni ca  || 231.71 ||
svayaṃ kṛtvā nivatsyanti tasmin bhūte yugakṣaye  |
araṇyeṣu ca vatsyanti narā mlecchagaṇaiḥ saha  || 231.72 ||
naiva śūnyā navāraṇyā bhaviṣyati vasuṃdharā  |
agoptāraśca goptāro bhaviṣyanti narādhipāḥ  || 231.73 ||
mṛgairmatsyairvihaṃgaiśca śvāpadaiḥ sarpakīṭakaiḥ  |
madhuśākaphalairmūlairvartayiṣyanti mānavāḥ  || 231.74 ||
śīrṇaparṇaphalāhārā valkalānyajināni ca  |
svayaṃ kṛtvā nivatsyanti yathā munijanastathā  || 231.75 ||
bījānāmakṛtasnehā āhatāḥ kāṣṭhaśaṅkubhiḥ  |
ajaiḍakaṃ kharoṣṭraṃ ca pālayiṣyanti nityaśaḥ  || 231.76 ||
nadīsrotāṃsi rotsyanti toyārthaṃ kūlamāśritāḥ  |
pakvānnavyavahāreṇa vipaṇantaḥ parasparam  || 231.77 ||
tanūruhairyathājātaiḥ samalāntarasaṃbhṛtaiḥ  |
bahvapatyāḥ prajāhīnāḥ kulaśīlavivarjitāḥ  || 231.78 ||
evaṃ bhaviṣyanti tadā narāścādharmajīvinaḥ  |
hīnā hīnaṃ tathā dharmaṃ prajā samanuvatsyati  || 231.79 ||
āyustatra ca martyānāṃ paraṃ triṃśadbhaviṣyati  |
durbalā viṣayaglānā jarāśokairabhiplutāḥ  || 231.80 ||
bhaviṣyanti tadā teṣāṃ rogairindriyasaṃkṣayaḥ  |
āyuḥpratyayasaṃrodhādviṣayāduparaṃsyate  || 231.81 ||
śuśrūṣavo bhaviṣyanti sādhūnāṃ darśane ratāḥ  |
satyaṃ ca pratipatsyanti vyavahāropasaṃkṣayāt || 231.82 ||
bhaviṣyanti ca kāmānāmalābhāddharmaśīlinaḥ  |
kariṣyanti ca saṃskāraṃ svayaṃ ca kṣayapīḍitāḥ  || 231.83 ||
evaṃ śuśrūṣavo dāne satye prāṇyabhirakṣaṇe  |
tataḥ pādapravṛtte tu dharme śreyo nipatsyate  || 231.84 ||
teṣāṃ labdhānumānānāṃ guṇeṣu parivartatām  |
svādu kiṃ tviti vijñāya dharma eva ca dṛśyate  || 231.85 ||
yathā hānikramaṃ prāptāstathā ṛddhikramaṃ gatāḥ  |
pragṛhīte tato dharme prapaśyanti kṛtaṃ yugam  || 231.86 ||
sādhuvṛttiḥ kṛtayuge kaṣāye hānirucyate  |
eka eva tu kālo'yaṃ hīnavarṇo yathā śaśī  || 231.87 ||
channaśca tamasā somo yathā kaliyugaṃ tathā  |
muktaśca tamasā soma evaṃ kṛtayugaṃ ca tat || 231.88 ||
arthavādaḥ paraṃ brahma vedārtha iti taṃ viduḥ  |
aviviktamavijñātaṃ dāyādyamiha dhāryate  || 231.89 ||
iṣṭavādastapo nāma tapo hi sthavirīkṛtaḥ  |
guṇaiḥ karmābhinirvṛttirguṇāḥ śudhyanti karmaṇā  || 231.90 ||
āśīstu puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā deśakālānuvartinī  |
yuge yuge yathākālamṛṣibhiḥ samudāhṛtā  || 231.91 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ devānāṃ ca pratikriyā  |
āśiṣaśca śivāḥ puṇyāstathaivāyuryuge yuge  || 231.92 ||
tathā yugānāṃ parivartanāni  231.93
cirapravṛttāni vidhisvabhāvāt 231.93
kṣaṇaṃ na saṃtiṣṭhati jīvalokaḥ  231.93
kṣayodayābhyāṃ parivartamānaḥ  231.93
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ trividhaḥ pratisaṃcaraḥ  |
naimittikaḥ prākṛtikastathaivātyantiko mataḥ  || 232.1 ||
brāhmo naimittikasteṣāṃ kalpānte pratisaṃcaraḥ  |
ātyantiko vai mokṣaśca prākṛto dviparārdhikaḥ  || 232.2 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
parārdhasaṃkhyāṃ bhagavaṃstvamācakṣva yathoditām  |
dviguṇīkṛtayajjñeyaḥ prākṛtaḥ pratisaṃcaraḥ  || 232.3 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sthānātsthānaṃ daśaguṇamekaikaṃ gaṇyate dvijāḥ  |
tato'ṣṭādaśame bhāge parārdhamabhidhīyate  || 232.4 ||
parārdhaṃ dviguṇaṃ yattu prākṛtaḥ sa layo dvijāḥ  |
tadāvyakte'khilaṃ vyaktaṃ sahetau layameti vai  || 232.5 ||
nimeṣo mānuṣo yo'yaṃ mātrāmātrapramāṇataḥ  |
taiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ kāṣṭhā triṃśatkāṣṭhāstathā kalā  || 232.6 ||
nāḍikā tu pramāṇena kalā ca daśa pañca ca  |
unmānenāmbhasaḥ sā tu palānyardhatrayodaśa  || 232.7 ||
hemamāṣaiḥ kṛtacchidrā caturbhiścaturaṅgulaiḥ  |
māgadhena pramāṇena jalaprasthastu sa smṛtaḥ  || 232.8 ||
nāḍikābhyāmatha dvābhyāṃ muhūrto dvijasattamāḥ  |
ahorātraṃ muhūrtāstu triṃśanmāso dinaistathā  || 232.9 ||
