māsairdvādaśabhirvarṣamahorātraṃ tu taddivi  |
tribhirvarṣaśatairvarṣaṃ ṣaṣṭyā caivāsuradviṣām  || 232.10 ||
taistu dvādaśasāhasraiścaturyugamudāhṛtam  |
caturyugasahasraṃ tu kathyate brahmaṇo dinam  || 232.11 ||
sa kalpastatra manavaścaturdaśa dvijottamāḥ  |
tadante caiva bho viprā brahmanaimittiko layaḥ  || 232.12 ||
tasya svarūpamatyugraṃ dvijendrā gadato mama  |
śṛṇudhvaṃ prākṛtaṃ bhūyastato vakṣyāmyahaṃ layam  || 232.13 ||
caturyugasahasrānte kṣīṇaprāye mahītale  |
anāvṛṣṭiratīvogrā jāyate śatavārṣikī  || 232.14 ||
tato yānyalpasārāṇi tāni sattvānyanekaśaḥ  |
kṣayaṃ yānti muniśreṣṭhāḥ pārthivānyatipīḍanāt || 232.15 ||
tataḥ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo rudrarūpī tathāvyayaḥ  |
kṣayāya yatate kartumātmasthāḥ sakalāḥ prajāḥ  || 232.16 ||
tataḥ sa bhagavān viṣṇurbhānoḥ saptasu raśmiṣu  |
sthitaḥ pibatyaśeṣāṇi jalāni munisattamāḥ  || 232.17 ||
pītvāmbhāṃsi samastāni prāṇibhūtagatāni vai  |
śoṣaṃ nayati bho viprāḥ samastaṃ pṛthivītalam  || 232.18 ||
samudrān saritaḥ śailāñśailaprasravaṇāni ca  |
pātāleṣu ca yattoyaṃ tatsarvaṃ nayati kṣayam  || 232.19 ||
tatastasyāpyabhāvena toyāhāropabṛṃhitāḥ  |
sahasraraśmayaḥ sapta jāyante tatra bhāskarāḥ  || 232.20 ||
adhaścordhvaṃ ca te dīptāstataḥ sapta divākarāḥ  |
dahantyaśeṣaṃ trailokyaṃ sapātālatalaṃ dvijāḥ  || 232.21 ||
dahyamānaṃ tu tairdīptaistrailokyaṃ dīptabhāskaraiḥ  |
sādrinagārṇavābhogaṃ niḥsnehamabhijāyate  || 232.22 ||
tato nirdagdhavṛkṣāmbu trailokyamakhilaṃ dvijāḥ  |
bhavatyeṣā ca vasudhā kūrmapṛṣṭhopamākṛtiḥ  || 232.23 ||
tataḥ kālāgnirudro'sau bhūtasargaharo haraḥ  |
śeṣāhiśvāsasaṃtāpātpātālāni dahatyadhaḥ  || 232.24 ||
pātālāni samastāni sa dagdhvā jvalano mahān  |
bhūmimabhyetya sakalaṃ dagdhvā tu vasudhātalam  || 232.25 ||
bhuvo lokaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ svargalokaṃ ca dāruṇaḥ  |
jvālāmālāmahāvartastatraiva parivartate  || 232.26 ||
ambarīṣamivābhāti trailokyamakhilaṃ tadā  |
jvālāvartaparīvāramupakṣīṇabalāstataḥ  || 232.27 ||
tatastāpaparītāstu lokadvayanivāsinaḥ  |
hṛtāvakāśā gacchanti maharlokaṃ dvijāstadā  || 232.28 ||
tasmādapi mahātāpa taptā lokāstataḥ param  |
gacchanti janalokaṃ te daśāvṛtyā paraiṣiṇaḥ  || 232.29 ||
tato dagdhvā jagatsarvaṃ rudrarūpī janārdanaḥ  |
mukhaniḥśvāsajānmeghān karoti munisattamāḥ  || 232.30 ||
tato gajakulaprakhyāstaḍidvanto ninādinaḥ  |
uttiṣṭhanti tadā vyomni ghorāḥ saṃvartakā ghanāḥ  || 232.31 ||
kecidañjanasaṃkāśāḥ kecitkumudasaṃnibhāḥ  |
dhūmavarṇā ghanāḥ kecitkecitpītāḥ payodharāḥ  || 232.32 ||
keciddharidrāvarṇābhā lākṣārasanibhāstathā  |
kecidvaidūryasaṃkāśā indranīlanibhāstathā  || 232.33 ||
śaṅkhakundanibhāścānye jātīkundanibhāstathā  |
indragopanibhāḥ kecinmanaḥśilānibhāstathā  || 232.34 ||
padmapattranibhāḥ keciduttiṣṭhanti ghanāghanāḥ  |
kecitpuravarākārāḥ kecitparvatasaṃnibhāḥ  || 232.35 ||
kūṭāgāranibhāścānye kecitsthalanibhā ghanāḥ  |
mahākāyā mahārāvā pūrayanti nabhastalam  || 232.36 ||
varṣantaste mahāsārāstamagnimatibhairavam  |
śamayantyakhilaṃ viprāstrailokyāntaravistṛtam  || 232.37 ||
naṣṭe cāgnau śataṃ te'pi varṣāṇāmadhikaṃ ghanāḥ  |
plāvayanto jagatsarvaṃ varṣanti munisattamāḥ  || 232.38 ||
dhārābhirakṣamātrābhiḥ plāvayitvākhilāṃ bhuvam  |
bhuvo lokaṃ tathaivordhvaṃ plāvayanti divaṃ dvijāḥ  || 232.39 ||
andhakārīkṛte loke naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame  |
varṣanti te mahāmeghā varṣāṇāmadhikaṃ śatam  || 232.40 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
saptarṣisthānamākramya sthite'mbhasi dvijottamāḥ  |
ekārṇavaṃ bhavatyetattrailokyamakhilaṃ tataḥ  || 233.1 ||
atha niḥśvāsajo viṣṇorvāyustāñjaladāṃstataḥ  |
nāśaṃ nayati bho viprā varṣāṇāmadhikaṃ śatam  || 233.2 ||
sarvabhūtamayo'cintyo bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ  |
anādirādirviśvasya pītvā vāyumaśeṣataḥ  || 233.3 ||
ekārṇave tatastasmiñśeṣaśayyāsthitaḥ prabhuḥ  |
brahmarūpadharaḥ śete bhagavānādikṛddhariḥ  || 233.4 ||
janalokagataiḥ siddhaiḥ sanakādyairabhiṣṭutaḥ  |
brahmalokagataiścaiva cintyamāno mumukṣubhiḥ  || 233.5 ||
ātmamāyāmayīṃ divyāṃ yoganidrāṃ samāsthitaḥ  |
ātmānaṃ vāsudevākhyaṃ cintayan parameśvaraḥ  || 233.6 ||
eṣa naimittiko nāma viprendrāḥ pratisaṃcaraḥ  |
nimittaṃ tatra yacchete brahmarūpadharo hariḥ  || 233.7 ||
yadā jāgarti sarvātmā sa tadā ceṣṭate jagat |
nimīlatyetadakhilaṃ māyāśayyāśaye'cyute  || 233.8 ||
padmayonerdinaṃ yattu caturyugasahasravat |
ekārṇavakṛte loke tāvatī rātrirucyate  || 233.9 ||
tataḥ prabuddho rātryante punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ karotyajaḥ  |
brahmasvarūpadhṛgviṣṇuryathā vaḥ kathitaṃ purā  || 233.10 ||
ityeṣa kalpasaṃhāro antarapralayo dvijāḥ  |
naimittiko vaḥ kathitaḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ prākṛtaṃ param  || 233.11 ||
avṛṣṭyagnyādibhiḥ samyakkṛte śayyālaye dvijāḥ  |
samasteṣveva lokeṣu pātāleṣvakhileṣu ca  || 233.12 ||
mahadādervikārasya viśeṣāttatra saṃkṣaye  |
kṛṣṇecchākārite tasmin pravṛtte pratisaṃcare  || 233.13 ||
āpo grasanti vai pūrvaṃ bhūmergandhādikaṃ guṇam  |
āttagandhā tato bhūmiḥ pralayāya prakalpate  || 233.14 ||
pranaṣṭe gandhatanmātre bhavatyurvī jalātmikā  |
āpastadā pravṛttāstu vegavatyo mahāsvanāḥ  || 233.15 ||
sarvamāpūrayantīdaṃ tiṣṭhanti vicaranti ca  |
salilenaivormimatā lokālokaḥ samantataḥ  || 233.16 ||
apāmapi guṇo yastu jyotiṣā pīyate tu saḥ  |
naśyantyāpaḥ sutaptāśca rasatanmātrasaṃkṣayāt || 233.17 ||
tataścāpo'mṛtarasā jyotiṣṭvaṃ prāpnuvanti vai  |
agnyavasthe tu salile tejasā sarvato vṛte  || 233.18 ||
sa cāgniḥ sarvato vyāpya ādatte tajjalaṃ tadā  |
sarvamāpūryato cābhistadā jagadidaṃ śanaiḥ  || 233.19 ||
arcibhiḥ saṃtate tasmiṃstiryagūrdhvamadhastathā  |
jyotiṣo'pi paraṃ rūpaṃ vāyuratti prabhākaram  || 233.20 ||
pralīne ca tatastasmin vāyubhūte'khilātmake  |
pranaṣṭe rūpatanmātre kṛtarūpo vibhāvasuḥ  || 233.21 ||
praśāmyati tadā jyotirvāyurdodhūyate mahān  |
nirāloke tadā loke vāyusaṃsthe ca tejasi  || 233.22 ||
tataḥ pralayamāsādya vāyusaṃbhavamātmanaḥ  |
ūrdhvaṃ ca vāyustiryakca dodhavīti diśo daśa  || 233.23 ||
vāyostvapi guṇaṃ sparśamākāśaṃ grasate tataḥ  |
praśāmyati tadā vāyuḥ khaṃ tu tiṣṭhatyanāvṛtam  || 233.24 ||
arūpamarasasparśamagandhavadamūrtimat |
sarvamāpūrayaccaiva sumahattatprakāśate  || 233.25 ||
parimaṇḍalatastattu ākāśaṃ śabdalakṣaṇam  |
śabdamātraṃ tathākāśaṃ sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati  || 233.26 ||
tataḥ śabdaguṇaṃ tasya bhūtādirgrasate punaḥ  |
bhūtendriyeṣu yugapadbhūtādau saṃsthiteṣu vai  || 233.27 ||
abhimānātmako hyeṣa bhūtādistāmasaḥ smṛtaḥ  |
bhūtādiṃ grasate cāpi mahābuddhirvicakṣaṇā  || 233.28 ||
urvī mahāṃśca jagataḥ prānte'ntarbāhyatastathā  |
evaṃ sapta mahābuddhiḥ kramātprakṛtayastathā  || 233.29 ||
pratyāhāraistu tāḥ sarvāḥ praviśanti parasparam  |
yenedamāvṛtaṃ sarvamaṇḍamapsu pralīyate  || 233.30 ||
saptadvīpasamudrāntaṃ saptalokaṃ saparvatam  |
udakāvaraṇaṃ hyatra jyotiṣā pīyate tu tat || 233.31 ||
jyotirvāyau layaṃ yāti yātyākāśe samīraṇaḥ  |
ākāśaṃ caiva bhūtādirgrasate taṃ tathā mahān  || 233.32 ||
mahāntamebhiḥ sahitaṃ prakṛtirgrasate dvijāḥ  |
guṇasāmyamanudriktamanyūnaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ  || 233.33 ||
procyate prakṛtirhetuḥ pradhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ param  |
ityeṣā prakṛtiḥ sarvā vyaktāvyaktasvarūpiṇī  || 233.34 ||
vyaktasvarūpamavyakte tasyāṃ viprāḥ pralīyate  |
ekaḥ śuddho'kṣaro nityaḥ sarvavyāpī tathā punaḥ  || 233.35 ||
so'pyaṃśaḥ sarvabhūtasya dvijendrāḥ paramātmanaḥ  |
naśyanti sarvā yatrāpi nāmajātyādikalpanāḥ  || 233.36 ||
sattāmātrātmake jñeye jñānātmanyātmanaḥ pare  |
sa brahma tatparaṃ dhāma paramātmā pareśvaraḥ  || 233.37 ||
sa viṣṇuḥ sarvamevedaṃ yato nāvartate punaḥ  |
prakṛtiryā mayākhyātā vyaktāvyaktasvarūpiṇī  || 233.38 ||
puruṣaścāpyubhāvetau līyete paramātmani  |
paramātmā ca sarveṣāmādhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ  || 233.39 ||
viṣṇunāmnā sa vedeṣu vedānteṣu ca gīyate  |
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma vaidikam  || 233.40 ||
tābhyāmubhābhyāṃ puruṣairyajñamūrtiḥ sa ijyate  |
ṛgyajuḥsāmabhirmārgaiḥ pravṛttairijyate hyasau  || 233.41 ||
yajñeśvaro yajñapumān puruṣaiḥ puruṣottamaḥ  |
jñānātmā jñānayogena jñānamūrtiḥ sa ijyate  || 233.42 ||
nivṛttairyogamārgaiśca viṣṇurmuktiphalapradaḥ  |
hrasvadīrghaplutairyattu kiṃcidvastvabhidhīyate  || 233.43 ||
yacca vācāmaviṣayastatsarvaṃ viṣṇuravyayaḥ  |
vyaktaḥ sa evamavyaktaḥ sa eva puruṣo'vyayaḥ  || 233.44 ||
paramātmā ca viśvātmā viśvarūpadharo hariḥ  |
vyaktāvyaktātmikā tasmin prakṛtiḥ sā vilīyate  || 233.45 ||
puruṣaścāpi bho viprā yastadavyākṛtātmani  |
dviparārdhātmakaḥ kālaḥ kathito yo mayā dvijāḥ  || 233.46 ||
tadahastasya viprendrā viṣṇorīśasya kathyate  |
vyakte tu prakṛtau līne prakṛtyāṃ puruṣe tathā  || 233.47 ||
tatrāsthite niśā tasya tatpramāṇā tapodhanāḥ  |
naivāhastasya ca niśā nityasya paramātmanaḥ  || 233.48 ||
upacārāttathāpyetattasyeśasya tu kathyate  |
ityeṣa muniśārdūlāḥ kathitaḥ prākṛto layaḥ  || 233.49 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
ādhyātmikādi bho viprā jñātvā tāpatrayaṃ budhaḥ  |
utpannajñānavairāgyaḥ prāpnotyātyantikaṃ layam  || 234.1 ||
ādhyātmiko'pi dvividhaḥ śārīro mānasastathā  |
śārīro bahubhirbhedairbhidyate śrūyatāṃ ca saḥ  || 234.2 ||
śirorogapratiśyāya jvaraśūlabhagaṃdaraiḥ  |
gulmārśaḥśvayathuśvāsa cchardyādibhiranekadhā  || 234.3 ||
tathākṣirogātīsāra kuṣṭhāṅgāmayasaṃjñakaiḥ  |
bhidyate dehajastāpo mānasaṃ śrotumarhatha  || 234.4 ||
kāmakrodhabhayadveṣa lobhamohaviṣādajaḥ  |
śokāsūyāvamānerṣyā mātsaryābhibhavastathā  || 234.5 ||
mānaso'pi dvijaśreṣṭhāstāpo bhavati naikadhā  |
ityevamādibhirbhedaistāpo hyādhyātmikaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 234.6 ||
mṛgapakṣimanuṣyādyaiḥ piśācoragarākṣasaiḥ  |
sarīsṛpādyaiśca nṛṇāṃ janyate cādhibhautikaḥ  || 234.7 ||
śītoṣṇavātavarṣāmbu vaidyutādisamudbhavaḥ  |
tāpo dvijavaraśreṣṭhāḥ kathyate cādhidaivikaḥ  || 234.8 ||
garbhajanmajarājñāna mṛtyunārakajaṃ tathā  |
duḥkhaṃ sahasraśo bhedairbhidyate munisattamāḥ  || 234.9 ||
sukumāratanurgarbhe janturbahumalāvṛte  |
ulbasaṃveṣṭito bhagna pṛṣṭhagrīvāsthisaṃhatiḥ  || 234.10 ||
atyamlakaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇa lavaṇairmātṛbhojanaiḥ  |
atitāpibhiratyarthaṃ bādhyamāno'tivedanaḥ  || 234.11 ||
prasāraṇākuñcanādau nāgānāṃ prabhurātmanaḥ  |
śakṛnmūtramahāpaṅka śāyī sarvatra pīḍitaḥ  || 234.12 ||
nirucchvāsaḥ sacaitanyaḥ smarañjanmaśatānyatha  |
āste garbhe'tiduḥkhena nijakarmanibandhanaḥ  || 234.13 ||
jāyamānaḥ purīṣāsṛṅmūtraśukrāvilānanaḥ  |
prājāpatyena vātena pīḍyamānāsthibandhanaḥ  || 234.14 ||
adhomukhastaiḥ kriyate prabalaiḥ sūtimārutaiḥ  |
kleśairniṣkrāntimāpnoti jaṭharānmāturāturaḥ  || 234.15 ||
mūrchāmavāpya mahatīṃ saṃspṛṣṭo bāhyavāyunā  |
vijñānabhraṃśamāpnoti jātastu munisattamāḥ  || 234.16 ||
kaṇṭakairiva tunnāṅgaḥ krakacairiva dāritaḥ  |
pūtivraṇānnipatito dharaṇyāṃ krimiko yathā  || 234.17 ||
kaṇḍūyane'pi cāśaktaḥ parivarte'pyanīśvaraḥ  |
stanapānādikāhāramavāpnoti parecchayā  || 234.18 ||
aśucisrastare suptaḥ kīṭadaṃśādibhistathā  |
bhakṣyamāṇo'pi naivaiṣāṃ samartho vinivāraṇe  || 234.19 ||
janmaduḥkhānyanekāni janmano'nantarāṇi ca  |
bālabhāve yadāpnoti ādhibhūtādikāni ca  || 234.20 ||
ajñānatamasā channo mūḍhāntaḥkaraṇo naraḥ  |
na jānāti kutaḥ ko'haṃ kutra gantā kimātmakaḥ  || 234.21 ||
kena bandhena baddho'haṃ kāraṇaṃ kimakāraṇam  |
kiṃ kāryaṃ kimakāryaṃ vā kiṃ vācyaṃ kiṃ na cocyate  || 234.22 ||
ko dharmaḥ kaśca vādharmaḥ kasmin varteta vai katham  |
kiṃ kartavyamakartavyaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ guṇadoṣavat || 234.23 ||
evaṃ paśusamairmūḍhairajñānaprabhavaṃ mahat |
avāpyate narairduḥkhaṃ śiśnodaraparāyaṇaiḥ  || 234.24 ||
ajñānaṃ tāmaso bhāvaḥ kāryārambhapravṛttayaḥ  |
ajñānināṃ pravartante karmalopastato dvijāḥ  || 234.25 ||
narakaṃ karmaṇāṃ lopātphalamāhurmaharṣayaḥ  |
tasmādajñānināṃ duḥkhamiha cāmutra cottamam  || 234.26 ||
jarājarjaradehaśca śithilāvayavaḥ pumān  |
vicalacchīrṇadaśano valisnāyuśirāvṛtaḥ  || 234.27 ||
dūrapranaṣṭanayano vyomāntargatatārakaḥ  |
nāsāvivaraniryāta romapuñjaścaladvapuḥ  || 234.28 ||
prakaṭībhūtasarvāsthirnatapṛṣṭhāsthisaṃhatiḥ  |
utsannajaṭharāgnitvādalpāhāro'lpaceṣṭitaḥ  || 234.29 ||
kṛcchracaṅkramaṇotthāna śayanāsanaceṣṭitaḥ  |
mandībhavacchrotranetra galallālāvilānanaḥ  || 234.30 ||
anāyattaiḥ samastaiśca karaṇairmaraṇonmukhaḥ  |
tatkṣaṇe'pyanubhūtānāmasmartākhilavastunām  || 234.31 ||
sakṛduccārite vākye samudbhūtamahāśramaḥ  |
śvāsakāsāmayāyāsa samudbhūtaprajāgaraḥ  || 234.32 ||
anyenotthāpyate'nyena tathā saṃveśyate jarī  |
bhṛtyātmaputradārāṇāmapamānaparākṛtaḥ  || 234.33 ||
prakṣīṇākhilaśaucaśca vihārāhārasaṃspṛhaḥ  |
hāsyaḥ parijanasyāpi nirviṇṇāśeṣabāndhavaḥ  || 234.34 ||
anubhūtamivānyasmiñjanmanyātmaviceṣṭitam  |
saṃsmaran yauvane dīrghaṃ niśvasityatitāpitaḥ  || 234.35 ||
evamādīni duḥkhāni jarāyāmanubhūya ca  |
maraṇe yāni duḥkhāni prāpnoti śṛṇu tānyapi  || 234.36 ||
ślathagrīvāṅghrihasto'tha prāpto vepathunā naraḥ  |
muhurglāniparaścāsau muhurjñānabalānvitaḥ  || 234.37 ||
hiraṇyadhānyatanaya bhāryābhṛtyagṛhādiṣu  |
ete kathaṃ bhaviṣyantītyatīva mamatākulaḥ  || 234.38 ||
marmavidbhirmahārogaiḥ krakacairiva dāruṇaiḥ  |
śarairivāntakasyograiśchidyamānāsthibandhanaḥ  || 234.39 ||
parivartamānatārākṣi hastapādaṃ muhuḥ kṣipan  |
saṃśuṣyamāṇatālvoṣṭha kaṇṭho ghuraghurāyate  || 234.40 ||
niruddhakaṇṭhadeśo'pi udānaśvāsapīḍitaḥ  |
tāpena mahatā vyāptastṛṣā vyāptastathā kṣudhā  || 234.41 ||
kleśādutkrāntimāpnoti yāmyakiṃkarapīḍitaḥ  |
tataśca yātanādehaṃ kleśena pratipadyate  || 234.42 ||
etānyanyāni cogrāṇi duḥkhāni maraṇe nṛṇām  |
śṛṇudhvaṃ narake yāni prāpyante puruṣairmṛtaiḥ  || 234.43 ||
yāmyakiṃkarapāśādi grahaṇaṃ daṇḍatāḍanam  |
yamasya darśanaṃ cogramugramārgavilokanam  || 234.44 ||
karambhavālukāvahni yantraśastrādibhīṣaṇe  |
pratyekaṃ yātanāyāśca yātanādi dvijottamāḥ  || 234.45 ||
krakacaiḥ pīḍyamānānāṃ mṛṣāyāṃ cāpi dhmāpyatām  |
kuṭhāraiḥ pāṭyamānānāṃ bhūmau cāpi nikhanyatām  || 234.46 ||
śūleṣvāropyamāṇānāṃ vyāghravaktre praveśyatām  |
gṛdhraiḥ saṃbhakṣyamāṇānāṃ dvīpibhiścopabhujyatām  || 234.47 ||
kvathyatāṃ tailamadhye ca klidyatāṃ kṣārakardame  |
uccānnipātyamānānāṃ kṣipyatāṃ kṣepayantrakaiḥ  || 234.48 ||
narake yāni duḥkhāni pāpahetūdbhavāni vai  |
prāpyante nārakairviprāsteṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate  || 234.49 ||
na kevalaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā narake duḥkhapaddhatiḥ  |
svarge'pi pātabhītasya kṣayiṣṇornāsti nirvṛtiḥ  || 234.50 ||
punaśca garbho bhavati jāyate ca punarnaraḥ  |
garbhe vilīyate bhūyo jāyamāno'stameti ca  || 234.51 ||
jātamātraśca mriyate bālabhāve ca yauvane  |
yadyatprītikaraṃ puṃsāṃ vastu viprāḥ prajāyate  || 234.52 ||
tadeva duḥkhavṛkṣasya bījatvamupagacchati  |
kalatraputramitrādi gṛhakṣetradhanādikaiḥ  || 234.53 ||
kriyate na tathā bhūri sukhaṃ puṃsāṃ yathāsukham  |
iti saṃsāraduḥkhārka tāpatāpitacetasām  || 234.54 ||
vimuktipādapacchāyāmṛte kutra sukhaṃ nṛṇām  |
tadasya trividhasyāpi duḥkhajātasya paṇḍitaiḥ  || 234.55 ||
garbhajanmajarādyeṣu sthāneṣu prabhaviṣyataḥ  |
nirastātiśayāhlādaṃ sukhabhāvaikalakṣaṇam  || 234.56 ||
bheṣajaṃ bhagavatprāptirekā cātyantikī matā  |
tasmāttatprāptaye yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ paṇḍitairnaraiḥ  || 234.57 ||
tatprāptiheturjñānaṃ ca karma coktaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
āgamotthaṃ vivekācca dvidhā jñānaṃ tathocyate  || 234.58 ||
śabdabrahmāgamamayaṃ paraṃ brahma vivekajam  |
andhaṃ tama ivājñānaṃ dīpavaccendriyodbhavam  || 234.59 ||
yathā sūryastathā jñānaṃ yadvai viprā vivekajam  |
manurapyāha vedārthaṃ smṛtvā yanmunisattamāḥ  || 234.60 ||
tadetacchrūyatāmatra saṃbandhe gadato mama  |
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat || 234.61 ||
śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati  |
dve vidye vai veditavye iti cātharvaṇī śrutiḥ  || 234.62 ||
parayā hyakṣaraprāptirṛgvedādimayāparā  |
yattadavyaktamajaramacintyamajamavyayam  || 234.63 ||
anirdeśyamarūpaṃ ca pāṇipādādyasaṃyutam  |
vittaṃ sarvagataṃ nityaṃ bhūtayonimakāraṇam  || 234.64 ||
vyāpyaṃ vyāptaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ tadvai paśyanti sūrayaḥ  |
tadbrahma paramaṃ dhāma taddheyaṃ mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ  || 234.65 ||
śrutivākyoditaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam  |
utpattiṃ pralayaṃ caiva bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim  || 234.66 ||
vetti vidyāmavidyāṃ ca sa vācyo bhagavāniti  |
jñānaśaktibalaiśvarya vīryatejāṃsyaśeṣataḥ  || 234.67 ||
bhagavacchabdavācyāni vinā heyairguṇādibhiḥ  |
sarvāṇi tatra bhūtāni nivasanti parātmani  || 234.68 ||
bhūteṣu ca sa sarvātmā vāsudevastataḥ smṛtaḥ  |
uvācedaṃ maharṣibhyaḥ purā pṛṣṭaḥ prajāpatiḥ  || 234.69 ||
nāmavyākhyāmanantasya vāsudevasya tattvataḥ  |
bhūteṣu vasate yo'ntarvasantyatra ca tāni yat |
dhātā vidhātā jagatāṃ vāsudevastataḥ prabhuḥ  || 234.70 ||
sa sarvabhūtaprakṛtirguṇāṃśca  234.71
doṣāṃśca sarvān saguṇo hyatītaḥ  234.71
atītasarvāvaraṇo'khilātmā  234.71
tenāvṛtaṃ yadbhuvanāntarālam  234.71
samastakalyāṇaguṇātmako hi  234.72
svaśaktileśādṛtabhūtasargaḥ  234.72
icchāgṛhītābhimatorudehaḥ  234.72
saṃsādhitāśeṣajagaddhito'sau  234.72
tejobalaiśvaryamahāvarodhaḥ  234.73
svavīryaśaktyādiguṇaikarāśiḥ  234.73
paraḥ parāṇāṃ sakalā na yatra  234.73
kleśādayaḥ santi parāpareśe  234.73
sa īśvaro vyaṣṭisamaṣṭirūpo  234.74
'vyaktasvarūpaḥ prakaṭasvarūpaḥ  234.74
sarveśvaraḥ sarvadṛksarvavettā  234.74
samastaśaktiḥ parameśvarākhyaḥ  234.74
saṃjñāyate yena tadastadoṣaṃ  234.75
śuddhaṃ paraṃ nirmalamekarūpam  234.75
saṃdṛśyate vāpyatha gamyate vā  234.75
tajjñānamajñānamato'nyaduktam  234.75
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
idānīṃ brūhi yogaṃ ca duḥkhasaṃyogabheṣajam  |
yaṃ viditvāvyayaṃ tatra yuñjāmaḥ puruṣottamam  || 235.1 ||
śrutvā sa vacanaṃ teṣāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastadā  |
abravītparamaprīto yogī yogavidāṃ varaḥ  || 235.2 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
yogaṃ vakṣyāmi bho viprāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ bhavanāśanam  |
yamabhyasyāpnuyādyogī mokṣaṃ paramadurlabham  || 235.3 ||
śrutvādau yogaśāstrāṇi gurumārādhya bhaktitaḥ  |
itihāsaṃ purāṇaṃ ca vedāṃścaiva vicakṣaṇaḥ  || 235.4 ||
āhāraṃ yogadoṣāṃśca deśakālaṃ ca buddhimān  |
jñātvā samabhyasedyogaṃ nirdvaṃdvo niṣparigrahaḥ  || 235.5 ||
bhuñjan saktuṃ yavāgūṃ ca takramūlaphalaṃ payaḥ  |
yāvakaṃ kaṇapiṇyākamāhāraṃ yogasādhanam  || 235.6 ||
na manovikale dhmāte na śrānte kṣudhite tathā  |
na dvaṃdve na ca śīte ca na coṣṇe nānilātmake  || 235.7 ||
saśabde na jalābhyāse jīrṇagoṣṭhe catuṣpathe  |
sarīsṛpe śmaśāne ca na nadyante'gnisaṃnidhau  || 235.8 ||
na caitye na ca valmīke sabhaye kūpasaṃnidhau  |
na śuṣkaparṇanicaye yogaṃ yuñjīta karhicit || 235.9 ||
deśānetānanādṛtya mūḍhatvādyo yunakti vai  |
pravakṣye tasya ye doṣā jāyante vighnakārakāḥ  || 235.10 ||
bādhiryaṃ jaḍatā lopaḥ smṛtermūkatvamandhatā  |
jvaraśca jāyate sadyastadvadajñānasaṃbhavaḥ  || 235.11 ||
tasmātsarvātmanā kāryā rakṣā yogavidā sadā  |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śarīraṃ sādhanaṃ yataḥ  || 235.12 ||
āśrame vijane guhye niḥśabde nirbhaye nage  |
śūnyāgāre śucau ramye caikānte devatālaye  || 235.13 ||
rajanyāḥ paścime yāme pūrve ca susamāhitaḥ  |
pūrvāhṇe madhyame cāhni yuktāhāro jitendriyaḥ  || 235.14 ||
āsīnaḥ prāṅmukho ramya āsane sukhaniścale  |
nātinīce na cocchrite niḥspṛhaḥ satyavākśuciḥ  || 235.15 ||
yuktanidro jitakrodhaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ  |
sarvadvaṃdvasaho dhīraḥ samakāyāṅghrimastakaḥ  || 235.16 ||
nābhau nidhāya hastau dvau śāntaḥ padmāsane sthitaḥ  |
saṃsthāpya dṛṣṭiṃ nāsāgre prāṇānāyamya vāgyataḥ  || 235.17 ||
samāhṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ manasā hṛdaye muniḥ  |
praṇavaṃ dīrghamudyamya saṃvṛtāsyaḥ suniścalaḥ  || 235.18 ||
rajasā tamaso vṛttiṃ sattvena rajasastathā  |
saṃchādya nirmale śānte sthitaḥ saṃvṛtalocanaḥ  || 235.19 ||
hṛtpadmakoṭare līnaṃ sarvavyāpi nirañjanam  |
yuñjīta satataṃ yogī muktidaṃ puruṣottamam  || 235.20 ||
karaṇendriyabhūtāni kṣetrajñe prathamaṃ nyaset |
kṣetrajñaśca pare yojyastato yuñjati yogavit || 235.21 ||
mano yasyāntamabhyeti paramātmani cañcalam  |
saṃtyajya viṣayāṃstasya yogasiddhiḥ prakāśitā  || 235.22 ||
yadā nirviṣayaṃ cittaṃ pare brahmaṇi līyate  |
samādhau yogayuktasya tadābhyeti paraṃ padam  || 235.23 ||
asaṃsaktaṃ yadā cittaṃ yoginaḥ sarvakarmasu  |
bhavatyānandamāsādya tadā nirvāṇamṛcchati  || 235.24 ||
śuddhaṃ dhāmatrayātītaṃ turyākhyaṃ puruṣottamam  |
prāpya yogabalādyogī mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 235.25 ||
niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyaḥ sarvatra priyadarśanaḥ  |
sarvatrānityabuddhistu yogī mucyeta nānyathā  || 235.26 ||
indriyāṇi na seveta vairāgyeṇa ca yogavit |
sadā cābhyāsayogena mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 235.27 ||
na ca padmāsanādyogo na nāsāgranirīkṣaṇāt |
manasaścendriyāṇāṃ ca saṃyogo yoga ucyate  || 235.28 ||
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhā yogaḥ prokto vimuktidaḥ  |
saṃsāramokṣahetuśca kimanyacchrotumicchatha  || 235.29 ||
{lomaharṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
śrutvā te vacanaṃ tasya sādhu sādhviti cābruvan  |
vyāsaṃ praśasya saṃpūjya punaḥ praṣṭuṃ samudyatāḥ  || 235.30 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
tava vaktrābdhisaṃbhūtamamṛtaṃ vāṅmayaṃ mune  |
pibatāṃ no dvijaśreṣṭha na tṛptiriha dṛśyate  || 236.1 ||
tasmādyogaṃ mune brūhi vistareṇa vimuktidam  |
sāṃkhyaṃ ca dvipadāṃ śreṣṭha śrotumicchāmahe vayam  || 236.2 ||
prajñāvāñśrotriyo yajvā khyātaḥ prājño'nasūyakaḥ  |
satyadharmamatirbrahman kathaṃ brahmādhigacchati  || 236.3 ||
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa sarvatyāgena medhayā  |
sāṃkhye vā yadi vā yoga etatpṛṣṭo vadasva naḥ  || 236.4 ||
manasaścendriyāṇāṃ ca yathaikāgryamavāpyate  |
yenopāyena puruṣastattvaṃ vyākhyātumarhasi  || 236.5 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
nānyatra jñānatapasornānyatrendriyanigrahāt |
nānyatra sarvasaṃtyāgātsiddhiṃ vindati kaścana  || 236.6 ||
mahābhūtāni sarvāṇi pūrvasṛṣṭiḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ  |
bhūyiṣṭhaṃ prāṇabhṛdgrāme niviṣṭāni śarīriṣu  || 236.7 ||
bhūmerdeho jalātsneho jyotiṣaścakṣuṣī smṛte  |
prāṇāpānāśrayo vāyuḥ koṣṭhāākāśaṃ śarīriṇām  || 236.8 ||
krāntau viṣṇurbale śakraḥ koṣṭhe'gnirbhoktumicchati  |
karṇayoḥ pradiśaḥ śrotre jihvāyāṃ vāksarasvatī  || 236.9 ||
karṇau tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī  |
daśa tānīndriyoktāni dvārāṇyāhārasiddhaye  || 236.10 ||
śabdasparśau tathā rūpaṃ rasaṃ gandhaṃ ca pañcamam  |
indriyārthān pṛthagvidyādindriyebhyastu nityadā  || 236.11 ||
indriyāṇi mano yuṅkte avaśyāniva rājinaḥ  |
manaścāpi sadā yuṅkte bhūtātmā hṛdayāśritaḥ  || 236.12 ||
indriyāṇāṃ tathaivaiṣāṃ sarveṣāmīśvaraṃ manaḥ  |
niyame ca visarge ca bhūtātmā manasastathā  || 236.13 ||
indriyāṇīndriyārthāśca svabhāvaścetanā manaḥ  |
prāṇāpānau ca jīvaśca nityaṃ deheṣu dehinām  || 236.14 ||
āśrayo nāsti sattvasya guṇaśabdo na cetanāḥ  |
sattvaṃ hi tejaḥ sṛjati na guṇān vai kathaṃcana  || 236.15 ||
evaṃ saptadaśaṃ dehaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirguṇaiḥ  |
manīṣī manasā viprāḥ paśyatyātmānamātmani  || 236.16 ||
na hyayaṃ cakṣuṣā dṛśyo na ca sarvairapīndriyaiḥ  |
manasā tu pradīptena mahānātmā prakāśate  || 236.17 ||
aśabdasparśarūpaṃ taccārasāgandhamavyayam  |
aśarīraṃ śarīre sve nirīkṣeta nirindriyam  || 236.18 ||
avyaktaṃ sarvadeheṣu martyeṣu paramārcitam  |
yo'nupaśyati sa pretya kalpate brahmabhūyataḥ  || 236.19 ||
vidyāvinayasaṃpanna brāhmaṇe gavi hastini  |
śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ  || 236.20 ||
sa hi sarveṣu bhūteṣu jaṅgameṣu dhruveṣu ca  |
vasatyeko mahānātmā yena sarvamidaṃ tatam  || 236.21 ||
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani  |
yadā paśyati bhūtātmā brahma saṃpadyate tadā  || 236.22 ||
yāvānātmani vedātmā tāvānātmā parātmani  |
ya evaṃ satataṃ veda so'mṛtatvāya kalpate  || 236.23 ||
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya sarvabhūtahitasya ca  |
devāpi mārge muhyanti apadasya padaiṣiṇaḥ  || 236.24 ||
śakuntānāmivākāśe matsyānāmiva codake  |
yathā gatirna dṛśyeta tathā jñānavidāṃ gatiḥ  || 236.25 ||
kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni sarvāṇyevātmanātmani  |
yasmiṃstu pacyate kālastanna vedeha kaścana  || 236.26 ||
na tadūrdhvaṃ na tiryakca nādho na ca punaḥ punaḥ  |
na madhye pratigṛhṇīte naiva kiṃcinna kaścana  || 236.27 ||
sarve tatsthā ime lokā bāhyameṣāṃ na kiṃcana  |
yadyapyagre samāgacchedyathā bāṇo guṇacyutaḥ  || 236.28 ||
naivāntaṃ kāraṇasyeyādyadyapi syānmanojavaḥ  |
tasmātsūkṣmataraṃ nāsti nāsti sthūlataraṃ tathā  || 236.29 ||
sarvataḥpāṇipādaṃ tatsarvatokṣiśiromukham  |
sarvataḥśrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati  || 236.30 ||
tadevāṇoraṇutaraṃ tanmahadbhyo mahattaram  |
tadantaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhanna dṛśyate  || 236.31 ||
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva dvedhā bhāvo'yamātmanaḥ  |
kṣaraḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu divyaṃ tvamṛtamakṣaram  || 236.32 ||
navadvāraṃ puraṃ kṛtvā haṃso hi niyato vaśī  |
īdṛśaḥ sarvabhūtasya sthāvarasya carasya ca  || 236.33 ||
hānenābhivikalpānāṃ narāṇāṃ saṃcayena ca  |
śarīrāṇāmajasyāhurhaṃsatvaṃ pāradarśinaḥ  || 236.34 ||
haṃsoktaṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva kūṭasthaṃ yattadakṣaram  |
tadvidvānakṣaraṃ prāpya jahāti prāṇajanmanī  || 236.35 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
bhavatāṃ pṛcchatāṃ viprā yathāvadiha tattvataḥ  |
sāṃkhyaṃ jñānena saṃyuktaṃ yadetatkīrtitaṃ mayā  || 236.36 ||
yogakṛtyaṃ tu bho viprāḥ kīrtayiṣyāmyataḥ param  |
ekatvaṃ buddhimanasorindriyāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ  || 236.37 ||
ātmano vyāpino jñānaṃ jñānametadanuttamam  |
tadetadupaśāntena dāntenādhyātmaśīlinā  || 236.38 ||
ātmārāmeṇa buddhena boddhavyaṃ śucikarmaṇā  |
yogadoṣān samucchidya pañca yān kavayo viduḥ  || 236.39 ||
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam  |
krodhaṃ śamena jayati kāmaṃ saṃkalpavarjanāt || 236.40 ||
sattvasaṃsevanāddhīro nidrāmucchettumarhati  |
dhṛtyā śiśnodaraṃ rakṣetpāṇipādaṃ ca cakṣuṣā  || 236.41 ||
cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ca manasā mano vācaṃ ca karmaṇā  |
apramādādbhayaṃ jahyāddambhaṃ prājñopasevanāt || 236.42 ||
evametān yogadoṣāñjayennityamatandritaḥ  |
agnīṃśca brāhmaṇāṃścātha devatāḥ praṇametsadā  || 236.43 ||
varjayeduddhatāṃ vācaṃ hiṃsāyuktāṃ manonugām  |
brahmatejomayaṃ śukraṃ yasya sarvamidaṃ jagat || 236.44 ||
etasya bhūtabhūtasya dṛṣṭaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam  |
dhyānamadhyayanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ hrīrārjavaṃ kṣamā  || 236.45 ||
śaucaṃ caivātmanaḥ śuddhirindriyāṇāṃ ca nigrahaḥ  |
etairvivardhate tejaḥ pāpmānaṃ cāpakarṣati  || 236.46 ||
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu labhyālabhyena vartayan  |
dhūtapāpmā tu tejasvī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ  || 236.47 ||
kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā niṣevedbrahmaṇaḥ padam  |
manasaścendriyāṇāṃ ca kṛtvaikāgryaṃ samāhitaḥ  || 236.48 ||
pūrvarātre parārdhe ca dhārayenmana ātmanaḥ  |
jantoḥ pañcendriyasyāsya yadyekaṃ klinnamindriyam  || 236.49 ||
tato'sya sravati prajñā gireḥ pādādivodakam  |
manasaḥ pūrvamādadyātkūrmāṇāmiva matsyahā  || 236.50 ||
tataḥ śrotraṃ tataścakṣurjihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca yogavit |
tata etāni saṃyamya manasi sthāpayedyadi  || 236.51 ||
tathaivāpohya saṃkalpānmano hyātmani dhārayet |
pañcendriyāṇi manasi hṛdi saṃsthāpayedyadi  || 236.52 ||
yadaitānyavatiṣṭhante manaḥṣaṣṭhāni cātmani  |
prasīdanti ca saṃsthāyāṃ tadā brahma prakāśate  || 236.53 ||
vidhūma iva dīptārcirāditya iva dīptimān  |
vaidyuto'gnirivākāśe paśyantyātmānamātmani  || 236.54 ||
sarvaṃ tatra tu sarvatra vyāpakatvācca dṛśyate  |
taṃ paśyanti mahātmāno brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ  || 236.55 ||
dhṛtimanto mahāprājñāḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ  |
evaṃ parimitaṃ kālamācaran saṃśitavrataḥ  || 236.56 ||
āsīno hi rahasyeko gacchedakṣarasāmyatām  |
pramoho bhrama āvarto ghrāṇaṃ śravaṇadarśane  || 236.57 ||
adbhutāni rasaḥ sparśaḥ śītoṣṇamārutākṛtiḥ  |
pratibhānupasargāśca pratisaṃgṛhya yogataḥ  || 236.58 ||
tāṃstattvavidanādṛtya sāmyenaiva nivartayet |
kuryātparicayaṃ yoge trailokye niyato muniḥ  || 236.59 ||
giriśṛṅge tathā caitye vṛkṣamūleṣu yojayet |
saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ koṣṭhe bhāṇḍamanā iva  || 236.60 ||
ekāgraṃ cintayennityaṃ yogānnodvijate manaḥ  |
yenopāyena śakyeta niyantuṃ cañcalaṃ manaḥ  || 236.61 ||
tatra yukto niṣeveta na caiva vicalettataḥ  |
śūnyāgārāṇi caikāgro nivāsārthamupakramet || 236.62 ||
nātivrajetparaṃ vācā karmaṇā manasāpi vā  |
upekṣako yatāhāro labdhālabdhasamo bhavet || 236.63 ||
yaścainamabhinandeta yaścainamabhivādayet |
samastayoścāpyubhayornābhidhyāyecchubhāśubham  || 236.64 ||
na prahṛṣyeta lābheṣu nālābheṣu ca cintayet |
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu sadharmā mātariśvanaḥ  || 236.65 ||
evaṃ svasthātmanaḥ sādhoḥ sarvatra samadarśinaḥ  |
ṣaṇmāsānnityayuktasya śabdabrahmābhivartate  || 236.66 ||
vedanārtān parān dṛṣṭvā samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ  |
evaṃ tu nirato mārgaṃ viramenna vimohitaḥ  || 236.67 ||
api varṇāvakṛṣṭastu nārī vā dharmakāṅkṣiṇī  |
tāvapyetena mārgeṇa gacchetāṃ paramāṃ gatim  || 236.68 ||
ajaṃ purāṇamajaraṃ sanātanaṃ  236.69
yamindriyātigamagocaraṃ dvijāḥ  236.69
avekṣya cemāṃ parameṣṭhisāmyatāṃ  236.69
prayāntyanāvṛttigatiṃ manīṣiṇaḥ  236.69
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
yadyevaṃ vedavacanaṃ kuru karma tyajeti ca  |
kāṃ diśaṃ vidyayā yānti kāṃ ca gacchanti karmaṇā  || 237.1 ||
etadvai śrotumicchāmastadbhavān prabravītu naḥ  |
etadanyonyavairūpyaṃ vartate pratikūlataḥ  || 237.2 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ muniśārdūlā yatpṛcchadhvaṃ samāsataḥ  |
karmavidyāmayau cobhau vyākhyāsyāmi kṣarākṣarau  || 237.3 ||
yāṃ diśaṃ vidyayā yānti yāṃ gacchanti ca karmaṇā  |
śṛṇudhvaṃ sāṃprataṃ viprā gahanaṃ hyetaduttaram  || 237.4 ||
asti dharma iti yuktaṃ nāsti tatraiva yo vadet |
yakṣasya sādṛśyamidaṃ yakṣasyedaṃ bhavedatha  || 237.5 ||
dvāvimāvatha panthānau yatra vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ  |
pravṛttilakṣaṇo dharmo nivṛtto vā vibhāṣitaḥ  || 237.6 ||
karmaṇā badhyate janturvidyayā ca vimucyate  |
tasmātkarma na kurvanti yatayaḥ pāradarśinaḥ  || 237.7 ||
karmaṇā jāyate pretya mūrtimān ṣoḍaśātmakaḥ  |
vidyayā jāyate nityamavyaktaṃ hyakṣarātmakam  || 237.8 ||
karma tveke praśaṃsanti svalpabuddhiratā narāḥ  |
tena te dehajālena ramayanta upāsate  || 237.9 ||
ye tu buddhiṃ parāṃ prāptā dharmanaipuṇyadarśinaḥ  |
na te karma praśaṃsanti kūpaṃ nadyāṃ pibanniva  || 237.10 ||
karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti sukhaduḥkhe bhavābhavau  |
vidyayā tadavāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati  || 237.11 ||
na mriyate yatra gatvā yatra gatvā na jāyate  |
na jīryate yatra gatvā yatra gatvā na vardhate  || 237.12 ||
yatra tadbrahma paramamavyaktamacalaṃ dhruvam  |
avyākṛtamanāyāmamamṛtaṃ cādhiyogavit || 237.13 ||
dvaṃdvairna yatra bādhyante mānasena ca karmaṇā  |
samāḥ sarvatra maitrāśca sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ  || 237.14 ||
vidyāmayo'nyaḥ puruṣo dvijāḥ karmamayo'paraḥ  |
viprāścandrasamasparśaḥ sūkṣmayā kalayā sthitaḥ  || 237.15 ||
tadetadṛṣiṇā proktaṃ vistareṇānugīyate  |
na vaktuṃ śakyate draṣṭuṃ cakratantumivāmbare  || 237.16 ||
ekādaśavikārātmā kalāsaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ  |
mūrtimāniti taṃ vidyādviprāḥ karmaguṇātmakam  || 237.17 ||
devo yaḥ saṃśritastasmin buddhīnduriva puṣkare  |
kṣetrajñaṃ taṃ vijānīyānnityaṃ yogajitātmakam  || 237.18 ||
tamo rajaśca sattvaṃ ca jñeyaṃ jīvaguṇātmakam  |
jīvamātmaguṇaṃ vidyādātmānaṃ paramātmanaḥ  || 237.19 ||
sacetanaṃ jīvaguṇaṃ vadanti  237.20
sa ceṣṭate jīvaguṇaṃ ca sarvam  237.20
tataḥ paraṃ kṣetravido vadanti  237.20
prakalpayanto bhuvanāni sapta  237.20
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
prakṛtyāstu vikārā ye kṣetrajñāste pariśrutāḥ  |
te cainaṃ na prajānanti na jānāti sa tānapi  || 237.21 ||
taiścaiva kurute kāryaṃ manaḥṣaṣṭhairihendriyaiḥ  |
sudāntairiva saṃyantā dṛḍhaḥ paramavājibhiḥ  || 237.22 ||
indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaḥ paramaṃ manaḥ  |
manasastu parā buddhirbuddherātmā mahān paraḥ  || 237.23 ||
mahataḥ paramavyaktamavyaktātparato'mṛtam  |
amṛtānna paraṃ kiṃcitsā kāṣṭhā paramā gatiḥ  || 237.24 ||
evaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu gūḍhātmā na prakāśate  |
dṛśyate tvagryayā buddhyā sūkṣmayā sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ  || 237.25 ||
antarātmani saṃlīya manaḥṣaṣṭhāni medhayā  |
indriyairindriyārthāṃśca bahucittamacintayan  || 237.26 ||
dhyāne'pi paramaṃ kṛtvā vidyāsaṃpāditaṃ manaḥ  |
anīśvaraḥ praśāntātmā tato gacchetparaṃ padam  || 237.27 ||
indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vaśyātmā calitasmṛtiḥ  |
ātmanaḥ saṃpradānena martyo mṛtyumupāśnute  || 237.28 ||
vihatya sarvasaṃkalpān sattve cittaṃ niveśayet |
sattve cittaṃ samāveśya tataḥ kālañjaro bhavet || 237.29 ||
cittaprasādena yatirjahātīha śubhāśubham  |
prasannātmātmani sthitvā sukhamatyantamaśnute  || 237.30 ||
lakṣaṇaṃ tu prasādasya yathā svapne sukhaṃ bhavet |
nirvāte vā yathā dīpo dīpyamāno na kampate  || 237.31 ||
evaṃ pūrvāpare rātre yuñjannātmānamātmanā  |
laghvāhāro viśuddhātmā paśyatyātmānamātmani  || 237.32 ||
rahasyaṃ sarvavedānāmanaitihyamanāgamam  |
ātmapratyāyakaṃ śāstramidaṃ putrānuśāsanam  || 237.33 ||
dharmākhyāneṣu sarveṣu satyākhyāneṣu yadvasu  |
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi nirmathyāmṛtamuddhṛtam  || 237.34 ||
navanītaṃ yathā dadhnaḥ kāṣṭhādagniryathaiva ca  |
tathaiva viduṣāṃ jñānaṃ muktihetoḥ samuddhṛtam  || 237.35 ||
snātakānāmidaṃ śāstraṃ vācyaṃ putrānuśāsanam  |
tadidaṃ nāpraśāntāya nādāntāya tapasvine  || 237.36 ||
nāvedaviduṣe vācyaṃ tathā nānugatāya ca  |
nāsūyakāyānṛjave na cānirdiṣṭakāriṇe  || 237.37 ||
na tarkaśāstradagdhāya tathaiva piśunāya ca  |
ślāghine ślāghanīyāya praśāntāya tapasvine  || 237.38 ||
idaṃ priyāya putrāya śiṣyāyānugatāya tu  |
rahasyadharmaṃ vaktavyaṃ nānyasmai tu kathaṃcana  || 237.39 ||
yadapyasya mahīṃ dadyādratnapūrṇāmimāṃ naraḥ  |
idameva tataḥ śreya iti manyeta tattvavit || 237.40 ||
ato guhyatarārthaṃ tadadhyātmamatimānuṣam  |
yattanmaharṣibhirdṛṣṭaṃ vedānteṣu ca gīyate  || 237.41 ||
tadyuṣmabhyaṃ prayacchāmi yanmāṃ pṛcchata sattamāḥ  |
yanme manasi varteta yastu vo hṛdi saṃśayaḥ  |
śrutaṃ bhavadbhistatsarvaṃ kimanyatkathayāmi vaḥ  || 237.42 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
adhyātmaṃ vistareṇeha punareva vadasva naḥ  |
yadadhyātmaṃ yathā vidmo bhagavannṛṣisattama  || 237.43 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
adhyātmaṃ yadidaṃ viprāḥ puruṣasyeha paṭhyate  |
yuṣmabhyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tasya vyākhyāvadhāryatām  || 237.44 ||
bhūmirāpastathā jyotirvāyurākāśameva ca  |
mahābhūtāni yaścaiva sarvabhūteṣu bhūtakṛt || 237.45 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
ākāraṃ tu bhavedyasya yasmin dehaṃ na paśyati  |
ākāśādyaṃ śarīreṣu kathaṃ tadupavarṇayet |
indriyāṇāṃ guṇāḥ kecitkathaṃ tānupalakṣayet || 237.46 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
etadvo varṇayiṣyāmi yathāvadanudarśanam  |
śṛṇudhvaṃ tadihaikāgryā yathātattvaṃ yathā ca tat || 237.47 ||
śabdaḥ śrotraṃ tathā khāni trayamākāśalakṣaṇam  |
prāṇaśceṣṭā tathā sparśa ete vāyuguṇāstrayaḥ  || 237.48 ||
rūpaṃ cakṣurvipākaśca tridhā jyotirvidhīyate  |
raso'tha rasanaṃ svedo guṇāstvete trayo'mbhasām  || 237.49 ||
ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca bhūmerete guṇāstrayaḥ  |
etāvānindriyagrāmo vyākhyātaḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ  || 237.50 ||
vāyoḥ sparśo raso'dbhyaśca jyotiṣo rūpamucyate  |
ākāśaprabhavaḥ śabdo gandho bhūmiguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 237.51 ||
mano buddhiḥ svabhāvaśca guṇā ete svayonijāḥ  |
te guṇānativartante guṇebhyaḥ paramā matāḥ  || 237.52 ||
yathā kūrma ivāṅgāni prasārya saṃniyacchati  |
evamevendriyagrāmaṃ buddhiśreṣṭho niyacchati  || 237.53 ||
yadūrdhvaṃ pādatalayoravārkordhvaṃ ca paśyati  |
etasminneva kṛtye sā vartate buddhiruttamā  || 237.54 ||
guṇaistu nīyate buddhirbuddhirevendriyāṇyapi  |
manaḥṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyā bhāvātkuto guṇāḥ  || 237.55 ||
indriyāṇi naraiḥ pañca ṣaṣṭhaṃ tanmana ucyate  |
saptamīṃ buddhimevāhuḥ kṣetrajñaṃ viddhi cāṣṭamam  || 237.56 ||
cakṣurālokanāyaiva saṃśayaṃ kurute manaḥ  |
buddhiradhyavasānāya sākṣī kṣetrajña ucyate  || 237.57 ||
rajastamaśca sattvaṃ ca traya ete svayonijāḥ  |
samāḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tān guṇānupalakṣayet || 237.58 ||
tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcidātmani lakṣayet |
praśāntamiva saṃyuktaṃ sattvaṃ tadupadhārayet || 237.59 ||
yattu saṃtāpasaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet |
pravṛttaṃ raja ityevaṃ tatra cāpyupalakṣayet || 237.60 ||
yattu saṃmohasaṃyuktamavyaktaṃ viṣamaṃ bhavet |
apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ tamastadupadhārayet || 237.61 ||
praharṣaḥ prītirānandaṃ svāmyaṃ svasthātmacittatā  |
akasmādyadi vā kasmādvadanti sāttvikān guṇān  || 237.62 ||
abhimāno mṛṣāvādo lobho mohastathākṣamā  |
liṅgāni rajasastāni vartante hetutattvataḥ  || 237.63 ||
tathā mohaḥ pramādaśca tandrī nidrāprabodhitā  |
kathaṃcidabhivartante vijñeyāstāmasā guṇāḥ  || 237.64 ||
manaḥ prasṛjate bhāvaṃ buddhiradhyavasāyinī  |
hṛdayaṃ priyameveha trividhā karmacodanā  || 237.65 ||
indriyebhyaḥ parā hyarthā arthebhyaśca paraṃ manaḥ  |
manasastu parā buddhirbuddherātmā paraḥ smṛtaḥ  || 237.66 ||
buddhirātmā manuṣyasya buddhirevātmanāyikā  |
yadā vikurute bhāvaṃ tadā bhavati sā manaḥ  || 237.67 ||
indriyāṇāṃ pṛthagbhāvādbuddhirvikurute hyanu  |
śṛṇvatī bhavati śrotraṃ spṛśatī sparśa ucyate  || 237.68 ||
paśyantī ca bhaveddṛṣṭī rasantī rasanā bhavet |
jighrantī bhavati ghrāṇaṃ buddhirvikurute pṛthak || 237.69 ||
indriyāṇi tu tānyāhusteṣāṃ vṛttyā vitiṣṭhati  |
tiṣṭhati puruṣe buddhirbuddhibhāvavyavasthitā  || 237.70 ||
kadācillabhate prītiṃ kadācidapi śocati  |
na sukhena ca duḥkhena kadācidiha muhyate  || 237.71 ||
svayaṃ bhāvātmikā bhāvāṃstrīnetānativartate  |
saritāṃ sāgaro bhartā mahāvelāmivormimān  || 237.72 ||
yadā prārthayate kiṃcittadā bhavati sā manaḥ  |
adhiṣṭhāne ca vai buddhyā pṛthagetāni saṃsmaret || 237.73 ||
indriyāṇi ca medhyāni vicetavyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ  |
sarvāṇyevānupūrveṇa yadyadā ca vidhīyate  || 237.74 ||
avibhāgamanā buddhirbhāvo manasi vartate  |
pravartamānastu rajaḥ sattvamapyativartate  || 237.75 ||
ye vai bhāvena vartante sarveṣveteṣu te triṣu  |
anvarthān saṃpravartante rathanemimarā iva  || 237.76 ||
pradīpārthaṃ manaḥ kuryādindriyairbuddhisattamaiḥ  |
niścaradbhiryathāyogamudāsīnairyadṛcchayā  || 237.77 ||
evaṃsvabhāvamevedamiti buddhvā na muhyati  |
aśocan saṃprahṛṣyaṃśca nityaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ  || 237.78 ||
na hyātmā śakyate draṣṭumindriyaiḥ kāmagocaraiḥ  |
pravartamānairanekairdurdharairakṛtātmabhiḥ  || 237.79 ||
teṣāṃ tu manasā raśmīn yadā samyaṅniyacchati  |
tadā prakāśate śyātmā dīpadīptā yathākṛtiḥ  || 237.80 ||
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ tamasyupagate yathā  |
prakāśaṃ bhavate sarvaṃ tathaivamupadhāryatām  || 237.81 ||
yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī na lipyati jale caran  |
vimuktātmā tathā yogī guṇadoṣairna lipyate  || 237.82 ||
evameva kṛtaprajño na doṣairviṣayāṃścaran  |
asajjamānaḥ sarveṣu na kathaṃcitpralipyate  || 237.83 ||
tyaktvā pūrvakṛtaṃ karma ratiryasya sadātmani  |
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya guṇasaṅgena sajjataḥ  || 237.84 ||
svayamātmā prasavati guṇeṣvapi kadācana  |
na guṇā vidurātmānaṃ guṇān veda sa sarvadā  || 237.85 ||
paridadhyādguṇānāṃ sa draṣṭā caiva yathātatham  |
sattvakṣetrajñayorevamantaraṃ lakṣayennaraḥ  || 237.86 ||
sṛjate tu guṇāneka eko na sṛjate guṇān  |
pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyaitau saṃprayuktau ca sarvadā  || 237.87 ||
yathāśmanā hiraṇyasya saṃprayuktau tathaiva tau  |
maśakodumbarau vāpi saṃprayuktau yathā saha  || 237.88 ||
iṣikā vā yathā muñje pṛthakca saha caiva ha  |
tathaiva sahitāvetau anyonyasmin pratiṣṭhitau  || 237.89 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sṛjate tu guṇān sattvaṃ kṣetrajñastvadhitiṣṭhati  |
guṇān vikriyataḥ sarvānudāsīnavadīśvaraḥ  || 238.1 ||
svabhāvayuktaṃ tatsarvaṃ yadimān sṛjate guṇān  |
ūrṇanābhiryathā sūtraṃ sṛjate tadguṇāṃstathā  || 238.2 ||
pravṛttā na nivartante pravṛttirnopalabhyate  |
evameke vyavasyanti nivṛttimiti cāpare  || 238.3 ||
ubhayaṃ saṃpradhāryaitadadhyavasyedyathāmati  |
anenaiva vidhānena bhavedvai saṃśayo mahān  || 238.4 ||
anādinidhano hyātmā taṃ buddhvā viharennaraḥ  |
akrudhyannaprahṛṣyaṃśca nityaṃ vigatamatsaraḥ  || 238.5 ||
ityevaṃ hṛdaye sarvo buddhicintāmayaṃ dṛḍham  |
anityaṃ sukhamāsīnamaśocyaṃ chinnasaṃśayaḥ  || 238.6 ||
tarayetpracyutāṃ pṛthvīṃ yathā pūrṇāṃ nadīṃ narāḥ  |
avagāhya ca vidvāṃso viprā lolamimaṃ tathā  || 238.7 ||
na tu tapyati vai vidvān sthale carati tattvavit |
evaṃ vicintya cātmānaṃ kevalaṃ jñānamātmanaḥ  || 238.8 ||
tāṃ tu buddhvā naraḥ sargaṃ bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim  |
samaceṣṭaśca vai samyaglabhate śamamuttamam  || 238.9 ||
etaddvijanmasāmagryaṃ brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ  |
ātmajñānasamasneha paryāptaṃ tatparāyaṇam  || 238.10 ||
tattvaṃ buddhvā bhavedbuddhaḥ kimanyadbuddhalakṣaṇam  |
vijñāyaitadvimucyante kṛtakṛtyā manīṣiṇaḥ  || 238.11 ||
na bhavati viduṣāṃ mahadbhayaṃ  238.12
yadaviduṣāṃ sumahadbhayaṃ paratra  238.12
nahi gatiradhikāsti kasyacid 238.12
bhavati hi yā viduṣaḥ sanātanī  238.12
loke mātaramasūyate naras 238.13
tatra devamanirīkṣya śocate  238.13
tatra cetkuśalo na śocate  238.13
ye vidustadubhayaṃ kṛtākṛtam  238.13
yatkarotyanabhisaṃdhipūrvakaṃ  238.14
tacca nindayati yatpurā kṛtam  238.14
yatpriyaṃ tadubhayaṃ na vāpriyaṃ  238.14
tasya tajjanayatīha kurvataḥ  238.14
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
yasmāddharmātparo dharmo vidyate neha kaścana  |
yo viśiṣṭaśca bhūtebhyastadbhavān prabravītu naḥ  || 238.15 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
dharmaṃ ca saṃpravakṣyāmi purāṇamṛṣibhiḥ stutam  |
viśiṣṭaṃ sarvadharmebhyaḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ  || 238.16 ||
indriyāṇi pramāthīni buddhyā saṃyamya tattvataḥ  |
sarvataḥ prasṛtānīha pitā bālānivātmajān  || 238.17 ||
manasaścendriyāṇāṃ cāpyaikāgryaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ  |
vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmebhyaḥ sa dharmaḥ para ucyate  || 238.18 ||
tāni sarvāṇi saṃdhāya manaḥṣaṣṭhāni medhayā  |
ātmatṛptaḥ sa evāsīdbahucintyamacintayan  || 238.19 ||
gocarebhyo nivṛttāni yadā sthāsyanti veśmani  |
tadā caivātmanātmānaṃ paraṃ drakṣyatha śāśvatam  || 238.20 ||
sarvātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ vidhūmamiva pāvakam  |
prapaśyanti mahātmānaṃ brāhmaṇā ye manīṣiṇaḥ  || 238.21 ||
yathā puṣpaphalopeto bahuśākho mahādrumaḥ  |
ātmano nābhijānīte kva me puṣpaṃ kva me phalam  || 238.22 ||
evamātmā na jānīte kva gamiṣye kuto'nvaham  |
anyo hyasyāntarātmāsti yaḥ sarvamanupaśyati  || 238.23 ||
jñānadīpena dīptena paśyatyātmānamātmanā  |
dṛṣṭvātmānaṃ tathā yūyaṃ virāgā bhavata dvijāḥ  || 238.24 ||
vimuktāḥ sarvapāpebhyo muktatvaca ivoragāḥ  |
parāṃ buddhimavāpyehāpyacintā vigatajvarāḥ  || 238.25 ||
sarvataḥsrotasaṃ ghorāṃ nadīṃ lokapravāhiṇīm  |
pañcendriyagrāhavatīṃ manaḥsaṃkalparodhasam  || 238.26 ||
lobhamohatṛṇacchannāṃ kāmakrodhasarīsṛpām  |
satyatīrthānṛtakṣobhāṃ krodhapaṅkāṃ saridvarām  || 238.27 ||
avyaktaprabhavāṃ śīghrāṃ kāmakrodhasamākulām  |
prataradhvaṃ nadīṃ buddhyā dustarāmakṛtātmabhiḥ  || 238.28 ||
saṃsārasāgaragamāṃ yonipātāladustarām  |
ātmajanmodbhavāṃ tāṃ tu jihvāvartadurāsadām  || 238.29 ||
yāṃ taranti kṛtaprajñā dhṛtimanto manīṣiṇaḥ  |
tāṃ tīrṇaḥ sarvato mukto vidhūtātmātmavāñśuciḥ  || 238.30 ||
uttamāṃ buddhimāsthāya brahmabhūyāya kalpate  |
uttīrṇaḥ sarvasaṃkleśān prasannātmā vikalmaṣaḥ  || 238.31 ||
bhūyiṣṭhānīva bhūtāni sarvasthānānnirīkṣya ca  |
akrudhyannaprasīdaṃśca nanṛśaṃsamatistathā  || 238.32 ||
tato drakṣyatha sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhavāpyayam  |
etaddhi sarvadharmebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ menire budhāḥ  || 238.33 ||
dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhā munayaḥ satyadarśinaḥ  |
ātmāno vyāpino viprā iti putrānuśāsanam  || 238.34 ||
prayatāya pravaktavyaṃ hitāyānugatāya ca  |
ātmajñānamidaṃ guhyaṃ sarvaguhyatamaṃ mahat || 238.35 ||
abravaṃ yadahaṃ viprā ātmasākṣikamañjasā  |
naiva strī na pumānevaṃ na caivedaṃ napuṃsakam  || 238.36 ||
aduḥkhamasukhaṃ brahma bhūtabhavyabhavātmakam  |
naitajjñātvā pumān strī vā punarbhavamavāpnuyāt || 238.37 ||
yathā matāni sarvāṇi tathaitāni yathā tathā  |
kathitāni mayā viprā bhavanti na bhavanti ca  || 238.38 ||
tatprītiyuktena guṇānvitena  238.39
putreṇa satputradayānvitena  238.39
dṛṣṭvā hitaṃ prītamanā yadarthaṃ  238.39
brūyātsutasyeha yaduktametat 238.39
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
mokṣaḥ pitāmahenokta upāyānnānupāyataḥ  |
tamupāyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śrotumicchāmahe mune  || 238.40 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
asmāsu tanmahāprājñā yuktaṃ nipuṇadarśanam  |
yadupāyena sarvārthānmṛgayadhvaṃ sadānaghāḥ  || 238.41 ||
ghaṭopakaraṇe buddhirghaṭotpattau na sā matā  |
evaṃ dharmādyupāyārthe nānyadharmeṣu kāraṇam  || 238.42 ||
pūrve samudre yaḥ panthā na sa gacchati paścimam  |
ekaḥ panthā hi mokṣasya tacchṛṇudhvaṃ mamānaghāḥ  || 238.43 ||
kṣamayā krodhamucchindyātkāmaṃ saṃkalpavarjanāt |
sattvasaṃsevanāddhīro nidrāmucchettumarhati  || 238.44 ||
apramādādbhayaṃ rakṣedrakṣetkṣetraṃ ca saṃvidam  |
icchāṃ dveṣaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca dhairyeṇa vinivartayet || 238.45 ||
nidrāṃ ca pratibhāṃ caiva jñānābhyāsena tattvavit |
upadravāṃstathā yogī hitajīrṇamitāśanāt || 238.46 ||
lobhaṃ mohaṃ ca saṃtoṣādviṣayāṃstattvadarśanāt |
anukrośādadharmaṃ ca jayeddharmamupekṣayā  || 238.47 ||
āyatyā ca jayedāśāṃ sāmarthyaṃ saṅgavarjanāt |
anityatvena ca snehaṃ kṣudhāṃ yogena paṇḍitaḥ  || 238.48 ||
kāruṇyenātmanātmānaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca paritoṣataḥ  |
utthānena jayettandrāṃ vitarkaṃ niścayājjayet || 238.49 ||
maunena bahubhāṣāṃ ca śauryeṇa ca bhayaṃ jayet |
yacchedvāṅmanasī buddhyā tāṃ yacchejjñānacakṣuṣā  || 238.50 ||
jñānamātmā mahān yacchettaṃ yacchecchāntirātmanaḥ  |
tadetadupaśāntena boddhavyaṃ śucikarmaṇā  || 238.51 ||
yogadoṣān samucchidya pañca yān kavayo viduḥ  |
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam  || 238.52 ||
parityajya niṣeveta yathāvadyogasādhanāt |
dhyānamadhyayanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ hrīrārjavaṃ kṣamā  || 238.53 ||
śaucamācārataḥ śuddhirindriyāṇāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ  |
etairvivardhate tejaḥ pāpmānamupahanti ca  || 238.54 ||
sidhyanti cāsya saṃkalpā vijñānaṃ ca pravartate  |
dhūtapāpaḥ sa tejasvī laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ  || 238.55 ||
kāmakrodhau vaśe kṛtvā nirviśedbrahmaṇaḥ padam  |
amūḍhatvamasaṅgitvaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjanam  || 238.56 ||
adainyamanudīrṇatvamanudvego hyavasthitiḥ  |
eṣa mārgo hi mokṣasya prasanno vimalaḥ śuciḥ  |
tathā vākkāyamanasāṃ niyamāḥ kāmato'vyayāḥ  || 238.57 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
sāṃkhyaṃ yogasya no vipra viśeṣaṃ vaktumarhasi  |
tava dharmajña sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ munisattama  || 239.1 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
sāṃkhyāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ praśaṃsanti yogān yogaviduttamāḥ  |
vadanti kāraṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ svapakṣodbhavanāya vai  || 239.2 ||
anīśvaraḥ kathaṃ mucyedityevaṃ munisattamāḥ  |
vadanti kāraṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ yogaṃ samyaṅmanīṣiṇaḥ  || 239.3 ||
vadanti kāraṇaṃ vedaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ samyagdvijātayaḥ  |
vijñāyeha gatīḥ sarvā virakto viṣayeṣu yaḥ  || 239.4 ||
ūrdhvaṃ sa dehātsuvyaktaṃ vimucyediti nānyathā  |
etadāhurmahāprājñāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ vai mokṣadarśanam  || 239.5 ||
svapakṣe kāraṇaṃ grāhyaṃ samarthaṃ vacanaṃ hitam  |
śiṣṭānāṃ hi mataṃ grāhyaṃ bhavadbhiḥ śiṣṭasaṃmataiḥ  || 239.6 ||
pratyakṣaṃ hetavo yogāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ śāstraviniścayāḥ  |
ubhe caite mate tattve samavete dvijottamāḥ  || 239.7 ||
ubhe caite mate jñāte munīndrāḥ śiṣṭasaṃmate  |
anuṣṭhite yathāśāstraṃ nayetāṃ paramāṃ gatim  || 239.8 ||
tulyaṃ śaucaṃ tayoryuktaṃ dayā bhūteṣu cānaghāḥ  |
vratānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ tulyaṃ darśanaṃ tvasamaṃ tayoḥ  || 239.9 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
yadi tulyaṃ vrataṃ śaucaṃ dayā cātra mahāmune  |
tulyaṃ taddarśanaṃ kasmāttanno brūhi dvijottama  || 239.10 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
rāgaṃ mohaṃ tathā snehaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca kevalam  |
yogāsthiroditān doṣān pañcaitān prāpnuvanti tān  || 239.11 ||
yathā vānimiṣāḥ sthūlaṃ jālaṃ chittvā punarjalam  |
prāpnuvanti tathā yogāttatpadaṃ vītakalmaṣāḥ  || 239.12 ||
tathaiva vāgurāṃ chittvā balavanto yathā mṛgāḥ  |
prāpnuyurvimalaṃ mārgaṃ vimuktāḥ sarvabandhanaiḥ  || 239.13 ||
lobhajāni tathā viprā bandhanāni balānvitaḥ  |
chittvā yogātparaṃ mārgaṃ gacchanti vimalaṃ śubham  || 239.14 ||
acalāstvāvilā viprā vāgurāsu tathāpare  |
vinaśyanti na saṃdehastadvadyogabalādṛte  || 239.15 ||
balahīnāśca viprendrā yathā jālaṃ gatā dvijāḥ  |
bandhaṃ na gacchantyanaghā yogāste tu sudurlabhāḥ  || 239.16 ||
yathā ca śakunāḥ sūkṣmaṃ prāpya jālamariṃdamāḥ  |
tatrāśaktā vipadyante mucyante tu balānvitāḥ  || 239.17 ||
karmajairbandhanairbaddhāstadvadyogaparā dvijāḥ  |
abalā na vimucyante mucyante ca balānvitāḥ  || 239.18 ||
alpakaśca yathā viprā vahniḥ śāmyati durbalaḥ  |
ākrānta indhanaiḥ sthūlaistadvadyogabalaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 239.19 ||
sa eva ca tadā viprā vahnirjātabalaḥ punaḥ  |
samīraṇagataḥ kṛtsnāṃ dahetkṣipraṃ mahīmimām  || 239.20 ||
tattvajñānabalo yogī dīptatejā mahābalaḥ  |
antakāla ivādityaḥ kṛtsnaṃ saṃśoṣayejjagat || 239.21 ||
durbalaśca yathā viprāḥ srotasā hriyate naraḥ  |
balahīnastathā yogī viṣayairhriyate ca saḥ  || 239.22 ||
tadeva tu yathā sroto viṣkambhayati vāraṇaḥ  |
tadvadyogabalaṃ labdhvā na bhavedviṣayairhṛtaḥ  || 239.23 ||
viśanti vā vaśādvātha yogādyogabalānvitāḥ  |
prajāpatīnmanūn sarvānmahābhūtāni ceśvarāḥ  || 239.24 ||
na yamo nāntakaḥ kruddho na mṛtyurbhīmavikramaḥ  |
viśante taddvijāḥ sarve yogasyāmitatejasaḥ  || 239.25 ||
ātmanāṃ ca sahasrāṇi bahūni dvijasattamāḥ  |
yogaṃ kuryādbalaṃ prāpya taiśca sarvairmahīṃ caret || 239.26 ||
prāpnuyādviṣayān kaścitpunaścograṃ tapaścaret |
saṃkṣipyecca punarviprāḥ sūryastejoguṇāniva  || 239.27 ||
balasthasya hi yogasya balārthaṃ munisattamāḥ  |
vimokṣaprabhavaṃ viṣṇumupapannamasaṃśayam  || 239.28 ||
balāni yogaproktāni mayaitāni dvijottamāḥ  |
nidarśanārthaṃ sūkṣmāṇi vakṣyāmi ca punardvijāḥ  || 239.29 ||
ātmanaśca samādhāne dhāraṇāṃ prati vā dvijāḥ  |
nidarśanāni sūkṣmāṇi śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ  || 239.30 ||
apramatto yathā dhanvī lakṣyaṃ hanti samāhitaḥ  |
yuktaḥ samyaktathā yogī mokṣaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam  || 239.31 ||
snehapātre yathā pūrṇe mana ādhāya niścalam  |
puruṣo yukta ārohetsopānaṃ yuktamānasaḥ  || 239.32 ||
muktastathāyamātmānaṃ yogaṃ tadvatsuniścalam  |
karotyamalamātmānaṃ bhāskaropamadarśane  || 239.33 ||
yathā ca nāvaṃ viprendrāḥ karṇadhāraḥ samāhitaḥ  |
mahārṇavagatāṃ śīghraṃ nayedviprāṃstu pattanam  || 239.34 ||
tadvadātmasamādhānaṃ yukto yogena yogavit |
durgamaṃ sthānamāpnoti hitvā dehamimaṃ dvijāḥ  || 239.35 ||
sārathiśca yathā yuktaḥ sadaśvān susamāhitaḥ  |
deśamiṣṭaṃ nayatyāśu dhanvinaṃ puruṣarṣabham  || 239.36 ||
tathaiva ca dvijā yogī dhāraṇāsu samāhitaḥ  |
prāpnotyāśu paraṃ sthānaṃ lakṣyamukta ivāśugaḥ  || 239.37 ||
āviśyātmani cātmānaṃ yo'vatiṣṭhati so'calaḥ  |
pāśaṃ hatveva mīnānāṃ padamāpnoti so'jaram  || 239.38 ||
nābhyāṃ śīrṣe ca kukṣau ca hṛdi vakṣasi pārśvayoḥ  |
darśane śravaṇe vāpi ghrāṇe cāmitavikramaḥ  || 239.39 ||
sthāneṣveteṣu yo yogī mahāvratasamāhitaḥ  |
ātmanā sūkṣmamātmānaṃ yuṅkte samyagdvijottamāḥ  || 239.40 ||
suśīghramacalaprakhyaṃ karma dagdhvā śubhāśubham  |
uttamaṃ yogamāsthāya yadīcchati vimucyate  || 239.41 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
āhārān kīdṛśān kṛtvā kāni jitvā ca sattama  |
yogī balamavāpnoti tadbhavān vaktumarhati  || 239.42 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
kaṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇe yuktaḥ piṇyākasya ca bho dvijāḥ  |
snehānāṃ varjane yukto yogī balamavāpnuyāt || 239.43 ||
bhuñjāno yāvakaṃ rūkṣaṃ dīrghakālaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
ekāhārī viśuddhātmā yogī balamavāpnuyāt || 239.44 ||
pakṣānmāsānṛtūṃścitrān saṃcaraṃśca guhāstathā  |
apaḥ pītvā payomiśrā yogī balamavāpnuyāt || 239.45 ||
akhaṇḍamapi vā māsaṃ satataṃ munisattamāḥ  |
upoṣya samyakśuddhātmā yogī balamavāpnuyāt || 239.46 ||
kāmaṃ jitvā tathā krodhaṃ śītoṣṇaṃ varṣameva ca  |
bhayaṃ śokaṃ tathā svāpaṃ pauruṣān viṣayāṃstathā  || 239.47 ||
aratiṃ durjayāṃ caiva ghorāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca bho dvijāḥ  |
sparśaṃ nidrāṃ tathā tandrāṃ durjayāṃ munisattamāḥ  || 239.48 ||
dīpayanti mahātmānaṃ sūkṣmamātmānamātmanā  |
vītarāgā mahāprājñā dhyānādhyayanasaṃpadā  || 239.49 ||
durgastveṣa mataḥ panthā brāhmaṇānāṃ vipaścitām  |
yaḥ kaścidvrajati kṣipraṃ kṣemeṇa munipuṃgavāḥ  || 239.50 ||
yathā kaścidvanaṃ ghoraṃ bahusarpasarīsṛpam  |
śvabhravattoyahīnaṃ ca durgamaṃ bahukaṇṭakam  || 239.51 ||
abhaktamaṭavīprāyaṃ dāvadagdhamahīruham  |
panthānaṃ taskarākīrṇaṃ kṣemeṇābhipatettathā  || 239.52 ||
yogamārgaṃ samāsādya yaḥ kaścidvrajate dvijaḥ  |
kṣemeṇoparamenmārgādbahudoṣo'pi saṃmataḥ  || 239.53 ||
āstheyaṃ kṣuradhārāsu niśitāsu dvijottamāḥ  |
dhāraṇā sā tu yogasya durgeyamakṛtātmabhiḥ  || 239.54 ||
viṣamā dhāraṇā viprā yānti vai na śubhāṃ gatim  |
netṛhīnā yathā nāvaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ tu vai dvijāḥ  || 239.55 ||
yastu tiṣṭhati yogādhau dhāraṇāsu yathāvidhi  |
maraṇaṃ janmaduḥkhitvaṃ sukhitvaṃ sa viśiṣyate  || 239.56 ||
nānāśāstreṣu niyataṃ nānāmuniniṣevitam  |
paraṃ yogasya panthānaṃ niścitaṃ taṃ dvijātiṣu  || 239.57 ||
paraṃ hi tadbrahmamayaṃ munīndrā  239.58
brahmāṇamīśaṃ varadaṃ ca viṣṇum  239.58
bhavaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca mahānubhāvaṃ  239.58
yadbrahmaputrān sumahānubhāvān  239.58
tamaśca kaṣṭaṃ sumahadrajaśca  239.59
sattvaṃ ca śuddhaṃ prakṛtiṃ parāṃ ca  239.59
siddhiṃ ca devīṃ varuṇasya patnīṃ  239.59
tejaśca kṛtsnaṃ sumahacca dhairyam  239.59
tārādhipaṃ khe vimalaṃ sutāraṃ  239.60
viśvāṃśca devānuragān pitṝṃśca  239.60
śailāṃśca kṛtsnānudadhīṃśca vācalān  239.60
nadīśca sarvāḥ sanagāṃśca nāgān  239.60
sādhyāṃstathā yakṣagaṇān diśaśca  239.61
gandharvasiddhān puruṣān striyaśca  239.61
parasparaṃ prāpya mahānmahātmā  239.61
viśeta yogī nacirādvimuktaḥ  239.61
kathā ca yā vipravarāḥ prasaktā  239.62
daive mahāvīryamatau śubheyam  239.62
yogān sa sarvānanubhūya martyā  239.62
nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ drutamāpnuvanti  239.62
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
samyakkriyeyaṃ viprendra varṇitā śiṣṭasaṃmatā  |
yogamārgo yathānyāyaṃ śiṣyāyeha hitaiṣiṇā  || 240.1 ||
sāṃkhye tvidānīṃ dharmasya vidhiṃ prabrūhi tattvataḥ  |
triṣu lokeṣu yajjñānaṃ sarvaṃ tadviditaṃ hi te  || 240.2 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarvamākhyānaṃ viditātmanām  |
vihitaṃ yatibhirvṛddhaiḥ kapilādibhirīśvaraiḥ  || 240.3 ||
yasmin suvibhramāḥ keciddṛśyante munisattamāḥ  |
guṇāśca yasmin bahavo doṣahāniśca kevalā  || 240.4 ||
jñānena parisaṃkhyāya sadoṣān viṣayān dvijāḥ  |
mānuṣān durjayān kṛtsnān paiśācān viṣayāṃstathā  || 240.5 ||
viṣayānauragāñjñātvā gandharvaviṣayāṃstathā  |
pitṝṇāṃ viṣayāñjñātvā tiryaktvaṃ caratāṃ dvijāḥ  || 240.6 ||
suparṇaviṣayāñjñātvā marutāṃ viṣayāṃstathā  |
maharṣiviṣayāṃścaiva rājarṣiviṣayāṃstathā  || 240.7 ||
āsurān viṣayāñjñātvā vaiśvadevāṃstathaiva ca  |
devarṣiviṣayāñjñātvā yogānāmapi vai parān  || 240.8 ||
viṣayāṃśca pramāṇasya brahmaṇo viṣayāṃstathā  |
āyuṣaśca paraṃ kālaṃ lokairvijñāya tattvataḥ  || 240.9 ||
sukhasya ca paraṃ kālaṃ vijñāya munisattamāḥ  |
prāptakāle ca yadduḥkhaṃ patatāṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām  || 240.10 ||
tiryaktve patatāṃ viprāstathaiva narakeṣu yat |
svargasya ca guṇāñjñātvā doṣān sarvāṃśca bho dvijāḥ  || 240.11 ||
vedavāde ca ye doṣā guṇā ye cāpi vaidikāḥ  |
jñānayoge ca ye doṣā jñānayoge ca ye guṇāḥ  || 240.12 ||
sāṃkhyajñāne ca ye doṣāṃstathaiva ca guṇā dvijāḥ  |
sattvaṃ daśaguṇaṃ jñātvā rajo navaguṇaṃ tathā  || 240.13 ||
tamaścāṣṭaguṇaṃ jñātvā buddhiṃ saptaguṇāṃ tathā  |
ṣaḍguṇaṃ ca nabho jñātvā tamaśca triguṇaṃ mahat || 240.14 ||
dviguṇaṃ ca rajo jñātvā sattvaṃ caikaguṇaṃ punaḥ  |
mārgaṃ vijñāya tattvena pralayaprekṣaṇena tu  || 240.15 ||
jñānavijñānasaṃpannāḥ kāraṇairbhāvitātmabhiḥ  |
prāpnuvanti śubhaṃ mokṣaṃ sūkṣmā iva nabhaḥ param  || 240.16 ||
rūpeṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saṃyuktāṃ ghrāṇaṃ gandhaguṇena ca  |
śabdagrāhyaṃ tathā śrotraṃ jihvāṃ rasaguṇena ca  || 240.17 ||
tvacaṃ sparśaṃ tathā śakyaṃ vāyuṃ caiva tadāśritam  |
mohaṃ tamasi saṃyuktaṃ lobhaṃ moheṣu saṃśritam  || 240.18 ||
viṣṇuṃ krānte bale śakraṃ koṣṭhe saktaṃ tathānalam  |
apsu devīṃ samāyuktāmāpastejasi saṃśritāḥ  || 240.19 ||
tejo vāyau tu saṃyuktaṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam  |
nabho mahati saṃyuktaṃ tamo mahasi saṃsthitam  || 240.20 ||
rajaḥ sattvaṃ tathā saktaṃ sattvaṃ saktaṃ tathātmani  |
saktamātmānamīśe ca deve nārāyaṇe tathā  || 240.21 ||
devaṃ mokṣe ca saṃyuktaṃ tato mokṣaṃ ca na kvacit |
jñātvā sattvaguṇaṃ dehaṃ vṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirguṇaiḥ  || 240.22 ||
svabhāvaṃ bhāvanāṃ caiva jñātvā dehasamāśritām  |
madhyasthamiva cātmānaṃ pāpaṃ yasminna vidyate  || 240.23 ||
dvitīyaṃ karma vai jñātvā viprendrā viṣayaiṣiṇām  |
indriyāṇīndriyārthāṃśca sarvānātmani saṃśritān  || 240.24 ||
durlabhatvaṃ ca mokṣasya vijñāya śrutipūrvakam  |
prāṇāpānau samānaṃ ca vyānodānau ca tattvataḥ  || 240.25 ||
ādyaṃ caivānilaṃ jñātvā prabhavaṃ cānilaṃ punaḥ  |
saptadhā tāṃstathā śeṣān saptadhā vidhivatpunaḥ  || 240.26 ||
prajāpatīnṛṣīṃścaiva sargāṃśca subahūn varān  |
saptarṣīṃśca bahūñjñātvā rājarṣīṃśca paraṃtapān  || 240.27 ||
surarṣīnmarutaścānyān brahmarṣīn sūryasaṃnibhān  |
aiśvaryāccyāvitān dṛṣṭvā kālena mahatā dvijāḥ  || 240.28 ||
mahatāṃ bhūtasaṃghānāṃ śrutvā nāśaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ  |
gatiṃ vācāṃ śubhāṃ jñātvā arcārhāḥ pāpakarmaṇām  || 240.29 ||
vaitaraṇyāṃ ca yadduḥkhaṃ patitānāṃ yamakṣaye  |
yoniṣu ca vicitrāsu saṃcārānaśubhāṃstathā  || 240.30 ||
jaṭhare cāśubhe vāsaṃ śoṇitodakabhājane  |
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣe ca tīvragandhasamanvite  || 240.31 ||
śukraśoṇitasaṃghāte majjāsnāyuparigrahe  |
śirāśatasamākīrṇe navadvāre pure'tha vai  || 240.32 ||
vijñāya hitamātmānaṃ yogāṃśca vividhān dvijāḥ  |
tāmasānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ ramaṇīyānṛtātmanām  || 240.33 ||
sāttvikānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ kutsitaṃ munisattamāḥ  |
garhitaṃ mahatāmarthe sāṃkhyānāṃ viditātmanām  || 240.34 ||
upaplavāṃstathā ghorāñśaśinastejasastathā  |
tārāṇāṃ patanaṃ dṛṣṭvā nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca paryayam  || 240.35 ||
dvaṃdvānāṃ viprayogaṃ ca vijñāya kṛpaṇaṃ dvijāḥ  |
anyonyabhakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūtānāmapi cāśubham  || 240.36 ||
bālye mohaṃ ca vijñāya pakṣadehasya cāśubham  |
rāgaṃ mohaṃ ca saṃprāptaṃ kvacitsattvaṃ samāśritam  || 240.37 ||
sahasreṣu naraḥ kaścinmokṣabuddhiṃ samāśritaḥ  |
durlabhatvaṃ ca mokṣasya vijñānaṃ śrutipūrvakam  || 240.38 ||
bahumānamalabdheṣu labdhe madhyasthatāṃ punaḥ  |
viṣayāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ vijñāya ca punardvijāḥ  || 240.39 ||
gatāsūnāṃ ca sattvānāṃ dehān bhittvā tathā śubhān  |
vāsaṃ kuleṣu jantūnāṃ maraṇāya dhṛtātmanām  || 240.40 ||
sāttvikānāṃ ca jantūnāṃ duḥkhaṃ vijñāya bho dvijāḥ  |
brahmaghnānāṃ gatiṃ jñātvā patitānāṃ sudāruṇām  || 240.41 ||
surāpāne ca saktānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ durātmanām  |
gurudāraprasaktānāṃ gatiṃ vijñāya cāśubhām  || 240.42 ||
jananīṣu ca vartante yena samyagdvijottamāḥ  |
sadevakeṣu lokeṣu yena vartanti mānavāḥ  || 240.43 ||
tena jñānena vijñāya gatiṃ cāśubhakarmaṇām  |
tiryagyonigatānāṃ ca vijñāya ca gatīḥ pṛthak || 240.44 ||
vedavādāṃstathā citrānṛtūnāṃ paryayāṃstathā  |
kṣayaṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca kṣayaṃ tathā  || 240.45 ||
pakṣakṣayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā divasānāṃ ca saṃkṣayam  |
kṣayaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca candrasya dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣatastathā  || 240.46 ||
vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā samudrāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ teṣāṃ tathā punaḥ  |
kṣayaṃ dhanānāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punarvṛddhiṃ tathaiva ca  || 240.47 ||
saṃyogānāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā yugānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ  |
dehavaiklavyatāṃ caiva samyagvijñāya tattvataḥ  || 240.48 ||
ātmadoṣāṃśca vijñāya sarvānātmani saṃsthitān  |
svadehādutthitān gandhāṃstathā vijñāya cāśubhān  || 240.49 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kānutpātabhavān doṣān paśyasi brahmavittama  |
etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vaktumarhasyaśeṣataḥ  || 240.50 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
pañca doṣān dvijā dehe pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ  |
mārgajñāḥ kāpilāḥ sāṃkhyāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ  || 240.51 ||
kāmakrodhau bhayaṃ nidrā pañcamaḥ śvāsa ucyate  |
ete doṣāḥ śarīreṣu dṛśyante sarvadehinām  || 240.52 ||
chindanti kṣamayā krodhaṃ kāmaṃ saṃkalpavarjanāt |
sattvasaṃsevanānnidrāmapramādādbhayaṃ tathā  || 240.53 ||
chindanti pañcamaṃ śvāsamalpāhāratayā dvijāḥ  |
guṇān guṇaśatairjñātvā doṣān doṣaśatairapi  || 240.54 ||
hetūn hetuśataiścitraiścitrān vijñāya tattvataḥ  |
apāṃ phenopamaṃ lokaṃ viṣṇormāyāśataiḥ kṛtam  || 240.55 ||
citrabhittipratīkāśaṃ nalasāramanarthakam  |
tamaḥsaṃbhramitaṃ dṛṣṭvā varṣabudbudasaṃnibham  || 240.56 ||
nāśaprāyaṃ sukhādhānaṃ nāśottaramahābhayam  |
rajastamasi saṃmagnaṃ paṅke dvipamivāvaśam  || 240.57 ||
sāṃkhyā viprā mahāprājñāstyaktvā snehaṃ prajākṛtam  |
jñānajñeyena sāṃkhyena vyāpinā mahatā dvijāḥ  || 240.58 ||
rājasānaśubhān gandhāṃstāmasāṃśca tathāvidhān  |
puṇyāṃśca sāttvikān gandhān sparśajān dehasaṃśritān  || 240.59 ||
chittvātmajñānaśastreṇa tapodaṇḍena sattamāḥ  |
tato duḥkhādikaṃ ghoraṃ cintāśokamahāhradam  || 240.60 ||
vyādhimṛtyumahāghoraṃ mahābhayamahoragam  |
tamaḥkūrmaṃ rajomīnaṃ prajñayā saṃtarantyuta  || 240.61 ||
snehapaṅkaṃ jarādurgaṃ sparśadvīpaṃ dvijottamāḥ  |
karmāgādhaṃ satyatīraṃ sthitaṃ vratamanīṣiṇaḥ  || 240.62 ||
harṣasaṃghamahāvegaṃ nānārasasamākulam  |
nānāprītimahāratnaṃ duḥkhajvarasamīritam  || 240.63 ||
śokatṛṣṇāmahāvartaṃ tīkṣṇavyādhimahārujam  |
asthisaṃghātasaṃghaṭṭaṃ śleṣmayogaṃ dvijottamāḥ  || 240.64 ||
dānamuktākaraṃ ghoraṃ śoṇitodgāravidrumam  |
hasitotkruṣṭanirghoṣaṃ nānājñānasuduṣkaram  || 240.65 ||
rodanāśrumalakṣāraṃ saṅgayogaparāyaṇam  |
pralabdhvā janmaloko yaṃ putrabāndhavapattanam  || 240.66 ||
ahiṃsāsatyamaryādaṃ prāṇayogamayormilam  |
vṛndānugāminaṃ kṣīraṃ sarvabhūtapayodadhim  || 240.67 ||
mokṣadurlabhaviṣayaṃ vāḍavāsukhasāgaram  |
taranti yatayaḥ siddhā jñānayogena cānaghāḥ  || 240.68 ||
tīrtvā ca dustaraṃ janma viśanti vimalaṃ nabhaḥ  |
tatastān sukṛtīñjñātvā sūryo vahati raśmibhiḥ  || 240.69 ||
padmatantuvadāviśya pravahan viṣayān dvijāḥ  |
tatra tān pravaho vāyuḥ pratigṛhṇāti cānaghāḥ  || 240.70 ||
vītarāgān yatīn siddhān vīryayuktāṃstapodhanān  |
sūkṣmaḥ śītaḥ sugandhaśca sukhasparśaśca bho dvijāḥ  || 240.71 ||
saptānāṃ marutāṃ śreṣṭho lokān gacchati yaḥ śubhān  |
sa tān vahati viprendrā nabhasaḥ paramāṃ gatim  || 240.72 ||
nabho vahati lokeśān rajasaḥ paramāṃ gatim  |
rajo vahati viprendrāḥ sattvasya paramāṃ gatim  || 240.73 ||
sattvaṃ vahati śuddhātmā paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum  |
prabhurvahati śuddhātmā paramātmānamātmanā  || 240.74 ||
paramātmānamāsādya tadbhūtā yatayo'malāḥ  |
amṛtatvāya kalpante na nivartanti ca dvijāḥ  || 240.75 ||
paramā sā gatirviprā nirdvaṃdvānāṃ mahātmanām  |
satyārjavaratānāṃ vai sarvabhūtadayāvatām  || 240.76 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
sthānamuttamamāsādya bhagavantaṃ sthiravratāḥ  |
ājanmamaraṇaṃ vā te ramante tatra vā na vā  || 240.77 ||
yadatra tathyaṃ tattvaṃ no yathāvadvaktumarhasi  |
tvadṛte mānavaṃ nānyaṃ praṣṭumarhāma sattama  || 240.78 ||
mokṣadoṣo mahāneṣa prāpya siddhiṃ gatānṛṣīn  |
yadi tatraiva vijñāne vartante yatayaḥ pare  || 240.79 ||
pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ paśyāma paramaṃ dvija  |
magnasya hi pare jñāne kiṃtu duḥkhāntaraṃ bhavet || 240.80 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
yathānyāyaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ praśnaḥ pṛṣṭaśca saṃkaṭaḥ  |
budhānāmapi saṃmohaḥ praśne'sminmunisattamāḥ  || 240.81 ||
atrāpi tattvaṃ paramaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama  |
buddhiśca paramā yatra kapilānāṃ mahātmanām  || 240.82 ||
indriyāṇyapi budhyante svadehaṃ dehināṃ dvijāḥ  |
karaṇānyātmanastāni sūkṣmaṃ paśyanti taistu saḥ  || 240.83 ||
ātmanā viprahīṇāni kāṣṭhakuḍyasamāni tu  |
vinaśyanti na saṃdeho velā iva mahārṇave  || 240.84 ||
indriyaiḥ saha suptasya dehino dvijasattamāḥ  |
sūkṣmaścarati sarvatra nabhasīva samīraṇaḥ  || 240.85 ||
sa paśyati yathānyāyaṃ smṛtvā spṛśati cānaghāḥ  |
budhyamāno yathāpūrvamakhileneha bho dvijāḥ  || 240.86 ||
indriyāṇi ha sarvāṇi sve sve sthāne yathāvidhi  |
anīśatvātpralīyante sarpā viṣahatā iva  || 240.87 ||
indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ svasthāneṣveva sarvaśaḥ  |
ākramya gatayaḥ sūkṣmā varatyātmā na saṃśayaḥ  || 240.88 ||
sattvasya ca guṇān kṛtsnān rajasaśca guṇān punaḥ  |
guṇāṃśca tamasaḥ sarvān guṇān buddheśca sattamāḥ  || 240.89 ||
guṇāṃśca manasaścāpi nabhasaśca guṇāṃstathā  |
guṇān vāyośca sarvajñāḥ snehajāṃśca guṇān punaḥ  || 240.90 ||
apāṃ guṇāstathā viprāḥ pārthivāṃśca guṇānapi  |
sarvāneva guṇairvyāpya kṣetrajñeṣu dvijottamāḥ  || 240.91 ||
ātmā carati kṣetrajñaḥ karmaṇā ca śubhāśubhe  |
śiṣyā iva mahātmānamindriyāṇi ca taṃ dvijāḥ  || 240.92 ||
prakṛtiṃ cāpyatikramya śuddhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ parātparam  |
nārāyaṇaṃ mahātmānaṃ nirvikāraṃ parātparam  || 240.93 ||
vimuktaṃ sarvapāpebhyaḥ praviṣṭaṃ ca hyanāmayam  |
paramātmānamaguṇaṃ nirvṛtaṃ taṃ ca sattamāḥ  || 240.94 ||
śreṣṭhaṃ tatra mano viprā indriyāṇi ca bho dvijāḥ  |
āgacchanti yathākālaṃ guroḥ saṃdeśakāriṇaḥ  || 240.95 ||
śakyaṃ vālpena kālena śāntiṃ prāptuṃ guṇāṃstathā  |
evamuktena viprendrāḥ sāṃkhyayogena mokṣiṇīm  || 240.96 ||
sāṃkhyā viprā mahāprājñā gacchanti paramāṃ gatim  |
jñānenānena viprendrāstulyaṃ jñānaṃ na vidyate  || 240.97 ||
atra vaḥ saṃśayo mā bhūjjñānaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ paraṃ matam  |
akṣaraṃ dhruvamevoktaṃ pūrvaṃ brahma sanātanam  || 240.98 ||
anādimadhyanidhanaṃ nirdvaṃdvaṃ kartṛ śāśvatam  |
kūṭasthaṃ caiva nityaṃ ca yadvadanti śamātmakāḥ  || 240.99 ||
yataḥ sarvāḥ pravartante sargapralayavikriyāḥ  |
evaṃ śaṃsanti śāstreṣu pravaktāro maharṣayaḥ  || 240.100 ||
sarve viprāśca vedāśca tathā sāmavido janāḥ  |
brahmaṇyaṃ paramaṃ devamanantaṃ paramācyutam  || 240.101 ||
prārthayantaśca taṃ viprā vadanti guṇabuddhayaḥ  |
samyaguktāstathā yogāḥ sāṃkhyāścāmitadarśanāḥ  || 240.102 ||
amūrtistasya viprendrāḥ sāṃkhyaṃ mūrtiriti śrutiḥ  |
abhijñānāni tasyāhurmahānti munisattamāḥ  || 240.103 ||
dvividhāni hi bhūtāni pṛthivyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ  |
agamyagamyasaṃjñāni gamyaṃ tatra viśiṣyate  || 240.104 ||
jñānaṃ mahadvai mahataśca viprā  240.105
vedeṣu sāṃkhyeṣu tathaiva yoge  240.105
yaccāpi dṛṣṭaṃ vidhivatpurāṇe  240.105
sāṃkhyāgataṃ tannikhilaṃ munīndrāḥ  240.105
yaccetihāseṣu mahatsu dṛṣṭaṃ  240.106
yathārthaśāstreṣu viśiṣṭadṛṣṭam  240.106
jñānaṃ ca loke yadihāsti kiṃcit 240.106
sāṃkhyāgataṃ tacca mahāmunīndrāḥ  240.106
samastadṛṣṭaṃ paramaṃ balaṃ ca  240.107
jñānaṃ ca mokṣaśca yathāvaduktam  240.107
tapāṃsi sūkṣmāṇi ca yāni caiva  240.107
sāṃkhye yathāvadvihitāni viprāḥ  240.107
viparyayaṃ tasya hitaṃ sadaiva  240.108
gacchanti sāṃkhyāḥ satataṃ sukhena  240.108
tāṃścāpi saṃdhārya tataḥ kṛtārthāḥ  240.108
patanti viprāyataneṣu bhūyaḥ  240.108
hitvā ca dehaṃ praviśanti mokṣaṃ  240.109
divaukasaścāpi ca yogasāṃkhyāḥ  240.109
ato'dhikaṃ te'bhiratā mahārhe  240.109
sāṃkhye dvijā bho iha śiṣṭajuṣṭe  240.109
teṣāṃ tu tiryaggamanaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ  240.110
nādho gatiḥ pāpakṛtāṃ nivāsaḥ  240.110
na vā pradhānā api te dvijātayo  240.110
ye jñānametanmunayo na saktāḥ  240.110
sāṃkhyaṃ viśālaṃ paramaṃ purāṇaṃ  240.111
mahārṇavaṃ vimalamudārakāntam  240.111
kṛtsnaṃ hi sāṃkhyā munayo mahātma  240.111
nārāyaṇe dhārayatāprameyam  240.111
etanmayoktaṃ paramaṃ hi tattvaṃ  240.112
nārāyaṇādviśvamidaṃ purāṇam  240.112
sa sargakāle ca karoti sargaṃ  240.112
saṃhārakāle ca hareta bhūyaḥ  240.112
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
kiṃ tadakṣaramityuktaṃ yasmānnāvartate punaḥ  |
kiṃsvittatkṣaramityuktaṃ yasmādāvartate punaḥ  || 241.1 ||
akṣarākṣarayorvyaktiṃ pṛcchāmastvāṃ mahāmune  |
upalabdhuṃ muniśreṣṭha tattvena munipuṃgava  || 241.2 ||
tvaṃ hi jñānavidāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ procyase vedapāragaiḥ  |
ṛṣibhiśca mahābhāgairyatibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ  || 241.3 ||
tadetacchrotumicchāmastvattaḥ sarvaṃ mahāmate  |
na tṛptimadhigacchāmaḥ śṛṇvanto'mṛtamuttamam  || 241.4 ||
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
atra vo varṇayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam  |
vasiṣṭhasya ca saṃvādaṃ karālajanakasya ca  || 241.5 ||
vasiṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhamāsīnamṛṣīṇāṃ bhāskaradyutim  |
papraccha janako rājā jñānaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param  || 241.6 ||
paramātmani kuśalamadhyātmagatiniścayam  |
maitrāvaruṇimāsīnamabhivādya kṛtāñjaliḥ  || 241.7 ||
svacchandaṃ sukṛtaṃ caiva madhuraṃ cāpyanulbaṇam  |
papraccharṣivaraṃ rājā karālajanakaḥ purā  || 241.8 ||
{karālajanaka uvāca̱ }
bhagavañśrotumicchāmi paraṃ brahma sanātanam  |
yasminna punarāvṛttiṃ prāpnuvanti manīṣiṇaḥ  || 241.9 ||
yacca tatkṣaramityuktaṃ yatredaṃ kṣarate jagat |
yaccākṣaramiti proktaṃ śivaṃ kṣemamanāmayam  || 241.10 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
śrūyatāṃ pṛthivīpāla kṣaratīdaṃ yathā jagat |
yatra kṣarati pūrveṇa yāvatkālena cāpyatha  || 241.11 ||
yugaṃ dvādaśasāhasryaṃ kalpaṃ viddhi caturyugam  |
daśakalpaśatāvartamahastadbrāhmamucyate  || 241.12 ||
rātriścaitāvatī rājan yasyānte pratibudhyate  |
sṛjatyanantakarmāṇi mahāntaṃ bhūtamagrajam  || 241.13 ||
mūrtimantamamūrtātmā viśvaṃ śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ  |
yatrotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi mūlato nṛpasattama  || 241.14 ||
aṇimā laghimā prāptirīśānaṃ jyotiravyayam  |
sarvataḥpāṇipādāntaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukham  || 241.15 ||
sarvataḥśrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati  |
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavāneṣa buddhiriti smṛtiḥ  || 241.16 ||
mahāniti ca yogeṣu viriñciriti cāpyatha  |
sāṃkhye ca paṭhyate śāstre nāmabhirbahudhātmakaḥ  || 241.17 ||
vicitrarūpo viśvātmā ekākṣara iti smṛtaḥ  |
dhṛtamekātmakaṃ yena kṛtsnaṃ trailokyamātmanā  || 241.18 ||
tathaiva bahurūpatvādviśvarūpa iti śrutaḥ  |
eṣa vai vikriyāpannaḥ sṛjatyātmānamātmanā  || 241.19 ||
pradhānaṃ tasya saṃyogādutpannaṃ sumahatpuram  |
ahaṃkāraṃ mahātejāḥ prajāpatinamaskṛtam  || 241.20 ||
avyaktādvyaktimāpannaṃ vidyāsargaṃ vadanti tam  |
mahāntaṃ cāpyahaṃkāramavidyāsarga eva ca  || 241.21 ||
acaraśca caraścaiva samutpannau tathaikataḥ  |
vidyāvidyeti vikhyāte śrutiśāstrānucintakaiḥ  || 241.22 ||
bhūtasargamahaṃkārāttṛtīyaṃ viddhi pārthiva  |
ahaṃkāreṣu nṛpate caturthaṃ viddhi vaikṛtam  || 241.23 ||
vāyurjyotirathākāśamāpo'tha pṛthivī tathā  |
śabdasparśau ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca  || 241.24 ||
evaṃ yugapadutpannaṃ daśavargamasaṃśayam  |
pañcamaṃ viddhi rājendra bhautikaṃ sargamarthakṛt || 241.25 ||
śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇameva ca pañcamam  |
vāghastau caiva pādau ca pāyurmeḍhraṃ tathaiva ca  || 241.26 ||
buddhīndriyāṇi caitāni tathā karmendriyāṇi ca  |
saṃbhūtānīha yugapanmanasā saha pārthiva  || 241.27 ||
eṣā tattvacaturviṃśā sarvākṛtiḥ pravartate  |
yāṃ jñātvā nābhiśocanti brāhmaṇāstattvadarśinaḥ  || 241.28 ||
evametatsamutpannaṃ trailokyamidamuttamam  |
veditavyaṃ naraśreṣṭha sadaiva narakārṇave  || 241.29 ||
sayakṣabhūtagandharve sakiṃnaramahorage  |
sacāraṇapiśāce vai sadevarṣiniśācare  || 241.30 ||
sadaṃśakīṭamaśake sapūtikṛmimūṣake  |
śuni śvapāke caiṇeye sacāṇḍāle sapulkase  || 241.31 ||
hastyaśvakharaśārdūle savṛke gavi caiva ha  |
yā ca mūrtiśca yatkiṃcitsarvatraitannidarśanam  || 241.32 ||
jale bhuvi tathākāśe nānyatreti viniścayaḥ  |
sthānaṃ dehavatāmāsīdityevamanuśuśruma  || 241.33 ||
kṛtsnametāvatastāta kṣarate vyaktasaṃjñakaḥ  |
ahanyahani bhūtātmā yaccākṣara iti smṛtam  || 241.34 ||
tatastatkṣaramityuktaṃ kṣaratīdaṃ yathā jagat |
jaganmohātmakaṃ cāhuravyaktādvyaktasaṃjñakam  || 241.35 ||
mahāṃścaivākṣaro nityametatkṣaravivarjanam  |
kathitaṃ te mahārāja yasmānnāvartate punaḥ  || 241.36 ||
pañcaviṃśatiko'mūrtaḥ sa nityastattvasaṃjñakaḥ  |
sattvasaṃśrayaṇāttattvaṃ sattvamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  || 241.37 ||
yadamūrtiḥ sṛjadvyaktaṃ tanmūrtimadhitiṣṭhati  |
caturviṃśatimo vyakto hyamūrtiḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ  || 241.38 ||
sa eva hṛdi sarvāsu mūrtiṣvātiṣṭhatātmavān  |
cetayaṃścetano nityaṃ sarvamūrtiramūrtimān  || 241.39 ||
sargapralayadharmeṇa sa sargapralayātmakaḥ  |
gocare vartate nityaṃ nirguṇo guṇasaṃjñitaḥ  || 241.40 ||
evameṣa mahātmā ca sargapralayakoṭiśaḥ  |
vikurvāṇaḥ prakṛtimānnābhimanyeta buddhimān  || 241.41 ||
tamaḥsattvarajoyuktastāsu tāsviha yoniṣu  |
līyate pratibuddhatvādabuddhajanasevanāt || 241.42 ||
sahavāsanivāsatvādbālo'hamiti manyate  |
yo'haṃ na so'hamityukto guṇānevānuvartate  || 241.43 ||
tamasā tāmasān bhāvān vividhān pratipadyate  |
rajasā rājasāṃścaiva sāttvikān sattvasaṃśrayāt || 241.44 ||
śuklalohitakṛṣṇāni rūpāṇyetāni trīṇi tu  |
sarvāṇyetāni rūpāṇi jānīhi prākṛtāni tu  || 241.45 ||
tāmasā nirayaṃ yānti rājasā mānuṣānatha  |
sāttvikā devalokāya gacchanti sukhabhāginaḥ  || 241.46 ||
niṣkevalena pāpena tiryagyonimavāpnuyāt |
puṇyapāpeṣu mānuṣyaṃ puṇyamātreṇa devatāḥ  || 241.47 ||
evamavyaktaviṣayaṃ mokṣamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  |
pañcaviṃśatimo yo'yaṃ jñānādeva pravartate  || 241.48 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
evamapratibuddhatvādabuddhamanuvartate  |
dehāddehasahasrāṇi tathā ca na sa bhidyate  || 242.1 ||
tiryagyonisahasreṣu kadāciddevatāsvapi  |
utpadyati tapoyogādguṇaiḥ saha guṇakṣayāt || 242.2 ||
manuṣyatvāddivaṃ yāti devo mānuṣyameti ca  |
mānuṣyānnirayasthānamālayaṃ pratipadyate  || 242.3 ||
koṣakāro yathātmānaṃ kīṭaḥ samabhirundhati  |
sūtratantuguṇairnityaṃ tathāyamaguṇo guṇaiḥ  || 242.4 ||
dvaṃdvameti ca nirdvaṃdvastāsu tāsviha yoniṣu  |
śīrṣaroge'kṣiroge ca dantaśūle galagrahe  || 242.5 ||
jalodare'tisāre ca gaṇḍamālāvicarcike  |
śvitrakuṣṭhe'gnidagdhe ca sidhmāpasmārayorapi  || 242.6 ||
yāni cānyāni dvaṃdvāni prākṛtāni śarīriṇām  |
utpadyante vicitrāṇi tānyevātmābhimanyate  || 242.7 ||
abhimānātimānānāṃ tathaiva sukṛtānyapi  |
ekavāsāścaturvāsāḥ śāyī nityamadhastathā  || 242.8 ||
maṇḍūkaśāyī ca tathā vīrāsanagatastathā  |
vīramāsanamākāśe tathā śayanameva ca  || 242.9 ||
iṣṭakāprastare caiva cakrakaprastare tathā  |
bhasmaprastaraśāyī ca bhūmiśayyānulepanaḥ  || 242.10 ||
vīrasthānāmbupāke ca śayanaṃ phalakeṣu ca  |
vividhāsu ca śayyāsu phalagṛhyānvitāsu ca  || 242.11 ||
udyāne khalalagne tu kṣaumakṛṣṇājinānvitaḥ  |
maṇivālaparīdhāno vyāghracarmaparicchadaḥ  || 242.12 ||
siṃhacarmaparīdhānaḥ paṭṭavāsāstathaiva ca  |
phalakaṃ paridhānaśca tathā kaṭakavastradhṛk || 242.13 ||
kaṭaikavasanaścaiva cīravāsāstathaiva ca  |
vastrāṇi cānyāni bahūnyabhimatya ca buddhimān  || 242.14 ||
bhojanāni vicitrāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca  |
ekarātrāntarāśitvamekakālikabhojanam  || 242.15 ||
caturthāṣṭamakālaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhakālikameva ca  |
ṣaḍrātrabhojanaścaiva tathā cāṣṭāhabhojanaḥ  || 242.16 ||
māsopavāsī mūlāśī phalāhārastathaiva ca  |
vāyubhakṣaśca piṇyāka dadhigomayabhojanaḥ  || 242.17 ||
gomūtrabhojanaścaiva kāśapuṣpāśanastathā  |
śaivālabhojanaścaiva tathā cānyena vartayan  || 242.18 ||
vartayañśīrṇaparṇaiśca prakīrṇaphalabhojanaḥ  |
vividhāni ca kṛcchrāṇi sevate siddhikāṅkṣayā  || 242.19 ||
cāndrāyaṇāni vidhivalliṅgāni vividhāni ca  |
cāturāśramyayuktāni dharmādharmāśrayāṇyapi  || 242.20 ||
upāśrayānapyaparān pākhaṇḍān vividhānapi  |
viviktāśca śilāchāyāstathā prasravaṇāni ca  || 242.21 ||
pulināni viviktāni vividhāni vanāni ca  |
kānaneṣu viviktāśca śailānāṃ mahatīrguhāḥ  || 242.22 ||
niyamān vividhāṃścāpi vividhāni tapāṃsi ca  |
yajñāṃśca vividhākārān vidyāśca vividhāstathā  || 242.23 ||
vaṇikpathaṃ dvijakṣatra vaiśyaśūdrāṃstathaiva ca  |
dānaṃ ca vividhākāraṃ dīnāndhakṛpaṇādiṣu  || 242.24 ||
abhimanyeta saṃdhātuṃ tathaiva vividhān guṇān  |
sattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva dharmārthau kāma eva ca  || 242.25 ||
prakṛtyātmānamevātmā evaṃ pravibhajatyuta  |
svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau svadhākāranamaskriye  || 242.26 ||
yajanādhyayane dānaṃ tathaivāhuḥ pratigraham  |
yājanādhyāpane caiva tathānyadapi kiṃcana  || 242.27 ||
janmamṛtyuvidhānena tathā viśasanena ca  |
śubhāśubhabhayaṃ sarvametadāhuḥ sanātanam  || 242.28 ||
prakṛtiḥ kurute devī bhayaṃ pralayameva ca  |
divasānte guṇānetānatītyaiko'vatiṣṭhate  || 242.29 ||
raśmijālamivādityastatkālaṃ saṃniyacchati  |
evamevaiṣa tatsarvaṃ krīḍārthamabhimanyate  || 242.30 ||
ātmarūpaguṇānetān vividhān hṛdayapriyān  |
evametāṃ prakurvāṇaḥ sargapralayadharmiṇīm  || 242.31 ||
kriyāṃ kriyāpathe raktastriguṇastriguṇādhipaḥ  |
kriyākriyāpathopetastathā taditi manyate  || 242.32 ||
prakṛtyā sarvamevedaṃ jagadandhīkṛtaṃ vibho  |
rajasā tamasā caiva vyāptaṃ sarvamanekadhā  || 242.33 ||
evaṃ dvaṃdvānyatītāni mama vartanti nityaśaḥ  |
matta etāni jāyante pralaye yānti māmapi  || 242.34 ||
nistartavyāṇyathaitāni sarvāṇīti narādhipa  |
manyate pakṣabuddhitvāttathaiva sukṛtānyapi  || 242.35 ||
bhoktavyāni mamaitāni devalokagatena vai  |
ihaiva cainaṃ bhokṣyāmi śubhāśubhaphalodayam  || 242.36 ||
sukhamevaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sakṛtkṛtvā sukhaṃ mama  |
yāvadeva tu me saukhyaṃ jātyāṃ jātyāṃ bhaviṣyati  || 242.37 ||
bhaviṣyati na me duḥkhaṃ kṛtenehāpyanantakam  |
sukhaduḥkhaṃ hi mānuṣyaṃ niraye cāpi majjanam  || 242.38 ||
nirayāccāpi mānuṣyaṃ kālenaiṣyāmyahaṃ punaḥ  |
manuṣyatvācca devatvaṃ devatvātpauruṣaṃ punaḥ  || 242.39 ||
manuṣyatvācca nirayaṃ paryāyeṇopagacchati  |
eṣa evaṃ dvijātīnāmātmā vai sa guṇairvṛtaḥ  || 242.40 ||
tena devamanuṣyeṣu nirayaṃ copapadyate  |
mamatvenāvṛto nityaṃ tatraiva parivartate  || 242.41 ||
sargakoṭisahasrāṇi maraṇāntāsu mūrtiṣu  |
ya evaṃ kurute karma śubhāśubhaphalātmakam  || 242.42 ||
sa evaṃ phalamāpnoti triṣu lokeṣu mūrtimān  |
prakṛtiḥ kurute karma śubhāśubhaphalātmakam  || 242.43 ||
prakṛtiśca tathāpnoti triṣu lokeṣu kāmagā  |
tiryagyonimanuṣyatve devaloke tathaiva ca  || 242.44 ||
trīṇi sthānāni caitāni jānīyātprākṛtāni ha  |
aliṅgaprakṛtitvācca liṅgairapyanumīyate  || 242.45 ||
tathaiva pauruṣaṃ liṅgamanumānāddhi manyate  |
sa liṅgāntaramāsādya prākṛtaṃ liṅgamavraṇam  || 242.46 ||
vraṇadvārāṇyadhiṣṭhāya karmāṇyātmani manyate  |
śrotrādīni tu sarvāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇyatha  || 242.47 ||
rāgādīni pravartante guṇeṣviha guṇaiḥ saha  |
ahametāni vai kurvanmamaitānīndriyāṇi ha  || 242.48 ||
nirindriyo hi manyeta vraṇavānasmi nirvraṇaḥ  |
aliṅgo liṅgamātmānamakālaṃ kālamātmanaḥ  || 242.49 ||
asattvaṃ sattvamātmānamamṛtaṃ mṛtamātmanaḥ  |
amṛtyuṃ mṛtyumātmānamacaraṃ caramātmanaḥ  || 242.50 ||
akṣetraṃ kṣetramātmānamasaṅgaṃ saṅgamātmanaḥ  |
atattvaṃ tattvamātmānamabhavaṃ bhavamātmanaḥ  || 242.51 ||
akṣaraṃ kṣaramātmānamabuddhatvāddhi manyate  |
evamapratibuddhatvādabuddhajanasevanāt || 242.52 ||
sargakoṭisahasrāṇi patanāntāni gacchati  |
janmāntarasahasrāṇi maraṇāntāni gacchati  || 242.53 ||
tiryagyonimanuṣyatve devaloke tathaiva ca  |
candramā iva kośānāṃ punastatra sahasraśaḥ  || 242.54 ||
nīyate'pratibuddhatvādevameva kubuddhimān  |
kalā pañcadaśī yonistaddhāma iti paṭhyate  || 242.55 ||
nityameva vijānīhi somaṃ vai ṣoḍaśāṃśakaiḥ  |
kalayā jāyate'jasraṃ punaḥ punarabuddhimān  || 242.56 ||
dhīmāṃścāyaṃ na bhavati nṛpa evaṃ hi jāyate  |
ṣoḍaśī tu kalā sūkṣmā sa soma upadhāryatām  || 242.57 ||
na tūpayujyate devairdevānapi yunakti saḥ  |
mamatvaṃ kṣapayitvā tu jāyate nṛpasattama  |
prakṛtestriguṇāyāstu sa eva triguṇo bhavet || 242.58 ||
{janaka uvāca̱ }
akṣarakṣarayoreṣa dvayoḥ saṃbandha iṣyate  |
strīpuṃsayorvā saṃbandhaḥ sa vai puruṣa ucyate  || 243.1 ||
ṛte tu puruṣaṃ neha strī garbhān dhārayatyuta  |
ṛte striyaṃ na puruṣo rūpaṃ nirvartate tathā  || 243.2 ||
anyonyasyābhisaṃbandhādanyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt |
rūpaṃ nirvartayedetadevaṃ sarvāsu yoniṣu  || 243.3 ||
ratyarthamatisaṃyogādanyonyaguṇasaṃśrayāt |
ṛtau nirvartate rūpaṃ tadvakṣyāmi nidarśanam  || 243.4 ||
ye guṇāḥ puruṣasyeha ye ca māturguṇāstathā  |
asthi snāyu ca majjā ca jānīmaḥ pitṛto dvija  || 243.5 ||
tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitaṃ ceti mātṛjānyanuśuśruma  |
evametaddvijaśreṣṭha vedaśāstreṣu paṭhyate  || 243.6 ||
pramāṇaṃ yacca vedoktaṃ śāstroktaṃ yacca paṭhyate  |
vedaśāstrapramāṇaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ tatsanātanam  || 243.7 ||
evamevābhisaṃbandhau nityaṃ prakṛtipūruṣau  |
yaccāpi bhagavaṃstasmānmokṣadharmo na vidyate  || 243.8 ||
athavānantarakṛtaṃ kiṃcideva nidarśanam  |
tanmamācakṣva tattvena pratyakṣo hyasi sarvadā  || 243.9 ||
mokṣakāmā vayaṃ cāpi kāṅkṣāmo yadanāmayam  |
ajeyamajaraṃ nityamatīndriyamanīśvaram  || 243.10 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
yadetaduktaṃ bhavatā vedaśāstranidarśanam  |
evametadyathā vakṣye tattvagrāhī yathā bhavān  || 243.11 ||
dhāryate hi tvayā grantha ubhayorvedaśāstrayoḥ  |
na ca granthasya tattvajño yathātattvaṃ nareśvara  || 243.12 ||
yo hi vede ca śāstre ca granthadhāraṇatatparaḥ  |
na ca granthārthatattvajñastasya taddhāraṇaṃ vṛthā  || 243.13 ||
bhāraṃ sa vahate tasya granthasyārthaṃ na vetti yaḥ  |
yastu granthārthatattvajño nāsya granthāgamo vṛthā  || 243.14 ||
granthasyārthaṃ sa pṛṣṭastu mādṛśo vaktumarhati  |
yathātattvābhigamanādarthaṃ tasya sa vindati  || 243.15 ||
na yaḥ samutsukaḥ kaścidgranthārthaṃ sthūlabuddhimān  |
sa kathaṃ mandavijñāno granthaṃ vakṣyati nirṇayāt || 243.16 ||
ajñātvā granthatattvāni vādaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥ  |
lobhādvāpyathavā dambhātsa pāpī narakaṃ vrajet || 243.17 ||
nirṇayaṃ cāpi cchidrātmā na tadvakṣyati tattvataḥ  |
so'pīhāsyārthatattvajño yasmānnaivātmavānapi  || 243.18 ||
tasmāttvaṃ śṛṇu rājendra yathaitadanudṛśyate  |
yathā tattvena sāṃkhyeṣu yogeṣu ca mahātmasu  || 243.19 ||
yadeva yogāḥ paśyanti sāṃkhyaṃ tadanugamyate  |
ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa buddhimān  || 243.20 ||
tvaṅmāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjāsthi snāyu ca  |
etadaindriyakaṃ tāta yadbhavānitthamāttha mām  || 243.21 ||
dravyāddravyasya nirvṛttirindriyādindriyaṃ tathā  |
dehāddehamavāpnoti bījādbījaṃ tathaiva ca  || 243.22 ||
nirindriyasya bījasya nirdravyasyāpi dehinaḥ  |
kathaṃ guṇā bhaviṣyanti nirguṇatvānmahātmanaḥ  || 243.23 ||
guṇā guṇeṣu jāyante tatraiva viramanti ca  |
evaṃ guṇāḥ prakṛtijā jāyante na ca yānti ca  || 243.24 ||
tvaṅmāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjāsthi snāyu ca  |
aṣṭau tānyatha śukreṇa jānīhi prākṛtena vai  || 243.25 ||
pumāṃścaivāpumāṃścaiva strīliṅgaṃ prākṛtaṃ smṛtam  |
vāyureṣa pumāṃścaiva rasa ityabhidhīyate  || 243.26 ||
aliṅgā prakṛtirliṅgairupalabhyati sātmajaiḥ  |
yathā puṣpaphalairnityaṃ mūrtaṃ cāmūrtayastathā  || 243.27 ||
evamapyanumānena sa liṅgamupalabhyate  |
pañcaviṃśatikastāta liṅgeṣu niyatātmakaḥ  || 243.28 ||
anādinidhano'nantaḥ sarvadarśanakevalaḥ  |
kevalaṃ tvabhimānitvādguṇeṣu guṇa ucyate  || 243.29 ||
guṇā guṇavataḥ santi nirguṇasya kuto guṇāḥ  |
tasmādevaṃ vijānanti ye janā guṇadarśinaḥ  || 243.30 ||
yadā tveṣa guṇānetān prākṛtānabhimanyate  |
tadā sa guṇavāneva guṇabhedān prapaśyati  || 243.31 ||
yattadbuddheḥ paraṃ prāhuḥ sāṃkhyayogaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ  |
budhyamānaṃ mahāprājñāḥ prabuddhaparivarjanāt || 243.32 ||
aprabuddhaṃ yathā vyaktaṃ svaguṇaiḥ prāhurīśvaram  |
nirguṇaṃ ceśvaraṃ nityamadhiṣṭhātārameva ca  || 243.33 ||
prakṛteśca guṇānāṃ ca pañcaviṃśatikaṃ budhāḥ  |
sāṃkhyayoge ca kuśalā budhyante paramaiṣiṇaḥ  || 243.34 ||
yadā prabuddhamavyaktamavasthātananīravaḥ  |
budhyamānaṃ na budhyante'vagacchanti samaṃ tadā  || 243.35 ||
etannidarśanaṃ samyaṅna samyaganudarśanam  |
budhyamānaṃ prabudhyante dvābhyāṃ pṛthagariṃdama  || 243.36 ||
paraspareṇaitaduktaṃ kṣarākṣaranidarśanam  |
ekatvamakṣaraṃ prāhurnānātvaṃ kṣaramucyate  || 243.37 ||
pañcaviṃśatiniṣṭho'yaṃ tadā samyakpracakṣate  |
ekatvadarśanaṃ cāsya nānātvaṃ cāsya darśanam  || 243.38 ||
tattvavittattvayoreva pṛthagetannidarśanam  |
pañcaviṃśatibhistattvaṃ tattvamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  || 243.39 ||
nistattvaṃ pañcaviṃśasya paramāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  |
varjyasya varjyamācāraṃ tattvaṃ tattvātsanātanam  || 243.40 ||
{karālajanaka uvāca̱ }
nānātvaikatvamityuktaṃ tvayaitaddvijasattama  |
paśyatastaddhi saṃdigdhametayorvai nidarśanam  || 243.41 ||
tathā buddhaprabuddhābhyāṃ budhyamānasya cānagha  |
sthūlabuddhyā na paśyāmi tattvametanna saṃśayaḥ  || 243.42 ||
akṣarakṣarayoruktaṃ tvayā yadapi kāraṇam  |
tadapyasthirabuddhitvātpranaṣṭamiva me'nagha  || 243.43 ||
tadetacchrotumicchāmi nānātvaikatvadarśanam  |
dvaṃdvaṃ caivāniruddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ  || 243.44 ||
vidyāvidye ca bhagavannakṣaraṃ kṣarameva ca  |
sāṃkhyayogaṃ ca kṛtsnena buddhābuddhiṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 243.45 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
hanta te saṃpravakṣyāmi yadetadanupṛcchasi  |
yogakṛtyaṃ mahārāja pṛthageva śṛṇuṣva me  || 243.46 ||
yogakṛtyaṃ tu yogānāṃ dhyānameva paraṃ balam  |
taccāpi dvividhaṃ dhyānamāhurvidyāvido janāḥ  || 243.47 ||
ekāgratā ca manasaḥ prāṇāyāmastathaiva ca  |
prāṇāyāmastu saguṇo nirguṇo mānasastathā  || 243.48 ||
mūtrotsarge purīṣe ca bhojane ca narādhipa  |
dvikālaṃ nopabhuñjīta śeṣaṃ bhuñjīta tatparaḥ  || 243.49 ||
indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyo nivartya manasā muniḥ  |
daśadvādaśabhirvāpi caturviṃśātparaṃ yataḥ  || 243.50 ||
sa codanābhirmatimānnātmānaṃ codayedatha  |
tiṣṭhantamajaraṃ taṃ tu yattaduktaṃ manīṣibhiḥ  || 243.51 ||
viśvātmā satataṃ jñeya ityevamanuśuśruma  |
dravyaṃ hyahīnamanaso nānyatheti viniścayaḥ  || 243.52 ||
vimuktaḥ sarvasaṅgebhyo laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ  |
pūrvarātre parārdhe ca dhārayīta mano hṛdi  || 243.53 ||
sthirīkṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ manasā mithileśvara  |
mano buddhyā sthiraṃ kṛtvā pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ  || 243.54 ||
sthāṇuvaccāpyakampyaḥ syāddāruvaccāpi niścalaḥ  |
