buddhyā vidhividhānajñastato yuktaṃ pracakṣate  || 243.55 ||
na śṛṇoti na cāghrāti na ca paśyati kiṃcana  |
na ca sparśaṃ vijānāti na ca saṃkalpate manaḥ  || 243.56 ||
na cāpi manyate kiṃcinna ca budhyeta kāṣṭhavat |
tadā prakṛtimāpannaṃ yuktamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  || 243.57 ||
na bhāti hi yathā dīpo dīptistadvacca dṛśyate  |
niliṅgaścādhaścordhvaṃ ca tiryaggatimavāpnuyāt || 243.58 ||
tadā tadupapannaśca yasmin dṛṣṭe ca kathyate  |
hṛdayastho'ntarātmeti jñeyo jñastāta madvidhaiḥ  || 243.59 ||
nirdhūma iva saptārcirāditya iva raśmivān  |
vaidyuto'gnirivākāśe paśyatyātmānamātmani  || 243.60 ||
yaṃ paśyanti mahātmāno dhṛtimanto manīṣiṇaḥ  |
brāhmaṇā brahmayonisthā hyayonimamṛtātmakam  || 243.61 ||
tadevāhuraṇubhyo'ṇu tanmahadbhyo mahattaram  |
sarvatra sarvabhūteṣu dhruvaṃ tiṣṭhanna dṛśyate  || 243.62 ||
buddhidravyeṇa dṛśyena manodīpena lokakṛt |
mahatastamasastāta pāre tiṣṭhanna tāmasaḥ  || 243.63 ||
tamaso dūra ityuktastattvajñairvedapāragaiḥ  |
vimalo vimataścaiva nirliṅgo'liṅgasaṃjñakaḥ  || 243.64 ||
yoga eṣa hi lokānāṃ kimanyadyogalakṣaṇam  |
evaṃ paśyan prapaśyeta ātmānamajaraṃ param  || 243.65 ||
yogadarśanametāvaduktaṃ te tattvato mayā  |
sāṃkhyajñānaṃ pravakṣyāmi parisaṃkhyānidarśanam  || 243.66 ||
avyaktamāhuḥ prakhyānaṃ parāṃ prakṛtimātmanaḥ  |
tasmānmahatsamutpannaṃ dvitīyaṃ rājasattama  || 243.67 ||
ahaṃkārastu mahatastṛtīya iti naḥ śrutam  |
pañcabhūtānyahaṃkārādāhuḥ sāṃkhyātmadarśinaḥ  || 243.68 ||
etāḥ prakṛtayastvaṣṭau vikārāścāpi ṣoḍaśa  |
pañca caiva viśeṣāśca tathā pañcendriyāṇi ca  || 243.69 ||
etāvadeva tattvānāṃ sāṃkhyamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  |
sāṃkhye sāṃkhyavidhānajñā nityaṃ sāṃkhyapathe sthitāḥ  || 243.70 ||
yasmādyadabhijāyeta tattatraiva pralīyate  |
līyante pratilomāni gṛhyante cāntarātmanā  || 243.71 ||
ānulomyena jāyante līyante pratilomataḥ  |
guṇā guṇeṣu satataṃ sāgarasyormayo yathā  || 243.72 ||
sargapralaya etāvān prakṛternṛpasattama  |
ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca tathā sṛji  || 243.73 ||
evameva ca rājendra vijñeyaṃ jñānakovidaiḥ  |
adhiṣṭhātāramavyaktamasyāpyetannidarśanam  || 243.74 ||
ekatvaṃ ca bahutvaṃ ca prakṛteranu tattvavān  |
ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca pravartanāt || 243.75 ||
bahudhātmā prakurvīta prakṛtiṃ prasavātmikām  |
tacca kṣetraṃ mahānātmā pañcaviṃśo'dhitiṣṭhati  || 243.76 ||
adhiṣṭhāteti rājendra procyate yatisattamaiḥ  |
adhiṣṭhānādadhiṣṭhātā kṣetrāṇāmiti naḥ śrutam  || 243.77 ||
kṣetraṃ jānāti cāvyaktaṃ kṣetrajña iti cocyate  |
avyaktike pure śete puruṣaśceti kathyate  || 243.78 ||
anyadeva ca kṣetraṃ syādanyaḥ kṣetrajña ucyate  |
kṣetramavyakta ityuktaṃ jñātāraṃ pañcaviṃśakam  || 243.79 ||
anyadeva ca jñānaṃ syādanyajjñeyaṃ taducyate  |
jñānamavyaktamityuktaṃ jñeyo vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ  || 243.80 ||
avyaktaṃ kṣetramityuktaṃ tathā sattvaṃ tatheśvaram  |
anīśvaramatattvaṃ ca tattvaṃ tatpañcaviṃśakam  || 243.81 ||
sāṃkhyadarśanametāvatparisaṃkhyā na vidyate  |
saṃkhyā prakurute caiva prakṛtiṃ ca pravakṣyate  || 243.82 ||
catvāriṃśaccaturviṃśatpratisaṃkhyāya tattvataḥ  |
saṃkhyā sahasrakṛtyā tu nistattvaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ  || 243.83 ||
pañcaviṃśatprabuddhātmā budhyamāna iti śrutaḥ  |
yadā budhyati ātmānaṃ tadā bhavati kevalaḥ  || 243.84 ||
samyagdarśanametāvadbhāṣitaṃ tava tattvataḥ  |
evametadvijānantaḥ sāmyatāṃ pratiyāntyuta  || 243.85 ||
samyaṅnidarśanaṃ nāma pratyakṣaṃ prakṛtestathā  |
guṇavattvādyathaitāni nirguṇebhyastathā bhavet || 243.86 ||
na tvevaṃ vartamānānāmāvṛttirvartate punaḥ  |
vidyate kṣarabhāvaśca na parasparamavyayam  || 243.87 ||
paśyantyamatayo ye na samyakteṣu ca darśanam  |
te vyaktiṃ pratipadyante punaḥ punarariṃdama  || 243.88 ||
sarvametadvijānanto na sarvasya prabodhanāt |
vyaktibhūtā bhaviṣyanti vyaktasyaivānuvartanāt || 243.89 ||
sarvamavyaktamityuktamasarvaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ  |
ya evamabhijānanti na bhayaṃ teṣu vidyate  || 243.90 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
sāṃkhyadarśanametāvaduktaṃ te nṛpasattama  |
vidyāvidye tvidānīṃ me tvaṃ nibodhānupūrvaśaḥ  || 244.1 ||
abhedyamāhuravyaktaṃ sargapralayadharmiṇaḥ  |
sargapralaya ityuktaṃ vidyāvidye ca viṃśakaḥ  || 244.2 ||
parasparasya vidyā vai tannibodhānupūrvaśaḥ  |
yathoktamṛṣibhistāta sāṃkhyasyātinidarśanam  || 244.3 ||
karmendriyāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidyā buddhīndriyaṃ smṛtam  |
buddhīndriyāṇāṃ ca tathā viśeṣā iti naḥ śrutam  || 244.4 ||
viṣayāṇāṃ manasteṣāṃ vidyāmāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ  |
manasaḥ pañca bhūtāni vidyā ityabhicakṣate  || 244.5 ||
ahaṃkārastu bhūtānāṃ pañcānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ  |
ahaṃkārastathā vidyā buddhirvidyā nareśvara  || 244.6 ||
buddhyā prakṛtiravyaktaṃ tattvānāṃ parameśvaraḥ  |
vidyā jñeyā naraśreṣṭha vidhiśca paramaḥ smṛtaḥ  || 244.7 ||
avyaktamaparaṃ prāhurvidyā vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ  |
sarvasya sarvamityuktaṃ jñeyajñānasya pāragaḥ  || 244.8 ||
jñānamavyaktamityuktaṃ jñeyaṃ vai pañcaviṃśakam  |
tathaiva jñānamavyaktaṃ vijñātā pañcaviṃśakaḥ  || 244.9 ||
vidyāvidye tu tattvena mayokte vai viśeṣataḥ  |
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva yaduktaṃ tannibodha me  || 244.10 ||
ubhāvetau kṣarāvuktau ubhāvetāvanakṣarau  |
kāraṇaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi yathājñānaṃ tu jñānataḥ  || 244.11 ||
anādinidhanāvetau ubhāveveśvarau matau  |
tattvasaṃjñāvubhāveva procyete jñānacintakaiḥ  || 244.12 ||
sargapralayadharmitvādavyaktaṃ prāhuravyayam  |
tadetadguṇasargāya vikurvāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ  || 244.13 ||
guṇānāṃ mahadādīnāmutpadyati parasparam  |
adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṣetramāhuretadvai pañcaviṃśakam  || 244.14 ||
yadantarguṇajālaṃ tu tadvyaktātmani saṃkṣipet |
tadahaṃ tadguṇaistaistu pañcaviṃśe vilīyate  || 244.15 ||
guṇā guṇeṣu līyante tadekā prakṛtirbhavet |
kṣetrajño'pi tadā tāvatkṣetrajñaḥ saṃpraṇīyate  || 244.16 ||
yadākṣaraṃ prakṛtiryaṃ gacchate guṇasaṃjñitā  |
nirguṇatvaṃ ca vai dehe guṇeṣu parivartanāt || 244.17 ||
evameva ca kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrajñānaparikṣayāt |
prakṛtyā nirguṇastveṣa ityevamanuśuśruma  || 244.18 ||
kṣaro bhavatyeṣa yadā guṇavatī guṇeṣvatha  |
prakṛtiṃ tvatha jānāti nirguṇatvaṃ tathātmanaḥ  || 244.19 ||
tathā viśuddho bhavati prakṛteḥ parivarjanāt |
anyo'hamanyeyamiti yadā budhyati buddhimān  || 244.20 ||
tadaiṣo'vyathatāmeti na ca miśratvamāvrajet |
prakṛtyā caiṣa rājendra miśro'nyo'nyasya dṛśyate  || 244.21 ||
yadā tu guṇajālaṃ tatprākṛtaṃ vijugupsate  |
paśyate ca paraṃ paśyaṃstadā paśyannu saṃsṛjet || 244.22 ||
kiṃ mayā kṛtametāvadyo'haṃ kālanimajjanaḥ  |
yathā matsyo hyabhijñānādanuvartitavāñjalam  || 244.23 ||
ahameva hi saṃmohādanyamanyaṃ janājjanam  |
matsyo yathodakajñānādanuvartitavāniha  || 244.24 ||
matsyo'nyatvamathājñānādudakānnābhimanyate  |
ātmānaṃ tadavajñānādanyaṃ caiva na vedmyaham  || 244.25 ||
mamāstu dhikkubuddhasya yo'haṃ magna imaṃ punaḥ  |
anuvartitavānmohādanyamanyaṃ janājjanam  || 244.26 ||
ayamanubhavedbandhuranena saha me kṣayam  |
sāmyamekatvatāṃ yāto yādṛśastādṛśastvaham  || 244.27 ||
tulyatāmiha paśyāmi sadṛśo'hamanena vai  |
ayaṃ hi vimalo vyaktamahamīdṛśakastadā  || 244.28 ||
yo'hamajñānasaṃmohādajñayā saṃpravṛttavān  |
saṃsargādatisaṃsargātsthitaḥ kālamimaṃ tvaham  || 244.29 ||
so'hamevaṃ vaśībhūtaḥ kālametaṃ na buddhavān  |
uttamādhamamadhyānāṃ tāmahaṃ kathamāvase  || 244.30 ||
samānamāyayā ceha sahavāsamahaṃ katham  |
gacchāmyabuddhabhāvatvādihedānīṃ sthiro bhava  || 244.31 ||
sahavāsaṃ na yāsyāmi kālametaṃ vivañcanāt |
vañcito hyanayā yaddhi nirvikāro vikārayā  || 244.32 ||
na tattadaparāddhaṃ syādaparādho hyayaṃ mama  |
yo'hamatrābhavaṃ saktaḥ parāṅmukhamupasthitaḥ  || 244.33 ||
tato'smin bahurūpo'tha sthito mūrtiramūrtimān  |
amūrtiścāpyamūrtātmā mamatvena pradharṣitaḥ  || 244.34 ||
prakṛtyā ca tayā tena tāsu tāsviha yoniṣu  |
nirmamasya mamatvena vikṛtaṃ tāsu tāsu ca  || 244.35 ||
yoniṣu vartamānena naṣṭasaṃjñena cetasā  |
samatā na mayā kācidahaṃkāre kṛtā mayā  || 244.36 ||
ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā so'yaṃ bhūyo yunakti mām  |
idānīmavabuddho'smi nirmamo nirahaṃkṛtaḥ  || 244.37 ||
mamatvaṃ manasā nityamahaṃkārakṛtātmakam  |
apalagnāmimāṃ hitvā saṃśrayiṣye nirāmayam  || 244.38 ||
anena sāmyaṃ yāsyāmi nānayāhamacetasā  |
kṣemaṃ mama sahānena naivaikamanayā saha  || 244.39 ||
evaṃ paramasaṃbodhātpañcaviṃśo'nubuddhavān  |
akṣaratvaṃ nigacchati tyaktvā kṣaramanāmayam  || 244.40 ||
avyaktaṃ vyaktadharmāṇaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā  |
nirguṇaṃ prathamaṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛgbhavati maithila  || 244.41 ||
akṣarakṣarayoretaduktaṃ tava nidarśanam  |
mayeha jñānasaṃpannaṃ yathā śrutinidarśanāt || 244.42 ||
niḥsaṃdigdhaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ ca viśuddhaṃ vimalaṃ tathā  |
pravakṣyāmi tu te bhūyastannibodha yathāśrutam  || 244.43 ||
sāṃkhyayogo mayā proktaḥ śāstradvayanidarśanāt |
yadeva sāṃkhyaśāstroktaṃ yogadarśanameva tat || 244.44 ||
prabodhanaparaṃ jñānaṃ sāṃkhyānāmavanīpate  |
vispaṣṭaṃ procyate tatra śiṣyāṇāṃ hitakāmyayā  || 244.45 ||
bṛhaccaivamidaṃ śāstramityāhurviduṣo janāḥ  |
asmiṃśca śāstre yogānāṃ punarbhavapuraḥsaram  || 244.46 ||
pañcaviṃśātparaṃ tattvaṃ paṭhyate ca narādhipa  |
sāṃkhyānāṃ tu paraṃ tattvaṃ yathāvadanuvarṇitam  || 244.47 ||
buddhamapratibuddhaṃ ca budhyamānaṃ ca tattvataḥ  |
budhyamānaṃ ca buddhatvaṃ prāhuryoganidarśanam  || 244.48 ||
{vasiṣṭha uvāca̱ }
aprabuddhamathāvyaktamimaṃ guṇanidhiṃ sadā  |
guṇānāṃ dhāryatāṃ tattvaṃ sṛjatyākṣipate tathā  || 245.1 ||
ajo hi krīḍayā bhūpa vikriyāṃ prāpta ityuta  |
ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā nāneva praticakṣate  || 245.2 ||
etadevaṃ vikurvāṇo budhyamāno na budhyate  |
guṇānācarate hyeṣa sṛjatyākṣipate tathā  || 245.3 ||
avyaktabodhanāccaiva budhyamānaṃ vadantyapi  |
na tvevaṃ budhyate'vyaktaṃ saguṇaṃ tāta nirguṇam  || 245.4 ||
kadācittveva khalvetattadāhuḥ pratibuddhakam  |
budhyate yadi cāvyaktametadvai pañcaviṃśakam  || 245.5 ||
budhyamāno bhavatyeṣa mamātmaka iti śrutaḥ  |
anyonyapratibuddhena vadantyavyaktamacyutam  || 245.6 ||
avyaktabodhanāccaiva budhyamānaṃ vadantyuta  |
pañcaviṃśaṃ mahātmānaṃ na cāsāvapi budhyate  || 245.7 ||
ṣaḍviṃśaṃ vimalaṃ buddhamaprameyaṃ sanātanam  |
satataṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ tu caturviṃśaṃ vibudhyate  || 245.8 ||
dṛśyādṛśye hyanugata tatsvabhāve mahādyute  |
avyaktaṃ caiva tadbrahma budhyate tāta kevalam  || 245.9 ||
pañcaviṃśaṃ caturviṃśamātmānamanupaśyati  |
budhyamāno yadātmānamanyo'hamiti manyate  || 245.10 ||
tadā prakṛtimāneṣa bhavatyavyaktalocanaḥ  |
budhyate ca parāṃ buddhiṃ viśuddhāmamalāṃ yathā  || 245.11 ||
ṣaḍviṃśaṃ rājaśārdūla tadā buddhaḥ kṛto vrajet |
tatastyajati so'vyaktaṃ sargapralayadharmiṇam  || 245.12 ||
nirguṇāṃ prakṛtiṃ veda guṇayuktāmacetanām  |
tataḥ kevaladharmāsau bhavatyavyaktadarśanāt || 245.13 ||
kevalena samāgamya vimuktātmānamāpnuyāt |
etattu tattvamityāhurnistattvamajarāmaram  || 245.14 ||
tattvasaṃśravaṇādeva tattvajño jāyate nṛpa  |
pañcaviṃśatitattvāni pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ  || 245.15 ||
na caiva tattvavāṃstāta saṃsāreṣu nimajjati  |
eṣāmupaiti tattvaṃ hi kṣipraṃ budhyasva lakṣaṇam  || 245.16 ||
ṣaḍviṃśo'yamiti prājño gṛhyamāṇo'jarāmaraḥ  |
kevalena balenaiva samatāṃ yātyasaṃśayam  || 245.17 ||
ṣaḍviṃśena prabuddhena budhyamāno'pyabuddhimān  |
etannānātvamityuktaṃ sāṃkhyaśrutinidarśanāt || 245.18 ||
cetanena sametasya pañcaviṃśatikasya ha  |
ekatvaṃ vai bhavettasya yadā buddhyānubudhyate  || 245.19 ||
budhyamānena buddhena samatāṃ yāti maithila  |
saṅgadharmā bhavatyeṣa niḥsaṅgātmā narādhipa  || 245.20 ||
niḥsaṅgātmānamāsādya ṣaḍviṃśaṃ karmajaṃ viduḥ  |
vibhustyajati cāvyaktaṃ yadā tvetadvibudhyate  || 245.21 ||
caturviṃśamagādhaṃ ca ṣaḍviṃśasya prabodhanāt |
eṣa hyapratibuddhaśca budhyamānastu te'nagha  || 245.22 ||
ukto buddhaśca tattvena yathāśrutinidarśanāt |
maśakodumbare yadvadanyatvaṃ tadvadetayoḥ  || 245.23 ||
matsyodake yathā tadvadanyatvamupalabhyate  |
evameva ca gantavyaṃ nānātvaikatvametayoḥ  || 245.24 ||
etāvanmokṣa ityukto jñānavijñānasaṃjñitaḥ  |
pañcaviṃśatikasyāśu yo'yaṃ dehe pravartate  || 245.25 ||
eṣa mokṣayitavyaiti prāhuravyaktagocarāt |
so'yamevaṃ vimucyeta nānyatheti viniścayaḥ  || 245.26 ||
paraśca paradharmā ca bhavatyeva sametya vai  |
viśuddhadharmā śuddhena nāśuddhena ca buddhimān  || 245.27 ||
vimuktadharmā buddhena sametya puruṣarṣabha  |
viyogadharmiṇā caiva vimuktātmā bhavatyatha  || 245.28 ||
vimokṣiṇā vimokṣaśca sametyeha tathā bhavet |
śucikarmā śuciścaiva bhavatyamitabuddhimān  || 245.29 ||
vimalātmā ca bhavati sametya vimalātmanā  |
kevalātmā tathā caiva kevalena sametya vai  |
svatantraśca svatantreṇa svatantratvamavāpyate  || 245.30 ||
etāvadetatkathitaṃ mayā te  245.31
tathyaṃ mahārāja yathārthatattvam  245.31
amatsarastvaṃ pratigṛhya buddhyā  245.31
sanātanaṃ brahma viśuddhamādyam  245.31
tadvedaniṣṭhasya janasya rājan  245.32
pradeyametatparamaṃ tvayā bhavet 245.32
vidhitsamānāya nibodhakārakaṃ  245.32
prabodhahetoḥ praṇatasya śāsanam  245.32
na deyametacca yathānṛtātmane  245.33
śaṭhāya klībāya na jihmabuddhaye  245.33
na paṇḍitajñānaparopatāpine  245.33
deyaṃ tathā śiṣyavibodhanāya  245.33
śraddhānvitāyātha guṇānvitāya  245.34
parāpavādādviratāya nityam  245.34
viśuddhayogāya budhāya caiva  245.34
kṛpāvate'tha kṣamiṇe hitāya  245.34
viviktaśīlāya vidhipriyāya  245.35
vivādahīnāya bahuśrutāya  245.35
vinītaveśāya nahaitukātmane  245.35
sadaiva guhyaṃ tvidameva deyam  245.35
etairguṇairhīnatame na deyam  245.36
etatparaṃ brahma viśuddhamāhuḥ  245.36
na śreyase yokṣyati tādṛśe kṛtaṃ  245.36
dharmapravaktāramapātradānāt 245.36
pṛthvīmimāṃ vā yadi ratnapūrṇāṃ  245.37
dadyādadeyaṃ tvidamavratāya  245.37
jitendriyāya prayatāya deyaṃ  245.37
deyaṃ paraṃ tattvavide narendra  245.37
karāla mā te bhayamasti kiṃcid 245.38
etacchrutaṃ brahma paraṃ tvayādya  245.38
yathāvaduktaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ  245.38
viśokamatyantamanādimadhyam  245.38
agādhametadajarāmaraṃ ca  245.39
nirāmayaṃ vītabhayaṃ śivaṃ ca  245.39
samīkṣya mohaṃ paravādasaṃjñam  245.39
etasya tattvārthamimaṃ viditvā  245.39
avāptametaddhi purā sanātanād 245.40
dhiraṇyagarbhāddhi tato narādhipa  245.40
prasādya yatnena tamugratejasaṃ  245.40
sanātanaṃ brahma yathā tvayaitat 245.40
pṛṣṭastvayā cāsmi yathā narendra  245.41
tathā mayedaṃ tvayi noktamanyat 245.41
yathāvāptaṃ brahmaṇo me narendra  245.41
mahājñānaṃ mokṣavidāṃ parāyaṇam  245.41
{vyāsa uvāca̱ }
etaduktaṃ paraṃ brahma yasmānnāvartate punaḥ  |
pañcaviṃśaṃ muniśreṣṭhā vasiṣṭhena yathā purā  || 245.42 ||
punarāvṛttimāpnoti paramaṃ jñānamavyayam  |
nāti budhyati tattvena budhyamāno'jarāmaram  || 245.43 ||
etanniḥśreyasakaraṃ jñānaṃ bhoḥ paramaṃ mayā  |
kathitaṃ tattvato viprāḥ śrutvā devarṣito dvijāḥ  || 245.44 ||
hiraṇyagarbhādṛṣiṇā vasiṣṭhena samāhṛtam  |
vasiṣṭhādṛṣiśārdūlo nārado'vāptavānidam  || 245.45 ||
nāradādviditaṃ mahyametaduktaṃ sanātanam  |
mā śucadhvaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ śrutvaitatparamaṃ padam  || 245.46 ||
yena kṣarākṣare bhinne na bhayaṃ tasya vidyate  |
vidyate tu bhayaṃ yasya yo nainaṃ vetti tattvataḥ  || 245.47 ||
avijñānācca mūḍhātmā punaḥ punarupadravān  |
pretya jātisahasrāṇi maraṇāntānyupāśnute  || 245.48 ||
devalokaṃ tathā tiryaṅmānuṣyamapi cāśnute  |
yadi vā mucyate vāpi tasmādajñānasāgarāt || 245.49 ||
ajñānasāgare ghore hyavyaktāgādha ucyate  |
ahanyahani majjanti yatra bhūtāni bho dvijāḥ  || 245.50 ||
tasmādagādhādavyaktādupakṣīṇātsanātanāt |
tasmādyūyaṃ virajaskā vitamaskāśca bho dvijāḥ  || 245.51 ||
evaṃ mayā muniśreṣṭhāḥ sārātsārataraṃ param  |
kathitaṃ paramaṃ mokṣaṃ yaṃ jñātvā na nivartate  || 245.52 ||
na nāstikāya dātavyaṃ nābhaktāya kadācana  |
na duṣṭamataye viprā na śraddhāvimukhāya ca  || 245.53 ||
{lomaharṣaṇa uvāca̱ }
evaṃ purā munīn vyāsaḥ purāṇaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā  |
daśāṣṭadoṣarahitairvākyaiḥ sāratarairdvijāḥ  || 246.1 ||
pūrṇamastamalaiḥ śuddhairnānāśāstrasamuccayaiḥ  |
jātiśuddhasamāyuktaṃ sādhuśabdopaśobhitam  || 246.2 ||
pūrvapakṣoktisiddhānta pariniṣṭhāsamanvitam  |
śrāvayitvā yathānyāyaṃ virarāma mahāmatiḥ  || 246.3 ||
te'pi śrutvā muniśreṣṭhāḥ purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam  |
ādyaṃ brāhmābhidhānaṃ ca sarvavāñchāphalapradam  || 246.4 ||
hṛṣṭā babhūvuḥ suprītā vismitāśca punaḥ punaḥ  |
praśaśaṃsustadā vyāsaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim  || 246.5 ||
{munaya ūcu̱ḥ }
aho tvayā muniśreṣṭha purāṇaṃ śrutisaṃmitam  |
sarvābhipretaphaladaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param  || 246.6 ||
proktaṃ śrutaṃ tathāsmābhirvicitrapadamakṣaram  |
na te'styaviditaṃ kiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu vai prabho  || 246.7 ||
sarvajñastvaṃ mahābhāga deveṣviva bṛhaspatiḥ  |
namasyāmo mahāprājñaṃ brahmiṣṭhaṃ tvāṃ mahāmunim  || 246.8 ||
yena tvayā tu vedārthā bhārate prakaṭīkṛtāḥ  |
kaḥ śaknoti guṇān vaktuṃ tava sarvānmahāmune  || 246.9 ||
adhītya caturo vedān sāṅgān vyākaraṇāni ca  |
kṛtavān bhārataṃ śāstraṃ tasmai jñānātmane namaḥ  || 246.10 ||
namo'stu te vyāsa viśālabuddhe  246.11
phullāravindāyatapattranetra  246.11
yena tvayā bhāratatailapūrṇaḥ  246.11
prajvālito jñānamayaḥ pradīpaḥ  246.11
ajñānatimirāndhānāṃ bhrāmitānāṃ kudṛṣṭibhiḥ  |
jñānāñjanaśalākena tvayā conmīlitā dṛśaḥ  || 246.12 ||
evamuktvā samabhyarcya vyāsaṃ te caiva pūjitāḥ  |
jagmuryathāgataṃ sarve kṛtakṛtyāḥ svamāśramam  || 246.13 ||
tathā mayā muniśreṣṭhā kathitaṃ hi sanātanam  |
purāṇaṃ sumahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam  || 246.14 ||
yathā bhavadbhiḥ pṛṣṭo'haṃ saṃpraśnaṃ dvijasattamāḥ  |
vyāsaprasādāttatsarvaṃ mayā saṃparikīrtitam  || 246.15 ||
idaṃ gṛhasthaiḥ śrotavyaṃ yatibhirbrahmacāribhiḥ  |
dhanasaukhyapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam  || 246.16 ||
tathā brahmaparairviprairbrāhmaṇādyaiḥ susaṃyataiḥ  |
śrotavyaṃ suprayatnena samyakśreyobhikāṅkṣibhiḥ  || 246.17 ||
prāpnoti brāhmaṇo vidyāṃ kṣatriyo vijayaṃ raṇe  |
vaiśyastu dhanamakṣayyaṃ śūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt || 246.18 ||
yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyañśṛṇoti puruṣaḥ śuciḥ  |
taṃ taṃ kāmamavāpnoti naro nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ  || 246.19 ||
purāṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tvetatsarvakilbiṣanāśanam  |
viśiṣṭaṃ sarvaśāstrebhyaḥ puruṣārthopapādakam  || 246.20 ||
etadvo yanmayākhyātaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam  |
śrute'smin sarvadoṣotthaḥ pāparāśiḥ praṇaśyati  || 246.21 ||
prayāge puṣkare caiva kurukṣetre tathārbude  |
upoṣya yadavāpnoti tadasya śravaṇānnaraḥ  || 246.22 ||
yadagnihotre suhute varṣe nāpnoti vai phalam  |
mahāpuṇyamayaṃ viprāstadasya śravaṇātsakṛt || 246.23 ||
yajjyeṣṭhaśukladvādaśyāṃ snātvā vai yamunājale  |
mathurāyāṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā prāpnoti puruṣaḥ phalam  || 246.24 ||
tadāpnoti phalaṃ samyaksamādhānena kīrtanāt |
purāṇe'sya hito viprāḥ keśavārpitamānasaḥ  || 246.25 ||
yatphalaṃ kriyamālokya puruṣo'tha labhennaraḥ  |
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi  || 246.26 ||
idaṃ yaḥ śraddhayā nityaṃ purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam  |
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānmartyaḥ sa yāti bhuvanaṃ hareḥ  || 246.27 ||
śrāvayedbrāhmaṇo yastu sadā parvasu saṃyataḥ  |
ekādaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati  || 246.28 ||
idaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sukhadaṃ kīrtivardhanam  |
balapuṣṭipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam  || 246.29 ||
trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedvidvāñśraddhayā susamāhitaḥ  |
idaṃ variṣṭhamākhyānaṃ sa sarvamīpsitaṃ labhet || 246.30 ||
rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt |
bhayādvimucyate bhīta āpadāpanna āpadaḥ  || 246.31 ||
jātismaratvaṃ vidyāṃ ca putrānmedhāṃ paśūn dhṛtim  |
dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ tu labhate naraḥ  || 246.32 ||
yān yān kāmānabhipretya paṭhetprayatamānasaḥ  |
tāṃstān sarvānavāpnoti puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ  || 246.33 ||
yaścedaṃ satataṃ śṛṇoti manujaḥ svargāpavargapradaṃ  246.34
viṣṇuṃ lokaguruṃ praṇamya varadaṃ bhaktyekacittaḥ śuciḥ  246.34
bhuktvā cātra sukhaṃ vimuktakaluṣaḥ svarge ca divyaṃ sukhaṃ  246.34
paścādyāti hareḥ padaṃ suvimalaṃ mukto guṇaiḥ prākṛtaiḥ  246.34
tasmādvipravaraiḥ svadharmaniratairmuktyekamārgepsubhis 246.35
tadvatkṣatriyapuṃgavaistu niyataiḥ śreyorthibhiḥ sarvadā  246.35
vaiśyaiścānudinaṃ viśuddhakulajaiḥ śūdraistathā dhārmikaiḥ  246.35
śrotavyaṃ tvidamuttamaṃ bahuphalaṃ dharmārthamokṣapradam  246.35
dharme matirbhavatu vaḥ puruṣottamānāṃ  246.36
sa hyeka eva paralokagatasya bandhuḥ  246.36
arthāḥ striyaśca nipuṇairapi sevyamānā  246.36
naiva prabhāvamupayānti na ca sthiratvam  246.36
dharmeṇa rājyaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ  246.37
svargaṃ ca dharmeṇa naraḥ prayāti  246.37
āyuśca kīrtiṃ ca tapaśca dharmaṃ  246.37
dharmeṇa mokṣaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ  246.37
dharmo'tra mātāpitarau narasya  246.38
dharmaḥ sakhā cātra pare ca loke  246.38
trātā ca dharmastviha mokṣadaśca  246.38
dharmādṛte nāsti tu kiṃcideva  246.38
idaṃ rahasyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca purāṇaṃ vedasaṃmitam  |
na deyaṃ duṣṭamataye nāstikāya viśeṣataḥ  || 246.39 ||
idaṃ mayoktaṃ pravaraṃ purāṇaṃ  246.40
pāpāpahaṃ dharmavivardhanaṃ ca  246.40
śrutaṃ bhavadbhiḥ paramaṃ rahasyam  246.40
ājñāpayadhvaṃ munayo vrajāmi  246.40
